entries.definitionEn: Used before a singular noun that starts with a consonant sound, when you mean one of that thing but not a particular one.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة نكرة تسبق اسماً مفرداً يبدأ بصوت ساكن، للدلالة على واحد غير محدد من ذلك الشيء.
entries.example: She bought a book at the station.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a clock time to show that it is in the morning, before midday.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم بعد الساعة لتبيّن أنها في الصباح قبل الظهر.
entries.example: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a person, place, or thing and not return. To stop doing something before it is finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: يترك شخصاً أو مكاناً أو شيئاً من غير عودة، أو يتوقف عن عمل قبل إتمامه.
entries.example: They had to abandon the car on the flooded road.

entries.definitionEn: Left empty or unused, usually because people have gone away and not come back.
entries.arabicMeaning: متروك وخالٍ، غالباً لأن أهله رحلوا ولم يعودوا.
entries.example: We walked past an abandoned factory by the river.

entries.definitionEn: A departure from what is usual, expected, or accepted as normal.
entries.arabicMeaning: انحراف عن المعتاد أو المتوقع أو عمّا يُعدّ طبيعياً.
entries.example: The sudden drop in sales was an aberration, not a lasting trend.

entries.definitionEn: To feel a strong and lasting hatred or disgust for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمقت شيئاً مقتاً شديداً دائماً.
entries.example: She abhors cruelty in any form.

entries.definitionEn: Causing strong hatred or disgust; morally repulsive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقيت؛ كريه أخلاقياً؛ باعث على الاشمئزاز الشديد
entries.example: The committee found the proposal abhorrent and rejected it at once.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes strong hatred or disgust.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يثير المقت الشديد أو الاشمئزاز.
entries.example: The practice was abhorrently unfair to the workers.

entries.definitionEn: The skill or power to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: المهارة أو القدرة على فعل شيء.
entries.example: He has the ability to stay calm under pressure.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme and without hope or dignity, especially of a bad condition. Completely without pride, as in an apology.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ السوء والهوان، لا أمل فيه ولا كرامة؛ أو تامّ في الخضوع كما في الاعتذار.
entries.example: They lived in abject poverty after the harvest failed.

entries.definitionEn: Having the skill, power, or chance to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على فعل شيء بفضل مهارة أو قوة أو فرصة.
entries.example: She was able to finish the report before lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Different from what is usual or expected, often in a way that may be a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخالف للمعتاد أو المتوقع، وغالباً على نحو قد يشكّل مشكلة.
entries.example: The doctor asked about any abnormal pain in the last week.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not usual or expected.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير معتاد أو غير متوقع.
entries.example: The river was abnormally high after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: On or onto a ship, plane, train, or bus.
entries.arabicMeaning: على متن سفينة أو طائرة أو قطار أو حافلة، أو باتجاهها.
entries.example: All passengers were already aboard when the doors closed.

entries.definitionEn: On or onto a particular ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: على متن مركبة معيّنة كسفينة أو طائرة.
entries.example: Several journalists travelled aboard the rescue ship.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the first people to live in a place, especially Australia.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصل بالسكان الأصليين لمكان ما، ولا سيما في أستراليا.
entries.example: The museum has a collection of aboriginal art from the north.

entries.definitionEn: A member of the original people of a country, especially Australia. Many speakers now treat this noun as dated.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرد من السكان الأصليين لبلد ما، ولا سيما أستراليا؛ وكثير من المتكلمين يعدّون هذا اللفظ قديماً اليوم.
entries.example: The old map used the word aborigine for the island's first inhabitants.

entries.definitionEn: To exist in large numbers or amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوجد بكثرة أو بغزارة.
entries.example: Wildflowers abound along the coastal path in spring.

entries.definitionEn: A little more or less than a number or amount; approximately.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً؛ أقل أو أكثر بقليل من رقم أو مقدار.
entries.example: There were about twenty people in the room.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show the subject of something, or what it concerns.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم لتبيّن موضوع الشيء أو ما يتصل به.
entries.example: We talked about our plans for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Mentioned earlier in the same text, or shown higher on the page.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذكور سابقاً في النص نفسه، أو ظاهر في موضع أعلى من الصفحة.
entries.example: Please follow the above instructions before you begin.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a higher place. Also used for a larger amount or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: في مكان أعلى أو إليه؛ وقد تعني أيضاً مقداراً أو مستوى أكبر.
entries.example: The apartment above is quieter at night.

entries.definitionEn: In a higher position than something else; more than a number or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: في موضع أعلى من شيء آخر، أو أكثر من رقم أو مستوى.
entries.example: The clock hangs above the door.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a foreign country.
entries.arabicMeaning: في بلد أجنبي أو إليه.
entries.example: She spent a year abroad after university.

entries.definitionEn: Suddenly and without warning, often in a way that feels sharp or rude.
entries.arabicMeaning: فجأة ومن دون إنذار، وغالباً على نحو حادّ أو فظّ.
entries.example: He stood up abruptly and left the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A time or state of not being present. The fact that something does not exist or is missing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة عدم الحضور أو فترة منه؛ أو انعدام شيء وغيابه.
entries.example: The team played poorly in the captain's absence.

entries.definitionEn: Not in a place where you are expected to be.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير موجود في المكان الذي يُنتظر أن يكون فيه.
entries.example: Three students were absent from class today.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is not present when they should be, for example at work or a vote.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يتغيب عن مكان يُفترض حضوره فيه، كالعمل أو التصويت.
entries.example: The manager called each absentee to check why they had missed the shift.

entries.definitionEn: Complete and total, with no limit or exception. Also used to emphasize a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: تامّ وكامل بلا حدّ ولا استثناء؛ ويُستخدم أيضاً لتوكيد الاسم.
entries.example: I have absolute confidence in her judgment.

entries.definitionEn: A principle or value treated as true in all cases, with no exceptions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبدأ أو قيمة يُعاملان على أنهما صادقان في كل حال بلا استثناء.
entries.example: She does not believe in moral absolutes.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; used to emphasize that something is true, or to agree strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ لتوكيد صحة شيء أو للموافقة القوية.
entries.example: I am absolutely sure we locked the door.

entries.definitionEn: To take in liquid, heat, or information so that it becomes part of something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمتص سائلاً أو حرارة أو معلومات حتى تصير جزءاً منه.
entries.example: The cloth will absorb the spilled water.

entries.definitionEn: Existing as an idea rather than as a physical thing. In art, not trying to show things as they look in real life.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجود كفكرة لا كشيء مادي؛ وفي الفن لا يسعى إلى تصوير الأشياء كما تبدو في الواقع.
entries.example: Justice is an abstract idea, but its effects are real.

entries.definitionEn: An idea formed by taking away details from particular cases. The process of thinking in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكرة تُستخلص بتجريد التفاصيل من حالات معيّنة، أو عملية التفكير على هذا النحو.
entries.example: The theory is useful, but it remains an abstraction until we test it.

entries.definitionEn: Completely unreasonable or silly, in a way that is hard to take seriously.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير معقول أو سخيف تماماً، على نحو يصعب أخذه على محمل الجد.
entries.example: It is absurd to expect the report by tomorrow morning.

entries.definitionEn: In large amounts; more than enough. Also used to mean very clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوفرة تزيد على الحاجة؛ وقد تعني أيضاً بوضوح تام.
entries.example: It was abundantly clear that the plan would not work.

entries.definitionEn: Cruel or violent treatment of a person. Wrong or harmful use of something, such as power or a substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاملة قاسية أو عنيفة لشخص؛ أو استعمال شيء على نحو خاطئ أو ضارّ، كالسلطة أو مادة ما.
entries.example: The report described years of verbal abuse in the workplace.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with education, schools, or study, especially at a college or university.
entries.arabicMeaning: متصل بالتعليم أو الدراسة، ولا سيما في الكلية أو الجامعة.
entries.example: She has a strong academic record in science.

entries.definitionEn: A school or organization that teaches a particular subject or skill. Also a society of people in a field of learning.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرسة أو مؤسسة تعلّم مادة أو مهارة معيّنة؛ وقد تعني أيضاً مجمعاً لأهل علم في مجال ما.
entries.example: He trained at a military academy for four years.

entries.definitionEn: A way of pronouncing a language that shows where a person is from. Also a mark over a letter, or special stress.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة نطق لغة تدل على موطن المتكلم؛ وقد تعني أيضاً علامة فوق حرف أو توكيداً خاصاً.
entries.example: I could hear a slight Scottish accent in her voice.

entries.definitionEn: To take something that is offered. To agree that something is true or cannot be changed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأخذ ما يُعرض عليه؛ أو يسلّم بأن شيئاً صحيح أو لا سبيل إلى تغييره.
entries.example: She accepted the job after a week of thought.

entries.definitionEn: Good enough, or allowed in a particular situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيّد بما يكفي، أو مسموح به في موقف معيّن.
entries.example: Casual clothes are acceptable in this office.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking something that is offered, or of agreeing that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبول ما يُعرض، أو التسليم بأن شيئاً صحيح.
entries.example: His acceptance of the award was brief and sincere.

entries.definitionEn: The right or opportunity to use something or to enter a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحق أو الفرصة في استعمال شيء أو دخول مكان.
entries.example: Students have access to the library until ten.

entries.definitionEn: To find and use information, especially on a computer. To reach or enter a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصل إلى معلومات ويستعملها، ولا سيما على الحاسوب؛ أو يبلغ مكاناً ويدخله.
entries.example: You can access your files from any trusted device.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to reach, enter, or use. Easy to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل البلوغ أو الدخول أو الاستعمال؛ أو سهل الفهم.
entries.example: The museum is accessible by bus from the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: A small extra item that goes with clothes or a machine, such as a bag, belt, or cable.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة إضافية صغيرة ترافق اللباس أو الجهاز، كحقيبة أو حزام أو كابل.
entries.example: She chose a simple dress and one bright accessory.

entries.definitionEn: An event that happens by chance and often causes damage or injury.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدث يقع مصادفة وغالباً يسبب ضرراً أو إصابة.
entries.example: He was late because of an accident on the main road.

entries.definitionEn: Happening by chance, not planned or intended.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدث مصادفة، من غير تخطيط ولا قصد.
entries.example: The discovery was accidental, not the result of a planned search.

entries.definitionEn: By chance, without intending to.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصادفة ومن غير قصد.
entries.example: I accidentally sent the email to the wrong person.

entries.definitionEn: A place to live or stay, such as a room, flat, or hotel.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان للسكن أو الإقامة، كغرفة أو شقة أو فندق.
entries.example: The university helps new students find accommodation.

entries.definitionEn: To go somewhere with someone. To happen or exist at the same time as something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرافق شخصاً إلى مكان؛ أو يحدث أو يوجد في الوقت نفسه مع شيء آخر.
entries.example: A nurse will accompany you to the scanning room.

entries.definitionEn: To succeed in doing or finishing something, especially something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينجح في إنجاز شيء أو إتمامه، ولا سيما إن كان صعباً.
entries.example: We accomplished the move in a single weekend.

entries.definitionEn: As shown or said by a particular person, book, or source.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحسب ما يبيّنه أو يقوله شخص أو كتاب أو مصدر معيّن.
entries.example: According to the forecast, rain will arrive tonight.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is suitable for the situation; as a result of what has been said.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يناسب الموقف؛ أو بناءً على ما قيل.
entries.example: Demand has risen, and we have increased production accordingly.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement with a bank to keep money. Also a description of an event, or a record of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: حساب مصرفي لحفظ المال؛ وقد تعني أيضاً رواية لحدث أو سجلاً للمال.
entries.example: I opened a new bank account last month.

entries.definitionEn: To be the explanation or cause of something. To consider something in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفسّر شيئاً أو يكون سببه؛ أو يعدّ شيئاً على نحو معيّن.
entries.example: Higher costs account for most of the price rise.

entries.definitionEn: The obligation to explain one's actions and accept responsibility for them.
entries.arabicMeaning: واجب تفسير الأفعال وتحمّل مسؤوليتها.
entries.example: Public officials must accept accountability for how funds are spent.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to keep and check financial records.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص عمله مسك السجلات المالية ومراجعتها.
entries.example: Our accountant files the tax return each spring.

entries.definitionEn: To increase gradually over time, especially of money, benefits, or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتراكم تدريجاً مع الوقت، ولا سيما المال أو المنافع أو الفائدة.
entries.example: Interest will accrue on the loan until it is repaid.

entries.definitionEn: To gather more and more of something over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمع المزيد من شيء مع مرور الوقت.
entries.example: Dust had accumulated behind the cupboard.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being correct and without mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفة الصحة والخلوّ من الخطأ.
entries.example: Check the figures for accuracy before you send them.

entries.definitionEn: Correct and true in every detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيح مطابق للتفاصيل كلها.
entries.example: The map is accurate down to the smallest street.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is correct and without mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو صحيح خالٍ من الخطأ.
entries.example: She accurately predicted the election result.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
entries.arabicMeaning: قول يتهم شخصاً بفعل خاطئ أو مخالف للقانون.
entries.example: He denied the accusation in a short public statement.

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسب إلى شخص فعلاً خاطئاً أو مخالفاً للقانون.
entries.example: They accuse the driver of ignoring the stop sign.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or yourself used to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل شخصاً أو نفسه يعتاد شيئاً.
entries.example: It took weeks to accustom the dog to city noise.

entries.definitionEn: Familiar with something because you have experienced it often; used to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مألوف لديه شيء لأنه تكرر عليه؛ معتاد عليه.
entries.example: She is accustomed to working late during the busy season.

entries.definitionEn: A continuous dull pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم مستمر خفيف.
entries.example: I woke with an ache in my lower back.

entries.definitionEn: To feel a continuous dull pain. Also to want something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشعر بألم مستمر خفيف؛ وقد يعني أيضاً يشتاق إلى شيء اشتياقاً شديداً.
entries.example: My legs ached after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: Possible to do or reach with effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممكن إنجازه أو بلوغه بالجهد.
entries.example: Set goals that are ambitious but still achievable.

entries.definitionEn: To succeed in doing something, especially after effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينجح في فعل شيء، ولا سيما بعد جهد.
entries.example: She achieved her target of reading twenty books.

entries.definitionEn: Something good that you have succeeded in doing, especially after effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر حسن نجحت في إنجازه، ولا سيما بعد جهد.
entries.example: Finishing the course was a real achievement for him.

entries.definitionEn: A chemical substance with a sour taste that can burn or dissolve other materials.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة كيميائية حامضة المذاق قد تحرق مواد أخرى أو تذيبها.
entries.example: The lab stores acid in a locked cabinet.

entries.definitionEn: Containing acid, or having the sharp sour quality of acid.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتوي حمضاً، أو يتّسم بطعم الحمض اللاذع.
entries.example: The soil was too acidic for those plants to thrive.

entries.definitionEn: To accept that something is true. To show that you have noticed or received something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّم بأن شيئاً صحيح؛ أو يُظهر أنه لاحظ شيئاً أو تلقّاه.
entries.example: She refused to acknowledge the mistake at first.

entries.definitionEn: The act of accepting that something is true, or of showing that you have received something.
entries.arabicMeaning: التسليم بصحة شيء، أو إظهار أنك تلقّيته.
entries.example: Please send an acknowledgement when the parcel arrives.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to sound or hearing. Of a musical instrument, not electric.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالصوت أو السمع؛ وللآلة الموسيقية: غير كهربائية.
entries.example: They recorded the song with acoustic guitars only.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to sound quality or how sound travels in a space.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يتصل بجودة الصوت أو بانتقال الصوت في المكان.
entries.example: The hall was acoustically poor, and speech was hard to follow.

entries.definitionEn: The qualities of a room or space that affect how sound is heard. Also the scientific study of sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصائص مكان تؤثر في كيفية سماع الصوت؛ وقد تعني أيضاً علم الصوت.
entries.example: The acoustics in the new theatre are excellent.

entries.definitionEn: A person you know a little, but who is not a close friend.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص تعرفه معرفة يسيرة وليس صديقاً مقرباً.
entries.example: I met an old acquaintance on the train.

entries.definitionEn: To get or gain something, often by your own effort or over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصل على شيء أو يكتسبه، وغالباً بجهد أو مع الوقت.
entries.example: She acquired fluent Spanish during her years in Madrid.

entries.definitionEn: The act of getting something. Something obtained, especially a company, object, or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل الحصول على شيء؛ أو الشيء المكتسَب، ولا سيما شركة أو غرض أو مهارة.
entries.example: Language acquisition is faster when you use the language every day.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of land area equal to 4,840 square yards, about 4,047 square metres.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحدة مساحة للأرض تعادل 4840 ياردة مربعة، أي نحو 4047 متراً مربعاً.
entries.example: The farm covers forty acres of pasture.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land measured in acres; the amount of land someone owns or uses.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساحة أرض تُقاس بالأفدنة؛ أو مقدار الأرض التي يملكها شخص أو يستعملها.
entries.example: The estate's acreage includes woodland as well as fields.

entries.definitionEn: Involving or showing skilled, controlled movements of the body, as in circus or gymnastic performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينطوي على حركات جسدية ماهرة منضبطة أو يُظهرها، كما في السيرك أو الجمباز.
entries.example: The dancers ended with an acrobatic lift.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows skilled, controlled bodily movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُظهر مهارة منضبطة في حركة الجسد.
entries.example: The cat jumped acrobatically from the wall to the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Skilled movements of the body, such as jumps and balances, often as a performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركات جسدية ماهرة كالقفز والتوازن، وغالباً في عرض.
entries.example: The circus act mixed comedy with serious acrobatics.

entries.definitionEn: From one side to the other. On the other side.
entries.arabicMeaning: من جانب إلى الجانب الآخر؛ أو في الجانب المقابل.
entries.example: She walked across and sat by the window.

entries.definitionEn: From one side of something to the other. On the other side of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: من أحد جانبي شيء إلى الجانب الآخر؛ أو في الجانب المقابل لشيء.
entries.example: There is a bakery across the street.

entries.definitionEn: Something that a person does. Also a law, or one part of a play.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء يفعله شخص؛ وقد تعني أيضاً قانوناً أو فصلاً من مسرحية.
entries.example: Helping the lost child was a kind act.

entries.definitionEn: To do something in order to deal with a situation. To perform in a play or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفعل شيئاً لمعالجة موقف؛ أو يؤدي دوراً في مسرحية أو فيلم.
entries.example: We must act quickly before the storm arrives.

entries.definitionEn: The process of doing something, often to deal with a problem. Something that is done.
entries.arabicMeaning: القيام بشيء، وغالباً لمعالجة مشكلة؛ أو الشيء الذي يُفعل.
entries.example: We need action, not more talk.

entries.definitionEn: Always doing things; busy and moving. Taking part in something.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير النشاط والحركة؛ مشارك في أمر.
entries.example: She leads an active life and walks every morning.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves doing things and taking part, not just waiting.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ينطوي على الفعل والمشاركة لا على الانتظار فحسب.
entries.example: He is actively looking for a new job.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you do for interest, work, or pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء تفعله اهتماماً أو عملاً أو متعة.
entries.example: Swimming is her favourite activity.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to perform in plays, films, or on television.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص عمله التمثيل في المسرح أو السينما أو التلفزيون.
entries.example: The actor learned his lines on the train.

entries.definitionEn: A woman whose job is to perform in plays, films, or on television.
entries.arabicMeaning: امرأة عملها التمثيل في المسرح أو السينما أو التلفزيون.
entries.example: The actress signed copies of the film poster.

entries.definitionEn: Real, not imagined, guessed, or only claimed.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقي، لا متخيَّل ولا مظنون ولا مدَّعى فحسب.
entries.example: The actual cost was higher than the first estimate.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say what is really true, often when it is surprising or different from what people think.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم لذكر ما هو صحيح حقاً، وغالباً حين يفاجئ أو يخالف الظن.
entries.example: I thought it was Tuesday, but actually it is Wednesday.

entries.definitionEn: Very serious or severe. Also very sharp or sensitive, as of pain, an angle, or a mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الجدّة أو الشدة؛ وقد يعني أيضاً حاداً أو مرهفاً، كالألم أو الزاوية أو الذهن.
entries.example: There is an acute shortage of nurses in the region.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is keenly felt or clearly understood; to a severe degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُحسّ بحدّة أو يُفهم بوضوح؛ أو إلى درجة شديدة.
entries.example: She was acutely aware of every sound in the house.

entries.definitionEn: Spoken or performed without a prepared script; improvised.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُقال أو يُؤدّى من غير نصّ معدّ؛ مرتجَل.
entries.example: His ad lib remarks got a bigger laugh than the written jokes.

entries.definitionEn: To speak or perform without a prepared script.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكلم أو يؤدي من غير نصّ معدّ.
entries.example: When the autocue failed, she had to ad-lib the last paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: A short notice that tries to sell something or tell people about an event; short for advertisement.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان موجز يسعى إلى بيع شيء أو الإخبار عن حدث؛ اختصار لكلمة advertisement.
entries.example: I saw an ad for a second-hand bicycle.

entries.definitionEn: To change something so that it is suitable for a new use or situation. To change your behaviour to fit a new situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغيّر شيئاً ليناسب استعمالاً أو ظرفاً جديداً؛ أو يغيّر سلوكه ليتلاءم مع وضع جديد.
entries.example: It took time to adapt to the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Able to change easily in order to suit a new situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على التغيّر بيسر ليناسب وضعاً جديداً.
entries.example: An adaptable team can handle sudden changes in the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To put something with another thing so that you have more. To put numbers together to find a total.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً مع شيء آخر حتى يزيد؛ أو يجمع أرقاماً ليحصل على المجموع.
entries.example: Please add some salt to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: A person who cannot stop taking a harmful drug. Also a person who likes something so much they cannot stop doing it.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص لا يستطيع التوقف عن تعاطي مخدّر ضارّ؛ وقد يعني أيضاً شخصاً مولعاً بشيء لا يكاد يقلع عنه.
entries.example: He is a coffee addict and drinks five cups a day.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to stop taking a drug or doing something, even when it causes harm or takes too much time.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاجز عن التوقف عن تعاطي مخدّر أو عن فعل شيء، حتى إن أضرّ أو استغرق وقتاً مفرطاً.
entries.example: She became addicted to a mobile game last winter.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being unable to stop taking a drug or doing something, even when it is harmful.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة العجز عن التوقف عن تعاطي مخدّر أو عن فعل شيء، حتى إن كان ضاراً.
entries.example: Treatment for addiction often includes counselling.

entries.definitionEn: The process of adding numbers. Something extra that is put with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية جمع الأرقام؛ أو شيء إضافي يُضمّ إلى شيء آخر.
entries.example: The glass roof was a later addition to the house.

entries.definitionEn: Extra; more than what is usual or already there.
entries.arabicMeaning: إضافي؛ زائد على المعتاد أو على ما هو موجود.
entries.example: There will be an additional charge for late payment.

entries.definitionEn: Used to add another fact or point; also.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم لإضافة حقيقة أو نقطة أخرى؛ كذلك.
entries.example: The room is large; additionally, it has excellent light.

entries.definitionEn: Produced by adding things together, so that the total is the sum of the parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشئ عن جمع الأشياء معاً، فيكون المجموع حاصل الأجزاء.
entries.example: The two drugs have an additive effect on blood pressure.

entries.definitionEn: A substance added to food or another product to improve it or preserve it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة تُضاف إلى طعام أو منتج آخر لتحسينه أو حفظه.
entries.example: This juice contains no artificial additives.

entries.definitionEn: The details of where a building is, used for finding it or sending mail.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيانات مكان مبنى تُستخدم للوصول إليه أو لإرسال البريد.
entries.example: Please write your address on the form.

entries.definitionEn: To speak to a person or group, often formally. To deal with a problem. To write a name and address on a letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخاطب شخصاً أو جماعة، وغالباً بأسلوب رسمي؛ أو يعالج مشكلة؛ أو يكتب الاسم والعنوان على رسالة.
entries.example: The mayor will address the staff at nine.

entries.definitionEn: The person to whom a letter, parcel, or message is sent.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشخص المرسَل إليه خطاب أو طرد أو رسالة.
entries.example: If the addressee has moved, return the letter to the sender.

entries.definitionEn: Highly skilled at something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماهر جداً في شيء.
entries.example: She is adept at turning complex data into a clear story.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is highly skilled at a particular activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص شديد المهارة في نشاط معيّن.
entries.example: He is an adept at classical guitar.

entries.definitionEn: Enough in quantity or quality for a particular purpose; acceptable but not excellent.
entries.arabicMeaning: كافٍ كماً أو كيفاً لغرض معيّن؛ مقبول دون أن يكون ممتازاً.
entries.example: The heating is adequate, but the house is never really warm.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is enough for the purpose, though not more than that.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يكفي الغرض، من غير زيادة عليه.
entries.example: The instructions were not adequately explained.

entries.definitionEn: To stick firmly to a surface. To follow a rule, belief, or agreement closely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتصق بسطح بقوة؛ أو يلتزم قاعدة أو معتقداً أو اتفاقاً التزاماً دقيقاً.
entries.example: Staff must adhere to the safety rules at all times.

entries.definitionEn: The action or ability of one thing sticking firmly to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل التصاق شيء بشيء آخر بقوة، أو القدرة على ذلك.
entries.example: The adhesion of the tape failed in the heat.

entries.definitionEn: A word that describes a noun, such as size, colour, or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة تصف اسماً، كالحجم أو اللون أو الصفة.
entries.example: In a cold morning, the word cold is an adjective.

entries.definitionEn: To be next to and joined with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكون ملاصقاً لشيء ومتصلاً به.
entries.example: The kitchen adjoins the dining room.

entries.definitionEn: Next to and connected with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاور لشيء ومتصل به.
entries.example: We booked two adjoining rooms for the family.

entries.definitionEn: To change something slightly so that it is better or more suitable. To get used to a new situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغيّر شيئاً تغييراً طفيفاً ليصير أفضل أو أنسب؛ أو يعتاد وضعاً جديداً.
entries.example: You can adjust the chair height with this lever.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be changed slightly to a different position, size, or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمكن تغييره تغييراً طفيفاً إلى موضع أو حجم أو مستوى آخر.
entries.example: The lamp has an adjustable neck for reading.

entries.definitionEn: A small change made to improve something or make it fit. The process of getting used to a new situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغيير صغير يُجرى لتحسين شيء أو لملاءمته؛ أو عملية الاعتياد على وضع جديد.
entries.example: I made a small adjustment to the camera settings.

entries.definitionEn: The work of managing a business, organization, or government. The group of people who do this work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل إدارة شركة أو مؤسسة أو حكومة؛ أو جماعة القائمين بهذا العمل.
entries.example: She works in hospital administration.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the management of a business, organization, or government.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بإدارة شركة أو مؤسسة أو حكومة.
entries.example: The job involves a lot of administrative work.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving respect and praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بالاحترام والثناء.
entries.example: Her patience with the new staff was admirable.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of respect and approval for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور بالاحترام والاستحسان تجاه شخص أو شيء.
entries.example: I have great admiration for her honesty.

entries.definitionEn: To like and respect someone or something because of their qualities.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحب شخصاً أو شيئاً ويحترمه لما فيه من صفات.
entries.example: I admire people who keep their promises.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows respect and approval.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُظهر الاحترام والاستحسان.
entries.example: He looked admiringly at the finished painting.

entries.definitionEn: Permission to enter a place, or the price of entering. Also a statement that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإذن بدخول مكان أو ثمن الدخول؛ وقد تعني أيضاً إقراراً بصحة شيء.
entries.example: Admission to the museum is free on Mondays.

entries.definitionEn: To agree that something is true, especially something you would rather not say. To allow someone to enter.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّم بأن شيئاً صحيح، ولا سيما مما يكره قوله؛ أو يسمح لشخص بالدخول.
entries.example: He admitted that he had forgotten the keys.

entries.definitionEn: Used when you accept that something is true, often before you add a contrasting point.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم حين تسلّم بصحة شيء، وغالباً قبل أن تضيف أمراً يخالفه.
entries.example: Admittedly the room is small, but the location is perfect.

entries.definitionEn: To take another person's child into your family and raise them legally as your own. To start to use a new method or attitude.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضمّ طفل شخص آخر إلى أسرته ويربّيه قانوناً كولده؛ أو يبدأ استعمال طريقة أو موقف جديد.
entries.example: They hope to adopt a child next year.

entries.definitionEn: Taken into a family by legal adoption. Also used of a country or method that someone has chosen as their own.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضموم إلى أسرة بالتبني القانوني؛ وقد يُقال أيضاً لبلد أو طريقة اختارها الشخص لنفسه.
entries.example: She keeps in touch with her adopted family in Canada.

entries.definitionEn: The legal process of taking a child into your family. The act of starting to use a new idea or method.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإجراء القانوني لضمّ طفل إلى الأسرة؛ أو الشروع في استعمال فكرة أو طريقة جديدة.
entries.example: The adoption of the new software took six months.

entries.definitionEn: Very attractive and easy to love, often used of a child or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذاب جداً وسهل أن يُحبّ، وغالباً يُقال لطفل أو حيوان.
entries.example: Their puppy is adorable when it sleeps.

entries.definitionEn: To love someone or something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحب شخصاً أو شيئاً حباً شديداً.
entries.example: She adores early mornings by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: Something used to decorate a person or thing; the act of decorating.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء يُستخدم لتزيين شخص أو شيء؛ أو فعل التزيين.
entries.example: The necklace was her only adornment.

entries.definitionEn: A substance produced by the body in fear or excitement, which makes the heart beat faster and gives a burst of energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة يفرزها الجسم عند الخوف أو الإثارة، تسرّع نبض القلب وتمنح دفعة من الطاقة.
entries.example: His adrenaline surged as he stepped onto the stage.

entries.definitionEn: Fully grown; of or for a grown person, not a child.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتمل النمو؛ خاص بالبالغين لا بالأطفال.
entries.example: This film is for an adult audience.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is fully grown; not a child.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص مكتمل النمو؛ ليس طفلاً.
entries.example: Two adults and one child booked the tickets.

entries.definitionEn: To make a substance less pure or of lower quality by adding something else, often cheaper.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل مادة أقل نقاء أو أدنى جودة بإضافة شيء إليها، وغالباً أرخص.
entries.example: It is illegal to adulterate olive oil with cheaper oils.

entries.definitionEn: Progress or an improvement. Money paid before the usual time. Movement forward.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدّم أو تحسّن؛ أو مال يُدفع قبل موعده المعتاد؛ أو حركة إلى الأمام.
entries.example: The research is an important advance in cancer treatment.

entries.definitionEn: To move forward. To make progress. To pay money earlier than usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقدم إلى الأمام؛ أو يحرز تقدماً؛ أو يدفع مالاً قبل الموعد المعتاد.
entries.example: Technology continues to advance each year.

entries.definitionEn: At a high level; more developed than usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: في مستوى عالٍ؛ أكثر تطوراً من المعتاد.
entries.example: She is taking an advanced English class.

entries.definitionEn: Progress in a career, knowledge, or technology. The process of moving forward.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدّم في مهنة أو معرفة أو تقنية؛ أو عملية المضيّ قدماً.
entries.example: He left the firm because there was little chance of advancement.

entries.definitionEn: Something that helps you to be more successful than other people or other options.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء يعينك على النجاح أكثر من غيرك أو من الخيارات الأخرى.
entries.example: Speaking two languages is a real advantage at work.

entries.definitionEn: The arrival of an important event, invention, or period.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدوم حدث أو اختراع أو عهد مهم.
entries.example: The advent of cheap air travel changed holiday habits.

entries.definitionEn: An unusual, exciting, or slightly dangerous experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجربة غير معتادة ومثيرة، وقد تنطوي على شيء من الخطر.
entries.example: Their trip through the mountains was a great adventure.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to try new, exciting, or slightly risky things.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعد لتجربة أمور جديدة مثيرة أو تنطوي على شيء من المخاطرة.
entries.example: He is more adventurous with food than I am.

entries.definitionEn: A word that adds information about a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, such as how, when, or where.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة تضيف معلومة عن فعل أو صفة أو حال أخرى أو عن الجملة كلها، كالكيفية أو الزمان أو المكان.
entries.example: In she spoke quietly, the word quietly is an adverb.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to an adverb, or doing the same job as an adverb in a sentence.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالحال، أو يقوم في الجملة بعمل الحال نفسه.
entries.example: In the morning is an adverbial phrase of time.

entries.definitionEn: A person or group that you compete or fight against.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو جماعة تنافسها أو تقاتلها.
entries.example: She treated her old adversary with unexpected courtesy.

entries.definitionEn: A difficult or unpleasant situation, especially over a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: وضع صعب أو كريه، ولا سيما إن امتد زمناً.
entries.example: The family stayed close through years of adversity.

entries.definitionEn: A notice that tries to sell something or tell people about an event; mainly British, short for advertisement.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان يسعى إلى بيع شيء أو الإخبار عن حدث؛ لفظ بريطاني غالباً، اختصار لـ advertisement.
entries.example: There was an advert for the concert on the radio.

entries.definitionEn: To tell people about a product, job, or event in order to encourage them to buy, apply, or come.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبر الناس عن منتج أو وظيفة أو حدث ليحضّهم على الشراء أو التقديم أو الحضور.
entries.example: They advertise the course in local newspapers.

entries.definitionEn: A notice, film, or picture that tries to sell something or tell people about an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان أو فيلم أو صورة تسعى إلى بيع شيء أو الإخبار عن حدث.
entries.example: I answered an advertisement for a part-time job.

entries.definitionEn: The business or activity of telling people about products or events in order to sell them or attract them.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط إخبار الناس عن منتجات أو أحداث لبيعها أو جذبهم إليها، أو مهنة ذلك.
entries.example: She works in advertising for a food company.

entries.definitionEn: An opinion that someone gives you about what you should do.
entries.arabicMeaning: رأي يقدّمه إليك شخص فيما ينبغي أن تفعل.
entries.example: My teacher gave me good advice about the exam.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone what you think they should do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبر شخصاً بما يرى أنه ينبغي أن يفعله.
entries.example: I advise you to book the tickets early.

entries.definitionEn: A person who gives official or professional advice.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يقدّم مشورة رسمية أو مهنية.
entries.example: Talk to a financial adviser before you invest.

entries.definitionEn: Having the role of giving advice, not of making the final decision. Also used of an official warning.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو دور استشاري لا قرار نهائي؛ وقد يُقال أيضاً لتحذير رسمي.
entries.example: She sits on an advisory committee for the school.

entries.definitionEn: Physical exercise that raises the heart rate, often done in a class to music.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمرين بدني يرفع معدل ضربات القلب، وغالباً في حصة مع الموسيقى.
entries.example: She goes to aerobics on Tuesday evenings.

entries.definitionEn: Concerned with beauty and with how something looks or feels as art or design.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالجمال وبمظهر الشيء أو وقعه فناً أو تصميماً.
entries.example: The building's aesthetic appeal comes from its simple lines.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to beauty or artistic appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يتصل بالجمال أو بالمظهر الفني.
entries.example: The chairs are aesthetically pleasing but rather hard.

entries.definitionEn: An event or a matter that people are involved in.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدث أو شأن ينشغل به الناس.
entries.example: The wedding was a quiet family affair.

entries.definitionEn: To have an influence on someone or something; to cause a change.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤثر في شخص أو شيء؛ يُحدث تغييراً.
entries.example: The late train will affect everyone on this platform.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that is not natural, used to impress other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلوك غير طبيعي يُقصد به إبهار الآخرين.
entries.example: His English accent was an affectation he dropped at home.

entries.definitionEn: A gentle feeling of liking or love.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور لطيف بالميل أو الحب.
entries.example: She showed her affection with small, regular kindnesses.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you like or love someone in a gentle, warm way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُظهر ميلاً أو حباً على نحو لطيف دافئ.
entries.example: He is an affectionate father and writes to his children often.

entries.definitionEn: In a gentle, loving way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لطيف مفعم بالمحبة.
entries.example: She smiled affectionately at her old teacher.

entries.definitionEn: To have enough money or time to do or buy something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملك من المال أو الوقت ما يكفي لفعل شيء أو شرائه.
entries.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.

entries.definitionEn: Cheap enough that people can pay for it without great difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخيص بما يكفي ليدفع الناس ثمنه من غير مشقة كبيرة.
entries.example: The city needs more affordable housing near the centre.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling fear. Also used to say you are sorry about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشعر بالخوف؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً للاعتذار عن أمر.
entries.example: The little boy is afraid of the dark.

entries.definitionEn: Later than something; afterwards.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق لشيء؛ بعد ذلك.
entries.example: We had coffee and left soon after.

entries.definitionEn: At a later time than the event in the following clause.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق للحدث المذكور في الجملة التابعة.
entries.example: I called her after I arrived at the station.

entries.definitionEn: Later than a time or event; following in place or order.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق لزمان أو حدث؛ أو تالٍ في المكان أو الترتيب.
entries.example: We can talk after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the day between midday and evening.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء اليوم بين الظهر والمساء.
entries.example: I have a meeting this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: At a later time; mainly used in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق؛ شائعة في الإنجليزية الأمريكية.
entries.example: We ate, and afterward we walked along the river.

entries.definitionEn: At a later time; common in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق؛ شائعة في الإنجليزية البريطانية.
entries.example: We visited the museum and went for tea afterwards.

entries.definitionEn: One more time; once more. Also used when something returns to a former state.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرة أخرى؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً حين يعود شيء إلى حال سابقة.
entries.example: Could you say that again, please?

entries.definitionEn: In opposition to a person or idea. Also touching something, or compared with it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضد شخص أو فكرة؛ وقد تعني أيضاً ملامساً لشيء أو مقارَناً به.
entries.example: Many people spoke against the new parking rules.

entries.definitionEn: How many years a person has lived, or how old something is.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدد السنوات التي عاشها شخص، أو عمر شيء.
entries.example: She started school at the age of five.

entries.definitionEn: Of a particular age. Also used, often formally, to mean very old.
entries.arabicMeaning: في عمر معيّن؛ ويُستخدم أيضاً، وغالباً بأسلوب رسمي، بمعنى طاعن في السن.
entries.example: The course is for children aged six to ten.

entries.definitionEn: Not appearing to grow old; not limited to a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يبدو عليه التقادم؛ أو غير مقيَّد بزمن معيّن.
entries.example: The song has an ageless quality that still moves listeners.

entries.definitionEn: A list of things to be discussed or done at a meeting. Also the aims a person or group wants to achieve.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائمة أمور تُناقش أو تُنجز في اجتماع؛ وقد تعني أيضاً أهداف شخص أو جماعة يريدون تحقيقها.
entries.example: The first item on the agenda is the budget.

entries.definitionEn: A person who arranges work or business for someone else. Also a person who represents a government or company.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يدبّر عملاً أو شأناً لحساب غيره؛ وقد يعني أيضاً ممثلاً لحكومة أو شركة.
entries.example: She called her travel agent to change the flight.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to attack or argue. Also determined and forceful in trying to succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعد للهجوم أو الجدال؛ وقد يعني أيضاً حازماً قوياً في السعي إلى النجاح.
entries.example: The dog became aggressive when strangers came near.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is ready to attack, or that is very forceful.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ينمّ عن استعداد للهجوم، أو على نحو شديد القوة.
entries.example: He drove aggressively and overtook without signalling.

entries.definitionEn: Filled with shock and horror.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملوء بالصدمة والهلع.
entries.example: We stood aghast at the damage after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: Able to move quickly and easily. Also able to think quickly and adapt.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على الحركة بسرعة ويسر؛ وقد يعني أيضاً سريع التفكير والتكيّف.
entries.example: The climber was agile enough to cross the narrow ledge.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to move or think quickly and easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة على الحركة أو التفكير بسرعة ويسر.
entries.example: The job rewards mental agility as much as technical skill.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a time word to say how far back something happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: منذ؛ قبل مدة من الزمن
entries.example: She moved here two years ago.

entries.definitionEn: To worry for a long time about a difficult choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلق طويلاً وهو يتردد في قرار صعب
entries.example: He agonized over which job to accept.

entries.definitionEn: To suffer intense mental strain while weighing a decision or problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكابد قلقاً شديداً وهو يقلّب أمراً عسيراً
entries.example: She agonized for weeks before telling her family.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme physical or mental pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم شديد أو عذاب
entries.example: He was in agony after twisting his knee.

entries.definitionEn: To have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to a plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوافق أو يتفق في الرأي
entries.example: I agree with you about the new schedule.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant and easy to like; also willing to accept a suggestion.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف ومقبول؛ مستعد للموافقة
entries.example: The terms were agreeable to both sides.

entries.definitionEn: A shared decision, or the state of having the same opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتفاق أو موافقة
entries.example: They signed an agreement last week.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with farming and with growing crops or raising animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: زراعي؛ متعلق بالزراعة
entries.example: The region depends on agricultural work.

entries.definitionEn: The work of growing food and raising animals on the land.
entries.arabicMeaning: الزراعة
entries.example: Agriculture is important in this valley.

entries.definitionEn: In front; further on in space or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأمام؛ في المقدمة أو المستقبل
entries.example: The station is two kilometres ahead.

entries.definitionEn: Help or support, often money, food, or equipment given to people in need.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساعدة أو معونة
entries.example: The village received medical aid after the flood.

entries.definitionEn: To help someone or make a process easier.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساعد أو يُعين
entries.example: The map aided us in finding the trail.

entries.definitionEn: A result that you want to achieve.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدف أو غاية
entries.example: Her main aim is to finish the course this year.

entries.definitionEn: To point or direct something at a target; also to intend to achieve something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوّب نحو هدف؛ يسعى إلى تحقيق شيء
entries.example: The company aims to reduce waste this year.

entries.definitionEn: Without a clear purpose or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا هدف أو غاية واضحة
entries.example: He spent an aimless afternoon walking through the city.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that has no clear purpose or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا هدف؛ على نحو عشوائي
entries.example: She wandered aimlessly around the museum.

entries.definitionEn: A system that cools and dries the air inside a building or vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكييف الهواء
entries.example: The air conditioning was too cold in the office.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a country's military that uses aircraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلاح الجو
entries.example: Her brother joined the air force after university.

entries.definitionEn: The mixture of gases around us that we breathe.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهواء
entries.example: Open the window and let in some air.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle that can fly, such as a plane or helicopter.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائرة؛ مركبة جوية
entries.example: The aircraft landed ten minutes early.

entries.definitionEn: The people who operate an aircraft during a flight.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاقم الطائرة
entries.example: The aircrew checked the cabin before take-off.

entries.definitionEn: A company that carries people or goods by plane.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة طيران
entries.example: Which airline are you flying with?

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle with wings that flies through the air.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائرة
entries.example: The airplane left the airport at noon.

entries.definitionEn: A place where planes take off and land, and where passengers start or end a trip.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطار
entries.example: We waited at the airport for three hours.

entries.definitionEn: A long narrow space between rows of seats or shelves.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممر بين صفوف المقاعد أو الرفوف
entries.example: Please keep your bags out of the aisle.

entries.definitionEn: A clock that makes a sound to wake you at a chosen time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة منبّه
entries.example: I set my alarm clock for six.

entries.definitionEn: A loud warning sound, or a sudden feeling of fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنذار أو شعور بالفزع
entries.example: The fire alarm woke everyone in the building.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel worried or frightened.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُقلق أو يُفزع
entries.example: The sudden noise alarmed the children.

entries.definitionEn: A set of songs released together, or a book for keeping photos.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألبوم أغاني أو صور
entries.example: She bought a new music album last week.

entries.definitionEn: Drinks such as beer, wine, or spirits that can make you drunk; also the chemical in those drinks.
entries.arabicMeaning: كحول؛ مشروبات كحولية
entries.example: He decided to drink less alcohol this month.

entries.definitionEn: Containing alcohol, or relating to alcohol.
entries.arabicMeaning: كحولي؛ يحتوي على كحول
entries.example: This sauce is not alcoholic.

entries.definitionEn: A person who cannot control their drinking of alcohol.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمن كحول
entries.example: The clinic helps alcoholics recover.

entries.definitionEn: A medical condition in which a person cannot stop drinking alcohol in a harmful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدمان الكحول
entries.example: He sought treatment for alcoholism.

entries.definitionEn: To warn someone so they can pay attention or take action.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينبّه أو يحذّر
entries.example: Staff alerted the manager to the leak.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel unwelcome or cut off from a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفّر شخصاً أو يبعده عن جماعة
entries.example: His harsh comments alienated several colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: To place things in a straight line, or to bring ideas or interests into agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفّ على خط واحد؛ يوفّق بين المواقف
entries.example: The designer aligned the text with the left margin.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being arranged in a line, or of agreeing in purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: اصطفاف أو توافق
entries.example: The wheels were out of alignment after the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Similar in appearance or character. Usually used after a verb, not before a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشابهان أو متماثلان
entries.example: The two sisters look very alike.

entries.definitionEn: In the same way; equally.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو متماثل؛ بالتساوي
entries.example: The new rule applies to staff and visitors alike.

entries.definitionEn: Living; not dead.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيّ؛ على قيد الحياة
entries.example: The plant is still alive after the frost.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; used to make another word stronger.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ بالكامل
entries.example: The clothes were all wet after the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean the whole amount or every one of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: كل؛ جميع
entries.example: All the windows were closed.

entries.definitionEn: Including every part or aspect of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل لكل الجوانب
entries.example: She offered an all-encompassing account of the project.

entries.definitionEn: The whole number or amount of people or things already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكل؛ الجميع
entries.example: I invited ten people, and all came.

entries.definitionEn: Satisfactory; not ill or in trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخير؛ مقبول
entries.example: Are you all right after the long trip?

entries.definitionEn: In a satisfactory way; used to say yes or that something is acceptable.
entries.arabicMeaning: على ما يرام؛ حسناً
entries.example: The meeting went all right.

entries.definitionEn: To say that something is true without yet proving it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعم أو يدّعي دون إثبات قاطع
entries.example: The report alleged that the funds were wasted.

entries.definitionEn: Using characters or events as symbols of a deeper moral or political meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمزي؛ على سبيل المجاز
entries.example: The novel is an allegorical tale about power.

entries.definitionEn: A story or image whose characters and events stand for a deeper idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصة رمزية أو مجاز
entries.example: The play is an allegory of greed.

entries.definitionEn: Becoming ill because of a substance such as pollen, food, or dust.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب بحساسية تجاه شيء
entries.example: She is allergic to peanuts.

entries.definitionEn: To make pain, trouble, or a problem less severe.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفّف أو يهوّن
entries.example: The medicine helped alleviate her headache.

entries.definitionEn: An agreement between people, groups, or countries to work together.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحالف
entries.example: The two companies formed an alliance.

entries.definitionEn: To give a share of time, money, or resources to someone for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخصّص نصيباً أو حصة
entries.example: The board allotted two hours to the discussion.

entries.definitionEn: An amount given as a share; in British English, also a small plot of land for growing plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصة مخصّصة؛ وفي بريطانيا قطعة أرض صغيرة للزراعة
entries.example: Each team received an allotment of travel funds.

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone may do something, or to make it possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمح أو يتيح
entries.example: The museum does not allow photos inside.

entries.definitionEn: Money given regularly for a purpose, or an amount of something you are permitted.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخصص مالي أو بدل؛ مقدار مسموح به
entries.example: She saves part of her monthly allowance.

entries.definitionEn: To mention something in an indirect way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلمّح إلى شيء دون التصريح به
entries.example: He alluded to the earlier dispute without naming anyone.

entries.definitionEn: An indirect mention of a person, story, or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميح أو إشارة غير مباشرة
entries.example: The speech contained an allusion to a famous poem.

entries.definitionEn: A person or group that supports another, especially when there is difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: حليف
entries.example: She found a strong ally in her manager.

entries.definitionEn: To join with someone for a shared purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحالف أو ينضم إلى طرف
entries.example: The smaller firms allied with a larger partner.

entries.definitionEn: Very nearly, but not completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً؛ يكاد
entries.example: It is almost time to leave.

entries.definitionEn: Without other people. Used after a verb, not before a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحيد؛ بمفرده
entries.example: He felt alone in the empty house.

entries.definitionEn: Without other people present.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمفرده؛ وحده
entries.example: She lives alone near the park.

entries.definitionEn: Forward; with you, or in company.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأمام؛ معك
entries.example: Bring a friend along if you like.

entries.definitionEn: From one end of a line, road, or path toward the other.
entries.arabicMeaning: على طول
entries.example: We walked along the river.

entries.definitionEn: Next to; together with.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى جانب؛ مع
entries.example: The new shops opened alongside the station.

entries.definitionEn: In a voice that other people can hear.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصوت مسموع
entries.example: Please read the paragraph aloud.

entries.definitionEn: The set of letters used to write a language, in a fixed order.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبجدية؛ حروف الهجاء
entries.example: Children learn the alphabet in the first year.

entries.definitionEn: Arranged in the order of the letters of the alphabet.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبجدي؛ مرتّب حسب الحروف
entries.example: Names are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.definitionEn: Before now, or sooner than expected.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالفعل؛ من قبل
entries.example: I have already finished my homework.

entries.definitionEn: Informal spelling of all right: satisfactory or not in trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخير؛ مقبول (صيغة غير رسمية)
entries.example: Are you alright after that fall?

entries.definitionEn: Informal spelling of all right: in a satisfactory way, or used to agree.
entries.arabicMeaning: على ما يرام؛ حسناً (صيغة غير رسمية)
entries.example: The bus arrived alright, but it was late.

entries.definitionEn: In addition; too.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيضاً
entries.example: She speaks French and also a little Spanish.

entries.definitionEn: A table or raised place used in religious ceremonies.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذبح
entries.example: Flowers were placed on the altar.

entries.definitionEn: To change something, usually in a small or partial way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغيّر أو يعدّل
entries.example: They had to alter the plan after the delay.

entries.definitionEn: To happen or be used in turns, one after another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتناوب أو يتعاقب
entries.example: We alternate between walking and cycling to work.

entries.definitionEn: Different from the usual choice, and able to be used instead.
entries.arabicMeaning: بديل
entries.example: Is there an alternative route to the airport?

entries.definitionEn: Another choice that can be used instead of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيار بديل
entries.example: Taking the train is a cheaper alternative.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce a different possibility.
entries.arabicMeaning: أو بدلاً من ذلك
entries.example: We can meet at noon; alternatively, we can talk tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: Used to join two ideas when the second is surprising after the first.
entries.arabicMeaning: على الرغم من أنّ
entries.example: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

entries.definitionEn: Height above sea level, especially of a plane or a mountain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتفاع عن سطح البحر
entries.example: The plane reached a high altitude.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; or considering everything together.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ في المجمل
entries.example: The trip cost two hundred pounds altogether.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of caring about other people without seeking reward.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيثار؛ حب الخير للآخرين دون مقابل
entries.example: Her career in nursing was driven by altruism.

entries.definitionEn: Showing a wish to help others rather than yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيثاري؛ يقدّم مصلحة الآخرين
entries.example: He made an altruistic gift to the local school.

entries.definitionEn: A light silver-grey metal used in cans, foil, and aircraft parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألومنيوم
entries.example: The window frames are made of aluminum.

entries.definitionEn: At all times; every time.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائماً
entries.example: She always drinks tea in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: The form of the verb be used with I in the present.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة فعل الكينونة مع ضمير المتكلم أنا
entries.example: I am ready to start.

entries.definitionEn: Done for pleasure rather than as a paid job; sometimes not skilful.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاوٍ؛ غير احترافي
entries.example: She plays in an amateur orchestra.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does an activity for pleasure, not as a profession.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاوٍ غير محترف
entries.example: The competition is open to amateurs only.

entries.definitionEn: To surprise someone greatly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدهش أو يبهر
entries.example: The magician amazed the children.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprised.
entries.arabicMeaning: مندهش
entries.example: I was amazed by the view from the hill.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of surprise.
entries.arabicMeaning: دهشة أو ذهول
entries.example: They stared in amazement at the fireworks.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprising and impressive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذهل؛ رائع
entries.example: The food at that restaurant is amazing.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes great surprise.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مذهل
entries.example: Amazingly, the train arrived on time.

entries.definitionEn: A person sent to represent their country in another country.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفير
entries.example: She met the ambassador at the reception.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of having more than one possible meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: غموض أو ازدواج في المعنى
entries.example: The contract was delayed because of ambiguity in one clause.

entries.definitionEn: Unclear because more than one meaning is possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: غامض أو ملتبس
entries.example: His answer was ambiguous, so we asked again.

entries.definitionEn: A strong wish to succeed or to reach a goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: طموح
entries.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor.

entries.definitionEn: Determined to succeed, or needing a lot of effort and skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: طموح؛ ذو أهداف كبيرة
entries.example: Starting a business is an ambitious plan.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيارة إسعاف
entries.example: An ambulance arrived within minutes.

entries.definitionEn: In the middle of, or during a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسط؛ في أثناء
entries.example: She stayed calm amid the noise of the market.

entries.definitionEn: A strong-smelling chemical used in cleaning products and industry.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمونيا؛ نشادر
entries.example: The cleaner contained ammonia, so we opened a window.

entries.definitionEn: In the middle of a group, or included as one of them.
entries.arabicMeaning: بين؛ وسط مجموعة
entries.example: She sat among her friends.

entries.definitionEn: A more formal or British form of among: in the middle of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: بين؛ وسط (صيغة أكثر رسمية)
entries.example: There was silence amongst the crowd.

entries.definitionEn: Without a clear shape, structure, or definite form.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الشكل الواضح؛ غير محدد البنية
entries.example: The committee remained an amorphous group with no leader.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that lacks a clear shape or structure.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو عديم الشكل أو غير منظم
entries.example: Ideas drifted amorphously through the long meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A quantity of something, especially something that is not counted as separate items.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدار أو كمية
entries.example: Add a small amount of salt to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: More than enough; plenty.
entries.arabicMeaning: وافِر؛ أكثر من كافٍ
entries.example: There is ample space for two desks.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making sound louder, or of adding detail to make something clearer.
entries.arabicMeaning: تضخيم الصوت؛ أو توسيع الشرح
entries.example: The hall needed better amplification for the speech.

entries.definitionEn: A device that makes sound louder.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضخّم صوت
entries.example: He plugged the guitar into an amplifier.

entries.definitionEn: To make a sound louder, or to increase the strength of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضخّم الصوت أو يزيد قوة شيء
entries.example: The microphone amplified her voice.

entries.definitionEn: Fully; more than enough.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوفرة؛ بما يكفي وزيادة
entries.example: The report amply supports that conclusion.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone smile or laugh, or to keep them pleasantly occupied.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّي أو يُضحك
entries.example: The story amused the whole class.

entries.definitionEn: Finding something funny; slightly entertained.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستمتع أو ضاحك بلطف
entries.example: She looked amused by the joke.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of finding something funny, or something done for fun.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسلية أو فكاهة
entries.example: The children played games for amusement.

entries.definitionEn: Funny in a gentle way; entertaining.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلٍّ؛ طريف
entries.example: He told an amusing story about his first job.

entries.definitionEn: The form of a used before a vowel sound to mean one of something, not a particular one.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة تنكير تُستخدم قبل صوت علة
entries.example: She ate an apple after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A comparison that shows how two things are similar in some way.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشبيه أو قياس بالمماثلة
entries.example: He explained electricity with an analogy about water pipes.

entries.definitionEn: A careful study of something in order to understand it.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحليل
entries.example: The analysis of the data took two days.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to examine information and explain it.
entries.arabicMeaning: محلل
entries.example: The financial analyst presented the figures.

entries.definitionEn: To study something carefully in order to understand it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلّل
entries.example: We need to analyze the test results.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking order, rules, or control.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضوي؛ بلا نظام
entries.example: The meeting became anarchic after the vote was delayed.

entries.definitionEn: A person in your family who lived a long time ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلف؛ جدّ من الأجداد
entries.example: Her ancestors came from the north.

entries.definitionEn: A heavy object that holds a ship in place; also the main presenter of a news programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرساة السفينة؛ أو مقدّم نشرة الأخبار الرئيسي
entries.example: The ship dropped its anchor near the harbour.

entries.definitionEn: To hold something firmly in place, or to be the main presenter of a broadcast.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت شيئاً في مكانه، أو يقدّم نشرة أخبار بصفته المذيع الرئيسي
entries.example: They anchored the tent with strong ropes.

entries.definitionEn: A place where ships can drop anchor safely.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرسى؛ مكان رسو السفن
entries.example: The boats waited in a quiet anchorage.

entries.definitionEn: Held firmly in place, or firmly based on something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثبّت؛ راسخ
entries.example: The discussion was anchored in clear evidence.

entries.definitionEn: A man who presents a news programme and holds it together.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدّم نشرة أخبار (رجل)
entries.example: The anchorman introduced the evening reports.

entries.definitionEn: A person who presents a news programme, used without specifying gender.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدّم نشرة أخبار
entries.example: The anchorperson summarized the day's events.

entries.definitionEn: Very old; from a time long ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: قديم جداً؛ عتيق
entries.example: We visited an ancient castle.

entries.definitionEn: Used to join words or parts of a sentence that belong together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف عطف بمعنى وَ
entries.example: I bought bread and cheese.

entries.definitionEn: A spiritual being in some religions, often shown with wings; also a very kind person.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاك؛ شخص بالغ اللطف
entries.example: The painting shows an angel above the village.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of being upset and wanting to react against someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: غضب
entries.example: He spoke without anger, but he was firm.

entries.definitionEn: The space between two lines or surfaces that meet; also a way of looking at something.
entries.arabicMeaning: زاوية؛ أو وجهة نظر
entries.example: The table stood at an angle to the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To place or move something so that it is not straight; also to present information from a particular viewpoint.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُميل أو يوجّه بزاوية؛ يعرض الأمر من زاوية معيّنة
entries.example: She angled the lamp toward the page.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows anger.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغضب
entries.example: He closed the door angrily.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing strong displeasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: غاضب
entries.example: She was angry about the broken vase.

entries.definitionEn: A lasting feeling of anxiety and unease, often about life or identity.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق وجودي أو ضيق نفسي مستمر
entries.example: The novel captures the angst of early adulthood.

entries.definitionEn: Full of anxious, restless unease, especially in a youthful or self-conscious way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بالقلق والضيق النفسي
entries.example: The letters sound angsty, but they are honest.

entries.definitionEn: Severe mental or physical suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرب أو عذاب شديد
entries.example: She waited in anguish for the test results.

entries.definitionEn: Having sharp corners or lean, bony lines rather than soft curves.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو زوايا حادة؛ نحيل الملامح
entries.example: The building has an angular glass front.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of having sharp angles or a lean, unrounded shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: تزوّي الشكل؛ حدّة الخطوط
entries.example: The sculpture's angularity caught the afternoon light.

entries.definitionEn: A living creature that is not a plant, such as a dog, bird, or fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان
entries.example: The farm has many animals.

entries.definitionEn: To make drawings or models appear to move; also to give life or energy to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّك رسوماً؛ يبثّ الحيوية
entries.example: They animate the characters on a computer.

entries.definitionEn: Full of energy and movement; also made as a film from drawings or models.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بالحيوية؛ أو رسوم متحركة
entries.example: They had an animated discussion after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: In a lively, energetic way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحماسة وحيوية
entries.example: They talked animatedly about the concert.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making drawings or models appear to move, or a film made that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسوم متحركة؛ تحريك الصور
entries.example: She studies animation at college.

entries.definitionEn: The joint between the foot and the leg.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاحل
entries.example: He hurt his ankle while running.

entries.definitionEn: A building added to a larger one, or an extra section attached to a document.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملحق مبنى أو وثيقة
entries.example: The library stores journals in a small annex.

entries.definitionEn: To take control of land or property and add it to a larger holding.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضمّ أرضاً أو ملكاً إلى كيان أكبر
entries.example: The city voted to annex the neighbouring farmland.

entries.definitionEn: A date remembered because something important happened on that day in a past year.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكرى سنوية
entries.example: Today is their wedding anniversary.

entries.definitionEn: To tell people about something officially or publicly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلن
entries.example: The school will announce the results tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: A public or official statement that gives news.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان
entries.example: There was an announcement about the delayed train.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone a little angry or impatient.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعج
entries.example: Loud music can annoy the neighbours.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of slight anger, or something that causes it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيق أو مصدر إزعاج
entries.example: The delay was a minor annoyance.

entries.definitionEn: A little angry or impatient.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزعج
entries.example: She was annoyed by the constant noise.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel a little angry or impatient.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزعج
entries.example: That dripping tap is annoying.

entries.definitionEn: Happening once every year.
entries.arabicMeaning: سنوي
entries.example: The town holds an annual book fair.

entries.definitionEn: Once every year.
entries.arabicMeaning: سنوياً
entries.example: The report is published annually.

entries.definitionEn: The state of not being named or identified.
entries.arabicMeaning: إخفاء الهوية؛ عدم الكشف عن الاسم
entries.example: Sources spoke on condition of anonymity.

entries.definitionEn: From a person whose name is not known or not given.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجهول الاسم؛ مجهول الهوية
entries.example: An anonymous donor paid for the repairs.

entries.definitionEn: One more of the same kind, or a different one.
entries.arabicMeaning: آخر؛ واحد إضافي
entries.example: Would you like another cup of tea?

entries.definitionEn: One more person or thing, or a different one.
entries.arabicMeaning: آخر؛ واحد غيره
entries.example: This pen is broken; can I have another?

entries.definitionEn: Something you say or write in reply, or the solution to a question.
entries.arabicMeaning: جواب أو إجابة
entries.example: I did not hear her answer.

entries.definitionEn: To say or write something in reply, or to pick up a phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجيب
entries.example: Please answer the question in full sentences.

entries.definitionEn: A small insect that lives in large groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: نملة
entries.example: An ant carried a crumb across the path.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely old-fashioned; belonging to a remote past.
entries.arabicMeaning: عتيق جداً؛ بالٍ إلى حدّ بعيد
entries.example: The office still uses antediluvian filing methods.

entries.definitionEn: A published collection of poems, stories, or other pieces by different writers.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختارات أدبية
entries.example: She edited an anthology of short stories.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the study of human societies, cultures, and development.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنثروبولوجي؛ متعلق بعلم الإنسان
entries.example: The museum holds anthropological records of village life.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the study of human societies and cultures.
entries.arabicMeaning: من منظور أنثروبولوجي
entries.example: The ritual is interesting anthropologically, not only historically.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies human societies, cultures, and development.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم أنثروبولوجيا
entries.example: The anthropologist spent a year in the coastal town.

entries.definitionEn: The study of human societies, cultures, and how people have developed.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الإنسان (الأنثروبولوجيا)
entries.example: She is studying anthropology at university.

entries.definitionEn: Opposed to a person, idea, or plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: معادٍ لـ؛ ضدّ
entries.example: He is strongly anti the proposed late-night flights.

entries.definitionEn: Designed to attack or defend against enemy aircraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضاد للطائرات
entries.example: The port had antiaircraft guns during the drill.

entries.definitionEn: Able to kill bacteria or stop them from growing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضاد للبكتيريا
entries.example: Use an antibacterial soap after handling raw meat.

entries.definitionEn: A drug or treatment used to fight cancer.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاج أو دواء مضاد للسرطان
entries.example: Researchers tested a new anticancer in early trials.

entries.definitionEn: To expect something and, often, to prepare for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقع ويستعد لحدوث شيء
entries.example: We did not anticipate such a long delay.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of expecting something, often with excitement or worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترقّب أو توقع
entries.example: The crowd waited in anticipation for the doors to open.

entries.definitionEn: Disappointing because the ending is weaker than what came before.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيّب لأنه أضعف من الذروة المتوقعة
entries.example: The final scene felt anticlimactic after such a strong start.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that ends more weakly than expected.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مخيّب بعد ترقّب أعلى
entries.example: The tour ended anticlimactically in an empty hall.

entries.definitionEn: Silly, unusual, or mischievous behaviour. Usually used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلوك طائش أو مقالب مضحكة
entries.example: The puppy's antics kept the children laughing.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that stops a poison from working; also something that counters a harmful effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترياق؛ علاج يُبطل أثراً ضاراً
entries.example: Doctors gave an antidote after the snake bite.

entries.definitionEn: Action, equipment, or rules intended to reduce pollution.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكافحة التلوث؛ إجراءات مضادة للتلوث
entries.example: The factory installed new antipollution to cut smoke.
