entries.definitionEn: Old-fashioned and no longer suitable for present needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: عتيق وغير ملائم للعصر
entries.example: The building still has an antiquated heating system.

entries.definitionEn: Valuable because it is old and from an earlier period.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثري؛ عتيق ذو قيمة
entries.example: They bought an antique wooden table.

entries.definitionEn: An old object that is valuable because of its age and quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحفة أثرية أو قطعة عتيقة ثمينة
entries.example: The shop sells antiques from the nineteenth century.

entries.definitionEn: The distant past, especially the time of ancient civilizations; also great age.
entries.arabicMeaning: العصور القديمة؛ القِدم
entries.example: The museum displays objects from classical antiquity.

entries.definitionEn: Designed to reduce or prevent the build-up of static electricity.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضاد للكهرباء الساكنة
entries.example: She wore an antistatic strap while repairing the computer.

entries.definitionEn: The direct opposite of something; also a contrast of ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقيض تام؛ تضاد
entries.example: Quiet study was the antithesis of the noisy cafe.

entries.definitionEn: Directly opposed in character or meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقيض؛ مضاد في الجوهر
entries.example: His methods were antithetical to the team's careful approach.

entries.definitionEn: Software that finds and removes computer viruses.
entries.arabicMeaning: برنامج مكافحة الفيروسات
entries.example: Update your antivirus before opening unknown files.

entries.definitionEn: A word that means the opposite of another word.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضدّ؛ كلمة ذات معنى معاكس
entries.example: Hot is an antonym of cold.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of worry or unease, often about something that may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق
entries.example: She felt anxiety before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Worried or nervous about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق أو متوتر
entries.example: He was anxious about the exam.

entries.definitionEn: In a worried or nervous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقلق
entries.example: She waited anxiously for the phone to ring.

entries.definitionEn: Used in questions and negatives to mean some; also used to mean it does not matter which one.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ؛ بعض في السؤال والنفي
entries.example: Do you have any questions?

entries.definitionEn: Used in questions and negatives instead of some; also it does not matter which.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شيء؛ بعض في السؤال والنفي
entries.example: I wanted tea, but they did not have any.

entries.definitionEn: Any person; used especially in questions and negatives.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شخص
entries.example: Did anybody call while I was out?

entries.definitionEn: Anyway; used to change the subject or to say that something is true despite other things.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أي حال
entries.example: It was late, but we went anyhow.

entries.definitionEn: Any longer; used with a negative to say that something has stopped.
entries.arabicMeaning: لم يعد؛ بعد الآن في سياق النفي
entries.example: She does not live here anymore.

entries.definitionEn: Any person. Used especially in questions and negative sentences, or when it does not matter who.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شخص؛ ضمير يُستعمل غالبًا في السؤال والنفي، أو حين لا يهمّ من يكون
entries.example: Has anyone seen my bag?

entries.definitionEn: Any thing. Used especially in questions and negative sentences, or when it does not matter what.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شيء؛ ضمير يُستعمل غالبًا في السؤال والنفي، أو حين لا يهمّ ماذا
entries.example: I do not need anything from the shop.

entries.definitionEn: Despite that; in any case. Used to add a point or to continue after a comment.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أي حال؛ رغم ذلك
entries.example: It was late, but we walked home anyway.

entries.definitionEn: In, at, or to any place.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أي مكان أو إلى أي مكان
entries.example: You can sit anywhere you like.

entries.definitionEn: Separated by a distance; not together.
entries.arabicMeaning: متباعدين؛ على حدة
entries.example: Their houses stand only a few metres apart.

entries.definitionEn: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقة سكنية
entries.example: They rent a small apartment near the park.

entries.definitionEn: A large primate with no tail, such as a gorilla or a chimpanzee.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرد كبير من الرئيسيات العليا، مثل الغوريلا أو الشمبانزي
entries.example: The zoo has a new ape that likes to sit in the shade.

entries.definitionEn: To say you are sorry for something you have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتذر عن خطأ أو إساءة
entries.example: I apologized for being late to the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Words that say you are sorry for something you have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتذار؛ كلام يعبّر عن الأسف
entries.example: She sent a written apology after the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: One of the twelve close followers of Jesus in Christian tradition. Also a strong public supporter of a cause.
entries.arabicMeaning: حواري من أتباع المسيح، أو داعية متحمس لقضية
entries.example: He became an apostle of simple living after years in the city.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark (') used to show possession or letters that have been left out.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاصلة عليا؛ علامة (') للملكية أو للحروف المحذوفة
entries.example: Put an apostrophe in the word don't.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone with shock and strong disapproval.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصدم ويبعث على الاشمئزاز الشديد
entries.example: The waste of food appalled the visiting inspectors.

entries.definitionEn: Shocking and extremely bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروّع؛ سيئ إلى حد يبعث على الصدمة
entries.example: The road conditions after the storm were appalling.

entries.definitionEn: In a shocking or extremely bad way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مروّع أو بالغ السوء
entries.example: The room was appallingly cold for a hospital ward.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see or understand. Also seeming to be true, though not yet proved.
entries.arabicMeaning: واضح للعيان؛ أو ظاهري غير مؤكد بعد
entries.example: It was apparent that she had prepared carefully.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something seems true, from what you have heard or seen.
entries.arabicMeaning: على ما يبدو
entries.example: Apparently the train is running ten minutes late.

entries.definitionEn: A serious request for help, money, or support. Also the quality that makes people like something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نداء أو التماس جدّي؛ كذلك الجاذبية التي تجعل الشيء محبوبًا
entries.example: The charity made an appeal for warm coats.

entries.definitionEn: To make a serious request. Also to be attractive or interesting to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتمس أمراً التماساً جدّياً؛ كذلك يجذب اهتمام شخص
entries.example: The quiet garden appeals to visitors who need a rest.

entries.definitionEn: To become able to be seen. Also to seem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظهر للعيان؛ كذلك يبدو
entries.example: A small boat appeared on the lake.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person or thing looks.
entries.arabicMeaning: المظهر الخارجي
entries.example: His appearance changed after he cut his hair.

entries.definitionEn: A desire for food. Also a strong wish for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهية للطعام؛ كذلك رغبة قوية في شيء
entries.example: Walking in the cold gave us a good appetite.

entries.definitionEn: To clap your hands to show you like a performance. Also to express praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفق إعجابًا؛ كذلك يثني على عمل
entries.example: The audience applauded when the singer finished.

entries.definitionEn: The sound of people clapping to show they like something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصفيق الجمهور
entries.example: Warm applause filled the hall after the speech.

entries.definitionEn: A round fruit that is often red, green, or yellow.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفاحة
entries.example: I ate an apple after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A machine designed for a particular household task, such as cooking, washing, or heating.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز منزلي لمهمة محددة كالطهي أو الغسل
entries.example: This kitchen appliance heats water in under a minute.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has formally asked for a job, a course, or a similar opportunity.
entries.arabicMeaning: متقدم بطلب لوظيفة أو فرصة رسمية
entries.example: Each applicant must send a short letter and a CV.

entries.definitionEn: A formal written request, for example for a job. Also the practical use of an idea or method.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلب رسمي مكتوب؛ كذلك التطبيق العملي لفكرة
entries.example: Her job application arrived before the closing date.

entries.definitionEn: To make a formal request, especially for a job or a place. Also to put a substance onto a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقدم بطلب رسمي؛ كذلك يضع مادة على سطح
entries.example: He wants to apply for a place on the course.

entries.definitionEn: To choose someone officially for a job or a role.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيّن شخصًا رسميًا في منصب
entries.example: The board appointed her as the new director.

entries.definitionEn: A planned meeting at a particular time, often with a doctor or an official.
entries.arabicMeaning: موعد محدد، غالبًا مع طبيب أو موظف
entries.example: I have an appointment at the dentist on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: To be grateful for something. Also to understand its value.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر المعروف أو القيمة
entries.example: I appreciate your help with the boxes.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being grateful, or of understanding the worth of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدير وعرفان؛ إدراك لقيمة شيء
entries.example: He wrote a note of appreciation to the volunteers.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you are grateful, or that you notice and value quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدِّر؛ يُظهر الشكر أو الإحساس بالجودة
entries.example: The speaker smiled at the appreciative audience.

entries.definitionEn: To catch and hold a suspected offender. Also to grasp a meaning fully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبض على مشتبه به؛ كذلك يدرك المعنى تمامًا
entries.example: Police apprehended the thief near the station.

entries.definitionEn: Worried that something unpleasant may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق مما قد يحدث
entries.example: She felt apprehensive before the long interview.

entries.definitionEn: A person who learns a skilled trade by working under an experienced worker.
entries.arabicMeaning: متدرّب يتعلم مهنة على يد محترف
entries.example: The apprentice watched the carpenter measure each board.

entries.definitionEn: A period of training in a trade that combines paid work with instruction.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة التلمذة المهنية المقرونة بالعمل والتدريب
entries.example: He completed an apprenticeship in electrical work.

entries.definitionEn: A way of dealing with a task or problem. Also the act of coming nearer.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسلوب في معالجة أمر؛ كذلك الاقتراب
entries.example: Their approach to the problem was slow but careful.

entries.definitionEn: To come nearer in space or time. Also to begin dealing with a task in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقترب مكانًا أو زمانًا؛ كذلك يتناول مسألة بطريقة معينة
entries.example: A cyclist approached the junction too quickly.

entries.definitionEn: Right or suitable for a particular situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناسب للموقف
entries.example: Wear clothes that are appropriate for the interview.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is suitable for the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مناسب
entries.example: Please dress appropriately for the formal dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Official agreement that something may go ahead. Also a feeling that something is good or acceptable.
entries.arabicMeaning: موافقة رسمية؛ كذلك استحسان
entries.example: The plan needs the manager's approval before we start.

entries.definitionEn: To officially agree to a plan or request. Also to think that something is good.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوافق رسميًا؛ كذلك يستحسن
entries.example: The committee approved the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Close to the real number or amount, but not exact.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريبي غير دقيق تمامًا
entries.example: Give me an approximate cost for the repairs.

entries.definitionEn: Close to a number or time, but not exact.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريبًا
entries.example: The journey takes approximately forty minutes.

entries.definitionEn: The fourth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبريل / نيسان؛ الشهر الرابع من السنة
entries.example: Her birthday is in April.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth worn over your clothes to keep them clean while you cook.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريلة تُلبس فوق الثياب أثناء الطبخ
entries.example: He put on an apron before he washed the dishes.

entries.definitionEn: Suitable or well chosen. Also having a natural talent or a tendency.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملائم جدًا؛ كذلك ذو استعداد طبيعي
entries.example: That was an apt remark after a long, messy meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to do something; having a tendency toward it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميل إلى؛ من المرجح أن يفعل
entries.example: He is apt to leave his keys in the door.

entries.definitionEn: A natural ability to learn or perform a particular kind of task well.
entries.arabicMeaning: استعداد فطري أو قدرة طبيعية على أداء نوع معيّن من العمل
entries.example: The test measures aptitude for spatial reasoning.

entries.definitionEn: Of a light blue-green colour, like clear shallow water.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلون أزرق مخضر فاتح كلون الماء الصافي
entries.example: She painted the bathroom walls aqua.

entries.definitionEn: A glass tank, or a public building, in which live fish and other water animals are kept for display.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوض أسماك زجاجي، أو مرفق لعرض الكائنات المائية
entries.example: The children watched the rays glide around the aquarium.

entries.definitionEn: Understood by only a few people with special knowledge; obscure in a specialised way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غامض لا يفهمه إلا ذوو اختصاص ضيق
entries.example: The contract was full of arcane legal phrases.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is obscure and known mainly to specialists.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غامض متخصص
entries.example: The rule was arcanely worded, so few staff could apply it.

entries.definitionEn: A curved structure that supports weight above an opening, or a similar curved shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوس معماري يحمل ثقلًا فوق فتحة، أو شكل مقوّس شبيه
entries.example: They walked under a stone arch into the courtyard.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies the past by excavating and examining old objects and sites.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم آثار يدرس الماضي عبر التنقيب عن البقايا القديمة
entries.example: The archaeologist carefully brushed soil from the clay bowl.

entries.definitionEn: Being a perfect or original example of a type.
entries.arabicMeaning: نموذجي أصيل يمثل النوع في أوضح صوره
entries.example: The lonely detective is an archetypal figure in crime fiction.

entries.definitionEn: An original model from which later examples are copied. Also a typical example of a kind of person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نموذج أصلي يُحتذى، أو مثال نمطي لشخص أو شيء
entries.example: The wise teacher is a familiar archetype in stories.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to design buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهندس معماري
entries.example: The architect showed us drawings of the new library.

entries.definitionEn: The design of buildings, or the style of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن العمارة أو أسلوب البناء
entries.example: I like the architecture of the old town hall.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to archives. Suitable for the long, careful storage of records.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرشيفي؛ صالح للحفظ الطويل للوثائق
entries.example: The letters were moved to archival boxes in a dry room.

entries.definitionEn: Of the far north polar region. Also extremely cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطبي شمالي؛ كذلك شديد البرودة
entries.example: An arctic wind swept across the open field.

entries.definitionEn: Strong, warm enthusiasm or passion for a person, a cause, or an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماس شديد أو شغف دافئ
entries.example: She spoke with ardor about restoring the old theatre.

entries.definitionEn: Needing a lot of effort over a long time; tiring and difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاقّ متعب يستغرق جهدًا طويلًا
entries.example: They made an arduous climb to the high ridge.

entries.definitionEn: With great and lasting effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمشقة بالغة وجهد متواصل
entries.example: He worked arduously through the night to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: The present form of be used with you, we, and they, to describe a state or to form continuous tenses.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة المضارع من الفعل المساعد be مع you وwe وthey
entries.example: You are early for the class.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a place, or a space used for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطقة أو حيّز مخصص لغرض معيّن
entries.example: This area of the park is quiet in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A large space with seats around it for sports or shows. Also a field of public activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحة واسعة للعروض أو الرياضة؛ كذلك ميدان نشاط عام
entries.example: Thousands filled the arena for the evening concert.

entries.definitionEn: To speak angrily with someone because you disagree. Also to give reasons for an opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجادل بغضب؛ كذلك يسوق حججًا لرأي
entries.example: They argue about the bill every month.

entries.definitionEn: An angry disagreement. Also a reason given to support an opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدال غاضب؛ كذلك حجة تؤيد رأيًا
entries.example: They had an argument about whose turn it was to cook.

entries.definitionEn: To happen or begin to exist, especially as a problem or an opportunity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشأ أو يحدث، ولا سيما كمشكلة أو فرصة
entries.example: If any questions arise, please write to the office.

entries.definitionEn: People of high social rank, often with inherited titles and land.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبقة النبلاء ذوي الرتب الموروثة
entries.example: The old palace once belonged to the local aristocracy.

entries.definitionEn: The branch of mathematics that deals with numbers, including adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الحساب؛ العمليات على الأعداد
entries.example: She checked the bill with simple arithmetic.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body from the shoulder to the hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذراع
entries.example: He carried the bag under his arm.

entries.definitionEn: To provide someone with weapons. Also to prepare a device so that it can operate.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّح؛ كذلك يفعّل جهازًا ليصبح جاهزًا للعمل
entries.example: Please arm the alarm before you leave the shop.

entries.definitionEn: A comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرسي بذراعين
entries.example: Grandfather fell asleep in the armchair by the window.

entries.definitionEn: Carrying a weapon, or provided with one.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلّح أو مزوَّد بسلاح
entries.example: An armed guard stood by the museum door.

entries.definitionEn: The amount that a person can hold in both arms.
entries.arabicMeaning: حِضن مما يُحمل بالذراعين
entries.example: She came in with an armful of fresh towels.

entries.definitionEn: A place where weapons and military equipment are stored.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستودع أسلحة ومعدات عسكرية
entries.example: Old rifles lined the walls of the armory.

entries.definitionEn: A large organized group of soldiers who fight on land.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيش بري منظَّم
entries.example: Her brother joined the army after college.

entries.definitionEn: In many places nearby; approximately; on all sides.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأنحاء القريبة؛ حوالي؛ من كل جانب
entries.example: There are good cafés around if you want coffee.

entries.definitionEn: On all sides of something; surrounding a place or object.
entries.arabicMeaning: حول شيء؛ من جميع جهاته
entries.example: They sat around the table and talked.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a feeling, interest, or reaction to begin.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثير شعورًا أو اهتمامًا أو رد فعل
entries.example: The strange noise aroused her curiosity.

entries.definitionEn: To plan or organize something. Also to put things in a neat order.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظم أو يرتب موعدًا؛ كذلك يضع الأشياء في نظام
entries.example: Can you arrange a meeting for Thursday afternoon?

entries.definitionEn: A plan or agreement. Also the way things are placed or organized.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترتيب أو اتفاق؛ كذلك هيئة تنظيم الأشياء
entries.example: We made an arrangement to share the cost of the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking someone into police custody because they may have broken the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقيف أو قبض من الشرطة
entries.example: News of the arrest spread through the small town.

entries.definitionEn: To take someone into police custody because they may have broken the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبض على شخص للاشتباه بمخالفة القانون
entries.example: Officers arrested the driver after the crash.

entries.definitionEn: The act of reaching a place. Also a person or thing that has just come.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصول؛ كذلك الوافد حديثًا
entries.example: Heavy snow delayed the arrival of the evening train.

entries.definitionEn: To reach a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصل إلى مكان
entries.example: We arrive at the hotel at six.

entries.definitionEn: Believing you are more important than other people, and showing it in a rude way.
entries.arabicMeaning: متغطرس يرى نفسه فوق غيره بأسلوب فظ
entries.example: His arrogant tone made the discussion harder.

entries.definitionEn: A thin pointed stick shot from a bow. Also a sign that points in a direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهم يُرمى بالقوس؛ كذلك علامة تشير إلى اتجاه
entries.example: Follow the arrow to the main exit.

entries.definitionEn: Painting, drawing, sculpture, and other work made to look beautiful or interesting.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن كالرسم والنحت وما يُصنع للجمال أو الإمتاع
entries.example: She studies art at the local college.

entries.definitionEn: A blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart. Also a major road or route.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريان يحمل الدم من القلب؛ كذلك طريق رئيس
entries.example: A blocked artery can reduce the flow of blood.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقال في صحيفة أو مجلة أو موقع
entries.example: I read an article about city parks.

entries.definitionEn: Able to express thoughts clearly and effectively in speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصيح قادر على التعبير الواضح المقنع
entries.example: She is an articulate speaker who rarely wastes a word.

entries.definitionEn: To express an idea clearly in words.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبّر عن فكرة بوضوح
entries.example: He found it hard to articulate why the plan felt wrong.

entries.definitionEn: The clear formation of speech sounds. Also a joint, or the way parts are connected.
entries.arabicMeaning: وضوح النطق؛ كذلك مفصل أو طريقة اتصال الأجزاء
entries.example: Clear articulation helped every student follow the lecture.

entries.definitionEn: An object made by humans, especially one of historical or cultural interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر مصنوع بيد الإنسان، ولا سيما ذو قيمة تاريخية
entries.example: The museum displayed a clay artifact from the valley.

entries.definitionEn: Clever skill used to create an effect or to hide the truth.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيلة بارعة أو صنعة تُستخدم للتأثير أو لإخفاء الحقيقة
entries.example: The plot depends on artifice rather than honest feeling.

entries.definitionEn: Made by people, not by nature. Also not sincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: اصطناعي غير طبيعي؛ كذلك غير صادق
entries.example: The room was lit by artificial light.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is made or caused by people, not by nature.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة اصطناعية لا طبيعية
entries.example: The lake level was raised artificially after the dry summer.

entries.definitionEn: A person who creates art, such as paintings, music, or performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: فنّان يبدع في الرسم أو الموسيقى أو الأداء
entries.example: The artist mixed the colours on a small wooden board.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to art. Also showing skill or imagination in creating things.
entries.arabicMeaning: فنيّ؛ كذلك ذو حس إبداعي في الصنع
entries.example: She has an artistic way of arranging flowers.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows artistic skill or judgement.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الفنية أو بذوق فنّي
entries.example: The photographs were artistically framed along the corridor.

entries.definitionEn: Creative skill of a high level.
entries.arabicMeaning: براعة فنية رفيعة
entries.example: The dancer's artistry held the whole room still.

entries.definitionEn: Used to mean because, while, or in the way that.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف ربط بمعنى لأن أو بينما أو كما
entries.example: As it was raining, we waited under the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say what role or job someone has.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى بصفته أو في دور معيّن
entries.example: She works as a nurse at the clinic.

entries.definitionEn: The grey powder left after something has burned.
entries.arabicMeaning: رماد يتبقى بعد الاحتراق
entries.example: Wind blew ash from the fireplace across the rug.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling bad or embarrassed because of something you have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: خجلان مما فعل
entries.example: He felt ashamed that he had forgotten her name.

entries.definitionEn: To one side; out of the main way, for later or for someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانبًا؛ بعيدًا عن الطريق الرئيس
entries.example: She put her phone aside and listened.

entries.definitionEn: To say something in order to get an answer or to request something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسأل طلبًا لجواب أو لشيء
entries.example: Can I ask a question?

entries.definitionEn: Sleeping; not awake.
entries.arabicMeaning: نائم
entries.example: The baby is asleep in the next room.

entries.definitionEn: One part of a situation, idea, or problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب من مسألة أو فكرة
entries.example: Cost is only one aspect of the decision.

entries.definitionEn: A strong hope or aim to achieve something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تطلع أو طموح قوي
entries.example: Her main aspiration is to finish medical school.

entries.definitionEn: To have a strong wish to achieve something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطمح إلى بلوغ غاية
entries.example: Many young players aspire to join a professional team.

entries.definitionEn: A common medicine used to reduce pain, fever, or inflammation.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسبرين؛ دواء شائع لتخفيف الألم أو الحمى
entries.example: He took an aspirin for his headache.

entries.definitionEn: A violent physical attack on a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتداء جسدي عنيف
entries.example: The court heard evidence about the assault near the station.

entries.definitionEn: To gather people or things together. Also to fit parts together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمع الناس أو الأشياء؛ كذلك يركّب الأجزاء
entries.example: Volunteers assembled in the hall at eight.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting of a group of people. Also the process of fitting parts together.
entries.arabicMeaning: اجتماع جماعة؛ كذلك عملية تجميع الأجزاء
entries.example: The school holds an assembly every Monday morning.

entries.definitionEn: To state something firmly and with confidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤكد أمرًا بحزم وثقة
entries.example: She asserted that the figures were correct.

entries.definitionEn: A firm statement presented as true, which may still need proof.
entries.arabicMeaning: زعم جازم يُقدَّم على أنه حقيقة وقد يحتاج إلى دليل
entries.example: His assertion that the bridge was safe surprised the engineers.

entries.definitionEn: To judge the quality, amount, or importance of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقيّم الجودة أو المقدار أو الأهمية
entries.example: Teachers assess the essays against a clear list of skills.

entries.definitionEn: A judgement of quality, ability, or value. Also a test used for that purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقييم للجودة أو القدرة؛ كذلك اختبار لهذا الغرض
entries.example: The final assessment includes a short written paper.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a job, duty, or piece of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسند إلى شخص مهمة أو واجبًا
entries.example: The teacher assigned each group a different chapter.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of work given to someone as part of a job or a course.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمة أو واجب يُعطى في العمل أو الدراسة
entries.example: The assignment is due on Friday morning.

entries.definitionEn: To absorb information, people, or substances so that they become part of a larger whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستوعب معلومات أو أفرادًا أو مواد حتى تندمج في الكل
entries.example: New staff need time to assimilate the team's methods.

entries.definitionEn: The process of absorbing and becoming part of a larger group, system, or body of knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية الاستيعاب والاندماج في جماعة أو نظام أو معرفة أوسع
entries.example: Slow assimilation of the new rules caused delays.

entries.definitionEn: To help someone do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساعد شخصًا في عمل
entries.example: Nurses assist the doctor during the examination.

entries.definitionEn: Help given to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساعدة تُقدَّم لشخص
entries.example: Please call if you need assistance with your bags.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a job title to mean helping a more senior person.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفة للمنصب بمعنى مساعد لمن هو أعلى رتبة
entries.example: She is the assistant manager of the bookshop.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to help someone more senior.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساعد في العمل لمن هو أعلى منصبًا
entries.example: The director's assistant booked the train tickets.

entries.definitionEn: To connect someone or something with another in your mind. Also to spend time with a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط في الذهن بين شيئين؛ كذلك يخالط جماعة
entries.example: Many people associate that smell with summer rain.

entries.definitionEn: An official group of people who share an interest or a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمعية رسمية تضم أصحاب اهتمام أو هدف مشترك
entries.example: She joined a local association for small business owners.

entries.definitionEn: To believe that something is true without being sure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفترض صحة أمر من دون تأكد
entries.example: I assume the office is closed on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: Something you believe is true without proof.
entries.arabicMeaning: افتراض يُعدّ صحيحًا بلا دليل
entries.example: Your assumption that the shop opens at eight is wrong.

entries.definitionEn: A confident promise that something is true or will happen. Also a feeling of confidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأكيد مطمئن؛ كذلك شعور بالثقة
entries.example: He gave us his assurance that the work would be finished.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone that something is true or will happen, in order to make them less worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطمئن شخصًا بتأكيد أن الأمر صحيح أو سيحدث
entries.example: I can assure you that the documents are safe.

entries.definitionEn: To surprise someone very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدهش شخصًا بشدة
entries.example: The magician's last trick astonished the children.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprised.
entries.arabicMeaning: مندهش جدًا
entries.example: We were astonished by the size of the old tree.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprising; hard to believe because it is so unusual or impressive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدهش يصعب تصديقه لندرته أو وقعه
entries.example: She made astonishing progress in only three months.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of great surprise.
entries.arabicMeaning: دهشة شديدة
entries.example: They stared in astonishment at the empty stage.

entries.definitionEn: Away from the right path or the intended place.
entries.arabicMeaning: على غير هدى؛ في غير موضعه المقصود
entries.example: One letter went astray and never reached the office.

entries.definitionEn: A liquid that tightens the skin or helps stop slight bleeding.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستحضر قابض يشد البشرة أو يحدّ من نزيف خفيف
entries.example: The barber used an astringent after the close shave.

entries.definitionEn: A person who travels in a spacecraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائد فضاء
entries.example: The astronaut described the view of Earth from space.

entries.definitionEn: A scientist who studies stars, planets, and other objects in space.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم فلك
entries.example: The astronomer spent the night at the mountain observatory.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of stars, planets, and space.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الفلك
entries.example: She took an evening class in astronomy.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show a place, a time, or an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر للمكان أو الوقت أو النشاط
entries.example: I will wait at the bus stop at seven.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is trained in sports, especially running, jumping, or throwing.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضي مدرَّب، ولا سيما في الجري أو القفز أو الرمي
entries.example: The athlete stretched carefully before the race.

entries.definitionEn: Physically strong and good at sports. Also relating to athletes.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضي البنية أو متعلق بالرياضيين
entries.example: He has an athletic build from years of swimming.

entries.definitionEn: Physical strength, speed, and skill in sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة رياضية تجمع القوة والسرعة والمهارة
entries.example: The performance combined grace with raw athleticism.

entries.definitionEn: Sports that include running, jumping, and throwing, often at a track.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألعاب القوى من جري وقفز ورمي
entries.example: School athletics take place on the field behind the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the Atlantic Ocean, between the Americas, Europe, and Africa.
entries.arabicMeaning: أطلسي؛ متعلق بالمحيط الأطلسي
entries.example: Cold Atlantic winds reached the western coast.

entries.definitionEn: The mixture of gases around the Earth. Also the feeling or mood in a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغلاف الجوي؛ كذلك الجوّ العام في مكان
entries.example: The café had a warm, quiet atmosphere.

entries.definitionEn: Creating a particular mood, especially a striking or mysterious one. Also relating to the Earth's atmosphere.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخلق مزاجًا خاصًا؛ كذلك متعلق بالغلاف الجوي
entries.example: Low lights made the room feel atmospheric.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest unit of a chemical element that can take part in a chemical change.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذرة؛ أصغر وحدة لعنصر كيميائي
entries.example: Everything around us is made of atoms.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to atoms, or to the energy produced from them.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذريّ؛ متعلق بالذرات أو بطاقتها
entries.example: The diagram shows the atomic structure of carbon.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten or join one thing to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت أو يُرفق شيئًا بآخر
entries.example: Please attach the form to your email.

entries.definitionEn: Joined to something. Also feeling fond of a person or a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرفق أو مربوط؛ كذلك متعلق عاطفيًا بشخص أو مكان
entries.example: He became attached to the quiet street where he grew up.

entries.definitionEn: Something joined to something else, such as a file sent with an email. Also a feeling of fondness.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرفق كملف مع رسالة؛ كذلك تعلق عاطفي
entries.example: I sent the photos as an email attachment.

entries.definitionEn: A violent attempt to hurt a person or damage a place. Also a sudden start of illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: هجوم عنيف؛ كذلك نوبة مرض مفاجئة
entries.example: Their attack in the second half surprised the other team.

entries.definitionEn: To try to hurt someone or damage something with force. Also to criticize strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهاجم بقوة؛ كذلك ينتقد بحدة
entries.example: The other team attacked from the first minute.

entries.definitionEn: To succeed in getting or reaching something, usually after effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبلغ غاية أو يحرزها بعد جهد
entries.example: She attained a high score on the final exam.

entries.definitionEn: Possible to achieve.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للبلوغ أو التحقيق
entries.example: With a clear plan, the target is attainable this year.

entries.definitionEn: An act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاولة لفعل شيء، ولا سيما إذا كان صعبًا
entries.example: This is my second attempt at baking bread.

entries.definitionEn: To try to do something, especially something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحاول فعل شيء صعب
entries.example: They attempted to repair the roof before the rain.

entries.definitionEn: To go to an event, meeting, or place, often regularly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحضر حدثًا أو اجتماعًا أو مكانًا
entries.example: More than two hundred people attended the lecture.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of being present. Also the number of people present.
entries.arabicMeaning: حضور؛ كذلك عدد الحاضرين
entries.example: Attendance at the evening class has risen this term.

entries.definitionEn: The act of watching, listening, or thinking carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتباه وتركيز
entries.example: Please pay attention to the safety instructions.

entries.definitionEn: Watching or listening carefully. Also noticing what someone needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتبه؛ يلاحظ ما يحتاجه الآخر
entries.example: The waiter was polite and attentive all evening.

entries.definitionEn: In a careful, listening way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بانتباه وتركيز
entries.example: The students listened attentively to the guest speaker.

entries.definitionEn: The way you think and feel about someone or something, which shows in how you behave.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقف ذهني أو طريقة تفكير تظهر في السلوك
entries.example: She has a positive attitude toward hard work.

entries.definitionEn: To pull someone or something toward you. Also to make people interested.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجذب شخصًا أو شيئًا؛ كذلك يثير الاهتمام
entries.example: Bright colours attract insects to the flowers.

entries.definitionEn: A place or thing that people want to visit. Also a feeling of liking or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: مَعْلَم يجذب الزوار؛ كذلك ميل أو إعجاب
entries.example: The old castle is the town's main attraction.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant to look at. Also interesting or worth having.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذاب المنظر؛ كذلك مرغوب أو مُغرٍ
entries.example: They made an attractive offer on the house.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being pleasant to look at or appealing.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجاذبية في المنظر أو الإغراء
entries.example: The attractiveness of the old square brings many walkers.

entries.definitionEn: A quality or feature of a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمة أو خاصية في شخص أو شيء
entries.example: Patience is an important attribute in teaching.

entries.definitionEn: To say that something is caused by a particular person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسب أمرًا إلى سبب أو شخص معيّن
entries.example: They attribute the delay to a fault on the line.

entries.definitionEn: Used of an adjective that comes before the noun it describes, as in a cold wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعتي؛ يوصف به النعت الواقع قبل الاسم
entries.example: In grammar class we learned that an attributive adjective stands before the noun.

entries.definitionEn: The gradual wearing down of strength, numbers, or resources. Also the process of staff leaving over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: استنزاف تدريجي للقوة أو العدد؛ كذلك تسرّب الموظفين مع الوقت
entries.example: Staff attrition left the small clinic short of nurses.

entries.definitionEn: Able to notice and respond well to a particular feeling, need, or signal.
entries.arabicMeaning: منسجم ومتأهب لإدراك شعور أو حاجة أو إشارة
entries.example: A good editor is attuned to small shifts in tone.

entries.definitionEn: Not typical; different from what is usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير نمطي؛ مخالف للمعتاد
entries.example: This quiet winter is atypical for the region.

entries.definitionEn: A shiny purple vegetable, also called eggplant.
entries.arabicMeaning: باذنجان
entries.example: Slice the aubergine and cook it slowly in olive oil.

entries.definitionEn: The people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, or programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمهور يشاهد أو يستمع
entries.example: The audience laughed at the first joke.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to recorded or transmitted sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوتي؛ متعلق بالصوت المسجَّل أو المنقول
entries.example: The audio quality on this recording is very clear.

entries.definitionEn: To examine accounts, systems, or processes officially in order to check that they are correct.
entries.arabicMeaning: يراجع الحسابات أو الأنظمة رسميًا للتحقق من صحتها
entries.example: An outside firm will audit the charity's accounts this spring.

entries.definitionEn: A short performance given to try to get a role in a play, film, or band.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجربة أداء قصيرة لنيل دور أو مكان في فرقة
entries.example: She has an audition for the choir on Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: The eighth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: أغسطس / آب؛ الشهر الثامن من السنة
entries.example: We usually take our holiday in August.

entries.definitionEn: The sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمة أو خالة، أو زوجة العم أو الخال
entries.example: My aunt lives in a small town by the river.

entries.definitionEn: Very simple and plain, with little comfort or decoration. Also morally strict.
entries.arabicMeaning: صارم زاهد في الزينة والراحة؛ كذلك متشدد خُلقيًا
entries.example: The room was austere, with white walls and one wooden chair.

entries.definitionEn: In a plain, strict, and unadorned way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصرامة وزهد في الزينة
entries.example: The hall was austerely furnished, with benches along the walls.

entries.definitionEn: A plain, strict way of living with little spending or comfort.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقشف؛ عيش شديد البساطة وقليل النفقة
entries.example: The monks chose a life of austerity in the mountain house.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being genuine, not copied or fake.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصالة؛ كون الشيء حقيقيًا غير مزيف
entries.example: Experts checked the authenticity of the old painting.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes a book, article, or similar work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلف كتاب أو مقال
entries.example: The author signed copies of her new novel.

entries.definitionEn: Sounding or looking as if you have knowledge and should be believed. Also having official power.
entries.arabicMeaning: موثوق ذو حجة؛ كذلك ذو سلطة رسمية
entries.example: She gave an authoritative account of the accident.

entries.definitionEn: The power to make decisions and to be obeyed. Also an official organization with that power.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلطة اتخاذ القرار؛ كذلك هيئة رسمية تملك هذه السلطة
entries.example: Only the head teacher has the authority to close the school.

entries.definitionEn: To give official permission for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرّح رسميًا بفعل شيء
entries.example: The manager authorized the extra payment.

entries.definitionEn: To make a machine or computer do a job instead of a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤتمت عملًا فيتولاه جهاز أو حاسوب بدل الإنسان
entries.example: The warehouse will automate the sorting of parcels next year.

entries.definitionEn: Working by itself, without a person controlling each step.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلقائي يعمل وحده دون تحكم في كل خطوة
entries.example: The doors are automatic and open when you walk up to them.

entries.definitionEn: To set a process or machine so that it continues by itself, without further control.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل عملية أو آلة تسير تلقائيًا دون تدخل لاحق
entries.example: They plan to automatic invoice reminders so staff do not send them by hand.

entries.definitionEn: Able to make decisions and act independently, without being controlled by others.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستقل ذاتيًا في القرار والعمل
entries.example: The region became more autonomous after the new law.

entries.definitionEn: Independently, without needing outside control or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة مستقلة، من دون حاجة إلى توجيه خارجي
entries.example: Once programmed, the irrigation valves adjust autonomously.

entries.definitionEn: A system that steers an aircraft or vehicle without constant human control. Informal use also describes doing something without thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطيار الآلي؛ نظام يقود المركبة من دون تحكم بشري متواصل
entries.example: The aircraft stayed on autopilot for most of the night flight.

entries.definitionEn: The season between summer and winter, when leaves often change colour and fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخريف
entries.example: The park is quiet and gold in autumn.

entries.definitionEn: Giving extra help or support, rather than being the main thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساعد أو إضافي يُستخدم للدعم لا كعنصر أساسي
entries.example: The hospital opened an auxiliary clinic during the busy season.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of being free to be used, obtained, or spoken to.
entries.arabicMeaning: التوافر؛ إمكان الحصول على شيء أو استخدامه أو التحدث إلى شخص
entries.example: Please check room availability before you book.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be used, bought, or spoken to at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: متاح للاستعمال أو الشراء أو الحديث
entries.example: The manager is not available this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A wide street in a town, often lined with trees.
entries.arabicMeaning: جادة؛ شارع عريض في مدينة، كثيرًا ما تُحيط به الأشجار
entries.example: Their office is on a quiet avenue near the park.

entries.definitionEn: Typical or ordinary; not very high and not very low.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوسط أو عادي، لا مرتفع جدًا ولا منخفض جدًا
entries.example: It was an average meal, neither good nor bad.

entries.definitionEn: A usual or middle amount, often found by adding numbers and dividing.
entries.arabicMeaning: المتوسط أو المعدّل؛ مقدار وسط يُحسب غالبًا بجمع الأرقام ثم القسمة
entries.example: The average of 4, 6, and 8 is 6.

entries.definitionEn: Strongly unwilling or opposed, usually in the phrase averse to.
entries.arabicMeaning: نافر من أمر أو كاره له، ويغلب في averse to
entries.example: He is averse to taking unnecessary risks.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to birds.
entries.arabicMeaning: طيوري؛ منسوب إلى الطيور
entries.example: The laboratory studies avian influenza in wild flocks.

entries.definitionEn: Showing keen interest or enthusiasm for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مولع بشيء أو شديد الحماسة له
entries.example: She is an avid reader of travel writing.

entries.definitionEn: To stay away from someone or something, or to try not to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجنّب شخصًا أو شيئًا، أو يحاول ألا يفعل أمرًا
entries.example: I avoid that road in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: To wait for something that is expected to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتظر أمرًا يُتوقع حدوثه
entries.example: We await the test results on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Not sleeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستيقظ
entries.example: The baby is still awake.

entries.definitionEn: A prize given to someone for good work or success in a competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: جائزة تُمنح لعمل جيد أو تفوّق في مسابقة
entries.example: She won an award for her short film.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a prize, money, or an official honour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنح شخصًا جائزة أو مالًا أو تكريمًا رسميًا
entries.example: The panel awarded first prize to a young pianist.

entries.definitionEn: Knowing that something exists or is happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرك أو عالم بوجود شيء أو بحدوثه
entries.example: I was not aware of the change in the timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Knowledge or understanding that something exists or is important.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعي أو إدراك بوجود أمر أو بأهميته
entries.example: The campaign raised awareness of heart disease.

entries.definitionEn: To or in another place; not here or not at home.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيدًا؛ في مكان آخر أو غير موجود هنا
entries.example: They are away until Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of great respect mixed with wonder or slight fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: رهبة ممزوجة بالإعجاب أو بشيء من الخشية
entries.example: The crowd watched the eclipse in awe.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone with wonder and deep respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملأ شخصًا إعجابًا عميقًا مشوبًا بالرهبة
entries.example: The scale of the canyon awed the hikers.

entries.definitionEn: Very impressive. In informal speech, extremely good.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير لإعجاب شديد؛ وفي الكلام العادي: رائع جدًا
entries.example: The view from the ridge was awesome.

entries.definitionEn: Very bad or unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ جدًا أو كريه
entries.example: The coffee tasted awful.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel uncomfortable, or difficult to deal with because of shape or social tension.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُحرِج أو غير مريح، أو صعب التعامل معه لشكله أو لحساسية الموقف
entries.example: There was an awkward silence after the question.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a heavy metal blade and a long handle, used for cutting wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: فأس؛ أداة ذات نصل معدني ثقيل ومقبض طويل لقطع الخشب
entries.example: He split the logs with an axe.

entries.definitionEn: A statement accepted as true without proof and used as a starting point for further thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلَّمة؛ قضية تُقبل بلا برهان وتُتخذ منطلقًا للتفكير
entries.example: It is an axiom of the model that total energy is conserved.

entries.definitionEn: So clearly true that it needs no proof.
entries.arabicMeaning: بديهي لا يحتاج إلى إثبات
entries.example: It is axiomatic that a contract needs clear terms.

entries.definitionEn: An imaginary line through the centre of an object, around which it turns.
entries.arabicMeaning: محور؛ خط وهمي يمر بمركز الجسم ويدور حوله
entries.example: The Earth turns on its axis.

entries.definitionEn: To talk quickly and unclearly, so that the words are hard to follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهذي أو يتكلم بسرعة وغموض يصعب معهما متابعة الكلام
entries.example: She babbled an apology and left the room.

entries.definitionEn: A very young child.
entries.arabicMeaning: رضيع؛ طفل صغير جدًا
entries.example: The baby is sleeping.

entries.definitionEn: To look after a child while the parents are out.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجلس مع طفل ويعتني به في غياب الأبوين
entries.example: Can you babysit on Saturday evening?

entries.definitionEn: A person who looks after a child while the parents are out.
entries.arabicMeaning: جليسة أطفال؛ من يعتني بالطفل في غياب الأبوين
entries.example: We hired a babysitter for the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: At the rear of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلفي؛ في مؤخرة الشيء
entries.example: Please use the back door.

entries.definitionEn: To the place or situation you were in before; in the opposite direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائدًا إلى المكان أو الحال السابقة؛ أو في الاتجاه المعاكس
entries.example: Please come back at three.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body opposite the chest, from the neck down to the waist.
entries.arabicMeaning: الظهر
entries.example: My back hurts after the long drive.

entries.definitionEn: To give support to a person, idea, or plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدعم شخصًا أو فكرة أو خطة
entries.example: Several neighbours backed her plan.

entries.definitionEn: Pain in the back.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم في الظهر
entries.example: He stayed home because of backache.

entries.definitionEn: A person's past family, education, and experience. Also the part of a picture behind the main subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخلفية: ماضي الشخص من أسرة وتعليم وخبرة، أو ما يظهر خلف الموضوع في صورة
entries.example: She has a background in graphic design.

entries.definitionEn: A bag with straps that you carry on your back.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيبة ظهر
entries.example: He packed a water bottle in his backpack.

entries.definitionEn: A person who travels with a backpack, usually on a low budget.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسافر يحمل حقيبة ظهر، وغالبًا بميزانية محدودة
entries.example: The hostel was full of backpackers from many countries.

entries.definitionEn: Travel in which you carry your belongings in a backpack, often cheaply and for some time.
entries.arabicMeaning: السفر بحقيبة الظهر، غالبًا بكلفة زهيدة ولفترة ممتدة
entries.example: They saved for a summer of backpacking in Portugal.

entries.definitionEn: An extra copy of data, or extra help ready if the first plan fails.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة احتياطية من البيانات، أو دعم جاهز إن أخفق الترتيب الأول
entries.example: Keep a backup of your files on an external drive.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the back, or in the reverse direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الخلف أو في الاتجاه المعاكس
entries.example: She glanced backwards before crossing the street.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land behind a house, used for sitting or play.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفناء الخلفي للمنزل
entries.example: The children played in the backyard until dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Salted or smoked meat from the back or sides of a pig, usually eaten in thin slices.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم خنزير مقدَّد أو مدخَّن، يُؤكل عادةً شرائح رقيقة
entries.example: She fried eggs and bacon for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: Not good; of low quality, or likely to cause harm or trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ؛ رديء أو مضر أو يسبب مشكلة
entries.example: The milk is bad; do not drink it.

entries.definitionEn: Easily becoming angry or impatient.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ المزاج؛ سريع الغضب أو الضيق
entries.example: He gets bad-tempered when he is hungry.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece of metal or plastic worn to show identity, rank, or membership.
entries.arabicMeaning: شارة تُلبس للدلالة على الهوية أو الرتبة أو العضوية
entries.example: The guard wore a name badge on his jacket.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not good, or to a serious degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل سيئ، أو إلى درجة شديدة
entries.example: The door was badly painted.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which players hit a light shuttlecock over a high net with rackets.
entries.arabicMeaning: الريشة الطائرة
entries.example: We play badminton at the sports centre on Thursdays.

entries.definitionEn: A container made of paper, cloth, or plastic, used for carrying things.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيس أو حقيبة لحمل الأشياء
entries.example: She put the apples in a bag.

entries.definitionEn: The bags and cases you take with you when you travel.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمتعة السفر
entries.example: Please collect your baggage from belt four.

entries.definitionEn: To cook food in an oven, using dry heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبز الطعام في فرن بحرارة جافة
entries.example: I bake bread on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make bread and cakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبّاز
entries.example: The baker opens the shop at six.

entries.definitionEn: A shop or place where bread and cakes are made or sold.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخبز؛ مكان يُصنع فيه الخبز والكعك أو يُباع
entries.example: There is a bakery on the corner.

entries.definitionEn: A state in which things are equal or a person or object stays steady.
entries.arabicMeaning: توازن؛ حال اعتدال أو ثبات لا يميل معها الشيء أو الشخص
entries.example: She lost her balance on the ice.

entries.definitionEn: To keep steady, or to give fair attention to different things.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوازن شيئًا ليثبت، أو يوزّع الاهتمام بعدل بين أمور مختلفة
entries.example: He balanced the tray on one hand.

entries.definitionEn: Fair and well mixed, with the right amount of each part.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوازن؛ عادل التوزيع وفيه المقدار المناسب من كل جزء
entries.example: Try to eat a balanced diet.

entries.definitionEn: A platform with a wall or rail, built out from the wall of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرفة بارزة من جدار المبنى
entries.example: We had breakfast on the balcony.

entries.definitionEn: Having little or no hair on the head.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصلع؛ قليل شعر الرأس أو معدوم
entries.example: He has been bald since his thirties.

entries.definitionEn: To lose hair from the head; to become bald.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصلع؛ يفقد شعر رأسه
entries.example: He started to bald in his late twenties.

entries.definitionEn: In a blunt, plain way, with no softening words.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوضوح جاف بلا تلطيف
entries.example: She stated baldly that the plan would fail.

entries.definitionEn: Unwilling to move or work as expected; stubborn, often of a machine or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعنت؛ يرفض الحركة أو العمل كما يُتوقع، وكثيرًا ما يوصف به جهاز أو حيوان
entries.example: The balky lock would not turn.

entries.definitionEn: A round object used in games, or any object with that shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة؛ جسم مستدير يُلعب به أو أي شيء بهذا الشكل
entries.example: The children kicked a ball in the park.

entries.definitionEn: A song or poem that tells a story, often slow and emotional.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصيدة أو أغنية سردية، كثيرًا ما تكون بطيئة وعاطفية
entries.example: The singer performed a slow ballad.

entries.definitionEn: A type of dancing that uses precise, graceful movements, often to tell a story on stage.
entries.arabicMeaning: الباليه؛ رقص دقيق رشيق يُروى به قصة على المسرح غالبًا
entries.example: She has studied ballet since childhood.

entries.definitionEn: A small rubber bag filled with air or gas, used as a toy or decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالون؛ كيس مطاطي صغير يُملأ هواءً أو غازًا للعب أو الزينة
entries.example: The child held a red balloon.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper used for secret voting, or the system of voting in that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورقة اقتراع سرّي، أو نظام التصويت بهذه الطريقة
entries.example: Voters marked their choice on the ballot.

entries.definitionEn: An official rule that stops people from doing or using something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظر رسمي يمنع فعلًا أو استعمالًا
entries.example: There is a ban on smoking indoors.

entries.definitionEn: To say officially that something is not allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحظر أمرًا حظرًا رسميًا
entries.example: The city banned plastic bags last year.

entries.definitionEn: A long curved fruit with a yellow skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: موزة؛ ثمرة طويلة مقوّسة ذات قشرة صفراء
entries.example: I eat a banana every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who play music together.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرقة موسيقية
entries.example: The band played until midnight.

entries.definitionEn: A strip of cloth used to cover and protect a wound.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمادة؛ شريط قماش يُغطى به الجرح ويُحمى
entries.example: The nurse wrapped a bandage around his wrist.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden loud noise, like a door slamming or something exploding.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوي مفاجئ، كصوت باب يُغلق بعنف أو شيء ينفجر
entries.example: We heard a loud bang in the street.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something hard so that it makes a loud noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب شيئًا بقوة فيُحدث صوتًا عاليًا
entries.example: Don't bang the door when you leave.

entries.definitionEn: To force someone to leave a place as a punishment, or to try to get rid of a thought or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفي شخصًا أو يطرده عقابًا، أو يسعى إلى طرد خاطر أو شعور
entries.example: The club banished him after repeated warnings.

entries.definitionEn: The act of sending someone away from a place and forbidding their return.
entries.arabicMeaning: النفي؛ إبعاد شخص عن مكان ومنعه من العودة
entries.example: His banishment from the court lasted ten years.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement with a bank for keeping and using your money.
entries.arabicMeaning: حساب مصرفي لحفظ المال واستخدامه
entries.example: I opened a bank account when I started work.

entries.definitionEn: A business that keeps your money, pays it out, and can lend money.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصرف؛ مؤسسة تحفظ المال وتخرجه ويمكنها إقراضه
entries.example: I need to go to the bank this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To put money into a bank, or to have an account at a particular bank.
entries.arabicMeaning: يودع مالًا في مصرف، أو يتعامل مع مصرف معيّن
entries.example: She banks her salary on the last Friday of the month.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works in a senior job at a bank.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصرفي؛ من يعمل في منصب مهم في مصرف
entries.example: Her father worked as a banker in the city.

entries.definitionEn: The business of banks; the work of keeping, lending, and moving money.
entries.arabicMeaning: العمل المصرفي؛ حفظ المال وإقراضه وتحويله
entries.example: He wants to study banking at university.

entries.definitionEn: To make a person or company unable to pay their debts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُفلس شخصًا أو شركة فيعجزون عن سداد الديون
entries.example: The lawsuit nearly bankrupted the small firm.

entries.definitionEn: The legal state of being unable to pay your debts.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإفلاس؛ حال قانونية يعجز فيها المرء عن سداد ديونه
entries.example: The company filed for bankruptcy in March.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people buy drinks, especially alcoholic drinks.
entries.arabicMeaning: حانة؛ مكان تُشترى فيه المشروبات ولا سيما الكحولية
entries.example: They met at a bar near the station.

entries.definitionEn: To officially prevent someone from entering a place or doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنع شخصًا رسميًا من دخول مكان أو من فعل شيء
entries.example: Guards barred reporters from the hall.

entries.definitionEn: A meal cooked outdoors over a fire, or the metal frame used to cook it.
entries.arabicMeaning: شواء في الهواء الطلق، أو الإطار المعدني المستعمل لذلك
entries.example: We had a barbecue in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: To cook food outdoors on a metal frame over a fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشوي الطعام في الهواء الطلق على إطار معدني فوق النار
entries.example: They barbecued chicken for the guests.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to cut men's hair and sometimes shave beards.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلّاق، وخاصّة من يقص شعر الرجال وقد يحلق اللحى
entries.example: He goes to the barber every month.

entries.definitionEn: A shop where a barber cuts hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: محل حلاقة
entries.example: The barbershop on the corner is always busy.

entries.definitionEn: Not covered by clothes, leaves, or other covering; with nothing extra.
entries.arabicMeaning: عارٍ أو مكشوف؛ خالٍ مما يستره أو مما يزيد عليه
entries.example: The walls were bare except for one photograph.

entries.definitionEn: To uncover something; to show what was hidden.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكشف شيئًا أو يُظهر ما كان مستورًا
entries.example: The dog bared its teeth.

entries.definitionEn: Only just; almost not.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالكاد؛ على نحو لا يكاد يتم
entries.example: We barely arrived in time.

entries.definitionEn: Something you buy for less than the usual price.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفقة رابحة؛ شيء يُشترى بأقل من سعره المعتاد
entries.example: This coat was a bargain in the sale.

entries.definitionEn: To discuss the price of something in order to agree on a lower one.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساوم على السعر ليُتفق على ثمن أدنى
entries.example: She bargained with the stallholder over the price.

entries.definitionEn: The hard outer covering of a tree.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحاء الشجرة؛ قشرتها الخارجية الصلبة
entries.example: The bark of the oak was thick and rough.

entries.definitionEn: To make the short, loud sound that a dog makes. Also to speak in a sharp, loud voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينبح كما ينبح الكلب، أو يكلم بصوت حاد مرتفع
entries.example: The dog barked at the postman.

entries.definitionEn: A grain used for food and for making beer and some spirits.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشعير؛ حبّ يُستخدم طعامًا وفي صناعة البيرة وبعض المشروبات
entries.example: Farmers grow barley in this valley.

entries.definitionEn: A man whose job is to serve drinks in a bar.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادل الحانة الرجل
entries.example: The barman poured two glasses of water.

entries.definitionEn: A large farm building used for animals, tools, or harvested crops.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظيرة أو مخزن زراعي كبير للحيوانات أو الأدوات أو المحاصيل
entries.example: They stored hay in the barn.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the richly decorated European style of art and music of the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries.
entries.arabicMeaning: باروكي؛ منسوب إلى الطراز الأوروبي الغني بالزخرفة في الفن والموسيقى في القرن السابع عشر وأوائل الثامن عشر
entries.example: The palace is famous for its baroque interior.

entries.definitionEn: A large round container, usually of wood or metal, for liquids or other goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: برميل؛ وعاء مستدير كبير من خشب أو معدن للسوائل أو غيرها
entries.example: Oil is often stored in a barrel.

entries.definitionEn: Too poor to produce plants or fruit; empty of life or useful results.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاحل لا يُنبت زرعًا، أو خالٍ من الحياة أو من ثمرة نافعة
entries.example: Nothing grew on the barren hillside.

entries.definitionEn: A fence or other object that stops people moving forward. Also something that makes progress difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاجز يمنع التقدم، أو عائق يصعّب إحراز تقدّم
entries.example: A barrier blocked the road after the flood.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to serve drinks in a bar.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادل الحانة
entries.example: The bartender wiped the counter and took our order.

entries.definitionEn: The lowest part of something, that it stands on. Also the main place from which work is done.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة الشيء التي يقوم عليها، أو المقر الرئيسي الذي يُنجز منه العمل
entries.example: The lamp has a heavy metal base.

entries.definitionEn: To use something as the main idea or starting point, usually with on.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبني أمرًا على أساس معيّن، ويغلب أن يُستعمل مع on
entries.example: The film is based on a true story.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two teams hit a ball with a bat and run around four bases.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيسبول؛ لعبة يضرب فيها فريقان كرة بمضرب ويدوران حول أربع قواعد
entries.example: The children played baseball after school.

entries.definitionEn: A room or floor of a building that is partly or wholly below ground level.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبو أو طابق سفلي تحت مستوى الأرض كله أو بعضه
entries.example: We keep old boxes in the basement.

entries.definitionEn: Simple and most important; forming the first level of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساسي وبسيط؛ يشكّل المستوى الأول من شيء
entries.example: I have a basic knowledge of Spanish.

entries.definitionEn: Used to give the simplest or most important point, without extra detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأساس؛ لتقديم الفكرة الأهم أو الأبسط من دون تفصيل زائد
entries.example: Basically, we need more time.

entries.definitionEn: A round open bowl for holding water, especially for washing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوض مفتوح مستدير للماء، ولا سيما للغسل
entries.example: Wash your hands in the basin.

entries.definitionEn: The main reason, idea, or system that something is built on.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأساس الذي يُبنى عليه أمر من علة أو فكرة أو نظام
entries.example: We meet on a weekly basis.

entries.definitionEn: A container made of thin pieces of wood, plastic, or wire, used for carrying things.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلة تُصنع من شرائح رقيقة من خشب أو بلاستيك أو سلك لحمل الأشياء
entries.example: She carried a basket of fruit.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two teams try to throw a large ball through a high ring.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة السلة
entries.example: He plays basketball twice a week.

entries.definitionEn: A small flying animal that is active at night and has wings of skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: خفّاش؛ حيوان طائر صغير ينشط ليلًا وجناحاه من الجلد
entries.example: A bat flew out of the cave at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: To hit a ball with a bat in a sport such as baseball or cricket.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب الكرة بالمضرب في رياضة كالبيسبول أو الكريكيت
entries.example: She batted the ball into the outfield.

entries.definitionEn: A group of things made, cooked, or dealt with at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفعة من الأشياء تُصنع أو تُطبخ أو تُعالَج معًا
entries.example: I baked a batch of cookies.

entries.definitionEn: A wash of your whole body in a large container of water, or that container itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: استحمام في حوض ماء كبير، أو الحوض نفسه
entries.example: She had a hot bath after work.

entries.definitionEn: To wash yourself or someone else in a bath, or to swim for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحم أو يغسل غيره في حوض، أو يسبح للمتعة
entries.example: They bathe in the lake in summer.

entries.definitionEn: A public building where people go to wash or take a steam bath.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمّام عام يُغتسل فيه أو يُؤخذ فيه بخار
entries.example: The old bathhouse still has steam rooms.

entries.definitionEn: A room with a toilet, and often a bath or shower.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمّام؛ غرفة فيها مرحاض وكثيرًا ما يكون فيها حوض أو دش
entries.example: The bathroom is at the end of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: A thin mixture of flour, eggs, and liquid used to coat food before frying.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجينة سائلة من دقيق وبيض وسائل يُغلف بها الطعام قبل القلي
entries.example: Dip the fish in batter before you fry it.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something hard again and again; to damage it by heavy use or weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب شيئًا بعنف متكرر، أو يتلفه من شدة الاستعمال أو من تقلّب الجو
entries.example: Waves battered the harbour wall all night.

entries.definitionEn: Damaged, worn, or injured by repeated blows or hard use.
entries.arabicMeaning: متهالك أو مصاب من تكرار الضرب أو شدة الاستعمال
entries.example: He wore a battered leather jacket.

entries.definitionEn: A fight between armies or groups, or a long struggle against a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: معركة بين جيوش أو جماعات، أو كفاح طويل ضد مشكلة
entries.example: The battle lasted from dawn until night.

entries.definitionEn: The piece of ground where a battle is fought.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحة المعركة
entries.example: Historians walked the old battlefield in silence.

entries.definitionEn: A cheap, showy ornament of little real value.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلية رخيصة لامعة قليلة القيمة الحقيقية
entries.example: She hung a glass bauble on the tree.

entries.definitionEn: A wide curve of the coast where the sea comes in.
entries.arabicMeaning: خليج؛ انحناء واسع في الساحل يدخل إليه البحر
entries.example: The hotel looks over a quiet bay.

entries.definitionEn: An auxiliary verb used with another verb to make continuous tenses or the passive. Forms include am, is, are, was, and were.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يُستعمل مع فعل آخر لتكوين الأزمنة المستمرة أو المبني للمجهول، ومن صوره am وis وare وwas وwere
entries.example: She is cooking dinner in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: An area of sand or small stones next to the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاطئ؛ أرض من رمل أو حصى صغير بجانب البحر
entries.example: We walked along the beach at sunset.

entries.definitionEn: A small hound with long ears, often kept as a pet or used for hunting by scent.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيغل؛ كلب صغير طويل الأذنين يُربى أليفًا أو يُستعمل للصيد بالرائحة
entries.example: Their beagle followed the scent across the field.

entries.definitionEn: The hard, pointed part of a bird's mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقار الطائر
entries.example: The parrot cracked the nut with its beak.

entries.definitionEn: A ray of light. Also a long strong piece of wood or metal that supports a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعاع ضوء، أو عارضة طويلة متينة من خشب أو معدن تسند البناء
entries.example: A beam of sunlight fell across the desk.

entries.definitionEn: A seed that we cook and eat, or the plant it grows on.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاصولياء أو حبّة تُطبخ وتُؤكل، أو النبات الذي تنمو عليه
entries.example: Add the beans to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: A large, strong wild animal with thick fur.
entries.arabicMeaning: دب؛ حيوان بري كبير قوي كثيف الفراء
entries.example: We saw a bear by the river.

entries.definitionEn: To accept something difficult or unpleasant; also to carry the weight of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحمّل أمرًا صعبًا أو مزعجًا، وقد يعني حمل ثقل شيء
entries.example: I cannot bear this noise.

entries.definitionEn: Hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحية
entries.example: He grew a beard during the winter.

entries.definitionEn: Having a beard.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملتحٍ؛ ذو لحية
entries.example: A bearded man opened the door.

entries.definitionEn: The connection or influence that something has on a situation. Also a person's way of standing or moving.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلة أمر بموقف أو أثره فيه؛ وقد تعني هيئة الوقوف أو المشي
entries.example: Her past work has a bearing on this decision.

entries.definitionEn: A large or wild animal. Sometimes used of a cruel person.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحش أو حيوان كبير بري؛ وقد يُطلق على شخص قاسٍ
entries.example: A lion is a powerful wild beast.

entries.definitionEn: A regular rhythm, especially in music or of the heart.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيقاع منتظم، ولا سيما في الموسيقى أو في نبض القلب
entries.example: Dance to the beat of the music.

entries.definitionEn: To defeat someone in a game, fight, or competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهزم شخصًا في لعبة أو قتال أو مسابقة
entries.example: Our team beat them by two goals.

entries.definitionEn: Very nice to look at or listen to.
entries.arabicMeaning: جميل المنظر أو الصوت
entries.example: The garden is beautiful in spring.

entries.definitionEn: In a very attractive or skilful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجمال أو بمهارة عالية
entries.example: She sings beautifully.

entries.definitionEn: To make a place or thing more attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمّل مكانًا أو شيئًا
entries.example: The city planted trees to beautify the square.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being beautiful.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجمال
entries.example: Everyone talked about the beauty of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A furry animal that lives by water and builds dams from wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: قندس؛ حيوان فروي يعيش عند الماء ويبني سدودًا من الخشب
entries.example: A beaver built a dam across the stream.

entries.definitionEn: Used to join a reason to the statement before it.
entries.arabicMeaning: لأن؛ حرف يربط جملة السبب بما قبلها
entries.example: She left early because she felt ill.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun phrase to show the reason for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسبب؛ تُستعمل قبل اسم لتبيان العلة
entries.example: The match was cancelled because of rain.

entries.definitionEn: To begin to be something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصبح؛ يصير
entries.example: The weather became cold in the evening.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture that you sleep on.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرير
entries.example: I go to bed at ten.

entries.definitionEn: A room used for sleeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة نوم
entries.example: The bedroom has two windows.

entries.definitionEn: The area beside a bed, often used of a table or of staying near someone who is ill.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب السرير، وكثيرًا ما يُراد به طاولة هناك أو المكث قرب مريض
entries.example: She sat at his bedside all night.

entries.definitionEn: A flying insect that makes honey and can sting.
entries.arabicMeaning: نحلة
entries.example: A bee landed on the flower.

entries.definitionEn: Meat from a cow.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم بقر
entries.example: We cooked beef with rice.

entries.definitionEn: The past participle of be, used with have or has to talk about experience or a completed state.
entries.arabicMeaning: التصريف الثالث لفعل be، يُستعمل مع have أو has للحديث عن تجربة أو حال مكتملة
entries.example: I have been to this museum before.

entries.definitionEn: An alcoholic drink made from grain.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيرة؛ شراب كحولي يُصنع من الحبوب
entries.example: He ordered a glass of beer.

entries.definitionEn: At an earlier time; in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: من قبل؛ في وقت سابق
entries.example: I have never been here before.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that one action or event happens earlier than another.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبل أن؛ تربط حدثًا يسبق حدثًا آخر
entries.example: Wash your hands before you eat.

entries.definitionEn: Earlier than a time or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبل وقت أو حدث
entries.example: Please arrive before noon.

entries.definitionEn: In advance; earlier than a particular event.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسبقًا؛ قبل الحدث المعيّن
entries.example: Let me know beforehand if you cannot come.

entries.definitionEn: To ask for something in a strong, urgent way, because you want or need it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوسّل أو يطلب بإلحاح لحاجة أو رغبة شديدة
entries.example: I beg you to listen for a moment.

entries.definitionEn: To start to do something, or to start happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدأ فعل شيء أو يبدأ حدوثه
entries.example: We begin work at nine.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is starting to learn or do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبتدئ
entries.example: This class is for beginners.

entries.definitionEn: The first part of something; the time when something starts.
entries.arabicMeaning: البداية؛ الجزء الأول أو وقت الشروع
entries.example: I liked the book from the beginning.

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in a way that charms, and may slightly deceive.
entries.arabicMeaning: آسر يستهوي، وقد يخدع بلطف
entries.example: The garden had a beguiling quiet.

entries.definitionEn: In a charming way that can also mislead a little.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو آسر قد يضلّل قليلًا
entries.example: He smiled beguilingly and changed the subject.

entries.definitionEn: Used in the phrase on behalf of to mean acting for someone else, or for their benefit.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُستعمل في on behalf of بمعنى النيابة عن شخص أو العمل لمصلحته
entries.example: She spoke on behalf of the whole team.

entries.definitionEn: To act in a particular way, especially well or badly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصرف على نحو معيّن، ولا سيما حسنًا أو سيئًا
entries.example: The children behaved well at the restaurant.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person or animal acts.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلوك الشخص أو الحيوان
entries.example: The dog's behaviour improved after training.

entries.definitionEn: A command or firm request, almost always in the phrase at the behest of.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر أو طلب جازم، ويغلب في at the behest of
entries.example: The report was written at the behest of the board.

entries.definitionEn: At or towards the back; remaining after others have gone.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الخلف أو إليه؛ باقيًا بعد ذهاب الآخرين
entries.example: The others walked on, but she stayed behind.

entries.definitionEn: A living person or creature.
entries.arabicMeaning: كائن حي؛ شخص أو مخلوق
entries.example: Every human being deserves respect.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling that something is true, or an idea that you hold.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتقاد راسخ بصدق شيء، أو فكرة يتمسك بها المرء
entries.example: It is my belief that she will succeed.
