entries.definitionEn: In a way that can be accepted as true or realistic.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يمكن تصديقه أو عده واقعيًا
entries.example: The actor played the role believably.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something is true, or to trust someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتقد أن شيئًا صادق، أو يثق بشخص
entries.example: I believe you.

entries.definitionEn: A hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when it is struck.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرس
entries.example: The bell rang at the end of class.

entries.definitionEn: Aggressive hostility; a readiness to fight or argue.
entries.arabicMeaning: نزعة عدائية واستعداد للخصام أو القتال
entries.example: His belligerence made the discussion harder.

entries.definitionEn: Hostile and ready to fight or argue.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدائي ميّال للنزاع أو القتال
entries.example: She grew belligerent when her figures were questioned.

entries.definitionEn: To shout in a deep, loud voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعق بصوت عميق مرتفع
entries.example: The coach bellowed instructions from the sideline.

entries.definitionEn: The front part of the body below the chest; the stomach area.
entries.arabicMeaning: البطن
entries.example: He lay on the grass on his belly.

entries.definitionEn: To be owned by someone, or to be in the right place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملكه أحد أو يكون في موضعه الصحيح
entries.example: These keys belong to the upstairs flat.

entries.definitionEn: The things that a person owns, especially those they can carry.
entries.arabicMeaning: المقتنيات الشخصية، ولا سيما ما يمكن حمله
entries.example: She packed her belongings into two suitcases.

entries.definitionEn: Greatly loved.
entries.arabicMeaning: محبوب حبًا شديدًا
entries.example: This is her beloved childhood home.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a lower place; later in a text.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأسفل أو إليه؛ أو لاحقًا في النص
entries.example: The notes below explain the symbols.

entries.definitionEn: In a lower position than something; less than a number or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحت شيء أو أدنى من رقم أو مستوى
entries.example: The temperature fell below zero.

entries.definitionEn: A long strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزام يُلبس حول الخصر
entries.example: He tightened his belt before the walk.

entries.definitionEn: A long seat for two or more people, often outdoors.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقعد طويل لشخصين أو أكثر، وكثيرًا ما يكون في العراء
entries.example: We sat on a bench in the park.

entries.definitionEn: A curve in a road, river, or object.
entries.arabicMeaning: منعطف أو انحناء في طريق أو نهر أو جسم
entries.example: Slow down at the sharp bend.

entries.definitionEn: To move part of your body so it is not straight, or to make something curved.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثني جزءًا من الجسم أو يجعل شيئًا مقوّسًا
entries.example: Bend your knees when you lift the box.

entries.definitionEn: Under something, often with a sense of being covered or lower in position.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحت شيء، وكثيرًا ما يفيد التغطية أو الدنو في الموضع
entries.example: The keys were beneath a pile of papers.

entries.definitionEn: Having a good effect; useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: نافع؛ ذو أثر حسن
entries.example: Regular walks are beneficial to health.

entries.definitionEn: A person who receives money, property, or an advantage from something such as a will or insurance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستفيد من مال أو مِلك أو ميزة، كوصية أو تأمين
entries.example: Each child is a beneficiary of the trust.

entries.definitionEn: An advantage or useful result.
entries.arabicMeaning: فائدة أو عائدة نافعة
entries.example: One benefit of cycling is lower travel costs.

entries.definitionEn: To get an advantage from something, or to give someone an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتفع من شيء أو يعود بالنفع على غيره
entries.example: Students benefit from extra practice.

entries.definitionEn: Kindness and a wish to do good for others.
entries.arabicMeaning: إحسان ورغبة في فعل الخير للآخرين
entries.example: The shelter depends on the benevolence of donors.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and wanting to help others.
entries.arabicMeaning: خير يرغب في نفع غيره
entries.example: A benevolent neighbour brought soup when she was ill.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and not intending harm. In medical use, not cancerous or dangerous.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف لا يقصد الأذى؛ وفي الطب: حميد غير خبيث ولا خطر
entries.example: The doctor said the lump was benign.

entries.definitionEn: In a kind, gentle, or harmless way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلطف أو على نحو غير مؤذٍ
entries.example: She smiled benignly at the nervous speaker.

entries.definitionEn: Not straight; curved or folded out of shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: محني أو مقوَّس عن شكله المستقيم
entries.example: The fork was bent and would not lie flat.

entries.definitionEn: To leave money, property, or another possession to someone in a will.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوصي لشخص بمال أو ممتلكات بعد وفاته
entries.example: She bequeathed her library to the local school.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking something needed or once possessed, often with a sharp sense of loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجرَّد مما كان يملكه أو يحتاجه، مع شعور بالفقدان
entries.example: After the move, he felt bereft of friends and routine.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows painful lack or emptiness after a loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يشي بالخواء أو الفقدان
entries.example: She looked around the empty room bereftly.

entries.definitionEn: A small juicy fruit that grows on a bush or tree, such as a strawberry or blueberry.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمرة صغيرة غضة تنمو على شجيرة أو شجرة
entries.example: She added a handful of berries to the yogurt.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that someone or something is next to another person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجانب؛ تستعمل للدلالة على القرب المكاني
entries.example: Please sit beside me.

entries.definitionEn: Used to add another reason or point; also; anyway.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضلاً عن ذلك؛ أيضاً
entries.example: I do not want to go out; besides, it is raining.

entries.definitionEn: In addition to; apart from.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالإضافة إلى؛ علاوة على
entries.example: Besides English, she speaks French and Arabic.

entries.definitionEn: To surround a place with force so that people cannot leave, or to crowd around someone with demands or questions.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحاصر مكاناً، أو يُضيِّق على شخص بكثرة الأسئلة والطلبات
entries.example: Reporters besieged the minister as she left the building.

entries.definitionEn: Better than all others; of the highest quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأفضل؛ الأعلى جودة
entries.example: This is the best cake I have ever eaten.

entries.definitionEn: In the most successful or suitable way; more than any other.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أفضل وجه؛ أكثر من غيره
entries.example: I work best in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: To give something valuable, such as an honour or a gift, to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنح شخصاً شيئاً ثميناً كتكريم أو هبة
entries.example: The university bestowed an honorary degree on the scientist.

entries.definitionEn: A book or other product that sells in very large numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتاب أو منتج واسع الرواج
entries.example: Her first novel became a bestseller within a month.

entries.definitionEn: To risk money on the result of a race or game. Also used to say you are fairly sure of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يراهن بالمال على نتيجة، أو يعبّر عن ثقته بحدوث أمر
entries.example: I bet they will arrive before six.

entries.definitionEn: To harm someone who trusts you by breaking a promise or helping their enemies. Also, to show a feeling you wanted to hide.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخون ثقة شخص، أو يفضح شعوراً أراد إخفاءه
entries.example: He refused to betray his friend's secret.

entries.definitionEn: Of a higher quality or more suitable. Also, less ill than before.
entries.arabicMeaning: أفضل جودة أو أنسب؛ أو أحسن حالاً بعد مرض
entries.example: I feel better after a good night's sleep.

entries.definitionEn: In a more successful, complete, or suitable way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل أفضل
entries.example: She sings better than I do.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show the space, time, or relation that separates two people, places, or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: بين؛ تستعمل للدلالة على ما يفصل اثنين
entries.example: The bakery is between the bank and the park.

entries.definitionEn: To confuse someone so that they do not know what to think or do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحيّر أو يُربك حتى يصعب الفهم أو التصرف
entries.example: The new software bewildered even the experienced staff.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being completely confused.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيرة شديدة
entries.example: He stared at the map in bewilderment.

entries.definitionEn: On the farther side of something; further than a place, time, or limit.
entries.arabicMeaning: وراء؛ أبعد من حد مكان أو زمان أو مقدار
entries.example: The hills lie beyond the river.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet.
entries.arabicMeaning: دراجة هوائية
entries.example: She rides her bicycle to work every day.

entries.definitionEn: To offer a particular amount of money for something, especially at an auction.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّم عرض سعر، ولا سيما في مزاد
entries.example: Several buyers bid for the painting.

entries.definitionEn: The offering of prices, especially at an auction. Also a request or order that you are expected to follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: المزايدة في الأسعار؛ أو أمر يُنتظر منك تنفيذه
entries.example: The bidding for the house rose quickly.

entries.definitionEn: Large in size, amount, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبير في الحجم أو الكمية أو الأهمية
entries.example: They live in a big house near the school.

entries.definitionEn: A bicycle, or a motorcycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: دراجة هوائية أو نارية
entries.example: He got on his bike and rode home.

entries.definitionEn: A two-piece garment that women wear for swimming.
entries.arabicMeaning: لباس سباحة نسائي من قطعتين
entries.example: She packed a bikini for the beach holiday.

entries.definitionEn: Able to speak two languages well, or written and spoken in two languages.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثنائي اللغة؛ يستخدم لغتين بطلاقة
entries.example: Their children are bilingual in Arabic and English.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper that shows how much you must pay for a meal, goods, or a service.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاتورة تبين المبلغ المستحق
entries.example: Could we have the bill, please?

entries.definitionEn: To send someone a written request for payment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل إلى شخص فاتورة بالمبلغ المستحق
entries.example: The clinic billed us for the extra tests.

entries.definitionEn: A game played with cues and balls on a cloth-covered table.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة البلياردو
entries.example: They spent the evening playing billiards in the club.

entries.definitionEn: The number 1,000,000,000; a thousand million.
entries.arabicMeaning: مليار؛ ألف مليون
entries.example: The company is worth several billion dollars.

entries.definitionEn: A container for rubbish, or for storing things.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندوق قمامة أو وعاء لحفظ الأشياء
entries.example: Please put the empty bottles in the bin.

entries.definitionEn: To tie something tightly, or to join people or things closely together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط بإحكام، أو يوحّد بين أشخاص أو أشياء
entries.example: They bind the old books with strong cloth.

entries.definitionEn: A short account of someone's life, often on a website or book cover.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبذة موجزة عن حياة شخص
entries.example: She updated the bio on her professional page.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of the chemical processes that take place in living things.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكيمياء الحيوية
entries.example: He is studying biochemistry at university.

entries.definitionEn: A book or other text that tells the story of a real person's life.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيرة مكتوبة عن حياة شخص حقيقي
entries.example: I am reading a biography of the inventor.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to living things or to the science of biology.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيولوجي؛ متصل بالكائنات الحية أو بعلم الأحياء
entries.example: The team collected biological samples from the river.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of living things.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الأحياء
entries.example: Biology is her favourite subject at school.

entries.definitionEn: The use of living cells and organisms in industry, medicine, and farming.
entries.arabicMeaning: التقنية الحيوية
entries.example: Biotechnology has changed how some medicines are made.

entries.definitionEn: An animal with feathers, two wings, and a beak, that usually can fly.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائر
entries.example: A small bird landed on the window ledge.

entries.definitionEn: A box or enclosure of wire or bars in which a bird is kept.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفص طيور
entries.example: She cleaned the birdcage every morning.

entries.definitionEn: The moment when a baby, or a young animal, comes out of its mother's body.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولادة
entries.example: They announced the birth of their daughter.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the year on which a person was born, often celebrated each year.
entries.arabicMeaning: عيد ميلاد
entries.example: Her birthday is in March.

entries.definitionEn: The town or country where a person was born, or where something began.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسقط الرأس؛ مكان الولادة أو البداية
entries.example: The museum stands in the poet's birthplace.

entries.definitionEn: A small, flat, dry cake, often sweet. In American English this is usually called a cookie.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسكويت
entries.example: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?

entries.definitionEn: A senior priest in some Christian churches who is in charge of a large area.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسقف؛ رتبة دينية رفيعة في بعض الكنائس
entries.example: The bishop spoke at the morning service.

entries.definitionEn: A small amount or piece of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل؛ قطعة صغيرة
entries.example: There is a bit of cheese left in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: An act of cutting into something with the teeth, the mark this leaves, or a small amount of food.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضة؛ أو لقمة صغيرة من الطعام
entries.example: The apple had one bite missing.

entries.definitionEn: To cut into something with the teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعضّ
entries.example: The dog did not bite the visitor.

entries.definitionEn: Having a sharp, unpleasant taste. Also angry and unhappy because of something unfair.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرّ المذاق؛ أو ممتلئ بالمرارة من ظلم وقع
entries.example: The coffee was too bitter to drink without sugar.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows strong anger or sadness, or to a severe degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمرارة شديدة؛ أو بدرجة قاسية
entries.example: She was bitterly disappointed by the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Very strange and unusual.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب أطواراً؛ شاذ عن المألوف
entries.example: The story took a bizarre turn in the final chapter.

entries.definitionEn: Having the darkest colour, like coal or a night sky with no light.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسود
entries.example: He wore a black coat.

entries.definitionEn: The darkest colour.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأسود
entries.example: She looks good in black.

entries.definitionEn: A dark board on a wall that a teacher writes on with chalk.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبورة سوداء
entries.example: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.

entries.definitionEn: The flat, sharp part of a knife or similar tool. Also a long, thin leaf of grass.
entries.arabicMeaning: نصل السكين أو نحوها؛ أو ورقة عشب رفيعة
entries.example: Be careful of the blade when you wash the knife.

entries.definitionEn: Responsibility for something bad that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللوم؛ تحميل المسؤولية عن خطأ
entries.example: He accepted the blame for the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone or something is the reason for something bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوم؛ يحمل المسؤولية عن أمر سيئ
entries.example: Do not blame her for the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Flattering words or gentle persuasion used to make someone do what you want, often insincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلام معسول أو إغراء لطيف يُقصد به الاستمالة
entries.example: She ignored the blandishments of the sales team.

entries.definitionEn: Empty, with nothing written, drawn, or recorded on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: فارغ؛ خالٍ من الكتابة أو الرسم
entries.example: Please write your name on the blank line.

entries.definitionEn: A thick cover that you put on a bed to keep warm.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطانية
entries.example: She pulled the blanket up to her chin.

entries.definitionEn: An empty quality, of a surface, a look, or a mind with no expression or content.
entries.arabicMeaning: فراغ أو خلوّ من التعبير والمحتوى
entries.example: The blankness of his expression worried her.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden strong rush of air, sound, or explosive force.
entries.arabicMeaning: انفجار أو دفعة قوية من هواء أو صوت
entries.example: They heard a blast from the construction site.

entries.definitionEn: To destroy or damage with an explosion, or to produce a very loud sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفجّر أو يُحدث صوتاً عالياً جداً
entries.example: Music blasted from the open window.

entries.definitionEn: A large, strong fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: حريق هائل
entries.example: Firefighters worked all night to control the blaze.

entries.definitionEn: To burn with a bright, strong flame.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأجج ويشتعل بوهج شديد
entries.example: The logs blazed in the fireplace.

entries.definitionEn: To lose blood from the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزف
entries.example: His finger began to bleed after he cut it.

entries.definitionEn: A mixture of different things, especially teas, coffees, or qualities.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزيج من عناصر مختلفة
entries.example: This coffee is a blend of two mild beans.

entries.definitionEn: To mix two or more things together so that they become one.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمزج حتى يصير الخليط واحداً
entries.example: Blend the fruit and yogurt until smooth.

entries.definitionEn: To ask God to protect someone or something, or to treat something as a cause for gratitude.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبارك؛ يدعو بالحماية أو يعترف بالنعمة
entries.example: The family gathered to bless the new house.

entries.definitionEn: Something good that you are grateful for, or approval and support.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعمة يُشكر عليها؛ أو مباركة وموافقة
entries.example: Good health is a blessing.

entries.definitionEn: Something that spoils, damages, or ruins a place, a life, or a crop.
entries.arabicMeaning: آفة تفسد زرعاً أو مكاناً أو حياة
entries.example: Empty shops were a blight on the high street.

entries.definitionEn: To spoil or damage something, often for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُتلف أو يُفسد على نحو يدوم أثره
entries.example: Years of drought blighted the harvest.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to see. Also unable or unwilling to notice something.
entries.arabicMeaning: كفيف؛ أو غير مدرك لأمر ظاهر
entries.example: The library offers audio books for blind readers.

entries.definitionEn: Without thinking carefully, or without being able to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو أعمى؛ من غير رويّة أو من غير إبصار
entries.example: Do not follow advice blindly.

entries.definitionEn: The condition of being unable to see. Also a failure to notice or accept something.
entries.arabicMeaning: العمى؛ أو عدم إدراك أمر واضح
entries.example: The disease can cause blindness if it is not treated.

entries.definitionEn: To shut and open the eyes quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرمش بعينيه
entries.example: The bright light made her blink.

entries.definitionEn: Perfect happiness; a state of deep, quiet joy.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعيم؛ سعادة تامة هادئة
entries.example: Lying in the sun after the long walk was sheer bliss.

entries.definitionEn: A painful swelling on the skin filled with liquid, often caused by heat or rubbing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفطة مؤلمة على الجلد
entries.example: The new shoes gave her a blister on her heel.

entries.definitionEn: To form blisters, or to cause them to form.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُكوّن نفطات أو يتغطى بها الجلد
entries.example: His hands blistered after a day of digging.

entries.definitionEn: In a cheerfully unconcerned way, often without noticing a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمرح غير مكترث، وكثيراً من غير انتباه للمشكلة
entries.example: He blithely ignored the warning on the door.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, intense attack or campaign, often lasting a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حملة مكثفة مفاجئة؛ أو هجوم خاطف
entries.example: The shop ran a week-long advertising blitz.

entries.definitionEn: To attack or deal with something in a sudden, intense way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشنّ على شيء حملة مكثفة مفاجئة
entries.example: They blitzed the apartment with a full day's cleaning.

entries.definitionEn: A solid piece of wood, stone, or other hard material, often with straight sides.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتلة صلبة من خشب أو حجر أو نحوه
entries.example: The child stacked the wooden blocks into a tower.

entries.definitionEn: To stop something from moving or from being seen or used, by putting something in the way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسدّ الطريق أو يحول دون المرور أو الرؤية
entries.example: A parked van blocked the entrance.

entries.definitionEn: A film, book, or show that is extremely popular and successful.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلم أو كتاب ذو نجاح جماهيري هائل
entries.example: The summer blockbuster sold out every evening.

entries.definitionEn: A website where a person writes regularly about their thoughts, work, or interests.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدوّنة إلكترونية
entries.example: She started a blog about cooking at home.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes a blog.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدوِّن
entries.example: The blogger posted three times a week.

entries.definitionEn: Having pale yellow or gold-coloured hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: أشقر الشعر
entries.example: She has blonde hair and brown eyes.

entries.definitionEn: The red liquid that flows through the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: دم
entries.example: The nurse took a sample of his blood.

entries.definitionEn: The blood as it moves through the veins and arteries of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجرى الدم في الجسم
entries.example: The medicine enters the bloodstream quickly.

entries.definitionEn: Covered in blood, or involving a lot of blood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملطخ بالدم؛ أو ينطوي على سفك كثير للدم
entries.example: He wrapped a cloth around his bloody hand.

entries.definitionEn: In informal British English, used before an adjective or adverb to add force.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الإنجليزية البريطانية غير الرسمية: تُستعمل لتقوية المعنى
entries.example: I was bloody tired after the night shift.

entries.definitionEn: A flower, or the state of having flowers open on a plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: زهرة؛ أو حال الإزهار
entries.example: The roses are in bloom this week.

entries.definitionEn: To produce flowers, or to develop in a healthy, successful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزهر؛ أو ينمو ويزدهر
entries.example: Confidence bloomed once she found the right teacher.

entries.definitionEn: Producing flowers; at the stage of flowering.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزهر؛ في طور الإزهار
entries.example: The blooming cherry trees lined the path.

entries.definitionEn: A flower on a tree, especially a fruit tree, or the mass of such flowers.
entries.arabicMeaning: زهر الشجر، ولا سيما أشجار الفاكهة
entries.example: Pink blossom covered the apple trees.

entries.definitionEn: A hard hit with the hand or an object. Also a sudden shock or disappointment.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضربة قوية؛ أو صدمة مفاجئة
entries.example: The news of the cancellation was a blow to the team.

entries.definitionEn: To send out air from the mouth, or to move as a current of air.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفخ الهواء؛ أو تهبّ الريح
entries.example: The wind will blow the leaves off the path.

entries.definitionEn: The thick layer of fat under the skin of whales and some other sea animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبقة الشحم السميكة تحت جلد الحوت ونحوه
entries.example: Whales store energy in a thick layer of blubber.

entries.definitionEn: Thick, soft, and fatty, like blubber.
entries.arabicMeaning: شحميّ سميك ليّن كشحم الحوت
entries.example: The seal had a blubbery coat that kept out the cold.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of a clear sky in the daytime.
entries.arabicMeaning: أزرق
entries.example: She bought a blue dress.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of a clear sky in the daytime.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأزرق
entries.example: Blue is my favourite colour.

entries.definitionEn: To make something less clear to see or understand, or to become less clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُذهب الوضوح عن رؤية أو فهم، أو يفقد الوضوح
entries.example: Tears blurred her view of the page.

entries.definitionEn: A short text on a book cover or website that describes a work and tries to attract readers.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبذة ترويجية موجزة على غلاف كتاب أو موقع
entries.example: The blurb on the back cover made her buy the novel.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden remark said without thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة تُقال على عجل من غير تفكير
entries.example: His blurt of the password surprised everyone in the room.

entries.definitionEn: A reddening of the face, usually from embarrassment or shyness.
entries.arabicMeaning: احمرار الوجه من الخجل
entries.example: A blush rose to her cheeks when her name was called.

entries.definitionEn: To become red in the face, usually because you feel embarrassed or shy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحمرّ وجهه خجلاً
entries.example: He blushed when they praised his work in public.

entries.definitionEn: A game played on a flat board, often with pieces that you move.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة لوحية
entries.example: We played a board game after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A long, thin, flat piece of wood. Also a flat surface used for writing or for notices.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوح من خشب؛ أو سطح للكتابة أو الإعلانات
entries.example: He cut the board to the right length.

entries.definitionEn: To get on a plane, train, ship, or bus in order to travel.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصعد إلى طائرة أو قطار أو سفينة أو حافلة
entries.example: Passengers may board the plane in ten minutes.

entries.definitionEn: A statement in which you praise yourself or what you own, often too proudly.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفاخرة؛ كلام يمدح به المرء نفسه بإفراط
entries.example: His boast about the deal sounded empty to the team.

entries.definitionEn: To talk too proudly about yourself, your abilities, or your possessions.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفاخر أو يتباهى بما لديه
entries.example: He likes to boast about his cooking.

entries.definitionEn: A small vehicle that travels on water.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارب
entries.example: They crossed the lake in a small boat.

entries.definitionEn: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: جسم الإنسان أو الحيوان
entries.example: Exercise is good for the body.

entries.definitionEn: Not genuine; false, though presented as real.
entries.arabicMeaning: زائف يُعرض على أنه حقيقي
entries.example: The website was selling bogus tickets.

entries.definitionEn: To heat a liquid until it produces bubbles and turns to steam, or to cook something in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلي السائل أو يطبخ بالغلي
entries.example: Boil the water before you make the tea.

entries.definitionEn: Cooked in water that is boiling.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلوق
entries.example: She served boiled potatoes with the fish.

entries.definitionEn: At the temperature at which a liquid boils. Informal: extremely hot.
entries.arabicMeaning: في درجة الغليان؛ أو حار جداً في الكلام اليومي
entries.example: It was boiling in the small kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: Confident and willing to take risks; not shy. Also strong and easy to notice, of colour or type.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريء واثق؛ أو واضح بارز في اللون أو الخط
entries.example: It was a bold decision to change careers.

entries.definitionEn: Thick, dark type used to make words stand out on a page.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخط العريض
entries.example: Put the title in bold so that readers see it first.

entries.definitionEn: In a confident, brave, or striking way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجرأة ووضوح
entries.example: She walked boldly to the front of the room.

entries.definitionEn: A metal pin used to fasten things together, often with a nut. Also a sudden flash of lightning.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسمار تثبيت معدني؛ أو وميض برق
entries.example: He tightened the bolt with a wrench.

entries.definitionEn: To run away suddenly, or to fasten something with a bolt.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرّ فجأة؛ أو يُحكم الغلق بمسمار التثبيت
entries.example: The horse bolted when the gate slammed.

entries.definitionEn: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage.
entries.arabicMeaning: قنبلة
entries.example: The museum displays an unexploded bomb from the war.

entries.definitionEn: To attack a place with bombs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقصف مكاناً بالقنابل
entries.example: The film shows a city that was bombed during the war.

entries.definitionEn: A large early cannon that fired heavy stone or metal balls.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدفع ضخم قديم كان يقذف كرات ثقيلة من حجر أو معدن
entries.example: The fortress still displayed an old bombard in the courtyard.

entries.definitionEn: A person or aircraft that drops bombs.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائرة قاذفة؛ أو شخص يلقي قنابل
entries.example: The museum has a restored wartime bomber.

entries.definitionEn: An attack in which bombs are dropped or set off.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصف بالقنابل؛ عملية تفجير
entries.example: The city recovered slowly after the bombing.

entries.definitionEn: Genuine; real, and not false or pretended.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقي أصيل غير مزيَّف
entries.example: Only bona fide members may use the archive.

entries.definitionEn: A close connection between people, groups, or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: رابطة وثيقة بين أشخاص أو جماعات أو أشياء
entries.example: Travel created a strong bond between the two friends.

entries.definitionEn: One of the hard parts inside the body of a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: عظم
entries.example: The doctor said there was no broken bone.

entries.definitionEn: Extra money or an extra advantage that you did not have to expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكافأة إضافية؛ أو ميزة زائدة
entries.example: Staff received a bonus at the end of the year.

entries.definitionEn: Very thin, so that the bones show, or made of bone.
entries.arabicMeaning: نحيل يظهر عظمه؛ أو عظميّ التركيب
entries.example: He held the child's bony hand.

entries.definitionEn: A set of printed pages fastened together for reading.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتاب
entries.example: I borrowed a book from the library.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange to have a seat, room, or ticket in advance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحجز مقعداً أو غرفة أو تذكرة مسبقاً
entries.example: We need to book a table for eight o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture with shelves for holding books.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة كتب
entries.example: The bookcase in the hall is already full.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement to have a seat, room, or ticket at a future time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حجز لموعد لاحق
entries.example: I have a booking at the hotel for Friday night.

entries.definitionEn: More interested in reading and study than in other activities.
entries.arabicMeaning: مولع بالقراءة والدراسة أكثر من سواهما
entries.example: He was a quiet, bookish child.

entries.definitionEn: A thin book with a paper cover, often giving information.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتيّب ذو غلاف ورقي
entries.example: Please read the safety booklet before the flight.

entries.definitionEn: A strip used to keep your place in a book. Also a saved link to a website.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاصل صفحات؛ أو رابط محفوظ لموقع
entries.example: She slipped a bookmark between the pages.

entries.definitionEn: To save the address of a website so that you can find it again quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفظ رابط صفحة لسهولة الرجوع إليها
entries.example: Bookmark this page if you want to come back later.

entries.definitionEn: A shelf, or a set of shelves, for holding books.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفّ كتب
entries.example: He put the novel back on the bookshelf.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that sells books.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتبة لبيع الكتب
entries.example: I found the textbook in a small bookshop.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that sells books.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجر كتب
entries.example: The bookstore opens at ten.

entries.definitionEn: A period of sudden growth and success, especially in business. Also a deep, loud sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: رواج مفاجئ ولا سيما في الأعمال؛ أو دويّ عميق
entries.example: There was a boom in online shopping that year.

entries.definitionEn: An increase or improvement that gives extra help or strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفعة تعزيز أو زيادة
entries.example: The good review gave her confidence a boost.

entries.definitionEn: To increase or improve something, or to help it succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعزّز شيئاً أو يزيده أو يُعين على نجاحه
entries.example: Extra practice boosted his exam score.

entries.definitionEn: A strong shoe that covers the foot and part of the leg.
entries.arabicMeaning: حذاء طويل يغطي القدم وجزءاً من الساق
entries.example: She pulled on her boots before walking in the snow.

entries.definitionEn: A small enclosed space used for a particular purpose, such as voting, selling, or taking a photo.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقصورة صغيرة لغرض معيّن
entries.example: He stepped into the photo booth and closed the curtain.

entries.definitionEn: The line that divides two countries or areas. Also a strip along the edge of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدود بين بلدين أو منطقتين؛ أو حاشية على الطرف
entries.example: They crossed the border early in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel tired and uninterested.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُملّ الشخص حتى يضيق ذرعاً
entries.example: Long speeches bore most of the audience.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting, or because you have nothing to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملول ضجر من قلة المتعة أو من الفراغ
entries.example: The children got bored on the long drive.

entries.definitionEn: The state of feeling bored.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملل؛ ضجر
entries.example: He read a magazine to fight boredom on the train.

entries.definitionEn: Not interesting.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممل
entries.example: The film was long and boring.

entries.definitionEn: To take something that belongs to someone else and give it back later.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعير شيئاً على أن يردّه
entries.example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?

entries.definitionEn: The person who is in charge of you at work.
entries.arabicMeaning: المدير في العمل؛ من يرأسك في الوظيفة
entries.example: My boss is away until Thursday.

entries.definitionEn: Too ready to tell other people what to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميّال إلى الأمر والسيطرة على الآخرين
entries.example: Her bossy tone annoyed her younger brother.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم النبات
entries.example: She took a course in botany at college.

entries.definitionEn: Used with the word and to show that two things are true at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل مع واو العطف للدلالة على أن الأمرين معاً صحيحان
entries.example: The room was both warm and quiet.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to talk about two people or things together, not just one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل الاسم للإشارة إلى الاثنين معاً
entries.example: Both tickets are on the table.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to mean two people or things already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يدل على الاثنين المذكورين معاً
entries.example: I like tea and coffee, and I drink both.

entries.definitionEn: Trouble or effort; something that causes inconvenience.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناء أو إزعاج
entries.example: Please call me if it is no bother.

entries.definitionEn: To annoy someone, or to take the trouble to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعج شخصاً؛ أو يكلّف نفسه عناء فعل شيء
entries.example: I am sorry to bother you so late.

entries.definitionEn: Worried or annoyed. Often used in not bothered to mean you do not mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزعج أو قلق؛ وكثيراً في النفي بمعنى غير مكترث
entries.example: She did not look bothered by the change of plan.

entries.definitionEn: Causing trouble or mild annoyance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزعج؛ مسبّب للضيق
entries.example: The bothersome noise kept him from sleeping.

entries.definitionEn: A container with a narrow neck, used for liquids, usually made of glass or plastic.
entries.arabicMeaning: زجاجة
entries.example: She bought a bottle of water.

entries.definitionEn: To put a liquid into bottles for keeping or selling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبّئ سائلاً في زجاجات للحفظ أو البيع
entries.example: They bottle the juice at a plant near the farm.

entries.definitionEn: The lowest part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسفل الشيء؛ القاع
entries.example: There is a label on the bottom of the box.

entries.definitionEn: The action of hitting a surface and moving back up, or the quality of doing this well.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتداد عن سطح؛ أو قدرة على الارتداد
entries.example: The bounce of the new ball surprised the players.

entries.definitionEn: To move back up after hitting a surface, or to make something do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتدّ بعد الاصطدام، أو يجعل شيئاً يرتدّ
entries.example: The ball bounced twice before he caught it.

entries.definitionEn: Certain to happen, or travelling towards a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا بدّ أن يحدث؛ أو متجه إلى مكان
entries.example: If you practise every day, you are bound to improve.

entries.definitionEn: A bunch of flowers arranged together, often given as a gift.
entries.arabicMeaning: باقة ورد منسّقة
entries.example: He brought a bouquet of roses to the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A type of American whisky made mainly from corn.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوربون؛ نوع من الويسكي الأمريكي يُصنع غالباً من الذرة
entries.example: He ordered a glass of bourbon at the bar.

entries.definitionEn: A short period of activity, illness, or strong feeling. Also a boxing or wrestling match.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوبة قصيرة من نشاط أو مرض أو شعور؛ أو مباراة ملاكمة
entries.example: She had a bout of flu in January.

entries.definitionEn: A knot tied with two loops, used to decorate clothes or packages.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقدة على شكل فيونكة تُزيَّن بها الثياب أو الهدايا
entries.example: She tied a red bow on the gift.

entries.definitionEn: To bend the head or upper body forward as a greeting or sign of respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينحني بالرأس أو الجذع تحية أو احتراماً
entries.example: The actors bowed at the end of the play.

entries.definitionEn: A round, deep dish used for food or liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعاء عميق مستدير للطعام أو الشراب
entries.example: She put the soup in a bowl.

entries.definitionEn: To roll a ball in a game such as bowling or cricket.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدحرج الكرة في ألعاب مثل البولينغ أو الكريكيت
entries.example: He learned to bowl at the sports centre.

entries.definitionEn: A container with straight sides, often with a lid, used for storing or packing things.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندوق
entries.example: The shoes came in a cardboard box.

entries.definitionEn: A person who fights as a sport with the fists, wearing special gloves.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاكم
entries.example: The boxer trained in the gym every morning.

entries.definitionEn: The sport of fighting with the fists, wearing special gloves.
entries.arabicMeaning: الملاكمة
entries.example: Boxing is shown on television on Friday nights.

entries.definitionEn: A male child, or a young man.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولد؛ صبي
entries.example: The boy is waiting for his father.

entries.definitionEn: A man or boy with whom someone has a romantic relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبيب؛ شريك عاطفي من الذكور
entries.example: She went to the cinema with her boyfriend.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing that women wear under other clothes to support the breasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمّالة صدر
entries.example: She bought a new bra at the department store.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوار يُلبس في المعصم
entries.example: The silver bracelet was a gift from her sister.

entries.definitionEn: One of a pair of marks such as ( ) used around extra words. Also a group or range, such as an age or income group.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوس في الكتابة؛ أو فئة ضمن مدى معيّن
entries.example: Put the extra information in brackets.

entries.definitionEn: A proud statement about yourself or your achievements; a boast.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفاخرة؛ كلام يتباهى به المرء
entries.example: His brag about the promotion irritated his colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: The organ inside the head that controls thought, memory, and the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: دماغ
entries.example: The brain needs sleep to work well.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting in which people suggest many ideas quickly, or a sudden clever idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلسة لتوليد الأفكار؛ أو فكرة مفاجئة
entries.example: We had a short brainstorm before we started writing.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of suggesting many ideas quickly in a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: العصف الذهني؛ توليد الأفكار في مجموعة
entries.example: Brainstorming helped the team find a simpler plan.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone accept ideas by repeating them so often that independent thought becomes hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغسل دماغ شخص بفرض أفكار عليه حتى يضعف تفكيره المستقل
entries.example: The documentary showed how the group tried to brainwash new members.

entries.definitionEn: The process of forcing someone to accept ideas by constant repetition and pressure.
entries.arabicMeaning: غسل الدماغ؛ فرض أفكار بالضغط والتكرار
entries.example: The book examines brainwashing in closed groups.

entries.definitionEn: A device that makes a vehicle go more slowly or stop.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكابح؛ فرامل
entries.example: Press the brake gently on the wet road.

entries.definitionEn: To make a vehicle go more slowly or stop, using the brake.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضغط على المكابح ليبطئ أو يتوقف
entries.example: She had to brake hard when the lights changed.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk. Also a local office of a larger company.
entries.arabicMeaning: غصن شجرة؛ أو فرع محلي لمؤسسة أكبر
entries.example: A bird sat on the highest branch.

entries.definitionEn: To divide into two or more directions, or to start a related new activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفرع اتجاهات عدة؛ أو يوسّع النشاط في مجال متصل
entries.example: The company plans to branch into online sales.

entries.definitionEn: Completely new; not used before.
entries.arabicMeaning: جديد تماماً؛ لم يُستعمل من قبل
entries.example: He drove a brand-new car home from the showroom.

entries.definitionEn: A name, design, or mark that a company uses on its products.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة تجارية: اسم أو تصميم تضعه الشركة على منتجاتها.
entries.example: I like this brand of tea better than the others.

entries.definitionEn: To wave something, especially a weapon, in a threatening or showy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوّح بشيء، وغالباً بسلاح، على نحو تهديدي أو استعراضي.
entries.example: The guard brandished a stick to keep the crowd back.

entries.definitionEn: A yellow metal made by mixing copper and zinc.
entries.arabicMeaning: النحاس الأصفر، معدن يُصنع بخلط النحاس والزنك.
entries.example: The old door key is made of brass.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to face danger or pain without showing much fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجاع يواجه الخطر أو الألم من غير خوف ظاهر.
entries.example: The brave girl ran back to help her friend.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows courage, even when something is hard or frightening.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشجاعة، حتى حين يكون الأمر صعباً أو مخيفاً.
entries.example: He spoke bravely about his long illness.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of facing danger, pain, or difficulty without giving in to fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشجاعة: مواجهة الخطر أو الألم أو المشقة من غير استسلام للخوف.
entries.example: The medal honoured her bravery during the rescue.

entries.definitionEn: A food made from flour and water and baked in an oven.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبز يُصنع من الدقيق والماء ويُخبز في الفرن.
entries.example: We had bread and cheese for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: The person whose earnings mainly support a household.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائل الأسرة: من يعتمد البيت على كسبه في المقام الأول.
entries.example: After her father retired, she became the breadwinner.

entries.definitionEn: A short time when you stop working or doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: استراحة قصيرة تتوقف فيها عن العمل أو عن نشاط ما.
entries.example: Let's have a break after this lesson.

entries.definitionEn: To make something separate into pieces, or stop working.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكسر شيئاً فيفصله قطعاً، أو يعطّله فلا يعود يعمل.
entries.example: Be careful or you will break the glass.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to damage or smash, so it must be handled with care.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للكسر، يحتاج إلى تعامل حذر.
entries.example: Pack the breakable dishes at the top of the box.

entries.definitionEn: A failure of a vehicle or system that stops it working.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطل تتوقف بسببه مركبة أو منظومة عن العمل.
entries.example: We had a breakdown on the way to the airport.

entries.definitionEn: The first meal of the day, eaten in the morning.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإفطار: أول وجبة في اليوم تُؤكل صباحاً.
entries.example: I usually eat breakfast at seven.

entries.definitionEn: An important discovery or success that makes progress possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنجاز كبير أو اكتشاف يفتح باب التقدّم.
entries.example: The new medicine was a breakthrough for patients.

entries.definitionEn: The end of a romantic relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: انفصال ينهي علاقة عاطفية.
entries.example: She moved cities after the breakup.

entries.definitionEn: The front of the chest; in women, one of the two parts that can produce milk.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصدر؛ وفي المرأة أحد الثديين.
entries.example: The bird had a bright red breast.

entries.definitionEn: The air that you take into and send out of your lungs.
entries.arabicMeaning: النَّفَس: الهواء الذي يدخل الرئتين ويخرج منهما.
entries.example: Take a deep breath before you dive.

entries.definitionEn: To take air into your lungs and send it out again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنفّس: يدخل الهواء إلى رئتيه ثم يخرجه.
entries.example: Sit down and breathe slowly.

entries.definitionEn: Finding it hard to breathe, usually after effort or strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاهث يجد صعوبة في التنفس، غالباً بعد جهد أو انفعال.
entries.example: We were breathless after running up the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: So beautiful or impressive that it takes your attention completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلّاب إلى درجة يخطف فيها الأنفاس من شدة جماله أو وقعه.
entries.example: The view from the hill was breathtaking.

entries.definitionEn: A particular type of animal developed by people, with shared features.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلالة معيّنة من الحيوان استُنبطت بخصائص مشتركة.
entries.example: A labrador is a popular breed of dog.

entries.definitionEn: To keep animals so that they produce young with chosen features.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربّي حيوانات لتتوالد وفق صفات مختارة.
entries.example: They breed horses on the farm.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of producing young animals, often under human care.
entries.arabicMeaning: تربية الحيوانات بهدف توالدها، وغالباً تحت رعاية الإنسان.
entries.example: The zoo is known for its breeding of rare birds.

entries.definitionEn: A light, pleasant wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسيم خفيف لطيف.
entries.example: A cool breeze came in through the window.

entries.definitionEn: With a fairly strong but pleasant wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: عليل تهب فيه ريح خفيفة منعشة.
entries.example: It was a bright, breezy morning by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being short in time or of using few words.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإيجاز: قِصر المدة أو الاقتصار على كلمات قليلة.
entries.example: The brevity of her reply made the point clearly.

entries.definitionEn: A place where beer is made.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنع تُنتَج فيه الجعة.
entries.example: We visited a small brewery on the edge of town.

entries.definitionEn: Money or a gift given to someone to make them do something dishonest.
entries.arabicMeaning: رشوة: مال أو هدية تُدفع لحمل شخص على فعل غير نزيه.
entries.example: The official was accused of taking a bribe.

entries.definitionEn: To give money or a gift so that someone will act dishonestly in your favour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرشو شخصاً بمال أو هدية ليحمله على محاباته على نحو غير نزيه.
entries.example: They tried to bribe the clerk to ignore the error.

entries.definitionEn: The crime or practice of giving or taking bribes.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرشوة بوصفها جريمة أو ممارسة: إعطاء الرشاوى أو أخذها.
entries.example: The inquiry found evidence of bribery in the contracts.

entries.definitionEn: A hard block of baked clay used for building walls.
entries.arabicMeaning: آجرة من طين مشوي تُستخدم في بناء الجدران.
entries.example: The house was built of red brick.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who is about to get married, or who has just got married.
entries.arabicMeaning: العروس: امرأة توشك أن تتزوج أو تزوجت حديثاً.
entries.example: The bride arrived at the hall with her parents.

entries.definitionEn: A structure built over a river, road, or railway so that people can cross.
entries.arabicMeaning: جسر يُقام فوق نهر أو طريق أو سكة حديد لعبور الناس.
entries.example: We walked across the old stone bridge.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting only a short time, or using few words.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجيز: لا يدوم إلا وقتاً قصيراً، أو لا يستخدم إلا كلمات قليلة.
entries.example: He gave a brief speech at the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A set of instructions or facts given for a particular piece of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجز التعليمات أو المعطيات المقدَّمة لإنجاز مهمة معيّنة.
entries.example: The designer asked for a clearer brief before starting.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone the information they need about a task or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُطلع شخصاً على المعلومات اللازمة لمهمة أو موقف.
entries.example: The manager briefed the team before the clients arrived.

entries.definitionEn: For a short time, or in a few words.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفترة وجيزة، أو بكلمات قليلة.
entries.example: She paused briefly, then continued.

entries.definitionEn: Full of light, or having a strong, clear colour.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساطع كثير الضوء، أو ذو لون قوي واضح.
entries.example: The kitchen is bright in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: With a lot of light, or in a cheerful, vivid way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسطوع، أو على نحو مشرق زاهٍ.
entries.example: The stars shone brightly above the field.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good, clever, or bright.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع أو ذكي جداً، أو شديد اللمعان.
entries.example: That was a brilliant idea for the project.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely well, cleverly, or with great brightness.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببراعة فائقة، أو بلمعان شديد.
entries.example: She played the piano brilliantly at the concert.

entries.definitionEn: To be so full that the contents almost spill over.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمتلئ حتى الحافة حتى يكاد محتواه يفيض.
entries.example: Her eyes brimmed with tears during the speech.

entries.definitionEn: An old word for sulphur, often used in religious language about punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ قديم للكبريت، يكثر في الكلام الديني عن العقاب.
entries.example: The old text spoke of fire and brimstone.

entries.definitionEn: To take a person or thing with you to a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحضر شخصاً أو شيئاً معه إلى مكان.
entries.example: Please bring your book tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The edge of a situation, just before something important or dangerous happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشفا: حافة موقف حاسم قبيل وقوع أمر مهم أو خطير.
entries.example: The company was on the brink of collapse.

entries.definitionEn: Wide from side to side, or covering a large range.
entries.arabicMeaning: عريض من جانب إلى جانب، أو شامل لنطاق واسع.
entries.example: They walked down a broad street lined with trees.

entries.definitionEn: A fast internet connection that is always available.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتصال إنترنت سريع ودائم يُعرف بالنطاق العريض.
entries.example: The apartment comes with broadband.

entries.definitionEn: A radio or television programme sent out to the public.
entries.arabicMeaning: برنامج يُبث عبر الراديو أو التلفزيون إلى الجمهور.
entries.example: I missed the evening news broadcast.

entries.definitionEn: To send out a programme on radio, television, or the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبث برنامجاً عبر الراديو أو التلفزيون أو الإنترنت.
entries.example: The match will be broadcast live tonight.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organisation that sends out radio or television programmes.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو هيئة تتولى البث الإذاعي أو التلفزيوني.
entries.example: She works as a news broadcaster.

entries.definitionEn: To make something wider, or to increase its range.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوسّع شيئاً أو يزيد نطاقه.
entries.example: Travel can broaden your experience of other cultures.

entries.definitionEn: In a general way, without looking at small details.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوجه عام، من غير الدخول في التفاصيل الدقيقة.
entries.example: The plan was broadly accepted by the staff.

entries.definitionEn: A green vegetable with a thick stem and a head of small tight flowers.
entries.arabicMeaning: البروكلي: خضار أخضر ذو ساق غليظة ورأس من زهرات متراصة.
entries.example: I steamed some broccoli to eat with the fish.

entries.definitionEn: A thin booklet with pictures that gives information about a product or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتيّب مصوّر يعرّف بمنتج أو مكان.
entries.example: The hotel sent us a brochure of the rooms.

entries.definitionEn: Damaged and in pieces, or not working.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكسور قد تفرّق قطعاً، أو معطّل لا يعمل.
entries.example: The broken cup cannot be used.

entries.definitionEn: A hard brownish metal made from copper and tin.
entries.arabicMeaning: البرونز: معدن صلب ضارب إلى البني يُصنع من النحاس والقصدير.
entries.example: The statue in the square is made of bronze.

entries.definitionEn: A group of young birds hatched at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حضنة من صغار الطيور فقست في وقت واحد.
entries.example: The hen gathered her brood under her wings.

entries.definitionEn: To keep thinking unhappily or anxiously about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطيل التفكير في أمر بكآبة أو قلق.
entries.example: He sat in the dark and brooded over the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: The brother of your husband or wife, or the husband of your sister.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخو الزوج أو الزوجة، أو زوج الأخت.
entries.example: My brother-in-law is staying with us this week.

entries.definitionEn: A boy or man who has the same parents as you.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخ يشترك معك في الأبوين أو في أحدهما.
entries.example: My brother is two years older than me.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of friendship and shared purpose among people; also an organisation of men.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخوّة: شعور بالودّ والهدف المشترك، أو جمعية من الرجال.
entries.example: The club was founded in a spirit of brotherhood.

entries.definitionEn: A noisy fuss about something, often more excitement than the matter deserves.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلبة وضجة أكبر مما يستحقه الأمر في العادة.
entries.example: The small error caused a brouhaha in the office.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of earth, wood, or coffee.
entries.arabicMeaning: بني، بلون التراب أو الخشب أو القهوة.
entries.example: She has brown eyes.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of earth, wood, or coffee.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون البني.
entries.example: Brown is a warm colour for a sitting room.

entries.definitionEn: To look through things in a casual way, especially in a shop or on the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصفّح الأشياء باسترخاء، في متجر أو على الإنترنت.
entries.example: She spent the afternoon browsing in the bookshop.

entries.definitionEn: A computer program used to look at websites.
entries.arabicMeaning: برنامج حاسوبي لتصفح مواقع الإنترنت.
entries.example: Open the page in your browser.

entries.definitionEn: A dark mark on the skin where someone has been hit.
entries.arabicMeaning: كدمة: أثر داكن على الجلد بعد ضربة.
entries.example: He had a bruise on his arm after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: An object with many short hairs or wires, used for cleaning, painting, or tidying hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرشاة للتنظيف أو الرسم أو تسريح الشعر.
entries.example: I need a brush to paint the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To clean or tidy something with a brush.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّف شيئاً أو يسوّيه بالفرشاة.
entries.example: Please brush your teeth after breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A ball of air or gas inside a liquid, or a thin ball of liquid filled with air.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقاعة من هواء أو غاز في سائل، أو كرة رقيقة من السائل مملوءة هواء.
entries.example: The child blew a soap bubble.

entries.definitionEn: Full of cheerful energy; also used of a drink with many bubbles.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بالحيوية والمرح؛ وقد يوصف به شراب كثير الفقاعات.
entries.example: She has a bubbly personality that lifts the room.

entries.definitionEn: A pirate, especially one who attacked ships in earlier centuries.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرصان بحري، وخصوصاً ممن كانوا يغيرون على السفن في القرون الماضية.
entries.example: The novel follows a buccaneer across the Caribbean.

entries.definitionEn: To act as a pirate, taking goods by force in a reckless, adventurous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمارس القرصنة فينهب بالقوة على نحو مجازف.
entries.example: The crew buccaneered along the unguarded coast.

entries.definitionEn: A round open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids.
entries.arabicMeaning: دلو مستدير مفتوح له مقبض يُحمل فيه السائل.
entries.example: Fill the bucket with water.

entries.definitionEn: A small part on a plant that will grow into a leaf or flower.
entries.arabicMeaning: برعم على النبات سيصير ورقة أو زهرة.
entries.example: The trees are covered in green buds.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a friend.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة غير رسمية تعني الصديق أو الرفيق.
entries.example: He went hiking with his buddy.

entries.definitionEn: Cheap; made or sold to cost as little as possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخيص أو اقتصادي، أُعدّ ليكون منخفض التكلفة.
entries.example: They stayed in a budget hotel near the station.

entries.definitionEn: A plan of how much money you have and how you will spend it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميزانية: خطة تبين المال المتاح وكيف سيُنفَق.
entries.example: We need a bigger budget for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Something that reduces the shock of a change, blow, or difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاجز يخفف صدمة تغيّر أو ضربة أو ضائقة.
entries.example: Cash savings act as a buffer in hard months.

entries.definitionEn: To protect someone or something from harm or from a sudden change.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفف الأثر أو يحمي من ضرر أو من تغيّر مفاجئ.
entries.example: Savings can buffer a family against a sudden loss of income.

entries.definitionEn: A person who behaves in a silly, comic, and often embarrassing way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يتصرّف بتهريج أحمق يثير الحرج في كثير من الأحيان.
entries.example: He played the buffoon to hide his nerves.

entries.definitionEn: Silly comic behaviour that makes a person look foolish.
entries.arabicMeaning: تهريج وسلوك أحمق يجعل صاحبه موضع سخرية.
entries.example: The meeting dissolved into buffoonery after the joke.

entries.definitionEn: A small insect.
entries.arabicMeaning: حشرة صغيرة.
entries.example: There is a bug on the window.

entries.definitionEn: To make something by putting parts together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبني شيئاً بجمع أجزائه.
entries.example: They want to build a new school.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنّاء يعمل في تشييد المباني.
entries.example: The builder said the wall would be ready next week.

entries.definitionEn: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house or school.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبنى له سقف وجدران، كالبيت أو المدرسة.
entries.example: Our office is in a tall building.

entries.definitionEn: The glass part of a lamp that produces light.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللمبة: الجزء الزجاجي من المصباح الذي يصدر الضوء.
entries.example: I need a new bulb for the lamp.

entries.definitionEn: An eating illness in which a person eats a large amount and then tries to get rid of the food.
entries.arabicMeaning: النُهام العصبي: اضطراب يفرط فيه الشخص في الأكل ثم يسعى إلى إخراج الطعام.
entries.example: The clinic treats people who have bulimia.

entries.definitionEn: The main part of something; also great size or weight.
entries.arabicMeaning: معظم الشيء أو الجزء الأكبر منه؛ وقد يعني الحجم أو الوزن الكبير.
entries.example: The bulk of the work was finished by Friday.

entries.definitionEn: To become heavier and more muscular, usually by exercise and eating.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزداد كتلة عضلية، عادة بالتمرين والأكل.
entries.example: He bulked up before the sports season.

entries.definitionEn: Large and awkward to carry or store because of size or shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضخم الحجم صعب الحمل أو التخزين بسبب حجمه أو شكله.
entries.example: The old printer is too bulky for this desk.

entries.definitionEn: An adult male of the cattle family.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثور: الذكر البالغ من البقر.
entries.example: The bull stood in the middle of the field.

entries.definitionEn: A small metal object fired from a gun.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصاصة: جسم معدني صغير يُطلق من سلاح ناري.
entries.example: The police found a bullet in the wall.

entries.definitionEn: A short official report of news.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشرة إخبارية قصيرة رسمية.
entries.example: A weather bulletin warned of heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: To frighten or hurt someone weaker, again and again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنمّر على شخص أضعف فيخيفه أو يؤذيه مراراً.
entries.example: The school acts quickly if students bully others.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for the part of the body that you sit on.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة غير رسمية تعني المقعدة.
entries.example: He slipped on the ice and landed on his bum.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something or someone by accident, usually not very hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصطدم بشيء أو بشخص من غير قصد، في العادة اصطداماً خفيفاً.
entries.example: I bumped my knee on the table.

entries.definitionEn: The bar at the front or back of a car that protects it in a small crash.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصد في مقدمة السيارة أو مؤخرتها يحميها عند الاصطدام الخفيف.
entries.example: The bumper was scratched in the car park.

entries.definitionEn: A small round piece of bread, sometimes slightly sweet.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبزة صغيرة مستديرة، قد تكون محلاة قليلاً.
entries.example: I had a bun with butter for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A number of things of the same kind that are held or growing together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزمة أو مجموعة من أشياء من نوع واحد مجتمعة.
entries.example: She bought a bunch of grapes.

entries.definitionEn: A heavy load, or a duty that is difficult to bear.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبء ثقيل، أو واجب يصعب احتماله.
entries.example: Looking after the house alone was a burden.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a heavy duty or worry to carry.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُثقل شخصاً بواجب أو همّ.
entries.example: I do not want to burden you with my problems.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to bear because it takes too much time, money, or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهق يصعب احتماله لما يطلبه من وقت أو مال أو جهد.
entries.example: The new rules felt burdensome to small shops.

entries.definitionEn: An office or organisation that provides a particular service.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب أو هيئة تقدّم خدمة معيّنة.
entries.example: She works at a travel bureau downtown.

entries.definitionEn: A system of official rules and offices that can be slow and complicated.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز إداري كثير القواعد، قد يكون بطيئاً ومعقّداً.
entries.example: The permit was delayed by bureaucracy.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to official rules and offices, often in a slow or inflexible way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيروقراطي: مرتبط بالقواعد الرسمية على نحو بطيء أو جامد.
entries.example: The process was slow and bureaucratic.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that follows official rules strictly, often without flexibility.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة بيروقراطية صارمة تفتقر إلى المرونة.
entries.example: The request was handled bureaucratically and took weeks.

entries.definitionEn: Growing or developing quickly and strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزدهر بسرعة ومتنامٍ بقوة.
entries.example: The city has a burgeoning food scene.

entries.definitionEn: A round piece of cooked meat served in a bread roll, often with salad.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة لحم مطبوخة مستديرة تُقدَّم في خبز، وغالباً مع خس.
entries.example: I ordered a burger and chips.

entries.definitionEn: A person who enters a building illegally in order to steal.
entries.arabicMeaning: لص يقتحم مبنى ليسرق.
entries.example: A burglar broke into the empty house.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of entering a building illegally in order to steal.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة اقتحام مبنى بقصد السرقة.
entries.example: There was a burglary on our street last night.

entries.definitionEn: To enter a building illegally and steal from it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسطو على مبنى فيسرق منه.
entries.example: Someone burgled the shop after closing time.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting a dead body in a grave.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدفن: وضع الميت في القبر.
entries.example: The burial will take place on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: An injury on the skin caused by fire or heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرق: إصابة في الجلد من نار أو حرارة.
entries.example: She had a small burn on her finger.

entries.definitionEn: To be on fire, or to damage something with fire or heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحترق، أو يُحرق شيئاً بالنار أو الحرارة.
entries.example: Dry wood burns slowly in a closed stove.

entries.definitionEn: On fire, or producing a strong feeling of heat or pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشتعل، أو يسبب حرارة أو ألماً شديداً.
entries.example: She felt a burning pain in her hand.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden short period of activity, sound, or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفعة مفاجئة قصيرة من نشاط أو صوت أو شعور.
entries.example: A burst of applause followed the speech.

entries.definitionEn: To break open suddenly, often because of pressure inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفجر أو ينشق فجأة، وغالباً من شدة الضغط في داخله.
entries.example: The balloon burst with a loud bang.

entries.definitionEn: To put a dead body, or something else, under the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفن جثماناً أو شيئاً آخر تحت التراب.
entries.example: They will bury the time capsule in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A large vehicle that carries people along a fixed route.
entries.arabicMeaning: حافلة كبيرة تنقل الناس في مسار ثابت.
entries.example: I go to work by bus.

entries.definitionEn: A place where buses start and finish their journeys.
entries.arabicMeaning: محطة حافلات تنطلق منها الرحلات وتنتهي عندها.
entries.example: Meet me at the bus station at six.

entries.definitionEn: A place at the side of the road where buses pick up passengers.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقف حافلة على جانب الطريق يصعد منه الركاب.
entries.example: Wait at the bus stop near the shop.

entries.definitionEn: A plant like a small tree, with many branches.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجيرة ذات أغصان كثيرة تشبه شجرة صغيرة.
entries.example: There is a rose bush in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: The work of buying and selling, or a company that does this.
entries.arabicMeaning: التجارة، أو شركة تمارس نشاطاً تجارياً.
entries.example: My uncle has a small business in town.

entries.definitionEn: A man who works in business, especially in a senior role.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل أعمال يعمل في التجارة، وخصوصاً في منصب مسؤول.
entries.example: The businessman flew to Dubai for a meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who works in business, especially in a senior role.
entries.arabicMeaning: امرأة أعمال تعمل في التجارة، وخصوصاً في منصب مسؤول.
entries.example: The businesswoman opened a second shop last year.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: to break something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكسر شيئاً، في كلام غير رسمي.
entries.example: He bust the chair when he sat down too hard.

entries.definitionEn: To move around in a busy, energetic way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحرك بنشاط وكثرة حركة.
entries.example: Waiters bustled between the kitchen and the tables.

entries.definitionEn: Full of busy movement and activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعجّ بالحركة والنشاط.
entries.example: The market is bustling on Saturday morning.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot to do, or full of activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشغول بكثرة العمل، أو مليء بالنشاط.
entries.example: She is busy with homework tonight.

entries.definitionEn: Used to join two ideas and show a difference or contrast.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف عطف بمعنى «لكن»، يربط جملتين بينهما اختلاف أو تضاد.
entries.example: I wanted to go out, but it started to rain.

entries.definitionEn: Except for; other than.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمعنى «سوى» أو «إلا»، أي باستثناء ما يُذكر بعده.
entries.example: Everyone but Sam arrived on time.

entries.definitionEn: A person who cuts and sells meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزّار يقطع اللحم ويبيعه.
entries.example: I bought lamb from the butcher.

entries.definitionEn: To kill an animal and cut it for meat; also to spoil a piece of work by doing it very badly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذبح حيواناً ويقطّعه للحمه؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً بمعنى إفساد عمل بسوء تنفيذه.
entries.example: He butchered the song by singing the wrong words.

entries.definitionEn: A yellow fat made from cream, used on bread and in cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: زبدة صفراء تُصنع من القشدة وتُدهن على الخبز أو تُستخدم في الطبخ.
entries.example: Spread some butter on the toast.

entries.definitionEn: An insect with large, often colourful wings.
entries.arabicMeaning: فراشة: حشرة ذات جناحين كبيرين وغالباً ملوّنين.
entries.example: A butterfly landed on the flower.

entries.definitionEn: A small round object used to fasten clothes, or something you press to operate a machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: زر لربط الثياب، أو زر يُضغط لتشغيل جهاز.
entries.example: One button on my coat is missing.

entries.definitionEn: To get something by paying money for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشتري شيئاً بالمال.
entries.example: I want to buy a new bag.

entries.definitionEn: A person who buys something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشترٍ: من يدفع مالاً ليحصل على شيء.
entries.example: The buyer asked for a lower price.

entries.definitionEn: A low continuous sound, or a feeling of excitement among people.
entries.arabicMeaning: أزيز مستمر، أو حالة من الحماس بين الناس.
entries.example: There was a buzz of conversation in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: To make a continuous low sound, like a bee or an electric machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث أزيزاً متواصلاً كصوت النحلة أو جهاز كهربائي.
entries.example: A fly buzzed around the lamp.

entries.definitionEn: A large bird of prey that often circles slowly in the sky.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائر جارح كبير يحوم ببطء في السماء، من الصقور الحوّامة.
entries.example: A buzzard circled above the field.

entries.definitionEn: An electric device that makes a buzzing sound as a signal.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز كهربائي يُصدر أزيزاً للتنبيه.
entries.example: Press the buzzer at the door.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show who does an action, or to mean beside something, or not later than a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يبيّن فاعل الفعل، أو يعني «بجانب»، أو «في موعد لا يتجاوز».
entries.example: The cake was made by my sister.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for goodbye.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة غير رسمية تعني «وداعاً».
entries.example: She waved and said bye as she left.

entries.definitionEn: To go around something instead of through it; to avoid a rule or person.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتف حول شيء بدل المرور به، أو يتجاوز قاعدة أو شخصاً.
entries.example: The new road bypasses the old town centre.

entries.definitionEn: A taxi.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيارة أجرة.
entries.example: We took a cab to the station.

entries.definitionEn: A round vegetable with thick green or white leaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: الملفوف: خضار مستدير بأوراق سميكة خضراء أو بيضاء.
entries.example: Chop the cabbage for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: A small wooden house, or a private room on a ship or plane.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوخ خشبي صغير، أو مقصورة خاصة في سفينة أو طائرة.
entries.example: We stayed in a cabin by the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture with doors, used for storing things. It can also mean a group of senior government ministers.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة ذات أبواب لحفظ الأشياء؛ وقد تعني مجلس الوزراء.
entries.example: She put the glasses in the kitchen cabinet.

entries.definitionEn: A thick wire or set of wires that carries electricity or electronic signals.
entries.arabicMeaning: كابل سميك من أسلاك ينقل الكهرباء أو الإشارات.
entries.example: The internet cable is behind the desk.

entries.definitionEn: A small place where you can buy drinks and light meals.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقهى صغير تُقدَّم فيه المشروبات والوجبات الخفيفة.
entries.example: We met at a cafe near the library.

entries.definitionEn: A restaurant, often in a school or workplace, where you choose food and carry it to a table.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطعم خدمة ذاتية، غالباً في مدرسة أو مكان عمل.
entries.example: Students eat lunch in the school cafeteria.

entries.definitionEn: To add caffeine to something, or to take caffeine in order to feel more awake.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزوّد شيئاً بالكافيين، أو يتناول الكافيين ليستيقظ أكثر.
entries.example: He caffeinated himself with two strong coffees.

entries.definitionEn: A box or space with bars, used to keep animals or birds.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفص ذو قضبان يُحفظ فيه حيوان أو طائر.
entries.example: The bird flew out of its cage.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet food made from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat, and then baked.
entries.arabicMeaning: كعكة حلوة تُخبز من دقيق وبيض وسكر ودهن.
entries.example: She baked a chocolate cake.

entries.definitionEn: Causing, or resulting from, a sudden disaster.
entries.arabicMeaning: كارثي: مسبّب لكارثة مفاجئة أو ناشئ عنها.
entries.example: The storm had a calamitous effect on the harvest.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes or resembles a disaster.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو كارثي يوقع كارثة أو يشبهها.
entries.example: The plan failed calamitously on the first day.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden event that causes great damage or distress.
entries.arabicMeaning: كارثة أو نازلة تفاجئ الناس بضرر بالغ أو كرب شديد.
entries.example: The flood was a calamity for the valley towns.

entries.definitionEn: To find a number or amount by using mathematics.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحسب عدداً أو مقداراً بالعمليات الرياضية.
entries.example: Calculate the total cost of the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية الحساب الرياضي للتوصل إلى رقم أو مقدار.
entries.example: Double-check your calculation before you pay.

entries.definitionEn: A small electronic device used for mathematical calculations.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة حاسبة إلكترونية صغيرة.
entries.example: You may use a calculator in this test.

entries.definitionEn: A chart of the days, weeks, and months of a year, used to plan dates.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقويم يعرض أيام السنة وأسابيعها وشهورها لترتيب المواعيد.
entries.example: Mark the meeting on your calendar.

entries.definitionEn: An act of speaking to someone on the telephone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكالمة هاتفية.
entries.example: I had a call from my sister this morning.

entries.definitionEn: To telephone someone, or to give someone or something a name.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصل بشخص هاتفياً، أو يسمّي شخصاً أو شيئاً.
entries.example: Please call me when you arrive.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes a telephone call.
entries.arabicMeaning: المتصل: من يُجري المكالمة الهاتفية.
entries.example: The caller did not leave a name.

entries.definitionEn: Showing no sympathy for other people's pain or trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الشفقة، لا يكترث لمعاناة الآخرين.
entries.example: It was callous to laugh at her mistake.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows no sympathy for other people's suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقسوة باردة لا تراعي ألم الآخرين.
entries.example: He callously ignored their request for help.

entries.definitionEn: Quiet and not showing strong emotion; also used of weather or water that is still.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ لا يظهر انفعالاً شديداً؛ ويوصف به الجو أو الماء الساكن.
entries.example: Keep your voice calm when you speak to the child.

entries.definitionEn: In a quiet, controlled way, without showing strong emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء وضبط للنفس من غير انفعال ظاهر.
entries.example: She spoke calmly to the frightened child.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being quiet and not showing strong emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة الهدوء وعدم الانفعال.
entries.example: His calmness helped the others stay steady.

entries.definitionEn: A unit that measures the energy that food gives the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعرة حرارية: وحدة تقيس الطاقة التي يمنحها الطعام للجسم.
entries.example: This drink has only ten calories.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to calories; containing a large amount of energy from food.
entries.arabicMeaning: حراري؛ غني بالسعرات الحرارية.
entries.example: Nuts are a calorific snack, so a small handful is enough.

entries.definitionEn: A large animal with one or two humps, used in dry regions to carry people and goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمل: حيوان كبير بسنام واحد أو سنامين يُستخدم للحمل في المناطق الجافة.
entries.example: A camel walked slowly across the sand.

entries.definitionEn: A device used to take photographs or to record video.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاميرا: جهاز لالتقاط الصور أو تسجيل الفيديو.
entries.example: I forgot my camera at home.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people live in tents or simple buildings for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيم يعيش فيه الناس في خيام أو مبانٍ بسيطة لفترة.
entries.example: The children stayed at a summer camp.

entries.definitionEn: To sleep outdoors in a tent.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيم وينام في خيمة في العراء.
entries.example: We camped by the river for two nights.

entries.definitionEn: A planned set of activities intended to achieve a particular goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: حملة منظّمة من أنشطة ترمي إلى تحقيق هدف معيّن.
