entries.example: The city started a campaign to reduce waste.

entries.definitionEn: To work in an organised way to achieve a public goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّم حملة أو يشارك فيها لتحقيق هدف عام.
entries.example: She campaigned for safer roads in her town.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of staying in a tent, usually on holiday.
entries.arabicMeaning: التخييم: الإقامة في خيمة، وغالباً في عطلة.
entries.example: Camping is cheaper than staying in a hotel.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people can stay in tents or caravans.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقع تخييم يُنصب فيه الخيام أو تُوقف الكرفانات.
entries.example: The campsite has showers and a small shop.

entries.definitionEn: The land and buildings of a university or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحرم الجامعي بما فيه من أرض ومبانٍ.
entries.example: The library is in the middle of the campus.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to say that someone is able to do something, or that it is possible or allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يأتي قبل الفعل ليدل على القدرة أو الإمكان أو الإذن.
entries.example: She can swim very well.

entries.definitionEn: A metal container for food or drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: علبة معدنية للطعام أو الشراب.
entries.example: There is a can of soup in the cupboard.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow waterway made by people for boats or for water supply.
entries.arabicMeaning: قناة مائية صناعية طويلة ضيقة للسفن أو لنقل المياه.
entries.example: The boat moved slowly along the canal.

entries.definitionEn: To say that a planned event will not happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلغي حدثاً أو موعداً كان مقرراً.
entries.example: They had to cancel the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A serious disease in which some cells in the body grow in a harmful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: السرطان: مرض خطير تنمو فيه بعض خلايا الجسم على نحو ضار.
entries.example: Early tests can help doctors find cancer.

entries.definitionEn: Honest and direct, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
entries.arabicMeaning: صريح ومباشر، حتى حين تكون الحقيقة مزعجة.
entries.example: She gave a candid account of what went wrong.

entries.definitionEn: A person who wants to be chosen for a job or an elected position.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرشح لوظيفة أو لمنصب يُختار بالانتخاب.
entries.example: There were three candidates for the manager's job.

entries.definitionEn: In an honest, direct way, without hiding the truth.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصراحة مباشرة من غير إخفاء للحقيقة.
entries.example: He spoke candidly about the team's mistakes.

entries.definitionEn: A stick of wax with a string through the middle that burns to give light.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمعة من شمع وفتيل تُحرق للإضاءة.
entries.example: Light a candle if the power goes out.

entries.definitionEn: Sweet food made with sugar, especially in small pieces.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلوى سكرية، وخصوصاً قطعاً صغيرة.
entries.example: The child asked for a piece of candy.

entries.definitionEn: A long stick that someone uses to help them walk.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصا طويلة يُستعان بها على المشي.
entries.example: He walked slowly with a cane after the operation.

entries.definitionEn: Preserved in a metal can.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلّب: محفوظ في علبة معدنية.
entries.example: We used canned tomatoes for the sauce.

entries.definitionEn: A heavy metal ball once fired from a cannon.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة مدفع ثقيلة كانت تُطلق من المدفع قديماً.
entries.example: The museum keeps a cannonball from the old fort.

entries.definitionEn: A light, narrow boat that you move with a paddle.
entries.arabicMeaning: زورق خفيف ضيق يُحرَّك بالمجداف.
entries.example: They crossed the lake in a canoe.

entries.definitionEn: The accepted set of important works or principles in a field.
entries.arabicMeaning: المجموعة المعتمدة من الأعمال أو المبادئ في ميدان ما.
entries.example: Those novels now belong to the literary canon.

entries.definitionEn: A place in a school, factory, or office where meals are served.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقصف في مدرسة أو مصنع أو مكتب تُقدَّم فيه الوجبات.
entries.example: Lunch in the office canteen is cheap.

entries.definitionEn: A soft hat with a hard curved part at the front.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبعة خفيفة ذات حافة أمامية صلبة منحنية.
entries.example: He wore a cap to keep the sun off his face.

entries.definitionEn: The power or ability to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة أو الإمكانية على أداء شيء ما.
entries.example: The software has the capability to edit video.

entries.definitionEn: Having the skill or ability to do something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر؛ يملك المهارة أو القدرة على إنجاز أمر
entries.example: She is capable of finishing the report without any help.

entries.definitionEn: Having a great deal of space; able to hold a large amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحب؛ يتسع لمقدار كبير
entries.example: The capacious bag held her laptop, books, and camera.

entries.definitionEn: The amount that a place or container can hold. Also a person's ability to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعة الاستيعاب؛ أو قدرة الشخص على أداء أمر
entries.example: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.

entries.definitionEn: A large form of a letter, such as A or B, used at the start of a sentence or a name.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف كبير يُكتب في بداية الجملة أو الاسم
entries.example: Begin each sentence with a capital letter.

entries.definitionEn: The city where a country's government is based.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاصمة؛ المدينة التي تقوم فيها حكومة البلد
entries.example: Paris is the capital of France.

entries.definitionEn: A small container of medicine that you swallow. Also a small closed space, such as part of a spacecraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبسولة دواء؛ أو حيز مغلق صغير كما في المركبة الفضائية
entries.example: The doctor told her to take one capsule after breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: The person in charge of a ship, an aircraft, or a sports team.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبطان سفينة أو طائرة؛ أو قائد فريق رياضي
entries.example: The captain asked everyone to stay in their seats.

entries.definitionEn: A short text that explains a picture, or words shown on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعليق يشرح صورة أو نص يظهر على الشاشة
entries.example: The caption under the photo named everyone in the group.

entries.definitionEn: A person or animal that is being held and is not free to leave.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسير؛ شخص أو حيوان محتجز وغير حر
entries.example: The keepers moved the captive into a quieter enclosure.

entries.definitionEn: The act of catching a person or animal, or of recording an image or a moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسر أو التقاط؛ عملية القبض أو تسجيل صورة أو لحظة
entries.example: The capture of the injured bird allowed a vet to treat it.

entries.definitionEn: To catch a person or animal and take control of them. Also to record an image or a feeling well.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأسر أو يقبض؛ وأيضاً يلتقط صورة أو يعبّر عن شعور بدقة
entries.example: The photographer tried to capture the light on the water.

entries.definitionEn: A road vehicle with an engine and seats for a driver and passengers.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيارة
entries.example: She drove her car to work every morning.

entries.definitionEn: An area where people can leave their cars for a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقف سيارات
entries.example: We left the car in the car park behind the station.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle that people live or sleep in on holiday, pulled by a car.
entries.arabicMeaning: عربة سكن تُجرّ بالسيارة في الرحلات
entries.example: They spent the summer travelling in a caravan along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A gas that people and animals breathe out, and that is produced when things burn. Plants take it in to grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثاني أكسيد الكربون
entries.example: Trees take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of carbon dioxide a person, product, or activity produces, used as a measure of environmental effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: البصمة الكربونية؛ مقدار ما يُنتَج من ثاني أكسيد الكربون
entries.example: Taking the train instead of flying can reduce your carbon footprint.

entries.definitionEn: A poisonous gas with no smell, produced when fuel burns without enough air.
entries.arabicMeaning: أول أكسيد الكربون؛ غاز سام بلا رائحة
entries.example: A blocked chimney can allow carbon monoxide to collect indoors.

entries.definitionEn: A chemical element found in all living things and in coal, oil, and diamonds.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكربون؛ عنصر كيميائي يدخل في تركيب الكائنات الحية
entries.example: Diamonds are made of carbon arranged in a tight crystal.

entries.definitionEn: To turn a substance into carbon, usually by heating it without enough air.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفحّم؛ يحوّل مادة إلى كربون بالحرارة مع نقص الهواء
entries.example: Intense heat can carbonize wood until only a black shell remains.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece of stiff paper used to pay, play a game, prove who you are, or send a message.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة للدفع أو اللعب أو إثبات الهوية أو إرسال رسالة
entries.example: Please show your card at the door.

entries.definitionEn: Thick, stiff paper used to make boxes and packaging.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورق مقوّى تُصنع منه الصناديق
entries.example: She packed the books in a cardboard box.

entries.definitionEn: A knitted jacket that opens at the front and usually has buttons.
entries.arabicMeaning: سترة محبوكة تُزرَّر من الأمام
entries.example: He put on a cardigan because the office was cold.

entries.definitionEn: Attention and protection given to a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناية؛ اهتمام وحماية
entries.example: Please take care of your brother while I am out.

entries.definitionEn: To feel that someone or something is important; to be concerned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهتم؛ يبالي بأمر أو بشخص
entries.example: I care about what happens to this team.

entries.definitionEn: A job or series of jobs that you do for a long time, often with progress.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسار مهني يمتد سنوات وتتقدم فيه
entries.example: She wants a career in medicine after she graduates.

entries.definitionEn: Without worries or heavy responsibilities; relaxed and light in mood.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالٍ من الهموم؛ مرتاح البال
entries.example: They spent a carefree afternoon by the lake.

entries.definitionEn: Giving attention so that you do not make a mistake or cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: حريص؛ منتبه حتى لا يخطئ أو يؤذي
entries.example: Be careful when you cross the street.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows attention and caution.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعناية؛ بحذر وانتباه
entries.example: She packed the glasses carefully so they would not break.

entries.definitionEn: Not giving enough attention, so that mistakes or accidents happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمل؛ لا يولي الأمر انتباهاً كافياً
entries.example: A careless mistake on the form delayed her application.

entries.definitionEn: Without enough attention or thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإهمال؛ من دون انتباه كافٍ
entries.example: He carelessly left the window open during the storm.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of not paying enough attention, which can lead to mistakes or harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: إهمال؛ قلة الانتباه التي قد تؤدي إلى خطأ أو ضرر
entries.example: The accident was caused by carelessness, not by bad luck.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and showing that you want to help and protect other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطوف؛ يُظهر رغبة في مساعدة الآخرين وحمايتهم
entries.example: She is a caring nurse who listens to every patient.

entries.definitionEn: A public festival with music, dancing, and colourful clothes, often in the street.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرنفال؛ مهرجان شعبي بالموسيقى والرقص والأزياء
entries.example: The city holds a carnival every spring with parades and music.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make and repair wooden structures and furniture.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجّار؛ من يصنع الأعمال الخشبية ويصلحها
entries.example: The carpenter fitted new shelves along the kitchen wall.

entries.definitionEn: The skill or work of making and repairing things from wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: النجارة؛ حرفة صنع الأشياء من الخشب وإصلاحها
entries.example: He learned carpentry from his uncle and now builds cabinets.

entries.definitionEn: A thick covering for a floor, made of wool or a similar material.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجادة سميكة تغطي الأرضية
entries.example: They chose a soft carpet for the living room.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement in which several people share one car for regular journeys.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشاركة سيارة واحدة في تنقلات منتظمة
entries.example: Their office carpool saves money on parking every week.

entries.definitionEn: A separate section of a train for passengers. Also an old vehicle pulled by horses.
entries.arabicMeaning: عربة ركاب في القطار؛ أو عربة قديمة تجرها الخيل
entries.example: We found seats in the last carriage of the train.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that transports people or goods. Also a person or animal that can pass on an infection.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناقل للركاب أو البضائع؛ أو حامل لعدوى قد ينقلها
entries.example: The airline is a major carrier on transatlantic routes.

entries.definitionEn: A long orange root vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزر
entries.example: She cut a carrot into sticks for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: To hold something and take it from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحمل شيئاً وينقله من مكان إلى آخر
entries.example: Can you carry this bag for me?

entries.definitionEn: A cardboard or plastic box used for food or drink, such as milk or juice.
entries.arabicMeaning: علبة من الورق المقوّى أو البلاستيك للطعام أو الشراب
entries.example: He bought a carton of milk on the way home.

entries.definitionEn: A funny drawing, or a short film made from drawings.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم فكاهي؛ أو فيلم قصير من الرسوم المتحركة
entries.example: She watched a short cartoon before the evening news.

entries.definitionEn: To cut wood, stone, or food into a shape, or to cut meat into pieces.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينحت الخشب أو الحجر، أو يقطّع اللحم إلى قطع
entries.example: She learned to carve a simple pattern into a piece of wood.

entries.definitionEn: To fall or flow down in a large amount, like water over rocks.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدفق متساقطاً بغزارة كالشلال
entries.example: Water cascaded over the rocks after the heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: A particular situation or example of something. Also a box or cover for keeping something safe.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة أو ظرف معيّن؛ أو حافظة تحمي شيئاً
entries.example: In this case, we should wait until Monday.

entries.definitionEn: Money in the form of notes and coins, not a card or a cheque.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقد؛ مال من ورق ومعدن لا بطاقة ولا شيك
entries.example: I paid for the tickets in cash.

entries.definitionEn: A machine, usually outside a bank, from which you can take money using a card.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز صرف آلي لسحب النقود بالبطاقة
entries.example: There is a cashpoint next to the supermarket.

entries.definitionEn: A small plastic case holding tape for playing music or recording sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريط كاسيت للموسيقى أو لتسجيل الصوت
entries.example: He found an old cassette of songs from his student years.

entries.definitionEn: A large strong building with thick walls, built in the past to protect people.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلعة حصينة بُنيت قديماً للحماية
entries.example: We visited an old castle on the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Relaxed and not formal, especially in clothes or behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير رسمي؛ مريح في اللباس أو السلوك
entries.example: The office allows casual clothes on Fridays.

entries.definitionEn: In a relaxed, informal way, without ceremony.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل غير رسمي؛ باسترخاء ومن دون تكلّف
entries.example: She casually mentioned that she might move abroad.

entries.definitionEn: A small animal with fur that people often keep as a pet.
entries.arabicMeaning: قط
entries.example: The cat slept on the sofa all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A list of items, often with short descriptions, such as products for sale or books in a library.
entries.arabicMeaning: فهرس أو كتالوج يسرد أصنافاً مع وصف موجز
entries.example: I ordered the lamp from the spring catalogue.

entries.definitionEn: Something that causes an important change to happen more quickly. In chemistry, a substance that speeds up a reaction.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل محفّز يسرّع تغيّراً مهماً؛ وفي الكيمياء مادة تسرّع التفاعل
entries.example: The new timetable was a catalyst for better attendance.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden event that causes great damage or suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: كارثة؛ حدث مفاجئ يسبب ضرراً أو معاناة بالغة
entries.example: The flood was a catastrophe for the farming towns.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes or resembles disaster; with extremely serious failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل كارثي؛ على نحو بالغ الخطورة أو الفشل
entries.example: The plan failed catastrophically when the equipment froze.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking hold of something that is moving, especially a ball.
entries.arabicMeaning: التقاط شيء متحرك، وخصوصاً الكرة
entries.example: That was a great catch in the last minute of the game.

entries.definitionEn: To take hold of something that is moving, especially with your hands.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتقط؛ يمسك شيئاً متحركاً بيديه
entries.example: Can you catch the ball?

entries.definitionEn: Easy to remember and pleasant to hear, especially a song or phrase.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذّاب سهل التذكر، وخصوصاً في لحن أو عبارة
entries.example: The advert had a catchy tune that stayed in my head.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting things into groups according to type.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصنيف؛ وضع الأشياء في مجموعات بحسب نوعها
entries.example: The library's categorization of books makes them easy to find.

entries.definitionEn: To put people or things into groups according to type.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنّف؛ يضع الناس أو الأشياء في مجموعات بحسب النوع
entries.example: We categorize the emails by topic so nothing is missed.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people or things that are similar in some way.
entries.arabicMeaning: فئة؛ مجموعة تتشابه في صفة ما
entries.example: This book is in the history category.

entries.definitionEn: The work of providing food and drink for events or for a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: توفير الطعام والشراب للمناسبات أو لمجموعة من الناس
entries.example: The hotel handles the catering for weddings and conferences.

entries.definitionEn: A large, important church that is the main church of a bishop.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتدرائية؛ الكنيسة الرئيسية الكبرى في أبرشية
entries.example: Visitors climbed the tower of the old cathedral.

entries.definitionEn: Cows and bulls kept on a farm for meat or milk.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماشية؛ أبقار تُربّى للحوم أو للحليب
entries.example: The farmer moved the cattle into a new field.

entries.definitionEn: The reason why something happens. Also an aim or principle that people support.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبب حدوث شيء؛ أو قضية يؤيدها الناس
entries.example: Doctors are still looking for the cause of the illness.

entries.definitionEn: To make something happen, especially something bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبّب؛ يجعل شيئاً يحدث وخصوصاً إن كان سيئاً
entries.example: Heavy rain caused delays on the motorway.

entries.definitionEn: Care taken to avoid danger or mistakes. Also an official warning.
entries.arabicMeaning: حذر لتفادي الخطر أو الخطأ؛ وقد يعني إنذاراً رسمياً
entries.example: Drive with caution on the icy road.

entries.definitionEn: Careful to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking unnecessary risks.
entries.arabicMeaning: حَذِر؛ يتجنب الخطر والخطأ ولا يخاطر بلا داعٍ
entries.example: He is cautious with money after losing his job.

entries.definitionEn: A large natural hole in a hillside or under the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: كهف؛ تجويف طبيعي في سفح أو تحت الأرض
entries.example: They explored a cave near the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A hole or empty space inside a solid object, such as a tooth or a wall.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجويف؛ فراغ داخل جسم صلب كسنّ أو جدار
entries.example: The dentist filled a cavity in her back tooth.

entries.definitionEn: A small, low island of sand or coral, especially in the Caribbean.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزيرة رملية أو مرجانية منخفضة، وخصوصاً في الكاريبي
entries.example: The boat stopped at a quiet cay for the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A small round disc used to store music or other information.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرص مدمج لتخزين الموسيقى أو المعلومات
entries.example: She bought a CD of the new album.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that plays music from a CD.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز تشغيل الأقراص المدمجة
entries.example: He put the disc in the CD player and sat down.

entries.definitionEn: A CD used to store computer programs or data that you can read but not easily change.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرص مدمج للقراءة يخزّن برامج أو بيانات حاسوبية
entries.example: The software came on a CD-ROM with the textbook.

entries.definitionEn: To stop happening, or to stop doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقف عن الحدوث أو يكفّ عن فعل شيء
entries.example: The factory will cease production at the end of the month.

entries.definitionEn: Continuing without stopping; constant.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا ينقطع؛ مستمر بلا توقف
entries.example: The ceaseless noise from the road made sleep difficult.

entries.definitionEn: Without stopping; continually.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا انقطاع؛ باستمرار
entries.example: Rain fell ceaselessly through the night.

entries.definitionEn: The top inside surface of a room. Also an official upper limit on an amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: السطح الداخلي أعلى الغرفة؛ أو حد أعلى رسمي لمقدار ما
entries.example: She painted the ceiling white to make the room feel larger.

entries.definitionEn: To do something enjoyable because of a special event or a success.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتفل بمناسبة خاصة أو بنجاح
entries.example: We celebrate her birthday with a small dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A special event or activity to mark a happy occasion.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتفال بمناسبة سعيدة
entries.example: There was a celebration after they finished the project.

entries.definitionEn: A famous person, especially in entertainment.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخصية مشهورة، وخصوصاً في مجال الترفيه
entries.example: A television celebrity opened the new shop.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest living part of an animal or plant. Also a small room, especially in a prison.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلية حية في نبات أو حيوان؛ أو غرفة صغيرة وخصوصاً في سجن
entries.example: The human body is made of millions of cells.

entries.definitionEn: A room under a house, often used for storing things.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبو؛ غرفة تحت المنزل تُستخدم للتخزين
entries.example: They keep wine and spare furniture in the cellar.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays the cello.
entries.arabicMeaning: عازف تشيللو
entries.example: The cellist played a slow piece at the start of the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A large stringed instrument, held between the knees and played with a bow.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشيللو؛ آلة وترية كبيرة تُعزف بالقوس بين الركبتين
entries.example: She has played the cello since she was twelve.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land where dead people are buried.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقبرة
entries.example: The old cemetery lies just outside the village.

entries.definitionEn: A coin or unit of money worth one hundredth of a dollar or a similar currency.
entries.arabicMeaning: سنت؛ جزء من مئة من الدولار أو من عملة مشابهة
entries.example: The apple costs ninety-nine cents.

entries.definitionEn: The middle of a place or thing. Also a building used for a particular activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسط المكان؛ أو مركز يُقام فيه نشاط معيّن
entries.example: The fountain is in the centre of the square.

entries.definitionEn: A scale for measuring temperature in which water freezes at 0 and boils at 100; now often called Celsius.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقياس مئوي للحرارة يجمد فيه الماء عند الصفر ويغلي عند المئة
entries.example: The temperature rose to thirty degrees centigrade.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.
entries.arabicMeaning: سنتيمتر؛ جزء من مئة من المتر
entries.example: The photo is ten centimetres wide.

entries.definitionEn: In or near the middle. Also most important.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الوسط أو قريب منه؛ وأيضاً أساسي
entries.example: The hotel is in a central part of the city.

entries.definitionEn: A system that heats a whole building from one source, usually through radiators.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدفئة مركزية للمبنى كله من مصدر واحد
entries.example: The flat has central heating, so the rooms stay warm in winter.

entries.definitionEn: Organized so that control and decisions come from one main place or authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركزي التنظيم؛ تُتخذ قراراته من جهة واحدة رئيسة
entries.example: The company uses a centralized system for all hiring.

entries.definitionEn: A period of one hundred years.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرن؛ مدة مئة سنة
entries.example: This church was built in the twelfth century.

entries.definitionEn: A breakfast food made from grain, often eaten with milk. Also a grass grown for its grain, such as wheat.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام إفطار من الحبوب؛ أو محصول حبي مثل القمح
entries.example: He eats cereal with milk every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A formal public or social event, often with set words and actions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراسم رسمية أو اجتماعية ذات أقوال وأفعال مقررة
entries.example: The award ceremony begins at seven o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: Sure that something is true; without doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: متأكد؛ واثق من صحة شيء بلا شك
entries.example: I am certain that I locked the door.

entries.definitionEn: Without any doubt; used to agree strongly or to emphasize.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالتأكيد؛ بلا شك ولتوكيد الموافقة
entries.example: I will certainly call you when I arrive.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being completely sure, or something that is sure to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقين؛ حالة التأكد التام أو أمر لا شك في وقوعه
entries.example: There is no certainty that the train will be on time.

entries.definitionEn: An official document that states a fact, such as a qualification or a birth.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهادة رسمية تثبت أمراً مثل مؤهل أو ميلاد
entries.example: She received a certificate at the end of the course.

entries.definitionEn: The official process of stating that someone or something meets a standard.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتماد رسمي بأن شخصاً أو شيئاً يستوفي معياراً
entries.example: The laboratory needs certification before it can test samples.

entries.definitionEn: To state officially that something is true, or that someone has a particular skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشهد رسمياً بصحة أمر أو بكفاءة شخص
entries.example: The board will certify the results next week.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of stopping or ending, especially of an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقف نشاط أو انتهاؤه
entries.example: Residents welcomed the cessation of overnight construction.

entries.definitionEn: A line of metal rings joined together, used for fastening or decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلسلة من حلقات معدنية للربط أو للزينة
entries.example: She wore a thin gold chain around her neck.

entries.definitionEn: A seat with a back, for one person.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرسي بمَسند ظهر لشخص واحد
entries.example: Please sit on this chair.

entries.definitionEn: The person in charge of a meeting or an organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيس اجتماع أو مؤسسة
entries.example: The chairman opened the meeting at nine.

entries.definitionEn: Something difficult that tests your skill or determination.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحدٍّ؛ أمر صعب يختبر المهارة أو العزيمة
entries.example: Learning a new language is a challenge, but it is worthwhile.

entries.definitionEn: To question whether something is true or right, or to invite someone to compete.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعترض على صحة أمر أو يدعو شخصاً إلى منافسة
entries.example: Several scientists challenged the results of the study.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult in a way that tests your ability and keeps you interested.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعب على نحو يختبر القدرة ويبقي الاهتمام
entries.example: She asked for a more challenging role at work.

entries.definitionEn: A sparkling white wine, often drunk at celebrations.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامبانيا؛ نبيذ أبيض فوّار يُشرب في الاحتفالات
entries.example: They opened a bottle of champagne after the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has won a competition, especially in sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطل؛ من فاز في مسابقة وخصوصاً رياضية
entries.example: She is the champion of last year's tennis tournament.

entries.definitionEn: A competition to find the best player or team.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطولة لتحديد أفضل لاعب أو فريق
entries.example: Our school team reached the final of the championship.

entries.definitionEn: A possibility that something will happen. Also an opportunity to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتمال حدوث شيء؛ أو فرصة للقيام بأمر
entries.example: There is a good chance of rain this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A senior official, such as the head of government in some countries, or the head of a university.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستشار أو رئيس حكومة في بعض البلدان؛ أو رئيس جامعة
entries.example: The chancellor announced a new plan for the university.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming different. Also coins you get back when you pay with more than the price.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغيّر شيء ليصبح مختلفاً؛ أو باقي النقود بعد الدفع
entries.example: There has been a big change in the timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To make or become different. Also to put on different clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغيّر أو يتغيّر؛ وأيضاً يبدّل ملابسه
entries.example: I need to change my shoes before we go out.

entries.definitionEn: A television station. Also a passage for water, or a way of sending information.
entries.arabicMeaning: قناة تلفزيونية؛ أو مجرى ماء أو وسيلة لنقل المعلومات
entries.example: Switch to channel four for the news.

entries.definitionEn: A state of complete confusion and lack of order.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضى تامة وانعدام للنظام
entries.example: There was chaos at the station when the trains were cancelled.

entries.definitionEn: In a state of complete confusion and disorder.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضوي؛ يعمه الاضطراب واختلال النظام
entries.example: The first day of the sale was chaotic, with long queues.

entries.definitionEn: In a confused, disordered way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو فوضوي مضطرب
entries.example: Papers were stacked chaotically across the desk.

entries.definitionEn: One of the main numbered parts of a book.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصل من الفصول المرقّمة في كتاب
entries.example: Read chapter three before the next class.

entries.definitionEn: A person in a book, play, or film. Also a letter or symbol used in writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخصية في قصة أو مسرحية أو فيلم؛ أو حرف في الكتابة
entries.example: My favourite character in the story is the teacher.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of a particular person, place, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مميّز؛ نموذجي لشخص أو مكان أو شيء
entries.example: Delay is characteristic of this busy airport.

entries.definitionEn: A typical quality or feature of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمة أو صفة مميّزة لشخص أو لشيء
entries.example: Honesty is an important characteristic of a good friend.

entries.definitionEn: The way a writer presents a person in a story; the description of someone's nature.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم الشخصية في النص؛ أو وصف طبائع شخص
entries.example: The novel's characterization of the detective feels true to life.

entries.definitionEn: To describe the typical qualities of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصف السمات النموذجية لشخص أو لشيء
entries.example: Critics characterize her writing as clear and calm.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of money you must pay for something. Also official control, or a statement that someone broke the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجرة مستحقة؛ أو مسؤولية رسمية؛ أو تهمة قانونية
entries.example: There is a small charge for using the car park.

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone to pay a particular amount. Also to put electrical power into a battery.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقاضى مبلغاً مقابل خدمة؛ أو يشحن بطارية
entries.example: They charge ten pounds for delivery.

entries.definitionEn: An open two-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, used in the past in war or races.
entries.arabicMeaning: عربة قديمة ذات عجلتين تجرها الخيل في الحرب أو السباق
entries.example: The museum shows a Roman chariot from a race.

entries.definitionEn: An organization that helps people in need. Also the act of giving help or money to those people.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمعية خيرية؛ أو عمل العطاء للمحتاجين
entries.example: She gives money to a charity that supports hospitals.

entries.definitionEn: A quality that attracts and pleases people. Also a small object worn for luck.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاذبية لطيفة تُرضي الناس؛ أو تعويذة صغيرة تُلبس للتفاؤل
entries.example: The old town has a quiet charm in the evening.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant and attractive in a way that makes people like a person or a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحر؛ لطيف وجذّاب يبعث على الإعجاب
entries.example: They stayed in a charming hotel near the river.

entries.definitionEn: A drawing or table that shows information clearly, such as numbers or trends.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخطط أو جدول يوضح معلومات كالأرقام أو الاتجاهات
entries.example: The chart shows how prices rose last year.

entries.definitionEn: To record information on a chart, or to follow and describe the course of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرصد على مخطط؛ أو يتتبع مسار أمر ويصفه
entries.example: The report charts the rise in remote work over a decade.

entries.definitionEn: An official document that states the rights or purpose of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميثاق رسمي يحدّد حقوق جهة أو غايتها
entries.example: The university's charter sets out its duties to students.

entries.definitionEn: To hire a plane, boat, or bus for a particular journey.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستأجر طائرة أو سفينة أو حافلة لرحلة معيّنة
entries.example: The company chartered a plane to fly the team home.

entries.definitionEn: The act of running after someone or something in order to catch them.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطاردة للإمساك بشخص أو بشيء
entries.example: The police chase ended at the edge of town.

entries.definitionEn: To run after someone or something in order to catch them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطارد؛ يجري خلف شخص أو شيء ليمسكه
entries.example: The dog chased the ball across the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A friendly, informal conversation.
entries.arabicMeaning: دردشة؛ حديث ودي غير رسمي
entries.example: We had a short chat before the meeting started.

entries.definitionEn: A television or radio programme in which a host talks with guests.
entries.arabicMeaning: برنامج حواري يستضيف فيه المقدّم ضيوفاً
entries.example: She appeared on a chat show to talk about her new book.

entries.definitionEn: To talk in a friendly, informal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدردش؛ يتحدث بطريقة ودية غير رسمية
entries.example: They chat on the phone every Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to drive a private car for someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائق خاص يعمل لدى شخص آخر
entries.example: The chauffer waited by the car outside the hotel.

entries.definitionEn: To drive someone in a private car as a job or as a favour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقود سيارة خاصة لنقل شخص
entries.example: Her brother offered to chauffer the guests to the station.

entries.definitionEn: Costing little money.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخيص؛ ثمنه منخفض
entries.example: These shoes are cheap, but they last a long time.

entries.definitionEn: To behave dishonestly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game, a test, or a deal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغش؛ يتصرف بغير أمانة ليحصل على ميزة
entries.example: Students who cheat in the exam will have to retake it.

entries.definitionEn: The desk at an airport where you show your ticket and leave your bags before a flight.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب تسجيل الوصول في المطار قبل الرحلة
entries.example: We joined the queue at the check-in counter an hour before departure.

entries.definitionEn: The desk at an airport or hotel where you register on arrival.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب تسجيل الوصول في المطار أو الفندق
entries.example: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport and ticket.

entries.definitionEn: An act of looking at something to make sure it is correct or safe.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحص أو مراجعة للتأكد من الصحة أو السلامة
entries.example: Do a quick check of the doors before you leave.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something to make sure it is correct, safe, or as you expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحقق؛ ينظر ليتأكد من صحة شيء أو سلامته
entries.example: Please check your email before the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The place in a shop where you pay for goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندوق المحاسبة في المتجر حيث يُدفع ثمن المشتريات
entries.example: There was a long line at the checkout.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people or vehicles are stopped and inspected, often by officials.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقطة تفتيش يُوقف عندها الناس أو المركبات للفحص
entries.example: Drivers had to stop at a checkpoint on the mountain road.

entries.definitionEn: The soft part of your face below each eye.
entries.arabicMeaning: خد
entries.example: A tear ran down her cheek.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly rude or disrespectful in a playful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقح بخفة؛ قليل الأدب على نحو مرح
entries.example: He made a cheeky remark about my old coat.

entries.definitionEn: To shout in order to show support or happiness.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهتف تشجيعاً أو فرحاً
entries.example: The crowd began to cheer when the team scored.

entries.definitionEn: Happy and showing it in your face and behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح؛ يبدو سعيداً في وجهه وسلوكه
entries.example: She gave us a cheerful wave from the window.

entries.definitionEn: In a happy, pleasant way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمرح؛ بطريقة سعيدة لطيفة
entries.example: He cheerfully agreed to stay an extra hour.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being happy and pleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح؛ صفة البهجة ولطف المعشر
entries.example: Her cheerfulness made the long journey easier.

entries.definitionEn: A food made from milk, which can be soft or hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبن
entries.example: I like cheese on my sandwich.

entries.definitionEn: A skilled cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاهٍ محترف، وخصوصاً رئيس المطبخ في مطعم
entries.example: The chef prepared a simple soup for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to chemistry or to substances used in chemistry.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيميائي؛ متصل بعلم الكيمياء أو بمواده
entries.example: The factory follows strict chemical safety rules.

entries.definitionEn: A substance used in chemistry or produced by a chemical process.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة كيميائية
entries.example: Some household chemicals should be kept away from children.

entries.definitionEn: In British English, a person who prepares and sells medicines. Also a scientist who studies chemistry.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيدلي يجهّز الأدوية ويبيعها؛ أو عالم في الكيمياء
entries.example: I asked the chemist for something to ease a sore throat.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of substances and how they change and combine.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكيمياء؛ دراسة المواد وتغيّرها واتحادها
entries.example: She is studying chemistry at university.

entries.definitionEn: The treatment of disease, especially cancer, with chemical medicines.
entries.arabicMeaning: العلاج الكيميائي، وخصوصاً لمرض السرطان
entries.example: He started chemotherapy last month and is resting between sessions.

entries.definitionEn: A printed piece of paper from a bank that you write on to pay someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيك مصرفي يُكتب عليه لدفع مبلغ لشخص
entries.example: She paid the rent with a cheque.

entries.definitionEn: To love and protect someone or something that is important to you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتزّ بشخص أو بشيء غالٍ ويحافظ عليه
entries.example: I cherish the letters my grandmother wrote to me.

entries.definitionEn: Loved and valued highly, often for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزيز؛ محبوب ومقدَّر منذ زمن
entries.example: The photograph is one of her most cherished possessions.

entries.definitionEn: A small, round, usually red fruit with a stone inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرز؛ ثمرة صغيرة مستديرة ذات نواة
entries.example: She put a fresh cherry on top of the cake.

entries.definitionEn: A game for two players with pieces on a square board, in which the aim is to trap the other player's king.
entries.arabicMeaning: شطرنج؛ لعبة لشخصين على رقعة مربعة والغاية حصار الملك
entries.example: They play chess in the park on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: The front part of your body between your neck and your stomach.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدر؛ الجزء الأمامي من الجسم بين العنق والبطن
entries.example: He felt a pain in his chest after running.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة أدراج لحفظ الملابس
entries.example: She folded the shirts and put them in the chest of drawers.

entries.definitionEn: To bite food repeatedly with your teeth so that you can swallow it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمضغ الطعام بأسنانه ليتمكن من ابتلاعه
entries.example: You should chew each bite slowly.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet that you chew for a long time but do not swallow.
entries.arabicMeaning: علكة تُمضغ وقتاً طويلاً ولا تُبتلع
entries.example: Please do not leave chewing gum on the seat.

entries.definitionEn: A bird that is kept for its eggs and meat, or the meat of that bird.
entries.arabicMeaning: دجاج؛ أو لحم الدجاج
entries.example: We had chicken and rice for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Most important; main.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأهم أو الأساسي؛ الرئيسي
entries.example: Her chief reason for moving was a new job.

entries.definitionEn: The leader of a group, organization, or community.
entries.arabicMeaning: زعيم أو رئيس مجموعة أو مؤسسة أو جماعة
entries.example: The chief of the fire service spoke after the rescue.

entries.definitionEn: A young person who is not yet an adult.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفل
entries.example: The child was drawing at the kitchen table.

entries.definitionEn: The time of your life when you are a child.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفولة؛ مرحلة العمر قبل البلوغ
entries.example: She spent her childhood in a small coastal town.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of a child in a way that is not suitable for an adult; silly or immature.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفولي على نحو لا يليق بالبالغ؛ غير ناضج
entries.example: The argument over the remote control was childish.

entries.definitionEn: A small hot pepper used to give food a spicy taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: فلفل حار يُستخدم لإضفاء طعم لاذع على الطعام
entries.example: Add a little chilli to the soup if you like spicy food.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of cold, or a slight coldness in the air. Also a sudden feeling of fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: برد خفيف في الهواء؛ أو قشعريرة من الخوف
entries.example: There was a chill in the air after sunset.

entries.definitionEn: To make something cold, or to become cold. Informally, to rest and relax.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبرّد شيئاً أو يبرد؛ وفي الكلام غير الرسمي يسترخي
entries.example: Chill the wine for an hour before you serve it.

entries.definitionEn: Uncomfortably cold. Also unfriendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارد على نحو غير مريح؛ أو فاتر في المعاملة
entries.example: It was a chilly morning, so she wore a coat.

entries.definitionEn: A vertical pipe or structure that takes smoke from a fire out of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدخنة تخرج دخان النار من المبنى
entries.example: Smoke rose from the chimney of the cottage.

entries.definitionEn: An African ape that is intelligent and lives in groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمبانزي؛ قرد إفريقي ذكي يعيش في جماعات
entries.example: The chimpanzee used a stick to reach the fruit.

entries.definitionEn: The part of your face below your mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذقن
entries.example: He rested his chin on his hand while he thought.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece broken off something hard. Also a fried piece of potato, or a tiny electronic part.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسرة من شيء صلب؛ أو شريحة بطاطا مقلية؛ أو رقاقة إلكترونية
entries.example: There is a small chip on the rim of this cup.

entries.definitionEn: A short high sound made by a small bird or insect.
entries.arabicMeaning: زقزقة قصيرة حادة يصدرها طائر صغير أو حشرة
entries.example: We heard the chirp of a sparrow outside the window.

entries.definitionEn: To cut or shape wood or stone with a sharp tool that has a flat blade.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينحت الخشب أو الحجر بإزميل ذي حدّ مسطّح
entries.example: He chiselled a groove into the oak beam.

entries.definitionEn: Having a clear, strong shape, as if cut with a tool; often used of a face.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحوت الملامح؛ واضح الزوايا كأنه قُطع بأداة
entries.example: The actor is known for his chiselled features.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet brown food made from cacao, eaten as a snack or used in cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: شوكولاتة؛ طعام حلو بنّي يُصنع من الكاكاو
entries.example: She gave him a bar of chocolate.

entries.definitionEn: The act of picking one thing from several, or the thing that is picked.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختيار؛ فعل الانتقاء أو الشيء المنتقى
entries.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوقة غنائية، وخصوصاً في كنيسة أو مدرسة
entries.example: She sings in the school choir every Thursday.

entries.definitionEn: To be unable to breathe because something is blocking your throat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختنق لانسداد في الحلق يمنعه من التنفس
entries.example: He started to choke on a piece of bread.

entries.definitionEn: To pick one thing or person from two or more possibilities.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختار شيئاً أو شخصاً من بين إمكانيات
entries.example: Please choose a colour for the walls.

entries.definitionEn: To cut something into pieces with a knife or similar tool, often with a quick downward movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقطّع بسكين بحركة سريعة إلى أسفل
entries.example: Chop the onions before you heat the pan.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the design and arrangement of dance movements.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بتصميم حركات الرقص وترتيبها
entries.example: The ballet's choreographical style is precise and spare.

entries.definitionEn: The art of designing dance movements, or the movements themselves in a performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصميم الرقص؛ فن ترتيب الحركات أو الحركات نفسها في العرض
entries.example: The choreography in the final scene was simple and powerful.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to Christianity or to people who follow it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسيحي؛ متعلق بالمسيحية أو بأتباعها
entries.example: The chapel holds a small collection of Christian art.

entries.definitionEn: In the order of time, from earliest to latest.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسب التسلسل الزمني من الأقدم إلى الأحدث
entries.example: She filed the letters chronologically.

entries.definitionEn: The order in which events happened, or an account arranged in that order.
entries.arabicMeaning: التسلسل الزمني للأحداث أو سرد مرتّب بحسبه
entries.example: The book opens with a chronology of the voyage.

entries.definitionEn: The hard case in which a caterpillar changes into a butterfly or moth.
entries.arabicMeaning: غلاف العذراء الذي تتحوّل فيه اليسروعة إلى فراشة أو عثّة
entries.example: A butterfly later emerged from the chrysalis.

entries.definitionEn: A quiet laugh, often a short one.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضحكة خافتة قصيرة
entries.example: A quiet chuckle ran through the room.

entries.definitionEn: A thick, solid piece of something. Also a fairly large amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة سميكة؛ أو مقدار كبير نسبياً
entries.example: She cut a chunk of bread from the loaf.

entries.definitionEn: A building where Christians go to pray.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنيسة
entries.example: The church is next to the school.

entries.definitionEn: To stir or shake a liquid with force. Also to move about violently, or to lose and replace people or customers at a high rate.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخضّ سائلاً بقوة أو يضطرب بعنف؛ وقد يعني تجدد الزبائن أو الموظفين بسرعة
entries.example: Rough water churned around the rocks.

entries.definitionEn: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco that people smoke.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيجارة
entries.example: He put out the cigarette before going inside.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people watch films on a large screen. Also films as a form of art or entertainment.
entries.arabicMeaning: دار سينما؛ أو فنّ الأفلام
entries.example: We went to the cinema on Friday night.

entries.definitionEn: The person in charge of camera work and lighting on a film.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدير التصوير السينمائي
entries.example: The cinematographer framed the scene in low light.

entries.definitionEn: The art and technique of filming a movie, especially camera work and lighting.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن التصوير السينمائي وأساليبه
entries.example: Critics praised the film's cinematography.

entries.definitionEn: A round shape, like a ring. Also a group of people who know each other.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائرة؛ أو جماعة من المعارف
entries.example: Draw a circle around the correct answer.

entries.definitionEn: To move around something in a ring, or to draw a ring around it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدور حول الشيء أو يحيطه بخط دائري
entries.example: Birds circled above the field.

entries.definitionEn: The system of electrical circuits inside a device.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدارات الكهربائية داخل جهاز
entries.example: Faulty circuitry caused the radio to fail.

entries.definitionEn: Shaped like a circle, or moving in a circle.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائري الشكل أو المسار
entries.example: They sat at a circular table.

entries.definitionEn: To move around a closed system, or to pass from person to person.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسري في مسار مغلق أو يتداول بين الناس
entries.example: Warm air circulates through the building.

entries.definitionEn: The movement of blood through the body. Also the passing of news or money among people, or the number of copies a newspaper sells.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدورة الدموية؛ أو تداول الأخبار والمال؛ أو عدد نسخ الصحيفة
entries.example: Walking improves circulation in the legs.

entries.definitionEn: To sail or travel all the way around something, especially the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطوف بحراً أو سفراً حول شيء بالكامل، ولا سيما العالم
entries.example: The crew plans to circumnavigate the globe.

entries.definitionEn: A journey all the way around something, especially the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: طواف كامل حول شيء، ولا سيما حول الأرض
entries.example: Their circumnavigation of the island took three days.

entries.definitionEn: A fact or condition connected with an event, often one that affects it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف من الظروف المحيطة بحدث
entries.example: Under the circumstances, they cancelled the trip.

entries.definitionEn: A show with performers and trained animals, often in a large tent. Also a round open space where streets meet.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيرك؛ أو ساحة دائرية تلتقي فيها شوارع
entries.example: The circus set up its tent at the edge of town.

entries.definitionEn: A quotation from or reference to a source. Also a formal mention of achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: استشهاد بمصدر أو إحالة إليه؛ أو تنويه رسمي
entries.example: Every claim in the essay needs a citation.

entries.definitionEn: To mention a book, study, or person as evidence or as an example.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستشهد بمصدر أو يذكره دليلاً
entries.example: The author cites three recent studies.

entries.definitionEn: A person who belongs to a country and has rights there.
entries.arabicMeaning: مواطن
entries.example: She became a citizen after five years.

entries.definitionEn: The legal status of being a citizen of a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: المواطنة أو الجنسية القانونية
entries.example: He applied for citizenship last year.

entries.definitionEn: A large and important town.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدينة
entries.example: They live in a city by the river.

entries.definitionEn: Happening in or affecting the whole of a city.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مستوى المدينة كلها
entries.example: A citywide bus strike began on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to ordinary people and public life, not the army or the church. Also polite in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدنيّ غير عسكري أو ديني؛ ومهذّب في المعاملة
entries.example: Civil flights use the main airport, not the military one.

entries.definitionEn: A society with cities, laws, and a developed culture. Also the comforts of modern life.
entries.arabicMeaning: حضارة ذات مدن وقوانين وثقافة؛ أو مظاهر العيش الحديث
entries.example: Ancient civilisation left temples along the river.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that something is true, which may still need proof. Also a demand for something as a right.
entries.arabicMeaning: ادّعاء يحتاج إلى إثبات؛ أو مطالبة بحق
entries.example: Her claim about the missing keys was later confirmed.

entries.definitionEn: To say that something is true, often without proof yet. Also to ask for something as yours.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعم أن شيئاً صحيح؛ أو يطالب بشيء على أنه له
entries.example: They claim the bag belongs to them.

entries.definitionEn: A shellfish with a hard shell that lives in sand or mud and is often eaten.
entries.arabicMeaning: محار يعيش في الرمل أو الطين ويؤكل
entries.example: We had clam soup at the harbour restaurant.

entries.definitionEn: Unpleasantly damp, sticky, and often cold, especially of skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: نديّ لزج وبارد الملمس على نحو كريه
entries.example: His hands felt clammy before the exam.

entries.definitionEn: A large group of families who share an ancestor, or a close group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشيرة تربطها قرابة واسعة؛ أو جماعة مترابطة
entries.example: Members of the clan still meet each summer.

entries.definitionEn: To hit your hands together to show you like something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفق
entries.example: The audience began to clap.

entries.definitionEn: To make something easier to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوضح المعنى أو يزيل اللبس
entries.example: Could you clarify what you mean by urgent?

entries.definitionEn: A group of students who learn together, or a lesson with them.
entries.arabicMeaning: صف دراسي أو حصة
entries.example: My English class starts at nine.

entries.definitionEn: To put someone or something in a particular group or type.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنّف في فئة أو رتبة
entries.example: The report classes the region as high risk.

entries.definitionEn: Of lasting quality and a typical, excellent kind. Also a very typical example of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلاسيكي رفيع وخالد؛ أو نموذجي أصيل
entries.example: It was a classic black coat, simple and well made.

entries.definitionEn: A book, film, or other work of lasting high quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر فني أو أدبي خالد
entries.example: That novel is a classic still read in schools.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the culture of ancient Greece and Rome, or to a serious traditional style, especially in music and art.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلاسيكي؛ متصل بالعالم القديم أو بأسلوب رصين تقليدي
entries.example: She prefers classical ballet to modern dance.

entries.definitionEn: Serious music in a long European tradition, often played by an orchestra.
entries.arabicMeaning: الموسيقى الكلاسيكية
entries.example: He listens to classical music while he works.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting things into groups, or a system for doing that.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصنيف أو نظام للتصنيف
entries.example: The library's classification puts travel books together.

entries.definitionEn: To put people or things into groups according to type.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنّف حسب النوع
entries.example: Scientists classify whales as mammals.

entries.definitionEn: A person in the same class as you at school.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل الصف
entries.example: I sat next to my classmate.

entries.definitionEn: A room where a class has lessons.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعة الصف
entries.example: The classroom has a large window.

entries.definitionEn: Stylish and of high quality, in an impressive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنيق راقٍ ورفيع المستوى
entries.example: They chose a classy restaurant for the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A group of words with a subject and a verb, forming part of a sentence. Also a separate section of a legal document.
entries.arabicMeaning: جملة فرعية فيها مسند إليه وفعل؛ أو بند في عقد
entries.example: The second clause of the contract covers late payment.

entries.definitionEn: A strong fear of being in a small or closed space.
entries.arabicMeaning: رهاب الأماكن المغلقة
entries.example: His claustrophobia made lifts hard to use.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling fear in a small closed space, or describing a place that causes that feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب برهاب الأماكن المغلقة؛ أو مكان يبعث على ذلك الضيق
entries.example: The tiny windowless room felt claustrophobic.

entries.definitionEn: Not dirty.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظيف
entries.example: Please keep your room clean.

entries.definitionEn: To make something not dirty.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّف
entries.example: I clean the kitchen after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to clean. Also a product used for cleaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل نظافة؛ أو مادة تنظيف
entries.example: The cleaner comes twice a week.

entries.definitionEn: In a clean or neat way, without mess. Also in a sharp, complete way, as of a cut or break.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنظافة وسلاسة؛ أو بقطع مستقيم بلا تمزّق
entries.example: The knife cut cleanly through the fruit.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see, hear, or understand. Also without clouds, marks, or objects in the way.
entries.arabicMeaning: واضح للفهم أو للرؤية؛ وصافٍ بلا عائق
entries.example: The instructions were clear.

entries.definitionEn: To remove things so a place is empty, or to become free of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُخلي المكان أو يزيل ما يعترض
entries.example: Please clear the table after breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand. Also without any doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوضوح؛ ومن دون شك
entries.example: She spoke clearly so everyone could hear.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being easy to see, hear, or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: وضوح
entries.example: The clearness of the photograph surprised us.

entries.definitionEn: To close the hand, teeth, or a muscle tightly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبض اليد أو يطبق الأسنان أو العضلة بإحكام
entries.example: He clenched his fists but said nothing.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to office work such as records, letters, and filing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتبي؛ متعلق بأعمال التوثيق والإدارة المكتبية
entries.example: The job involves a lot of clerical work.

entries.definitionEn: A person who keeps records or helps customers in an office, bank, or shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب أو موظف مكتب واستقبال
entries.example: Ask the clerk at the desk for a form.

entries.definitionEn: Quick to learn and able to think well. Also showing skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكي؛ بارع في التفكير أو العمل
entries.example: That was a clever way to save time.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being quick-witted or skilful in thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطنة وذكاء في التفكير
entries.example: The puzzle rewarded cleverness more than speed.

entries.definitionEn: A short, sharp sound. Also an act of pressing a computer mouse or similar button.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقطقة قصيرة؛ أو نقرة على زر
entries.example: I heard a click when the lock closed.

entries.definitionEn: To make a short sharp sound, or to press a button on a mouse or screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث طقطقة أو ينقر زراً
entries.example: Click the button to start the video.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that pays for professional services or advice.
entries.arabicMeaning: عميل يتلقى خدمة مهنية
entries.example: The lawyer met her client in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A high, steep face of rock, often beside the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرف صخري شاهق، غالباً على البحر
entries.example: They stood at the edge of the cliff and watched the sea.

entries.definitionEn: Forming the most intense or important point in a series of events.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذروي؛ يمثّل أشدّ نقطة في تسلسل الأحداث
entries.example: The film's climactic scene takes place on a bridge.

entries.definitionEn: Long-term change in the Earth's weather patterns, especially warming caused by human activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغيّر المناخ على المدى البعيد، ولا سيما الاحترار
entries.example: Farmers discussed how climate change affects rainfall.

entries.definitionEn: The usual weather in a place over a long time. Also the general mood or conditions in a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناخ المكان عبر الزمن؛ أو الأجواء العامة في جماعة
entries.example: The climate here is mild in winter.

entries.definitionEn: The most intense or important point in a story, event, or process.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذروة الحدث أو القصة
entries.example: The story reaches its climax in the final chapter.

entries.definitionEn: An act of going up, especially using your hands and feet.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعود أو تسلّق
entries.example: The climb to the top took an hour.

entries.definitionEn: To go up something, often using your hands and feet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسلّق أو يصعد
entries.example: We climb the stairs every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person who climbs rocks or mountains as a sport. Also a plant that grows up a wall or support.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسلّق جبال أو صخور؛ أو نبات متسلّق
entries.example: The climber checked her rope before starting.

entries.definitionEn: The sport or activity of going up rocks, mountains, or walls.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة التسلّق
entries.example: Climbing is popular in this mountain town.

entries.definitionEn: To finally confirm or win something after uncertainty, such as a deal or a title.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحسم أمراً أو يُبرمه بصورة نهائية
entries.example: A late goal helped them clinch the title.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people go for medical treatment, often for one type of problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: عيادة
entries.example: She made an appointment at the eye clinic.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the observation and treatment of patients. Also coldly practical, without emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريري متعلق بعلاج المرضى؛ أو بارد بلا انفعال
entries.example: The drug will now move to clinical testing.

entries.definitionEn: A short piece of a film, video, or recording. Also a small object that holds things together.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطع قصير من تسجيل؛ أو مشبك يضمّ الأشياء
entries.example: He showed a short clip from the interview.

entries.definitionEn: A loose coat without sleeves that fastens at the neck. Also something that hides or covers.
entries.arabicMeaning: عباءة فضفاضة تُعقد عند العنق؛ أو غطاء يستر
entries.example: She pulled the cloak around her shoulders in the wind.

entries.definitionEn: A device on a wall or table that shows the time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة حائط أو منضدة
entries.example: Look at the clock on the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To block a pipe, road, or system so that things cannot pass easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسدّ أنبوباً أو ممراً حتى يتعذّر المرور
entries.example: Fallen leaves clog the drain every autumn.

entries.definitionEn: A covered walk around a courtyard in a monastery, cathedral, or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: رواق مسقوف يحيط بصحن دير أو كلية
entries.example: Students crossed the cloister on their way to the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Kept away from ordinary public life; secluded.
entries.arabicMeaning: منعزل عن صخب الحياة العادية
entries.example: He had a cloistered childhood, rarely leaving the estate.

entries.definitionEn: To make an exact copy of a living thing or of a file.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنسخ نسخة مطابقة من كائن حي أو من ملف
entries.example: Scientists cloned the plant from a small piece of stem.

entries.definitionEn: Near in space or time. Also having a strong personal relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريب في المكان أو الزمن؛ أو وثيق الصلة
entries.example: The station is close to our hotel.

entries.definitionEn: To shut something, or to stop being open for business.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلق شيئاً أو يتوقف عن العمل
entries.example: Please close the window.

entries.definitionEn: Not open. Also not willing to accept new ideas or people.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغلق؛ أو منغلق على الأفكار أو الناس
entries.example: The museum is closed on Mondays.

entries.definitionEn: With little distance or difference; with care and attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن كثب وبانتباه؛ وعلى نحو وثيق
entries.example: Listen closely to the next set of instructions.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being near in space, or of being emotionally intimate.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرب مكاني أو ألفة عاطفية
entries.example: Years of shared work created a real closeness between them.

entries.definitionEn: The act of closing a place or ending a process. Also a feeling that an unhappy event has been dealt with.
entries.arabicMeaning: إغلاق مكان أو إنهاء عملية؛ أو شعور بانقضاء الأمر
entries.example: Residents were told about the closure of the local library.

entries.definitionEn: Material made by weaving, used for clothes or for cleaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: قماش يُحاك منه الثياب أو يُمسح به
entries.example: She wiped the table with a damp cloth.

entries.definitionEn: The things you wear, such as shirts, trousers, and dresses.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملابس
entries.example: He packed his clothes in a small bag.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes in general, thought of as a type of thing rather than as separate items.
entries.arabicMeaning: الملابس بوصفها فئة عامة
entries.example: Pack light clothing for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: A white or grey mass in the sky that can bring rain. Also a mass of smoke or dust.
entries.arabicMeaning: سحابة؛ أو سحابة من دخان أو غبار
entries.example: A dark cloud covered the sun.

entries.definitionEn: Full of clouds. Also not clear, of a liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: غائم؛ أو عكر إن وُصف به سائل
entries.example: It was cloudy all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A performer who wears bright clothes and make-up to make people laugh.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهرّج
entries.example: The clown made balloon animals after the show.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who meet to do the same activity. Also a place for music and dancing, or a heavy stick used as a weapon.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادٍ يجتمع لنشاط مشترك؛ أو ملهى؛ أو هراوة
entries.example: She joined a book club in her first year.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of information that helps you find the answer to a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل أو قرينة تعين على الحل
entries.example: The torn ticket was the only clue they had.

entries.definitionEn: Moving in an awkward way and tending to drop or hit things. Also said or done without skill or tact.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخرق في الحركة؛ أو فجّ في القول أو التصرّف
entries.example: He made a clumsy attempt to change the subject.

entries.definitionEn: In a vehicle, the device or pedal that disconnects the engine from the wheels so the driver can change gear.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابض المركبة أو دواسته التي تفصل المحرّك لتغيير السرعة
entries.example: Press the clutch before you change gear.

entries.definitionEn: To hold something tightly, often from fear, pain, or urgency.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمسك الشيء بشدة، غالباً من خوف أو ألم
entries.example: She clutched the railing as the boat rolled.

entries.definitionEn: A messy collection of things scattered about.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضى من أغراض متراكمة
entries.example: Clear the clutter off your desk before you start.

entries.definitionEn: To fill a place with too many things in a messy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملأ المكان بأشياء كثيرة بلا نظام
entries.example: Do not clutter the hallway with boxes.

entries.definitionEn: A person who trains a person or team in a sport. Also a comfortable bus for a long journey.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرّب رياضي؛ أو حافلة مريحة للسفر البعيد
entries.example: Our basketball coach cancelled training.

entries.definitionEn: To train someone in a sport, skill, or job, often with advice and practice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرّب شخصاً في رياضة أو مهارة
entries.example: She coaches the junior tennis team.

entries.definitionEn: The work of training someone in a sport, skill, or job.
entries.arabicMeaning: التدريب والتوجيه في رياضة أو مهارة
entries.example: Good coaching improved her serve.

entries.definitionEn: A hard black rock that is burned to produce heat and power.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحم حجري يُحرق للدفء والطاقة
entries.example: The old stove still burns coal.

entries.definitionEn: A temporary alliance of groups, often political parties, formed to work together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ائتلاف مؤقت بين أطراف، غالباً أحزاب
entries.example: Two parties formed a coalition to pass the bill.

entries.definitionEn: Rough in texture, not smooth or fine. Also rude or vulgar in speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: خشن الملمس؛ أو فظّ في الكلام
entries.example: The coarse sand scratched the paint on the boat.

entries.definitionEn: The land beside the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحل
entries.example: They spent a week on the coast.

entries.definitionEn: To move without using engine power, especially downhill. Also to succeed with little effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينساب بقوة الدفع دون محرّك؛ أو يتقدّم بجهد قليل
entries.example: We turned off the engine and coasted down the hill.

entries.definitionEn: On or near a coast.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحلي
entries.example: Coastal towns can be busy in summer.

entries.definitionEn: The outline of a coast, where land meets the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط الساحل حيث يلتقي البرّ بالبحر
entries.example: The coastline is rocky and full of small bays.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing you wear over other clothes to keep warm or dry.
entries.arabicMeaning: معطف
entries.example: Wear a coat; it is cold outside.

entries.definitionEn: To persuade someone gently and patiently to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستميل بلطف وصبر حتى يستجيب
entries.example: He managed to coax the cat out from under the bed.

entries.definitionEn: A drink made by mixing alcohol with other liquids. Also a mixture of different things.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوكتيل من مشروبات مخلوطة؛ أو خليط من عناصر
entries.example: He ordered a cocktail at the hotel bar.

entries.definitionEn: A brown powder from cacao beans, used in chocolate and in a hot drink; also the drink itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاكاو مسحوقاً أو شراباً ساخناً
entries.example: Add a spoon of cocoa to the warm milk.

entries.definitionEn: A large hard fruit with white flesh and a hole of sweet liquid inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوز هند
entries.example: The dessert was topped with grated coconut.

entries.definitionEn: To wrap or surround someone or something in a covering that protects or isolates.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلّف شخصاً أو شيئاً بغطاء واقٍ يعزله
entries.example: Thick curtains cocooned the room from street noise.

entries.definitionEn: A large sea fish with white flesh, often used as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمك القدّ
entries.example: They served baked cod with potatoes.

entries.definitionEn: A set of numbers or letters used to open something or keep a message secret.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمز من أرقام أو حروف للفتح أو للسرّية
entries.example: Enter the code to open the door.

entries.definitionEn: A hot brown drink made from roasted coffee beans. Also the beans or powder used to make it.
entries.arabicMeaning: قهوة؛ أو حبّها وبودرتها
entries.example: I drink coffee in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A long box in which a dead person is placed for burial.
entries.arabicMeaning: تابوت
entries.example: The coffin was carried slowly from the church.

entries.definitionEn: Of an argument or reason: clear, logical, and convincing.
entries.arabicMeaning: سديد مقنع في الحجة والمنطق
entries.example: She offered a cogent case for delaying the launch.

entries.definitionEn: In a clear, logical, and convincing way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب منطقي مقنع
entries.example: He argued cogently against rushing the decision.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the mental processes of thinking, knowing, and remembering.
entries.arabicMeaning: معرفي؛ متعلق بعمليات التفكير والإدراك
entries.example: Sleep loss can affect cognitive performance.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being logical, consistent, and easy to follow as a whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماسك منطقي يجعل النص مفهوماً ككل
entries.example: The essay lacked coherence after the third paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: Clear, logical, and consistent; easy to understand as a whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: متماسك واضح يسهل فهمه كوحدة
entries.example: Please give a coherent account of what happened.

entries.definitionEn: A small round piece of metal used as money.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة نقد معدنية
entries.example: He paid with a coin because he had no notes.

entries.definitionEn: To happen at the same time, or to be the same in some way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتزامن أو يتوافق في وجه من الوجوه
entries.example: The meeting coincides with her train's arrival.

entries.definitionEn: The surprising fact of two things happening at the same time by chance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصادفة
entries.example: Meeting her there was a complete coincidence.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet brown fizzy drink; cola.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروب كولا غازي بنّي حلو
entries.example: Would you like a coke with your sandwich?

entries.definitionEn: A sweet brown fizzy drink flavoured with cola nuts.
entries.arabicMeaning: كولا؛ شراب غازي بنّي المنكهة
entries.example: He asked for a glass of cola with ice.

entries.definitionEn: Having a low temperature; not warm. Also unfriendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارد؛ أو فاتر في المعاملة
entries.example: The water is too cold to swim.

entries.definitionEn: An illness of the nose and throat that is not usually serious. Also cold weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: زكام؛ أو برد الجو
entries.example: She stayed home because she had a cold.

entries.definitionEn: To work together with others on a task or project.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعاون مع غيره في عمل أو مشروع
entries.example: The two labs will collaborate on the study.

entries.definitionEn: The act of working with others to produce something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاون في إنجاز عمل مشترك
entries.example: The report was the result of close collaboration.

entries.definitionEn: Involving two or more people or groups working together.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاوني؛ يقوم على العمل المشترك
entries.example: They used a collaborative writing tool.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works with others on a project.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريك في عمل تعاوني
entries.example: Each collaborator added a chapter to the book.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden falling down, or a sudden failure of a system, business, or person.
entries.arabicMeaning: انهيار مفاجئ لمبنى أو نظام أو شخص
entries.example: Doctors treated him after his collapse at work.

entries.definitionEn: To fall down suddenly, or to fail completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينهار فجأة أو يفشل تماماً
entries.example: The old barn collapsed after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a shirt, dress, or coat that goes around the neck. Also a band around an animal's neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: ياقة الثوب؛ أو طوق حول عنق الحيوان
entries.example: He loosened his collar in the heat.

entries.definitionEn: A person you work with in a job or profession.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل في العمل
entries.example: I asked a colleague to check the figures.

entries.definitionEn: To bring things together, or to go and get something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمع أشياء أو يذهب لأخذ شيء
entries.example: The children collect shells on the beach.

entries.definitionEn: A group of things of the same type that someone has gathered.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة من الأشياء المتشابهة
entries.example: She has a large collection of stamps.

entries.definitionEn: A person who gathers objects of a particular kind as a hobby or job.
entries.arabicMeaning: جامع مقتنيات من نوع معيّن
entries.example: A stamp collector showed us her rarest piece.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people study after they finish school.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلية للدراسة بعد المدرسة
entries.example: He starts college in September.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something or someone with force while moving.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصادم أثناء الحركة
entries.example: The two cyclists collided at the corner.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that accelerates particles and makes them smash into one another so scientists can study the results.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصادم جسيمات يسرّعها حتى تتصادم للدراسة
entries.example: The collider smashes tiny particles together at high speed.

entries.definitionEn: A pair or group of words that native speakers often use together.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلازم لفظي معتاد بين كلمات
entries.example: Heavy rain is a common collocation in English.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of informal spoken language rather than formal writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: دارج في الحديث اليومي غير الرسمي
entries.example: The guide explains colloquial phrases used in shops.

entries.definitionEn: In informal spoken language; as people usually say it.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالكلام الدارج
entries.example: The machine is colloquially known as a clicker.

entries.definitionEn: An academic meeting for discussion of a specialist topic.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندوة علمية لمناقشة موضوع متخصص
entries.example: She presented her findings at a research colloquium.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark (:) used before a list, explanation, or quotation. In the body, also the main part of the large intestine.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقطتان رأسيتان في الترقيم؛ وفي التشريح القولون
entries.example: Put a colon before the list of names.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a colony, or to a period when one country controlled another.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمستعمرات أو بعهد السيطرة الاستعمارية
entries.example: The museum displays furniture from the colonial era.

entries.definitionEn: Red, blue, green, and other shades that you can see.
entries.arabicMeaning: لون
entries.example: Her favourite colour is blue.

entries.definitionEn: To add colour to a picture or object.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوّن
entries.example: The children colour the maps in geography.

entries.definitionEn: Having many bright colours. Also interesting and full of variety.
entries.arabicMeaning: زاهي الألوان؛ أو حافل بالتنوّع
entries.example: The market was full of colourful stalls.

entries.definitionEn: A tall upright post that supports a building. Also a block of print going down a page.
