entries.arabicMeaning: عمود يحمل بناءً؛ أو عمود نص نازل في صفحة
entries.example: A stone column stands at each side of the door.

entries.definitionEn: A journalist who writes a regular article in a newspaper or magazine.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب عمود صحفي منتظم
entries.example: The columnist writes about city life every Friday.

entries.definitionEn: A long, deep state of unconsciousness caused by injury or illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: غيبوبة عميقة طويلة بسبب إصابة أو مرض
entries.example: He remained in a coma for several days after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a row of teeth, used to tidy hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشط
entries.example: She kept a comb in her bag.

entries.definitionEn: To tidy hair with a comb. Also to search a place very thoroughly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمشّط الشعر؛ أو يفتّش المكان بدقة
entries.example: They combed the beach for the lost ring.

entries.definitionEn: Two or more things joined or mixed together.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزيج أو توليفة من عناصر
entries.example: The dish is a combination of rice and vegetables.

entries.definitionEn: To join or mix two or more things so they work or exist together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدمج شيئين أو أكثر أو يخلطهما
entries.example: Combine the flour and sugar in a bowl.

entries.definitionEn: The chemical process of burning.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاحتراق بوصفه عملية كيميائية
entries.example: The engine produces energy through combustion of fuel.

entries.definitionEn: To move towards the speaker, or to arrive at a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأتي نحو المتكلم أو يصل إلى مكان
entries.example: Please come here for a moment.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make people laugh, especially on stage or on screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممثل كوميدي أو فكاهي محترف
entries.example: The comedian had the whole room laughing.

entries.definitionEn: A play, film, or style of writing that is meant to be funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوميديا؛ عمل فكاهي في المسرح أو السينما
entries.example: We watched a comedy after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A bright object in space with a long tail of gas and dust, which moves around the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذنّب
entries.example: The comet was visible in the sky before dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being physically relaxed and free from pain or worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: راحة جسدية أو اطمئنان
entries.example: After the long walk she sat down in comfort.

entries.definitionEn: Giving physical ease, or feeling relaxed and free from pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريح أو مرتاح
entries.example: This chair is very comfortable.

entries.definitionEn: In a comfortable way. Also easily, with no struggle.
entries.arabicMeaning: براحة؛ أو بسهولة واضحة
entries.example: She won the race comfortably.

entries.definitionEn: Funny; making you laugh.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكاهي يبعث على الضحك
entries.example: He made a comic face and everyone laughed.

entries.definitionEn: A magazine with stories told in pictures.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجلة قصص مصوّرة
entries.example: She bought a comic to read on the train.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark (,) used to separate parts of a sentence or items in a list.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاصلة في الترقيم
entries.example: Add a comma between the city and the country.

entries.definitionEn: An order given by someone in authority. Also control over people, or skill in a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر صادر عن سلطة؛ أو سيطرة أو إتقان
entries.example: The captain gave the command to turn back.

entries.definitionEn: An officer in charge of a military unit or operation.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائد وحدة أو عملية عسكرية
entries.example: The commander inspected the camp at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: To officially remember and honour a person or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحيي ذكرى شخص أو حدث بصورة رسمية
entries.example: A small plaque commemorates the opening of the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone formally, often in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثني على شخص ثناءً رسمياً
entries.example: I commend you for finishing the work so carefully.

entries.definitionEn: Formal praise, often given as an official honour.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشادة رسمية أو تنويه بالثناء
entries.example: She received a commendation for her work during the flood.

entries.definitionEn: Matching something in size, degree, or quality; in proportion.
entries.arabicMeaning: متناسب مع القدر أو الحجم أو الجودة
entries.example: Pay should be commensurate with experience.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that matches something in size or degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو متناسب مع المقدار
entries.example: Costs rose, and prices increased commensurately.

entries.definitionEn: A spoken or written remark that gives an opinion or explains something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعليق أو ملاحظة تبدي رأياً أو توضيحاً
entries.example: He made a brief comment on the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To give an opinion or remark about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّق برأي أو ملاحظة
entries.example: She refused to comment on the rumour.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of buying and selling goods and services.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجارة بيع السلع والخدمات وشراؤها
entries.example: The harbour grew rich through overseas commerce.

entries.definitionEn: Related to business and to making money from goods or services.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجاري؛ متعلق بالأعمال والربح
entries.example: The song was written for commercial radio.

entries.definitionEn: An advertisement on television, radio, or online.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان تجاري في التلفاز أو الراديو أو الشبكة
entries.example: A loud commercial came on during the film.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that concerns business or is intended to make a profit.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجارياً من زاوية الربح والأعمال
entries.example: The invention was never commercially successful.

entries.definitionEn: To do something wrong or illegal. Also to promise firmly to give time, money, or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتكب ذنباً أو مخالفة؛ أو يلتزم بوقت أو جهد
entries.example: She did not want to commit to a date before checking her diary.

entries.definitionEn: A promise to do something, or the hard work you give to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزام أو عهد بالقيام بشيء
entries.example: She made a commitment to practise every day.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people chosen to discuss something and make decisions.
entries.arabicMeaning: لجنة تُختار للبحث واتخاذ القرار
entries.example: The committee meets on Thursday afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A low chest of drawers, often ornamental. Also a chair with a pot used as a toilet.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة أدراج منخفضة؛ أو كرسي فيه وعاء يُستخدم كمرحاض
entries.example: A lacquered commode stood beneath the mirror.

entries.definitionEn: A raw material or basic product bought and sold in large quantities, such as oil, grain, or metal.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلعة أوّلية تُتداول بكميات كبيرة كالنفط والحبوب
entries.example: Wheat is a commodity traded across the world.

entries.definitionEn: Happening often, or found in many places. Also shared by two or more people.
entries.arabicMeaning: شائع كثير الحدوث؛ أو مشترك بين أكثر من واحد
entries.example: Rain is common here in April.

entries.definitionEn: Practical good judgment that most people are expected to have.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسّ سليم وحكم عملي متوقع من الناس
entries.example: Locking the door is just common sense.

entries.definitionEn: Often; by many people or in many cases.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو شائع؛ في كثير من الأحيان
entries.example: This bird is commonly seen near rivers.

entries.definitionEn: An association of countries or states that share political ties, especially the Commonwealth of Nations.
entries.arabicMeaning: كومنولث؛ رابطة دول أو كيانات سياسية ذات روابط مشتركة
entries.example: Several island states belong to the same commonwealth.

entries.definitionEn: To share information, ideas, or feelings with others by speaking, writing, or using signs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتواصل؛ ينقل معلومات أو أفكاراً أو مشاعر بالكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة
entries.example: They communicate by email when they cannot meet.

entries.definitionEn: The act of sharing information or feelings with other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: تواصل أو اتصال لتبادل المعلومات أو المشاعر
entries.example: Good communication keeps the team working well.

entries.definitionEn: Willing and able to talk and share information with others.
entries.arabicMeaning: تواصلي؛ ميّال إلى الحديث وتبادل المعلومات
entries.example: The new colleague is friendly and communicative.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who live in the same area or who share an interest or identity.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجتمع؛ جماعة تعيش في مكان واحد أو يجمعها اهتمام مشترك
entries.example: The library is at the centre of the local community.

entries.definitionEn: To travel regularly between home and a place of work or study.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنقّل بانتظام بين المنزل ومكان العمل أو الدراسة
entries.example: She commutes to the city by train each morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person or animal that spends time with you and keeps you company.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفيق أو أنيس يرافقك ويقضي الوقت معك
entries.example: His dog has been a loyal companion for years.

entries.definitionEn: A business that makes or sells goods or services. Also people who are with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة تجارية؛ وأيضاً رفقة الناس
entries.example: She works for a small software company.

entries.definitionEn: The form of an adjective or adverb used to show a difference between two things, such as taller or more careful.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة المقارنة في الصفة أو الظرف التي تبيّن زيادة صفة في شيء على آخر
entries.example: In class we practised the comparative of common adjectives.

entries.definitionEn: To look at two or more things to see how they are similar or different.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقارن بين شيئين أو أكثر ليرى أوجه الشبه والاختلاف
entries.example: Compare the two prices before you buy.

entries.definitionEn: The act of looking at two or more things to see how they are similar or different.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقارنة تُظهر التشابه أو الاختلاف بين أشياء
entries.example: A comparison of the two reports showed the same error.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of sympathy for someone who is suffering, and a wish to help.
entries.arabicMeaning: شفقة ورأفة بمن يعاني مع رغبة في المساعدة
entries.example: She treated the injured bird with compassion.

entries.definitionEn: Showing kindness and sympathy towards people who are suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: رؤوف شفوق بمن يتألم
entries.example: The nurse was calm and compassionate with every patient.

entries.definitionEn: Able to exist or work together without problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوافق؛ يصلح أن يعمل أو يعيش مع غيره بلا مشكلات
entries.example: Check that the charger is compatible with your phone.

entries.definitionEn: To force someone to do something, or to make an action unavoidable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُرغم شخصاً على فعل شيء أو يجعل الأمر محتّماً
entries.example: The evidence compelled the board to reopen the case.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that strongly persuades or holds attention, so that it is hard to ignore.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مقنع قاهر يصعب تجاهله
entries.example: She argued compellingly for a shorter working week.

entries.definitionEn: To give money or something else to make up for loss, damage, or extra effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعوّض عن خسارة أو ضرر أو جهد إضافي بمال أو غيره
entries.example: The airline compensated passengers for the cancelled flight.

entries.definitionEn: Money or something else given to make up for loss, injury, or extra work.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعويض يُقدَّم عن ضرر أو إصابة أو جهد زائد
entries.example: He received compensation for the damaged luggage.

entries.definitionEn: To try to win or to do better than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنافس ليسود أو يتفوّق على غيره
entries.example: Several teams will compete for the trophy.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to do something well and to the required standard.
entries.arabicMeaning: كفاءة وقدرة على أداء العمل بالمستوى المطلوب
entries.example: The job requires competence in two languages.

entries.definitionEn: Having the skill and knowledge needed to do something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: كفء قدير يمتلك المهارة اللازمة
entries.example: She is a competent driver even in heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: An event in which people try to win by being better than others. Also the activity of trying to win.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسابقة أو تنافس يسعى فيه الناس إلى التفوّق
entries.example: He won first prize in the photography competition.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting to win or be better than others. Also involving people or companies who are trying to win.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنافسي؛ راغب في التفوّق أو قائم على التنافس
entries.example: She has a competitive streak on the tennis court.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that is trying to win or do better than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: منافس يسعى إلى التفوّق على غيره
entries.example: Our main competitor opened a shop on the same street.

entries.definitionEn: To collect information or material from different places and put it together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمع معلومات أو مواد من مصادر مختلفة ويؤلّفها
entries.example: The researcher compiled a list of local bird species.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكو من أمر أو يبدي عدم رضاه عنه
entries.example: Customers complained about the slow service.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكوى تعبّر عن عدم الرضا
entries.example: The hotel received a complaint about the noisy room.

entries.definitionEn: Something that goes well with something else and improves it. Also the number or amount needed to make a group complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكمّل ينسجم مع شيء فيحسّنه؛ أو العدد الذي يُتمّ المجموعة
entries.example: A sharp salad is a good complement to rich cheese.

entries.definitionEn: Combining well with something else, so that each supplies what the other lacks.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكمّل لغيره بحيث يسدّ كل طرف ما ينقص الآخر
entries.example: Their skills are complementary, so they work well as a pair.

entries.definitionEn: Having all the necessary parts; finished; total.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامل الأجزاء أو تامّ أو منتهٍ
entries.example: Please return the complete form by Friday.

entries.definitionEn: To finish something, or to make it whole by adding what is missing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُنهي عملاً أو يُكمله بإضافة ما ينقصه
entries.example: She completed the report before lunch.

entries.definitionEn: In every way; totally.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ على نحو كامل
entries.example: The room was completely silent.

entries.definitionEn: The act of finishing something, or the state of being finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: إتمام العمل أو حالة اكتماله
entries.example: Payment is due on completion of the work.

entries.definitionEn: Made of many connected parts and not simple to understand or deal with.
entries.arabicMeaning: معقّد كثير الأجزاء وصعب الفهم أو المعالجة
entries.example: The instructions for the machine were quite complex.

entries.definitionEn: The natural colour and appearance of a person's skin, especially on the face.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشرة الوجه ولونها وهيئتها الطبيعية
entries.example: The walk in the cold wind brought colour to her complexion.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of following a rule, law, or official request.
entries.arabicMeaning: امتثال لقاعدة أو قانون أو طلب رسمي
entries.example: The factory was inspected for compliance with safety rules.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to follow rules, standards, or requests.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتثل للقواعد أو المعايير أو الطلبات
entries.example: The software is now compliant with the new standard.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that follows rules or requests without resistance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ممتثل بلا مقاومة
entries.example: He signed the form compliantly and left the office.

entries.definitionEn: To make something more difficult to understand or deal with.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعقّد الأمر فيصعّب فهمه أو معالجته
entries.example: A late change in the plan will only complicate the work.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to understand or deal with because of many parts or details.
entries.arabicMeaning: معقّد صعب الفهم لكثرة التفاصيل أو الأجزاء
entries.example: The tax form is more complicated than last year's.

entries.definitionEn: A remark that praises someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطراء أو ثناء يُقال في حق شخص أو شيء
entries.example: She paid him a sincere compliment on the meal.

entries.definitionEn: Expressing praise. Also given free of charge.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادح ينطوي على ثناء؛ أو مجاني دون مقابل
entries.example: Guests received a complimentary breakfast with the room.

entries.definitionEn: To do what a rule, law, or request requires.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمتثل لما يفرضه قانون أو قاعدة أو طلب
entries.example: All staff must comply with the fire regulations.

entries.definitionEn: One of the parts that together make a whole machine, system, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكوّن أو جزء يدخل في تكوين كلّ أكبر
entries.example: The fan is a key component of the cooling system.

entries.definitionEn: To write music or carefully written text. Also to make up a whole, or to make yourself calm.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤلّف موسيقى أو نصاً؛ أو يتكوّن الشيء منه؛ أو يهدّئ نفسه
entries.example: He composed a short piece for piano and violin.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes music.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلّف موسيقي
entries.example: The composer wrote the song for a film.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of music or writing. Also the way the parts of something are arranged.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلَّف موسيقي أو كتابي؛ أو تركيب أجزاء الشيء وترتيبها
entries.example: Her composition for the exam was clear and well organised.

entries.definitionEn: A substance or word made of two or more parts. Also an enclosed area with buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركّب كيميائي أو لفظي من أجزاء؛ أو مجمع مبانٍ مسيّج
entries.example: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to understand something, especially spoken or written language.
entries.arabicMeaning: فهم ولا سيما فهم الكلام أو النص
entries.example: The test measured reading comprehension, not speed.

entries.definitionEn: Including almost everything that is needed; thorough.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل يغطي معظم ما يلزم
entries.example: They published a comprehensive guide to the city.

entries.definitionEn: A pad of cloth pressed on the body to reduce pain, heat, or swelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمّادة تُضغط على موضع في الجسم لتخفيف الألم أو التورم
entries.example: She held a cold compress against her forehead.

entries.definitionEn: The act of pressing something so that it takes up less space, or the state of being pressed together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضغط يقلّل الحجم أو حيّز الشيء، أو حالة الانضغاط
entries.example: The photos needed compression before they could be sent.

entries.definitionEn: To consist of particular parts or members; to make up a whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكوّن من أجزاء أو أعضاء معيّنة؛ أو يشكّل الكلّ
entries.example: The panel comprises three doctors and a lawyer.

entries.definitionEn: An agreement in which each side gives up something in order to settle a disagreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسوية يتنازل فيها كل طرف عن شيء لإنهاء خلاف
entries.example: After a long discussion they reached a fair compromise.

entries.definitionEn: To reach an agreement by each side giving up something. Also to put something valued at risk.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوصل إلى تسوية بتنازل متبادل؛ أو يعرّض أمراً ثميناً للخطر
entries.example: Neither side wanted to compromise on the deadline.

entries.definitionEn: Weakened, damaged, or put at risk, especially in health, safety, or security.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضعَّف أو متضرر أو معرَّض للخطر ولا سيما في الصحة أو الأمان
entries.example: The leak left several passwords compromised.

entries.definitionEn: A strong, often unwanted urge to do something. Also a force of law or duty that makes you act.
entries.arabicMeaning: رغبة قهرية تدفع إلى الفعل؛ أو إلزام قانوني أو أخلاقي
entries.example: He felt a compulsion to check the lock again.

entries.definitionEn: Required by a rule or law; not optional.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلزامي بحكم قاعدة أو قانون وليس اختيارياً
entries.example: Helmets are compulsory on this building site.

entries.definitionEn: To calculate a number or result, often with a machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحسب رقماً أو نتيجة وغالباً بالاستعانة بآلة
entries.example: The program can compute the total in a second.

entries.definitionEn: An electronic machine that stores information and helps you work with it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسوب يخزّن المعلومات ويعين على معالجتها
entries.example: She works on her computer after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To change a system so that a computer does the work that people or paper records used to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوسب نظاماً فيجعل الحاسوب ينجز ما كان يُنجز يدوياً أو ورقياً
entries.example: The library computerized its catalogue last year.

entries.definitionEn: A dishonest trick, especially one used to get money. Also a disadvantage, as in the phrase pros and cons.
entries.arabicMeaning: خدعة احتيال ولا سيما لأخذ المال؛ أو جانب سلبي يقابل الإيجابيات
entries.example: The investment offer turned out to be a con.

entries.definitionEn: To trick someone, especially in order to get money or an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتال على شخص ولا سيما لأخذ مال أو منفعة
entries.example: They conned him into paying for a repair he did not need.

entries.definitionEn: To hide something so that it cannot be seen or known.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفي شيئاً كي لا يُرى أو لا يُعلم
entries.example: She tried to conceal the gift behind the sofa.

entries.definitionEn: To admit that something is true, often unwillingly. Also to give up a point, right, or victory.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّم بصحة أمر على مضض؛ أو يتنازل عن نقطة أو حق أو فوز
entries.example: He had to concede that the figures were wrong.

entries.definitionEn: Too much pride in yourself and your abilities.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرور مفرط بالنفس والقدرات
entries.example: Success had filled him with conceit.

entries.definitionEn: To give all your attention to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركّز كل انتباهه على أمر
entries.example: I cannot concentrate with the radio on.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to give all your attention to something. Also the amount of a substance in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: تركيز الذهن؛ أو مقدار مادة في موضع معيّن
entries.example: The puzzle needs a lot of concentration.

entries.definitionEn: An idea of how something is or how it works.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفهوم أو فكرة عن ماهية الشيء أو طريقة عمله
entries.example: The course explains the basic concept of supply and demand.

entries.definitionEn: The way something is imagined or understood. Also the beginning of a pregnancy.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصوّر ذهني لشيء؛ أو بدء الحمل
entries.example: His conception of fairness was shaped by years of teaching.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of worry. Also something that matters to you or is your responsibility.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق؛ أو أمر يهمّك أو يقع في مسؤوليتك
entries.example: There is growing concern about the river's water quality.

entries.definitionEn: To be about a particular subject. Also to make someone feel worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعلق بموضوع معيّن؛ أو يثير القلق في نفس شخص
entries.example: The new rules concern everyone who uses the building.

entries.definitionEn: Worried about something. Also involved in something or affected by it.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق من أمر؛ أو معنيّ به ومتأثر منه
entries.example: Parents were concerned about the late buses.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show what a statement is about; similar to about or regarding.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى بخصوص أو فيما يتصل بـ، يقدّم موضوع الكلام
entries.example: The manager sent a notice concerning the new opening hours.

entries.definitionEn: A public performance of music.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفلة موسيقية علنية
entries.example: We went to a concert in the park.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of music for one or more solo instruments with an orchestra.
entries.arabicMeaning: كونشرتو؛ قطعة لآلة منفردة أو أكثر مع أوركسترا
entries.example: The pianist played a Mozart concerto with the city orchestra.

entries.definitionEn: Something you agree to give or allow, often to reach an agreement. Also a special right to sell, or a reduced price.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنازل يُقدَّم للوصول إلى اتفاق؛ أو امتياز بيع أو سعر مخفَّض
entries.example: Each side made a small concession to keep the talks going.

entries.definitionEn: The process of ending a disagreement by bringing people towards a calm agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: توفيق يُنهي خلافاً بتقريب المواقف بهدوء
entries.example: A skilled mediator guided the conciliation between the two departments.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to reduce anger and restore a more friendly relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: توفيقي يسعى إلى تهدئة الغضب وإعادة الودّ
entries.example: He struck a conciliatory tone after the argument.

entries.definitionEn: To decide something after considering the facts. Also to bring something to an end.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنتج أمراً بعد النظر في الوقائع؛ أو يختتم شيئاً
entries.example: The study concluded that the new method was faster.

entries.definitionEn: A decision reached after thinking about the facts. Also the end of a speech, text, or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: استنتاج بعد التفكير في الوقائع؛ أو خاتمة كلام أو حدث
entries.example: Her conclusion was that they needed more time.

entries.definitionEn: Real and specific rather than abstract. Also made of the building material concrete.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملموس محدد لا مجرّد؛ أو مصنوع من الخرسانة
entries.example: The report asked for concrete examples, not general claims.

entries.definitionEn: A hard building material made from cement, sand, stone, and water.
entries.arabicMeaning: خرسانة؛ مادة بناء صلبة من إسمنت ورمل وحجارة وماء
entries.example: The path was laid with fresh concrete.

entries.definitionEn: To agree with someone or with an opinion or decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوافق شخصاً أو رأياً أو قراراً
entries.example: Two of the judges concurred with the majority view.

entries.definitionEn: Agreement with an opinion or decision. Also the fact of two things happening at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: موافقة على رأي أو قرار؛ أو تزامن وقوع أمرين
entries.example: The plan went ahead with the concurrence of both teams.

entries.definitionEn: To say strongly that something is wrong. Also to give a severe official punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدين أمراً بشدة؛ أو يحكم بعقوبة رسمية قاسية
entries.example: Local residents condemned the dumping of waste in the river.

entries.definitionEn: Drops of water that form when vapour cools on a surface. Also the process of making a text shorter.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكاثف البخار قطرات على سطح بارد؛ أو اختصار نص
entries.example: Condensation ran down the inside of the window.

entries.definitionEn: The state that something is in. Also an illness, or something that must be true before something else can happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة الشيء؛ أو مرض؛ أو شرط لا بد من تحققه
entries.example: The bike is old but in good condition.

entries.definitionEn: To train or influence someone so that they behave in a particular way. Also to treat hair or fabric with a special substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكيّف السلوك بالتمرين أو التأثير؛ أو يعالج الشعر أو القماش بمستحضر
entries.example: Years of drills had conditioned the crew to react quickly.

entries.definitionEn: Depending on something else being true or happening first.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروط بتحقّق أمر آخر أولاً
entries.example: The job offer is conditional on a successful health check.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that depends on something else being true or happening first.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة مشروطة تتوقف على أمر آخر
entries.example: The board approved the grant conditionally, pending a full budget.

entries.definitionEn: To accept or ignore behaviour that is wrong, as if it were allowable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتغاضى عن سلوك خاطئ كأنه جائز أو مقبول
entries.example: The school does not condone cheating in any exam.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person behaves, especially in public or at work.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلوك الشخص ولا سيما في العلن أو في العمل
entries.example: Staff are expected to follow a clear code of conduct.

entries.definitionEn: To organize and carry out an activity. Also to lead musicians, or to allow heat or electricity to pass.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّم نشاطاً وينفّذه؛ أو يقود الموسيقيين؛ أو يوصل حرارة أو كهرباء
entries.example: Researchers will conduct interviews over the next month.

entries.definitionEn: A person who leads an orchestra. Also a material that lets heat or electricity pass, or a person who collects fares on a bus or train.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائد أوركسترا؛ أو مادّة موصلة للحرارة أو الكهرباء؛ أو كماري يجمع الأجرة
entries.example: The conductor raised the baton and the hall fell silent.

entries.definitionEn: A pipe or channel that carries water, wires, or other things. Also a person or organization through which something is passed on.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنبوب أو قناة لنقل الماء أو الأسلاك أو غيرها؛ أو وسيط يُمرَّر عبره شيء
entries.example: Cables were laid inside a plastic conduit along the wall.

entries.definitionEn: A solid shape that is round at one end and pointed at the other. Also the woody fruit of a pine, or a wafer holder for ice cream.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخروط؛ أو كوز صنوبر؛ أو حامل بسكويت للمثلجات
entries.example: The lampshade was shaped like a cone.

entries.definitionEn: To invent memories without intending to lie, as in some disorders of memory. Also to talk informally.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخترع ذكريات من غير قصد الكذب كما في بعض اضطرابات الذاكرة؛ أو يدردش
entries.example: After the injury he would confabulate details that had never happened.

entries.definitionEn: A memory that is invented yet believed to be true. Also informal talk.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكرى مختلقة يُحسب أنها صادقة؛ أو دردشة غير رسمية
entries.example: The clinician noted confabulation in the patient's account of the journey.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet food, often richly decorated. Also something cleverly put together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلوى مصنوعة بعناية وغالباً مزخرفة؛ أو شيء مركّب ببراعة
entries.example: The bakery displayed a delicate confection of cream and fruit.

entries.definitionEn: A formal meeting of people to discuss a particular subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤتمر؛ اجتماع رسمي لمناقشة موضوع معيّن
entries.example: She presented her paper at an international conference.

entries.definitionEn: The holding of meetings by telephone or video among people in different places.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقد الاجتماعات عن بُعد بالهاتف أو الفيديو بين أماكن متفرقة
entries.example: Video conferencing saved the team a day of travel.

entries.definitionEn: To admit that you have done something wrong, or that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعترف بخطأ ارتكبه أو بحقيقة أمر
entries.example: He confessed that he had forgotten to send the letter.

entries.definitionEn: A statement in which you admit something, often a wrong or a secret.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتراف يُقرّ فيه الشخص بخطأ أو بسرّ
entries.example: Her confession surprised everyone in the room.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone a private thought or secret because you trust them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُسرّ إلى شخص بفكر خاص أو سرّ لثقته به
entries.example: She confided her doubts to a close friend.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of trust in your own ability, or in another person. Also a secret told to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقة بالنفس أو بالآخرين؛ أو سرّ يُودع عند أحد
entries.example: Regular practice gave her more confidence on stage.

entries.definitionEn: Sure that you can do something well, or sure that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: واثق من قدرته أو من صحة أمر
entries.example: He felt confident about the interview.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are sure of yourself or of the facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: بثقة تُظهر الاطمئنان إلى النفس أو إلى الوقائع
entries.example: She answered the questions confidently.

entries.definitionEn: To keep someone or something within limits or in a small space.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصر شخصاً أو شيئاً في حدود أو حيّز ضيق
entries.example: Please confine your comments to the topic of the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being kept in a limited space, often against your will.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبس أو تقييد في حيّز محدود وغالباً رغماً عن الشخص
entries.example: Long confinement indoors made the dog restless.

entries.definitionEn: To say or show that something is true or definite.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤكّد أن شيئاً صحيح أو ثابت
entries.example: Please confirm your booking by email.

entries.definitionEn: A statement or sign that something is true or definite.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأكيد قولي أو علامة على أن الأمر صحيح أو ثابت
entries.example: We are still waiting for confirmation of the delivery date.

entries.definitionEn: A serious disagreement or a fight between people or groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلاف حادّ أو نزاع بين أشخاص أو جماعات
entries.example: The two neighbours were in conflict over the fence.

entries.definitionEn: To behave according to rules or to what is usual or expected.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمتثل للقواعد أو لما هو مألوف ومتوقَّع
entries.example: The new chairs must conform to safety standards.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that follows rules, standards, or what is usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: امتثال للقواعد أو المعايير أو للمألوف
entries.example: The design was rejected for lack of conformity with the code.

entries.definitionEn: To face a person or a problem directly, often in a challenging way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يواجه شخصاً أو مشكلة مواجهة مباشرة وغالباً بتحدٍّ
entries.example: She decided to confront him about the missing files.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to start an argument or to treat other people as opponents.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميّال إلى إثارة الجدل ومعاملة الآخرين كخصوم
entries.example: A confrontational style made the talks harder, not easier.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that seeks argument or treats others as opponents.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو استفزازي يواجه الآخرين كخصوم
entries.example: He spoke confrontationally and the discussion collapsed.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone unable to think clearly or to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربك شخصاً فيعجز عن التفكير بوضوح أو الفهم
entries.example: Too many instructions will confuse new users.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to think clearly or to understand what is happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتبك لا يحسن التفكير بوضوح أو فهم ما يجري
entries.example: I felt confused by the sudden change of plan.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to understand; making people unsure.
entries.arabicMeaning: مربك صعب الفهم يجعل الناس في حيرة
entries.example: The map of the station is confusing at first.

entries.definitionEn: A state of being unsure, mixed up, or unable to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتباك أو لبس يعجز معه المرء عن الفهم بوضوح
entries.example: There was some confusion about which gate to use.

entries.definitionEn: A large company made up of several different businesses.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكتل شركات كبرى يجمع أنشطة تجارية متنوعة
entries.example: A media conglomerate bought the small publishing house.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone that you are pleased about their success or good luck.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهنّئ شخصاً بنجاح أو حظ سعيد
entries.example: We called to congratulate her on the new job.

entries.definitionEn: To come together in a group in one place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجمّع الناس في مكان واحد
entries.example: Visitors congregate in the square before the tour begins.

entries.definitionEn: An opinion formed without enough evidence; a reasoned guess.
entries.arabicMeaning: تخمين أو حدس يُبنى من غير دليل كافٍ
entries.example: Any date for the find is still conjecture.

entries.definitionEn: To form an opinion without enough evidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخمن أمراً من غير دليل كافٍ
entries.example: Historians can only conjecture what the missing pages said.

entries.definitionEn: A word that joins words, phrases, or clauses, such as and or but. Also the fact of two things happening together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف عطف يربط كلمات أو جملاً؛ أو اقتران حدثين معاً
entries.example: Because is a conjunction that introduces a reason.

entries.definitionEn: To make something appear as if by magic. Also to bring an image or feeling strongly to mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحضر شيئاً كالسحر؛ أو يُحضر صورة أو شعوراً إلى الذهن بقوة
entries.example: The smell of rain conjured memories of childhood summers.

entries.definitionEn: To join two things, or to form a link between people or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط بين شيئين أو ينشئ صلة بين أشخاص أو أفكار
entries.example: You need a cable to connect the camera to the laptop.

entries.definitionEn: A link between people, things, or ideas. Also a train, bus, or flight that you take after another.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلة أو رابط بين أشخاص أو أشياء أو أفكار؛ أو وسيلة مواصلات تالية
entries.example: There is a clear connection between sleep and mood.

entries.definitionEn: A person with expert knowledge and fine judgement in a subject such as art, food, or wine.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذواقة خبير ذو حكم رفيع في فنّ أو طعام أو شراب
entries.example: A tea connoisseur noticed the difference at once.

entries.definitionEn: An extra meaning or feeling that a word suggests besides its main, literal sense.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيحاء دلالي أو شعوري يحمله اللفظ زيادة على معناه الأصلي
entries.example: Home has a warmer connotation than house for many speakers.

entries.definitionEn: To suggest an extra meaning or feeling beyond a word's main sense.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوحي بمعنى أو شعور إضافي يتجاوز الدلالة الأصلية للفظ
entries.example: In that culture white can connote mourning rather than celebration.

entries.definitionEn: To take control of a place or people by force. Also to succeed in dealing with a problem or fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغزو أرضاً أو شعباً فيسيطر بالقوة؛ أو يتغلّب على مشكلة أو خوف
entries.example: She finally conquered her fear of speaking in public.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking control of a place by force, or something gained in that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتح أو غزو للسيطرة على أرض، أو ما يُكتسب بذلك
entries.example: The museum exhibit traced the conquest of the valley.

entries.definitionEn: The inner sense of what is right and wrong that guides a person's behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير؛ حسّ داخلي بالصواب والخطأ يوجّه السلوك
entries.example: His conscience would not let him keep the extra change.

entries.definitionEn: Careful to do your work thoroughly and to do what you believe is right.
entries.arabicMeaning: دؤوب حريص على إتقان العمل وعلى فعل ما يراه صواباً
entries.example: A conscientious editor caught the error before print.

entries.definitionEn: In a careful, responsible way that aims to do work well.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعناية مسؤولة تحرص على تجويد العمل
entries.example: She checked every figure conscientiously.

entries.definitionEn: Awake and aware of what is happening. Also noticing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: واعٍ مستيقظ مدرك لما يجري؛ أو متنبّه لأمر
entries.example: He was still conscious after the fall and could answer questions.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being awake and aware. Also people's shared awareness of a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعي؛ حالة الاستيقاظ والإدراك، أو إدراك جماعي بأمر
entries.example: She recovered consciousness a few minutes after the faint.

entries.definitionEn: General agreement among a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجماع أو اتفاق عام بين جماعة
entries.example: The committee reached a consensus on the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Permission to do something, given by someone who has the right to allow it.
entries.arabicMeaning: موافقة أو إذن ممّن يملك حق السماح
entries.example: The clinic cannot share the records without written consent.

entries.definitionEn: A result of something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: نتيجة تترتب على أمر وقع
entries.example: If you miss the train, the consequence is a long wait.

entries.definitionEn: As a result; therefore.
entries.arabicMeaning: بناءً على ذلك؛ نتيجةً لما سبق
entries.example: The road was flooded; consequently the bus was late.

entries.definitionEn: The protection of nature, buildings, or resources so they are not damaged or wasted.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفظ الطبيعة أو المباني أو الموارد من التلف أو الهدر
entries.example: The park is managed for the conservation of wetland birds.

entries.definitionEn: Not liking sudden change and preferring familiar ways. Also careful with money or risk.
entries.arabicMeaning: محافظ يكره التغيير المفاجئ ويفضّل المألوف؛ أو حذر في المال أو المخاطرة
entries.example: She took a conservative approach to spending this year.

entries.definitionEn: A glass room attached to a house, used for sitting or for plants. Also a school for music or drama.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة زجاجية ملحقة بالمنزل للجلوس أو للنبات؛ أو معهد للموسيقى أو التمثيل
entries.example: They eat breakfast in the conservatory when the sun is out.

entries.definitionEn: To protect something from being wasted, damaged, or used up.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصون شيئاً من الهدر أو التلف أو النفاد
entries.example: Turn off unused lights to conserve electricity.

entries.definitionEn: To think carefully about something, especially before you decide.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظر في الأمر بتأنٍّ ولا سيما قبل اتخاذ قرار
entries.example: Please consider all the options before you choose.

entries.definitionEn: Large in size, amount, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبير في الحجم أو المقدار أو الأهمية
entries.example: The repairs will take a considerable amount of time.

entries.definitionEn: By a large amount; much.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد كبير؛ بكثير
entries.example: The delay was considerably longer than we expected.

entries.definitionEn: Careful thought. Also kindness towards other people's feelings, or a fact you take into account.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفكير متأنٍّ؛ أو مراعاة لمشاعر الغير؛ أو أمر يُؤخذ في الحسبان
entries.example: After careful consideration, she accepted the offer.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce a clause that makes what follows less surprising, given that fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة ربط تقدّم جملة توضّح ظرفاً يجعل ما يأتي أقل مفاجأة
entries.example: Considering that she had only an hour, she finished a great deal.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun phrase to mean if you take that fact into account.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى مع مراعاة، يليه اسم أو عبارة تُؤخذ في الحسبان عند الحكم
entries.example: Considering the rain, the garden still looks healthy.

entries.definitionEn: To send goods to a person or place. Also to put someone or something into an unpleasant place or state.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل بضاعة إلى شخص أو موضع؛ أو يودع شخصاً أو شيئاً في حال غير مرضية
entries.example: The shop consigned the unsold books back to the publisher.

entries.definitionEn: A load of goods sent to a person or place, often for sale.
entries.arabicMeaning: شحنة بضائع تُرسل إلى شخص أو موضع وغالباً للبيع
entries.example: A consignment of coffee arrived at the warehouse this morning.

entries.definitionEn: To be made of particular parts or materials, used with of.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكوّن من أجزاء أو مواد معيّنة
entries.example: The team consists of six people.

entries.definitionEn: Always behaving or happening in the same way. Also in agreement with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثابت النهج لا يتغيّر؛ أو متسق مع أمر آخر
entries.example: Her work has been consistent all year.

entries.definitionEn: Comfort given to someone who is sad or disappointed, or something that provides that comfort.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزاء يُقدَّم لمن يحزن أو يخيب، أو ما يمنح ذلك العزاء
entries.example: The kind letter was a small consolation after the loss.

entries.definitionEn: To try to make someone feel better when they are sad or disappointed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعزّي شخصاً ويحاول تخفيف حزنه أو خيبته
entries.example: Friends came over to console her after the rejection.

entries.definitionEn: A speech sound made by partly or fully blocking air, or a letter that stands for such a sound, such as b, t, or s.
entries.arabicMeaning: صامت يُحبس معه الهواء جزئياً أو كلياً، أو حرف يرمز إلى ذلك الصوت
entries.example: The word stop ends with the consonant p.

entries.definitionEn: Happening all the time, or staying the same and not changing.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائم الحدوث أو ثابت لا يتغيّر
entries.example: The fans made a constant noise during the match.

entries.definitionEn: All the time; again and again.
entries.arabicMeaning: باستمرار؛ مراراً وتكراراً
entries.example: She constantly checks the weather before cycling.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of shock, worry, and confusion caused by something unexpected and unwelcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذعر وحيرة شديدة يثيرهما أمر مفاجئ غير مرغوب
entries.example: The sudden cancellation caused consternation among the guests.

entries.definitionEn: To be a particular thing in law or fact, or to be the parts that form a whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعدّ بمثابة شيء معيّن في الحكم أو الواقع، أو يشكّل أجزاء الكلّ
entries.example: These twelve essays constitute the first part of the book.

entries.definitionEn: The set of basic laws of a country. Also a person's physical health and strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: دستور الدولة الأساسي؛ أو بنية الجسم من حيث الصحة والقوة
entries.example: The constitution sets out how the government is formed.

entries.definitionEn: Limited or forced to act in a restricted way, often so that the result feels unnatural.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقيَّد يُضطر إلى التصرّف في حيّز ضيق وغالباً على نحو غير طبيعي
entries.example: His smile looked constrained in front of the camera.

entries.definitionEn: A limit on what you can do, often of time, money, or rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: قيد يحدّ ما يمكن فعله وغالباً من وقت أو مال أو قواعد
entries.example: Budget constraints delayed the renovation.

entries.definitionEn: To build something, or to form an idea, argument, or sentence.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبني شيئاً أو يركّب فكرة أو حجة أو جملة
entries.example: Workers will construct a new bridge over the river.

entries.definitionEn: The process or business of building. Also the way something, especially a sentence, is put together.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية البناء أو قطاعه؛ أو طريقة تركيب شيء ولا سيما الجملة
entries.example: Construction of the new school will start in March.

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone for advice or information, or to look something up in a book or record.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستشير شخصاً طلباً للنصح أو المعلومة، أو يرجع إلى كتاب أو سجل
entries.example: You should consult a doctor about that cough.

entries.definitionEn: A company that gives expert advice, or the work of giving such advice.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة استشارية تقدّم خبرة متخصصة، أو عمل تقديم تلك المشورة
entries.example: She left the bank to start a small design consultancy.

entries.definitionEn: An expert whose job is to give professional advice. Also a senior hospital doctor in some countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستشار خبير يقدّم مشورة مهنية؛ أو طبيب استشاري كبير في بعض البلدان
entries.example: They hired a consultant to improve the booking system.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting in which advice or information is sought. Also the process of asking people for their views before a decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلسة استشارة لطلب نصح أو معلومة؛ أو تشاور يُطلب فيه رأي الناس قبل القرار
entries.example: The doctor booked a follow-up consultation for next week.

entries.definitionEn: To eat, drink, or use something up.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستهلك شيئاً أكلاً أو شرباً أو استخداماً حتى ينفد أو يُستخدم
entries.example: This old fridge consumes a lot of electricity.

entries.definitionEn: A person who buys goods or services for their own use.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستهلك يشتري سلعاً أو خدمات لاستعماله الخاص
entries.example: Clear labels help the consumer choose food more easily.

entries.definitionEn: The act of using, eating, or buying something, or the amount that is used.
entries.arabicMeaning: استهلاك بالاستخدام أو الأكل أو الشراء، أو مقدار ما يُستهلك
entries.example: Water consumption rose during the hot week.

entries.definitionEn: Communication with someone, or the state of touching something.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتصال بشخص أو تلامس مع شيء
entries.example: I have lost contact with my old classmates.

entries.definitionEn: To write to, call, or speak to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصل بشخص كتابةً أو هاتفاً أو كلاماً
entries.example: Please contact the office if you cannot come.

entries.definitionEn: The spread of disease from one person or place to another. Also the rapid spread of a feeling or idea through a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدوى ينتقل بها المرض من شخص أو موضع إلى آخر؛ أو سريان شعور أو فكرة في جماعة
entries.example: Handwashing reduces the contagion of common winter illnesses.

entries.definitionEn: To have something inside. Also to keep a feeling or a problem under control.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتوي على شيء في داخله؛ أو يكبح شعوراً أو مشكلة
entries.example: This box contains the spare keys.

entries.definitionEn: A box, bottle, or other object used to hold or carry things.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعاء أو صندوق أو زجاجة تُحفظ فيها الأشياء أو تُنقل
entries.example: Put the leftovers in a sealed container.

entries.definitionEn: To make something dirty or harmful by adding a dangerous or unwanted substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوّث شيئاً بمادة ضارة أو غير مرغوبة
entries.example: A cracked pipe could contaminate the drinking water.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to the present time. Also living or happening at the same period as someone or something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاصر ينتمي إلى الزمن الحاضر؛ أو يعيش أو يقع في الحقبة نفسها
entries.example: The gallery shows contemporary painting from this city.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling that someone or something is worthless and does not deserve respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدراء شديد يرى أن شخصاً أو شيئاً لا يستحق الاحترام
entries.example: He spoke of the careless work with open contempt.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you think someone or something is worthless and does not deserve respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدرائي يُظهر أن الشخص أو الشيء لا يستحق الاحترام
entries.example: She gave the suggestion a contemptuous look and said nothing.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows scorn and a lack of respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: بازدراء يُظهر الاحتقار وقلة الاحترام
entries.example: He dismissed the warning contemptuously.

entries.definitionEn: Happy and satisfied with what you have and not wanting more.
entries.arabicMeaning: راضٍ قانع بما لديه ولا يطلب المزيد
entries.example: He seemed content to sit and read by the window.

entries.definitionEn: The things that are inside something, or the ideas and information in a book, speech, or website.
entries.arabicMeaning: محتوى ما في داخل شيء، أو أفكار نص أو خطاب أو موقع ومعلوماته
entries.example: Check the content of the box before you sign.

entries.definitionEn: A competition to see who is best at something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسابقة لمعرفة من هو الأفضل في أمر
entries.example: She entered a writing contest at school.

entries.definitionEn: To say that something is wrong or unfair and try to change it. Also to take part in a competition for a position or prize.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينازع في صحة أمر أو عدله ويسعى إلى تغييره؛ أو يخوض منافسة على منصب أو جائزة
entries.example: The team plans to contest the referee's decision.

entries.definitionEn: Disputed; not accepted by everyone as settled or rightful.
entries.arabicMeaning: متنازع عليه لم يسلّم الجميع بأنه محسوم أو حق
entries.example: The border remains a contested issue between the two towns.

entries.definitionEn: The situation around something that helps you understand it.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياق يحيط بالأمر ويعين على فهمه
entries.example: You need the context of the whole paragraph to understand this word.

entries.definitionEn: One of the large land areas of the earth, such as Africa or Asia.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارّة؛ إحدى الكتل الأرضية الكبرى مثل أفريقيا أو آسيا
entries.example: Africa is a continent with many different climates.

entries.definitionEn: Happening again and again over a period of time, often in an annoying way.
entries.arabicMeaning: متكرر على مدى فترة وغالباً على نحو مزعج
entries.example: Continual interruptions made the meeting last twice as long.

entries.definitionEn: Again and again; repeatedly over a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراراً وتكراراً على مدى فترة
entries.example: He was continually interrupted by phone calls.

entries.definitionEn: To keep doing something without stopping, or to start again after a pause.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستمر في فعل شيء بلا توقف، أو يستأنف بعد توقف
entries.example: Please continue reading from the next page.

entries.definitionEn: The state of going on without a break, or of staying consistent over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: استمرارية بلا انقطاع، أو ثبات النهج عبر الزمن
entries.example: A deputy was appointed to ensure continuity while the director was away.

entries.definitionEn: Going on without a break or pause.
entries.arabicMeaning: متواصل يسير بلا انقطاع أو توقف
entries.example: There was a continuous line of traffic on the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: Without stopping.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا توقف أو انقطاع
entries.example: The machine ran continuously for twelve hours.

entries.definitionEn: A written legal agreement that people or organizations must follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقد مكتوب ملزم قانوناً بين طرفين
entries.example: They signed a contract for the new apartment.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller or shorter. Also to catch an illness, or to make a legal agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينكمش أو يقصر؛ وقد يعني الإصابة بمرض أو إبرام عقد
entries.example: Metal contracts as it cools.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company hired to do a particular job, especially building or repair work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاول يُكلَّف بعمل محدد، ولا سيما في البناء
entries.example: The contractor finished the kitchen last month.

entries.definitionEn: Set out in a contract, or arising from one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاقدي؛ ناشئ عن عقد
entries.example: The delay was a contractual breach.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that a contract requires or governs.
entries.arabicMeaning: بموجب العقد أو على نحو تعاقدي
entries.example: She is contractually bound to stay for two years.

entries.definitionEn: To say the opposite of what someone else has said, or to be opposite to a fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناقض قولاً أو يتعارض مع حقيقة
entries.example: The two reports contradict each other.

entries.definitionEn: A difference between two statements or facts that cannot both be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: تناقض بين أمرين لا يمكن أن يصدقا معاً
entries.example: There is a contradiction in his story.

entries.definitionEn: Saying opposite things, or unable to both be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: متناقض؛ يقول أموراً متعارضة
entries.example: The witnesses gave contradictory accounts.

entries.definitionEn: A device that looks strange, complicated, or homemade.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز غريب أو معقّد أو مرتجل الصنع
entries.example: He built a noisy contraption to water the plants.

entries.definitionEn: Opposite in nature, direction, or meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاكس أو مخالف
entries.example: The results were contrary to our hopes.

entries.definitionEn: A clear difference between two things when you compare them.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرق واضح يظهر عند المقارنة
entries.example: There is a contrast between the two photos.

entries.definitionEn: To give money, help, or ideas toward something that is shared.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساهم بمال أو مساعدة أو فكرة
entries.example: Many people contributed to the project.

entries.definitionEn: Money, help, or ideas that you give to a person, group, or cause.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساهمة بالمال أو العون أو الأفكار
entries.example: Her contribution made the event possible.

entries.definitionEn: To manage to do something by clever, and sometimes slightly dishonest, planning.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدبّر أمراً ببراعة أو بحيلة
entries.example: They contrived to meet without anyone noticing.

entries.definitionEn: The power to make a person or thing do what you want.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيطرة أو تحكّم
entries.example: He lost control of the car on the ice.

entries.definitionEn: To have power over something and decide what it does.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحكّم في الشيء أو يضبطه
entries.example: She tried to control her anger.

entries.definitionEn: Causing public disagreement or strong argument.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير للجدل
entries.example: The new rule is controversial among staff.

entries.definitionEn: A lot of public disagreement about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدل واسع أو خلاف عام
entries.example: The film caused controversy when it was released.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being easy and useful. Also something that makes daily life easier.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهولة الاستخدام؛ أو مرفق ييسّر الحياة اليومية
entries.example: The shop's location is a real convenience.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to use or easy to reach, and saving time or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريح وسهل المنال
entries.example: The hotel is convenient for the station.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is easy or well timed. Sometimes used when something happens in a way that seems too lucky.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطريقة مريحة أو في وقت مناسب؛ وقد يوحي بأن الأمر جاء مواتياً أكثر مما ينبغي
entries.example: The keys were conveniently left on the table.

entries.definitionEn: A large meeting of people who do the same kind of work. Also an accepted way of behaving or doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤتمر كبير لأهل مهنة واحدة؛ أو عرف متّبع
entries.example: She spoke at a teachers' convention.

entries.definitionEn: Following the usual way of doing things, rather than a new or different one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقليدي يتبع المألوف
entries.example: They chose a conventional design for the house.

entries.definitionEn: A talk between two or more people.
entries.arabicMeaning: محادثة
entries.example: We had a long conversation after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Opposite in meaning, order, or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاكس في المعنى أو الاتجاه
entries.example: The converse claim is also worth testing.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the opposite of what you have just said.
entries.arabicMeaning: على العكس من ذلك
entries.example: Some plants need sun; conversely, others prefer shade.

entries.definitionEn: The act of changing something from one form, use, or belief to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحويل من شكل أو استخدام أو اعتقاد إلى آخر
entries.example: The barn's conversion into a studio took a year.

entries.definitionEn: To change something into a different form or use. Also to change someone's beliefs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوّل الشيء إلى شكل أو استعمال آخر؛ وقد يعني تغيير المعتقد
entries.example: They converted the loft into a bedroom.

entries.definitionEn: To communicate a feeling or idea. Also to carry something from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقل معنى أو شعوراً؛ وقد يعني نقل شيء من مكان إلى آخر
entries.example: Her letter conveyed how grateful she was.

entries.definitionEn: A person found guilty of a crime and sent to prison.
entries.arabicMeaning: محكوم عليه قضائياً ويقضي عقوبة السجن
entries.example: The convict was released after ten years.

entries.definitionEn: To decide in a court of law that someone is guilty of a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدين شخصاً بحكم قضائي
entries.example: The jury convicted him of fraud.

entries.definitionEn: A strong belief. Also a court's formal decision that someone is guilty.
entries.arabicMeaning: قناعة راسخة؛ أو حكم بالإدانة
entries.example: She spoke with conviction about the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone believe that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقنع شخصاً بأن شيئاً صحيح
entries.example: I cannot convince him to stay.

entries.definitionEn: Sure that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقتنع ومتأكد
entries.example: I am convinced we took the right train.

entries.definitionEn: Twisted and extremely complicated, and therefore hard to follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: معقّد ملتوٍ يصعب تتبعه
entries.example: The plot was too convoluted to enjoy.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to prepare food.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبّاخ
entries.example: The cook made soup for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: To prepare food by heating it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطبخ الطعام
entries.example: I cook dinner every evening.

entries.definitionEn: A kitchen appliance with an oven and hot plates for cooking food.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقد طبخ فيه فرن وسطح تسخين
entries.example: The rice is on the cooker.

entries.definitionEn: A small, sweet, baked biscuit.
entries.arabicMeaning: كعكة صغيرة حلوة
entries.example: She packed a cookie in her bag.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of preparing food. Also a particular style of food.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطبخ؛ أو أسلوب معيّن في إعداد الطعام
entries.example: His cooking is simple and good.

entries.definitionEn: A little cold in a pleasant way. Also fashionable or impressive, in informal use.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارد بعض الشيء على نحو مريح؛ وقد يعني أنيقاً أو رائعاً في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: The water is cool and clean.

entries.definitionEn: To become less hot, or to make something less hot.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبرّد أو يبرد
entries.example: Let the soup cool before you serve it.

entries.definitionEn: A box or bag that keeps food and drinks cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: حافظة تبريد
entries.example: We put the drinks in a cooler for the picnic.

entries.definitionEn: To work together with others toward the same goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعاون مع الآخرين لتحقيق هدف مشترك
entries.example: The two teams cooperated on the report.

entries.definitionEn: The act of working together for a shared purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاون من أجل هدف مشترك
entries.example: The rescue needed close cooperation.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to help and work with other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعاون ومستعد للعمل مع غيره
entries.example: The staff were cooperative during the move.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a police officer.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرطي في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: A cop stopped the car at the corner.

entries.definitionEn: To deal successfully with a difficult situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدبّر أمراً صعباً بنجاح
entries.example: She is learning to cope with the new hours.

entries.definitionEn: A reddish-brown metal used in wires, coins, and pipes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نحاس
entries.example: The pipes are made of copper.

entries.definitionEn: One of several things that are the same, such as a book or a document.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة من كتاب أو وثيقة
entries.example: I need a copy of the form.

entries.definitionEn: To make something that is the same as something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسخ الشيء ليكون مطابقاً
entries.example: Please copy this page for me.

entries.definitionEn: The legal right to control how a book, song, or other work is copied and used.
entries.arabicMeaning: حق المؤلف في التحكّم بنسخ المصنَّف واستعماله
entries.example: The photograph is still under copyright.

entries.definitionEn: A hard, colorful substance formed in the sea by tiny animals, often in reefs.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرجان
entries.example: Divers swam above the coral.

entries.definitionEn: To stop people from entering an area, usually by placing police or barriers around it. Often used with off.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطوّق منطقة بخط يمنع الدخول، وغالباً مع off
entries.example: Police cordoned off the street after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: The central and most important part of something. Also the hard center of some fruits.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهر الشيء أو أهمّ جزء فيه؛ وقد يعني لبّ الثمرة
entries.example: Trust is at the core of the team.

entries.definitionEn: A tall plant with yellow grains that people eat, or those grains as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذرة
entries.example: We had corn with dinner.

entries.definitionEn: The place where two sides, streets, or edges meet.
entries.arabicMeaning: زاوية أو ناصية
entries.example: The shop is on the corner.

entries.definitionEn: The most important part of a plan or idea, on which everything else depends.
entries.arabicMeaning: حجر الأساس لفكرة أو خطة
entries.example: Honesty is the cornerstone of the policy.

entries.definitionEn: A brass musical instrument like a small trumpet.
entries.arabicMeaning: كورنيت، آلة نفخ نحاسية تشبه البوق الصغير
entries.example: She played the cornet in the band.

entries.definitionEn: The faint outer glow around the sun, seen most clearly during an eclipse.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهالة الضوئية الخارجية حول الشمس
entries.example: Photographers captured the sun's corona.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the body, especially physical punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: جسدي؛ ولا سيما في العقاب البدني
entries.example: The school banned corporal punishment.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a large company, or to business in general.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركوي أو متعلق بالشركات
entries.example: She works in corporate law.

entries.definitionEn: A large company, or a group of companies acting as one.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة كبيرة أو مجموعة شركات
entries.example: The corporation employs thousands of people.

entries.definitionEn: A specialized group of people who work together, especially in the army or a profession.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلق أو هيئة متخصصة تعمل معاً
entries.example: He joined the medical corps.

entries.definitionEn: A dead human body.
entries.arabicMeaning: جثة إنسان
entries.example: The pathologist examined the corpse.

entries.definitionEn: A large collection of written or spoken texts used for study.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدوّنة نصوص كبيرة تُستخدم في الدراسة
entries.example: The linguist searched a corpus of news articles.

entries.definitionEn: Right, with no mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيح بلا خطأ
entries.example: That answer is correct.

entries.definitionEn: To make something right by removing mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوّب الخطأ
entries.example: Please correct these spelling errors.

entries.definitionEn: A change that makes something right.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصحيح
entries.example: The teacher marked a correction in the margin.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is right and without mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل صحيح
entries.example: She spelled every name correctly.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being accurate, or of following accepted rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحة الأمر أو مطابقته للقواعد المقبولة
entries.example: He checked the correctness of the figures.

entries.definitionEn: One of two things that are closely linked and tend to occur together.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحد أمرين يرتبطان ويحدثان معاً في العادة
entries.example: Income is a known correlate of education level.

entries.definitionEn: To have a close connection with something else, so that the two change together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتبط أمر بآخر فيتغيّران معاً
entries.example: Hours of practice correlate with higher scores.

entries.definitionEn: A connection between two things in which they change together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتباط بين أمرين يتغيّران معاً
entries.example: There is a strong correlation between sleep and mood.

entries.definitionEn: To match or be similar to something. Also to write letters to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطابق أو يشابه؛ وقد يعني تبادل الرسائل
entries.example: The results correspond with earlier tests.

entries.definitionEn: Letters exchanged between people. Also a close match between two things.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراسلات؛ أو تطابق وثيق
entries.example: I kept the correspondence in a folder.

entries.definitionEn: A journalist who reports from a particular place or on a particular subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراسل صحفي
entries.example: The foreign correspondent filed her story at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Matching or related to something already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقابل أو مطابق لما ذُكر
entries.example: Each question has a corresponding answer key.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow passage in a building, with doors along it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممر طويل في مبنى
entries.example: Her office is at the end of the corridor.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to do dishonest things for money or power. Also damaged and unusable, of data or files.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاسد يسعى للمنفعة بطرق غير نزيهة؛ وقد يعني تلفاً في البيانات
entries.example: The inquiry exposed a corrupt official.

entries.definitionEn: Dishonest or illegal behavior by people in power, often for money.
entries.arabicMeaning: فساد ذوي السلطة طمعاً في منفعة
entries.example: The mayor promised to fight corruption.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the universe, or so vast that it feels beyond ordinary life.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوني؛ أو هائل يتجاوز المألوف
entries.example: Astronomers tracked a cosmic burst of light.

entries.definitionEn: To treat someone with too much care and protection.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدلل شخصاً بحماية مفرطة
entries.example: They cosseted the youngest child.

entries.definitionEn: Giving good results for the amount of money spent.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجدٍ اقتصادياً بالنسبة إلى تكلفته
entries.example: Solar panels proved cost-effective over time.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of money you need to buy or do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكلفة أو ثمن
entries.example: The cost of the ticket is twenty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: To have a particular price.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكلّف مبلغاً معيّناً
entries.example: The meal cost more than I expected.

entries.definitionEn: Expensive, or causing serious loss or harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: باهظ الثمن أو مكلف في نتائجه
entries.example: The delay was a costly mistake.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes worn to look like someone or something else, especially in a play or at a party.
entries.arabicMeaning: زي تنكري أو مسرحي
entries.example: She wore a bird costume to the party.

entries.definitionEn: A small house, typically in the countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوخ أو بيت ريفي صغير
entries.example: They rented a cottage by the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A soft cloth made from a plant, or the plant itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطن
entries.example: This shirt is made of cotton.

entries.definitionEn: A long, soft seat for more than one person.
entries.arabicMeaning: أريكة
entries.example: The cat is sleeping on the couch.

entries.definitionEn: The act or sound of forcing air from the lungs suddenly. Also an illness with that symptom.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعال
entries.example: He had a dry cough all week.

entries.definitionEn: To force air from your lungs with a sudden noise, often when you are ill.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسعل
entries.example: She coughed during the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Used to talk about ability in the past, about what is possible, or to make a polite request.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد للدلالة على القدرة في الماضي، أو الإمكان، أو الطلب بأدب
entries.example: Could you help me with this bag?

entries.definitionEn: A group of people elected to govern a town or to give official advice.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجلس منتخب لإدارة مدينة أو لتقديم مشورة رسمية
entries.example: The city council voted on the new park.

entries.definitionEn: Advice, especially formal or professional. Also a lawyer representing someone in court.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشورة رسمية؛ أو محامٍ في قضية
entries.example: She sought counsel before signing.

entries.definitionEn: Professional talk that helps someone deal with a problem or a hard time.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرشاد نفسي أو مهني بالحديث
entries.example: He started counseling after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A total found by adding things up. Also a noble title in some countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدد إجمالي بعد الإحصاء؛ أو لقب نبيل في بعض البلدان
entries.example: The final count was sixty votes.

entries.definitionEn: To say numbers in order, or to find how many there are.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعدّ الأرقام أو الأشياء
entries.example: The children counted to ten.

entries.definitionEn: A long flat surface in a shop or kitchen where people are served or food is prepared.
entries.arabicMeaning: منضدة في محل أو مطبخ
entries.example: Leave the keys on the counter.

entries.definitionEn: To speak or act against something in order to reduce its effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يواجه أمراً أو يردّ عليه ليحدّ من أثره
entries.example: She countered the claim with new evidence.

entries.definitionEn: Having the opposite of the useful effect you wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: عكسي النفع؛ يأتي بنتيجة مضادة للمقصود
entries.example: Late-night emails proved counterproductive.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that produces the opposite of the intended benefit.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يأتي بعكس الفائدة المقصودة
entries.example: He argued so fiercely that he counterproductively lost support.

entries.definitionEn: Too many to count.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُحصى عدداً
entries.example: She has taken countless photos of the city.

entries.definitionEn: A nation with its own government. Also land outside towns and cities.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلد؛ أو ريف خارج المدن
entries.example: Italy is a beautiful country.

entries.definitionEn: A person from the same country as you. Also a man who lives in the countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: مواطن من البلد نفسه؛ أو رجل ريفي
entries.example: He helped a fellow countryman at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: Land outside towns, with fields, woods, and small villages.
entries.arabicMeaning: الريف
entries.example: We spent the weekend in the countryside.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or existing across a whole country.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مستوى البلد كله
entries.example: A countrywide survey began in March.

entries.definitionEn: A region with its own local government, especially in the UK, Ireland, or the US.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاطعة إدارية محلية
entries.example: She grew up in a rural county.

entries.definitionEn: Two people in a romantic relationship. Also two things, or a small number of them.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوجان؛ أو اثنان أو عدد قليل
entries.example: A young couple sat by the window.

entries.definitionEn: Joined together, or happening along with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقترن أو مصحوب بشيء آخر
entries.example: Low pay, coupled with long hours, caused staff to leave.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to do something difficult or frightening.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجاعة
entries.example: It took courage to speak in front of the class.

entries.definitionEn: Brave when facing danger or difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجاع في مواجهة الخطر أو الصعوبة
entries.example: The firefighter made a courageous rescue.

entries.definitionEn: A long green vegetable, also called zucchini.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوسا خضراء طويلة
entries.example: She sliced a courgette for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: A series of lessons on a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: دورة دراسية
entries.example: I am taking a Spanish course.

entries.definitionEn: A place where legal cases are heard. Also an area marked out for some sports.
entries.arabicMeaning: محكمة؛ أو ملعب لبعض الرياضات
entries.example: The players walked onto the tennis court.

entries.definitionEn: Polite behavior that shows respect for other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاملة ولطف في المعاملة
entries.example: He thanked her out of courtesy, even though he disagreed.

entries.definitionEn: The child of your aunt or uncle.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابن العم أو الخال أو بنت العمة أو الخالة
entries.example: My cousin is visiting next week.

entries.definitionEn: Something put over an object to protect it. Also the outside of a book.
entries.arabicMeaning: غطاء؛ أو غلاف كتاب
entries.example: Put the cover on the pan.

entries.definitionEn: To put something over something else in order to hide or protect it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغطي الشيء ليستره أو يحميه
entries.example: Please cover the food.

entries.definitionEn: The way a subject is reported in the news. Also the protection given by an insurance policy.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغطية إعلامية؛ أو تغطية تأمينية
entries.example: The storm received wide news coverage.

entries.definitionEn: A large farm animal kept for milk or meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقرة
entries.example: The cow stood in the field.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is too afraid to do what is necessary or right.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبان
entries.example: He called himself a coward for staying silent.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking courage, or done out of fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبان أو صادر عن جبن
entries.example: It was a cowardly thing to say behind her back.

entries.definitionEn: The pleasant feeling of being warm, comfortable, and safe.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفء مريح وشعور بالراحة والأمان
entries.example: The fire added to the coziness of the room.

entries.definitionEn: Warm, comfortable, and pleasant, especially of a small place.
entries.arabicMeaning: دافئ ومريح، ولا سيما في مكان صغير
entries.example: We spent a cozy evening at home.

entries.definitionEn: A sea animal with a hard shell and claws.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرطان البحر
entries.example: They ordered crab at the restaurant.

entries.definitionEn: A thin line where something is broken but not fully apart. Also a sudden sharp sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: شق رفيع؛ أو صوت فرقعة مفاجئة
entries.example: There is a crack in the window.

entries.definitionEn: To break so that a thin line appears, without falling into pieces. Also to make a sudden sharp sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتشقق أو يُحدث فرقعة
entries.example: The glass cracked when it hit the floor.

entries.definitionEn: Skill in making things by hand, or the things made that way. Sometimes a boat or plane.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفة يدوية أو منتجاتها؛ وقد تعني مركباً
entries.example: Pottery is an old craft.

entries.definitionEn: To make something with skill and care.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنع الشيء بمهارة وعناية
entries.example: She crafted a short speech for the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A person skilled at making things by hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفي ماهر
entries.example: A local craftsman repaired the chair.

entries.definitionEn: An accident in which a vehicle hits something. Also a sudden loud noise, or a computer failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: حادث اصطدام؛ أو دويّ مفاجئ أو تعطّل الحاسوب
entries.example: There was a crash on the main road.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something hard and cause damage. Also, of a computer, to stop working suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصطدم بشدة؛ أو يتوقف الحاسوب فجأة
entries.example: The car crashed into a wall.
