entries.definitionEn: A large round hole in the ground, often made by a bomb or a meteor.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوهة كبيرة في الأرض
entries.example: The moon is covered with craters.

entries.definitionEn: To want something very strongly, especially a food or a feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشتهي الشيء بقوة
entries.example: After the hike she craved cold water.

entries.definitionEn: A strong desire for something, often a particular food.
entries.arabicMeaning: اشتهاء شديد، وغالباً لطعام معيّن
entries.example: He had a craving for chocolate.

entries.definitionEn: To move on your hands and knees, or very slowly close to the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزحف على اليدين والركبتين أو ببطء شديد
entries.example: The baby crawled across the floor.

entries.definitionEn: Very strange, silly, or not sensible. Also very enthusiastic, in informal use.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب أو أحمق؛ وقد يعني شديد الحماس في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: That idea sounds a bit crazy.

entries.definitionEn: Pale yellow-white in color.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلون كريمي مائل إلى البياض المصفر
entries.example: She painted the walls cream.

entries.definitionEn: The thick, fatty part of milk. Also a smooth substance you put on skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: قشدة الحليب؛ أو كريم للبشرة
entries.example: Would you like cream in your coffee?

entries.definitionEn: Smooth, thick, and rich, like cream. Also pale cream in color.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريمي الملمس أو كثيف غني؛ وقد يعني بلون القشدة
entries.example: The sauce is creamy and mild.

entries.definitionEn: A line or fold in cloth or paper, often from being pressed or bent.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثنية أو تجعيد في قماش أو ورق
entries.example: He ironed out the crease in his shirt.

entries.definitionEn: To make something new.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبتكر أو يصنع شيئاً جديداً
entries.example: They create new games every year.

entries.definitionEn: Something that has been made. Also the act of making it.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء مصنوع مبتكَر؛ أو فعل الخلق
entries.example: The sculpture is her latest creation.

entries.definitionEn: Good at thinking of new ideas or making new things.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبدع وحسن الابتكار
entries.example: She is a creative designer.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows new ideas and imagination.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو إبداعي
entries.example: The team solved the problem creatively.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to think of new ideas or make new things.
entries.arabicMeaning: إبداع
entries.example: Art class helps children show their creativity.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes something new, such as a story, product, or work of art.
entries.arabicMeaning: منشئ أو مبتكر
entries.example: The creator of the app still works on updates.

entries.definitionEn: A living animal, or any living being.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخلوق حي
entries.example: A small creature ran under the bush.

entries.definitionEn: A qualification, document, or fact that shows you can be trusted or are suitable for a role. Often used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤهل أو وثيقة تثبت الجدارة، وغالباً بالجمع
entries.example: A teaching certificate is a useful credential.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being trusted and believed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصداقية
entries.example: The error damaged the report's credibility.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be believed or trusted.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بالتصديق أو بالثقة
entries.example: The witness gave a credible account.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can be believed.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُصدَّق
entries.example: No one could credibly deny the footage.

entries.definitionEn: A plastic card from a bank that lets you buy things and pay later.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة ائتمان
entries.example: I paid with a credit card.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement to buy now and pay later. Also praise for something good.
entries.arabicMeaning: ائتمان للشراء والدفع لاحقاً؛ أو فضل يُنسب لشخص
entries.example: The store offered six months of credit.

entries.definitionEn: A small stream, or a narrow inlet of water.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدول صغير أو خور ضيق
entries.example: They walked along the creek after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel slightly frightened or uneasy.
entries.arabicMeaning: موحش يثير القلق أو خوفاً خفيفاً
entries.example: The empty house felt creepy at night.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who work together on a ship, plane, or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاقم يعمل معاً على سفينة أو طائرة أو فيلم
entries.example: The film crew arrived at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A bat-and-ball game popular in several countries. Also a jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريكت؛ أو حشرة صرّارة
entries.example: The children played cricket in the park.

entries.definitionEn: An illegal act, or illegal activity in general.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة؛ أو الإجرام عموماً
entries.example: The police are investigating the crime.

entries.definitionEn: Related to crime, or against the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنائي أو متعلق بالجريمة
entries.example: It is a criminal offence to steal.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has committed a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجرم
entries.example: The criminal was caught on camera.

entries.definitionEn: An old-fashioned and now offensive word for a person with a serious physical disability.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ قديم ومسيء لمن لديه إعاقة جسدية بالغة
entries.example: Style guides warn against using cripple to describe a person.

entries.definitionEn: Causing severe damage or making it almost impossible to act or continue.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُقعِد أو مُشلّ القدرة على العمل
entries.example: The company faced crippling debts.

entries.definitionEn: A time of serious difficulty or danger, when important decisions must be made.
entries.arabicMeaning: أزمة
entries.example: The hospital faced a staffing crisis.

entries.definitionEn: A very thin slice of fried potato, sold in a bag. Used especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقائق بطاطس مقلية رقيقة، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية البريطانية
entries.example: She offered me a crisp from the packet.

entries.definitionEn: The standards you use to judge or decide something. This is the usual plural of criterion.
entries.arabicMeaning: معايير يُحكم بها أو يُقرَّر على أساسها
entries.example: The judges explained the criteria for the prize.

entries.definitionEn: A person who judges art, books, or films. Also someone who points out faults.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناقد فني أو أدبي؛ أو من يبرز العيوب
entries.example: The critic liked the new play.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely important. Also expressing disapproval, or seriously ill.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الأهمية؛ أو ناقد لاذع؛ أو في حالة صحية حرجة
entries.example: Timing is critical in this job.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is extremely important, severely judgmental, or medically serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل حاسم أو ناقد أو خطير طبياً
entries.example: The patient was critically ill.

entries.definitionEn: Remarks that point out faults. Also the work of judging art or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقد يبرز العيوب؛ أو نقد الأعمال الفنية والأدبية
entries.example: The plan faced strong criticism.

entries.definitionEn: To say what you think is wrong or bad about someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقد ويبيّن العيوب
entries.example: Please do not criticize her in public.

entries.definitionEn: A large reptile with a long body, thick skin, and a wide mouth, living in rivers in warm regions.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمساح
entries.example: A crocodile lay still near the riverbank.

entries.definitionEn: A close friend of someone powerful, often suggesting unfair favors.
entries.arabicMeaning: صديق لصيق لذي نفوذ، وغالباً بما يوحي بالمحاباة
entries.example: The minister gave the contract to a crony.

entries.definitionEn: A plant grown by farmers for food, or the harvest of that plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: محصول زراعي
entries.example: Wheat is the main crop here.

entries.definitionEn: A mark like + or ×. Also the Christian symbol of two bars.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة تقاطع؛ أو صليب
entries.example: Put a cross next to the right answer.

entries.definitionEn: To go from one side of something to the other.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبر من جانب إلى آخر
entries.example: We crossed the street at the lights.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you can go across a road, river, or railway.
entries.arabicMeaning: معبر
entries.example: Use the crossing near the school.

entries.definitionEn: In an annoyed or slightly angry way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغضب خفيف أو بامتعاض
entries.example: She answered crossly when he interrupted.

entries.definitionEn: A place where two roads meet. Also a moment when an important choice must be made.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفترق طرق؛ أو لحظة قرار مهم
entries.example: The village sits at a quiet crossroads.

entries.definitionEn: A large black bird with a loud cry.
entries.arabicMeaning: غراب
entries.example: A crow landed on the fence.

entries.definitionEn: A large group of people in one place.
entries.arabicMeaning: حشد من الناس
entries.example: A crowd waited outside the cinema.

entries.definitionEn: Full of people, with little space.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزدحم
entries.example: The bus was crowded this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A special gold hat worn by a king or queen. Also the position of being the monarch.
entries.arabicMeaning: تاج؛ أو عرش الملك
entries.example: The queen wore a gold crown.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely important for the success of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسم الأهمية
entries.example: This meeting is crucial for the deal.

entries.definitionEn: Rough and not carefully made. Also rude, or of oil, not yet refined.
entries.arabicMeaning: خشن غير متقن؛ أو فظ؛ أو غير مكرّر عن النفط
entries.example: The first model was crude but useful.

entries.definitionEn: In a rough, inexact, or rude way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخشونة أو بفظاظة أو على نحو غير دقيق
entries.example: The map was crudely drawn but clear enough.

entries.definitionEn: Causing pain or unhappiness on purpose, without kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاسٍ يتعمد الإيذاء
entries.example: It is cruel to laugh at someone's mistake.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes pain or unhappiness without kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقسوة
entries.example: The character was cruelly treated in the story.

entries.definitionEn: Behavior that causes pain or suffering, or the quality of being cruel.
entries.arabicMeaning: قسوة
entries.example: The law forbids cruelty to animals.

entries.definitionEn: A holiday on a large ship that visits several places.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة بحرية سياحية
entries.example: They booked a cruise in the Mediterranean.

entries.definitionEn: To travel smoothly and without hurry, especially in a car, boat, or plane.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسير بسلاسة وبلا عجلة
entries.example: The boat cruised along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A very small piece of bread, cake, or biscuit.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتات خبز أو كعك
entries.example: She brushed a crumb from the table.

entries.definitionEn: To break into small pieces. Also to become weaker and begin to fail.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفتت قطعاً صغيرة؛ أو ينهار ضعفاً
entries.example: The old wall began to crumble.

entries.definitionEn: A strong but usually short-lived romantic liking for someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعجاب عاطفي قوي وقصير في العادة
entries.example: She had a crush on her classmate.

entries.definitionEn: A loud sound of pain, fear, or calling out. Also an act of weeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: صرخة؛ أو بكاء
entries.example: We heard a cry from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: To produce tears because you are sad or hurt. Also to shout.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبكي؛ أو يصرخ
entries.example: The baby started to cry.

entries.definitionEn: The process of forming crystals, or of an idea becoming definite and clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبلور بلورات أو وضوح فكرة حتى تصبح محددة
entries.example: The crystallization of the plan took months.

entries.definitionEn: A solid shape with six equal square sides. Also a lump of something in that shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكعّب
entries.example: She dropped an ice cube into the glass.

entries.definitionEn: An early twentieth-century art style that shows objects as geometric shapes, often seen from several angles at once.
entries.arabicMeaning: التكعيبية: مذهب فني يصوّر الأشياء بأشكال هندسية ومن زوايا عدة في آن واحد
entries.example: Picasso helped to develop cubism in the early twentieth century.

entries.definitionEn: A long green vegetable with pale, watery flesh, often eaten raw in salads.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيار
entries.example: She sliced a cucumber for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: The band at the end of a sleeve, around the wrist. Also, informal, a handcuff.
entries.arabicMeaning: كُفّة الكمّ عند المعصم؛ وقد تعني قيد اليد، وغالباً بالجمع
entries.example: He unbuttoned the cuff of his shirt.

entries.definitionEn: To select and remove animals from a group, often to control numbers. Also to pick out the best items from a large set.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستبعد أفراداً من مجموعة، وغالباً للسيطرة على أعداد الحيوانات؛ أو يصطفي مختارات من كثرة
entries.example: The park had to cull some of the deer.

entries.definitionEn: The highest or final point of a process, after which nothing more important follows.
entries.arabicMeaning: الذروة أو الغاية التي يبلغها أمر بعد تطوّره
entries.example: The concert was the culmination of months of practice.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of a cult; showing intense, uncritical devotion to a person, group, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتّسم بولاء متعصّب أعمى يشبه ولاء الجماعات المنغلقة
entries.example: The group had a cultish loyalty to its founder.

entries.definitionEn: To grow plants for food or other use. Also to develop a skill, quality, or friendship over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزرع نباتات؛ أو ينمّي مهارة أو صفة أو علاقة مع الوقت
entries.example: They cultivate tomatoes in the greenhouse.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the ideas, arts, and way of life of a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقافي؛ متصل بأفكار جماعة وفنونها وأسلوب حياتها
entries.example: The festival is an important cultural event.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the ideas, arts, or customs of a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الثقافية أو بحسب عادات جماعة وأفكارها
entries.example: The two regions are culturally quite different.

entries.definitionEn: The way of life of a group of people, including their ideas, art, and customs.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقافة؛ أسلوب حياة جماعة بما فيه أفكارها وفنونها وعاداتها
entries.example: Food is an important part of our culture.

entries.definitionEn: A small round container with a handle, used for drinking. Also the amount it holds.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوب؛ وقد تعني ما يسعه الكوب
entries.example: Would you like a cup of tea?

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture with doors, used for storing plates, food, or other things.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة لحفظ الأطباق أو الطعام أو غيرها
entries.example: The plates are in the cupboard.

entries.definitionEn: To select, organize, and look after items for an exhibition or collection. Also used of carefully chosen online content.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقي أعمالاً وينظّم عرضها في مجموعة أو معرض؛ ويُقال أيضاً عن انتقاء المحتوى الرقمي بعناية
entries.example: She was hired to curate the new photography show.

entries.definitionEn: A person who selects and looks after the objects in a museum or gallery.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمين متحف أو معرض يتولّى اختيار القطع والعناية بها
entries.example: The curator explained how the paintings were chosen.

entries.definitionEn: A treatment or medicine that makes an illness go away completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاج شافٍ يُذهب المرض
entries.example: Researchers are still looking for a cure.

entries.definitionEn: To make a person or animal healthy again. Also to preserve food such as meat or fish with salt, smoke, or drying.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشفي مريضاً؛ وقد يعني معالجة الطعام بالملح أو التدخين أو التجفيف لحفظه
entries.example: The new treatment helped to cure the infection.

entries.definitionEn: A strong wish to know or learn about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضول؛ رغبة قوية في المعرفة
entries.example: Children learn a lot through curiosity.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting to know or learn something. Also unusual and a little strange.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضولي يرغب في المعرفة؛ وقد يعني غريباً غير مألوف
entries.example: I was curious about the noise in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you want to know more. Also in a strange or surprising way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بفضول؛ أو على نحو غريب مثير للاستغراب
entries.example: He looked at the box curiously.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of hair that curves round. Also a curved shape in something such as smoke or paper.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصلة شعر مجعّدة؛ أو هيئة منحنية لشيء كالدخان أو الورق
entries.example: A curl of hair fell across her forehead.

entries.definitionEn: Having curves or curls, especially of hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجعّد، ولا سيما الشعر
entries.example: She has curly hair.

entries.definitionEn: The system of money that a country uses.
entries.arabicMeaning: عُملة بلد
entries.example: The euro is the currency of many European countries.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or existing now.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاليّ قائم الآن
entries.example: What is your current address?

entries.definitionEn: At the present time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالياً؛ في الوقت الحاضر
entries.example: She is currently working in Madrid.

entries.definitionEn: A dish of meat, fish, or vegetables cooked in a spicy sauce, often served with rice.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبق كاري حار يُطهى فيه لحم أو سمك أو خضار
entries.example: We ordered chicken curry and rice.

entries.definitionEn: Words that ask for something bad to happen to someone. Also a rude word said in anger.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعنة؛ أو كلمة نابية تُقال غاضباً
entries.example: The story is about a curse on the family.

entries.definitionEn: A small moving mark on a computer screen that shows where you are working.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤشّر على شاشة الحاسوب يبيّن موضع العمل
entries.example: Move the cursor to the top of the page.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth that hangs across a window or the front of a stage.
entries.arabicMeaning: ستارة تُسدل على نافذة أو مقدّم مسرح
entries.example: Please close the curtain; the sun is bright.

entries.definitionEn: A line or surface that bends smoothly, with no sharp angles.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحنى؛ خط أو سطح ينثني بسلاسة
entries.example: The road follows a long curve around the hill.

entries.definitionEn: A bag filled with soft material, used to make a seat more comfortable.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسادة تُوضع للجلوس بارتياح
entries.example: She put a cushion behind her back.

entries.definitionEn: A way of behaving that is usual in a place or among a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادة شائعة في مكان أو بين جماعة
entries.example: It is a local custom to remove your shoes.

entries.definitionEn: Usual in a particular place or situation, because it is the accepted practice.
entries.arabicMeaning: معتاد في موضع أو مقام معيّن لأنه جرى به العرف
entries.example: It is customary to shake hands at the start of the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A person who buys goods or services from a shop or company.
entries.arabicMeaning: زبون
entries.example: The shop was full of customers.

entries.definitionEn: The official place at a border or airport where goods and bags are checked. Also the tax on goods brought into a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجمارك: نقطة تفتيش البضائع على الحدود أو في المطار؛ وقد تعني الرسوم المفروضة عليها
entries.example: We had to wait at customs for twenty minutes.

entries.definitionEn: An opening or wound made by something sharp. Also a reduction in size, amount, or pay.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرح قطعي؛ أو خفض في الحجم أو المقدار أو الأجر
entries.example: He had a small cut on his finger.

entries.definitionEn: To divide something, or make a hole in it, with a knife, scissors, or another sharp tool.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقطع شيئاً بسكين أو مقص أو أداة حادّة
entries.example: Please cut the bread.

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in a pretty or charming way, often used of children or animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف المظهر، وغالباً للأطفال أو الحيوانات
entries.example: The puppy is so cute.

entries.definitionEn: A document that lists your education, jobs, and skills, used when you apply for work. Short for curriculum vitae.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيرة ذاتية تُرفق بطلب العمل
entries.example: Please send your CV with the application.

entries.definitionEn: A person who cannot stop using the internet or computers for long periods.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمن استخدام الإنترنت أو الحاسوب فترات طويلة
entries.example: He joked that he was becoming a cyberaddict.

entries.definitionEn: A café where customers can pay to use computers and the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقهى إنترنت يوفّر حواسيب مقابل أجر
entries.example: She checked her email at a cybercafe near the station.

entries.definitionEn: Crime committed using computers or the internet, such as stealing data or money online.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة إلكترونية تُرتكب عبر الحاسوب أو الإنترنت
entries.example: The company hired experts to fight cybercrime.

entries.definitionEn: An electronic or on-screen pet that you look after as if it were a real animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان أليف إلكتروني أو افتراضي يُعتنى به على الشاشة
entries.example: The child looked after a cyberpet on the screen.

entries.definitionEn: A school that teaches mainly over the internet rather than in a physical classroom.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرسة تُدرّس أساساً عبر الإنترنت لا في صفّ حضوري
entries.example: Some students attend a cyberschool from home.

entries.definitionEn: The online world of computers and the internet, thought of as a place where people meet and information moves.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفضاء الإلكتروني: عالم الحواسيب والإنترنت بوصفه مكاناً للتواصل وتبادل المعلومات
entries.example: Personal data can travel widely in cyberspace.

entries.definitionEn: A series of events that happens again and again in the same order. Also a bicycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: دورة من الأحداث تتكرر بالنسق نفسه؛ وقد تعني دراجة هوائية
entries.example: The seasons follow a yearly cycle.

entries.definitionEn: To ride a bicycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقود دراجة هوائية
entries.example: I cycle to the office when the weather is fine.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of riding a bicycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركوب الدراجات
entries.example: Cycling is a good way to stay fit.

entries.definitionEn: A person who rides a bicycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: درّاج؛ من يقود دراجة هوائية
entries.example: A cyclist stopped at the red light.

entries.definitionEn: A person who believes that people are mainly selfish and that their good actions hide private aims.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساخر مرتاب لا يرى في الناس إلا المصلحة ويشكّ في صدق نواياهم
entries.example: He is a cynic who trusts nobody's motives.

entries.definitionEn: Unwilling to believe that people have honest reasons; expecting selfishness or hidden aims.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساخر متشكك في صدق الدوافع، يتوقع المصلحة أو المآرب الخفية
entries.example: She gave a cynical smile at the promise.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows little trust in people's honesty or good intentions.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسخرية متشككة لا تثق في صدق الناس
entries.example: He cynically suggested they only wanted the publicity.

entries.definitionEn: The belief that people are mainly selfish, and a tendency to doubt honest motives.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخرية ارتيابية؛ ميل إلى الشك في صدق نوايا الناس
entries.example: Years of broken promises had fed his cynicism.

entries.definitionEn: A father. Informal and friendly.
entries.arabicMeaning: أب (لفظ ودّي غير رسمي)
entries.example: My dad is cooking dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A child's word for father.
entries.arabicMeaning: بابا؛ كلمة الأطفال للأب
entries.example: The little boy called for his daddy.

entries.definitionEn: Silly or not sensible. Informal, especially British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحمق أو غير معقول (لفظ غير رسمي، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية البريطانية)
entries.example: That is a daft idea.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or done every day.
entries.arabicMeaning: يومي؛ يحدث كل يوم
entries.example: She takes a daily walk after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Every day.
entries.arabicMeaning: يومياً
entries.example: He checks his email daily.

entries.definitionEn: A small flower with a yellow centre and white petals.
entries.arabicMeaning: زهرة أقحوان صغيرة صفراء الوسط بيضاء البتلات
entries.example: A daisy was growing by the path.

entries.definitionEn: A wall built across a river to hold back water.
entries.arabicMeaning: سدّ يُبنى عبر نهر لحبس الماء
entries.example: The dam holds back the river.

entries.definitionEn: Harm or injury that makes something less useful, less valuable, or less healthy.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضرر يُضعف صلاح الشيء أو قيمته أو صحته
entries.example: The storm caused a lot of damage.

entries.definitionEn: To harm something so that it is less useful, less valuable, or less healthy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُتلف شيئاً أو يضرّ به
entries.example: Water can damage the floor.

entries.definitionEn: Harmed so that it is no longer in good condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: تالف؛ لم يعد بحالة جيدة
entries.example: The damaged box was thrown away.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show anger or annoyance. Informal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُستعمل قبل الاسم لإظهار الغضب أو الضيق (غير رسمي)
entries.example: I cannot find the damn keys.

entries.definitionEn: Used before an adjective or adverb to make it stronger, often when you are annoyed. Informal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُستعمل لتوكيد صفة أو حال، غالباً مع الضيق (غير رسمي)
entries.example: The bag was damn heavy.

entries.definitionEn: Said when you are angry, surprised, or disappointed. Informal.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُقال عند الغضب أو المفاجأة أو الخيبة (غير رسمية)
entries.example: Damn, I missed the bus.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly wet, often in a way that feels cold or unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: رطب قليلاً، وغالباً على نحو بارد أو غير مريح
entries.example: The towel is still damp.

entries.definitionEn: To make something slightly wet. Also to make a feeling, sound, or reaction less strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرطّب شيئاً قليلاً؛ أو يُخمد قوة شعور أو صوت أو ردّ فعل
entries.example: The delay did not dampen their excitement.

entries.definitionEn: In a slightly wet way.
entries.arabicMeaning: برطوبة خفيفة
entries.example: The cloth hung damply over the rail.

entries.definitionEn: A set of movements to music. Also a social event where people dance.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقصة؛ أو حفلة يُرقص فيها
entries.example: They went to a dance on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: To move your body to music.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرقص على الموسيقى
entries.example: The children like to dance.

entries.definitionEn: A person who dances, especially as a job or with skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: راقص، ولا سيما محترف أو ماهر
entries.example: She trained as a dancer for years.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of moving to music.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرقص
entries.example: Dancing is fun.

entries.definitionEn: A wild plant with a bright yellow flower and seeds that blow away on a white clock of fluff.
entries.arabicMeaning: هندباء برية صفراء الزهر تتطاير بذورها في ندف بيضاء
entries.example: A dandelion had grown through a crack in the path.

entries.definitionEn: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطر؛ احتمال وقوع أذى
entries.example: There is a danger of falling rocks.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to cause harm or injury.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطير يُحتمل أن يسبب أذى
entries.example: Ice on the road is dangerous.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that could cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو خطير قد يسبب أذى
entries.example: He was driving dangerously fast.

entries.definitionEn: To be brave enough to do something that may be risky or that other people may not like.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرؤ على فعل قد يكون محفوفاً بالمخاطر أو غير مرغوب فيه
entries.example: She did not dare to open the letter.

entries.definitionEn: With little or no light. Also of a colour that is closer to black than to white.
entries.arabicMeaning: مظلم قليل الضوء؛ أو قاتم اللون
entries.example: It gets dark early in winter.

entries.definitionEn: The state of having little or no light.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظلام؛ انعدام الضوء أو قلّته
entries.example: We waited in darkness until the power returned.

entries.definitionEn: A room kept dark so that photographic film can be developed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة مظلمة لتحميض الأفلام الفوتوغرافية
entries.example: He developed the film in a darkroom.

entries.definitionEn: Dear or much loved. Also charming in a sweet, attractive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزيز محبوب؛ أو فاتن بلطفه
entries.example: They spent a week in a darling cottage by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A person you love, used especially when you speak to them.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحبيب أو العزيز، ولا سيما في النداء
entries.example: Good night, darling.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden short run. Also a punctuation mark, or a small amount of something added.
entries.arabicMeaning: اندفاعة قصيرة؛ أو شرطة في الكتابة؛ أو مقدار يسير يُضاف
entries.example: She made a dash for the train.

entries.definitionEn: To run or go somewhere very quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندفع مسرعاً
entries.example: He dashed across the road.

entries.definitionEn: Facts and figures collected for study, planning, or computer use.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيانات: وقائع وأرقام تُجمع للدراسة أو التخطيط أو الحوسبة
entries.example: The study is based on data from two hundred households.

entries.definitionEn: An organized set of information stored on a computer so that it can be searched and used.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة بيانات منظّمة على الحاسوب يمكن البحث فيها
entries.example: Customer names are stored in a database.

entries.definitionEn: A particular day of the month or year.
entries.arabicMeaning: تاريخ يوم معيّن
entries.example: What is the date today?

entries.definitionEn: To go out with someone you are interested in romantically. Also to write or show the date of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخرج مع شخص في علاقة غرامية؛ أو يؤرّخ شيئاً بكتابة تاريخه
entries.example: They started to date last spring.

entries.definitionEn: No longer modern in style; old-fashioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: عتيق الطراز لم يعد حديثاً
entries.example: The furniture looks a bit dated.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of going out with someone you may want as a partner.
entries.arabicMeaning: المواعدة
entries.example: She met him through online dating.

entries.definitionEn: Your son's wife.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنّة؛ زوجة الابن
entries.example: His daughter-in-law is a doctor.

entries.definitionEn: A person's female child.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابنة
entries.example: Their daughter is six years old.

entries.definitionEn: The time of day when light first appears in the sky, before sunrise.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفجر؛ أول ضوء يطلع في السماء قبل الشروق
entries.example: We left at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A period of twenty-four hours. Also the time when it is light.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوم ذو أربع وعشرين ساعة؛ أو وقت النهار
entries.example: I work five days a week.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant thoughts that take your mind away from what you are doing, while you are awake.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلم يقظة؛ خواطر سارّة تصرف الذهن عن العمل والمرء صاحٍ
entries.example: She drifted into a pleasant daydream.

entries.definitionEn: To have pleasant thoughts that take your attention away from the present.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلم يقظة فينصرف ذهنه عمّا حوله
entries.example: He tends to daydream in long meetings.

entries.definitionEn: The natural light of the day.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضوء النهار
entries.example: We need to finish the work in daylight.

entries.definitionEn: The hours of the day when it is light, as opposed to night.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعات النهار مقابل الليل
entries.example: The museum is open in the daytime.

entries.definitionEn: A confused state in which you cannot think clearly, often after a shock.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذهول يُفقد صفاء التفكير، وغالباً بعد صدمة
entries.example: He walked out of the exam in a daze.

entries.definitionEn: A very bright light that makes it hard to see. Also an impressive display that catches the eye.
entries.arabicMeaning: وهج شديد يعشي البصر؛ أو عرض باهر يلفت النظر
entries.example: She raised a hand against the dazzle of the headlights.

entries.definitionEn: Existing in fact, even if it is not officially recognized.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائم فعلاً وإن لم يُعترف به رسمياً
entries.example: He became the de facto leader of the team.

entries.definitionEn: No longer alive.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميّت
entries.example: The plant is dead.

entries.definitionEn: To make a feeling, pain, or sound less strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُخفّف حدّة شعور أو ألم أو صوت
entries.example: Thick curtains deaden the noise from the street.

entries.definitionEn: A time by which something must be finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: موعد نهائي يجب إنجاز العمل قبله
entries.example: The deadline for the report is Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to cause death.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاتل يُحتمل أن يسبب الموت
entries.example: Some snakes have a deadly bite.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to hear, or unable to hear well.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصمّ أو ضعيف السمع
entries.example: Her grandfather is deaf in one ear.

entries.definitionEn: An agreement, especially about buying, selling, or working together.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفقة أو اتفاق، ولا سيما في البيع أو التعاون
entries.example: They signed a deal with a new supplier.

entries.definitionEn: To take action to solve a problem or manage a situation. Also to do business, or to give out playing cards.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعالج مشكلة أو موقفاً؛ وقد يعني المتاجرة أو توزيع ورق اللعب
entries.example: I will deal with the problem this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that buys and sells a particular product.
entries.arabicMeaning: تاجر يبيع سلعة معيّنة ويشتريها
entries.example: She bought the car from a local dealer.

entries.definitionEn: Loved. Also used before a name at the start of a letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزيز محبوب؛ ويُستعمل قبل الاسم في صدر الرسالة
entries.example: Dear Maria, thank you for your letter.

entries.definitionEn: A kind way of speaking to someone you like, especially a child or someone close to you.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ ودّي في مناداة من تحب، ولا سيما طفل أو قريب
entries.example: Would you like some tea, dear?

entries.definitionEn: Very much. Also at a great cost.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيراً جداً؛ أو بثمن باهظ
entries.example: She loved her grandparents dearly.

entries.definitionEn: The end of a person's or animal's life.
entries.arabicMeaning: الموت
entries.example: His death was a shock to the family.

entries.definitionEn: A discussion in which people give different opinions, often in a formal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقاش أو مناظرة تُعرض فيها آراء مختلفة، وغالباً بصورة رسمية
entries.example: There was a debate about the new school.

entries.definitionEn: A plastic card used to pay for things by taking money straight from your bank account.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة خصم تُسحب بها الأموال مباشرة من الحساب
entries.example: I paid with my debit card.

entries.definitionEn: A sum of money taken out of a bank account. Also a record of that payment.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلغ يُخصم من الحساب؛ أو قيد بذلك الخصم
entries.example: There was a debit of forty pounds on the statement.

entries.definitionEn: To take money out of a bank account.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخصم مبلغاً من حساب مصرفي
entries.example: The bank will debit the fee from your account.

entries.definitionEn: Broken pieces of something that are left after it has been destroyed or damaged.
entries.arabicMeaning: حطام وبقايا متناثرة بعد تلف أو دمار
entries.example: Workers cleared debris from the road.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you owe to a person or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: دَين؛ مال واجب الأداء
entries.example: He is trying to pay off his debt.

entries.definitionEn: A person's first public appearance in a particular role, or the first showing of a work.
entries.arabicMeaning: الظهور الأول لشخص في دور معيّن، أو العرض الأول لعمل
entries.example: The film was her debut as a director.

entries.definitionEn: To appear or be shown in public for the first time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظهر أو يُعرض للجمهور أول مرة
entries.example: The new phone will debut next month.

entries.definitionEn: A period of ten years.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقد؛ فترة عشر سنوات
entries.example: She lived abroad for a decade.

entries.definitionEn: To become gradually worse or weaker by rotting or falling apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحلّل أو يتدهور تدريجاً بالتعفّن أو التفكك
entries.example: Fallen leaves decay on the forest floor.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that hides the truth in order to make someone believe something false.
entries.arabicMeaning: خداع يُخفي الحقيقة ليصدّق الناس باطلاً
entries.example: The contract was obtained by deceit.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone believe something that is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخدع شخصاً فيصدّق ما ليس صحيحاً
entries.example: The advertisement was designed to deceive buyers.

entries.definitionEn: The twelfth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديسمبر؛ كانون الأول
entries.example: Christmas is in December.

entries.definitionEn: Of an acceptable or fairly good standard. Also honest and morally acceptable.
entries.arabicMeaning: لائق بمستوى مقبول أو جيد إلى حد ما؛ وقد يعني نزيهاً مستقيم الخلق
entries.example: The room was small but decent.

entries.definitionEn: To move power, work, or services away from a single centre so that they are shared among several places or groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوزّع السلطة أو العمل أو الخدمات بعيداً عن مركز واحد على عدة مواضع أو جهات
entries.example: The company plans to decentralize its decision-making.

entries.definitionEn: Making you believe something that is not true, often because the appearance is misleading.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضلّل يوهم بخلاف الحقيقة بسبب المظهر
entries.example: The climb looks easy, but that is deceptive.

entries.definitionEn: To choose what you will do after thinking about it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقرّر بعد تفكير
entries.example: We need to decide where to go.

entries.definitionEn: A choice that you make after thinking about what to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرار يُتخذ بعد تفكير
entries.example: It was a difficult decision.

entries.definitionEn: Making the result of something certain. Also able to make choices quickly and firmly.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسم يحسم النتيجة؛ أو قادر على البتّ بسرعة وحزم
entries.example: Her vote was decisive in the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A floor on a ship. Also a set of playing cards.
entries.arabicMeaning: سطح سفينة؛ أو مجموعة ورق لعب
entries.example: Passengers stood on the deck and watched the harbour.

entries.definitionEn: An official statement of facts, plans, or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان رسمي بوقائع أو نيّات أو مواقف
entries.example: He signed a declaration of the goods in his bag.

entries.definitionEn: To say something officially or publicly. Also to tell customs what you are bringing into a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلن أمراً رسمياً أو علناً؛ أو يصرّح للجمارك بما يحمله
entries.example: You must declare large amounts of cash at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: In astronomy, a star's angular distance north or south of the celestial equator. Also a formal word for a polite refusal.
entries.arabicMeaning: في علم الفلك: الميل، أي البعد الزاوي لجرم سماوي شمال خط الاستواء السماوي أو جنوبه؛ وقد تعني رفضاً مهذّباً بأسلوب رسمي
entries.example: Astronomers recorded the star's declination.

entries.definitionEn: A fall in amount, quality, or strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: تراجع في المقدار أو الجودة أو القوة
entries.example: There has been a decline in sales.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller, weaker, or worse. Also to refuse something politely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتراجع حجماً أو قوة أو جودة؛ أو يرفض بأدب
entries.example: She declined the invitation politely.

entries.definitionEn: The process of rotting or breaking down into simpler parts, especially of dead plants or animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحلّل المواد العضوية إلى أجزاء أبسط، ولا سيما بعد الموت
entries.example: Heat speeds up the decomposition of food waste.

entries.definitionEn: To make something look more attractive by adding colour, objects, or patterns.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيّن شيئاً بإضافة لون أو قطع أو نقوش
entries.example: They decorate the house before the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: Something added to make a place or object look more attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: زينة تُضاف لتحسين المظهر
entries.example: The only decoration was a bowl of fruit.

entries.definitionEn: Made or used to look attractive rather than to be useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: زخرفي يُقصد به الجمال لا المنفعة
entries.example: The tiles are decorative rather than useful.

entries.definitionEn: A fall in size, amount, or strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: انخفاض في الحجم أو المقدار أو القوة
entries.example: There was a decrease in temperature overnight.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller or less, or to make something smaller or less.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقص أو يُنقص حجماً أو مقداراً
entries.example: Prices should decrease next year.

entries.definitionEn: To give your time, effort, or something you make to a particular purpose or person.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكرّس وقته أو جهده أو نتاجه لغرض أو لشخص
entries.example: She decided to dedicate more time to study.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of giving a lot of time and effort to something you believe is important.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفانٍ في بذل الوقت والجهد لأمر يُعدّ مهماً
entries.example: The project succeeded through her dedication.

entries.definitionEn: To reach a conclusion by thinking carefully about known facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنتج نتيجة بالتفكير في وقائع معلومة
entries.example: From the wet streets, I deduced that it had rained.

entries.definitionEn: A conclusion reached by thinking about known facts. Also an amount taken away, especially from pay.
entries.arabicMeaning: استنتاج يُتوصّل إليه بالتفكير في الوقائع؛ أو مبلغ يُقتطع ولا سيما من الأجر
entries.example: His deduction about the missing key was correct.

entries.definitionEn: Something that someone does, especially something notable. Also a legal document about property.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل، ولا سيما ذو شأن؛ أو سند قانوني يتصل بملك
entries.example: Helping the stranded driver was a kind deed.

entries.definitionEn: To consider something to be a particular thing, often in an official or formal judgment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يَعُدّ الشيء كذلك، وغالباً في حكم رسمي
entries.example: The committee did not deem the plan necessary.

entries.definitionEn: Going a long way down from the top or surface. Also strong or serious, as of a feeling or thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: عميق يمتد بعيداً عن السطح؛ أو بالغ العمق في شعور أو فكر
entries.example: The lake is very deep in the middle.

entries.definitionEn: A long way down or in.
entries.arabicMeaning: عميقاً إلى مسافة بعيدة نحو الأسفل أو الداخل
entries.example: The nail went deep into the wood.

entries.definitionEn: Very much. Also a long way down.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعمق؛ كثيراً جداً، أو إلى مسافة بعيدة نحو الأسفل
entries.example: He slept deeply after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: A wild animal with long legs that eats plants. The male often has antlers.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيل؛ حيوان بري طويل القوائم يقتات النبات، وللذكر غالباً قرون متفرّعة
entries.example: A deer ran across the road.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of losing against an opponent, or the act of beating someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: هزيمة؛ الخسارة أمام خصم أو إيقاعه في الخسارة
entries.example: The team was quiet after its defeat.

entries.definitionEn: To win against someone in a fight, game, or contest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهزم خصماً في قتال أو مباراة أو سباق
entries.example: They hope to defeat the champions.

entries.definitionEn: To protect someone or something from attack. Also to speak in support of a person or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدافع عن شخص أو شيء ضد هجوم؛ أو يؤيد بالكلام شخصاً أو فكرة
entries.example: She had to defend her idea in the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A person who protects someone or something from attack. In sport, a player whose main job is to stop the other team scoring.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدافع يحمي من الهجوم؛ وفي الرياضة لاعب مهمته صدّ الفريق الآخر
entries.example: The defender stopped the attack near the goal.

entries.definitionEn: The act of protecting against attack. Also the players or arguments used for that purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفاع عن النفس أو الموقع؛ أو اللاعبون أو الحجج المعدّة لذلك
entries.example: The city's defence was well organized.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of something that is needed, especially a substance the body needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقص في شيء لازم، ولا سيما مادة يحتاجها الجسم
entries.example: A vitamin deficiency can cause tiredness.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking something that is needed for a good or complete result.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناقص يفتقر إلى ما يلزم لجودة النتيجة أو تمامها
entries.example: The soil is deficient in nitrogen.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that lacks something needed; inadequately.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ناقص لا يفي بما يلزم
entries.example: The system performed deficiently under heavy use.

entries.definitionEn: To explain the meaning of a word. Also to show or describe something clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرّف معنى كلمة؛ أو يحدّد شيئاً ويصفه بوضوح
entries.example: Can you define this word?

entries.definitionEn: Clear and certain; not likely to change.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤكد واضح لا يُرجَّح تغيّره
entries.example: We need a definite answer by Monday.

entries.definitionEn: The word the in English, used before a noun when both speaker and listener know which thing is meant.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة التعريف في الإنكليزية، تسبق اسماً حين يكون المقصود معلوماً للمتكلم والمخاطب
entries.example: In English, the word 'the' is the definite article.

entries.definitionEn: Without any doubt; certainly.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعاً بلا شك
entries.example: I will definitely come.

entries.definitionEn: A statement of what a word or idea means. Also the clearness of the shape or edges of an image.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعريف يوضح معنى كلمة أو فكرة؛ وقد تعني حدّة معالم الصورة
entries.example: Look up the definition in the dictionary.

entries.definitionEn: The cutting down or clearing of trees over a large area.
entries.arabicMeaning: إزالة الغابات بقطع الأشجار على نطاق واسع
entries.example: Deforestation has reduced rainfall in the region.

entries.definitionEn: To refuse to obey a person, rule, or order. Also to be so strong that something seems impossible.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعصي شخصاً أو قاعدة أو أمراً؛ أو يبلغ من القوة ما يجعل أمراً يبدو مستحيلاً
entries.example: The protesters decided to defy the ban.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming worse in quality or condition. Also treatment that makes someone feel worthless.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدهور في الجودة أو الحال؛ أو معاملة تُهين الإنسان وتُشعره بالهوان
entries.example: Pollution has caused the degradation of the river.

entries.definitionEn: To treat someone as if they have little worth. Also to make something worse in quality, or to break down chemically.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُهين شخصاً كأن لا قدر له؛ أو يُفسد جودة شيء، أو يتحلّل كيميائياً
entries.example: Poor storage will degrade the quality of the paper.

entries.definitionEn: Causing someone to feel worthless or ashamed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُهين يُشعر المرء بالهوان أو الخزي
entries.example: The comments were degrading and unfair.

entries.definitionEn: A unit for measuring temperature or angles. Also a qualification from a university.
entries.arabicMeaning: درجة لقياس الحرارة أو الزوايا؛ أو شهادة جامعية
entries.example: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

entries.definitionEn: To treat people as if they were not human, or to take away qualities that make them human.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرّد الناس من صفتهم الإنسانية أو يعاملهم كأنهم ليسوا بشراً
entries.example: The film shows how war can dehumanize people.

entries.definitionEn: A time when you have to wait because something happens later than planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأخير يضطرك إلى الانتظار
entries.example: There was a delay at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: To make something happen later than planned, or to be late.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤخّر وقوع أمر عن موعده، أو يتأخر
entries.example: Rain may delay the match.

entries.definitionEn: A person chosen to speak or act for a group at a meeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: مندوب يُختار لتمثيل جماعة في اجتماع
entries.example: Each country sent a delegate to the conference.

entries.definitionEn: To remove something written or stored, especially on a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحذف نصاً أو ملفاً، ولا سيما من الحاسوب
entries.example: Please delete the old file.

entries.definitionEn: Done on purpose, not by accident. Also slow and careful.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعمّد غير عارض؛ وقد يعني متأنياً حذراً
entries.example: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead us.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something carefully, often by discussing it before a decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدبّر أمراً ملياً، وغالباً بالنقاش قبل البتّ فيه
entries.example: The jury will deliberate tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: On purpose; not by accident.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمداً لا مصادفة
entries.example: She deliberately left the door open.

entries.definitionEn: A rare or expensive food that is considered especially good. Also the quality of being easily damaged, or of needing careful handling.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام نادر أو فاخر يُعدّ شهياً؛ أو رهافة تقتضي حذراً لأن الشيء سريع التلف
entries.example: The restaurant is known for a local delicacy.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to damage or needing careful handling. Also fine and pleasant, or needing tact.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقيق سريع التلف يحتاج حذراً؛ أو دقيق لذيذ، أو يستدعي لطفاً في التعامل
entries.example: The glass is very delicate.

entries.definitionEn: In a careful, light way, so as not to cause damage or offence.
entries.arabicMeaning: برقة وحذر حتى لا يقع تلف أو إساءة
entries.example: She lifted the vase delicately.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that sells high-quality cooked meats, cheeses, and other prepared foods.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجر أطعمة شهية يبيع لحوماً مطبوخة وأجباناً وأطعمة جاهزة رفيعة
entries.example: He bought olives at the delicatessen.

entries.definitionEn: Very pleasant to taste or smell.
entries.arabicMeaning: لذيذ الطعم أو الرائحة
entries.example: This soup is delicious.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of great pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهجة؛ سرور شديد
entries.example: The children shouted with delight.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone great pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُبهج شخصاً سروراً شديداً
entries.example: The show will delight young audiences.

entries.definitionEn: Very pleased.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرور جداً
entries.example: I am delighted to hear your news.

entries.definitionEn: Very pleasant and enjoyable.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتع جداً يبعث السرور
entries.example: We had a delightful evening.

entries.definitionEn: To take goods, letters, or a message to a person or place. Also to give a speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلّم بضاعة أو بريداً إلى شخص أو مكان؛ وقد يعني إلقاء خطاب
entries.example: The postman will deliver the parcel tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking goods or letters to a person or place. Also the way someone speaks in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسليم بضاعة أو رسائل؛ وقد تعني أسلوب الإلقاء أمام الجمهور
entries.example: The delivery arrived in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A firm request for something. Also the desire of people to buy or use something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطالبة جازمة؛ أو طلب الناس على سلعة أو خدمة
entries.example: There is a high demand for nurses.

entries.definitionEn: To ask for something firmly, as if you have a right to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطالب بشيء بحزم كأنّه حق له
entries.example: The workers demanded better pay.

entries.definitionEn: Needing a lot of skill, effort, or attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاقّ يتطلّب مهارة أو جهداً أو انتباهاً كثيراً
entries.example: It is a demanding job.

entries.definitionEn: The end of something that used to exist, such as a business or a way of life. Also a formal word for death.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوال أمر كان قائماً كمؤسسة أو أسلوب حياة؛ وقد تعني الموت بأسلوب رسمي
entries.example: The demise of the old factory changed the town.

entries.definitionEn: A short demonstration of how a product or program works. Also a recording made to show a musician's work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض تجريبي موجز لمنتج أو برنامج؛ أو تسجيل يعرّف بعمل موسيقي
entries.example: The sales team gave a demo of the new software.

entries.definitionEn: A system of government in which people vote to choose their leaders. Also a country with this system.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديمقراطية: نظام حكم يختار فيه الناس قادتهم بالانتخاب؛ أو بلد يقوم على هذا النظام
entries.example: The country is a democracy.

entries.definitionEn: Based on the idea that everyone can vote and has a say. Relating to democracy.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديمقراطي؛ قائم على حق الجميع في التصويت وإبداء الرأي
entries.example: They held a democratic vote.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the structure of a population, such as age, income, or education.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديموغرافي؛ متصل بتركيب السكان من حيث العمر أو الدخل أو التعليم
entries.example: The survey collected demographic information about age and income.

entries.definitionEn: A particular group of people in a population, often defined by age, income, or similar traits.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريحة سكانية تُحدَّد غالباً بالعمر أو الدخل أو صفات مشابهة
entries.example: The new service is aimed at a younger demographic.

entries.definitionEn: In terms of the size, structure, or groups of a population.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية السكانية؛ بحسب تركيب السكان أو شرائحهم
entries.example: The city has changed demographically over the last twenty years.

entries.definitionEn: The statistical study of human populations, including their size, age, and change.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم السكان؛ الدراسة الإحصائية لحجم المجتمعات وتغيّرها
entries.example: Demography helps planners estimate how many schools a city will need.

entries.definitionEn: To pull down a building or destroy something completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهدم بناءً أو يدمّر شيئاً بالكامل
entries.example: They will demolish the old warehouse next month.

entries.definitionEn: The act of pulling down a building or other structure.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدم مبنى أو منشأة
entries.example: The demolition of the factory began at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: To show how something works, or to show that something is true. Also to take part in a public protest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبيّن طريقة عمل شيء أو يثبت صحته؛ وقد يعني المشاركة في تظاهرة
entries.example: She will demonstrate how to use the new software.

entries.definitionEn: An act of showing how something works. Also a public gathering to protest or support something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض عملي لكيفية عمل شيء؛ أو تظاهرة عامة
entries.example: The chef gave a short demonstration of the recipe.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making a difficult or mysterious subject clearer and easier to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: إزالة الغموض عن موضوع صعب وجعله أوضح فهماً
entries.example: The lecture was a demystification of modern painting techniques.

entries.definitionEn: To make a difficult or mysterious subject easier to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيل الغموض عن موضوع صعب ويجعله مفهوماً
entries.example: The guide demystifies the tax rules for small businesses.

entries.definitionEn: A strong cotton cloth, usually blue, used especially for jeans and jackets.
entries.arabicMeaning: دنيم؛ قماش قطني متين يُصنع منه الجينز والسترات غالباً
entries.example: She wore a denim jacket over a white shirt.

entries.definitionEn: The literal meaning of a word, as opposed to the feelings or ideas it may suggest.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدلالة الحرفية للكلمة في مقابل ما توحي به من مشاعر أو أفكار
entries.example: The denotation of home is simply a place where someone lives.

entries.definitionEn: To be a sign of something, or to mean something in a precise way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدلّ على شيء أو يعنيه بدقة
entries.example: A red light denotes danger at this crossing.

entries.definitionEn: To say publicly that someone or something is wrong or harmful.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدين علناً شخصاً أو أمراً بوصفه خطأ أو ضاراً
entries.example: The coach denounced the unfair remarks after the match.

entries.definitionEn: Packed closely together, or thick and hard to see through. Also difficult to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيف متراصّ أو صعب الرؤية من خلاله؛ وقد يعني صعب الفهم
entries.example: A dense fog covered the harbour.

entries.definitionEn: In a crowded or tightly packed way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بكثافة؛ بصورة متراصّة
entries.example: The neighbourhood is densely populated.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to teeth or to the care of teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: سِنّي؛ متعلق بالأسنان أو بعلاجها
entries.example: He has a dental appointment on Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to care for people's teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب أسنان
entries.example: The dentist checked her teeth and cleaned them.

entries.definitionEn: A public statement that strongly criticizes someone or something as wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدانة علنية شديدة لشخص أو أمر
entries.example: His denunciation of the fraud was reported in the papers.

entries.definitionEn: To say that something is not true. Also to refuse to give someone something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينكر صحة شيء؛ أو يرفض إعطاء شخص شيئاً
entries.example: She denied breaking the window.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a place, especially to start a journey.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغادر مكاناً ولا سيما ليبدأ رحلة
entries.example: The train will depart at six.

entries.definitionEn: A section of a large organization, shop, or government that deals with one area of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: قسم في مؤسسة أو متجر أو جهة حكومية يتولى مجالاً معيّناً
entries.example: She works in the sales department.

entries.definitionEn: A large shop that sells many different kinds of goods in separate sections.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجر شامل تُباع فيه سلع متنوعة في أقسام منفصلة
entries.example: We bought a suitcase at the department store.

entries.definitionEn: The act of leaving a place. Also a change from the usual way of doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغادرة مكان؛ وقد تعني خروجاً عن الطريقة المعتادة
entries.example: Our departure was delayed by fog.

entries.definitionEn: To need someone or something in order to live, happen, or succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتمد على شخص أو شيء ليعيش أو ينجح أو يحدث أمر
entries.example: Young children depend on their parents for food and care.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be trusted to do what is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: موثوق يُعتمد عليه في أداء المطلوب
entries.example: She is a dependable colleague who always meets deadlines.

entries.definitionEn: Needing someone or something for support or in order to exist.
entries.arabicMeaning: معتمد على غيره في الدعم أو البقاء
entries.example: The young plants are dependent on regular watering.

entries.definitionEn: A person who relies on someone else for money, food, or care.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُعال؛ شخص يعتمد مادياً أو رعائياً على غيره
entries.example: He listed two dependents on the tax form.

entries.definitionEn: To show or describe someone or something in a picture, story, or other work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوّر أو يصف شخصاً أو شيئاً في صورة أو نص أو عمل فني
entries.example: The painting depicts a quiet harbour at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: A picture or description of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصوير أو وصف لشخص أو شيء
entries.example: The film's depiction of city life felt honest.

entries.definitionEn: A sum of money paid as a first payment or as security. Also money put into a bank account.
entries.arabicMeaning: عربون أو مبلغ ضمان؛ أو وديعة تُوضع في حساب مصرفي
entries.example: We paid a deposit to reserve the flat.

entries.definitionEn: To put money into a bank account. Also to put something down in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يودِع مالاً في حساب مصرفي؛ أو يضع شيئاً في موضع معيّن
entries.example: Please deposit the cheque before Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Morally corrupt; enjoying things that most people regard as wrong or cruel.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاسد الأخلاق؛ مولع بما يعدّه أكثر الناس خطأ أو قسوة
entries.example: The novel portrays a depraved villain with no pity.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being morally corrupt.
entries.arabicMeaning: انحطاط أخلاقي؛ فساد في الخلق
entries.example: The court heard evidence of his depravity.

entries.definitionEn: To express mild or formal disapproval of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنكر أمراً باعتدال أو بتحفّظ رسمي
entries.example: She deprecated the wasteful use of paper in the office.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that belittles something, often including yourself or your own work.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يقلّل من قيمة الشيء، وكثيراً ما يشمل المتكلم أو عمله
entries.example: He smiled deprecatingly at his own suggestion.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling very sad and without hope, often for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتئب؛ حزين جداً وبلا أمل وغالباً لفترة طويلة
entries.example: He felt depressed after losing his job.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel sad and without hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُحزن يبعث على الكآبة وفقدان الأمل
entries.example: The empty streets on a wet Sunday looked depressing.

entries.definitionEn: A medical condition of deep, lasting sadness. Also a period when trade and jobs decline.
entries.arabicMeaning: اكتئاب طبي يدوم حزناً عميقاً؛ وقد تعني أيضاً كساداً اقتصادياً
entries.example: She is receiving treatment for depression.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to or causing depression.
entries.arabicMeaning: اكتئابي؛ متعلق بالاكتئاب أو مسبب له
entries.example: He has a depressive illness that comes and goes.

entries.definitionEn: To take something away from someone, or to stop them from having it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرم شخصاً من شيء أو يمنعه عنه
entries.example: The storm deprived the village of electricity for two days.

entries.definitionEn: How deep something is. Also the quality of being serious and thorough.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمق الشيء؛ أو رصانة وجدّية في المعالجة
entries.example: The pool has a depth of two metres.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is second in rank and can act for the leader.
entries.arabicMeaning: نائب يتولى العمل مكان المسؤول الأعلى
entries.example: The deputy manager ran the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: In very poor condition because of neglect; left unused and falling apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: متروك متهالك من الإهمال وغير مستعمل
entries.example: They converted a derelict warehouse into studios.

entries.definitionEn: A person with no home or means, living in a very poor condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريد بلا مأوى يعيش في حال بائسة
entries.example: The novel follows a derelict living under a bridge.

entries.definitionEn: The act of laughing at someone or something in a scornful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخرية لاذعة؛ استهزاء بشخص أو شيء
entries.example: His idea was met with derision.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you think someone or something is ridiculous and worth mocking.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساخر مستهزئ يرى الأمر مثيراً للسخرية
entries.example: She gave a derisive laugh at the excuse.

entries.definitionEn: In a scornful, mocking way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسخرية لاذعة
entries.example: He snorted derisively at the suggestion.

entries.definitionEn: To get something from a source. Also to come from something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستمدّ شيئاً من مصدر؛ أو ينشأ عن شيء
entries.example: She derives great pleasure from gardening.

entries.definitionEn: To go down. Also to come from an ancestor.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزل إلى أسفل؛ وقد يعني ينحدر من نسب
entries.example: We descended the hill before sunset.

entries.definitionEn: A movement down. Also a person's family origin.
entries.arabicMeaning: هبوط إلى الأسفل؛ أو أصل أسري ونسب
entries.example: The path makes a steep descent to the beach.

entries.definitionEn: To say what someone or something is like.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصف شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: Can you describe your bag?

entries.definitionEn: A spoken or written account of what someone or something is like.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصف منطوق أو مكتوب لهيئة شخص أو شيء
entries.example: Write a short description of your town.

entries.definitionEn: Giving details about what something looks, sounds, or feels like.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصفي؛ يقدّم تفاصيل عن هيئة الشيء أو وقعه
entries.example: The article is highly descriptive of the coastline.

entries.definitionEn: A large, dry area of land with little rain and few plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحراء واسعة قليلة المطر والنبات
entries.example: Camels crossed the desert at night.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a person, place, or duty when you should stay.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهجر شخصاً أو مكاناً أو واجباً كان ينبغي البقاء فيه
entries.example: He deserted his post during the night.

entries.definitionEn: The act of leaving a duty, person, or place when you should stay.
entries.arabicMeaning: هجر الواجب أو الشخص أو المكان في وقت كان ينبغي البقاء
entries.example: The soldier was charged with desertion.

entries.definitionEn: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحقّ شيئاً بسبب أفعاله أو صفاته
entries.example: You deserve a rest after that long walk.

entries.definitionEn: A drawing or plan for how something will look or be made. Also the way something is planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصميم؛ رسم أو خطة لشكل الشيء أو صنعه
entries.example: I like the design of this chair.

entries.definitionEn: To plan how something will look or work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصمّم شكل شيء أو طريقة عمله
entries.example: She designs furniture for small apartments.

entries.definitionEn: Made by a famous designer and often expensive.
entries.arabicMeaning: من إنتاج مصمم شهير وغالباً باهظ الثمن
entries.example: He bought a designer watch for the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to plan how things will look or work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصمم يتولى تخطيط شكل الأشياء أو طريقة عملها
entries.example: She works as a fashion designer.

entries.definitionEn: Wanted or worth having; attractive as a choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرغوب فيه وجدير بأن يُقتنى
entries.example: A quiet room is desirable if you need to study.

entries.definitionEn: A strong wish for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رغبة قوية في شيء
entries.example: He had a desire to live by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: To want something strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرغب في شيء رغبة قوية
entries.example: They desired a simpler life in the countryside.

entries.definitionEn: A table that you sit at to write or work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب؛ طاولة للكتابة أو العمل
entries.example: Her books are on the desk.

entries.definitionEn: The main screen of a computer, or a computer made to stay on a desk.
entries.arabicMeaning: سطح المكتب في الحاسوب؛ أو حاسوب مكتبي ثابت
entries.example: Save the file to your desktop.

entries.definitionEn: A state of empty ruin, or a feeling of great loneliness and sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: خراب قفر؛ أو وحشة وحزن شديد
entries.example: After the fire, desolation filled the valley.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling that there is no hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأس؛ شعور بانعدام الأمل
entries.example: He fought against despair and kept looking for work.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to try anything because a situation is very bad. Also needing something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يائس مستعد لأي محاولة لسوء الحال؛ أو شديد الحاجة إلى شيء
entries.example: They made a desperate search for the missing keys.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows great need or a very bad situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيأس أو لحاجة شديدة
entries.example: She searched desperately for her passport.

entries.definitionEn: The state of needing something so badly that you may act without care.
entries.arabicMeaning: حال اليأس التي قد تدفع إلى التهور
entries.example: In desperation, he sold the last of his tools.

entries.definitionEn: To dislike someone or something very much and have no respect for them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزدري؛ يكره كرهاً شديداً مع انعدام الاحترام
entries.example: She despises cruelty to animals.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something happens even though there is a fact that might prevent it.
entries.arabicMeaning: على الرغم من؛ حرف جر يفيد حدوث شيء رغم وجود ما قد يمنعه
entries.example: We enjoyed the walk despite the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلوى تُقدَّم في نهاية الوجبة
entries.example: Ice cream is my favourite dessert.

entries.definitionEn: The place that someone or something is going to.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجهة الوصول
entries.example: Paris was our final destination.

entries.definitionEn: The things that will happen to someone in the future, thought of as already decided.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدر؛ ما يُظن أنه مكتوب للمرء في المستقبل
entries.example: She felt that teaching was her destiny.

entries.definitionEn: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used or no longer exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدمّر شيئاً حتى يتعذّر استعماله أو يزول
entries.example: The storm destroyed several roofs.

entries.definitionEn: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.
entries.arabicMeaning: دمار؛ فعل التدمير أو حال ما دُمّر
entries.example: The flood caused widespread destruction.

entries.definitionEn: Causing severe damage.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمّر يُلحق ضرراً بالغاً
entries.example: The fire was highly destructive.

entries.definitionEn: To separate something from a larger thing. Also to become emotionally distant.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصل شيئاً عن غيره؛ وقد يعني الابتعاد عاطفياً
entries.example: Please detach the form and keep the copy.

entries.definitionEn: The state of not being emotionally involved. Also a small group of soldiers, or the act of separating.
entries.arabicMeaning: برود عاطفي وعدم انخراط شعوري؛ وقد تعني مفرزة عسكرية أو فعل الفصل
entries.example: He listened with calm detachment.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece of information or a small part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفصيل؛ جزء صغير من معلومة أو شيء
entries.example: Please tell me every detail of the plan.

entries.definitionEn: Including many small facts or parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفصّل كثير الجزئيات
entries.example: She gave a detailed account of the journey.

entries.definitionEn: To notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتشف أو يلحظ شيئاً ولا سيما إن خفي
entries.example: The test can detect the virus early.

entries.definitionEn: A person, often a police officer, whose job is to find out who committed a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: محقّق؛ من عمله كشف مرتكب الجريمة
entries.example: The detective asked a few quiet questions.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of continuing to try, even when something is difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزيمة؛ إصرار على الاستمرار رغم الصعوبة
entries.example: Her determination helped her finish the course.

entries.definitionEn: To decide something, or to find out the facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقرّر أمراً أو يتبيّن الحقائق
entries.example: Tests will determine the cause of the leak.

entries.definitionEn: Having a firm decision to do something and not giving up.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصمّم لا يتراجع عن قراره
entries.example: He was determined to learn the language.

entries.definitionEn: A word such as a, the, this, or some that comes before a noun and shows which thing you mean.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدد؛ كلمة تسبق الاسم لتبيّن المقصود منه مثل a وthe
entries.example: In this book, the word this is a determiner.

entries.definitionEn: Something that discourages people from doing something, often through fear of the result.
entries.arabicMeaning: رادع يثني الناس عن فعل خوفاً من العاقبة
entries.example: High fines are a deterrent to illegal parking.

entries.definitionEn: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمقت؛ يكره كرهاً شديداً
entries.example: I detest the smell of burnt toast.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving strong dislike; very unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقيت جدير بالكراهية الشديدة
entries.example: He found the cruelty detestable.

entries.definitionEn: To make something seem less good or less valuable.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقص من جودة الشيء أو قيمته
entries.example: A few errors do not detract from the book's value.

entries.definitionEn: Harm or damage to someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضرر أو أذى يلحق بشخص أو شيء
entries.example: He worked long hours to the detriment of his health.

entries.definitionEn: Causing harm or damage.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضارّ يُلحق أذى
entries.example: Too little sleep is detrimental to concentration.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ضار
entries.example: The chemical affected the soil detrimentally.

entries.definitionEn: Waste or leftover fragments, often after something has been destroyed or used.
entries.arabicMeaning: حطام وبقايا متخلفة بعد استعمال أو تدمير
entries.example: Waves left detritus along the shore.

entries.definitionEn: To destroy a place, or to badly damage someone's life or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدمّر مكاناً أو يصيب حياة أحد أو مشاعره بضرر بالغ
entries.example: The earthquake devastated several towns.

entries.definitionEn: Causing great damage, or causing deep shock and sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمّر أو صادم يخلّف حزناً عميقاً
entries.example: The news was devastating for the family.

entries.definitionEn: To grow or change into a more advanced form. Also to create something over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتطور أو ينمو؛ أو يُنشئ شيئاً تدريجياً
entries.example: Children develop new skills at school.

entries.definitionEn: Having modern industry and services. Also fully grown or fully formed.
entries.arabicMeaning: متقدم في الصناعة والخدمات؛ أو مكتمل النمو
entries.example: A developed country usually has good roads and hospitals.

entries.definitionEn: Growing or becoming more advanced. Of a country: still building its economy and services.
entries.arabicMeaning: نامٍ وفي طور التقدّم؛ ولبلد ما زال يبني اقتصاده وخدماته
entries.example: She works as a nurse in a developing country.

entries.definitionEn: The process of growing or creating something. Also a new event or a new set of buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: تطوير أو نمو؛ وقد تعني حدثاً جديداً أو مشروعاً عمرانياً
entries.example: The development of the app took two years.

entries.definitionEn: Differing from what is considered usual or acceptable, especially in behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحرف عن المعتاد أو المقبول، ولا سيما في السلوك
entries.example: The study examined deviant behaviour among teenagers.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose behaviour differs greatly from what a group regards as normal.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص سلوكه بعيد جداً عما تعدّه الجماعة طبيعياً
entries.example: The film's narrator is treated as a deviant by the town.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that differs from accepted behaviour or norms.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو منحرف عن المعايير المقبولة
entries.example: He acted deviantly by ignoring every house rule.

entries.definitionEn: A machine or tool made for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز أو أداة لغرض معيّن
entries.example: This device measures the room's temperature.

entries.definitionEn: An evil spirit in some religions. Also a very wicked person, or used in set phrases for emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيطان؛ روح شريرة في بعض الأديان، وقد يُطلق على شخص بالغ السوء
entries.example: In the story, the devil offers a dangerous bargain.

entries.definitionEn: To give a lot of time, effort, or attention to someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكرّس وقتاً أو جهداً أو اهتماماً لشخص أو أمر
entries.example: She devoted her evenings to studying.

entries.definitionEn: Giving a lot of love, time, or attention to someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخلص كثير المحبة والعناية
entries.example: He is a devoted father.

entries.definitionEn: A person who admires someone or something very much and supports it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاشق لشيء أو شخص يدعمه بإعجاب شديد
entries.example: She is a devotee of classical music.

entries.definitionEn: Strong love, loyalty, or commitment.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفانٍ؛ حب وولاء والتزام قوي
entries.example: Her devotion to her students was clear.

entries.definitionEn: A simple drawing that shows how something works or how parts relate.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم توضيحي يبيّن عمل شيء أو علاقة أجزائه
entries.example: The diagram explains the water cycle.

entries.definitionEn: The face of a clock or a round control that you turn. Also the numbered part of an old telephone.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرص ساعة أو مفتاح دائري؛ أو لوحة أرقام الهاتف القديم
entries.example: Turn the dial to the right to increase the heat.

entries.definitionEn: To enter a telephone number in order to call someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلب رقماً هاتفياً للاتصال بشخص
entries.example: Please dial this number if you need help.

entries.definitionEn: A conversation between people, especially in a book, play, or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوار بين أشخاص ولا سيما في كتاب أو مسرحية أو فيلم
entries.example: The dialogue in the play sounds natural.

entries.definitionEn: A straight line through the centre of a circle, from one side to the other; also its length.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطر الدائرة؛ الخط المار بالمركز من جانب إلى آخر، أو طوله
entries.example: The bowl has a diameter of twenty centimetres.

entries.definitionEn: A very hard, clear precious stone. Also a shape with four equal sides, like a kite.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماسة؛ حجر كريم شديد الصلابة، أو شكل معيّني كالطائرة الورقية
entries.example: She wore a small diamond ring.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth or paper worn by a baby to catch waste; mainly US, British nappy.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفاض للرضيع في الاستعمال الأمريكي
entries.example: She changed the baby's diaper before the trip.

entries.definitionEn: An illness in which waste from the body is watery and frequent.
entries.arabicMeaning: إسهال
entries.example: He stayed home because of diarrhoea.

entries.definitionEn: A book in which you write what happens each day, or a book of dates for appointments.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذكرة يومية أو دفتر مواعيد
entries.example: She writes in her diary every night.

entries.definitionEn: A ruler who has total power, usually without being elected, and often rules by force.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاكم مطلق السلطة، غالباً بغير انتخاب ويحكم بالقوة
