entries.example: The country lived under a dictator for many years.

entries.definitionEn: A book or app that lists words and explains what they mean.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاموس يشرح معاني الكلمات
entries.example: Look up the word in a dictionary.

entries.definitionEn: The past form of do, used to make questions and negatives in the past, and for emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الماضي من do لتكوين السؤال والنفي في الماضي وللتوكيد
entries.example: Did you lock the door?

entries.definitionEn: To stop living.
entries.arabicMeaning: يموت؛ يتوقف عن الحياة
entries.example: The plant will die without water.

entries.definitionEn: The food that a person or animal usually eats. Also a plan to eat in a particular way, often to lose weight.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظام غذائي؛ ما يُؤكل عادة أو خطة للأكل وغالباً لتخفيف الوزن
entries.example: A healthy diet includes fruit and vegetables.

entries.definitionEn: To be unlike. Also to disagree.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختلف؛ يكون مغايراً أو يخالف في الرأي
entries.example: Our opinions differ on the best route.

entries.definitionEn: The way in which two things are not the same. Also the amount by which they are not the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرق؛ وجه المغايرة بين شيئين أو مقداره
entries.example: There is a big difference between the two plans.

entries.definitionEn: Not the same as someone or something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختلف؛ ليس مماثلاً لغيره
entries.example: This bag is different from mine.

entries.definitionEn: In another way; not in the same way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل مختلف
entries.example: She explained it differently the second time.

entries.definitionEn: Not easy; needing a lot of effort or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعب يحتاج جهداً أو مهارة
entries.example: This puzzle is difficult.

entries.definitionEn: A problem, or the state of being hard to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعوبة؛ مشكلة أو حال العسر
entries.example: He had difficulty opening the jar.

entries.definitionEn: Spread over a wide area and not concentrated. Also not clear or precise.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتشر غير مركّز على نطاق واسع؛ أو غير واضح دقيق
entries.example: The room was lit by a diffuse glow.

entries.definitionEn: To spread through a space or among people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتشر في حيّز أو بين الناس
entries.example: The scent of coffee diffused through the house.

entries.definitionEn: An act of making a hole in the ground by moving earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل الحفر في الأرض
entries.example: The children had a dig in the sand.

entries.definitionEn: To make a hole in the ground by moving earth. Also to search for information.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفر حفرة في الأرض؛ وقد يعني ينقّب عن معلومات
entries.example: They dug a hole for the tree.

entries.definitionEn: A short collection of summarized information, often as a magazine or report.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجز يجمع خلاصات معلومات، كثيراً ما يكون في مجلة أو تقرير
entries.example: She reads a weekly news digest on the train.

entries.definitionEn: Using computers or recording information as numbers. Also showing time in numbers rather than with hands.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقمي؛ يستخدم الحاسوب أو يعرض الوقت بأرقام لا بعقارب
entries.example: I prefer a digital watch.

entries.definitionEn: A camera that stores pictures as computer files, not on film.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاميرا رقمية تخزّن الصور كملفات لا على فيلم
entries.example: He took photos with a digital camera.

entries.definitionEn: The process of changing information or services into a computer-based form.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقمنة؛ تحويل المعلومات أو الخدمات إلى صيغة حاسوبية
entries.example: The digitalisation of old records took months.

entries.definitionEn: To convert information or processes into a digital, computer-based form.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرقمن؛ يحوّل معلومات أو إجراءات إلى صيغة رقمية
entries.example: The library will digitalise its archives next year.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something seem worthy of respect, sometimes more than they deserve.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنح وقاراً أو اعتباراً، وأحياناً فوق ما يستحق
entries.example: I will not dignify that rude remark with an answer.

entries.definitionEn: A calm, serious quality that earns respect. Also the right to be treated with honour.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرامة؛ رصانة تستحق الاحترام، أو حق المعاملة باحترام
entries.example: She spoke with quiet dignity.

entries.definitionEn: A situation in which you must choose between two difficult options.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأزق يفرض الاختيار بين أمرين صعبين
entries.example: He faced a dilemma: stay in the job or move abroad.

entries.definitionEn: In a careful, hard-working way.
entries.arabicMeaning: باجتهاد وعناية
entries.example: She worked diligently on the translation.

entries.definitionEn: Not bright; weakly lit. Also not clear, of a memory or a chance.
entries.arabicMeaning: خافت الإضاءة؛ أو غير واضح في الذاكرة أو الاحتمال
entries.example: The hallway was too dim to read in.

entries.definitionEn: A United States coin worth ten cents.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملة أمريكية قيمتها عشرة سنتات
entries.example: The parking meter still takes a dime.

entries.definitionEn: A measurement of length, width, or height. Also an aspect of a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: بُعد قياسي كالطول أو العرض أو الارتفاع؛ أو جانب من موقف
entries.example: The box's dimensions are printed on the side.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller or less important, or to make something so.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّ أو يُضعِف شيئاً في الحجم أو الأهمية
entries.example: His influence diminished after he left the board.

entries.definitionEn: A room where people eat meals.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة طعام
entries.example: Dinner is served in the dining room.

entries.definitionEn: The main meal of the day, often in the evening.
entries.arabicMeaning: العشاء أو الوجبة الرئيسة في اليوم
entries.example: We have dinner at seven.

entries.definitionEn: A large animal that lived millions of years ago and no longer exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديناصور؛ حيوان ضخم انقرض منذ ملايين السنين
entries.example: The museum has a dinosaur skeleton.

entries.definitionEn: A chemical compound that contains two oxygen atoms, such as carbon dioxide.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثاني أكسيد؛ مركّب كيميائي فيه ذرتا أكسجين
entries.example: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.

entries.definitionEn: To put something briefly into a liquid. Also to go down slightly and often rise again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغمس شيئاً قليلاً في سائل؛ أو ينخفض قليلاً ثم قد يعود
entries.example: She dipped the bread in olive oil.

entries.definitionEn: A serious infectious disease that makes breathing difficult and can harm the throat.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخناق؛ مرض معدٍ خطير يصيب الحلق ويصعّب التنفس
entries.example: Children are vaccinated against diphtheria.

entries.definitionEn: An official paper that shows you have completed a course of study.
entries.arabicMeaning: دبلوم؛ شهادة رسمية بإتمام دراسة
entries.example: She received her diploma in June.

entries.definitionEn: A person who represents their country in dealings with other countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: دبلوماسي يمثّل بلده في التعامل مع الدول
entries.example: The diplomat attended the talks in Geneva.

entries.definitionEn: Going straight to a place without stopping. Also honest and clear, saying what you mean.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباشر بلا توقف؛ أو صريح واضح يقول ما يعنيه
entries.example: Is there a direct train to Leeds?

entries.definitionEn: To control or guide people or a process. Also to tell someone the way, or to be in charge of a film or play.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدير أو يوجّه؛ أو يدلّ على الطريق، أو يخرج فيلماً أو مسرحية
entries.example: She directed the choir for ten years.

entries.definitionEn: The way that someone or something is moving or facing. Also guidance or instruction.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتجاه الحركة أو التوجّه؛ أو إرشاد وتعليمات
entries.example: Walk in this direction toward the river.

entries.definitionEn: In a straight line or without anything in between. Also immediately, or in an honest way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباشرة؛ على خط مستقيم أو بلا واسطة، أو فوراً أو بصراحة
entries.example: The hotel is directly opposite the station.

entries.definitionEn: A person who manages a company or organization, or who is in charge of making a film or play.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدير مؤسسة أو مخرج فيلم أو مسرحية
entries.example: The director of the company spoke at the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Earth or soil. Also any unclean substance on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: تراب أو تربة؛ أو وسخ على سطح
entries.example: Wipe the dirt off your shoes.

entries.definitionEn: Not clean.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسخ غير نظيف
entries.example: Please don't sit on the dirty floor.

entries.definitionEn: A physical or mental condition that makes some activities harder.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعاقة؛ حال جسدية أو عقلية تصعّب بعض الأنشطة
entries.example: The office was rebuilt to support staff with a disability.

entries.definitionEn: To stop a machine or system from working. Also to cause someone to have a disability.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطّل جهازاً أو نظاماً؛ وقد يعني يُحدث إعاقة لشخص
entries.example: You can disable the alarm in the settings.

entries.definitionEn: Having a physical or mental condition that makes some activities harder. Also, of a machine, switched off so that it does not work.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو إعاقة؛ ولجهاز معطّل عن العمل
entries.example: The station has lifts for disabled passengers.

entries.definitionEn: Something that makes a situation worse or less likely to succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: عيب أو جانب سلبي يقلّل فرص النجاح
entries.example: One disadvantage of the flat is the noisy street.

entries.definitionEn: To have a different opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخالف في الرأي
entries.example: I disagree with that idea.

entries.definitionEn: A difference of opinion, or an argument.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلاف في الرأي أو نزاع
entries.example: They had a disagreement about the budget.

entries.definitionEn: To become impossible to see or find.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختفي فلا يُرى أو يُعثر عليه
entries.example: The sun will disappear behind the clouds.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of becoming impossible to see or find.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختفاء
entries.example: The disappearance of the keys caused a delay.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone sad because something is not as good as they hoped.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيّب أمل شخص لأن الأمر دون ما توقّع
entries.example: I don't want to disappoint you.

entries.definitionEn: Sad because something was not as good as you hoped.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيب الأمل؛ حزين لأن الأمر جاء دون المأمول
entries.example: She was disappointed with the meal.

entries.definitionEn: Not as good as you hoped.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيب للآمال؛ دون المتوقع
entries.example: The film was disappointing.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being disappointed, or a person or thing that disappoints.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيبة أمل؛ أو شخص أو أمر مخيب
entries.example: The cancellation was a disappointment.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling or sign that you think something is wrong or bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: استهجان؛ شعور أو إشارة بأنك ترى الأمر خطأ
entries.example: She showed her disapproval with a frown.

entries.definitionEn: To think that someone or something is wrong or bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستهجن؛ يرى أن شخصاً أو شيئاً على غير الصواب
entries.example: My parents disapprove of loud music late at night.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden event that causes great damage or suffering. Also a complete failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: كارثة؛ حدث مفاجئ بضرر بالغ، أو فشل ذريع
entries.example: The flood was a disaster for the farms.

entries.definitionEn: Causing great damage or complete failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: كارثي يسبب ضرراً بالغاً أو فشلاً تاماً
entries.example: The delay had disastrous effects on the schedule.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays recorded music for an audience, especially on radio or at a party.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يقدّم الموسيقى المسجّلة للجمهور ولا سيما في الراديو أو الحفلات
entries.example: The disc jockey played songs from the 1990s.

entries.definitionEn: To throw something away because you no longer want or need it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتخلّص من شيء برميه لأنه لم يعد مطلوباً
entries.example: Please discard the broken pens.

entries.definitionEn: Official permission to leave a hospital, job, or the armed forces. Also a substance that flows out.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسريح رسمي من مستشفى أو عمل أو خدمة عسكرية؛ أو مادة تخرج من موضع
entries.example: She received her discharge from the hospital on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A person who follows the teaching of a leader, especially a religious teacher.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميذ يتبع تعاليم معلّم ولا سيما ديني
entries.example: She became a disciple of the famous painter.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of training people to follow rules. Also self-control, or a subject of study.
entries.arabicMeaning: انضباط؛ تدريب على القواعد، أو ضبط النفس، أو فرع علمي
entries.example: Daily practice takes discipline.

entries.definitionEn: A place or event where people dance to recorded popular music.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديسكو؛ مكان أو حفلة للرقص على موسيقى مسجّلة
entries.example: They went to a disco on Saturday night.

entries.definitionEn: A slight feeling of pain, or of being physically or mentally uneasy.
entries.arabicMeaning: انزعاج أو ألم خفيف في الجسد أو النفس
entries.example: The hard chair caused some discomfort.

entries.definitionEn: To separate a machine from a supply or from another device. Also to stop feeling a link with people.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصل جهازاً عن مصدر طاقة أو عن جهاز آخر؛ وقد يعني انقطاع الصلة الشعورية
entries.example: Disconnect the charger before you clean the phone.

entries.definitionEn: A reduction in the usual price.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصم من السعر المعتاد
entries.example: Students get a discount on tickets.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone less confident or less willing to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّط الهمة أو يقلّل الرغبة في الفعل
entries.example: Don't let one mistake discourage you.

entries.definitionEn: Written or spoken communication, especially serious discussion of a subject. Also a formal talk.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطاب أو نقاش جاد منطوق أو مكتوب؛ أو حديث رسمي
entries.example: Public discourse about health has changed in recent years.

entries.definitionEn: To find something for the first time, or something that was hidden.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتشف شيئاً أول مرة أو شيئاً كان خفياً
entries.example: Scientists discovered a new species of frog.

entries.definitionEn: The act of finding something new, or the thing that is found.
entries.arabicMeaning: اكتشاف؛ فعل العثور على جديد أو الشيء المكتشف
entries.example: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine.

entries.definitionEn: To make people stop believing or respecting someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعزع ثقة الناس بشخص أو شيء أو احترامهم له
entries.example: They tried to discredit the witness.

entries.definitionEn: To treat a person or group unfairly because of who they are. Also to recognize a difference.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميّز ضد شخص أو فئة معاملة غير عادلة؛ أو يميّز فرقاً
entries.example: It is illegal to discriminate against someone because of their age.

entries.definitionEn: Unfair treatment of people because of who they are. Also the ability to see fine differences.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمييز مجحف بسبب هوية الشخص؛ أو قدرة على إدراك الفروق الدقيقة
entries.example: The law forbids discrimination at work.

entries.definitionEn: To talk about something with other people, usually to share ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناقش موضوعاً مع غيره لتبادل الآراء
entries.example: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A talk in which people share ideas about a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقاش؛ حديث لتبادل الأفكار حول موضوع
entries.example: The class had a discussion about travel.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling that someone or something is not good enough to deserve your respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدراء؛ شعور بأن شخصاً أو شيئاً لا يستحق الاحترام
entries.example: She looked at the messy desk with disdain.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you think someone or something is unworthy of respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزدرٍ يُظهر أن الشخص أو الشيء لا يستحق الاحترام
entries.example: He gave a disdainful glance at the cheap copy.

entries.definitionEn: An illness that affects people, animals, or plants, and is not a simple injury.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرض يصيب الإنسان أو الحيوان أو النبات، وليس مجرد إصابة جسدية
entries.example: The doctor said the disease was not serious.

entries.definitionEn: The loss of other people's respect because of something shameful. Also a person or act that causes that shame.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزي وفقدان للاحترام بسبب أمر مشين؛ وقد يُوصف به الشخص أو الفعل نفسه
entries.example: Losing the files was a disgrace to the whole office.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes, makeup, or another change of appearance that hides who someone is.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنكّر؛ هيئة أو لباس يخفي هوية الشخص
entries.example: He wore a disguise so that no one would recognize him.

entries.definitionEn: To change appearance so that people do not recognize someone. Also to hide a feeling or fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنكّر أو يخفي الهيئة؛ وقد يعني إخفاء شعور أو حقيقة
entries.example: She tried to disguise her voice on the phone.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely unpleasant to see, smell, taste, or think about.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقزّز؛ بالغ الإساءة للحس أو الذوق
entries.example: The smell from the bin was disgusting.

entries.definitionEn: Food cooked and served in a particular way. Also a plate or bowl for serving food.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبق من الطعام يُعدّ بطريقة معيّنة؛ أو وعاء تقديم الطعام
entries.example: This rice dish is my favourite.

entries.definitionEn: Not honest; ready to lie, cheat, or hide the truth.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير أمين؛ يميل إلى الكذب أو الغش أو إخفاء الحقيقة
entries.example: It is dishonest to copy someone else's work.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that is not honest, such as lying or cheating.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدم الأمانة؛ سلوك يقوم على الكذب أو الغش
entries.example: The inquiry found clear evidence of dishonesty.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that washes plates, glasses, and cutlery.
entries.arabicMeaning: غسالة صحون
entries.example: Load the plates into the dishwasher after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone see that a person, idea, or situation is not as good as they believed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيّب الظن ويكشف أن الأمر دون ما كان يُعتقد
entries.example: The poor results disillusioned even her strongest supporters.

entries.definitionEn: The disappointed feeling that comes when something proves less admirable than it seemed.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيبة الأمل بعد اكتشاف أن شيئاً ليس كما تُصوّر
entries.example: There was widespread disillusionment after the reform failed.

entries.definitionEn: A flat circular object. Also a computer storage device, or a CD.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرص مسطّح مستدير؛ ومنها قرص الحاسوب أو القرص المدمج
entries.example: She saved a backup copy of the file on a disk.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of not liking someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفور؛ شعور بعدم المحبة
entries.example: She made no secret of her dislike of cold weather.

entries.definitionEn: To not like someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يحب؛ ينفر من شخص أو شيء
entries.example: I dislike waiting in long queues.

entries.definitionEn: To force something or someone out of a fixed or secure position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيح شيئاً أو شخصاً عن موضع ثابت بقوة
entries.example: The storm dislodged several tiles from the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Gloomy, depressing, or of very poor quality, with little hope of improvement.
entries.arabicMeaning: كئيب أو بالغ الرداءة، لا أمل يُذكر في تحسنه
entries.example: The team put in a dismal performance on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: In a gloomy or very unsuccessful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو كئيب أو مخيّب للغاية
entries.example: The plan failed dismally in the first week.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of shock mixed with disappointment or worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزع؛ صدمة يشوبها خيبة أو قلق
entries.example: They watched in dismay as the water rose.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone with shock and disappointment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفزع أو يخيّب على نحو صادم
entries.example: The sudden delay dismayed the passengers.

entries.definitionEn: To refuse to consider an idea as important. Also to send someone away, or to end their job.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرف النظر عن فكرة؛ أو يصرف شخصاً أو يُنهي عمله
entries.example: Do not dismiss her idea without hearing it.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of order; a messy or confused state. Also a medical condition that affects the body or mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضى أو اختلال في النظام؛ أو اضطراب صحي يصيب الجسم أو العقل
entries.example: The files were in complete disorder after the move.

entries.definitionEn: Untidy and without order. Also noisy and causing trouble in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضوي غير مرتّب؛ أو صاخب مخلّ بالنظام في مكان عام
entries.example: A disorderly pile of papers covered the desk.

entries.definitionEn: Not arranged in a clear or effective way; lacking order or planning.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير منظّم؛ يفتقر إلى الترتيب أو التخطيط
entries.example: His notes were too disorganized to follow.

entries.definitionEn: To speak of someone or something as if they have little worth or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقص من قيمة شخص أو شيء ويصغّره في الكلام
entries.example: She did not disparage her colleagues in public.

entries.definitionEn: The act of speaking about someone or something as if they are of little worth.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتقاص؛ كلام يحقّر أو يصغّر القيمة
entries.example: He rejected the report as mere disparagement.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you think someone or something is of little worth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينطوي على انتقاص أو تحقير
entries.example: A disparaging remark silenced the room.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows low regard for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ينتقص أو يحقّر
entries.example: He spoke disparagingly of the whole scheme.

entries.definitionEn: A place, often in a hospital or clinic, where medicines are prepared and given out.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيدلية توزيع أدوية، غالباً في مستشفى أو عيادة
entries.example: She collected the medicine from the hospital dispensary.

entries.definitionEn: To give something out, especially in measured amounts. Also to prepare and supply medicine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوزّع شيئاً بمقادير محدودة؛ أو يصرف دواءً
entries.example: The pharmacist will dispense the medicine this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: The process of spreading people, animals, or things over a wide area.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفرّق أو انتشار على نطاق واسع
entries.example: Wind aided the dispersal of the seeds across the field.

entries.definitionEn: To spread over a wide area, or to cause people or things to move apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفرّق أو يفرّق؛ ينتشر على مساحة واسعة
entries.example: The clouds began to disperse by noon.

entries.definitionEn: To take the place of something. Also to force people to leave their home or country.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلّ محلّ شيء؛ أو يضطر الناس إلى ترك ديارهم
entries.example: The new software will displace the old system next year.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement of things for people to look at.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض مرتّب لأشياء كي يراها الناس
entries.example: There is a display of old maps in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: To put something where people can see it. Also to show a feeling or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض شيئاً للمشاهدة؛ أو يُظهر شعوراً أو صفة
entries.example: The museum will display the letters next month.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being annoyed or unhappy about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: استياء؛ شعور بالضيق أو عدم الرضا
entries.example: He made no secret of his displeasure at the delay.

entries.definitionEn: The process of getting rid of something. If something is at your disposal, you are free to use it.
entries.arabicMeaning: التخلّص من شيء؛ وإذا كان الشيء تحت تصرّفك فلك أن تستعمله
entries.example: Safe disposal of batteries is important.

entries.definitionEn: A person's usual character or mood. Also a natural tendency to behave in a certain way.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبع الشخص أو مزاجه المعتاد؛ أو ميل طبيعي إلى سلوك معيّن
entries.example: She has a calm disposition, even under pressure.

entries.definitionEn: A serious disagreement, often about rights, facts, or money.
entries.arabicMeaning: نزاع جدّي، غالباً حول حق أو واقعة أو مال
entries.example: The two companies are in a dispute over the contract.

entries.definitionEn: To stop someone from taking part in a competition or activity because they have broken a rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستبعد شخصاً من مسابقة أو نشاط لمخالفته قاعدة
entries.example: A false start can disqualify a runner.

entries.definitionEn: Causing a feeling of unease or worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلق؛ يبعث على عدم الاطمئنان
entries.example: The findings were disquieting to the research team.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of attention or respect for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجاهل؛ عدم اكتراث أو احترام
entries.example: The accident was caused by a disregard for safety rules.

entries.definitionEn: To interrupt the normal course of an event, system, or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطّل المسار المعتاد لحدث أو نظام أو نشاط
entries.example: Roadworks will disrupt traffic this week.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of not being pleased or content with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدم رضا؛ شعور بأن الأمر دون المطلوب
entries.example: Staff expressed dissatisfaction with the new hours.

entries.definitionEn: Not pleased with something, because it is not good enough.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير راضٍ لأن الأمر دون المستوى
entries.example: Many customers were dissatisfied with the delay.

entries.definitionEn: To cut open a plant or animal in order to study it. Also to examine something in close detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرّح كائناً لدراسته؛ أو يحلّل أمراً بدقة متناهية
entries.example: Students will dissect the poem line by line.

entries.definitionEn: The act of cutting open a body for study, or of examining something in very close detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشريح للدرس؛ أو تحليل بالغ الدقة
entries.example: The dissection of the argument revealed several weak points.

entries.definitionEn: To hide your true feelings, motives, or beliefs by pretending otherwise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتظاهر بخلاف ما يُضمر من شعور أو قصد
entries.example: He could not dissemble his disappointment.

entries.definitionEn: To spread information, ideas, or knowledge widely.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشر معلومات أو أفكاراً على نطاق واسع
entries.example: The agency will disseminate the results online.

entries.definitionEn: The wide spreading of information, ideas, or knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشر واسع للمعلومات أو الأفكار
entries.example: Wide dissemination of the guidelines is essential.

entries.definitionEn: Strong disagreement that causes conflict within a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقاق؛ خلاف شديد يفرّق الجماعة
entries.example: Dissension within the committee delayed the vote.

entries.definitionEn: A person who publicly disagrees with official policy or with those in power.
entries.arabicMeaning: معارض يعلن اختلافه مع السياسة الرسمية أو مع أصحاب السلطة
entries.example: The journalist interviewed a well-known dissident.

entries.definitionEn: To mix into a liquid and become part of it. Also to bring an organization or meeting to an end.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذوب في سائل ويندمج فيه؛ أو يحلّ منظمة أو اجتماعاً
entries.example: Sugar will dissolve quickly in hot water.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of space between two places or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: المسافة بين مكانين أو شيئين
entries.example: The distance from here to the station is two kilometres.

entries.definitionEn: Far away in space or time. Also not warm or friendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيد في المكان أو الزمان؛ أو بارد غير ودود في المعاملة
entries.example: We could see a distant ship on the horizon.

entries.definitionEn: To heat a liquid and cool the vapour in order to purify it or extract a substance. Also to draw out the essential part of an idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقطّر سائلاً لتنقيته أو استخلاص مادة منه؛ أو يستخلص جوهر فكرة
entries.example: They distill the liquid to make it purer.

entries.definitionEn: The process of purifying a liquid by heating it and cooling the vapour. Also a concentrated form of an idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقطير السائل بالحرارة ثم التبريد؛ أو صيغة مركّزة لفكرة
entries.example: Distillation separates the alcohol from the mixture.

entries.definitionEn: A clear difference between two things. Also a mark of high quality or honour.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرق واضح بين شيئين؛ أو تميّز رفيع يُعدّ شرفاً
entries.example: There is a clear distinction between the two methods.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is clear and easy to notice or remember.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوضوح يسهل معه الإدراك أو التذكّر
entries.example: I distinctly remember locking the door.

entries.definitionEn: To recognize the difference between two or more things. Also to see or hear something clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميّز الفرق بين شيئين أو أكثر؛ أو يدرك شيئاً بوضوح
entries.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins from each other.

entries.definitionEn: Successful, respected, and often impressive in appearance or achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرموق محترم، وغالباً ذو وقار أو إنجاز بيّن
entries.example: A distinguished scientist opened the conference.

entries.definitionEn: A change that makes something look, sound, or seem different from the truth or the original.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشويه يغيّر الصورة أو الصوت أو المعنى عن أصله أو عن الحقيقة
entries.example: The cheap speaker caused distortion of the music.

entries.definitionEn: To take someone's attention away from what they should be doing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشتّت انتباه شخص عمّا ينبغي أن يفعله
entries.example: Please do not distract me while I am driving.

entries.definitionEn: Something that takes your attention away from what you should be doing.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر يصرف الانتباه عمّا ينبغي الاشتغال به
entries.example: The radio was a constant distraction.

entries.definitionEn: Causing sadness, worry, or pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلم أو مُحزن؛ يبعث على القلق
entries.example: The news of the accident was distressing.

entries.definitionEn: To give things out to several people, or to spread them over an area.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوزّع أشياء على عدة أشخاص أو ينشرها في مساحة
entries.example: Volunteers will distribute water at the finish line.

entries.definitionEn: The act of giving things out or spreading them. Also the way something is shared or spread.
entries.arabicMeaning: توزيع الأشياء أو نشرها؛ أو الكيفية التي تتوزّع بها
entries.example: The distribution of food began at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that supplies goods to shops or customers.
entries.arabicMeaning: موزّع؛ جهة تورّد السلع إلى المتاجر أو الزبائن
entries.example: The company is the main distributor of the product in this region.

entries.definitionEn: An area of a town or country, often with its own character or local government.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطقة أو حيّ من مدينة أو بلد، وغالباً له طابع أو إدارة محلية
entries.example: She works in a quiet district near the river.

entries.definitionEn: To interrupt someone or stop them from working or sleeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعج شخصاً أو يقاطعه عن عمله أو نومه
entries.example: Please do not disturb her while she is working.

entries.definitionEn: Something that interrupts people or breaks the peace. Also a state of public unrest.
entries.arabicMeaning: إزعاج يقطع الهدوء؛ أو اضطراب في النظام العام
entries.example: A loud disturbance woke the neighbours.

entries.definitionEn: To delay making a decision because you cannot choose between options.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتردّد في حيرة فلا يحسم أمره
entries.example: He dithered for weeks before choosing a course.

entries.definitionEn: To jump into water head first. Also to swim underwater.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقفز إلى الماء ورأسه إلى الأمام؛ أو يسبح تحت الماء
entries.example: She learned to dive at the local pool.

entries.definitionEn: A person who swims underwater, often with special equipment, or who jumps into water head first.
entries.arabicMeaning: غوّاص يسبح تحت الماء، أو من يقفز إلى الماء ورأسه إلى الأمام
entries.example: The diver checked his equipment before entering the water.

entries.definitionEn: To separate and go in different directions. Also to become different from something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتباعد ويسلك طريقاً مختلفاً؛ أو يصير مختلفاً عن غيره
entries.example: The two paths diverge behind the farm.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming different, or a difference that develops between things once similar.
entries.arabicMeaning: تباعد أو اختلاف ينشأ بين أمور كانت متقاربة
entries.example: There is a growing divergence between the two forecasts.

entries.definitionEn: Developing in different directions; no longer the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: متباعد؛ يسلك اتجاهات مختلفة
entries.example: The team offered two divergent explanations.

entries.definitionEn: Including many different types of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: متنوّع؛ يضم أنواعاً كثيرة مختلفة
entries.example: The city has a diverse population.

entries.definitionEn: A change of route. Also something that takes your attention away, or a pleasant activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحويل للمسار؛ أو إلهاء يصرف الانتباه؛ أو تسلية
entries.example: A traffic diversion sent cars along the old road.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of including many different types of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنوّع؛ اشتمال على أنواع شتى من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: The university values diversity among its students.

entries.definitionEn: To change the direction of something. Also to take someone's attention away, or to entertain them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوّل الاتجاه؛ أو يصرف الانتباه؛ أو يسلّي
entries.example: Signs divert traffic away from the square.

entries.definitionEn: A difference that separates people or groups. Also a line that separates two areas.
entries.arabicMeaning: هوّة أو فرق يفصل بين فئات؛ أو خط يفصل منطقتين
entries.example: A deep divide remains between the two groups.

entries.definitionEn: To separate something into parts, or to share it among people.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقسم شيئاً إلى أجزاء أو يوزّعه بين الناس
entries.example: Divide the cake into eight pieces.

entries.definitionEn: Split into groups that disagree. Also separated into parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقسم الرأي بين فئات؛ أو مفصول إلى أجزاء
entries.example: Opinion on the proposal is divided.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of trying to discover hidden knowledge or the future by signs, ritual, or supposed supernatural means.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرافة؛ طلب معرفة الغيب أو الخفيّ عبر علامات أو طقوس
entries.example: The museum has a display on ancient methods of divination.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to God or a god, or coming from that source.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلهي؛ منسوب إلى الله أو إلى إله
entries.example: The poem speaks of divine mercy.

entries.definitionEn: The sport or activity of jumping into water or swimming underwater.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة القفز إلى الماء أو السباحة تحته
entries.example: Diving is not allowed in this part of the pool.

entries.definitionEn: The act of separating something into parts. Also a section of a large organization, or a disagreement that splits people.
entries.arabicMeaning: قسمة أو تجزئة؛ أو قسم من مؤسسة كبيرة؛ أو انقسام يفرّق الناس
entries.example: She works in the sales division of the firm.

entries.definitionEn: The legal ending of a marriage.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلاق؛ إنهاء الزواج بحكم القانون
entries.example: They agreed on the terms of the divorce.

entries.definitionEn: To end a marriage legally. Also to separate one thing completely from another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلّق شرعاً أو قانوناً؛ أو يفصل أمراً عن آخر فصلاً تاماً
entries.example: They decided to divorce after years of argument.

entries.definitionEn: No longer married, because the marriage has been legally ended.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطلّق أو مطلّقة بعد إنهاء الزواج قانوناً
entries.example: He has been divorced for three years.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling as if everything is spinning, so that you may fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائخ؛ كأن الأشياء تدور فيخشى السقوط
entries.example: I felt dizzy after standing up too quickly.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays recorded music for an audience, on radio or at an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: منسّق موسيقى يشغّل التسجيلات لجمهور في إذاعة أو مناسبة
entries.example: The DJ played songs from the 1990s.

entries.definitionEn: The chemical in living cells that carries genetic information from parents to children.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحمض النووي الذي يحمل المعلومات الوراثية من الآباء إلى الأبناء
entries.example: Scientists compared the DNA from both samples.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a main verb to make questions and negatives in the present, and to add emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يأتي قبل الفعل الأصلي لتكوين السؤال والنفي في المضارع، وللتوكيد
entries.example: Do you need any help?

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a doctor. Also a short form of document.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب في الكلام غير الرسمي؛ أو اختصار لكلمة وثيقة
entries.example: The doc said I should rest for a week.

entries.definitionEn: Calm and easy to manage, teach, or control.
entries.arabicMeaning: وديع سهل الانقياد والتعليم
entries.example: The horse was surprisingly docile on the ride.

entries.definitionEn: In a calm, obedient way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوداعة وسهولة انقياد
entries.example: The child followed docilely behind his uncle.

entries.definitionEn: A place in a harbour where ships load, unload, or are repaired.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصيف في ميناء تُحمَّل عنده السفن أو تُفرَّغ أو تُصلح
entries.example: The ship is waiting at the dock.

entries.definitionEn: A person trained to treat people who are ill. Also the written title Dr.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب؛ ويُكتب اللقب اختصاراً Dr
entries.example: You should see a doctor about that cough.

entries.definitionEn: An official paper or computer file that gives information.
entries.arabicMeaning: وثيقة رسمية ورقية أو ملف حاسوبي يحمل معلومات
entries.example: Please sign the document at the bottom.

entries.definitionEn: A film or television programme that presents facts about real people or events.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلم أو برنامج وثائقي يعرض وقائع عن أناس أو أحداث حقيقية
entries.example: We watched a documentary about the ocean.

entries.definitionEn: The form of do used with he, she, and it in the present, to make questions, negatives, and emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الفعل المساعد do مع he وshe وit في المضارع، للسؤال والنفي والتوكيد
entries.example: Does this bus stop at the museum?

entries.definitionEn: An animal often kept as a pet, that barks and is related to wolves.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلب؛ حيوان أليف ينبح وهو من فصيلة الذئاب
entries.example: Their dog waits by the door each evening.

entries.definitionEn: The -ing form of do, used with be to talk about an action in progress.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة do المنتهية بـ ing، تُستعمل مع be للحديث عن فعل جارٍ
entries.example: She is doing her homework now.

entries.definitionEn: To give something out in portions, often slowly or in small amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوزّع شيئاً على دفعات، وغالباً بمقادير شحيحة أو ببطء
entries.example: The kitchen staff doled out soup to everyone in line.

entries.definitionEn: A child's toy that looks like a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: دمية على هيئة إنسان يلعب بها الأطفال
entries.example: The child put the doll in the pram.

entries.definitionEn: The unit of money used in the United States and in some other countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: دولار؛ وحدة نقد في الولايات المتحدة وفي بعض البلدان الأخرى
entries.example: This book costs ten dollars.

entries.definitionEn: A sea animal with a long nose that is intelligent and often swims in groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: دلفين؛ حيوان بحري ذكي طويل الخطم يسبح غالباً في جماعات
entries.example: A dolphin swam beside the boat.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the home or family. Also relating to one's own country, not to other countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزلي أو أسري؛ أو داخلي يخص البلد لا الخارج
entries.example: The firm sells mainly to the domestic market.

entries.definitionEn: Inside a country rather than abroad. Also in the home.
entries.arabicMeaning: على الصعيد الداخلي لا الخارجي؛ أو في نطاق البيت
entries.example: The product is produced domestically.

entries.definitionEn: To train an animal to live with people and be useful to them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستأنس حيواناً ليعيش مع الناس وينفعهم
entries.example: Humans first began to domesticate sheep thousands of years ago.

entries.definitionEn: The process of training animals to live with people and serve human needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: استئناس الحيوان ليعيش مع الإنسان ويخدم حاجاته
entries.example: The domestication of dogs happened over a long period.

entries.definitionEn: Home life, especially when it is quiet, settled, and centred on the household.
entries.arabicMeaning: حياة البيت والألفة المنزلية الهادئة المستقرة
entries.example: After years of travel, he longed for quiet domesticity.

entries.definitionEn: Strongest, most important, or most noticeable; having the most control or influence.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهيمن؛ الأقوى أو الأبرز أو الأكثر نفوذاً
entries.example: Oak is the dominant tree in this forest.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is strongest, most noticeable, or most influential.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مهيمن أو بالغ البروز والتأثير
entries.example: One colour appears dominantly in the painting.

entries.definitionEn: To have the most power, control, or importance. Also to be the largest or most noticeable thing in a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهيمن نفوذاً أو أهمية؛ أو يكون الأبرز في المكان
entries.example: Tall buildings dominate the skyline.

entries.definitionEn: Control or power over a person, group, or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيمنة؛ سيطرة على شخص أو جماعة أو وضع
entries.example: The team's domination of the league lasted a decade.

entries.definitionEn: To give money, goods, or blood to help a person or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتبرّع بمال أو سلع أو دم لمساعدة شخص أو جهة
entries.example: She decided to donate blood at the clinic.

entries.definitionEn: Money, goods, or blood given to help a person or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبرّع بمال أو سلع أو دم
entries.example: The library received a large donation of books.

entries.definitionEn: The past participle of do, used with have, has, or had to talk about a finished action.
entries.arabicMeaning: التصريف الثالث لفعل do، يُستعمل مع have أو has أو had للحديث عن فعل مكتمل
entries.example: Have you done the shopping?

entries.definitionEn: An animal like a small horse, with long ears, used for carrying loads.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمار؛ حيوان يشبه الحصان الصغير طويل الأذنين يُحمَّل عليه
entries.example: A donkey was carrying sacks along the path.

entries.definitionEn: Death, ruin, or a very bad fate that seems certain.
entries.arabicMeaning: هلاك أو خراب أو مصير سيئ يبدو محتوماً
entries.example: They spoke of the project as if doom were certain.

entries.definitionEn: A movable barrier used to open or close the entrance to a room, building, or cupboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: باب يُفتح ويُغلق عند مدخل غرفة أو مبنى أو خزانة
entries.example: Please close the door behind you.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to watch a door and control who goes in.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوّاب؛ من يراقب الباب ويضبط الدخول
entries.example: The doorkeeper checked our tickets.

entries.definitionEn: The opening in a wall where a door is fitted; the space you pass through to enter.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتحة الباب في الجدار؛ المدخل الذي تمرّ منه
entries.example: She waited in the doorway until the rain eased.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a dormitory; a building or room where students sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكن طلابي في الكلام غير الرسمي؛ غرفة أو مبنى ينام فيه الطلاب
entries.example: He shares a dorm with three other students.

entries.definitionEn: A large room or building where a number of people, especially students, sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنبر نوم أو سكن جامعي يأوي عدداً من النائمين ولا سيما الطلاب
entries.example: First-year students live in the dormitory on campus.

entries.definitionEn: A measured amount of medicine taken at one time.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرعة دواء تُؤخذ في مرة واحدة
entries.example: Take one dose of the medicine after meals.

entries.definitionEn: A small round mark.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقطة؛ علامة مستديرة صغيرة
entries.example: Put a dot over the letter i.

entries.definitionEn: Twice as much or as many; made of two similar parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضعف المقدار؛ أو مكوّن من جزأين متشابهين
entries.example: She booked a double room for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A person who looks extremely like someone else. Also twice the usual amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبيه يكاد يطابق شخصاً آخر؛ أو ضعف المقدار المعتاد
entries.example: The actor's double stood in for the dangerous scene.

entries.definitionEn: To become twice as large, or to make something twice as large.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتضاعف أو يضاعف الشيء حتى يصير ضعفين
entries.example: The company hopes to double its sales this year.

entries.definitionEn: To twice the degree; for two reasons at once.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضاعفاً في الدرجة؛ أو لسببين معاً
entries.example: She felt doubly responsible after making the promise.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of not being sure about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شك؛ شعور بعدم اليقين
entries.example: I have no doubt that he will arrive.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something may not be true or likely. Also to have little confidence in someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكّ في صحة أمر أو رجحانه؛ أو يقلّ ثقته بشخص
entries.example: I doubt we will finish before Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Not likely to happen, or not feeling sure.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرجّح الحدوث؛ أو غير واثق
entries.example: It is doubtful that the train will be on time.

entries.definitionEn: A bird of the pigeon family, often pale in colour, and sometimes used as a symbol of peace.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمامة؛ طائر من فصيلة الحمام، وغالباً فاتح اللون، وقد يُتَّخذ رمزاً للسلام
entries.example: A dove landed on the fountain.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy or depressed. Also not working, of a computer or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتئب أو حزين؛ أو معطّل إذا وُصف به حاسوب أو نظام
entries.example: The website is down this morning.

entries.definitionEn: Towards a lower place or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى أسفل؛ نحو موضع أدنى
entries.example: Please sit down.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show movement from a higher place to a lower one, or along a path or surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على الحركة من أعلى إلى أسفل، أو على امتداد طريق أو سطح
entries.example: We walked down the hill to the shop.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden loss of power, success, or good fortune.
entries.arabicMeaning: سقوط مفاجئ من موقع القوة أو النجاح أو الحظ
entries.example: Careless spending led to the company's downfall.

entries.definitionEn: A file copied from the internet onto a computer or phone, or the act of copying it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملف يُنزَّل من الإنترنت إلى حاسوب أو هاتف؛ أو عملية التنزيل نفسها
entries.example: The download will take a few minutes.

entries.definitionEn: To copy a file from the internet onto a computer or phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزّل ملفاً من الإنترنت إلى حاسوب أو هاتف
entries.example: You can download the form from the website.

entries.definitionEn: To reduce the size of a company, especially by cutting jobs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّص حجم شركة، ولا سيما بخفض عدد الوظائف
entries.example: The factory had to downsize after demand fell.

entries.definitionEn: On or relating to a lower floor of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الطابق الأسفل أو متعلق به
entries.example: The downstairs bathroom is free.

entries.definitionEn: To or on a lower floor of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الطابق الأسفل أو فيه
entries.example: I'll wait downstairs.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the central part of a city, especially in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وسط المدينة أو باتجاهه، ولا سيما في الإنجليزية الأمريكية
entries.example: Let's meet downtown after work.

entries.definitionEn: Moving or pointing towards a lower place or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: متّجه إلى أسفل مكاناً أو مستوى
entries.example: There has been a downward trend in prices.

entries.definitionEn: Money or property that a bride or her family gives at marriage in some traditions.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوطة؛ مال أو ممتلكات تقدّمها العروس أو أسرتها عند الزواج في بعض التقاليد
entries.example: In some traditions, a dowry is given at marriage.

entries.definitionEn: A short, light sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: غفوة؛ نوم قصير خفيف
entries.example: He had a short doze on the train.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean twelve of that thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل الاسم بمعنى اثني عشر من ذلك الشيء
entries.example: She bought a dozen eggs for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A group of twelve. Also, informally, a fairly large number.
entries.arabicMeaning: دزينة؛ مجموعة من اثني عشر، وقد تعني عدداً غير قليل في الكلام العادي
entries.example: They sell bread rolls by the dozen.

entries.definitionEn: A dull, lifeless quality in colour, appearance, or atmosphere.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهتان وكآبة في اللون أو الهيئة أو الجوّ
entries.example: The drabness of the office walls made the room feel smaller.

entries.definitionEn: A first version of a piece of writing. Also a current of air, or beer served from a barrel, often spelled draught.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسودة أولى لنص؛ أو تيار هواء، أو جعة تُسحب من البرميل وغالباً تُكتب draught
entries.example: Please read the first draft of the letter.

entries.definitionEn: To pull something along the ground with effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرّ شيئاً على الأرض بجهد
entries.example: Don't drag the chair across the floor.

entries.definitionEn: A pipe or channel that carries away water or waste liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصرف؛ أنبوب أو قناة تصرف الماء أو الفضلات السائلة
entries.example: Leaves had blocked the drain.

entries.definitionEn: To let liquid flow away from something. Also to use up someone's energy or resources.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرّف السائل من شيء؛ أو يستنزف طاقة شخص أو موارده
entries.example: Drain the pasta before adding the sauce.

entries.definitionEn: A play for the theatre, television, or radio.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرحية أو عمل درامي للمسرح أو التلفزيون أو الراديو
entries.example: We saw a drama at the theatre last night.

entries.definitionEn: Sudden and striking. Also connected with plays and acting.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفاجئ بالغ الأثر؛ أو متعلق بالمسرح والتمثيل
entries.example: There has been a dramatic change in the weather.

entries.definitionEn: In a sudden, large, or exciting way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفاجئ أو بالغ أو مثير
entries.example: Costs have risen dramatically this year.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes plays.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب مسرحي
entries.example: The dramatist adapted the novel for the stage.

entries.definitionEn: Cloth hanging in loose folds, especially as curtains.
entries.arabicMeaning: قماش يتدلى طيات، ولا سيما الستائر
entries.example: Heavy drapery kept the room dark.

entries.definitionEn: A game or competition in which both sides have the same score.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعادل في مباراة أو مسابقة
entries.example: The match ended in a draw.

entries.definitionEn: To make a picture with a pencil, pen, or crayon.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسم صورة بقلم رصاص أو حبر أو تلوين
entries.example: The children like to draw animals.

entries.definitionEn: A disadvantage or problem that makes something less attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب سلبي أو عيب يقلّل جاذبية الشيء
entries.example: The main drawback is the high cost.

entries.definitionEn: A box-like part of a piece of furniture that slides in and out.
entries.arabicMeaning: درج في قطعة أثاث يُدفع ويُسحب
entries.example: The keys are in the top drawer.

entries.definitionEn: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon. Also the skill of making such pictures.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم بالقلم؛ أو مهارة عمل الرسوم
entries.example: She showed me a drawing of the house.

entries.definitionEn: To feel very afraid or worried about something that is going to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخشى أمراً قادماً خشية شديدة أو قلقاً بالغاً
entries.example: I dread the long wait at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: فظيع؛ بالغ السوء أو الإزعاج
entries.example: We had dreadful weather all weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Pictures and events that you see in your mind while you sleep. Also a hope for the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلم تراه أثناء النوم؛ أو أمنية للمستقبل
entries.example: I had a strange dream last night.

entries.definitionEn: To see pictures in your mind while you sleep. Also to hope for something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلم أثناء النوم؛ أو يتمنى أمراً بشدة
entries.example: She dreams of opening a small café.

entries.definitionEn: Having a faraway, thoughtful look, as if lost in pleasant thoughts. Also pleasantly like a dream.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالِم شارد كمن غرق في خواطر لطيفة؛ أو شبيه بالحلم في رقّته
entries.example: He had a dreamy look as he listened to the music.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and hangs down over the legs.
entries.arabicMeaning: فستان يغطي الجسم ويتدلى فوق الساقين
entries.example: She wore a blue dress to the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: To put clothes on yourself or someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتدي ملابس أو يُلبس غيره
entries.example: I need to dress quickly; we are late.

entries.definitionEn: Wearing clothes. Often used with an adverb to say how someone is wearing them.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتدٍ ملابسه؛ وغالباً يُوصف بكيفية الارتداء
entries.example: Are you dressed yet?

entries.definitionEn: A thin flow of liquid. In sport, the movement of a ball by short taps, bounces, or kicks.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيل رقيق من سائل؛ وفي الرياضة مراوغة الكرة بنقرات أو ركلات قصيرة
entries.example: A dribble of sauce ran down the plate.

entries.definitionEn: To let liquid fall in small drops, especially from the mouth. Also to move a ball with short taps or kicks.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسيل سائلاً قطرات ولا سيما من الفم؛ أو يراوغ بالكرة بنقرات أو ركلات قصيرة
entries.example: He dribbled the ball past two defenders.

entries.definitionEn: To make a hole with a rotating tool. Also to train people by repeating an action many times.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثقب بمثقاب دوّار؛ أو يدرّب الناس بتكرار الفعل مراراً
entries.example: They will drill a hole in the wall for the cable.

entries.definitionEn: A liquid that you swallow, such as water, juice, or tea.
entries.arabicMeaning: شراب؛ سائل يُبتلع كالماء أو العصير أو الشاي
entries.example: Would you like a drink of water?

entries.definitionEn: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرب؛ يبتلع سائلاً
entries.example: Please drink some water.

entries.definitionEn: Safe and pleasant enough to drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: صالح للشرب ومقبول الطعم
entries.example: The tap water here is drinkable.

entries.definitionEn: A person who drives a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائق مركبة
entries.example: The bus driver waited at the stop.

entries.definitionEn: An official document that allows you to drive a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخصة قيادة
entries.example: You must show your driving licence at the desk.

entries.definitionEn: A downward sag, as of the head, the eyelids, or a plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدلٍ إلى الأسفل، كما في الرأس أو الجفنين أو النبات
entries.example: There was a tired droop to her shoulders.

entries.definitionEn: A very small amount of liquid. Also a fall in amount or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطرة من سائل؛ أو انخفاض في مقدار أو مستوى
entries.example: Add a drop of oil to the pan.

entries.definitionEn: To let something fall, or to fall yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسقط شيئاً أو يسقط هو
entries.example: Don't drop the glass.

entries.definitionEn: A person who leaves school or college before finishing.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقطع عن الدراسة قبل إتمامها
entries.example: He was a college dropout who later started a business.

entries.definitionEn: A long period with little or no rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: جفاف؛ فترة طويلة يقلّ فيها المطر أو ينقطع
entries.example: The drought lasted all summer.

entries.definitionEn: To die because you are under water and cannot breathe. Also to flood something with too much liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغرق فيموت تحت الماء لانقطاع النفس؛ أو يغمر شيئاً بسائل كثير
entries.example: He cannot swim and is afraid he might drown.

entries.definitionEn: Hard, boring work that has to be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: كدح مملّ لا بدّ من القيام به
entries.example: Filing papers all day felt like drudgery.

entries.definitionEn: A medicine. Also a substance that people take for pleasure, which can be harmful.
entries.arabicMeaning: دواء؛ أو مادة تُتناول للنشوة وقد تضرّ
entries.example: The doctor prescribed a drug for the pain.

entries.definitionEn: A shop, especially in the United States, that sells medicines and everyday goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيدلية أمريكية تبيع أيضاً حاجات يومية
entries.example: I bought toothpaste at the drugstore.

entries.definitionEn: A musical instrument that you hit with your hands or with sticks.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبل؛ آلة موسيقية تُضرب باليد أو بالعصي
entries.example: He played the drum in the school band.

entries.definitionEn: Having drunk so much alcohol that you cannot think or act clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمل؛ قد شرب من الخمر ما يعطّل وضوح الفكر والتصرف
entries.example: He was too drunk to drive.

entries.definitionEn: Not wet. Also with little rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاف غير مبتل؛ أو قليل المطر
entries.example: Hang the wet coat until it is dry.

entries.definitionEn: To make something dry, or to become dry.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجفّف شيئاً أو يجفّ هو
entries.example: Dry your hands on this towel.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows doubt or distrust. Also in a way that is questionable.
entries.arabicMeaning: بريبة أو بعدم ثقة؛ أو على نحو مشكوك فيه
entries.example: She looked at the offer dubiously.

entries.definitionEn: A bird that lives on or near water, with short legs and a wide beak.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطة؛ طائر يعيش عند الماء قصير الساقين عريض المنقار
entries.example: A duck was swimming on the pond.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a man.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: That dude over there is in my class.

entries.definitionEn: Expected to happen, arrive, or be paid at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستحق أو متوقع في موعد معيّن حدوثاً أو وصولاً أو دفعاً
entries.example: The rent is due on the first of the month.

entries.definitionEn: A formal fight between two people, especially with weapons, to settle a dispute. Also a contest between two sides.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبارزة رسمية بين شخصين لحسم نزاع؛ أو مواجهة بين طرفين
entries.example: The two candidates faced each other in a televised duel.

entries.definitionEn: Not interesting or exciting. Also not bright, sharp, or loud.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملّ؛ أو باهت أو غير حادّ أو خافت
entries.example: The lecture was so dull that several people started yawning.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: showing little thought or good sense. Older use: unable to speak.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير حكيم أو أحمق في الاستعمال غير الرسمي؛ وفي استعمال أقدم: غير قادر على الكلام
entries.example: Forgetting the tickets was a dumb mistake.

entries.definitionEn: A place where waste is left. Informal: a dirty or unpleasant place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكبّ للنفايات؛ وفي الاستعمال غير الرسمي مكان قذر أو كريه
entries.example: Old furniture was taken to the town dump.

entries.definitionEn: To put something down carelessly, or to get rid of it, especially waste.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلقي شيئاً بلا عناية أو يتخلّص منه، ولا سيّما النفايات
entries.example: They dumped the broken chairs behind the shed.

entries.definitionEn: An exact copy of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة مطابقة
entries.example: Keep a duplicate of the form for your records.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making an exact copy, or the fact of having two of the same thing when one would do.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل نسخة مطابقة، أو وجود تكرار لا حاجة إليه
entries.example: The new system reduces duplication of work.

entries.definitionEn: Able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out.
entries.arabicMeaning: متين يدوم طويلاً دون أن يتكسّر أو يبلى
entries.example: The jacket is made from a durable fabric that resists rain.

entries.definitionEn: In economics, a product made to last, such as a car or washing machine; often used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الاقتصاد: سلعة معمّرة كسيارة أو غسالة، وغالباً تُستعمل بالجمع
entries.example: Sales of durables rose after the holiday period.

entries.definitionEn: The length of time that something lasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: المدّة التي يستغرقها شيء
entries.example: Guests remained seated for the duration of the speech.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something happens throughout a period of time, or at some point in it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على أن شيئاً يحدث طوال فترة أو في أثنائها
entries.example: Please keep your phone silent during the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Very small dry pieces of dirt that settle on surfaces.
entries.arabicMeaning: غبار
entries.example: There was a layer of dust on the bookshelf.

entries.definitionEn: A container for household waste, especially outside or in a kitchen.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندوق قمامة منزلي
entries.example: She put the empty bottles in the dustbin.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with dust.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغبرّ
entries.example: The unused room felt dry and dusty.

entries.definitionEn: Doing what you should, from a sense of duty rather than from pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤدي واجبه عن شعور بالمسؤولية لا عن رغبة
entries.example: He paid a dutiful visit to his aunt every Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are doing what is expected of you.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يفي بالواجب المتوقع
entries.example: She dutifully completed every form on the list.

entries.definitionEn: Sold without tax, especially at airports, and so often cheaper.
entries.arabicMeaning: معفى من الرسوم الجمركية، ولا سيّما في المطارات
entries.example: She bought duty-free perfume at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: Something you should do because of your job or because it is right. Also a tax on goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: واجب تقتضيه الوظيفة أو الأخلاق؛ وأيضاً ضريبة على السلع
entries.example: It is your duty to report the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A thick, soft cover filled with feathers or similar material, used on a bed.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحاف سميك محشوّ يُفرَش على السرير
entries.example: She pulled the duvet up to her chin.

entries.definitionEn: A disc used to store films, music, or computer data.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرص رقمي لتخزين الأفلام أو الموسيقى أو البيانات
entries.example: We watched a film on DVD last night.

entries.definitionEn: In stories, a small imaginary being. Also a person with dwarfism, a condition that makes someone much shorter than average.
entries.arabicMeaning: في القصص: كائن خيالي صغير الحجم؛ وأيضاً شخص مصاب بالقزامة
entries.example: In the story, a dwarf helps the travellers find the path.

entries.definitionEn: To make something seem small or unimportant by comparison.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل شيئاً يبدو صغيراً أو قليل الشأن بالمقارنة
entries.example: The new tower dwarfs every building around it.

entries.definitionEn: A medical condition in which a person is much shorter than average because of the way the body grows.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة طبية يكون فيها الشخص أقصر كثيراً من المعدّل بسبب نمو الجسم
entries.example: The clinic offers support to families affected by dwarfism.

entries.definitionEn: A substance used to change the colour of hair, cloth, or other material.
entries.arabicMeaning: صبغة تغيّر لون الشعر أو القماش أو غيره
entries.example: She mixed the dye according to the instructions.

entries.definitionEn: Full of energy and new ideas. Also continuously changing, or relating to force and movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بالنشاط والأفكار الجديدة؛ أو دائم التغيّر أو متعلق بالقوة والحركة
entries.example: She is a dynamic speaker who holds the room's attention.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is energetic, or that changes continuously in response to conditions.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفعم بالنشاط أو يتغيّر باستمرار وفق الظروف
entries.example: The software adjusts prices dynamically.

entries.definitionEn: A series of rulers from the same family, or a period when they are in power.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلالة حاكمة من أسرة واحدة، أو عهد حكمها
entries.example: The country was ruled by one dynasty for centuries.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a singular noun to mean every one of two or more things, considered separately.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل اسم مفرد لتعني كلّ واحد من اثنين أو أكثر على حدة
entries.example: Each student received a workbook.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show that each of two or more people does the same thing to the other or others.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير تبادلي يدل على أن كلّ طرف يفعل الشيء نفسه للآخر
entries.example: The two friends emailed each other every week.

entries.definitionEn: Every one of two or more people or things, considered separately.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلّ واحد من اثنين أو أكثر يُنظر إليه على حدة
entries.example: The tickets cost ten pounds each.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting very much to do or have something.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشوّق جداً لفعل شيء أو الحصول عليه
entries.example: The children were eager to open their presents.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows strong interest or desire.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتشوّق شديد
entries.example: She eagerly accepted the invitation.

entries.definitionEn: A strong wish to do or have something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشوّق شديد
entries.example: He showed great eagerness to start the new job.

entries.definitionEn: A large bird of prey with a hooked beak and strong wings.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقاب: طائر جارح كبير ذو منقار معقوف
entries.example: An eagle circled high above the valley.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body on each side of the head that you hear with.
entries.arabicMeaning: أذن
entries.example: She whispered something in his ear.

entries.definitionEn: Pain inside the ear.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم في الأذن
entries.example: The child stayed home because of an earache.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or done near the beginning of a period, or before the usual time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبكر؛ يحدث قرب بداية فترة أو قبل الوقت المعتاد
entries.example: We took an early train to the city.

entries.definitionEn: Before the usual or expected time.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت أبكر من المعتاد أو المتوقع
entries.example: She arrived early for the appointment.

entries.definitionEn: To get money by working. Also to get something because you deserve it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكسب مالاً بالعمل؛ أو ينال شيئاً باستحقاقه
entries.example: He earns a good salary at the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Serious and sincere, not joking.
entries.arabicMeaning: جادّ ومخلص غير هازل
entries.example: She gave an earnest apology for the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Money that a person or company receives from work or business.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيرادات العمل أو النشاط التجاري
entries.example: Her earnings increased after the promotion.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of jewellery worn on the ear.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرط يُلبس في الأذن
entries.example: She lost one earring on the way home.

entries.definitionEn: The planet we live on. Also the soil that plants grow in.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأرض، كوكبنا؛ وأيضاً التراب الذي تنمو فيه النباتات
entries.example: Water is essential for life on earth.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, strong shaking of the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: زلزال
entries.example: The earthquake damaged several old buildings.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of difficulty. Also a calm, comfortable state.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهولة؛ أو حالة من الراحة والاطمئنان
entries.example: She passed the test with ease.

entries.definitionEn: To make something less severe, tight, or difficult. Also to move slowly and carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفّف شدة شيء أو صعوبته؛ أو يتحرّك ببطء وحذر
entries.example: The medicine helped ease the pain.

entries.definitionEn: Without difficulty. Also without doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسهولة؛ أو بلا شكّ
entries.example: You can easily walk to the station from here.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the east; of the eastern part of a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرقي؛ في الشرق أو باتجاهه
entries.example: They live on the east side of the river.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the east.
entries.arabicMeaning: نحو الشرق
entries.example: The plane flew east across the desert.

entries.definitionEn: The direction where the sun rises, or the part of a place that is in that direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشرق: الجهة التي تشرق منها الشمس، أو الجزء الواقع فيها
entries.example: The windows face the east.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the east of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرقي؛ واقع في شرق بلد أو منطقة أو آتٍ منه
entries.example: Snow is common in the eastern mountains.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the east.
entries.arabicMeaning: باتجاه الشرق
entries.example: The storm moved eastward overnight.

entries.definitionEn: Not difficult to do or understand. Also relaxed and comfortable.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل غير عسير؛ أو مريح بلا تكلّف
entries.example: The first exercise is easy.

entries.definitionEn: Relaxed and not easily upset or worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ المزاج لا يغضب أو يقلق بسهولة
entries.example: He is an easygoing neighbour who never complains.

entries.definitionEn: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأكل
entries.example: We eat dinner at seven.

entries.definitionEn: Of a tide: to flow back from the land. Also to become weaker or less.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينحسر المدّ عن اليابسة؛ أو يضعف ويقلّ
entries.example: Support for the plan began to ebb after the costs rose.

entries.definitionEn: Unusual in a way that other people notice, often in behaviour or dress.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب الأطوار على نحو يلفت الانتباه، غالباً في السلوك أو اللباس
entries.example: He had an eccentric habit of wearing two watches.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose behaviour or tastes are unusual in a noticeable way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص غريب الأطوار في سلوكه أو ذوقه
entries.example: The village treated the old eccentric with affection.

entries.definitionEn: In an unusual, noticeable way that is not typical.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غريب غير مألوف يلفت النظر
entries.example: The house was furnished rather eccentrically.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being unusual in behaviour or taste, or a particular unusual habit.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرابة الأطوار في السلوك أو الذوق، أو عادة غير مألوفة بعينها
entries.example: His only eccentricity was to walk everywhere, even in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: A sound heard again after it reflects off a surface. Also a later repetition or reminder of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدى صوت يرتدّ عن سطح؛ أو تكرار لاحق أو أثر يذكّر بشيء
entries.example: Her warning found an echo in later reports.

entries.definitionEn: To send back a sound. Also to repeat or closely resemble an idea, feeling, or statement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يردّ صوتاً؛ أو يكرّر فكرة أو شعوراً أو قولاً أو يشبهه
entries.example: Several speakers echoed her concern about safety.

entries.definitionEn: To find objects by sending out sound and listening for the returning echo, as some animals do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدد مواقع الأشياء بإرسال صوت والاستماع إلى صداه، كما تفعل بعض الحيوانات
entries.example: Bats echolocate insects as they fly at night.

entries.definitionEn: A method of finding objects by sending out sound and judging the returning echo.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحديد المواقع بالصدى عبر إرسال صوت وقياس ما يرتدّ منه
entries.example: Dolphins use echolocation to hunt in dark water.

entries.definitionEn: Choosing from a wide range of styles, ideas, or sources rather than from one only.
entries.arabicMeaning: متنوّع؛ مأخوذ من أساليب أو أفكار أو مصادر شتّى لا من مصدر واحد
entries.example: The playlist was an eclectic mix of jazz and folk.

entries.definitionEn: A person who takes ideas or tastes from many different sources.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يستقي أفكاره أو أذواقه من مصادر شتّى
entries.example: As an eclectic, she refused to follow a single school of design.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that draws on many different styles or sources.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يستمدّ من أساليب أو مصادر متعددة
entries.example: The rooms were furnished eclectically, with old and new pieces together.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: a product or option designed to be less harmful to the environment.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الاستعمال غير الرسمي: منتج أو خيار يُقصد به أن يكون أقل ضرراً بالبيئة
entries.example: They chose the eco even though it cost a little more.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the relationship between living things and their environment, or to protecting it.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيئي؛ متعلق بعلاقة الكائنات بمحيطها أو بحمايته
entries.example: The project studies the ecological effects of the new road.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to ecology or is not harmful to the environment.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية البيئية أو على نحو غير ضار بالبيئة
entries.example: The farm is run as ecologically as possible.

entries.definitionEn: A scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم بيئة يدرس علاقات الكائنات الحية بمحيطها
entries.example: An ecologist measured plant growth along the river.

entries.definitionEn: The study of how living things relate to each other and to their environment. Also those relationships in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم البيئة؛ أو شبكة العلاقات بين الكائنات ومحيطها في مكان معيّن
entries.example: She is studying marine ecology at university.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to trade, industry, and the management of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتصادي؛ متعلق بالتجارة والصناعة وإدارة المال
entries.example: The government announced a new economic plan.

entries.definitionEn: Using money, time, or resources carefully, without waste.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقتصد لا يهدر المال أو الوقت أو الموارد
entries.example: A smaller car is more economical to run.

entries.definitionEn: The study of how money, trade, and industry are organized.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الاقتصاد
entries.example: He took a course in economics.

entries.definitionEn: An expert in economics.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبير اقتصادي
entries.example: The economist explained the rise in prices.

entries.definitionEn: To reduce spending or use of resources in order to save.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقتصد في الإنفاق أو في استعمال الموارد ادّخاراً
entries.example: We had to economize after the rent went up.

entries.definitionEn: The system of trade, industry, and money in a country or area. Also careful use of money or resources.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتصاد بلد أو منطقة؛ وأيضاً الاقتصاد في الإنفاق أو الموارد
entries.example: Tourism is important to the local economy.

entries.definitionEn: All the living things in a place and the environment they share, considered as a system.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظام بيئي يشمل الكائنات الحية في مكان ومحيطها المشترك
entries.example: Pollution can damage a river ecosystem.

entries.definitionEn: Tourism designed to protect natural places and support local people, with as little harm as possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياحة بيئية تُقصد لحماية الطبيعة ودعم السكان المحليين بأقل ضرر ممكن
entries.example: The park promotes ecotourism rather than large hotels.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows extreme happiness or excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: بفرح أو حماس بالغ
entries.example: The crowd cheered ecstatically when the team scored.

entries.definitionEn: The outer limit or border of something. Also a slight advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: حافة الشيء أو حدّه الخارجي؛ أو أفضلية طفيفة
entries.example: She sat on the edge of the bed.

entries.definitionEn: The improvement of someone's mind or character through teaching or example.
entries.arabicMeaning: تهذيب العقل أو الخلق بالتعليم أو القدوة
entries.example: He quoted the poem for our edification, not for show.

entries.definitionEn: A large, impressive building. Also a complex system of ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: صرح كبير مهيّب؛ أو منظومة أفكار معقّدة
entries.example: The courthouse is a stone edifice on the main square.

entries.definitionEn: To improve someone's mind or character, especially through teaching.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثقّف العقل أو يهذّب الخلق، ولا سيّما بالتعليم
entries.example: The lecture was meant to edify as well as inform.

entries.definitionEn: A change made to a text, film, or recording, or a version produced by such changes.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعديل على نص أو فيلم أو تسجيل، أو نسخة ناتجة عن ذلك
entries.example: The final edit of the article was much shorter.

entries.definitionEn: To prepare a text, film, or recording by correcting and arranging it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّر نصاً أو فيلماً أو تسجيلاً بالتصحيح والترتيب
entries.example: She had to edit the report before sending it.

entries.definitionEn: A particular version of a book, newspaper, or other publication.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبعة معيّنة من كتاب أو صحيفة أو منشور
entries.example: I have the latest edition of the dictionary.

entries.definitionEn: A person who prepares a book, newspaper, or film for publication, or who is in charge of its content.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرّر يعدّ كتاباً أو صحيفة أو فيلماً للنشر أو يشرف على محتواه
entries.example: The editor asked for a shorter opening paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: An article in a newspaper or magazine that gives the publication's opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقال افتتاحي يعبّر عن رأي الصحيفة أو المجلة
entries.example: The editorial argued for better public transport.

entries.definitionEn: To teach someone, especially over a long period in a school or similar place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّم شخصاً، ولا سيّما على مدى طويل في مدرسة أو ما يشبهها
entries.example: The programme aims to educate young drivers.

entries.definitionEn: Having had a good education; showing knowledge and good judgment.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلّم نال تعليماً جيداً؛ يظهر معرفة وحسن تقدير
entries.example: She is a highly educated engineer.

entries.definitionEn: The process of teaching and learning, especially in schools.
