entries.arabicMeaning: التعليم؛ عملية التدريس والتعلّم ولا سيّما في المدارس
entries.example: Education is free for children in this country.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with education, or designed to teach you something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعليمي؛ متصل بالتعليم أو مصمّم للتعليم
entries.example: The museum has an educational programme for schools.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to teach, or who is an expert in education.
entries.arabicMeaning: مربّ أو معلّم؛ أو خبير في شؤون التعليم
entries.example: Experienced educators designed the new course.

entries.definitionEn: A change that is caused by something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر أو نتيجة يُحدثها شيء
entries.example: The medicine had a strong effect.

entries.definitionEn: Producing the result that is wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعّال يحقّق النتيجة المطلوبة
entries.example: This method is effective for learning new words.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that produces the result you want. Also in practice, even if not in name.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو فعّال؛ أو في الواقع وإن لم يكن بالاسم
entries.example: She dealt with the complaint effectively.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of producing the result that is wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفعالية في تحقيق النتيجة المطلوبة
entries.example: They tested the effectiveness of the new vaccine.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of doing something well, without wasting time, money, or energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكفاءة في الإنجاز من غير هدر للوقت أو المال أو الطاقة
entries.example: New software improved the efficiency of the office.

entries.definitionEn: Working well without wasting time, money, or energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: كفء لا يهدر وقتاً ولا مالاً ولا طاقة
entries.example: The new heating system is more efficient.

entries.definitionEn: The use of energy or determination to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهد يُبذل لإنجاز شيء
entries.example: She put a lot of effort into the project.

entries.definitionEn: Done with little apparent difficulty, as if it required no strain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدو سهلاً لا يتطلّب عناء ظاهراً
entries.example: He gave an effortless performance at the piano.

entries.definitionEn: Based on the belief that people should have equal rights and opportunities.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائم على مبدأ المساواة في الحقوق والفرص
entries.example: The club had an egalitarian rule that every member could vote.

entries.definitionEn: A person who believes that people should have equal rights and opportunities.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يؤمن بالمساواة في الحقوق والفرص
entries.example: She described herself as an egalitarian in matters of pay.

entries.definitionEn: An oval object laid by a bird, used as food, or the cell from which a young bird or other animal develops.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيضة
entries.example: I had an egg for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A person's sense of their own worth or importance, sometimes too strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور المرء بذاته أو أهميته، وقد يكون مفرطاً
entries.example: The criticism bruised his ego more than he admitted.

entries.definitionEn: The number 8.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمانية؛ العدد 8
entries.example: There are eight chairs around the table.

entries.definitionEn: The number 18.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمانية عشر؛ العدد 18
entries.example: She will be eighteen next month.

entries.definitionEn: The number 80.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمانون؛ العدد 80
entries.example: My grandfather is eighty years old.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a negative statement to mean also not.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بعد جملة منفية بمعنى «أيضاً لا»
entries.example: I don't like coffee, and I don't like tea either.

entries.definitionEn: Used before the first of two choices, with or before the second.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل الخيار الأول من اثنين، ويأتي or قبل الثاني
entries.example: You can either wait here or come with us.

entries.definitionEn: One or the other of two people or things; also each of two.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحد اثنين؛ وقد تعني كلاً من الاثنين
entries.example: There are shops on either side of the street.

entries.definitionEn: One or the other of two people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحدهما من اثنين
entries.example: I have two keys, but either will open the door.

entries.definitionEn: To make a small amount last by using it very carefully. Also to manage to live with difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمدّد مقداراً قليلاً بالاستعمال الشديد للحرص؛ أو يعتاش بصعوبة
entries.example: They had to eke out the last of the rice until payday.

entries.definitionEn: Very detailed and complicated, often with many parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ التفصيل والتعقيد، كثيراً ما يتألف من أجزاء كثيرة
entries.example: The cake was covered in elaborate icing.

entries.definitionEn: To add more detail to an explanation or plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضيف تفصيلاً إلى شرح أو خطة
entries.example: Could you elaborate on that last point?

entries.definitionEn: The addition of more detail, or a more detailed account.
entries.arabicMeaning: إضافة مزيد من التفصيل، أو عرض أكثر تفصيلاً
entries.example: The report needed further elaboration before it could be published.

entries.definitionEn: Able to stretch and then return to its original shape. Also able to change or adapt easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرن يتمدد ثم يعود إلى شكله؛ أو قابل للتكيّف بسهولة
entries.example: The waistband is elastic and comfortable.

entries.definitionEn: A stretchy material, often a band, that returns to its shape after being pulled.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة مطاطية مرنة، غالباً شريط، تعود إلى شكلها بعد الشدّ
entries.example: She tied her hair back with a piece of elastic.

entries.definitionEn: The ability of a material to stretch and return to shape. In economics, how much demand or supply changes when price changes.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرونة المادة في التمدد والعودة؛ وفي الاقتصاد مدى تغيّر الطلب أو العرض مع السعر
entries.example: The economist measured the elasticity of demand.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely happy and excited, often after a success.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد الفرح والحماس، غالباً بعد نجاح
entries.example: She was elated when the exam results arrived.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of great happiness and excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابتهاج شديد وحماس
entries.example: He could not hide his elation at the news.

entries.definitionEn: The joint in the middle of your arm, where it bends.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرفق
entries.example: He leaned on the table with his elbow.

entries.definitionEn: Used as a polite word for people who are old.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسنّ؛ كلمة مهذّبة لكبار السن
entries.example: The bus has seats for elderly passengers.

entries.definitionEn: To choose someone for a position by voting.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتخب شخصاً لمنصب بالتصويت
entries.example: Members will elect a new chair next week.

entries.definitionEn: An occasion when people vote to choose someone for a position.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتخاب؛ مناسبة يصوّت فيها الناس لاختيار شخص لمنصب
entries.example: The election will be held in May.

entries.definitionEn: Chosen rather than required, especially of a course or a medical procedure.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختياري لا إلزامي، ولا سيّما في المقررات أو الإجراءات الطبية
entries.example: She took an elective course in photography.

entries.definitionEn: Using electricity to work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعمل بالكهرباء
entries.example: We bought an electric kettle.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to electricity, or using it.
entries.arabicMeaning: كهربائي؛ متعلق بالكهرباء أو يستخدمها
entries.example: An electrical fault caused the lights to fail.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to fit and repair electrical equipment.
entries.arabicMeaning: كهربائي يركّب الأجهزة الكهربائية ويصلحها
entries.example: We called an electrician to fix the wiring.

entries.definitionEn: A form of energy used for lighting, heating, and making machines work.
entries.arabicMeaning: كهرباء
entries.example: The electricity was off for two hours.

entries.definitionEn: A conductor through which electricity enters or leaves a device, battery, or living tissue.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطب كهربائي يدخل منه التيار أو يخرج من جهاز أو بطارية أو نسيج حي
entries.example: The technician attached an electrode to the patient's chest.

entries.definitionEn: A tiny particle with a negative charge that moves around the nucleus of an atom.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلكترون: دقيقة سالبة الشحنة تدور حول نواة الذرة
entries.example: An electron carries a negative charge.

entries.definitionEn: Using electrical signals, especially in computers and similar devices, rather than mechanical parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلكتروني يعتمد إشارات كهربائية، ولا سيّما في الحواسيب وما شابهها
entries.example: I prefer electronic tickets to paper ones.

entries.definitionEn: By means of electronic equipment or systems.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالوسائل الإلكترونية
entries.example: You can pay the bill electronically.

entries.definitionEn: Electronic devices, or the science and industry that make them.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأجهزة الإلكترونية، أو العلم والصناعة اللذان ينتجانها
entries.example: He studied electronics at college.

entries.definitionEn: Graceful and attractive style in appearance, movement, or design.
entries.arabicMeaning: أناقة ورشاقة في الهيئة أو الحركة أو التصميم
entries.example: The room was furnished with quiet elegance.

entries.definitionEn: Graceful and attractive in appearance or style; also pleasingly simple and effective.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنيق رشيق في الهيئة أو الأسلوب؛ أو بسيط فعّال على نحو مُرضٍ
entries.example: She wore an elegant black dress.

entries.definitionEn: In a graceful, attractive, or pleasingly simple way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأناقة ورشاقة أو ببساطة مُرضية
entries.example: The problem was solved elegantly in a few lines of code.

entries.definitionEn: An important part of something. Also a simple chemical substance such as gold or oxygen.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء مهم من شيء؛ وأيضاً عنصر كيميائي بسيط كالذهب أو الأكسجين
entries.example: Trust is a key element of a good team.

entries.definitionEn: Basic and powerful, like the forces of nature. Also relating to chemical elements.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوّلي قوي كقوى الطبيعة؛ أو متعلق بالعناصر الكيميائية
entries.example: The storm had an elemental force.

entries.definitionEn: Simple and basic. Also relating to the first years of school.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوّلي بسيط؛ أو متعلق بسنوات الدراسة الأولى
entries.example: She is learning elementary English.

entries.definitionEn: A very large animal with a long trunk and thick grey skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيل
entries.example: We saw an elephant at the zoo.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large and heavy, like an elephant; often awkward because of size.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضخم ثقيل كالفيل؛ وغالباً ثقيل الحركة بسبب الحجم
entries.example: He moved the elephantine sofa with great difficulty.

entries.definitionEn: To raise something to a higher position, level, or rank.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع شيئاً إلى موضع أو مستوى أو رتبة أعلى
entries.example: The award helped elevate her career.

entries.definitionEn: Height above a level, especially sea level. Also the act of raising someone or something in rank or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتفاع فوق مستوى معيّن ولا سيّما سطح البحر؛ أو ترقية في الرتبة أو الشأن
entries.example: The village sits at an elevation of 1,200 metres.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that carries people or goods up and down in a building; a lift.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصعد
entries.example: Take the elevator to the third floor.

entries.definitionEn: The number 11.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحد عشر؛ العدد 11
entries.example: There are eleven players in a football team.

entries.definitionEn: Having the right to do or receive something because you meet the conditions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤهّل يستوفي الشروط لنيل شيء أو القيام به
entries.example: You must be over 18 to be eligible for the course.

entries.definitionEn: To remove or get rid of something completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيل شيئاً تماماً أو يتخلّص منه
entries.example: The new design will eliminate the extra step.

entries.definitionEn: A small group of people who have the most wealth, power, or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: نخبة صغيرة تملك أكبر الثروة أو السلطة أو المهارة
entries.example: Only a small elite could afford the private club.

entries.definitionEn: A person who believes that a small group of people deserve more power or respect than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: نخبوي يرى أن فئة صغيرة تستحق من السلطة أو الاحترام أكثر من غيرها
entries.example: She rejected the label of elitist and taught free evening classes.

entries.definitionEn: To make something longer, or to become longer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطيل شيئاً أو يستطيل
entries.example: Stretching will elongate the muscle gently.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to speak or write in a clear, fluent, and persuasive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلاغة: القدرة على الكلام أو الكتابة بوضوح وطلاقة وإقناع
entries.example: The speech was remembered for its eloquence.

entries.definitionEn: Able to express ideas clearly and persuasively in speech or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بليغ يحسن التعبير بإقناع في الكلام أو الكتابة
entries.example: She gave an eloquent defence of the proposal.

entries.definitionEn: Used after words such as someone, what, or anything to mean a different person, thing, or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بعد كلمات مثل someone وwhat وanything بمعنى شخص أو شيء أو مكان آخر
entries.example: Would you like anything else?

entries.definitionEn: In or to another place.
entries.arabicMeaning: في مكان آخر أو إليه
entries.example: If this shop is closed, we can look elsewhere.

entries.definitionEn: To escape from someone or something, especially by being clever or quick. Also of an idea: to be hard to understand or remember.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفلت من شخص أو شيء بالحيلة أو السرعة؛ وقد يعني أن فكرة تصعب على الفهم أو التذكر
entries.example: The meaning of the poem continued to elude him.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to find, catch, remember, or define.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعب المنال أو الإمساك أو التذكر أو التعريف
entries.example: Peace of mind proved elusive after the move.

entries.definitionEn: A message sent by computer from one person to another, or this system of sending messages.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسالة إلكترونية، أو نظام إرسالها
entries.example: I sent her an email this morning.

entries.definitionEn: To send someone a message by email.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل رسالة بالبريد الإلكتروني
entries.example: Please email the form to the office.

entries.definitionEn: To get on a ship, aircraft, or train at the start of a journey. Also to begin a new project or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركب سفينة أو طائرة أو قطاراً في بدء الرحلة؛ أو يشرع في مشروع أو نشاط جديد
entries.example: They will embark on the research project in March.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel awkward or ashamed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحرج شخصاً أو يخجله
entries.example: Please don't embarrass her in front of the class.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling awkward or ashamed.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرج أو خجلان
entries.example: He felt embarrassed when he forgot her name.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel awkward or ashamed.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرج يبعث على الخجل
entries.example: It was an embarrassing mistake, but nobody was angry.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being awkward or ashamed, or something that causes that feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرج أو خجل، أو ما يسبّبه
entries.example: She hid her embarrassment with a laugh.

entries.definitionEn: The group of officials who represent their country abroad, or the building they work in.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفارة: بعثة تمثّل بلدها في الخارج أو المبنى الذي تعمل فيه
entries.example: You may need to contact the embassy for a visa.

entries.definitionEn: To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass. Also to include something as a lasting part of a text, system, or culture.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغرس شيئاً بثبات في وسط يحيط به؛ أو يدرجه جزءاً دائماً في نص أو نظام أو ثقافة
entries.example: The designer will embed the chart in the report.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that represents a quality or idea perfectly.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجسيد حيّ لصفة أو فكرة
entries.example: She was the embodiment of patience during the long wait.

entries.definitionEn: To represent a quality or idea in a clear, visible form.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجسّد صفة أو فكرة في صورة واضحة ملموسة
entries.example: The design embodies the company's wish for simplicity.

entries.definitionEn: The act of holding someone closely in your arms. Also a willing acceptance of an idea or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناق؛ أو قبول راغب لفكرة أو تغيير
entries.example: They met in a warm embrace at the station.

entries.definitionEn: To appear or come out from somewhere. Also to become known.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظهر أو يخرج من مكان؛ أو يتبيّن ويعرف
entries.example: The sun began to emerge from behind the clouds.

entries.definitionEn: The process of coming into view or becoming known.
entries.arabicMeaning: بروز أو ظهور إلى العلن
entries.example: The emergence of new shops changed the street.

entries.definitionEn: A serious, unexpected situation that needs action at once.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة طارئة خطيرة غير متوقعة تستدعي تدخلاً فورياً
entries.example: Call this number in an emergency.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being respected and important, especially in a profession.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكانة رفيعة محترمة ولا سيّما في مهنة
entries.example: He achieved eminence as a heart surgeon.

entries.definitionEn: Famous, respected, and important in a particular field.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارز محترم ذو شأن في ميدانه
entries.example: An eminent historian opened the conference.

entries.definitionEn: Formal: money or other benefit received for work, especially in an official post.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأسلوب الرسمي: أجر أو منفعة تُنال مقابل عمل، ولا سيّما في منصب رسمي
entries.example: The contract listed every emolument attached to the post.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling such as love, anger, or fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاطفة أو شعور قوي كالحب أو الغضب أو الخوف
entries.example: Her voice shook with emotion.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with feelings. Also easily affected by feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاطفي؛ متعلق بالمشاعر أو سريع التأثر بها
entries.example: It was an emotional farewell at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to feelings, or that shows strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية العاطفية أو على نحو يظهر شعوراً قوياً
entries.example: He found it hard to talk emotionally about the past.

entries.definitionEn: The male ruler of an empire.
entries.arabicMeaning: إمبراطور: الحاكم الذكر لإمبراطورية
entries.example: The emperor lived in a vast palace.

entries.definitionEn: Special importance given to something, or extra force given to a word.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأكيد أو اهتمام خاص بشيء، أو نبرة أقوى على كلمة
entries.example: The course puts emphasis on speaking skills.

entries.definitionEn: To give special importance to something, or to say a word with extra force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤكّد أهمية شيء أو ينطق كلمة بنبرة أقوى
entries.example: The teacher emphasized the need to revise every day.

entries.definitionEn: In a strong, clear way that leaves no doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو قاطع واضح لا لبس فيه
entries.example: She emphatically denied the rumour.

entries.definitionEn: A group of countries ruled by one person or government. Also a large group of companies under one control.
entries.arabicMeaning: إمبراطورية: مجموعة بلدان يحكمها شخص أو حكومة؛ أو مجموعة شركات كبيرة تحت إدارة واحدة
entries.example: The museum has maps of the Roman empire.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a job and pay them for it. Also to use something for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوظّف شخصاً ويأجره؛ أو يستخدم شيئاً لغرض معيّن
entries.example: The factory employs two hundred people.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is paid to work for a person or company.
entries.arabicMeaning: موظّف يعمل بأجر لدى شخص أو شركة
entries.example: Each employee receives a staff card.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organization that pays people to work.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب عمل يدفع أجراً لمن يعمل لديه
entries.example: Her employer offered her a training course.

entries.definitionEn: Work that you are paid to do, or the fact of having such work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل مدفوع الأجر، أو حالة الحصول عليه
entries.example: He is looking for full-time employment.

entries.definitionEn: Containing nothing; with no people or things inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: فارغ لا يحتوي شيئاً ولا أحداً
entries.example: The bottle was empty.

entries.definitionEn: To try to equal or copy someone or something you admire, often by matching their methods or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحاكي شخصاً أو شيئاً يُعجب به سعياً لمماثلته في الأسلوب أو الجودة
entries.example: Young designers often emulate the work of earlier masters.

entries.definitionEn: The act of trying to equal or copy someone or something admired. Also, in computing, the imitation of one system by another.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاكاة من يُعجب به سعياً لمماثلته؛ وفي الحوسبة تقليد نظام لنظام آخر
entries.example: Friendly emulation among the students raised the standard of the essays.

entries.definitionEn: The process of mixing two liquids that do not easily combine, such as oil and water, into a stable mixture.
entries.arabicMeaning: استحلاب: مزج سائلين لا يختلطان بسهولة كالزيت والماء في خليط ثابت
entries.example: Emulsification keeps the dressing from separating.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that helps two liquids mix and stay mixed.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل استحلاب يساعد سائلين على الامتزاج والبقاء ممتزجين
entries.example: The recipe uses egg yolk as an emulsifier.

entries.definitionEn: To mix two liquids that do not easily combine into a stable mixture, or to undergo that process.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحلب سائلين عسيري الاختلاط في خليط ثابت، أو يحدث له ذلك
entries.example: Whisk the oil slowly so that it will emulsify with the vinegar.

entries.definitionEn: To make it possible for someone to do something, or for something to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمكّن شخصاً من فعل شيء أو يجعل حدوث شيء ممكناً
entries.example: The grant will enable the school to buy new books.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that makes something possible. Also someone who unintentionally helps another person continue harmful behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو شيء يجعل أمراً ممكناً؛ وأيضاً من يساعد غيره من غير قصد على استمرار سلوك ضار
entries.example: Cheap data plans were an enabler of mobile learning.

entries.definitionEn: To surround something on all sides. Also to put something in the same envelope or package as a letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيط بشيء من كل الجهات؛ أو يرفق شيئاً في الظرف أو الطرد مع الرسالة
entries.example: Please enclose a copy of your passport with the form.

entries.definitionEn: To include a wide range of things, or to surround an area completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمل نطاقاً واسعاً من الأشياء، أو يحيط بمنطقة إحاطة تامة
entries.example: The survey will encompass every department in the firm.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting with someone, especially by chance. Also an unexpected experience, often a difficult one.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقاء غير متوقع؛ أو مواجهة تجربة صعبة
entries.example: She had a brief encounter with an old colleague at the station.

entries.definitionEn: To meet someone or something unexpectedly, or to come up against a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصادف شخصاً أو شيئاً على غير توقع، أو يواجه مشكلة
entries.example: They encountered strong winds on the way back.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone support or confidence so they feel able to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشجّع شخصاً ويمنحه الثقة
entries.example: My teacher encouraged me to try again.

entries.definitionEn: Words or actions that give someone confidence and support.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشجيع يمنح الثقة والدعم
entries.example: A little encouragement helped her finish the race.

entries.definitionEn: Giving you hope or confidence that something good will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُشجّع يبعث الأمل أو الثقة
entries.example: The first test results were encouraging.

entries.definitionEn: To weigh someone down or restrict movement or action, especially with a burden or obligation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُثقل الحركة أو يقيّد الفعل بعبء أو التزام
entries.example: Heavy bags encumbered the climbers on the steep path.

entries.definitionEn: Something that burdens, obstructs, or restricts a person or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبء أو عائق يقيّد الحركة أو العمل
entries.example: The extra equipment became an encumbrance on the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: A book, set of books, or online work that gives information on many subjects.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسوعة تعرض معلومات في موضوعات كثيرة
entries.example: She looked the river up in an encyclopedia.

entries.definitionEn: The last part of something; the point where it stops.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهاية الشيء
entries.example: This is the end of the story.

entries.definitionEn: To stop, or to make something stop or finish.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتهي أو يُنهي شيئاً
entries.example: The meeting ended at five.

entries.definitionEn: To put someone or something in a situation where they may be harmed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرّض شخصاً أو شيئاً للخطر
entries.example: Pollution can endanger wildlife.

entries.definitionEn: At risk of disappearing or being harmed, especially a type of animal or plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهدَّد بالانقراض أو بالضرر
entries.example: The panda is an endangered animal.

entries.definitionEn: A serious attempt to do something, especially something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسعى جاد لإنجاز أمر صعب
entries.example: The research was a long scientific endeavor.

entries.definitionEn: The last part of a story, film, or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهاية قصة أو فيلم أو حدث
entries.example: I liked the ending of the book.

entries.definitionEn: Having no end, or seeming to go on for a very long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا نهاية له، أو يبدو أنه يمتد وقتاً طويلاً
entries.example: They waited in an endless line.

entries.definitionEn: Without stopping, or for a very long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا توقف أو لوقت طويل جداً
entries.example: He talked endlessly about his trip.

entries.definitionEn: To say publicly that you support or approve of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤيد علناً شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: Several doctors endorsed the new health advice.

entries.definitionEn: A public statement of support or approval.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأييد علني
entries.example: The campaign gained an important endorsement from the union.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to keep doing something difficult for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة على التحمّل والاستمرار في أمر شاق
entries.example: The race tests both speed and endurance.

entries.definitionEn: To experience something painful or difficult for a long time without giving up.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحمّل أمراً شاقاً أو مؤلماً فترة طويلة
entries.example: She had to endure a long wait at the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a long time; continuing despite difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائم يستمر زمناً طويلاً رغم الصعاب
entries.example: They share an enduring friendship.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that lasts or continues to have an effect over a long period.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو دائم الأثر عبر الزمن
entries.example: The novel remains enduringly popular.

entries.definitionEn: A person, group, or country that is against you and wants to harm you.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدو
entries.example: The two countries were once enemies.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of energy; active and lively.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشيط مليء بالحيوية
entries.example: The children are very energetic in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: The strength to be active in body or mind. Also power from sources such as electricity, fuel, or the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاقة للنشاط الجسدي أو الذهني؛ أو قدرة مستمدّة من الكهرباء أو الوقود أو الشمس
entries.example: Solar energy can heat the building.

entries.definitionEn: To make sure that a law or rule is followed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرض تطبيق قانون أو قاعدة
entries.example: The police enforce the speed limit.

entries.definitionEn: To take part in something, or to attract and hold someone's interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشارك في أمر أو يستحوذ على اهتمام شخص
entries.example: The speaker engaged the audience from the first minute.

entries.definitionEn: Busy with something. Also having formally agreed to get married.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشغول بأمر؛ أو مرتبط بخطبة زواج
entries.example: Sorry, she is engaged on another call.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement to do something at a particular time. Also a formal agreement to marry, or involvement in an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: موعد ملتزَم به؛ أو خطبة زواج؛ أو انخراط في نشاط
entries.example: She has a prior engagement this evening.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to arise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يولّد شعوراً أو وضعاً
entries.example: The speech engendered a sense of hope.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that produces power to make a vehicle or other machine work.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرّك
entries.example: The car's engine would not start.

entries.definitionEn: A person who designs, builds, or looks after machines, roads, or buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهندس
entries.example: My brother is an engineer.

entries.definitionEn: To design and build something using technical skill. Also to arrange a situation cleverly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصمّم ويبني بمهارة تقنية؛ أو يدبّر وضعاً ببراعة
entries.example: They engineered a quieter cooling system.

entries.definitionEn: The work of designing and building machines, roads, bridges, and similar things.
entries.arabicMeaning: هندسة؛ عمل تصميم وبناء الآلات والطرق والجسور
entries.example: She studied engineering at university.

entries.definitionEn: A man from England.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل إنجليزي
entries.example: An Englishman sat next to us on the train.

entries.definitionEn: To occupy someone's full attention so they notice little else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستغرق انتباه شخص تماماً
entries.example: The novel engrossed her for hours.

entries.definitionEn: So interesting that it holds your full attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: شائق يستحوذ على الانتباه بالكامل
entries.example: It was an engrossing documentary.

entries.definitionEn: To surround and cover something completely, often suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيط بشيء ويغطّيه تماماً، غالباً على نحو مفاجئ
entries.example: Smoke engulfed the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: To improve the quality, value, or attractiveness of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحسّن جودة الشيء أو قيمته أو جاذبيته
entries.example: Good lighting can enhance a photograph.

entries.definitionEn: To like doing something; to get pleasure from it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستمتع بشيء
entries.example: I enjoy walking in the park.

entries.definitionEn: Giving pleasure; pleasant to do or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتع
entries.example: We had an enjoyable meal together.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of pleasure you get from doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعة؛ شعور باللذة من فعل شيء
entries.example: She takes great enjoyment in cooking.

entries.definitionEn: Very large in size or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: هائل الحجم أو المقدار
entries.example: They live in an enormous house.

entries.definitionEn: To a very great degree; extremely.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى درجة عظيمة جداً
entries.example: The city has changed enormously in ten years.

entries.definitionEn: To the degree that is needed; as much as is necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: بما يكفي؛ بالقدر المطلوب
entries.example: She is old enough to travel alone.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to say that the amount is as much as is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: كافٍ؛ يستعمل قبل الاسم للدلالة على بلوغ المقدار المطلوب
entries.example: We have enough time to finish.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to mean the amount that is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يكفي؛ يقوم مقام الاسم للدلالة على المقدار المطلوب
entries.example: I have had enough, thank you.

entries.definitionEn: To improve something by adding to it, or to make someone richer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثري شيئاً بالإضافة إليه، أو يغني شخصاً
entries.example: Travel can enrich your understanding of the world.

entries.definitionEn: To put your name on an official list in order to join a course, school, or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسجّل اسمه للالتحاق بدورة أو مدرسة أو منظمة
entries.example: She plans to enroll in an evening class.

entries.definitionEn: To make certain that something happens or is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضمن حدوث شيء أو صحته
entries.example: Please ensure that the door is locked.

entries.definitionEn: To go into a place. Also to take part in a competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدخل مكاناً؛ أو يشترك في مسابقة
entries.example: Please enter through the side door.

entries.definitionEn: A business or project, especially one that involves some risk. Also the willingness to start new, often bold, activities.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروع فيه شيء من المخاطرة؛ أو روح المبادرة
entries.example: The family runs a small catering enterprise.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to try new, clever, or somewhat bold plans, especially in business.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبادر وجريء في تجريب خطط جديدة
entries.example: An enterprising neighbour started a repair service.

entries.definitionEn: To interest and amuse people. Also to have people as guests.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسلي الناس ويؤنسهم؛ أو يستضيف ضيوفاً
entries.example: The magician entertained the children.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to amuse people, for example a singer or comedian.
entries.arabicMeaning: فنّان ترفيه يؤدي لإمتاع الجمهور
entries.example: The entertainer told jokes between songs.

entries.definitionEn: Amusing and interesting.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلٍّ شائق
entries.example: The talk was short and entertaining.

entries.definitionEn: Shows, films, music, and other things that people watch or listen to for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترفيه من عروض وأفلام وموسيقى
entries.example: The hotel offers evening entertainment.

entries.definitionEn: To talk about something with strong excitement, or to fill someone with that excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحدث بحماسة شديدة عن شيء أو يُشعل الحماسة في غيره
entries.example: She enthused about the new gallery.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of interest and excitement about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماسة واهتمام شديد
entries.example: His enthusiasm for cooking is obvious.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاوٍ شديد الاهتمام بنشاط أو موضوع
entries.example: He is a railway enthusiast.

entries.definitionEn: Showing a lot of excitement and interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: متحمّس
entries.example: The team gave an enthusiastic welcome.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows strong excitement and interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحماسة ظاهرة
entries.example: The crowd clapped enthusiastically.

entries.definitionEn: Whole; complete, with nothing left out.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامل بأكمله دون نقص
entries.example: She spent the entire afternoon reading.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; in every way.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً من كل وجه
entries.example: I am not entirely sure of the time.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone the right to have or do something. Also to give a title to a book or other work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنح حقاً في شيء؛ أو يضع عنواناً لعمل
entries.example: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.

entries.definitionEn: The door or opening where you go into a place. Also the act of going in.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدخل المكان؛ أو فعل الدخول
entries.example: Wait for me at the main entrance.

entries.definitionEn: A person who starts a business and takes on its risks in the hope of profit.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائد أعمال يبدأ مشروعاً ويتحمّل مخاطره
entries.example: The entrepreneur opened three cafés in two years.

entries.definitionEn: The act of going in, or the right to go in. Also something written in a list, diary, or dictionary.
entries.arabicMeaning: دخول أو حق الدخول؛ أو بند مكتوب في قائمة أو دفتر
entries.example: There is a separate entry for each date.

entries.definitionEn: A flat paper cover for a letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف رسالة
entries.example: She put the card in an envelope.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that others would wish to have; so fortunate or attractive as to invite envy.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُغبط عليه ويدعو إلى التمني
entries.example: She had secured an enviable seat by the window.

entries.definitionEn: The natural world of land, water, air, and living things. Also the conditions around a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيئة الطبيعية؛ أو الظروف المحيطة بشخص أو مكان
entries.example: We must protect the environment.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the natural world and the effects of human activity on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيئي؛ متعلق بالطبيعة وأثر النشاط البشري فيها
entries.example: The report discusses environmental damage.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works to protect the natural world.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشط بيئي يعمل على حماية الطبيعة
entries.example: The environmentalist spoke about cleaner rivers.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to, or affects, the natural world.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية البيئية أو بما يؤثّر في الطبيعة
entries.example: The factory is not environmentally safe.

entries.definitionEn: Designed or done so as to cause little harm to the natural world.
entries.arabicMeaning: صديق للبيئة؛ قليل الضرر بالطبيعة
entries.example: They switched to environmentally friendly cleaning products.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of wanting what someone else has.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسد أو غبطة لما يملكه غيرك
entries.example: He looked at their garden with envy.

entries.definitionEn: To wish that you had something that someone else has.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغبط شخصاً أو يحسده على ما يملك
entries.example: I envy her calm at work.

entries.definitionEn: Things made to last only a short time, such as tickets, posters, or leaflets, often kept as a collection.
entries.arabicMeaning: مواد عابرة كالتذاكر والملصقات، تُحفظ أحياناً كمجموعات
entries.example: The museum displays theatre ephemera from the 1920s.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a very short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: عابر لا يدوم إلا قليلاً
entries.example: Fame of that kind is often ephemeral.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of lasting only a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفة الزوال وقصر الأمد
entries.example: The poem dwells on the ephemerality of spring blossom.

entries.definitionEn: One part of a television or radio series. Also a single event in a longer story.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلقة من مسلسل؛ أو واقعة ضمن سياق أطول
entries.example: I watched the last episode last night.

entries.definitionEn: A strong adhesive or coating made from a synthetic resin that hardens when mixed.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيبوكسي: راتنج صناعي قوي يُستخدم لاصقاً أو طلاءً
entries.example: He sealed the crack with epoxy.

entries.definitionEn: Calm and even-tempered; not easily upset. Also, of climate, without extreme changes.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ المزاج لا يضطرب بسهولة؛ وقد يوصف به مناخ معتدل بلا تطرف
entries.example: She remained equable under pressure.

entries.definitionEn: The same in size, number, value, or status.
entries.arabicMeaning: متساوٍ في الحجم أو العدد أو القيمة أو المكانة
entries.example: The two rooms are equal in size.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has the same ability, rights, or status as another.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندّ يساوي غيره قدرة أو مكانة
entries.example: She treats her staff as equals.

entries.definitionEn: To be the same as something in number, size, or value.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساوي شيئاً عدداً أو حجماً أو قيمة
entries.example: Three plus five equals eight.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being equal, especially in rights, status, or opportunities.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساواة في الحقوق أو المكانة أو الفرص
entries.example: The law supports equality at work.

entries.definitionEn: To the same degree; in the same way or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: على قدم المساواة؛ بالقدر نفسه
entries.example: The prize money was divided equally.

entries.definitionEn: A mathematical statement that two amounts or expressions are equal.
entries.arabicMeaning: معادلة رياضية تقول بتساوي مقدارين
entries.example: Solve the equation for x.

entries.definitionEn: A balanced state in which opposing forces or influences are equal. Also mental or emotional stability.
entries.arabicMeaning: توازن بين قوى متضادة؛ أو اتزان نفسي
entries.example: The market returned to equilibrium after the shock.

entries.definitionEn: To provide someone or something with the tools or skills needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزوّد شخصاً أو شيئاً بما يلزم من أدوات أو مهارات
entries.example: The lab is equipped with new computers.

entries.definitionEn: The set of tools, machines, or other things needed for an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدّات لازمة لنشاط ما
entries.example: You can hire climbing equipment here.

entries.definitionEn: Fairness in the way people are treated. Also the value of a share in a property or company after debts.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنصاف في المعاملة؛ أو حصة ملكية في عقار أو شركة بعد خصم الديون
entries.example: She bought equity in the family firm.

entries.definitionEn: A long period of time with a particular character in history.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقبة زمنية ذات طابع مميز
entries.example: The photograph belongs to a different era.

entries.definitionEn: Upright; standing straight rather than leaning or lying down.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتصب قائم باستقامة
entries.example: He sat with his back erect.

entries.definitionEn: A mistake.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطأ
entries.example: There is an error in this bill.

entries.definitionEn: Of a volcano, to send out rock, ash, or lava. Also to break out suddenly, as a conflict or strong feeling may.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثور بركاناً؛ أو ينفجر فجأة نزاع أو انفعال
entries.example: The volcano erupted without much warning.

entries.definitionEn: The act of erupting, especially of a volcano. Also a sudden outbreak.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثوران بركان؛ أو اندلاع مفاجئ
entries.example: Ash from the eruption covered the town.

entries.definitionEn: A moving staircase that carries people between floors.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلم متحرك
entries.example: Take the escalator to the second floor.

entries.definitionEn: The act of getting away from a place or a dangerous situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرار أو نجاة من مكان أو خطر
entries.example: The film is about a prison escape.

entries.definitionEn: To get away from a place or a dangerous situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرّ أو ينجو من مكان أو خطر
entries.example: Two passengers escaped from the burning bus.

entries.definitionEn: More than usual, or more than in other cases; particularly.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصوصاً؛ أكثر من المعتاد أو من غيره
entries.example: I like fruit, especially apples.

entries.definitionEn: A short piece of writing on a subject, often for school or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقالة قصيرة غالباً لأغراض الدراسة
entries.example: She wrote an essay about her hometown.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes essays, especially as a literary form.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب مقالات أدبية
entries.example: The essayist is known for quiet, careful prose.

entries.definitionEn: The most important quality or meaning of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهر الشيء وأهم ما فيه
entries.example: Trust is the essence of a good partnership.

entries.definitionEn: Completely necessary; of the greatest importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساسي لا غنى عنه
entries.example: Water is essential for life.

entries.definitionEn: In the most important or basic way; basically.
entries.arabicMeaning: في جوهر الأمر؛ أساساً
entries.example: The two plans are essentially the same.

entries.definitionEn: To start something that will last, such as a company or a school.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤسس شيئاً يدوم كشركة أو مدرسة
entries.example: They established a small shop in 2010.

entries.definitionEn: An organization, business, or institution. Also the act of starting one.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤسسة أو منشأة؛ أو فعل تأسيسها
entries.example: The hotel is a well-run establishment.

entries.definitionEn: A large area of land, often with a large house. Also all of a person's property, or a group of houses built together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيعة واسعة؛ أو تركة شخص؛ أو مجمع سكني
entries.example: They walked around the country estate.

entries.definitionEn: A judgment of the size, cost, or value of something, not an exact figure.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدير تقريبي للحجم أو التكلفة أو القيمة
entries.example: The builder gave us an estimate for the roof.

entries.definitionEn: To judge the size, cost, or amount of something without measuring it exactly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر الحجم أو التكلفة أو المقدار دون قياس دقيق
entries.example: I estimate it will take two hours.

entries.definitionEn: Judged approximately rather than measured exactly.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدَّر على وجه التقريب لا القياس الدقيق
entries.example: The estimated cost is too high.

entries.definitionEn: A judgment or opinion of the value, size, or quality of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدير أو رأي في قيمة الشيء أو حجمه أو جودته
entries.example: In my estimation, the plan will work.

entries.definitionEn: To cut a design into a hard surface with acid or a sharp tool. Also to fix something very clearly in the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفر رسماً على سطح صلب بحمض أو أداة؛ أو يرسّخ صورة في الذهن
entries.example: The artist etched a fine line into the plate.

entries.definitionEn: A picture made by cutting a design into a metal plate and printing from it.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة مطبوعة من لوح معدني محفور
entries.example: An etching of the harbour hung in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting forever, or seeming to last forever.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبدي، أو يبدو أنه لا ينتهي
entries.example: They swore eternal friendship.

entries.definitionEn: Forever, or for a very long time. Also used to emphasize lasting thanks or a continuing state.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأبد أو لزمن طويل جداً
entries.example: I am eternally grateful for your help.

entries.definitionEn: Time without end. Also a period that feels extremely long.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأبد؛ أو مدة تبدو لا تنتهي
entries.example: The wait felt like an eternity.

entries.definitionEn: A set of moral principles about how a person or group should behave.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظومة مبادئ أخلاقية تحكم السلوك
entries.example: She has a strong work ethic.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to beliefs about right and wrong. Also morally acceptable.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخلاقي؛ متعلق بالصواب والخطأ أو موافق لهما
entries.example: They asked an ethical question about the research.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is morally right, or that relates to moral principles.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو أخلاقي سليم أو من زاوية الأخلاق
entries.example: The company claims to source materials ethically.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a group of people who share a culture, language, or origin.
entries.arabicMeaning: إثني؛ متعلق بجماعة تشترك في ثقافة أو لغة أو أصل
entries.example: The festival celebrates ethnic music from the region.

entries.definitionEn: The characteristic spirit, values, and attitudes of a person, group, or institution.
entries.arabicMeaning: روح جماعة أو مؤسسة وقيمها السائدة
entries.example: The school's ethos stresses kindness and effort.

entries.definitionEn: A milder or less direct word or phrase used instead of one that may shock or upset.
entries.arabicMeaning: كناية مُلطِّفة تغني عن لفظ خشن أو محرج
entries.example: Passed away is a common euphemism for death.

entries.definitionEn: Using, or of the nature of, a milder word in place of a harsher one.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنائي مُلطِّف في التعبير
entries.example: The report used euphemistic language about the cuts.

entries.definitionEn: In a milder, less direct way of speaking.
entries.arabicMeaning: على سبيل التلطيف في القول
entries.example: The job was euphemistically described as a restructuring.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of intense happiness and excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشوة غامرة من الفرح والحماسة
entries.example: A wave of euphoria followed the final whistle.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing intense happiness and excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغمور بنشوة الفرح
entries.example: The crowd was euphoric after the win.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows intense happiness and excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنشوة فرح غامرة
entries.example: They celebrated euphorically in the street.

entries.definitionEn: The unit of money used in many European countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليورو؛ وحدة نقدية في بلدان أوروبية كثيرة
entries.example: The ticket costs twenty euros.

entries.definitionEn: To move people from a dangerous place to a safer one.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُخلي الناس من مكان خطر إلى مكان آمن
entries.example: Police asked residents to evacuate the building.

entries.definitionEn: The act of moving people from a dangerous place to safety.
entries.arabicMeaning: إخلاء الناس من مكان خطر
entries.example: The evacuation took less than an hour.

entries.definitionEn: To judge the quality, value, or importance of something after careful thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقيّم جودة الشيء أو قيمته أو أهميته بعد تروٍّ
entries.example: Teachers evaluate students' written work.

entries.definitionEn: A careful judgment of the quality, value, or importance of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقييم متأنٍّ للجودة أو القيمة أو الأهمية
entries.example: The course ends with a written evaluation.

entries.definitionEn: Flat and level. Also equal on each side, or of a number that can be divided by two.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستوٍ؛ أو متعادل؛ أو زوجي ينقسم على اثنين
entries.example: The table has an even surface.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize something surprising, or to add a stronger point.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتى؛ تُستعمل لتوكيد أمر مفاجئ أو أقوى
entries.example: She cannot even remember his name.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the day after the afternoon and before night.
entries.arabicMeaning: المساء
entries.example: I will call you this evening.

entries.definitionEn: In an equal way, with the same amount for each. Also smoothly, without sudden changes.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالتساوي؛ أو بسلاسة دون تغيّر حاد
entries.example: Spread the paint evenly.

entries.definitionEn: Something that happens, especially something important or planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدث، وخصوصاً إن كان مهماً أو منظَّماً
entries.example: The school has an event on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: After a period of time, especially after delay or difficulty; in the end.
entries.arabicMeaning: في النهاية بعد مدة أو صعوبة
entries.example: We eventually found the right street.

entries.definitionEn: At any time. Used in questions, negatives, and with if.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أي وقت؛ تُستعمل في السؤال والنفي ومع إذا
entries.example: Have you ever been to Lisbon?

entries.definitionEn: Lasting forever, or for a very long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبدي أو يدوم زمناً طويلاً جداً
entries.example: They hoped for everlasting peace between the families.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to talk about all the people or things in a group, one by one.
entries.arabicMeaning: كل؛ تستعمل للحديث عن جميع أفراد المجموعة واحداً واحداً
entries.example: Every student has a book.

entries.definitionEn: Every person; all people.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجميع؛ كل شخص
entries.example: Everybody was quiet.

entries.definitionEn: Ordinary; used or happening each day.
entries.arabicMeaning: يومي عادي
entries.example: These are my everyday shoes.

entries.definitionEn: Every person; all people.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجميع؛ كل شخص
entries.example: Everyone enjoyed the meal.

entries.definitionEn: All things; all that is involved.
entries.arabicMeaning: كل شيء
entries.example: Everything is ready for the guests.

entries.definitionEn: In or to all places.
entries.arabicMeaning: في كل مكان
entries.example: I looked everywhere for my keys.

entries.definitionEn: Facts or signs that show whether something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل أو بيّنة تُظهر صدق أمر أو عدمه
entries.example: There is no evidence of damage.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see or understand; clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: واضح بيّن
entries.example: It was evident that she was tired.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is clear to see; apparently.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو واضح؛ أو بحسب الظاهر
entries.example: He was evidently pleased with the result.

entries.definitionEn: Morally very bad; intending to harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرير بالغ السوء
entries.example: The story has an evil king.

entries.definitionEn: Very bad or harmful behaviour; something morally wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشر؛ سلوك بالغ الأذى
entries.example: They spoke of the evil of cruelty.

entries.definitionEn: To bring a feeling, memory, or image into the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحضر شعوراً أو ذكرى أو صورة في الذهن
entries.example: The smell of rain evoked her childhood.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that brings feelings, memories, or images strongly to mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يستحضر المشاعر أو الذكريات بقوة
entries.example: The film was evokingly shot in winter light.

entries.definitionEn: The gradual development of living things over a very long time. Also gradual change in ideas, systems, or designs.
entries.arabicMeaning: تطوّر الكائنات عبر الزمن؛ أو تغيّر تدريجي في الأفكار أو النظم
entries.example: The evolution of the phone has been rapid.

entries.definitionEn: To develop gradually, especially from a simpler to a more complex form.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتطور تدريجياً وخصوصاً من صورة أبسط إلى أعقد
entries.example: Her style evolved over many years.

entries.definitionEn: A female sheep.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعجة؛ أنثى الخروف
entries.example: The ewe stayed close to her lamb.

entries.definitionEn: Completely correct and accurate; neither more nor less.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقيق تماماً
entries.example: I need the exact time of arrival.

entries.definitionEn: To demand and obtain something, often by force or pressure, such as payment or a penalty.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتزع مالاً أو عقوبة أو التزاماً بالقوة أو الضغط
entries.example: The contract exacted strict conditions from both sides.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize that something is completely correct or precise. Also used to agree.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ للتوكيد على الدقة أو للموافقة
entries.example: It is exactly three o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being completely accurate and precise.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقة تامة
entries.example: The work demands exactness.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making something seem larger, better, or worse than it really is.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبالغة تجعل الأمر أكبر أو أسوأ مما هو في الحقيقة
entries.example: His friends told him not to exaggerate the story.

entries.definitionEn: A statement or description that makes something seem more than it really is.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبالغة في القول أو الوصف
entries.example: Saying the bag weighed a ton was an exaggeration.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone or something highly, or to raise them in rank or honour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمجّد شخصاً أو شيئاً أو يرفع منزلته
entries.example: The poem exalts ordinary kindness.

entries.definitionEn: Of high rank, status, or moral standing.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفيع المقام أو المنزلة
entries.example: He rose to an exalted position in the firm.

entries.definitionEn: In a manner that shows high praise, lofty feeling, or elevated status.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مشوب بالتمجيد أو السمو
entries.example: She spoke exaltedly of her former teacher.

entries.definitionEn: A formal test of knowledge or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: امتحان
entries.example: I have an English exam tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: A close look at something. Also a formal test.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحص دقيق؛ أو امتحان رسمي
entries.example: The doctor completed a careful examination.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something carefully. Also to test someone's knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفحص شيئاً بعناية؛ أو يختبر معرفة شخص
entries.example: The mechanic examined the engine.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is taking an exam.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتحَن يؤدي اختباراً
entries.example: Each examinee was given two hours.

entries.definitionEn: A person who sets or marks an exam, or who inspects something officially.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتحِن يضع الاختبار أو يصحّحه؛ أو مفتش رسمي
entries.example: The examiner asked a few extra questions.

entries.definitionEn: Something that shows what other things of the same kind are like.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثال يوضح نوع الشيء
entries.example: Can you give me an example?

entries.definitionEn: To go beyond a number, limit, or expected amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجاوز عدداً أو حداً أو مقداراً متوقعاً
entries.example: Do not exceed the speed limit.

entries.definitionEn: To be very good at something, better than most people.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفوّق في شيء على معظم الناس
entries.example: She excels at languages.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being extremely good.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفوّق وجودة بالغة
entries.example: The school is known for academic excellence.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتاز
entries.example: The food was excellent.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the only thing that is not included, often with that.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلا أنّ؛ تُستعمل لاستثناء الحالة الوحيدة
entries.example: I would come, except that I am working.

entries.definitionEn: Not including; apart from.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدا؛ باستثناء
entries.example: Everyone went except Tom.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that is not included in a general rule or statement.
entries.arabicMeaning: استثناء من قاعدة عامة
entries.example: There is an exception to every rule.

entries.definitionEn: Unusually good, or unusual in a way that is not typical.
entries.arabicMeaning: استثنائي الجودة أو غير مألوف
entries.example: She showed exceptional skill for her age.

entries.definitionEn: To an unusual degree; unusually.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو استثنائي
entries.example: It has been exceptionally cold this week.

entries.definitionEn: More than is needed, usual, or allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيادة فوق الحاجة أو الحد المسموح
entries.example: Cut off the excess before you sew.

entries.definitionEn: More than is reasonable or necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط يتجاوز المعقول أو اللازم
entries.example: The noise was excessive after ten.

entries.definitionEn: The act of giving one thing and receiving another. Also a short conversation.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبادل شيء بشيء؛ أو حوار قصير
entries.example: We had a friendly exchange of ideas.

entries.definitionEn: The value of one country's money compared with another's.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعر صرف عملة مقابل أخرى
entries.example: The exchange rate has changed this month.

entries.definitionEn: To give something and receive something else in return.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتبادل شيئاً بشيء آخر
entries.example: They exchanged phone numbers.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling very happy and eager about something that is going to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متحمّس سعيد بشيء سيحدث
entries.example: The children are excited about the trip.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are very happy and eager.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحماسة ظاهرة من الفرح والتوق
entries.example: She spoke excitedly about the news.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being happy, eager, and full of energy because something good is happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: إثارة وحماسة من حدث سارّ
entries.example: There was great excitement in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel happy, eager, and full of energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير للحماسة والسعادة
entries.example: It was an exciting game.

entries.definitionEn: To say something suddenly and loudly because of a strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهتف فجأة بصوت عالٍ لانفعال قوي
entries.example: "Look at that!" she exclaimed.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark (!) used after a strong or sudden remark.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة التعجب (!)
entries.example: Put an exclamation mark at the end.

entries.definitionEn: To keep someone or something out; to not include them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستبعد شخصاً أو شيئاً ولا يُدخله
entries.example: The price excludes drinks.

entries.definitionEn: The act of keeping someone or something out, or the state of being left out.
entries.arabicMeaning: إقصاء أو استبعاد
entries.example: His exclusion from the team surprised us.

entries.definitionEn: Limited to a particular person or group; not shared. Also high-class and expensive.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصري لجماعة معيّنة؛ أو راقٍ باهظ
entries.example: This club is exclusive; only members may enter.

entries.definitionEn: Only; involving no one and nothing else.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصرياً دون سواه
entries.example: The room is used exclusively for meetings.

entries.definitionEn: A short trip, often for pleasure, taken by a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة قصيرة للمتعة غالباً مع جماعة
entries.example: We went on a boat excursion.

entries.definitionEn: A reason you give to explain a mistake or why you cannot do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عذر
entries.example: She had a good excuse for being late.

entries.definitionEn: To forgive someone for a small mistake, or to give a reason that tries to justify it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعذر شخصاً على هفوة، أو يقدّم مبرّراً
entries.example: Please excuse me for arriving late.

entries.definitionEn: To carry out a plan, order, or piece of work. In law, it can also mean to put someone to death as punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفّذ خطة أو أمراً؛ وفي القانون قد يعني إعدام شخص
entries.example: The team executed the plan on schedule.

entries.definitionEn: The act of carrying out a plan or task. Also the legal killing of a person as punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنفيذ خطة أو مهمة؛ وقد يعني الإعدام بحكم القانون
entries.example: Poor execution delayed an otherwise sound plan.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the people who manage an organization and make its main decisions.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنفيذي؛ متعلق بإدارة مؤسسة واتخاذ قراراتها الكبرى
entries.example: She joined the executive committee last year.

entries.definitionEn: A senior manager in a company or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسؤول تنفيذي كبير في شركة أو مؤسسة
entries.example: The marketing executive presented the new campaign.

entries.definitionEn: Physical activity that you do to stay healthy. Also a short task for practice.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط بدني للحفاظ على الصحة؛ أو تمرين للتدريب
entries.example: She does exercise every morning before work.

entries.definitionEn: To move your body in order to stay healthy and strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحرّك أو يتمرّن ليبقى صحيح الجسم
entries.example: I exercise in the park after breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: To use power, influence, or physical effort in a deliberate way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبذل جهداً أو يمارس نفوذاً عن قصد
entries.example: She had to exert herself to finish the climb.

entries.definitionEn: Waste gas from an engine, or the pipe that lets it out.
entries.arabicMeaning: غاز العادم من المحرّك أو أنبوب خروجه
entries.example: Black smoke poured from the truck's exhaust.

entries.definitionEn: To use up a supply completely, or to make someone extremely tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنفد مورداً بالكامل أو يُنهك شخصاً
entries.example: The long debate exhausted every practical option.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهق جداً
entries.example: He felt exhausted after the night shift.

entries.definitionEn: Making you extremely tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُرهِق يُذهب الطاقة
entries.example: The twelve-hour journey was exhausting.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being extremely tired, with little energy left.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنهاك شديد ونفاد الطاقة
entries.example: She collapsed from exhaustion after the race.

entries.definitionEn: To show something in public, or to display a quality or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض شيئاً للناس أو يُظهر صفة أو شعوراً
entries.example: The museum will exhibit the paintings in May.

entries.definitionEn: A public event where people can see art, objects, or information.
entries.arabicMeaning: معرض علني للفن أو المعروضات
entries.example: We went to an art exhibition on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel very happy, lively, and excited.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدخل على النفس بهجة وحماسة شديدتين
entries.example: The cold sea air exhilarated the walkers.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel very happy, lively, and excited.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُبهج يبعث حماسة شديدة
entries.example: The mountain ride was exhilarating.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of happiness mixed with excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهجة شديدة ممتزجة بالحماسة
entries.example: She laughed with exhilaration at the summit.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being forced to live away from your own country. Also a person living in that state.
entries.arabicMeaning: منفى قسري عن الوطن؛ أو الشخص المنفي
entries.example: The writer lived in exile for ten years.

entries.definitionEn: To be real or to be present.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوجد أو يكون حقيقياً
entries.example: Do you think life can exist on other planets?

entries.definitionEn: The fact of being real or alive. Also a way of living.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجود شيء أو حياة شخص؛ وقد يعني أسلوب عيش
entries.example: The records prove the existence of an older town.

entries.definitionEn: Already in place or in use now, rather than new.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائم حالياً وليس جديداً
entries.example: They improved the existing software instead of replacing it.

entries.definitionEn: A door or way out of a building, vehicle, or road.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخرج من مبنى أو مركبة أو طريق
entries.example: Please leave by the nearest exit.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a place, building, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغادر مكاناً أو نظاماً
entries.example: Passengers must exit at the next station.

entries.definitionEn: The departure of a large number of people from a place at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحيل جماعي لعدد كبير من الناس في وقت واحد
entries.example: The factory closure caused an exodus of workers from the town.

entries.definitionEn: A ritual intended to drive an evil spirit out of a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقس يُقصد به إخراج روح شريرة من شخص أو مكان
entries.example: The novel describes an exorcism in a remote village.

entries.definitionEn: A person who performs rituals to drive out evil spirits.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يمارس طقوس إخراج الأرواح الشريرة
entries.example: The film follows an exorcist called to an old house.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that seems strikingly foreign, unusual, or richly unfamiliar.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غريب أخّاذ يوحي بالبعيد وغير المألوف
entries.example: Spices scented the market exotically.

entries.definitionEn: To become larger, or to make something larger in size, number, or range.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتّسع أو يوسّع شيئاً حجماً أو عدداً أو نطاقاً
entries.example: The company plans to expand next year.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming larger in size, number, or range.
entries.arabicMeaning: توسّع في الحجم أو العدد أو النطاق
entries.example: The city's expansion has been rapid.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something will happen, or that someone will arrive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقع حدوث شيء أو وصول أحد
entries.example: We expect the train at six.

entries.definitionEn: A belief that something will happen, or a hope about how good it will be.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقع بحدوث شيء أو أمل في مستواه
entries.example: The film did not meet our expectations.

entries.definitionEn: Regarded as likely to happen or as normal in the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوقع أو معتاد في مثل هذا الموقف
entries.example: The expected guests arrived at noon.

entries.definitionEn: To make a process happen more quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرّع إنجاز عملية أو إجراء
entries.example: Please expedite the shipping of this order.

entries.definitionEn: The money that something costs, or that you spend on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكلفة شيء أو مال يُنفق عليه
entries.example: They shared the expense of the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Costing a lot of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: غالٍ؛ يكلّف مالاً كثيراً
entries.example: That coat is too expensive for me.

entries.definitionEn: Knowledge or skill that you get by doing something. Also something that happens to you.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبرة تُكتسب بالممارسة؛ أو تجربة تمرّ بالشخص
entries.example: She has a lot of experience with children.

entries.definitionEn: To have something happen to you, or to feel it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمرّ بشيء أو يحسّ به
entries.example: Many visitors experience delays in summer.

entries.definitionEn: Having skill or knowledge from doing something for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو خبرة اكتسبها بطول الممارسة
entries.example: We need an experienced driver for this route.

entries.definitionEn: A scientific test done to discover something or to check an idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختبار علمي لاكتشاف شيء أو التحقق من فكرة
entries.example: The students did an experiment in the lab.

entries.definitionEn: To try new methods, materials, or ideas in order to see what works.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرّب طرائق أو مواد أو أفكاراً جديدة ليرى ما ينجح
entries.example: The chef likes to experiment with spices.

entries.definitionEn: Having a high level of skill or knowledge in a particular subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو مهارة أو معرفة عالية في مجال معيّن
entries.example: She gave us expert advice on the contract.

entries.definitionEn: A person who knows a lot about a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبير يعرف كثيراً عن موضوع معيّن
entries.example: We asked an expert about the old painting.

entries.definitionEn: To reach the end of a period of validity. Also, in formal language, to die.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتهي سريان شيء؛ وفي الأسلوب الرسمي قد يعني يموت
entries.example: My passport will expire in March.

entries.definitionEn: To make something clear by giving reasons or details.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرح شيئاً فيوضحه بأسباب أو تفاصيل
entries.example: Can you explain this sentence to me?

entries.definitionEn: A statement that makes something clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرح يوضح شيئاً
entries.example: She gave a simple explanation of the rules.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to make something easier to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفسيري يُقصد به تيسير الفهم
entries.example: The notes include a short explanatory paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: To burst apart with force and a loud noise. Also to increase or become angry very suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفجر بقوة وصوت عالٍ؛ وقد يعني يزيد أو يغضب فجأة
entries.example: The fireworks exploded over the harbour.

entries.definitionEn: The unfair use of a person or resource for someone else's gain.
entries.arabicMeaning: استغلال شخص أو مورد بغير إنصاف لمصلحة غيره
entries.example: The report condemned the exploitation of cheap labour.

entries.definitionEn: The act of travelling through a place or examining something in order to learn about it.
entries.arabicMeaning: استكشاف مكان أو موضوع للتعلّم عنه
entries.example: The book describes the exploration of the river.

entries.definitionEn: To travel around a place to learn about it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجول في مكان ليتعرّف إليه
entries.example: We want to explore the old town.

entries.definitionEn: A person who travels to little-known places in order to discover them.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستكشف يسافر إلى أماكن قليلة المعرفة ليكتشفها
entries.example: The explorer kept a detailed diary of the journey.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden burst of energy, noise, and often damage. Also a sudden large increase.
entries.arabicMeaning: انفجار مفاجئ؛ وقد يعني زيادة كبيرة سريعة
entries.example: People heard the explosion from several streets away.

entries.definitionEn: Able or likely to explode. Also likely to cause sudden strong feeling or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للانفجار؛ أو مرشّح لإثارة شعور أو تغيّر مفاجئ
entries.example: The gas mixture is highly explosive.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that can explode.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة قابلة للانفجار
entries.example: The police found no explosive in the vehicle.

entries.definitionEn: In a sudden, violent, or rapidly increasing way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفاجئ عنيف أو سريع التزايد
entries.example: Demand for the product grew explosively.

entries.definitionEn: A product sold to another country, or the business of selling goods abroad.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلعة تُباع إلى بلد آخر أو تجارة البيع إلى الخارج
entries.example: Coffee is a major export of the region.

entries.definitionEn: To send goods to another country in order to sell them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصدّر سلعاً إلى بلد آخر لبيعها
entries.example: The factory exports furniture to several countries.

entries.definitionEn: To uncover something, or to make a hidden fact known. Also to leave someone unprotected from harm or weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكشف شيئاً أو حقيقة خافية؛ أو يعرّض شخصاً لضرر أو لعوامل الجو
entries.example: The article exposed serious errors in the report.

entries.definitionEn: A fast train or bus that stops at only a few places.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطار أو حافلة سريعة تتوقف في محطات قليلة
entries.example: We took the express to the city.

entries.definitionEn: To show a feeling, idea, or opinion in words or actions.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبّر عن شعور أو فكرة أو رأي بالكلام أو الفعل
entries.example: He found it hard to express his thanks.

entries.definitionEn: A look on someone's face that shows a feeling. Also a word or phrase.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملامح الوجه التي تُظهر شعوراً؛ أو عبارة لغوية
entries.example: Her expression became serious.

entries.definitionEn: Clearly showing thoughts or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: معبّر يُظهر الأفكار أو المشاعر بوضوح
entries.example: She has an expressive face.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely beautiful, delicate, or finely made.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الجمال والرقة أو متقن الصنع
entries.example: The shop sells exquisite handmade jewellery.

entries.definitionEn: Still in existence, especially of a document, building, or species that has survived.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما زال موجوداً، وخصوصاً من وثيقة أو مبنى أو نوع حيّ بقي
entries.example: Only three extant copies of the book are known.

entries.definitionEn: To make something longer or larger, or to stretch it out. Also to offer something such as help.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمدّد شيئاً أو يوسّعه؛ وقد يعني يقدّم عوناً
entries.example: They decided to extend the deadline by a week.

entries.definitionEn: Something added to make a building or period of time longer. Also a phone line in an office.
entries.arabicMeaning: إضافة تطيل مبنى أو مهلة؛ وقد تعني تحويلة هاتفية
entries.example: They built an extension at the back of the house.

entries.definitionEn: Covering a large area, amount, or range.
entries.arabicMeaning: واسع النطاق أو المقدار
entries.example: The storm caused extensive damage.

entries.definitionEn: To a large degree, or over a large area.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد كبير أو على نطاق واسع
entries.example: She has travelled extensively in East Africa.

entries.definitionEn: The size, amount, or degree of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى شيء أو مقداره أو درجته
entries.example: We do not yet know the extent of the damage.

entries.definitionEn: The outer surface or outside of a building or object.
entries.arabicMeaning: السطح الخارجي لمبنى أو جسم
entries.example: The exterior of the house needs new paint.

entries.definitionEn: Coming from or relating to the outside of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارجي يأتي من الخارج أو يتعلق به
entries.example: The company hired an external consultant.

entries.definitionEn: No longer existing as a living species.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقرض لم يبقَ منه نوع حيّ
entries.example: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.

entries.definitionEn: The dying out of a species so that it no longer exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: انقراض نوع حيّ حتى لا يبقى منه شيء
entries.example: Several plants here are at risk of extinction.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of getting money or favours by threats.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة انتزاع مال أو منفعة بالتهديد
entries.example: The investigation uncovered a case of extortion.

entries.definitionEn: More than the usual or needed amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: إضافي يزيد على المعتاد أو المطلوب
entries.example: Do you need extra time for the test?

entries.definitionEn: More than usual; to a greater degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكثر من المعتاد؛ بدرجة أكبر
entries.example: She worked extra hard this week.

entries.definitionEn: An additional thing or charge. Also a person with a very small part in a film.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء أو رسم إضافي؛ أو ممثل ثانوي في فيلم
entries.example: Breakfast is an extra at this hotel.

entries.definitionEn: A short passage taken from a text. Also a substance taken from a plant or food.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقتطف من نص؛ أو مادة مستخلصة من نبات أو طعام
entries.example: She read a short extract from the novel.

entries.definitionEn: To remove or pull something out, often with effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستخرج شيئاً أو ينتزعه، غالباً بجهد
entries.example: The dentist had to extract the broken tooth.

entries.definitionEn: Taking place outside the regular courses of a school or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاصفيّ يجري خارج المقررات الدراسية المعتادة
entries.example: The school offers several extracurricular clubs.

entries.definitionEn: An activity at school or college that is not part of the regular courses.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط مدرسي أو جامعي خارج المقررات المعتادة
entries.example: Music is her favourite extracurricular.

entries.definitionEn: To a very unusual or surprising degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة غير معتادة أو مدهشة جداً
entries.example: The weather has been extraordinarily mild.

entries.definitionEn: Very unusual, special, or surprising.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير عادي أو مميز أو مدهش
entries.example: She showed extraordinary courage.

entries.definitionEn: Wasteful or excessive spending, or something bought in that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بذخ مفرط أو إنفاق مسرف، أو شيء اشتُري على هذا النحو
entries.example: The marble fountain was a private extravagance.

entries.definitionEn: Very great in degree, or furthest from the centre or from what is usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الدرجة أو أقصى البعد عن المعتاد
entries.example: They live in an area of extreme heat.

entries.definitionEn: Sports that involve high speed, height, or danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضات تنطوي على سرعة عالية أو ارتفاع أو خطر
