entries.example: He took up extreme sports after university.

entries.definitionEn: To a very high degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: للغاية؛ بدرجة عالية جداً
entries.example: The bag is extremely heavy.

entries.definitionEn: Lively high spirits and unrestrained energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوية فيّاضة وحماسة غير مكبوتة
entries.example: The children's exuberance filled the garden.

entries.definitionEn: Full of energy, excitement, and lively high spirits.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم حيوية وحماسة فيّاضة
entries.example: An exuberant crowd greeted the team.

entries.definitionEn: In a lively, high-spirited, and unrestrained way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحيوية وحماسة فيّاضة غير مكبوتة
entries.example: She waved exuberantly from the platform.

entries.definitionEn: To display a quality so strongly that others feel it. Also to give off a liquid or smell.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفيض بصفة حتى يحسّ بها الآخرون؛ أو يفرز سائلاً أو رائحة
entries.example: He exudes quiet confidence in meetings.

entries.definitionEn: Showing great joy, especially after a success.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبتهج فرحاً شديداً ولا سيما بعد نجاح
entries.example: The exultant players lifted the trophy.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body that you see with.
entries.arabicMeaning: العين التي يُبصر بها
entries.example: She has something in her eye.

entries.definitionEn: The line of hair above each eye.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحاجب؛ خط الشعر فوق العين
entries.example: He raised one eyebrow in surprise.

entries.definitionEn: A short hair growing on the edge of the eyelid.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمش ينبت على حافة الجفن
entries.example: A stray eyelash made her eye water.

entries.definitionEn: The thin skin that covers the eye when it is closed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجفن الذي يغطي العين عند إغلاقها
entries.example: Her eyelid was swollen after the insect bite.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: البصر؛ القدرة على الرؤية
entries.example: His eyesight has become weaker with age.

entries.definitionEn: Famous in stories and legend, whether or not the fame is fully proven.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذائع في القصص والأساطير وإن لم تثبت شهرته كلها
entries.example: They searched for the fabled lost city.

entries.definitionEn: Cloth used for making clothes or coverings. Also the basic structure of a building or society.
entries.arabicMeaning: قماش يُصنع منه اللباس أو الأغطية؛ وقد يعني بنية مبنى أو مجتمع
entries.example: The dress is made of a light cotton fabric.

entries.definitionEn: To invent a false story or piece of evidence. Also to manufacture a product, especially from parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلفّق قصة أو دليلاً كاذباً؛ أو يصنّع منتجاً وخصوصاً من أجزاء
entries.example: The witness later admitted he had fabricated the story.

entries.definitionEn: A made-up story presented as true. Also the process of manufacturing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رواية مختلقة تُعرض على أنها صدق؛ أو عملية التصنيع
entries.example: The accusation was a complete fabrication.

entries.definitionEn: To invent stories, often mixing imagined events with ordinary life.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختلق قصصاً يمزج فيها المتخيّل بمجرى الحياة العادية
entries.example: Late at night he would fabulate whole histories for the old house.

entries.definitionEn: The invention of stories that blend fiction with apparent fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختلاق قصص تخلط الخيال بما يبدو واقعاً
entries.example: The memoir slides into fabulation in its later chapters.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good or impressive. Also belonging to myth or legend.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً أو باهر؛ وقد يعني أسطورياً من عالم الخرافات
entries.example: We had a fabulous meal by the river.

entries.definitionEn: To an extreme and impressive degree; wonderfully.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة بالغة الروعة والإبهار
entries.example: The apartment was fabulously well designed.

entries.definitionEn: The front part of the head, with the eyes, nose, and mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: الوجه في مقدّم الرأس
entries.example: He has a kind face.

entries.definitionEn: Involving people who meet in person rather than by phone or online.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجاهي يتمّ باللقاء المباشر لا بالهاتف أو الشبكة
entries.example: The college prefers a face-to-face interview.

entries.definitionEn: In person, looking at the other person rather than through a screen or letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجهاً لوجه بالمقابلة المباشرة
entries.example: They finally spoke face to face after months of messages.

entries.definitionEn: To look towards something, or to deal with a problem that you cannot avoid.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجه بنظره نحو شيء أو يواجه مشكلة لا مفر منها
entries.example: We have to face the problem today.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the face.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجهي؛ متعلق بالوجه
entries.example: The injury caused slight facial swelling.

entries.definitionEn: A beauty treatment in which the face is cleaned and cared for.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلسة عناية تجميلية لتنظيف الوجه والعناية به
entries.example: She booked a facial at the spa.

entries.definitionEn: To make a process or action easier.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسهّل عملية أو إجراء
entries.example: Clear signs facilitate movement through the building.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making a process easier, often by guiding a discussion or arrangement.
entries.arabicMeaning: تيسير عملية، وغالباً بقيادة نقاش أو ترتيب
entries.example: Good facilitation kept the meeting on track.

entries.definitionEn: Buildings, equipment, or services provided for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرافق من مبانٍ أو تجهيزات أو خدمات لغرض معيّن
entries.example: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.

entries.definitionEn: A place designed for a particular activity or service.
entries.arabicMeaning: منشأة مُعدّة لنشاط أو خدمة معيّنة
entries.example: The new sports facility opens in June.

entries.definitionEn: An exact copy of a document, book, or work of art.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة طبق الأصل من وثيقة أو كتاب أو أثر فني
entries.example: The archive holds a facsimile of the original letter.

entries.definitionEn: Something that is known to be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقة معلوم أنها صحيحة
entries.example: It is a fact that water freezes at zero degrees.

entries.definitionEn: A smaller group inside a larger one, especially one that disagrees with the rest.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصيل أصغر داخل جماعة أكبر، وخصوصاً إن خالف سائرها
entries.example: A rival faction opposed the new rules.

entries.definitionEn: One of the things that causes or influences a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل من العوامل التي تُحدث نتيجة أو تؤثّر فيها
entries.example: Cost was a major factor in the decision.

entries.definitionEn: A building where goods are made by machines.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنع تُصنع فيه السلع بالآلات
entries.example: She works in a shoe factory.

entries.definitionEn: A department of a university. Also a natural ability of the mind or body.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلية في جامعة؛ أو ملكة طبيعية في العقل أو الجسم
entries.example: He teaches in the faculty of law.

entries.definitionEn: To become less bright, strong, or clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفت أو يبهت أو يضعف وضوحه
entries.example: The music began to fade as we left the hall.

entries.definitionEn: To not succeed in doing something, or to not pass a test.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفشل في عمل شيء أو لا ينجح في اختبار
entries.example: I will fail the test if I do not study.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of success, or a person or thing that does not succeed. Also a time when a machine stops working.
entries.arabicMeaning: إخفاق أو شخص أو شيء لم ينجح؛ وقد يعني تعطّل آلة
entries.example: The plan ended in failure.

entries.definitionEn: Weak, slight, or difficult to see, hear, or feel.
entries.arabicMeaning: خفيف أو ضعيف يصعب رؤيته أو سماعه أو الإحساس به
entries.example: There was a faint smell of smoke.

entries.definitionEn: To lose consciousness for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُغمى عليه وقتاً قصيراً
entries.example: He fainted in the heat and woke a minute later.

entries.definitionEn: Treating people equally and reasonably. Also acceptable in amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادل في معاملة الناس؛ أو مقبول في المقدار
entries.example: The teacher was fair to every student.

entries.definitionEn: An outdoor event with stalls, games, and often rides. Also a large market or trade show.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهرجان خارجي فيه أكشاك وألعاب؛ أو سوق أو معرض تجاري كبير
entries.example: We spent the afternoon at the village fair.

entries.definitionEn: To a moderate degree; quite. Also in a just and reasonable way.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد ما؛ وكذلك بعدل وإنصاف
entries.example: The room is fairly small but comfortable.

entries.definitionEn: A small magical being in children's stories.
entries.arabicMeaning: كائن سحري صغير في قصص الأطفال
entries.example: The story is about a kind fairy in the woods.

entries.definitionEn: Strong belief or trust, often in a religion or in a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيمان راسخ أو ثقة، وغالباً في دين أو في شخص
entries.example: She has great faith in her doctor's advice.

entries.definitionEn: Loyal and true to a person, duty, or belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: وفيّ صادق لشخص أو واجب أو معتقد
entries.example: He remained a faithful friend through hard years.

entries.definitionEn: Made to look real but not genuine.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزيف صُنع ليبدو أصلياً وهو ليس كذلك
entries.example: The watch was fake, not real gold.

entries.definitionEn: An act of dropping to the ground. Also a decrease, and in American English the season of autumn.
entries.arabicMeaning: سقوط إلى الأرض؛ أو انخفاض؛ وفي الإنكليزية الأمريكية فصل الخريف
entries.example: He had a bad fall on the icy path.

entries.definitionEn: To drop down towards the ground by accident.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسقط نحو الأرض من غير قصد
entries.example: Be careful not to fall on the wet floor.

entries.definitionEn: A false belief, or an argument that looks reasonable but is mistaken.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتقاد باطل أو حجة تبدو معقولة وهي مغلوطة
entries.example: The idea that memory never changes is a fallacy.

entries.definitionEn: Having dropped to the ground. Also no longer in a former high or successful position.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساقط إلى الأرض؛ أو لم يعد في منزلته السابقة
entries.example: Fallen leaves covered the garden path.

entries.definitionEn: Not true or not real.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير صحيح أو غير حقيقي
entries.example: That statement is false.

entries.definitionEn: To lose strength or confidence, or to speak and move with hesitation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضعف أو يفقد الثقة، أو يتردد في الكلام والحركة
entries.example: Her voice did not falter during the speech.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being known by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهرة يعرفها كثير من الناس
entries.example: The novel brought him sudden fame.

entries.definitionEn: Well known to you because you have seen or heard it before.
entries.arabicMeaning: مألوف لأنك رأيته أو سمعته من قبل
entries.example: This street looks familiar to me.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who are related, especially parents and their children.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسرة من أقارب، وخصوصاً الوالدين وأبناءهم
entries.example: My family lives in a small town.

entries.definitionEn: Known by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشهور يعرفه كثير من الناس
entries.example: This city is famous for its old bridge.

entries.definitionEn: A person who likes a team, singer, or activity very much. Also a machine that moves air.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشجع يحب فريقاً أو مغنياً أو نشاطاً كثيراً؛ أو مروحة تحرّك الهواء
entries.example: She is a fan of that football team.

entries.definitionEn: Showing extreme and uncritical enthusiasm for a cause or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: متحمّس جداً لقضية أو نشاط بلا نقد
entries.example: His fanatic devotion to the club surprised even other supporters.

entries.definitionEn: A person with extreme enthusiasm for a cause, activity, or belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص ذو حماسة مفرطة لقضية أو نشاط أو معتقد
entries.example: He is a fitness fanatic who trains every day.

entries.definitionEn: In an extremely enthusiastic or obsessive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحماسة مفرطة أو تعلق شديد
entries.example: She trained fanatically for the marathon.

entries.definitionEn: Imagined in a creative way but unlikely to be true or practical.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيالي مبتكر لكنه بعيد عن الصدق أو العملية
entries.example: The plan was too fanciful to work.

entries.definitionEn: Decorative and not simple; looking expensive or special.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزخرف غير بسيط؛ يبدو فاخراً أو مميزاً
entries.example: They booked a fancy hotel for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A liking for something, or a thought produced by the imagination.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل إلى شيء أو خاطر من الخيال
entries.example: She took a fancy to the quiet cottage.

entries.definitionEn: To want or like something. Also to imagine that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرغب في شيء أو يحبّه؛ وقد يعني يتوهّم أنه كذلك
entries.example: Do you fancy a walk after lunch?

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً
entries.example: We had a fantastic day at the beach.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely well, or to an amazing degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو رائع جداً أو بدرجة مدهشة
entries.example: The choir sang fantastically last night.

entries.definitionEn: A pleasant imagined situation. Also stories that include magic or invented worlds.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصور لطيف في الخيال؛ أو قصص فيها سحر وعوالم مخترعة
entries.example: Winning the prize was only a fantasy.

entries.definitionEn: A long way away in space or time; distant.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيد في المكان أو الزمان
entries.example: They live on the far side of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: At or to a great distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مسافة كبيرة أو إليها
entries.example: The school is not far from our house.

entries.definitionEn: A long distance from where you are.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناءٍ بعيد عن موضعك
entries.example: She dreamed of travelling to faraway countries.

entries.definitionEn: A comic play based on ridiculous situations. Also a serious event that has become absurd.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملهاة قائمة على مواقف مضحكة عبثية؛ أو أمر جادّ صار مهزلة
entries.example: The meeting turned into a farce when the papers were lost.

entries.definitionEn: So absurd or badly managed that it seems like a joke.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبثي أو سيّئ التدبير حتى ليبدو كالمهزلة
entries.example: The delay made the whole process farcical.

entries.definitionEn: The money that you pay to travel by bus, train, or taxi.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجرة السفر بالحافلة أو القطار أو السيارة
entries.example: The bus fare is two pounds.

entries.definitionEn: An act of saying goodbye, often when someone is leaving for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: وداع، وخصوصاً عند فراق يدوم طويلاً
entries.example: They held a small farewell for their colleague.

entries.definitionEn: Land and buildings used for growing crops or keeping animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزرعة من أرض ومبانٍ لزراعة المحاصيل أو تربية الحيوانات
entries.example: My uncle lives on a farm.

entries.definitionEn: A person who owns or works on a farm.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزارع يملك مزرعة أو يعمل فيها
entries.example: The farmer gets up early every day.

entries.definitionEn: The work of growing crops and raising animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل زراعة المحاصيل وتربية الحيوانات
entries.example: Farming is the main work in this valley.

entries.definitionEn: Land used for growing crops or keeping animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض تُستخدم للزراعة أو تربية الحيوانات
entries.example: Most of the valley is open farmland.

entries.definitionEn: At or to a greater distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مسافة أكبر أو إليها
entries.example: We walked farther than we had planned.

entries.definitionEn: At or to the greatest distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أكبر مسافة أو إليها
entries.example: Of all the islands, this one lies farthest from the coast.

entries.definitionEn: To attract and hold someone's interest very strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجذب الاهتمام بقوة ويشدّه
entries.example: Old maps fascinate her.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely interested in something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفتون بشيء وشديد الاهتمام به
entries.example: The children were fascinated by the telescope.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely interesting.
entries.arabicMeaning: شائق جداً يشدّ الاهتمام
entries.example: The museum was fascinating.

entries.definitionEn: A very strong interest in something.
entries.arabicMeaning: اهتمام شديد بشيء يبلغ حد الافتتان
entries.example: He has a fascination with old clocks.

entries.definitionEn: A style of clothes or behaviour that is popular at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضة في اللباس أو السلوك تشيع في زمن معيّن
entries.example: Long coats are in fashion this year.

entries.definitionEn: Following a style that is popular at the moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصري يتبع أسلوباً شائعاً الآن
entries.example: They live in a fashionable part of the city.

entries.definitionEn: Moving or happening at high speed.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع الحركة أو الحدوث
entries.example: This train is very fast.

entries.definitionEn: At high speed; quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسرعة عالية
entries.example: Please do not drive so fast.

entries.definitionEn: Food that is prepared and served quickly, often in a restaurant.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام يُعدّ ويُقدَّم بسرعة، وغالباً في مطعم
entries.example: We bought fast food on the way home.

entries.definitionEn: To close or fix something so that it stays in place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط شيئاً أو يثبّته حتى يبقى في موضعه
entries.example: Please fasten your seat belt.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of extra weight on the body. Also containing a lot of oil.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمين ذو وزن زائد؛ أو دسم كثير الزيت
entries.example: The puppy grew fat over the winter.

entries.definitionEn: A substance in food and in the body that stores energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: دهن في الطعام والجسم يخزن الطاقة
entries.example: The doctor advised him to eat less fat.

entries.definitionEn: Causing death. Also causing complete failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاتل يسبب الموت؛ أو يؤدي إلى إخفاق تام
entries.example: The driver made a fatal error on the bend.

entries.definitionEn: A death caused by an accident, disaster, or fighting.
entries.arabicMeaning: وفاة ناتجة عن حادث أو كارثة أو قتال
entries.example: The storm caused several fatalities along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A power that some people believe controls what happens, independently of human plans.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدر يراه بعضهم متحكماً فيما يحدث بمعزل عن تدبير الناس
entries.example: By a strange twist of fate they met again.

entries.definitionEn: The father of your husband or wife.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبو الزوج أو الزوجة؛ الحمو
entries.example: Her father-in-law taught her to bake bread.

entries.definitionEn: A male parent.
entries.arabicMeaning: أب
entries.example: My father works in a hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme tiredness after long effort. In technical use, the weakening of a material after repeated stress.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرهاق شديد بعد جهد طويل؛ وفي الاستعمال التقني ضعف مادة بعد إجهاد متكرر
entries.example: The crew showed signs of fatigue after the long flight.

entries.definitionEn: Responsibility for a mistake, or a problem in a machine or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسؤولية عن خطأ، أو خلل في آلة أو نظام
entries.example: It was not your fault that the train was late.

entries.definitionEn: Not working correctly because of a defect.
entries.arabicMeaning: معيب لا يعمل كما ينبغي
entries.example: A faulty wire caused the lights to fail.

entries.definitionEn: A kind act that you do to help someone. Also support or approval.
entries.arabicMeaning: معروف تساعد به أحداً؛ أو تأييد وموافقة
entries.example: Could you do me a favour and watch the door?

entries.definitionEn: Showing approval, or likely to produce a good result.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينمّ عن موافقة، أو مواتٍ لنتائج طيبة
entries.example: The weather looks favourable for the picnic.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows approval or that gives an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ينمّ عن استحسان أو يمنح ميزة
entries.example: The proposal was received favourably by the board.

entries.definitionEn: Liked more than others of the same kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفضّل على غيره من جنسه
entries.example: Blue is my favourite colour.

entries.definitionEn: The person or thing that you like more than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشخص أو الشيء الذي تفضّله على سواه
entries.example: This song is my favourite.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that sends a copy of a document by telephone line, or the copy itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز يرسل نسخة من وثيقة عبر خط هاتفي، أو النسخة نفسها
entries.example: Please send the contract by fax.

entries.definitionEn: To send a document using a fax machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل وثيقة بجهاز الفاكس
entries.example: I will fax the form this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling that something bad may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: خوف من أن يحدث شيء سيئ
entries.example: She has a fear of high places.

entries.definitionEn: To be afraid of someone or something, or to worry that something bad will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخشى شخصاً أو شيئاً، أو يقلق من وقوع أمر سيئ
entries.example: Many people fear flying in storms.

entries.definitionEn: Frightening, or looking as if you should be afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروّع أو يبدو مخيفاً
entries.example: The dog had a fearsome bark but a gentle nature.

entries.definitionEn: A large special meal, often for a celebration.
entries.arabicMeaning: وليمة كبيرة تُقام غالباً احتفالاً
entries.example: They prepared a feast for the wedding guests.

entries.definitionEn: An impressive and difficult action or achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأثرة أو إنجاز باهر صعب
entries.example: Climbing that route was a remarkable feat.

entries.definitionEn: One of the light, soft parts that cover a bird's body.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريشة من الريش الخفيف الذي يغطي جسم الطائر
entries.example: A small feather floated down from the bird's wing.

entries.definitionEn: An important part or quality of something. Also a part of the face, such as the eyes or mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميزة بارزة أو صفة مهمة؛ وأيضاً ملامح الوجه
entries.example: The phone's best feature is its long battery life.

entries.definitionEn: To include someone or something as an important part of a show, story, or product.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُبرز شخصاً أو شيئاً بوصفه عنصراً أساسياً في عرض أو منتج
entries.example: The documentary will feature interviews with local farmers.

entries.definitionEn: The second month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: فبراير، الشهر الثاني من السنة
entries.example: Her birthday is in February.

entries.definitionEn: Annoyed or bored because something has gone on too long.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضجر أو سئم لأن أمراً طال أكثر مما يُحتمل
entries.example: She was fed up with the constant delays.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a system of government in which states share power with a central national government.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتحادي؛ متعلق بنظام تتقاسم فيه الولايات السلطة مع حكومة مركزية
entries.example: Federal law applies in every state.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you pay for a service or for the right to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسوم تُدفع مقابل خدمة أو حق معيّن
entries.example: There is a small fee to enter the museum.

entries.definitionEn: Food given to animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: علف يُقدَّم للحيوانات
entries.example: The farmer bought feed for the chickens.

entries.definitionEn: To give food to a person or an animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُطعم شخصاً أو حيواناً
entries.example: She feeds the cat twice a day.

entries.definitionEn: Comments on how well someone has done something, given so they can improve.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاحظات تُعطى لتقييم أداء شخص ومساعدته على التحسّن
entries.example: The teacher's feedback helped him rewrite the essay.

entries.definitionEn: The way something seems when you touch it, or the general atmosphere of a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملمس الشيء عند لمسه، أو أجواء المكان
entries.example: I like the soft feel of this fabric.

entries.definitionEn: To experience an emotion or a physical sensation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشعر بعاطفة أو بإحساس جسدي
entries.example: I feel tired after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: An emotion, or something you notice in your body.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور عاطفي أو إحساس في الجسم
entries.example: She had a feeling of relief when the test ended.

entries.definitionEn: To pretend to have a feeling, illness, or quality that is not genuine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتظاهر بشعور أو علّة أو صفة ليست حقيقية
entries.example: He tried to feign surprise when they announced the news.

entries.definitionEn: Used of people who share the same group, job, or situation as you.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل؛ يصف من يشاركك المجموعة أو المهنة أو الظرف
entries.example: She asked her fellow passengers for directions.

entries.definitionEn: A man, often in informal speech. Also a member of a learned society or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل في الكلام غير الرسمي؛ أو زميل في جمعية علمية أو كلية
entries.example: A fellow in a grey coat held the door open.

entries.definitionEn: Of the sex that can give birth or produce eggs.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنثوي؛ من الجنس القادر على الولادة أو وضع البيض
entries.example: The female bird sat on the nest.

entries.definitionEn: A woman or girl, or an animal of the sex that can give birth or produce eggs.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنثى من البشر أو الحيوانات
entries.example: The study compared males and females of the same age.

entries.definitionEn: A barrier of wood, metal, or wire around a garden, field, or building.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياج من خشب أو معدن يحيط بحديقة أو حقل
entries.example: They painted the wooden fence white.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely fierce, violent, or intense.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضاري أو عنيف إلى أقصى حد
entries.example: A ferocious storm tore branches from the trees.

entries.definitionEn: In an extremely fierce or intense way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بضراوة شديدة
entries.example: The two sides argued ferociously over the contract.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme fierceness, violence, or intensity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضراوة بالغة أو حدّة عنيفة
entries.example: The ferocity of the attack shocked even experienced officers.

entries.definitionEn: A boat that carries people and vehicles across water on a regular route.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبارة تنقل الناس والمركبات عبر الماء في خط منتظم
entries.example: We took the ferry across the river.

entries.definitionEn: A boat used as a ferry to carry people or vehicles across water.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارب عبارة يُستخدم لنقل الركاب أو المركبات
entries.example: The old ferryboat still runs twice a day.

entries.definitionEn: A special time of celebration with music, food, or other public events.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهرجان احتفالي بموسيقى أو طعام أو فعاليات عامة
entries.example: The town holds a music festival every summer.

entries.definitionEn: Cheerful and connected with a celebration.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهيج ومرتبط بالاحتفال
entries.example: The streets looked festive with lights and banners.

entries.definitionEn: To go and bring something or someone back.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذهب ليحضر شيئاً أو شخصاً
entries.example: Could you fetch my coat from the hall?

entries.definitionEn: An outdoor public celebration, often held to raise money for a school or charity.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتفال شعبي في الهواء الطلق، غالباً لجمع تبرعات
entries.example: The village fete raised money for the new library.

entries.definitionEn: A high body temperature when you are ill.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمّى؛ ارتفاع حرارة الجسم عند المرض
entries.example: The child had a fever and stayed in bed.

entries.definitionEn: In a hurried, excited, or anxious way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحمّى من العجلة أو القلق
entries.example: They worked feverishly to finish before midnight.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a plural noun to mean a small number, often with the sense that there are not many.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل من؛ تسبق جمعاً للدلالة على عدد صغير، غالباً بمعنى النقص
entries.example: Few shops were open on Sunday morning.

entries.definitionEn: A small number of people or things already understood from the context.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليلون؛ عدد صغير من أشخاص أو أشياء يُفهم من السياق
entries.example: Many were invited, but few actually came.

entries.definitionEn: A thin thread in plants, cloth, or the body. In food, the part that helps digestion.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليف رفيع في النبات أو القماش أو الجسم؛ وفي الطعام يساعد الهضم
entries.example: Wholegrain bread is high in fibre.

entries.definitionEn: Stories that are invented rather than true.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصص مختلقة وليست واقعية؛ أدب خيالي
entries.example: She prefers fiction to history books.

entries.definitionEn: Invented for a story; not real.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيالي؛ مخترَع في قصة وليس حقيقياً
entries.example: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective.

entries.definitionEn: A violin, especially in folk music. Also an informal word for a dishonest scheme.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمان، ولا سيما في الموسيقى الشعبية؛ وقد تعني احتيالاً غير رسمي
entries.example: He played a lively tune on the fiddle.

entries.definitionEn: To keep touching or moving something with your fingers, often when you are nervous. Also to change figures dishonestly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبث بشيء بأصابعه، غالباً من التوتر؛ أو يزوّر أرقاماً
entries.example: Stop fiddling with that pen and listen.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays the fiddle.
entries.arabicMeaning: عازف كمان شعبي
entries.example: The fiddler kept time with his foot.

entries.definitionEn: Awkward to do because it needs small, careful movements.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقيق ومعقّد في التنفيذ ويحتاج حركات صغيرة حذرة
entries.example: The tiny screws made the repair fiddly.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land used for farming or sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقل للزراعة أو ملعب للرياضة
entries.example: The children played football in the field.

entries.definitionEn: A cruel or wicked person. Also someone extremely enthusiastic about an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص بالغ القسوة؛ أو مولع بشيء إلى حد الهوس
entries.example: He's a crossword fiend and finishes one every morning.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely cruel, clever in a harmful way, or unusually difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيطاني في قسوته أو دهائه، أو بالغ الصعوبة
entries.example: The last puzzle was fiendish.

entries.definitionEn: In an extremely cruel, cunning, or difficult way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصعوبة أو دهاء بالغين
entries.example: The instructions were fiendishly complicated.

entries.definitionEn: Violent and aggressive, or very strong in feeling or competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرس وعنيف، أو شديد في العاطفة أو التنافس
entries.example: There was fierce competition for the job.

entries.definitionEn: With intense force, anger, or determination.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعنف أو إصرار شديد
entries.example: She defended her idea fiercely.

entries.definitionEn: The number 15.
entries.arabicMeaning: خمسة عشر
entries.example: There are fifteen chairs in the room.

entries.definitionEn: One of five equal parts. Also the person or thing in position number five.
entries.arabicMeaning: خُمس؛ أو صاحب الترتيب الخامس
entries.example: She inherited a fifth of the farm.

entries.definitionEn: The number 50.
entries.arabicMeaning: خمسون
entries.example: The ticket costs fifty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: An act of hitting or struggling with someone. Also a determined effort against something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عراك أو شجار؛ وأيضاً كفاح ضد أمر ما
entries.example: Two boys had a fight in the playground.

entries.definitionEn: To try to hurt someone in a struggle, or to work hard against a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقاتل أو يتعارك؛ أو يكافح مشكلة
entries.example: They decided to fight the decision in court.

entries.definitionEn: A person who fights, or a fast military aircraft designed for combat.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاتل؛ أو طائرة حربية مخصّصة للقتال
entries.example: She is a tough fighter who never gives up.

entries.definitionEn: Physical conflict between people or armed groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: قتال أو اشتباك بين أشخاص أو جماعات
entries.example: The fighting stopped after midnight.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that uses words for effect rather than in their literal sense.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجازياً لا بالمعنى الحرفي
entries.example: When she said the news hit her like a train, she meant it figuratively.

entries.definitionEn: A number. Also the shape of a person's body, or an important person.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقم أو عدد؛ وأيضاً قوام الجسم أو شخصية بارزة
entries.example: The exact figure is still unknown.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something is true, or to appear as part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظنّ أن أمراً صحيح، أو يظهر ضمن شيء
entries.example: I figure we should leave before the traffic starts.

entries.definitionEn: A collection of papers or computer information kept together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملف يجمع أوراقاً أو معلومات حاسوبية
entries.example: Please put this letter in the customer file.

entries.definitionEn: To put documents in order, or to make an official request or complaint.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفظ الوثائق مرتّبة، أو يقدّم طلباً أو شكوى رسمية
entries.example: She filed a complaint with the housing office.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the duty or affection of a child toward a parent.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنوي؛ متعلق ببرّ الولد لوالديه
entries.example: He felt a filial duty to visit his mother every week.

entries.definitionEn: To make something full, or to become full.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملأ شيئاً أو يمتلئ
entries.example: Please fill the jug with water.

entries.definitionEn: The food put inside a sandwich, pie, or cake. Also material a dentist puts in a tooth.
entries.arabicMeaning: حشوة طعام داخل شطيرة أو فطيرة؛ أو حشوة الأسنان
entries.example: The pie had an apple filling.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes films, especially as a director or producer.
entries.arabicMeaning: صانع أفلام، ولا سيما مخرج أو منتج
entries.example: The film-maker spent two years on the documentary.

entries.definitionEn: A story shown as moving pictures; a movie. Also a very thin layer.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلم سينمائي؛ وأيضاً طبقة رقيقة
entries.example: We watched a film last night.

entries.definitionEn: To record moving pictures with a camera.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوّر مشاهد متحركة بكاميرا
entries.example: They will film the interview outdoors.

entries.definitionEn: A device that removes unwanted material from a liquid, gas, or list.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرشّح يزيل الشوائب من سائل أو هواء أو قائمة
entries.example: Change the water filter every three months.

entries.definitionEn: Last in a series, with nothing coming after it.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخير في سلسلة ولا يأتي بعده شيء
entries.example: This is the final page of the book.

entries.definitionEn: The last game, race, or exam in a competition or course.
entries.arabicMeaning: المباراة أو الامتحان الختامي
entries.example: Our team reached the final.

entries.definitionEn: After a long wait, or as the last point in a list.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخيراً بعد انتظار طويل، أو كنقطة أخيرة
entries.example: The bus finally arrived.

entries.definitionEn: The management of money. Also the money needed to run a project or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدارة المال؛ أو التمويل اللازم لمشروع أو مؤسسة
entries.example: She works in finance at a large bank.

entries.definitionEn: To provide the money needed for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يموّل شيئاً بتوفير المال اللازم له
entries.example: The bank agreed to finance the new factory.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to money and how it is managed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالي؛ متعلق بالمال وإدارته
entries.example: They asked for financial advice before buying a house.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to money.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية المالية
entries.example: The company is now financially stable.

entries.definitionEn: To discover something by looking, or by chance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجد شيئاً بالبحث أو مصادفة
entries.example: I cannot find my keys.

entries.definitionEn: Something discovered as a result of research or an official inquiry.
entries.arabicMeaning: نتيجة يُتوصَّل إليها بالبحث أو التحقيق
entries.example: The study's main finding surprised the doctors.

entries.definitionEn: Good, well, or acceptable. Also of high quality, or very thin.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخير أو مقبول؛ وأيضاً رفيع الجودة أو دقيق جداً
entries.example: I'm fine, thank you.

entries.definitionEn: In a satisfactory way; very well.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مُرضٍ أو بشكل جيد جداً
entries.example: The old printer still works fine.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you must pay as a punishment for breaking a rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرامة مالية عقاباً على مخالفة
entries.example: He paid a fine for parking in the wrong place.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone pay money as a punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرِض غرامة على شخص
entries.example: The court fined him for speeding.

entries.definitionEn: Into very small pieces, or in a delicate, precise way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل ناعم جداً أو بدقة لطيفة
entries.example: Chop the onions finely before you add them.

entries.definitionEn: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: إصبع من أصابع اليد
entries.example: He wore a ring on his little finger.

entries.definitionEn: The hard covering at the end of a finger.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظفر الإصبع
entries.example: She painted her fingernails a deep red.

entries.definitionEn: The end of a race, task, or period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهاية سباق أو مهمة أو فترة زمنية
entries.example: He was exhausted at the finish of the race.

entries.definitionEn: To complete something, or to come to the end of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُتمّ شيئاً أو يصل إلى نهايته
entries.example: Please finish your homework before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: An organization of people whose job is to put out fires.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرقة الإطفاء المسؤولة عن إخماد الحرائق
entries.example: Someone called the fire brigade when the kitchen caught fire.

entries.definitionEn: The heat and light produced when something burns.
entries.arabicMeaning: نار؛ الحرارة والضوء الناتجان عن الاحتراق
entries.example: They sat around the fire to keep warm.

entries.definitionEn: A building where firefighters wait and keep their vehicles and equipment.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركز إطفاء تنتظر فيه الفرق وتُحفظ المعدات
entries.example: The fire station is on the corner of High Street.

entries.definitionEn: To shoot a gun or similar weapon. Also to dismiss someone from a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلق النار من سلاح؛ أو يفصل شخصاً من عمله
entries.example: The company fired him after the audit.

entries.definitionEn: A gun that a person can carry and fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلاح ناري يمكن حمله
entries.example: The museum displayed an old firearm from the last century.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل إطفاء أو عنصر إنقاذ يعمل على إخماد الحرائق
entries.example: A firefighter carried the child out of the building.

entries.definitionEn: An open space in a wall where a fire can be lit indoors.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدفأة جدارية تُشعل فيها النار داخل البيت
entries.example: Logs burned quietly in the fireplace.

entries.definitionEn: A security system that controls what data can enter or leave a computer network.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدار حماية يضبط دخول البيانات إلى شبكة حاسوبية وخروجها منها
entries.example: The company's firewall blocked the suspicious download.

entries.definitionEn: A device that explodes with coloured light and noise, used at celebrations.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاروخ ألعاب نارية يضيء ويُحدث صوتاً في الاحتفالات
entries.example: A firework burst above the river at midnight.

entries.definitionEn: Solid and not easily bent. Also definite and not likely to change.
entries.arabicMeaning: متين لا ينثني بسهولة؛ أو حاسم غير قابل للتراجع
entries.example: Give the lid a firm push until it closes.

entries.definitionEn: A company or business, especially a professional one.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة أو مكتب مهني
entries.example: She joined a law firm in the city.

entries.definitionEn: To make something more solid, steady, or definite.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت شيئاً أو يجعله أكثر صلابة أو حسماً
entries.example: They need to firm up the travel dates this week.

entries.definitionEn: In a strong, steady, or definite way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بثبات أو بحزم
entries.example: She held the child's hand firmly at the crossing.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being solid, steady, or determined.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلابة أو ثبات أو حزم
entries.example: The firmness of the mattress suited his back.

entries.definitionEn: Coming before all others in time, order, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوّل في الزمن أو الترتيب أو الأهمية
entries.example: This is my first visit to the city.

entries.definitionEn: Before anything else, or for the first time.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولاً قبل أي شيء آخر، أو للمرة الأولى
entries.example: First, wash your hands.

entries.definitionEn: On the floor of a building that is one level above the ground (in British English), or at ground level (in American English).
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع في الطابق الأول: فوق الأرضي في الإنكليزية البريطانية، أو الأرضي في الأمريكية
entries.example: They rented a first-floor office above the shop.

entries.definitionEn: The floor of a building above the ground floor in British English, or the ground level in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطابق الأول: فوق الأرضي بريطانياً، أو مستوى الأرض أمريكياً
entries.example: The clinic is on the first floor.

entries.definitionEn: The wife of a president or other head of state, or a woman in a similar public role.
entries.arabicMeaning: السيدة الأولى، زوجة رئيس الدولة أو من في حكمها
entries.example: The first lady opened the new children's hospital.

entries.definitionEn: The language a person learns from birth and uses most naturally.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللغة الأم التي يتعلّمها المرء منذ ولادته
entries.example: Arabic is her first language.

entries.definitionEn: The name given to you at birth, not your family name.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاسم الأول لا اسم العائلة
entries.example: Please write your first name at the top of the form.

entries.definitionEn: The grammatical form using I and we. Also a story told by a character as "I".
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير المتكلم (أنا/نحن)؛ أو سرد بضمير الأنا
entries.example: The novel is written in the first person.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the first of several points.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولاً؛ لافتتاح أولى النقاط في تعداد
entries.example: Firstly, we need to agree on the budget.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to government money, especially taxes and public spending.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالي حكومي، ولا سيما ما يخص الضرائب والإنفاق العام
entries.example: The minister announced a new fiscal policy.

entries.definitionEn: An animal that lives in water and breathes through gills.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمك؛ حيوان يعيش في الماء ويتنفس بالخياشيم
entries.example: There are many fish in this lake.

entries.definitionEn: To try to catch fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصيد السمك
entries.example: They fish in the river every weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A person who catches fish, for work or as a hobby.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيّاد سمك
entries.example: The fisherman pulled the net onto the boat.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of catching fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيد السمك نشاطاً أو هواية
entries.example: Fishing is popular on this lake.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow crack, especially in rock, earth, or ice.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقّ طويل ضيّق، ولا سيما في الصخر أو الأرض
entries.example: A deep fissure split the glacier.

entries.definitionEn: How well clothes or equipment match a body. Also a sudden short burst of illness or emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى ملاءمة الثوب أو الأداة للجسم؛ أو نوبة مفاجئة من مرض أو انفعال
entries.example: These shoes have a comfortable fit.

entries.definitionEn: To be the right size or shape for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناسب حجماً أو شكلاً
entries.example: These shoes don't fit me.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being physically healthy and strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: لياقة بدنية؛ حال الصحة والقوة الجسدية
entries.example: Regular swimming improved her fitness.

entries.definitionEn: The number 5.
entries.arabicMeaning: خمسة
entries.example: She has five books on the desk.

entries.definitionEn: A solution to a problem. Also an awkward situation that is hard to escape.
entries.arabicMeaning: حل لمشكلة؛ أو مأزق يصعب الخروج منه
entries.example: Restarting the laptop was a quick fix.

entries.definitionEn: To repair something, or to arrange it so that it is ready.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصلح شيئاً أو يرتّبه حتى يصبح جاهزاً
entries.example: Can you fix the broken chair?

entries.definitionEn: Not changing, or fastened firmly in one place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثابت لا يتغيّر، أو مشدود في موضع واحد
entries.example: The rent is a fixed amount each month.

entries.definitionEn: A sports event that is already scheduled. Also an object attached to a building, such as a light or tap.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباراة محددة الموعد؛ أو تجهيز ثابت في مبنى كالمصباح أو الحنفية
entries.example: Saturday's fixture was postponed because of rain.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth with a design that represents a country, group, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم قماشي يرمز إلى بلد أو جماعة أو فكرة
entries.example: They raised the flag at sunrise.

entries.definitionEn: Becoming weaker, slower, or less enthusiastic.
entries.arabicMeaning: متراجع النشاط أو الحماس
entries.example: Coffee revived his flagging energy in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: The hot, bright gas that rises from a fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: لهب؛ الغاز الحار الساطع المتصاعد من النار
entries.example: A flame leapt from the dry wood.

entries.definitionEn: To move up and down or from side to side, like wings or a loose piece of cloth.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفرف صعوداً وهبوطاً كالأجنحة أو قطعة قماش فضفاضة
entries.example: The bird flapped its wings and rose into the air.

entries.definitionEn: Happening very quickly and suddenly. Also showy and meant to impress.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاطف وسريع جداً؛ أو مبهرج بقصد الإعجاب
entries.example: A flash flood closed the mountain road.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden bright light, or a very short period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ومضة ضوء مفاجئة، أو لحظة قصيرة جداً
entries.example: There was a flash of lightning over the hills.

entries.definitionEn: To shine brightly for a moment, or to appear suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلمع لحظة أو يظهر فجأة
entries.example: A warning light flashed on the dashboard.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden memory of an earlier event, or a scene in a story that returns to the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: استرجاع مفاجئ لذكرى، أو مشهد يعود بالقصة إلى الماضي
entries.example: The film opens with a flashback to her childhood.

entries.definitionEn: A bottle designed to keep liquid hot or cold, or a glass container used in a laboratory.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارورة لحفظ السائل ساخناً أو بارداً، أو وعاء زجاجي مخبري
entries.example: He poured tea from a thermos flask.

entries.definitionEn: Level, with no raised parts. Also without energy, interest, or fizz.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستوٍ بلا نتوءات؛ أو فاتر بلا حيوية أو فقاعات
entries.example: They looked for a flat piece of ground to pitch the tent.

entries.definitionEn: In a level position, or completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل مستوٍ، أو تماماً
entries.example: Lay the map flat on the table.

entries.definitionEn: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقة سكنية غالباً في طابق واحد
entries.example: They live in a small flat near the station.

entries.definitionEn: At the greatest possible speed or effort. Also completely exhausted.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأقصى سرعة أو جهد؛ أو مرهق تماماً
entries.example: She worked flat out to meet the deadline.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone more than is sincere, often to win favour. Also to make someone look more attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجامل بمدح مبالغ فيه لكسب الرضا؛ أو يُظهر الشخص بمظهر أجمل
entries.example: Don't flatter me; just tell me if the draft is clear.

entries.definitionEn: Praise that is excessive or not entirely sincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: مديح مفرط أو غير خالص
entries.example: He saw through the flattery at once.

entries.definitionEn: The taste of a food or drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: نكهة الطعام أو الشراب
entries.example: This soup has a rich tomato flavour.

entries.definitionEn: A fault or weakness that makes something less perfect.
entries.arabicMeaning: عيب أو ثغرة تنقص من كمال الشيء
entries.example: There is a small flaw in the glass.

entries.definitionEn: Without any faults or mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالٍ من العيوب أو الأخطاء
entries.example: Her performance was flawless.

entries.definitionEn: A plant grown for its fibre, used to make linen, and for its seeds.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتّان؛ نبات يُزرع لِليفه الذي يُصنع منه الكتان ولِبذوره
entries.example: Farmers in the valley still grow flax for linen.

entries.definitionEn: A small jumping insect that lives on animals and bites them.
entries.arabicMeaning: برغوث؛ حشرة صغيرة تقفز وتعيش على الحيوانات وتلدغها
entries.example: The dog kept scratching because of a flea.

entries.definitionEn: To run away from danger or from a place as quickly as possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرّ من خطر أو مكان بأسرع ما يمكن
entries.example: Residents had to flee the rising water.

entries.definitionEn: A group of ships, or of vehicles owned by one organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسطول سفن، أو مجموعة مركبات تملكها جهة واحدة
entries.example: The company runs a fleet of delivery vans.

entries.definitionEn: The soft part of a body between the skin and the bones. Also the soft inner part of a fruit.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم الجسم بين الجلد والعظم؛ أو لبّ الثمرة
entries.example: Cut away the flesh of the mango from the stone.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to bend easily, or to change according to the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرونة في الانثناء أو في التكيّف مع الظروف
entries.example: The job offers some flexibility in working hours.

entries.definitionEn: Able to bend easily without breaking, or able to change to fit new conditions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرن ينثني بلا انكسار، أو قابل للتكيّف
entries.example: We need a more flexible schedule this month.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can change to fit the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمرونة تتكيّف مع الظرف
entries.example: The team worked flexibly around school holidays.

entries.definitionEn: To move something with a short, sudden motion of the fingers or wrist.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقر أو يحرّك شيئاً بحركة قصيرة مفاجئة للأصابع أو المعصم
entries.example: She flicked the switch and the lamp came on.

entries.definitionEn: A brief, unsteady light or movement. Also a faint, passing feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: وميض غير ثابت أو حركة خاطفة؛ أو شعور عابر خافت
entries.example: A flicker of doubt crossed his face.

entries.definitionEn: A journey by plane. Also the act of flying, or of running away.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة بالطائرة؛ أو الطيران، أو الفرار
entries.example: Our flight leaves at six in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being unreliable or of changing mood and purpose too easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: طيش وتقلّب في المزاج أو المقصد
entries.example: His flightiness made long-term planning almost impossible.

entries.definitionEn: Not serious or reliable; changing mood or interest too easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائش غير ثابت، سريع تبدّل المزاج أو الاهتمام
entries.example: She dismissed the rumour as the talk of a flighty neighbour.

entries.definitionEn: To turn something over quickly, or to change suddenly to the opposite state.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلب شيئاً بسرعة، أو يتحوّل فجأة إلى النقيض
entries.example: He flipped the pancake with a short toss.

entries.definitionEn: To move lightly and quickly from place to place, staying only a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقل بخفة وسرعة من موضع إلى آخر ولا يلبث طويلاً
entries.example: Butterflies flit from flower to flower.

entries.definitionEn: An object that stays on the surface of water. Also a decorated vehicle in a parade.
entries.arabicMeaning: عَوّامة تبقى على سطح الماء؛ أو مركبة مزيّنة في موكب
entries.example: She held onto the float while she learned to swim.

entries.definitionEn: To stay on the surface of a liquid without sinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطفو على سطح السائل بلا غوص
entries.example: Leaves float on the pond after rain.

entries.definitionEn: A group of birds, sheep, or similar animals that move together.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرب طيور أو قطيع أغنام يتحرّك معاً
entries.example: A flock of geese passed over the field.

entries.definitionEn: A sheet of floating ice, especially in the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوح جليد عائم، ولا سيما في البحر
entries.example: The ship slowed beside a wide ice floe.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount of water covering land that is usually dry.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيضان يغمر أرضاً تكون في العادة جافة
entries.example: The flood damaged several houses by the river.

entries.definitionEn: To cover a place with water, or to arrive in very large numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغمر مكاناً بالماء، أو يتوافد بأعداد هائلة
entries.example: Heavy rain flooded the lower streets.

entries.definitionEn: Gates that control the flow of water. Also, in speech, something that, once opened, lets a large flow begin.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوابات تضبط تدفق الماء؛ ومجازاً ما إن يُفتح حتى يندفع سيل كبير
entries.example: The ruling opened the floodgates to similar claims.

entries.definitionEn: The surface you walk on inside a building. Also a level of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرضية المبنى التي تُمشى عليها؛ أو طابق فيه
entries.example: Please don't leave your bag on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: A powder made from grain, used for baking bread and cakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقيق يُصنع من الحبوب ويُستخدم في الخبز والكعك
entries.example: Mix the flour with milk and eggs.

entries.definitionEn: A bold, showy movement or an extra decorative detail meant to impress.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركة استعراضية أو زخرفة بارزة يُقصد بها الإبهار
entries.example: He signed the letter with a flourish.

entries.definitionEn: To grow or develop successfully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزدهر وينمو بنجاح
entries.example: Small bookshops still flourish in this neighbourhood.

entries.definitionEn: The steady movement of a liquid, or of people, traffic, or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريان منتظم لسائل، أو لحركة الناس أو المرور أو الأفكار
entries.example: The flow of traffic slowed after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: To move steadily and continuously in one direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجري بثبات واستمرار في اتجاه واحد
entries.example: The river flows down to the sea.

entries.definitionEn: The colourful part of a plant, often with a pleasant smell.
entries.arabicMeaning: زهرة النبات، غالباً ذات لون ورائحة زكية
entries.example: She picked a yellow flower from the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A common illness with fever, aches, and a runny nose.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنفلونزا؛ مرض شائع بحمّى وآلام وسيلان أنف
entries.example: He stayed home because he had the flu.

entries.definitionEn: To rise and fall irregularly over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتذبذب صعوداً وهبوطاً بغير انتظام
entries.example: Fuel prices fluctuate from week to week.

entries.definitionEn: An irregular rise and fall in amount, level, or value.
entries.arabicMeaning: تذبذب غير منتظم في مقدار أو مستوى أو قيمة
entries.example: Small fluctuations in temperature are normal.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to speak or write a language easily, accurately, and without long pauses.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلاقة في الكلام أو الكتابة بلا توقفات طويلة
entries.example: Daily practice improved her fluency in Spanish.

entries.definitionEn: Able to speak a language easily and well.
entries.arabicMeaning: طليق يتكلم لغة بسهولة وإجادة
entries.example: He is fluent in French and Italian.

entries.definitionEn: In a smooth, easy way, especially when speaking a language.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطلاقة وسلاسة، ولا سيما في الكلام
entries.example: She speaks English fluently.

entries.definitionEn: Able to flow like a liquid. Also changing easily and not fixed in form.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائل قابل للجريان؛ أو متغيّر غير ثابت الشكل
entries.example: The situation remained fluid throughout the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To fail a test, exam, or course (informal).
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسب في اختبار أو مقرر (غير رسمي)
entries.example: He flunked the driving test the first time.

entries.definitionEn: A musical instrument that you hold sideways and blow across a hole.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناي عرضي أو فلوت يُنفخ من الجانب
entries.example: She played a slow melody on the flute.

entries.definitionEn: A light, quick, irregular movement, as of wings or a heartbeat. Also a feeling of nervous excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفرفة خفيفة غير منتظمة؛ أو شعور بإثارة قلقة
entries.example: She felt a flutter of nerves before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: A small insect with two wings.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذبابة؛ حشرة صغيرة بجناحين
entries.example: A fly landed on the window.

entries.definitionEn: To move through the air, or to travel by plane.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطير في الهواء أو يسافر بالطائرة
entries.example: Birds fly south in winter.

entries.definitionEn: The centre of attention or activity. Also the point at which an image is sharp.
entries.arabicMeaning: بؤرة الاهتمام أو النشاط؛ أو نقطة وضوح الصورة
entries.example: The focus of the meeting was the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To give all your attention to one thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركّز كل انتباهه على شيء واحد
entries.example: Please focus on the question.

entries.definitionEn: Thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضباب كثيف قرب الأرض يحجب الرؤية
entries.example: Thick fog covered the road this morning.

entries.definitionEn: Full of fog, so it is hard to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضبابي يحجب الرؤية
entries.example: It was a foggy morning by the river.

entries.definitionEn: A line where something is bent over on itself. Also a group of people who share the same beliefs.
entries.arabicMeaning: طية ينثني عندها الشيء؛ أو جماعة يشتركون في معتقد
entries.example: Press along the fold so the paper lies flat.

entries.definitionEn: To bend something so that one part lies on another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطوي شيئاً حتى ينطبق جزء على جزء
entries.example: Fold the letter before you put it in the envelope.

entries.definitionEn: A cover for holding papers, or a place on a computer where files are kept.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجلّد لحفظ الأوراق، أو مجلد على الحاسوب للملفات
entries.example: Save the photos in a new folder.

entries.definitionEn: People in general. Also traditional music or culture of ordinary people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناس عموماً؛ أو تراث شعبي وموسيقى تقليدية
entries.example: Country folk often know the local paths well.

entries.definitionEn: A traditional story passed down among ordinary people, usually by word of mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكاية شعبية تُتوارث مشافهة بين عامة الناس
entries.example: Grandmother told a folktale about a clever fox.

entries.definitionEn: To go after someone, or to do what someone says or shows.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتبع شخصاً أو يمتثل لما يقوله أو يبيّنه
entries.example: Please follow me to the waiting room.

entries.definitionEn: A person who supports someone or copies them. Also a person who reads someone's posts online.
entries.arabicMeaning: تابع يؤيد شخصاً أو يقتدي به؛ أو متابع لحساب على الإنترنت
entries.example: The writer has thousands of followers on social media.

entries.definitionEn: Coming next in time or order.
entries.arabicMeaning: التالي في الزمن أو الترتيب
entries.example: We leave the following morning.

entries.definitionEn: After a particular event, or as a result of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد حدث معيّن أو نتيجة له
entries.example: Following the storm, several roads were closed.

entries.definitionEn: A foolish act, idea, or lack of good judgement.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماقة أو فعل أحمق يدل على سوء تقدير
entries.example: It would be folly to ignore the warning signs.

entries.definitionEn: Having a warm liking for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مولع بشخص أو شيء محبةً دافئة
entries.example: He is fond of long walks by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows warm affection or pleasant memory.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحنان أو بمودة دافئة
entries.example: She spoke fondly of her years at university.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of liking someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل محبّ ومودة تجاه شخص أو شيء
entries.example: He never lost his fondness for old jazz records.

entries.definitionEn: Things that people and animals eat.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام يأكله الناس والحيوانات
entries.example: The shop sells fresh food every day.

entries.definitionEn: A person who behaves in a silly or unwise way.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحمق يتصرف بغباء أو دون حكمة
entries.example: Don't be a fool; wear a coat in this rain.

entries.definitionEn: To trick someone into believing something that is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخدع شخصاً فيصدّق ما ليس صحيحاً
entries.example: The fake email did not fool her.

entries.definitionEn: Not sensible; silly or unwise.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحمق غير حكيم
entries.example: It was foolish to leave the door unlocked.

entries.definitionEn: In a silly or unwise way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحماقة أو دون رويّة
entries.example: He foolishly lent money he could not spare.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body at the end of the leg, used for standing and walking. Also a unit of length equal to twelve inches.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدم؛ وأيضاً وحدة طول تعادل اثني عشر بوصة
entries.example: He hurt his foot while walking on the rocks.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two teams kick a ball and try to score. Also the ball used in that game.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة القدم؛ أو الكرة المستخدمة فيها
entries.example: The children play football after school.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays football as a job or as a hobby.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاعب كرة قدم
entries.example: He wants to be a professional footballer.

entries.definitionEn: A short note at the bottom of a page that explains something in the text.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاشية توضيحية في أسفل الصفحة
entries.example: Read the footnote before you quote that figure.

entries.definitionEn: A linking word meaning 'because', used mainly in formal or literary English.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف ربط بمعنى «لأنّ»، ويكثر في الأسلوب الرسمي
entries.example: She spoke quietly, for the baby was asleep.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show purpose, who receives something, or how long something lasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يبيّن الغرض أو المستفيد أو المدة
entries.example: This present is for my sister.

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone is not allowed to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنع شخصاً من فعل شيء
entries.example: The school forbids phones in class.

entries.definitionEn: Not allowed by a rule or law.
entries.arabicMeaning: محظور بموجب قاعدة أو قانون
entries.example: Smoking is forbidden in this building.

entries.definitionEn: Power that makes something move or happen. Also a group of people organized for a purpose, such as the police.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوة تحرّك شيئاً أو تُحدثه؛ أو جهاز منظّم كالشرطة
entries.example: The force of the wind closed the door.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone do something they do not want to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُجبر شخصاً على فعل ما لا يريد
entries.example: Do not force her to sign the contract.

entries.definitionEn: In a strong and determined way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقوة وعزم
entries.example: He argued forcefully for a later deadline.

entries.definitionEn: A statement about what is likely to happen, especially about the weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقّع لما سيحدث، ولا سيما حالة الطقس
entries.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the face above the eyes and below the hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجبهة
entries.example: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.

entries.definitionEn: From another country.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجنبي؛ من بلد آخر
entries.example: She is learning a foreign language.

entries.definitionEn: A person who comes from another country.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص من بلد آخر
entries.example: Many foreigners visit the old city each year.

entries.definitionEn: A worker who is in charge of a group of other workers.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيس العمال
entries.example: The foreman checked the safety equipment before the shift.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to scientific methods used to investigate crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرعي جنائي؛ متعلق بالتحقيق العلمي في الجرائم
entries.example: Forensic evidence linked the suspect to the scene.

entries.definitionEn: To expect that something will happen in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقع حدوث شيء في المستقبل
entries.example: Nobody could foresee how long the delay would last.

entries.definitionEn: A large area of land covered with trees.
entries.arabicMeaning: غابة
entries.example: We walked through the forest all morning.

entries.definitionEn: The science and work of planting and looking after forests.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الغابات والعمل على رعايتها
entries.example: She studied forestry at university.

entries.definitionEn: For all time; always.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأبد
entries.example: I will remember that day forever.

entries.definitionEn: To lose or give up something as a penalty.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفقد شيئاً أو يتنازل عنه عقاباً
entries.example: They had to forfeit the deposit when they cancelled.

entries.definitionEn: The loss of property or a right as a legal penalty.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصادرة مال أو حق عقاباً قانونياً
entries.example: The court ordered the forfeiture of the stolen funds.

entries.definitionEn: To not remember something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسى
entries.example: Do not forget your keys.

entries.definitionEn: To stop feeling angry with someone for something they did.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسامح
entries.example: She found it hard to forgive the lie.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with points that you use to pick up food.
entries.arabicMeaning: شوكة للأكل
entries.example: He picked up his fork and started eating.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy, lonely, and as if there is little hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: كئيب مهجور يبدو بلا أمل
entries.example: The empty station looked forlorn in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: In a sad, lonely way that suggests little hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيأس كئيب
entries.example: She waited forlornly for a call that never came.

entries.definitionEn: A printed paper with spaces for you to write information.
entries.arabicMeaning: استمارة
entries.example: Please fill in this form.

entries.definitionEn: To make something start to exist, or to come together as a shape or group.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوّن شيئاً أو يتشكّل
entries.example: Ice began to form on the window.

entries.definitionEn: Official or following accepted rules, not relaxed or casual.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسمي
entries.example: The letter was written in a formal style.

entries.definitionEn: An official procedure that must be followed, even if it feels empty. Also stiff, official behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجراء رسمي لا بد منه؛ أو تكلّف في السلوك
entries.example: The interview was largely a formality.

entries.definitionEn: In an official or polite way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل رسمي
entries.example: She was formally invited to the ceremony.

entries.definitionEn: The way something is arranged or presented.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنسيق أو هيئة العرض
entries.example: Save the file in PDF format.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange text or data in a particular layout.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسّق نصاً أو بيانات وفق هيئة معيّنة
entries.example: Please format the report with clear headings.

entries.definitionEn: The process of coming into existence, or an arranged shape or group.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكوّن؛ أو تشكيلة مرتّبة
entries.example: Cloud formation was unusually rapid that afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: From an earlier time; previous.
entries.arabicMeaning: سابق
entries.example: She met her former teacher at the market.

entries.definitionEn: In the past; before now.
entries.arabicMeaning: سابقاً
entries.example: The building was formerly a school.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is impressive and perhaps intimidating because of skill or strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مهاب يثير الإعجاب أو الوجل
entries.example: The team was formidably well prepared.

entries.definitionEn: A set of numbers, letters, or rules used to work something out. Also a fixed method.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة حسابية أو قاعدة ثابتة للعمل
entries.example: He used a simple formula to check the cost.

entries.definitionEn: To create or express a plan, idea, or theory carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوغ خطة أو فكرة بعناية
entries.example: The committee will formulate a new policy.

entries.definitionEn: Out into view, or onwards from a place or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأمام أو إلى الخارج
entries.example: She stepped forth to greet the guests.

entries.definitionEn: Planned to happen soon. Also willing to give information.
entries.arabicMeaning: وشيك؛ أو صريح في إعطاء المعلومات
entries.example: Details of the forthcoming concert will be announced next week.

entries.definitionEn: A period of two weeks.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسبوعان
entries.example: They will be away for a fortnight.

entries.definitionEn: Lucky.
entries.arabicMeaning: محظوظ
entries.example: We were fortunate to find a taxi so quickly.

entries.definitionEn: In a lucky way; it is lucky that.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحسن الحظ
entries.example: Fortunately, the train was not late.

entries.definitionEn: Luck, good or bad. Also a very large amount of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظ؛ أو ثروة كبيرة
entries.example: She made a fortune from the business.

entries.definitionEn: The number 40.
entries.arabicMeaning: أربعون
entries.example: There are forty chairs in the room.

entries.definitionEn: Towards a place in front of you.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الأمام
entries.example: Please step forward and give your name.

entries.definitionEn: The remains of a plant or animal preserved in rock from a very long time ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحفورة
entries.example: The museum has a rare fossil of an early fish.

entries.definitionEn: Very unpleasant, dirty, or against the rules in a sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريه أو قذر؛ أو مخالِف لقواعد الرياضة
entries.example: A foul smell came from the drain.

entries.definitionEn: To start an organization, school, or city.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤسّس منظمة أو مدينة
entries.example: They founded the company in 2010.

entries.definitionEn: The solid base of a building. Also an organization that gives money for a cause, or the basis of an idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساس مبنى؛ أو مؤسسة مانحة؛ أو قاعدة فكرة
entries.example: The house needs a strong foundation.

entries.definitionEn: A structure that sends water up into the air, often in a public place.
entries.arabicMeaning: نافورة
entries.example: Children played near the fountain in the square.

entries.definitionEn: The number 4.
entries.arabicMeaning: أربعة
entries.example: There are four people in our family.

entries.definitionEn: The number 14.
entries.arabicMeaning: أربعة عشر
entries.example: She turned fourteen last month.

entries.definitionEn: A wild animal with reddish fur, a pointed face, and a thick tail.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثعلب
entries.example: A fox ran across the field at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a whole, especially written as one number over another. Also a small amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسر رياضي؛ أو جزء يسير
entries.example: Only a small fraction of the letters were answered.

entries.definitionEn: Easily annoyed and hard to control.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكس سريع الغضب ويصعب ضبطه
entries.example: The fractious debate achieved very little.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece that has broken off something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شظية أو قطعة منكسرة
entries.example: She found a fragment of glass on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: The process of breaking or being broken into small pieces or groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفتت أو انقسام إلى أجزاء
entries.example: The fragmentation of the market made prices unstable.

entries.definitionEn: A pleasant smell.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائحة زكية أو عطر
entries.example: The fragrance of jasmine filled the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A border of wood or metal around a picture, window, or door. Also the basic structure of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطار؛ أو هيكل أساسي
entries.example: She put the photo in a wooden frame.

entries.definitionEn: To put a picture in a frame. Also to express an idea in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع صورة في إطار؛ أو يصوغ فكرة بصيغة معيّنة
entries.example: He framed the painting and hung it in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Honest and direct when you speak.
entries.arabicMeaning: صريح
entries.example: Be frank with me about the problem.

entries.definitionEn: In an honest, direct way; used to show you are being open.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصراحة
entries.example: Frankly, I do not think that plan will work.

entries.definitionEn: In a hurried, anxious way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعجلة وقلق شديدين
entries.example: She searched frantically for her passport.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of tricking someone in order to get money or an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتيال
entries.example: He was arrested for credit-card fraud.

entries.definitionEn: To become very frightened, angry, or excited all of a sudden (informal).
entries.arabicMeaning: ينهار أو يفزع فجأة (غير رسمي)
entries.example: She freaked when she saw the bill.

entries.definitionEn: Costing no money. Also able to do what you want, or not busy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاني؛ أو حرّ غير مقيّد؛ أو غير مشغول
entries.example: The museum is free on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: Without paying, or without being limited.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاناً أو بلا قيد
entries.example: Children under five travel free.

entries.definitionEn: To let someone or something out of a place where they are trapped.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّر من حبس أو مأزق
entries.example: Firefighters freed the driver from the car.

entries.definitionEn: The right or state of being able to live and act as you wish.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرية
entries.example: They fought for freedom of speech.

entries.definitionEn: Without being limited or controlled.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحرية ومن دون قيد
entries.example: You can speak freely in this meeting.

entries.definitionEn: To turn into ice, or to become very cold. Also to keep food very cold so it lasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجمّد أو يشتدّ برده؛ أو يجمّد طعاماً
entries.example: Water will freeze in this weather.

entries.definitionEn: A large box or part of a fridge that keeps food frozen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجمّدة لحفظ الطعام
entries.example: Put the meat in the freezer.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارص البرودة
entries.example: It is freezing outside this morning.

entries.definitionEn: How often something happens. Also the rate of a sound or radio wave.
entries.arabicMeaning: تواتر الحدوث؛ أو تردد موجة
entries.example: The frequency of the buses is better on weekdays.

entries.definitionEn: Happening often.
entries.arabicMeaning: متكرر
entries.example: There are frequent delays on this line.

entries.definitionEn: Often.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيراً، بشكل متكرر
entries.example: She frequently works from home.

entries.definitionEn: Recently made, picked, or produced, and still good. Also new or clean.
entries.arabicMeaning: طازج؛ أو جديد نظيف
entries.example: Buy fresh bread in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A student in the first year of high school or university, especially in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: طالب السنة الأولى
entries.example: My brother is a freshman at college.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوم الجمعة
entries.example: We finish work early on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: A cold cupboard in the kitchen for keeping food fresh.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاجة
entries.example: Milk should be kept in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: Cooked in hot oil.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلي
entries.example: I ordered fried eggs and toast.

entries.definitionEn: A person you know well and like to spend time with.
entries.arabicMeaning: صديق
entries.example: She is my best friend.

entries.definitionEn: Kind, pleasant behaviour towards other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ودّ ولطف في المعاملة
entries.example: His friendliness made the new staff feel welcome.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and pleasant towards other people. Also describing a relationship that is not hostile.
entries.arabicMeaning: ودود
entries.example: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.

entries.definitionEn: The relationship between people who are friends.
entries.arabicMeaning: صداقة
entries.example: Their friendship began at school.

entries.definitionEn: A medium-sized fast warship.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرقاطة
entries.example: The frigate returned to port after the exercise.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden feeling of fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: فزعة، خوف مفاجئ
entries.example: The loud bang gave her a fright.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيف
entries.example: Thunder can frighten young children.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: خائف
entries.example: The frightened cat hid under the bed.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيف
entries.example: That film was too frightening for me.

entries.definitionEn: A small animal that lives in water and on land and can jump well.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضفدع
entries.example: A frog sat on a leaf in the pond.

entries.definitionEn: To play in a lively, happy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمرح ويلعب بحيوية
entries.example: The dogs frolic in the snow every winter.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show where someone or something starts, comes from, or is sent.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يبيّن المصدر أو نقطة البداية
entries.example: This letter is from my uncle.

entries.definitionEn: At the side that faces forward.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمامي
entries.example: Please use the front door.

entries.definitionEn: The part of something that faces forward, or the place in front.
entries.arabicMeaning: الواجهة أو المقدمة
entries.example: There is a garden at the front of the house.

entries.definitionEn: The border between two countries. Also the edge of what is known or settled.
