entries.arabicMeaning: حدود بين بلدين؛ أو تخوم ما هو معروف
entries.example: They crossed the frontier at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A thin white layer of ice that forms on surfaces when it is very cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: صقيع
entries.example: There was frost on the grass this morning.

entries.definitionEn: To become covered with frost. Also to cover a cake with icing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغطّى بالصقيع؛ أو يكسو كعكة بالكريمة
entries.example: Cold air frosted the car windows overnight.

entries.definitionEn: In an unfriendly, cold manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببرود فيه جفاء
entries.example: She answered frostily and left the room.

entries.definitionEn: Very cold and covered with frost. Also unfriendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: صقيعي؛ أو بارد الجفاء في المعاملة
entries.example: Their greeting was polite but frosty.

entries.definitionEn: Turned into ice, or kept very cold. Also unable to move because of fear or cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجمّد؛ أو مشلول من الخوف أو البرد
entries.example: The lake was frozen in January.

entries.definitionEn: Careful not to waste money or food.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقتصد لا يبدّد المال أو الطعام
entries.example: They lived a frugal life and saved enough to travel.

entries.definitionEn: The sweet part of a plant that you can eat, such as an apple or orange.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاكهة
entries.example: Would you like some fruit after lunch?

entries.definitionEn: The point at which a plan or effort is successfully realized.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحقّق أمر بعد جهد وانتظار
entries.example: After years of work, the project finally came to fruition.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling annoyed because you cannot do or change something.
entries.arabicMeaning: محبَط من العجز عن الإنجاز أو التغيير
entries.example: She felt frustrated when the software kept crashing.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being annoyed because you cannot do what you want.
entries.arabicMeaning: إحباط
entries.example: He hid his frustration and tried again.

entries.definitionEn: A thin piece of potato cooked in oil; usually used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة بطاطا مقلية؛ وتغلب صيغة الجمع
entries.example: He ordered fries with his sandwich.

entries.definitionEn: To cook food in hot oil or fat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلي الطعام في زيت ساخن
entries.example: I will fry the onions first.

entries.definitionEn: A wide, shallow pan used for frying food.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلاة
entries.example: Heat a little oil in the frying pan.

entries.definitionEn: A substance such as petrol, gas, or coal that is burned to produce heat or power.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقود
entries.example: The car is low on fuel.

entries.definitionEn: To do or provide what is needed, promised, or hoped for.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحقّق وعداً أو حاجة أو أملاً
entries.example: She worked hard to fulfil the terms of the contract.

entries.definitionEn: Holding or containing as much as possible. Also complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتلئ؛ أو كامل
entries.example: The bottle is full of water.

entries.definitionEn: The mark (.) used at the end of a sentence; also called a period.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقطة في نهاية الجملة
entries.example: Remember to put a full stop at the end.

entries.definitionEn: For all the hours of a normal working week.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدوام كامل
entries.example: She has a full-time job at the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: During all the hours of a normal working week.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أساس دوام كامل
entries.example: He now works full-time at the library.

entries.definitionEn: Completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً
entries.example: I don't fully understand the question.

entries.definitionEn: Smoke or gas that has a strong smell and can be harmful; usually used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبخرة ذات رائحة قوية وقد تكون ضارة
entries.example: Paint fumes filled the small room.

entries.definitionEn: Enjoyable and making you feel happy.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتع
entries.example: The party was really fun.

entries.definitionEn: Enjoyment and pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعة
entries.example: We had a lot of fun at the beach.

entries.definitionEn: The purpose of something, or the way it works. Also a formal event.
entries.arabicMeaning: وظيفة الشيء أو غرضه؛ أو مناسبة رسمية
entries.example: The function of the heart is to pump blood.

entries.definitionEn: To work in the correct way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعمل كما ينبغي
entries.example: The printer is not functioning.

entries.definitionEn: Practical and useful rather than decorative. Also working correctly.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملي يؤدي الغرض؛ أو صالح للعمل
entries.example: The kitchen is small but functional.

entries.definitionEn: The range of things that a product or system can do.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة الوظائف والإمكانات
entries.example: The new app has more functionality than the old one.

entries.definitionEn: A sum of money saved or collected for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: مال مجموع لغرض معيّن
entries.example: They set up a fund to repair the school.

entries.definitionEn: To provide money for a project or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: يموّل
entries.example: The city will fund the new sports centre.

entries.definitionEn: Forming the base of something; very important and basic.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهري أساسي
entries.example: Honesty is fundamental to trust.

entries.definitionEn: A ceremony for someone who has died.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنازة
entries.example: Many friends came to the funeral.

entries.definitionEn: A style of dance music with a strong rhythm. Also a state of fear or low mood.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى فانك ذات إيقاع قوي؛ أو حالة خوف أو كآبة
entries.example: The band mixed jazz with funk.

entries.definitionEn: Fashionable in an unusual, lively way. Also having the style of funk music.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنيق على نحو غير مألوف وحيوي؛ أو على طراز الفانك
entries.example: She wore a funky jacket to the party.

entries.definitionEn: Making you laugh.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضحك
entries.example: He told a funny story at dinner.

entries.definitionEn: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: فراء
entries.example: The cat's fur is very soft.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: غاضب جداً
entries.example: She was furious about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: In an extremely angry way. Also with intense energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغضب شديد؛ أو بنشاط محموم
entries.example: He typed furiously to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: To put furniture in a room. Also to supply something that is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤثّث غرفة؛ أو يوفّر ما يُحتاج إليه
entries.example: They furnished the apartment with simple chairs.

entries.definitionEn: Large objects such as tables, chairs, and beds that you use in a room.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثاث
entries.example: We need new furniture for the living room.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden outburst of public anger or excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضجة غاضبة أو هياج عام مفاجئ
entries.example: The announcement caused a furore in the press.

entries.definitionEn: More; additional.
entries.arabicMeaning: إضافي؛ مزيد من
entries.example: If you have further questions, please ask.

entries.definitionEn: To a greater distance or degree; more.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبعد؛ أو بدرجة أكبر
entries.example: We walked further down the road.

entries.definitionEn: In addition; used to add a stronger point.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاوة على ذلك
entries.example: The plan is cheap; furthermore, it is easy to run.

entries.definitionEn: To the greatest distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى أبعد مدى
entries.example: Who can throw the ball furthest?

entries.definitionEn: To join together and become one, especially when heated. Also, of an electrical fuse, to stop working.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندمج في واحد ولا سيما بالحرارة؛ أو يحترق المنصهر الكهربائي
entries.example: The metals fused under intense heat.

entries.definitionEn: The process or result of joining two things into one.
entries.arabicMeaning: اندماج شيئين في واحد
entries.example: The restaurant is known for its fusion of local and French cooking.

entries.definitionEn: Unnecessary excitement, worry, or activity about something small.
entries.arabicMeaning: جَلبة مبالغ فيها حول أمر يسير
entries.example: Don't make a fuss; it is only a small scratch.

entries.definitionEn: Coming after the present time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستقبلي
entries.example: We need to discuss future plans.

entries.definitionEn: The time that will come after now.
entries.arabicMeaning: المستقبل
entries.example: I want to study medicine in the future.

entries.definitionEn: A small, clever device that does a useful job.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة صغيرة ذكية تؤدي عملاً مفيداً
entries.example: This kitchen gadget slices vegetables in seconds.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling or atmosphere of cheerful enjoyment.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح بهيج
entries.example: The market was full of colour and gaiety.

entries.definitionEn: An increase in amount, profit, or advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكسب أو زيادة
entries.example: The company reported a small gain last year.

entries.definitionEn: To get or win something useful, such as time, weight, or an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتسب شيئاً نافعاً
entries.example: She gained a lot of experience in the role.

entries.definitionEn: A very strong wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاصفة رياح شديدة
entries.example: A gale blew tiles off the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Rude confidence; the nerve to do something that may offend.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقاحة وجرأة مستفزة
entries.example: He had the gall to ask for a raise after arriving late all week.

entries.definitionEn: A room or building where people look at works of art.
entries.arabicMeaning: معرض فني
entries.example: We spent the afternoon in the art gallery.

entries.definitionEn: A unit for measuring liquid, equal to about 4.5 litres in the UK.
entries.arabicMeaning: غالون، وحدة حجم للسوائل
entries.example: The tank holds about ten gallons of water.

entries.definitionEn: A calculated opening move, often involving a risk, made to gain an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناورة محسوبة في البداية وقد تنطوي على مخاطرة
entries.example: His opening gambit was a surprising offer of help.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of risking money on games or races in the hope of winning more.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقامرة
entries.example: He lost a lot of money through gambling.

entries.definitionEn: An activity with rules that you play for fun or as a sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة
entries.example: Would you like to play a game?

entries.definitionEn: In a brave, willing way despite difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشجاعة واستعداد رغم الصعوبة
entries.example: She smiled gamely and tried the steep path again.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who spend time together, especially one that causes trouble or commits crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصابة أو جماعة تتسكع معاً وقد تُحدث أذى
entries.example: The police broke up the gang last year.

entries.definitionEn: A member of a criminal gang.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل عصابات
entries.example: The film is about a gangster in the 1930s.

entries.definitionEn: A space or opening between two things. Also a difference between two situations.
entries.arabicMeaning: فجوة أو فراغ؛ أو تفاوت بين حالين
entries.example: There is a gap in the fence.

entries.definitionEn: To stare with your mouth open, often in surprise. Also to be wide open.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّق فاغر الفم دهشة؛ أو ينفرج على اتساع
entries.example: Tourists gape at the size of the waterfall.

entries.definitionEn: A building where you keep a car, or a place that repairs cars.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرآب أو ورشة سيارات
entries.example: He parked the car in the garage.

entries.definitionEn: Waste that you throw away; mainly used in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفايات
entries.example: Please put the garbage outside.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of land next to a house where you grow flowers, fruit, or vegetables.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديقة المنزل
entries.example: The children are playing in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to look after a garden.
entries.arabicMeaning: بستاني
entries.example: The gardener planted roses along the wall.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of looking after a garden.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعمال العناية بالحديقة
entries.example: Gardening is her favourite hobby.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with a strong taste and smell, used in cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثوم
entries.example: Add some garlic to the sauce.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة ملابس
entries.example: Each garment must be labelled with the size.

entries.definitionEn: A substance like air that is not solid or liquid, often used for cooking or heating. In American English, also petrol.
entries.arabicMeaning: غاز؛ وفي الأمريكية قد يعني بنزين السيارات
entries.example: Turn off the gas when you finish cooking.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden short breath in, because of surprise, pain, or lack of air.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهقة مفاجئة من دهشة أو ألم أو ضيق نفس
entries.example: There was a gasp from the crowd.

entries.definitionEn: A door in a fence or wall that you can open.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوابة
entries.example: Please close the gate behind you.

entries.definitionEn: An entrance that is a gate, or a means of reaching something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوابة عبور أو مدخل إلى شيء آخر
entries.example: The old town is a gateway to the mountains.

entries.definitionEn: To come together in one place, or to collect things.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجتمع أو يجمع أشياء
entries.example: The family gathered in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: Awkward and lacking social skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخرق يفتقر إلى اللباقة الاجتماعية
entries.example: His gauche remark silenced the table.

entries.definitionEn: Too bright and colourful in a way that shows poor taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبهرج مفرط الألوان بلا ذوق
entries.example: The shop window was full of gaudy decorations.

entries.definitionEn: Attracted to people of the same sex.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثلي الجنس
entries.example: She has been openly gay since university.

entries.definitionEn: A long, steady look.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحديقة طويلة ثابتة
entries.example: He met her gaze and did not look away.

entries.definitionEn: Equipment needed for a particular activity. Also the system in a vehicle that controls speed and power.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدات لازمة لنشاط؛ أو تروس المركبة
entries.example: Don't forget your hiking gear.

entries.definitionEn: A word people say when they are surprised or impressed (informal).
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة تُقال عند دهشة خفيفة (غير رسمية)
entries.example: Gee, I didn't know you could cook so well.

entries.definitionEn: A precious stone. Also a person or thing that is especially good or valuable.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهرة؛ أو شخص أو شيء نادر النفاسة
entries.example: That little restaurant is a real gem.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of being male, female, or another identity.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنس من حيث الذكورة أو الأنوثة أو غير ذلك
entries.example: The form asks for your name and gender.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a cell that passes traits from parents to children.
entries.arabicMeaning: مورّثة تنقل الصفات من الأبوين
entries.example: The gene is linked to eye colour.

entries.definitionEn: Not detailed; relating to most people or things, not one particular case.
entries.arabicMeaning: عام غير تفصيلي
entries.example: Start with a general introduction, then give the details.

entries.definitionEn: A very senior officer in an army.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنرال؛ قائد عسكري كبير
entries.example: The general inspected the troops.

entries.definitionEn: A broad statement that may be true in many cases but not in every one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعميم قد يصدق في كثير من الحالات لا كلها
entries.example: That generalization ignores important differences.

entries.definitionEn: To make a broad statement based on a few cases.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعمّم حكماً انطلاقاً من حالات قليلة
entries.example: It is unwise to generalise from one example.

entries.definitionEn: Usually; in most cases. Also by most people.
entries.arabicMeaning: عموماً في معظم الحالات
entries.example: I generally take the bus to work.

entries.definitionEn: To produce or create something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يولّد أو يُنتج
entries.example: The solar panels generate electricity.

entries.definitionEn: All the people born around the same period. Also a stage in a family.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيل
entries.example: This song is popular with the younger generation.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being willing to give more than is usual or necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرم
entries.example: We were touched by their generosity.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to give more money, time, or help than is usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريم
entries.example: It was generous of you to share your lunch.

entries.definitionEn: In a generous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بكرم
entries.example: She donated generously to the school fund.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to genes and the way traits are passed on.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيني وراثي
entries.example: Some diseases have a genetic cause.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to genes.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الجينية
entries.example: The two plants are genetically similar.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of genes and heredity.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الوراثة
entries.example: She is studying genetics at university.

entries.definitionEn: Very great and rare ability, or a person who has it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبقرية نادرة؛ أو شخص عبقري
entries.example: Mozart was a musical genius.

entries.definitionEn: The complete set of genes in a cell or living thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: المجموعة الكاملة من الجينات في خلية أو كائن حي
entries.example: Scientists have mapped the human genome.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a genome, the complete set of genes in an organism.
entries.arabicMeaning: جينومي؛ متعلق بالمجموعة الجينية الكاملة لكائن حي
entries.example: Genomic data helped identify the mutation.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to genomes or to genomic information.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو جينومي؛ من حيث المعلومات الجينية الكاملة
entries.example: The two species are genomically very similar.

entries.definitionEn: A particular type of literature, art, music, or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوع أدبي أو فني أو موسيقي أو سينمائي
entries.example: Science fiction is her favourite genre.

entries.definitionEn: Kind, calm, and not rough or loud.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف هادئ غير عنيف
entries.example: Be gentle with the kitten.

entries.definitionEn: A polite word for a man. Also a man who is polite and well mannered.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب مؤدب للرجل؛ أو رجل مهذب حسن السلوك
entries.example: An old gentleman held the door open.

entries.definitionEn: In a kind, careful, or soft way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلطف وعناية، أو برقة
entries.example: He closed the door gently.

entries.definitionEn: Real, not fake. Also honest and sincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقي غير مزيف؛ أو صادق مخلص
entries.example: Is this a genuine signature?

entries.definitionEn: Really; in an honest and sincere way.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقاً؛ بصدق وإخلاص
entries.example: She seemed genuinely pleased to see us.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the physical features of an area or to geography.
entries.arabicMeaning: جغرافي يتعلق بموقع منطقة أو بتضاريسها
entries.example: The geographic location of the port is excellent.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to geography or to the features of a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: جغرافي يتعلق بعلم الجغرافيا أو بخصائص المكان
entries.example: The map shows the geographical features of the region.

entries.definitionEn: The study of the Earth's lands, seas, and climate. Also the physical features of a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الجغرافيا؛ أو تضاريس منطقة وخصائصها
entries.example: We have a geography test tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the rocks, layers, and history of the Earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيولوجي يتعلق بصخور الأرض وطبقاتها وتاريخها
entries.example: The region has a complex geological history.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the Earth's rocks and geological history.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الجيولوجية؛ بما يخص صخور الأرض وتاريخها
entries.example: The island is geologically young.

entries.definitionEn: The study of the Earth's rocks, soil, and the way they were formed.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الجيولوجيا؛ دراسة صخور الأرض وتربتها وتكونها
entries.example: She studied geology at university.

entries.definitionEn: A very small living thing that can cause disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرثومة دقيقة قد تسبب المرض
entries.example: Wash your hands to kill germs.

entries.definitionEn: A movement of the hand or body that shows a feeling or idea. Also a small action that shows your attitude.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيماءة باليد أو الجسم؛ أو بادرة صغيرة تدل على موقف
entries.example: He made a gesture for us to sit down.

entries.definitionEn: To receive or obtain something. Also to become, or to arrive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصل على شيء أو يناله؛ أو يصبح، أو يصل
entries.example: Did you get my message?

entries.definitionEn: A short holiday. Also an escape from a place, especially after a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطلة قصيرة؛ أو فرار من مكان ولا سيما بعد جريمة
entries.example: They booked a weekend getaway by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A poor part of a city where a particular group of people live, often with little choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: حي فقير يتركّز فيه جماعة معيّنة، غالباً لقلة الخيارات
entries.example: He spent his childhood in a crowded city ghetto.

entries.definitionEn: The spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبح؛ روح ميت يُعتقد أنها تُرى
entries.example: The story is about a ghost in an old house.

entries.definitionEn: Like a ghost; pale, faint, or faintly eerie.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبحي؛ شاحب أو خافت أو موحش كالأشباح
entries.example: A ghostly light moved across the water.

entries.definitionEn: Very large; much bigger than usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملاق الحجم؛ أكبر بكثير من المعتاد
entries.example: They built a giant statue in the square.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you give to someone, especially on a special day.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدية تُقدَّم لشخص ولا سيما في مناسبة
entries.example: This gift is for you.

entries.definitionEn: Having a natural ability to do something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: موهوب ذو قدرة فطرية على شيء
entries.example: She is a gifted musician.

entries.definitionEn: A paid live performance by a musician or comedian. Also a short-term job.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفلة أداء مدفوعة لموسيقي أو كوميدي؛ أو عمل مؤقت
entries.example: The band has a gig in town tonight.

entries.definitionEn: A light, silly laugh that is often hard to stop.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضحكة خفيفة مكتومة يصعب وقفها أحياناً
entries.example: A giggle ran through the classroom.

entries.definitionEn: A hot-tasting root used in cooking, or the plant it comes from.
entries.arabicMeaning: زنجبيل؛ جذر حارّ الطعم يُستخدم في الطبخ
entries.example: Add some fresh ginger to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: A tall African animal with a very long neck and long legs.
entries.arabicMeaning: زرافة؛ حيوان أفريقي طويل العنق والقوائم
entries.example: The giraffe reached the high leaves.

entries.definitionEn: A female child, or a young woman.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتاة أو بنت
entries.example: The girl is reading a book.

entries.definitionEn: A girl or woman that someone is in a romantic relationship with.
entries.arabicMeaning: صديقة في علاقة عاطفية
entries.example: He is going out with his girlfriend.

entries.definitionEn: To hand something to someone so they can have it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطي شيئاً لشخص كي يأخذه
entries.example: Please give me the book.

entries.definitionEn: Something given free, often to promote a product. Also a sign that reveals a secret.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء يُهدى مجاناً للترويج غالباً؛ أو علامة تكشف سراً
entries.example: The shop offered a free mug as a giveaway.

entries.definitionEn: Stated or decided already; particular.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدد أو مقرَّر مسبقاً
entries.example: You must finish the work by a given date.

entries.definitionEn: A gentle slope, especially an artificial bank in front of a fort.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحدر لطيف، ولا سيما ساتر مائل أمام حصن
entries.example: A wide glacis sloped down from the old walls.

entries.definitionEn: Happy about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرور سعيد بشيء
entries.example: I am glad you came.

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in a rich, exciting, and fashionable way.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاتن جذاب بأناقة لامعة مثيرة
entries.example: She looked glamorous in the evening dress.

entries.definitionEn: A quick look.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرة سريعة
entries.example: He took a glance at his watch.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلقي نظرة سريعة
entries.example: She glanced at the clock.

entries.definitionEn: A strong, unpleasant light. Also an angry, steady look.
entries.arabicMeaning: وهج قوي مزعج؛ أو نظرة غاضبة ثابتة
entries.example: The glare of the headlights made it hard to see.

entries.definitionEn: A hard clear material, or a container made from it that you drink from.
entries.arabicMeaning: زجاج؛ أو كأس تشرب منها
entries.example: He poured water into a glass.

entries.definitionEn: Two pieces of glass or plastic in a frame that you wear to see better.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظارات تُلبس لتحسين الرؤية
entries.example: I need glasses to read.

entries.definitionEn: A small, bright light reflected from a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: وميض صغير لامع ينعكس عن سطح
entries.example: A gleam of sunlight hit the window.

entries.definitionEn: To collect information slowly and with difficulty from various sources.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتقط معلومات بجهد وعلى مهل من مصادر شتى
entries.example: We gleaned a few facts from the old letters.

entries.definitionEn: Great delight, often mixed with a little mischief.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابتهاج شديد يشوبه أحياناً شيء من المرح الخبيث
entries.example: The children shouted with glee.

entries.definitionEn: A smooth, quiet movement, as if without effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: انسياب حركة سلسة هادئة كأنها بلا جهد
entries.example: The skater finished with a long glide.

entries.definitionEn: A very short look at something, often incomplete.
entries.arabicMeaning: لمحة قصيرة غير مكتملة غالباً
entries.example: We caught a glimpse of the sea from the hill.

entries.definitionEn: To give off small, quick flashes of light.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلمع بومضات صغيرة سريعة
entries.example: Sunlight glinted on the river.

entries.definitionEn: Showy, expensive glitter, especially in entertainment, that can feel superficial.
entries.arabicMeaning: بريق استعراضي فخم، ولا سيما في الترفيه، قد يبدو سطحياً
entries.example: The awards night was all glitz and cameras.

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in a flashy, expensive, and showy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبهر لامع على نحو استعراضي فاخر
entries.example: They booked a glitzy downtown hotel.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the whole world.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالمي يشمل العالم كله
entries.example: The company has a global market.

entries.definitionEn: The gradual rise in the Earth's average temperature, caused by gases that trap heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاحترار العالمي؛ ارتفاع تدريجي في متوسط حرارة الأرض
entries.example: The report examines the effects of global warming.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves the whole world.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نطاق عالمي
entries.example: The product is now sold globally.

entries.definitionEn: The world, or a round model of the Earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: العالم؛ أو مجسّم كروي للأرض
entries.example: She spun the globe and pointed to Japan.

entries.definitionEn: Combining global and local ideas or methods, especially in business.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالمي ومحلي معاً، ولا سيما في أسلوب العمل
entries.example: The brand follows a glocal marketing strategy.

entries.definitionEn: Dark in a way that feels sad. Also without hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: كئيب مظلم؛ أو ميؤوس قليل الأمل
entries.example: It was a gloomy afternoon with heavy cloud.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone or something highly, sometimes more than they deserve.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمجّد شخصاً أو شيئاً، وقد يبالغ في الثناء
entries.example: The article seemed to glorify fame more than skill.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving great praise, or extremely beautiful and impressive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجيد يستحق الثناء؛ أو رائع مدهش الحسن
entries.example: It was a glorious morning.

entries.definitionEn: To take great pleasure in something, often openly or proudly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبتهج بأمر ويزهو به علناً غالباً
entries.example: She seemed to glory in the attention.

entries.definitionEn: Great honour and praise won by success, beauty, or achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجد وشرف عظيم يُنالان بنجاح أو جمال أو إنجاز
entries.example: The team brought glory to the town.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing that covers your hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفاز يغطي اليد
entries.example: She lost one glove on the train.

entries.definitionEn: A steady, soft light, or a warm colour in the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: توهج هادئ ثابت؛ أو دفء لوني في البشرة
entries.example: The lamp gave a warm glow.

entries.definitionEn: Looking or feeling sad, silent, and without hope.
entries.arabicMeaning: عابس كئيب صامت قليل الأمل
entries.example: He sat looking glum after the result.

entries.definitionEn: In a sad, silent, and discouraged way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بكآبة صامتة وانكسار
entries.example: She stared glumly out of the window.

entries.definitionEn: To bite or chew something repeatedly. Also, of a feeling, to cause lasting worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقرض شيئاً بأسنانه مراراً؛ أو يؤرق شعورٌ مستمر
entries.example: Doubt continued to gnaw at her all week.

entries.definitionEn: A turn to do something in a game, or an attempt to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: دور في لعبة؛ أو محاولة لفعل شيء
entries.example: Can I have a go on the piano?

entries.definitionEn: To move or travel from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذهب من مكان إلى آخر
entries.example: We go to the park on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: Something you want to do or achieve. In sport, a point scored by sending the ball into the net.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدف تريد بلوغه؛ وفي الرياضة نقطة تُحرز بإدخال الكرة في المرمى
entries.example: My goal is to learn English.

entries.definitionEn: The player whose job is to stop the ball going into the goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: حارس المرمى
entries.example: The goalkeeper saved the shot.

entries.definitionEn: An animal with horns that is kept for its milk, meat, or hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماعز يُربى للحليب أو اللحم أو الشعر
entries.example: The goat was eating grass by the fence.

entries.definitionEn: A being that people worship as having power over nature and human life.
entries.arabicMeaning: إله يُعبد ويُعتقد أن له سلطاناً على الطبيعة والحياة
entries.example: The temple was built for the god of the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A female god in some religions and stories.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلهة في بعض الأديان والحكايات
entries.example: The statue represents an ancient goddess.

entries.definitionEn: Living in a way that follows religious teaching; devout.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقيّ يعيش وفق تعاليم دينية
entries.example: He was known as a quiet, godly man.

entries.definitionEn: Made of gold, or having the colour of gold.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذهبي؛ مصنوع من الذهب أو بلونه
entries.example: She has a gold ring.

entries.definitionEn: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and coins.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذهب؛ معدن أصفر ثمين يُستخدم في الحلي والنقود
entries.example: The ring is made of gold.

entries.definitionEn: Bright yellow like gold. Also very special or successful.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذهبي اللون؛ أو ثمين ناجح جداً
entries.example: She has long golden hair.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which you hit a small ball into holes with special sticks.
entries.arabicMeaning: غولف؛ لعبة تُضرب فيها كرة صغيرة إلى حفر بعصي خاصة
entries.example: My father plays golf on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays golf.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاعب غولف
entries.example: The golfer waited at the first hole.

entries.definitionEn: Of high quality, or pleasant. Also kind or well behaved.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيد حسن الجودة؛ أو لطيف حسن السلوك
entries.example: The soup is good, but it is a little hot.

entries.definitionEn: A polite greeting used in the afternoon.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحية تُقال بعد الظهر
entries.example: Good afternoon, everyone.

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيم أو جذّاب المظهر
entries.example: He is a good-looking man.

entries.definitionEn: A polite greeting used in the morning.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحية تُقال في الصباح؛ صباح الخير
entries.example: Good morning, how are you?

entries.definitionEn: Said in the evening when you leave someone or go to bed.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُقال مساءً عند الوداع أو قبل النوم؛ تصبح على خير
entries.example: Good night, sleep well.

entries.definitionEn: What is morally right, or something that benefits people.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخير وما هو صواب؛ أو منفعة تعود على الناس
entries.example: She works for the common good.

entries.definitionEn: Said to show surprise or mild shock.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُقال للتعجب أو الدهشة الخفيفة
entries.example: Goodness, look at the time!

entries.definitionEn: Things that are made or grown to be sold.
entries.arabicMeaning: بضائع وسلع تُصنع أو تُزرع للبيع
entries.example: The truck was carrying goods to the shops.

entries.definitionEn: Friendly, helpful feelings towards other people. Also the value of a company's good reputation.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسن نية وودّ؛ وقد يعني قيمة سمعة شركة طيبة
entries.example: The talks were held in a spirit of goodwill.

entries.definitionEn: A highly offensive racist slur for a person of East Asian origin. In informal American English it can also mean a sticky mess.
entries.arabicMeaning: شتيمة عنصرية بالغة الإساءة تُقال لشخص من أصل شرق آسيوي؛ وقد تعني في العامية الأميركية مادة لزجة
entries.example: Style guides warn that gook is a racist slur.

entries.definitionEn: A large water bird with a long neck, related to ducks and swans.
entries.arabicMeaning: إوزة؛ طائر مائي كبير طويل العنق من فصيلة البط والوز
entries.example: A goose walked across the farmyard.

entries.definitionEn: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often with a river.
entries.arabicMeaning: وادٍ ضيق عميق شديد الانحدار يجري فيه نهر غالباً
entries.example: The river runs through a deep gorge.

entries.definitionEn: Very beautiful or attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع الجمال أو بالغ الجاذبية
entries.example: The view from the hotel was gorgeous.

entries.definitionEn: A large, strong African ape.
entries.arabicMeaning: غوريلا؛ قرد أفريقي ضخم قوي
entries.example: The gorilla sat quietly in the shade.

entries.definitionEn: Informal talk about other people's private lives, which may not be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: نميمة أو كلام عن شؤون الآخرين الخاصة وقد لا يصح
entries.example: I don't listen to office gossip.

entries.definitionEn: To talk about other people's private lives, often in an unkind way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينمّ أو يتحدث عن شؤون الآخرين، غالباً بغير لطف
entries.example: They sat in the café and gossiped for an hour.

entries.definitionEn: Of food that is of very high quality and prepared with great skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاخر في الطعام ومعدّ بمهارة عالية
entries.example: They booked a table at a gourmet restaurant.

entries.definitionEn: A person who knows a lot about good food and enjoys it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذواقة خبير بالطعام الراقي ويستمتع به
entries.example: He is a gourmet who plans trips around meals.

entries.definitionEn: A disease that causes sudden, intense pain and swelling in a joint, often the big toe.
entries.arabicMeaning: داء النقرس؛ ألم وتورم مفاجئان في مفصل وغالباً إبهام القدم
entries.example: He missed the walk because of an attack of gout.

entries.definitionEn: To officially control a country or organization and make its rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحكم بلداً أو مؤسسة ويتولى وضع قواعدها
entries.example: The party has governed the country for ten years.

entries.definitionEn: The group of people who officially control a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحكومة؛ من يديرون شؤون بلد بصفة رسمية
entries.example: The government has a new plan.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to government.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكومي يتعلق بالحكومة
entries.example: A governmental committee will review the plan.

entries.definitionEn: The official leader of a state, region, or institution.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاكم ولاية أو منطقة أو مؤسسة
entries.example: The governor visited the flooded towns.

entries.definitionEn: A long dress worn on formal occasions. Also a loose robe worn by judges, doctors, or graduates.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثوب طويل للمناسبات الرسمية؛ أو روب فضفاض للقاضي أو الطبيب أو الخريج
entries.example: She wore a long gown to the dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To take hold of something suddenly and roughly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمسك شيئاً فجأة وبشيء من العجلة أو الخشونة
entries.example: He grabbed his coat and ran.

entries.definitionEn: A smooth, attractive way of moving or behaving.
entries.arabicMeaning: رشاقة جذابة في الحركة أو السلوك
entries.example: The dancer moved with grace.

entries.definitionEn: Moving in a smooth, attractive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رشيق أنيق الحركة
entries.example: The cat made a graceful jump.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of moving or behaving in a smooth, attractive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رشاقة ورهافة في الحركة أو السلوك
entries.example: The dancer's gracefulness impressed the audience.

entries.definitionEn: A number or letter that shows how well you have done in school.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة أو تقدير دراسي
entries.example: She got a good grade in maths.

entries.definitionEn: To judge the quality of work and give it a mark or class.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقيّم عملاً ويعطيه علامة أو فئة
entries.example: The essays will be graded next week.

entries.definitionEn: Happening slowly, in small stages.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدريجي يحدث ببطء وعلى مراحل
entries.example: There has been a gradual rise in prices.

entries.definitionEn: Slowly, over a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدريجياً على مدى وقت
entries.example: The weather gradually became warmer.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has completed a university degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: خرّيج أنهى درجة جامعية
entries.example: She is a graduate in chemistry.

entries.definitionEn: To complete a school or university course and receive a diploma.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتخرّج بعد إتمام دراسة والحصول على شهادة
entries.example: She will graduate next year.

entries.definitionEn: The ceremony or fact of completing a course of study.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفل التخرج أو واقعة إتمام الدراسة
entries.example: Her family came to the graduation.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of living tissue transplanted so that it can grow. Also, in informal British English, hard work.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقعة نسيج حيّ تُزرع لتنمو؛ وفي العامية البريطانية كدح شاق
entries.example: The surgeon used a skin graft to close the wound.

entries.definitionEn: To attach living tissue or a plant shoot onto another so that it grows there.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزرع نسيجاً حياً أو يطعّم نباتاً بغصن لينمو عليه
entries.example: They grafted a new shoot onto the old apple tree.

entries.definitionEn: The seeds of plants such as wheat and rice used as food. Also a very small piece of something hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبوب كالقمح والأرز للطعام؛ أو حبة صغيرة صلبة
entries.example: Farmers store grain after the harvest.

entries.definitionEn: A small unit for measuring weight.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرام؛ وحدة صغيرة لقياس الوزن
entries.example: This apple weighs about 150 grams.

entries.definitionEn: The rules of a language that show how words are put together.
entries.arabicMeaning: قواعد اللغة التي تبين نظم الكلمات
entries.example: We have a grammar class today.

entries.definitionEn: Impressive and large in style. Informal: excellent.
entries.arabicMeaning: فخم مهيب في هيئته؛ وفي الكلام غير الرسمي: ممتاز
entries.example: They stayed in a grand old hotel.

entries.definitionEn: The child of your son or daughter.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفيد أو حفيدة؛ ولد ابنك أو ابنتك
entries.example: Their grandchild visits every weekend.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for grandfather.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّ؛ لفظ غير رسمي
entries.example: My granddad told us a story.

entries.definitionEn: The daughter of your son or daughter.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفيدة؛ بنت الابن أو البنت
entries.example: His granddaughter is starting school this year.

entries.definitionEn: The father of your mother or father.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّ؛ أبو الأم أو الأب
entries.example: My grandfather lives near the sea.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for grandmother.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّة؛ لفظ غير رسمي
entries.example: Grandma baked a cake for us.

entries.definitionEn: The mother of your mother or father.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّة؛ أم الأم أو الأب
entries.example: Her grandmother taught her to cook.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for grandfather.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّ؛ لفظ غير رسمي
entries.example: Grandpa is waiting in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A parent of your mother or father; a grandmother or grandfather.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّ أو جدّة؛ أحد والدي أمك أو أبيك
entries.example: Each grandparent sent a birthday card.

entries.definitionEn: The son of your son or daughter.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفيد؛ ابن الابن أو البنت
entries.example: Their grandson plays football on Saturdays.

entries.definitionEn: An informal, often affectionate word for grandmother.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّة؛ لفظ غير رسمي دافئ غالباً
entries.example: We visited granny on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: A sum of money given by an organization for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحة مالية تقدّمها جهة لغرض معيّن
entries.example: He received a grant to study abroad.

entries.definitionEn: To agree to give someone what they have asked for. Also to admit that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنح شخصاً ما طلبه؛ أو يُقرّ بأن شيئاً صحيح
entries.example: The bank granted them a loan.

entries.definitionEn: A small round fruit that grows in bunches and is used to make wine.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنبة؛ ثمرة صغيرة مستديرة تنمو في عناقيد ويُصنع منها النبيذ
entries.example: Would you like a grape?

entries.definitionEn: A large, round citrus fruit with yellow or pink flesh that tastes sharp and slightly bitter.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريفون؛ ثمرة حمضيات كبيرة ذات لب أصفر أو وردي حامض مرّ قليلاً
entries.example: She had grapefruit for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A drawing that shows how numbers or amounts are related.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم بياني يوضح علاقة أرقام أو مقادير
entries.example: This graph shows last year's sales.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with drawing, printing, or visual design. Also very clear and detailed.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصميمي يتعلق بالرسم أو الطباعة؛ أو بالغ الوضوح والتفصيل
entries.example: She works in graphic design.

entries.definitionEn: By means of graphs or images. Also in a very clear, vivid way.
entries.arabicMeaning: برسوم أو صور؛ أو بوضوح تصويري بالغ
entries.example: The results are shown graphically in the report.

entries.definitionEn: Pictures and designs, especially those produced by a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسوم وتصاميم بصرية ولا سيما الحاسوبية
entries.example: The game has excellent graphics.

entries.definitionEn: A firm hold with the hand. Also an understanding of a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبضة محكمة باليد؛ أو فهم لموضوع
entries.example: She has a good grasp of the topic.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with thin green leaves that covers fields and gardens.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشب ذو أوراق خضراء رفيعة يغطي الحقول والحدائق
entries.example: The children sat on the grass.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling that you want to thank someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتنّ يريد أن يشكر
entries.example: I am grateful for your help.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being thankful.
entries.arabicMeaning: امتنان وشعور بالشكر
entries.example: She wrote to express her gratitude.

entries.definitionEn: A hole in the ground where a dead person is buried, or that place.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبر؛ حفرة يُدفن فيها ميت أو موضع الدفن
entries.example: They laid flowers on the grave.

entries.definitionEn: A stone that marks a grave, usually with a name on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاهد قبر؛ حجر يعلّم القبر ويحمل اسماً غالباً
entries.example: His name is carved on the gravestone.

entries.definitionEn: To be drawn towards a person, place, or activity as if pulled there.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينجذب إلى شخص أو مكان أو نشاط كأنما يُشدّ إليه
entries.example: Students often gravitate to the café after class.

entries.definitionEn: The force that pulls objects towards one another, especially towards the Earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجاذبية؛ القوة التي تشدّ الأجسام بعضها إلى بعض ولا سيما نحو الأرض
entries.example: Newton described the laws of gravitation.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the force of gravity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقالي؛ متعلق بقوة الجاذبية
entries.example: The moon's gravitational pull affects the tides.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves or is caused by gravity.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يتعلق بالجاذبية أو ينشأ عنها
entries.example: The two stars are gravitationally bound.

entries.definitionEn: A sauce made from the juices of cooked meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلصة تُصنع من عصارة اللحم المطبوخ
entries.example: He poured gravy over the potatoes.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of clouds, ash, or silver mixed with black; not bright.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمادي كلون الغيم أو الرماد
entries.example: The sky looks gray today.

entries.definitionEn: The colour between black and white.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الرمادي بين الأسود والأبيض
entries.example: She prefers grey to black.

entries.definitionEn: Very good, or very large and important.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً؛ أو كبير مهم
entries.example: We had a great time.

entries.definitionEn: Very much; to a large degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيراً؛ إلى حد بعيد
entries.example: She was greatly surprised by the news.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being important, powerful, or excellent.
entries.arabicMeaning: عظمة؛ جودة الأهمية أو القوة أو الامتياز
entries.example: The book explores the greatness of the poet.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting more food, money, or things than you need.
entries.arabicMeaning: جشع يريد فوق حاجته من طعام أو مال أو أشياء
entries.example: Don't be greedy; leave some cake for others.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of grass or leaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخضر كلون العشب أو الأوراق
entries.example: She wore a green dress.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of grass. Also a grassy area in a town.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأخضر؛ أو مساحة عشبية في بلدة
entries.example: Green is my favourite colour.

entries.definitionEn: A building with glass walls and a glass roof, used for growing plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفيئة زجاجية لزراعة النباتات
entries.example: The tomatoes are growing in the greenhouse.

entries.definitionEn: To say hello to someone, or to welcome them when they arrive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيّي شخصاً أو يرحب به عند قدومه
entries.example: She went to the door to greet her friends.

entries.definitionEn: Something you say or do when you meet someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحية تُقال أو تُفعل عند اللقاء
entries.example: He gave us a warm greeting.

entries.definitionEn: Great sadness, especially after a death.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزن شديد ولا سيما بعد فقد
entries.example: The family was filled with grief.

entries.definitionEn: A complaint, or a cause for complaint, especially about unfair treatment at work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مظلمة أو شكوى، ولا سيما من معاملة جائرة في العمل
entries.example: Staff filed a grievance about unpaid overtime.

entries.definitionEn: To feel great sadness, especially because someone has died.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحزن حزناً شديداً ولا سيما لموت أحد
entries.example: He is still grieving for his brother.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment that cooks food with strong heat from above or below.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشواة تطهو الطعام بحرارة قوية من أعلى أو أسفل
entries.example: Put the bread under the grill.

entries.definitionEn: To cook food over or under strong heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشوي الطعام على حرارة قوية
entries.example: I will grill the chicken this evening.

entries.definitionEn: Cooked on a grill or under strong heat.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشوي على مشواة أو تحت حرارة قوية
entries.example: I ordered grilled fish.

entries.definitionEn: Very serious, worrying, or unpleasant. Also looking stern.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاتم خطير أو كريه؛ أو عابس صارم الملامح
entries.example: The news from the hospital was grim.

entries.definitionEn: A wide smile.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابتسامة عريضة
entries.example: He gave a broad grin when he saw us.

entries.definitionEn: A tight hold with the hand. Also control over a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبضة محكمة باليد؛ أو سيطرة على موقف
entries.example: Keep a firm grip on the rail.

entries.definitionEn: To hold something tightly. Also to hold someone's attention strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبض بقوة؛ أو يشدّ انتباه أحد بشدة
entries.example: She gripped the steering wheel.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that sells food and things you need for the house.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجر بقالة يبيع طعاماً ولوازم البيت
entries.example: I bought bread at the grocery store.

entries.definitionEn: A man who is getting married. Also a person who looks after horses.
entries.arabicMeaning: عريس في يوم زفافه؛ أو سائس يعتني بالخيل
entries.example: The groom waited at the front of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Total, before anything is taken away. Informal: very unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجمالي قبل أي حسم؛ وفي العامية: مقرف جداً
entries.example: What is your gross salary before tax?

entries.definitionEn: The floor of a building that is at street level.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطابق الأرضي بمستوى الشارع
entries.example: The shop is on the ground floor.

entries.definitionEn: The solid surface of the earth that you walk on.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأرض؛ السطح الصلب الذي تمشي عليه
entries.example: The bag fell to the ground.

entries.definitionEn: To keep an aircraft from flying. Also to keep a child at home as punishment, or to base an idea on evidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمنع طائرة من الإقلاع؛ أو يحبس طفلاً في البيت عقاباً؛ أو يسند فكرة إلى دليل
entries.example: Fog grounded all flights until noon.

entries.definitionEn: The land and gardens around a large building. Also the reasons for a belief, action, or legal claim.
entries.arabicMeaning: أراضٍ وحدائق حول مبنى كبير؛ أو مسوّغات لاعتقاد أو فعل أو دعوى
entries.example: Visitors may walk in the grounds after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A number of people or things that are together or belong together.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة من الناس أو الأشياء مجتمعة أو مترابطة
entries.example: A group of students waited outside.

entries.definitionEn: To put people or things into groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجمع الناس أو الأشياء في مجموعات
entries.example: The teacher grouped the students by age.

entries.definitionEn: A set of people or things that have been put together as a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجميع أو فئة وُضعت معاً كمجموعة
entries.example: The countries formed a new trading grouping.

entries.definitionEn: To get bigger, or to plant something so that it gets bigger.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينمو فيكبر؛ أو يزرع شيئاً لينمو
entries.example: Plants grow in the spring.

entries.definitionEn: Increasing in size, number, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزايد في الحجم أو العدد أو الأهمية
entries.example: There is a growing interest in local food.

entries.definitionEn: Adult in behaviour or appearance; no longer like a child.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناضج كالكبار في السلوك أو الهيئة
entries.example: She has a very grown-up manner for her age.

entries.definitionEn: An adult, especially in the language used with or by children.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص بالغ، ولا سيما في كلام الأطفال
entries.example: The grown-ups sat in the kitchen and talked.

entries.definitionEn: The process of getting bigger or developing. Also an increase in size or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: نمو وتطور؛ أو زيادة في الحجم أو المقدار
entries.example: There has been strong growth in sales.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely tiring and demanding over a long period.
entries.arabicMeaning: منهك شاق جداً يمتد وقتاً طويلاً
entries.example: They completed a gruelling ten-hour exam.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely unpleasant and shocking, especially because of injury or death.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروّع صادم ولا سيما لما فيه من أذى أو موت
entries.example: The novel opens with a gruesome discovery.

entries.definitionEn: In a shocking, unpleasant way that involves injury or death.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مروّع صادم لما فيه من أذى أو موت
entries.example: The injury was gruesomely detailed in the report.

entries.definitionEn: A firm promise that something will happen or that a product will work, often in writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمان وعد قاطع بحدوث شيء أو بصلاح عمل منتج، مكتوباً غالباً
entries.example: The fridge comes with a two-year guarantee.

entries.definitionEn: To promise that something will certainly happen or be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضمن أن شيئاً سيحدث أو سيُنجز حتماً
entries.example: We cannot guarantee a seat at this hour.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to protect a place or people.
entries.arabicMeaning: حارس مهمته حماية مكان أو أناس
entries.example: A guard stood at the door.

entries.definitionEn: To watch a person or place in order to protect them or stop them leaving.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرس شخصاً أو مكاناً حمايةً أو منعاً من المغادرة
entries.example: Two officers guarded the entrance.

entries.definitionEn: A member of a small unofficial armed group that fights a larger regular army.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاتل في جماعة مسلحة صغيرة غير نظامية تواجه جيشاً أكبر
entries.example: The guerrilla fighters hid in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: An attempt to give an answer or amount when you are not sure.
entries.arabicMeaning: تخمين؛ محاولة إجابة من غير يقين
entries.example: That was only a guess, not a fact.

entries.definitionEn: To give an answer without being sure it is right.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخمن إجابة من غير تأكد
entries.example: Can you guess the answer?

entries.definitionEn: A person who is visiting your home or staying in a hotel.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيف في بيتك أو في فندق
entries.example: We have a guest for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Help and advice about what to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرشاد ونصح بما ينبغي فعله
entries.example: Students receive guidance on course choices.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to show a place to visitors, or a book that does this.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل يصطحب الزوار؛ أو كتاب يقوم بذلك
entries.example: The guide showed us the old castle.

entries.definitionEn: To show someone the way, or to help them decide what to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرشد شخصاً في الطريق أو يعينه على القرار
entries.example: She guided us through the museum.

entries.definitionEn: A book of information for people visiting a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل سياحي فيه معلومات للزائر
entries.example: We used a guidebook to find the museum.

entries.definitionEn: Official advice on how something should be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرشاد رسمي أو مبدأ توجيهي لكيفية العمل
entries.example: The school issued a new guideline on absences.

entries.definitionEn: The unhappy feeling that you have done something wrong. Also the fact of having committed a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور بالذنب بعد فعل خطأ؛ وقد يعني ثبوت المسؤولية عن جريمة
entries.example: He felt guilt after lying to his friend.

entries.definitionEn: Having done something wrong, or feeling that you have. In law, responsible for a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذنب أو يشعر بالذنب؛ وفي القانون مسؤول عن جريمة
entries.example: She felt guilty about missing her sister's call.

entries.definitionEn: A musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers or a small piece of plastic.
entries.arabicMeaning: غيتار؛ آلة موسيقية ذات أوتار تُعزف بالأصابع أو بريشة
entries.example: She is learning to play the guitar.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays the guitar.
entries.arabicMeaning: عازف غيتار
entries.example: The guitarist played a short solo in the middle of the song.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount of a drink swallowed at once. Also the act of swallowing in that way, sometimes from nerves.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرعة كبيرة تُبتلع دفعة واحدة؛ أو حركة البلع وقد تكون من التوتر
entries.example: He finished the water in one gulp.

entries.definitionEn: A flavoured substance that you chew but do not swallow. Also the firm pink flesh around the teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: علكة تُمضغ ولا تُبلع؛ أو اللثة حول الأسنان
entries.example: Would you like a piece of gum?

entries.definitionEn: A weapon that fires bullets.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلاح يطلق الرصاص
entries.example: The museum display included an old hunting gun.

entries.definitionEn: The sound or firing of a gun. Also a wound caused by a bullet.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلقة نارية؛ صوتها أو الإصابة الناجمة عنها
entries.example: A gunshot woke the neighbours just after midnight.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, strong flow of liquid. Also an excessive outpouring of praise or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدفق مفاجئ غزير لسائل؛ أو فيض مفرط من الثناء أو المشاعر
entries.example: A gush of water burst from the broken pipe.

entries.definitionEn: To flow out suddenly and in large amounts. Also to speak with too much enthusiasm or praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندفع سائلاً بغزارة؛ أو يفرط في الثناء بحماسة
entries.example: Oil gushed from the damaged well.

entries.definitionEn: Expressing praise or emotion in a way that is too strong or sentimental.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط في الثناء أو العاطفة حتى يبدو متكلّفاً
entries.example: His gushing review ignored every flaw in the play.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows too much enthusiasm or praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإفراط في الحماسة أو المديح
entries.example: She spoke gushingly about her favourite novel.

entries.definitionEn: Great energy and enjoyment in what you are doing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماس واستمتاع شديدان بما يُفعل
entries.example: He ate the meal with gusto after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: courage and determination. Also the internal organs of a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجاعة وعزيمة (غير رسمي)؛ أو أحشاء الجسم
entries.example: It took guts to admit the mistake in front of the whole team.

entries.definitionEn: Showing courage and a willingness to take risks.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريء مقدام لا يهاب المخاطرة
entries.example: It was a gutsy decision to start the business again from nothing.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a man. Guys can also mean a mixed group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل (غير رسمي)؛ وguys قد تعني جماعة من الناس
entries.example: That guy at the desk can help you with your ticket.

entries.definitionEn: A room or building with equipment for physical exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: صالة رياضية فيها أجهزة للتمرين
entries.example: She goes to the gym three times a week.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to gymnastics, or showing the strength, balance, and control that sport needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالجمباز أو بما يتطلّبه من قوة وتوازن وتحكّم
entries.example: The dance included several gymnastic jumps.

entries.definitionEn: A sport of exercises that need strength, balance, and control of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة الجمباز التي تعتمد على القوة والتوازن والتحكّم بالجسم
entries.example: My daughter has gymnastics practice on Thursdays.

entries.definitionEn: A dated word, now often considered offensive, for a Roma person. Sometimes also used, still offensively to many, for someone who lives a wandering life.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ قديم وغالباً مسيء للإشارة إلى شخص من الروم؛ يُفضَّل القول Roma
entries.example: The editor asked the writer to replace gypsy with Roma.

entries.definitionEn: Something you do often, usually in the same way, without thinking much about it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادة تُفعل كثيراً بالطريقة نفسها من غير تفكير كثير
entries.example: Drinking tea at breakfast is a habit of hers.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives in a particular place; an inhabitant.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساكن؛ من يقيم في مكان معيّن
entries.example: Few habitants remained in the village after the mill closed.

entries.definitionEn: The natural environment where an animal or plant normally lives.
entries.arabicMeaning: الموطن الطبيعي الذي يعيش فيه حيوان أو نبات
entries.example: Wetlands are an important habitat for many birds.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of living in a place. Also a dwelling or settlement.
entries.arabicMeaning: السكنى في مكان؛ أو موضع يُتَّخذ للسكن
entries.example: The island showed no sign of human habitation.

entries.definitionEn: A clever unofficial solution or shortcut. Also an unauthorized intrusion into a computer system.
entries.arabicMeaning: حل غير رسمي ذكي أو اختصار في العمل؛ أو اختراق حاسوب دون إذن
entries.example: A simple keyboard hack saved her an hour each day.

entries.definitionEn: To gain unauthorized access to a computer system. Also to cut something roughly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخترق نظاماً حاسوبياً دون إذن؛ أو يقطع شيئاً بخشونة
entries.example: Someone tried to hack the company's email last night.

entries.definitionEn: The past form of have, used with a past participle to make the past perfect, and as the past of have.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الماضي من have، تُستعمل مع التصريف الثالث لتكوين الماضي التام
entries.example: She had already left when I arrived.

entries.definitionEn: To argue, usually over a price, in order to reach an agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساوم، غالباً على السعر، حتى يتم الاتفاق
entries.example: They spent twenty minutes haggling over the price of the rug.

entries.definitionEn: To call out or signal in order to attract someone's attention, especially a taxi. Also to praise someone or something publicly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينادي أو يلوّح لاستيقاف أحد ولا سيما سيارة أجرة؛ أو يُشيد بشخص أو أمر علناً
entries.example: She stepped off the pavement to hail a taxi.

entries.definitionEn: The thin threads that grow on your head and, in smaller amounts, on your body.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشعر الذي ينبت على الرأس، وبمقدار أقل على الجسم
entries.example: She has short dark hair.

entries.definitionEn: The act of cutting someone's hair, or the style that results.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصّ الشعر أو الهيئة الناتجة عنه
entries.example: He got a haircut on Saturday morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to cut and style hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلاّق أو مُصفّف شعر
entries.example: The hairdresser trimmed two centimetres off her hair.

entries.definitionEn: A small electrical device that blows hot air to dry hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجفف شعر كهربائي ينفخ هواءً ساخناً
entries.example: She used a hairdryer after her shower.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with a lot of hair. Informal: dangerous or full of problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير الشعر؛ وعامياً صعب أو محفوف بالمخاطر
entries.example: The cat had a thick, hairy coat.

entries.definitionEn: To the extent of fifty percent; partly, but not completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حدّ النصف؛ أو جزئياً لا بالكامل
entries.example: The work is only half done.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean one of two equal parts of that thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل الاسم بمعنى نصف ذلك الشيء
entries.example: Half the seats in the hall were empty.

entries.definitionEn: One of two equal parts of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحد قسمين متساويين من شيء
entries.example: Cut the apple in half and share it.

entries.definitionEn: Costing half the usual price.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنصف السعر المعتاد
entries.example: These coats are half-price until Friday.

entries.definitionEn: For half the usual price.
entries.arabicMeaning: بثمن يعادل نصف السعر المعتاد
entries.example: Students can travel half-price on this bus route.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to mean one of two equal parts of something already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقوم مقام الاسم بمعنى نصف شيء سبق ذكره
entries.example: I ate half and put the rest in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: A large room or building for meetings, concerts, or other events. Also the space just inside the front door of a house.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعة كبيرة للاجتماعات أو الحفلات؛ أو بهو المدخل في البيت
entries.example: The concert was held in the town hall.

entries.definitionEn: Meat from the upper part of a pig's leg, often salted or smoked.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم من أعلى فخذ الخنزير، غالباً مقدَّد أو مدخَّن
entries.example: Would you like ham in your sandwich?

entries.definitionEn: A round piece of cooked minced meat, usually eaten in a bread roll.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة مستديرة من اللحم المفروم المطبوخ، تُؤكل عادة في خبز
entries.example: I ordered a hamburger and a salad.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a heavy metal head, used for hitting nails into wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطرقة ذات رأس معدني ثقيل لدقّ المسامير
entries.example: He used a hammer to put up the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something with a hammer, or to hit it hard again and again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدقّ بالمطرقة أو يضرب بقوة مرة بعد مرة
entries.example: She hammered the nail into the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To make movement, growth, or progress more difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيق الحركة أو النمو أو التقدّم
entries.example: Bad weather hampered the rescue for several hours.

entries.definitionEn: Small enough, and designed, to be held and used in the hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: صغير ومصمَّم ليُمسَك ويُستعمل باليد
entries.example: She filmed the interview with a hand-held camera.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body at the end of the arm, with four fingers and a thumb.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليد في طرف الذراع، بأصابع أربعة وإبهام
entries.example: Wash your hands before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To give something to someone by holding it out to them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناول شخصاً شيئاً بمدّه إليه
entries.example: Please hand me that plate.

entries.definitionEn: A small bag that a person, often a woman, carries to hold money, keys, and other personal things.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيبة يد صغيرة لحمل النقود والمفاتيح والأغراض الشخصية
entries.example: She put her keys in her handbag.

entries.definitionEn: A team sport in which players throw a ball into a goal with their hands. Also, in football, the illegal touching of the ball with the hand or arm.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة اليد؛ وفي كرة القدم لمس الكرة باليد أو الذراع مخالفةً
entries.example: They play handball at the sports centre on Mondays.

entries.definitionEn: A disadvantage that makes success more difficult. In sport, extra weight or points given to make a contest fairer.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائق ينقص فرص النجاح؛ وفي الرياضة تسوية لجعل المنافسة أعدل
entries.example: Lack of experience was a handicap in the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Having a physical or mental disability. An older term; many people now prefer disabled.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو إعاقة جسدية أو عقلية؛ لفظ أقدم يُفضَّل عليه غالباً disabled
entries.example: The building has a ramp for handicapped visitors.

entries.definitionEn: Skilled work making decorative or useful objects by hand. Also an object made in that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفة يدوية ماهرة؛ أو قطعة مصنوعة باليد
entries.example: The market stall sold local handicraft from nearby villages.

entries.definitionEn: A small square of cloth used for wiping the nose or face.
entries.arabicMeaning: منديل قماشي صغير لمسح الأنف أو الوجه
entries.example: He wiped his glasses with a handkerchief.

entries.definitionEn: The part of an object that you hold in order to pick it up or open it.
entries.arabicMeaning: المقبض الذي تُمسك به الشيء لرفعه أو فتحه
entries.example: The handle of the cup is broken.

entries.definitionEn: To deal with a situation, person, or piece of work. Also to touch or hold something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعامل مع موقف أو شخص أو عمل؛ أو يمسك شيئاً
entries.example: She handled the complaint calmly.

entries.definitionEn: A printed sheet of notes given to people, especially in a class. Also money, food, or clothes given to people in need.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورقة مطبوعة تُوزَّع ولا سيما في الدرس؛ أو مساعدة عينية أو نقدية للمحتاج
entries.example: The teacher gave us a handout with the new rules.

entries.definitionEn: A long bar that you hold to support yourself on stairs or a slope.
entries.arabicMeaning: درابزين يُمسَك به للاستناد على الدرج أو المنحدر
entries.example: Hold the handrail as you go down the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking someone's right hand and moving it up and down as a greeting or agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصافحة باليد اليمنى للتحية أو لتأكيد الاتفاق
entries.example: They sealed the agreement with a handshake.

entries.definitionEn: Good-looking, especially used about a man.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيم، وغالباً يُقال عن الرجل
entries.example: Her brother is a handsome man.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person writes with a pen or pencil, not by typing.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط اليد حين يكتب المرء بالقلم لا بالطباعة
entries.example: His handwriting is hard to read.

entries.definitionEn: Useful and convenient. Also nearby, or skilful with your hands.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملي مريح الاستعمال؛ أو قريب؛ أو ماهر باليدين
entries.example: Keep a torch handy in case the lights fail.

entries.definitionEn: Informal, in get the hang of: the skill of doing something. Also the way a piece of clothing falls when worn.
entries.arabicMeaning: في عبارة get the hang of: إجادة عمل؛ أو طريقة تدلي الثوب عند ارتدائه
entries.example: You'll soon get the hang of the new software.

entries.definitionEn: To attach something so that it is held from above and can swing freely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّق شيئاً من أعلاه بحيث يتدلى
entries.example: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.

entries.definitionEn: Suspended from above and not resting on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلَّق من أعلى وغير مستند إلى سطح
entries.example: Hanging baskets of flowers lined the balcony.

entries.definitionEn: A decorative piece of cloth hung on a wall. Also the act of executing someone by hanging them by the neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة قماش تزيينية تُعلَّق على الجدار؛ أو الإعدام شنقاً
entries.example: A silk hanging covered the far wall of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Done or arranged with no order, plan, or care.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشوائي بلا نظام أو تخطيط أو عناية
entries.example: The files were stored in a haphazard pile.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows no order, plan, or care.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو عشوائي بلا ترتيب أو خطة
entries.example: Books were stacked haphazardly on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: Unlucky, and often unable to improve a bad situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ الحظ، وغالباً عاجز عن تحسين وضعه
entries.example: The hapless tourist had lost both tickets and his map.

entries.definitionEn: To take place, usually without being planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدث، غالباً من غير تخطيط
entries.example: What will happen if we miss the last bus?

entries.definitionEn: A chance event; something that occurs without being planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصادفة؛ حدث يقع من غير قصد أو ترتيب
entries.example: They met by happenstance on a delayed train.

entries.definitionEn: In a happy way. Also willingly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسعادة؛ أو عن طيب خاطر
entries.example: The children played happily in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being pleased and content.
entries.arabicMeaning: السعادة والرضا
entries.example: Their letters were full of happiness after the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing pleasure and contentment.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعيد أو يبدو عليه السرور والرضا
entries.example: She looks happy today.

entries.definitionEn: To trouble someone repeatedly in a way that causes fear, stress, or annoyance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضايق شخصاً بإلحاح متكرر يورث خوفاً أو توتراً أو ضيقاً
entries.example: It is against the rules to harass a colleague at work.

entries.definitionEn: Repeated unwanted behaviour that causes someone fear, stress, or annoyance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضايقة متكررة غير مرغوبة تورث خوفاً أو توتراً أو ضيقاً
entries.example: Staff can report harassment to human resources.

entries.definitionEn: A sheltered area of water where ships can stay safely.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميناء محمي ترسو فيه السفن بأمان
entries.example: Fishing boats returned to the harbour at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: To keep a thought or feeling secretly in your mind. Also to give shelter to a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضمر فكراً أو شعوراً في نفسه؛ أو يؤوي شخصاً أو حيواناً
entries.example: She harboured doubts about the plan for months.

entries.definitionEn: Solid and not soft. Also difficult to do or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلب غير ليّن؛ أو صعب الفعل أو الفهم
entries.example: The test was hard, but she passed.

entries.definitionEn: With a lot of effort or force.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجهد كبير أو بقوة
entries.example: She worked hard all week to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a computer that stores programs and files, usually inside the machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: القرص الصلب في الحاسوب لتخزين البرامج والملفات
entries.example: Copy the photos onto the hard drive before you leave.

entries.definitionEn: Putting a lot of effort into your work or studies.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجتهد يبذل جهداً كبيراً في عمله أو دراسته
entries.example: She is a hard-working student who never misses a class.

entries.definitionEn: Almost not; only just.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالكاد؛ يكاد لا
entries.example: There is hardly any milk left in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: A situation of suffering or serious difficulty, especially from lack of money or comfort.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشقة أو ضيق شديد، ولا سيما من قلة المال أو الراحة
entries.example: The family faced hardship after the factory closed.

entries.definitionEn: The physical parts of a computer. Also tools and equipment made of metal.
entries.arabicMeaning: عتاد الحاسوب المادي؛ أو أدوات ومعدات معدنية
entries.example: They upgraded the computer hardware last month.

entries.definitionEn: Damage, injury, or a bad effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: أذى أو ضرر أو أثر سيئ
entries.example: The storm did little harm to the crops.

entries.definitionEn: To hurt a person, animal, or thing, or to have a bad effect on them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤذي شخصاً أو حيواناً أو شيئاً، أو يُلحق به أثراً سيئاً
entries.example: Smoking can harm your lungs.

entries.definitionEn: Causing damage or injury.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضار يُحدث أذى أو تلفاً
entries.example: Too much sun is harmful to the skin.

entries.definitionEn: Not causing damage or injury. Also not meant in a bad way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ضار؛ أو غير مقصود به السوء
entries.example: Most garden spiders are harmless.

entries.definitionEn: A pleasant combination of musical notes. Also a state of peaceful agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: انسجام الأصوات الموسيقية؛ أو وئام واتفاق هادئ
entries.example: The two voices sang in harmony.

entries.definitionEn: A set of straps that hold a person or animal safely, or that attach a horse to a cart.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة أحزمة تُثبّت شخصاً أو حيواناً بأمان، أو تربط الحصان بالعربة
entries.example: The climber checked her harness before she started.

entries.definitionEn: A farm tool with spikes or discs, pulled over soil to break it up and make it even.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشط زراعي بأسنان أو أقراص يُجرّ على التربة لتكسيرها وتسويتها
entries.example: The farmer pulled a harrow across the field after ploughing.

entries.definitionEn: The time when crops are gathered, or the crops that are gathered.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسم جمع المحصول أو المحصول المجموع نفسه
entries.example: The apple harvest was good this year.

entries.definitionEn: To gather crops when they are ready. Also to collect a large amount of a resource such as data.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصد المحصول حين ينضج؛ أو يجمع مورداً بكثرة كمثل البيانات
entries.example: The company harvested customer data from its app.

entries.definitionEn: The form of have used with he, she, and it in the present, especially to make the present perfect.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة have مع he وshe وit في المضارع، ولا سيما لتكوين المضارع التام
entries.example: He has finished his homework.

entries.definitionEn: Speed in doing something, often too much speed and too little care.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجلة في الإنجاز، وغالباً مع قلة تروٍّ
entries.example: In her haste she left the keys on the counter.

entries.definitionEn: In a hurried way, often without enough care.
entries.arabicMeaning: على عجل، وغالباً من غير عناية كافية
entries.example: He packed hastily and forgot his charger.

entries.definitionEn: Done too quickly, without enough thought or care.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعجل يفتقر إلى التروي أو العناية
entries.example: Try not to make a hasty decision about the job.

entries.definitionEn: A covering for the head, worn for warmth, protection, or style.
entries.arabicMeaning: غطاء للرأس يُلبس للدّفء أو الوقاية أو الزينة
entries.example: Put on a hat; the wind is cold.

entries.definitionEn: An opening in a floor, wall, or ship, usually with a cover.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتحة في أرضية أو جدار أو سفينة، غالباً ذات غطاء
entries.example: The cook passed the plates through the kitchen hatch.

entries.definitionEn: The process of a young bird, fish, or insect coming out of an egg. Also fine parallel lines used in drawing.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقس البيض وخروج الصغير منه؛ أو خطوط متوازية دقيقة في الرسم
entries.example: Warmth is vital in the first hours after hatching.

entries.definitionEn: A very strong feeling of dislike.
entries.arabicMeaning: كره شديد
entries.example: The anonymous letter was full of hate.

entries.definitionEn: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكره شخصاً أو شيئاً كرهاً شديداً
entries.example: I hate getting up before sunrise.

entries.definitionEn: A strong, lasting feeling of dislike or hostility.
entries.arabicMeaning: كراهية أو حقد قوي يدوم
entries.example: The speech warned against hatred between neighbouring towns.

entries.definitionEn: In a proud way that shows you think you are better than other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتكبّر يوحي بالاستعلاء على الآخرين
entries.example: He answered haughtily and turned away.

entries.definitionEn: Proud in a way that shows scorn for other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: متكبّر متعالٍ ينظر إلى غيره بازدراء
entries.example: She gave a haughty look and walked past the queue.
