entries.definitionEn: A place that someone visits often.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان يرتاده المرء كثيراً
entries.example: The little café became her favourite haunt on wet afternoons.

entries.definitionEn: If a ghost haunts a place, it appears there. Also, if a memory haunts you, it keeps coming back in an unpleasant way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظهر الشبح في مكان فيلازمه؛ أو تلاحق الذكرى المرء على نحو مزعج
entries.example: That unfinished conversation still haunts him.

entries.definitionEn: Beautiful, sad, or strange in a way that stays in your mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: جميل أو حزين أو غريب على نحو يعلق في الذهن
entries.example: The singer had a haunting voice.

entries.definitionEn: In a beautiful, sad, or strange way that stays in the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو جميل أو حزين يعلق في النفس ولا يُنسى
entries.example: The melody was hauntingly beautiful.

entries.definitionEn: Used with a past participle to make perfect tenses, showing that an action is completed in relation to a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل مع التصريف الثالث لتكوين الأزمنة التامة، للدلالة على اكتمال الفعل بالنسبة إلى زمن
entries.example: I have seen that film before.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to say that something is necessary or required.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأتي قبل الفعل لتفيد الوجوب أو الضرورة
entries.example: We have to wear a badge inside the building.

entries.definitionEn: Grass that has been cut and dried, used as food for animals such as horses and cows.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشب مجفف يُقدَّم علفاً للخيل والبقر ونحوهما
entries.example: They stored hay in the barn for the winter.

entries.definitionEn: Something that can cause danger, injury, or damage.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر قد يسبب خطراً أو إصابة أو تلفاً
entries.example: Icy steps are a hazard for older people.

entries.definitionEn: To risk suggesting something that may be wrong. Also to put something at risk.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجازف بطرح رأي قد يكون خاطئاً؛ أو يعرّض شيئاً للخطر
entries.example: I would hazard a guess that the train is running late.

entries.definitionEn: Dangerous, especially to health or safety.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطر، ولا سيما على الصحة أو السلامة
entries.example: Workers wore masks because the dust was hazardous.

entries.definitionEn: Used to talk about a male person or animal already known, as the subject of a verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير الغائب المذكر في محل فاعل، لمن سبق ذكره
entries.example: Ali is my cousin, and he lives nearby.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body above the neck, with the face, brain, and hair. Also the person in charge of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرأس فوق العنق؛ أو الشخص المسؤول عن جماعة
entries.example: He nodded his head in agreement.

entries.definitionEn: To go in a particular direction. Also to be in charge of a group or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجه صوب مكان؛ أو يترأس جماعة أو مؤسسة
entries.example: We should head home before dark.

entries.definitionEn: A pain in your head.
entries.arabicMeaning: صداع؛ ألم في الرأس
entries.example: I have a headache and need to sit down.

entries.definitionEn: The title of a newspaper article, printed in large letters.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنوان مقال في صحيفة يُطبع بأحرف كبيرة
entries.example: The headline on the front page was about the storm.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who is in charge of a school, especially in older British usage.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناظرة المدرسة، ولا سيما في الاستعمال البريطاني الأقدم
entries.example: The headmistress announced the exam dates in assembly.

entries.definitionEn: A device worn over or in the ears to listen to sound privately. Usually used in the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: سماعة تُوضع على الأذن أو فيها للاستماع على انفراد؛ وغالباً بصيغة الجمع
entries.example: He put on his headphones and started the podcast.

entries.definitionEn: The main offices of an organization, from which it is controlled.
entries.arabicMeaning: المقر الرئيسي الذي تُدار منه المؤسسة
entries.example: The company's headquarters are in Dubai.

entries.definitionEn: Determined to do what you want, even if other people advise against it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنيد يصرّ على رأيه ولو خالفه الناصحون
entries.example: The headstrong intern ignored the warning and sent the email anyway.

entries.definitionEn: The teacher in charge of a school, especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدير المدرسة أو مديرتها، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية البريطانية
entries.example: The headteacher spoke at the school assembly.

entries.definitionEn: To become healthy again, or to make a wound or a person healthy again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشفى أو يُبرئ جرحاً أو مريضاً
entries.example: The cut on her finger began to heal after a few days.

entries.definitionEn: Helping a wound, illness, or emotional pain to get better.
entries.arabicMeaning: شافٍ يعين على برء الجرح أو المرض أو الألم النفسي
entries.example: Sleep had a healing effect after the long illness.

entries.definitionEn: The services that look after people's health, including doctors, hospitals, and treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرعاية الصحية من أطباء ومستشفيات وعلاج
entries.example: Access to health care varies from place to place.

entries.definitionEn: The condition of your body and mind, and how free you are from illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: حال الجسم والعقل ومدى الخلوّ من المرض
entries.example: Regular walks are good for your health.

entries.definitionEn: Well and not ill. Also good for your health.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيح غير مريض؛ أو مفيد للصحة
entries.example: She eats a healthy breakfast every morning.

entries.definitionEn: An untidy pile of things.
entries.arabicMeaning: كومة غير مرتبة من الأشياء
entries.example: A heap of clothes lay on the chair.

entries.definitionEn: To put things in an untidy pile. Also to give a large amount of something such as praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوم أشياء فوق بعض بلا ترتيب؛ أو يغمر شخصاً بشيء كثير كالثناء
entries.example: They heaped the fallen leaves by the gate.

entries.definitionEn: To notice a sound with your ears.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمع صوتاً بأذنيه
entries.example: Can you hear the birds outside?

entries.definitionEn: The sense that lets you notice sound. Also an official meeting to listen to facts, especially in a court.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسة السمع؛ أو جلسة رسمية للاستماع إلى الوقائع ولا سيما في المحكمة
entries.example: Her hearing is still excellent at eighty.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, serious failure of the heart to work properly, often causing great pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوبة قلبية يتوقف فيها القلب فجأة عن العمل السليم
entries.example: He was taken to hospital after a heart attack.

entries.definitionEn: The organ in the chest that pumps blood around the body. Also used to talk about feelings and kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: القلب الذي يضخّ الدم؛ وقد يُراد به المشاعر والطيبة
entries.example: Her heart was beating fast after the run.

entries.definitionEn: Causing great sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُحزن جداً يفطر القلب
entries.example: It was heartbreaking to see the empty playground after the school closed.

entries.definitionEn: Used in compounds such as kind-hearted and hard-hearted to describe a person's character.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل في مركّبات مثل kind-hearted لوصف طبع الشخص
entries.example: Everyone knows her as a kind-hearted neighbour.

entries.definitionEn: Causing feelings of happiness and kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفئ القلب ويبعث السرور والعطف
entries.example: The reunion was a heartwarming moment for the whole family.

entries.definitionEn: Loud, cheerful, and full of energy. Also, of a meal, large and satisfying.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح جهوري مليء بالحيوية؛ ومن الوجبة: دسمة مشبعة
entries.example: They sat down to a hearty breakfast before the journey.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being hot, or hot weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحرارة أو الجو الحار
entries.example: Stay in the shade in this heat.

entries.definitionEn: To make something hot or warm.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسخّن شيئاً أو يدفئه
entries.example: Heat the soup before you serve it.

entries.definitionEn: A device that produces heat to warm a room or a liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز يولّد حرارة لتدفئة غرفة أو سائل
entries.example: They turned on the heater when the temperature dropped.

entries.definitionEn: The system that warms a building, or the process of making something warm.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظام التدفئة في المبنى، أو عملية التسخين
entries.example: The heating is broken in our flat.

entries.definitionEn: In some religions, the place where God is and where good people go after death. Also a place or state of great happiness.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنة أو السماء في بعض المعتقدات؛ أو موضع أو حال من النعيم البالغ
entries.example: The quiet garden felt like heaven after the noisy street.

entries.definitionEn: Related to heaven. Also extremely pleasant or delicious.
entries.arabicMeaning: سماوي متعلق بالجنة؛ أو لذيذ رائع جداً
entries.example: This soup smells heavenly.

entries.definitionEn: To a great degree, or with a lot of weight or force. Of rain or snow, in large amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد بعيد أو بثقل وقوة؛ ومن المطر أو الثلج: بغزارة
entries.example: It rained heavily last night.

entries.definitionEn: Weighing a lot. Also, of rain, traffic, or work, large in amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقيل الوزن؛ ومن المطر أو السير أو العمل: كثير المقدار
entries.example: This box is too heavy to lift alone.

entries.definitionEn: A row of bushes or small trees planted close together, often as a border. Also something that protects you against loss or risk.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياج من الشجيرات المتلاصقة؛ أو وسيلة للتحوّط من الخسارة أو الخطر
entries.example: Birds nested in the hedge along the path.

entries.definitionEn: A small brown animal with a round body covered in sharp spines.
entries.arabicMeaning: قنفذ؛ حيوان صغير بني يغطي جسمه شوك حاد
entries.example: A hedgehog rolled into a ball when the dog came near.

entries.definitionEn: The back part of the foot, below the ankle. Also the raised back part of a shoe.
entries.arabicMeaning: كعب القدم تحت الكاحل؛ أو الجزء المرتفع في خلف الحذاء
entries.example: There is a stone in the heel of my shoe.

entries.definitionEn: A young female cow that has not yet had a calf.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجلة؛ بقرة صغيرة لم تلد بعد
entries.example: The heifer will have her first calf next spring.

entries.definitionEn: How tall a person or thing is, or how far something is above the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: طول الشخص أو الشيء، أو ارتفاعه عن الأرض
entries.example: What is the height of that building?

entries.definitionEn: To make a feeling, effect, or quality stronger or more intense.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيد شعوراً أو أثراً أو صفة حدة وقوة
entries.example: The music heightened the tension in the scene.

entries.definitionEn: An aircraft with large spinning blades on top, able to go straight up and down and to hover.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروحية؛ طائرة ذات ريش دوّارة في أعلاها تصعد وتهبط عمودياً وتحوم
entries.example: A helicopter landed on the hospital roof.

entries.definitionEn: In some religions, a place of punishment after death. Informal: a very unpleasant situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجحيم في بعض الأديان؛ وعامياً وضع بالغ السوء
entries.example: The kitchen was hell during the lunch rush.

entries.definitionEn: The greeting hello, thought of as a word or an act of greeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحية hello نفسها، بوصفها لفظاً أو فعل ترحيب
entries.example: She gave us a cheerful hello at the door.

entries.definitionEn: The wheel or tiller that steers a ship. Also, in at the helm, the position of being in charge.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفة السفينة أو عجلة قيادتها؛ وفي at the helm: موقع القيادة
entries.example: A new director is now at the helm of the museum.

entries.definitionEn: A hard hat that protects the head, worn for sport, work, or riding.
entries.arabicMeaning: خوذة صلبة تقي الرأس في الرياضة أو العمل أو الركوب
entries.example: You must wear a helmet on this building site.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making a job or a problem easier for someone, or the person or thing that does that.
entries.arabicMeaning: المساعدة في عمل أو مشكلة، أو من يقوم بها
entries.example: Thank you for your help with the boxes.

entries.definitionEn: To make it easier for someone to do something, by doing part of the work or giving support.
entries.arabicMeaning: يساعد شخصاً بتيسير العمل أو تقديم العون
entries.example: Can you help me with this bag?

entries.definitionEn: A person who gives assistance, especially with a practical task.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاون يساعد في عمل عملي
entries.example: Each teacher had a classroom helper on the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Giving useful help or information.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفيد يقدّم عوناً أو معلومات نافعة
entries.example: The staff at the desk were very helpful.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to do anything to protect yourself or to change a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاجز لا يستطيع حماية نفسه أو تغيير الوضع
entries.example: The injured bird looked helpless on the path.

entries.definitionEn: A plant whose strong fibres are used to make rope, cloth, and paper. Related plants are also grown for oil and other products.
entries.arabicMeaning: القنب؛ نبات تُصنع من أليافه الحبال والقماش والورق
entries.example: The old rope was made of hemp.

entries.definitionEn: For this reason; therefore. Also, from this time or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: لهذا السبب؛ ومن ثمّ. وقد تعني من هذا الوقت أو المكان
entries.example: The evidence was incomplete, hence the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to a female person or animal already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق الاسم لتفيد أن الشيء يخص أنثى سبق ذكرها
entries.example: She left her bag on the chair.

entries.definitionEn: The object form of she, used after a verb or a preposition.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة المفعول من she، بعد فعل أو حرف جر
entries.example: I saw her at the market this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that announces or is a sign of what is coming.
entries.arabicMeaning: نذير أو بشير بما سيأتي
entries.example: Robins are a herald of spring in this valley.

entries.definitionEn: To be a sign that something is about to happen, or to announce it publicly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكون علامة على قرب حدوث شيء، أو يعلن عنه
entries.example: The agreement heralds a new stage of cooperation.

entries.definitionEn: A plant whose leaves, seeds, or flowers are used to flavour food or to make medicine.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشب تُستعمل أوراقه أو بذوره أو أزهاره لتطييب الطعام أو للدواء
entries.example: Basil is a herb that goes well with tomatoes.

entries.definitionEn: A group of animals of the same kind that live and feed together, such as cows or deer.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطيع من حيوان واحد يعيش ويأكل معاً كالبقر أو الأيائل
entries.example: A herd of cows crossed the narrow road.

entries.definitionEn: In, at, or to this place.
entries.arabicMeaning: في هذا المكان أو عنده أو إليه
entries.example: Please sit here.

entries.definitionEn: The traditions, buildings, and objects that a country or group receives from the past and values.
entries.arabicMeaning: التراث من تقاليد ومبانٍ وآثار يرثها بلد أو جماعة ويعتز بها
entries.example: The old market is part of the city's heritage.

entries.definitionEn: Closed so tightly that air cannot enter or escape. Also sealed off from outside influence.
entries.arabicMeaning: محكم الإغلاق لا ينفذ منه الهواء ولا إليه؛ أو منعزل عما حوله
entries.example: Keep the powder in a hermetic container.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives alone and away from other people, often for religious reasons.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناسك يعيش وحده بمعزل عن الناس، وغالباً لسبب ديني
entries.example: The hermit lived in a hut above the valley.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is admired for courage or for doing something difficult. Also the main male character in a story.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطل يُعجاب بشجاعته أو بعمل صعب؛ أو الشخصية الذكورية الرئيسة في قصة
entries.example: The firefighters were called heroes after the rescue.

entries.definitionEn: A woman admired for courage or achievement. Also the main female character in a story.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطلة يُعجاب بشجاعتها أو إنجازها؛ أو الشخصية الأنثوية الرئيسة في قصة
entries.example: The heroine of the novel saves her village.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to mean something that belongs to a female person already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير ملكية منفصل بمعنى ما يخص أنثى سبق ذكرها
entries.example: The blue coat is hers.

entries.definitionEn: Used when the same female person is both the subject and the object, or to emphasize that she did something alone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير منعكس للمؤنثة حين تكون فاعلاً ومفعولاً، أو لتوكيد أنها فعلت الأمر بنفسها
entries.example: She made the cake herself.

entries.definitionEn: To pause before doing or saying something, because you are unsure or nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتردد ويتوقف قبل الفعل أو القول من شك أو توتر
entries.example: Don't hesitate to ask if you need help.

entries.definitionEn: A pause before you do or say something, because you are unsure.
entries.arabicMeaning: تردّد أو توقف قبل الفعل أو القول من عدم يقين
entries.example: She agreed without hesitation.

entries.definitionEn: Used to get someone's attention, or as an informal greeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُقال للفت الانتباه أو للتحية غير الرسمية
entries.example: Hey, wait for me at the corner.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word that you say when you meet someone; like hello.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحية غير رسمية تُقال عند اللقاء؛ بمعنى مرحبا
entries.example: Hi, I'm Nadia.

entries.definitionEn: If an animal hibernates, it spends the winter in a deep sleep, using very little energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبت الحيوان شتاءً في نوم عميق قليل استهلاك الطاقة
entries.example: Bears hibernate during the coldest months.

entries.definitionEn: The state of spending winter in a deep sleep, as some animals do.
entries.arabicMeaning: السبات الشتوي؛ نوم عميق تمضي فيه بعض الحيوانات فصل البرد
entries.example: The bats enter hibernation in November.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to be seen or easily found; kept out of sight.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخفي لا يُرى أو لا يُعثر عليه بسهولة
entries.example: There is a hidden key under the flowerpot.

entries.definitionEn: To put something or yourself in a place where you cannot easily be seen or found.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفي شيئاً أو يختبئ حيث يصعب أن يُرى أو يُوجد
entries.example: The cat likes to hide under the bed.

entries.definitionEn: Measuring a long way from bottom to top, or a long way above the ground. Also large in amount or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتفع من أسفل إلى أعلى أو عن الأرض؛ أو كبير المقدار أو المستوى
entries.example: The wall is too high to climb.

entries.definitionEn: At or to a great height.
entries.arabicMeaning: في موضع عالٍ أو إليه
entries.example: The kite flew high above the park.

entries.definitionEn: In some countries, a school for students in their mid to late teens.
entries.arabicMeaning: المدرسة الثانوية في بعض البلدان لطلاب منتصف المراهقة وآخرها
entries.example: My sister is still in high school.

entries.definitionEn: Using the most advanced machines, materials, or methods.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالي التقنية يعتمد أحدث الآلات أو المواد أو الأساليب
entries.example: The factory uses high-tech equipment to check every part.

entries.definitionEn: The most interesting or important part of an event or period. Also a light streak in the hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبرز ما في حدث أو فترة؛ أو خصلة فاتحة في الشعر
entries.example: The highlight of the trip was the boat ride.

entries.definitionEn: To give special attention to something so that people notice it. Also to mark text with a bright colour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبرز أمراً حتى يُلتفت إليه؛ أو يعلّم النص بلون فاقع
entries.example: The report highlights the need for more staff.

entries.definitionEn: To a high degree; very.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى درجة عالية؛ جداً
entries.example: The book is highly recommended by the teachers.

entries.definitionEn: A wide main road for fast traffic between towns.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريق سريع واسع يربط بين المدن
entries.example: We drove along the highway for two hours.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of taking control of a vehicle, especially a plane, by force.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة الاستيلاء بالقوة على مركبة ولا سيما طائرة
entries.example: The hijack of the plane ended without injuries.

entries.definitionEn: To take control of a vehicle, especially a plane, by force. Also to take control of a discussion or process for your own purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستولي بالقوة على مركبة ولا سيما طائرة؛ أو يحوّل نقاشاً أو عملية لخدمة غرضه
entries.example: Criminals tried to hijack the delivery van on the motorway.

entries.definitionEn: A long walk in the countryside or mountains, usually for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: نزهة طويلة سيراً في الريف أو الجبال
entries.example: We went on a hike through the forest.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of going on long walks in the countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة المشي الطويل في الطبيعة
entries.example: Hiking is her favourite weekend activity.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضحك جداً
entries.example: The film was hilarious from start to finish.

entries.definitionEn: A raised area of land, smaller than a mountain.
entries.arabicMeaning: تل؛ أرض مرتفعة أصغر من الجبل
entries.example: They walked up the hill to see the view.

entries.definitionEn: The object form of he, used for a male person or animal already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير المفعول للمذكّر الغائب
entries.example: I saw him at the library yesterday.

entries.definitionEn: Used when the same male person is both the subject and the object, or to emphasize that person.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير انعكاسي أو توكيدي للمذكّر بمعنى نفسه
entries.example: He taught himself to play the piano.

entries.definitionEn: To make it more difficult for someone to do something, or for something to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيق شخصاً أو يعرقل حدوث أمر
entries.example: Poor lighting hindered their work on the details.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that delays or obstructs progress.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائق يبطئ التقدّم أو يحول دونه
entries.example: The missing documents were a hindrance to the sale.

entries.definitionEn: The understanding of a situation that you have only after it has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدراك الأمر بعد وقوعه
entries.example: With hindsight, the warning signs were obvious.

entries.definitionEn: A small suggestion or piece of information that helps you guess or understand something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميح أو إشارة خفيفة تساعد على الفهم
entries.example: She gave him a hint about the answer.

entries.definitionEn: A style of popular music and street culture that includes rap, DJing, and breakdance.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهيب هوب: موسيقى شعبية وثقافة شارع تشمل الراب والدي جي والرقص
entries.example: He listens to hip hop on the way to work.

entries.definitionEn: The joint at the side of the body where the leg meets the pelvis, or the area around it.
entries.arabicMeaning: الورك؛ المفصل الذي تتصل عنده الساق بالحوض
entries.example: She felt a sharp pain in her hip after the run.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a job, or to pay to use something for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوظّف شخصاً، أو يستأجر شيئاً لمدة قصيرة
entries.example: The café needs to hire two extra cooks this summer.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to say that something belongs to a male person or animal already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل الاسم للدلالة على ما يخصّ المذكّر الغائب
entries.example: He left his keys on the table.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to mean the thing or things that belong to a male person already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير ملكية للمذكّر بمعنى ما يخصّه
entries.example: This bag is mine, and that one is his.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies or writes about the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤرّخ يدرس الماضي أو يكتب عنه
entries.example: The historian spent years in the archives.

entries.definitionEn: Important in history, or likely to be remembered as a turning point.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو أهمية تاريخية؛ جدير بأن يُذكر منعطفاً
entries.example: They signed a historic agreement after long talks.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the past, or with the study of history.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالماضي أو بدراسة التاريخ
entries.example: The museum has a large historical collection.

entries.definitionEn: Things that happened in the past, or the study of those things.
entries.arabicMeaning: التاريخ: أحداث الماضي أو دراستها
entries.example: She is studying history at university.

entries.definitionEn: Overly theatrical or exaggerated in emotion, often in a way that seems insincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرحي مبالغ في الانفعال حتى ليبدو متكلّفاً
entries.example: His histrionic reaction made the meeting harder to finish.

entries.definitionEn: In an overly theatrical or exaggerated way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مسرحي مبالغ فيه
entries.example: She sighed histrionically and left the room.

entries.definitionEn: A successful song, film, or product. Also a blow that strikes someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجاح جماهيري كأغنية أو فيلم؛ وقد يعني ضربة
entries.example: The song became a hit within a week.

entries.definitionEn: To strike someone or something with force, by accident or on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب شيئاً أو يصطدم به بقوة
entries.example: The ball hit the window but did not break it.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something to a vehicle or post. Also to get a free lift in a passing vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط شيئاً بعربة أو وتد؛ أو يستوقف سيارة طلباً لمقعد مجاني
entries.example: They hitched the trailer to the truck before dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Until now, or until the time being discussed.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتى الآن، أو حتى ذلك الحين
entries.example: The documents revealed a hitherto unknown agreement.

entries.definitionEn: A virus that attacks the immune system and can lead to AIDS if it is not treated.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيروس نقص المناعة البشرية، وقد يؤدي إلى الإيدز إن تُرك دون علاج
entries.example: Regular treatment helps many people with HIV live long, healthy lives.

entries.definitionEn: An activity that you do regularly in your free time for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: هواية تُمارَس في وقت الفراغ للمتعة
entries.example: Painting is her favourite hobby.

entries.definitionEn: A team sport played with sticks and a ball or puck.
entries.arabicMeaning: هوكي: رياضة جماعية تُلعب بعصيّ وكرة أو قرص
entries.example: The children play hockey after school.

entries.definitionEn: To raise something heavy, often using ropes or machinery.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع شيئاً ثقيلاً، غالباً بالحبال أو الآلات
entries.example: The crew hoisted the cargo onto the deck.

entries.definitionEn: The act of keeping something in your hands, or a place where you can grip it.
entries.arabicMeaning: إمساك أو قبضة؛ أو موضع يُمسَك منه
entries.example: Keep a firm hold on the rail.

entries.definitionEn: To have something in your hands or arms and not let it fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمسك شيئاً بيده أو بين ذراعيه فلا يسقط
entries.example: Please hold my bag while I find the keys.

entries.definitionEn: A person who legally has something, such as a ticket or title. Also a device that holds an object.
entries.arabicMeaning: حائز لشيء كتذكرة أو لقب؛ أو حامل يُوضع فيه شيء
entries.example: Passport holders should wait in the first queue.

entries.definitionEn: An empty space in something solid, or an opening through it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقب أو فجوة في جسم صلب
entries.example: There is a hole in my sock.

entries.definitionEn: A time when you do not work or study, often spent travelling or resting.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطلة؛ وقت بعيد عن العمل أو الدراسة
entries.example: We are going on holiday next week.

entries.definitionEn: Empty inside, with space rather than solid material. Also sounding empty or not sincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجوف فارغ من الداخل؛ وقد يعني كلاماً أو صوتاً بلا صدق
entries.example: The tree trunk was hollow after years of decay.

entries.definitionEn: The Holocaust is the mass murder of Jews and other groups by Nazi Germany. More broadly, a catastrophe in which many people are killed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهولوكوست: إبادة اليهود وغيرهم على يد ألمانيا النازية؛ وقد تعني كارثة يُقتل فيها كثيرون
entries.example: The museum exhibits documents from the Holocaust.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with God or religion, and treated with special respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدّس مرتبط بالله أو بالدين
entries.example: Visitors removed their shoes at the holy site.

entries.definitionEn: To or at the place where you live.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى البيت أو فيه
entries.example: I usually go home after six.

entries.definitionEn: The place where you live, especially with your family.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيت؛ المكان الذي تسكن فيه
entries.example: Their home is near the river.

entries.definitionEn: Without a place to live.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا مأوى؛ لا بيت له
entries.example: The city opened a shelter for homeless people.

entries.definitionEn: In British English, simple and comfortable, like a home. In American English, it can mean unattractive in appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الإنكليزية البريطانية: بسيط مريح كجوّ البيت؛ وفي الأمريكية قد يعني غير وسيم
entries.example: The inn had a homely kitchen that felt welcoming.

entries.definitionEn: A house and the land around it, especially a farm lived on and worked by a family.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزرعة سكنية: بيت والأرض المحيطة به تعيش عليها أسرة وتعمل
entries.example: They restored the old homestead at the edge of the valley.

entries.definitionEn: The town or city where you were born or grew up.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسقط الرأس؛ البلدة التي وُلدت أو نشأت فيها
entries.example: She still visits her hometown every summer.

entries.definitionEn: Going or directed towards home.
entries.arabicMeaning: متّجه إلى البيت
entries.example: They started the homeward journey before sunset.

entries.definitionEn: Work that a teacher gives you to do at home.
entries.arabicMeaning: واجب مدرسي يُنجَز في البيت
entries.example: I finished my homework before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A fine stone used for sharpening the edge of a blade.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسنّ ناعم يُشحذ به حدّ الشفرة
entries.example: He ran the chisel lightly over the hone.

entries.definitionEn: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادق لا يكذب ولا يغشّ
entries.example: She was honest about the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: In a truthful way. Also used to emphasize that you mean what you say.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصدق؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً لتوكيد الكلام
entries.example: He answered the questions honestly.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of telling the truth and not cheating.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدق وأمانة
entries.example: I value honesty in a colleague.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet, thick substance made by bees, used as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: عسل النحل
entries.example: She put honey in her tea.

entries.definitionEn: A holiday that a newly married couple takes after the wedding.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهر العسل: عطلة الزوجين بعد الزفاف
entries.example: They spent their honeymoon by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: The loud sound of a car horn, or a similar sound made by a goose.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوت بوق السيارة، أو نعيق الإوزّ
entries.example: A long honk made everyone look up from the pavement.

entries.definitionEn: To make a loud sound with a car horn, or to make that sound as a goose does.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزمّر ببوق السيارة، أو يُصدر صوتاً كالإوزّ
entries.example: Drivers honk when the lights change too slowly.

entries.definitionEn: Respect that people show you because of your actions or position. Also a privilege that you are proud to have.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرف واحترام يُنالان بالعمل أو المنزلة؛ وقد تعني مزية يُعتزّ بها
entries.example: It was an honour to speak at the ceremony.

entries.definitionEn: To show respect for someone or something, or to keep a promise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكرّم شخصاً أو يفي بعهد
entries.example: They honoured her for thirty years of service.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving respect because of honest or morally good behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريف جدير بالاحترام لسلوكه
entries.example: He made an honourable decision to return the money.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a coat or jacket that covers the head. Also, in American English, the metal cover over a car engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلنسوة المعطف التي تغطي الرأس؛ وفي الأمريكية غطاء محرّك السيارة
entries.example: She pulled up her hood when it started to rain.

entries.definitionEn: A curved piece of metal or plastic used for hanging things or catching fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطّاف مقوّس للتعليق أو لصيد السمك
entries.example: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten or catch something with a hook, or to attach it in a similar way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّق أو يمسك شيئاً بخطّاف
entries.example: He hooked the trailer onto the car.

entries.definitionEn: A short jump on one foot. Also a short journey, especially by air.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفزة قصيرة على قدم واحدة؛ أو رحلة قصيرة ولا سيما جوّاً
entries.example: The ferry ride is only a short hop from the mainland.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling that something good may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمل في أن يحدث خير
entries.example: There is still hope that the train will arrive.

entries.definitionEn: To want something to happen and think that it may.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأمل أن يحدث شيء ويتوقّع إمكانه
entries.example: I hope you feel better tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing hope that something good will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بالأمل أو باعث عليه
entries.example: She felt hopeful after the interview.

entries.definitionEn: In a hopeful way. Also used to say that you hope something will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأمل؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً بمعنى على أمل أن
entries.example: Hopefully the rain will stop before the match.

entries.definitionEn: Without hope, or so bad that success seems impossible. Also very poor at a skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميؤوس منه؛ أو سيئ إلى حدّ يتعذّر معه النجاح؛ وقد تعني ضعيف المهارة جداً
entries.example: The situation looked hopeless until help arrived.

entries.definitionEn: The line where the earth or sea seems to meet the sky.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأفق: الخط الذي تبدو عنده الأرض أو البحر ملتقية بالسماء
entries.example: The sun sank slowly below the horizon.

entries.definitionEn: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals, or a device in a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرن الحيوان؛ أو بوق السيارة للتحذير
entries.example: The driver pressed the horn as a cyclist crossed.

entries.definitionEn: Very unpleasant or frightening.
entries.arabicMeaning: فظيع أو كريه جداً
entries.example: There was a horrible smell in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: To shock someone by being extremely unpleasant or frightening.
entries.arabicMeaning: يروّع شخصاً أو يفزعه بشدة
entries.example: The news of the accident horrified the whole street.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of fear or shock. Also stories or films meant to frighten people.
entries.arabicMeaning: رعب شديد؛ أو قصص وأفلام للتخويف
entries.example: She watched a horror film and could not sleep.

entries.definitionEn: A large animal that people ride or use to pull loads.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصان
entries.example: The horse ran across the field.

entries.definitionEn: A place that cares for people who are very ill and near the end of life.
entries.arabicMeaning: دار رعاية للمحتضرين شديدي المرض
entries.example: Her father spent his last weeks in a hospice.

entries.definitionEn: Friendly and generous to guests or visitors.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضياف كريم مع الضيوف
entries.example: They were hospitable to everyone who stayed the night.

entries.definitionEn: A place where sick or injured people are treated.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستشفى
entries.example: She works in a hospital in the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: Friendly, generous treatment of guests. Also the business of hotels, restaurants, and similar services.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيافة كريمة؛ وقد تعني قطاع الفنادق والمطاعم
entries.example: We thanked them for their hospitality.

entries.definitionEn: To take someone into hospital for treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُدخل شخصاً المستشفى للعلاج
entries.example: The doctor hospitalised her overnight for observation.

entries.definitionEn: A person who receives guests, or who presents a radio or television programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضيف يستقبل الضيوف، أو مقدّم برنامج
entries.example: Our host showed us around the house.

entries.definitionEn: A cheap place to stay, often with shared rooms, especially for students or travellers.
entries.arabicMeaning: نُزُل رخيص غالباً بغرف مشتركة للطلّاب أو المسافرين
entries.example: We stayed in a hostel near the station.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who receives guests, or who looks after passengers or customers.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضيفة تستقبل الضيوف أو ترعى المسافرين والزبائن
entries.example: The hostess showed the guests to their table.

entries.definitionEn: Unfriendly and ready to oppose or attack. Also difficult or dangerous to live in.
entries.arabicMeaning: معادٍ مستعد للمواجهة؛ أو بيئة قاسية يصعب العيش فيها
entries.example: The crowd became hostile when the decision was announced.

entries.definitionEn: Unfriendly feeling or behaviour, or fighting between groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: عداء أو سلوك غير ودّي؛ وقد تعني قتالاً بين جماعات
entries.example: There was open hostility between the two teams.

entries.definitionEn: Having a high temperature. Also tasting spicy.
entries.arabicMeaning: حارّ الحرارة؛ أو حريف المذاق
entries.example: The soup is too hot to eat yet.

entries.definitionEn: A building where you pay to stay in a room for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: فندق
entries.example: We booked a hotel near the airport.

entries.definitionEn: A person who owns or manages a hotel.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب فندق أو مديره
entries.example: The hotelier greeted guests in the lobby each evening.

entries.definitionEn: A period of sixty minutes.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة زمنية: ستون دقيقة
entries.example: The meeting lasted an hour.

entries.definitionEn: Happening every hour, or paid for each hour of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدث كل ساعة، أو يُحسب أجره بالساعة
entries.example: There is an hourly bus to the airport.

entries.definitionEn: A building that people live in, usually for one family.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيت يسكنه الناس، غالباً لأسرة واحدة
entries.example: They live in a small house by the park.

entries.definitionEn: To provide a place for someone or something to live or be kept.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوفّر مأوى لشخص أو مكاناً لحفظ شيء
entries.example: The new building will house the city archives.

entries.definitionEn: All the people who live together in one home, or the home considered as a unit.
entries.arabicMeaning: أهل البيت؛ من يعيشون معاً في منزل واحد
entries.example: The survey asked each household about energy use.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to clean and look after a house or hotel rooms.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدبّر منزل أو عامل نظافة غرف في فندق
entries.example: The housekeeper changed the towels every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A teacher in charge of a boarding house at a school, especially in Britain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناظر السكن الداخلي في مدرسة، ولا سيما في بريطانيا
entries.example: The housemaster checked that the students were in their rooms.

entries.definitionEn: A woman whose main work is looking after her home and family, and who is not in paid employment.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربّة بيت تتولّى شؤون المنزل والأسرة دون عمل مأجور
entries.example: She worked as a housewife while the children were young.

entries.definitionEn: The cooking, cleaning, and other work needed to look after a home.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعمال المنزل من طبخ وتنظيف ونحوهما
entries.example: They share the housework at the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask about the way something is done, or about amount, degree, or condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيف؛ تُستعمل للسؤال عن الطريقة أو المقدار أو الحال
entries.example: How do you get to the station from here?

entries.definitionEn: Used to add a fact that is different from what you have just said.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير أنّ؛ ومع ذلك
entries.example: The plan is costly; however, it should save money later.

entries.definitionEn: A small group of people standing or sitting close together. In American football, a brief gathering of players.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة متلاصقة من الناس؛ وفي كرة القدم الأمريكية اجتماع قصير للاعبين
entries.example: A huddle of reporters waited outside the courthouse.

entries.definitionEn: To crowd close together, often because of cold or fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتلاصق الناس تجمّعاً، غالباً من برد أو خوف
entries.example: The walkers huddled under the trees until the rain eased.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting your arms around someone to show affection.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناق؛ ضمّ شخص بالذراعين ودّاً
entries.example: She gave her brother a hug at the station.

entries.definitionEn: To put your arms around someone and hold them, usually to show love or comfort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعانق شخصاً بالذراعين
entries.example: The child hugged her grandmother.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large in size or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضخم جداً حجماً أو مقداراً
entries.example: They live in a huge apartment overlooking the river.

entries.definitionEn: To a very great degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حدّ بعيد جداً
entries.example: The concert was hugely popular with students.

entries.definitionEn: The main body of a ship, not including the masts or superstructure.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدن السفينة دون الصواري والبنية الفوقية
entries.example: Rust had spread along the hull below the waterline.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to people rather than to animals, machines, or gods.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشري؛ متعلق بالإنسان لا بالحيوان أو الآلة
entries.example: Kindness is a human quality.

entries.definitionEn: A person; a member of the human species.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنسان؛ فرد من جنس البشر
entries.example: Humans have lived in this valley for thousands of years.

entries.definitionEn: Basic freedoms and protections that every person should have, such as safety and fair treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقوق الإنسان: حريات وحمايات أساسية لكل شخص
entries.example: The charter lists human rights such as safety and fair treatment.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and showing care for people or animals, especially by reducing suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحيم يراعي تخفيف المعاناة عن الإنسان أو الحيوان
entries.example: The shelter follows humane methods of care.

entries.definitionEn: A person who believes that reason, ethics, and human welfare should guide life, often without religious belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنساني المذهب: من يرى أن العقل والأخلاق وصالح الإنسان هادي الحياة، غالباً دون استناد إلى الدين
entries.example: The speaker described herself as a humanist rather than a follower of any faith.

entries.definitionEn: All people as a group. Also kindness and sympathy, or the quality of being human.
entries.arabicMeaning: البشرية جمعاء؛ وقد تعني الرحمة والإنسانية
entries.example: Medical research can benefit all of humanity.

entries.definitionEn: To make something seem more human, kind, or easier to relate to.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُكسب شيئاً طابعاً إنسانياً أو ألطف وأقرب إلى الناس
entries.example: The film humanises the scientists behind the discovery.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel less proud, often by showing them their limits.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكسر كبرياء شخص أو يضعه عند حدّه
entries.example: The unexpected defeat humbled the defending champions.

entries.definitionEn: Dishonest or empty talk meant to deceive. In British English, also a hard peppermint sweet.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلام زائف أو فارغ للخداع؛ وفي البريطانية أيضاً حلوى نعنع صلبة
entries.example: She dismissed the advertisement as humbug.

entries.definitionEn: Containing a lot of water vapour in the air; damp and often warm.
entries.arabicMeaning: رطب الهواء؛ كثير بخار الماء وغالباً دافئ
entries.example: The weather was hot and humid all week.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel ashamed or foolish, especially in front of others.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذلّ شخصاً أو يحرجه أمام الناس
entries.example: He did not want to humiliate her in the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel ashamed or foolish, especially in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذلّ يبعث الخجل ولا سيما علناً
entries.example: Losing in the first round was a humiliating result.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling or experience of being made to look foolish or ashamed.
entries.arabicMeaning: إذلال أو شعور بالخزي بعد التحقير
entries.example: She never forgot the humiliation of that public mistake.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being funny, or the ability to see what is funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسّ الفكاهة أو الطرافة
entries.example: His sense of humour made the long journey easier.

entries.definitionEn: Funny, or showing a sense of humour.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكاهي أو ذو حسّ طريف
entries.example: She wrote a humorous account of the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The number 100.
entries.arabicMeaning: مئة؛ العدد 100
entries.example: The hall can seat a hundred people.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of needing food. Also a strong wish for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوع؛ وقد تعني رغبة شديدة في شيء
entries.example: Hunger made it hard to concentrate in class.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting or needing food.
entries.arabicMeaning: جائع يحتاج إلى طعام
entries.example: The children were hungry after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: An occasion of chasing and trying to catch animals. Also a search for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطاردة للصيد؛ أو عملية بحث عن شخص أو شيء
entries.example: The hunt for the missing keys lasted all morning.

entries.definitionEn: To chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport. Also to search carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطارد الحيوان للصيد؛ أو يبحث بدقّة
entries.example: Owls hunt at night.

entries.definitionEn: A person or animal that hunts.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيّاد من الناس أو الحيوانات
entries.example: The hunter tracked the deer through the snow.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of chasing and killing animals for food or sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصيد: مطاردة الحيوان وقتله طعاماً أو رياضة
entries.example: Hunting is tightly controlled in this region.

entries.definitionEn: In a rushed way, because you do not have much time.
entries.arabicMeaning: على عجل لقلة الوقت
entries.example: She packed hurriedly and ran for the train.

entries.definitionEn: The need to do something quickly; a rush.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجلة؛ حاجة إلى الإسراع
entries.example: There is no hurry; the shop is open until eight.

entries.definitionEn: To move or do something more quickly, or to make someone do so.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرع أو يحمل غيره على الإسراع
entries.example: We must hurry or we will miss the bus.

entries.definitionEn: Injured, or upset because of what someone has said or done.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب بأذى، أو مجروح المشاعر
entries.example: She felt hurt by the unfair remark.

entries.definitionEn: To cause pain or injury, or to feel pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤلم أو يصيب بأذى؛ أو يتألّم
entries.example: I hurt my ankle on the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: The man that a woman is married to; a male spouse.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوج
entries.example: Her husband cooked dinner on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something quiet, or to become quiet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُسكت شخصاً أو يهدّئ صوتاً، أو يهدأ
entries.example: She hushed the baby until he fell asleep.

entries.definitionEn: A small, simple building, often made of wood or metal.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوخ صغير بسيط، غالباً من خشب أو معدن
entries.example: The walkers rested in a mountain hut.

entries.definitionEn: Made by combining two different things, such as two types of plant, vehicle, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: هجين ناتج عن الجمع بين نوعين مختلفين
entries.example: They bought a hybrid car that uses both petrol and electricity.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean in order to stay healthy.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظافة صحية تقي من المرض
entries.example: Good hygiene in the kitchen prevents food poisoning.

entries.definitionEn: Deliberate exaggeration used for effect, not meant to be taken literally.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبالغة بيانية لا يُقصد بها المعنى الحرفي
entries.example: Calling the wait a nightmare was hyperbole, but it felt long.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark (-) used to join words or parts of words.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرطة الوصل (-) بين الكلمات أو أجزائها
entries.example: The word well-known is written with a hyphen.

entries.definitionEn: Treatment that uses hypnosis to help with habits, pain, or anxiety.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاج بالتنويم الإيحائي لعادات أو ألم أو قلق
entries.example: She tried hypnotherapy to stop smoking.

entries.definitionEn: The behaviour of claiming to have moral standards that your own actions do not match.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفاق: ادّعاء قيم لا يطابقها الفعل
entries.example: Promising thrift while spending freely struck her as hypocrisy.

entries.definitionEn: A person who pretends to have beliefs or virtues that their behaviour does not show.
entries.arabicMeaning: منافق يدّعي قيماً يكذّبها سلوكه
entries.example: He felt like a hypocrite telling others to save while he wasted paper.

entries.definitionEn: Claiming moral standards that your own behaviour does not follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: منافق في ادّعائه قيماً يخالفها عمله
entries.example: It seemed hypocritical to demand silence while talking through the film.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that claims moral standards you yourself do not follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو منافق يناقض فيه القولُ الفعلَ
entries.example: She hypocritically praised teamwork after ignoring her colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: An idea that is suggested as a possible explanation and then tested.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرضية تُطرح تفسيراً محتملاً ثم تُختبَر
entries.example: The study tested the hypothesis that sleep improves memory.

entries.definitionEn: To suggest a possible explanation that can be tested.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع فرضية قابلة للاختبار
entries.example: Researchers hypothesize that the two symptoms share a cause.

entries.definitionEn: Based on a possible situation rather than on facts that have been shown.
entries.arabicMeaning: افتراضي مبني على احتمال لا على واقع ثابت
entries.example: Let us consider a hypothetical case before we decide.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme, uncontrolled emotion in a person or group, often fear or excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: هستيريا: انفعال فردي أو جماعي خارج عن الضبط، غالباً خوفاً أو حماسة
entries.example: Media hysteria made the small delay sound like a crisis.

entries.definitionEn: In a state of uncontrolled emotion, such as laughter or panic. Also extremely funny in informal use.
entries.arabicMeaning: هستيري خارج عن ضبط الانفعال؛ وفي الكلام العادي قد يعني مضحكاً جداً
entries.example: She became hysterical with laughter at the story.

entries.definitionEn: In an uncontrolled, highly emotional way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو هستيري خارج عن الضبط
entries.example: The child was crying hysterically after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: The word you use to talk about yourself as the subject of a sentence.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير المتكلّم المفرد في موقع الفاعل: أنا
entries.example: I am ready to leave now.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet frozen food made from milk or cream.
entries.arabicMeaning: آيس كريم؛ مثلّجات من الحليب أو القشدة
entries.example: We bought ice cream after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A team sport played on ice with sticks and a small hard puck.
entries.arabicMeaning: هوكي الجليد: رياضة جماعية على الجليد بعصيّ وقرص صلب
entries.example: Ice hockey is popular in cold countries.

entries.definitionEn: Frozen water, hard and cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: جليد؛ ماء متجمّد
entries.example: There was ice on the lake in January.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of moving on ice wearing ice skates.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزلج على الجليد بأحذية مزوّدة بشفرات
entries.example: Ice skating is taught at the city rink in winter.

entries.definitionEn: A man whose job was to deliver blocks of ice, especially before refrigerators were common.
entries.arabicMeaning: بائع الثلج أو موزّعه قبل انتشار الثلاجات
entries.example: The iceman left a block of ice on the doorstep at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A small picture on a screen that you click to open a program. Also a person or image treated as a famous symbol.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيقونة على الشاشة لفتح برنامج؛ أو رمز مشهور لشخص أو صورة
entries.example: Click the folder icon on the desktop.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with ice, or extremely cold. Also unfriendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغطى بالجليد أو شديد البرودة؛ وقد يعني بارداً في المعاملة
entries.example: Drive slowly on icy roads.

entries.definitionEn: A small card that proves who you are, often with a photograph.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة هوية تثبت من أنت، وغالباً عليها صورة
entries.example: Show your ID card at the entrance.

entries.definitionEn: An official document or number that proves who you are.
entries.arabicMeaning: إثبات هوية: وثيقة أو رقم رسمي يدلّ على الشخص
entries.example: You need ID to collect the parcel.

entries.definitionEn: A thought or plan in your mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكرة أو خطة في الذهن
entries.example: She had a good idea for the project.

entries.definitionEn: The best possible; perfect for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثالي؛ الأفضل لغرض معيّن
entries.example: This room is ideal for studying.

entries.definitionEn: In the best possible situation, or in an ideal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الوضع الأمثل؛ على نحو مثالي
entries.example: Ideally, we should finish the report today.

entries.definitionEn: Exactly the same as something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطابق تماماً لغيره
entries.example: The two keys look identical.

entries.definitionEn: The process of recognizing who or what someone or something is. Also an official document that proves who you are.
entries.arabicMeaning: التعرّف على هوية شخص أو شيء؛ أو وثيقة تثبت الهوية
entries.example: The identification of the plant took several days.

entries.definitionEn: To recognize someone or something and say who or what they are.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعرّف على شخص أو شيء ويحدّد هويته
entries.example: Can you identify the man in this photograph?

entries.definitionEn: An official card that shows your name and photograph and proves who you are.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة هوية رسمية بالاسم والصورة
entries.example: Carry your identity card when you travel.

entries.definitionEn: Who a person is, or the qualities that make a person or group distinct.
entries.arabicMeaning: هوية الشخص أو الصفات التي تميّزه أو تميّز جماعة
entries.example: She kept her identity secret in the study.

entries.definitionEn: A set of ideas that form the basis of a political or economic system, or of a way of thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيديولوجيا: منظومة أفكار تؤسس لنظام سياسي أو اقتصادي أو لأسلوب تفكير
entries.example: The book explains the ideology behind the reform.

entries.definitionEn: A group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the separate words.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعبير اصطلاحي لا يُفهم من معاني كلماته منفردة
entries.example: The phrase kick the bucket is an idiom meaning to die.

entries.definitionEn: Using expressions that sound natural to native speakers, rather than word-for-word translation.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصيح على أسلوب أهل اللغة، لا ترجمة حرفية
entries.example: Her Spanish is fluent and idiomatic.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that uses natural native expressions rather than literal wording.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو اصطلاحي طبيعي في اللغة
entries.example: The phrase cannot be translated idiomatically word for word.

entries.definitionEn: A habit or feature peculiar to one person, group, or thing, often slightly odd.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصيصة أو عادة فردية غريبة بعض الشيء
entries.example: One idiosyncrasy of the clock is that it chimes twice at noon.

entries.definitionEn: Peculiar to one person or thing; distinctive and often unusual.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاصّ بفرد أو شيء، مميّز وقد يكون غير مألوف
entries.example: He has an idiosyncratic way of organizing his notes.

entries.definitionEn: A rude word for a person you think is very foolish.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحمق؛ لفظ جافٍ لمن تراه بالغ الغباء
entries.example: I felt like an idiot after locking the keys inside.

entries.definitionEn: Not working or being used. Also lazy, or with no serious purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاطل عن العمل أو غير مستعمَل؛ وقد يعني كسولاً أو بلا غاية جدّية
entries.example: The factory stood idle during the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: Of an engine, to run slowly while the vehicle is not moving. Also to spend time doing nothing useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعمل المحرّك على السرعة الخاملة والمركبة واقفة؛ أو يمضي الوقت بلا عمل مفيد
entries.example: She let the engine idle while she scraped ice from the windscreen.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is greatly admired. Also a statue or image worshipped as a god.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدوة يُعجَب بها الناس إعجاباً شديداً؛ أو تمثال يُعبَد
entries.example: The singer became an idol to a generation of fans.

entries.definitionEn: To admire someone so much that you treat them as perfect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّس شخصاً إعجاباً حتى يراه كاملاً
entries.example: As a child she idolised the captain of the national team.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that one thing will happen only when another thing happens, or to talk about a condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: إذا؛ حرف يربط جملة بشرط وقوع أمر آخر
entries.example: If it rains, we will stay inside.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving or causing public shame; humiliating.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخزٍ يجلب العار على الملأ
entries.example: The team suffered an ignominious defeat in the final.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that brings public shame.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مخزٍ يجلب العار
entries.example: The proposal was ignominiously withdrawn after the leak.

entries.definitionEn: Lack of knowledge or information about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهل؛ نقص في المعرفة أو المعلومات
entries.example: His comments showed ignorance of the basic facts.

entries.definitionEn: Not knowing facts or information that you should know. Also rude in informal use.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاهل بما ينبغي أن يُعلم؛ وفي الكلام العادي قد يعني فظّاً
entries.example: I was ignorant of the new rules until she explained them.

entries.definitionEn: To pay no attention to someone or something, on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجاهل عمداً شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: She chose to ignore the rude remark.

entries.definitionEn: Not in good health; sick.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريض؛ عليل الصحة
entries.example: He stayed at home because he was ill.

entries.definitionEn: Not allowed by law.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير قانوني؛ مخالف للقانون
entries.example: It is illegal to park on the pavement here.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is against the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مخالف للقانون
entries.example: The files had been copied illegally.

entries.definitionEn: A disease or period of being unwell.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرض أو فترة اعتلال
entries.example: She missed a week of work because of illness.

entries.definitionEn: To shine light on something. Also to make an idea easier to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضيء شيئاً بنور؛ أو يجلي فكرة فيسهل فهمها
entries.example: Street lamps illuminate the path through the park.

entries.definitionEn: To explain something by giving examples, or to add pictures to a text.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوضّح بالأمثلة، أو يزيّن النص بالصور
entries.example: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the process.

entries.definitionEn: A picture in a book or article, or an example that helps explain something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم توضيحي في كتاب، أو مثال يشرح فكرة
entries.example: Each chapter begins with a small illustration.

entries.definitionEn: A picture of someone or something. Also the way a person or organization is seen by others.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة لشخص أو شيء؛ أو صورة ذهنية عن شخص أو جهة
entries.example: The image on the screen was not clear.

entries.definitionEn: Language that creates pictures in the mind, especially in literature. Also a set of visual images.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصوير لغوي يخلق صوراً في الذهن، ولا سيما في الأدب؛ أو مجموعة صور مرئية
entries.example: The poem is full of sea imagery.

entries.definitionEn: Existing only in the mind, not in real life.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيالي لا وجود له في الواقع
entries.example: The child had an imaginary friend.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind that are not present.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيال: القدرة على تصوّر ما ليس حاضراً
entries.example: Use your imagination to finish the story.

entries.definitionEn: To form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتخيّل شيئاً في ذهنه
entries.example: Can you imagine living without a telephone?

entries.definitionEn: To copy the way someone speaks, looks, or behaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّد كلام شخص أو هيئته أو سلوكه
entries.example: Children often imitate their parents.

entries.definitionEn: A copy of something, or the act of copying a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقليد أو محاكاة؛ أو نسخة عن أصل
entries.example: The bag is an imitation of a famous design.

entries.definitionEn: Happening now or very soon, with no delay. Also nearest in space or relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوري بلا تأخير؛ أو الأقرب مكاناً أو صلة
entries.example: The problem needs immediate attention.

entries.definitionEn: Now, without any delay.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوراً بلا إبطاء
entries.example: Please call me immediately if the train is late.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large or great.
entries.arabicMeaning: هائل الحجم أو القدر
entries.example: They faced an immense amount of work.

entries.definitionEn: To a very great degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حدّ هائل
entries.example: I am immensely grateful for your help.

entries.definitionEn: To put something completely into a liquid. Also to involve yourself fully in an activity or language.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغمر شيئاً في سائل، أو ينغمس تماماً في نشاط أو لغة
entries.example: She immersed herself in Italian during the year abroad.

entries.definitionEn: A person who comes to live permanently in a country that is not their original home.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص ينتقل للعيش الدائم في بلد غير بلده الأصلي
entries.example: Many immigrants start new businesses in the city.

entries.definitionEn: To come and live in a country that is not your original home.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهاجر إلى بلد آخر ليستقر فيه
entries.example: They immigrated to Canada when their children were young.

entries.definitionEn: The act of coming to live in a country that is not your original home. Also the official process that controls this.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهجرة إلى بلد آخر للإقامة فيه، أو الإجراءات الرسمية المنظِّمة لها
entries.example: Immigration rules can change from year to year.

entries.definitionEn: Wrong according to accepted ideas of honesty or fairness.
entries.arabicMeaning: منافٍ للأخلاق المقبولة
entries.example: Lying to customers is widely seen as immoral.

entries.definitionEn: Living forever, or remembered for so long that it seems never to fade.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالد لا يموت، أو يبقى ذكره زمناً طويلاً
entries.example: The poet became immortal through those few verses.

entries.definitionEn: The state of living forever, or of being remembered for a very long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخلود أو دوام الذكر
entries.example: Ancient myths often promised immortality to heroes.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something remembered for a very long time, often in art or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخلّد ذكر شخص أو شيء في الفن أو الكتابة
entries.example: The photograph immortalized the moment the bridge opened.

entries.definitionEn: A small creature in stories that causes mischief. Also a child who behaves in a playfully naughty way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عفريت صغير مشاكس في القصص، أو طفل كثير المقالب
entries.example: The little imp hid his sister's shoes again.

entries.definitionEn: The effect that something has on a person, thing, or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر شيء في شخص أو وضع
entries.example: The new road had a big impact on local shops.

entries.definitionEn: To make something weaker or less effective, especially a sense or ability.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضعف شيئاً أو يقلل فاعليته، وخصوصاً حاسة أو قدرة
entries.example: Loud noise can impair your hearing over time.

entries.definitionEn: Fair and not supporting one side more than another.
entries.arabicMeaning: محايد لا ينحاز لطرف دون آخر
entries.example: The judge must remain impartial during the trial.

entries.definitionEn: Annoyed because you have to wait, or because something is too slow.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الصبر، يتضايق من الانتظار أو البطء
entries.example: The children grew impatient in the long queue.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are annoyed by waiting or delay.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغير صبر، مع تبرم من الانتظار
entries.example: He glanced impatiently at his watch.

entries.definitionEn: Perfect, with no faults that can be found.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا عيب فيه؛ في غاية الإتقان
entries.example: Her research notes were impeccable.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is faultless or perfectly correct.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإتقان تام لا يشوبه خلل
entries.example: He was impeccably dressed for the interview.

entries.definitionEn: To slow down or block the progress of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيق تقدّم شخص أو أمر أو يبطئه
entries.example: Poor roads impede the delivery of supplies.

entries.definitionEn: Something that makes progress difficult. Also a problem that affects speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائق يصعّب التقدّم؛ وقد يعني عيباً في النطق
entries.example: High fees were an impediment to further study.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely important and necessary; something that must be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضروري ملحّ لا بدّ منه
entries.example: It is imperative that the documents arrive today.

entries.definitionEn: So slight or gradual that it can hardly be noticed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الدقة أو البطء حتى يكاد لا يُحسّ
entries.example: There was an imperceptible change in the light.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is almost too slight to notice.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يكاد لا يُلاحَظ
entries.example: The temperature rose imperceptibly through the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting only for a limited time; not lasting forever.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير دائم؛ يبقى زمناً محدوداً
entries.example: The exhibition is an impermanent installation in the square.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking warmth or personal feeling; treating people in a distant, official way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتقر إلى الدفء الشخصي؛ رسمي بارد في التعامل
entries.example: The letter was polite but impersonal.

entries.definitionEn: In a distant or official way, without personal feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب رسمي بارد خالٍ من الطابع الشخصي
entries.example: Complaints were handled impersonally by a central office.

entries.definitionEn: To copy someone's voice, appearance, or manner, often in order to entertain or deceive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّد صوت شخص أو هيئته، للترفيه أو للخداع
entries.example: The actor can impersonate several famous singers.

entries.definitionEn: The act of copying someone else's voice, appearance, or manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقليد صوت شخص أو مظهره أو أسلوبه
entries.example: Her impersonation of the mayor made the whole room laugh.

entries.definitionEn: A person who copies someone else's voice, appearance, or manner, usually as entertainment.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يتخصّص في تقليد الآخرين، غالباً للترفيه
entries.example: The impersonator opened the show with a famous speech.

entries.definitionEn: Not affected or influenced by something. Also not allowing liquid to pass through.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يتأثر بشيء؛ أو لا ينفذ منه السائل
entries.example: She seemed impervious to criticism.

entries.definitionEn: Playfully mischievous, like a naughty child.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشاكس بمرح، كطفل كثير المقالب
entries.example: He gave her an impish smile and hid the keys.

entries.definitionEn: In a playfully mischievous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمرح مشاكس
entries.example: She grinned impishly and refused to explain the joke.

entries.definitionEn: A tool or piece of equipment used for a particular job.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة أو معدّة تُستخدم لعمل معيّن
entries.example: The kit includes several garden implements.

entries.definitionEn: To put a plan, system, or decision into action.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفّذ خطة أو نظاماً أو قراراً
entries.example: The school implemented the new timetable in September.

entries.definitionEn: To show or suggest that someone is involved in a crime or wrongdoing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يورّط شخصاً أو يُظهر ضلوعه في خطأ أو جريمة
entries.example: The emails implicated two senior managers.

entries.definitionEn: A possible result or meaning that is suggested but not stated directly.
entries.arabicMeaning: نتيجة أو معنى محتمل يُفهم من غير تصريح مباشر
entries.example: Have you considered the implications of leaving early?

entries.definitionEn: To suggest something without saying it openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوحي بمعنى من غير أن يصرّح به
entries.example: His tone implied that the offer was final.

entries.definitionEn: Rude; not showing good manners.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الأدب؛ خلاف آداب التعامل
entries.example: It is impolite to interrupt when someone is speaking.

entries.definitionEn: In a rude way; without good manners.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب غير مهذّب
entries.example: She impolitely cut across his explanation.

entries.definitionEn: To bring goods or ideas into a country from abroad.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستورد سلعاً أو أفكاراً من الخارج
entries.example: The company imports coffee from several regions.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being valuable, serious, or worth attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: أهمية الشيء وقيمته
entries.example: She stressed the importance of sleep.

entries.definitionEn: Of great value or needing attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمّ يستحق العناية
entries.example: Water is important for life.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that a fact matters a lot.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة مهمة؛ للدلالة على أن أمراً جدير بالاهتمام
entries.example: More importantly, nobody was hurt.

entries.definitionEn: To force a rule, tax, or burden on people. Also to ask too much of someone's time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرض قاعدة أو ضريبة أو عبئاً؛ وقد يعني الإثقال على وقت أحد
entries.example: The council imposed a limit on parking hours.

entries.definitionEn: The act of forcing a rule or burden on people. Also an unwelcome demand on someone's time or kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرض أمر على الناس، أو طلب ثقيل على وقت أحد أو لطفه
entries.example: Asking her to stay late again felt like an imposition.

entries.definitionEn: Something that cannot happen or be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر يستحيل وقوعه أو إنجازه
entries.example: Finishing the report by noon is an impossibility.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to happen or be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستحيل لا يمكن حدوثه أو فعله
entries.example: It is impossible to open this door without a key.

entries.definitionEn: Made very poor. Also made weaker or less rich in quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: أُفقر مادياً؛ أو صار أفقر جودةً وثراءً
entries.example: The drought left many farming families impoverished.

entries.definitionEn: Not sensible or useful in real situations, often because it is too difficult or costly.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير عملي في الواقع لصعوبته أو كلفته
entries.example: A glass table seemed beautiful but impractical with young children.

entries.definitionEn: A person who organizes and manages concerts, operas, or other public performances.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظّم حفلات أو عروض فنية يتولى إدارتها
entries.example: The impresario booked three orchestras for the festival.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone admire you or feel respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعجب شخصاً أو ينال احترامه
entries.example: His calm answers impressed the interviewers.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling admiration or respect because of something good.
entries.arabicMeaning: معجب بما رأى أو سمع
entries.example: I was impressed by how clearly she explained the problem.

entries.definitionEn: An idea or feeling you get about someone or something. Also a mark left by pressing.
entries.arabicMeaning: انطباع أو شعور يتكوّن لديك؛ وقد يعني أثراً بالضغط
entries.example: She made a good impression on her first day.

entries.definitionEn: A style of painting that shows light and colour in loose brushstrokes, especially in late nineteenth-century France.
entries.arabicMeaning: الانطباعية: أسلوب تصوير يُبرز الضوء واللون بضربات فرشاة حرّة
entries.example: The museum has a strong collection of Impressionism.

entries.definitionEn: A painter who works in the Impressionist style. Also a performer who copies famous people.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسّام انطباعي؛ وقد يعني فنّاناً يقلّد المشاهير
entries.example: Monet is among the best-known Impressionists.

entries.definitionEn: Giving a general sense of something rather than exact detail, often in a loose, painterly way.
entries.arabicMeaning: انطباعي يقدّم إحساساً عاماً لا تفصيلاً دقيقاً
entries.example: The report was impressionistic rather than based on hard figures.

entries.definitionEn: In a loose, suggestive way that captures a general feeling rather than precise detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب انطباعي يُبرز الإحساس لا الدقة التفصيلية
entries.example: She described the city impressionistically, in flashes of colour and sound.

entries.definitionEn: Causing admiration because of size, skill, or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير للإعجاب لحجمه أو مهارته أو جودته
entries.example: The team's recovery was impressive.

entries.definitionEn: To put someone in prison.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسجن شخصاً
entries.example: The court imprisoned him for six months.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being kept in prison.
entries.arabicMeaning: السجن أو الاحتجاز في السجن
entries.example: She faced two years of imprisonment.

entries.definitionEn: Not likely to be true or to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محتمل الصدق أو الوقوع
entries.example: An improbable last-minute goal won the match.

entries.definitionEn: Not correct, suitable, or acceptable in a particular situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير لائق أو غير صحيح في المقام
entries.example: It is improper to read private messages without permission.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is wrong, unsuitable, or against the rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير صحيح أو غير لائق
entries.example: The machine had been improperly installed.

entries.definitionEn: To become better, or to make something better.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحسّن أو يحسّن شيئاً
entries.example: Her English improved after six months abroad.

entries.definitionEn: Better than before.
entries.arabicMeaning: أفضل مما كان
entries.example: The improved design uses less energy.

entries.definitionEn: A change that makes something better, or the process of becoming better.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحسّن أو تغيير يجعل الأمر أفضل
entries.example: There has been a clear improvement in her writing.

entries.definitionEn: Created in the moment without a prepared plan, especially in music, theatre, or speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتجل يُبتكر في لحظته بلا إعداد مسبق
entries.example: The band is famous for long improvisational passages.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden wish to act, often without much thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: دافع مفاجئ للفعل من غير رويّة طويلة
entries.example: On impulse, she booked a ticket for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Acting suddenly, without thinking carefully first.
entries.arabicMeaning: مندفع يتصرف بلا تروٍ كافٍ
entries.example: He regretted the impulsive purchase the next morning.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that someone or something is inside a place, or has arrived there.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف يدل على الوجود في الداخل أو على الوصول
entries.example: Come in; the door is open.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show that something is inside a place, during a time, or part of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على المكان داخل شيء، أو الزمان، أو الانتماء إلى مجموعة
entries.example: The keys are in the drawer.

entries.definitionEn: Not correct or exact; containing mistakes.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير دقيق وفيه أخطاء
entries.example: The first report of the accident was inaccurate.

entries.definitionEn: Not enough, or not good enough for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير كافٍ أو دون المستوى المطلوب
entries.example: The lighting in the hall was inadequate for reading.

entries.definitionEn: Not alive; without life, as objects are.
entries.arabicMeaning: جماد لا حياة فيه
entries.example: A stone is an inanimate object.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking skill, taste, or feeling for art.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الحسّ الفني أو الذوق الجمالي
entries.example: The cover looked cheap and inartistic beside the others.

entries.definitionEn: Present from birth; natural rather than learned.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطري موجود منذ الولادة لا مكتسب
entries.example: She has an inborn talent for languages.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that is burned to produce a sweet smell, often in religious ceremonies.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخور يُحرق لرائحته الزكية، وغالباً في الطقوس
entries.example: They lit incense before the evening prayer.

entries.definitionEn: Something that encourages you to work harder or to do a particular thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حافز يشجّع على بذل جهد أو القيام بأمر
entries.example: A small bonus was an incentive to finish early.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to about 2.54 centimetres.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحدة طول تساوي نحو 2.54 سنتيمتراً
entries.example: The screen is fourteen inches wide.

entries.definitionEn: To move slowly and carefully, a little at a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقدم ببطء شديد خطوة فخطوة
entries.example: The traffic inched forward after the lights changed.

entries.definitionEn: Just beginning and not yet fully formed or organized.
entries.arabicMeaning: في بدايته ولم يكتمل تشكّله بعد
entries.example: The proposal was still inchoate and needed a clearer plan.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is only beginning and not yet fully formed.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو بدائي غير مكتمل التشكّل
entries.example: The idea was only inchoately expressed in the first draft.

entries.definitionEn: Something that happens, especially something unusual, unpleasant, or violent.
entries.arabicMeaning: حادث أو واقعة، وخصوصاً إن كانت غير عادية أو سيئة
