entries.example: The police were called after a minor incident outside the station.

entries.definitionEn: Just beginning to appear or develop.
entries.arabicMeaning: في طور النشوء أو بداية الظهور
entries.example: Doctors treated the incipient infection before it spread.

entries.definitionEn: To cut into a surface, often to make a mark or opening.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشقّ سطحاً أو يحفر فيه قطعاً
entries.example: The surgeon incised the skin along a marked line.

entries.definitionEn: A cut made into the body, especially during an operation.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقّ يُجرى في الجسم، وخصوصاً أثناء عملية جراحية
entries.example: The incision healed cleanly within two weeks.

entries.definitionEn: One of the front teeth used for cutting food.
entries.arabicMeaning: سن أمامية قاطعة
entries.example: He chipped an incisor when he bit the hard sweet.

entries.definitionEn: To have something as a part, or to make someone or something part of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمل شيئاً كجزء، أو يُدخل شخصاً أو شيئاً في مجموعة
entries.example: The price includes breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show that a person or thing is part of the group you are talking about.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يبيّن أن شخصاً أو شيئاً داخل المجموعة المذكورة
entries.example: Everyone went, including the children.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making someone or something part of a group. Also the fact of being included.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدماج شخص أو شيء في مجموعة، أو كونه مشمولاً فيها
entries.example: The policy supports the inclusion of students with extra needs.

entries.definitionEn: Including a wide range of people or things. Also covering everything mentioned, such as a price that covers extras.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل لفئات أو عناصر واسعة؛ وقد يعني سعراً يغطي كل البنود
entries.example: They wanted a more inclusive discussion, not just senior staff.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that includes many people or things, rather than leaving some out.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب يضمّ الكثيرين ولا يستثني
entries.example: The chair spoke inclusively so that every team felt addressed.

entries.definitionEn: Money that a person or organization receives, especially from work or investments.
entries.arabicMeaning: دخل من عمل أو استثمارات
entries.example: Her monthly income covers rent and food.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being strangely out of place or not in harmony with the surroundings.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنافر أو مفارقة تجعل الشيء ناشزاً عن سياقه
entries.example: He smiled at the incongruity of a piano in the warehouse.

entries.definitionEn: Strange because it does not fit the situation or surroundings.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشز لا ينسجم مع المقام أو المحيط
entries.example: A tuxedo looked incongruous at the beach picnic.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that does not fit the situation or surroundings.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ناشز عن السياق
entries.example: A neon sign hung incongruously above the old doorway.

entries.definitionEn: Causing problems or extra difficulty; not easy or suitable at that time.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ملائم ويسبب صعوبة إضافية
entries.example: The meeting is at an inconvenient hour for parents.

entries.definitionEn: Wrong; not true or not accurate.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاطئ أو غير صحيح
entries.example: The first answer on the form was incorrect.

entries.definitionEn: A rise in amount, number, or level.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيادة في الكم أو العدد أو المستوى
entries.example: There has been an increase in train fares.

entries.definitionEn: To become larger in amount or number, or to make something larger.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيد أو يزداد كماً أو عدداً
entries.example: Prices increased last month.

entries.definitionEn: More and more.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو متزايد
entries.example: Working from home is becoming increasingly common.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good, large, or surprising, or hard to believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذهل أو يصعب تصديقه
entries.example: The view from the ridge was incredible.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely; in a way that is hard to believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة بالغة أو يصعب تصديقها
entries.example: She was incredibly calm before the exam.

entries.definitionEn: Currently holding an official position. Also, if something is incumbent on you, it is your duty.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغل للمنصب حالياً؛ أو واجب محتّم على شخص
entries.example: It is incumbent on managers to explain the delay.

entries.definitionEn: The person who currently holds a particular official position.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغل المنصب الحالي
entries.example: The incumbent faces a strong challenge this year.

entries.definitionEn: To bring an unpleasant cost, debt, or result on yourself through your actions.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكبّد كلفة أو ديناً أو نتيجة سيئة بسبب فعله
entries.example: Late delivery will incur extra charges.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to be cured or made fully well.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُرجى شفاؤه التام
entries.example: Some conditions remain incurable even with modern treatment.

entries.definitionEn: Owing money. Also feeling grateful because someone has helped you.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدين بالمال؛ أو ممتنان لمن قدّم عوناً
entries.example: I am indebted to her for the introduction.

entries.definitionEn: Used to add force to a statement, or to agree strongly. It can mean really or in fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: للتوكيد أو للموافقة القوية؛ بمعنى حقاً أو في الواقع
entries.example: The room was very cold indeed.

entries.definitionEn: Not clear, not fixed, or without a stated limit in time.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محدّد أو بلا أجل معلوم
entries.example: The office was closed for an indefinite period.

entries.definitionEn: In English grammar, the words a and an, used before a noun that is not specific.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة التنكير في الإنجليزية، وهي a و an قبل اسم غير معيّن
entries.example: Use an indefinite article before a singular countable noun.

entries.definitionEn: For a period of time that has no stated end.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى أجل غير مسمّى
entries.example: The project was postponed indefinitely.

entries.definitionEn: To start a line of writing further from the margin than the other lines.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُدخل أول السطر إلى الداخل عن الهامش
entries.example: Indent the first line of each paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being free from control by other people or another country.
entries.arabicMeaning: استقلال عن سيطرة الآخرين أو بلد آخر
entries.example: She values her independence and lives alone.

entries.definitionEn: Free from control or support by others; able to manage by yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستقل لا يخضع لسيطرة الغير ويقدر على تدبير أموره
entries.example: He is financially independent of his parents.

entries.definitionEn: Without help or control from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: باستقلال ومن غير عون أو سيطرة من الغير
entries.example: The two labs reached the same result independently.

entries.definitionEn: So extreme or unusual that you cannot find words for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفوق الوصف فلا تكاد تجد له كلمات
entries.example: The noise after the explosion was indescribable.

entries.definitionEn: An alphabetical list of topics in a book, showing page numbers. Also a number that shows how a set of values is changing.
entries.arabicMeaning: فهرس أبجدي في كتاب؛ أو مؤشر رقمي يبيّن تغيّر مجموعة قيم
entries.example: Look up the topic in the index at the back.

entries.definitionEn: To show or point to something, or to be a sign of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبيّن أو يشير إلى شيء، أو يكون علامة عليه
entries.example: The sign indicates the way to the station.

entries.definitionEn: Not interested or not caring. Also of only average quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مكترث؛ وقد يعني متوسط الجودة
entries.example: She was indifferent to fashion and wore the same coat for years.

entries.definitionEn: Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساخط لغضب يرى فيه ظلماً أو إهانة
entries.example: He was indignant at being accused without evidence.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows anger at something unfair or insulting.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسخط على ما يُرى ظلماً أو إهانة
entries.example: I did nothing wrong, she said indignantly.

entries.definitionEn: Treatment that makes you feel ashamed or less respected.
entries.arabicMeaning: إهانة أو معاملة تُذهب الكرامة
entries.example: He suffered the indignity of being searched in public.

entries.definitionEn: Not going straight to a place, person, or point; not said openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مباشر في المسار أو في القول
entries.example: We took an indirect route to avoid the traffic.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not straight or not said openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة غير مباشرة
entries.example: She heard the news indirectly from a neighbour.

entries.definitionEn: Not divided into distinct, separate parts; treated as one undivided whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير منقسم إلى أجزاء متمايزة؛ يُعامل ككلّ واحد
entries.example: The data formed an indiscrete mass rather than clear categories.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that shows a lack of good judgement, especially by revealing a secret or doing something unwise.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلّة تبصّر، وخصوصاً بإفشاء سر أو فعل طائش
entries.example: One youthful indiscretion should not define a whole career.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to one person or thing, considered separately from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: فردي يخصّ واحداً بعينه دون الجماعة
entries.example: Each student has an individual study plan.

entries.definitionEn: A single person, considered separately from a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرد يُنظر إليه بمعزل عن الجماعة
entries.example: Every individual in the team has a clear role.

entries.definitionEn: The belief that the needs and rights of each person matter more than those of the group.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذهب يقدّم حاجة الفرد وحقوقه على الجماعة
entries.example: The essay examines individualism in modern city life.

entries.definitionEn: The qualities that make a person or thing different from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرادة الصفات التي تميّز شخصاً أو شيئاً عن غيره
entries.example: The school tries to protect each child's individuality.

entries.definitionEn: The habit of avoiding activity or effort; laziness.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسل والميل إلى اجتناب الجهد
entries.example: Years of indolence left him unfit for hard work.

entries.definitionEn: Wanting to avoid activity or effort; lazy.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسول يكره بذل الجهد
entries.example: An indolent afternoon passed with no work done.

entries.definitionEn: In a lazy way, without energy or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: بكسل وقلة نشاط
entries.example: He stretched indolently and reached for another book.

entries.definitionEn: Used or happening inside a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخلي يجري داخل مبنى
entries.example: We play indoor tennis when it rains.

entries.definitionEn: Inside a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: في داخل المبنى
entries.example: Let's go indoors; it is starting to rain.

entries.definitionEn: To cause something to happen, or to persuade someone to do something. In medicine, to start a process such as labour on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث أمراً أو يقنع شخصاً بفعله؛ وفي الطب قد يعني تحريض الولادة
entries.example: The drug can induce drowsiness.

entries.definitionEn: Something offered to persuade a person to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: إغراء أو حافز يُقدَّم لإقناع شخص بفعل شيء
entries.example: A signing bonus was the main inducement to join.

entries.definitionEn: To formally admit someone into a group, job, or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُدخل شخصاً رسمياً في جماعة أو وظيفة أو منظمة
entries.example: The club will induct three new members next month.

entries.definitionEn: A formal process of introducing someone to a job or organization. Also reasoning from particular facts to a general idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعريف رسمي بوظيفة أو جماعة؛ أو استدلال من الجزئيات إلى حكم عام
entries.example: New staff attend a week of induction.

entries.definitionEn: The act of allowing yourself or someone else something pleasant. Also a thing enjoyed as a treat.
entries.arabicMeaning: تساهل في منح متعة، أو شيء يُستمتع به تدليلاً
entries.example: Dark chocolate was her only evening indulgence.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to allow someone to have or do what they want, often too kindly.
entries.arabicMeaning: متساهل يلين أكثر مما ينبغي في تلبية الرغبات
entries.example: Indulgent grandparents said yes to every request.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that allows someone extra freedom or pleasure, often too kindly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتساهل يمنح حرية أو متعة زائدة
entries.example: She smiled indulgently at the child's wild story.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to factories, production, and industry.
entries.arabicMeaning: صناعي متعلق بالمصانع والإنتاج
entries.example: The city grew around industrial work in the last century.

entries.definitionEn: To develop factories and large-scale production in a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُصنّع بلداً أو منطقة ببناء المصانع والإنتاج الواسع
entries.example: The region industrialized rapidly after the railway arrived.

entries.definitionEn: The production of goods, especially in factories. Also a particular type of business.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصناعة وإنتاج السلع؛ أو قطاع أعمال معيّن
entries.example: Tourism is an important industry in the region.

entries.definitionEn: Not producing the result you want.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الفاعلية لا يحقّق النتيجة المرجوة
entries.example: The old filter was ineffective against fine dust.

entries.definitionEn: Certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
entries.arabicMeaning: محتوم لا مفرّ منه
entries.example: After such a dry summer, water shortages were inevitable.

entries.definitionEn: Too bad to be forgiven or justified.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُعذر ولا يُبرَّر
entries.example: Leaving a child unattended was inexcusable.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be forgiven or justified.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا يُعذر
entries.example: The report was inexcusably late.

entries.definitionEn: So large or lasting that it seems impossible to use up.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا ينفد، كأنّه لا يُستنفد
entries.example: She seemed to have inexhaustible patience with beginners.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being impossible to stop or persuade; relentless certainty.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتمية لا تُلين ولا تُوقف
entries.example: They feared the inexorability of rising costs.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to stop or persuade; continuing without mercy or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُردّ ولا يلين؛ ماضٍ بلا هوادة
entries.example: Ageing is an inexorable process.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be stopped or changed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا هوادة وعلى نحو لا يُوقف
entries.example: The deadline drew inexorably closer.

entries.definitionEn: Not costing a lot of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مكلف؛ رخيص نسبياً
entries.example: The café serves inexpensive meals.

entries.definitionEn: Having little knowledge or practice of a job or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الخبرة في عمل أو نشاط
entries.example: The inexperienced driver stalled at the junction.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to explain or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعصي على التفسير أو الفهم
entries.example: There was an inexplicable delay with no announcement.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be explained.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا تفسير له
entries.example: The lights inexplicably went out at midnight.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of never being wrong or never failing.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصمة من الخطأ أو من الإخفاق
entries.example: No method has the infallibility that its inventors claimed.

entries.definitionEn: Never wrong and never failing.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يخطئ ولا يخفق
entries.example: Memory is useful, but it is not infallible.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that never fails or is never wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا إخفاق وعلى نحو لا يخطئ
entries.example: The old clock infallibly struck on the hour.

entries.definitionEn: A very young child, especially a baby.
entries.arabicMeaning: رضيع أو طفل صغير جداً
entries.example: The clinic sees infants and their parents on Tuesdays.

entries.definitionEn: To pass a disease or germs to a person, animal, or plant. Also to spread a feeling or problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعدي بمرض أو جراثيم؛ وقد يعني نشر شعور أو مشكلة
entries.example: One sick child can infect the whole class.

entries.definitionEn: Affected by disease-causing germs.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب بعدوى جرثومية
entries.example: The infected wound needed antibiotics.

entries.definitionEn: An illness caused by germs entering the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدوى يسببها دخول الجراثيم إلى الجسم
entries.example: Wash the cut to reduce the risk of infection.

entries.definitionEn: Able to spread from one person to another, as a disease can. Also easily passed on, as laughter or enthusiasm can be.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُعدٍ ينتقل من شخص لآخر؛ وقد يوصف به الضحك أو الحماس إذا سرى بسهولة
entries.example: Flu is highly infectious in crowded rooms.

entries.definitionEn: To form an opinion from evidence and reasoning, rather than from a direct statement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنتج رأياً من دلائل واستدلال لا من تصريح مباشر
entries.example: From the empty desk I inferred that she had already left.

entries.definitionEn: A conclusion you reach from evidence and reasoning, not from something said directly.
entries.arabicMeaning: استنتاج يُبنى على دلائل لا على قول صريح
entries.example: That inference is possible, but we still need proof.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to hell. Also used to show strong annoyance about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهنّمي؛ ويُستعمل للتذمّر الشديد من شيء مزعج
entries.example: The infernal noise from the pipes kept us awake.

entries.definitionEn: In an extremely annoying way, or as if connected with hell.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو بالغ الإزعاج أو كأنه من الجحيم
entries.example: The room was infernally hot by noon.

entries.definitionEn: The basic form of a verb, often with to, as in to go or to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: المصدر المجرد للفعل، وغالباً مسبوقاً بأداة to
entries.example: The infinitive of go is to go.

entries.definitionEn: Redness, heat, and swelling in part of the body, usually as a reaction to injury or infection.
entries.arabicMeaning: التهاب يظهر احمراراً وحرارة وتورّماً في موضع من الجسم
entries.example: Ice can reduce inflammation after a sprain.

entries.definitionEn: Causing inflammation in the body. Also likely to make people angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسبّب للالتهاب؛ أو محرّض يثير الغضب
entries.example: Inflammatory comments made the meeting harder to manage.

entries.definitionEn: To fill something with air or gas so that it becomes larger. Also to make a number or price rise too much.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفخ شيئاً بالهواء أو الغاز؛ أو يضخّم رقماً أو سعراً أكثر مما ينبغي
entries.example: Please inflate the tyres before the long drive.

entries.definitionEn: A general rise in prices, so that money buys less. Also the act of filling something with air.
entries.arabicMeaning: تضخّم يرفع الأسعار فيضعف القوة الشرائية؛ وقد يعني نفخ شيء بالهواء
entries.example: High inflation made food more expensive.

entries.definitionEn: The power to change how someone thinks or what happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأثير يغيّر فكراً أو مجرى أمور
entries.example: Parents have a strong influence on young children.

entries.definitionEn: To change how someone thinks or how something develops.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤثّر في تفكير شخص أو في مسار أمر
entries.example: The review influenced my decision to apply.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of power to change opinions or events.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو نفوذ واسع في الآراء أو الأحداث
entries.example: She is an influential voice in local education.

entries.definitionEn: A common infectious illness that causes fever, aches, and tiredness; also called flu.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإنفلونزا: مرض معدٍ شائع يسبب حمى وآلاماً وإرهاقاً
entries.example: He missed a week of work because of influenza.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone facts or news.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُبلغ شخصاً بخبر أو معلومة
entries.example: Please inform us if your address changes.

entries.definitionEn: Relaxed and not official; suitable for friendly situations rather than ceremonies.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير رسمي، يناسب المواقف الودّية لا المراسم
entries.example: The office has an informal dress code on Fridays.

entries.definitionEn: A person who gives information, especially secretly to the police, or to a researcher.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخبر يقدّم معلومات، وخصوصاً للشرطة سرّاً أو للباحث
entries.example: The linguist recorded several informants in the village.

entries.definitionEn: Facts or details about someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلومات وحقائق عن شخص أو شيء
entries.example: I need more information about the course.

entries.definitionEn: Giving useful facts or knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفيد غني بالمعلومات
entries.example: The talk was short but informative.

entries.definitionEn: To break a law, rule, or right, or to limit someone's freedom unfairly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتهك قانوناً أو حقاً، أو يضيّق حرية أحد بغير وجه
entries.example: The new cameras must not infringe people's privacy.

entries.definitionEn: An action that breaks a law, rule, or right.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتهاك لقانون أو قاعدة أو حق
entries.example: Copying the software without a licence is an infringement.

entries.definitionEn: Clever at inventing things or solving problems in a new way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارع في ابتكار الحلول على نحو ذكي
entries.example: They found an ingenious way to save water.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being clever at inventing things or solving problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: براعة الابتكار في حل المشكلات
entries.example: Building the shelter took patience and ingenuity.

entries.definitionEn: Honest, open, and sometimes too ready to believe others; not cunning.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساذج صريح يصدّق بسهولة، بعيد عن المكر
entries.example: Her ingenuous questions showed she had nothing to hide.

entries.definitionEn: In an open, honest way that may seem a little naive.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصراحة ساذجة خالية من المكر
entries.example: He asked ingenuously why the rule existed.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is not grateful for help or kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاحد لا يشكر المعروف
entries.example: Only an ingrate would forget such generous support.

entries.definitionEn: To try to make someone like you, often by pleasing them too eagerly. Usually used as ingratiate yourself with someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتودّد بإلحاح ليكسب رضى أحد
entries.example: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new director.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to win favour, often in a way that seems too eager or insincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: تودّدي مفرط قد يبدو متكلّفاً لكسب الحظوة
entries.example: An ingratiating smile did not hide his impatience.

entries.definitionEn: In an eager way meant to win someone's favour.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتودّد مقصود لكسب الرضى
entries.example: He laughed ingratiatingly at every weak joke.

entries.definitionEn: One of the foods or substances used to make a dish. Also a quality that helps something succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكوّن في طبق؛ أو عنصر يسهم في نجاح أمر
entries.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this bread.

entries.definitionEn: To live in a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسكن مكاناً أو يعيش فيه
entries.example: Rare birds inhabit the wetlands in spring.

entries.definitionEn: A person or animal that lives in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساكن في مكان معيّن من الناس أو الحيوان
entries.example: The island has only three hundred inhabitants.

entries.definitionEn: To breathe air, smoke, or gas into your lungs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستنشق هواءً أو دخاناً أو غازاً إلى الرئتين
entries.example: Try not to inhale the dust while you sweep.

entries.definitionEn: Existing as a natural and permanent part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصيل كامن في طبيعة الشيء
entries.example: Risk is inherent in mountain climbing.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is a natural and permanent part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطبيعته وعلى نحو أصيل فيه
entries.example: The plan is not inherently unfair, but it needs clearer rules.

entries.definitionEn: To receive money, property, or a quality from someone who has died, or from a parent.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرث مالاً أو ملكاً أو صفة من ميّت أو من أحد الوالدين
entries.example: She inherited the house from her aunt.

entries.definitionEn: Money, property, or qualities received from someone who has died, or from a parent.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرث من مال أو ملك أو صفات يُتلقّى من ميّت أو من والد
entries.example: He used part of his inheritance to start a small studio.

entries.definitionEn: Happening at the beginning of a process or period, before later stages.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولي؛ يقع في بداية عملية أو فترة قبل المراحل اللاحقة
entries.example: Her initial reaction was surprise, then relief.

entries.definitionEn: The first letter of a name, often written as a short form of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحرف الأول من الاسم، وغالباً ما يُكتب اختصاراً له
entries.example: Please add your initials at the bottom of the form.

entries.definitionEn: At first; in the early stage, before things change.
entries.arabicMeaning: في البداية؛ أول الأمر قبل أن تتغيّر الحال
entries.example: I was initially unsure, but the plan made sense.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to decide and act without waiting to be told. Also a new plan meant to solve a problem or improve something.
entries.arabicMeaning: روح المبادرة في التصرف من غير انتظار أمر؛ أو خطة جديدة لمعالجة مشكلة أو تحسين أمر
entries.example: She showed initiative by fixing the error before anyone asked.

entries.definitionEn: To put a liquid into the body with a needle. Also to add something that is needed, such as money or energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحقن سائلاً في الجسم بإبرة؛ أو يضخّ ما يُحتاج إليه من مال أو حيوية
entries.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting a liquid into the body with a needle, or the liquid itself. Also a sudden addition of money or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقن سائل في الجسم بإبرة، أو السائل نفسه؛ وقد يعني ضخّ مال أو جهد فجأة
entries.example: She had an injection before travelling.

entries.definitionEn: To hurt a person or animal, often in an accident, so that part of the body is damaged.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤذي شخصاً أو حيواناً، غالباً في حادث، فيُتلف جزءاً من الجسم
entries.example: He injured his ankle on the wet steps.

entries.definitionEn: Hurt in the body, or damaged in dignity or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب في الجسم، أو ممسوس في كرامته أو مشاعره
entries.example: The injured passenger was taken to hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Physical harm to a part of the body, or damage to someone's rights or reputation.
entries.arabicMeaning: أذى جسدي في عضو من الجسم، أو ضرر يلحق حقاً أو سمعة
entries.example: She missed three weeks of work after a back injury.

entries.definitionEn: Unfair treatment, or a particular act that is unfair, especially when people cannot easily defend themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظلم أو جور، أو فعل بعينه يجافي الإنصاف ولا سيما حين يعجز الناس عن دفعه
entries.example: The report described a serious injustice in the hiring process.

entries.definitionEn: A coloured liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبر؛ سائل ملوّن للكتابة أو الطباعة أو الرسم
entries.example: The printer ran out of black ink.

entries.definitionEn: Present from birth rather than learned; belonging to someone's nature.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطري مولود به لا مكتسب؛ أصيل في طبيعة الشخص
entries.example: She has an innate talent for languages.

entries.definitionEn: On the inside, or further from the outer edge. Also felt privately, not shown to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخلي أو أبعد عن الحافة الخارجية؛ وقد يعني ما يُحسّ في الباطن ولا يُظهر
entries.example: The inner courtyard is quieter than the street.

entries.definitionEn: Furthest inside, or most private and deeply felt.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأعمق في الداخل، أو الأشدّ خصوصية في المشاعر
entries.example: He rarely shares his innermost thoughts.

entries.definitionEn: Not guilty of a crime or of causing harm. Also simple and not intending to hurt anyone.
entries.arabicMeaning: بريء من تهمة أو أذى؛ وقد يعني ساذجاً لا يقصد الإساءة
entries.example: The court found her innocent of all charges.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows no guilt or no intention to cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببراءة؛ على نحو لا يشي بذنب ولا بقصد الأذى
entries.example: He smiled innocently when they asked who had eaten the cake.

entries.definitionEn: To introduce new methods, ideas, or products, especially in a field of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبتكر طرائق أو أفكاراً أو منتجات جديدة، ولا سيما في مجال العمل
entries.example: The lab continues to innovate in battery design.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organization that introduces new ideas, methods, or products.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبتكر؛ شخص أو جهة تقدّم أفكاراً أو طرائق أو منتجات جديدة
entries.example: She is known as an innovator in medical equipment.

entries.definitionEn: An indirect hint that suggests something, often critical or slightly improper, without stating it openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميح خفي يوحي بشيء، غالباً جارح أو غير لائق، من غير تصريح مباشر
entries.example: The joke relied on innuendo rather than a direct remark.

entries.definitionEn: Ideas, information, or work that you contribute to a discussion or system. Also data entered into a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: إسهام من أفكار أو معلومات أو عمل في نقاش أو نظام؛ أو بيانات تُدخَل إلى الحاسوب
entries.example: We welcome your input on the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To ask for information about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستفسر؛ يطلب معلومات عن أمر
entries.example: I called to inquire about the job.

entries.definitionEn: A question asking for information, or an official process of finding out the facts about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: استفسار لطلب معلومة، أو تحقيق رسمي للكشف عن الوقائع
entries.example: She made an inquiry about the delayed parcel.

entries.definitionEn: Seriously mentally ill. Also, in everyday speech, extremely foolish or unreasonable.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصاب بخلل عقلي شديد؛ وفي الكلام اليومي يعني شديد الحمق أو مجافياً للعقل
entries.example: It would be insane to drive through that storm.

entries.definitionEn: To write or carve words on a surface, often as a lasting record.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقش أو يكتب كلاماً على سطح، غالباً ليبقى أثراً دائماً
entries.example: They inscribed her name on the trophy.

entries.definitionEn: Words written or carved on a surface such as stone, metal, or the front of a book.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقش أو كتابة على سطح كالحجر أو المعدن أو صفحة كتاب
entries.example: The inscription on the stone was hard to read.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to interpret; showing no clue to someone's thoughts or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصيّ على الفهم؛ لا تُقرأ منه نية ولا شعور
entries.example: His inscrutable expression gave nothing away.

entries.definitionEn: A small animal with six legs, such as an ant, bee, or fly.
entries.arabicMeaning: حشرة؛ حيوان صغير بست أرجل مثل النملة أو النحلة أو الذبابة
entries.example: An insect landed on the window.

entries.definitionEn: Not confident about yourself or your position. Also not firmly fixed, protected, or reliable.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير واثق بنفسه أو بموضعه؛ أو غير ثابت أو محمي أو موثوق
entries.example: She felt insecure during her first months in the new job.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not firmly fixed, or that shows a lack of confidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغير ثبات، أو على نحو يشي بضعف الثقة
entries.example: The mirror hung insecurely from a single nail.

entries.definitionEn: Not noticing or caring about other people's feelings. Also not reacting to something that usually causes a response.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يلحظ مشاعر الآخرين ولا يبالي بها؛ أو لا يستجيب لما يثير الاستجابة عادة
entries.example: It was insensitive to joke about her loss.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows little care for other people's feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا مراعاة لمشاعر الآخرين
entries.example: He spoke insensitively about the family's situation.

entries.definitionEn: So closely connected that they cannot be separated, or that they are rarely apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: متلازمان لا ينفصلان، أو نادراً ما يفترقان
entries.example: The two friends have been inseparable since college.

entries.definitionEn: On or from the inner side. Also known only to people within a group or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخلي أو من الجهة الداخلية؛ وقد يعني معلوماً لدى أهل مجموعة أو مؤسسة دون غيرهم
entries.example: He kept the letter in an inside pocket.

entries.definitionEn: In or into a building or container, not outside.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الداخل أو إلى الداخل، لا في الخارج
entries.example: It started to rain, so we went inside.

entries.definitionEn: The inner part of something, as opposed to the outer surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: باطن الشيء مقابل سطحه الخارجي
entries.example: The inside of the box was lined with cloth.

entries.definitionEn: In the inner part of a place, container, or period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخل مكان أو وعاء أو فترة زمنية
entries.example: The keys are inside the drawer.

entries.definitionEn: A clear and useful understanding of a situation, person, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصيرة؛ فهم واضح نافع لموقف أو شخص أو فكرة
entries.example: The book offers insight into how cities grow.

entries.definitionEn: Showing a deep and accurate understanding of a person or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثاقب النظر؛ يُظهر فهماً عميقاً دقيقاً لشخص أو موقف
entries.example: Her insightful comments changed the discussion.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows deep and accurate understanding.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببصيرة نافذة تُظهر فهماً عميقاً دقيقاً
entries.example: He wrote insightfully about the causes of the delay.

entries.definitionEn: To say firmly that something is true, or that something must be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرّ على صحة أمر أو على وجوب فعله
entries.example: I insist that you stay for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something carefully in order to check its condition or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفحص شيئاً بعناية للتأكد من حالته أو جودته
entries.example: The engineer will inspect the bridge tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: A careful official check of a place, machine, or piece of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحص رسمي دقيق لمكان أو آلة أو عمل
entries.example: The kitchen passed its health inspection.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to check that rules are followed or that something is in good condition. Also a police rank in some countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفتش يتحقق من الالتزام بالقواعد أو من سلامة شيء؛ وقد يكون رتبة في الشرطة
entries.example: The inspector asked to see the safety records.

entries.definitionEn: A person, thing, or idea that gives you new thoughts or the wish to do something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلهام؛ شخص أو شيء أو فكرة تبعث أفكاراً جديدة أو رغبة في الإحسان
entries.example: Her teacher was a great inspiration to her.

entries.definitionEn: Giving people the wish or energy to do something good or difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُلهم يبعث في الناس رغبة أو طاقة لعمل صالح أو عسير
entries.example: The coach gave an inspirational talk before the match.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone with the wish or ability to do something, often something creative or brave.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُلهم شخصاً رغبة أو قدرة على فعل شيء، غالباً إبداعي أو شجاع
entries.example: The story inspired her to start writing again.

entries.definitionEn: To put equipment or software in place so that it is ready to use. Also to put someone in an official position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركّب جهازاً أو برنامجاً حتى يصبح جاهزاً للاستعمال؛ أو يُنصّب شخصاً في منصب رسمي
entries.example: They will install the new heater on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A particular example of a situation, behaviour, or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثال معيّن أو حالة من موقف أو سلوك أو حدث
entries.example: In this instance, waiting was the safest choice.

entries.definitionEn: Happening immediately. Also describing food that is prepared very quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوري يحدث في الحال؛ وقد يوصف به طعام يُعدّ بسرعة
entries.example: The message got an instant reply.

entries.definitionEn: Occurring in an instant, with no perceptible delay.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحظي يقع في آن واحد بلا مهلة تُدرك
entries.example: The reaction was almost instantaneous.

entries.definitionEn: In an instant; with no perceptible delay.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الحال؛ بلا مهلة تُدرك
entries.example: The lights came on instantaneously.

entries.definitionEn: Immediately; without waiting.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوراً؛ من غير انتظار
entries.example: She recognized him instantly.

entries.definitionEn: In place of something else; as another choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدلاً من ذلك؛ كخيار آخر
entries.example: The café was closed, so we cooked at home instead.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun or a verb with -ing to say that one thing takes the place of another.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدلاً من؛ تُستعمل قبل اسم أو مصدر لبيان أن شيئاً يقوم مقام آخر
entries.example: We took the train instead of driving.

entries.definitionEn: To gradually put an idea, feeling, or habit into someone's mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغرس فكرة أو شعوراً أو عادة في ذهن شخص على التدريج
entries.example: Parents try to instill good habits in their children.

entries.definitionEn: A natural way of behaving or knowing something, without having to learn or think it through.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريزة؛ سلوك أو معرفة طبيعية من غير تعلّم أو تفكير طويل
entries.example: Her first instinct was to call for help.

entries.definitionEn: Done automatically, from natural feeling rather than from conscious thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريزي يصدر تلقائياً عن الإحساس الطبيعي لا عن تفكير واعٍ
entries.example: Stepping back from the edge was an instinctive reaction.

entries.definitionEn: Without thinking, by natural reaction.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغريزة؛ من غير تفكير، كردّ فعل طبيعي
entries.example: She instinctively reached out to steady the glass.

entries.definitionEn: An organization that does research, teaching, or professional work in a particular field.
entries.arabicMeaning: معهد أو مؤسسة تعنى بالبحث أو التعليم أو العمل المهني في مجال معيّن
entries.example: He trained at a medical institute in the capital.

entries.definitionEn: To start or introduce a system, rule, or process in a formal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُنشئ نظاماً أو قاعدة أو إجراءً أو يُدخله على نحو رسمي
entries.example: The board voted to institute a new safety policy.

entries.definitionEn: A large established organization such as a university, bank, or hospital. Also a custom that has existed for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤسسة كبيرة راسخة كجامعة أو مصرف أو مستشفى؛ أو عرف قائم منذ زمن طويل
entries.example: The university is one of the oldest institutions in the city.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone to do something, often officially. Also to teach a skill or subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأمر شخصاً بفعل شيء، غالباً بصفة رسمية؛ أو يعلّم مهارة أو مادة
entries.example: The officer instructed us to wait behind the line.

entries.definitionEn: Information that tells you how to do something. Also the act of teaching.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعليمات تبيّن كيفية عمل شيء؛ أو فعل التعليم نفسه
entries.example: Read the instructions before you start.

entries.definitionEn: A person who teaches a skill or a practical subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرّب أو معلّم لمهارة أو مادة عملية
entries.example: The driving instructor remained calm throughout the lesson.

entries.definitionEn: A tool used to make music, or a tool used for a particular job, especially in science or medicine.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة موسيقية، أو أداة تُستعمل لعمل معيّن ولا سيما في العلم أو الطب
entries.example: She plays a musical instrument in the school band.

entries.definitionEn: Refusing to obey someone in authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: متمرد على صاحب سلطة؛ يرفض الامتثال للأوامر
entries.example: His insubordinate remarks angered the supervisor.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that refuses to obey authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتمرد على السلطة ورفض للامتثال
entries.example: She answered insubordinately and was sent out of the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The act of refusing to obey someone in authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصيان الأوامر ورفض الانقياد لصاحب سلطة
entries.example: The sailor was charged with insubordination.

entries.definitionEn: Not enough for what is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير كافٍ لما يُحتاج إليه
entries.example: Two hours is insufficient time to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: Narrow in outlook and cut off from outside ideas. Also relating to an island.
entries.arabicMeaning: منغلق فكرياً بعيد عن تأثير الخارج؛ وقد يعني جزرياً متعلقاً بجزيرة
entries.example: Years of working alone had made his views rather insular.

entries.definitionEn: A remark or action that is meant to offend someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: إهانة؛ قول أو فعل يُقصد به الإساءة
entries.example: She ignored the insult and continued speaking.

entries.definitionEn: To say or do something that offends someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهين؛ يقول أو يفعل ما يسيء إلى شخص
entries.example: He did not mean to insult her.

entries.definitionEn: An agreement in which you pay money to a company so that it will pay costs if something bad happens, such as an accident or illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأمين؛ عقد تدفع بموجبه مالاً لشركة فتغطي التكاليف إن وقع مكروه كحادث أو مرض
entries.example: Check that your travel insurance covers medical care.

entries.definitionEn: Necessary as a part of a whole; so important that the thing would be incomplete without it.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء لا يتجزأ من الكل؛ أساسي بحيث ينقص الشيء بغيابه
entries.example: Trust is an integral part of any close friendship.

entries.definitionEn: To combine parts so that they work as a whole. Also to become an accepted member of a group or society.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدمج أجزاء حتى تعمل ككل واحد؛ أو يندمج في جماعة أو مجتمع فيُقبل فيه
entries.example: The school aims to integrate new students quickly.

entries.definitionEn: The process of combining parts into a unified whole, or of becoming an accepted member of a group or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: إدماج أجزاء في كلّ موحّد، أو الاندماج حتى يصير المرء عضواً مقبولاً في جماعة أو نظام
entries.example: The integration of the two departments took a full year.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to think, reason, and understand, especially at a high level, as distinct from emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملكة التفكير والتعقّل والفهم، ولا سيما على مستوى رفيع، بمعزل عن العاطفة
entries.example: The puzzle was a test of intellect more than of memory.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the ability to think about ideas, rather than to feelings or practical skills.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكري؛ متعلق بالقدرة على التفكير في الأفكار لا بالمشاعر أو المهارات العملية
entries.example: She enjoys intellectual debate after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A person who spends a lot of time thinking about ideas, culture, or scholarship.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثقف؛ شخص يصرف وقتاً طويلاً في التفكير في الأفكار أو الثقافة أو العلم
entries.example: The magazine is popular among intellectuals.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to learn, understand, and think.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكاء؛ القدرة على التعلّم والفهم والتفكير
entries.example: The test is meant to measure intelligence, not memory.

entries.definitionEn: Good at learning, understanding, and thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكي؛ بارع في التعلّم والفهم والتفكير
entries.example: She asked an intelligent question about the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To have a plan or purpose in mind; to mean to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينوي؛ يضع في نفسه خطة أو غرضاً، أي يقصد فعل شيء
entries.example: We intend to leave at six.

entries.definitionEn: Very strong in degree, feeling, or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد في الدرجة أو الشعور أو الجهد
entries.example: The heat was intense by midday.

entries.definitionEn: Involving a lot of effort, work, or care in a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكثّف يقتضي جهداً أو عملاً أو عناية كثيرة في وقت قصير
entries.example: She took an intensive language course last summer.

entries.definitionEn: Showing strong attention or determination; fully concentrated on something.
entries.arabicMeaning: منصرف باهتمام وعزم؛ مركّز تمام التركيز على أمر
entries.example: He was intent on finishing the work that night.

entries.definitionEn: What you plan or mean to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: نية؛ ما تعتزم فعله أو تقصده
entries.example: It was never my intention to upset you.

entries.definitionEn: On purpose; not by accident.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمداً؛ عن قصد لا عن غير قصد
entries.example: She did not ignore you intentionally.

entries.definitionEn: To talk or work with someone, or to have an effect on each other.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفاعل؛ يحدّث غيره أو يعمل معه، أو يؤثر كل طرف في الآخر
entries.example: The children interact well in small groups.

entries.definitionEn: Communication or contact between people, or the way two things affect each other.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفاعل؛ تواصل أو اتصال بين الناس، أو تأثير متبادل بين شيئين
entries.example: Daily interaction with customers taught her patience.

entries.definitionEn: Allowing people to take part and respond, rather than only watch or listen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفاعلي يتيح المشاركة والرد لا المشاهدة أو الاستماع فحسب
entries.example: The museum has an interactive display for visitors.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of wanting to know or do more about something. Also extra money paid or earned on a loan.
entries.arabicMeaning: اهتمام ورغبة في معرفة المزيد أو فعل المزيد؛ أو فائدة تُدفع أو تُجنى على قرض
entries.example: She has a strong interest in photography.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone want to know more or give their attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثير اهتمام شخص فيجعله يريد المعرفة أو يُقبل بالانتباه
entries.example: Does history interest you?

entries.definitionEn: Wanting to know more about something, or wanting to take part in it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهتم؛ يريد أن يعرف المزيد أو أن يشارك
entries.example: I am interested in learning Spanish.

entries.definitionEn: Making you want to know more; holding your attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير للاهتمام؛ يشدّ الانتباه
entries.example: That was an interesting film.

entries.definitionEn: To get involved in something that is not your business, often causing problems. Also to prevent something from working properly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدخل فيما لا يعنيه فيفسد غالباً؛ أو يعوق شيئاً عن العمل على الوجه السليم
entries.example: Please do not interfere in their discussion.

entries.definitionEn: The inside of a building, vehicle, or country, as opposed to the outside.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخل مبنى أو مركبة أو بلد، مقابل الخارج
entries.example: The interior of the house was freshly painted.

entries.definitionEn: To interrupt a conversation by inserting a remark.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقحم ملاحظة في حديث فيقاطعه
entries.example: May I interject a question before we move on?

entries.definitionEn: A word or short remark that expresses sudden feeling, such as oh or wow. Also a comment pushed into a conversation.
entries.arabicMeaning: اسم صوت أو لفظ قصير يعبّر عن انفعال مفاجئ مثل آه؛ أو مداخلة تُقحم في حديث
entries.example: In grammar, wow is an interjection.

entries.definitionEn: Joined by parts that fit into one another so that they hold together.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشابك يركب بعضه في بعض حتى يتماسك
entries.example: The wall was built of interlocking bricks.

entries.definitionEn: A short period of a different character between two events, or a pause in a performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة فاصلة قصيرة ذات طابع مختلف بين حدثين، أو استراحة في عرض
entries.example: After a brief interlude, the music began again.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organization that acts as a link between two parties.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيط؛ شخص أو جهة تصل بين طرفين
entries.example: They hired an intermediary to negotiate the contract.

entries.definitionEn: In the middle, between a basic level and an advanced one.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوسط؛ بين المستوى الأساسي والمتقدم
entries.example: This class is for intermediate learners.

entries.definitionEn: A short break during a play, film, or concert.
entries.arabicMeaning: استراحة قصيرة في أثناء مسرحية أو فيلم أو حفلة موسيقية
entries.example: We bought drinks during the intermission.

entries.definitionEn: Inside a place, body, or organization, rather than outside it.
entries.arabicMeaning: داخلي في مكان أو جسم أو مؤسسة، لا خارجي
entries.example: The company is holding an internal review.

entries.definitionEn: Involving more than one country.
entries.arabicMeaning: دولي؛ يضم أكثر من بلد
entries.example: She works for an international company.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves many countries, or in many countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: على المستوى الدولي؛ في بلدان كثيرة
entries.example: The singer is internationally famous.

entries.definitionEn: The worldwide system that connects computers so people can share information.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإنترنت؛ الشبكة العالمية التي تصل الحواسيب ليشارك الناس المعلومات
entries.example: I found the recipe on the internet.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the way people communicate and deal with one another.
entries.arabicMeaning: بين الأشخاص؛ متعلق بطريقة تواصل الناس وتعاملهم بعضهم مع بعض
entries.example: The job requires strong interpersonal skills.

entries.definitionEn: To explain the meaning of something. Also to translate spoken language as someone is speaking.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفسّر معنى شيء؛ أو يترجم الكلام الشفهي في أثناء الحديث
entries.example: How should we interpret these results?

entries.definitionEn: An explanation of the meaning of something, or one particular way of understanding it.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفسير لمعنى شيء، أو وجه معيّن من وجوه فهمه
entries.example: Her interpretation of the poem was original.

entries.definitionEn: A person who translates spoken language from one language into another as it is spoken.
entries.arabicMeaning: مترجم فوري ينقل الكلام الشفهي من لغة إلى أخرى في أثناء الحديث
entries.example: An interpreter sat beside the speaker.

entries.definitionEn: To question someone closely and at length, especially in an official investigation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستجوب شخصاً باستقصاء وإطالة، ولا سيما في تحقيق رسمي
entries.example: Detectives will interrogate the witness tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The process of questioning someone closely, especially as part of an official investigation.
entries.arabicMeaning: استجواب؛ عملية سؤال دقيق مطوّل، ولا سيما في تحقيق رسمي
entries.example: The interrogation lasted two hours.

entries.definitionEn: Having the form or force of a question.
entries.arabicMeaning: استفهامي؛ ذو صيغة السؤال أو قوته
entries.example: An interrogative sentence asks a question.

entries.definitionEn: In a questioning manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنبرة استفهام؛ على نحو سائل
entries.example: He looked at her interrogatively.

entries.definitionEn: To stop someone speaking or something happening by saying or doing something in the middle of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقاطع شخصاً وهو يتكلم أو يوقف حدثاً بالتدخل في أثنائه
entries.example: Sorry to interrupt, but the taxi is here.

entries.definitionEn: Something that stops a speech, activity, or process for a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاطعة؛ ما يوقف كلاماً أو نشاطاً أو عملية إلى حين
entries.example: There was a brief interruption when the power failed.

entries.definitionEn: A place where two or more roads meet. Also a point where two things overlap.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقاطع طرق؛ أو موضع يتداخل فيه شيئان
entries.example: Turn left at the next intersection.

entries.definitionEn: To scatter things at intervals among other things.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوزّع أشياء على فترات بين ثنايا أشياء أخرى
entries.example: She interspersed the lecture with short videos.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time between two events. Also a short break during a performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاصل زمني بين حدثين؛ أو استراحة قصيرة في أثناء عرض
entries.example: There will be a short interval after the first act.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting in which someone asks you questions, for a job or for a news story.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقابلة يُسأل فيها الشخص أسئلة، لوظيفة أو لتقرير إخباري
entries.example: I have a job interview on Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone questions in a formal meeting, for a job or for a news story.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُجري مقابلة فيسأل شخصاً أسئلة في لقاء رسمي لوظيفة أو لتقرير
entries.example: They will interview the candidates on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: The person who is asked questions in an interview.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشخص الذي تُجرى معه المقابلة ويُسأل
entries.example: The interviewee answered the questions calmly.

entries.definitionEn: The person who asks the questions in an interview.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يُجري المقابلة ويطرح الأسئلة
entries.example: The interviewer smiled and asked me to sit down.

entries.definitionEn: To weave together, or to combine elements so that they are closely mixed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسج معاً، أو يمزج عناصر حتى تتداخل تداخلاً وثيقاً
entries.example: The novel interweaves several family stories.

entries.definitionEn: Very close and personal. Also private, or based on deep knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: حميم وثيق الصلة؛ أو خاص، أو قائم على معرفة عميقة
entries.example: She told the news only to intimate friends.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show movement from outside to inside, or a change from one state to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى داخل؛ تُستعمل لبيان الانتقال من الخارج إلى الداخل، أو التحوّل من حال إلى حال
entries.example: He put the keys into his pocket.

entries.definitionEn: Describing a verb that does not take a direct object.
entries.arabicMeaning: لازم؛ يوصف به فعل لا يأخذ مفعولاً به
entries.example: In she slept, the verb is intransitive.

entries.definitionEn: Going into or existing within a vein, usually said of medicine or fluids.
entries.arabicMeaning: وريدي؛ يدخل الوريد أو يجري فيه، وغالباً ما يوصف به دواء أو سائل
entries.example: The patient was given intravenous fluids.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to the essential nature of a thing, rather than coming from outside it.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهري أصيل في طبيعة الشيء لا وافد عليه من خارج
entries.example: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of childhood.

entries.definitionEn: By its very nature; in an inherent way.
entries.arabicMeaning: في جوهره؛ بحكم طبيعته الأصيلة
entries.example: The task is not intrinsically difficult.

entries.definitionEn: To tell people each other's names when they meet. Also to bring something new into use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّم الناس بعضهم إلى بعض بذكر الأسماء؛ أو يُدخل شيئاً جديداً في الاستعمال
entries.example: Let me introduce my brother.

entries.definitionEn: The act of introducing people or something new. Also the first part of a book or talk.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقديم الناس أو إدخال شيء جديد؛ أو مقدمة كتاب أو حديث
entries.example: The introduction explains the aim of the book.

entries.definitionEn: To go into a place or situation where you are not wanted or do not belong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتطفل أو يقتحم مكاناً أو موقفاً لا يُرحَّب به فيه أو لا يخصّه
entries.example: I did not mean to intrude on your conversation.

entries.definitionEn: A person who enters a place without permission, often a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: متطفل أو مقتحم يدخل مكاناً من غير إذن، وغالباً مبنى
entries.example: The alarm went off when an intruder opened the door.

entries.definitionEn: An unwelcome entry into a place, or an unwelcome interruption of someone's privacy.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتحام غير مرغوب لمكان، أو تطفل على خصوصية أحد
entries.example: She regarded the visit as an intrusion on her evening.

entries.definitionEn: To know or understand something by feeling, without conscious reasoning.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرك بالحدس من غير استدلال واعٍ
entries.example: She could intuit that he was holding something back.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to understand something immediately, without conscious reasoning.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدس؛ قدرة على الفهم الفوري من غير استدلال واعٍ
entries.example: Her intuition told her the offer was too good.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to understand without instruction. Also based on feeling rather than on conscious reasoning.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل الفهم من غير تعليم؛ أو قائم على الإحساس لا على الاستدلال الواعي
entries.example: The software is intuitive and easy to learn.

entries.definitionEn: By intuition; in a way that feels natural without analysis.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالحدس؛ على نحو يبدو طبيعياً من غير تحليل
entries.example: She intuitively chose the safer route.

entries.definitionEn: To enter a country with an army in order to take control of it. Also to enter a place in large numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغزو بلداً بجيش ليسيطر عليه؛ أو يدخل مكاناً بأعداد كبيرة
entries.example: The army planned to invade at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Never changing; always the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثابت لا يتغيّر؛ على حال واحدة أبداً
entries.example: His morning routine was invariable.

entries.definitionEn: Always; without exception.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائماً؛ بلا استثناء
entries.example: She is invariably ten minutes early.

entries.definitionEn: An attack in which an army enters a country to take control of it. Also a sudden arrival in large numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: غزو يدخل فيه جيش بلداً للسيطرة عليه؛ أو وفود مفاجئ بأعداد كبيرة
entries.example: The museum has an exhibition about the invasion.

entries.definitionEn: To make or think of something for the first time. Also to make up a story that is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخترع شيئاً أول مرة؛ أو يختلق قصة غير صادقة
entries.example: Who invented the telephone?

entries.definitionEn: A new thing or method that someone has made or thought of. Also a story that is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختراع؛ شيء أو أسلوب جديد ابتكره أحد؛ أو قصة مختلقة
entries.example: The light bulb was an important invention.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes or thinks of something new for the first time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخترع؛ من يبتكر شيئاً جديداً أول مرة
entries.example: The inventor spent years improving the design.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation marks used around quoted words; also called quotation marks.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامتا الاقتباس اللتان تُوضعان حول الكلام المنقول
entries.example: Put the title in inverted commas.

entries.definitionEn: To put money into something hoping to make a profit. Also to spend time or effort on something useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستثمر مالاً أملاً في ربح؛ أو يبذل وقتاً أو جهداً في أمر نافع
entries.example: They decided to invest in solar panels.

entries.definitionEn: To try to find out the facts about something, especially a crime or a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحقّق؛ يسعى إلى كشف الوقائع ولا سيما في جريمة أو مشكلة
entries.example: The police will investigate the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A careful search for facts, especially about a crime or a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحقيق؛ بحث دقيق عن الوقائع ولا سيما في جريمة أو مشكلة
entries.example: The investigation lasted several months.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to find out the facts about a crime or problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: محقّق؛ شخص عمله كشف الوقائع في جريمة أو مشكلة
entries.example: The investigator asked to see the documents.

entries.definitionEn: Money put into something in the hope of a profit, or the thing you put it into. Also time or effort spent for a later benefit.
entries.arabicMeaning: استثمار مال أملاً في ربح، أو الشيء المستثمَر فيه؛ أو بذل وقت أو جهد لنفع لاحق
entries.example: Buying the flat proved to be a sound investment.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organization that puts money into something hoping to make a profit.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستثمر؛ شخص أو جهة تضع مالاً في شيء أملاً في ربح
entries.example: The investor asked for a clearer plan.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to see, or so small or faint that you hardly notice it.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرئي، أو دقيق أو باهت حتى يكاد لا يُلحَظ
entries.example: The stain was almost invisible.

entries.definitionEn: A spoken or written request asking someone to come to an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: دعوة شفهية أو مكتوبة تطلب من شخص حضور مناسبة
entries.example: Thank you for the invitation to dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone to come to an event or to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدعو شخصاً إلى مناسبة أو إلى فعل شيء
entries.example: They invited us to dinner on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that makes you want to go near, take part, or accept.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يغري بالاقتراب أو المشاركة أو القبول
entries.example: The fire glowed invitingly in the grate.

entries.definitionEn: A document listing goods or services supplied and the amount to be paid.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاتورة تدرج السلع أو الخدمات المقدَّمة والمبلغ المستحق
entries.example: Please attach the invoice to your email.

entries.definitionEn: To use a law, right, or principle in support of an action. Also to call on something for help or authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستند إلى قانون أو حق أو مبدأ تأييداً لفعل؛ أو يستدعي أمراً طلباً لعون أو حجة
entries.example: The lawyer will invoke an earlier ruling.

entries.definitionEn: Without intending to; not by choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغير إرادة؛ لا عن اختيار
entries.example: He shivered involuntarily in the cold.

entries.definitionEn: To include someone or something as a necessary part, or to make someone take part.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمل شخصاً أو شيئاً بوصفه جزءاً لازماً، أو يُشرك شخصاً في الأمر
entries.example: The job will involve a lot of travel.

entries.definitionEn: Taking part in something, or connected with it. Also complicated.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشارك أو مرتبط بأمر؛ وقد يعني معقّداً
entries.example: She is involved in the school project.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of taking part in something or being connected with it.
entries.arabicMeaning: انخراط أو مشاركة أو ارتباط بأمر
entries.example: His involvement in the charity began last year.

entries.definitionEn: Very angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد الغضب
entries.example: An irate customer demanded a refund.

entries.definitionEn: In a very angry way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغضب شديد
entries.example: She spoke irately about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: A strong metal used for tools and structures. Also a heated tool used to smooth clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديد؛ معدن قوي للأدوات والمنشآت؛ أو مكواة تُسخَّن لتسوية الثياب
entries.example: The gate is made of iron.

entries.definitionEn: To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوي الثياب بمكواة ساخنة لتسويتها
entries.example: I need to iron this shirt before the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Using or marked by irony; happening in a way that is the opposite of what was expected or appropriate.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساخر أو حامِل مفارقة؛ يقع على خلاف المتوقع أو المناسب
entries.example: It is ironic that the fire station needed repairs after a small blaze.

entries.definitionEn: In an ironic way, or used to point out a contrast with what you would expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ساخر أو مفارق؛ أو لتبيين خلاف المتوقع
entries.example: Ironically, the delay saved us from the traffic jam.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of smoothing clothes with an iron, or the clothes waiting to be ironed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكيّ؛ أو الثياب المنتظرة للكيّ
entries.example: I spent Sunday morning doing the ironing.

entries.definitionEn: A contrast between what is said and what is meant, or between what is expected and what actually happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفارقة أو سخرية تقوم على خلاف بين القول والقصد، أو بين المتوقع وما يقع
entries.example: The irony is that he taught safety and then forgot his own helmet.

entries.definitionEn: Not based on reason or clear thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير عقلاني؛ لا يستند إلى منطق أو تفكير واضح
entries.example: Fear of flying can feel irrational but still be strong.

entries.definitionEn: Not following the usual pattern or timetable. In grammar, not forming parts in the usual way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير منتظم لا يجري على النمط أو الجدول المعتاد؛ وفي النحو لا تُصاغ أجزاؤه على القياس
entries.example: His working hours are irregular this month.

entries.definitionEn: A matter that has no bearing on the point at issue, or the quality of being irrelevant.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر لا صلة له بموضوع البحث، أو صفة انعدام الصلة
entries.example: The judge dismissed the comment as an irrelevancy.

entries.definitionEn: Too strong or attractive to refuse or ignore.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُقاوَم؛ أقوى أو أشدّ إغراءً من أن يُرفض أو يُتجاهل
entries.example: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is too strong or attractive to refuse.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقوة لا تُقاوَم؛ على نحو يعسر رفضه
entries.example: She was irresistibly drawn to the sea.

entries.definitionEn: Not showing proper care for the results of your actions, especially when others may be harmed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مسؤول؛ لا يُعنى بعواقب فعله ولا سيما إن أضرّ ذلك بغيره
entries.example: Leaving the door unlocked was irresponsible.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to reverse, withdraw, or undo.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا رجعة فيه؛ يتعذّر نقضه أو سحبه أو إلغاؤه
entries.example: Signing the contract was an irrevocable decision.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be reversed or undone.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا رجعة فيه
entries.example: The landscape was irrevocably changed by the flood.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone slightly angry. Also to make the skin or a part of the body sore.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغيظ شخصاً غيظاً خفيفاً؛ أو يهيج الجلد أو عضواً فيؤلمه
entries.example: The constant noise began to irritate him.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly angry. Also sore or inflamed, of skin or a body part.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزعج أو مغيظ بعض الشيء؛ أو ملتهب مؤلم في الجلد أو عضو
entries.example: She sounded irritated after the third interruption.

entries.definitionEn: Making you slightly angry, or making the skin sore.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزعج يغيظ بعض الشيء، أو مهيج للجلد
entries.example: His habit of tapping the table is irritating.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of slight anger, or a sore place on the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيق أو غيظ خفيف، أو موضع مؤلم في الجلد
entries.example: She could not hide her irritation.

entries.definitionEn: The form of be used with he, she, it, or a singular noun. It describes a person or thing, or helps make continuous tenses and the passive.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة من فعل be تُستعمل مع he وshe وit أو مع اسم مفرد، للوصف أو لتكوين الزمن المستمر والمبني للمجهول
entries.example: The shop is closed on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of land with water all around it.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزيرة؛ قطعة أرض يحيط بها الماء من كل جانب
entries.example: They spent a week on a small island.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives on an island.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساكن جزيرة
entries.example: Many islanders work in fishing or tourism.

entries.definitionEn: An island, often in names or in a slightly literary style.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزيرة، وغالباً في الأسماء أو في أسلوب فيه مسحة أدبية
entries.example: They spent a week on a small isle off the coast.

entries.definitionEn: To keep a person, place, or substance apart from others. Also to identify and separate one thing for study.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعزل شخصاً أو مكاناً أو مادة عن سواها؛ أو يفرز شيئاً بعينه للدراسة
entries.example: Doctors had to isolate the patients with the infection.

entries.definitionEn: Far from others or cut off from them. Also happening only once, not as part of a pattern.
entries.arabicMeaning: معزول بعيد عن الناس أو مقطوع عنهم؛ أو حادث مرة واحدة لا ضمن نمط
entries.example: The village is isolated in winter.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being alone or separate from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزلة؛ حال الانفراد أو الانفصال عن الآخرين
entries.example: He lived in isolation in a cabin for a month.

entries.definitionEn: An important problem or topic that people discuss. Also one copy of a magazine or newspaper.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسألة أو موضوع مهم يتداوله الناس؛ أو عدد من مجلة أو صحيفة
entries.example: Parking is a big issue on this street.

entries.definitionEn: To officially give or send out something, such as a statement, ticket, or warning.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصدر شيئاً بصفة رسمية كبيان أو تذكرة أو إنذار
entries.example: The office will issue new passes next week.

entries.definitionEn: Information technology: computers, software, and related systems used to store and share information.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقنية المعلومات: الحواسيب والبرمجيات والأنظمة المتصلة لخزن المعلومات وتبادلها
entries.example: She works in IT support.

entries.definitionEn: Used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea already mentioned. Also used as a dummy subject in sentences about time, weather, or distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يعود على شيء أو حيوان أو موقف أو فكرة مذكورة؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً فاعلاً شكلياً في جمل الوقت والطقس والمسافة
entries.example: It is raining, so take a coat.

entries.definitionEn: To write or print words in a sloping type, often for titles or emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتب أو يطبع كلاماً بخط مائل، غالباً للعناوين أو للتوكيد
entries.example: Please italicize the book titles.

entries.definitionEn: To have an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch. Also to want to do something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحكّ الجلد حكة تدفع إلى الحكّ؛ أو يشتاق أشدّ الشوق إلى فعل شيء
entries.example: My eyes itch in the spring.

entries.definitionEn: One thing in a list or a group of things.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنصر أو قطعة واحدة في قائمة أو مجموعة
entries.example: Each item on the list has a price.

entries.definitionEn: A planned route or list of places and times for a journey.
entries.arabicMeaning: برنامج رحلة؛ مسار مخطط أو قائمة مواضع وأوقات للسفر
entries.example: The itinerary includes two nights in Rome.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to a thing or animal already mentioned, not to a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدِّد ملكية يسبق الاسم ليبين أن الشيء يخص شيئاً أو حيواناً مذكوراً لا شخصاً
entries.example: The bird built its nest in the oak.

entries.definitionEn: The possessive form of it, used before a noun to show that something belongs to a thing, animal, or situation already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير ملكية من it يسبق اسماً ليبين أن الشيء يخص شيئاً أو حيواناً أو موقفاً ذُكر من قبل
entries.example: The cat licked its paw.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize a thing or animal, or to show that an action happens to that same thing without help.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يوكّد الشيء أو الحيوان نفسه، أو يدل على أن الفعل يقع عليه من غير مساعدة
entries.example: The door closed by itself.

entries.definitionEn: A hard creamy-white material from elephant tusks. Also that pale colour.
entries.arabicMeaning: العاج: مادة صلبة كريمية من أنياب الفيل، ويُطلق أيضاً على ذلك اللون الشاحب
entries.example: The old piano keys were made of ivory.

entries.definitionEn: A short coat.
entries.arabicMeaning: سترة قصيرة أو جاكيت
entries.example: He put on his jacket before going out.

entries.definitionEn: A hard green stone used in jewellery and small carvings.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليشم: حجر أخضر صلب يُستخدم في الحلي والنحت الصغير
entries.example: She wore a bracelet of green jade.

entries.definitionEn: A prison, especially for shorter sentences. Gaol is an older British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجن، وخصوصاً للمدد الأقصر؛ وgaol إملاء بريطاني أقدم
entries.example: He spent six months in jail.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet food made from fruit boiled with sugar. Also a situation in which things cannot move, especially traffic.
entries.arabicMeaning: مربى الفاكهة؛ وأيضاً ازدحام يمنع الحركة، وخصوصاً في المرور
entries.example: I spread jam on my toast.

entries.definitionEn: To push things tightly into a space, or to become stuck so that movement stops.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحشر أشياء في حيّز ضيّق، أو يعلق حتى تتوقف الحركة
entries.example: She jammed the papers into her bag.

entries.definitionEn: The first month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناير / كانون الثاني؛ الشهر الأول من السنة
entries.example: Her birthday is in January.

entries.definitionEn: A glass or pottery container with a wide mouth, used for food.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرطبان زجاجي أو فخاري واسع الفوهة لحفظ الطعام
entries.example: She opened a jar of olives.

entries.definitionEn: Special words used by people in a particular job or field, often hard for outsiders to follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: رطانة مهنية: مصطلحات خاصة بعمل أو مجال، وكثيراً ما يصعب على غير أهله فهمها
entries.example: The contract was full of legal jargon.

entries.definitionEn: Unpleasantly harsh or out of harmony; shocking to the senses or the mood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشز أو صادم يخدش الحس أو الجو العام
entries.example: The bright neon sign looked jarring against the old stone.

entries.definitionEn: The lower part of the face that moves when you speak or eat, or either of the bones that hold the teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفك: الجزء المتحرك من الوجه عند الكلام أو الأكل، أو أحد العظمين الحاملين للأسنان
entries.example: He injured his jaw in the fall.

entries.definitionEn: A type of music with a strong rhythm that began among African American musicians.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى الجاز ذات الإيقاع القوي التي نشأت بين الموسيقيين الأمريكيين من أصل أفريقي
entries.example: They listened to jazz in a small club.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy because someone has something you want, or because you fear losing someone's love or attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: غيور أو حسود إذا امتلك غيرك ما تتمناه، أو خفت أن تفقد حب شخص أو اهتمامه
entries.example: He felt jealous when she praised her colleague.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows envy, or a wish to keep something or someone for yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغيْرة أو حسد، أو حرصاً على إبقاء شيء أو شخص لك
entries.example: She guarded her notes jealously.

entries.definitionEn: Trousers made of strong cotton cloth, usually blue.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنطلون جينز من قماش قطني متين، وغالباً أزرق
entries.example: He wore jeans and a white shirt.

entries.definitionEn: A soft sweet food made from fruit juice that shakes when you move it.
entries.arabicMeaning: هلام فاكهة طري يهتز عند تحريكه
entries.example: The children ate strawberry jelly.

entries.definitionEn: To put something at risk of harm or loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرّض شيئاً لخطر الضرر أو الفقدان
entries.example: Lying now would jeopardize the whole deal.

entries.definitionEn: Made of jersey, a soft knitted fabric that stretches a little.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنوع من قماش الجرسي المحبوك الناعم القابل للتمدد قليلاً
entries.example: She wore a jersey dress on the long flight.

entries.definitionEn: A knitted shirt, especially one worn by a sports team.
entries.arabicMeaning: قميص محبوك، وخصوصاً قميص فريق رياضي
entries.example: The player pulled on his team jersey.

entries.definitionEn: A fast plane with a jet engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائرة نفاثة سريعة
entries.example: The jet left the airport at noon.

entries.definitionEn: A precious stone used in jewellery.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوهرة ثمينة تُستخدم في الحلي
entries.example: The crown was set with a red jewel.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes, repairs, or sells jewellery.
entries.arabicMeaning: صائغ يصنع الحلي أو يصلحها أو يبيعها
entries.example: The jeweler repaired her broken necklace.

entries.definitionEn: Objects you wear for decoration, such as rings and necklaces.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجوهرات وحلي تُلبس للزينة كالخواتم والعقود
entries.example: She kept her jewelry in a small box.

entries.definitionEn: Work that you do to earn money.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل أو وظيفة لكسب المال
entries.example: She got a new job at the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: A slow run done for exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: هرولة بطيئة للرياضة
entries.example: He went for a jog before breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of running slowly for exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهرولة كنشاط رياضي
entries.example: Jogging in the park helps her stay fit.

entries.definitionEn: To become a member of a group, or to come together with someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينضم إلى جماعة أو يلتقي بشخص
entries.example: Would you like to join us for lunch?

entries.definitionEn: Shared by two or more people or groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشترك بين شخصين أو أكثر أو بين جهات
entries.example: They opened a joint bank account.

entries.definitionEn: A place where two bones or parts meet and can move.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفصل يلتقي فيه عظمان أو جزءان ويمكن أن يتحرك
entries.example: Her knee joint was stiff after the walk.

entries.definitionEn: Something you say or do to make people laugh.
entries.arabicMeaning: نكتة أو مزحة تُضحك الناس
entries.example: He told a joke at the start of the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: To say things that are funny and not meant to be serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمزح ويقول كلاماً طريفاً غير جاد
entries.example: They were only joking about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: A magazine about a serious subject. Also a diary of what you do each day.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجلة أو دورية في موضوع جاد؛ وأيضاً دفتر يوميات
entries.example: She published the study in a medical journal.

entries.definitionEn: The work of writing news for newspapers, websites, or broadcasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحافة: عمل كتابة الأخبار للصحف أو المواقع أو البث
entries.example: He studied journalism at university.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes news stories for newspapers, websites, or broadcasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحافي يكتب الأخبار للصحف أو المواقع أو البث
entries.example: The journalist asked several careful questions.

entries.definitionEn: Travel from one place to another, especially a long trip.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة من مكان إلى آخر، وخصوصاً إذا طالت
entries.example: The train journey takes three hours.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of happiness.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرح شديد أو بهجة
entries.example: Their faces were full of joy.

entries.definitionEn: A person who decides cases in a court of law. Also someone who decides the winner of a contest.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاضٍ يفصل في القضايا؛ وأيضاً محكّم يختار الفائز في مسابقة
entries.example: The judge asked the witness to speak more clearly.

entries.definitionEn: To form an opinion about someone or something, or to decide who wins a contest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوّن رأياً في شخص أو شيء، أو يحكم فيمن يفوز
entries.example: Don't judge the book by its cover.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to make good decisions. Also a decision given by a court.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسّ سليم في اتخاذ القرار؛ وأيضاً حكم تصدره محكمة
entries.example: Use your own judgment when you choose.
