entries.definitionEn: A Japanese sport in which people throw or hold each other down, using skill more than strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجودو: رياضة يابانية يُطرح فيها الخصم أو يُثبَّت بالمهارة أكثر من القوة
entries.example: She has practised judo since she was a teenager.

entries.definitionEn: A container with a handle and a lip, used for pouring liquids.
entries.arabicMeaning: إبريق ذو مقبض وفوهة لصب السوائل
entries.example: He filled the jug with water.

entries.definitionEn: The liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصير الفاكهة أو الخضار
entries.example: Would you like a glass of orange juice?

entries.definitionEn: Containing a lot of juice and pleasant to eat.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير العصارة ولذيذ عند الأكل
entries.example: The peaches were ripe and juicy.

entries.definitionEn: The seventh month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوليو / تموز؛ الشهر السابع من السنة
entries.example: We usually go away in July.

entries.definitionEn: A movement of pushing yourself off the ground with your legs.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفزة عن الأرض بالساقين
entries.example: She cleared the fence with one jump.

entries.definitionEn: To push yourself off the ground using your legs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقفز عن الأرض برجليه
entries.example: The children jumped over the puddle.

entries.definitionEn: A knitted piece of clothing for the upper body.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنزة محبوكة للجزء العلوي من الجسم
entries.example: She pulled on a warm jumper.

entries.definitionEn: The sixth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: يونيو / حزيران؛ الشهر السادس من السنة
entries.example: School ends in June.

entries.definitionEn: A thick tropical forest with many trees and plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: غابة استوائية كثيفة الأشجار والنباتات
entries.example: They walked along a path through the jungle.

entries.definitionEn: Lower in rank or younger. Also for children or younger students.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدنى رتبة أو أصغر سناً؛ وقد يُطلق على ما يخص الأطفال أو الطلاب الأصغر
entries.example: He is a junior member of the team.

entries.definitionEn: Food that is quick to eat but low in nutrients and often high in fat, salt, or sugar.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام سريع قليل الفائدة الغذائية، وكثيراً ما يكثر فيه الدهن أو الملح أو السكر
entries.example: She tries not to eat junk food every day.

entries.definitionEn: Things that are old, useless, or of little value.
entries.arabicMeaning: خردة أو أشياء قديمة عديمة النفع تقريباً
entries.example: The garage was full of junk.

entries.definitionEn: The official power to make legal decisions in a particular area, or that area itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختصاص قانوني أو ولاية قضائية على منطقة معينة، أو المنطقة نفسها
entries.example: The case falls outside this court's jurisdiction.

entries.definitionEn: A member of a jury in a court of law.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضو هيئة محلفين في محكمة
entries.example: Each juror listened carefully to the evidence.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people in a court who decide if someone is guilty.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيئة محلفين تقرر إن كان المتهم مذنباً
entries.example: The jury reached a verdict after two days.

entries.definitionEn: A very short time ago. Also exactly, or only.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبل وقت قصير جداً؛ وأيضاً تماماً أو فقط
entries.example: I have just finished my homework.

entries.definitionEn: Fair treatment according to the law or to what is right.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدالة في المعاملة وفق القانون أو ما هو حق
entries.example: They demanded justice for the victims.

entries.definitionEn: To give a good reason for something, especially when it might be criticized.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبرّر شيئاً بسبب وجيه، وخصوصاً إذا كان عرضة للنقد
entries.example: Can you justify spending so much on this?

entries.definitionEn: In a fair way, or with good reason.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعدل أو لسبب وجيه
entries.example: She was justly proud of her work.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to young people, especially in law. Also childish in a way that does not suit an adult.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالأحداث وخصوصاً في القانون؛ وقد يعني سلوكاً صبيانياً لا يليق بالبالغ
entries.example: The court heard a juvenile case that morning.

entries.definitionEn: A young person, especially one below the legal age of an adult.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدث أو قاصر دون سن الرشد القانونية
entries.example: The centre houses juveniles awaiting trial.

entries.definitionEn: A large Australian animal that hops on strong back legs and carries its young in a pouch.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنغر: حيوان أسترالي كبير يقفز على رجليه الخلفيتين ويحمل صغاره في جراب
entries.example: A kangaroo crossed the road at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: Entertainment in which people sing along to recorded music, usually in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاريوكي: غناء مع موسيقى مسجّلة، وغالباً أمام الناس
entries.example: They spent the evening at a karaoke bar.

entries.definitionEn: Very interested or eager. Also sharp, of a mind or the senses.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد الاهتمام أو الحماس؛ وأيضاً حادّ الذهن أو الحواس
entries.example: She is keen to start the new course.

entries.definitionEn: To continue to have something, to stay in a state, or to store something in a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتفظ بشيء أو يبقى على حال أو يحفظ شيئاً في موضع
entries.example: Please keep this letter in a safe place.

entries.definitionEn: A person who looks after animals, a building, or a collection.
entries.arabicMeaning: حارس أو قيّم يعتني بحيوانات أو مبنى أو مجموعة
entries.example: The zoo keeper fed the birds at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A thin oil used as fuel for lamps, heaters, and some engines.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيروسين: زيت رقيق يُستخدم وقوداً للمصابيح والمدافئ وبعض المحركات
entries.example: They filled the lamp with kerosene.

entries.definitionEn: A container used to boil water, usually for tea or coffee.
entries.arabicMeaning: غلاية لغلي الماء، وغالباً للشاي أو القهوة
entries.example: Put the kettle on, please.

entries.definitionEn: Very important.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهم جداً أو أساسي
entries.example: Timing is a key part of the plan.

entries.definitionEn: A metal object that opens a lock.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفتاح معدني يفتح قفلاً
entries.example: She left the key in the door.

entries.definitionEn: The set of keys on a computer, piano, or similar instrument.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة مفاتيح حاسوب أو بيانو أو آلة مشابهة
entries.example: He cleaned the keyboard with a soft cloth.

entries.definitionEn: A single press of a key on a keyboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضغطة واحدة على مفتاح في لوحة المفاتيح
entries.example: The error was caused by one wrong keystroke.

entries.definitionEn: A hit with the foot.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركلة بالقدم
entries.example: He scored with a powerful kick.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something with your foot.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركل شيئاً بقدمه
entries.example: Don't kick the ball in the house.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a child.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولد أو طفل في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: The kids are playing in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: To say something that is not true, as a joke.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمزح ويدّعي ما ليس صحيحاً على سبيل الدعابة
entries.example: I'm not kidding; the train really left.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a person, animal, or plant to die.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقتل شخصاً أو حيواناً أو نباتاً فيميته
entries.example: Frost can kill young plants.

entries.definitionEn: A person, animal, or thing that kills.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاتل من الناس أو الحيوانات أو الأشياء
entries.example: Police are still looking for the killer.

entries.definitionEn: The act of causing death, especially of a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: قتل، وخصوصاً قتل إنسان
entries.example: The killing shocked the whole town.

entries.definitionEn: A kilogram; a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيلو: وحدة وزن تعادل ألف غرام
entries.example: I bought two kilos of rice.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيلوغرام: وحدة وزن تعادل ألف غرام
entries.example: The parcel weighed one kilogram.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of distance equal to 1,000 metres.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيلومتر: وحدة مسافة تعادل ألف متر
entries.example: The school is two kilometers from our house.

entries.definitionEn: Friendly and helpful to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف وودود يساعد غيره
entries.example: She was very kind to the new student.

entries.definitionEn: A type or sort of thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوع أو ضرب من الأشياء
entries.example: What kind of music do you like?

entries.definitionEn: Kind and friendly in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: ودود لطيف في المعاملة
entries.example: A kindly neighbour helped us move the boxes.

entries.definitionEn: In a kind way. Also used in polite requests.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلطف؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً في الطلب المهذّب
entries.example: He kindly offered us a lift home.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being kind, or a kind act.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطف أو عمل كريم
entries.example: Thank you for your kindness.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to movement, or to the energy an object has because it is moving.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركي؛ متعلق بالحركة أو بطاقة الجسم بسبب تحركه
entries.example: The sculpture uses kinetic energy from the wind.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to movement or kinetic energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو حركي أو بما يتصل بطاقة الحركة
entries.example: The installation is kinetically driven by passing air.

entries.definitionEn: A male ruler of a country, usually from a royal family.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملك يحكم بلداً، وغالباً من أسرة ملكية
entries.example: The king opened the new hospital.

entries.definitionEn: A country ruled by a king or queen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملكة يحكمها ملك أو ملكة
entries.example: The story is set in a distant kingdom.

entries.definitionEn: A touch with the lips to show love or greeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبلة بالشفتين للتعبير عن الحب أو التحية
entries.example: She gave her son a kiss before school.

entries.definitionEn: To touch someone with your lips to show love or greeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبّل شخصاً بالشفتين حباً أو تحية
entries.example: They kissed each other goodbye at the station.

entries.definitionEn: A set of tools, clothes, or equipment for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقم أدوات أو ملابس أو معدات لغرض معيّن
entries.example: He packed his first-aid kit.

entries.definitionEn: A room where food is prepared and cooked.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطبخ يُعدّ فيه الطعام ويُطبخ
entries.example: We ate breakfast in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: A light frame covered with paper or cloth that flies on a string in the wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائرة ورقية تطير في الريح على خيط
entries.example: The children flew a kite on the beach.

entries.definitionEn: A young cat.
entries.arabicMeaning: هريرة: قط صغير
entries.example: The kitten slept in a warm basket.

entries.definitionEn: A natural skill for doing something easily and well.
entries.arabicMeaning: موهبة أو براعة فطرية في أداء شيء بيسر وإتقان
entries.example: He has a knack for remembering names.

entries.definitionEn: The joint in the middle of your leg.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركبة: المفصل في وسط الساق
entries.example: She fell and hurt her knee.

entries.definitionEn: To go down on one or both knees.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجثو على ركبة أو ركبتين
entries.example: He knelt to tie the child's shoe.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a blade for cutting.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكين ذات نصل للقطع
entries.example: Cut the bread with a sharp knife.

entries.definitionEn: To make cloth or clothes by joining wool with two long needles.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوك قماشاً أو ملابس بإبرتين وصوف
entries.example: My grandmother taught me how to knit.

entries.definitionEn: The sound of hitting a door or surface, especially to ask to come in.
entries.arabicMeaning: طرق أو صوت ضرب على باب أو سطح، وخصوصاً للاستئذان
entries.example: There was a knock at the door.

entries.definitionEn: To hit a door or surface, usually to get attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطرق باباً أو سطحاً للتنبيه
entries.example: Please knock before you enter.

entries.definitionEn: A join made by tying string or rope.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقدة تُعقد في خيط أو حبل
entries.example: He tied a tight knot in the rope.

entries.definitionEn: To have information in your mind, or to be familiar with a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرف معلومة أو يكون على دراية بشخص أو مكان
entries.example: Do you know her phone number?

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you understand, often a shared secret. Also on purpose, with full knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن علم ووعي، وغالباً بسرّ مفهوم؛ وأيضاً عن قصد مع تمام المعرفة
entries.example: She smiled knowingly across the table.

entries.definitionEn: Information and understanding that you have in your mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: معرفة وفهم في الذهن
entries.example: He has a good knowledge of French.

entries.definitionEn: Knowing a lot about a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: واسع الاطلاع في موضوع معيّن
entries.example: Our guide was knowledgeable about local history.

entries.definitionEn: Familiar to people; recognized.
entries.arabicMeaning: معروف لدى الناس أو مُعترَف به
entries.example: She is a known expert in the field.

entries.definitionEn: A short form of laboratory: a room for scientific work or tests.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختصر laboratory: مختبر للعمل العلمي أو الفحوص
entries.example: The samples were sent to the lab.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper or cloth that gives information about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة أو لصاقة عليها معلومات عن الشيء
entries.example: Read the label before you wash the shirt.

entries.definitionEn: Work, especially hard physical work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل، وخصوصاً الجهد البدني الشاق
entries.example: The job involves heavy labor.

entries.definitionEn: A room or building for scientific experiments and tests.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختبر أو معمل للتجارب والفحوص العلمية
entries.example: The medicine was tested in a laboratory.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does hard physical work, often outdoors.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل يقوم بعمل بدني شاق، وغالباً في العراء
entries.example: A laborer helped unload the bricks.

entries.definitionEn: The state of not having enough of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقص أو انعدام ما يكفي من شيء
entries.example: The delay was caused by a lack of staff.

entries.definitionEn: To not have something, or not have enough of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتقر إلى شيء أو لا يملك منه ما يكفي
entries.example: The report lacks clear evidence.

entries.definitionEn: Dull and not impressive or energetic.
entries.arabicMeaning: باهت قليل التألق أو الحماس
entries.example: The team gave a lackluster performance.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment with steps, used for climbing up or down.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلّم درجات للصعود أو النزول
entries.example: He climbed the ladder to reach the roof.

entries.definitionEn: A polite word for a woman.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيدة: لفظ مؤدب للمرأة
entries.example: A young lady asked for directions.

entries.definitionEn: A large area of water surrounded by land.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحيرة: مساحة ماء واسعة تحيط بها اليابسة
entries.example: They swam in the lake all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A young sheep, or its meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمل صغير؛ أو لحم الضأن الصغير
entries.example: We had roast lamb for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to walk well because of an injured leg. Informal: weak or unconvincing.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعرج لا يحسن المشي لإصابة في الساق؛ وفي الكلام غير الرسمي: واهٍ أو غير مقنع
entries.example: The horse went lame after the race.

entries.definitionEn: To express sadness or regret about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندب أمراً أو يبدي أسفاً وحزناً عليه
entries.example: Critics lamented the loss of the old theatre.

entries.definitionEn: An expression of deep sadness or mourning.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندب أو نواح يعبّر عن حزن عميق
entries.example: The poem is a lamentation for a lost city.

entries.definitionEn: A device that gives light.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصباح يضيء
entries.example: She switched on the lamp beside the bed.

entries.definitionEn: A long spear once used by soldiers on horses.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمح طويل كان فرسان الماضي يحملونه
entries.example: The statue shows a rider with a lance.

entries.definitionEn: The solid part of the earth, not the sea. Also ground used for a purpose, such as farming.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليابسة لا البحر؛ وأيضاً أرض تُستخدم لغرض كزراعة
entries.example: They bought a piece of land near the river.

entries.definitionEn: To come down to the ground after flying.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهبط إلى الأرض بعد الطيران
entries.example: The plane will land in twenty minutes.

entries.definitionEn: The act of coming down to the ground in a plane. Also a flat area at the top of stairs.
entries.arabicMeaning: هبوط طائرة إلى الأرض؛ وأيضاً بسطة أعلى الدرج
entries.example: The pilot made a smooth landing.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who owns a house or flat and rents it to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالكة تؤجّر بيتاً أو شقة
entries.example: Our landlady lives in the flat upstairs.

entries.definitionEn: A person who owns a house or flat and rents it to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالك يؤجّر بيتاً أو شقة
entries.example: The landlord raised the rent in April.

entries.definitionEn: A view of an area of countryside, or a picture of that view.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشهد طبيعي للريف، أو صورة لذلك المشهد
entries.example: The train passed through a green landscape.

entries.definitionEn: To change the look of an area of land by planting and shaping it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسّق أرضاً بالغرس والتشكيل ليغيّر مظهرها
entries.example: They plan to landscape the garden next spring.

entries.definitionEn: A mass of earth and rock that slides down a slope.
entries.arabicMeaning: انهيار أرضي ينحدر فيه تراب وصخر
entries.example: Heavy rain caused a landslide on the mountain road.

entries.definitionEn: A narrow road, often in the country. Also a marked strip on a wide road.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريق ضيقة وغالباً في الريف؛ وأيضاً مسار محدّد في طريق واسعة
entries.example: Cyclists should stay in the left lane.

entries.definitionEn: The words people in a country or group use to speak and write.
entries.arabicMeaning: لغة يتكلم بها أهل بلد أو جماعة ويكتبون بها
entries.example: English is her first language.

entries.definitionEn: A short failure in memory, judgement, or behaviour. Also a period of time that has passed.
entries.arabicMeaning: هفوة قصيرة في الذاكرة أو الحكم أو السلوك؛ وأيضاً مدة انقضت
entries.example: A brief lapse in concentration caused the error.

entries.definitionEn: To come to an end because it is not renewed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتهي لعدم تجديده
entries.example: Her membership will lapse if she does not pay.

entries.definitionEn: A small computer that you can carry and use on your lap.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسوب محمول يُستخدم على الحضن
entries.example: She took her laptop to the café.

entries.definitionEn: Bigger than usual or than average.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبير أكبر من المعتاد
entries.example: They live in a large house.

entries.definitionEn: To a great extent; mostly.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد كبير أو في معظمه
entries.example: The delay was largely due to the weather.

entries.definitionEn: Inflammation of the larynx, often causing a sore throat and a weak or lost voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: التهاب الحنجرة يسبب غالباً ألماً في الحلق وضعف الصوت أو فقدانه
entries.example: The singer cancelled the concert because of laryngitis.

entries.definitionEn: A device that produces a narrow, powerful beam of light.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليزر: جهاز يصدر شعاع ضوء ضيقاً قوياً
entries.example: The surgeon used a laser to treat the eye.

entries.definitionEn: A state of tiredness and lack of energy or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتور وإعياء مع قلة الطاقة أو الاهتمام
entries.example: A deep lassitude followed the long illness.

entries.definitionEn: After everything or everyone else; most recently.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد الجميع أو كل شيء؛ وفي أقرب وقت مضى
entries.example: Who spoke last at the meeting?

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean the final one, or the one before now.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق اسماً لتعني الأخير أو السابق لهذا الوقت
entries.example: This is the last train tonight.

entries.definitionEn: Done or happening at the latest possible time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتم في آخر لحظة ممكنة
entries.example: They made a last-minute change to the plan.

entries.definitionEn: The latest possible time before something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: آخر لحظة قبل وقوع أمر
entries.example: He arrived at the last minute.

entries.definitionEn: Your family name, used after your given name.
entries.arabicMeaning: اسم العائلة الذي يلي الاسم الأول
entries.example: Please write your last name in capital letters.

entries.definitionEn: The final one, or the one that remains after the others.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأخير أو ما يبقى بعد غيره
entries.example: She was the last to arrive.

entries.definitionEn: To continue for a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستمر مدة من الزمن
entries.example: The meeting lasted two hours.

entries.definitionEn: Continuing for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائم يستمر زمناً طويلاً
entries.example: The trip left a lasting impression on her.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the final point in a list.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم لتقديم النقطة الأخيرة في تعداد
entries.example: Lastly, remember to lock the door.

entries.definitionEn: After the usual or expected time. Also near the end of a period.
entries.arabicMeaning: متأخر عن الوقت المعتاد؛ وأيضاً قريب من نهاية فترة
entries.example: Sorry I am late for the class.

entries.definitionEn: After the usual or expected time.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت متأخر عن المعتاد
entries.example: The train arrived late.

entries.definitionEn: A person who arrives after the expected time.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يصل بعد الوقت المتوقع
entries.example: A latecomer slipped into a seat at the back.

entries.definitionEn: In the recent past; recently.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤخراً في الأيام القريبة
entries.example: Have you seen her lately?

entries.definitionEn: Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامن موجود لكنه غير ظاهر أو غير مكتمل بعد
entries.example: The test can detect latent infection.

entries.definitionEn: Coming after the present time or after something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاحق بالزمن الحاضر أو بما سبق
entries.example: We can discuss this at a later meeting.

entries.definitionEn: After the present time, or after a time already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت لاحق أو بعد وقت ذُكر
entries.example: I'll call you later.

entries.definitionEn: The most recent.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأحدث أو الأقرب عهداً
entries.example: Have you heard the latest news?

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun for the second of two things already mentioned, or for the part nearer the end of a period.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق اسماً لتعني الثاني من شيئين ذُكرا، أو الجزء الأقرب إلى نهاية فترة
entries.example: Of the two plans, the latter option is cheaper.

entries.definitionEn: Not a time adverb in standard English. Do not use latter to mean later. Use later for a later time, and latter as an adjective or pronoun for the second of two things already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليست ظرف زمان بمعنى later. للوقت اللاحق استخدم later، وللثاني من شيئين سبق ذكرهما استخدم latter صفة أو ضميرًا.
entries.example: Write later, not latter, when you mean a later time.

entries.definitionEn: The second of two people or things just mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثاني من شخصين أو شيئين ذُكرا للتو
entries.example: Tea or coffee? I'll have the latter.

entries.definitionEn: To praise someone or something highly, especially in public or in writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمدح شخصاً أو شيئاً مدحاً بليغاً، وخصوصاً علناً أو كتابة
entries.example: The review lauded the film for its honest script.

entries.definitionEn: Expressing high praise.
entries.arabicMeaning: مديحي يعبر عن ثناء بالغ
entries.example: The speech was frankly laudatory.

entries.definitionEn: The sound you make when you find something funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضحكة: الصوت عند الاستمتاع بشيء طريف
entries.example: A loud laugh came from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: To make the sound that shows you think something is funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضحك حين يجد شيئاً طريفاً
entries.example: The joke made everyone laugh.

entries.definitionEn: The sound or act of laughing.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضحك أو قهقهة
entries.example: The room filled with laughter.

entries.definitionEn: The act of starting a new product, or of sending a ship or rocket into motion.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطلاق منتج جديد، أو إنزال سفينة أو صاروخ ليبدأ حركته
entries.example: The company announced the launch of a new phone.

entries.definitionEn: To start something new, or to send a rocket or boat into motion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلق شيئاً جديداً، أو يرسل صاروخاً أو قارباً في الحركة
entries.example: They will launch the app next month.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes that need washing or have just been washed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غسيل: ملابس تنتظر الغسل أو غُسلت تواً
entries.example: He folded the clean laundry on the bed.

entries.definitionEn: Hot liquid rock that comes out of a volcano.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمم بركانية سائلة تخرج من البركان
entries.example: Lava flowed down the side of the volcano.

entries.definitionEn: A toilet, or a room with a toilet; a formal or British word.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرحاض أو غرفة فيها مرحاض؛ لفظ رسمي أو بريطاني
entries.example: The lavatory is at the end of the corridor.

entries.definitionEn: The system of rules in a country. Also one of those rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: قانون: منظومة القواعد في بلد، أو قاعدة منها
entries.example: Stealing is against the law.

entries.definitionEn: Allowed by the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروع مسموح به قانوناً
entries.example: The sale of the house was entirely lawful.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes laws, especially an elected member of a legislature.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشرّع يضع القوانين، وخصوصاً عضو منتخب في هيئة تشريعية
entries.example: Lawmakers voted on the new bill.

entries.definitionEn: An area of short, regularly cut grass, especially in a garden.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشب قصير يُجزّ بانتظام، وخصوصاً في حديقة
entries.example: The children played on the front lawn.

entries.definitionEn: A case that someone brings against another person in a court of law.
entries.arabicMeaning: دعوى قضائية يرفعها شخص على آخر
entries.example: She filed a lawsuit against the company.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to advise people about the law and speak for them in court.
entries.arabicMeaning: محامٍ يقدم المشورة القانونية ويمثّل الناس أمام القضاء
entries.example: You should speak to a lawyer before you sign.

entries.definitionEn: To put something down carefully in a flat position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً برفق في وضع مستوٍ
entries.example: She laid the book on the table.

entries.definitionEn: A lazy person who avoids work; informal and disapproving.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسول يتفادى العمل؛ لفظ غير رسمي للذم
entries.example: He called his brother a layabout for staying in bed all day.

entries.definitionEn: A quantity of a material that covers a surface, or that lies between others.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبقة تغطي سطحاً أو تقع بين طبقات أخرى
entries.example: Spread a thin layer of paint on the wall.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of not wanting to work or make an effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسل: عزوف عن العمل أو بذل الجهد
entries.example: Laziness kept him from finishing the job.

entries.definitionEn: Not willing to work or make an effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: كسول لا يريد العمل أو الاجتهاد
entries.example: Don't be lazy; help me with the dishes.

entries.definitionEn: Main or most important, as in a lead role or lead singer.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيسي أو الأهم، كما في الدور الأول أو المغني الأول
entries.example: She got the lead part in the play.

entries.definitionEn: The first position in a race or competition. Also a soft grey metal.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدارة السباق أو المنافسة؛ وأيضاً معدن الرصاص الرمادي الليّن
entries.example: Our team is in the lead by two points.

entries.definitionEn: To go in front and show the way, or to be in charge of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقدم ليدل على الطريق، أو يتولى قيادة جماعة
entries.example: She will lead the discussion tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is in charge of a group or country.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائد يتولى أمر جماعة أو بلد
entries.example: The team chose a new leader.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being a leader, or the skill of leading people.
entries.arabicMeaning: قيادة: تولّي الزعامة أو مهارة قيادة الناس
entries.example: The company needs strong leadership.

entries.definitionEn: Most important or most successful in a field.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأبرز أو الأنجح في مجال
entries.example: He is a leading expert on climate.

entries.definitionEn: A flat green part that grows on a plant or tree.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورقة خضراء مسطحة تنبت على نبات أو شجرة
entries.example: A yellow leaf fell from the tree.

entries.definitionEn: A small printed sheet of paper that gives information.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشرة مطبوعة صغيرة تقدّم معلومات
entries.example: They handed out a leaflet about the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A group of sports clubs that play against each other.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوري أندية تتنافس فيما بينها
entries.example: Our team is top of the league.

entries.definitionEn: A hole or crack that lets liquid or gas escape. Also the escape of secret information.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقب أو شق يتسرب منه سائل أو غاز؛ وأيضاً تسريب معلومات سرية
entries.example: There is a leak under the kitchen sink.

entries.definitionEn: To let liquid or gas escape through a hole. Also to give out secret information.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسرب منه سائل أو غاز من ثقب؛ وأيضاً يسرّب معلومات سرية
entries.example: The pipe began to leak after the frost.

entries.definitionEn: Thin in a healthy way, with little fat. Also of meat with little fat.
entries.arabicMeaning: نحيل بصحة وقليل الشحم؛ وللحم: قليل الدهن
entries.example: He has a tall, lean build.

entries.definitionEn: To bend your body in one direction, or to rest it against something for support.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميل بجسمه أو يستند إلى شيء
entries.example: She leaned against the wall while she waited.

entries.definitionEn: A long or high jump. Also a sudden large increase or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفزة بعيدة أو عالية؛ أو زيادة أو تغيّر مفاجئ كبير
entries.example: There has been a leap in the number of applications.

entries.definitionEn: To jump a long way, or high into the air, often quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقفز بعيداً أو عالياً، وغالباً بسرعة
entries.example: The cat leapt onto the table.

entries.definitionEn: To get knowledge or a skill by studying, practising, or being taught.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعلّم معرفة أو مهارة بالدراسة أو التمرين أو التعليم
entries.example: The children learn English at school.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is learning a subject or skill, especially a language.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلّم؛ شخص يتعلّم مادة أو مهارة ولا سيما لغة
entries.example: This course is designed for new learners.

entries.definitionEn: The process of gaining knowledge or skill through study or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: التعلّم؛ اكتساب المعرفة أو المهارة بالدراسة أو الخبرة
entries.example: Online learning is now part of many university courses.

entries.definitionEn: A legal agreement that lets you use a building, land, or vehicle for a set time in return for payment.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقد إيجار يتيح استعمال عقار أو مركبة لمدة محددة مقابل أجر
entries.example: They signed a two-year lease on the flat.

entries.definitionEn: A strap or chain fastened to a dog's collar so that you can control it when you walk.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقود يُربط إلى طوق الكلب للسيطرة عليه في المشي
entries.example: Keep the dog on a leash in the park.

entries.definitionEn: To the smallest degree or amount; less than anything or anyone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أقلّ درجة أو مقدار؛ أقلّ من أي شيء أو أحد سواه
entries.example: Of the three routes, this one is least convenient.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean the smallest amount of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق اسماً لتعني أقلّ مقدار من ذلك الشيء
entries.example: This recipe uses the least sugar.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest amount of something, or the smallest thing that can be done or given.
entries.arabicMeaning: أقلّ مقدار؛ أو أدنى ما يمكن فعله أو تقديمه
entries.example: Checking the figures once more is the least we can do.

entries.definitionEn: Animal skin that has been treated so that it can be used to make shoes, bags, and furniture.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلد مدبوغ يُصنع منه الأحذية والحقائب والأثاث
entries.example: His shoes were made of brown leather.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time when you are allowed to be away from work.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجازة؛ مدة يُسمح فيها بالغياب عن العمل
entries.example: She is on leave until the end of the month.

entries.definitionEn: To go away from a person or place. Also to let something stay where it is.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغادر شخصاً أو مكاناً؛ أو يترك شيئاً في موضعه
entries.example: We have to leave at seven.

entries.definitionEn: To add yeast or a similar agent so that dough rises. Also to make something livelier or less heavy by adding a contrasting quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخمر العجين بالخميرة؛ أو يلطّف شيئاً بإضافة صفة مغايرة تخفف ثقله
entries.example: A little humour can leaven a serious discussion.

entries.definitionEn: A substance, such as yeast, that makes dough rise. Also a quality that lightens or modifies something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: خميرة أو مادة تخمير؛ أو صفة تلطّف شيئاً أو تعدّله
entries.example: Yeast is the usual leavening in this bread.

entries.definitionEn: A formal talk to a group of people in order to teach them about a subject, especially at a university.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاضرة؛ حديث رسمي لجماعة بقصد التعليم، ولا سيما في الجامعة
entries.example: The professor gave a lecture on climate.

entries.definitionEn: A person who teaches at a university or college, often by giving lectures.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاضر جامعي يدرّس في جامعة أو كلية
entries.example: She works as a history lecturer at the university.

entries.definitionEn: A long green and white vegetable that tastes like a mild onion.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرّاث؛ خضار طويل أخضر وأبيض بطعم البصل الخفيف
entries.example: He chopped a leek for the soup.

entries.definitionEn: On the side of your body that is towards the west when you face north; the opposite of right.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيسر؛ على الجهة المقابلة لليمين
entries.example: Raise your left hand.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the left side.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى اليسار
entries.example: Turn left at the next lights.

entries.definitionEn: On or towards the left side of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيسر؛ واقع على الجهة اليسرى من شيء
entries.example: The cups are on the left-hand shelf.

entries.definitionEn: The left side or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليسار؛ الجهة اليسرى
entries.example: The bank is on the left.

entries.definitionEn: One of the two long parts of the body that you stand and walk on.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساق؛ أحد الطرفين اللذين نقف ونمشي عليهما
entries.example: He sat down and stretched his legs.

entries.definitionEn: Something that remains from an earlier time, person, or event. Also money or property left to someone in a will.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرث باقٍ من زمن أو شخص أو حدث سابق؛ أو تركة من مال أو ممتلكات
entries.example: The architect left a lasting legacy in the city.

entries.definitionEn: Allowed by the law, or connected with the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: قانوني؛ مباح شرعاً بالقانون أو متصل به
entries.example: It is not legal to park here overnight.

entries.definitionEn: According to the law; in a way that the law allows or requires.
entries.arabicMeaning: قانونياً؛ وفق ما يجيزه القانون أو يوجبه
entries.example: They are legally required to wear a helmet.

entries.definitionEn: An old story that is well known but may not be true. Also a very famous person.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسطورة قديمة ذائعة قد لا تكون صادقة؛ أو شخص ذائع الصيت
entries.example: According to legend, a hidden city lies under the lake.

entries.definitionEn: Very famous, and often talked about in stories. Also from a legend.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسطوري؛ ذائع الصيت يتناقله الناس، أو منسوب إلى أسطورة
entries.example: She became a legendary figure in music.

entries.definitionEn: A large division of an army, especially in ancient Rome. Also a very great number of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلق عسكري كبير، ولا سيما في روما القديمة؛ أو جمع غفير من الناس
entries.example: He has a legion of admirers across the country.

entries.definitionEn: To make laws.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسنّ القوانين
entries.example: Parliament will legislate on this issue next year.

entries.definitionEn: A law or a set of laws made by a government.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشريع؛ قانون أو مجموعة قوانين تضعها سلطة حاكمة
entries.example: New legislation will protect the river.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the making of laws.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشريعي؛ متصل بسنّ القوانين
entries.example: The legislative process can take many months.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make or change laws.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشرّع؛ من عمله سنّ القوانين أو تعديلها
entries.example: The legislators voted on the housing bill.

entries.definitionEn: The group of people who have the official power to make and change the laws of a country or region.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيئة تشريعية لها سلطة سنّ القوانين وتعديلها في بلد أو إقليم
entries.example: The state legislature passed the budget yesterday.

entries.definitionEn: Allowed by law, or fair and reasonable.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروع قانوناً؛ أو وجيه مقبول
entries.example: They have a legitimate reason to complain.

entries.definitionEn: Time when you are free to do what you enjoy, not work.
entries.arabicMeaning: فراغ؛ وقت حرّ للمتعة لا للعمل
entries.example: She reads in her leisure time.

entries.definitionEn: In a slow, unhurried way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مهل وبغير عجلة
entries.example: We walked leisurely through the old town.

entries.definitionEn: A yellow citrus fruit with a sour taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليمون حامض أصفر
entries.example: Add a slice of lemon to the tea.

entries.definitionEn: A drink made from lemons, water, and sugar. In British English, also a sweet fizzy lemon drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: شراب الليمون بالماء والسكر؛ وفي الإنكليزية البريطانية أيضاً مشروب غازي بنكهة الليمون
entries.example: The children drank cold lemonade in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: To give something to someone for a short time, expecting it to be returned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعير شيئاً لوقت قصير على أن يُردّ
entries.example: Can you lend me a pen?

entries.definitionEn: How long something is from one end to the other. Also the amount of time something lasts.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطول من طرف إلى طرف؛ أو مدة استمرار شيء
entries.example: Measure the length of the table.

entries.definitionEn: To become longer, or to make something longer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطول أو يُطيل شيئاً
entries.example: The days lengthen in spring.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting a long time, often more time than is wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطوّل يستغرق وقتاً طويلاً، وغالباً أكثر مما يُرغب
entries.example: The meeting was followed by a lengthy discussion.

entries.definitionEn: A large wild cat with a yellowish coat and black spots.
entries.arabicMeaning: نمر مرقط؛ قطّ بري كبير أصفر الجلد منقّط بالأسود
entries.example: A leopard rested in the shade of a tree.

entries.definitionEn: To a smaller degree; not as much.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة أقل؛ ليس بالقدر نفسه
entries.example: He drives less than he did last year.

entries.definitionEn: Used before an uncountable noun to mean a smaller amount of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق اسماً غير معدود لتعني مقداراً أصغر منه
entries.example: Please use less salt in the soup.

entries.definitionEn: A smaller amount of something already understood from the context.
entries.arabicMeaning: أقلّ؛ مقدار أصغر من شيء يُفهم من السياق
entries.example: I should have eaten less.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller in amount, force, or importance, or to make something do so.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّ أو يخفّ مقداراً أو قوةً أو أهمية، أو يجعل شيئاً كذلك
entries.example: The medicine helped lessen the pain.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time in which someone is taught a subject or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: درس؛ مدة يُعلَّم فيها موضوع أو مهارة
entries.example: We have an English lesson after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that you do something in order to prevent something bad or unwanted from happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: لئلا؛ حرف يربط الفعل بما يُخشى وقوعه فيُتَّقى
entries.example: He wrote the number down lest he forget it.

entries.definitionEn: To allow someone to do something, or to allow something to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدع أو يسمح لشخص أن يفعل، أو بأن يحدث شيء
entries.example: Please let me help you.

entries.definitionEn: Having little energy or interest; slow and sleepy.
entries.arabicMeaning: خامل فاتر الهمة، بطيء وكأنه نعسان
entries.example: The heat made everyone feel lethargic.

entries.definitionEn: In a slow, sleepy way, with little energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخمول وفتور، كأن المرء نعسان قليل الطاقة
entries.example: He moved lethargically from the sofa to the door.

entries.definitionEn: A state of having little energy or interest; tired inactivity.
entries.arabicMeaning: خمول وفتور همة؛ كسل من التعب وقلة النشاط
entries.example: A heavy lunch left him in a state of lethargy.

entries.definitionEn: A written message that you send to someone. Also a symbol in an alphabet.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسالة مكتوبة تُرسل إلى أحد؛ أو حرف من حروف الهجاء
entries.example: She wrote a letter to her grandmother.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with large green leaves that are eaten raw in salads.
entries.arabicMeaning: خس؛ نبات أوراقه خضر كبيرة تُؤكل نيئة في السلطة
entries.example: Wash the lettuce before you make the salad.

entries.definitionEn: Flat and not sloping. Also at the same height as something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستوٍ غير مائل؛ أو في ارتفاع واحد مع شيء آخر
entries.example: Make sure the picture is level before you hang it.

entries.definitionEn: A particular height, amount, or standard. Also a floor in a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستوى من ارتفاع أو مقدار أو معيار؛ أو طابق في مبنى
entries.example: This course is for students at an intermediate level.

entries.definitionEn: To make a surface flat and even. Also to make two things equal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسوّي سطحاً حتى يستوي؛ أو يعادل بين شيئين
entries.example: They need to level the ground before laying the path.

entries.definitionEn: To work with another person or group and share information so that you act together.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينسّق مع جهة أخرى ويتبادل المعلومات للعمل معاً
entries.example: She will liaise with the hospital about the schedule.

entries.definitionEn: Communication and cooperation between people or groups. Also a person who maintains that contact.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنسيق وتواصل بين أطراف؛ أو شخص يقوم بهذه الصلة
entries.example: He acts as a liaison between the two departments.

entries.definitionEn: A person who tells lies.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاذب؛ من يختلق الأكاذيب
entries.example: Nobody trusted him after they found he was a liar.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to accept different opinions and ways of living. Also generous with money or amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: منفتح متسامح مع اختلاف الآراء وأساليب العيش؛ أو سخيّ بالمال أو المقدار
entries.example: The college has a liberal attitude towards student clubs.

entries.definitionEn: To set someone or something free from control, prison, or an unfair situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّر شخصاً أو شيئاً من سيطرة أو سجن أو وضع جائر
entries.example: The prisoners were liberated at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: The act of setting someone or something free, or the state of being free.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحرير؛ فعل العتق من القيد أو حال الحرية بعده
entries.example: The city celebrated its liberation.

entries.definitionEn: The freedom to live, act, and think as you choose, within the law.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرية العيش والعمل والتفكير ضمن القانون
entries.example: Students have the liberty to choose any topic.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works in a library and helps people find books and information.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمين مكتبة يساعد الناس على إيجاد الكتب والمعلومات
entries.example: Ask the librarian if you cannot find the book.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you can borrow or read books, and often use computers.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتبة عامة أو مدرسية يُستعار منها الكتب أو تُقرأ فيها
entries.example: I borrowed this book from the library.

entries.definitionEn: To give official permission for a person to do something or for an activity to take place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرخّص؛ يمنح إذناً رسمياً لشخص أو لنشاط
entries.example: The city will license the new restaurant next month.

entries.definitionEn: To move your tongue across the surface of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلحس شيئاً بلسانه
entries.example: The child licked the ice cream before it melted.

entries.definitionEn: A cover for the top of a container such as a pan, box, or jar.
entries.arabicMeaning: غطاء لأعلى إناء أو علبة أو برطمان
entries.example: Put the lid back on the jar.

entries.definitionEn: Something you say that you know is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: كذبة؛ قول يعلم صاحبه أنه غير صادق
entries.example: He told a lie about where he had been.

entries.definitionEn: To be in a flat or resting position, or to move into that position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستلقي أو يكون في وضع رقادي
entries.example: Please lie on your back and keep still.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being alive, or the time that a person or animal is alive.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحياة؛ أو مدة بقاء الإنسان أو الحيوان حيّاً
entries.example: He has lived in this city all his life.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to rescue people who are in danger in the water.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقذ سباحة؛ من عمله إنقاذ من يصيبه خطر في الماء
entries.example: The lifeguard blew a whistle and everyone left the water.

entries.definitionEn: Dead, or seeming to have no life, energy, or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: هامد بلا حياة؛ أو خالٍ من الطاقة والاهتمام
entries.example: The pond looked lifeless in winter.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for the whole of a person's life.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدوم مدى الحياة
entries.example: They have been lifelong friends.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person or group lives, including habits, work, and free time.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسلوب حياة يشمل العادات والعمل ووقت الفراغ
entries.example: She has a healthy lifestyle, with long walks every day.

entries.definitionEn: The period of time that a person is alive. Also a very long time in someone's experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمر الإنسان كلّه؛ أو مدة تبدو طويلة جداً في تجربة المرء
entries.example: He spent a lifetime studying the river.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that carries people up and down inside a building. Also a free ride in someone's vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصعد في مبنى؛ أو توصيلة مجانية في مركبة أحد
entries.example: We took the lift to the fifth floor.

entries.definitionEn: To move something to a higher position. Also to raise or remove a rule or restriction.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع شيئاً إلى موضع أعلى؛ أو يرفع قيداً أو حظراً
entries.example: Can you help me lift this box?

entries.definitionEn: Not dark, or pale in colour. Also not heavy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضيء أو فاتح اللون؛ وأيضاً خفيف الوزن
entries.example: She wore a light jacket because it was warm.

entries.definitionEn: Brightness from the sun, a lamp, or fire, that lets you see. Also a lamp or other source of that brightness.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضوء يتيح الرؤية؛ أو مصباح ومصدر ذلك الضياء
entries.example: Please turn on the light.

entries.definitionEn: To make something start to burn, or to give light to a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشعل شيئاً أو يضيء مكاناً
entries.example: He stopped to light the candle.

entries.definitionEn: To become brighter or less dark, or to make something less heavy or less serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضيء أو يخفّ ظلامه؛ أو يخفف ثقلاً أو جدّة
entries.example: A short break helped lighten the mood.

entries.definitionEn: A small device that produces a flame, used to light cigarettes or candles.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولاعة صغيرة تُشعل بها السجائر أو الشموع
entries.example: She used a lighter to start the candles.

entries.definitionEn: The lights in a place, or the way they are arranged and used.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإضاءة في مكان، أو طريقة توزيع المصابيح واستعمالها
entries.example: The lighting in the kitchen is too dim.

entries.definitionEn: With little weight, force, or amount. Also not seriously.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخفة في الوزن أو القوة أو المقدار؛ أو من غير جدّ
entries.example: He touched her shoulder lightly.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden bright flash of electricity in the sky during a storm.
entries.arabicMeaning: برق؛ وميض كهربائي مفاجئ في السماء أثناء العاصفة
entries.example: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.

entries.definitionEn: Used, especially in speech, to mean as if, or in the same way that.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يُستعمل ولا سيما في الكلام بمعنى كأنّ أو كما
entries.example: It looks like we will be late.

entries.definitionEn: Similar to someone or something; in the same way as.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثل؛ يشبه شخصاً أو شيئاً أو على شاكلته
entries.example: She looks like her mother.

entries.definitionEn: To find someone or something pleasant or enjoyable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحب شيئاً أو يعجبه شخص أو أمر
entries.example: I like coffee in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: The chance that something will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجحان الحدوث؛ مقدار احتمال وقوع أمر
entries.example: There is little likelihood of rain tonight.

entries.definitionEn: Probably going to happen, or probably true.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرجّح الحدوث أو الصدق
entries.example: It is likely to rain this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of looking like someone or something. Also a picture of a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبه في المظهر؛ أو صورة لشخص
entries.example: There is a strong likeness between the two sisters.

entries.definitionEn: In the same way. Also used to say that you feel or will do the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالمثل؛ على النحو نفسه، أو للرد بأن الحال عندك كذلك
entries.example: The first group improved, and the second did likewise.

entries.definitionEn: A tall plant with large flowers, often white, yellow, or orange.
entries.arabicMeaning: زنبق؛ نبات طويل ذو زهر كبير أبيض أو أصفر أو برتقالي غالباً
entries.example: A white lily stood in a tall vase.

entries.definitionEn: An arm or a leg. Also a large branch of a tree.
entries.arabicMeaning: طرف من الجسم كيد أو رجل؛ أو غصن كبير من شجرة
entries.example: He rested his injured limb on a cushion.

entries.definitionEn: The greatest amount, number, or level that is allowed or possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدّ أقصى مسموح أو ممكن من مقدار أو عدد أو مستوى
entries.example: There is a speed limit on this road.

entries.definitionEn: To keep something within a particular amount, number, or range.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّ شيئاً في مقدار أو عدد أو نطاق معيّن
entries.example: The school limits the number of students in each class.

entries.definitionEn: A rule or fact that restricts something. Also a weakness that reduces what someone can do.
entries.arabicMeaning: قيد يضيّق أمراً؛ أو ضعف يحدّ مما يستطيعه المرء
entries.example: The main limitation of the plan is cost.

entries.definitionEn: Not very great in amount, number, or extent.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدود في المقدار أو العدد أو المدى
entries.example: We have a limited amount of time.

entries.definitionEn: Having no end or boundary; seeming to have no limit.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا حدّ له؛ يبدو بلا نهاية أو قيد
entries.example: The view from the cliff seemed limitless.

entries.definitionEn: To walk with difficulty because one leg or foot is injured or weak.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرج في مشيه لضعف أو إصابة في رجل أو قدم
entries.example: He limped home after twisting his ankle.

entries.definitionEn: A long thin mark. Also a row of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط رفيع طويل؛ أو صف من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: Draw a straight line under the title.

entries.definitionEn: To form a row along the edge of something. Also to cover the inside of something with a layer of material.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصطفّ على امتداد شيء؛ أو يبطّن داخله بمادة
entries.example: Trees line the road to the village.

entries.definitionEn: Arranged in a straight line, or progressing in a simple sequence from one stage to the next.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطّي؛ مرتّب على خط مستقيم أو يسير في تتابع بسيط مرحلة فمرحلة
entries.example: The plot follows a linear sequence of events.

entries.definitionEn: In a straight line, or in a steady one-to-one way as one thing changes with another.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو خطّي؛ باستقامة أو بنسبة ثابتة مع تغيّر شيء آخر
entries.example: Costs rose linearly with the number of guests.

entries.definitionEn: Cloth made from the flax plant. Also sheets, tablecloths, and similar household textiles.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتان؛ أو بياضات البيت من ملاءات ومفارش ونحوها
entries.example: She changed the bed linen on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A large ship that carries passengers on long journeys.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفينة ركاب كبيرة للرحلات الطويلة
entries.example: They crossed the ocean on a passenger liner.

entries.definitionEn: A long-bodied sea fish of northern waters, related to the cod and used as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمك اللينغ؛ سمك بحري طويل الجسم من المياه الشمالية يُؤكل، وهو قريب من القدّ
entries.example: The market stall was selling smoked ling.

entries.definitionEn: To stay somewhere longer than necessary. Also, of a feeling or smell, to remain for a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتلكأ في مكان أكثر من الحاجة؛ أو يبقى أثر شعور أو رائحة حيناً
entries.example: We lingered in the café after finishing our coffee.

entries.definitionEn: A connection between two people, things, or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: رابط أو صلة بين شخصين أو شيئين أو فكرتين
entries.example: There is a strong link between exercise and sleep.

entries.definitionEn: To connect two or more people, things, or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط بين أشخاص أو أشياء أو أفكار
entries.example: The bridge links the island to the mainland.

entries.definitionEn: A large wild cat of Africa and India. The male has a thick mane around its head.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسد؛ قطّ بري كبير في أفريقيا والهند، وللذكر لبدة حول رأسه
entries.example: The lion rested in the tall grass.

entries.definitionEn: One of the two soft edges of the mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: شفة؛ أحد طرفي الفم الليّنين
entries.example: She bit her lip and said nothing.

entries.definitionEn: In the form of a liquid; not solid or gas.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائل؛ ليس صلباً ولا غازاً
entries.example: Water is liquid at room temperature.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that can flow, such as water or oil, and is not a solid or a gas.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائل يجري كالماء أو الزيت، ليس صلباً ولا غازاً
entries.example: Add a little liquid to the pan so the rice does not stick.

entries.definitionEn: A series of names, items, or things written one after another.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائمة أسماء أو بنود تُكتب الواحد تلو الآخر
entries.example: I made a list of things to buy.

entries.definitionEn: To write or say items one after another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُدرج بنوداً واحداً تلو الآخر كتابة أو نطقاً
entries.example: Please list your skills on the form.

entries.definitionEn: To pay attention to a sound, or to what someone is saying.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستمع إلى صوت أو إلى كلام أحد
entries.example: Please listen to the teacher.

entries.definitionEn: A person who listens, especially to the radio or to someone speaking.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستمع؛ ولا سيما إلى الراديو أو إلى متحدث
entries.example: The radio show has millions of listeners.

entries.definitionEn: A unit for measuring liquid, equal to 1,000 millilitres.
entries.arabicMeaning: لتر؛ وحدة حجم للسوائل تساوي ألف مليلتر
entries.example: This bottle holds one litre of water.

entries.definitionEn: The basic, original meaning of a word or phrase, not a figurative one.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفي؛ المعنى الأصلي للكلمة لا المجازي
entries.example: The literal meaning of the phrase is quite different from how people use it.

entries.definitionEn: According to the most basic meaning of the words, not as an image or exaggeration.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفياً؛ وفق المعنى الأصلي لا على سبيل التصوير أو المبالغة
entries.example: The word is not meant literally in this sentence.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with literature, especially novels, plays, and poetry of lasting value.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدبي؛ متصل بالأدب من روايات ومسرح وشعر ذي قيمة باقية
entries.example: She is taking a course in literary studies.

entries.definitionEn: Novels, plays, poetry, and other written works that are valued as art.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدب؛ روايات ومسرحيات وشعر وغيرها مما يُعدّ فناً مكتوباً
entries.example: He is studying English literature at university.

entries.definitionEn: Paper, bottles, and other waste left in a public place. Also a group of baby animals born to one mother at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: قمامة ملقاة في مكان عام؛ أو بطن من صغار الحيوان وُلدوا معاً
entries.example: Please take your litter home from the beach.

entries.definitionEn: Small in size. Also young, in phrases such as little brother.
entries.arabicMeaning: صغير الحجم؛ أو صغير السن في نحو الأخ الصغير
entries.example: They live in a little house near the river.

entries.definitionEn: Used, often with a, to mean slightly or to a small degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليلاً؛ تُستعمل وغالباً مع a بمعنى إلى حدّ يسير
entries.example: I was a little cold, so I put on a jumper.

entries.definitionEn: Used before an uncountable noun to mean not much of it, often with the sense that the amount is too small.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل من؛ تسبق اسماً غير معدود بمعنى المقدار النزر، وغالباً أنه دون الحاجة
entries.example: There is little milk left in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: Not much of something already understood; a very small amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: القليل؛ مقدار يسير مما يُفهم من السياق
entries.example: Little is known about his early years.

entries.definitionEn: Happening now and seen or heard as it happens, not recorded. Also not dead, of animals or wires that carry electricity.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباشر يُرى أو يُسمع لحظة وقوعه لا مسجّلاً؛ أو حيّ، أو موصّل بالكهرباء
entries.example: We watched a live match on television.

entries.definitionEn: To have your home in a place. Also to be alive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسكن في مكان؛ أو يعيش أي يكون حيّاً
entries.example: They live in a small flat near the station.

entries.definitionEn: Full of energy, movement, or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوي مفعم بالحركة والنشاط أو الاهتمام
entries.example: The market is lively on Saturday morning.

entries.definitionEn: A large organ in the body that helps process food and clean the blood. Also this organ eaten as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكبد؛ عضو كبير يعين على هضم الطعام وتنقية الدم، ويُؤكل أيضاً
entries.example: The doctor asked about her liver after the blood test.

entries.definitionEn: Alive now; not dead.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيّ في هذا الوقت؛ غير ميّت
entries.example: All living things need water.

entries.definitionEn: The money you earn in order to pay for the things you need. Also a way of life.
entries.arabicMeaning: رزق يُكتسب لسدّ الحاجة؛ أو نمط عيش
entries.example: She makes a living as a translator.

entries.definitionEn: The main room in a house where people sit and relax.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة المعيشة؛ الغرفة الرئيسة للجلوس والراحة في البيت
entries.example: They were sitting in the living room.

entries.definitionEn: Something heavy that is carried or transported. Also the amount of work a person or machine has to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمولة تُحمل أو تُنقل؛ أو مقدار العمل على شخص أو آلة
entries.example: The truck carried a heavy load of bricks.

entries.definitionEn: To put a large amount of things into a vehicle, machine, or container.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحمّل مركبة أو آلة أو وعاء بمقدار كبير من الأشياء
entries.example: They loaded the boxes into the van.

entries.definitionEn: Bread that has been baked in one piece, usually in a shape that can be sliced.
entries.arabicMeaning: رغيف خبز يُخبز قطعة واحدة تُقطَّع عادة شرائح
entries.example: I bought a loaf of bread on the way home.

entries.definitionEn: Money that a bank or person lends you, which you must pay back, usually with interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرض يُردّ عادة مع فائدة
entries.example: He took out a loan to buy a car.

entries.definitionEn: The large area just inside the entrance of a hotel or other public building.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهو المدخل في فندق أو مبنى عام
entries.example: We waited for her in the hotel lobby.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with a particular area, especially the one near you.
entries.arabicMeaning: محلي؛ متصل بمنطقة معيّنة ولا سيما القريبة منك
entries.example: She shops at the local market.

entries.definitionEn: To find the exact position of someone or something. Also to put something in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدد موضع شخص أو شيء بدقة؛ أو يضع شيئاً في مكان معيّن
entries.example: We could not locate the keys anywhere.

entries.definitionEn: A place or position, especially in relation to other things.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقع أو موضع، ولا سيما بالنسبة إلى ما حوله
entries.example: The hotel is in a quiet location near the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A device that fastens a door, drawer, or container so that it can be opened only with a key or code.
entries.arabicMeaning: قفل يثبّت باباً أو درجاً فلا يُفتح إلا بمفتاح أو رمز
entries.example: The lock on the door is broken.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something with a lock. Also to become or make something become fixed so that it cannot move.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقفل شيئاً بالقفل؛ أو يثبّته حتى لا يتحرك
entries.example: Remember to lock the door when you leave.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to move from one place to another, or the act of doing so.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة التنقّل من موضع إلى آخر، أو فعل ذلك
entries.example: Injury can restrict locomotion in older animals.

entries.definitionEn: A railway engine that pulls a train.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاطرة؛ محرّك سكة حديد يجرّ القطار
entries.example: The locomotive pulled a long line of freight cars.

entries.definitionEn: A small house in the country, often used for a short stay. Also a small building at the entrance to a larger one.
entries.arabicMeaning: نُزل ريفي صغير للإقامة القصيرة؛ أو بيت عند مدخل مبنى أكبر
entries.example: They rented a lodge in the mountains for a week.

entries.definitionEn: To make a formal complaint, protest, or claim. Also to become firmly stuck in a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّم شكوى أو احتجاجاً أو مطالبة رسمية؛ أو ينحشر في موضع فيثبت فيه
entries.example: She decided to lodge a formal complaint.

entries.definitionEn: A thick piece of wood cut from a tree, used especially for burning.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذع أو كتلة خشب غليظة تُقطع من شجرة، وغالباً للوقود
entries.example: He put another log on the fire.

entries.definitionEn: A careful way of thinking that uses reason. Also the set of reasons for a decision or belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطق؛ تفكير متأنّ قائم على العقل، أو وجاهة أسباب قرار أو اعتقاد
entries.example: I could not follow the logic of his argument.

entries.definitionEn: Reasonable and based on clear thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطقي؛ معقول قائم على تفكير بيّن
entries.example: It seemed the logical thing to do.

entries.definitionEn: A small design used as the official sign of a company or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعار؛ رسم صغير يُتَّخذ علامة رسمية لشركة أو هيئة
entries.example: The company's logo is printed on every bag.

entries.definitionEn: To stand or wait in a public place with no clear purpose, often in a way that bothers others.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسكع في مكان عام بلا غرض بيّن، وغالباً على نحو يزعج الناس
entries.example: A sign asked people not to loiter outside the shop.

entries.definitionEn: The unhappy feeling of being alone or of having no close companions.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحدة؛ شعور بالكآبة من الانفراد أو فقد الأنيس
entries.example: He felt a deep loneliness after his friends moved away.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy because you are alone or have no friends nearby.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحيد حزين لغيبة الأنيس أو الأصحاب
entries.example: She felt lonely in the new city.

entries.definitionEn: Measuring a great distance from one end to the other, or lasting a great amount of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: طويل مسافة من طرف إلى طرف، أو طويل مدة
entries.example: It was a long walk to the station.

entries.definitionEn: For a great amount of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: طويلاً؛ لمدة كبيرة من الوقت
entries.example: Have you been waiting long?

entries.definitionEn: Covering or travelling a great distance, such as a call, journey, or race.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيد المدى؛ لمسافة كبيرة كمكالمة أو رحلة أو سباق
entries.example: She made a long-distance call to her parents.

entries.definitionEn: Continuing for a long period into the future, not only for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: طويل الأمد؛ يمتد حيناً طويلاً في المستقبل لا وقتاً قصيراً فحسب
entries.example: They made a long-term plan for the business.

entries.definitionEn: An act of turning your eyes towards something. Also the appearance of a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرة؛ فعل توجيه العينين. وأيضاً هيئة شخص أو شيء
entries.example: Take a look at this photo.

entries.definitionEn: To turn your eyes towards something so that you can see it. Also to seem.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظر إلى شيء ليراه؛ وأيضاً يبدو
entries.example: Look at the board, please.

entries.definitionEn: To appear as a large, often threatening shape. Also, of a problem or event, to seem about to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوح شكلاً كبيراً مهيباً غالباً؛ أو يوشك أمر أو مشكلة أن يقع
entries.example: A difficult decision loomed at the end of the week.

entries.definitionEn: Not firmly fixed in place. Also, of clothes, not tight on the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخلخل غير مشدود في موضعه؛ أو فضفاض من الثياب
entries.example: The screw is loose and needs tightening.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not tight, exact, or strictly controlled.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو فضفاض أو غير دقيق أو غير صارم الضبط
entries.example: The scarf was loosely tied around her neck.

entries.definitionEn: A large motor vehicle used for carrying goods by road.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاحنة كبيرة لنقل البضائع في الطريق
entries.example: A lorry delivered the furniture this morning.

entries.definitionEn: To no longer have something because you cannot find it, or because it is taken away. Also to fail to win.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفقد شيئاً لأنه ضاع أو أُخذ؛ أو يخسر فلا يفوز
entries.example: Do not lose your ticket.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of no longer having something. Also money lost in business, or the death of a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقدان شيء؛ أو خسارة مالية في عمل، أو وفاة شخص
entries.example: They were upset by the loss of the old tree.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to find your way. Also that cannot be found, or that you no longer have.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضائع لا يهتدي إلى طريقه؛ أو مفقود لا يُعثر عليه
entries.example: We got lost on the way to the hotel.

entries.definitionEn: Used in a lot to mean very much or very often.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل في a lot بمعنى كثيراً جداً أو مراراً
entries.example: I like this café a lot.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of land used for a particular purpose, such as parking. Also a group of things of one kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة أرض لغرض معيّن كوقوف السيارات؛ أو مجموعة من الأشياء من نوع واحد
entries.example: They parked on the empty lot beside the school.

entries.definitionEn: Used in a lot to mean a large amount or number of something already understood.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل في a lot بمعنى مقدار أو عدد كبير مما يُفهم من السياق
entries.example: We learned a lot on the trip.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which people buy tickets with numbers and can win money if their numbers are chosen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يانصيب؛ لعبة تُشترى فيها تذاكر بأرقام وقد يفوز صاحب الرقم بالجائزة
entries.example: She bought a lottery ticket at the shop.

entries.definitionEn: Making a lot of noise; easy to hear because the sound is strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالٍ الصوت؛ قوي الضجيج سهل السماع
entries.example: The music was too loud for conversation.

entries.definitionEn: In a loud voice; with a lot of sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصوت عالٍ
entries.example: Please do not talk so loud in the library.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that makes a lot of noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصوت عالٍ كثير الضجيج
entries.example: Someone knocked loudly on the door.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment that makes sound louder so that many people can hear it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكبّر صوت يرفع الصوت ليسمعه جمع من الناس
entries.example: A loudspeaker announced the next train.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: very bad or of poor quality. Also feeling unwell.
entries.arabicMeaning: رديء جداً في الكلام الدارج؛ أو على غير ما يرام من وعكة
entries.example: The food was lousy and the service was slow.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of liking and caring for someone. Also a strong interest in something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حب شديد لشخص مع عناية به؛ أو ولع شديد بشيء
entries.example: He has a great love of cooking.

entries.definitionEn: To have a strong feeling of liking and caring for someone. Also to enjoy something very much.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحب شخصاً حباً شديداً؛ أو يستمتع بشيء جداً
entries.example: I love this song.

entries.definitionEn: Beautiful, or very pleasant and enjoyable.
entries.arabicMeaning: جميل أو ممتع جداً
entries.example: What a lovely day for a walk.

entries.definitionEn: A person who likes something very much. Also a person in a romantic relationship with someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: محب لشيء ولعاً شديداً؛ أو حبيب في علاقة عاطفية
entries.example: She is a lover of classical music.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows love or great care.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمحبة أو بعناية شديدة
entries.example: He packed the old letters lovingly into a box.

entries.definitionEn: Not high, or small in amount, level, or value.
entries.arabicMeaning: منخفض؛ أو قليل في المقدار أو المستوى أو القيمة
entries.example: The table is too low for the chairs.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a low position, level, or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: على انخفاض في الموضع أو المستوى أو المقدار
entries.example: The plane flew low over the fields.

entries.definitionEn: To move something down, or to make an amount or level smaller.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفض شيئاً إلى أسفل، أو يقلّل مقداراً أو مستوى
entries.example: Please lower your voice in the corridor.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land that is fairly flat and not high above sea level.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض منخفضة مستوية نسبياً قريبة من سطح البحر
entries.example: Farming is easier in the lowland than in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: Always supporting a person, group, or idea, and not changing that support.
entries.arabicMeaning: وفيّ لشخص أو جماعة أو فكرة لا يحوّل عنها
entries.example: She has remained loyal to her oldest friends.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being loyal; steady support for a person, group, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولاء؛ ثبات النصرة لشخص أو جماعة أو فكرة
entries.example: The team is known for its loyalty to the coach.

entries.definitionEn: Good or bad things that happen to you by chance, not because of your own effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظ؛ ما يصيب المرء خيراً أو شرّاً من غير سعيه
entries.example: He wished her luck before the exam.

entries.definitionEn: Because of good luck; in a way that is fortunate.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحسن الحظ
entries.example: Luckily, the train was late, so we still caught it.

entries.definitionEn: Having good luck, or bringing good luck.
entries.arabicMeaning: محظوظ أو جالب لليُمن
entries.example: You are lucky to have such kind neighbours.

entries.definitionEn: Producing a large amount of money or profit.
entries.arabicMeaning: مربح يدرّ مالاً كثيراً
entries.example: She found a lucrative job in the city.

entries.definitionEn: So unreasonable or unsuitable that it deserves to be laughed at; absurd.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخيف إلى حدّ يثير الضحك؛ باطل لا يُعقل
entries.example: The suggestion was ludicrous and nobody took it seriously.

entries.definitionEn: In a ludicrous way; to a degree that is absurd.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو سخيف؛ إلى درجة لا تُعقل
entries.example: The tickets were ludicrously expensive for such a short trip.

entries.definitionEn: The bags and cases you take with you when you travel. It is usually uncountable.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمتعة السفر: الحقائب والصناديق التي تأخذها في الرحلة، وغالباً غير معدودة
entries.example: She put her luggage on a trolley at the hotel.

entries.definitionEn: A meal that you eat in the middle of the day.
entries.arabicMeaning: غداء: وجبة منتصف النهار
entries.example: We had lunch at twelve.

entries.definitionEn: The time of day when people usually eat lunch.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقت الغداء
entries.example: The office is quiet at lunchtime.

entries.definitionEn: One of the two organs in your chest that you use for breathing.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئة: أحد العضوين في الصدر للتنفس
entries.example: The doctor listened to her left lung.

entries.definitionEn: Unpleasantly bright in colour, or shocking in a cheap, sensational way, especially about crime or violence.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاقع مزعج في لونه، أو صادم بأسلوب رخيص مثير، وخصوصاً في وصف الجريمة أو العنف
entries.example: The paper printed a lurid account of the crime.

entries.definitionEn: In a shockingly bright or cheaply sensational way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو فاقع أو مثير بشكل رخيص صادم
entries.example: The alley was luridly lit in orange and pink.

entries.definitionEn: Growing thick, green, and healthy, especially of plants. Also rich and luxurious.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيف ناضر، وخصوصاً للنبات؛ ويوصف به أيضاً ما هو فاخر ووفير
entries.example: The garden looked lush after the spring rain.

entries.definitionEn: A strong sexual desire. Also a powerful desire for something such as power or money.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهوة شديدة؛ وأيضاً رغبة عارمة في شيء كالسلطة أو المال
entries.example: Ambition in him had hardened into a lust for power.

entries.definitionEn: Very comfortable, elegant, and expensive.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاخر ومريح وأنيق إلى حدّ باهظ
entries.example: They spent the night in a luxurious hotel.

entries.definitionEn: Designed to be expensive and of very high quality, used before a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاخر: يصف سلعاً أو خدمات باهظة عالية الجودة، ويأتي قبل الاسم
entries.example: She bought a luxury watch for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Great comfort that costs a lot of money. Also something pleasant that you do not really need.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترف ورفاهية باهظة؛ وأيضاً شيء ممتع لست مضطراً إليه
entries.example: A quiet weekend felt like a luxury after the busy month.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the words of a song, or with short poems about personal feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بكلمات الأغنية، أو بالشعر الغنائي القصير الذي يعبّر عن المشاعر
entries.example: She wrote a short lyric poem about the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Expressing strong feeling in a beautiful, songlike way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاعري غنائي يعبّر عن عاطفة قوية بجمال
entries.example: Her letter was almost lyrical in its praise of the landscape.

entries.definitionEn: In a lyrical, songlike, or emotionally poetic way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب شاعري غنائي
entries.example: He wrote lyrically about his childhood by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes the words of songs.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب كلمات الأغاني
entries.example: The lyricist finished the chorus in an afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: The words of a song.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمات الأغنية
entries.example: She learned the lyrics before the concert.

entries.definitionEn: The short form of am, used after I.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختصار am بعد الضمير I
entries.example: I'm ready to leave now.

entries.definitionEn: Disturbing because it deals with death or violence in a grim, fascinated way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروع قاتم يتعلق بالموت أو العنف على نحو يثير اهتماماً مشوباً بالرهبة
entries.example: The novel has a macabre sense of humour.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment with moving parts that does a particular job.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة ذات أجزاء متحركة تؤدي عملاً معيناً
entries.example: This machine washes the dishes.

entries.definitionEn: Very angry. Also not thinking clearly, or behaving in a wild or foolish way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غاضب جداً؛ وأيضاً غير عاقل أو أحمق في سلوكه
entries.example: She was mad at him for being late.

entries.definitionEn: A polite way to address a woman, especially a customer or in formal speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيدة: خطاب مهذب لامرأة، وخصوصاً زبونة أو في كلام رسمي
entries.example: How can I help you, madam?

entries.definitionEn: A French title for a woman, used before a name or as a polite form of address.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدام: لقب فرنسي لامرأة يُستخدم قبل الاسم أو في الخطاب المهذب
entries.example: Madame Laurent opened the shop at nine.

entries.definitionEn: Very foolish behaviour. Also serious mental illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماقة بالغة؛ وأيضاً جنون أو مرض عقلي خطير
entries.example: It would be madness to swim in this storm.

entries.definitionEn: A situation of violent confusion and upheaval. Originally a powerful whirlpool.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوامة فوضى عنيفة؛ وأصل الكلمة دوامة مائية هائلة
entries.example: The company was caught in a maelstrom of rumours.

entries.definitionEn: A great musician, especially a conductor. Also a master of any art or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميسترو: موسيقي عظيم ولا سيما قائد أوركسترا؛ ويُطلق أيضاً على أستاذ أي فن
entries.example: The maestro raised his baton and the hall fell silent.

entries.definitionEn: A thin book with pictures and articles that comes out regularly.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجلة: مطبوعة دورية بصور ومقالات
entries.example: I read an article in a travel magazine.

entries.definitionEn: The soft larva of a fly, often found in rotting food.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرقة ذبابة رخوة، كثيراً ما توجد في الطعام المتعفن
entries.example: A maggot crawled out of the old fruit.

entries.definitionEn: Using special powers that are not real, or seeming to have those powers.
entries.arabicMeaning: سحري: يستخدم قوى خارقة غير حقيقية، أو يبدو كذلك
entries.example: The children loved the magic show.
