entries.definitionEn: Special powers that make impossible things happen, in stories or in tricks.
entries.arabicMeaning: سحر: قوى تجعل المستحيل يحدث، في القصص أو في الخدع
entries.example: She does not believe in magic.

entries.definitionEn: Wonderful in a way that seems like magic.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحر: رائع كأنه من عالم السحر
entries.example: The quiet lake looked magical at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does magic tricks, or who uses magic in stories.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحر يؤدي خدع السحر، أو يستخدم السحر في القصص
entries.example: A magician pulled a bird from his hat.

entries.definitionEn: Generous and forgiving behaviour, especially toward a rival or someone weaker.
entries.arabicMeaning: سماحة ونبل في العفو، وخصوصاً تجاه خصم أو شخص أضعف
entries.example: The winner showed magnanimity toward the team that lost.

entries.definitionEn: Generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمح نبيل يعفو، وخصوصاً تجاه خصمه
entries.example: She was magnanimous in victory and praised her rival.

entries.definitionEn: In a generous and forgiving way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسماحة ونبل في العفو
entries.example: He magnanimously shared the credit with the whole team.

entries.definitionEn: A wealthy and powerful person in business or industry.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطب: رجل أعمال ثري نافذ في صناعة أو تجارة
entries.example: The oil magnate donated a wing to the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Able to attract iron or steel. Also having a powerful personal attraction.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغناطيسي يجذب الحديد؛ وأيضاً ذو جاذبية شخصية قوية
entries.example: Keep bank cards away from magnetic fields.

entries.definitionEn: By magnetism, or as if pulled by a magnet.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغناطيسياً، أو كأن قوة مغناطيس تشدّه
entries.example: The door closes magnetically.

entries.definitionEn: The physical force that magnets have. Also a person's power to attract others.
entries.arabicMeaning: المغناطيسية قوة فيزيائية في المغناطيس؛ وأيضاً جاذبية الشخص للآخرين
entries.example: The experiment showed the magnetism of the iron bar.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely impressive and beautiful.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع باهر في جماله أو فخامته
entries.example: The palace has a magnificent view of the river.

entries.definitionEn: To make something look larger than it is. Also to make a problem seem more serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكبّر صورة الشيء؛ أو يضخّم مشكلة حتى تبدو أخطر
entries.example: This lens will magnify the tiny print.

entries.definitionEn: A black-and-white bird often said to collect shiny objects. Also a person who gathers odds and ends.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقعق: طائر أبيض وأسود يُعرف بجمع الأشياء اللامعة؛ وأيضاً شخص يجمع شتّى الأشياء
entries.example: A magpie stole a shiny ring from the windowsill.

entries.definitionEn: Letters and packages sent through the post, or the system that delivers them.
entries.arabicMeaning: بريد: رسائل وطرود، أو نظام توصيلها
entries.example: The mail arrived before noon.

entries.definitionEn: To send something by post.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل شيئاً بالبريد
entries.example: Please mail this form to the office.

entries.definitionEn: A box in the street or at a house for sending or receiving letters.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندوق بريد لإرسال الرسائل أو استلامها
entries.example: She dropped the letter in the mailbox.

entries.definitionEn: Largest or most important.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيسي: الأكبر أو الأهم
entries.example: The main problem is the lack of time.

entries.definitionEn: The largest part of a meal, usually after a starter.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطبق الرئيسي في الوجبة، غالباً بعد المقبلات
entries.example: I ordered fish for the main course.

entries.definitionEn: For the most part; mostly.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساساً؛ في المقام الأول
entries.example: The shop sells mainly books and maps.

entries.definitionEn: To keep something in good condition, or to continue to have or say something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصون شيئاً ويبقيه صالحاً، أو يواصل امتلاك أمر أو التمسك بقول
entries.example: You must maintain the engine if you want it to last.

entries.definitionEn: The work of keeping a building, machine, or system in good condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيانة: عمل إبقاء مبنى أو آلة أو نظام في حال جيدة
entries.example: The building needs regular maintenance.

entries.definitionEn: Very large or important.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبير أو مهم جداً
entries.example: There has been a major change in the timetable.

entries.definitionEn: An army officer of middle rank. Also a student's main subject at university, especially in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائد في الجيش؛ وأيضاً التخصص الجامعي الرئيسي، وخصوصاً في الإنجليزية الأمريكية
entries.example: She is a biology major in her third year.

entries.definitionEn: Most of a group of people or things; more than half.
entries.arabicMeaning: أغلبية: أكثر من نصف مجموعة من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: The majority of staff voted to stay.

entries.definitionEn: The name of the company that produced a product, especially a car.
entries.arabicMeaning: طراز أو ماركة الصانع، وخصوصاً للسيارات
entries.example: What make is your car?

entries.definitionEn: Coloured creams and powders put on the face to change or improve appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكياج: مستحضرات تُوضع على الوجه لتغيير المظهر أو تحسينه
entries.example: She put on her make-up before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: To create or produce something. Also to cause something to happen or someone to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنع شيئاً أو ينتجه؛ وأيضاً يجعل أمراً يحدث أو يحمل شخصاً على فعل
entries.example: She can make a cake in twenty minutes.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that makes a particular thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: صانع: شخص أو شركة تصنع شيئاً معيناً
entries.example: He is a furniture maker in the old town.

entries.definitionEn: A disease, or a serious problem that affects a person, group, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: علة أو داء؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً لخلل خطير يصيب شخصاً أو جماعة أو نظاماً
entries.example: She suffered from a mysterious malady every winter.

entries.definitionEn: A serious disease spread by mosquitoes, causing fever and weakness.
entries.arabicMeaning: الملاريا: مرض خطير ينقله البعوض يسبب الحمى والضعف
entries.example: Travellers took tablets to prevent malaria.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to men or boys, or to the sex that produces sperm.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكري: متعلق بالرجال أو الصبيان، أو بالجنس الذي ينتج الحيوانات المنوية
entries.example: The male lion has a thick mane.

entries.definitionEn: A man or boy, or a male animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكر: رجل أو صبي، أو حيوان ذكر
entries.example: The vet said the puppy was a male.

entries.definitionEn: To fail to work correctly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعطّل أو يعمل على نحو خاطئ
entries.example: The printer began to malfunction during the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The wish to harm or upset someone; ill will.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقد ونية إلحاق الأذى أو الإساءة
entries.example: There was no malice in her joke.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to harm or upset someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبيث بقصد الإيذاء أو الإساءة
entries.example: Someone posted a malicious rumour about the shop.

entries.definitionEn: In a way intended to harm or upset someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخبث وقصد الإيذاء
entries.example: The files had been maliciously deleted.

entries.definitionEn: A large building with many shops inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجمّع تسوق كبير فيه متاجر كثيرة
entries.example: We spent the afternoon at the shopping mall.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being easily shaped, or of being easily influenced.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابلية التشكيل بسهولة، أو سهولة التأثر والانقياد
entries.example: Gold is valued for its malleability.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to shape by pressing or hammering. Also easily influenced.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للتشكيل بالضغط أو الطرق؛ وأيضاً سهل التأثير عليه
entries.example: Copper is a malleable metal.

entries.definitionEn: An informal or child's word for mother. Mamma is a variant spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماما: كلمة ودية أو طفولية للأم، وmamma إملاء بديل
entries.example: The child called out for her mama.

entries.definitionEn: An adult male person.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل: ذكر بالغ
entries.example: That man is my neighbour.

entries.definitionEn: To work at a place or operate equipment, providing the people needed for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشغّل موقعاً أو جهازاً بتوفير العاملين اللازمين له
entries.example: Volunteers will man the phones all night.

entries.definitionEn: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult. Also to be in charge of people or work.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمكن من فعل شيء وخصوصاً إن صعب؛ وأيضاً يدير أناساً أو عملاً
entries.example: Did you manage to finish the report?

entries.definitionEn: The people who run a company or organization, or the skill of running it.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإدارة: من يديرون شركة أو مؤسسة، أو مهارة تسييرها
entries.example: The hotel is under new management.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is in charge of a team, shop, or part of a company.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدير مسؤول عن فريق أو متجر أو قسم في شركة
entries.example: Ask the manager if you can change the booking.

entries.definitionEn: To damage something badly by crushing or twisting it. Also to ruin a speech or performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسحق أو يلوي حتى يتشوه الشيء تشوهاً بالغاً؛ وأيضاً يفسد كلاماً أو أداءً
entries.example: The machine will mangle the fabric if you force it.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and a large stone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مانجو: فاكهة استوائية حلوة بلحم برتقالي ونواة كبيرة
entries.example: He sliced a ripe mango for dessert.

entries.definitionEn: A treatment that cleans, shapes, and sometimes paints the fingernails.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناية بأظافر اليدين: تنظيف وتقليم وقد يشمل الطلاء
entries.example: She booked a manicure for Friday afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To clean, shape, or paint someone's fingernails.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجري عناية لأظافر اليدين تنظيفاً وتقليماً أو طلاءً
entries.example: The salon will manicure her nails before the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: To control someone or something, often unfairly. Also to handle an object or data with skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلاعب أو يتحكم، وغالباً بغير إنصاف؛ وأيضاً يحرّك شيئاً أو بيانات بمهارة
entries.example: He tried to manipulate the results of the survey.

entries.definitionEn: The act of controlling people, facts, or objects, often unfairly, or of handling something skilfully.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلاعب أو تحكم غير منصف في الناس أو الوقائع؛ أو معالجة ماهرة لشيء
entries.example: The film is a study of emotional manipulation.

entries.definitionEn: Human beings as a group; the human race.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنس البشري؛ بنو الإنسان جماعةً
entries.example: The invention changed the history of mankind.

entries.definitionEn: The way that someone does something or behaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة فعل الشيء أو أسلوب السلوك
entries.example: She spoke in a calm manner.

entries.definitionEn: A very large and impressive house.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصر أو منزل فخم واسع
entries.example: They grew up in a stone mansion on the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Done with the hands rather than by a machine. Also operated by hand rather than automatically.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدوي: يُنجز باليدين لا بالآلة، أو يُشغَّل يدوياً لا تلقائياً
entries.example: The job involves a lot of manual work.

entries.definitionEn: A book of instructions for using a machine or doing a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل تعليمات لاستخدام آلة أو لأداء عمل
entries.example: Read the manual before you switch the machine on.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making goods in large numbers, usually in a factory.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصنيع السلع بأعداد كبيرة، عادة في مصنع
entries.example: The manufacture of cars employs thousands here.

entries.definitionEn: To make goods in large numbers, usually in a factory.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنّع سلعاً بأعداد كبيرة، عادة في مصنع
entries.example: The factory will manufacture parts for aircraft.

entries.definitionEn: A company that makes goods in a factory.
entries.arabicMeaning: شركة مصنّعة تنتج السلع في مصنع
entries.example: Choose a manufacturer with a good safety record.

entries.definitionEn: The industry or activity of making goods in factories.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطاع التصنيع أو نشاط إنتاج السلع في المصانع
entries.example: Manufacturing still supports many local jobs.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a plural noun to mean a large number of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم قبل اسم جمع للدلالة على عدد كبير من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: There are many shops on this street.

entries.definitionEn: A large number of people or things already understood from the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يدل على عدد كبير من الناس أو الأشياء المفهومة من السياق
entries.example: Many have already left the hall.

entries.definitionEn: A drawing of an area that shows roads, towns, or countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: خريطة ترسم منطقة فتبيّن الطرق أو المدن أو البلدان
entries.example: I looked at the map to find the station.

entries.definitionEn: A tree with distinctive leaves, or the wood or sweet syrup that comes from it.
entries.arabicMeaning: قيقب: شجرة ذات أوراق مميزة، أو خشبها أو شرابها الحلو
entries.example: They sat under a maple in the park.

entries.definitionEn: A long running race of about 42 kilometres. Also any long, difficult activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماراثون: سباق جري طويل نحو 42 كيلومتراً؛ وأيضاً أي نشاط طويل شاق
entries.example: She trained for months before the marathon.

entries.definitionEn: A hard stone, often with coloured patterns, used in buildings and sculpture.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخام: حجر صلب كثيراً ما يكون مخططاً، يُستخدم في البناء والنحت
entries.example: The stairs were made of white marble.

entries.definitionEn: To walk with regular, firm steps, like soldiers.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسير بخطوات منتظمة حازمة كسير الجنود
entries.example: The soldiers march across the square every morning.

entries.definitionEn: The empty space at the edge of a page. Also the amount by which something is won, or the difference between cost and selling price.
entries.arabicMeaning: هامش الصفحة الفارغ؛ وأيضاً الفارق الذي يُحسم به أمر، أو الربح المضاف إلى التكلفة
entries.example: Leave a wide margin on the left of the page.

entries.definitionEn: Small and not very important. Also existing at the edge of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: هامشي: ضئيل الأهمية؛ أو واقع على الحافة
entries.example: The difference in cost was only marginal.

entries.definitionEn: Only slightly; by a small amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقدر ضئيل؛ على نحو طفيف
entries.example: This model is only marginally faster than the old one.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the sea and the living things in it.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحري: متعلق بالبحر وما يعيش فيه
entries.example: Oil can damage marine life.

entries.definitionEn: A sailor, especially one whose work is at sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحّار يعمل في البحر
entries.example: The old mariner knew every current along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A spot, line, or stain on a surface. Also a score given for a piece of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة أو بقعة على سطح؛ وأيضاً درجة تُعطى لعمل
entries.example: She got a good mark on the test.

entries.definitionEn: An amount added to the cost of something when it is sold.
entries.arabicMeaning: هامش ربح يُضاف إلى سعر التكلفة عند البيع
entries.example: The shop adds a 20 percent mark-up on imported goods.

entries.definitionEn: To put a written sign or score on something. Also to show a place or time as special.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع علامة مكتوبة أو يرصد درجة؛ وأيضاً يميّز مكاناً أو وقتاً
entries.example: Please mark the correct answers with a tick.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to notice; clear and definite.
entries.arabicMeaning: واضح جليّ يسهل ملاحظته
entries.example: There has been a marked improvement in her writing.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people buy and sell goods, especially food. Also the people who might buy a product.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوق يُشترى فيه ويُباع، وخصوصاً الطعام؛ وأيضاً جمهور المشترين المحتملين
entries.example: We bought fruit at the market.

entries.definitionEn: To advertise and sell a product in a planned way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسوّق منتجاً بالترويج له وبيعه وفق خطة
entries.example: They market the cream as a luxury product.

entries.definitionEn: How easy it is to sell a product or an idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى سهولة تسويق الشيء وبيعه
entries.example: Better packaging improved the marketability of the snack.

entries.definitionEn: The work of advertising and selling products.
entries.arabicMeaning: التسويق: عمل الترويج للمنتجات وبيعها
entries.example: She works in marketing for a food company.

entries.definitionEn: The legal relationship of two people as spouses, or the ceremony that begins it.
entries.arabicMeaning: زواج: الرابطة الشرعية بين زوجين، أو حفل عقده
entries.example: Their marriage lasted twenty years.

entries.definitionEn: Having a husband or wife.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزوج: له زوج أو زوجة
entries.example: They have been married for three years.

entries.definitionEn: To become someone's husband or wife.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتزوج شخصاً فيصير زوجاً أو زوجة له
entries.example: They plan to marry in June.

entries.definitionEn: A traditional system of fighting and self-defence, such as karate or judo.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن قتالي تقليدي للدفاع عن النفس، مثل الكاراتيه أو الجودو
entries.example: He has practised a martial art since he was a child.

entries.definitionEn: A wonderful and surprising person, thing, or achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعجوبة: شخص أو شيء أو إنجاز يثير الدهشة والإعجاب
entries.example: The bridge is an engineering marvel.

entries.definitionEn: To feel great surprise and admiration.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندهش بإعجاب شديد
entries.example: Visitors marvel at the size of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good or enjoyable. Marvellous is the usual British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً أو ممتع للغاية؛ وmarvellous الإملاء البريطاني الشائع
entries.example: We had a marvellous day at the beach.

entries.definitionEn: To crush food until it is soft.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهرس الطعام حتى يلين
entries.example: Mash the potatoes with a little butter.

entries.definitionEn: Something that covers the face, for protection, hiding, or a costume.
entries.arabicMeaning: قناع يغطي الوجه للحماية أو الإخفاء أو للتنكر
entries.example: Wear a mask if the air is dusty.

entries.definitionEn: Involving a large number of people at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: جماعي واسع النطاق يشمل عدداً كبيراً من الناس في آن
entries.example: The flood caused mass evacuation of the town.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount or number of something. Also the amount of matter in an object.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتلة كبيرة أو كمية ضخمة؛ وأيضاً مقدار المادة في جسم
entries.example: A mass of dark cloud covered the hills.

entries.definitionEn: The killing of a large number of people at one time, especially people who cannot defend themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذبحة: قتل عدد كبير من الناس دفعة واحدة، وخصوصاً من لا يستطيعون الدفاع عن أنفسهم
entries.example: The museum records the massacre of that year.

entries.definitionEn: The rubbing and pressing of muscles to ease pain or help someone relax.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدليك يفرك العضلات ويضغطها لتخفيف الألم أو للاسترخاء
entries.example: A shoulder massage eased the stiffness.

entries.definitionEn: A man whose job is to give massages.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدلّك: رجل عمله تدليك الجسم
entries.example: The masseur worked on his injured back.

entries.definitionEn: Very large, heavy, or serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضخم جداً في حجمه أو ثقله أو خطورته
entries.example: A massive truck blocked the narrow street.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is highly skilled at something. Also a man who has control or authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: أستاذ ماهر في فن أو علم؛ وأيضاً سيد ذو سلطة أو سيطرة
entries.example: She is a master of classical guitar.

entries.definitionEn: A work of art of the highest quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحفة فنية من أعلى مراتب الجودة
entries.example: The painting is considered his masterpiece.

entries.definitionEn: Great skill or complete control of a subject or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: إتقان وسيطرة تامة على موضوع أو نشاط
entries.example: Years of practice gave her mastery of the language.

entries.definitionEn: A sports game between two teams or players. Also a small stick used to light a fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباراة رياضية بين فريقين أو لاعبين؛ وأيضاً عود ثقاب لإشعال النار
entries.example: The match starts at three.

entries.definitionEn: To be the same as something, or to go well with it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطابق شيئاً أو يناسبه وينسجم معه
entries.example: Your socks do not match.

entries.definitionEn: A friend, especially in informal British English. Also the sexual partner of an animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب أو صديق، وخصوصاً في الإنجليزية البريطانية غير الرسمية؛ وأيضاً زوج الحيوان
entries.example: He went to the cinema with his mate.

entries.definitionEn: Cloth, or any substance used to make things. Also facts or ideas used in a piece of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: قماش أو أي مادة يُصنع منها شيء؛ وأيضاً معطيات أو أفكار تُستخدم في عمل
entries.example: This material feels soft and light.

entries.definitionEn: The belief that money and possessions matter more than spiritual or intellectual values.
entries.arabicMeaning: المادية: تغليب المال والممتلكات على القيم الروحية أو الفكرية
entries.example: The essay criticizes modern materialism.

entries.definitionEn: Caring too much about money and possessions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادي الهوى: مفرط الاهتمام بالمال والممتلكات
entries.example: He feared he was becoming too materialistic.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming real or actually happening. Materialisation is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحقّق الأمر أو ظهوره فعلاً؛ وmaterialisation الإملاء البريطاني
entries.example: The materialization of the plan took another year.

entries.definitionEn: To appear or become real, especially after being hoped for or planned. Materialise is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحقق أو يظهر فعلاً بعد أن كان مأمولاً أو مخططاً؛ وmaterialise الإملاء البريطاني
entries.example: The promised funding did not materialize.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a mother, or typical of a mother's care.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمومي: متعلق بالأم أو بعطفها ورعايتها
entries.example: She felt a strong maternal bond with the child.

entries.definitionEn: Behaving in an overly mothering or protective way.
entries.arabicMeaning: متكلف دور الأم؛ حامٍ على نحو مفرط
entries.example: His maternalistic tone annoyed the adult students.

entries.definitionEn: The study of numbers, shapes, and amounts. Math is American; maths is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرياضيات: دراسة الأعداد والأشكال والمقادير؛ وmath أمريكية وmaths بريطانية
entries.example: She is good at maths.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to mathematics.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضي: متعلق بعلم الرياضيات
entries.example: He used a mathematical model to test the idea.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies or works with mathematics.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم رياضيات يدرس هذا العلم أو يعمل به
entries.example: The mathematician explained the proof in simple steps.

entries.definitionEn: The study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرياضيات: علم دراسة الأعداد والكميات والأشكال
entries.example: She teaches mathematics at the local college.

entries.definitionEn: A subject or situation that you need to deal with. Also the physical substance that things are made of.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر أو مسألة تحتاج معالجة؛ وأيضاً المادة التي تتكوّن منها الأشياء
entries.example: This is a private matter.

entries.definitionEn: To be important.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهمّ ويكون ذا أهمية
entries.example: Your opinion matters to the team.

entries.definitionEn: Fully grown or developed. Also sensible and adult in behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناضج مكتمل النمو؛ وأيضاً عاقل في سلوكه كالكبار
entries.example: He is mature for his age.

entries.definitionEn: A large, impressive building that holds a tomb.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضريح فخم: بناء كبير يضم قبراً
entries.example: Tourists visited the marble mausoleum at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: A person who thinks and acts independently, often against the usual way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص مستقل الرأي والفعل، كثيراً ما يخالف المألوف
entries.example: The designer was a maverick who ignored fashion trends.

entries.definitionEn: Informal short form of maximum; the highest amount allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحد الأقصى المسموح، بصيغة غير رسمية مختصرة من maximum
entries.example: Ten kilos is the max for cabin bags.

entries.definitionEn: As large, high, or great as possible or allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: أقصى ما يمكن أو يُسمح به من كبر أو ارتفاع أو قدر
entries.example: The maximum speed on this road is fifty.

entries.definitionEn: The largest amount or number that is possible or allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحد الأقصى الممكن أو المسموح من مقدار أو عدد
entries.example: You can borrow a maximum of four books.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is possible, or to ask for or give permission.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد للدلالة على الجواز أو لطلب الإذن أو منحه
entries.example: You may leave when you have finished.

entries.definitionEn: The fifth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: مايو / أيار: الشهر الخامس من السنة
entries.example: The flowers bloom in May.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربما: للدلالة على احتمال غير مؤكد
entries.example: Maybe we can meet after work.

entries.definitionEn: The elected leader of a town or city.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمدة أو رئيس بلدية منتخب لمدينة أو بلدة
entries.example: The mayor opened the new library.

entries.definitionEn: The form of I used after a verb or preposition, when you are the person receiving the action.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير نصب للمتكلم، يُستخدم بعد فعل أو حرف جر حين يقع الفعل عليك
entries.example: Please call me tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: Too small in amount or quality; barely enough. Meagre is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: شحيح زهيد لا يكاد يكفي؛ وmeagre الإملاء البريطاني
entries.example: They survived on a meagre diet of rice.

entries.definitionEn: Food eaten at one time, such as breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجبة تُؤكل دفعة واحدة مثل الفطور أو الغداء أو العشاء
entries.example: Dinner is my favourite meal.

entries.definitionEn: Unkind or cruel. Also not generous with money.
entries.arabicMeaning: لئيم أو قاسٍ؛ وأيضاً بخيل بالمال
entries.example: It was mean to laugh at her mistake.

entries.definitionEn: The average of a set of numbers, found by adding them and dividing by how many there are.
entries.arabicMeaning: المتوسط الحسابي: مجموع الأعداد مقسوماً على عددها
entries.example: The mean of 4, 6 and 8 is 6.

entries.definitionEn: To have a particular meaning, or to intend to say or do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعني معنى معيناً، أو يقصد أن يقول أو يفعل شيئاً
entries.example: What does this word mean?

entries.definitionEn: What a word, sign, or action expresses or represents.
entries.arabicMeaning: معنى: ما يعبّر عنه لفظ أو إشارة أو فعل
entries.example: Do you know the meaning of this sign?

entries.definitionEn: Having a clear purpose or important meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو معنى أو مغزى واضح الأهمية
entries.example: We had a meaningful talk about the future.

entries.definitionEn: Having no purpose, value, or real meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم المعنى أو الجدوى
entries.example: Without context the numbers are meaningless.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that has no purpose or meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو بلا معنى أو غاية
entries.example: He repeated the phrase meaninglessly, as if he no longer heard it.

entries.definitionEn: A method of doing something. Also the money or resources a person has.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيلة لفعل شيء؛ وأيضاً موارد الشخص المالية
entries.example: The tram is a cheap means of travel.

entries.definitionEn: In the time between two events, or at the same time as something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأثناء: في الوقت الفاصل، أو في الوقت نفسه
entries.example: I'll cook; meanwhile, you set the table.

entries.definitionEn: An official action taken to deal with a problem. Also a way of finding size or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجراء رسمي لمعالجة مشكلة؛ وأيضاً مقياس لمعرفة الحجم أو المقدار
entries.example: They introduced a new measure to cut waste.

entries.definitionEn: To find the size, length, or amount of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقيس حجم شيء أو طوله أو مقداره
entries.example: Measure the window before you buy the curtains.

entries.definitionEn: A number that shows size, length, or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: قياس: رقم يبيّن الحجم أو الطول أو المقدار
entries.example: Write down the measurement of each wall.

entries.definitionEn: The flesh of an animal used as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم الحيوان يُتخذ طعاماً
entries.example: Do you eat meat?

entries.definitionEn: A person who repairs machines, especially cars.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميكانيكي يصلح الآلات، وخصوصاً السيارات
entries.example: The mechanic repaired the brakes.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to machines. Also done without thought, like a machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميكانيكي متعلق بالآلات؛ وأيضاً آلي يُفعل بلا تفكير
entries.example: The clock has a mechanical movement.

entries.definitionEn: A system of parts that work together in a machine. Also a method by which something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلية: منظومة أجزاء تعمل معاً في آلة؛ وأيضاً طريقة يحدث بها أمر
entries.example: The lock has a simple mechanism.

entries.definitionEn: To introduce machines into a process so that it needs less human labour. Mechanise is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمَكْنن عملية بإدخال الآلات حتى تقلّ الحاجة إلى العمل اليدوي؛ وmechanise الإملاء البريطاني
entries.example: The farm began to mechanize the harvest.

entries.definitionEn: A metal disc given as a prize, especially in sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميدالية: قرص معدني يُمنح جائزة، وخصوصاً في الرياضة
entries.example: She won a gold medal in swimming.

entries.definitionEn: Newspapers, television, radio, and the internet as sources of news and public information.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسائل الإعلام من صحف وتلفزيون وراديو وإنترنت بوصفها مصادر للأخبار
entries.example: The story was all over the media.

entries.definitionEn: To help two sides in a disagreement reach an agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوسط بين طرفين مختلفين حتى يتفقا
entries.example: A lawyer was asked to mediate between the two families.

entries.definitionEn: The process of helping two sides in a disagreement reach an agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: وساطة: عملية مساعدة طرفين مختلفين على التوصل إلى اتفاق
entries.example: The dispute ended after months of mediation.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to illness, health, and doctors.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبي: متعلق بالمرض والصحة والأطباء
entries.example: He needed medical help after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: A medicine or set of medicines used to treat an illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: دواء أو مجموعة أدوية تُستعمل لعلاج مرض
entries.example: Take this medication twice a day.

entries.definitionEn: A substance you take to treat illness. Also the science of treating illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: دواء يُتناول لعلاج المرض؛ وأيضاً علم الطب
entries.example: This medicine tastes bitter.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the Middle Ages, roughly from the 5th to the 15th century. Mediaeval is a less common British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: من العصور الوسطى، تقريباً من القرن الخامس إلى الخامس عشر؛ وmediaeval إملاء بريطاني أقل شيوعاً
entries.example: We visited a medieval castle.

entries.definitionEn: Not very good; only average.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوسط رديء؛ ليس بالجودة ولا بالتميّز
entries.example: The meal was mediocre, not worth the price.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being only average and not at all impressive.
entries.arabicMeaning: رداءة التوسط: انعدام التميز والاكتفاء بما هو عادي
entries.example: He feared a life of comfortable mediocrity.

entries.definitionEn: To sit quietly and focus the mind, often as a calming or religious practice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأمل بهدوء مركّزاً ذهنه، غالباً للاطمئنان أو كعبادة
entries.example: She likes to meditate for ten minutes each morning.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of sitting quietly and focusing the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأمل: جلوس هادئ مع تركيز الذهن
entries.example: Meditation helps him sleep.

entries.definitionEn: The sea between southern Europe, North Africa, and western Asia, or the region around it.
entries.arabicMeaning: البحر الأبيض المتوسط بين جنوب أوروبا وشمال أفريقيا وغرب آسيا، أو المنطقة حوله
entries.example: They spent July on the Mediterranean.

entries.definitionEn: In the middle between small and large, or light and strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوسط بين الصغير والكبير، أو بين الخفيف والقوي
entries.example: I take a medium size in this shirt.

entries.definitionEn: A way of communicating or creating art. Also a middle size.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيلة تواصل أو إبداع فني؛ وأيضاً مقاس متوسط
entries.example: Television is a powerful medium.

entries.definitionEn: To come together with someone, by chance or by arrangement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتقي شخصاً مصادفة أو بموعد
entries.example: Let's meet at the café at six.

entries.definitionEn: An occasion when people come together to talk or decide something.
entries.arabicMeaning: اجتماع يجتمع فيه الناس للكلام أو لاتخاذ قرار
entries.example: The meeting starts at ten.

entries.definitionEn: Sad in a quiet, thoughtful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: كئيب حزين بهدوء وتأمل
entries.example: The music had a melancholy tone.

entries.definitionEn: A quiet, thoughtful sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: كآبة هادئة مشوبة بتأمل
entries.example: A quiet melancholy settled over the empty house.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant to hear, like a beautiful tune.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجي عذب كأنه لحن جميل
entries.example: A melodious voice came from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: In a pleasant, tuneful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلحن عذب مستساغ
entries.example: The birds sang melodiously at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A tune; a series of musical notes that form a song or theme.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحن: سلسلة نغمات تكوّن أغنية أو جملة موسيقية
entries.example: Hum the melody and I will find the chords.

entries.definitionEn: A large, sweet fruit with a thick skin and juicy flesh.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمام: فاكهة كبيرة حلوة ذات قشر سميك ولحم عصير
entries.example: She cut the melon into slices.

entries.definitionEn: To become liquid because of heat, or to make something do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذوب بالحرارة فيصير سائلاً، أو يذيب شيئاً
entries.example: The ice will melt in the sun.

entries.definitionEn: A person who belongs to a group, club, or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضو ينتمي إلى مجموعة أو نادٍ أو منظمة
entries.example: She is a member of the book club.

entries.definitionEn: The state of belonging to a group, or the people who belong to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضوية: الانتماء إلى جماعة، أو مجموع المنتمين إليها
entries.example: Annual membership costs forty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to remember because it is special or unusual.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُنسى لأنه مميز أو غير عادي
entries.example: It was a memorable evening by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: Something built or held to remember a person or event, especially after a death.
entries.arabicMeaning: نصب تذكاري أو مراسم لإحياء ذكرى شخص أو حدث، وخصوصاً بعد وفاة
entries.example: They stood in silence at the war memorial.

entries.definitionEn: To learn something so well that you can remember it exactly, without looking.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفظ شيئاً عن ظهر قلب حتى يسترجعه بدقة من غير أن ينظر إليه
entries.example: She spent the evening trying to memorize the poem.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to remember things. Also something that you remember from the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: الذاكرة: القدرة على التذكّر؛ وأيضاً ذكرى من الماضي
entries.example: I have a good memory for names.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing likely to cause harm. Also a threatening quality in someone's look or manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطر يتهدّد، أو شخص أو شيء يُخشى أذاه؛ وأيضاً نبرة تهديد في النظرة أو الهيئة
entries.example: That loose balcony is a menace to anyone walking below.

entries.definitionEn: Suggesting that harm or trouble is likely; having a threatening air.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُهدِّد؛ يوحي بأن أذى أو متاعب وشيكة
entries.example: A menacing silence filled the hallway after the lights went out.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that suggests harm or trouble is coming.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مُهدِّد يوحي باقتراب الأذى
entries.example: The dog growled menacingly when we approached the gate.

entries.definitionEn: To repair something that is broken or damaged. Also to improve a bad situation or relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُصلح ما انكسر أو تلف؛ وقد يعني أيضاً تحسين حال سيئة أو علاقة
entries.example: He offered to mend the torn curtain.

entries.definitionEn: Of work that needs little skill and is often seen as low in status, such as cleaning or fetching.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُقال للعمل الوضيع الذي لا يحتاج مهارة ويُعدّ قليل الشأن، كالتنظيف أو جلب الحاجات
entries.example: She took menial jobs in kitchens until her qualifications were recognised.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the mind, thoughts, or the way people think.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقلي أو ذهني؛ يتصل بالفكر أو بطريقة التفكير
entries.example: Chess is a mental challenge as well as a game.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the mind, not the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذهنياً؛ على نحو يتصل بالعقل لا بالجسد
entries.example: She was mentally tired after the long exam.

entries.definitionEn: A brief remark in which someone or something is named or spoken about.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشارة عابرة يُذكر فيها شخص أو شيء
entries.example: There was no mention of the delay in the email.

entries.definitionEn: To speak or write about someone or something, usually briefly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذكر شخصاً أو شيئاً في الكلام أو الكتابة، عادة باختصار
entries.example: Did she mention what time the train leaves?

entries.definitionEn: An experienced person who advises and helps someone with less experience, especially in work or study.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجّه خبير يرشد من هو أقل خبرة، ولا سيما في العمل أو الدراسة
entries.example: Her mentor at the office helped her prepare for the interview.

entries.definitionEn: A list of food and drinks in a restaurant. Also a list of choices on a computer or phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائمة الطعام والشراب في مطعم؛ وأيضاً قائمة خيارات على حاسوب أو هاتف
entries.example: We looked at the menu before we ordered.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with trade, merchants, and commercial business.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجاري؛ متصل بالتجارة والتجار والأعمال التجارية
entries.example: The old harbour still has a mercantile character, with warehouses along the quay.

entries.definitionEn: A professional soldier hired to fight for a country or group that is not their own.
entries.arabicMeaning: جندي مأجور يقاتل لقاء أجر في خدمة بلد أو جماعة ليست بلده
entries.example: The novel follows a mercenary who is paid to guard a remote camp.

entries.definitionEn: Goods that are bought and sold, especially in a shop or as branded products.
entries.arabicMeaning: بضاعة تُشترى وتُباع، ولا سيما في متجر أو كمنتجات تحمل علامة
entries.example: The shop window was full of sports merchandise.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose business is buying and selling goods, often in large amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: تاجر عمله شراء السلع وبيعها، وغالباً بكميات كبيرة
entries.example: The merchant imported tea and sold it to local shops.

entries.definitionEn: Kindness and forgiveness shown to someone you have the power to punish or harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحمة وعفو تُبدى لمن تملك القدرة على عقابه أو إيذائه
entries.example: The judge showed mercy and reduced the fine.

entries.definitionEn: Only; and nothing more than that.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجرد؛ ليس إلا، من غير زيادة على ذلك
entries.example: I was merely asking a question, not making a complaint.

entries.definitionEn: To combine or join together to form one thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدمج أو يندمج حتى يصير شيئاً واحداً
entries.example: The two companies agreed to merge next year.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being good enough to deserve praise, attention, or reward. Also a particular good point.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدارة تجعل الأمر أهلاً للثناء أو الاهتمام أو الجزاء؛ وأيضاً مزية معيّنة
entries.example: The proposal has merit, even if the budget is tight.

entries.definitionEn: To deserve something because of its quality or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحق شيئاً لما فيه من جودة أو أهمية
entries.example: The complaint merits a full investigation.

entries.definitionEn: Happy and cheerful.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح ومبتهج
entries.example: They had a merry evening with friends and music.

entries.definitionEn: To fit or work well together. Also to become caught or interlocked, as in a net or in gears.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتلاءم أو يعمل بتوافق؛ وقد يعني أيضاً أن يشتبك أو يتداخل كأسنان التروس أو خيوط الشبكة
entries.example: The new hours did not mesh with her childcare arrangements.

entries.definitionEn: Holding the attention as if by hypnosis; strangely fascinating.
entries.arabicMeaning: آسر يسحر الانتباه كأن به تنويماً؛ فاتن على نحو غريب
entries.example: The speaker's slow, even voice had a mesmeric effect on the room.

entries.definitionEn: A dirty or untidy state. Also a difficult or confused situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضى أو اتساخ؛ وأيضاً موقف عسير أو مختلط
entries.example: Please tidy this mess before guests arrive.

entries.definitionEn: To make something dirty or untidy, or to spoil it by handling it badly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوث أو يبعثر، أو يفسد الشيء بسوء التعامل معه
entries.example: Don't mess the papers on my desk.

entries.definitionEn: A board, on a wall or on a website, where people leave written messages for others to read.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة رسائل على جدار أو موقع يترك فيها الناس كتابات ليقرأها غيرهم
entries.example: She posted a question on the class message board.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of information that you send to someone, in writing, by phone, or by another person.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسالة: معلومة ترسلها إلى أحد كتابة أو بالهاتف أو عبر شخص آخر
entries.example: I left a message on your phone.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to carry a message from one person or place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسول أو حامل رسالة ينقلها من شخص أو مكان إلى آخر
entries.example: A messenger brought the signed papers to the office.

entries.definitionEn: Dirty or untidy. Also complicated and likely to cause trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضوي أو وسخ؛ وقد يعني أيضاً معقّداً كثير المتاعب
entries.example: The kitchen was messy after we cooked.

entries.definitionEn: A hard material such as iron, gold, or steel, often shiny and able to be melted and shaped.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدن صلب كالحديد أو الذهب أو الفولاذ، وغالباً لمّاع يمكن صهره وتشكيله
entries.example: The gate is made of metal.

entries.definitionEn: Of a road: given a hard surface of broken stone, tar, or similar material.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُقال للطريق إذا مُهِّد بسطح صلب من حصى أو قار أو ما شابه
entries.example: After the farm track we reached a metalled road.

entries.definitionEn: A way of describing something by saying it is something else, to show a likeness in a striking way.
entries.arabicMeaning: استعارة: تصف شيئاً بأنه شيء آخر لإبراز شبه لافت
entries.example: Poets often use the metaphor of time as a thief.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the science of weather, or to weather conditions themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرصادي؛ يتصل بعلم الطقس أو بأحوال الجو
entries.example: The meteorological office issued a warning of strong winds.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of the atmosphere and of weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الأرصاد الجوية: دراسة الغلاف الجوي والطقس
entries.example: She studied meteorology because she wanted to forecast storms.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of length in the metric system, a little longer than a yard. Meter is the usual American spelling; metre is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: متر: وحدة طول في النظام المتري، أطول قليلاً من الياردة؛ meter إملاء أمريكي وmetre بريطاني
entries.example: The pool is twenty-five metres long.

entries.definitionEn: A particular way of doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة معيّنة لعمل شيء
entries.example: This method of cooking keeps the vegetables firm.

entries.definitionEn: Done, or doing things, in a careful, ordered, and systematic way.
entries.arabicMeaning: منهجي مرتّب؛ يعمل أو يُنجَز بعناية ونظام
entries.example: He was methodical in checking every figure twice.

entries.definitionEn: Concerned with the methods used in a particular field of study or research.
entries.arabicMeaning: منهجي بمعنى المتصل بأساليب البحث في حقل علمي معيّن
entries.example: The paper raises a methodological question about how the sample was chosen.

entries.definitionEn: With regard to the methods of inquiry or research.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية المنهجية؛ بالنظر إلى أساليب البحث والاستقصاء
entries.example: The study is methodologically sound, even if the results are modest.

entries.definitionEn: A system of methods and principles used in a particular activity, especially in research.
entries.arabicMeaning: منهجية: منظومة طرائق ومبادئ تُتبع في نشاط معيّن، ولا سيما في البحث
entries.example: The team explained its methodology in the first chapter.

entries.definitionEn: Showing extreme care about small details; very precise.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد التدقيق في التفاصيل الدقيقة؛ بالغ الدقة
entries.example: Her notes were meticulous, with every source dated.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows extreme care for small details.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدقة متناهية وعناية بالتفاصيل الصغيرة
entries.example: He meticulously labelled each box before the move.

entries.definitionEn: Using or relating to the metric system of measurement, based on the metre and the kilogram.
entries.arabicMeaning: متري؛ يستخدم نظام القياس القائم على المتر والكيلوغرام أو يتصل به
entries.example: The recipe gives metric measurements in grams and millilitres.

entries.definitionEn: Informal word for a microcomputer, a small personal computer of an earlier kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ غير رسمي للحاسوب الصغير، وهو حاسوب شخصي صغير من جيل أقدم
entries.example: He learned to write simple programs on a classroom micro.

entries.definitionEn: A living thing that is too small to see without a microscope, especially one that can cause disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميكروب: كائن حي لا يُرى إلا بالمجهر، وخصوصاً ما قد يسبب مرضاً
entries.example: Washing your hands helps stop microbes from spreading.

entries.definitionEn: A small computer with a microprocessor, of the kind once used in homes, schools, and small offices.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسوب دقيق صغير بمعالج دقيق، مما كان يُستخدم في البيوت والمدارس والمكاتب الصغيرة
entries.example: The museum keeps an early microcomputer still able to run old software.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to one millionth of a metre. Micrometer is the usual American spelling; micrometre is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميكرومتر: وحدة طول تساوي جزءًا من مليون من المتر؛ micrometer إملاء أمريكي وmicrometre بريطاني
entries.example: The coating is only a few micrometres thick.

entries.definitionEn: A living thing too small to see without a microscope, such as a bacterium or virus.
entries.arabicMeaning: كائن دقيق لا يُرى بغير مجهر، كجرثومة أو فيروس
entries.example: Some microorganisms in soil help plants take up nutrients.

entries.definitionEn: A device that turns sound into an electrical signal so it can be recorded or made louder.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميكروفون: جهاز يحوّل الصوت إلى إشارة كهربائية للتسجيل أو التكبير
entries.example: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.

entries.definitionEn: A scientific instrument that makes very small things look large enough to study.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجهر: أداة علمية تكبر الأشياء الدقيقة حتى يمكن دراستها
entries.example: The students examined the leaf cells under a microscope.

entries.definitionEn: Too small to be seen without a microscope. Also extremely small.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجهري لا يُرى بغير مجهر؛ وأيضاً بالغ الصغر
entries.example: The water sample contained microscopic particles.

entries.definitionEn: The practice or technique of using a microscope to examine very small objects.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفحص المجهري: استخدام المجهر لدراسة الأشياء الدقيقة
entries.example: The lab specialises in microscopy of blood samples.

entries.definitionEn: An oven that cooks food quickly using microwave energy. Also a short electromagnetic wave of that kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرن ميكروويف يطبخ الطعام بسرعة بموجات قصيرة؛ وأيضاً ذلك النوع من الموجات الكهرومغناطيسية
entries.example: Heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.

entries.definitionEn: Twelve o'clock in the day; the middle of the day.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتصف النهار؛ الساعة الثانية عشرة ظهراً
entries.example: We stopped for lunch at midday.

entries.definitionEn: In the centre, or between two other things, people, or points.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوسط؛ في المركز أو بين شيئين أو شخصين أو موضعين
entries.example: She sat in the middle seat.

entries.definitionEn: In the period of life between being young and being old, often roughly from the mid-forties to the mid-sixties.
entries.arabicMeaning: في منتصف العمر، بين الشباب والشيخوخة، وغالباً من أواسط الأربعين إلى أواسط الستين تقريباً
entries.example: A middle-aged couple bought the house next door.

entries.definitionEn: The central part of something, equally far from the sides, ends, or edges.
entries.arabicMeaning: الوسط: الجزء المركزي المتساوي البعد عن الأطراف
entries.example: There is a fountain in the middle of the square.

entries.definitionEn: Twelve o'clock at night.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتصف الليل؛ الساعة الثانية عشرة ليلاً
entries.example: The train arrives just after midnight.

entries.definitionEn: The middle of a situation, group, or activity, usually in the phrase in the midst of.
entries.arabicMeaning: خضم أو وسط موقف أو جماعة أو نشاط، وغالباً في عبارة in the midst of
entries.example: They were in the midst of moving house when the letter arrived.

entries.definitionEn: A trained health worker who helps women during pregnancy and childbirth.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابلة: عاملة صحية مدرَّبة تساعد النساء في الحمل والولادة
entries.example: The midwife stayed with her through the night of the birth.

entries.definitionEn: The work, skill, or profession of a midwife.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهنة التوليد أو فنّها: عمل القابلة ومهارتها
entries.example: She trained in midwifery after working as a nurse.

entries.definitionEn: A person's appearance, bearing, or expression, especially as a sign of mood or character.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيماء المرء وهيئته وتعبير وجهه، ولا سيما بما يكشف عن مزاجه أو طبعه
entries.example: Despite the bad news, he kept a calm mien.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to say that something is possible, or to make a polite suggestion.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يأتي قبل الفعل ليفيد الإمكان، أو لتقديم اقتراح بأدب
entries.example: It might rain later, so take a coat.

entries.definitionEn: Very strong, powerful, or large.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبّار أو قوي جداً أو عظيم الحجم
entries.example: A mighty river runs through the valley.

entries.definitionEn: The movement of people or animals from one region to another, to live or to spend part of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: هجرة الناس أو الحيوانات من منطقة إلى أخرى للعيش أو لقضاء جزء من السنة
entries.example: The autumn migration of geese fills the sky for days.

entries.definitionEn: Not strong, sharp, or severe. Used of weather, flavour, illness, or a gentle personality.
entries.arabicMeaning: خفيف أو معتدل؛ يُقال للطقس أو المذاق أو المرض أو لشخص دمث
entries.example: The soup has a mild taste, not too spicy.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometres.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل: وحدة مسافة تعادل نحو 1.6 كيلومتراً
entries.example: The station is a mile from our house.

entries.definitionEn: The social or cultural environment in which a person lives or an activity takes place.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسط اجتماعي أو ثقافي يعيش فيه المرء أو يجري فيه نشاط
entries.example: She grew up in a musical milieu, with concerts every weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to soldiers, the army, or armed forces.
entries.arabicMeaning: عسكري؛ يتصل بالجنود أو الجيش أو القوات المسلحة
entries.example: He comes from a military family.

entries.definitionEn: The white liquid that comes from cows, goats, or similar animals, drunk as food or used in cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحليب: سائل أبيض من البقر أو المعز ونحوهما، يُشرب أو يُستعمل في الطبخ
entries.example: Would you like some milk in your tea?

entries.definitionEn: A building with machinery for grinding grain into flour, or for making materials such as paper, cloth, or steel.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطحنة لطحن الحبوب، أو مصنع فيه آلات لصنع الورق أو القماش أو الفولاذ
entries.example: The old mill by the river is now a museum.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre. Millimeter is the usual American spelling; millimetre is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: مليمتر: وحدة طول تساوي جزءاً من ألف من المتر؛ millimeter إملاء أمريكي وmillimetre بريطاني
entries.example: The gap is only a few millimetres wide.

entries.definitionEn: The number 1,000,000.
entries.arabicMeaning: مليون؛ العدد 1,000,000
entries.example: More than a million people visit the city each year.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has money and property worth at least a million pounds, dollars, or another currency.
entries.arabicMeaning: مليونير: من تبلغ ثروته مليوناً على الأقل من الجنيهات أو الدولارات أو غيرهما
entries.example: The inventor became a millionaire after the patent was sold.

entries.definitionEn: A person or animal that is skilled at copying another’s voice, movements, or appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلِّد بارع في محاكاة صوت غيره أو حركاته أو هيئته، من الناس أو الحيوان
entries.example: The parrot is an excellent mimic of household sounds.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a person that thinks, feels, remembers, and imagines.
entries.arabicMeaning: العقل: ما به يفكر المرء ويشعر ويتذكّر ويتخيّل
entries.example: A walk in the park cleared her mind.

entries.definitionEn: To feel annoyed or unhappy about something; often used in polite requests. Also to be careful of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمانع أو يكره أمراً، ويشيع في الطلب المهذّب؛ وقد يعني أيضاً أن ينتبه ويحذر
entries.example: Do you mind if I open the window?

entries.definitionEn: A place underground where coal, gold, or other materials are taken out. Also a bomb hidden in the ground or in water.
entries.arabicMeaning: منجم يُستخرج منه الفحم أو الذهب أو غيرهما؛ وأيضاً لغم يُخبأ في الأرض أو الماء
entries.example: His grandfather worked in a coal mine.

entries.definitionEn: The possessive form of I, used without a following noun to mean something that belongs to me.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير ملكية من I يقوم وحده بمعنى ما يخصّني، من غير اسم بعده
entries.example: This coat is mine.

entries.definitionEn: An area of land or water where explosive mines have been hidden. Also a situation full of hidden difficulties.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقل ألغام في بر أو بحر؛ وأيضاً موقف مليء بالمزالق الخفية
entries.example: Discussing salaries on the first day can be a minefield.

entries.definitionEn: A natural substance in the ground, such as coal, salt, or iron ore. Also a substance the body needs in small amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدن طبيعي في الأرض كالفحم أو الملح أو خام الحديد؛ وأيضاً عنصر يحتاجه الجسم بمقادير صغيرة
entries.example: Salt is a mineral we use every day in cooking.

entries.definitionEn: Water from the ground that contains minerals, usually sold in bottles.
entries.arabicMeaning: مياه معدنية من الأرض تحتوي أملاحاً معدنية، وغالباً تُباع في زجاجات
entries.example: She ordered a bottle of mineral water with the meal.

entries.definitionEn: To mix, or to move among people at a gathering and talk with them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختلط؛ أو يتنقّل بين الحاضرين في مجلس فيحادثهم
entries.example: The host asked us to mingle so that nobody stood alone.

entries.definitionEn: Much smaller than the usual size, often as a small copy of something larger.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصغّر جداً عن الحجم المعتاد، وغالباً كنسخة صغيرة من شيء أكبر
entries.example: The children played with a miniature railway on the table.

entries.definitionEn: To make something as small as possible in amount, degree, or importance. Minimize is the usual American spelling; minimise is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّل الشيء إلى أدنى حد في المقدار أو الدرجة أو الأهمية؛ minimize إملاء أمريكي وminimise بريطاني
entries.example: We should minimize waste in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest that is allowed, needed, or possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدنى ما يُسمح به أو يُحتاج إليه أو يمكن بلوغه
entries.example: The minimum age for this ticket is sixteen.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest amount, number, or degree that is allowed, needed, or possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحد الأدنى من مقدار أو عدد أو درجة مما يُسمح به أو يُحتاج إليه أو يمكن
entries.example: You need a minimum of six hours of sleep.

entries.definitionEn: A member of a government in charge of a department. Also a religious leader in some Christian churches.
entries.arabicMeaning: وزير يتولى شؤون وزارة؛ وأيضاً رجل دين في بعض الكنائس المسيحية
entries.example: The health minister answered questions on television.

entries.definitionEn: Small and not very important or serious.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفيف أو قليل الأهمية أو غير خطير
entries.example: There was a minor delay, but we still arrived on time.

entries.definitionEn: The smaller part of a group. Also a group of people who differ from most others in a place, for example in language or religion.
entries.arabicMeaning: أقلية: الجزء الأصغر من جماعة؛ وأيضاً فئة تختلف عن جمهور المكان بلغة أو دين مثلاً
entries.example: Only a minority of staff wanted to change the hours.

entries.definitionEn: To attend to someone’s needs, especially in a caring or pastoral role; a nonstandard spelling of the verb minister. In standard English, minster is a noun meaning a large church, often once monastic.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرعى حاجات أحد ولا سيما في دور رعوي؛ وهو إملاء غير معياري للفعل minister، أما minster في الاستعمال الفصيح فاسم لكنيسة كبيرة كانت في الأصل ديرية
entries.example: Volunteers stayed to minster to families waiting in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with a fresh taste used in food and tea, or a sweet flavoured with it. Also a place where coins are made.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعناع يُستعمل في الطعام والشاي، أو حلوى بطعمه؛ وأيضاً دار سكّ النقود
entries.example: She added fresh mint to the salad.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a number to mean that it is taken away, or that a temperature is below zero. Also used to mean without.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى ناقص قبل عدد يُطرح، أو دون الصفر في الحرارة؛ وقد يعني أيضاً بغير
entries.example: Ten minus three is seven.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds. Also a very short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقيقة: ستون ثانية؛ وأيضاً وقت وجيز جداً
entries.example: The bus leaves in five minutes.

entries.definitionEn: Small, precise, or trivial details of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقائق الأمور: تفاصيل صغيرة دقيقة أو تافهة في ظاهرها
entries.example: The contract was delayed by arguments over legal minutiae.

entries.definitionEn: A surprising and welcome event that you cannot explain in ordinary terms, or something so lucky that it feels almost impossible.
entries.arabicMeaning: معجزة: حدث مفاجئ محمود لا يُفسَّر بمجرى العادة، أو حظ يبلغ حدّاً يكاد يكون مستحيلاً
entries.example: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the crash.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of special glass that you look at to see yourself or what is behind you.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرآة: زجاج خاص تنظر فيه لترى نفسك أو ما خلفك
entries.example: She checked her hair in the mirror.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly bad behaviour that is not meant to cause serious harm, often by children. Also trouble or damage caused on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقاوة: سلوك سيئ خفيف لا يُقصد به أذى بليغ، وغالباً من الأطفال؛ وقد يعني أيضاً أذى يُتعمَّد
entries.example: The twins were full of mischief all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A wrong idea or belief that people have because they have not understood something correctly.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفهوم خاطئ يحمله الناس لأنهم لم يفهموا الأمر على وجهه
entries.example: There is a common misconception that bats are blind.

entries.definitionEn: A relatively minor crime, less serious than a felony. Misdemeanor is the American spelling; misdemeanour is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنحة: جريمة أخف من الجناية؛ misdemeanor إملاء أمريكي وmisdemeanour بريطاني
entries.example: Parking in a forbidden zone can be treated as a misdemeanor.

entries.definitionEn: Very unhappy. Also of very poor quality, or of weather that is cold, wet, and unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعيس جداً؛ وقد يوصف به الرديء الجودة، أو الطقس البارد الممطر الكريه
entries.example: He felt miserable after he lost his keys.

entries.definitionEn: Great unhappiness or suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقاء أو عناء شديد
entries.example: The long wait in the rain added to their misery.

entries.definitionEn: Bad luck, or an unlucky event.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوء طالع، أو حدث سيئ الحظ
entries.example: It was his misfortune to miss the last bus by a minute.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone to believe something that is not true, whether on purpose or by accident.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضلّل فيحمل أحداً على اعتقاد ما ليس صحيحاً، عمداً أو عن غير قصد
entries.example: The headline may mislead readers about the real figures.

entries.definitionEn: Giving the wrong idea or impression, even if the words are not an open lie.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضلِّل يعطي انطباعاً خاطئاً وإن لم يكن الكلام كذباً صريحاً
entries.example: The advertisement was misleading about the size of the room.

entries.definitionEn: To put something in the wrong place and be unable to find it for a time. Also to give a feeling, such as trust, to an unsuitable person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع الشيء في غير موضعه فيتعذّر عليه العثور عليه حيناً؛ وقد يعني توجيه شعور كالثقة إلى غير أهله
entries.example: I always misplace my glasses when I am in a hurry.

entries.definitionEn: A title used before the name of a girl or an unmarried woman.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب يسبق اسم فتاة أو امرأة غير متزوجة: الآنسة
entries.example: Miss Taylor will see you now.

entries.definitionEn: To fail to hit, catch, or be present for something. Also to feel sad because a person or thing is not with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفوت شيئاً فلا يصيبه أو يلحقه أو يحضره؛ وأيضاً يشتاق لأن شخصاً أو شيئاً غاب عنه
entries.example: I miss my sister when she is away.

entries.definitionEn: An object or weapon that is thrown or launched through the air to hit a target.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقذوفة أو صاروخ يُرمى أو يُطلق في الهواء ليصيب هدفاً
entries.example: The museum has a model of an early missile used in tests.

entries.definitionEn: Not in the expected place; lost, or not able to be found.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفقود؛ ليس في موضعه المتوقع أو يتعذّر العثور عليه
entries.example: One sock is missing from the pair.

entries.definitionEn: An important job or purpose, or a trip made to carry it out.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمة ذات شأن أو غاية، أو رحلة تُقام لإنجازها
entries.example: Her mission was to deliver the documents before noon.

entries.definitionEn: A thin cloud of tiny water drops close to the ground, making it hard to see far.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضباب خفيف من قطرات ماء دقيقة قرب الأرض يحجب الرؤية البعيدة
entries.example: A light mist hung over the lake at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Something you do, say, or think that is wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطأ في فعل أو قول أو ظن
entries.example: I made a mistake in the last sum.

entries.definitionEn: To treat a person or animal in a cruel or unfair way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسيء معاملة شخص أو حيوان بقسوة أو بغير إنصاف
entries.example: The shelter takes in animals that people mistreat.

entries.definitionEn: Not ready to trust someone or something; suspicious.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتاب غير مستعد للثقة بشخص أو شيء
entries.example: Years of broken promises had made him mistrustful of official notices.

entries.definitionEn: Full of mist, or not clear, as if seen through mist.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضبابي يملؤه الضباب الخفيف، أو غير واضح كأنما يُرى من خلاله
entries.example: It was a misty morning, and the hills were hard to see.

entries.definitionEn: To fail to understand the meaning or intention of something correctly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسيء الفهم فلا يدرك المعنى أو القصد على وجهه
entries.example: Don't misunderstand me: I am not against the plan, only the timing.

entries.definitionEn: A failure to understand something correctly, often causing confusion or disagreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوء فهم يؤدي غالباً إلى لبس أو خلاف
entries.example: The argument started from a simple misunderstanding about the time.

entries.definitionEn: A combination of different people or things. Also a prepared combination of substances, such as a cake mix.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزيج من أناس أو أشياء مختلفة؛ وأيضاً خليط جاهز كخليط الكعك
entries.example: The audience was a mix of students and local residents.

entries.definitionEn: To combine two or more substances or groups so that they become one, or so that they are together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخلط مادتين أو جماعتين أو أكثر حتى تجتمعا أو تصيرا واحداً
entries.example: Mix the flour and sugar in a bowl.

entries.definitionEn: A deep bowl used in cooking for stirring ingredients together.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعاء خلط عميق يُستعمل في الطبخ لخلط المكوّنات
entries.example: Crack the eggs into the mixing bowl.

entries.definitionEn: Something made by combining different substances or elements. Also a combination of different types of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: خليط ينشأ بجمع مواد أو عناصر مختلفة؛ وأيضاً مزيج من أنواع شتى من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: Add water to the powder to make a smooth mixture.

entries.definitionEn: Able to move or be moved easily. Also relating to phones you can carry with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: متنقل يسهل تحريكه أو انتقاله؛ وأيضاً متعلق بالهواتف المحمولة
entries.example: The library has a mobile service that visits small villages.

entries.definitionEn: A mobile phone; a telephone you can carry with you. Common especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاتف جوّال يمكن حمله؛ شائع بهذا المعنى ولا سيما في الإنجليزية البريطانية
entries.example: Call me on my mobile if the train is late.

entries.definitionEn: A telephone you can carry with you and use away from home.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاتف جوّال تحمله وتستعمله خارج البيت
entries.example: Please switch off your mobile phone in the theatre.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to move freely, of a person or of a group. Also the chance to change social or job position.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة شخص أو جماعة على التنقل بحرية؛ وأيضاً إمكان تغيير الموقع الاجتماعي أو الوظيفي
entries.example: The new ramps improved mobility for wheelchair users.

entries.definitionEn: Not real, but made to look or serve like the real thing. Also done as practice, not the official event.
entries.arabicMeaning: وهمي أو محاكٍ يُصنع ليبدو كالشيء الحقيقي؛ وأيضاً تجريبي يُقام على سبيل التمرين لا الحدث الرسمي
entries.example: The students sat a mock exam in May.

entries.definitionEn: A grammar word such as can, must, or should, used with a main verb to express ability, necessity, possibility, or permission. Also called a modal.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد قيسي مثل can وmust وshould يرافق الفعل الأصلي ليفيد القدرة أو الوجوب أو الإمكان أو الإذن، ويُسمى أيضاً modal
entries.example: Can is a modal verb used to talk about ability.

entries.definitionEn: Used as an excellent example to copy. Also made as a small copy of something larger.
entries.arabicMeaning: نموذجي يُتخذ مثالاً يُحتذى؛ أو مصنوع كنسخة صغيرة من شيء أكبر
entries.example: She was a model student, always prepared for class.

entries.definitionEn: A small copy of something. Also a person whose job is to wear clothes in photographs or shows, or a particular design of a product.
entries.arabicMeaning: نموذج مصغّر لشيء؛ وأيضاً عارض أزياء أو طراز معيّن من منتج
entries.example: He built a model of the old bridge.

entries.definitionEn: To wear clothes as a model in a show or photograph. Also to make a model, or to shape behaviour on an example.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض الأزياء في عرض أو صورة؛ أو يصنع نموذجاً، أو يقتدي بمثال في سلوكه
entries.example: She modelled the winter coats at the afternoon show.

entries.definitionEn: A device that connects a computer to the internet or to a telephone line.
entries.arabicMeaning: مودم: جهاز يربط الحاسوب بالإنترنت أو بخط هاتف
entries.example: The internet stopped working when the modem overheated.

entries.definitionEn: Average in amount, strength, or degree; not extreme.
entries.arabicMeaning: معتدل في المقدار أو القوة أو الدرجة؛ ليس مفرطاً
entries.example: We walked at a moderate pace so nobody got tired.

entries.definitionEn: Of the present time, or using the newest methods, designs, or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديث من هذا الزمن، أو قائم على أحدث الأساليب والتصاميم والأفكار
entries.example: They live in a modern apartment near the station.

entries.definitionEn: A movement in the arts, architecture, and thought that broke with traditional forms in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحداثة: مذهب في الفنون والعمارة والفكر خرج على الأشكال التقليدية في أواخر القرن التاسع عشر وأوائل العشرين
entries.example: The gallery's new wing is a study in architectural modernism.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making something more modern by using newer methods, equipment, or ideas. Modernization is the usual American spelling; modernisation is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحديث شيء بوسائل أو معدات أو أفكار أحدث؛ modernization إملاء أمريكي وmodernisation بريطاني
entries.example: The modernization of the railway cut journey times.

entries.definitionEn: To make something more modern by introducing newer methods, equipment, or ideas. Modernize is the usual American spelling; modernise is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّث الشيء بإدخال أساليب أو معدات أو أفكار أحدث؛ modernize إملاء أمريكي وmodernise بريطاني
entries.example: The city plans to modernize the tram network.

entries.definitionEn: Not talking proudly about yourself or your abilities. Also not large in amount, size, or price.
entries.arabicMeaning: متواضع لا يفاخر بنفسه أو بقدراته؛ وأيضاً غير كبير في المقدار أو الحجم أو الثمن
entries.example: She gave a modest smile when they praised her work.

entries.definitionEn: A small change made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعديل صغير يُدخل على شيء لتحسينه أو لجعله أوفق
entries.example: They made a few modifications to the original design.

entries.definitionEn: To change something slightly, usually to improve it or make it more suitable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعدّل شيئاً تعديلاً طفيفاً، عادة لتحسينه أو لجعله أوفق
entries.example: You can modify the settings to make the screen brighter.

entries.definitionEn: A very rich and powerful person in an industry, especially in business, film, or the media.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملاق في صناعة ما، غني نافذ، ولا سيما في الأعمال أو السينما أو الإعلام
entries.example: The newspaper mogul owned three national dailies.

entries.definitionEn: Very small amounts of water in the air or on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: رطوبة: مقادير يسيرة من الماء في الهواء أو على سطح
entries.example: Wipe off the moisture on the window with a cloth.

entries.definitionEn: A furry fungus that grows on old food or in damp places. Also a hollow container used to give shape to a soft material. Mold is the usual American spelling; mould is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: عفن فروي ينمو على الطعام القديم أو في المواضع الرطبة؛ وأيضاً قالب مجوّف لتشكيل مادة ليّنة؛ mold إملاء أمريكي وmould بريطاني
entries.example: Moisture can cause mould to grow on the walls.

entries.definitionEn: To shape a soft material in a particular form. Also to influence the way a person or thing develops. Mold is the usual American spelling; mould is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكّل مادة ليّنة في هيئة معيّنة؛ وأيضاً يصوغ تطوّر شخص أو شيء؛ mold إملاء أمريكي وmould بريطاني
entries.example: Years of practice moulded her technique.

entries.definitionEn: The smallest unit of a chemical substance that still has the properties of that substance, made of atoms joined together.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزيء: أصغر وحدة من مادة كيميائية تحتفظ بخصائصها، مكوّنة من ذرات مترابطة
entries.example: A water molecule is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for mother, especially in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ غير رسمي بمعنى الأم، شائع ولا سيما في الإنجليزية الأمريكية
entries.example: My mom packed lunch for me this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A very short period of time. Also a particular point in time.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحظة: فترة وجيزة جداً؛ وأيضاً نقطة معيّنة في الزمن
entries.example: Wait a moment, please.

entries.definitionEn: For a very short time. In American English it can also mean in a moment; very soon.
entries.arabicMeaning: للحظة وجيزة؛ وفي الإنجليزية الأمريكية قد تعني أيضاً بعد قليل / قريباً جداً
entries.example: The lights went out momentarily, then came back on.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a very short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحظي لا يدوم إلا وقتاً قصيراً جداً
entries.example: There was a momentary pause before she answered.

entries.definitionEn: A child's informal word for mother. Mommy is the usual spelling; mommie is less common.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفظ طفولي غير رسمي بمعنى ماما؛ mommy هو الإملاء الأشيع وmommie أقل شيوعاً
entries.example: The toddler called for his mommy from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: A building where monks live, work, and practise their religion, often apart from ordinary town life.
entries.arabicMeaning: دير يسكنه الرهبان ويعملون فيه ويقيمون شعائرهم، وغالباً بمعزل عن حياة البلدة
entries.example: We visited a monastery in the hills last summer.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to monks or monasteries. Also extremely simple and self-denying, like a monk’s way of life.
entries.arabicMeaning: رهباني يتصل بالرهبان أو الأديرة؛ وأيضاً بالغ البساطة والزهد كعيشة الراهب
entries.example: He kept a monastic room, with only a bed and a desk.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاثنين: اليوم الذي يلي الأحد ويسبق الثلاثاء
entries.example: The shop is closed on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: Coins and notes that you use to buy things, or the amount that someone has.
entries.arabicMeaning: المال من نقود ورقية ومعدنية تُشترى بها الأشياء، أو مقدار ما يملكه المرء
entries.example: I do not have enough money for a taxi.

entries.definitionEn: A screen for a computer. Also a person or device that watches or checks something over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاشة حاسوب؛ وأيضاً شخص أو جهاز يراقب شيئاً أو يتفقده على مدى الوقت
entries.example: The graph appeared on the monitor.

entries.definitionEn: To watch and check something regularly over a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يراقب شيئاً ويتفقده بانتظام على مدى فترة
entries.example: Nurses monitor the patient's temperature every hour.

entries.definitionEn: A man who lives in a religious community, usually apart from ordinary life, according to a set of rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: راهب يعيش في جماعة دينية، وغالباً بمعزل عن الحياة العادية، وفق قواعد معلومة
entries.example: The monk showed visitors around the quiet garden.

entries.definitionEn: An animal with a long tail that lives in trees and is related to apes and humans.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرد ذو ذيل طويل يعيش في الأشجار، وهو من أقرباء القردة العليا والبشر
entries.example: A monkey swung from branch to branch.

entries.definitionEn: Boring because it stays the same and has too little variety.
entries.arabicMeaning: رتيب ممل لثباته وقلة تنوّعه
entries.example: The monotonous hum of the machine made it hard to stay awake.

entries.definitionEn: In a dull, unvarying way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو رتيب لا يتغيّر فيورث الملل
entries.example: The rain fell monotonously on the tin roof all night.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being boring because of a lack of change or variety.
entries.arabicMeaning: رتابة: ملل ينشأ من انعدام التغيير أو التنوّع
entries.example: A short walk at lunch broke the monotony of desk work.

entries.definitionEn: A large imaginary creature that is frightening. Also a very cruel person, or something unusually large.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحش كبير مخيف في الخيال؛ وأيضاً شخص بالغ القسوة، أو شيء ضخم على غير العادة
entries.example: The child drew a green monster with three eyes.

entries.definitionEn: One of the twelve parts of the year, such as January or June.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهر: واحد من أقسام السنة الاثني عشر، كانون الثاني أو حزيران مثلاً
entries.example: She will start the new job next month.

entries.definitionEn: Happening, appearing, or paid once a month.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهري: يقع أو يصدر أو يُدفع مرة في الشهر
entries.example: We have a monthly meeting on the first Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Once a month.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهرياً؛ مرة كل شهر
entries.example: The magazine is published monthly.

entries.definitionEn: A statue, building, or stone put up to honour a person or a past event. Also an important historic structure.
entries.arabicMeaning: نصب تذكاري من تمثال أو بناء أو حجر يُقام لتكريم شخص أو حدث؛ وأيضاً أثر تاريخي مهم
entries.example: They laid flowers at the monument in the square.

entries.definitionEn: The way you feel at a particular time, such as happy, sad, or angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزاج: الحال الشعورية في وقت معيّن، من فرح أو حزن أو غضب
entries.example: He was in a good mood after the walk.

entries.definitionEn: Often changing between being friendly and being bad-tempered, without a clear reason.
entries.arabicMeaning: متقلّب المزاج ينتقل بين اللطف وسوء الخلق من غير سبب بيّن
entries.example: She becomes moody when she has not slept enough.

entries.definitionEn: The round object that you see shining in the sky at night, which goes around the Earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: القمر: الجرم المستدير الذي يضيء في السماء ليلاً ويدور حول الأرض
entries.example: The moon was bright above the trees.

entries.definitionEn: The light that comes from the moon.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضوء القمر
entries.example: They walked home by moonlight.

entries.definitionEn: A stretch of land that looks empty, rocky, and barren, like the surface of the moon.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض جرداء صخرية موحشة المنظر تشبه سطح القمر
