entries.example: The lava field was a grey moonscape without a single tree.

entries.definitionEn: An open area of high, often wet ground, typically covered with grass, heather, or peat, especially in Britain.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض بور مرتفعة كثيراً ما تكون رطبة، تغطيها الحشائش أو الخلنج أو الخث، ولا سيما في بريطانيا
entries.example: A cold wind blew across the moor.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to principles of right and wrong behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخلاقي؛ يتصل بمبادئ الصواب والخطأ في السلوك
entries.example: Telling the truth was a moral duty in her family.

entries.definitionEn: A lesson about right and wrong that a story or event is meant to teach.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبرة: درس في الصواب والخطأ يُقصد من قصة أو حدث أن يعلّمه
entries.example: The moral of the story is that honesty matters.

entries.definitionEn: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأخلاق أو منظومة الخلق: معتقدات ومبادئ في صواب السلوك وخطئه
entries.example: The debate was about the morality of keeping animals in zoos.

entries.definitionEn: According to principles of right and wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخلاقياً؛ وفق مبادئ الصواب والخطأ
entries.example: She felt morally obliged to return the wallet.

entries.definitionEn: To a greater degree or extent. Also used with adjectives and adverbs to form the comparative.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف يفيد زيادة الدرجة أو المقدار؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً مع الصفات والظروف لتكوين صيغة التفضيل
entries.example: Please speak more slowly.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean a greater amount or number of that thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدد يسبق اسماً ليفيد مقداراً أو عدداً أكبر من ذلك الشيء
entries.example: We need more chairs for the guests.

entries.definitionEn: Used without a noun to mean a greater amount or number of something already understood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يقوم مقام اسم مفهوم من السياق ليفيد مقداراً أو عدداً أكبر
entries.example: Would you like more?

entries.definitionEn: In addition; used to add a point that supports or strengthens what you have just said.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاوة على ذلك؛ تُستعمل لإضافة نقطة تعزّز ما سبق
entries.example: The room is cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.

entries.definitionEn: At the point of death. Also no longer active or successful and close to failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: محتضر على شفا الموت؛ وأيضاً راكد أو آيل إلى الزوال لقلة النشاط أو النجاح
entries.example: Without new members the club looked moribund.

entries.definitionEn: The early part of the day, from when people get up until midday.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصباح: أول النهار من القيام من النوم حتى الظهر
entries.example: I drink tea every morning.

entries.definitionEn: Certain to die; not living forever. Also causing death, or relating to humans rather than to gods.
entries.arabicMeaning: فانٍ لا يخلد؛ وأيضاً قاتل يسبب الموت، أو بشري مقابل الإلهي
entries.example: All living creatures are mortal.

entries.definitionEn: A mix of sand, water, and cement or lime used to hold bricks or stones together. Also a short gun that fires shells in a high arc.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاط من رمل وماء وإسمنت أو كلس يمسك اللبن أو الحجارة؛ وأيضاً هاون يطلق قذائف في قوس عالية
entries.example: The bricklayer spread mortar between the stones.

entries.definitionEn: A loan from a bank to buy a house or land, with the property as security until the loan is paid.
entries.arabicMeaning: رهن عقاري: قرض من مصرف لشراء بيت أو أرض، والعين ضامنة حتى سداد الدين
entries.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first flat.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel extremely ashamed or embarrassed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخزي أو يُخجل أحداً خجلاً شديداً
entries.example: It would mortify her to forget a guest's name at her own party.

entries.definitionEn: A building where Muslims go to pray.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسجد: بناء يصلي فيه المسلمون
entries.example: The mosque on the corner is busy on Fridays.

entries.definitionEn: A small flying insect that bites people and animals and can carry disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعوضة: حشرة طائرة صغيرة تلدغ الناس والحيوان وقد تنقل مرضاً
entries.example: A mosquito bit me on the ankle.

entries.definitionEn: A small green plant that grows in a soft mass on damp ground, trees, or stones, without flowers.
entries.arabicMeaning: طحلب أخضر صغير ينمو كتلة ليّنة على الأرض الرطبة أو الشجر أو الحجارة، من غير زهر
entries.example: Soft moss covered the stones by the stream.

entries.definitionEn: To the greatest degree. Also used with adjectives and adverbs to form the superlative.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف يفيد أعلى درجة؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً مع الصفات والظروف لتكوين صيغة التفضيل العليا
entries.example: This is the most comfortable chair in the room.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean the largest part or number of that group or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدد يسبق اسماً ليفيد معظم ذلك المجموع أو أكبر جزء منه
entries.example: Most people arrived before seven.

entries.definitionEn: Used without a noun to mean the largest number or amount, or the majority of something already understood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يقوم مقام اسم مفهوم ليفيد الأكبر عدداً أو مقداراً، أو غالبية الشيء
entries.example: Some left early, but most stayed until the end.

entries.definitionEn: In most cases; mainly.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الغالب؛ أساساً
entries.example: The shop sells mostly fruit and vegetables.

entries.definitionEn: The mother of your husband or wife.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحماة: أم الزوج أو الزوجة
entries.example: His mother-in-law is staying with them this week.

entries.definitionEn: A female parent.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأم
entries.example: My mother taught me how to cook rice.

entries.definitionEn: The country where you were born, especially when you feel a strong tie to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: الوطن الأم: البلد الذي وُلدت فيه، ولا سيما حين تشعر بارتباط وثيق به
entries.example: She returned to her motherland after twenty years abroad.

entries.definitionEn: The action or process of moving. Also a formal proposal put to a meeting for a decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركة أو سير الانتقال؛ وأيضاً اقتراح رسمي يُعرض في اجتماع للبتّ فيه
entries.example: The slow motion of the boat on the water made her sleepy.

entries.definitionEn: Not moving at all.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساكن لا يتحرك البتة
entries.example: The cat sat motionless, watching the bird.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a reason to do something, or to make them want to act.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفّز شخصاً أو يمنحه سبباً للعمل
entries.example: A good teacher can motivate students to keep practising.

entries.definitionEn: Having a strong reason or desire to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: متحفّز؛ لديه دافع قوي للعمل
entries.example: She is highly motivated to finish the course.

entries.definitionEn: The reason or enthusiasm that makes you want to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدافع أو الحماس الذي يدفعك إلى العمل
entries.example: His motivation for learning French was a job in Paris.

entries.definitionEn: A reason for doing something, especially one that is hidden or connected with a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: الباعث أو السبب، وخصوصاً إن خفي أو اتصل بجريمة
entries.example: The police could not find a motive for the attack.

entries.definitionEn: Made up of many different kinds that do not match; mixed in a striking or odd way.
entries.arabicMeaning: خليط غير متجانس من عناصر شتى، على نحو لافت أو غريب
entries.example: A motley crowd gathered in the square.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that uses electricity or fuel to make something move.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرّك يحوّل الكهرباء أو الوقود إلى حركة
entries.example: The fan stopped when the motor failed.

entries.definitionEn: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine; a motorcycle, especially a lighter one.
entries.arabicMeaning: دراجة نارية، وغالباً الأخف وزناً
entries.example: He rode his motorbike to work.

entries.definitionEn: A two-wheeled road vehicle with an engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: دراجة نارية
entries.example: She learned to ride a motorcycle last summer.

entries.definitionEn: A person who drives a car.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائق سيارة
entries.example: Motorists were asked to avoid the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: A wide, fast road for long journeys between cities.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريق سريع واسع للسفر بين المدن
entries.example: We drove on the motorway for two hours.

entries.definitionEn: Marked with spots or patches of different colours.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبقّع بقع أو لطخات بألوان مختلفة
entries.example: The old leaves were mottled brown and yellow.

entries.definitionEn: A short phrase that expresses a belief or aim.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعار قصير يعبّر عن مبدأ أو هدف
entries.example: The school's motto hung above the main door.

entries.definitionEn: A mountain, especially in names. Also an animal you sit on to ride, or a support that holds an object.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبل وخصوصاً في الأسماء؛ أو مركوب، أو حامل يُثبَّت عليه شيء
entries.example: The camera was fixed to a wall mount.

entries.definitionEn: To organize and begin something such as an exhibition or campaign. Also to get onto a horse, or to rise.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّم ويبدأ معرضاً أو حملة؛ أو يركب حصاناً؛ أو يرتفع
entries.example: They will mount an exhibition of local art.

entries.definitionEn: A very high hill.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبل
entries.example: They walked up the mountain at the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A person who climbs mountains as a sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسلّق جبال
entries.example: The mountaineer reached the ridge before noon.

entries.definitionEn: The highest part of a mountain.
entries.arabicMeaning: قمة الجبل
entries.example: Clouds hid the mountaintop all morning.

entries.definitionEn: To feel and show sadness because someone has died, or because something is lost.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحزن وينعى ميتاً أو شيئاً ضائعاً
entries.example: The town came together to mourn the victims.

entries.definitionEn: Full of sadness, especially because of loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزين كئيب، وخصوصاً من أثر الفقد
entries.example: A mournful song played as people left the hall.

entries.definitionEn: A small animal with a long tail. Also a small device you move to control a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: فأر؛ وأيضاً فأرة الحاسوب
entries.example: A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.

entries.definitionEn: The opening in your face that you use to eat and speak.
entries.arabicMeaning: فم
entries.example: She covered her mouth when she coughed.

entries.definitionEn: An act of changing place, or a change of home. Also a step in a game or plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقلة أو انتقال من بيت؛ أو خطوة في لعبة أو خطة
entries.example: Their move to the new flat took all day.

entries.definitionEn: To change position or go to a different place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقل أو يغيّر مكانه
entries.example: Please move your chair closer to the table.

entries.definitionEn: The act of moving, or a group of people working for a shared aim.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركة أو انتقال؛ أو تيار من الناس يجمعهم هدف
entries.example: The movement of the train woke her.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that moves furniture. Also a person who makes things happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل أو شركة نقل أثاث؛ أو شخص يحرّك الأمور
entries.example: The movers carried the sofa up the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: A film that you watch at a cinema or at home.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلم
entries.example: We watched a movie after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Causing strong feeling, especially sadness or sympathy. Also in the process of changing place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤثّر يحرّك المشاعر؛ أو في حال الانتقال
entries.example: Her speech was so moving that the room went quiet.

entries.definitionEn: A small device that stores and plays digital music files.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشغّل صغير لملفات الموسيقى الرقمية
entries.example: He listened to an MP3 player on the bus.

entries.definitionEn: A title used before a man's family name.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب السيد قبل اسم عائلة الرجل
entries.example: Mr Hassan is waiting at reception.

entries.definitionEn: A title used before a married woman's family name.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب السيدة قبل اسم عائلة المرأة المتزوجة
entries.example: Mrs Ali teaches science at our school.

entries.definitionEn: A title used before a woman's family name when you do not say whether she is married.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب السيدة قبل اسم عائلة المرأة من غير بيان حالتها الزوجية
entries.example: Please write to Ms Khan at this address.

entries.definitionEn: To a large degree; a lot.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثيراً؛ إلى حد كبير
entries.example: Thank you very much for your help.

entries.definitionEn: Used with uncountable nouns to talk about a large amount, often in questions and negatives.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل مع الأسماء غير المعدودة لكمية كبيرة، وغالباً في السؤال والنفي
entries.example: I haven't got much time this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount of something, often in questions and negatives.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمية كبيرة من شيء، وغالباً في السؤال والنفي
entries.example: I don't know much about cars.

entries.definitionEn: Wet, soft earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحل أو طين ليّن رطب
entries.example: The children came home with mud on their boots.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with mud, or like mud in colour or texture.
entries.arabicMeaning: موحل أو بلون الطين وقوامه
entries.example: The path was muddy after the rain.

entries.definitionEn: A large cup with straight sides and a handle.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوب كبير مستقيم الجوانب ذو مقبض
entries.example: She drank tea from a blue mug.

entries.definitionEn: An animal whose parents are a horse and a donkey, used for carrying loads.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغل؛ نسل الحصان والحمار يُستخدم للحمل
entries.example: The mule carried bags up the hill.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something slowly and carefully before deciding.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّب الأمر في ذهنه بتمهّل قبل أن يقرر
entries.example: She needed a week to mull over the job offer.

entries.definitionEn: Many; more than one.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعدّد؛ أكثر من واحد
entries.example: The injury had multiple causes.

entries.definitionEn: To add a number to itself a given number of times. Also to increase greatly in number.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب عدداً في عدد؛ أو يتضاعف كثيراً
entries.example: If you multiply six by three, you get eighteen.

entries.definitionEn: A mother; an informal British word.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمّ، في الكلام البريطاني غير الرسمي
entries.example: My mum is picking me up after class.

entries.definitionEn: Speech that is quiet and not clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلام مكتوم غير واضح
entries.example: His answer came out as a mumble.

entries.definitionEn: To speak quietly and unclearly, so that the words are hard to hear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمتم كلاماً خافتاً يصعب سماعه
entries.example: She mumbled an apology and left the room.

entries.definitionEn: To chew food steadily, often with a little noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمضغ الطعام بثبات وغالباً بصوت خفيف
entries.example: He sat on the bench and munched an apple.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being ordinary, dull, or concerned only with everyday life.
entries.arabicMeaning: رتابة العيش العادي وابتذال اليومي
entries.example: She wanted a break from the mundanity of office routine.

entries.definitionEn: Great generosity in giving money or gifts.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرم واسع في العطاء
entries.example: The library was built through the munificence of a local family.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of killing a person on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة قتل عمد
entries.example: The film is about a murder in a small town.

entries.definitionEn: To kill a person on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقتل شخصاً عمداً
entries.example: The court found that he had murdered his business partner.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has murdered someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاتل عمد
entries.example: The murderer was caught two weeks later.

entries.definitionEn: A low, soft, continuous sound of voices, or of something like water or wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: همهمة خفيضة متصلة، أو خرير خفيف
entries.example: A murmur of agreement went through the room.

entries.definitionEn: Having large, stiff muscles that limit easy movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط العضلات حتى تتصلّب حركته
entries.example: The muscle-bound lifter could barely scratch his back.

entries.definitionEn: Tissue in the body that can tighten and relax to produce movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضلة
entries.example: He pulled a muscle in his shoulder.

entries.definitionEn: Having well-developed muscles; relating to the muscles.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضليّ؛ قوي العضلات أو متعلق بها
entries.example: Swimming gave her a muscular back.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something slowly and often dreamily.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأمّل أمراً على مهل وكأنه شارد
entries.example: He mused on the idea while walking home.

entries.definitionEn: A building where objects of art, history, or science are shown to the public.
entries.arabicMeaning: متحف
entries.example: We spent the afternoon at the museum.

entries.definitionEn: A fungus with a round top that you can eat, or that grows in the wild.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطر يؤكل أو ينبت في البرية
entries.example: She sliced a mushroom for the omelette.

entries.definitionEn: Sounds arranged so that people listen to them or play them.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى
entries.example: She listens to music on the way to work.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with music, or good at making it.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقيّ أو ذو موهبة موسيقية
entries.example: He comes from a musical family.

entries.definitionEn: A play or film in which the story is told partly through songs.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرحية أو فيلم غنائي
entries.example: We booked tickets for a musical in town.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays, sings, or writes music.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقيّ
entries.example: Her brother is a musician in a small band.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is necessary, or that you are sure it is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد للوجوب، أو للترجيح بأن الأمر مؤكد
entries.example: You must wear a helmet on the site.

entries.definitionEn: Hair that a man grows on his upper lip.
entries.arabicMeaning: شارب
entries.example: He shaved off his moustache before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: A hot yellow or brown sauce made from mustard seeds, eaten with meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: خردل
entries.example: Would you like mustard with your sandwich?

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being able to change, or of changing often.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابلية التغيّر أو سرعة التحوّل
entries.example: The mutability of fashion keeps shops busy.

entries.definitionEn: Able to change, or likely to change.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للتغيّر أو معرّض له
entries.example: Public opinion on the plan is still mutable.

entries.definitionEn: Refusing to obey people in authority; ready to rebel, especially of a crew or troops.
entries.arabicMeaning: متمرّد يرفض طاعة السلطة، وخصوصاً في طاقم أو جند
entries.example: The mutinous sailors refused to leave harbour.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows refusal to obey authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتمرّد ورفض للطاعة
entries.example: The class stared mutinously at the extra homework.

entries.definitionEn: A quiet complaint or remark that is not fully spoken out loud.
entries.arabicMeaning: غمغمة أو تذمّر مكتوم
entries.example: There was a mutter of protest at the back.

entries.definitionEn: To speak in a low voice, often in complaint, so that others barely hear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمتم أو يتذمّر بصوت خفيض
entries.example: He muttered something under his breath and sat down.

entries.definitionEn: Meat from an adult sheep.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم الضأن من شاة بالغة
entries.example: The stew was made with mutton and root vegetables.

entries.definitionEn: Felt or done by each toward the other; shared by two or more people.
entries.arabicMeaning: متبادل أو مشترك بين طرفين أو أكثر
entries.example: The two companies have a mutual interest in the project.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves each side equally, or that is shared.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل متبادل أو مشترك
entries.example: They reached a mutually acceptable price.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to or connected with the speaker.
entries.arabicMeaning: ياء الملكية؛ يخصّ المتكلم
entries.example: This is my coat.

entries.definitionEn: Countless; existing in very great numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُحصى؛ بالغ الكثرة
entries.example: The night sky held myriad stars.

entries.definitionEn: Used when the speaker both does the action and receives it, or to emphasize I.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير منعكس أو توكيد للمتكلم
entries.example: I made myself a cup of tea.

entries.definitionEn: Strange and not easy to understand or explain.
entries.arabicMeaning: غامض يصعب فهمه أو تفسيره
entries.example: We heard a mysterious noise in the night.

entries.definitionEn: Something that is not known or not understood. Also a story about a crime that needs solving.
entries.arabicMeaning: لغز أو أمر مجهول؛ أو قصة جريمة تحتاج إلى حل
entries.example: Her sudden departure remains a mystery.

entries.definitionEn: To confuse someone completely; to make something impossible to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيّر حتى يستغلق الفهم
entries.example: The magician's last trick mystified the audience.

entries.definitionEn: An attractive air of mystery or special power around a person, place, or skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: هالة غموض جذّابة تحيط بشخص أو مكان أو مهارة
entries.example: The old theatre still has a certain mystique.

entries.definitionEn: An old traditional story, often about gods or heroes. Also a belief that is not true.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسطورة قديمة؛ أو اعتقاد شائع غير صحيح
entries.example: The book retells a Greek myth about the sea.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to myths, or existing only in myth.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسطوريّ أو متعلق بالأساطير
entries.example: The vase shows a mythological hunt.

entries.definitionEn: The collection of myths belonging to a culture, or the study of such stories.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة أساطير شعب، أو دراسة تلك القصص
entries.example: She is writing a thesis on Norse mythology.

entries.definitionEn: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe. Also a thin metal spike used to join wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظفر؛ أو مسمار
entries.example: He hit the nail with a hammer.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking experience of the world, so that you trust too easily or see things too simply.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساذج قليل الخبرة يصدّق بسهولة أو يبسّط الأمور
entries.example: It was naive to think the contract needed no lawyer.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows a lack of experience or too much trust.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسذاجة وقلة خبرة
entries.example: She naively believed the email was from the bank.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being naive.
entries.arabicMeaning: سذاجة وقلة دربة
entries.example: His naivety about money surprised his colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: Not wearing clothes. Also without the usual covering.
entries.arabicMeaning: عارٍ بلا ثياب؛ أو مكشوف بلا غطاء
entries.example: The trees looked naked after the last leaves fell.

entries.definitionEn: The word or words that a person, place, or thing is called.
entries.arabicMeaning: اسم
entries.example: My name is Layla.

entries.definitionEn: To give a name to someone or something, or to say what it is called.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمّي أو يذكر الاسم
entries.example: They named the baby after her grandmother.

entries.definitionEn: Informal for nanotechnology, or for work and devices at an extremely small scale.
entries.arabicMeaning: النانو: تقنية بالغة الصغر، أو العمل والأجهزة على هذا المقياس
entries.example: He studied nano and now designs tiny medical sensors.

entries.definitionEn: A short sleep, usually during the day.
entries.arabicMeaning: قيلولة
entries.example: She had a nap after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth or paper used to protect clothes and wipe the mouth at meals.
entries.arabicMeaning: منديل سفرة
entries.example: He placed a napkin on his lap.

entries.definitionEn: Too interested in yourself and your appearance or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: نرجسيّ مفرط الانشغال بذاته
entries.example: His narcissistic comments made the meeting awkward.

entries.definitionEn: To tell a story, or to describe what is happening in a film.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرد قصة أو يعلّق على أحداث فيلم
entries.example: She will narrate the documentary.

entries.definitionEn: Telling a story, or relating to the way a story is told.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرديّ؛ متعلق بطريقة رواية القصة
entries.example: The book uses a simple narrative style.

entries.definitionEn: The person who tells a story in a book, play, or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: راوي القصة
entries.example: The narrator speaks in the first person.

entries.definitionEn: Small in width from one side to the other. Also limited in range.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيّق العرض؛ أو محدود النطاق
entries.example: The narrow street was full of parked cars.

entries.definitionEn: Only just; by a very small amount. Also in a limited way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بفارق ضئيل؛ أو على نحو محدود
entries.example: She narrowly missed the last train.

entries.definitionEn: Just beginning to exist or develop.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشئ في أول تكوّنه
entries.example: The city has a nascent technology industry.

entries.definitionEn: Unkind, unpleasant, or severe.
entries.arabicMeaning: كريه أو سيئ أو قاسٍ
entries.example: He made a nasty remark about her work.

entries.definitionEn: A country and its people.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمّة أو بلد وأهله
entries.example: People from many nations came to the conference.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with a whole country, not just one part.
entries.arabicMeaning: وطنيّ على مستوى البلاد كلها
entries.example: Football is a national sport here.

entries.definitionEn: A person who wants their country to be independent, or who strongly supports their own nation.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوميّ يريد استقلال بلده أو يتحمّس له بقوة
entries.example: The nationalist spoke about self-rule.

entries.definitionEn: The legal status of belonging to a particular country.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنسية
entries.example: What is your nationality?

entries.definitionEn: Happening in or covering the whole of a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل للبلاد كلها
entries.example: The nationwide survey included every region.

entries.definitionEn: Across the whole of a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أنحاء البلاد كلها
entries.example: The shops will open nationwide next month.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the place where you were born, or belonging naturally to a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصليّ مولود في المكان، أو طبيعيّ في بيئة ما
entries.example: Spanish is her native language.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has spoken a language from early childhood.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناطق أصلي باللغة
entries.example: The course is taught by a native speaker of Japanese.

entries.definitionEn: Existing in nature, not made by people. Also normal and not forced.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيعيّ غير مصنوع؛ أو عفوي غير متكلّف
entries.example: This soap is made from natural oils.

entries.definitionEn: In a natural way; as you would expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل طبيعي؛ أو كما هو متوقع
entries.example: She is naturally good at languages.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of seeming real, easy, and not forced.
entries.arabicMeaning: عفوية وعدم تكلّف
entries.example: The naturalness of her acting won the prize.

entries.definitionEn: Badly behaved, especially of a child. Also slightly rude in a playful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقيّ سيئ السلوك وخصوصاً من طفل؛ أو جريء قليلاً على سبيل الدعابة
entries.example: The naughty puppy chewed the cushion.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with a country's navy or with warships.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحريّ عسكريّ متعلق بالأسطول
entries.example: He trained at a naval academy.

entries.definitionEn: To find your way, especially in a ship or aircraft, or by using a map. Also to deal with a difficult system.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهتدي إلى الطريق في سفينة أو طائرة أو بخريطة؛ أو يشق طريقه في نظام معقّد
entries.example: She used the app to navigate through the city.

entries.definitionEn: The process of finding the way from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاحة أو اهتداء إلى الطريق
entries.example: Good navigation saved them an hour on the road.

entries.definitionEn: Of a dark blue colour, like a navy uniform.
entries.arabicMeaning: كحليّ؛ أزرق داكن كلون الزي البحري
entries.example: He wore a navy blue jacket to the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a country's armed forces that fights at sea, and its ships.
entries.arabicMeaning: البحرية؛ القوات المسلحة في البحر
entries.example: Her sister joined the navy after university.

entries.definitionEn: Not far away in distance or time; close.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريب في المكان أو الزمان
entries.example: The nearest station is a ten-minute walk.

entries.definitionEn: At a short distance; close.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مقربة
entries.example: Don't go too near the edge.

entries.definitionEn: Close to a place, time, or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرب؛ بجوار
entries.example: They live near the school.

entries.definitionEn: Not far away.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريب أو مجاور
entries.example: We found a nearby cafe.

entries.definitionEn: At a short distance from here.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مقربة من هنا
entries.example: Is there a pharmacy nearby?

entries.definitionEn: Almost, but not completely or not quite.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً؛ يكاد
entries.example: It is nearly time to leave.

entries.definitionEn: Tidy and carefully arranged. Also clever and simple.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتّب أنيق؛ أو ذكي بسيط
entries.example: Keep your desk neat during the inspection.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that must be true or must happen. Often used in not necessarily to mean not always.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالضرورة؛ وغالباً في not necessarily بمعنى ليس دائماً
entries.example: A high price does not necessarily mean better quality.

entries.definitionEn: Needed in order for something to happen or be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضروريّ لازم
entries.example: A passport is necessary for this trip.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you must have or do; the state of being needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضرورة أو حاجة لا بد منها
entries.example: Clean water is a basic necessity.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body that joins the head to the shoulders.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنق أو رقبة
entries.example: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of jewellery worn around the neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقد يُلبس في العنق
entries.example: He gave her a silver necklace.

entries.definitionEn: The sweet liquid that flowers produce, collected by bees.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحيق الأزهار
entries.example: Bees gather nectar from the blossom.

entries.definitionEn: Used in questions and negatives to say whether something is necessary, without to after it.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد في السؤال والنفي لبيان اللزوم، من غير to بعده
entries.example: You need not wait; I will call you.

entries.definitionEn: A situation in which something is necessary, or a thing that you must have.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاجة أو ضرورة
entries.example: There is a growing need for trained nurses.

entries.definitionEn: To require something because it is necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتاج إلى شيء لأنه لازم
entries.example: I need a new pair of shoes.

entries.definitionEn: A thin pointed piece of metal used for sewing, or for giving an injection. Also a pine leaf.
entries.arabicMeaning: إبرة خياطة أو حقن؛ أو ورقة الصنوبر
entries.example: She pushed the needle through the cloth.

entries.definitionEn: Not necessary; that could have been avoided.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ضروري؛ كان يمكن تجنّبه
entries.example: The delay caused needless worry.

entries.definitionEn: Not having enough money or support. Also wanting a lot of attention and care.
entries.arabicMeaning: محتاج مادياً؛ أو شديد الحاجة إلى الاهتمام
entries.example: The charity helps needy families in winter.

entries.definitionEn: Bad or harmful, or expressing no. Also less than zero in number.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلبيّ أو مضرّ أو رافض؛ أو أقل من صفر
entries.example: Try not to start with a negative comment.

entries.definitionEn: In a bad or refusing way; with a minus effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو سلبي
entries.example: The change affected small shops negatively.

entries.definitionEn: Failure to give someone or something the care they need.
entries.arabicMeaning: إهمال في الرعاية
entries.example: The garden showed years of neglect.

entries.definitionEn: Failing to give proper care or attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمِل في الرعاية أو الانتباه
entries.example: He was neglectful of his health during the project.

entries.definitionEn: Failing to take the care that a reasonable person or professional should take.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقصّر في واجب العناية المعقولة
entries.example: The company was found negligent in maintaining the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that fails to take proper care.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتقصير في واجب العناية
entries.example: The files had been negligently left unlocked.

entries.definitionEn: So small or unimportant that it can be ignored.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضئيل يمكن إهماله
entries.example: The difference in price is negligible.

entries.definitionEn: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفاوض للوصول إلى اتفاق
entries.example: They will negotiate the contract next week.

entries.definitionEn: Discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفاوض
entries.example: The negotiation lasted three days.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives near you.
entries.arabicMeaning: جار
entries.example: Our neighbour brought us some bread.

entries.definitionEn: The area around where you live, and the people there.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيّ سكني وما حوله من ناس
entries.example: This neighbourhood has several small parks.

entries.definitionEn: Near or next to a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاور
entries.example: People from neighbouring villages came to the market.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a negative statement to say that the same is true of someone or something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بعد نفي لتبيّن أن الحكم نفسه ينطبق على طرف آخر
entries.example: I don't like olives, and neither does she.

entries.definitionEn: Used before the first of two negative choices, usually with nor.
entries.arabicMeaning: تربط خيارين منفيين، وغالباً مع nor
entries.example: Neither the bus nor the train was on time.

entries.definitionEn: Not one and not the other of two people or things, used before a singular noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا هذا ولا ذاك من اثنين، قبل اسم مفرد
entries.example: Neither answer is correct.

entries.definitionEn: Not one and not the other of two people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا واحد منهما
entries.example: Neither of the keys fitted the lock.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is new to a skill, job, or belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستجدّ قليل الخبرة في مهارة أو عمل أو معتقد
entries.example: Even a neophyte can follow this recipe.

entries.definitionEn: The son of your brother or sister.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابن الأخ أو الأخت
entries.example: My nephew starts school in September.

entries.definitionEn: A fibre in the body that carries messages of feeling and movement. Also the courage to do something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصب ينقل الإحساس والحركة؛ أو جرأة على أمر صعب
entries.example: It took nerve to ask for a raise.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of worry or fear before something important.
entries.arabicMeaning: توتر وقلق قبل أمر مهم
entries.example: She always gets nerves before a speech.

entries.definitionEn: Worried or slightly afraid about what may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوتر أو قلق ممّا قد يحدث
entries.example: He felt nervous before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: In a worried or uneasy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتوتر وقلق
entries.example: She laughed nervously and looked at the door.

entries.definitionEn: The state of feeling nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: توتر وقلق
entries.example: His nervousness showed in his voice.

entries.definitionEn: A headland; a piece of land that sticks out into the sea, especially in place names.
entries.arabicMeaning: رأس بحري؛ أرض ناتئة في البحر وخصوصاً في أسماء الأماكن
entries.example: The village sits on a windy ness above the tide.

entries.definitionEn: Left after you take away costs, tax, or extra weight.
entries.arabicMeaning: صافٍ بعد طرح التكاليف أو الضريبة أو الوزن الزائد
entries.example: Her net pay is lower than the figure on the contract.

entries.definitionEn: Material of knotted string or wire with holes, used for catching things or in sport. Also the internet in some uses.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبكة من خيوط أو أسلاك؛ وقد تعني الإنترنت
entries.example: The football hit the back of the net.

entries.definitionEn: A person who spends time looking at pages on the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: متصفّح للإنترنت يتنقّل بين الصفحات
entries.example: The site is popular with casual net surfers.

entries.definitionEn: A system of connected lines, people, or computers.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبكة خطوط أو أشخاص أو حواسيب
entries.example: The rail network covers most of the country.

entries.definitionEn: A mental condition with strong anxiety or obsessive thoughts that make daily life harder.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصاب: قلق شديد أو أفكار وسواسية تعيق العيش اليومي
entries.example: Therapy helped her manage the neurosis without panic.

entries.definitionEn: Not supporting either side in a disagreement. Also not strongly coloured.
entries.arabicMeaning: محايد لا ينحاز؛ أو بلا لون صارخ
entries.example: The chair stayed neutral during the debate.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making something harmless, ineffective, or chemically neither acid nor alkali.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحييد يجعل الشيء غير ضار أو غير فعّال، أو معادلته كيميائياً
entries.example: Neutralisation of the spill took most of the night.

entries.definitionEn: To stop something from having an effect, or to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيّد أثراً أو يعادل حمضاً أو قاعدة
entries.example: They used lime to neutralize the acid.

entries.definitionEn: Not at any time; not once.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبداً؛ ليس في أي وقت
entries.example: I have never been to Japan.

entries.definitionEn: In spite of that; however.
entries.arabicMeaning: ومع ذلك
entries.example: The task was hard; nevertheless, she finished it.

entries.definitionEn: Recently made, bought, or found; not used or known before.
entries.arabicMeaning: جديد
entries.example: They moved into a new apartment.

entries.definitionEn: Recently born.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديث الولادة
entries.example: The newborn baby slept in a small crib.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: وافد جديد
entries.example: The club welcomed every newcomer at the door.

entries.definitionEn: Recently; a short time ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديثاً؛ منذ وقت قصير
entries.example: They are a newly married couple.

entries.definitionEn: New information about recent events, especially on television, radio, or in papers.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخبار
entries.example: Have you heard the news about the storm?

entries.definitionEn: A person who reads the news on television or radio.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذيع أخبار
entries.example: The newscaster summarised the day's events.

entries.definitionEn: A set of large printed sheets with news, sold daily or weekly.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيفة
entries.example: He reads the newspaper on the train.

entries.definitionEn: Important or interesting enough to be reported as news.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بأن يُنشر خبراً
entries.example: The discovery was newsworthy across the region.

entries.definitionEn: Immediately afterwards; then.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد ذلك مباشرة
entries.example: What happened next?

entries.definitionEn: Coming immediately after this one in time or order.
entries.arabicMeaning: التالي
entries.example: See you next week.

entries.definitionEn: In the nearest house, room, or building.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجاور في البيت أو الغرفة التالية
entries.example: Our next-door neighbours are very quiet.

entries.definitionEn: In or to the nearest house or room.
entries.arabicMeaning: في البيت المجاور أو إليه
entries.example: They live next door.

entries.definitionEn: The person or thing that follows this one.
entries.arabicMeaning: التالي من الأشخاص أو الأشياء
entries.example: Who's next in the queue?

entries.definitionEn: Beside; at the side of.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجانب
entries.example: Sit next to me.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant, kind, or enjoyable.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف أو ممتع
entries.example: It was nice to see you again.

entries.definitionEn: In a pleasant, kind, or satisfactory way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلطف أو على نحو مرضٍ
entries.example: The room is coming along nicely.

entries.definitionEn: A comfortable or suitable position. Also a small specialist part of a market, or a hollow in a wall.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضع ملائم؛ أو شريحة سوق ضيقة؛ أو كوّة في جدار
entries.example: She found a niche writing about local food.

entries.definitionEn: An informal name used instead of a real name.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقب غير رسمي بدلاً من الاسم الحقيقي
entries.example: His nickname at school was Fox.

entries.definitionEn: The daughter of your brother or sister.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابنة الأخ أو الأخت
entries.example: My niece is learning to ride a bicycle.

entries.definitionEn: Near in place or time; almost. Mainly literary or old-fashioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريب أو يكاد؛ في أسلوب أدبي أو قديم
entries.example: The end of the journey was nigh.

entries.definitionEn: The time of darkness between evening and morning.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليل
entries.example: I sleep well at night.

entries.definitionEn: A place that is open late, where people dance and listen to music.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادي ليلي
entries.example: They went to a nightclub after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Entertainment available at night in a city, such as bars and clubs.
entries.arabicMeaning: حياة ليلية من سهر وترفيه
entries.example: The city is famous for its nightlife.

entries.definitionEn: A very frightening dream. Also a very difficult or unpleasant situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: كابوس؛ أو وضع بالغ السوء
entries.example: The delay at the airport was a nightmare.

entries.definitionEn: The number 9.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسعة؛ العدد 9
entries.example: There are nine chairs in the room.

entries.definitionEn: The number 19.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسعة عشر؛ العدد 19
entries.example: She will be nineteen in March.

entries.definitionEn: The number 90.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسعون؛ العدد 90
entries.example: My grandmother is ninety years old.

entries.definitionEn: Used to give a negative answer, or to disagree.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا؛ للرفض أو المخالفة
entries.example: No, I am not ready yet.

entries.definitionEn: Not any; not even one.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا شيء من؛ ولا حتى واحد
entries.example: There is no milk in the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: Not a single person; nobody.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا أحد؛ ليس هناك شخص واحد
entries.example: No one answered the door.

entries.definitionEn: The class of people with a high rank by birth. Also the quality of being morally admirable.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبقة النبلاء؛ وأيضاً نبل الخلق
entries.example: Members of the nobility attended the ceremony.

entries.definitionEn: Having high moral qualities, or belonging to a family of high rank.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبيل الخلق أو نبيل النسب
entries.example: It was noble of her to admit the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: A man who belongs to the nobility by rank or birth.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبيل؛ رجل من طبقة النبلاء
entries.example: The nobleman owned a large estate in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: No person; not anyone.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا أحد
entries.example: Nobody knew the password.

entries.definitionEn: Active or happening at night rather than by day.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليلي؛ ينشط أو يحدث في الليل لا في النهار
entries.example: Owls are nocturnal hunters.

entries.definitionEn: A quick movement of the head down and up, used to agree, greet, or give a signal.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيماءة بالرأس للموافقة أو التحية أو الإشارة
entries.example: She gave a small nod of agreement.

entries.definitionEn: To move your head down and up, usually to show agreement, greeting, or understanding.
entries.arabicMeaning: يومئ برأسه موافقة أو تحية أو فهماً
entries.example: He nodded when I asked if he was ready.

entries.definitionEn: A sound, especially a loud or unwanted one.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضجيج؛ صوت مرتفع أو غير مرغوب
entries.example: Please do not make so much noise.

entries.definitionEn: In a loud way; with a lot of noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصخب؛ بصوت مرتفع
entries.example: The children ran noisily down the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: Making a lot of noise, or full of noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاخب؛ كثير الضجيج
entries.example: The café was too noisy for a quiet talk.

entries.definitionEn: A person who moves from place to place instead of living in one settled home.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحّالة ينتقل من موضع إلى آخر ولا يستقر في بيت واحد
entries.example: The nomad moved with his herd each season.

entries.definitionEn: The official act of naming someone as a candidate for a job, prize, or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترشيح رسمي لشخص لمنصب أو جائزة
entries.example: Her nomination for the award surprised her.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has been officially named as a candidate for a job, prize, or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرشَّح لمنصب أو جائزة
entries.example: Each nominee gave a short speech.

entries.definitionEn: Used of a place where people are not allowed to smoke.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممنوع التدخين
entries.example: We booked a non-smoking room.

entries.definitionEn: Calm and casually unconcerned, as if nothing is worth worry or fuss.
entries.arabicMeaning: متظاهر باللامبالاة؛ هادئ كأن الأمر لا يستحق الاكتراث
entries.example: He gave a nonchalant shrug, as if the delay did not matter.

entries.definitionEn: In a calmly casual way, showing little concern.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا اكتراث ظاهر؛ بهدوء لامبالٍ
entries.example: She nonchalantly dropped the keys on the desk.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking distinctive features; ordinary and hard to describe.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا ملامح مميزة؛ عادي يصعب وصفه
entries.example: They met in a nondescript grey building.

entries.definitionEn: Not any of a group of people or things; not one.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا أحد منهم أو لا شيء منه
entries.example: None of the keys fitted the lock.

entries.definitionEn: In spite of what has just been said; all the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: مع ذلك؛ على الرغم مما سبق
entries.example: The task was hard; she finished it nonetheless.

entries.definitionEn: Not done as a paid job; amateur rather than professional.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محترف؛ على سبيل الهواية لا المهنة
entries.example: The choir is a nonprofessional group of neighbours.

entries.definitionEn: Words or ideas that are silly, untrue, or have no meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: هراء؛ كلام فارغ أو أفكار لا معنى لها
entries.example: That story is complete nonsense.

entries.definitionEn: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
entries.arabicMeaning: الظهر؛ الساعة الثانية عشرة نهاراً
entries.example: We will meet at noon.

entries.definitionEn: Used after neither, or to add a second negative idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: ولا؛ تُستخدم بعد neither أو لإضافة نفي ثانٍ
entries.example: He neither called nor sent a message.

entries.definitionEn: Usual and as you would expect; not strange or special.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادي؛ طبيعي كما يُتوقع
entries.example: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.

entries.definitionEn: Usually; in the ordinary way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادةً؛ على النحو المألوف
entries.example: I normally take the bus to work.

entries.definitionEn: Accepted standards of behaviour in a group or society.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعراف ومعايير سلوك مقبولة في جماعة أو مجتمع
entries.example: Office norms require people to be on time.

entries.definitionEn: In, towards, or facing the north.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمالي؛ في جهة الشمال أو نحوها
entries.example: We entered through the north gate.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the north.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمالاً؛ باتجاه الشمال
entries.example: Keep walking north until you see the river.

entries.definitionEn: The direction towards the top of a map, or the part of a place that is in that direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشمال: الجهة أو الجزء الشمالي من مكان
entries.example: Cold air was coming from the north.

entries.definitionEn: In, towards, or facing the northeast.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمالي شرقي
entries.example: A northeast wind made the morning colder.

entries.definitionEn: The direction between north and east, or the part of a place that lies that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشمال الشرقي
entries.example: The storm moved towards the northeast.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the northeast part of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع في الشمال الشرقي أو منسوب إليه
entries.example: She grew up in a northeastern town.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the north of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمالي؛ من شمال بلد أو منطقة
entries.example: He has a northern accent.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the north.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوب الشمال
entries.example: The path climbs northward into the hills.

entries.definitionEn: In, towards, or facing the northwest.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمالي غربي
entries.example: A northwest wind brought dry air.

entries.definitionEn: The direction between north and west, or the part of a place that lies that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشمال الغربي
entries.example: They drove towards the northwest.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the northwest part of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع في الشمال الغربي أو منسوب إليه
entries.example: The northwestern region gets more rain.

entries.definitionEn: The part of your face that you use to smell and breathe.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأنف
entries.example: She has a small nose.

entries.definitionEn: A bittersweet longing for a time, place, or feeling in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: حنين ممزوج بالأسى إلى زمن أو مكان أو شعور مضى
entries.example: The old photographs filled her with nostalgia.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or causing a longing for the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: حنون إلى الماضي أو مثير لذلك الحنين
entries.example: He felt nostalgic when he heard that song.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows longing for the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحنين إلى الماضي
entries.example: They spoke nostalgically about their first apartment.

entries.definitionEn: One of the two openings at the end of the nose.
entries.arabicMeaning: منخر؛ إحدى فتحتي الأنف
entries.example: Cold air stung her left nostril.

entries.definitionEn: Used with a verb or other word to make it negative.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة نفي تجعل الفعل أو الكلمة منفية
entries.example: I am not hungry.

entries.definitionEn: Important, interesting, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بالذكر؛ بارز يستحق الانتباه
entries.example: The city is notable for its old library.

entries.definitionEn: A short written message. Also a single musical sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسالة قصيرة مكتوبة؛ وأيضاً نغمة موسيقية
entries.example: She left a note on the table.

entries.definitionEn: To write something down, or to give it your attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسجّل شيئاً أو ينتبه إليه
entries.example: Please note the new opening hours.

entries.definitionEn: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفتر ملاحظات
entries.example: I wrote the address in my notebook.

entries.definitionEn: Not anything; no thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا شيء
entries.example: There is nothing in this bag.

entries.definitionEn: A written announcement giving information. Also attention given to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعلان مكتوب؛ وأيضاً الانتباه إلى شيء
entries.example: A notice on the door said the shop was closed.

entries.definitionEn: To see, hear, or become aware of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلاحظ شيئاً ببصره أو سمعه أو انتباهه
entries.example: Did you notice the new sign?

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see or recognize; clear enough to attract attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظاهر يسهل الانتباه إليه
entries.example: There was a noticeable change in his voice.

entries.definitionEn: A board on a wall where notices and messages are put.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة إعلانات تُعلَّق عليها الرسائل
entries.example: The timetable is on the noticeboard.

entries.definitionEn: An idea, belief, or understanding, often a rather vague one.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكرة أو تصوّر، وغالباً غير مكتمل
entries.example: I had no notion of how long the trip would take.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being widely known for something bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوء السمعة؛ شهرة قائمة على أمر سيئ
entries.example: The scheme gained notoriety after the report.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is famous for a bad or unwelcome quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ذائع الصيت بسوء
entries.example: The route is notoriously slow at rush hour.

entries.definitionEn: In spite of; without being stopped or cancelled by something.
entries.arabicMeaning: على الرغم من؛ من غير أن يمنع ذلك الأمرَ
entries.example: Notwithstanding the rain, the match went ahead.

entries.definitionEn: The number zero, especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفر، وخصوصاً في الاستعمال البريطاني
entries.example: Write nought if the answer is zero.

entries.definitionEn: A word that names a person, place, thing, or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: اسم في النحو: كلمة تسمّي شخصاً أو مكاناً أو شيئاً أو معنى
entries.example: In this sentence, table is a noun.

entries.definitionEn: To give a person, animal, or plant the food needed to live and grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغذّي شخصاً أو حيواناً أو نباتاً بما يلزم للحياة والنمو
entries.example: Warm soup can nourish you after a long walk.

entries.definitionEn: Food or other substances that help a person, animal, or plant live and grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: غذاء أو ما يمدّ الجسم أو النبات بما يحتاج إليه
entries.example: The plants need water and nourishment.

entries.definitionEn: A long written story about invented people and events.
entries.arabicMeaning: رواية: قصة طويلة مكتوبة عن أشخاص وأحداث متخيَّلة
entries.example: She is reading a long novel.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes novels.
entries.arabicMeaning: روائي؛ كاتب روايات
entries.example: The novelist signed copies of her book.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being new and unusual. Also a small unusual object sold as a toy or gift.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدّة الشيء وغرابة عهده؛ وأيضاً شيء طريف صغير للبيع
entries.example: The novelty of the gadget wore off after a week.

entries.definitionEn: The eleventh month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوفمبر / تشرين الثاني؛ الشهر الحادي عشر من السنة
entries.example: Her birthday is in November.

entries.definitionEn: At the present time; at this moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: الآن؛ في هذا الوقت
entries.example: We should leave now.

entries.definitionEn: Used to mean that because a situation is true, something else can happen. Often followed by that.
entries.arabicMeaning: رابطة بمعنى ما دام الأمر كذلك، وغالباً مع that
entries.example: Now that you are here, we can begin.

entries.definitionEn: At the present time, in contrast with the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: في هذه الأيام، مقارنةً بما كان سابقاً
entries.example: Nowadays many people work from home.

entries.definitionEn: Not in or to any place.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا في أي مكان ولا إلى أي مكان
entries.example: There was nowhere to sit.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the energy produced from the centre of atoms, or to that central part itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: نووي؛ متعلق بطاقة نواة الذرة أو بالنواة ذاتها
entries.example: Some power stations use nuclear fuel.

entries.definitionEn: The central part of an atom or a cell. Also the core of a group or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: نواة الذرة أو الخلية؛ وأيضاً قلب جماعة أو فكرة
entries.example: The nucleus is at the centre of the atom.

entries.definitionEn: A person, thing, or situation that causes trouble or annoyance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصدر إزعاج من شخص أو شيء أو موقف
entries.example: The dripping tap is a real nuisance.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to feel in a part of the body, or emotionally unable to react, often after cold, shock, or a drug.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاقد الإحساس في موضع من الجسم، أو خدر المشاعر بعد برد أو صدمة أو دواء
entries.example: My fingers were numb from the cold.

entries.definitionEn: To take away physical feeling or emotional reaction.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخدر الإحساس الجسدي أو يُضعف ردّ الفعل العاطفي
entries.example: The dentist used a gel to numb her gum.

entries.definitionEn: A word or symbol that shows how many, or a figure used to identify something, such as a phone number.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدد أو رقم، أو رقم يُستخدم للتعريف كرقم الهاتف
entries.example: What is your phone number?

entries.definitionEn: Relating to numbers, or expressed as numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: عددي؛ متعلق بالأرقام أو مُعبَّر عنه بها
entries.example: The results are shown in numerical order.

entries.definitionEn: Many; existing in large numbers.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير؛ موجود بأعداد كبيرة
entries.example: She received numerous messages that morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person trained to care for people who are ill or injured.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممرض أو ممرضة؛ من يُدرَّب على رعاية المرضى والجرحى
entries.example: The nurse checked his temperature.

entries.definitionEn: To look after someone who is ill or injured.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتني بمريض أو جريح
entries.example: She stayed home to nurse her son through a fever.

entries.definitionEn: A place where young children are looked after. Also a place where plants are grown for sale.
entries.arabicMeaning: حضانة أطفال؛ وأيضاً مشتل تُربّى فيه النباتات للبيع
entries.example: She drops her daughter at the nursery on the way to work.

entries.definitionEn: A dry fruit with a hard shell and an edible seed inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمرة جافة صلبة القشرة وبداخلها بذرة تؤكل
entries.example: She cracked a nut with a small hammer.

entries.definitionEn: A substance in food that living things need in order to live and grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنصر غذائي يحتاجه الكائن الحي للعيش والنمو
entries.example: Spinach is rich in this nutrient.

entries.definitionEn: The process of taking in and using food, or the food needed for health.
entries.arabicMeaning: التغذية: تناول الطعام والاستفادة منه، أو الغذاء اللازم للصحة
entries.example: Good nutrition helps you stay healthy.

entries.definitionEn: Containing substances that are good for health and growth.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغذٍّ؛ يحتوي ما ينفع الصحة والنمو
entries.example: Oats make a nutritious breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: The hard outer covering of a nut. In a nutshell means in a few words.
entries.arabicMeaning: قشرة الجوز الصلبة؛ وتعبير in a nutshell يعني باختصار
entries.example: In a nutshell, we need more time.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a number from one to twelve to say what hour it is.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم بعد الرقم من الواحد إلى الاثني عشر للدلالة على الساعة التامة
entries.example: The train leaves at six o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: A large tree with hard wood, or the wood of that tree.
entries.arabicMeaning: السنديان أو البلوط، أو خشبه الصلب
entries.example: An old oak stood beside the house.

entries.definitionEn: A solemn promise, often made with a formal or religious formula. Also a swear word.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمين رسمي أو ديني؛ وأيضاً سباب
entries.example: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of doing what you are told to do by a person or rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاعة أمر شخص أو حكم قاعدة
entries.example: The dog was trained for calm obedience.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to do what you are told to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطيع؛ يمتثل لما يُؤمر به
entries.example: The obedient dog sat when she raised her hand.

entries.definitionEn: To do what a person, rule, or law tells you to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطيع شخصاً أو قاعدة أو قانوناً
entries.example: Drivers must obey the speed limit.

entries.definitionEn: A short piece of writing about the life of someone who has just died.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعي: نص قصير عن حياة من توفي حديثاً
entries.example: She read her uncle's obituary in the paper.

entries.definitionEn: A thing that you can see and touch. In grammar, the person or thing affected by a verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: جسم مادي يُرى ويُلمس؛ وفي النحو مفعول به
entries.example: A small metal object lay on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you disagree with something or that you do not approve of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعترض أو يبدي عدم الموافقة
entries.example: Several neighbours object to the late noise.

entries.definitionEn: A reason for disagreeing, or the act of saying that you disagree.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتراض؛ سبب للرفض أو فعل إبدائه
entries.example: Does anyone have an objection to the plan?

entries.definitionEn: Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضوعي؛ قائم على الوقائع لا على الهوى
entries.example: Try to give an objective summary of the facts.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you are trying to achieve; a goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدف يُسعى إلى بلوغه
entries.example: Our main objective is to finish on time.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you must do because of a law, duty, or promise.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزام أو واجب يفرضه قانون أو ذمة أو وعد
entries.example: Parents have an obligation to care for their children.

entries.definitionEn: To make it necessary for someone to do something. Also to do someone a favour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُلزم شخصاً بفعل شيء؛ وأيضاً يسدي إليه معروفاً
entries.example: The contract will oblige both sides to share the costs.

entries.definitionEn: Slanting rather than straight or level. Also expressed in an indirect way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مائل غير مستقيم؛ وأيضاً غير مباشر في التعبير
entries.example: She made an oblique remark about the missing file.

entries.definitionEn: Not well known, or hard to understand or see clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الشهرة، أو غامض يصعب فهمه أو رؤيته
entries.example: He quoted an obscure poet from the last century.

entries.definitionEn: To hide something or make it difficult to see, hear, or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحجب شيئاً أو يجعل رؤيته أو فهمه عسيراً
entries.example: Low clouds can obscure the mountains.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is hard to understand, see, or know about.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غامض يعسر فهمه أو إدراكه
entries.example: The rule was obscurely worded and hard to apply.

entries.definitionEn: The act of watching something carefully. Also a remark based on what you have noticed.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصد ومراقبة دقيقة؛ وأيضاً ملاحظة تُقال بناءً على ما رُئي
entries.example: Careful observation showed a crack in the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To watch something carefully, or to notice it. Also to follow a rule or custom.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرصد أو يلاحظ؛ وأيضاً يلتزم بقاعدة أو عادة
entries.example: Scientists observe the birds each spring.

entries.definitionEn: A person who watches an event or situation, often without taking part.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراقب يشهد الأمر غالباً من غير أن يشارك فيه
entries.example: An independent observer watched the count.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone's mind so that they cannot stop thinking about a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحوذ على الفكر حتى لا يكاد ينصرف عنه
entries.example: Do not let one mistake obsess you for weeks.

entries.definitionEn: A thought or interest that you cannot stop returning to, often in an unhealthy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: هوس: فكرة أو اهتمام لا يفارق الذهن، وغالباً على نحو غير صحي
entries.example: His obsession with neatness slowed every task.

entries.definitionEn: Thinking too much about one thing, in a way that is hard to control.
entries.arabicMeaning: قهري الاستحواذ؛ مفرط الانشغال بشيء واحد
entries.example: She has an obsessive need to check the locks.

entries.definitionEn: Something that blocks your way or makes it harder to achieve something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقبة تعترض الطريق أو تصعّب بلوغ غاية
entries.example: Lack of money was the main obstacle.

entries.definitionEn: To get something, especially by asking, buying, or making an effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصل على شيء بطلب أو شراء أو جهد
entries.example: You can obtain a copy from the office.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see, understand, or recognize; not hidden.
entries.arabicMeaning: واضح يسهل إدراكه؛ غير خفي
entries.example: It was obvious that she was tired.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is easy to see or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوضوح؛ على نحو لا يخفى
entries.example: He was obviously pleased with the result.

entries.definitionEn: A particular time when something happens. Also a special event.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناسبة: وقت بعينه يقع فيه أمر، أو حدث خاص
entries.example: A wedding is a special occasion.

entries.definitionEn: To cause something to happen, in rather formal language.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسبب في حدوث شيء، في أسلوب أقرب إلى الرسمية
entries.example: The delay occasioned extra costs.

entries.definitionEn: Happening sometimes, but not often or regularly.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرضي؛ يحدث أحياناً لا بانتظام
entries.example: We hear occasional traffic from the road.

entries.definitionEn: Sometimes, but not often.
entries.arabicMeaning: من حين إلى آخر؛ لا كثيراً
entries.example: She occasionally works on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives in, works in, or is present in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغل المكان: من يسكنه أو يعمل فيه أو يوجد فيه
entries.example: Each occupant of the building received a letter.

entries.definitionEn: A job or type of work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهنة أو نوع من العمل
entries.example: Teaching is a demanding occupation.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a person's job or to work in general.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهني؛ متعلق بالعمل أو بالحرفة
entries.example: They discussed occupational risks in the lab.

entries.definitionEn: To fill a space or period of time, or to live or work in a place. Also to keep someone busy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشغل حيّزاً أو وقتاً، أو يسكن مكاناً أو يعمل فيه؛ وأيضاً يشغل شخصاً عن الفراغ
entries.example: Two families occupy the small house.

entries.definitionEn: To happen, especially without being planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدث، وخصوصاً من غير تدبير سابق
entries.example: Power cuts occur during storms.

entries.definitionEn: A very large area of salt water between continents.
entries.arabicMeaning: محيط: مساحة واسعة جداً من الماء المالح بين القارات
entries.example: They sailed across the ocean.

entries.definitionEn: The tenth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكتوبر / تشرين الأول؛ الشهر العاشر من السنة
entries.example: The conference is in October.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is between eighty and eighty-nine years old.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمانيني: من كان بين الثمانين والتاسعة والثمانين
entries.example: The octogenarian still walks to the market each morning.

entries.definitionEn: Strange or unusual. Also used of a number that cannot be divided by two.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب أو غير مألوف؛ وأيضاً فردي لا ينقسم على اثنين
entries.example: It seemed odd that the shop was closed at noon.

entries.definitionEn: A strange person, thing, or quality; something that does not fit the usual pattern.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرابة أو أمر شاذ لا يجري على المألوف
entries.example: The old clock is an oddity in a modern kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show belonging, origin, contents, or what something is about or made from.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على الإضافة أو الأصل أو المحتوى أو المادة أو موضوع الحديث
entries.example: The cover of the book is torn.

entries.definitionEn: Not switched on; not operating.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطفأ؛ غير شغّال
entries.example: The lights are off.

entries.definitionEn: Away from a place, or so that something is removed or no longer on the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيداً، أو على نحو يُنزع به الشيء عن موضعه أو عن الجسم
entries.example: She took her coat off.

entries.definitionEn: Away from a surface or position; no longer on something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن سطح أو موضع؛ لم يعد على الشيء
entries.example: The glass fell off the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone upset or angry by what you say or do. Also to break a law or rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرح شعور أحد أو يغضبه بقوله أو فعله؛ وأيضاً يخالف قانوناً أو قاعدة
entries.example: I did not mean to offend you.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has broken a law or rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخالف؛ من ارتكب جرماً أو خرق قاعدة
entries.example: The offender had to pay a fine.

entries.definitionEn: A crime or a break of the rules. Also the feeling of being hurt or insulted. Offence is usual in British English; offense in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة أو مخالفة؛ وأيضاً شعور بالإساءة. offence الشائع بريطانياً وoffense أمريكياً
entries.example: He was charged with a minor offence.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to upset or insult people.
entries.arabicMeaning: جارح أو مسيء يحتمل أن يؤذي الشعور
entries.example: Some people found the joke offensive.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that you are willing to give or do something. Also a special price.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض بأن تعطي أو تفعل شيئاً؛ وأيضاً سعر خاص
entries.example: They made me a job offer.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you are willing to give something or to do something for someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض أن يعطي شيئاً أو يفعل شيئاً لأحد
entries.example: Can I offer you some tea?

entries.definitionEn: Without checking or thinking first; from memory at that moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: على البديهة من غير مراجعة أو تفكير سابق
entries.example: I cannot give you the figures offhand.

entries.definitionEn: A room or building where people do desk work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب: غرفة أو مبنى للعمل المكتبي
entries.example: She works in a small office.

entries.definitionEn: A person with a position of authority, especially in the police or the armed forces.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضابط أو موظف ذو سلطة، وخصوصاً في الشرطة أو الجيش
entries.example: A police officer asked for my name.

entries.definitionEn: Approved by a person or group in authority; connected with their role.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسمي؛ صادر عن جهة ذات سلطة أو متعلق بدورها
entries.example: This is the official list of winners.

entries.definitionEn: A person who holds a position of authority in an organization or government.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسؤول يتولى منصباً في هيئة أو حكومة
entries.example: A city official opened the new library.

entries.definitionEn: In an official way; according to formal rules or announcements.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسمياً؛ بحسب القواعد أو الإعلانات المعتمدة
entries.example: The museum is officially closed on Mondays.

entries.definitionEn: In the sea, at a distance from the land. Also based in another country, often for business.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع في البحر بعيداً عن البر؛ وأيضاً قائم في بلد آخر وغالباً لأغراض العمل
entries.example: The company built an offshore wind farm.

entries.definitionEn: A person's or animal's child or children. The form is the same in the singular and the plural.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذرية الشخص أو الحيوان؛ والصيغة واحدة للمفرد والجمع
entries.example: The bird stayed close to its offspring.

entries.definitionEn: Many times; frequently.
entries.arabicMeaning: غالباً؛ مرات كثيرة
entries.example: I often read before bed.

entries.definitionEn: A thick liquid from plants or from under the ground, used in cooking, machines, or as fuel.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيت: سائل كثيف من النبات أو من باطن الأرض، للطبخ أو الآلات أو الوقود
entries.example: Add a little oil to the pan.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with oil, or containing a lot of oil.
entries.arabicMeaning: دهني؛ مغطى بالزيت أو كثير الزيت
entries.example: Wash your hands if they feel oily.

entries.definitionEn: A thick, smooth medicine that you rub on the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهم: دواء كثيف أملس يُدهن على الجلد
entries.example: She put ointment on the dry skin.

entries.definitionEn: All right; acceptable or not ill. OK and okay are both used.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخير أو مقبول. وتُستعمل OK وokay
entries.example: Are you okay after the long flight?

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is acceptable or all right. OK and okay are both used.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مقبول أو سليم. وتُستعمل OK وokay
entries.example: The printer is working okay now.

entries.definitionEn: Having lived or existed for a long time; not new. Also used for a former role or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: قديم أو كبير السن؛ غير جديد. ويُستعمل أيضاً لما كان سابقاً
entries.example: Her grandfather is very old.

entries.definitionEn: No longer modern in style, method, or attitude.
entries.arabicMeaning: قديم الطراز في الشكل أو الأسلوب أو الموقف
entries.example: The kitchen has an old-fashioned stove.

entries.definitionEn: A small green or black fruit, eaten or crushed for oil. Also the tree that bears it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمرة الزيتون الخضراء أو السوداء، تُؤكل أو يُستخرج منها الزيت؛ وأيضاً شجرتها
entries.example: He added an olive to the salad.

entries.definitionEn: Oil pressed from olives, used in cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيت الزيتون
entries.example: Fry the onions in olive oil.

entries.definitionEn: The ancient sanctuary in Greece where the original Olympic Games were held.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولمبيا: الحرم اليوناني القديم الذي أُقيمت فيه الألعاب الأولمبية الأولى
entries.example: Tourists walked among the ruins of Olympia.

entries.definitionEn: A celebration of the Olympic Games, or a period of four years linked to them. Also a major international contest, especially in sport or knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: دورة أولمبية أو حقبة الأربع سنوات المرتبطة بها؛ وأيضاً مباراة دولية كبرى في رياضة أو علم
entries.example: She won a medal at the last Olympiad.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the Olympic Games.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولمبي؛ متعلق بالألعاب الأولمبية
entries.example: He is training for the Olympic team.

entries.definitionEn: The Olympic Games, a major international sports competition held every four years.
entries.arabicMeaning: الألعاب الأولمبية: مسابقة رياضية دولية كبرى كل أربع سنوات
entries.example: She watched the Olympics on television.

entries.definitionEn: A dish of beaten eggs cooked in a pan, often folded around a filling. Omelette is usual in British English; omelet in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجة بيض تُطبخ في مقلاة وغالباً تُطوى على حشوة. omelette الشائع بريطانياً وomelet أمريكياً
entries.example: I had a cheese omelette for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: So that a machine is working, or so that clothes are being worn. Also so that something continues.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحيث يعمل الجهاز أو يُلبس الثوب؛ وأيضاً بحيث يستمر الأمر
entries.example: Please put the kettle on.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is touching a surface, or to talk about a day, date, or subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: على سطح؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً مع اليوم أو التاريخ أو موضوع الحديث
entries.example: The keys are on the table.

entries.definitionEn: One time only. Also at a time in the past, but not now.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرة واحدة؛ وأيضاً في زمن مضى لا الآن
entries.example: I have visited that museum once.

entries.definitionEn: As soon as; when something has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمجرد أن؛ حين يقع الأمر
entries.example: Once the paint is dry, we can hang the pictures.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean a single person or thing, or to stress that there is only that number.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسبق اسماً بمعنى واحد من ذلك الشيء، أو لتوكيد هذا العدد
entries.example: I have one question.

entries.definitionEn: The number 1.
entries.arabicMeaning: العدد واحد
entries.example: One plus four is five.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun for a single person or thing already mentioned, or easy to understand from the situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يحل محل اسم مفرد سبق ذكره أو يُفهم من المقام
entries.example: If you need a pen, I have one.

entries.definitionEn: The reflexive form of one, used when the same person is both the subject and the object, or for emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة oneself الانعكاسية من one، حين يكون المرء فاعلاً ومفعولاً أو للتوكيد
entries.example: It is hard to see oneself clearly.

entries.definitionEn: A round vegetable with a strong smell and taste, made of tight layers.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصلة: خضار مستديرة حادة الرائحة والطعم ذات طبقات متراصة
entries.example: She chopped an onion for the soup.

entries.definitionEn: Connected to the internet, or happening on the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: متصل بالإنترنت أو جارٍ عبره
entries.example: I found an online map of the city.

entries.definitionEn: Using the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبر الإنترنت
entries.example: You can pay online.

entries.definitionEn: With no others of the same kind; unique in that group or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: الوحيد من نوعه في ذلك المقام
entries.example: This is the only ticket left.

entries.definitionEn: No more than; nothing except.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقط؛ لا أكثر من ذلك
entries.example: She only asked for a glass of water.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or appearing on the stage during a performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: على خشبة المسرح أثناء العرض
entries.example: The onstage furniture had to be moved between scenes.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show movement to a position on a surface. Onto is often one word; on to is also used.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى موضع على سطح. وتُكتب onto كلمة واحدة كثيراً، وon to أيضاً
entries.example: The cat jumped onto the chair.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of not letting light through. Also the quality of being hard to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: العتامة التي تمنع نفوذ الضوء؛ وأيضاً غموض المعنى
entries.example: The opacity of the glass kept the room dim.

entries.definitionEn: Not allowing light to pass through. Also difficult to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: معتم لا ينفذ منه الضوء؛ وأيضاً عسير الفهم
entries.example: The bathroom window is opaque.

entries.definitionEn: Not closed or covered; allowing people or things to go in or out.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفتوح غير مغلق؛ يأذن بالدخول أو الخروج
entries.example: The window is open.

entries.definitionEn: To make something no longer closed, or to become no longer closed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتح شيئاً أو ينفتح
entries.example: Please open the door.

entries.definitionEn: The beginning of an event, or a hole or gap. Also a job that is available.
entries.arabicMeaning: افتتاح حدث أو بدايته، أو فجوة؛ وأيضاً شاغر وظيفي
