entries.example: The opening of the new shop is on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that does not hide thoughts, feelings, or actions.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصراحة وعلن، من غير إخفاء للفكر أو الشعور أو الفعل
entries.example: She spoke openly about her doubts.

entries.definitionEn: A play in which the words are sung to music.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوبرا: مسرحية تُغنّى كلماتها مع الموسيقى
entries.example: We went to the opera last night.

entries.definitionEn: To use a machine so that it works, or (of a machine) to work. Also to cut into a body in a medical procedure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشغّل آلة أو تعمل هي؛ وأيضاً يجري عملية جراحية
entries.example: Do you know how to operate this machine?

entries.definitionEn: A planned activity with a clear purpose. Also a medical procedure in which a doctor cuts into the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية منظمة ذات غاية؛ وأيضاً عملية جراحية
entries.example: He had an operation on his knee.

entries.definitionEn: A person who controls a machine. Also a company that runs a service.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشغّل آلة؛ وأيضاً شركة تتولى تشغيل خدمة
entries.example: The crane needs a skilled operator.

entries.definitionEn: What you think or believe about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رأي؛ ما تراه أو تعتقده في أمر
entries.example: In my opinion, we should wait.

entries.definitionEn: A person or team that you compete against, or someone who disagrees with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصم في منافسة، أو من يخالفك الرأي
entries.example: She beat her opponent in the final.

entries.definitionEn: A chance to do something or to get something you want.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرصة لفعل شيء أو نيل ما تريده
entries.example: This job is a good opportunity.

entries.definitionEn: To disagree with a plan or idea and try to stop it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعارض خطة أو فكرة ويسعى إلى منعها
entries.example: Many residents oppose the new road.

entries.definitionEn: Facing something, or completely different from it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقابل لشيء، أو معاكس له تمام الاختلاف
entries.example: They live on the opposite side of the street.

entries.definitionEn: On the other side of a space, facing someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الجهة المقابلة، مواجهاً شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: She sat opposite and opened her book.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that is completely different from another.
entries.arabicMeaning: العكس: شخص أو شيء يختلف تمام الاختلاف عن آخر
entries.example: Hot is the opposite of cold.

entries.definitionEn: Facing someone or something, with a space between.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقابل شخص أو شيء وبينهما فراغ
entries.example: The bank is opposite the station.

entries.definitionEn: Strong disagreement with a plan or idea. Also the people or team competing against you.
entries.arabicMeaning: معارضة شديدة لخطة أو فكرة؛ وأيضاً الطرف المنافس
entries.example: There was strong opposition to the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To treat people harshly and unfairly, especially by using power to limit their freedom.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضطهد الناس بقسوة وجور، وخصوصاً بتضييق حريتهم بالسلطة
entries.example: The new rules seemed designed to oppress smaller shops.

entries.definitionEn: Cruel or unfair treatment, especially by people in power.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطهاد: معاملة قاسية أو جائرة، وخصوصاً من ذوي السلطة
entries.example: They wrote about the oppression of factory workers in that period.

entries.definitionEn: A tendency to expect that good things will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفاؤل: ميل إلى ترقب الخير
entries.example: Her optimism helped the team stay calm.

entries.definitionEn: A person who usually expects good things to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفائل: من يغلب عليه ترقب الخير
entries.example: He is an optimist even when plans change.

entries.definitionEn: Hoping or expecting that good things will happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفائل؛ يرجو الخير أو يتوقعه
entries.example: She is optimistic about the test results.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you can choose to do or have.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيار يمكن اختياره فعلاً أو اقتناءً
entries.example: You have the option to pay later.

entries.definitionEn: Not required; you can choose whether to have or do it.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختياري غير إلزامي؛ يجوز فعله أو تركه
entries.example: The dessert is optional, so you can skip it.

entries.definitionEn: Great wealth displayed in rich surroundings, clothes, or possessions.
entries.arabicMeaning: بذخ وثراء فاحش يظهر في المكان أو اللباس أو المقتنيات
entries.example: The hotel lobby was decorated with quiet opulence.

entries.definitionEn: Very rich and luxurious in appearance or style.
entries.arabicMeaning: مترف بالغ الفخامة والثراء في الهيئة أو الأسلوب
entries.example: They dined in an opulent hall with marble floors.

entries.definitionEn: In a richly luxurious way that shows great wealth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببذخ وفخامة ظاهرة تدل على ثراء كبير
entries.example: The rooms were opulently furnished with silk and gold.

entries.definitionEn: Used between words or clauses to show a choice or another possibility.
entries.arabicMeaning: أو؛ حرف عطف يربط بين خيارين أو إمكانين
entries.example: Would you like tea or coffee?

entries.definitionEn: Spoken rather than written. Also relating to the mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: شفهي لا مكتوب؛ وقد يعني متعلقاً بالفم
entries.example: The course ends with an oral exam.

entries.definitionEn: A spoken examination, often used to test a language or a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختبار شفهي، وغالباً ما يُستعمل في اللغة أو في مادة دراسية
entries.example: She passed the oral but found the written paper harder.

entries.definitionEn: Having a colour between red and yellow, like the fruit of the same name.
entries.arabicMeaning: برتقالي؛ لون بين الأحمر والأصفر كلون الثمرة
entries.example: He wore an orange jacket on the building site.

entries.definitionEn: A round fruit with thick skin and sweet juice. Also the colour of that fruit.
entries.arabicMeaning: برتقالة؛ ثمرة مستديرة حلوة العصير، ويُطلق أيضاً على لونها
entries.example: She peeled an orange and shared the pieces.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is skilled at making public speeches.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطيب بارع في الكلام أمام جمهور
entries.example: The orator held the crowd's attention for an hour.

entries.definitionEn: The curved path of a planet, moon, or satellite around another body in space.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدار؛ مسار منحنٍ لكوكب أو قمر أو قمر صناعي حول جرم آخر
entries.example: The satellite was placed in orbit around the Earth.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of land planted with fruit trees.
entries.arabicMeaning: بستان تُزرع فيه أشجار الفاكهة
entries.example: Apple trees filled the orchard behind the farmhouse.

entries.definitionEn: A large group of musicians who play many instruments together.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوركسترا؛ فرقة موسيقية كبيرة تعزف معاً
entries.example: The orchestra rehearsed the symphony all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Written for an orchestra, or played by one.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوركسترالي؛ مؤلَّف للأوركسترا أو تعزفه
entries.example: The film uses a rich orchestral score.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with unusual, often brightly coloured flowers.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوركيد؛ نبتة ذات أزهار غير مألوفة الشكل وكثيراً ما تكون زاهية
entries.example: A white orchid stood in a pot on the windowsill.

entries.definitionEn: To officially make someone a priest or minister. Also, more formally, to order that something shall happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسم شخصاً كاهناً أو قسيساً؛ وقد يعني أيضاً أن يقضي بأمر على نحو رسمي
entries.example: The bishop will ordain three new priests next month.

entries.definitionEn: A request for food or goods to be brought or sent. Also the way things are arranged.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلب طعام أو بضاعة؛ أو ترتيب الأشياء على نحو معيّن
entries.example: Can I take your order?

entries.definitionEn: To ask for food or goods. Also to tell someone that they must do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلب طعاماً أو بضاعة؛ أو يأمر شخصاً بفعل شيء
entries.example: We ordered soup and bread at the café.

entries.definitionEn: Neat and well arranged. Also calm and well behaved.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظم مرتب؛ وقد يعني هادئاً حسن التصرف
entries.example: Please form an orderly queue at the desk.

entries.definitionEn: Usually; in normal circumstances, not in a special case.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادةً؛ في الظروف العادية لا في حالة استثنائية
entries.example: She is ordinarily home by six, but the train was late.

entries.definitionEn: Normal and not special or different from what you expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادي مألوف غير استثنائي
entries.example: It was an ordinary Tuesday, until the power went off.

entries.definitionEn: Rock or earth from which a metal can be extracted.
entries.arabicMeaning: خام؛ صخر أو تراب يُستخرج منه معدن
entries.example: The mine produces iron ore for the steel works.

entries.definitionEn: A part of the body with a particular job, such as the heart or liver. Also a large musical instrument with pipes and a keyboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضو في الجسم له وظيفة معيّنة كالقلب أو الكبد؛ أو أورغن آلة موسيقية كبيرة ذات أنابيب ولوحة مفاتيح
entries.example: The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

entries.definitionEn: Grown or made without artificial chemicals. Also relating to living things.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضوي يُزرع أو يُصنع بلا مواد كيميائية مصنّعة؛ وقد يعني متعلقاً بالكائنات الحية
entries.example: She buys organic vegetables from the market.

entries.definitionEn: A living thing, such as a plant, animal, or bacterium.
entries.arabicMeaning: كائن حي كالنبات أو الحيوان أو الجرثومة
entries.example: A pond is full of tiny organisms you cannot see.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who work together for a shared purpose. Also the way things are arranged.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظمة أو مؤسسة يعمل أهلها لغرض مشترك؛ أو طريقة ترتيب الأمور
entries.example: She works for an organization that trains nurses.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the structure, systems, or management of an organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنظيمي؛ متعلق بهيكل المؤسسة أو أنظمتها أو إدارتها
entries.example: Poor organizational planning delayed the launch.

entries.definitionEn: To plan and arrange an event or activity. Also to put things in a clear order.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّم حدثاً أو نشاطاً ويعدّ له؛ أو يرتّب الأشياء على نحو واضح
entries.example: They will organize a picnic for the new staff.

entries.definitionEn: Arranged in a clear system. Also good at planning and keeping things in order.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظَّم مرتب وفق نظام واضح؛ أو حسن التخطيط والترتيب
entries.example: Her files are organized by date and topic.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plans and runs an event. Also a folder or tool used to keep things in order.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظِّم حدث يتولى التخطيط له وإدارته؛ أو أداة لحفظ الترتيب
entries.example: The organizer sent everyone a map of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: The beginning or source of something. Also the place, family, or background a person comes from.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصل الشيء أو منبعه؛ أو منبت الشخص من مكان أو أسرة أو خلفية
entries.example: Scientists still debate the origin of the custom.

entries.definitionEn: Existing first, not a copy. Also new and not taken from someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصلي موجود أولاً لا نسخة؛ أو جديد غير مأخوذ عن غيره
entries.example: Please bring the original document, not a photocopy.

entries.definitionEn: The first version of something, from which copies are made.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأصل الذي تُصنع عنه النسخ
entries.example: The museum keeps the original in a locked room.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being new, fresh, and not copied from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: أصالة وابتكار غير منقول عن الغير
entries.example: The design won a prize for its originality.

entries.definitionEn: In the beginning, before later changes.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الأصل؛ أول الأمر قبل التغييرات اللاحقة
entries.example: The building was originally a warehouse.

entries.definitionEn: To begin or first appear in a particular place or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشأ أو يظهر أول مرة في مكان أو حال معيّنة
entries.example: The style is said to originate in the south.

entries.definitionEn: An object used to decorate a room, a tree, or a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: زينة أو حلية تُستعمل لتزيين غرفة أو شجرة أو شخص
entries.example: A glass ornament hung from the lamp.

entries.definitionEn: Made or used for decoration rather than for a practical purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: زخرفي يُراد به الزينة لا الاستعمال العملي
entries.example: The pond is purely ornamental and is not used for fishing.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with many complicated patterns or decorative details.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزخرف بتفاصيل ونقوش كثيرة معقدة
entries.example: An ornate ceiling looked down on the dining room.

entries.definitionEn: A child whose parents have died.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتيم فقد أبويه
entries.example: The story follows an orphan who finds a new home.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a child to lose both parents, often through death.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُيتم طفلاً بفقد أبويه، وغالباً بالموت
entries.example: The epidemic orphaned hundreds of children.

entries.definitionEn: Presented as the reason or appearance, though the real one may be different.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظاهري يُذكر سبباً أو هيئة، وقد يكون الحقيقي غيره
entries.example: His ostensible purpose was research, but he was also looking for work.

entries.definitionEn: According to what is said or shown, though it may not be the full truth.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الظاهر بحسب ما يُقال أو يُظهر، وقد لا يكون ذلك كل الحقيقة
entries.example: She stayed late, ostensibly to finish a report.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean a different one, or the remaining one of two or more.
entries.arabicMeaning: آخر؛ يسبق اسماً للدلالة على مغاير للمذكور أو على الباقي من اثنين أو أكثر
entries.example: This key is stuck; try the other door.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to talk about a different or remaining person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: الآخر؛ يُستعمل بدل الاسم للدلالة على شخص أو شيء مغاير أو متبقٍّ
entries.example: One glove is here, but I cannot find the other.

entries.definitionEn: In a different way. Also used to say what will happen if something is not done.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخلاف ذلك أو بطريقة أخرى؛ وتُستعمل لبيان ما يقع إن لم يُفعل أمر
entries.example: Leave now; otherwise you will miss the bus.

entries.definitionEn: A furry mammal that lives in rivers or on coasts and swims well, feeding mainly on fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: قضاعة؛ حيوان فروي يعيش في الأنهار أو السواحل ويجيد السباحة ويتغذى غالباً على السمك
entries.example: An otter slid into the river with a fish in its mouth.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to say what is right, expected, or a good idea. It is milder than must.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينبغي؛ فعل مساعد يسبق الفعل للدلالة على ما هو صواب أو متوقع أو مستحسن، وهو ألين من أفعال الإلزام
entries.example: You ought to rest after such a long journey.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of weight equal to about 28 grams. Also a very small amount of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أونصة وحدة وزن تعادل نحو ثمانية وعشرين غراماً؛ وقد تعني مقداراً ضئيلاً جداً
entries.example: Add an ounce of grated cheese to the sauce.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to us.
entries.arabicMeaning: نا؛ محدِّد ملكية يسبق الاسم ليبين أن الشيء لنا
entries.example: Our train leaves at eight.

entries.definitionEn: Used to refer to the thing or things that belong to us, without repeating the noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: لنا؛ ضمير ملكية يغني عن إعادة الاسم
entries.example: Their garden is small, but ours is larger.

entries.definitionEn: Used when we are both the ones who act and the ones affected, or to emphasize we.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنفسنا؛ يُستعمل حين نكون الفاعل والمفعول، أو لتوكيد نحن
entries.example: We made the bread ourselves.

entries.definitionEn: Away from the inside of a place. Also not at home, or no longer burning or shining.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارجاً بعيداً عن الداخل؛ أو غير موجود في البيت؛ أو منطفئ
entries.example: She went out to buy milk.

entries.definitionEn: No longer useful, fashionable, or valid.
entries.arabicMeaning: قديم لم يعد صالحاً أو مواكباً أو ساري المفعول
entries.example: This map is out-of-date and misses the new road.

entries.definitionEn: From inside a place. Also used when there is none left, or when something is made from a material.
entries.arabicMeaning: من داخل مكان؛ أو عند نفاد الشيء؛ أو للدلالة على المادة التي صُنع منها
entries.example: He took a letter out of the envelope.

entries.definitionEn: The remote inland parts of Australia, far from cities.
entries.arabicMeaning: المناطق النائية في داخل أستراليا بعيداً عن المدن
entries.example: They drove for days through the outback.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden start of something unpleasant, such as a disease or fighting.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفشٍّ أو اندلاع مفاجئ لأمر سيئ كمرض أو قتال
entries.example: The school closed after an outbreak of flu.

entries.definitionEn: The result of an action, process, or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: نتيجة فعل أو عملية أو موقف
entries.example: We will know the outcome of the talks tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: To go further or faster than someone else and leave them behind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبق غيره مسافة أو سرعة فيتركه خلفه
entries.example: She outdistanced the other runners on the last lap.

entries.definitionEn: To do better than someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفوق على غيره في الأداء
entries.example: Each year they try to outdo last year's festival.

entries.definitionEn: Happening, used, or existing outside a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارجي يحدث أو يُستعمل أو يوجد خارج المبنى
entries.example: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.

entries.definitionEn: Outside a building, in the open air.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الهواء الطلق خارج المبنى
entries.example: The children played outdoors until sunset.

entries.definitionEn: On the outside, or furthest from the centre.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارجي أو الأبعد عن المركز
entries.example: Leave your shoes in the outer hallway.

entries.definitionEn: A set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقم ملابس يُلبس معاً لمناسبة معيّنة
entries.example: She chose a simple black outfit for the interview.

entries.definitionEn: To grow too big for clothes, or too mature for a habit or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكبر عن ثياب فلا تعود تناسبه، أو يتجاوز عادة أو اهتماماً
entries.example: He has already outgrown last year's coat.

entries.definitionEn: A short trip taken for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: نزهة قصيرة للمتعة
entries.example: The class went on an outing to the museum.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives outside the law, especially in stories of the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارج عن القانون، ولا سيما في قصص الماضي
entries.example: The film follows an outlaw hiding in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that sells a company's goods, often at a lower price. Also a way of expressing feelings, or a point where electricity or liquid comes out.
entries.arabicMeaning: منفذ بيع لبضائع شركة وغالباً بسعر أقل؛ أو متنفَّس للمشاعر؛ أو مخرج للكهرباء أو السائل
entries.example: Running is a healthy outlet for her stress.

entries.definitionEn: A line that shows the shape of something. Also a short plan of the main points.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط يبيّن شكل الشيء؛ أو ملخص للنقاط الرئيسة
entries.example: Write a brief outline before you start the essay.

entries.definitionEn: To describe the main points of a plan, idea, or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض النقاط الرئيسة لخطة أو فكرة أو موقف
entries.example: The manager outlined the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To live longer than another person, or to last longer than something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيش أطول من شخص آخر، أو يبقى بعد زوال شيء
entries.example: The old oak outlived the house beside it.

entries.definitionEn: A person's general attitude to life. Also what seems likely to happen in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرة الشخص العامة إلى الحياة؛ أو ما يُتوقع حدوثه في المستقبل
entries.example: Despite the delay, her outlook remained positive.

entries.definitionEn: No longer modern, fashionable, or useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: عتيق لم يعد مواكباً أو رائجاً أو نافعاً
entries.example: The factory still uses outmoded machinery.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناتج؛ كمية ما يُنتجه شخص أو آلة أو نظام
entries.example: Factory output rose in the last quarter.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of anger at something unfair or shocking. Also an action that causes this feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخط شديد على أمر جائر أو صادم؛ أو فعل يثير هذا السخط
entries.example: The fine caused public outrage.

entries.definitionEn: Shocking and hard to accept, or extremely unusual.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادم يصعب قبوله، أو بالغ الغرابة
entries.example: The hotel charged an outrageous fee for a bottle of water.

entries.definitionEn: The beginning of something, often in the phrase from the outset.
entries.arabicMeaning: البداية؛ وغالباً بمعنى منذ بدء الأمر
entries.example: She made her aims clear from the outset.

entries.definitionEn: To be clearly better or more impressive than someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفوق بوضوح على غيره ويبزّه
entries.example: The young pianist outshone the rest of the contestants.

entries.definitionEn: Not inside a building. Also coming from another person or group, not from within.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارج المبنى؛ أو آتٍ من شخص أو جماعة أخرى لا من الداخل
entries.example: Please use the outside stairs during the drill.

entries.definitionEn: Not in a building; in the open air.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الخارج لا داخل المبنى
entries.example: The children are playing outside.

entries.definitionEn: The outer part or surface of something, not the inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجانب الخارجي أو السطح لا الداخل
entries.example: The outside of the box was wet, but the books were dry.

entries.definitionEn: Not in a particular place; beyond its walls or limits.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارج مكان معيّن؛ وراء جدرانه أو حدوده
entries.example: Wait outside the door until they call you.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does not belong to a particular group, or who is not expected to win.
entries.arabicMeaning: دخيل لا ينتمي إلى الجماعة، أو من لا يُتوقع فوزه
entries.example: As a newcomer she felt like an outsider at first.

entries.definitionEn: The outer areas of a town or city, away from the centre.
entries.arabicMeaning: أطراف بلدة أو مدينة بعيداً عن وسطها
entries.example: They rented a flat on the outskirts of Leeds.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely good. Also not yet paid, finished, or dealt with.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتاز بارز الجودة؛ أو غير مسدَّد أو غير منجز بعد
entries.example: She gave an outstanding performance in the final.

entries.definitionEn: On the outside, or going away from a place rather than towards it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظاهر خارجي؛ أو متجه إلى الخارج لا إلى الداخل
entries.example: His outward calm hid a lot of worry.

entries.definitionEn: In appearance, even if the inner feeling or fact is different.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الظاهر وإن خالف الباطن أو الحقيقة
entries.example: She seemed outwardly calm before the speech.

entries.definitionEn: To be greater or more important than something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرجح على غيره قدراً أو أهمية
entries.example: The benefits outweigh the extra cost.

entries.definitionEn: Shaped like a stretched circle, similar to an egg.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيضوي؛ على شكل دائرة ممدودة تشبه البيضة
entries.example: The table has an oval top.

entries.definitionEn: A kitchen appliance with a hot enclosed space for baking or roasting food.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرن؛ جهاز في المطبخ يسخن من الداخل لخبز الطعام أو شيّه
entries.example: Put the cake in the oven for thirty minutes.

entries.definitionEn: From one side to the other, or above. Also used to say that something is finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: من جانب إلى آخر أو من فوق؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً للدلالة على أن الأمر قد انتهى
entries.example: Come over here and look at this photo.

entries.definitionEn: Above or covering something. Also more than a number, or during a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوق شيء أو مغطّياً له؛ أو أكثر من عدد؛ أو خلال مدة
entries.example: A bridge goes over the river.

entries.definitionEn: Including everything; general rather than about one part only.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل عام ينظر إلى الكل لا إلى جزء واحد
entries.example: The overall cost was lower than we expected.

entries.definitionEn: When everything is considered; in general.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجمالاً بالنظر إلى الأمور كلها
entries.example: There were small delays, but overall the trip went well.

entries.definitionEn: A one-piece garment worn over other clothes to protect them during dirty or practical work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريول أو بدلة عمل قطعة واحدة تُلبس فوق الثياب للوقاية في العمل الوسخ أو العملي
entries.example: The mechanic wiped his hands on his overalls.

entries.definitionEn: Over the side of a ship or boat into the water.
entries.arabicMeaning: من فوق جانب السفينة أو القارب إلى الماء
entries.example: A wave washed the empty crate overboard.

entries.definitionEn: To sell more tickets, seats, or rooms than are actually available.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحجز أو يبيع فوق العدد المتاح من المقاعد أو الغرف
entries.example: Airlines sometimes overbook popular flights.

entries.definitionEn: A long warm coat worn over other clothes in cold weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: معطف طويل ثقيل يُلبس فوق الثياب في البرد
entries.example: He buttoned his overcoat against the wind.

entries.definitionEn: To succeed in dealing with a problem, fear, or difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتغلب على مشكلة أو خوف أو صعوبة
entries.example: She overcame her fear of speaking in public.

entries.definitionEn: An amount of money taken from a bank account that is more than the account holds, so that you owe the bank.
entries.arabicMeaning: سحب على المكشوف؛ مبلغ يُؤخذ من الحساب فوق رصيده فيصير ديناً للمصرف
entries.example: An unexpected bill pushed her into an overdraft.

entries.definitionEn: To take more money from a bank account than it contains.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسحب من الحساب المصرفي أكثر مما فيه
entries.example: Try not to overdraft your account at the end of the month.

entries.definitionEn: To give too much importance or attention to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبالغ في إبراز أهمية شيء أو في تسليط الاهتمام عليه
entries.example: Teachers should not overemphasize exam scores alone.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something is larger, better, or more important than it really is.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر الشيء بأكثر من حجمه أو جودته أو أهميته الحقيقية
entries.example: We overestimated how long the repair would take.

entries.definitionEn: To hear what other people are saying by accident, without meaning to listen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمع حديث غيره مصادفة من غير قصد إلى الاستماع
entries.example: I overheard them discussing the surprise party.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely happy about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرور غاية السرور
entries.example: They were overjoyed when the test results came back clear.

entries.definitionEn: A shared part of two things, or the amount by which they cover the same area or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: تداخل أو جزء مشترك؛ أو مقدار تغطية الشيئين للمنطقة أو الوقت نفسه
entries.example: There is some overlap between the two courses.

entries.definitionEn: To put a layer of something on top of something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع طبقة من شيء فوق شيء آخر
entries.example: The map overlays rainfall data on the city streets.

entries.definitionEn: To fail to notice something. Also to have a view of a place from above.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغفل عن شيء فلا ينتبه إليه؛ أو يشرف على مكان من أعلى
entries.example: Do not overlook the small print on the form.

entries.definitionEn: Too much; more than is reasonable or needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإفراط أكثر مما ينبغي أو يُحتاج إليه
entries.example: The instructions were overly complicated for a simple task.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting through the night. Also happening very suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستغرق الليل؛ أو يحدث فجأة بين عشية وضحاها
entries.example: We took an overnight train to the coast.

entries.definitionEn: During the night. Also very suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلال الليل؛ أو فجأة بين عشية وضحاها
entries.example: Leave the dough to rise overnight.

entries.definitionEn: In, from, or relating to a country across the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع في بلد عبر البحر أو آتٍ منه أو متعلق به
entries.example: She took an overseas posting for two years.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a country across the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: في بلد عبر البحر أو إليه
entries.example: He went overseas to study engineering.

entries.definitionEn: To watch work or a process in order to make sure it is done properly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرف على عمل أو عملية ليضمن حسن إنجازها
entries.example: A senior engineer will oversee the building work.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to watch and direct other people's work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشرف يتولى مراقبة عمل الآخرين وتوجيهه
entries.example: The overseer checked each crate before it left the yard.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something seem less important. Also to cast a shadow over a place or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطغى على شخص أو شيء فيقلل شأنه؛ أو يلقي بظله على مكان أو حدث
entries.example: News of the delay overshadowed the opening ceremony.

entries.definitionEn: Larger than the usual or standard size.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكبر من المقاس المعتاد أو المعياري
entries.example: He prefers an oversize shirt for comfort.

entries.definitionEn: To go beyond a limit of what is allowed or acceptable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجاوز حداً مسموحاً أو مقبولاً
entries.example: The reporter overstepped the mark with that personal question.

entries.definitionEn: To pass a vehicle going in the same direction. Also to become greater or more successful than someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجاوز مركبة تسير في الاتجاه نفسه؛ أو يفوق غيره قدراً أو نجاحاً
entries.example: It is not safe to overtake on this bend.

entries.definitionEn: To remove a leader or government from power by force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُسقط حاكماً أو حكومة بالقوة
entries.example: The rebels failed to overthrow the king.

entries.definitionEn: Beyond usual working hours.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد ساعات العمل المعتادة
entries.example: She had to work overtime to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: Extra time spent at work beyond usual hours, or the pay for that time.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقت عمل إضافي فوق الساعات المعتادة، أو أجر ذلك الوقت
entries.example: He earned a lot of overtime in December.

entries.definitionEn: To turn something upside down or onto its side. Also to reverse a decision, especially a legal one.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلب شيئاً على رأسه أو جنبه؛ أو ينقض قراراً ولا سيما قضائياً
entries.example: The lorry hit a patch of ice and overturned.

entries.definitionEn: Heavier than is healthy or allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: زائد الوزن فوق ما هو صحي أو مسموح
entries.example: The suitcase was overweight, so we paid an extra fee.

entries.definitionEn: To affect someone so strongly that they cannot cope. Also to defeat completely by greater force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغمر شخصاً حتى يعجز عن الاحتمال؛ أو يهزم هزيمة تامة بقوة أكبر
entries.example: The amount of homework can overwhelm new students.

entries.definitionEn: Very great in amount or strength, so that it is hard to deal with.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاغي الشدة أو الكم حتى يصعب احتماله
entries.example: There was overwhelming support for the new library.

entries.definitionEn: The state of working too hard or for too many hours.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرهاق من فرط العمل أو طول ساعاته
entries.example: Headaches from overwork sent him to the doctor.

entries.definitionEn: A short cry of sudden pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيحة ألم قصيرة مفاجئة
entries.example: A sharp ow came from the kitchen when she touched the pan.

entries.definitionEn: To have to pay money back to someone. Also to have something because of another person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدين بمال يجب ردّه؛ أو يرجع ما عنده إلى فضل شخص أو شيء
entries.example: I owe you twenty pounds from lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Still to be paid; remaining unpaid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستحق الدفع لم يُسدَّد بعد
entries.example: There is still fifty pounds owing on the bill.

entries.definitionEn: Because of; as a result of.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسبب؛ نتيجةً لـ
entries.example: The match was delayed owing to heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: A bird with a flat face and large eyes that usually hunts at night.
entries.arabicMeaning: بومة؛ طائر ذو وجه مسطّح وعينين كبيرتين يصيد غالباً ليلاً
entries.example: An owl called from the trees after dark.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to a particular person, not to anyone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاص بشخص معيّن لا بغيره
entries.example: She cooked dinner in her own kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a possessive to talk about something that belongs to someone, or in phrases such as on your own.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُستعمل بعد ضمير ملكية للدلالة على ما يخص الشخص، أو لمعنى الانفراد من غير مساعدة
entries.example: He finally has a room of his own.

entries.definitionEn: To have something as your property.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملك شيئاً على أنه له
entries.example: They own a small shop on the high street.

entries.definitionEn: A person who owns something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالك الشيء
entries.example: The owner of the café unlocked the door.

entries.definitionEn: A large bull used for pulling heavy loads, especially in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثور يُستعمل لجرّ الأحمال الثقيلة، ولا سيما في الماضي
entries.example: An ox pulled the wooden cart along the track.

entries.definitionEn: The gas in the air that people and animals need in order to live.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكسجين؛ الغاز الموجود في الهواء الذي يحتاجه الناس والحيوان للحياة
entries.example: Climbers carry extra oxygen at high altitude.

entries.definitionEn: A form of oxygen high in the atmosphere that helps block harmful sunlight.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوزون؛ صورة من الأكسجين في طبقات الجو العليا تقي من أشعة الشمس الضارة
entries.example: Scientists measure ozone high above the poles.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a clock time to show that it is in the afternoon or evening, after midday.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بعد الساعة لتبيّن أنها بعد الظهر أو مساءً
entries.example: The shop closes at 6 p.m.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for father.
entries.arabicMeaning: بابا؛ لفظ غير رسمي بمعنى الأب
entries.example: Pa taught me how to mend a puncture.

entries.definitionEn: The speed at which someone walks or something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرعة المشي أو سير الأمور
entries.example: We walked at a slow pace along the river.

entries.definitionEn: To walk backwards and forwards, often when anxious. Also to set the speed of an activity so that it can be kept up.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذرع المكان جيئة وذهاباً وغالباً من القلق؛ أو يضبط سرعة نشاط ليُطاق الاستمرار فيه
entries.example: He paced the corridor while waiting for news.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the Pacific Ocean, the large ocean between Asia and the Americas.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمحيط الهادئ بين آسيا والأمريكتين
entries.example: Pacific islands attract visitors in the winter.

entries.definitionEn: A bag you carry, or a set of things sold or kept together. Also a group of animals such as wolves.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيبة تُحمل، أو رزمة أشياء تُباع أو تُحفظ معاً؛ وقد تعني قطيعاً من الحيوان كالذئاب
entries.example: He put a bottle of water in his pack.

entries.definitionEn: To put things into a bag or box for travel or storage.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبّئ الأشياء في حقيبة أو صندوق للسفر أو الحفظ
entries.example: I need to pack my suitcase tonight.

entries.definitionEn: A wrapped box or parcel. Also a set of related things offered together.
entries.arabicMeaning: طرد مغلف أو رزمة؛ أو باقة أشياء مترابطة تُقدَّم معاً
entries.example: A package arrived for you this morning.

entries.definitionEn: Completely full of people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتظ ممتلئ بالناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: The train was packed after the match.

entries.definitionEn: A small container or wrapped amount of something, such as biscuits or seeds.
entries.arabicMeaning: علبة صغيرة أو رزمة من شيء كالبسكويت أو البذور
entries.example: She opened a packet of biscuits for the guests.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting things into bags or boxes. Also material used to protect goods in transit.
entries.arabicMeaning: التعبئة في حقائب أو صناديق؛ أو مواد التغليف لحماية البضائع في النقل
entries.example: Leave time for packing before the taxi comes.

entries.definitionEn: A thick piece of soft material used for comfort or protection. Also a set of sheets of paper joined at one edge.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسادة سميكة للراحة أو الوقاية؛ أو دفتر أوراق مشبوكة من طرف
entries.example: She wrote the number on a pad by the phone.

entries.definitionEn: A short pole with a wide flat end, used to move a small boat through water.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجداف قصير عريض الطرف لتحريك قارب صغير في الماء
entries.example: He dropped a paddle and had to reach for it in the water.

entries.definitionEn: To move a boat with a paddle. Also to walk or play in shallow water.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجدّف بقارب بمجداف؛ أو يخوض ويلعب في ماء ضحل
entries.example: They paddled the canoe across the lake.

entries.definitionEn: One side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, or document.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفحة؛ وجه من ورقة في كتاب أو مجلة أو وثيقة
entries.example: Please turn to page ten.

entries.definitionEn: Receiving money for work. Also already settled with money.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأجور يتقاضى مالاً على العمل؛ أو مدفوع قد سُدِّد ثمنه
entries.example: She has a paid job at the library three days a week.

entries.definitionEn: An unpleasant feeling in the body when you are hurt or ill. Also great sadness or emotional hurt.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم في الجسم من أذى أو مرض؛ أو حزن شديد أو أذى نفسي
entries.example: He felt a sharp pain in his knee.

entries.definitionEn: Causing physical pain, or causing emotional hurt.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلم في الجسم، أو موجع في المشاعر
entries.example: The injection was quick but painful.

entries.definitionEn: Done with great care and close attention to every detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: دؤوب بالغ العناية بكل تفصيل
entries.example: Restoring the manuscript was painstaking work.

entries.definitionEn: With great care and close attention to every detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعناية فائقة تلتفت إلى كل تفصيل
entries.example: She painstakingly copied each name from the old list.

entries.definitionEn: A coloured liquid that you put on a surface to decorate or protect it.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلاء أو دهان؛ سائل ملوّن يُوضع على سطح للزينة أو الوقاية
entries.example: We need more white paint for the ceiling.

entries.definitionEn: To cover a surface with paint, or to make a picture using paint.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدهَن سطحاً بالطلاء، أو يرسم صورة بالألوان
entries.example: They will paint the front door blue.

entries.definitionEn: A brush used for putting paint on a wall or a picture.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرشاة طلاء أو رسم
entries.example: Rinse the paintbrush before the paint dries.

entries.definitionEn: A person who paints pictures, or who paints walls and buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسام يصنع اللوحات، أو دهّان يطلي الجدران والمباني
entries.example: The painter finished the bedroom in one day.

entries.definitionEn: A picture made with paint. Also the activity of making such pictures or of putting paint on walls.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة مصنوعة بالألوان؛ أو فن الرسم بالألوان أو طلاء الجدران
entries.example: A small painting hung above the fireplace.

entries.definitionEn: Two things of the same type that are used together.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوج من شيئين من نوع واحد يُستعملان معاً
entries.example: I need a new pair of shoes.

entries.definitionEn: Loose clothes worn in bed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيجامة؛ لباس فضفاض للنوم
entries.example: He put on his pajamas and turned out the light.

entries.definitionEn: A friend, in informal speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب؛ صديق في الكلام العادي
entries.example: He went to the match with an old pal from school.

entries.definitionEn: A very large home of a king, queen, or other important person.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصر؛ بيت بالغ الكبر لملك أو ملكة أو شخص رفيع الشأن
entries.example: Visitors waited at the gates of the palace.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant enough to eat or drink. Also acceptable to people's feelings or opinions.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائغ يطيب أكله أو شربه؛ أو مقبول لدى الناس في الشعور أو الرأي
entries.example: The soup was plain but palatable.

entries.definitionEn: The roof of the mouth. Also a person's sense of taste, or their liking for particular flavours.
entries.arabicMeaning: سقف الفم الحنكي؛ أو حاسة التذوق وميل الشخص إلى نكهات معيّنة
entries.example: The burn on her palate made cold water painful.

entries.definitionEn: Light in colour, or having less colour than usual, often from illness, cold, or shock.
entries.arabicMeaning: باهت شاحب اللون، أو أقل لوناً من المعتاد وغالباً من مرض أو برد أو صدمة
entries.example: She looked pale after the long flight.

entries.definitionEn: A flat wooden platform used to stack and move goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: منصة خشبية مسطحة تُرصّ عليها البضائع وتُنقل
entries.example: A forklift lifted the pallet of boxes onto the truck.

entries.definitionEn: The inner surface of the hand between the wrist and the fingers. Also a tropical tree with a long trunk and large leaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: راحة اليد بين المعصم والأصابع؛ أو نخلة ذات جذع طويل وأوراق كبيرة
entries.example: He held the coins in the palm of his hand.

entries.definitionEn: A metal container used for cooking food on a hob.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلاة أو قدر معدني لطبخ الطعام على الموقد
entries.example: Heat a little oil in a pan.

entries.definitionEn: A thin, flat cake of fried batter, often eaten with a sweet or savoury topping.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطيرة رقيقة مقليّة من عجين سائل، تُؤكل غالباً بحشوة حلوة أو مالحة
entries.example: She flipped the pancake when bubbles appeared.

entries.definitionEn: Spreading over a whole country or many countries, used of a disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: جائح ينتشر في بلد بأكمله أو في بلدان كثيرة، يوصف به المرض
entries.example: Health staff prepared for a pandemic flu season.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people chosen to discuss or judge something. Also a flat piece that forms part of a door, wall, or machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: لجنة يُختار أعضاؤها للمناقشة أو التحكيم؛ أو لوح مسطّح في باب أو جدار أو آلة
entries.example: A panel of teachers marked the speeches.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden strong feeling of fear that makes it hard to think clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذعر مفاجئ شديد يصعّب التفكير بوضوح
entries.example: There was a moment of panic when the lights went out.

entries.definitionEn: To suddenly feel so afraid that you cannot think or act calmly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُصاب فجأة بذعر يمنعه من التفكير أو التصرف بهدوء
entries.example: Try not to panic if you miss your stop.

entries.definitionEn: A wide view of a whole area of land or city.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطلالة واسعة على منطقة كاملة من الأرض أو المدينة
entries.example: From the hill we had a panorama of the valley.

entries.definitionEn: Showing or having a wide view of a whole area.
entries.arabicMeaning: بانورامي يعرض إطلالة واسعة على منطقة كاملة
entries.example: The hotel rooms have panoramic views of the bay.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes that cover each leg separately, especially in American English. In British English the word often means underwear.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنطلون يغطي كل ساق على حدة ولا سيما في الأمريكية؛ وفي البريطانية كثيراً ما يعني لباساً داخلياً
entries.example: He bought a new pair of pants for work.

entries.definitionEn: A large tropical fruit with orange flesh and small black seeds.
entries.arabicMeaning: بابايا؛ ثمرة استوائية كبيرة لحمها برتقالي وبذورها سوداء صغيرة
entries.example: Breakfast was yoghurt with slices of papaya.

entries.definitionEn: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping. Also a newspaper.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورق للكتابة أو الطباعة أو التغليف؛ أو صحيفة
entries.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper.

entries.definitionEn: Using electronic records instead of paper documents.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا ورق؛ يعتمد السجلات الإلكترونية بدل الوثائق الورقية
entries.example: The office aims to become paperless within a year.

entries.definitionEn: Routine written work such as forms, letters, and official documents.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاملات ورقية وروتين كتابي من نماذج ورسائل ووثائق رسمية
entries.example: The visa application involved a lot of paperwork.

entries.definitionEn: A short story that teaches a moral or religious lesson.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثل؛ قصة قصيرة ذات عبرة أخلاقية أو دينية
entries.example: The teacher ended the lesson with a parable about honesty.

entries.definitionEn: A large piece of cloth that opens in the air so a person can fall slowly and safely from an aircraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: مظلة هبوط تنفتح في الهواء ليهبط بها الشخص من طائرة ببطء وأمان
entries.example: His parachute opened just in time.

entries.definitionEn: A public procession of people and vehicles, often to celebrate something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض أو موكب علني من الناس والمركبات، وغالباً للاحتفال
entries.example: Crowds lined the street for the parade.

entries.definitionEn: A place or state of perfect happiness. Also, in some religions, heaven.
entries.arabicMeaning: فردوس؛ مكان أو حال من النعيم التام؛ وفي بعض الأديان الجنة
entries.example: The quiet beach felt like paradise after the noisy city.

entries.definitionEn: A statement or situation that seems to contradict itself but may still be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفارقة؛ قول أو حال يناقض ظاهره وقد يصدق مع ذلك
entries.example: It is a paradox that the quietest person wrote the loudest songs.

entries.definitionEn: Seeming to contradict itself, yet possibly true or real.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفارق يناقض ظاهره، وقد يكون مع ذلك صادقاً أو واقعاً
entries.example: It seems paradoxical to rest in order to work better.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that seems to contradict itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفارق يناقض الظاهر
entries.example: Paradoxically, fewer meetings made the team faster.

entries.definitionEn: A group of sentences about one idea, starting on a new line.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقرة؛ مجموعة جمل حول فكرة واحدة تبدأ من سطر جديد
entries.example: Write one paragraph about your hometown.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that makes you unable to move or act; extremely.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يشل الحركة أو القدرة على الفعل؛ إلى حدّ بالغ
entries.example: She felt paralyzingly nervous before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to emergency medical workers who treat people before they reach hospital.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمسعفين الذين يعالجون المصاب قبل وصوله إلى المستشفى
entries.example: A paramedic crew reached the scene within minutes.

entries.definitionEn: A limit or factor that defines how something can be done or measured.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدّ أو عامل يضبط كيفية إنجاز أمر أو قياسه
entries.example: Cost is an important parameter in the design.

entries.definitionEn: More important than anything else.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوق كل اعتبار في الأهمية
entries.example: Safety is paramount on this building site.

entries.definitionEn: A living thing that lives on or in another and takes food from it. Also a person who lives off others without giving much in return.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفيلي يعيش على كائن آخر ويأخذ غذاءه منه؛ أو شخص يعيش عالة على غيره بلا عطاء يُذكر
entries.example: The biologist studied a parasite that lives in freshwater fish.

entries.definitionEn: Living as a parasite on another organism. Also taking from others without giving much in return.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفيلي يعيش على كائن آخر؛ أو يأخذ من الناس بلا عطاء يُذكر مقابل ذلك
entries.example: Some wasps have a parasitic life cycle.

entries.definitionEn: A soldier trained to jump from an aircraft using a parachute.
entries.arabicMeaning: جندي مدرَّب على القفز بالمظلة من طائرة
entries.example: The paratrooper landed safely in the open field.

entries.definitionEn: A package wrapped in paper or in a box, sent by post or carried by hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: طرد أو رزمة مغلّفة تُرسَل أو تُحمَل
entries.example: A parcel arrived for you this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A polite word used when you did not hear someone, or when you want to say you are sorry.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة مهذّبة تُقال حين لم تسمع الكلام أو حين تعتذر
entries.example: I beg your pardon; I didn't hear the last word.

entries.definitionEn: To forgive someone, especially officially for a crime. Also to excuse a small fault.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفح عن شخص أو يعفو عنه، وخصوصاً بصفة رسمية عن جريمة؛ وقد يعني التجاوز عن هفوة
entries.example: The governor decided to pardon the prisoner.

entries.definitionEn: A mother or a father.
entries.arabicMeaning: أب أو أم
entries.example: Every child needs a parent who listens.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with being a parent, or with a mother or father.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالوالدين أو بصفة الأبوة والأمومة
entries.example: The school needs parental permission for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: A public place with grass and trees where people can walk and play.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديقة عامة فيها عشب وأشجار للتنزه واللعب
entries.example: The children played football in the park.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a car or other vehicle in a place for a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركن سيارة أو مركبة في مكان لفترة
entries.example: You can park behind the shop.

entries.definitionEn: The act of leaving a vehicle in a place, or space provided for this.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركن السيارات أو المكان المخصص لذلك
entries.example: Parking is difficult in the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: The group of people elected to make a country's laws.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيئة منتخبة تتولى سنّ قوانين البلاد
entries.example: The new law was debated in parliament.

entries.definitionEn: Narrow in outlook and limited to small local concerns. Also relating to a church parish.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيّق الأفق لا يتجاوز الشأن المحلي؛ وأيضاً متعلق برعية كنسية
entries.example: The discussion stayed parochial and ignored the wider region.

entries.definitionEn: A colourful bird that can copy human speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببغاء: طائر زاهي الألوان قد يحاكي كلام البشر
entries.example: The parrot repeated her name again and again.

entries.definitionEn: One piece of a whole. Also a role in a play or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء من كلّ؛ أو دور في مسرحية أو فيلم
entries.example: I only understood part of the story.

entries.definitionEn: Working or studying for only some of the usual hours, not full-time.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدوام جزئي؛ لساعات أقل من العمل أو الدراسة الكاملة
entries.example: She found a part-time job at the library.

entries.definitionEn: For only some of the usual working or studying hours.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أساس دوام جزئي لا كامل
entries.example: He works part-time while he studies.

entries.definitionEn: To separate or go in different directions. Also to divide something into pieces.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفترق أو يمضي كلٌّ في طريق؛ وأيضاً يقسم شيئاً إلى أجزاء
entries.example: They parted at the station after the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Not complete; only some of the whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزئي غير مكتمل
entries.example: The report gives only a partial picture of the problem.

entries.definitionEn: A person who takes part in an activity or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يشترك في نشاط أو حدث
entries.example: Each participant received a certificate.

entries.definitionEn: To take part in an activity or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشترك في نشاط أو حدث
entries.example: Students are invited to participate in the discussion.

entries.definitionEn: The act of taking part in an activity or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاشتراك في نشاط أو حدث
entries.example: Public participation in the meeting was high.

entries.definitionEn: A verb form such as broken or walking, used to make tenses or as an adjective.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة فعل مثل broken أو walking تُستعمل في الأزمنة أو صفة
entries.example: In the broken window, broken is a participle.

entries.definitionEn: A very small piece of matter. Also a short grammar word such as up in give up.
entries.arabicMeaning: جسيم بالغ الصغر؛ أو كلمة نحوية قصيرة مثل up في give up
entries.example: Dust particles floated in the sunlight.

entries.definitionEn: Used to single out one specific person or thing. Also meaning very careful or hard to please.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُفرد شخصاً أو شيئاً بعينه؛ وقد يعني شديد التدقيق أو صعب الإرضاء
entries.example: Is there a particular colour you prefer?

entries.definitionEn: Especially; more than usual or more than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصوصاً؛ أكثر من المعتاد أو من سواه
entries.example: The soup was particularly good this evening.

entries.definitionEn: A strong supporter of one side, group, or idea, often unwilling to consider other views.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناصر شديد لجهة أو فكرة، وغالباً بغير التفات إلى الرأي الآخر
entries.example: He remained a partisan of the original plan.

entries.definitionEn: To some degree, but not completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزئياً؛ إلى حدّ ما لا بالكامل
entries.example: The delay was partly caused by the weather.

entries.definitionEn: Someone you do something with, such as a husband or wife, a person in a business, or a person you dance with.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريك في الحياة أو العمل أو الرقص
entries.example: She discussed the idea with her business partner.

entries.definitionEn: A relationship in which people or organizations work together, especially in business.
entries.arabicMeaning: شراكة يتعاون فيها أشخاص أو جهات، وخصوصاً في العمل
entries.example: The two companies formed a partnership last year.

entries.definitionEn: A gathering of people to enjoy themselves, eat, and talk.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفلة يجتمع فيها الناس للمرح والطعام والحديث
entries.example: We had a party for her birthday.

entries.definitionEn: A successful result in a test. Also a ticket or document that lets you go somewhere.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجاح في اختبار؛ أو تصريح أو تذكرة تسمح بالمرور
entries.example: She was pleased to get a pass in the driving test.

entries.definitionEn: To go past a person or place. Also to succeed in a test, or to give something to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمرّ من جانب شخص أو مكان؛ أو ينجح في اختبار، أو يناول شيئاً لشخص
entries.example: Please pass the salt.

entries.definitionEn: A short piece of writing. Also a narrow way through a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقرة قصيرة من نص؛ أو ممر ضيق في مبنى
entries.example: Read the passage and answer the questions.

entries.definitionEn: A person travelling in a vehicle who is not the driver.
entries.arabicMeaning: راكب في مركبة وليس سائقها
entries.example: The bus was full of passengers.

entries.definitionEn: A very strong feeling of love, anger, or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور قوي جداً من حب أو غضب أو اهتمام
entries.example: Music has always been her great passion.

entries.definitionEn: Having or showing very strong feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بشعور قوي أو يُظهره
entries.example: He gave a passionate speech about education.

entries.definitionEn: With very strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشعور قوي جداً
entries.example: She argued passionately for the new library.

entries.definitionEn: Accepting what happens without taking action. Also describing a grammar form in which the subject receives the action.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلبي يقبل ما يحدث بلا فعل؛ أو المبني للمجهول في النحو حيث يقع الفعل على الفاعل النحوي
entries.example: He took a passive role and let others decide.

entries.definitionEn: An official document that allows you to travel to other countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: جواز سفر: وثيقة رسمية تتيح السفر إلى بلدان أخرى
entries.example: Don't forget your passport at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: A secret word or code that lets you use a computer, account, or door.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة سر تتيح الدخول إلى جهاز أو حساب أو باب
entries.example: Never share your password with anyone.

entries.definitionEn: Gone by in time; belonging to an earlier period.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقضٍ؛ يعود إلى زمن سابق
entries.example: In past years the town was much quieter.

entries.definitionEn: From one side of something to the other, without stopping.
entries.arabicMeaning: مروراً من جانب إلى الجانب الآخر من غير توقف
entries.example: The bus went past without stopping.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that someone or something goes to the other side of a place, or that a time is later than a given point.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يدل على التجاوز مكاناً إلى الجانب الآخر، أو على زمان بعد حدّ معيّن
entries.example: The shop is just past the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: Food made from flour, water, and often eggs, such as spaghetti or macaroni.
entries.arabicMeaning: معكرونة من دقيق وماء وغالباً بيض، مثل السباغيتي
entries.example: We had pasta with tomato sauce.

entries.definitionEn: A Christian minister, especially in some Protestant churches.
entries.arabicMeaning: راعٍ كنسي أو قسّ، وخصوصاً في بعض الكنائس البروتستانتية
entries.example: The pastor spoke at the wedding.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the countryside and a quiet rural life. Also connected with a priest's care of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريفي هادئ متعلق بالريف؛ أو متعلق برعاية الكاهن لجماعته
entries.example: The painting showed a pastoral scene of fields and sheep.

entries.definitionEn: A small area that is different from what is around it. Also a piece of material used to cover a hole.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقعة صغيرة تختلف عما حولها؛ أو رقعة تُغطّى بها فتحة
entries.example: There was a patch of ice on the path.

entries.definitionEn: In an uneven way, with quality or coverage that varies from place to place.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير متساوٍ تختلف فيه الجودة أو التغطية من موضع إلى آخر
entries.example: The new rule was patchily applied across the country.

entries.definitionEn: Uneven or incomplete in quality, amount, or coverage.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متساوٍ أو ناقص في الجودة أو المقدار أو التغطية
entries.example: Reception is patchy in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a father, or typical of a father. Also describing a protective manner that can feel controlling.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبوي متعلق بالأب أو بطباعه؛ وقد يصف حماية مفرطة تبدو مقيِّدة
entries.example: He felt a paternal duty to advise the younger staff.

entries.definitionEn: Managing people in a fatherly way that limits their freedom, while claiming it is for their good.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصرف بوصاية أبوية تقيّد حرية الناس بحجة أن ذلك لمصلحتهم
entries.example: Staff disliked the paternalistic tone of the new rules.

entries.definitionEn: A way for people to walk, especially one through a garden, park, or countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: درب يمشي عليه الناس، وخصوصاً في حديقة أو ريف
entries.example: Follow the path along the river.

entries.definitionEn: A quality in a situation, story, or performance that stirs pity or tender sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجن في موقف أو قصة أو أداء يثير الشفقة أو الحزن الرقيق
entries.example: The final scene was full of pathos.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to wait, or to deal with problems, without becoming angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة على الانتظار أو تحمّل المشقة من غير غضب
entries.example: Teaching young children requires a lot of patience.

entries.definitionEn: Able to wait or deal with delay without becoming angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: صبور؛ يتحمل الانتظار أو التأخير بلا غضب
entries.example: Please be patient; the doctor will see you soon.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is receiving medical care.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريض يتلقى رعاية طبية
entries.example: The nurse spoke quietly to the patient.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you can wait or deal with difficulty without getting angry.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصبر ومن غير غضب رغم الانتظار أو الصعوبة
entries.example: She waited patiently for her name to be called.

entries.definitionEn: A person who loves their country and is ready to support it.
entries.arabicMeaning: محب لوطنه مستعد لنصرته
entries.example: He was remembered as a patriot who served in difficult years.

entries.definitionEn: Showing love of your country.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُظهر حب الوطن
entries.example: The crowd sang a patriotic song after the match.

entries.definitionEn: Love of your country and a wish to support it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حب الوطن والرغبة في نصرته
entries.example: The speech appealed to a quiet sense of patriotism.

entries.definitionEn: The act of going around an area to watch and protect it, or a group that does this.
entries.arabicMeaning: طواف على منطقة للحراسة، أو المجموعة التي تقوم بذلك
entries.example: A police patrol passed the school every hour.

entries.definitionEn: A person who supports an artist or organization with money. Also a regular customer.
entries.arabicMeaning: راعٍ يموّل فناناً أو مؤسسة؛ أو زبون منتظم
entries.example: The museum's chief patron funded the new wing.

entries.definitionEn: To treat someone as if they were less intelligent or important. Also to be a regular customer of a shop or restaurant. Patronise is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعامل مع شخص بتعالي كأنه أقل فهماً أو قدراً؛ أو يرتاد محلاً بانتظام. وpatronise إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: Do not patronize her; she knows the work well.

entries.definitionEn: Treating others as if they were less intelligent or important. Patronising is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعالٍ في المعاملة كأن الآخر أقل فهماً أو قدراً. وpatronising إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: His patronizing smile made the room go quiet.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that treats others as less intelligent or important. Patronisingly is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: بتعالي ينتقص من فهم الآخر أو قدره. وpatronisingly إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: He explained the obvious point patronizingly.

entries.definitionEn: A repeated design. Also a regular way in which something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقش يتكرر؛ أو أسلوب منتظم يحدث به شيء
entries.example: The curtains have a floral pattern.

entries.definitionEn: A short stop in speech or action before it continues.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقف قصير في الكلام أو العمل قبل المتابعة
entries.example: There was a long pause before she answered.

entries.definitionEn: To stop for a short time before continuing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقف قليلاً ثم يواصل
entries.example: He paused at the door and looked back.

entries.definitionEn: To cover a path or road with a hard surface such as stone or concrete.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرصف طريقاً أو ممراً بسطح صلب كالحجر أو الإسمنت
entries.example: Workers will pave the path next spring.

entries.definitionEn: A raised hard path beside a road for people to walk on.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصيف مرتفع بجانب الطريق يمشي عليه الناس
entries.example: Please walk on the pavement, not in the road.

entries.definitionEn: An animal's foot with claws, especially of a dog or cat.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدم الحيوان ذات المخالب، وخصوصاً للكلب أو القط
entries.example: The cat licked its paw.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose business is lending money in return for items left as security.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يُقرض مالاً مقابل رهن أغراض تُترك ضماناً
entries.example: She took the watch to a pawnbroker on the high street.

entries.definitionEn: A shop that lends money against items left as security, and may sell goods that are not collected.
entries.arabicMeaning: محل يُقرض مقابل رهن أغراض، وقد يبيع ما لا يُسترد
entries.example: He found a second-hand guitar in the pawnshop.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you receive for the work you do.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجر تتقاضاه مقابل عملك
entries.example: The pay is better at the new job.

entries.definitionEn: To give money for something you buy or use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفع مالاً ثمناً لشيء يشتريه أو يستعمله
entries.example: I will pay for the tickets.

entries.definitionEn: An amount of money that is paid, or the act of paying.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلغ يُدفع أو فعل الدفع نفسه
entries.example: The first payment is due on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A restriction on a website that hides most content until the reader pays.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاجز على موقع يمنع معظم المحتوى حتى يدفع القارئ
entries.example: The article sat behind a paywall.

entries.definitionEn: A personal computer; a computer designed for one person to use.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسوب شخصي معدّ لاستعمال فرد واحد
entries.example: She saved the file on her PC.

entries.definitionEn: A small round green seed eaten as a vegetable.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبة بازلاء خضراء صغيرة تُؤكل خضاراً
entries.example: Add the peas to the soup near the end.

entries.definitionEn: A time without war or fighting. Also a calm, quiet feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلام بلا حرب أو قتال؛ أو شعور بالهدوء
entries.example: They hoped for peace after the talks.

entries.definitionEn: Quiet and calm, without fighting or noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ بلا قتال أو ضجيج
entries.example: The lake is a peaceful place to sit.

entries.definitionEn: In a calm way, without fighting or noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء وبلا عنف أو ضجيج
entries.example: The demonstrators marched peacefully through the streets.

entries.definitionEn: A round fruit with soft yellow-pink skin and a large stone inside.
entries.arabicMeaning: درّاقة أو خوخة مستديرة ناعمة القشرة وفيها نواة كبيرة
entries.example: She sliced a ripe peach for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: A large bird; the male can spread a long tail of bright patterned feathers.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاووس؛ والذكر يفرد ذيلاً طويلاً زاهي الريش
entries.example: A peacock displayed its tail in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: The pointed top of a mountain, or the highest level of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قمة جبل مدبّبة، أو أعلى مستوى يبلغه شيء
entries.example: Demand for heating reaches its peak in January.

entries.definitionEn: A small oval nut that grows in a pod underground.
entries.arabicMeaning: فول سوداني: ثمرة بيضاوية صغيرة تنمو في قرن تحت الأرض
entries.example: He packed a bag of peanuts for the journey.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet fruit that is wide at the bottom and narrower near the stem.
entries.arabicMeaning: إجاص أو كمثرى: فاكهة حلوة تتّسع من أسفل وتضيق عند العنق
entries.example: She put a pear in her lunch box.

entries.definitionEn: A hard, shiny, usually white ball formed inside some shellfish and used as jewellery.
entries.arabicMeaning: لؤلؤة: كرة صلبة لامعة تتكون داخل بعض المحاريات وتُستخدم حلية
entries.example: The necklace was made of small white pearls.

entries.definitionEn: A farm worker of low social rank, especially in historical or traditional rural societies.
entries.arabicMeaning: فلاح بسيط المكانة، وخصوصاً في المجتمعات الريفية التاريخية أو التقليدية
entries.example: The novel follows a peasant family through a hard winter.

entries.definitionEn: A small, smooth stone, often found on a beach or in a river.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصاة ملساء صغيرة، وغالباً على الشاطئ أو في النهر
entries.example: She skipped a pebble across the lake.

entries.definitionEn: Strange or unusual. Also belonging only to a particular person, place, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب غير معتاد؛ أو خاص بشخص أو مكان أو شيء بعينه
entries.example: There was a peculiar smell in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: A lever that you push with your foot, on a bicycle, car, or piano.
entries.arabicMeaning: دواسة تُدفع بالقدم في دراجة أو سيارة أو بيانو
entries.example: Her foot slipped off the bicycle pedal.

entries.definitionEn: Too concerned with small rules or details, in a way that can annoy others.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط التمسك بالقواعد أو التفاصيل الصغيرة على نحو قد يزعج غيره
entries.example: His pedantic comments slowed the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A base that supports a statue or column. Also a position of high, often uncritical, admiration.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة يقوم عليها تمثال أو عمود؛ أو مكانة إعجاب عالية قد تبلغ الغلو
entries.example: The bronze figure stood on a stone pedestal.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking imagination or excitement; ordinary in a dull way.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الخيال أو الحماسة؛ عادي على نحو باهت
entries.example: The speech was competent but pedestrian.

entries.definitionEn: A person walking in a street or public place, especially where there is traffic.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماشٍ في الشارع أو في مكان عام، وخصوصاً حيث تمر المركبات
entries.example: The driver stopped to let the pedestrian cross.

entries.definitionEn: A treatment in which the feet and toenails are cleaned and made neat.
entries.arabicMeaning: عناية تجميلية بالقدمين وأظافرهما تنظيفاً وترتيباً
entries.example: She booked a pedicure before the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: to pass urine from the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير رسمي: يتبول
entries.example: I need to pee before we leave.

entries.definitionEn: The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.
entries.arabicMeaning: قشرة الفاكهة أو الخضار
entries.example: Throw the orange peel in the bin.

entries.definitionEn: To remove the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable. Also of paint or skin coming off in layers.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقشر فاكهة أو خضاراً؛ أو يتقشر الطلاء أو الجلد على شكل طبقات
entries.example: Peel the potatoes before you boil them.

entries.definitionEn: A quick look, often secret. Also a short high sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرة سريعة غالباً خلسة؛ أو صوت قصير حاد
entries.example: She took a peep through the curtains.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is your equal in age, rank, or ability.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندّ في السن أو المرتبة أو القدرة
entries.example: Teenagers often care what their peers think.

entries.definitionEn: A small pin, hook, or clip used to hang things or hold them in place.
entries.arabicMeaning: وتد أو خطاف أو مشبك صغير لتعليق الأشياء أو تثبيتها
entries.example: Hang your coat on the peg by the door.

entries.definitionEn: A tool for writing or drawing with ink.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلم للكتابة أو الرسم بالحبر
entries.example: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

entries.definitionEn: To punish someone, or put them at a disadvantage, for breaking a rule. Penalise is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعاقب شخصاً أو يضعه في موقف أضعف لمخالفة قاعدة. وpenalise إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: The team was penalized for a late tackle.

entries.definitionEn: A punishment for breaking a law or rule. In sport, an advantage given after a foul, such as a free shot at goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقوبة على مخالفة قانون أو قاعدة؛ وفي الرياضة ميزة بعد خطأ كركلة جزاء
entries.example: The referee gave a penalty after the foul.

entries.definitionEn: The plural of penny; a British unit of money. One hundred pence make one pound.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمع penny؛ وحدة نقد بريطانية، ومئة بنس تساوي جنيهاً واحداً
entries.example: The apple costs fifty pence.

entries.definitionEn: A thin stick of wood with a black or coloured centre, used for writing or drawing.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلم رصاص: عود رفيع من خشب وفي وسطه مادة سوداء أو ملوّنة للكتابة أو الرسم
entries.example: She sharpened her pencil before the test.

entries.definitionEn: Hanging down loosely and often swinging.
entries.arabicMeaning: متدلٍّ يتأرجح إلى أسفل
entries.example: The tree had pendulous branches after the rain.

entries.definitionEn: A weight hung so that it can swing freely, as in some clocks. Also used of something that swings between two extremes.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقّاص يتأرجح بحرية كما في بعض الساعات؛ ويُستعار لما يتردد بين طرفين
entries.example: The clock's pendulum kept a steady beat.

entries.definitionEn: To go into or through something. Also to understand something that is difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخترق شيئاً أو ينفذ إليه؛ أو يفهم أمراً عسير الفهم
entries.example: The cold wind penetrated his thin coat.

entries.definitionEn: A person you write letters to regularly as a friend, often in another country, without having met. Also written pen friend.
entries.arabicMeaning: صديق بالمراسلة تكتب إليه بانتظام، وغالباً في بلد آخر، من غير أن تكونا قد التقيتما
entries.example: My penfriend sent a letter from Italy.

entries.definitionEn: A black-and-white seabird that cannot fly and swims well, found mainly in the southern hemisphere.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطريق: طائر بحري أسود وأبيض لا يطير ويحسن السباحة، وأكثره في النصف الجنوبي من الأرض
entries.example: A penguin slid across the ice on its stomach.

entries.definitionEn: A medicine made from a mould, used to kill some bacteria and treat infections.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنسلين: دواء من العفن يقتل بعض الجراثيم ويعالج التهابات
entries.example: The doctor prescribed penicillin for the infection.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of land almost surrounded by water but joined to a larger land mass.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبه جزيرة: أرض يحيط بها الماء من معظم الجهات وتتصل بكتلة أكبر
entries.example: Italy is a long peninsula in the Mediterranean.

entries.definitionEn: Having no money at all.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدَم لا يملك مالاً البتة
entries.example: He arrived in the city almost penniless.

entries.definitionEn: A British coin; one hundred pennies make one pound. Also used to mean a very small amount of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنس بريطاني؛ ومئة بنس تساوي جنيهاً. وقد يُراد به مبلغ زهيد جداً
entries.example: I haven't got a penny until Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Regular money paid to someone after they have stopped work, usually because of age.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاش منتظم يُدفع لمن ترك العمل، وغالباً بسبب السن
entries.example: She lives on a small pension.

entries.definitionEn: A flat shape with five straight sides and five angles.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكل هندسي مسطّح له خمسة أضلاع مستقيمة وخمس زوايا
entries.example: Draw a pentagon with equal sides.

entries.definitionEn: Men, women, and children; human beings in general, or more than one person.
entries.arabicMeaning: الناس من رجال ونساء وأطفال؛ البشر عامة أو أكثر من شخص
entries.example: There were a lot of people in the shop.

entries.definitionEn: A hot-tasting powder used to flavour food. Also a hollow vegetable that may be green, red, or yellow.
entries.arabicMeaning: فلفل توابل حارّ المذاق؛ أو خضار مجوّف أخضر أو أحمر أو أصفر
entries.example: Add salt and pepper to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a unit to mean for each, especially when you talk about a rate or price.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يسبق وحدة بمعنى لكلّ واحد، وخصوصاً عند بيان معدّل أو سعر
entries.example: The tickets cost ten pounds per person.

entries.definitionEn: To notice or become aware of something. Also to understand or regard something in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلاحظ شيئاً أو يعيه؛ أو يفهمه أو يراه على نحو معيّن
entries.example: I perceived a slight change in her voice.

entries.definitionEn: One part in every hundred. Also written per cent.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء من كل مئة. ويُكتب أيضاً per cent
entries.example: Prices rose by three percent last year.

entries.definitionEn: An amount expressed as a part of one hundred.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدار يُعبَّر عنه جزءاً من مئة
entries.example: A large percentage of students walk to school.

entries.definitionEn: The way you notice, understand, or form an idea of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة ملاحظتك لشيء أو فهمك له أو تصوّرك إياه
entries.example: Public perception of the plan has improved.

entries.definitionEn: Quick to notice and understand things that are not obvious.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع الملاحظة والفهم لما ليس بديهياً
entries.example: Her perceptive questions showed she had read the report closely.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows a sharp understanding of what is not obvious.
entries.arabicMeaning: بفطنة تلحظ ما يخفى على غيره وتفهمه
entries.example: He commented perceptively on the gap in the data.

entries.definitionEn: A branch, rod, or other place on which a bird sits. Also a high resting place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجثم من غصن أو قضيب يحطّ عليه الطائر؛ أو موضع مرتفع للاستراحة
entries.example: The owl found a perch in the old oak.

entries.definitionEn: To sit or rest on the edge or top of something, often high up, as a bird does.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحطّ أو يقعد على حافة شيء أو أعلاه، وغالباً في موضع مرتفع كالطائر
entries.example: The cat perched on the fence.

entries.definitionEn: As good as it can be; with nothing wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامل لا عيب فيه؛ على خير ما يكون
entries.example: The weather is perfect for a walk.

entries.definitionEn: To make something as good as possible by improving it with care.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُتقن شيئاً ويرفعه إلى أفضل حال بتحسينه بعناية
entries.example: She spent years trying to perfect her technique.

entries.definitionEn: In a perfect way; completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو كامل؛ تماماً
entries.example: The jacket fits perfectly.

entries.definitionEn: To do a job or action. Also to entertain people by acting, singing, or playing music.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤدي عملاً أو فعلاً؛ أو يقدّم عرضاً بالتمثيل أو الغناء أو العزف
entries.example: They will perform the play on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: A show of acting, music, or dance. Also how well a person or machine does a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض تمثيل أو موسيقى أو رقص؛ أو مستوى أداء شخص أو آلة
entries.example: The evening performance starts at eight.

entries.definitionEn: A person who acts, sings, dances, or plays music for an audience.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤدٍّ يمثّل أو يغني أو يرقص أو يعزف أمام جمهور
entries.example: The performer thanked the crowd at the end.

entries.definitionEn: A pleasant-smelling liquid that you put on your skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطر: سائل طيب الرائحة يُوضع على الجلد
entries.example: She bought a bottle of perfume.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something may be true, but you are not sure; maybe.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربما؛ تُستعمل حين يجوز أن يكون الأمر صحيحاً من غير يقين
entries.example: Perhaps we can meet after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A length of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدة من الزمن
entries.example: We lived there for a long period.

entries.definitionEn: The state of lasting for a long time or forever.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوام الشيء زمناً طويلاً أو على وجه الثبات
entries.example: Nothing in fashion has much permanence.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a long time or forever; not temporary.
entries.arabicMeaning: دائم زمناً طويلاً أو إلى غير أمد؛ غير مؤقت
entries.example: She finally found a permanent job.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that lasts for a long time or forever.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصفة دائمة لا مؤقتة
entries.example: They have permanently closed the old factory.

entries.definitionEn: To spread through every part of a place, group, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتخلل كل جزء من مكان أو جماعة أو شيء
entries.example: The smell of coffee permeated the house.

entries.definitionEn: The right to do something, given by someone who can allow it.
