entries.arabicMeaning: إذن يمنحه من يملك السماح بفعل شيء
entries.example: You need permission to leave early.

entries.definitionEn: To allow something to happen or someone to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمح بحدوث شيء أو بفعل شخص له
entries.example: The rules do not permit smoking here.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a situation, idea, or practice to continue, especially one that is harmful or untrue.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُبقي وضعاً أو فكرة أو ممارسة مستمرة، وخصوصاً إن كانت ضارة أو غير صحيحة
entries.example: These stories perpetuate an old misunderstanding.

entries.definitionEn: To treat a person or group cruelly and unfairly over time, especially because of who they are or what they believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضطهد شخصاً أو جماعة بقسوة وظلم على مدى زمن، وخصوصاً بسبب هويتهم أو معتقدهم
entries.example: The family fled after being persecuted for their beliefs.

entries.definitionEn: Cruel and unfair treatment of people over time, especially because of their beliefs or identity.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطهاد: معاملة قاسية ظالمة تمتد زمناً، وخصوصاً بسبب المعتقد أو الهوية
entries.example: The book describes the persecution of the village.

entries.definitionEn: Continued effort to do something even when it is difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثابرة: مواصلة الجهد رغم الصعوبة
entries.example: Finishing the course took real perseverance.

entries.definitionEn: To continue doing something even though it is difficult or not welcome. Also of a problem that does not stop.
entries.arabicMeaning: يواصل الفعل رغم الصعوبة أو عدم الترحيب؛ أو يستمر مشكل ولا ينقطع
entries.example: If the pain persists, see a doctor.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of continuing despite difficulty, or the fact that something continues.
entries.arabicMeaning: إصرار يواصل رغم العسر، أو استمرار شيء لا ينقطع
entries.example: Her persistence finally got a reply.

entries.definitionEn: Continuing for a long time, or continuing even when it is difficult or unwelcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستمر زمناً طويلاً، أو مواصل رغم الصعوبة أو عدم الترحيب
entries.example: He had a persistent cough all winter.

entries.definitionEn: A man, woman, or child; a human being.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل أو امرأة أو طفل؛ إنسان
entries.example: She is a kind person.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to or concerning one particular person.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخصي يخص فرداً بعينه أو يتصل به
entries.example: This is my personal phone.

entries.definitionEn: The set of qualities that makes someone different from other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: جملة الصفات التي تميّز شخصاً عن غيره
entries.example: He has a friendly personality.

entries.definitionEn: The process of changing something so that it fits a particular person. Personalisation is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: تخصيص شيء ليلائم شخصاً بعينه. وpersonalisation إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: The app offers personalization of the home screen.

entries.definitionEn: To change something so that it suits a particular person. Personalise is the British spelling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخصّص شيئاً ليلائم شخصاً بعينه. وpersonalise إملاء بريطاني
entries.example: You can personalize the card with a name.

entries.definitionEn: Used to give your own opinion. Also meaning as an individual, not only in an official role.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل لبيان الرأي الخاص؛ وتعني أيضاً بصفتك فرداً لا بدور رسمي فحسب
entries.example: Personally, I would wait until Friday.

entries.definitionEn: To be a clear living example of a quality. Also to represent an idea as if it were a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجسّد صفة تجسيداً حياً واضحاً؛ أو يصوّر فكرة في هيئة شخص
entries.example: She personifies calm under pressure.

entries.definitionEn: The people who work for an organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: العاملون في مؤسسة
entries.example: All personnel must wear a badge.

entries.definitionEn: A particular way of thinking about something. Also a method of drawing that shows depth.
entries.arabicMeaning: زاوية نظر معيّنة في فهم أمر؛ أو أسلوب رسم يُظهر العمق
entries.example: Try to see the problem from her perspective.

entries.definitionEn: Sweat; the liquid that comes from your skin when you are hot or nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرق: سائل يخرج من الجلد عند الحر أو التوتر
entries.example: Beads of perspiration formed on his forehead.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone agree to do or believe something by giving reasons.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقنع شخصاً بأن يفعل شيئاً أو يصدّقه بإيراد الأسباب
entries.example: I persuaded him to stay for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making someone agree or believe something. Also a set of beliefs.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل الإقناع حتى يوافق الشخص أو يصدّق؛ وقد تعني مجموعة معتقدات
entries.example: It took a lot of persuasion to change her mind.

entries.definitionEn: Able to make people agree with you or do what you ask.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على حمل الناس على الموافقة أو على فعل ما تطلب
entries.example: She made a persuasive argument for the new plan.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is likely to make people agree or believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يرجَّح أن يحمل الناس على الموافقة أو التصديق
entries.example: He spoke persuasively about the need for training.

entries.definitionEn: To be connected with or relevant to a particular subject or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعلق بموضوع أو وضع معيّن أو يخصّه
entries.example: These notes pertain to last week's meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Directly related to the matter being discussed; relevant and to the point.
entries.arabicMeaning: وثيق الصلة بالمسألة المطروحة؛ وجيه في محلّه
entries.example: She asked a pertinent question about the budget.

entries.definitionEn: Spread through every part of a place or situation, often in an unwanted way.
entries.arabicMeaning: متغلغل في كل ناحية من مكان أو وضع، وغالباً على نحو غير مرغوب
entries.example: A pervasive smell of paint filled the hallway.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being present throughout a whole area, group, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغلغل الشيء وحضوره في كل جزء من حيّز أو جماعة أو نظام
entries.example: The pervasiveness of background noise made it hard to think.

entries.definitionEn: Unreasonably determined to act against what is sensible, expected, or wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاند على نحو غير معقول، يصرّ على خلاف المعقول أو المتوقع أو المطلوب
entries.example: It seemed perverse to refuse help when we were so short of time.

entries.definitionEn: A stubborn inclination to go against what is reasonable, expected, or in one's own interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل عنيد إلى خلاف المعقول أو المتوقع أو حتى المصلحة
entries.example: Out of sheer perversity, he argued against his own earlier plan.

entries.definitionEn: A person who usually expects the worst to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشائم يتوقع في العادة أسوأ الاحتمالات
entries.example: Don't be such a pessimist; the interview went well.

entries.definitionEn: Expecting that bad things will happen, or seeing the least hopeful side of a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقع حدوث السيئ، أو يرى الجانب الأقل أملاً في الوضع
entries.example: She was pessimistic about the weather for the picnic.

entries.definitionEn: An animal that you keep at home and look after, such as a cat or a dog.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان أليف تُبقيه في البيت وتعتني به، كالقط أو الكلب
entries.example: They have a pet cat.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely frightened. Rarely, turned into stone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذعور جداً؛ ونادراً: متحجّر كأنه صار حجراً
entries.example: I was petrified of speaking in front of the class.

entries.definitionEn: The liquid fuel that many cars use; called gasoline in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنزين السيارات؛ ويُسمّى gasoline في الإنجليزية الأمريكية
entries.example: We need to stop for petrol.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you buy petrol and other fuel for a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: محطة بنزين تُباع فيها وقود المركبات
entries.example: There's a petrol station on the corner.

entries.definitionEn: Small and unimportant. Also unkind or angry about things that do not matter much.
entries.arabicMeaning: تافه قليل الشأن؛ أو ضيّق الصدر غضوباً من أمور لا تستحق
entries.example: They argued over a petty detail.

entries.definitionEn: A number that shows how acidic or alkaline a liquid is, usually on a scale from about 0 to 14.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرقم الهيدروجيني: مقياس حموضة السائل أو قلويته، وغالباً من نحو 0 إلى 14
entries.example: Test the pH of the soil before you plant.

entries.definitionEn: Seeming to exist but not real; imagined or ghostly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدو موجوداً وليس كذلك؛ وهمي أو شبحي
entries.example: He felt a phantom pain in the old injury.

entries.definitionEn: A ghost, or something that appears to exist but does not.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبح، أو شيء يبدو موجوداً ولا وجود له
entries.example: The old house was said to have a phantom.

entries.definitionEn: A person trained to prepare and sell medicines.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيدلي مدرَّب على تحضير الأدوية وبيعها
entries.example: Ask the pharmacist about possible side effects.

entries.definitionEn: A shop, or part of a shop, that sells medicines.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيدلية: محل أو قسم يبيع الأدوية
entries.example: I bought the tablets at the pharmacy.

entries.definitionEn: Extraordinary; far greater or more impressive than usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: استثنائي يفوق المعتاد جداً في القدر أو الأثر
entries.example: The team made phenomenal progress in a month.

entries.definitionEn: To an extraordinary degree; far more than usual.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو استثنائي يفوق المعتاد كثيراً
entries.example: The book sold phenomenally well.

entries.definitionEn: Something that happens or exists and can be seen or experienced, especially something unusual or interesting.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظاهرة تحدث أو توجد ويمكن ملاحظتها، وخصوصاً إن كانت غير معتادة أو جديرة بالاهتمام
entries.example: Lightning is a natural phenomenon.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to help others, especially by giving money.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيري يراد به نفع الآخرين، وخصوصاً ببذل المال
entries.example: The family set up a philanthropic fund for scholarships.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that aims to help others, especially through gifts of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: بروح العطاء الخيري، وخصوصاً ببذل المال
entries.example: She gave philanthropically to several hospitals.

entries.definitionEn: A person who gives a lot of money to help other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: محسن كبير يبذل مالاً كثيراً لمساعدة الناس
entries.example: A local philanthropist paid for the new library.

entries.definitionEn: The practice of giving money and help to people and good causes.
entries.arabicMeaning: العطاء المنظَّم من مال وجهد لمساعدة الناس والوجوه الخيرية
entries.example: His later years were devoted to philanthropy.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has little interest in art, literature, or culture, and may even look down on them.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص قليل الاكتراث بالفن والأدب والثقافة، وقد يزدريها
entries.example: He called himself a philistine and never went to galleries.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies or writes about knowledge, existence, and how we should live.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيلسوف يدرس أو يكتب في المعرفة والوجود وكيف ينبغي أن نعيش
entries.example: The philosopher asked what a good life is.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with philosophy. Also calm when facing difficulty you cannot easily change.
entries.arabicMeaning: فلسفي متعلق بالفلسفة؛ أو رصين أمام صعوبة لا يسهل تغييرها
entries.example: She took a philosophical view of the delay.

entries.definitionEn: The study of ideas about knowledge, truth, and how we should live. Also a set of beliefs that guides behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفلسفة: دراسة أفكار المعرفة والحقيقة وكيف ينبغي أن نعيش؛ أو جملة معتقدات تهدي السلوك
entries.example: He is studying philosophy at university.

entries.definitionEn: In stories, a bird that burns and is born again from the ashes.
entries.arabicMeaning: العنقاء في القصص: طائر يحترق ثم يُبعث من الرماد
entries.example: The story of the phoenix is told in many cultures.

entries.definitionEn: A device you use to speak to someone who is not with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاتف تتكلم به مع من ليس حاضراً معك
entries.example: Can I use your phone?

entries.definitionEn: To call someone using a telephone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصل بشخص عبر الهاتف
entries.example: I will phone you this evening.

entries.definitionEn: A picture made with a camera; a short form of photograph.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة تُلتقط بكاميرا؛ اختصار photograph
entries.example: This is a photo of my family.

entries.definitionEn: A paper copy of a document or picture made by a machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة ورقية من وثيقة أو صورة تُصنع بآلة
entries.example: Please bring a photocopy of your passport.

entries.definitionEn: A picture made with a camera.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة تُلتقط بكاميرا
entries.example: He took a photograph of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: To take a photograph of a person, place, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتقط صورة فوتوغرافية لشخص أو مكان أو شيء
entries.example: She asked if she could photograph the old marketplace.

entries.definitionEn: A person who takes photographs, as a job or as a hobby.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصوّر يلتقط الصور عملاً أو هواية
entries.example: The photographer waited for better light before taking the shot.

entries.definitionEn: The skill or activity of taking photographs.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن التصوير الفوتوغرافي أو ممارسته
entries.example: He took a course in photography after buying his first camera.

entries.definitionEn: A verb made of a main verb plus an adverb or preposition, often with a meaning that is not obvious from the parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مركّب من فعل أساسي وحرف أو ظرف، وكثيراً ما يختلف معناه عن معنى أجزائه
entries.example: Students often confuse the phrasal verb give up with give in.

entries.definitionEn: A short group of words that belong together and express an idea, but are not a full sentence.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبارة قصيرة من كلمات مترابطة تعبّر عن معنى وليست جملة تامة
entries.example: She asked us to repeat the phrase until it sounded natural.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the body rather than the mind. Also relating to things you can see or touch.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالجسم لا بالعقل؛ وأيضاً بما يمكن رؤيته أو لمسه
entries.example: After the long flight he needed some physical exercise.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being physical, especially a strong or noticeable use of the body in movement or performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحضور الجسدي وقوة الجسد في الحركة أو الأداء
entries.example: The dancer's physicality made every gesture feel powerful.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the body or to real, material things.
entries.arabicMeaning: من ناحية الجسد أو الأشياء المادية الملموسة
entries.example: She was physically tired after climbing the hill.

entries.definitionEn: A doctor, especially one who treats illness with medicine rather than surgery.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب، ولا سيما من يعالج بالدواء لا بالجراحة
entries.example: The physician listened carefully and then explained the test results.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of matter, energy, force, and how they affect one another.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم الفيزياء: دراسة المادة والطاقة والقوة وتأثير بعضها في بعض
entries.example: Physics helps us understand how light and motion work.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the way living bodies function, including organs, cells, and chemical processes.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بوظائف أعضاء الكائن الحي وخلاياه وعملياته الكيميائية
entries.example: Stress can trigger a physiological response such as a faster heartbeat.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that concerns the functioning of a living body.
entries.arabicMeaning: من حيث وظائف الجسم وآلياته الحيوية
entries.example: The two species are physiologically adapted to desert heat.

entries.definitionEn: The shape and strength of a person's body, especially the muscles.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوام الجسم وبنيته العضلية
entries.example: Years of swimming had given her a lean, strong physique.

entries.definitionEn: The mathematical constant, about 3.14, used in calculations that involve circles.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثابت الرياضي باي، نحو 3.14، المستخدم في حسابات الدائرة
entries.example: The class used pi to find the circumference of the circle.

entries.definitionEn: A large musical instrument with black and white keys that you play with your fingers.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيانو: آلة موسيقية كبيرة ذات مفاتيح سوداء وبيضاء تُعزف بالأصابع
entries.example: She is learning to play the piano.

entries.definitionEn: A choice you make from several options. Also a pointed tool for breaking hard ground or ice.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختيار من بين خيارات؛ وأيضاً معول مدبّب لكسر الأرض الصلبة أو الجليد
entries.example: If you could live anywhere, what would be your first pick?

entries.definitionEn: To choose something from a group. Also to take something small with your fingers, such as fruit.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختار شيئاً من مجموعة؛ أو يقطف شيئاً صغيراً بأصابعه مثل الثمر
entries.example: Please pick a colour for the walls.

entries.definitionEn: A vegetable, often cucumber, preserved in vinegar or salt and eaten cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخلل: خضار، وغالباً الخيار، محفوظ في الخل أو الملح ويؤكل بارداً
entries.example: He put a pickle on the side of his sandwich.

entries.definitionEn: Hard to please, especially about food or small details.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعب الإرضاء، ولا سيما في الطعام أو التفاصيل الصغيرة
entries.example: Their cat is picky and will eat only one kind of food.

entries.definitionEn: A meal that you eat outdoors, for pleasure, often sitting on the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: نزهة: وجبة تؤكل في الهواء الطلق للمتعة
entries.example: We had a picnic by the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A drawing, painting, or photograph. Also a mental image of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة أو رسم؛ وأيضاً صورة ذهنية لشيء
entries.example: There is a picture of her family on the desk.

entries.definitionEn: To imagine something in your mind as if you could see it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتخيّل شيئاً في ذهنه كأنه يراه
entries.example: Can you picture the house with a garden in front?

entries.definitionEn: Attractive in a way that looks like a painting, especially of places.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلّاب المنظر كأنه لوحة، ولا سيما في وصف الأماكن
entries.example: We walked through a picturesque village of stone cottages.

entries.definitionEn: A baked dish of pastry filled with fruit, meat, or vegetables.
entries.arabicMeaning: فطيرة مخبوزة بحشوة من الفاكهة أو اللحم أو الخضار
entries.example: She baked an apple pie for dessert.

entries.definitionEn: A part of something, or one single item of a kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة من شيء، أو واحد من مجموعة من النوع نفسه
entries.example: Would you like a piece of cake?

entries.definitionEn: Strong respect for God and for religious duty.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقوى وورع في أداء الواجب الديني
entries.example: His piety showed in the quiet way he kept the fast.

entries.definitionEn: A farm animal with a fat body and a short flat nose, kept for its meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: خنزير: حيوان مزرعة ذو جسم ممتلئ يُربى للحم
entries.example: The pig was sleeping in the mud.

entries.definitionEn: A plump bird with a small head, often grey, common in towns and closely related to the dove.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحمام: طائر ممتلئ صغير الرأس، غالباً رمادي، شائع في المدن وقريب من اليمام
entries.example: A pigeon landed on the window ledge and looked in.

entries.definitionEn: A number of things lying one on top of another.
entries.arabicMeaning: كومة من الأشياء فوق بعضها
entries.example: There was a pile of books on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: A person who travels to a holy place for religious reasons.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاجّ يسافر إلى مكان مقدّس لسبب ديني
entries.example: The pilgrim walked for days to reach the holy city.

entries.definitionEn: A small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبّة دواء صغيرة تُبلع
entries.example: She took a pill for her headache.

entries.definitionEn: A soft cushion that you rest your head on in bed.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسادة يُوضع عليها الرأس في السرير
entries.example: He rested his head on the pillow and fell asleep.

entries.definitionEn: A removable cloth cover for a pillow.
entries.arabicMeaning: غطاء الوسادة القابل للنزع
entries.example: She changed the pillowcase before the guests arrived.

entries.definitionEn: A person who flies an aircraft.
entries.arabicMeaning: طيّار يقود طائرة
entries.example: The pilot spoke to the passengers before take-off.

entries.definitionEn: A short thin piece of metal with a sharp point, used to fasten things together.
entries.arabicMeaning: دبوس رفيع مدبّب يُستخدم لتثبيت الأشياء
entries.example: She used a pin to hold the notice on the board.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something with a pin, or to hold someone or something so they cannot move.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت شيئاً بدبوس، أو يمسك شخصاً أو شيئاً فلا يستطيع الحركة
entries.example: He pinned the badge to his jacket.

entries.definitionEn: A tall evergreen tree with long thin leaves called needles, and cones.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجرة الصنوبر الدائمة الخضرة ذات الأوراق الإبرية والمخاريط
entries.example: A tall pine stood at the edge of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A large tropical fruit with sweet yellow flesh and a rough, spiky skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأناناس: ثمرة استوائية كبيرة حلوة اللب خشنة القشرة
entries.example: They served fresh pineapple after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Having a pale red colour, like some flowers.
entries.arabicMeaning: وردي اللون، كالاحمرار الخفيف في بعض الأزهار
entries.example: She wore a pink scarf.

entries.definitionEn: The colour between red and white.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الوردي بين الأحمر والأبيض
entries.example: The sky turned a soft pink at sunset.

entries.definitionEn: The highest point of success, quality, or achievement. Also a pointed peak of rock.
entries.arabicMeaning: الذروة في النجاح أو الجودة؛ وأيضاً قمة صخرية مدبّبة
entries.example: Winning the prize was the pinnacle of her career.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of liquid measure equal to about half a litre, used especially in Britain and the US.
entries.arabicMeaning: الباينت: وحدة حجم للسوائل تعادل نحو نصف لتر، شائعة في بريطانيا وأمريكا
entries.example: He ordered a pint of milk from the shop.

entries.definitionEn: One of the first people to do, discover, or develop something new.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائد يكون من الأوائل في عمل أو اكتشاف أو تطوير شيء جديد
entries.example: She was a pioneer in heart surgery.

entries.definitionEn: To be one of the first to develop a new method, product, or area of activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكون من أوائل من يطوّرون طريقة أو منتجاً أو مجالاً جديداً
entries.example: The lab pioneered a safer way to store vaccines.

entries.definitionEn: A tube used to carry water, gas, or other liquids. Also a tube for smoking tobacco.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنبوب لنقل الماء أو الغاز أو السوائل؛ وأيضاً غليون للتدخين
entries.example: Water leaked from a broken pipe under the sink.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of attacking ships at sea. Also the illegal copying of films, music, or software.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرصنة السفن في البحر؛ وأيضاً النسخ غير القانوني للأفلام أو الموسيقى أو البرامج
entries.example: The company lost money because of software piracy.

entries.definitionEn: A person who attacks ships at sea to steal from them. Also someone who copies films, music, or software illegally.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرصان يهاجم السفن للسرقة؛ وأيضاً من ينسخ الأفلام أو البرامج بلا إذن
entries.example: The story was about a pirate who hid treasure on an island.

entries.definitionEn: A large hole in the ground. Also the stone in some fruit, or a sunken area such as an orchestra pit.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفرة واسعة في الأرض؛ وأيضاً نواة بعض الثمار أو موضع منخفض مثل حفرة الأوركسترا
entries.example: They dug a pit to plant the young tree.

entries.definitionEn: How high or low a sound is. Also a sports field, or a short talk meant to persuade someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: درجة ارتفاع الصوت أو انخفاضه؛ وأيضاً ملعب رياضي أو عرض قصير لإقناع أحد
entries.example: The singer changed pitch in the middle of the song.

entries.definitionEn: To throw something with force, to set up a tent, or to present an idea in order to persuade.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرمي شيئاً بقوة، أو ينصب خيمة، أو يعرض فكرة لإقناع الآخرين
entries.example: They pitched the tent before it got dark.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of sadness for someone who is suffering. Also used to say that something is unfortunate.
entries.arabicMeaning: شفقة على من يتألم؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً للأسف على أمر مؤسف
entries.example: It is a pity you missed the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A flat round bread baked with tomato, cheese, and other toppings.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيتزا: خبز مسطّح يُخبز بالطماطم والجبن وإضافات أخرى
entries.example: We ordered a pizza for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A particular area, building, or position. Also a seat or space for someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان معيّن أو موضع؛ وأيضاً مقعد أو فراغ لشخص
entries.example: This is a quiet place to read.

entries.definitionEn: To put something in a particular position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً في موضع معيّن
entries.example: Please place the keys on the table.

entries.definitionEn: Calm and peaceful, and not easily excited or upset.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ ساكن لا يثور أو ينزعج بسهولة
entries.example: The lake was placid in the early morning.

entries.definitionEn: In a calm, quiet way, without showing excitement or anger.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء ساكن من غير انفعال أو غضب
entries.example: The dog lay placidly by the fire.

entries.definitionEn: A serious infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills many people. Also a large number of things that cause harm or trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطاعون: مرض معدٍ خطير سريع الانتشار؛ وأيضاً آفة كثيرة تؤذي أو تزعج
entries.example: The museum has a display about the plague in the seventeenth century.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone or something continual trouble or suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلاحق شخصاً أو شيئاً بمتاعب أو معاناة متكررة
entries.example: Technical problems plagued the project from the start.

entries.definitionEn: Simple and without decoration. Also clear and easy to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسيط غير مزخرف؛ وأيضاً واضح سهل الفهم
entries.example: She preferred a plain white shirt to anything fancy.

entries.definitionEn: An idea about what you will do and how you will do it.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطة: تصوّر لما ستفعله وكيف ستفعله
entries.example: We need a plan for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: To decide in advance what you are going to do and how you will do it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخطّط: يقرّر مسبقاً ما سيفعله وكيف
entries.example: They plan to visit their parents in May.

entries.definitionEn: A large round object in space that moves around a star, such as the Earth around the Sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: كوكب يدور حول نجم، كالأرض حول الشمس
entries.example: Earth is the planet we live on.

entries.definitionEn: The process of thinking about and arranging how something will be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: التخطيط: عملية التفكير في أمر وتنظيم طريقة إنجازه
entries.example: Good planning saved them a lot of time.

entries.definitionEn: A living thing that grows in soil and usually has a stem, leaves, and roots.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبات ينمو في التربة وغالباً له ساق وأوراق وجذور
entries.example: She watered the plant on the windowsill.

entries.definitionEn: To put a seed or young plant in the ground so that it can grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزرع بذرة أو شتلة في الأرض لتنمو
entries.example: They planted tomatoes in the back garden.

entries.definitionEn: A flat piece of metal or stone on a wall, with writing that honours a person or event. Also a sticky film on teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة تذكارية على جدار تحمل كتابة؛ وأيضاً ترسّبات لزجة على الأسنان
entries.example: A brass plaque on the wall named the building's founder.

entries.definitionEn: A soft mixture that hardens as it dries, used to cover walls and ceilings. Also a small sticky covering for a cut.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجصّ لطلاء الجدران والسقوف؛ وأيضاً لصقة صغيرة لجرح
entries.example: The old plaster on the ceiling was beginning to crack.

entries.definitionEn: To cover a surface with plaster. Also to cover something thickly or in a very obvious way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغطّي سطحاً بالجصّ؛ أو يكسو شيئاً بكثافة وبشكل ظاهر
entries.example: They plastered the new wall and left it to dry.

entries.definitionEn: Made of plastic.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنوع من البلاستيك
entries.example: The toys came in a plastic bag.

entries.definitionEn: A light, strong material made from chemicals, used for many everyday objects.
entries.arabicMeaning: البلاستيك: مادة خفيفة متينة تُصنع كيميائياً لكثير من الأشياء اليومية
entries.example: Too much plastic ends up in the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A flat, usually round dish that you eat from or serve food on.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبق مسطّح، وغالباً مستدير، يُؤكل منه أو يُقدَّم عليه الطعام
entries.example: He put the rice on a plate.

entries.definitionEn: The raised area beside a railway track where you get on and off a train. Also a raised floor for speakers or performers.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصيف المحطة بجانب السكة؛ وأيضاً منصة مرتفعة للخطباء أو المؤدّين
entries.example: The train to Oxford leaves from platform three.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of seeming reasonable and likely to be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: المعقولية: أن يبدو الأمر منطقياً وقابلاً للتصديق
entries.example: The plausibility of the explanation convinced the committee.

entries.definitionEn: Seeming reasonable and likely to be true, even if you cannot be sure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدو معقولاً وقابلاً للتصديق وإن لم يُقطع بصحته
entries.example: Her account of the delay sounded plausible.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that seems reasonable and likely to be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يبدو معقولاً وقابلاً للتصديق
entries.example: He argued, quite plausibly, that the figures were incomplete.

entries.definitionEn: A story written to be performed by actors. Also activity done for fun, especially by children.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرحية تمثَّل على خشبة؛ وأيضاً اللعب للتسلية ولا سيما عند الأطفال
entries.example: We saw a play at the local theatre.

entries.definitionEn: To take part in a game or sport, to make music on an instrument, or to do something for fun.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلعب لعبة أو رياضة، أو يعزف على آلة، أو يفعل شيئاً للمتعة
entries.example: The children play in the garden after school.

entries.definitionEn: A person who takes part in a game or sport. Also someone who plays a musical instrument.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاعب في لعبة أو رياضة؛ وأيضاً عازف على آلة موسيقية
entries.example: She is the best player on the team.

entries.definitionEn: Full of fun and not serious, in a friendly way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرح يحب الدعابة من غير جدية ثقيلة
entries.example: The kitten gave him a playful tap.

entries.definitionEn: An outdoor area where children can play, often with swings and slides.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحة لعب للأطفال في الهواء الطلق، وغالباً فيها أراجيح وزلاقات
entries.example: The playground was full of children after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A child who regularly plays with another child.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفيق لعب لطفل آخر
entries.example: His cousin was his favourite playmate during the holidays.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes plays for the theatre.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب مسرحي يؤلّف نصوصاً للعرض
entries.example: The playwright spent a year rewriting the last act.

entries.definitionEn: To ask for something in an urgent, emotional way. Also to state in court whether you are guilty or not guilty.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوسّل بإلحاح وعاطفة؛ وأيضاً يصرّح في المحكمة بالذنب أو البراءة
entries.example: She pleaded with him to stay a little longer.

entries.definitionEn: Enjoyable, nice, or friendly.
entries.arabicMeaning: لطيف ممتع أو ودود
entries.example: We had a pleasant walk along the river.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is enjoyable or friendly.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لطيف سارّ أو ودود
entries.example: The room was pleasantly warm.

entries.definitionEn: Used to make a request more polite.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُضاف إلى الطلب للتهذيب بمعنى من فضلك
entries.example: Could you pass the salt, please?

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel happy or satisfied.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُسعد شخصاً أو يرضيه
entries.example: He worked hard to please his new manager.

entries.definitionEn: Happy or satisfied about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرور أو راضٍ عن شيء
entries.example: She was pleased with the test results.

entries.definitionEn: Giving a feeling of pleasure or satisfaction, especially to the senses.
entries.arabicMeaning: سارّ يبعث الرضا، ولا سيما للحواس
entries.example: The garden had a pleasing mix of colour and shade.

entries.definitionEn: Giving enjoyment; pleasant to do or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتع يبعث اللذة في الفعل أو التجربة
entries.example: Reading in the evening is a pleasurable habit.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعة أو سرور
entries.example: It was a pleasure to meet you.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount of something; more than enough.
entries.arabicMeaning: وفرة أو مقدار كبير يكفي وزيادة
entries.example: There is plenty of time before the train leaves.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun phrase to mean a large amount of something already understood from the context.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير بمعنى مقدار كبير مما فُهم من السياق، يغني عن إعادة الاسم
entries.example: Don't buy more coffee; we still have plenty.

entries.definitionEn: The series of events that make up a story. Also a secret plan, or a small piece of land.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبكة القصة وتسلسل أحداثها؛ وأيضاً مؤامرة سرّية أو قطعة أرض صغيرة
entries.example: The plot of the novel kept her awake until midnight.

entries.definitionEn: A clever trick used to gain an advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيلة بارعة لنيل منفعة
entries.example: The discount was a ploy to get shoppers into the store.

entries.definitionEn: Courage and determination when facing difficulty or danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرأة وعزم في مواجهة الصعوبة أو الخطر
entries.example: It took real pluck to speak up in front of the whole room.

entries.definitionEn: To pull something quickly, especially to pick fruit or feathers, or to pull the strings of a musical instrument.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزع شيئاً بسرعة، ولا سيما قطف الثمر أو نتف الريش، أو نبر أوتار آلة
entries.example: She plucked a ripe apple from the branch.

entries.definitionEn: A small plastic or rubber object that connects an electrical device to a socket. Also something that fills a hole.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابس كهربائي يوصل الجهاز بالمقبس؛ وأيضاً سدادة تملأ فتحة
entries.example: He pushed the plug into the wall socket.

entries.definitionEn: To connect a device to an electricity supply. Also to fill a hole so that nothing can pass through.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوصل جهازاً بالكهرباء؛ أو يسدّ فتحة حتى لا ينفذ منها شيء
entries.example: Plug the lamp in before you switch it on.

entries.definitionEn: Highly desirable and often hard to get, especially of a job or opportunity.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرغوب جداً وعسير المنال، ولا سيما في وصف وظيفة أو فرصة ممتازة
entries.example: She landed a plum job at the design studio.

entries.definitionEn: A small, round, sweet fruit with a smooth skin and a stone in the middle.
entries.arabicMeaning: البرقوق: ثمرة صغيرة مستديرة حلوة ذات نواة
entries.example: He bit into a ripe plum over the sink.

entries.definitionEn: A bird's feathers considered together, especially their colour and pattern.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريش الطائر مجتمعاً، ولا سيما لونه ونقشه
entries.example: The peacock's plumage shone in the sun.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to fit and repair water pipes, baths, and toilets.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبّاك يركّب أنابيب الماء والحمّامات ويصلحها
entries.example: We called a plumber when the tap would not stop dripping.

entries.definitionEn: The system of water pipes in a building, or the work of fitting and repairing them.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبكة أنابيب الماء في مبنى، أو عمل تركيبها وإصلاحها
entries.example: The house needs new plumbing before anyone can move in.

entries.definitionEn: A long, soft feather. Also a tall column of smoke, steam, or dust that spreads as it rises.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريشة طويلة ناعمة؛ وأيضاً عمود من دخان أو بخار أو غبار يتصاعد ويتّسع
entries.example: A plume of smoke rose from the chimney.

entries.definitionEn: To fall suddenly and quickly from a high level.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهوي فجأة وبسرعة من مستوى مرتفع
entries.example: Temperatures plummeted overnight.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden fall or dive. Also a bold decision to start doing something difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: هبوط أو غوص مفاجئ؛ وأيضاً قرار جريء بالشروع في أمر عسير
entries.example: She took the plunge and accepted the job abroad.

entries.definitionEn: To move or fall suddenly downwards or into something. Also to push someone or something into a particular state.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندفع أو يهوي فجأة إلى الأسفل أو إلى داخل شيء؛ أو يُدخل في حال معيّنة
entries.example: He plunged into the cold water.

entries.definitionEn: The form of a word used when you mean more than one person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الجمع في اللغة عندما يُقصد أكثر من واحد
entries.example: The plural of child is children.

entries.definitionEn: Used to add another fact, in the same way as and also.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يضيف معلومة أخرى بمعنى وأيضاً
entries.example: The flat is quiet, plus the rent is reasonable.

entries.definitionEn: An advantage or a good point.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميزة إيجابية أو نقطة حسنة
entries.example: Flexible hours are a plus in this job.

entries.definitionEn: Added to; used with numbers or amounts, and also to mean with the addition of.
entries.arabicMeaning: زائد: تُستخدم مع الأعداد والمقادير بمعنى مضافاً إليه
entries.example: The bill was forty pounds plus tax.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose power comes from great wealth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثريّ نافذ يستمد سلطته من ثروته الطائلة
entries.example: The plutocrat owned several newspapers and a shipping firm.

entries.definitionEn: A serious illness in which one or both lungs become inflamed and fill with fluid.
entries.arabicMeaning: التهاب رئوي خطير تمتلئ فيه الرئة أو الرئتان بسائل
entries.example: He was in hospital with pneumonia for a week.

entries.definitionEn: A small amount of money given regularly to a child to spend as they like.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصروف الجيب: مبلغ صغير يُعطى للطفل بانتظام لينفقه كما يشاء
entries.example: She saved her pocket money to buy a book.

entries.definitionEn: A small bag sewn into or onto clothes, used for carrying things.
entries.arabicMeaning: جيب مخيط في الثياب لحمل الأشياء
entries.example: He put the ticket in his pocket.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of writing in short lines that expresses feelings or ideas, often with a rhythm.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصيدة: نص في أسطر قصيرة يعبّر عن شعور أو فكرة، وغالباً له إيقاع
entries.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes poems.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاعر يكتب القصائد
entries.example: The poet read her new work to a small audience.

entries.definitionEn: An old-fashioned word for a woman who writes poems; poet is now the usual term for any gender.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاعرة: صيغة أقدم لامرأة تكتب الشعر، والشائع اليوم كلمة poet لأي جنس
entries.example: In older books she is described as a poetess rather than a poet.

entries.definitionEn: Poems in general, or the art of writing them.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشعر عموماً، أو فن كتابته
entries.example: He reads poetry on the train.

entries.definitionEn: An idea or piece of information. Also the sharp end of something, or a mark in a game.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكرة أو معلومة؛ وأيضاً الطرف الحاد لشيء، أو نقطة في مباراة
entries.example: That is a good point.

entries.definitionEn: A way of thinking about a situation, or the position from which a story is told.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجهة نظر في موقف، أو الزاوية التي تُروى منها قصة
entries.example: From her point of view, the change was long overdue.

entries.definitionEn: To show direction or position with a finger, hand, or object.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشير بإصبع أو يد أو شيء ليبين اتجاهاً أو موضعاً
entries.example: He pointed at the map on the wall.

entries.definitionEn: Having no purpose or useful result.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الجدوى أو بلا هدف نافع
entries.example: It seemed pointless to argue any further.

entries.definitionEn: Calm, controlled behaviour, especially in a difficult situation. Also a graceful, balanced way of holding the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: رباطة جأش واتزان في السلوك، ولا سيما في موقف صعب؛ وأيضاً رشاقة القوام
entries.example: She answered the difficult questions with poise.

entries.definitionEn: To hold something in a steady, balanced position, often ready to move.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُبقي شيئاً في وضع متوازن ثابت، وغالباً على أهبة الحركة
entries.example: He poised the glass on the edge of the tray.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that can harm or kill a living thing if it is swallowed, breathed, or absorbed.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمّ يضر الكائن الحي أو يقتله إذا بُلع أو استُنشق أو امتُصّ
entries.example: Some mushrooms contain a dangerous poison.

entries.definitionEn: To harm or kill with poison, or to put poison into food, water, or the air.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمّم فيضر أو يقتل، أو يضع السمّ في طعام أو ماء أو هواء
entries.example: Chemicals from the factory poisoned the river.

entries.definitionEn: Containing or producing poison, and therefore able to cause harm or death.
entries.arabicMeaning: سامّ يحتوي سماً أو يفرزه فيقدر أن يؤذي أو يقتل
entries.example: That snake is poisonous and should not be handled.

entries.definitionEn: A large white bear that lives in the Arctic.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدب القطبي: دب أبيض كبير يعيش في المنطقة القطبية الشمالية
entries.example: The polar bear stood still on the ice.

entries.definitionEn: A long, thin, straight piece of wood or metal. Also either of the two points at the far north and south of the Earth.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمود طويل رفيع من خشب أو معدن؛ وأيضاً أحد قطبي الأرض شمالاً أو جنوباً
entries.example: They used a long pole to push the boat away from the bank.

entries.definitionEn: The official organisation whose job is to make sure people obey the law, or the people who work for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشرطة: الجهة الرسمية لحفظ القانون، أو أفرادها
entries.example: Someone called the police after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A member of the police.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنصر في الشرطة
entries.example: A police officer asked to see his driving licence.

entries.definitionEn: A building where the police work and where people can go to report a crime or ask for help.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركز الشرطة: مبنى تعمل فيه الشرطة ويُبلَّغ فيه عن الجرائم أو يُطلب العون
entries.example: She went to the police station to report the lost bag.

entries.definitionEn: A male police officer. Police officer is now the more usual term.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرطي رجل؛ والشائع اليوم عبارة police officer
entries.example: A policeman directed traffic around the closed road.

entries.definitionEn: A female police officer. Police officer is now the more usual term.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرطية امرأة؛ والشائع اليوم عبارة police officer
entries.example: The policewoman took a statement from the witness.

entries.definitionEn: A set of ideas or rules that an organisation or government follows. Also a written agreement with an insurance company.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياسة أو مجموعة قواعد تتبعها جهة أو حكومة؛ وأيضاً وثيقة تأمين
entries.example: The school has a strict policy on late homework.

entries.definitionEn: A serious infectious disease that can cause lasting paralysis, especially in children.
entries.arabicMeaning: شلل الأطفال: مرض معدٍ خطير قد يسبب شللاً دائماً ولا سيما عند الصغار
entries.example: The vaccine has made polio rare in many countries.

entries.definitionEn: A substance rubbed onto a surface to make it shine. Also a high quality of skill or elegance in performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة تلميع تُفرك على سطح ليَلمع؛ وأيضاً صقل وأناقة في الأداء
entries.example: She put polish on her shoes before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Behaving in a way that shows respect and good manners.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهذّب في سلوكه يحترم الآخرين ويتأدّب معهم
entries.example: He was polite to everyone at the table.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows respect and good manners.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأدب واحترام
entries.example: She politely declined a second helping.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being polite; respectful and well-mannered behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: التهذيب: سلوك محترم حسن المعاملة
entries.example: A little politeness made the conversation easier.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the government of a country or to the activities of people who hold or seek power in it.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بحكم البلاد أو بنشاط من يتولّون السلطة أو يسعون إليها
entries.example: The newspaper has a long political section each morning.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to government, public power, or the effect of a decision on these.
entries.arabicMeaning: من زاوية الحكم والسلطة العامة أو أثر قرار فيهما
entries.example: The decision was politically difficult for the mayor.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to work in government or in a political party.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياسي يعمل في الحكم أو في حزب
entries.example: The politician answered questions at the town hall.

entries.definitionEn: The activities of government and of people who want power in a country. Also the study of this.
entries.arabicMeaning: النشاط السياسي في الحكم والسعي إلى السلطة؛ وأيضاً دراسة هذا النشاط
entries.example: She is studying politics at university.

entries.definitionEn: An organised society with a particular form of government.
entries.arabicMeaning: كيان سياسي منظّم له نظام حكم معيّن
entries.example: The island developed a polity based on elected councils.

entries.definitionEn: A substance that makes air, water, or soil dirty and harmful.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادّة ملوِّثة تجعل الهواء أو الماء أو التربة وسخة وضارة
entries.example: Smoke from the factory is a serious pollutant.

entries.definitionEn: To make air, water, or land dirty and dangerous to people, animals, or plants.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوّث الهواء أو الماء أو الأرض فيجعلها وسخة وخطرة على الأحياء
entries.example: Old cars pollute the air in the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: Dirty and harmful substances in the air, water, or land, or the process of causing this.
entries.arabicMeaning: التلوث: مواد وسخة ضارة في الهواء أو الماء أو الأرض، أو إحداث ذلك
entries.example: Air pollution is worse on hot, still days.

entries.definitionEn: A game played on horseback in which two teams try to hit a ball with long-handled mallets.
entries.arabicMeaning: البولو: لعبة على ظهور الخيل يضرب فيها فريقان كرة بمضارب طويلة
entries.example: They watched a polo match on the wide green field.

entries.definitionEn: Having several syllables.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعدّد المقاطع الصوتية
entries.example: Technical writing is full of polysyllabic terms.

entries.definitionEn: A small area of still water, smaller than a lake, often in a garden or park.
entries.arabicMeaning: بركة ماء راكد أصغر من البحيرة، وغالباً في حديقة
entries.example: Ducks swam across the pond.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something carefully for a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأمّل أمراً ويفكر فيه بروية مدة من الوقت
entries.example: She pondered the offer for several days.

entries.definitionEn: Slow and heavy in movement, or dull and laboured in style.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقيل بطيء في الحركة، أو متكلّف مملّ في الأسلوب
entries.example: His ponderous speech made the meeting feel twice as long.

entries.definitionEn: In a slow, heavy, or laboured way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بثقل وبطء أو بتكلّف
entries.example: The old truck moved ponderously up the hill.

entries.definitionEn: A hole or tank filled with water for swimming. Also a small area of liquid on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسبح للسباحة؛ وأيضاً بقعة سائل على سطح
entries.example: The hotel has a swimming pool.

entries.definitionEn: Having little money or few possessions. Also of low quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقير قليل المال أو المتاع؛ وأيضاً رديء الجودة
entries.example: The family was too poor to repair the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Modern popular music with a strong rhythm, often with singing.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى البوب الحديثة ذات الإيقاع الواضح، وغالباً مع غناء
entries.example: She likes pop more than classical music.

entries.definitionEn: To burst with a short, sharp sound. Also to go somewhere quickly for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينفجر بصوت قصير حاد؛ أو يذهب بسرعة إلى مكان لوقت قصير
entries.example: The balloon popped when it hit the sharp edge.

entries.definitionEn: Maize grains heated until they burst into light, fluffy pieces, often eaten as a snack.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفشار: حبّات ذرة تُحمّى حتى تنفرط قطعاً خفيفة، وغالباً تُؤكل وجبة خفيفة
entries.example: They bought popcorn before the film started.

entries.definitionEn: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: محبوب أو شائع لدى كثير من الناس
entries.example: The café is popular with students.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being liked or supported by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشعبية: مدى حب الناس لشخص أو شيء أو تأييدهم له
entries.example: The show's popularity grew week after week.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making something specialist known, liked, or easier to understand among the general public.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبسيط موضوع متخصص ونشره حتى يشيع ويفهمه عامة الناس
entries.example: His book was a popularization of recent medical research.

entries.definitionEn: To make something known, liked, or easier to understand among many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل شيئاً معروفاً أو محبوباً أو أيسر فهماً لدى جمهور واسع
entries.example: The series helped popularize cooking at home.

entries.definitionEn: All the people who live in a particular country, city, or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: السكان: كل من يعيش في بلد أو مدينة أو منطقة
entries.example: The population of the town has grown quickly.

entries.definitionEn: A covered area at the entrance to a building, often with a roof and sometimes open at the sides.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرفة مسقوفة عند مدخل المبنى، وقد تكون مفتوحة الجوانب
entries.example: They sat on the porch and watched the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Meat from a pig.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحم الخنزير
entries.example: The recipe uses pork and apples.

entries.definitionEn: A town or place by the sea or a river where ships load and unload.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميناء: بلدة أو موضع على بحر أو نهر ترسو فيه السفن للشحن والتفريغ
entries.example: The ship arrived at the port at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to carry or move from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل الحمل أو النقل من مكان إلى آخر
entries.example: She carried a portable charger in her bag.

entries.definitionEn: A device designed to be carried, especially a small computer or radio.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز محمول يُصمم للحمل، ولا سيما حاسوب صغير أو مذياع
entries.example: He wrote the report on a portable on the train.

entries.definitionEn: A sign or omen that something important, often unwelcome, is about to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: نذير أو أمارة على أمر مهم وشيك، وغالباً غير محمود
entries.example: They read the dark sky as a porten of a coming storm.

entries.definitionEn: A part of something larger, especially an amount of food for one person.
entries.arabicMeaning: جزء من شيء أكبر، ولا سيما حصة طعام لشخص واحد
entries.example: She asked for a smaller portion of rice.

entries.definitionEn: A painting, drawing, or photograph of a person, especially of the face.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة شخصية لوجه إنسان أو هيئته رسماً أو تصويراً
entries.example: A portrait of her grandmother hung in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: The art of making portraits in painting, drawing, or photography.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن رسم الوجوه أو تصويرها
entries.example: The exhibition was devoted to portraiture from the last century.

entries.definitionEn: To show or describe a person or thing in a particular way in art, film, or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصوّر شخصاً أو شيئاً على نحو معيّن في الفن أو الفيلم أو الكتابة
entries.example: The film portrays him as a quiet, stubborn man.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person or thing is shown or described in art, film, or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة تصوير شخص أو موضوع في عمل فني أو أدبي
entries.example: Her portrayal of the judge felt fair and human.

entries.definitionEn: The position in which someone stands or sits, especially for a photograph or painting. Also an affected way of behaving.
entries.arabicMeaning: وضعية الجسم ولا سيما أمام كاميرا أو رسّام؛ وأيضاً تكلّف في السلوك
entries.example: The model held the pose until the photographer was ready.

entries.definitionEn: To create a problem, risk, or question. Also to hold the body in a particular position, especially for a photograph.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكّل مشكلة أو خطراً أو سؤالاً؛ أو يتّخذ وضعية للجسم ولا سيما أمام كاميرا
entries.example: Flooding still poses a risk to the lower streets.

entries.definitionEn: Expensive, stylish, and typical of a high social class, often used informally.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاخر أنيق يوحي بطبقة راقية، وغالباً في كلام غير رسمي
entries.example: They booked a posh hotel for their anniversary.

entries.definitionEn: To put forward an idea or theory as a starting point for discussion or belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطرح فكرة أو نظرية منطلقاً للنقاش أو الاعتقاد
entries.example: The paper posits that sleep quality affects memory.

entries.definitionEn: The place where someone or something is. Also a job, or an opinion on a matter.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضع شخص أو شيء؛ وأيضاً وظيفة أو موقف من مسألة
entries.example: Keep the vase in that position so it does not fall.

entries.definitionEn: Hopeful and confident, or showing agreement. Also certain, or more than zero.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفائل واثق أو دالّ على الموافقة؛ وأيضاً مؤكَّد أو أكبر من الصفر
entries.example: She tried to stay positive after the setback.

entries.definitionEn: In a hopeful or favourable way. Also used to emphasise that something is definitely true.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطريقة إيجابية مواتية؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً لتوكيد أن الأمر قطعي
entries.example: He spoke positively about the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To have or own something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملك شيئاً أو يحوزه
entries.example: The museum possesses a rare collection of maps.

entries.definitionEn: Controlled as if by an evil spirit. Also filled with a very strong feeling or energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: كأن روحاً شريرة تسيطر عليه؛ أو يملؤه شعور أو طاقة شديدة
entries.example: She worked as if possessed until the draft was finished.

entries.definitionEn: The state of having or owning something. Also a thing that you own.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة التملّك؛ وأيضاً شيء تملكه
entries.example: The keys are now in your possession.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, showing who something belongs to, as in my or their. Also unwilling to share a person or thing you care about.
entries.arabicMeaning: في النحو: دالّ على الملكية مثل my وtheir؛ وأيضاً ضنين بما يحب فلا يحب مشاركته
entries.example: In this sentence, her is a possessive adjective.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that has or owns something.
entries.arabicMeaning: المالك أو الحائز لشيء
entries.example: The possessor of the ticket must show identification.

entries.definitionEn: Something that might happen or be true. Also the fact that something can happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر قد يحدث أو يكون صحيحاً؛ وأيضاً إمكان حدوث شيء
entries.example: There is a possibility of rain this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be done or to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممكن أن يُفعل أو يحدث
entries.example: Is it possible to finish this today?

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something might be true or might happen. Also used to make a request more polite.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربما يكون الأمر صحيحاً أو يحدث؛ وتُستخدم أيضاً لتلطيف الطلب
entries.example: Could you possibly call me back later?

entries.definitionEn: The official system for sending letters and parcels, or the letters and parcels themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: البريد: النظام الرسمي لإرسال الرسائل والطرود، أو الرسائل والطرود نفسها
entries.example: The letter came in the post this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you can buy stamps and send letters and parcels.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب البريد حيث تُشترى الطوابع وتُرسل الرسائل والطرود
entries.example: I need to go to the post office to send this parcel.

entries.definitionEn: To send a letter or parcel through the official mail system. Also to put a notice where people can see it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل رسالة أو طرداً بالبريد؛ أو يلصق إعلاناً حيث يراه الناس
entries.example: Did you post the form yesterday?

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the post, or to the sending of letters and parcels.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالبريد أو بإرسال الرسائل والطرود
entries.example: Write your full postal address on the back.

entries.definitionEn: A small card, often with a picture on one side, that you send by post without an envelope.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة بريدية صغيرة، وغالباً عليها صورة، تُرسل بلا ظرف
entries.example: She sent a postcard from Rome.

entries.definitionEn: A large printed picture or notice put on a wall to advertise something or for decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملصق كبير على جدار للإعلان أو للزينة
entries.example: They put a poster on the classroom wall.

entries.definitionEn: All the people who will live in the future; later generations.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأجيال القادمة من بعدنا
entries.example: The letters were kept for posterity.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to deliver letters and parcels.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعي البريد يوصّل الرسائل والطرود
entries.example: The postman left the parcel by the door.

entries.definitionEn: To move an event or action to a later time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤجّل حدثاً أو عملاً إلى وقت لاحق
entries.example: They decided to postpone the meeting until Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the way the body is held and aligned, especially when sitting or standing.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بوضعية الجسد واستقامته عند الجلوس أو الوقوف
entries.example: The physiotherapist assessed her postural alignment at the desk.

entries.definitionEn: The way a person holds their body when sitting or standing. Also a public attitude toward an issue.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيئة الجسد عند الجلوس أو الوقوف؛ وأيضاً موقف معلَن من قضية
entries.example: Good posture can reduce pain in the neck and back.

entries.definitionEn: To behave in a way meant to impress others or to suggest an attitude you may not truly hold.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصنّع هيئة أو موقفاً ليؤثر في الآخرين أو ليوحي بما قد لا يعتقده
entries.example: The rivals postured for the cameras before the debate.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour intended to impress or to display strength or principle, often insincerely.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصنّع المواقف لإبهار الآخرين أو لإظهار القوة، وكثيراً ما يكون غير صادق
entries.example: The talks stalled amid weeks of empty posturing.

entries.definitionEn: A round container used for cooking food or for growing a plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: إناء مستدير للطبخ أو أصيص لزراعة نبات
entries.example: She put the soup on the stove in a large pot.

entries.definitionEn: A round vegetable that grows under the ground and is often cooked.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاطا: خضار مستديرة تنمو تحت الأرض وتُطبخ غالباً
entries.example: Would you like rice or potatoes with the chicken?

entries.definitionEn: Having a strong effect, especially a drug, chemical, or argument.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوي التأثير، ولا سيما في دواء أو مادة كيميائية أو حجة
entries.example: The medicine is potent, so the dose must stay small.

entries.definitionEn: Possible in the future, but not yet real or actual.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممكن أن يحدث أو يصير، لكنه لم يتحقق بعد
entries.example: The flood is a potential risk after heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: A quality or ability that could develop into something useful or successful.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة كامنة يمكن أن تتطوّر إلى نجاح أو نفع
entries.example: The coach said the young player has great potential.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is possible, even if it has not happened yet.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو محتمل قد يقع وإن لم يحدث بعد
entries.example: The delay could potentially affect the whole schedule.

entries.definitionEn: Pots, plates, and similar objects made from clay. Also the craft of making them.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوانٍ فخارية من الطين؛ وأيضاً صناعة الفخار
entries.example: The market stall sold handmade pottery from the village.

entries.definitionEn: To jump suddenly on a person or animal in order to catch them. Also to act quickly to take an opportunity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقضّ فجأة ليصطاد شخصاً أو حيواناً؛ وأيضاً يبادر باغتنام فرصة
entries.example: The cat waited behind the chair and then pounced.

entries.definitionEn: The unit of money used in the United Kingdom. Also a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنيه: عملة المملكة المتحدة؛ وأيضاً الرطل وحدة وزن تقارب 454 غراماً
entries.example: The jacket cost eighty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something hard again and again. Also, of the heart, to beat strongly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب بقوة مرة بعد مرة؛ أو يخفق القلب بشدة
entries.example: Waves pounded the rocks all night.

entries.definitionEn: To make a liquid flow out of a container.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسكب سائلاً من إناء
entries.example: Please pour some water into my glass.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being very poor and having too little money for basic needs.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقر: قلّة المال عن سدّ الحاجات الأساسية
entries.example: The charity works to reduce poverty in the city.

entries.definitionEn: A dry substance made of very small fine grains.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسحوق جاف من حبيبات دقيقة جداً
entries.example: She mixed the milk powder with warm water.

entries.definitionEn: To cover something with powder, or to crush it into a fine dry substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغطّي الشيء بالمسحوق أو يسحقه حتى يصير ناعماً جافاً
entries.example: The baker powdered the cakes with sugar.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to control people or things. Also energy that makes machines work, such as electricity.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدرة على السيطرة؛ أو طاقة تحرّك الآلات كالكهرباء
entries.example: The storm cut off power for several hours.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of power, strength, or influence.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو قوة أو تأثير كبير
entries.example: The engine is small but very powerful.

entries.definitionEn: With great strength, force, or effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقوة وتأثير بالغ
entries.example: The speaker argued powerfully for a change in the rules.

entries.definitionEn: Useful in real situations, not only in theory. Also good at dealing with real problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملي يصلح للواقع لا للتنظير وحده؛ وأيضاً بارع في معالجة المشكلات الحقيقية
entries.example: She gave us practical advice about packing for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being useful and suitable for real use. Also a practical aspect of a plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطابع العملي وصلاحية الشيء للاستعمال؛ وأيضاً جانب عملي من خطة
entries.example: We liked the design, but its practicality in a small kitchen was unclear.

entries.definitionEn: Almost; very nearly. Also in a way that is useful in real life.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً إلى حد بعيد؛ أو من الناحية العملية في الواقع
entries.example: The hall was practically empty by nine o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of doing something many times so that you get better at it. Also a usual way of doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمرين متكرر لإجادة مهارة؛ أو عادة متّبعة في عمل شيء
entries.example: Daily practice helped her play the piano more smoothly.

entries.definitionEn: To do something regularly in order to improve a skill. Practice is the usual American spelling; practise is British for the verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمرّن بتكرار فعل لتحسين المهارة؛ practice إملاء أمريكي وpractise للفعل في البريطانية
entries.example: He practises the guitar for half an hour every evening.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works in a profession, especially medicine or law. Also someone who regularly does a particular activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممارس لمهنة ولا سيما الطب أو القانون؛ وأيضاً من يواظب على نشاط معيّن
entries.example: She is a general practitioner at the local clinic.

entries.definitionEn: Words that show you admire someone or think they have done well.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثناء يعبّر عن الإعجاب أو عن جودة ما أُنجز
entries.example: The team received praise for finishing the work early.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you admire someone or that they have done something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثني على شخص أو على جودة عمله
entries.example: The manager praised the staff after the busy weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A springing, high-stepping movement, like that of a horse showing off.
entries.arabicMeaning: وثبة خفيفة متبخترة كخطوة حصان يتباهى
entries.example: The pony's little prance made the children laugh.

entries.definitionEn: A small sea animal with a shell and ten legs, eaten as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: روبيان: قشري بحري صغير يؤكل
entries.example: We ordered prawns with rice for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To speak to God, especially to ask for help or to give thanks.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدعو الله أو يصلّي، ولا سيما طلباً للعون أو شكراً
entries.example: They pray together every morning.

entries.definitionEn: Words said to God, or the act of speaking to God.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلاة أو دعاء يُرفع إلى الله
entries.example: She said a quiet prayer before the exam.

entries.definitionEn: To give a talk on a religious or moral subject, especially in a place of worship. Also to tell people how they ought to behave.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعظ في أمر ديني أو أخلاقي ولا سيما في دار عبادة؛ وأيضاً يوصي الناس بما ينبغي لهم
entries.example: The imam will preach at Friday prayers this week.

entries.definitionEn: A person who gives religious talks to a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: واعظ يلقي خطباً دينية على جماعة
entries.example: The preacher spoke slowly so everyone could follow.

entries.definitionEn: To happen or come before something else in time or order.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبق غيره في الزمن أو الترتيب
entries.example: A short film will precede the main feature.

entries.definitionEn: Very valuable, either because it costs a lot or because it matters a great deal to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمين لعظم ثمنه أو لعظم قيمته عند صاحبه
entries.example: The ring was a precious gift from her grandmother.

entries.definitionEn: Exact, clear, and careful; not vague.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقيق واضح غير مبهم
entries.example: Please give me the precise time of your arrival.

entries.definitionEn: In an exact way. Also used to agree that something is exactly right.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدقة تامة؛ وأيضاً لتأكيد أن القول مطابق تماماً
entries.example: The train arrived at precisely ten o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being exact and accurate.
entries.arabicMeaning: دقة متناهية في الضبط والإصابة
entries.example: The watch is valued for its precision.

entries.definitionEn: Having skills or understanding that appear unusually early for a person's age.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناضج قبل أوانه، بمهارات أو فهم يفوقان عمره
entries.example: The precocious child was already reading adult novels.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows unusually early development for a person's age.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يفوق العمر نضجاً مبكراً
entries.example: She argued precociously about the story's ending.

entries.definitionEn: An opinion formed before you have enough knowledge or evidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: تصوّر مسبق يُعقد قبل توفّر المعرفة أو الدليل الكافي
entries.example: Travel helped him drop some preconceptions about the city.

entries.definitionEn: A difficult or embarrassing situation that is hard to get out of.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأزق محرج يصعب الخروج منه
entries.example: Losing both keys left us in an awkward predicament.

entries.definitionEn: To base a statement, plan, or action on a particular idea or fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبني قولاً أو خطة أو فعلاً على أساس فكرة أو حقيقة معيّنة
entries.example: The forecast was predicated on a rise in demand.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, used after a linking verb such as be to describe the subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: في النحو: يقع بعد فعل رابط مثل يكون ليصف المبتدأ
entries.example: In the clause she is ready, ready is a predicative adjective.

entries.definitionEn: To say what you think will happen in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقول ما يتوقع حدوثه في المستقبل
entries.example: The weather report predicted rain for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to guess because it happens in the way you expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل التوقع لأنه يجري على النحو المنتظر
entries.example: The ending of the film was too predictable.

entries.definitionEn: A statement about what you think will happen in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: قول بما يُتوقع حدوثه لاحقاً
entries.example: His prediction about the score was almost right.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to or used for saying what is likely to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالتنبؤ أو مستخدم للدلالة على ما يُرجح حدوثه
entries.example: The app uses predictive text to finish your words.

entries.definitionEn: Something that helps you judge what is likely to happen later.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤشر يُستدل به على ما يُرجح أن يحدث
entries.example: Attendance is a useful predictor of exam success.

entries.definitionEn: A special liking for something, often a long-standing one.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل خاص وهوى نحو شيء، وكثيراً ما يطول أمده
entries.example: He has a predilection for quiet cafés in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: More distinguished or important than all others in a particular field.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأبرز والأرفع مقاماً في بابه على سائر النظراء
entries.example: She is the preeminent historian of the period.

entries.definitionEn: In some schools, a senior student given limited authority over other pupils.
entries.arabicMeaning: في بعض المدارس: طالب كبير يُكلَّف ضبط زملائه بسلطة محدودة
entries.example: The prefect reminded the younger students to walk, not run.

entries.definitionEn: To like one person or thing more than another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفضّل شخصاً أو شيئاً على آخر
entries.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: Better or more suitable than another option.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرجح وأولى بالاختيار من غيره
entries.example: A later train would be preferable if the meeting runs long.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say what you would like most if a choice is possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: على سبيل التفضيل إن تيسّر الاختيار
entries.example: Come in the morning, preferably before ten.

entries.definitionEn: A greater liking for one thing rather than another.
entries.arabicMeaning: تفضيل شيء على غيره
entries.example: Do you have a preference for a window seat?

entries.definitionEn: A group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: بادئة: مجموعة حروف تُضاف إلى أول الكلمة فتغيّر معناها
entries.example: The prefix un turns happy into unhappy.

entries.definitionEn: Having a baby developing inside the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: حامل بجنين في رحمها
entries.example: She is six months pregnant and still walks to work.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to the time before people wrote down history.
entries.arabicMeaning: عائد إلى ما قبل التدوين والتاريخ المكتوب
entries.example: The cave paintings date from prehistoric times.

entries.definitionEn: An ancestor of modern humans that lived before our species.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلف للإنسان الحديث عاش قبل نوعنا
entries.example: The museum display compared tools used by a prehuman and by later people.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to the period before factories and modern industry became common.
entries.arabicMeaning: سابق لشيوع المصانع والصناعة الحديثة
entries.example: The village kept some preindustrial crafts alive.

entries.definitionEn: To form an opinion about someone or something before you know the facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصدر حكماً قبل معرفة الوقائع
entries.example: Try not to prejudge the applicants from a single email.

entries.definitionEn: An unfair opinion about a person or group, formed without enough knowledge or with hostility.
entries.arabicMeaning: رأي مسبق غير منصف تجاه شخص أو جماعة، من غير علم كاف أو مع عداء
entries.example: The course examines how prejudice can affect hiring decisions.

entries.definitionEn: Coming before the main event or piece of work, often as preparation.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمهيدي يسبق الأمر الرئيسي، وغالباً على سبيل الإعداد
entries.example: The committee published a preliminary report in March.

entries.definitionEn: Best or most important; first in rank or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأرفع رتبة أو جودة؛ الأول في بابه
entries.example: It is the country's premier music festival.

entries.definitionEn: The head of a government, especially a prime minister.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيس الحكومة، ولا سيما رئيس الوزراء
entries.example: The premier met visiting officials at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: An idea or statement accepted as true and used as the basis of an argument.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلَّمة تُقبل وتُبنى عليها الحجة
entries.example: The whole plan rests on the premise that costs will fall.

entries.definitionEn: The buildings and land that a business or organisation uses.
entries.arabicMeaning: المباني والأرض التابعة لعمل أو مؤسسة
entries.example: No smoking is allowed on the hospital premises.

entries.definitionEn: A state of thinking so much about one thing that you notice little else. Also the thing that fills your thoughts.
entries.arabicMeaning: انشغال ذهني يستأثر بالفكر حتى يغفل صاحبه عمّا سواه؛ أو الأمر الذي يملأ الخاطر
entries.example: Work had become a preoccupation that followed him home.

entries.definitionEn: The process of getting something or someone ready.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعداد وتهيئة شخص أو شيء مسبقاً
entries.example: Good preparation made the interview less stressful.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something ready for a later event or use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعدّ شخصاً أو شيئاً ويهيئه لحدث أو استعمال لاحق
entries.example: She prepared a salad while the pasta was cooking.

entries.definitionEn: Ready to do something, or made ready in advance. Also willing.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاهز للقيام بشيء أو مُعدّ سلفاً؛ وأيضاً مستعد نفسياً
entries.example: They were well prepared for the long drive.

entries.definitionEn: A word such as in, on, or from that shows a relation of place, time, or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر مثل in وon وfrom يبيّن علاقة مكان أو زمان أو اتجاه
entries.example: In the phrase on the table, on is a preposition.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to children who are not yet old enough for primary school, or to their education.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالأطفال قبل سن المدرسة الابتدائية أو بتعليمهم
entries.example: She teaches in a preschool class of four-year-olds.

entries.definitionEn: If a doctor prescribes a medicine, they say officially that a patient should take it. Also to lay down as a rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصف الطبيب دواءً على وجه رسمي؛ وأيضاً يفرض أمراً قاعدةً
entries.example: The doctor prescribed a cream for the rash.

entries.definitionEn: A written order from a doctor for medicine, or the medicine itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصفة طبية مكتوبة، أو الدواء المصروف بموجبها
entries.example: You will need a prescription to buy this medicine.

entries.definitionEn: Telling people what they must do, rather than describing what they actually do. Also laying down rules for how language should be used.
entries.arabicMeaning: آمر يحدّد ما ينبغي فعله لا ما هو كائن؛ وأيضاً يضع قواعد لكيفية استعمال اللغة
entries.example: The guide is more descriptive than prescriptive.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of being in a particular place. Also a quality that makes a person noticeable.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجود في مكان معيّن؛ أو هيبة تجعل صاحبها ملحوظاً
entries.example: Your presence at the meeting would be helpful.

entries.definitionEn: In a particular place. Also existing or happening now.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجود في المكان؛ أو قائم في الزمن الحالي
entries.example: All the team members were present except one.

entries.definitionEn: Something you give to someone, for example on a birthday.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدية تُعطى لشخص في مناسبة كعيد الميلاد
entries.example: He wrapped the present in blue paper.

entries.definitionEn: To show or offer something to people, often in a formal way. Also to give a talk.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض شيئاً أو يقدّمه إلى الناس وغالباً بصفة رسمية؛ وأيضاً يلقي عرضاً
entries.example: She will present her findings to the board on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A talk in which you show information to a group. Also the way something is shown or arranged.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض منظَّم لمعلومات أمام جماعة؛ أو هيئة الشيء وطريقة إظهاره
entries.example: His presentation used clear slides and short examples.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the way information, a performance, or an idea is shown to an audience.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بأسلوب عرض المعلومات أو الأداء أو الفكرة على الجمهور
entries.example: The course covers presentational skills for public talks.

entries.definitionEn: A person who introduces and talks through a radio or television programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدّم يقدّم برنامجاً إذاعياً أو تلفزيونياً ويدير الحديث فيه
entries.example: The presenter asked each guest the same three questions.

entries.definitionEn: The act of keeping something in its original state or of protecting it from harm or loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: صون شيء على حاله أو حمايته من التلف والضياع
entries.example: The museum is devoted to the preservation of old photographs.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works to protect old buildings, landscapes, or traditions from being destroyed or replaced.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يعمل على صون المباني القديمة أو المناظر أو التقاليد من الهدم أو الاستبدال
entries.example: Local preservationists opposed knocking down the old library.

entries.definitionEn: To keep something as it is, or to protect it from harm, decay, or loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحفظ الشيء على حاله أو يقيه التلف والضياع
entries.example: Salt was used to preserve the fish.

entries.definitionEn: The job of being president, or the period during which someone holds that job.
entries.arabicMeaning: منصب الرئاسة أو مدة شغل هذا المنصب
entries.example: The reform was the main achievement of her presidency.
