entries.definitionEn: The leader of a country that has a president, or the head of an organisation.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيس دولة ذات نظام رئاسي، أو رئيس منظمة
entries.example: The president opened the new hospital on Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a president or to the job of president.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالرئيس أو بمنصب الرئاسة
entries.example: The presidential election will be held in November.

entries.definitionEn: Newspapers and magazines, and the people who write for them. Also a machine that presses something.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصحافة من صحف ومجلات والعاملون فيها؛ وأيضاً آلة للضغط
entries.example: The press asked for a statement after the announcement.

entries.definitionEn: To push something firmly. Also to try hard to persuade someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضغط على شيء بقوة؛ أو يلحّ في إقناع شخص
entries.example: Press the green button to start the machine.

entries.definitionEn: The force of one thing pushing on another. Also a feeling that you must do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوة دفع شيء على آخر؛ أو شعور بوجوب الفعل
entries.example: There is a lot of pressure to finish the work this week.

entries.definitionEn: The process of keeping the air in a closed space, such as an aircraft cabin, at a suitable pressure.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضبط ضغط الهواء في حيّز مغلق كحجرة الطائرة ليبقى صالحاً
entries.example: Cabin pressurization keeps the air breathable at high altitude.

entries.definitionEn: To keep air in a closed space at a raised pressure. Also to try hard to make someone do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع ضغط الهواء في حيّز مغلق ويثبّته؛ أو يضغط على شخص ليحمله على فعل
entries.example: The system pressurizes the cabin as the plane climbs.

entries.definitionEn: Respect and admiration that come from success, quality, or high status.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكانة قائمة على النجاح أو الجودة أو علوّ المنزلة
entries.example: Winning the prize brought prestige to the whole department.

entries.definitionEn: Respected and admired because of high quality or status.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرموق يُحترم لجودته أو منزلته العالية
entries.example: She won a place at a prestigious university.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that you think something is likely, based on what you know.
entries.arabicMeaning: على ما يُرجَّح استناداً إلى ما يُعلم
entries.example: The lights are on, so someone is presumably at home.

entries.definitionEn: To assume that something is true before you continue. Also to require something as a necessary prior condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفترض صحة أمر سلفاً قبل المضي؛ أو يتطلّبه شرطاً سابقاً لازماً
entries.example: The method presupposes that the data are complete.

entries.definitionEn: Something that is assumed to be true before an argument or discussion begins.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر يُسلَّم به سلفاً قبل بدء الحجاج أو النقاش
entries.example: The policy rests on a presupposition that demand will stay high.

entries.definitionEn: Not real, but imagined or used in play.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير حقيقي، يُتّخذ في التخييل أو اللعب
entries.example: The children served pretend tea in tiny cups.

entries.definitionEn: To act as if something is true when it is not.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتظاهر بأن شيئاً حقيقي وهو ليس كذلك
entries.example: He pretended to be asleep when she came in.

entries.definitionEn: Pleasant to look at, in a gentle or attractive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: جميل المنظر على نحو لطيف جذّاب
entries.example: The garden looks pretty in the spring.

entries.definitionEn: Fairly; quite, but not extremely.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد بعيد أو إلى حدّ ما، دون المبالغة
entries.example: The bag was pretty heavy to carry home.

entries.definitionEn: To prove stronger and succeed. Also to be common or usual at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلب وينتصر؛ أو يشيع ويكون هو السائد في زمن معيّن
entries.example: Common sense prevailed and they turned back before the storm.

entries.definitionEn: To stop something from happening, or to stop someone from doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحول دون حدوث شيء أو دون قيام شخص بفعل
entries.example: A lock on the gate will prevent the dog from running out.

entries.definitionEn: The act of stopping something bad from happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقاية تحول دون وقوع أمر سيئ
entries.example: Hand washing is a simple form of disease prevention.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to stop something bad from happening before it starts.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقائي يُقصد به منع الضرر قبل وقوعه
entries.example: They offered free preventive checks at the clinic.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or existing before the one you are talking about now.
entries.arabicMeaning: سابق للذي يُتحدَّث عنه الآن
entries.example: I met her once in a previous job.

entries.definitionEn: At an earlier time; before now.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت سابق؛ من قبل
entries.example: He had previously worked in a bookshop.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of money that you pay for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثمن الذي يُدفع لقاء شيء
entries.example: The price of the tickets has gone up.

entries.definitionEn: To decide or show how much something costs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّد سعر شيء أو يظهره
entries.example: The shop priced the chairs at fifty pounds each.

entries.definitionEn: So valuable that it is impossible to give it a price.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعظم قيمة من أن يُقدَّر بثمن
entries.example: The museum holds several priceless manuscripts.

entries.definitionEn: A slight sharp pain, or a tiny hole made by a pointed object.
entries.arabicMeaning: وخزة خفيفة أو ثقب دقيق يحدثه شيء محدّد الرأس
entries.example: She felt a prick as the needle went in.

entries.definitionEn: A good feeling about something you have done or about who you are. Also too high an opinion of yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: اعتزاز بما أنجزته أو بمن تكون؛ وأيضاً عجب مفرط بالنفس
entries.example: She felt pride in her daughter's first concert.

entries.definitionEn: A person who leads religious ceremonies in some religions, especially Christianity.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاهن يتولّى شعائر دينية في بعض الأديان ولا سيما المسيحية
entries.example: The priest spoke to the family after the service.

entries.definitionEn: Mainly; more than anything else.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساساً؛ في المقام الأول
entries.example: The course is primarily for beginners.

entries.definitionEn: Most important. Also relating to the first years of school.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأهم؛ أو متعلق بسنوات المدرسة الأولى
entries.example: Our primary concern is the safety of the passengers.

entries.definitionEn: A school for children in the first years of education, usually before secondary school.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرسة المرحلة الابتدائية للأطفال قبل التعليم الثانوي
entries.example: Their son starts primary school in September.

entries.definitionEn: Main, or of the best quality. Also most suitable.
entries.arabicMeaning: أساسي أو من أفضل نوع؛ وأيضاً الأنسب
entries.example: The house is in a prime location near the station.

entries.definitionEn: The head of the government in some countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيس الوزراء في بعض الدول
entries.example: The prime minister answered questions in parliament.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to the earliest ages of the world; ancient and original.
entries.arabicMeaning: موغل في القِدم يعود إلى أوائل العصور؛ أصيل عتيق
entries.example: The forest felt primeval, dense and almost silent.

entries.definitionEn: Very simple and not highly developed, especially of tools or living conditions. Also belonging to an early stage in history.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسيط غير بالغ التطوّر ولا سيما في الأدوات أو العيش؛ أو عائد إلى مرحلة تاريخية مبكرة
entries.example: They cooked over a primitive wood stove in the cabin.

entries.definitionEn: In a very simple or undeveloped way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو بسيط غير متطوّر
entries.example: The hut was primitively built from rough timber.

entries.definitionEn: The son of a king or queen, or a male member of a royal family.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابن الملك أو الملكة، أو ذكر من الأسرة المالكة
entries.example: The prince opened the new library in the town.

entries.definitionEn: The daughter of a king or queen, or the wife of a prince.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابنة الملك أو الملكة، أو زوجة الأمير
entries.example: The princess visited the hospital in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Main; most important.
entries.arabicMeaning: رئيسي؛ الأهم
entries.example: The principal reason for the delay was the weather.

entries.definitionEn: The person in charge of a school. Also a sum of money invested, not including interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدير المدرسة؛ أو أصل المال المستثمر دون الفائدة
entries.example: The principal spoke to parents at the start of term.

entries.definitionEn: Mainly; for the most part.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة رئيسية؛ في معظم الأمر
entries.example: The shop sells books, principally for language learners.

entries.definitionEn: A basic rule or belief that guides behaviour. Also a general scientific or technical rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة أو معتقد أساسي يوجّه السلوك؛ أو قانون علمي أو تقني عام
entries.example: She refused the offer as a matter of principle.

entries.definitionEn: Words or pictures produced on paper by a machine. Also a copy of a photograph.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمات أو صور تُخرجها آلة على ورق؛ أو نسخة من صورة
entries.example: The print in this contract is too small to read easily.

entries.definitionEn: To put words or pictures onto paper using a machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطبع كلمات أو صوراً على ورق بآلة
entries.example: Please print two copies of the form.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that puts words and pictures onto paper. Also a person whose job is printing.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة تطبع الكلمات والصور على الورق؛ أو عامل في مطبعة
entries.example: The printer is out of paper again.

entries.definitionEn: Existing or happening before something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: سابق لغيره وجوداً أو حدوثاً
entries.example: You need prior approval before changing the plan.

entries.definitionEn: Something that is treated as more important than other things and is dealt with first.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر يُقدَّم على غيره في الأهمية فيُباشر أولاً
entries.example: Safety is our first priority on the building site.

entries.definitionEn: To force something open or away from a surface, usually with a lever. Prise is the usual British spelling; pry is American.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتح شيئاً أو يخلعه عن سطح بعتلة في الغالب؛ prise إملاء بريطاني وpry أمريكي
entries.example: He prised the lid off the wooden crate.

entries.definitionEn: A building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجن: مبنى يُحبس فيه الناس عقاباً على جريمة
entries.example: He spent two years in prison for fraud.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is kept in prison, or who is held against their will.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجين في الحبس، أو شخص يُحتجز رغماً عنه
entries.example: The prisoner was allowed a short visit from his sister.

entries.definitionEn: Too easily shocked by anything slightly improper, and too concerned with being neat and correct.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط التحفّظ والتأنق يضيق بأدنى خروج عن اللياقة
entries.example: His prissy remarks about the muddy boots annoyed everyone.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being alone or of keeping your personal life away from other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصوصية: أن تكون بمعزل أو أن تُبقى شؤونك الشخصية بمنأى عن أعين الناس
entries.example: She closed the door to have some privacy for the call.

entries.definitionEn: For one person or group, not for everyone. Also not connected with work or with the government.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاص بشخص أو جماعة لا للجميع؛ أو غير متصل بالعمل أو بالدولة
entries.example: They held a private meeting after the public session.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not public; with only a few people knowing. Also by a person or company rather than the state.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير علني لا يعلمه إلا قليل؛ أو بصفة فرد أو شركة لا الدولة
entries.example: She spoke to him privately after the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A special right or advantage that only some people have.
entries.arabicMeaning: حق أو مزية خاصة لا تتاح للجميع
entries.example: Staff have the privilege of using the library after hours.

entries.definitionEn: Having special rights or advantages that others do not have.
entries.arabicMeaning: متمتع بحقوق أو مزايا لا يملكها غيره
entries.example: He grew up in a privileged family with every educational chance.

entries.definitionEn: Something you win in a competition or are given for doing well.
entries.arabicMeaning: جائزة تُنال في مسابقة أو تقديراً لحسن العمل
entries.example: She won first prize in the writing contest.

entries.definitionEn: An informal word for a professional, especially in a sport. Also an advantage, as in the pros and cons.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الكلام العادي: محترف ولا سيما في الرياضة؛ أو ميزة كما في الموازنة بين الحسنات والسيئات
entries.example: He used to play as a tennis pro before he started coaching.

entries.definitionEn: How likely something is to happen, sometimes expressed as a number.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى رجحان حدوث شيء، وقد يُعبَّر عنه برقم
entries.example: There is a high probability of rain this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to happen or to be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: راجح الحدوث أو الصدق
entries.example: The most probable cause was a loose wire.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is likely.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم للدلالة على أن الأمر مرجَّح
entries.example: She will probably be home before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A thorough investigation. Also a long thin instrument used to examine something, or a spacecraft sent to gather information.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحقيق متعمّق؛ أو مسبار رفيع للفحص، أو مركبة فضائية لجمع المعلومات
entries.example: The newspaper began a probe into the missing funds.

entries.definitionEn: A difficult situation or question that needs to be solved.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشكلة؛ مسألة تحتاج إلى حل
entries.example: The problem is that the door will not open.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the official or accepted way of doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالطريقة الرسمية أو المتّبعة لإنجاز عمل
entries.example: The delay was caused by a procedural error in the paperwork.

entries.definitionEn: A crime story or film that follows official methods of investigation in close detail.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصة أو فيلم جريمة يتتبع خطوات التحقيق الرسمية بتفصيل دقيق
entries.example: She prefers a police procedural to a thriller with wild twists.

entries.definitionEn: The usual or official way of doing something, especially a series of steps.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطريقة المعتادة أو الرسمية لإنجاز عمل، ولا سيما سلسلة خطوات
entries.example: Please follow the safety procedure before you start the machine.

entries.definitionEn: To continue with an action or to go forward, often after a pause.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمضي في عمل أو يتقدّم، وغالباً بعد توقف
entries.example: After a short break, the speaker proceeded with her talk.

entries.definitionEn: A series of actions or changes that lead to a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلسلة أفعال أو تغيّرات تفضي إلى نتيجة
entries.example: Learning a language is a slow process.

entries.definitionEn: To deal with information, documents, or materials in an official or organised way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعالج بيانات أو وثائق أو مواد بطريقة رسمية أو منظَّمة
entries.example: The office will process your application within five days.

entries.definitionEn: To say something publicly and officially.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلن أمراً على الملأ بصفة رسمية
entries.example: The mayor proclaimed the first day of the festival open.

entries.definitionEn: The habit of delaying something that you should do.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسويف: عادة تأخير ما ينبغي عمله
entries.example: Procrastination left him writing the report the night before.

entries.definitionEn: To make or grow something. Also to cause a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنع شيئاً أو يزرعه؛ وأيضاً يُحدث نتيجة
entries.example: The factory produces parts for bicycles.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that makes goods. Also someone who organises the making of a film, play, or programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو شركة تصنع سلعاً؛ أو من ينظّم إنتاج فيلم أو مسرحية أو برنامج
entries.example: The producer raised the money for the new film.

entries.definitionEn: Something that is made to be sold.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلعة تُصنع لتُباع
entries.example: The company launched a new cleaning product.

entries.definitionEn: The process of making things, especially in large amounts. Also a play, film, or show that is performed.
entries.arabicMeaning: صنع الأشياء ولا سيما بكميات كبيرة؛ أو عرض مسرحي أو سينمائي أو فني
entries.example: Production at the factory stopped for a week.

entries.definitionEn: Producing a large amount, or achieving useful results.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير الإنتاج أو النفع
entries.example: It was a productive morning and we finished the list.

entries.definitionEn: To claim that you have a feeling, quality, or belief, sometimes without proof. Also to state a belief openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدّعي إحساساً أو صفة أو معتقداً وقد يخلو ذلك من بيّنة؛ أو يصرّح بمعتقد علناً
entries.example: He professed complete ignorance of the missing files.

entries.definitionEn: A type of work that needs special training, such as medicine, law, or teaching.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهنة تحتاج إعداداً خاصاً كالطب أو القانون أو التعليم
entries.example: She chose nursing as her profession.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a job that needs special training. Also showing skill and serious behaviour at work.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بمهنة تحتاج تدريباً خاصاً؛ أو دالّ على مهارة وسلوك جادّ في العمل
entries.example: She bought a professional camera for her new job.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does a job that needs special training, or who is paid to do an activity others do for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يزاول مهنة تحتاج إعداداً، أو يُدفع له لعمل يمارسه غيره هواية
entries.example: The team hired a professional to redesign the website.

entries.definitionEn: The skill, care, and behaviour expected of someone who does a job well.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهارة وعناية وسلوك يليق بمن يحسن مهنته
entries.example: Her professionalism kept the meeting calm under pressure.

entries.definitionEn: A senior teacher at a university.
entries.arabicMeaning: أستاذ جامعي رفيع الرتبة
entries.example: The professor asked us to read two chapters before class.

entries.definitionEn: A short description of a person or organisation. Also the side view of a face, or the amount of public attention someone receives.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبذة موجزة عن شخص أو جهة؛ أو منظر الوجه من الجانب، أو مقدار الحضور في أعين الناس
entries.example: The magazine published a profile of the young architect.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you gain from a business after costs have been paid.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربح يزيد على التكاليف بعد دفعها
entries.example: The shop made a small profit in its first year.

entries.definitionEn: The degree to which a business or activity makes a profit.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى تحقيق النشاط أو العمل للربح
entries.example: Lower energy costs improved the factory's profitability.

entries.definitionEn: Making a profit, or likely to do so.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرّ ربحاً أو يُرجَّح أن يدرّه
entries.example: Selling online proved more profitable than the high-street shop.

entries.definitionEn: Very great or intense. Also showing deep understanding.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ العمق في الأثر أو الشدّة؛ أو دالّ على فهم عميق
entries.example: The book had a profound effect on how she saw her work.

entries.definitionEn: In a deep or intense way; extremely.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو عميق بالغ؛ إلى حد بعيد
entries.example: He was profoundly grateful for their quiet support.

entries.definitionEn: A show on television or radio. Also a plan of events, or a set of instructions that tell a computer what to do. Programme is the usual British spelling for a show or plan; program is American, and is also used in both for computers.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض في التلفزيون أو الراديو؛ أو خطة أحداث؛ أو تعليمات للحاسوب. programme إملاء بريطاني للعرض أو الخطة، وprogram أمريكي ويُستعمل أيضاً للحاسوب في النظامين
entries.example: There is a good programme about oceans on television tonight.

entries.definitionEn: To write instructions for a computer, or to set a machine to do something at a particular time. Program is the usual American spelling; programme is sometimes used in British English for machines.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتب تعليمات للحاسوب أو يضبط جهازاً ليعمل في وقت معيّن؛ program إملاء أمريكي وprogramme قد يُستعمل بريطانياً للأجهزة
entries.example: She programmed the heating to come on at six.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to write computer programs.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبرمج يكتب برامج الحاسوب
entries.example: The programmer fixed the error in a few hours.

entries.definitionEn: The work of writing computer programs. Also the planning of what will be broadcast.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتابة برامج الحاسوب؛ أو التخطيط لما سيُبثّ
entries.example: She studied programming after leaving school.

entries.definitionEn: Improvement or movement toward a better or later stage.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحسّن أو تقدّم نحو مرحلة أفضل أو لاحقة
entries.example: The students have made good progress this term.

entries.definitionEn: To improve, develop, or move forward.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحسّن أو يتطوّر أو يتقدّم
entries.example: The talks progressed more quickly after the first day.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or changing gradually, step by step. Also supporting new ideas and social change.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدث أو يتغيّر تدريجياً خطوة فخطوة؛ أو يناصر الأفكار الجديدة والتغيير الاجتماعي
entries.example: They made progressive changes, a little at a time.

entries.definitionEn: To say officially that something is not allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحظر أمراً بصفة رسمية فلا يُباح
entries.example: The rules prohibit smoking inside the building.

entries.definitionEn: The act of officially forbidding something, or a law that forbids it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظر رسمي لشيء، أو قانون يحرّمه
entries.example: There is a prohibition on parking in front of the gate.

entries.definitionEn: So expensive that people cannot or will not pay. Also intended to prevent an action.
entries.arabicMeaning: باهظ إلى حد يمنع الدفع أو يثني عنه؛ أو معدّ لمنع فعل
entries.example: Rents in the centre have become prohibitive for many workers.

entries.definitionEn: To a degree that stops people from doing something, especially because of cost.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مانع يحول دون الفعل، ولا سيما بسبب الكلفة
entries.example: The tickets were prohibitively expensive for a family of four.

entries.definitionEn: A planned piece of work with a particular aim, often with a time limit.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل منظَّم له هدف معيّن وغالباً أجل محدد
entries.example: The class is working on a science project about plants.

entries.definitionEn: To show an image on a screen. Also to estimate a future amount, or to present a particular image of yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض صورة على شاشة؛ أو يقدّر رقماً مستقبلياً؛ أو يُظهر صورة معيّنة عن نفسه
entries.example: They projected the map onto the wall for the briefing.

entries.definitionEn: An estimate of a future amount or situation. Also an image shown on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدير لمقدار أو وضع مستقبلي؛ أو صورة معروضة على شاشة
entries.example: The latest projection shows a small rise in sales next year.

entries.definitionEn: A rapid increase in the number or amount of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدياد سريع في العدد أو الكمية
entries.example: The proliferation of small shops changed the high street.

entries.definitionEn: Producing a large amount of work, results, or offspring.
entries.arabicMeaning: غزير الإنتاج في العمل أو النتائج أو الذرية
entries.example: She is a prolific writer of short stories.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that produces a large amount of work or results.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغزارة في الإنتاج أو النتائج
entries.example: He painted prolifically during those two summers.

entries.definitionEn: To make something last longer than it otherwise would.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطيل أمد شيء أكثر مما كان ليكون
entries.example: They did not want to prolong the meeting without a decision.

entries.definitionEn: A formal dance for students at the end of a school year, especially in the United States.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفلة راقصة رسمية لطلاب المدرسة في ختام العام، ولا سيما في الولايات المتحدة
entries.example: She bought a new dress for the school prom.

entries.definitionEn: A wide path for walking, especially beside the sea. Also a slow, leisurely walk in a public place.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممشى فسيح للنزهة ولا سيما على البحر؛ أو تمشٍّ هادئ في موضع عام
entries.example: We walked the promenade from the pier to the café.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being well known, important, or easily noticed.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهرة ومكانة ظاهرة يسهل معها أن يُلتفت إلى صاحبها
entries.example: The discovery brought her to prominence in her field.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to see or well known; standing out from others.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارز أو مشهور؛ واضح بين غيره
entries.example: She is a prominent member of the local business group.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that you will definitely do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعد بأنك ستفعل شيئاً دون شك
entries.example: He kept his promise and arrived before lunch.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you will definitely do something. Also, to show signs that something good is likely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعد بأن يفعل شيئاً حتماً؛ وقد يعني أنه يبشّر بخير
entries.example: I promise I will send the documents today.

entries.definitionEn: Suitable or ready to be raised to a higher job, rank, or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: قابل للترقية إلى منصب أو رتبة أعلى
entries.example: After a strong year, she was clearly promotable to senior editor.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a more important job. Also, to support or advertise something so that it becomes more successful.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرقّي شخصاً إلى وظيفة أهم، أو يروّج لشيء ويدعمه
entries.example: The firm will promote him to manager in June.

entries.definitionEn: A move to a more important job. Also, activity that advertises a product or idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترقية وظيفية؛ أو نشاط للترويج لمنتج أو فكرة
entries.example: She received a promotion after three successful projects.

entries.definitionEn: Done without delay; arriving or acting at the right time.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوري ومن دون تأخير؛ يأتي أو يتصرف في الوقت المناسب
entries.example: We are grateful for your prompt reply.

entries.definitionEn: A word, sign, or message that reminds you what to say or do, including a cue on a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميح أو إشارة تذكّرك بما تقول أو تفعل، ومنها رسالة على الحاسوب
entries.example: The actor missed his line and waited for a prompt.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone to do or say something, or to remind them of the next words.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفع شخصاً إلى فعل أو قول شيء، أو يذكّره بما يلي
entries.example: The news prompted him to call his parents at once.

entries.definitionEn: Without delay; at the agreed or expected time.
entries.arabicMeaning: على الفور أو في الوقت المتفق عليه
entries.example: She arrived promptly at nine.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to suffer from something or to do something, often something unwelcome. Also lying face downwards.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميّال إلى أمر، غالباً غير مرغوب؛ وأيضاً مستلقٍ على وجهه
entries.example: The old roof is prone to leaks in heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: A word such as she, they, or it that is used instead of a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يُستخدم بدل الاسم مثل هي وهم وهو
entries.example: In this sentence they is a pronoun that refers to the students.

entries.definitionEn: To make the sound of a word or letter.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينطق كلمة أو حرفاً
entries.example: How do you pronounce this name?

entries.definitionEn: The way a word or language is spoken.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة نطق كلمة أو لغة
entries.example: Her pronunciation of English is very clear.

entries.definitionEn: Facts or information that show something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل يبيّن أن شيئاً صحيح
entries.example: The photo was proof that they had been there.

entries.definitionEn: An object used on stage in a play. Also a stick or support that holds something up.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة من أدوات المسرح؛ وأيضاً دعامة تُبقي شيئاً قائماً
entries.example: The table on stage was only a wooden prop.

entries.definitionEn: To support something so that it stays in position, often by leaning it against something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسند شيئاً ليبقيه في موضعه، غالباً بإمالته على شيء
entries.example: She propped the door open with a chair.

entries.definitionEn: Right or correct for a particular situation; real or suitable.
entries.arabicMeaning: مناسب وصحيح في ذلك الموقف؛ حقيقي أو لائق
entries.example: You need proper shoes for a long walk.

entries.definitionEn: In the right or correct way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على النحو الصحيح
entries.example: Please wash the glasses properly.

entries.definitionEn: A building or land that someone owns. Also a quality that something has.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقار من مبانٍ أو أرض يملكها شخص؛ وأيضاً خاصية في شيء
entries.example: They bought a small property near the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A person believed to speak for God or to show what will happen in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبي يُعتقد أنه يتكلم باسم الله أو يكشف ما سيأتي
entries.example: The book describes a prophet who warned the city of drought.

entries.definitionEn: Describing or showing what will happen in the future, like a prophet.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبوي أو كاشف عمّا سيحدث في المستقبل
entries.example: His warning later seemed prophetic.

entries.definitionEn: A person who supports an idea, plan, or cause and argues for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤيد لفكرة أو خطة أو قضية يدافع عنها
entries.example: She is a well-known proponent of cleaner public transport.

entries.definitionEn: The amount or share of something compared with the whole, or how parts relate in size.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسبة أو حصة من الكل، أو تناسب أجزاء الشيء في الحجم
entries.example: A large proportion of the class passed the exam.

entries.definitionEn: Corresponding in size, amount, or degree to something else; in a constant ratio.
entries.arabicMeaning: متناسب في الحجم أو المقدار أو الدرجة مع شيء آخر
entries.example: The tax is proportional to income.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that matches the size, amount, or degree of something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو متناسب مع الحجم أو المقدار أو الدرجة
entries.example: Costs rose, but wages did not increase proportionally.

entries.definitionEn: A plan or idea that is offered for people to consider. Also an offer of marriage.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتراح يُعرض للنظر؛ وأيضاً عرض زواج
entries.example: The committee discussed her proposal for a shorter working week.

entries.definitionEn: To suggest a plan or idea. Also to ask someone to marry you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقترح خطة أو فكرة؛ وأيضاً يطلب الزواج
entries.example: I propose that we meet on Thursday morning.

entries.definitionEn: Suggested as a plan but not yet accepted or begun.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقترح بوصفه خطة ولم يُقبل أو يُبدأ بعد
entries.example: The proposed route would cut through the park.

entries.definitionEn: An idea, offer, or statement put forward for consideration, including one that can be judged true or false.
entries.arabicMeaning: طرح أو عرض أو قضية تُقدَّم للنظر، ومنها ما يُحكم عليه بالصدق أو الكذب
entries.example: The merger was a risky commercial proposition.

entries.definitionEn: Owned and controlled by a particular company or person, and not freely available to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملوك لجهة معيّنة وغير متاح للجميع
entries.example: The software uses a proprietary file format.

entries.definitionEn: Behaving as if you own a person, place, or thing, often in a possessive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصرف تصرف المالك، غالباً على نحو تملكي
entries.example: He placed a proprietorial hand on the back of her chair.

entries.definitionEn: To forbid something officially, often by law.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّم شيئاً تحريماً رسمياً، غالباً بقوة القانون
entries.example: The new rules proscribe smoking in all indoor public spaces.

entries.definitionEn: The official act of forbidding something, or the state of being forbidden.
entries.arabicMeaning: حظر رسمي لشيء أو حالة كونه محظوراً
entries.example: The proscription of the group surprised many lawyers.

entries.definitionEn: Ordinary written or spoken language, not poetry.
entries.arabicMeaning: النثر: الكلام العادي المكتوب أو المنطوق لا الشعر
entries.example: The novel is written in clear, simple prose.

entries.definitionEn: To take legal action against someone in a court of law for a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقاضي شخصاً أمام المحكمة بتهمة جريمة
entries.example: The state decided to prosecute the driver for dangerous speeding.

entries.definitionEn: The possibility that something will happen, often in the future. Also a wide view.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتمال حدوث شيء في المستقبل؛ وأيضاً مشهد واسع
entries.example: The prospect of a long delay made everyone restless.

entries.definitionEn: Expected or likely to happen or become something in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتقب أو مرجّح أن يحدث أو يصير كذلك في المستقبل
entries.example: They met a prospective buyer for the apartment.

entries.definitionEn: To become successful and rich, or to grow in a healthy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزدهر وينجح مادياً، أو ينمو على نحو صحي
entries.example: Small shops can prosper if the street stays busy.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being successful and having enough money.
entries.arabicMeaning: رخاء ونجاح مع توفّر المال
entries.example: The city enjoyed a period of prosperity after the new port opened.

entries.definitionEn: Rich and successful.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزدهر وغني وناجح
entries.example: They lived in a prosperous neighbourhood near the river.

entries.definitionEn: Lying flat with the face down, especially from exhaustion, illness, or respect. Also completely overcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: منبطح على وجهه من إرهاق أو مرض أو احترام؛ وأيضاً مغلوب تماماً
entries.example: He lay prostrate on the floor after the climb.

entries.definitionEn: To lie face down, often in worship or exhaustion. Also to make someone extremely weak.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينبطح على وجهه تعبّداً أو إعياءً؛ وأيضاً يُضعف شخصاً جداً
entries.example: The fever prostrated her for several days.

entries.definitionEn: The main character in a story, play, or film. Also a leading figure in a real event.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشخصية الرئيسية في قصة أو مسرحية أو فيلم؛ وأيضاً فاعل أساسي في حدث
entries.example: The protagonist must choose between duty and friendship.

entries.definitionEn: To keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحمي شخصاً أو شيئاً من الأذى أو التلف أو الضياع
entries.example: A fence was built to protect the garden from the wind.

entries.definitionEn: The act of keeping someone or something safe, or something that does this.
entries.arabicMeaning: حماية شخص أو شيء، أو ما يوفّر هذه الحماية
entries.example: Wear a hat for protection from the sun.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to keep someone or something safe. Also wanting to look after someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقٍ يهدف إلى السلامة؛ وأيضاً حريص على رعاية شخص
entries.example: She gave him a protective look when the questions became personal.

entries.definitionEn: A strong public expression of disagreement, often by a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتجاج علني قوي على أمر، غالباً من جماعة
entries.example: A large protest was held outside the city hall.

entries.definitionEn: To say or show publicly that you disagree with something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتج علناً على شيء ويعبّر عن رفضه
entries.example: Workers gathered to protest the sudden pay cut.

entries.definitionEn: To stick out from a surface or from a surrounding area.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبرز من سطح أو من محيطه
entries.example: A nail protruded from the old floorboard.

entries.definitionEn: Something that sticks out, or the fact of sticking out.
entries.arabicMeaning: نتوء بارز أو حالة البروز
entries.example: The scan showed a small protrusion on the bone.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling pleased because of something you or someone close to you has done. Also having too high an opinion of yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: فخور بما فعلتَ أو فعله قريب منك؛ وقد يعني المتكبّر
entries.example: Her parents were proud of her exam results.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are pleased and satisfied with someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بفخر واعتزاز
entries.example: He proudly showed us the certificate on the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To show that something is true by giving facts or evidence. Also to turn out to be a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُثبت صحة شيء بالأدلة؛ وأيضاً يتبيّن أنه على حال معيّنة
entries.example: The tests will prove whether the theory is right.

entries.definitionEn: Shown to be true, effective, or reliable by evidence or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُثبت بالدليل أو بالتجربة أنه صحيح أو ناجع أو موثوق
entries.example: It is a proven method for reducing waste.

entries.definitionEn: A short, well-known sentence that gives advice or says something that is usually true.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثل قصير معروف يحمل نصحاً أو حقيقة شائعة
entries.example: The teacher explained the proverb about looking before you leap.

entries.definitionEn: Well known, as if from a proverb; referred to so often that it has become a saying.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذائع كالمثل؛ يُذكر كثيراً حتى صار مضرب مثل
entries.example: He arrived with the proverbial bad timing.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone something that they need.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوفّر لشخص ما يحتاجه
entries.example: The hotel will provide towels and soap.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something will happen only if another thing happens first; if, on the condition that.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة شرط بمعنى إذا، على أن يتحقق أمر آخر أولاً
entries.example: You may leave early provided you finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: A large area that is part of a country and has its own local government.
entries.arabicMeaning: إقليم أو محافظة واسعة لها إدارة محلية
entries.example: They spent the summer in a quiet province in the north.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a province rather than the capital. Also limited in outlook, as if unused to city life or wider culture.
entries.arabicMeaning: إقليمي لا عاصمي؛ وأيضاً ضيّق الأفق كمن قلّ احتكاكه بالمدينة أو بالثقافة الأوسع
entries.example: His tastes struck some colleagues as rather provincial.

entries.definitionEn: The act of supplying something needed. Also a condition in a legal document.
entries.arabicMeaning: توفير ما يُحتاج إليه؛ وأيضاً بند في وثيقة قانونية
entries.example: The contract includes a provision for extra payments.

entries.definitionEn: Supplies of food and drink, especially for a journey or a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤن من طعام وشراب، ولا سيما لسفر أو مدة معيّنة
entries.example: They packed enough provisions for a week in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: Action or speech that is intended to make someone angry or to cause a reaction.
entries.arabicMeaning: استفزاز بالقول أو الفعل لإغضاب شخص أو لاستثارة رد
entries.example: He walked away rather than respond to the provocation.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to make people angry, interested, or sexually aware, often on purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: استفزازي يُقصد به إغضاب الناس أو إثارة اهتمامهم أو حسّهم الجنسي
entries.example: She asked a provocative question that no one wanted to answer.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is meant to provoke anger, interest, or sexual attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو استفزازي يثير الغضب أو الاهتمام أو الانتباه الجنسي
entries.example: He smiled provocatively and waited for a reply.

entries.definitionEn: To cause a strong reaction, especially anger, or to make something happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستفز فيثير غضباً أو رد فعل قوي، أو يتسبب في حدوث شيء
entries.example: The article provoked a fierce debate in the office.

entries.definitionEn: To move quietly and carefully, often while hunting or looking for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسلل بهدوء وحذر، غالباً وهو يبحث أو يصيد
entries.example: A cat prowled along the garden wall at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: Situated nearer to the centre of the body or to the point where a limb is attached.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدنى إلى مركز الجسم أو إلى موضع اتصال الطرف
entries.example: The injury was on the proximal end of the bone.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being near in space or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرب في المكان أو الزمان
entries.example: The hotel's proximity to the station made it a convenient choice.

entries.definitionEn: An excessive or unhealthy interest in sexual matters.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضول مفرط أو غير صحي في الأمور الجنسية
entries.example: The article was accused of prurience rather than serious reporting.

entries.definitionEn: Having or showing an excessive or unhealthy interest in sexual matters.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينطوي على فضول جنسي مفرط أو غير صحي
entries.example: The magazine took a prurient interest in the actor's private life.

entries.definitionEn: The human mind, especially in relation to deep feelings and thoughts.
entries.arabicMeaning: النفس البشرية ولا سيما المشاعر والأفكار العميقة
entries.example: The novel explores the psyche of a lonely traveller.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the medical study and treatment of mental illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالطب النفسي وعلاج الاضطرابات العقلية
entries.example: She works on a psychiatric ward in the city hospital.

entries.definitionEn: A doctor who treats mental illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب نفسي يعالج الاضطرابات العقلية
entries.example: The psychiatrist discussed treatment options with the family.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the mind and the way it works, or to mental health.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالعقل وطريقة عمله أو بالصحة النفسية
entries.example: The accident had a psychological effect on the driver.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the mind or mental state.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية النفسية أو العقلية
entries.example: The team was psychologically ready for the final.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies the mind and how people think and behave.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخصائي علم النفس يدرس العقل والسلوك
entries.example: A psychologist talked to the class about memory and learning.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour.
entries.arabicMeaning: علم النفس: الدراسة العلمية للعقل والسلوك
entries.example: She is studying psychology at university.

entries.definitionEn: A building where people go to drink alcohol and sometimes eat, especially in Britain and Ireland.
entries.arabicMeaning: حانة يرتادها الناس للشرب وأحياناً للطعام، ولا سيما في بريطانيا وإيرلندا
entries.example: They met at the pub after work.

entries.definitionEn: Open to or involving ordinary people, not private. Also known by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: عام متاح للناس لا خاص؛ وأيضاً معروف على نطاق واسع
entries.example: The park is a public space, so anyone can walk there.

entries.definitionEn: Ordinary people in general; people as a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجمهور عامةً؛ الناس كجماعة
entries.example: The museum is open to the public every afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Buses, trains, and other vehicles that anyone can pay to use.
entries.arabicMeaning: النقل العام من حافلات وقطارات وغيرها مما يدفع أجره أي راكب
entries.example: I take public transport to work to avoid the traffic.

entries.definitionEn: The act of printing and offering a book, magazine, or article. Also a book or magazine that is published.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشر كتاب أو مجلة أو مقال؛ وأيضاً المطبوعة نفسها
entries.example: The publication of her second novel is planned for spring.

entries.definitionEn: Attention from newspapers, television, or the internet, or the business of getting that attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: اهتمام وسائل الإعلام، أو عمل اجتذاب هذا الاهتمام
entries.example: The film received a great deal of publicity before it opened.

entries.definitionEn: To make information widely known, especially through media or advertising.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلن أمراً على نطاق واسع، ولا سيما عبر الإعلام أو الإعلان
entries.example: The charity will publicize the campaign on local radio.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; not in private.
entries.arabicMeaning: علناً بحيث يراه الناس أو يسمعونه لا في السر
entries.example: She publicly thanked the volunteers after the event.

entries.definitionEn: To print a book, newspaper, or article and make it available to people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشر كتاباً أو صحيفة أو مقالاً ويجعله متاحاً
entries.example: They will publish the results next month.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that prepares and sells books, magazines, or newspapers.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناشر يعدّ الكتب أو المجلات أو الصحف ويبيعها
entries.example: The publisher asked for a shorter version of the chapter.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal, especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلوى تُؤكل في آخر الوجبة، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية البريطانية
entries.example: Would you like pudding after dinner?

entries.definitionEn: To hold something and move it towards you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسحب شيئاً نحوه
entries.example: Pull the door to open it.

entries.definitionEn: A warm piece of clothing that you pull over your head, usually knitted.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنزة دافئة تُلبس من الرأس، غالباً محاكة
entries.example: He put on a wool pullover before going outside.

entries.definitionEn: The regular beat of blood through the body, felt at the wrist or neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبض الدم المنتظم يُحسّ في المعصم أو العنق
entries.example: The nurse checked his pulse and wrote down the number.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that moves liquid or gas from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضخة تنقل سائلاً أو غازاً من موضع إلى آخر
entries.example: The pump in the basement stopped working overnight.

entries.definitionEn: A large, round, orange fruit with thick skin, often cooked or used as a decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرع كبير مستدير برتقالي القشرة يُطبخ أو يُستخدم للزينة
entries.example: She made soup from a pumpkin grown in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: A hard hit with a closed hand. Also a drink made from fruit juice mixed with other liquids.
entries.arabicMeaning: لكمة بقبضة اليد؛ وأيضاً شراب من عصير الفاكهة مخلوطاً بسوائل أخرى
entries.example: One punch was enough to end the short fight.

entries.definitionEn: To hit someone or something hard with a closed hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلكم شخصاً أو شيئاً بقبضة اليد
entries.example: He punched the bag until his arms were tired.

entries.definitionEn: Marks such as commas, full stops, and question marks used in writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامات الترقيم كالفصلة والنقطة وعلامة الاستفهام
entries.example: Check your punctuation before you send the email.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone suffer because they have done something wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعاقب شخصاً لأنه أخطأ
entries.example: The school will not punish students for an honest mistake.

entries.definitionEn: Something unpleasant done to a person because they have done something wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقوبة تُوقع على من أخطأ
entries.example: The punishment for late returns is a small fine.

entries.definitionEn: Intended as punishment, often harsh or meant to hurt financially.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقابي، وغالباً قاسٍ أو يراد به الإضرار المادي
entries.example: The court imposed punitive damages on the company.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is intended as punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو عقابي مقصود
entries.example: Fees were raised punitively after repeated delays.

entries.definitionEn: A young dog.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرو: كلب صغير السن
entries.example: The puppy slept in a basket by the door.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you buy, or the act of buying it. More formal than buy.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية شراء أو الشيء المشترى، بصيغة أكثر رسمية من buy
entries.example: Keep the receipt for every large purchase.

entries.definitionEn: To buy something, especially in a formal or business context.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشتري شيئاً، ولا سيما في سياق رسمي أو تجاري
entries.example: The museum purchased three paintings last year.

entries.definitionEn: Not mixed with anything else; clean. Also complete, as in pure luck.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقي غير مخلوط؛ نظيف؛ وقد يعني تاماً كما في الحظ المحض
entries.example: The water from the spring was pure and cold.

entries.definitionEn: To make something clean by removing dirty or harmful substances.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقّي شيئاً بإزالة ما فيه من أوساخ أو مواد ضارة
entries.example: The filter will purify the drinking water.

entries.definitionEn: Very strict about moral behaviour, especially about pleasure and sex.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزمت تزمّتاً شديداً في الأخلاق، ولا سيما في اللذة والجنس
entries.example: His puritanical views made ordinary conversation awkward.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being pure, not mixed or spoiled. Also moral innocence.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقاء من الشوائب؛ وأيضاً براءة أخلاقية
entries.example: They tested the purity of the silver before the sale.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour that is a mix of red and blue.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرجواني، بين الأحمر والأزرق
entries.example: She wore a purple scarf to the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The colour that is a mix of red and blue.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأرجواني بين الأحمر والأزرق
entries.example: Purple is her favourite colour.

entries.definitionEn: The reason why you do something or why something exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغرض أو السبب الذي من أجله يُفعل الشيء أو يوجد
entries.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Having a clear aim and showing determination.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادف وعازم على غاية واضحة
entries.example: She walked across the room in a purposeful way.

entries.definitionEn: A small bag for carrying money. In American English, also a woman's handbag.
entries.arabicMeaning: محفظة صغيرة للنقود؛ وفي الأمريكية أيضاً حقيبة يد للمرأة
entries.example: She took a coin from her purse and paid for the ticket.

entries.definitionEn: To follow someone or something in order to catch them. Also to try to achieve a goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلاحق ليمسك؛ وأيضاً يسعى إلى تحقيق هدف
entries.example: He decided to pursue a career in teaching.

entries.definitionEn: The act of following in order to catch. Also an activity that you spend time on.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطاردة للإمساك؛ وأيضاً نشاط يُصرف فيه الوقت
entries.example: In pursuit of the thief, they ran down the alley.

entries.definitionEn: An act of using force to move something away. Also a determined effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفعة لتحريك شيء بعيداً؛ وأيضاً جهد حازم
entries.example: Give the door a gentle push if it sticks.

entries.definitionEn: To use your hands to move something away from you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفع شيئاً بيديه بعيداً عنه
entries.example: Please push the chair under the table.

entries.definitionEn: To move something to a particular place or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً في موضع معيّن
entries.example: Put the keys on the table.

entries.definitionEn: A game or problem that you solve by thinking carefully. Also something that is hard to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: لغز يُحل بالتفكير؛ وأيضاً أمر يصعب فهمه
entries.example: She finished the crossword puzzle on the train.

entries.definitionEn: To confuse someone because something is hard to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيّر شخصاً لأن الأمر صعب الفهم
entries.example: His sudden silence puzzled the whole team.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to understand something; confused.
entries.arabicMeaning: محتار لا يفهم الأمر
entries.example: She looked puzzled when she read the instructions.

entries.definitionEn: A pile of wood on which a dead body is burned as a funeral rite.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرقة من الحطب تُحرق عليها جثة في طقس جنائزي
entries.example: They built a pyre on the riverbank at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: An earthquake; a sudden shaking of the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: زلزال: اهتزاز مفاجئ للأرض
entries.example: People ran outside when the quake began.

entries.definitionEn: An official record of passing an exam or completing training. Also a limit on a statement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤهل رسمي بعد امتحان أو تدريب؛ وأيضاً قيد على كلام
entries.example: You need a teaching qualification for this job.

entries.definitionEn: Having passed the exams or training needed for a job. Also limited, not complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤهل بما يلزم من امتحانات أو تدريب؛ وأيضاً مقيَّد غير تام
entries.example: She is a fully qualified nurse.

entries.definitionEn: To pass the tests or reach the standard needed for something. Also to add a limit to what you say.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأهل باجتياز اختبار أو بلوغ مستوى؛ وأيضاً يقيّد كلامه
entries.example: He hopes to qualify as an engineer next year.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the quality or nature of something rather than to numbers or amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوعي يتعلق بطبيعة الشيء لا بأرقامه أو كمياته
entries.example: The study used qualitative interviews rather than surveys.

entries.definitionEn: Of a high standard.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو جودة عالية
entries.example: They only buy quality tools that last.

entries.definitionEn: How good or bad something is. Also a typical feature of a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى جودة الشيء أو سوئه؛ وأيضاً سمة مميّزة
entries.example: The quality of the cloth is excellent.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of doubt or unease, especially about whether something is right.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاجس أو تردد، ولا سيما في سلامة الأمر أخلاقياً
entries.example: A sudden qualm made her check the lock again.

entries.definitionEn: To measure or express something as a number or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر شيئاً رقماً أو كمية
entries.example: It is hard to quantify the benefits of the new policy.

entries.definitionEn: An amount or number of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمية أو عدد من شيء
entries.example: We need a large quantity of paper for the copies.

entries.definitionEn: A period when a person, animal, or goods must stay apart from others to stop disease from spreading.
entries.arabicMeaning: حجر صحي يُعزل فيه شخص أو حيوان أو بضاعة لمنع انتشار المرض
entries.example: The dog spent two weeks in quarantine after the flight.

entries.definitionEn: An angry argument, especially between people who know each other.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجار غاضب، ولا سيما بين من يعرف بعضهم بعضاً
entries.example: They had a quarrel about whose turn it was to cook.

entries.definitionEn: To have an angry argument.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتشاجر جدالاً غاضباً
entries.example: The sisters quarrelled, then made up before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Often getting into arguments; ready to quarrel.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير الخصام ميّال إلى الشجار
entries.example: He became quarrelsome when he was tired.

entries.definitionEn: A place where stone, sand, or slate is dug from the ground. Also an animal or person being hunted.
entries.arabicMeaning: محجر يُستخرج منه الحجر أو الرمل أو الأردواز؛ وأيضاً فريسة يُطارد
entries.example: The old quarry is now filled with rainwater.

entries.definitionEn: One of four equal parts of something. Also fifteen minutes of an hour.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربع الشيء؛ وأيضاً خمس عشرة دقيقة من الساعة
entries.example: A quarter of the cake was left on the plate.

entries.definitionEn: A woman who rules a country, or the wife of a king.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملكة تحكم بلداً، أو زوجة الملك
entries.example: The queen opened the new hospital last year.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to people whose sexual orientation or gender identity is not heterosexual or cisgender. In older use, strange or unusual.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بمن لا تنتمي توجهاتهم الجنسية أو هوياتهم الجندرية إلى النمط المغاير التقليدي؛ وفي الاستعمال الأقدم: غريب أو غير معتاد
entries.example: The library added a shelf of queer fiction this year.

entries.definitionEn: A question, especially one that asks for information or expresses doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: استفسار يطلب معلومة أو يعبّر عن شك
entries.example: If you have a query, please write to the office.

entries.definitionEn: To ask a question about something, especially because you doubt it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستفسر عن شيء، ولا سيما لأنه يشك فيه
entries.example: Several staff queried the figures in the report.

entries.definitionEn: A long search for something that is difficult to find, often with a serious purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسعى طويل للعثور على أمر عسير، غالباً لغاية جدية
entries.example: The book follows a quest for a lost manuscript.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark ? used at the end of a question.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة الاستفهام في آخر السؤال
entries.example: Do not forget the question mark at the end.

entries.definitionEn: Something you ask in order to get information.
entries.arabicMeaning: سؤال تطلب به معلومة
entries.example: Can I ask a question about the homework?

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone questions, especially in an official way. Also to express doubt about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستجوب بسؤال رسمي؛ وأيضاً يشكك في أمر
entries.example: Police questioned the witnesses after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A written list of questions that people answer, often for a survey.
entries.arabicMeaning: استبيان مكتوب يجيب عنه الناس، غالباً لدراسة
entries.example: Please complete the questionnaire and return it by Friday.

entries.definitionEn: A line of people waiting for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: صف من الناس ينتظرون
entries.example: There was a long queue at the ticket office.

entries.definitionEn: To wait in a line of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقف منتظراً في صف
entries.example: We queued for twenty minutes to buy coffee.

entries.definitionEn: Doing something or happening in a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع يحدث أو يُنجز في وقت قصير
entries.example: That was a quick decision.

entries.definitionEn: In a short time; at a fast speed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسرعة وفي وقت قصير
entries.example: Please come quickly; the taxi is waiting.

entries.definitionEn: Making little noise; calm and not busy.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ قليل الضجيج؛ ساكن غير مزدحم
entries.example: Please be quiet in the library.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being calm and with little noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: الهدوء وقلة الضجيج
entries.example: She needed a few hours of quiet to finish the essay.

entries.definitionEn: With little noise; without attracting attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء ومن غير ضجيج أو لفت نظر
entries.example: He closed the door quietly and sat down.

entries.definitionEn: A short, clever, and often funny remark.
entries.arabicMeaning: نكتة قصيرة ذكية
entries.example: His quip about the delay made the room laugh.

entries.definitionEn: To say something short, clever, and often funny.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقول نكتة قصيرة ذكية
entries.example: She could not help but quip about the endless delay.

entries.definitionEn: A strange or unusual habit or feature that is typical of a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمة غريبة أو عادة مميّزة في شخص أو شيء
entries.example: One quirk of the machine is that it hums before it starts.

entries.definitionEn: To twist or curve suddenly, especially of the mouth or an eyebrow.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوي الفم أو الحاجب فجأة
entries.example: He quirked an eyebrow at the unlikely excuse.

entries.definitionEn: Unusual in an interesting or attractive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب على نحو طريف جذاب
entries.example: The café has a quirky mix of old furniture.

entries.definitionEn: Unusual or eccentric style treated as a thing in itself; an informal noun use of the adjective.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغرابة الطريفة بوصفها شيئاً قائماً؛ استخدام اسمي لصفة quirky
entries.example: Shoppers come here for the quirky, not for the ordinary stock.

entries.definitionEn: Free of something; no longer burdened by it. Formal or old-fashioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالٍ من أمر ومتحرر منه؛ استعمال رسمي أو قديم
entries.example: She was glad to be quit of the old contract.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a job or to stop doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يترك وظيفة أو يقلع عن فعل شيء
entries.example: He decided to quit smoking in January.

entries.definitionEn: Fairly or rather; to some degree. In some sentences it means completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد ما أو نوعاً ما؛ وفي بعض الجمل يعني تماماً
entries.example: The room was quite cold in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A slight trembling movement. Also a case for carrying arrows.
entries.arabicMeaning: رعشة خفيفة؛ وأيضاً جعبة لحمل السهام
entries.example: A quiver of fear ran through her as the lights went out.

entries.definitionEn: To shake with a slight, rapid movement, often from cold, fear, or emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتجف ارتجافاً خفيفاً سريعاً من برد أو خوف أو انفعال
entries.example: His voice quivered when he read the last line.

entries.definitionEn: A short test or a game in which people answer questions.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختبار قصير أو لعبة أسئلة
entries.example: We have a vocabulary quiz on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: Worth repeating because it is well expressed or memorable.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بأن يُقتبس لحسن صياغته أو لسهولة تذكّره
entries.example: The speech was full of quotable lines.

entries.definitionEn: Words copied from a book, speech, or person. Also a statement of how much a job will cost.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتباس من كلام أو كتاب؛ وأيضاً عرض بسعر عمل
entries.example: She began her essay with a quotation from the novel.

entries.definitionEn: A quotation; words taken from someone else. Also an estimated price.
entries.arabicMeaning: اقتباس من كلام الغير؛ وأيضاً سعر تقديري
entries.example: His favourite quote is on the first page of the book.

entries.definitionEn: To repeat the exact words that someone else has said or written.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقتبس كلام شخص بحرفه
entries.example: You should quote the author if you use her sentence.

entries.definitionEn: A small animal with long ears that lives in holes in the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرنب صغير طويل الأذنين يعيش في جحور
entries.example: The children watched a rabbit in the field.

entries.definitionEn: A competition to see who is fastest. Also a group of people thought of as sharing ancestry.
entries.arabicMeaning: سباق لمعرفة الأسرع؛ وأيضاً جماعة تُعدّ ذات أصل مشترك
entries.example: She won the race by a few seconds.

entries.definitionEn: To take part in a race, or to move very fast.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسابق أو يتحرك بسرعة كبيرة
entries.example: We had to race to catch the last bus.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a person's race or to relations between racial groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالعرق أو بالعلاقات بين الجماعات العرقية
entries.example: The school has a policy against racial discrimination.

entries.definitionEn: Unfair treatment of people, or the belief that some racial groups are better than others.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنصرية: معاملة غير عادلة أو اعتقاد بتفوق جماعة عرقية
entries.example: The report examined racism in hiring practices.

entries.definitionEn: A person who believes that some racial groups are better than others, or who treats people unfairly because of race.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص عنصري يعتقد بتفوق عرقي أو يعامل الناس معاملة غير عادلة بسبب العرق
entries.example: The commentator was widely described as a racist after the remarks.

entries.definitionEn: A frame or shelf used for holding things.
entries.arabicMeaning: رف أو حامل لحفظ الأشياء
entries.example: Hang your coat on the rack by the door.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of sports equipment with a handle and strings, used in tennis or similar games.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضرب له مقبض وخيوط يُستخدم في التنس ونحوه
entries.example: She bought a new tennis racket last week.

entries.definitionEn: A system that uses radio waves to find the position of objects such as planes or ships.
entries.arabicMeaning: رادار يستخدم موجات الراديو لتحديد مواقع أجسام كالطائرات والسفن
entries.example: The ship appeared on the radar long before it was visible.

entries.definitionEn: To send out light, heat, or a feeling in all directions.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشعّ ضوءاً أو حرارة أو شعوراً في كل اتجاه
entries.example: The stove radiated a gentle heat across the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: Energy that travels as waves or particles, such as heat, light, or rays from radioactive material.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشعاع: طاقة تنتقل موجات أو جسيمات كالحرارة والضوء وأشعة المواد المشعة
entries.example: Doctors use a low level of radiation in some scans.

entries.definitionEn: A metal device, usually on a wall, that heats a room. Also the part of a car that cools the engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشعّ حراري على الجدار لتدفئة الغرفة؛ وأيضاً مبرّد محرك السيارة
entries.example: The radiator in the bedroom was cold all morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person who wants extreme political or social change.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص راديكالي يريد تغييراً سياسياً أو اجتماعياً جذرياً
entries.example: As a young radical he argued for a complete rewrite of the rules.

entries.definitionEn: In a very complete or extreme way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو جذري تام
entries.example: The new software radically changed how we file reports.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment that receives sound programmes sent through the air, or the programmes themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذياع يستقبل البرامج الصوتية، أو البرامج نفسها
entries.example: I listen to the radio in the car.

entries.definitionEn: A radioactive chemical element once widely used in medicine and industry.
entries.arabicMeaning: الراديوم: عنصر كيميائي مشع استُخدم كثيراً في الطب والصناعة
entries.example: Early scientists studied radium without knowing all the risks.

entries.definitionEn: One of the sloping beams that support a roof.
entries.arabicMeaning: رافدة: خشبة مائلة تسند السقف
entries.example: A bird had nested between the rafters in the barn.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of old cloth, often used for cleaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: خرقة من قماش قديم تُستخدم غالباً للتنظيف
entries.example: He wiped the table with a damp rag.

entries.definitionEn: Very strong anger that is hard to control.
entries.arabicMeaning: غضب شديد يصعب ضبطه
entries.example: She was shaking with rage after the unfair decision.

entries.definitionEn: The system of trains; also a long metal bar that you can hold or that trains run on.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكك الحديد؛ وأيضاً قضيب معدني للتمسك أو تسير عليه القطارات
entries.example: We decided to travel by rail to save time.

entries.definitionEn: The system of trains and tracks, especially in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكة الحديد، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية الأمريكية
entries.example: The railroad connected the two towns in the 1880s.

entries.definitionEn: The system of trains and tracks, especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكة الحديد، ولا سيما في الإنكليزية البريطانية
entries.example: The railway station is a ten-minute walk from here.

entries.definitionEn: Water that falls from clouds in drops.
entries.arabicMeaning: مطر يسقط من السحب قطرات
entries.example: The rain started just as we left the house.

entries.definitionEn: When water falls from the clouds in drops.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمطر: يسقط الماء من السحب قطرات
entries.example: It will rain this afternoon, so take a coat.

entries.definitionEn: A curve of colours that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوس قزح: قوس ألوان يظهر حين تسطع الشمس في المطر
entries.example: A rainbow appeared over the valley after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: A coat that keeps you dry in the rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: معطف مطر يقي من البلل
entries.example: She hung her wet raincoat in the hall.

entries.definitionEn: The amount of rain that falls in a place during a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمية المطر التي تسقط في مكان خلال مدة
entries.example: Annual rainfall is higher in the mountains than on the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A thick forest in a hot area with a lot of rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: غابة مطيرة كثيفة في منطقة حارة كثيرة المطر
entries.example: Many rare birds live in the rainforest.

entries.definitionEn: A storm with heavy rain, often with wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاصفة مطرية شديدة، غالباً مع ريح
entries.example: The rainstorm flooded the lower streets by evening.

entries.definitionEn: With a lot of rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممطر؛ فيه مطر كثير
entries.example: It was a rainy afternoon, so we stayed indoors.

entries.definitionEn: To lift something to a higher position. Also to increase an amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع شيئاً إلى موضع أعلى؛ أو يزيد مقداراً
entries.example: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.

entries.definitionEn: A large public meeting to support a person or cause. Also a sudden recovery after a fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجمّع شعبي كبير لتأييد شخص أو قضية؛ وأيضاً انتعاش مفاجئ بعد هبوط
entries.example: Thousands of people came to the rally in the square.

entries.definitionEn: To come together in support of someone or something. Also to recover strength or value after a decline.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجتمع مع غيره تأييداً لأمر أو شخص؛ أو يستعيد القوة أو القيمة بعد تراجع
entries.example: The players always rally behind their injured captain.

entries.definitionEn: An adult male sheep. Also a machine or part that hits something with force.
entries.arabicMeaning: كبش بالغ؛ وأيضاً آلة أو جزء يصدم بقوة
entries.example: The ram stood on the hillside with the rest of the flock.

entries.definitionEn: A sloping surface that connects two levels, used instead of or beside steps.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحدر يربط بين مستويين، يُستخدم بدل الدرج أو بجانبه
entries.example: Wheelchair users took the ramp beside the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: A set of different things of the same general type. Also the space between a lowest and highest amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة متنوعة من الأشياء من نوع واحد؛ أو المدى بين أدنى قيمة وأعلاها
entries.example: The shop has a wide range of bags.

entries.definitionEn: To vary between two points or limits.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفاوت أو يتراوح بين حدّين
entries.example: Ticket prices range from ten to fifty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to look after a forest, park, or nature reserve.
entries.arabicMeaning: حارس غابة أو منتزه أو محمية طبيعية
entries.example: The ranger asked us not to feed the animals.

entries.definitionEn: A person's position in an organization, especially the army, navy, or police.
entries.arabicMeaning: رتبة الشخص في مؤسسة، وخصوصاً في الجيش أو الشرطة
entries.example: She was promoted to a higher rank last year.

entries.definitionEn: A type of music in which words are spoken rhythmically over a beat.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى الراب: كلام موقّع على إيقاع
entries.example: He listens to rap on his way to work.

entries.definitionEn: To perform rap music. Also to hit something quickly and lightly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤدّي موسيقى الراب؛ أو يطرق شيئاً طرقاً خفيفاً سريعاً
entries.example: She learned to rap when she was still at school.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of forcing a person to have sex against their will.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة الاغتصاب: إكراه شخص على الجنس دون رضاه
entries.example: The law treats rape as a serious crime.

entries.definitionEn: To force a person to have sex against their will.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغتصب شخصاً بإكراهه على الجنس دون رضاه
entries.example: The court heard evidence that he had raped the victim.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or moving very quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع جداً في الحدوث أو الحركة
entries.example: There was a rapid change in the weather.

entries.definitionEn: Very quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسرعة كبيرة
entries.example: The city grew rapidly over the last decade.

entries.definitionEn: A friendly relationship of understanding and trust.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألفة وانسجام مبنيان على الفهم والثقة
entries.example: She quickly built a rapport with the new team.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of intense joy or delight.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشوة غامرة من الفرح أو الطرب
entries.example: The audience listened in rapture as the orchestra played.

entries.definitionEn: Full of intense joy or enthusiasm.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفعم بنشوة الفرح أو الحماس الشديد
entries.example: The speech received rapturous applause.

entries.definitionEn: With intense joy or enthusiasm.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنشوة فرح أو حماس شديد
entries.example: The crowd cheered rapturously at the final note.

entries.definitionEn: Not happening or found very often. Also of meat that is cooked only a little.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادر قلّما يحدث أو يُوجد؛ وللحم: قليل النضج
entries.example: Snow is rare in this part of the country.

entries.definitionEn: Not often.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادراً
entries.example: She rarely eats out during the week.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being rare. Also a thing that is uncommon.
entries.arabicMeaning: الندرة؛ أو شيء نادر الوجود
entries.example: A quiet evening at home is a rarity for her.

entries.definitionEn: Done too quickly, without thinking about the results.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسرّع بلا تروٍّ في العواقب
entries.example: Quitting your job in anger would be a rash decision.

entries.definitionEn: A small, soft red fruit that grows on a bush.
entries.arabicMeaning: توت العُليق: ثمرة صغيرة حمراء طرية
entries.example: She added a fresh raspberry to the yogurt.

entries.definitionEn: An animal like a large mouse, often living near people and buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرذ: حيوان أكبر من الفأر، كثيراً ما يعيش قرب الناس والمباني
entries.example: A rat ran behind the bins.

entries.definitionEn: A measure of how fast something happens, or how much you pay, compared with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدّل يقيس سرعة أمر أو مقدار ما يُدفع بالنسبة إلى شيء آخر
entries.example: The interest rate on the loan is quite low.

entries.definitionEn: To judge how good or how strong something is.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقيّم جودة شيء أو قوته
entries.example: Guests are asked to rate the hotel after their stay.

entries.definitionEn: To a fairly large degree. Also used with would to say that you prefer one thing to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حدّ لا بأس به؛ وتُستعمل مع would للدلالة على التفضيل
entries.example: I would rather take the train than drive.

entries.definitionEn: A score that shows how good, popular, or suitable something is.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقييم رقمي يبيّن جودة شيء أو شعبيته أو ملاءمته
entries.example: The film has a high rating online.

entries.definitionEn: A fixed amount of food or supplies that you are allowed when there is not enough.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصة محدودة من طعام أو مؤن عند الشحّ
entries.example: Each family received a weekly ration of rice.

entries.definitionEn: Based on clear thinking rather than emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: عقلاني مبني على التفكير الواضح لا على الانفعال
entries.example: We need a rational plan, not a panic.

entries.definitionEn: A series of short, sharp knocking sounds. Also a baby's toy that makes that sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: قعقعة طرقات قصيرة حادة؛ أو لعبة طفل تُحدث هذا الصوت
entries.example: We heard a rattle in the engine.

entries.definitionEn: In a sexually crude or boldly suggestive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأسلوب فجّ أو إيحائي جريء
entries.example: The dancer moved raunchily across the stage.

entries.definitionEn: Sexually crude or boldly suggestive.
entries.arabicMeaning: فجّ أو جريء في الإيحاء الجنسي
entries.example: The comedian told a few raunchy jokes.

entries.definitionEn: Severe damage, often used in the plural for the lasting harm caused by war, time, or disaster.
entries.arabicMeaning: دمار شديد، وغالباً بصيغة الجمع لآثار الحرب أو الزمن أو الكارثة
entries.example: The photographs showed the ravages of the storm.

entries.definitionEn: To fill someone with intense delight. In older use, to seize a person by force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملأ شخصاً بنشوة شديدة؛ وفي استعمال أقدم: يختطف شخصاً عنوة
entries.example: The soprano's voice ravished the audience.

entries.definitionEn: Not cooked. Also in a natural state, not yet processed.
entries.arabicMeaning: نيء غير مطبوخ؛ أو على حالته الطبيعية بلا معالجة
entries.example: Do not eat raw chicken.

entries.definitionEn: A narrow line of light.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعاع ضوء ضيّق
entries.example: A ray of sunlight came through the curtain.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a sharp blade, used for shaving hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: موس ذو نصل حاد يُستعمل لحلق الشعر
entries.example: He bought a new razor.

entries.definitionEn: The short form of are, used after you, we, or they.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختصار are بعد you أو we أو they
entries.example: You're early today.

entries.definitionEn: The distance you can stretch your arm. Also the extent of someone's power or ability.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى ما تبلغه اليد بالتمدد؛ أو نطاق قدرة شخص أو نفوذه
entries.example: The top shelf was just out of reach.

entries.definitionEn: To arrive at a place. Also to stretch out and touch something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصل إلى مكان؛ أو يمدّ يده حتى يلمس شيئاً
entries.example: We reached the station at six.

entries.definitionEn: To behave in a particular way because of something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصرف استجابةً لما حدث
entries.example: How did she react to the news?

entries.definitionEn: Something you do, say, or feel because of something that has happened. Also a chemical change.
entries.arabicMeaning: ردّ فعل في السلوك أو الشعور؛ وأيضاً تفاعل كيميائي
entries.example: His first reaction was surprise.

entries.definitionEn: To look at written words and understand them.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظر في كلام مكتوب ويفهمه
entries.example: I read a book every evening.

entries.definitionEn: Clear and pleasant to read. Also of writing that is easy to make out.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائغ القراءة واضح ممتع؛ أو الخط الذي يسهل تبيّنه
entries.example: The report is surprisingly readable for a technical paper.

entries.definitionEn: A person who reads.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارئ
entries.example: She is a careful reader of the instructions.

entries.definitionEn: Quickly and willingly. Also easily, without difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسرعة وعن طيب خاطر؛ أو بيسر بلا عناء
entries.example: He readily agreed to help.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of looking at written words and understanding them.
entries.arabicMeaning: القراءة: النظر في الكلام المكتوب وفهمه
entries.example: Reading helps you learn new words.

entries.definitionEn: Prepared to do something, or prepared to be used.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعد لفعل شيء، أو جاهز للاستعمال
entries.example: Breakfast is ready.

entries.definitionEn: True and actual, not imagined or false.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقي غير متخيّل أو مزيّف
