entries.example: Is that a real diamond?

entries.definitionEn: Used in informal speech to mean very.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل في الكلام غير الرسمي بمعنى جداً
entries.example: She was real happy with the result.

entries.definitionEn: Land and buildings that can be bought and sold.
entries.arabicMeaning: العقارات: الأرض والمباني القابلة للبيع والشراء
entries.example: He works in real estate in the city.

entries.definitionEn: The attitude of accepting facts as they are. Also an art style that shows life as it actually looks.
entries.arabicMeaning: الواقعية: قبول الحقائق كما هي؛ أو أسلوب فني يصوّر الحياة على حالها
entries.example: Her budget showed a welcome sense of realism.

entries.definitionEn: A person who accepts facts as they are and does not hope for the impossible.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقعي يقبل الحقائق ولا يعلّق الأمل على المستحيل
entries.example: As a realist, he knew the repairs would take months.

entries.definitionEn: Accepting things as they really are. Also looking true to life.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقعي يرى الأمور كما هي؛ أو يبدو مطابقاً للحياة
entries.example: Set a realistic goal for this month.

entries.definitionEn: The way things actually are, not how we imagine them.
entries.arabicMeaning: الواقع كما هو لا كما نتخيّله
entries.example: The reality of the job was harder than she expected.

entries.definitionEn: The moment when you understand something clearly. Also the act of making a plan actually happen. Realization is the usual American spelling; realisation is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحظة إدراك أمر بوضوح؛ أو تحويل خطة إلى واقع. وrealization الإملاء الأمريكي الشائع وrealisation البريطاني
entries.example: The realization that she had missed the train came too late.

entries.definitionEn: To understand something, often suddenly. Realize is the usual American spelling; realise is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرك أمراً، وكثيراً ما يكون ذلك فجأة. وrealize الإملاء الأمريكي الشائع وrealise البريطاني
entries.example: I didn't realize you were waiting.

entries.definitionEn: In fact; truly. Also used to make a statement stronger.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقاً؛ أو لتوكيد الكلام
entries.example: I really like this soup.

entries.definitionEn: To cut and collect a crop. Also to get a result from what you have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصد محصولاً؛ أو يجني نتيجة ما عمل
entries.example: They hoped to reap the benefits of years of study.

entries.definitionEn: At the back of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلفي في مؤخرة الشيء
entries.example: Please use the rear entrance.

entries.definitionEn: To change the order or position of things.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد ترتيب الأشياء أو مواضعها
entries.example: She rearranged the chairs for the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A fact that explains why something happens or why someone does something.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبب يفسّر وقوع أمر أو فعل شخص
entries.example: The reason I'm late is the traffic.

entries.definitionEn: Fair and sensible. Also not too expensive.
entries.arabicMeaning: معقول عادل منطقي؛ أو غير مبالغ في ثمنه
entries.example: The hotel charged a reasonable price.

entries.definitionEn: In a fair and sensible way. Also to a fairly good degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة معقولة عادلة؛ أو إلى درجة جيدة نسبياً
entries.example: The work was reasonably well paid.

entries.definitionEn: Something you say or do to make someone feel less worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: تطمين يهوّن القلق
entries.example: She needed reassurance that the test was normal.

entries.definitionEn: To say or do something that makes someone feel less worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطمئن شخصاً فيخفّ قلقه
entries.example: The nurse reassured him about the procedure.

entries.definitionEn: A person who fights against people in power, or who refuses to obey rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثائر على السلطة، أو رافض للانقياد للقواعد
entries.example: As a student he was a rebel who questioned every rule.

entries.definitionEn: To fight against authority, or to refuse to obey rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمرّد على سلطة أو يرفض طاعة القواعد
entries.example: The workers rebelled against the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Unwilling to obey rules or people in authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: متمرّد يأبى الانقياد للقواعد أو لأصحاب السلطة
entries.example: His rebellious attitude caused trouble at school.

entries.definitionEn: A recovery after a fall or setback. Also, in sport, a ball that bounces back.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتعاش بعد هبوط أو نكسة؛ وفي الرياضة: الكرة المرتدة
entries.example: Shares enjoyed a strong rebound in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To bounce back after hitting something. Also to recover after a setback.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتدّ بعد الاصطدام؛ أو يتعافى بعد نكسة
entries.example: The ball rebounded off the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To build something again after it has been damaged.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد بناء شيء بعد تضرره
entries.example: They plan to rebuild the bridge next year.

entries.definitionEn: A sharp expression of criticism or disapproval.
entries.arabicMeaning: توبيخ حاد
entries.example: She accepted the manager's rebuke in silence.

entries.definitionEn: To criticize someone sharply for what they have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوبّخ شخصاً توبيخاً حاداً على فعله
entries.example: The judge rebuked the lawyer for interrupting.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to remember. Also an official order to return a product.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة على التذكّر؛ أو سحب منتج من الأسواق بأمر رسمي
entries.example: His recall of names is remarkable.

entries.definitionEn: To remember something. Also to officially order a product to be returned.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتذكر أمراً؛ أو يسحب منتجاً بأمر رسمي
entries.example: I cannot recall her address.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper that shows you have paid for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيصال يثبت أنك دفعت ثمن شيء
entries.example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the coat.

entries.definitionEn: To get something that is given or sent to you.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستلم شيئاً أُعطي أو أُرسل إليه
entries.example: Did you receive my email?

entries.definitionEn: Happening or beginning a short time ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديث العهد وقع أو بدأ قبل وقت قصير
entries.example: I have been busy with recent changes at work.

entries.definitionEn: A short time ago.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤخراً؛ قبل وقت قصير
entries.example: She moved here recently.

entries.definitionEn: The desk in a hotel or office where visitors go first. Also a formal party to welcome people.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكتب الاستقبال في فندق أو شركة؛ وأيضاً حفلة استقبال رسمية
entries.example: Please leave your key at reception.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to welcome visitors and answer the phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: موظّف استقبال يرحّب بالزوار ويجيب على الهاتف
entries.example: The receptionist asked me to wait.

entries.definitionEn: A temporary stop in a meeting, court, or parliament. Also a small space set back in a wall.
entries.arabicMeaning: استراحة مؤقتة في جلسة أو محكمة أو برلمان؛ أو تجويف في جدار
entries.example: Parliament is in recess until January.

entries.definitionEn: A period when a country's economy becomes weaker and many people lose jobs.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركود اقتصادي تضعف فيه أحوال البلاد ويفقد كثيرون عملهم
entries.example: Many shops closed during the recession.

entries.definitionEn: Of a gene: producing an effect only when two copies are present, not just one.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الوراثة: جين متنحٍّ لا يظهر أثره إلا باجتماع نسختين
entries.example: Blue eyes are often linked to a recessive gene.

entries.definitionEn: To put electrical power back into a battery. Also to rest so that you regain energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد شحن بطارية؛ أو يستجمّ ليسترد نشاطه
entries.example: I need to recharge my phone before we leave.

entries.definitionEn: A set of instructions for cooking a dish. Also a likely way to cause a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصفة طبخ؛ أو سبيل مفضٍ إلى نتيجة
entries.example: This recipe needs only four ingredients.

entries.definitionEn: The act of saying a poem or other text from memory in front of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلقاء قصيدة أو نص من الذاكرة أمام الناس
entries.example: Her recitation of the poem was clear and calm.

entries.definitionEn: To think or believe, especially in informal speech. Also to calculate an amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظنّ أو يعتقد، ولا سيما في الكلام غير الرسمي؛ أو يحسب مقداراً
entries.example: I reckon we'll be home by six.

entries.definitionEn: To get back something that is yours.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستردّ شيئاً يخصّه
entries.example: You can reclaim the tax if you overpaid.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives alone and avoids other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: منعزل يعتزل الناس ويعيش وحده
entries.example: The writer became a recluse in later life.

entries.definitionEn: Living apart from others and avoiding company.
entries.arabicMeaning: انعزالي يفرّ من مخالطة الناس
entries.example: The reclusive artist rarely gave interviews.

entries.definitionEn: The act of knowing someone or something because you have seen them before. Also public praise or official acceptance.
entries.arabicMeaning: التعرّف على شخص أو شيء لسبق رؤيته؛ أو إشادة علنية أو إقرار رسمي
entries.example: She hoped for recognition of her years of work.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to identify. Recognizable is the usual American spelling; recognisable is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسهل التعرّف عليه. وrecognizable الإملاء الأمريكي الشائع وrecognisable البريطاني
entries.example: The song was recognizable from the first notes.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can be identified. Recognizably is the usual American spelling; recognisably is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة يمكن التعرّف عليها. وrecognizably الإملاء الأمريكي الشائع وrecognisably البريطاني
entries.example: The building is recognizably Victorian.

entries.definitionEn: To know someone or something because you have seen or heard them before. Also to accept something as true or official. Recognize is the usual American spelling; recognise is British.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعرّف على شخص أو شيء لسبق رؤيته أو سماعه؛ أو يقرّ بأمر. وrecognize الإملاء الأمريكي الشائع وrecognise البريطاني
entries.example: I didn't recognize you with that hat.

entries.definitionEn: To remember something, especially with some effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحضر أمراً في ذاكرته، وخصوصاً بجهد
entries.example: He could not recollect the exact date.

entries.definitionEn: To say that someone or something is good and suitable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوصي بشخص أو شيء لأنه مناسب وجيد
entries.example: Can you recommend a quiet hotel?

entries.definitionEn: Worth recommending; suitable to be suggested to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بأن يُوصى به
entries.example: The museum is highly recommendable on a rainy afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A suggestion that someone or something is good and suitable. Also official advice.
entries.arabicMeaning: توصية بأن شخصاً أو شيئاً مناسب وجيد؛ أو مشورة رسمية
entries.example: I booked the restaurant on a friend's recommendation.

entries.definitionEn: To make people friendly again after a disagreement. Also to make two ideas exist together without conflict.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصلح بين متخاصمين؛ أو يوفّق بين فكرتين بلا تعارض
entries.example: She tried to reconcile her parents after the argument.

entries.definitionEn: The restoration of a friendly relationship after a disagreement. Also the process of making accounts or ideas consistent.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصالحة تعيد الودّ بعد خلاف؛ أو توفيق بين حسابات أو أفكار
entries.example: The meeting ended in a genuine reconciliation.

entries.definitionEn: To think again about a decision, often with a view to changing it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد النظر في قرار، وغالباً تمهيداً لتغييره
entries.example: I hope you will reconsider my application.

entries.definitionEn: Information kept about something that happened. Also the best result ever achieved. Also a thin disc of recorded music.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجلّ يحفظ معلومات عما وقع؛ أو رقم قياسي؛ أو أسطوانة موسيقى
entries.example: The school keeps a record of attendance.

entries.definitionEn: To store sound, pictures, or information so that it can be used later.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسجّل صوتاً أو صورة أو معلومات لحفظها واستعمالها لاحقاً
entries.example: They recorded the interview on a phone.

entries.definitionEn: Sound or pictures stored so that they can be played later.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسجيل صوتي أو مرئي يمكن تشغيله لاحقاً
entries.example: I have a recording of the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A source of help that you can turn to in a difficult situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاذ يُلجأ إليه عند الضيق
entries.example: Borrowing was our last recourse.

entries.definitionEn: To become well again after an illness or shock. Also to get back something that was lost.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعافى بعد مرض أو صدمة؛ أو يستردّ شيئاً ضائعاً
entries.example: It took her a month to recover from the flu.

entries.definitionEn: The process of becoming well or normal again. Also the getting back of something lost.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعافٍ وعودة إلى الحال السوية؛ أو استرداد شيء ضائع
entries.example: His recovery after the operation was quick.

entries.definitionEn: Activity done for enjoyment when you are not working.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترفيه ونشاط يُمارس للمتعة خارج العمل
entries.example: Walking by the river is her favourite recreation.

entries.definitionEn: To find new people to join a company, organization, or the armed forces.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستقطب أناساً جدداً لشركة أو منظمة أو الجيش
entries.example: The firm hopes to recruit more engineers this year.

entries.definitionEn: Having the shape of a rectangle, with four straight sides and four right angles.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستطيل الشكل بأربعة أضلاع مستقيمة وأربع زوايا قائمة
entries.example: The table has a rectangular top.

entries.definitionEn: Lying down.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستلقٍ
entries.example: The sculpture showed a recumbent figure on a couch.

entries.definitionEn: To get back your health and strength after illness or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستردّ صحته وقوته بعد مرض أو جهد
entries.example: She went to the coast to recuperate.

entries.definitionEn: The process of getting back health and strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: استرداد الصحة والقوة
entries.example: Full recuperation may take several weeks.

entries.definitionEn: Helping you to recover health or strength.
entries.arabicMeaning: معين على استرداد العافية أو القوة
entries.example: Sleep has a recuperative effect after hard training.

entries.definitionEn: To treat used materials so that they can be used again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد تدوير المواد المستعملة لتُستخدم من جديد
entries.example: We recycle paper and glass at home.

entries.definitionEn: Made from materials that have been used before and treated again.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنوع من مواد أُعيد تدويرها
entries.example: This bag is made from recycled plastic.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of treating used materials so they can be used again.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعادة التدوير
entries.example: The town has improved its recycling service.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of blood or a ripe tomato.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحمر كلون الدم أو الطماطم الناضجة
entries.example: She wore a red coat.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of blood or a ripe tomato.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأحمر
entries.example: Red is my favourite colour.

entries.definitionEn: To find again something that was forgotten or no longer used.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد اكتشاف شيء نُسي أو تُرك
entries.example: She rediscovered her love of drawing during the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: To do something again, often in order to do it better.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد عمل شيء، وغالباً ليحسّنه
entries.example: I had to redo the last page of the report.

entries.definitionEn: To make something smaller or less in amount or size.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلّل مقداراً أو حجماً
entries.example: We need to reduce the amount of sugar we eat.

entries.definitionEn: The act or result of making something smaller or less.
entries.arabicMeaning: خفض أو نقصان
entries.example: There has been a reduction in train fares.

entries.definitionEn: The state of losing your job because that role is no longer needed. Also the use of extra words or parts that are not necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: فائض وظيفي يُستغنى فيه عن الموظف لأن الدور لم يعد لازماً؛ أو حشو زائد لا ضرورة له
entries.example: After the factory closed, many workers faced redundancy.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that repeats something unnecessarily, or that provides an extra spare.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو زائد مكرّر بلا حاجة؛ أو بتوفير احتياط إضافي
entries.example: He explained the same point redundantly.

entries.definitionEn: A tall thin plant that grows in wet ground. Also a thin piece in some wind instruments that vibrates to make sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصب ينبت في الأرض الرطبة؛ أو قصبة في بعض آلات النفخ تهتز لتُحدث الصوت
entries.example: Reeds grew thick along the river bank.

entries.definitionEn: A line of rocks or coral near the surface of the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعاب صخرية أو مرجانية قرب سطح البحر
entries.example: They went diving on the coral reef.

entries.definitionEn: To perform the events of a past situation again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد تمثيل أحداث ماضية
entries.example: The society will reenact the battle next summer.

entries.definitionEn: To mention someone or something. Also to send a person to someone else for help or information.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشير إلى شخص أو شيء؛ أو يحيل شخصاً إلى غيره للمساعدة أو المعلومة
entries.example: Please do not refer to your notes during the test.

entries.definitionEn: The official who controls a sports match and makes sure the rules are followed.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكم المباراة يسيرها ويطبّق قواعدها
entries.example: The referee blew the whistle for half-time.

entries.definitionEn: A mention of something. Also a source you look at for information. Also a letter about someone's character and work.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشارة إلى شيء؛ أو مرجع يُستقى منه؛ أو خطاب تزكية
entries.example: The article contains a reference to her earlier research.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the person or thing that a word or sign points to.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمشار إليه بكلمة أو علامة
entries.example: Circle the referent noun that the pronoun replaces.

entries.definitionEn: A factory where a raw material, especially oil, is made purer and ready to use.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصفاة تنقّي مادة خاماً، وخصوصاً النفط، حتى تصلح للاستعمال
entries.example: The oil refinery lies outside the city.

entries.definitionEn: To send back light, heat, or an image from a surface. Also to show something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعكس ضوءاً أو حرارة أو صورة من سطح؛ أو يبيّن أمراً
entries.example: The lake reflected the mountains.

entries.definitionEn: An image seen in a mirror or in water. Also careful thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة منعكسة في مرآة أو ماء؛ أو تفكير متأنٍّ
entries.example: She saw her reflection in the shop window.

entries.definitionEn: Thinking carefully and quietly. Also sending back light.
entries.arabicMeaning: متأمل مفكر بهدوء؛ أو عاكس للضوء
entries.example: He became more reflective after the long journey.

entries.definitionEn: A change made in order to improve a system, law, or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: إصلاح يغيّر نظاماً أو قانوناً أو مؤسسة نحو الأفضل
entries.example: The school announced a reform of the timetable.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a song or poem that is repeated.
entries.arabicMeaning: لازمة تتكرر في أغنية أو قصيدة
entries.example: Everyone joined in the refrain.

entries.definitionEn: An act of updating something so that it shows the latest information, especially on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحديث يعرض أحدث المعلومات، ولا سيما على شاشة
entries.example: A refresh of the page showed the new comments.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel less tired or hot. Also to update information on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينعّش شخصاً فيخفّ تعبه أو حرّه؛ أو يحدّث معلومات على شاشة
entries.example: A short walk will refresh you.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel less tired or hot. Also pleasantly new and different.
entries.arabicMeaning: منعش يخفّف التعب أو الحرّ؛ أو جديد سارّ يخالف المألوف
entries.example: The breeze off the sea was refreshing.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is pleasantly new, or that restores energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة منعشة أو سارة في جدّتها
entries.example: He was refreshingly honest about the delays.

entries.definitionEn: Drinks and small amounts of food provided at an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيافة من مشروبات وطعام خفيف في مناسبة
entries.example: Refreshments will be served after the talk.

entries.definitionEn: A large cupboard that keeps food and drinks cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاجة تحفظ الطعام والشراب بارداً
entries.example: Put the milk in the refrigerator.

entries.definitionEn: A place that gives protection from danger or trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملاذ يقي من خطر أو ضيق
entries.example: They found refuge in a neighbour's house during the storm.

entries.definitionEn: A person forced to leave their country because of war or danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاجئ أُكره على مغادرة بلده بسبب حرب أو خطر
entries.example: The camp provides shelter for refugees.

entries.definitionEn: Money that is given back because you returned goods or were not satisfied.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلغ يُردّ إليك لأنك أعدت بضاعة أو لم ترضَ
entries.example: I asked for a refund when the shoes did not fit.

entries.definitionEn: To repair and improve a building or room so that it looks new again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجدّد مبنى أو غرفة بالإصلاح وتحسين المظهر
entries.example: They plan to refurbish the old theatre.

entries.definitionEn: The work of repairing and improving a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعمال تجديد مبنى وإصلاحه
entries.example: The library is closed for refurbishment.

entries.definitionEn: The act of saying no to a request or offer.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفض طلب أو عرض
entries.example: Her refusal to join surprised us.

entries.definitionEn: Waste material; things that have been thrown away.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفايات وقمامة
entries.example: Household refuse is collected on Tuesdays.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you will not do or accept something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفض أن يفعل أمراً أو يقبله
entries.example: He refused to sign the form.

entries.definitionEn: To prove that a statement or idea is wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدحض قولاً أو فكرة بإثبات بطلانها
entries.example: The scientist was able to refute the claim with new data.

entries.definitionEn: To get back something that you had lost, such as health, control, or a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعيد شيئاً فقده كالصحة أو السيطرة أو موضع
entries.example: It took him weeks to regain his strength.

entries.definitionEn: Respect and admiration. Also attention or care. Also used in the phrase in this regard to mean on this point.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقدير واحترام؛ أو عناية واهتمام؛ ويُقال in this regard بمعنى في هذا الصدد
entries.example: She is held in high regard by her colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: To think of someone or something in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعدّ شخصاً أو شيئاً على نحو معيّن
entries.example: I regard her as a close friend.

entries.definitionEn: About; on the subject of.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخصوص؛ في موضوع
entries.example: I am writing regarding your job application.

entries.definitionEn: Without being affected or influenced by something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغضّ النظر عن شيء ودون التأثر به
entries.example: She went for a run regardless of the rain.

entries.definitionEn: A style of popular music that began in Jamaica, with a strong regular beat.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسيقى الريغي التي نشأت في جامايكا بإيقاع منتظم قوي
entries.example: They played reggae all evening.

entries.definitionEn: A system of government, especially a strict one. Also a set of rules for food, exercise, or treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظام حكم، وخصوصاً إذا كان صارماً؛ أو نظام غذائي أو رياضي أو علاجي
entries.example: He followed a strict training regime before the race.

entries.definitionEn: A large area of a country or of the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطقة واسعة من بلد أو من العالم
entries.example: This region is famous for its cheese.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a particular region.
entries.arabicMeaning: إقليمي متعلق بمنطقة معيّنة
entries.example: She works for a regional newspaper.

entries.definitionEn: An official list of names or items. Also the range of a voice or instrument. Also how formal language is.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجلّ رسمي بالأسماء أو المواد؛ أو مدى الصوت أو الآلة؛ أو مستوى رسمية اللغة
entries.example: Please sign the register at the front desk.

entries.definitionEn: To put a name or item on an official list.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسجّل اسماً أو مادة في قائمة رسمية
entries.example: You must register for the course by Friday.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting a name or item on an official list. Also the documents that show this.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسجيل في قائمة رسمية؛ أو وثائقه
entries.example: Registration for the conference is now open.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of sadness about something you have done or not done.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندم على ما فُعل أو تُرك
entries.example: He felt a deep regret about leaving so early.

entries.definitionEn: To feel sorry about something you have done or about a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندم على فعل أو حال
entries.example: I regret my rude reply.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is unfortunate and you wish it were not so.
entries.arabicMeaning: لسوء الحظ؛ بما يدعو إلى الأسف
entries.example: Regrettably, the concert has been cancelled.

entries.definitionEn: Happening often with similar timing. Also usual or ordinary.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتظم يتكرر في أوقات متقاربة؛ أو معتاد عادي
entries.example: There is a regular bus to the airport.

entries.definitionEn: Often, with similar timing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بانتظام
entries.example: She swims regularly on weekday mornings.

entries.definitionEn: To control something by rules or laws. Also to adjust a machine so that it works steadily.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّم أمراً بقواعد أو قوانين؛ أو يضبط آلة لتعمل بثبات
entries.example: The agency was set up to regulate food safety.

entries.definitionEn: An official rule.
entries.arabicMeaning: لائحة أو قاعدة رسمية
entries.example: New safety regulations come into force next month.

entries.definitionEn: Having the official job of making or enforcing rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقابي أو تنظيمي يتولى وضع القواعد أو إنفاذها
entries.example: The bank is subject to strict regulatory controls.

entries.definitionEn: A practice of a play, concert, or other performance before the real event.
entries.arabicMeaning: بروفة لمسرحية أو حفلة قبل العرض الحقيقي
entries.example: Tomorrow's rehearsal starts at ten.

entries.definitionEn: To make something stronger. Also to give more support to an idea or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعزّز شيئاً فيزيده قوة؛ أو يدعم فكرة أو شعوراً
entries.example: The extra beams will reinforce the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Extra strength or support. Also extra people or supplies sent to help.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعزيز إضافي للقوة أو الدعم؛ أو إمداد بأشخاص أو مواد للمساعدة
entries.example: The wall needs reinforcement before winter.

entries.definitionEn: To publish or produce something again, such as a book, album, or stamp.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد إصدار كتاب أو ألبوم أو طابع
entries.example: The studio will reissue the album on vinyl.

entries.definitionEn: To refuse to accept a person, idea, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفض قبول شخص أو فكرة أو شيء
entries.example: They rejected our offer on the house.

entries.definitionEn: The act of refusing to accept a person, idea, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفض قبول شخص أو فكرة أو شيء
entries.example: He took the rejection of his manuscript calmly.

entries.definitionEn: To return to a group or place after being away. Also to reply, in formal use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعود إلى جماعة أو مكان بعد غياب؛ أو يردّ في أسلوب رسمي
entries.example: She rejoined her colleagues after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A return of illness or of a bad habit after a period of improvement.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتكاس يعود فيه المرض أو العادة السيئة بعد تحسّن
entries.example: After two good months he suffered a relapse.

entries.definitionEn: To become ill again, or to return to a bad habit.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتكس فيعود المرض أو العادة السيئة
entries.example: She relapsed a week after leaving hospital.

entries.definitionEn: To show or see a connection between things. Also to tell a story. Also to understand and feel close to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط بين أمور أو يرى الصلة بينها؛ أو يسرد قصة؛ أو يشعر بالقرب من شخص
entries.example: How does this question relate to the last one?

entries.definitionEn: Connected in some way. Also belonging to the same family.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتبط بصلة ما؛ أو من الأقارب
entries.example: The two accidents may be related.

entries.definitionEn: The way in which two people or things are connected. Also a member of your family.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاقة تربط شخصين أو شيئين؛ أو قريب من الأهل
entries.example: There is a close relation between diet and health.

entries.definitionEn: The way two people or groups feel and behave toward each other. Also a romantic partnership.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاقة شعور وسلوك بين طرفين؛ وأيضاً علاقة عاطفية
entries.example: Trust is important in any relationship.

entries.definitionEn: True or large only when compared with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسبي يُقاس بالمقارنة مع غيره
entries.example: We live in relative comfort compared with last year.

entries.definitionEn: A member of your family.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريب من أهل الأسرة
entries.example: A relative is staying with us this week.

entries.definitionEn: To a fairly large degree, when compared with others.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسبياً إذا قورن بغيره
entries.example: The test was relatively easy.

entries.definitionEn: Einstein's scientific theory about space, time, and gravity. Also the state of being understood only by comparison.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرية أينشتاين في المكان والزمان والجاذبية؛ أو كون الأمر يُفهم بالمقارنة فقط
entries.example: The course includes a chapter on relativity.

entries.definitionEn: To become less tense and more calm, or to make a part of the body less tight.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسترخي فيخفّ توتره؛ أو يرخي جزءاً من الجسم
entries.example: Sit down and relax for a few minutes.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being relaxed, or an activity that helps you relax. Also a loosening of rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: استرخاء أو نشاط يعين عليه؛ أو تخفيف للقواعد
entries.example: She plays the piano for relaxation.

entries.definitionEn: Calm and not worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتاح البال غير قلق
entries.example: He seemed relaxed before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel calm and less worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريح يعين على هدوء البال
entries.example: A hot bath is relaxing after a long day.

entries.definitionEn: A race in which each member of a team goes part of the distance. Also a system that passes a message or signal along.
entries.arabicMeaning: سباق تتابع يكمل كل عضو جزءاً من المسافة؛ أو نظام ينقل رسالة أو إشارة
entries.example: She ran the last stretch of the relay.

entries.definitionEn: The act of letting a person or animal go free. Also the moment when a new film, song, or product becomes available.
entries.arabicMeaning: إفراج أو إطلاق سراح؛ وأيضاً صدور فيلم أو أغنية أو منتج جديد
entries.example: The band announced the release of their new album.

entries.definitionEn: To let someone or something go free. Also to make a film, song, or product available to the public.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلق سراح شخص أو شيء؛ أو يُصدر فيلماً أو أغنية أو منتجاً للجمهور
entries.example: The hospital will release her tomorrow if the tests are clear.

entries.definitionEn: To put someone or something in a lower or less important position. In sport, to move a team down to a weaker division.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُنزل شخصاً أو شيئاً إلى مرتبة أدنى؛ وفي الرياضة يُهبط فريقاً إلى درجة أضعف
entries.example: After a poor season the club was relegated to the second division.

entries.definitionEn: Closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in.
entries.arabicMeaning: وثيق الصلة بالموضوع أو بالموقف القائم
entries.example: Please keep your comments relevant to the agenda.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be trusted to work well or to do what you expect.
entries.arabicMeaning: موثوق يمكن الاعتماد عليه في العمل أو في الوفاء بما يُنتظر منه
entries.example: She is a reliable colleague who always meets her deadlines.

entries.definitionEn: An object from the past that still exists. Also a custom or idea that belongs to an earlier time.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر قديم ما زال باقياً؛ أو عادة أو فكرة من زمن سابق
entries.example: The museum displays a relic from the ancient port.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of comfort when worry, pain, or pressure becomes less or ends. Also help given to people in difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتياح يزول معه القلق أو الألم؛ وأيضاً إغاثة تُقدَّم لمن هم في ضيق
entries.example: It was a relief to hear that the flight had landed safely.

entries.definitionEn: To make pain, worry, or pressure less. Also to take over a duty so that someone else can rest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخفف ألماً أو قلقاً أو ضغطاً؛ أو يحل محل شخص في واجب ليرتاح
entries.example: A short walk can relieve stiffness in the shoulders.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling glad and less worried because something bad did not happen or has ended.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتاح ومسرور لأن أمراً سيئاً لم يقع أو انتهى
entries.example: We were relieved when the missing keys turned up.

entries.definitionEn: Belief in a god or gods, and the practices and teachings connected with that belief.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإيمان بإله أو آلهة، وما يتصل به من شعائر وتعاليم
entries.example: She studies how religion shapes daily life in different countries.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with religion. Also having a strong belief in a religion and following its practices.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالدين؛ أو متديّن يلتزم بشعائره
entries.example: The festival has both religious and family traditions.

entries.definitionEn: Unwilling to do something, and slow to agree to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عازف عن فعل شيء ومتردد في الموافقة عليه
entries.example: He was reluctant to leave before the meeting ended.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you do not really want to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: على مضض، بما يبيّن أنك لا ترغب حقاً في الفعل
entries.example: She reluctantly agreed to postpone the trip.

entries.definitionEn: To need someone or something in order to succeed, or to trust them to do what is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعتمد على شخص أو شيء للنجاح، أو يثق بأن يؤدي ما يُحتاج إليه
entries.example: We rely on public transport to get to work.

entries.definitionEn: To stay in the same place or the same way. Also to be left after other people or things have gone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبقى في المكان نفسه أو الحال نفسها؛ أو يتبقى بعد ذهاب غيره
entries.example: Please remain in your seats until the train stops.

entries.definitionEn: The part of something that is left after the rest has been used, taken, or dealt with.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجزء المتبقي بعد استخدام الباقي أو أخذه أو معالجته
entries.example: She spent the remainder of the evening reading.

entries.definitionEn: Still left; not yet used, taken, or finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: متبقٍّ لم يُستخدم أو يُؤخذ أو يُنجَز بعد
entries.example: Use the remaining flour for the second batch of bread.

entries.definitionEn: What is left of something after the rest has been destroyed, eaten, or taken away. Also a dead body, especially an ancient one.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يبقى من شيء بعد تلفه أو أكله أو إزالته؛ وأيضاً رفات، ولا سيما القديمة
entries.example: Archaeologists found the remains of a small settlement.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you say, often as a short comment or opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما تقوله من تعليق قصير أو رأي
entries.example: His remark about the weather made everyone smile.

entries.definitionEn: To say something as a comment, often without planning a long speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقول شيئاً على سبيل التعليق، غالباً من غير حديث مطوّل
entries.example: She remarked that the hall was colder than usual.

entries.definitionEn: Unusual in a way that is worth noticing and talking about.
entries.arabicMeaning: لافت وغير معتاد على نحو يستحق الانتباه والحديث
entries.example: She made remarkable progress in only six months.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is unusual and worth noticing; to a surprising degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لافت يستحق الانتباه؛ بدرجة تدعو إلى الدهشة
entries.example: The old clock is still remarkably accurate.

entries.definitionEn: Intended to correct a problem, weakness, or gap in knowledge, especially through extra teaching or treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: معدّ لإصلاح خلل أو ضعف أو نقص، ولا سيما بدروس تقوية أو علاج
entries.example: The college offers remedial classes in mathematics.

entries.definitionEn: A way of solving a problem. Also a treatment that is meant to make an illness better.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسيلة لحل مشكلة؛ وأيضاً علاج يُقصد به تحسين علة
entries.example: A simple apology is sometimes the best remedy.

entries.definitionEn: To keep a person, thing, or fact in your mind; to not forget.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتذكر شخصاً أو شيئاً أو حقيقة؛ لا ينسى
entries.example: Do you remember the way to the station?

entries.definitionEn: The act of thinking about people or events from the past, especially those who have died.
entries.arabicMeaning: إحياء ذكرى أناس أو أحداث من الماضي، ولا سيما من ماتوا
entries.example: A minute of silence was held in remembrance of the victims.

entries.definitionEn: To help someone remember something they might forget.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذكّر شخصاً بأمر قد ينساه
entries.example: Please remind me to call her this evening.

entries.definitionEn: Something that helps you remember a task, fact, or person.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يعينك على تذكر مهمة أو حقيقة أو شخص
entries.example: The calendar pop-up was a useful reminder of the appointment.

entries.definitionEn: To talk or think about pleasant memories from the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسترجع ذكريات الماضي السارة بالحديث أو التفكير
entries.example: The old friends sat by the fire and reminisced about school.

entries.definitionEn: Making you think of a particular person, thing, or time because of a similarity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذكّر بشخص أو شيء أو زمن لما فيه من شبه
entries.example: The music was reminiscent of summer evenings by the sea.

entries.definitionEn: To send money, especially to another place. Also to cancel a debt or punishment, or to send a matter to another authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوّل مالاً ولا سيما إلى مكان آخر؛ أو يعفو عن دين أو عقوبة، أو يحيل أمراً إلى جهة أخرى
entries.example: Each month she remits money to her family abroad.

entries.definitionEn: A sum of money sent to someone, especially to support family in another country.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلغ يُرسل إلى شخص، ولا سيما لإعالة أهل في بلد آخر
entries.example: The family depends on a monthly remittance from their son.

entries.definitionEn: A formal protest or complaint, often made in strong but careful language.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتجاج رسمي أو شكوى تُرفع غالباً بلغة حازمة متأنية
entries.example: The board received a written remonstrance from the staff.

entries.definitionEn: A deep feeling of sadness and guilt because you have done something wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندم عميق وشعور بالذنب لارتكاب خطأ
entries.example: He felt genuine remorse for the harm his words had caused.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing deep regret for a wrong you have done.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادم ندماً شديداً على خطأ ارتكبه، أو يُظهر ذلك
entries.example: The remorseful driver apologized to everyone involved.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows deep regret for a wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُظهر ندماً عميقاً على خطأ
entries.example: She spoke remorsefully about the missed deadline.

entries.definitionEn: Without pity. Also continuing in a harsh way without stopping.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الشفقة؛ أو مستمر بقسوة من غير توقف
entries.example: The remorseless heat lasted well into the night.

entries.definitionEn: Without pity, or in a way that does not stop or become milder.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا شفقة، أو على نحو لا يتوقف ولا يلين
entries.example: The questions came remorselessly, one after another.

entries.definitionEn: Far away from towns and other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناءٍ بعيد عن المدن والناس
entries.example: They spent the weekend in a remote village in the hills.

entries.definitionEn: A small device used to operate a television, player, or other machine from a distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز صغير للتحكم في تلفاز أو جهاز آخر عن بُعد
entries.example: He could not find the remote control for the television.

entries.definitionEn: From a distance, without being in the same place. Also, usually with not, to even a small degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن بُعد من غير الحضور في المكان نفسه؛ وأيضاً مع النفي بمعنى: على الإطلاق أو بأي قدر
entries.example: She was not remotely interested in changing the plan.

entries.definitionEn: To take something away from a place. Also to take off clothes or a covering.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزيل شيئاً من مكان؛ أو يخلع ثوباً أو غطاء
entries.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter.

entries.definitionEn: Distant or separate from something; not closely connected with it. Also used in family terms for a relative a generation apart, as in a cousin once removed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعيد الصلة عن شيء أو منفصل عنه؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً في النسب للدلالة على قريب يفصله جيل
entries.example: His calm tone felt far removed from the panic in the room.

entries.definitionEn: To cause something to be in a particular state. Also to give help or a service, or to represent something in art or performance.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصيّر الشيء على حال معيّنة؛ أو يقدّم عوناً أو خدمة، أو يصوّر شيئاً في فن أو أداء
entries.example: The storm rendered the mountain road impassable.

entries.definitionEn: A particular performance or artistic version of a work. Also a drawing that shows how a building is meant to look.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداء معيّن أو صياغة فنية لعمل؛ وأيضاً رسم يبيّن هيئة مبنى كما سيبدو
entries.example: The architect presented a rendering of the finished courtyard.

entries.definitionEn: To make an agreement, contract, or official document valid for a further period. Also to start again with fresh energy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجدّد صلاحية اتفاق أو عقد أو وثيقة لفترة أخرى؛ أو يستأنف بنشاط جديد
entries.example: I need to renew my passport before the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being widely known and admired for skill or achievement.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهرة واسعة تقوم على المهارة أو الإنجاز
entries.example: The chef won international renown for her simple regional dishes.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you pay regularly to live in a house, room, or land that belongs to someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: مال تدفعه بانتظام للسكن في بيت أو غرفة أو أرض لغيرك
entries.example: The rent is due on the first day of each month.

entries.definitionEn: To pay money to use a house, car, or other thing for a period. Also to let someone use something you own in return for money.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدفع مالاً لاستعمال بيت أو سيارة أو غيرهما مدة؛ أو يؤجّر ما يملكه مقابل مال
entries.example: We rented a small apartment near the station.

entries.definitionEn: The act of renting something, or a thing that is rented. Also the amount of money paid to rent it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية الاستئجار أو الشيء المستأجَر؛ وأيضاً مبلغ الإيجار
entries.example: The car rental included insurance for the week.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange the parts of a company, system, or activity again so that it works better.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد ترتيب أجزاء شركة أو نظام أو نشاط ليؤدي عمله على نحو أفضل
entries.example: The new manager reorganized the office into smaller teams.

entries.definitionEn: An act of painting a surface again; a fresh coat of paint.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعادة طلاء سطح؛ طبقة طلاء جديدة
entries.example: The hallway looked brighter after a full repaint.

entries.definitionEn: Work done to fix something that is broken or damaged.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل يُصلح به شيء مكسور أو تالف
entries.example: The phone is in for repair this week.

entries.definitionEn: To fix something that is broken or damaged so that it works again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصلح شيئاً مكسوراً أو تالفاً حتى يعود إلى العمل
entries.example: Can you repair the broken chair?

entries.definitionEn: To pay back money that you owe. Also to do something kind in return for a kindness.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسدّد مالاً عليه؛ أو يرد الجميل بفعل طيب
entries.example: She plans to repay the loan within two years.

entries.definitionEn: To say or do something again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقول شيئاً أو يفعله مرة أخرى
entries.example: Could you repeat that, please?

entries.definitionEn: Many times; again and again.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراراً؛ مرة بعد مرة
entries.example: He knocked repeatedly, but no one answered.

entries.definitionEn: To drive back an attack. Also to cause a strong feeling of dislike, or to push something away, as magnets can.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصد هجوماً؛ أو يثير نفوراً شديداً، أو يدفع شيئاً بعيداً كما تفعل المغناطيسات
entries.example: The walls were built to repel invaders from the coast.

entries.definitionEn: Causing a strong feeling of dislike. Also able to keep insects, water, or other things away.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثير نفوراً شديداً؛ أو قادر على طرد الحشرات أو الماء أو غيرهما
entries.example: The smell of the chemical was faintly repellant.

entries.definitionEn: A substance used to keep insects or other pests away.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة تُستخدم لطرد الحشرات أو الآفات
entries.example: They sprayed insect repellant before the evening walk.

entries.definitionEn: All the plays, songs, or skills that a person or group can perform or use.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذخيرة ما يستطيع شخص أو فريق أداءه من مسرحيات أو أغاني أو مهارات
entries.example: The pianist added two new pieces to her repertoire.

entries.definitionEn: A type of theatre in which a company performs a changing set of plays. Also a stock of works ready to be performed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرح ذخيرة تقدّم فيه فرقة مجموعة متبدلة من المسرحيات؛ وأيضاً رصيد أعمال جاهزة للأداء
entries.example: She spent a year acting in a small repertory company.

entries.definitionEn: The act of doing or saying the same thing again. Also a thing that is repeated.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل الشيء نفسه أو قوله مرة أخرى؛ وأيضاً الأمر المكرَّر
entries.example: Learning a language needs a lot of repetition.

entries.definitionEn: To put a new thing in the place of an old one. Also to take the place of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً جديداً محل قديم؛ أو يحل محل شخص أو شيء
entries.example: We need to replace the broken window.

entries.definitionEn: A person or thing that takes the place of another.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو شيء يحل محل آخر
entries.example: The shop sent a replacement for the damaged kettle.

entries.definitionEn: An exact copy of an object, especially of something valuable or historic.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة مطابقة لشيء، ولا سيما لقطعة ثمينة أو تاريخية
entries.example: The museum sold a small replica of the ancient vase.

entries.definitionEn: An answer to a letter, message, or question.
entries.arabicMeaning: رد على رسالة أو سؤال
entries.example: I am still waiting for a reply to my email.

entries.definitionEn: To answer a letter, message, or question.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرد على رسالة أو سؤال
entries.example: She replied to his message the same evening.

entries.definitionEn: A spoken or written description of events, facts, or results.
entries.arabicMeaning: وصف منطوق أو مكتوب لأحداث أو وقائع أو نتائج
entries.example: The teacher wrote a short report on each student.

entries.definitionEn: To tell people about something that has happened, especially officially or in the news.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبر الناس بما حدث، ولا سيما بصفة رسمية أو في الأخبار
entries.example: Witnesses reported a loud noise near the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: A person who finds out news and tells it in a newspaper, on television, or on the radio.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراسل يجمع الأخبار وينقلها في صحيفة أو تلفاز أو راديو
entries.example: A reporter asked the coach about the match.

entries.definitionEn: A state of rest, calm, and quiet, especially of the body or mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: حال من الراحة والسكينة والهدوء، ولا سيما للجسد أو العقل
entries.example: After the long climb they sat in complete repose.

entries.definitionEn: To rest or lie still. Also, in formal use, to place trust, power, or hope in someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستريح أو يرقد ساكناً؛ وفي الاستعمال الرسمي يضع ثقة أو سلطة أو أملاً في شخص
entries.example: The cat reposed in a square of afternoon sunlight.

entries.definitionEn: To speak or act for a person or group. Also to be a sign, picture, or example of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكلم أو يعمل نيابة عن شخص أو جماعة؛ أو يكون رمزاً أو صورة أو مثالاً لشيء
entries.example: A lawyer will represent her in court.

entries.definitionEn: A person chosen to speak or act for other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يُختار ليتكلم أو يعمل نيابة عن غيره
entries.example: Each department sent a representative to the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: To hold back a feeling and not show it. Also to control people by force and limit their freedom.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكبت شعوراً فلا يُظهره؛ أو يقمع الناس بالقوة ويقيّد حريتهم
entries.example: She tried to repress a smile during the serious talk.

entries.definitionEn: The use of force to control people and limit their freedom. Also the holding back of feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: استخدام القوة للسيطرة على الناس وتقييد حريتهم؛ وأيضاً كبت المشاعر
entries.example: The novel describes a long period of political repression.

entries.definitionEn: A new printed copy of a book or article that has already been published.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبعة جديدة من كتاب أو مقال سبق نشره
entries.example: The popular textbook is now in its fifth reprint.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone, often with sadness or disappointment, that they have done something wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوم شخصاً، وغالباً بأسى أو خيبة، على خطأ ارتكبه
entries.example: He reproached himself for missing the early train.

entries.definitionEn: To make a copy of something. Also, of living things, to produce young.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصنع نسخة من شيء؛ وأيضاً يتكاثر الكائن الحي فينتج نسلاً
entries.example: Please do not reproduce this diagram without permission.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone they have done something wrong, in a mild or formal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوبّخ شخصاً على خطأ، بلطف أو بأسلوب رسمي
entries.example: The tutor reproved him for arriving late again.

entries.definitionEn: Of or like a reptile. Also, of a manner, cold and unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: زاحفي أو شبيه بالزواحف؛ وأيضاً من حيث الأسلوب: بارد كريه
entries.example: The statue had a still, almost reptilian face.

entries.definitionEn: A country whose leader is elected by the people, not a king or queen.
entries.arabicMeaning: دولة يُنتخَب رئيسها ولا يحكمها ملك أو ملكة
entries.example: The country became a republic after the last king stepped down.

entries.definitionEn: The opinion that people have about someone or something, based on what they have done in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يراه الناس في شخص أو شيء بناء على ما سبق منه
entries.example: The restaurant has a reputation for honest, simple food.

entries.definitionEn: The reputation that a person or place has, especially a good one.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيت شخص أو مكان، ولا سيما الصيت الحسن
entries.example: She is a scholar of high repute in her field.

entries.definitionEn: To consider someone or something to be a particular kind of person or thing; usually used in the passive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعدّ شخصاً أو شيئاً على صفة معيّنة؛ ويغلب استعماله مبنياً للمجهول
entries.example: He is reputed to be one of the finest surgeons in the city.

entries.definitionEn: An act of asking for something in a polite or official way.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلب شيء بأسلوب مهذّب أو رسمي
entries.example: I sent a request for a later appointment.

entries.definitionEn: To ask for something in a polite or official way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلب شيئاً بأسلوب مهذّب أو رسمي
entries.example: Guests are requested to check out by eleven.

entries.definitionEn: To need something. Also to say that something must be done.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتاج إلى شيء؛ أو يوجب فعل أمر
entries.example: This job requires a good knowledge of two languages.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you need, or that a rule says you must have or do.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما تحتاج إليه، أو ما تشترط القاعدة أن تملكه أو تفعله
entries.example: A valid passport is a requirement for international travel.

entries.definitionEn: An official written demand for supplies, rooms, or services, especially by an organization or the military.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلب رسمي مكتوب لتوريد مواد أو غرف أو خدمات، ولا سيما من مؤسسة أو الجيش
entries.example: The office filed a requisition for extra chairs.

entries.definitionEn: The act of saving someone or something from danger or a bad situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: إنقاذ شخص أو شيء من خطر أو وضع سيئ
entries.example: The mountain rescue took several hours.

entries.definitionEn: To save someone or something from danger or a bad situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقذ شخصاً أو شيئاً من خطر أو وضع سيئ
entries.example: Firefighters rescued the family from the smoke-filled house.

entries.definitionEn: Careful study to find out new facts about a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: دراسة متأنية لاستكشاف حقائق جديدة في موضوع
entries.example: Her research looks at how children learn to read.

entries.definitionEn: To study a subject carefully in order to discover new facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرس موضوعاً بعناية لاكتشاف حقائق جديدة
entries.example: He spent a year researching the history of the river.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to study a subject carefully and find out new facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص عمله دراسة موضوع بعناية واستكشاف حقائق جديدة
entries.example: The researcher presented her findings at the conference.

entries.definitionEn: To look like someone or something, or to be similar in some way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشبه شخصاً أو شيئاً في الهيئة أو في وجه من الوجوه
entries.example: The younger sister resembles their mother.

entries.definitionEn: To feel bitter or angry because you think you have been treated unfairly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستاء أو يضغن لأنه يرى أنه عومل بغير إنصاف
entries.example: She resented being left out of the discussion.

entries.definitionEn: An arrangement to have a seat, room, or table kept for you. Also a feeling of doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: حجز مقعد أو غرفة أو طاولة؛ وأيضاً تحفّظ أو شك
entries.example: I made a reservation for two at eight o'clock.

entries.definitionEn: A supply kept for later use. Also an area of land protected for wildlife, or a cautious, quiet manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخزون يُحفظ لاستعمال لاحق؛ وأيضاً محمية للحياة البرية، أو تحفّظ في الطبع
entries.example: The hospital keeps a reserve of emergency supplies.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange for a seat, room, or table to be kept for you. Also to keep something for a particular purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحجز مقعداً أو غرفة أو طاولة؛ أو يُبقي شيئاً لغرض معيّن
entries.example: We reserved a table by the window.

entries.definitionEn: A place where someone lives, especially a large or official home. Also the fact of living in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان يسكنه شخص، ولا سيما بيت كبير أو رسمي؛ وأيضاً الإقامة في موضع معيّن
entries.example: The ambassador's residence is near the park.

entries.definitionEn: Living in a particular place.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقيم في مكان معيّن
entries.example: Only resident staff may use that car park.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives in a particular house, area, or country.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يسكن بيتاً أو حياً أو بلداً معيّناً
entries.example: Local residents asked for better street lighting.

entries.definitionEn: Consisting of houses rather than offices or factories; relating to where people live.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكني تغلب عليه البيوت لا المكاتب أو المصانع؛ متعلق بمواضع السكن
entries.example: They bought a house on a quiet residential street.

entries.definitionEn: Remaining after the main part of something has gone or been used.
entries.arabicMeaning: متبقٍّ بعد ذهاب الجزء الأكبر أو استعماله
entries.example: There was a residual smell of paint in the hallway.

entries.definitionEn: A small amount of a substance left after the rest has gone, been used, or been removed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدار يسير من مادة يبقى بعد ذهاب الباقي أو استعماله أو إزالته
entries.example: Wash the pan well so that no residue of oil remains.

entries.definitionEn: To leave a job or position officially, usually by telling your employer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يترك عملاً أو منصباً بصفة رسمية، عادة بإبلاغ صاحب العمل
entries.example: She resigned from the committee last spring.

entries.definitionEn: The act of leaving a job officially. Also calm acceptance of something unpleasant that you cannot change.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترك العمل بصفة رسمية؛ وأيضاً قبول هادئ لأمر مكروه لا سبيل إلى تغييره
entries.example: His resignation takes effect at the end of the month.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to recover quickly from difficulty, shock, or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة على التعافي سريعاً من صعوبة أو صدمة أو تغيّر
entries.example: The team's resilience helped them recover after a poor start.

entries.definitionEn: Able to recover quickly from difficulty. Also able to return to shape after being bent or stretched.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على التعافي سريعاً من الشدة؛ أو يعود إلى هيئته بعد الانحناء أو الشد
entries.example: Young trees are often more resilient in strong wind.

entries.definitionEn: To fight against something or refuse to accept it. Also to stop yourself from doing something you want to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقاوم شيئاً أو يرفض قبوله؛ أو يمنع نفسه عن فعل يشتهيه
entries.example: He tried to resist the urge to check his phone.

entries.definitionEn: The act of fighting against something or refusing to accept it. Also the body's ability to fight illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقاومة شيء أو رفض قبوله؛ وأيضاً قدرة الجسم على مقاومة المرض
entries.example: There was little resistance to the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: A firm decision to do or not do something. Also the solving of a problem, or the sharpness of an image.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزم راسخ على فعل شيء أو تركه؛ وأيضاً حل مشكلة، أو دقة الصورة
entries.example: Her New Year's resolution was to walk every morning.

entries.definitionEn: To find a solution to a problem or argument. Also to decide firmly to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجد حلاً لمشكلة أو خلاف؛ أو يعزم عزماً ثابتاً على فعل شيء
entries.example: They met to resolve the delay in the schedule.

entries.definitionEn: Deep, clear, and continuing in sound. Also having a special meaning that stays with you.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوت عميق واضح ممتد؛ وأيضاً ذو دلالة تبقى في النفس
entries.example: He spoke in a low, resonant voice.

entries.definitionEn: To produce a deep, full sound that continues. Also to have a strong effect because it matches someone's feelings or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث صوتاً عميقاً ممتلئاً يمتد؛ أو يلقى صدى لأنه يوافق شعور أحد أو تجربته
entries.example: Her speech resonated with people who had changed careers later in life.

entries.definitionEn: To turn to something, often as a last choice, because other methods have failed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلجأ إلى أمر، وغالباً بعد نفاد الوسائل الأخرى
entries.example: They resorted to candles when the power failed.

entries.definitionEn: To fill a place with a loud, continuing sound. Also, of news or fame, to be widely talked about.
entries.arabicMeaning: يملأ المكان صوتاً عالياً ممتداً؛ وأيضاً يشيع الخبر أو الذكر فيُتحدَّث به على نطاق واسع
entries.example: Laughter resounded through the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Very loud and echoing. Also, of a success or defeat, very clear and complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالٍ ذو صدى؛ وأيضاً عن نجاح أو هزيمة: واضح تام
entries.example: The proposal won resounding support from the members.

entries.definitionEn: In a very clear, complete, and often loud way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو واضح تام، وغالباً بصوت عالٍ أو أثر قوي
entries.example: The motion was resoundingly defeated.

entries.definitionEn: Something that a country, organization, or person can use, such as money, land, oil, or skills.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يمكن لبلد أو مؤسسة أو شخص استعماله من مال أو أرض أو نفط أو مهارات
entries.example: Water is a vital resource in a dry climate.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of admiration for someone because of their qualities or what they have done. Also polite regard for someone's rights or feelings.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعجاب بشخص لصفاته أو لأفعاله؛ وأيضاً مراعاة مهذّبة لحقوقه أو مشاعره
entries.example: She has great respect for her former teacher.

entries.definitionEn: To admire someone for their qualities or achievements. Also to treat someone's rights, wishes, or feelings as important.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعجب بشخص لصفاته أو إنجازاته؛ أو يراعي حقوقه ورغباته ومشاعره
entries.example: I respect her decision to change careers.

entries.definitionEn: Considered socially acceptable and decent. Also fairly good in amount or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُعدّ لائقاً مقبولاً في المجتمع؛ وأيضاً جيد بقدر معقول في الكم أو النوع
entries.example: He found a respectable job in the town centre.

entries.definitionEn: In a socially acceptable way. Also to a fairly good standard.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لائق اجتماعياً؛ أو بمستوى جيد معقول
entries.example: The team played respectably against a much stronger side.

entries.definitionEn: Admired by many people for your work, character, or knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحظى بإعجاب كثيرين لعمله أو خلقه أو علمه
entries.example: She is a respected voice in local architecture.

entries.definitionEn: The process of breathing; the taking in of air and the giving out of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية التنفس: إدخال الهواء وإخراجه
entries.example: The nurse checked the patient's pulse and respiration.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to breathing or to the organs used for breathing.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالتنفس أو بأعضاء التنفس
entries.example: Cold air can irritate the respiratory system.

entries.definitionEn: A short period of rest from something difficult, tiring, or unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهلة قصيرة من الراحة بعد أمر شاق أو متعب أو مكروه
entries.example: The rain gave the gardeners a brief respite from the heat.

entries.definitionEn: To answer someone. Also to react to something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجيب أحداً؛ أو يتفاعل مع ما حدث
entries.example: She did not respond to the first email.

entries.definitionEn: An answer or a reaction to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جواب أو رد فعل على شيء
entries.example: His response to the invitation was a short thank-you.

entries.definitionEn: A duty to deal with something or take care of someone. Also blame for something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: واجب القيام بأمر أو رعاية أحد؛ وأيضاً تبعة ما وقع
entries.example: It is your responsibility to lock the door.

entries.definitionEn: Having the duty to take care of something. Also being the cause of something, or able to be trusted.
entries.arabicMeaning: عليه واجب العناية بشيء؛ أو هو سبب الأمر، أو أهل للثقة
entries.example: Who is responsible for locking the office?

entries.definitionEn: A period of relaxing after work or effort. Also the remaining part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة راحة بعد عمل أو جهد؛ وأيضاً الجزء الباقي من شيء
entries.example: She needed a rest after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: To stop working or moving in order to relax. Also to place something so that it is supported.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقف عن العمل أو الحركة ليستريح؛ أو يضع شيئاً مستنداً
entries.example: Sit down and rest for a few minutes.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you pay to sit and eat a meal.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان تدفع فيه لتجلس وتأكل وجبة
entries.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near the river.

entries.definitionEn: The act of returning something to an earlier, better condition. Also the return of a former system or leader.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعادة شيء إلى حال أسبق أفضل؛ وأيضاً عودة نظام أو زعيم سابق
entries.example: The restoration of the old theatre took three years.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel stronger, healthier, or more energetic again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد النشاط والقوة أو يحسّن الصحة
entries.example: A swim in cool water can be restorative after a hot day.

entries.definitionEn: To bring something back to an earlier, better condition. Also to give something back to its owner.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد شيئاً إلى حال أسبق أفضل؛ أو يردّه إلى صاحبه
entries.example: They hope to restore the old railway station.

entries.definitionEn: To limit what someone can do, or what is allowed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّ مما يمكن لشخص فعله، أو مما هو مسموح
entries.example: The new rules restrict parking on this street.

entries.definitionEn: A rule or fact that limits what is allowed or possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة أو واقع يحدّ مما هو مسموح أو ممكن
entries.example: There is a restriction on the number of bags you may take.

entries.definitionEn: Something that happens because of something else. Also the score of a game, test, or exam.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يحدث بسبب شيء آخر؛ وأيضاً نتيجة مباراة أو اختبار
entries.example: The result of the test will come tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: To happen because of something else, or to cause a particular outcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتج عن شيء آخر، أو يؤدي إلى عاقبة معيّنة
entries.example: The delay resulted in several missed connections.

entries.definitionEn: To start again after a pause.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستأنف بعد توقف
entries.example: Talks will resume on Monday morning.

entries.definitionEn: To bring someone back to consciousness when they have stopped breathing or their heart has stopped.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد شخصاً إلى الوعي بعد توقف التنفس أو القلب
entries.example: Paramedics managed to resuscitate the swimmer on the beach.

entries.definitionEn: The act of bringing someone back to consciousness when breathing or the heartbeat has stopped.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية إعادة شخص إلى الوعي بعد توقف التنفس أو نبض القلب
entries.example: The staff practised resuscitation once a month.

entries.definitionEn: The sale of goods to the public in shops, not in large amounts to other businesses.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيع السلع للجمهور في المتاجر، لا بالجملة لشركات أخرى
entries.example: She has worked in retail since leaving school.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that sells goods to the public.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أو شركة تبيع السلع للجمهور
entries.example: The retailer offered a discount on last season's coats.

entries.definitionEn: To keep something; to continue to have it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتفظ بشيء ويستمر في امتلاكه
entries.example: The building retains many of its original features.

entries.definitionEn: To slow down the development, progress, or speed of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبطئ نمو شيء أو تقدمه أو سرعته
entries.example: Cold nights can retard the growth of young plants.

entries.definitionEn: To tell a story again, often in a new way or to a new audience.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد سرد قصة، غالباً بأسلوب جديد أو لجمهور آخر
entries.example: The teacher asked the class to retell the story in their own words.

entries.definitionEn: The continued keeping of something. Also the ability to remember information.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاستمرار في الاحتفاظ بشيء؛ وأيضاً القدرة على تذكر المعلومات
entries.example: The course measures students' retention of key terms.

entries.definitionEn: The layer at the back of the eye that is sensitive to light and sends signals to the brain.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبقة في مؤخرة العين حسّاسة للضوء وترسل إشارات إلى الدماغ
entries.example: The doctor examined the retina for signs of damage.

entries.definitionEn: To stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتوقف عن العمل، عادة لبلوغ سن معيّنة
entries.example: He plans to retire next year.

entries.definitionEn: No longer working, usually because of age.
entries.arabicMeaning: لم يعد يعمل، عادة بسبب السن
entries.example: My retired neighbour walks by the river every morning.

entries.definitionEn: The period of life after you have stopped working, or the act of stopping work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرحلة الحياة بعد ترك العمل، أو فعل التوقف عن العمل
entries.example: She moved to the coast after retirement.

entries.definitionEn: To go back along the same path. Also to go over events again in your mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعود على الأثر في السبيل نفسه؛ أو يستعيد الأحداث في ذهنه
entries.example: They had to retrace their steps to find the dropped keys.

entries.definitionEn: A movement back from a position, especially by an army. Also a quiet place where people go to rest.
entries.arabicMeaning: تراجع عن موقع، ولا سيما للجيش؛ وأيضاً مكان هادئ يُقصد للراحة
entries.example: The army's retreat left the valley undefended.

entries.definitionEn: To move back from a position, especially to avoid danger. Also to go to a quiet place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتراجع عن موقع، ولا سيما اتقاءً للخطر؛ أو يذهب إلى مكان هادئ
entries.example: The hikers retreated when the fog grew thicker.

entries.definitionEn: To get something back from the place where it was. Also to find and bring back stored information.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعيد شيئاً من حيث كان؛ أو يجد معلومات مخزّنة ويجلبها
entries.example: The dog ran to retrieve the ball from the long grass.

entries.definitionEn: The act of looking back at past events and thinking about them.
entries.arabicMeaning: النظر في أحداث الماضي والتأمل فيها
entries.example: In quiet retrospection he saw how small choices had added up.

entries.definitionEn: Looking back at the past. Also applying to a period before a rule or decision was made.
entries.arabicMeaning: استعادي ينظر إلى الماضي؛ أو يسري على مدة سابقة لوضع القاعدة أو القرار
entries.example: The museum held a retrospective exhibition of her early work.

entries.definitionEn: The act of going or coming back. Also a ticket for a trip there and back.
entries.arabicMeaning: عودة إلى مكان؛ وأيضاً تذكرة ذهاب وإياب
entries.example: We bought a return ticket to the city.

entries.definitionEn: To go or come back to a place. Also to give something back.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذهب أو يأتي عائداً إلى مكان؛ أو يردّ شيئاً
entries.example: She will return the books on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: The act of joining together again, especially a country that was divided.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعادة جمع ما تفرّق، ولا سيما توحيد بلد كان منقسماً
entries.example: Talks on reunification lasted for several years.

entries.definitionEn: To join a divided country, group, or family together again.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد توحيد بلد أو جماعة أو أسرة كانت منقسمة
entries.example: Leaders promised to reunify the split organization.

entries.definitionEn: A meeting of people who have not seen each other for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقاء أناس طال فراقهم
entries.example: The school reunion is held every five years.

entries.definitionEn: To show something that was hidden. Also to make unknown information known.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُظهر شيئاً كان خفياً؛ أو يعلن معلومة لم تكن معروفة
entries.example: The curtains opened to reveal a simple wooden stage.

entries.definitionEn: Showing something that was hidden, especially a truth about a person or situation. Also, of clothes, showing a lot of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكشف أمراً كان خفياً، ولا سيما حقيقة عن شخص أو موقف؛ وعن اللباس: يكشف كثيراً من الجسد
entries.example: The interview was revealing about how the decision was made.

entries.definitionEn: A surprising fact that becomes known. Also the act of making something secret known.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقيقة مفاجئة تظهر للعلن؛ أو فعل كشف سر
entries.example: His letter contained a revelation about the missing funds.

entries.definitionEn: Making something previously hidden clearly known; highly revealing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكشف بجلاء أمراً كان خفياً؛ شديد الإبانة
entries.example: The diary was revelatory about her years abroad.

entries.definitionEn: Harm done to someone because they harmed you.
entries.arabicMeaning: أذى يُلحَق بشخص لأنه قد آذى من قبل
entries.example: The play is about a man who seeks revenge after a betrayal.

entries.definitionEn: Money that a company, organization, or government receives from sales or taxes.
entries.arabicMeaning: مال يدخل على شركة أو مؤسسة أو حكومة من مبيعات أو ضرائب
entries.example: Ticket sales are the museum's main source of revenue.

entries.definitionEn: An echoing sound effect, especially one added to recorded music or a voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر صوتي للصدى، ولا سيما ما يُضاف إلى موسيقى مسجّلة أو صوت
entries.example: The producer added a little reverb to the vocal track.

entries.definitionEn: To echo repeatedly in a space. Also, of an event, to have continuing effects.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتردد صداه مراراً في مكان؛ وعن حدث: يمتد أثره
entries.example: Footsteps reverberated in the empty stairwell.

entries.definitionEn: A continuing echo in a space. Also a lasting effect of an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدى ممتد في المكان؛ وأيضاً أثر باقٍ لحدث
entries.example: The last chord faded in a long reverberation.

entries.definitionEn: To respect and admire someone or something very deeply.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجلّ شخصاً أو شيئاً إجلالاً عميقاً
entries.example: Many readers still revere the poet's late essays.

entries.definitionEn: Deep respect mixed with admiration or awe.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقير عميق يخالطه إعجاب أو مهابة
entries.example: They spoke of the old craftsman with genuine reverence.

entries.definitionEn: To change something to the opposite. Also to make a vehicle go backwards.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعكس الشيء إلى ضدّه؛ أو يجعل مركبة تسير إلى الخلف
entries.example: The driver had to reverse out of the narrow lane.

entries.definitionEn: A report that says what someone thinks of a book, film, or product. Also a careful look at something again.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقرير يبيّن رأي شخص في كتاب أو فيلم أو منتج؛ وأيضاً إعادة نظر متأنية
entries.example: I read a review of the new film.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something again in order to check or improve it. Also to write an opinion of a book, film, or product.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد النظر في شيء للتحقق منه أو تحسينه؛ أو يكتب رأياً في كتاب أو فيلم أو منتج
entries.example: The committee will review the proposal next week.

entries.definitionEn: To criticize someone in an angry, insulting way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشنّع على شخص بكلام غاضب مهين
entries.example: Crowds used to revile the tax collector in the old plays.

entries.definitionEn: To change a text or plan in order to correct or improve it. Also, especially in British English, to study again before an exam.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعدّل نصاً أو خطة ليصحّحها أو يحسّنها؛ وفي الإنكليزية البريطانية خصوصاً: يراجع دروسه قبل الامتحان
entries.example: She spent the weekend revising her essay.

entries.definitionEn: A change made to improve a text or plan. Also, especially in British English, the work of studying again before an exam.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعديل يُدخل لتحسين نص أو خطة؛ وفي الإنكليزية البريطانية خصوصاً: مراجعة الدروس قبل الامتحان
entries.example: The second revision of the report is much clearer.

entries.definitionEn: A return to strength, popularity, or activity after a period of weakness.
entries.arabicMeaning: عودة إلى القوة أو الرواج أو النشاط بعد ضعف
entries.example: There has been a revival of interest in handwritten letters.

entries.definitionEn: To become or make something become active, healthy, or popular again.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشط أو يُنشط شيئاً فيعود إلى الصحة أو الرواج أو الحيوية
entries.example: A cup of tea helped revive her after the long meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, complete change in government, often by force. Also a very big change in methods or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغيير مفاجئ تام في الحكم، وغالباً بالقوة؛ وأيضاً تحوّل كبير في الأساليب أو الأفكار
entries.example: The invention of the printing press caused a revolution in learning.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with a political revolution. Also completely new and likely to cause a big change.
entries.arabicMeaning: متصل بثورة سياسية؛ أو جديد كل الجدة وقد يُحدث تغييراً كبيراً
entries.example: The design was revolutionary for its time.

entries.definitionEn: To change something completely, especially by making it much better or more modern.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث تغييراً تاماً في شيء، ولا سيما بجعله أفضل أو أحدث بكثير
entries.example: Online maps revolutionized the way people find their way in a city.

entries.definitionEn: To turn in a circle around a central point. Also, of life or talk, to have something as the main subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدور حول نقطة وسطى؛ وعن الحياة أو الحديث: يكون شيء محورَه
entries.example: The Earth revolves around the Sun.

entries.definitionEn: A strong, sudden feeling of disgust.
entries.arabicMeaning: اشمئزاز شديد مفاجئ
entries.example: She drew back in revulsion at the smell from the drain.

entries.definitionEn: Something given in return for good work, effort, or help, or for finding something that was lost.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يُعطى مقابل عمل جيد أو جهد أو عون، أو مقابل العثور على ضالة
entries.example: There is a small reward for anyone who finds the missing cat.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone something in return for good work, effort, or help.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكافئ شخصاً مقابل عمل جيد أو جهد أو عون
entries.example: The company rewarded the team with an extra day off.

entries.definitionEn: To write something again in a different or better way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعيد كتابة شيء بأسلوب مختلف أو أفضل
entries.example: The editor asked her to rewrite the opening paragraph.

entries.definitionEn: Skillful language used to persuade, sometimes without honest meaning. Also the art of speaking or writing effectively.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلام بارع يُقصد به الإقناع، وقد يخلو من صدق المعنى؛ وأيضاً فن الخطابة والكتابة المؤثرة
entries.example: The speech was full of rhetoric but short on practical detail.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the art of persuasive speaking or writing. Also, of a question, asked for effect rather than for an answer.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بفن الإقناع في الكلام أو الكتابة؛ وعن السؤال: يُلقى للتأثير لا لطلب جواب
entries.example: It was a rhetorical question, and no one was expected to answer.
