entries.definitionEn: In a way that uses language for effect or persuasion, not to seek a real answer or simple fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يستعمل اللغة للتأثير أو الإقناع، لا لطلب جواب حقيقي أو واقعة بسيطة
entries.example: She asked rhetorically whether anyone still believed the old timetable would work.

entries.definitionEn: A large, heavy animal with thick skin and one or two horns on its nose, found in Africa and Asia.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان ضخم ثقيل ذو جلد غليظ وقرن أو قرنين على أنفه، يعيش في أفريقيا وآسيا
entries.example: The rhinoceros stood still at the edge of the watering hole.

entries.definitionEn: To end with the same sound as another word. Also to write lines of verse that do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتقفّى مع كلمة أخرى بأن ينتهي بالصوت نفسه؛ أو ينظم أبياتاً على قافية
entries.example: In English, light and night rhyme.

entries.definitionEn: A regular pattern of sounds or movements, especially in music or speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيقاع: نمط منتظم من الأصوات أو الحركات، ولا سيما في الموسيقى أو الكلام
entries.example: She clapped along with the rhythm of the song.

entries.definitionEn: Having a regular, repeating pattern of sound or movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيقاعي: ذو نمط صوتي أو حركي منتظم يتكرر
entries.example: The dancers moved in rhythmic steps across the floor.

entries.definitionEn: One of the curved bones that protect the chest. Also a cut of meat from this part of an animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضلع من عظام القفص الصدري؛ وأيضاً قطعة لحم من هذا الموضع
entries.example: He felt a sharp pain in his left rib after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: A long, thin strip of cloth used for tying or decorating something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريط قماش رفيع يُستعمل للربط أو الزينة
entries.example: She tied a blue ribbon around the gift.

entries.definitionEn: Small white or brown grains from a plant, cooked and eaten as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأرز: حبّات صغيرة تُطبخ وتُؤكل
entries.example: We had rice with vegetables for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: So old or poorly made that it shakes and seems likely to collapse.
entries.arabicMeaning: متداعٍ واهن، يهتز ويكاد ينهار من القدم أو سوء الصنع
entries.example: They climbed the rickety wooden stairs with care.

entries.definitionEn: To make a person or place free of something unwanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخلّص شخصاً أو مكاناً من شيء غير مرغوب فيه
entries.example: They finally rid the kitchen of ants.

entries.definitionEn: A puzzling question that has a clever or unexpected answer.
entries.arabicMeaning: لغز: سؤال محيّر له جواب ذكي أو غير متوقع
entries.example: The children tried to solve the riddle before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To make a great many holes in something, or to fill it with faults.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثقّب شيئاً بكثرة، أو يملؤه بالعيوب
entries.example: Insects had riddled the wooden fence with tiny holes.

entries.definitionEn: A journey on a bicycle, a horse, or in a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة ركوب على دراجة أو حصان أو في مركبة
entries.example: We went for a ride along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: To sit on a bicycle, horse, or similar thing and travel. Also to travel in a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركب دراجة أو حصاناً ونحوهما؛ وأيضاً يسافر في مركبة
entries.example: She learned to ride a bicycle when she was six.

entries.definitionEn: A person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle.
entries.arabicMeaning: راكب حصان أو دراجة أو دراجة نارية
entries.example: The rider stopped to check the horse's shoe.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow raised line, especially of hills or of high ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرف أو سلسلة مرتفعة ضيقة، ولا سيما من التلال أو الأرض العالية
entries.example: They walked along the ridge and looked down at the valley.

entries.definitionEn: Very silly or unreasonable; easy to laugh at in a critical way.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخيف أو غير معقول إلى حد يثير السخرية
entries.example: It is ridiculous to wait three hours for a five-minute meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Very common, especially of something unwelcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفشٍ على نطاق واسع، وغالباً لأمر مكروه
entries.example: Rumours were rife in the office before the announcement.

entries.definitionEn: A serious break in a relationship. Also a crack in rock, ice, or the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرخ خطير في علاقة؛ وأيضاً صدع في صخر أو جليد أو أرض
entries.example: A rift opened between the two friends after the argument.

entries.definitionEn: Correct. Also on the side that is not the left.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيح؛ وأيضاً واقع على الجهة التي ليست اليسار
entries.example: You gave the right answer to the question.

entries.definitionEn: Exactly, completely, or immediately.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً أو فوراً؛ للدلالة على الموضع أو الزمان بدقة
entries.example: The keys are right here on the table.

entries.definitionEn: On or toward the right side of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيمن؛ واقع على جهة اليمين أو نحوها
entries.example: The cups are on the right-hand shelf.

entries.definitionEn: Something you are allowed to have or do by law or fairness. Also the right-hand side.
entries.arabicMeaning: حق يبيحه القانون أو الإنصاف؛ وأيضاً جهة اليمين
entries.example: Everyone has the right to a fair hearing.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being morally right and acting according to what is just.
entries.arabicMeaning: البرّ والصلاح: الاستقامة الخلقية والعمل بما هو عادل
entries.example: The speech praised righteousness over easy success.

entries.definitionEn: Correctly; for a good reason.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن حق؛ بصورة صحيحة ولسبب وجيه
entries.example: She was rightly proud of the work she had done.

entries.definitionEn: The outer edge of a circular object, such as a cup, a wheel, or a pair of glasses.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحافة الدائرية لكأس أو عجلة أو إطار نظارة
entries.example: A chip appeared on the rim of the glass.

entries.definitionEn: A circle of metal worn on a finger. Also any circular band or shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاتم يُلبس في الإصبع؛ وأيضاً أي حلقة أو شكل دائري
entries.example: He bought a gold ring for their anniversary.

entries.definitionEn: To make a sound like a bell, or to call someone on the phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرنّ كالجرس، أو يتّصل بشخص بالهاتف
entries.example: Please ring me when you arrive at the station.

entries.definitionEn: To tear something quickly or with force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمزّق شيئاً بسرعة أو بقوة
entries.example: Be careful not to rip the paper when you open the envelope.

entries.definitionEn: Fully grown and ready to eat, of fruit or crops. Also ready for a particular action.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناضج جاهز للأكل من الثمر أو الزرع؛ وأيضاً مهيأ لأمر ما
entries.example: The peaches are ripe and sweet this week.

entries.definitionEn: An increase in amount, level, or number. Also an upward movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتفاع أو زيادة في مقدار أو مستوى أو عدد؛ وأيضاً حركة إلى الأعلى
entries.example: There has been a rise in the price of coffee.

entries.definitionEn: To go up, to increase, or to get up from a sitting or lying position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتفع أو يزيد أو ينهض من جلوس أو اضطجاع
entries.example: The sun will rise just after six tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The possibility that something bad may happen. Also a person or thing that may cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: احتمال وقوع أمر سيئ؛ وأيضاً شخص أو شيء قد يسبب ضرراً
entries.example: There is a risk of ice on the roads tonight.

entries.definitionEn: To put something in danger, or to do something that might have a bad result.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرّض شيئاً للخطر، أو يقدم على فعل قد تكون عاقبته سيئة
entries.example: She did not want to risk missing the last train.

entries.definitionEn: Involving a chance of harm, loss, or failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: محفوف بالمخاطر: ينطوي على احتمال أذى أو خسارة أو فشل
entries.example: Investing all your money in one company is risky.

entries.definitionEn: A formal ceremony, often religious, that follows a set of traditional actions.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعيرة أو طقس رسمي، وغالباً ديني، يجري وفق أفعال متوارثة
entries.example: The wedding rite lasted a little over an hour.

entries.definitionEn: A set of actions performed in a fixed way, in religion or in everyday life.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقس: مجموعة أفعال تُؤدّى بنظام ثابت في الدين أو في الحياة اليومية
entries.example: Making tea was part of her morning ritual.

entries.definitionEn: A person, team, or company that you compete with.
entries.arabicMeaning: منافس من الأشخاص أو الفرق أو الشركات
entries.example: The two bakeries have been rivals for years.

entries.definitionEn: A large natural stream of water that flows across the land to a sea or lake.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهر: مجرى ماء طبيعي كبير يصب في بحر أو بحيرة
entries.example: They sat by the river and watched the boats.

entries.definitionEn: So interesting or exciting that you cannot look away.
entries.arabicMeaning: آسر بالغ التشويق حتى لا تكاد تصرف عنه نظرك
entries.example: The documentary was riveting from the first minute.

entries.definitionEn: A hard path for cars, buses, and other vehicles to travel on.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريق معبّد تسير عليه السيارات والحافلات وغيرها
entries.example: The road to the village is narrow and quiet.

entries.definitionEn: The area along the edge of a road.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب الطريق وحافته
entries.example: They waited at the roadside for the next bus.

entries.definitionEn: A period of wandering freely, with no fixed route.
entries.arabicMeaning: جولة تجوال حرّ بلا مسار محدّد
entries.example: After a roam through the old market they stopped for tea.

entries.definitionEn: To make a long, loud, deep sound, like a lion, a crowd, or a strong engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزأر أو يدوي صوتاً عميقاً طويلاً كالأسد أو الحشد أو المحرّك القوي
entries.example: The crowd began to roar when the team scored.

entries.definitionEn: Cooked in an oven or over a fire, used especially before names of food.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشوي في الفرن أو على النار، وغالباً قبل اسم الطعام
entries.example: They served roast chicken with potatoes.

entries.definitionEn: To cook food in an oven or over a fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشوي الطعام في الفرن أو على النار
entries.example: Roast the vegetables until they are brown at the edges.

entries.definitionEn: To steal from a person or a place, often using force or threats.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرق شخصاً أو مكاناً، وغالباً بالقوة أو التهديد
entries.example: Two men tried to rob the small shop after closing time.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of stealing from a person or place, often with force.
entries.arabicMeaning: جريمة السطو: سرقة من شخص أو مكان وغالباً بالقوة
entries.example: The police are investigating a robbery at the post office.

entries.definitionEn: A small bird with a red face and chest, often seen in gardens.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبو الحناء: طائر صغير أحمر الوجه والصدر يُرى كثيراً في الحدائق
entries.example: A robin landed on the garden fence.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that can do some of the work of a person, often controlled by a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: روبوت: آلة تؤدي بعض عمل الإنسان، وغالباً يتحكّم فيها حاسوب
entries.example: The factory uses a robot to pack the boxes.

entries.definitionEn: Strong and not easily damaged. Also, of a system or argument, sound and effective.
entries.arabicMeaning: متين لا يسهل إتلافه؛ ورصين فعّال إذا وُصف به نظام أو حجة
entries.example: The table is made of a robust hardwood.

entries.definitionEn: In a strong, determined, or sturdy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقوة وعزم ومتانة
entries.example: She robustly defended her research methods.

entries.definitionEn: A hard piece of stone. Also a kind of loud popular music.
entries.arabicMeaning: صخرة أو قطعة حجر صلبة؛ وأيضاً ضرب من الموسيقى الصاخبة الشائعة
entries.example: He sat on a rock by the sea and ate his lunch.

entries.definitionEn: To move gently from side to side, or to make something do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمايل بلطف يمنة ويسرة، أو يهزّ شيئاً كذلك
entries.example: She rocked the baby until he fell asleep.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle shaped like a tube that is driven into the air by burning fuel, used to reach space or as a weapon.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاروخ: مركبة أنبوبية تُدفع بحرق الوقود إلى الفضاء أو تُستعمل سلاحاً
entries.example: The rocket lifted off just after dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with or full of rocks. Also difficult and uncertain.
entries.arabicMeaning: صخري أو مليء بالحجارة؛ وأيضاً صعب غير مستقر
entries.example: The path up the hill was rocky and slow.

entries.definitionEn: The part that someone has in a play, film, or real situation. Also a person's job or duty.
entries.arabicMeaning: دور في مسرحية أو فيلم أو موقف حقيقي؛ وأيضاً مهمة الشخص أو واجبه
entries.example: Her role in the play is the doctor.

entries.definitionEn: A small round piece of bread. Also something formed into a tube, such as paper.
entries.arabicMeaning: لفة خبز صغيرة مستديرة؛ وأيضاً شيء ملفوف على هيئة أنبوب كالورق
entries.example: She bought a cheese roll for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: To move by turning over and over, or to form something into a tube or ball.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدحرج بالدوران المتكرر، أو يلفّ شيئاً على هيئة أنبوب أو كرة
entries.example: The ball rolled under the table.

entries.definitionEn: Having a surface that rises and falls in gentle waves. Also continuing steadily.
entries.arabicMeaning: متموّج السطح يرتفع وينخفض بلطف؛ وأيضاً مستمر بانتظام
entries.example: The train passed through rolling green hills.

entries.definitionEn: A close love relationship, or a story about one.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاقة حب وثيقة، أو قصة تدور حولها
entries.example: Their summer romance began on a train journey.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with love, or showing strong feelings of love. Also appealing in an emotional, often idealised, way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رومانسي: متعلق بالحب أو مظهر لمشاعر قوية؛ وأيضاً جذّاب على نحو عاطفي مثالي
entries.example: They had a romantic dinner by the window.

entries.definitionEn: To play in a lively, energetic way. Also to win easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمرح بحيوية صاخبة؛ أو يفوز بسهولة بالغة
entries.example: The puppies romped across the wet grass.

entries.definitionEn: A one-piece garment with short legs, worn by a baby or as casual adult clothing.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة ملابس واحدة قصيرة الساقين، للرضيع أو لباساً كاجوال للكبار
entries.example: The baby wore a cotton romper in the heat.

entries.definitionEn: The top covering of a building, car, or other structure.
entries.arabicMeaning: سقف المبنى أو السيارة أو أي منشأة
entries.example: Rain drummed on the roof all night.

entries.definitionEn: A space inside a building with its own walls and door.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة: حيّز داخل مبنى له جدرانه وبابه
entries.example: This room is bright in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: To live in a rented room, or to share a room with someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسكن في غرفة مستأجرة، أو يشارك غيره غرفة
entries.example: She roomed with her cousin during her first year at college.

entries.definitionEn: A person who shares a room or home with you, especially as a student or tenant.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل السكن الذي يشاركك غرفة أو منزلاً، ولا سيما في الدراسة أو الإيجار
entries.example: My roommate cooks dinner on weekdays.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a plant that grows under the ground and takes in water. Also the origin of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذر النبات تحت الأرض يمتص الماء؛ وأيضاً أصل الشيء ومنشؤه
entries.example: Be careful not to damage the roots when you move the plant.

entries.definitionEn: A strong, thick cord made by twisting threads together, used for tying or pulling.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبل قوي غليظ من خيوط مفتولة يُستعمل للربط أو الشدّ
entries.example: They used a rope to pull the box up the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: A flower with a sweet smell, often given as a gift, that grows on a bush with thorns.
entries.arabicMeaning: وردة عطرة تُهدى كثيراً، تنمو على شجيرة ذات أشواك
entries.example: He put a red rose in a tall glass of water.

entries.definitionEn: Pink like a rose. Also hopeful and likely to go well.
entries.arabicMeaning: وردي كلون الوردة؛ وأيضاً متفائل يُرجى أن يسير على ما يرام
entries.example: The report painted a rosy picture of next year's sales.

entries.definitionEn: To turn around a central point, or to cause something to do so. Also to take turns in a regular order.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدور حول محور أو يدير شيئاً كذلك؛ وأيضاً يتناوب بنظام
entries.example: The Earth rotates once every twenty-four hours.

entries.definitionEn: Decayed and no longer good to eat or use. Also very bad or unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعفّن لم يعد صالحاً للأكل أو الاستعمال؛ وأيضاً سيئ أو كريه جداً
entries.example: The fruit at the bottom of the bowl was rotten.

entries.definitionEn: Not smooth, gentle, or exact. Also stormy, or only approximate.
entries.arabicMeaning: خشن غير أملس أو رقيق أو دقيق؛ وأيضاً عاصف أو تقريبي
entries.example: The road was rough after the heavy rain.

entries.definitionEn: About; not exactly. Also in a way that is not gentle.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً لا على وجه الدقة؛ وأيضاً بخشونة
entries.example: There were roughly twenty people in the room.

entries.definitionEn: Shaped like a circle or a ball.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستدير كالدائرة أو الكرة
entries.example: They sat at a round table in the corner.

entries.definitionEn: In a circle, to the other side, or to various places nearby.
entries.arabicMeaning: في دائرة، أو إلى الجهة الأخرى، أو في أرجاء المكان القريب
entries.example: Turn round and look at the view behind you.

entries.definitionEn: One stage in a competition or set of talks. Also drinks for everyone in a group, or a circular slice.
entries.arabicMeaning: جولة من مسابقة أو مفاوضات؛ وأيضاً مشروبات للمجموعة أو شريحة دائرية
entries.example: She won the first round of the contest.

entries.definitionEn: On all sides of something; around. Also used for movement in a circle or to various places.
entries.arabicMeaning: حول شيء من كل جهاته؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً للحركة في دائرة أو في أرجاء المكان
entries.example: They sat round the table and shared a meal.

entries.definitionEn: To go around a corner or bend. Also to make something curved, or to change a number to the nearest whole number.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدور حول منعطف؛ أو يجعل الشيء مقوّساً؛ أو يقرّب رقماً إلى أقرب عدد صحيح
entries.example: The car rounded the corner a little too fast.

entries.definitionEn: A circular road junction where traffic moves in one direction around a central island.
entries.arabicMeaning: دوار مروري: تقاطع دائري تسير فيه المركبات باتجاه واحد حول جزيرة وسطى
entries.example: Take the second exit at the roundabout.

entries.definitionEn: A short summary of the main points. Also the gathering of people or animals into one place.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجز جامع لأبرز النقاط؛ وأيضاً تجميع أشخاص أو حيوانات في موضع واحد
entries.example: Here is a roundup of today's main stories.

entries.definitionEn: A way from one place to another that you travel along.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسار أو طريق محدد من موضع إلى آخر
entries.example: This is the fastest route to the airport.

entries.definitionEn: The usual order in which you do things, especially every day.
entries.arabicMeaning: روتين: الترتيب المعتاد لأعمالك، ولا سيما كل يوم
entries.example: Exercise is part of her daily routine.

entries.definitionEn: A line of people or things side by side.
entries.arabicMeaning: صف من أشخاص أو أشياء متجاورة
entries.example: Please sit in the front row.

entries.definitionEn: To move a boat through water using oars.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجدّف قارباً بالمجاديف عبر الماء
entries.example: They rowed across the quiet lake at sunrise.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with a king, a queen, or their family.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملكي: متعلق بملك أو ملكة أو أسرتهما
entries.example: The royal garden is open to visitors on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: Members of a royal family. Also money paid to a writer or inventor when their work is used.
entries.arabicMeaning: أفراد الأسرة المالكة؛ وأيضاً عائد يُدفع لمؤلّف أو مخترع عند استعمال عمله
entries.example: Royalty attended the opening of the new gallery.

entries.definitionEn: To press and move your hand or a cloth over a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرك سطحاً باليد أو بقطعة قماش ضاغطاً ومحرّكاً
entries.example: Rub the lotion into your hands until it disappears.

entries.definitionEn: A strong elastic material made from the juice of a tropical tree or from chemicals. In British English, also a small object used to remove pencil marks.
entries.arabicMeaning: المطاط: مادة مرنة قوية؛ وفي الإنجليزية البريطانية أيضاً ممحاة للقلم الرصاص
entries.example: The tyres are made of thick black rubber.

entries.definitionEn: Things that you throw away because they are no longer useful. Also something you think is nonsense or of very poor quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفايات تُرمى لأنها لم تعد نافعة؛ وأيضاً كلام فارغ أو شيء رديء جداً
entries.example: Please put the rubbish in the bin outside.

entries.definitionEn: Broken stones and bricks from a building that has been destroyed or knocked down.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنقاض: حجارة ولبن مكسّر من مبنى هُدم أو دُمّر
entries.example: Workers cleared the rubble from the old wall.

entries.definitionEn: Not polite; speaking or acting in a way that offends people.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقح غير مهذّب في القول أو الفعل
entries.example: It is rude to interrupt when someone is speaking.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not polite and may offend people.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوقاحة تخلّ بالأدب وقد تسيء إلى الناس
entries.example: He laughed rudely during the quiet speech.

entries.definitionEn: Basic and not yet fully developed.
entries.arabicMeaning: أوليّ بدائي لم يكتمل نموّه بعد
entries.example: He had only a rudimentary knowledge of the software.

entries.definitionEn: The simplest first facts or skills of a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: المبادئ الأولية لأبسط حقائق مادة أو مهاراتها
entries.example: She taught him the rudiments of cooking in a week.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of thick cloth used to cover part of a floor.
entries.arabicMeaning: سجادة صغيرة سميكة تُفرش على جزء من الأرض
entries.example: A thick rug covered the wooden floor.

entries.definitionEn: A team sport in which players carry, kick, and pass an oval ball, using their hands and feet.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرغبي: رياضة جماعية تُحمل فيها كرة بيضاوية وتُركل وتُمرَّر باليد والقدم
entries.example: He plays rugby with friends on Saturday mornings.

entries.definitionEn: The broken remains of a building. Also the state of being severely damaged or destroyed.
entries.arabicMeaning: أطلال مبنى مهدّم؛ وأيضاً حال الدمار الشديد
entries.example: We walked among the ruins of the old castle.

entries.definitionEn: To spoil or destroy something completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفسد شيئاً أو يدمّره تماماً
entries.example: The sudden rain will ruin the picnic if we stay outside.

entries.definitionEn: Causing severe damage or collapse, especially financial collapse.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمّر يفضي إلى خراب شديد، ولا سيما مالياً
entries.example: The legal fees would have been ruinous for a small firm.

entries.definitionEn: An official instruction that says what you must or must not do.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاعدة أو تعليم رسمي بما يجب فعله أو اجتنابه
entries.example: The first rule is to listen when others are speaking.

entries.definitionEn: To have official power over a country or group. Also, of a court, to make an official decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحكم بلداً أو جماعة بسلطة رسمية؛ أو يُصدر قراراً قضائياً رسمياً
entries.example: The queen ruled the country for many years.

entries.definitionEn: A straight piece of wood or plastic with marks, used for measuring or drawing lines.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسطرة: قطعة مستقيمة معلّمة تُستعمل للقياس أو لرسم الخطوط
entries.example: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.

entries.definitionEn: A low, continuous rolling sound, like distant thunder or heavy traffic.
entries.arabicMeaning: دويّ خفيض مستمر كالرعد البعيد أو مرور المركبات الثقيلة
entries.example: We heard a rumble of thunder in the distance.

entries.definitionEn: To make a low, continuous rolling sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدوي دويّاً خفيضاً متواصلاً
entries.example: Thunder rumbled over the hills all evening.

entries.definitionEn: Chewing food again after swallowing it, as cows and sheep do; relating to such animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجترّ: يعيد مضغ الطعام بعد ابتلاعه كالبقر والغنم؛ أو متعلق بهذه الحيوانات
entries.example: Sheep are ruminant animals with a complex stomach.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something slowly and at length. Also, of some animals, to chew food again after swallowing it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُطيل التفكير في أمر على مهل؛ وأيضاً يجترّ الحيوان طعامه بعد ابتلاعه
entries.example: She ruminated on the decision all weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Long, circling thought about something. Also the chewing of cud by certain animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطالة التفكير الدائري في أمر؛ وأيضاً اجترار بعض الحيوانات لطعامها
entries.example: Late-night rumination kept him from sleep.

entries.definitionEn: Given to long, quiet thought.
entries.arabicMeaning: تأملي ميّال إلى التفكير الطويل الهادئ
entries.example: He spoke in a quiet, ruminative voice.

entries.definitionEn: A story or piece of information that people talk about, which may not be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: شائعة: خبر يتداوله الناس وقد لا يكون صحيحاً
entries.example: A rumour spread that the shop would close next month.

entries.definitionEn: An act of running, often for exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: ركضة أو جولة جري، وغالباً للتمرين
entries.example: I went for a run before breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: To move faster than walking, with both feet off the ground in turn.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجري أسرع من المشي، وقدماهُ ترتفعان عن الأرض بالتناوب
entries.example: The children run in the park after school.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has left home or a place without permission, especially a young person.
entries.arabicMeaning: هارب غادر بيته أو موضعه من غير إذن، ولا سيما إن كان يافعاً
entries.example: The police found the runaway waiting at the station.

entries.definitionEn: A person who runs, especially in a race or for exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدّاء يركض في سباق أو للتمرين
entries.example: The runner crossed the finish line first.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of moving fast on foot.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجري رياضة أو نشاطاً
entries.example: Running is good for your heart if you start slowly.

entries.definitionEn: A long, wide strip of ground at an airport where planes take off and land.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرج المطار: شريط طويل عريض تقلع منه الطائرات وتهبط عليه
entries.example: The plane taxied onto the runway and waited for clearance.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the countryside rather than towns or cities.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريفي: متعلق بالريف لا بالمدن
entries.example: They moved to a rural village after they retired.

entries.definitionEn: The busy time of day when many people are travelling to or from work.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة الذروة: وقت ازدحام التنقّل من العمل وإليه
entries.example: I try not to drive during rush hour.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden fast movement, or a period of hurried activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: اندفاع مفاجئ أو فترة عجلة شديدة
entries.example: There was a rush for the door when the bell rang.

entries.definitionEn: To move or do something very quickly, often because there is little time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرع في الحركة أو العمل، وغالباً لضيق الوقت
entries.example: We had to rush to catch the bus.

entries.definitionEn: A light, dry sound like leaves, paper, or cloth moving together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفيف خفيف كأوراق الشجر أو الورق أو القماش إذا تحرك
entries.example: She heard the rustle of dry leaves behind her.

entries.definitionEn: To make a light, dry sound, or to cause leaves, paper, or cloth to do so.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث حفيفاً خفيفاً، أو يحرّك ورقاً أو قماشاً حتى يحفّ
entries.example: The papers rustled in the draught from the window.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with rust. Also, of a skill, weaker because it has not been used for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدئ قد علاه الصدأ؛ ومهارة ضعفت من طول الترك
entries.example: The old bicycle was rusty after years in the shed.

entries.definitionEn: Hard and determined, with no pity for others, in order to get what you want.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاسٍ لا يرحم، حازم في بلوغ مراده بلا شفقة
entries.example: The company was ruthless in cutting costs that year.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of acting without pity in pursuit of a goal.
entries.arabicMeaning: القسوة بلا رحمة في السعي إلى غاية
entries.example: His ruthlessness in negotiation surprised even his colleagues.

entries.definitionEn: The short form of is or has, added to a noun or pronoun.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة مختصرة من is أو has تُلحق بالاسم أو الضمير
entries.example: She's already finished her homework.

entries.definitionEn: To dismiss someone from a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصل شخصاً من عمله
entries.example: The firm sacked him after repeated late arrivals.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with God or religion, and treated with great respect. Also too important to be interfered with.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدّس متصل بالدين ويُعامل باحترام بالغ؛ وأيضاً أجلّ من أن يُمسّ
entries.example: Visitors removed their shoes before entering the sacred hall.

entries.definitionEn: The act of giving up something valued for a more important purpose. Also an offering made in a religious ceremony.
entries.arabicMeaning: تضحية بالتخلي عن شيء عزيز لغاية أهم؛ وأيضاً قربان في شعيرة دينية
entries.example: Moving abroad meant a sacrifice of time with her family.

entries.definitionEn: To give up something valued in order to achieve something more important.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضحّي بشيء عزيز كي يبلغ أمراً أهم
entries.example: He sacrificed his weekend to finish the report.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy, or causing a feeling of unhappiness.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزين أو يبعث على الحزن
entries.example: She felt sad when her friend moved away.

entries.definitionEn: In a sad way. Also used to say that something unfortunate is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحزن؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً للدلالة على أمر مؤسف
entries.example: Sadly, the small shop has closed.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of being unhappy.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحزن: شعور بعدم السعادة
entries.example: A quiet sadness stayed with him after the goodbye.

entries.definitionEn: A trip, often in Africa, to watch wild animals in their natural home.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفاري: رحلة، وغالباً في أفريقيا، لمشاهدة الحيوانات البرية في موطنها
entries.example: They booked a safari to see elephants and giraffes.

entries.definitionEn: Not in danger, or not likely to cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: آمن غير معرّض للخطر، أو غير مرجّح أن يسبب أذى
entries.example: Keep the medicine in a safe place away from children.

entries.definitionEn: A rule, device, or action that protects someone or something from harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمانة أو إجراء واقٍ يحمي من الأذى
entries.example: Helmets are an important safeguard for cyclists.

entries.definitionEn: To protect something from harm or loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحمي شيئاً ويصونه من الأذى أو الضياع
entries.example: The new rules will safeguard customers' personal data.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that does not cause harm or put anyone in danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: بأمان على نحو لا يسبب أذى ولا يعرّض أحداً للخطر
entries.example: The climbers returned safely before dark.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being protected from danger or harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: السلامة: حال الحماية من الخطر أو الأذى
entries.example: Wear a helmet for your own safety.

entries.definitionEn: A downward bend or droop, often in the middle, caused by weight or weakness.
entries.arabicMeaning: تهدّل أو هبوط إلى الأسفل، وغالباً في الوسط، من ثقل أو ضعف
entries.example: There was a sag in the middle of the old mattress.

entries.definitionEn: A plant with grey-green leaves used to flavour food.
entries.arabicMeaning: الميرمية: نبات أوراقه رمادية الخضرة يُستعمل لتتبيل الطعام
entries.example: She added chopped sage to the roast potatoes.

entries.definitionEn: To travel on water in a boat or ship, especially one that uses sails.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبحر في قارب أو سفينة، ولا سيما ممّا يعتمد على الأشرعة
entries.example: The ship will sail at dawn tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The sport or activity of travelling in a boat that uses sails.
entries.arabicMeaning: الإبحار الشراعي رياضة أو نشاطاً
entries.example: Sailing is her favourite summer sport.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works on a ship, or who sails for sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحّار يعمل على سفينة، أو يبحر رياضة
entries.example: The sailor checked the ropes before they left the harbour.

entries.definitionEn: Used in for the sake of to mean for the benefit or purpose of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل في for the sake of بمعنى من أجل مصلحة شخص أو غرض أمر
entries.example: He lowered his voice for the children's sake.

entries.definitionEn: A cold dish of mixed raw vegetables, sometimes with other foods.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلطة: طبق بارد من خضار نيئة مخلوطة، وقد تُضاف إليها أطعمة أخرى
entries.example: I'll have a salad with my sandwich.

entries.definitionEn: Money that an employee receives regularly, usually every month, for doing a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: راتب يتقاضاه الموظف بانتظام، وغالباً كل شهر، مقابل عمله
entries.example: Her monthly salary is paid on the last working day.

entries.definitionEn: The act of selling something. Also a time when a shop sells goods at lower prices.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية البيع؛ وأيضاً فترة تخفيض الأسعار في متجر
entries.example: The house has been for sale since March.

entries.definitionEn: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.
entries.arabicMeaning: بائع رجل عمله بيع السلع أو الخدمات
entries.example: The salesman showed us three different phones.

entries.definitionEn: Skill in persuading people to buy something.
entries.arabicMeaning: براعة البيع: مهارة إقناع الناس بالشراء
entries.example: Good salesmanship means listening before you talk.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to sell goods or services.
entries.arabicMeaning: مندوب مبيعات: شخص عمله بيع السلع أو الخدمات
entries.example: A salesperson helped us choose the right size.

entries.definitionEn: A woman whose job is to sell goods or services.
entries.arabicMeaning: بائعة عملها بيع السلع أو الخدمات
entries.example: The saleswoman explained the return policy clearly.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to saliva or to the glands that produce it.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعابي: متعلق باللعاب أو بالغدد التي تفرزه
entries.example: The salivary glands produce the fluid that starts digestion.

entries.definitionEn: To produce saliva, often at the thought or sight of food.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسيل لعابه أو يفرزه، وغالباً عند رؤية الطعام أو تذكّره
entries.example: The smell of fresh bread made him salivate.

entries.definitionEn: A large fish with pink flesh that lives in the sea and in rivers, eaten as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: السلمون: سمك كبير وردي اللحم يعيش في البحر والأنهار ويُؤكل
entries.example: We had grilled salmon with lemon for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A shop where you can have your hair cut or receive beauty treatments.
entries.arabicMeaning: صالون لقص الشعر أو للعناية بالتجميل
entries.example: She has an appointment at the salon on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: In British English, a car with a closed body and a separate boot. Also an old-fashioned American bar.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيارة صالون بريطانية ذات صندوق خلفي منفصل؛ وأيضاً حانة أمريكية قديمة الطراز
entries.example: They hired a saloon for the long motorway journey.

entries.definitionEn: A spicy sauce made with tomatoes and chilli. Also a lively Latin American dance.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلصة السالسا الحارة بالطماطم والفلفل؛ وأيضاً رقصة لاتينية حيوية
entries.example: She spooned salsa over the grilled fish.

entries.definitionEn: A white substance from the sea or from the ground, used to flavour and preserve food.
entries.arabicMeaning: الملح: مادة بيضاء من البحر أو الأرض تُستعمل لتتبيل الطعام وحفظه
entries.example: Add a little salt to the soup.

entries.definitionEn: Containing salt, or tasting of salt.
entries.arabicMeaning: مالح يحتوي على ملح أو يطعم به
entries.example: The soup was too salty, so she added more water.

entries.definitionEn: To rescue something of value from wreckage, damage, or failure.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقذ ما له قيمة من حطام أو تلف أو فشل
entries.example: They managed to salvage some furniture from the flood.

entries.definitionEn: Being saved from harm, failure, or destruction. In religious use, being saved from sin.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجاة من أذى أو هلاك؛ وفي الاستعمال الديني خلاص من الخطيئة
entries.example: The emergency loan was the company's salvation.

entries.definitionEn: A soothing ointment for the skin. Also something that eases hurt, guilt, or wounded pride.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهم ملطّف للجلد؛ أو بلسم يسكّن ألماً أو شعوراً جارحاً
entries.example: She put a salve on the small burn.

entries.definitionEn: Not different; exactly like another person or thing already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفسه غير مختلف؛ مطابق لشخص أو شيء مذكور
entries.example: We live on the same street as my sister.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a verb to mean in the same way.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بعد الفعل بمعنى على النحو نفسه
entries.example: He treats every customer the same.

entries.definitionEn: Used, usually after the, to refer to the person or thing already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير، وغالباً بعد the، يعود على الشخص أو الشيء المذكور نفسه
entries.example: I'll have the same, please.

entries.definitionEn: A small amount of something that shows what the rest is like.
entries.arabicMeaning: عيّنة صغيرة تدل على صفة الباقي
entries.example: The shop gave us a free sample of cheese.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being holy, or of deserving great respect and protection.
entries.arabicMeaning: القداسة أو الحرمة التي تستوجب احتراماً بالغاً وحماية
entries.example: They spoke of the sanctity of private family life.

entries.definitionEn: Very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرمل: حبّات صخرية دقيقة على الشواطئ وفي الصحارى
entries.example: The children played in the sand near the water.

entries.definitionEn: A light open shoe with straps, worn in warm weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: صندل: حذاء خفيف مفتوح بسيور يُلبس في الحر
entries.example: He wore sandals to the beach.

entries.definitionEn: A rock formed from compressed sand, often used as a building material.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحجر الرملي: صخر يتكوّن من رمل مضغوط ويُستعمل كثيراً في البناء
entries.example: The church was built of yellow sandstone.

entries.definitionEn: Two pieces of bread with food such as cheese or meat between them.
entries.arabicMeaning: شطيرة: شريحتا خبز بينهما جبن أو لحم ونحوه
entries.example: I packed a cheese sandwich for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Pressed tightly between two people or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: محشور بإحكام بين شخصين أو شيئين
entries.example: The cafe was sandwiched between two tall office buildings.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with sand, or containing a lot of sand.
entries.arabicMeaning: رملي مغطى بالرمل أو كثير الرمل
entries.example: We walked along the sandy beach at low tide.

entries.definitionEn: Clean and not likely to cause disease. Also relating to the protection of public health through hygiene.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحي نظيف لا يُرجّح أن يسبب مرضاً؛ ومتعلق بحماية الصحة العامة بالنظافة
entries.example: The kitchen was not in a sanitary condition.

entries.definitionEn: Systems and practices for keeping places clean and for removing waste, to protect health.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصرف الصحي والنظافة العامة: نظم وممارسات لإبقاء الأماكن نظيفة وإزالة الفضلات حماية للصحة
entries.example: The camp needed better sanitation after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: The watery liquid that carries food through a plant.
entries.arabicMeaning: النسغ: السائل الذي ينقل الغذاء عبر النبات
entries.example: Maple sap is collected in early spring.

entries.definitionEn: Remarks that mean the opposite of what they say, used to mock or criticise.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخرية تهكمية تقول عكس المقصود للاستهزاء أو النقد
entries.example: His sarcasm made the joke feel unkind.

entries.definitionEn: Using remarks that mean the opposite of what they say, in order to mock.
entries.arabicMeaning: تهكمي يسخر بقول عكس ما يعني
entries.example: She gave a sarcastic smile when he called the delay a small delay.

entries.definitionEn: In a sarcastic way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسخرية تهكمية
entries.example: Oh, perfect timing, he said sarcastically as the rain began.

entries.definitionEn: A machine sent into space to circle the Earth and send information. Also a natural body that circles a planet, such as the Moon.
entries.arabicMeaning: قمر صناعي يدور حول الأرض وينقل معلومات؛ وأيضاً جرم طبيعي يدور حول كوكب كالقمر
entries.example: The weather satellite sent back new images of the storm.

entries.definitionEn: A pleased feeling because you have achieved something or received what you wanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: رضا وسرور لبلوغ أمر أو نيل ما أردت
entries.example: She smiled with satisfaction when the cake came out well.

entries.definitionEn: Good enough for a particular purpose, though not excellent.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُرضٍ يكفي للغرض وإن لم يبلغ حدّ الامتياز
entries.example: The repair was satisfactory, but not perfect.

entries.definitionEn: Pleased because you have what you wanted or needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: راضٍ لأنه نال ما أراد أو احتاج
entries.example: He was satisfied with the final result.

entries.definitionEn: To please someone by giving them what they want or need. Also to be enough for a requirement.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرضي شخصاً بإعطائه ما يريد أو يحتاج؛ وأيضاً يفي بمطلب
entries.example: A piece of fruit did not satisfy her hunger.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Friday and before Sunday.
entries.arabicMeaning: السبت: اليوم الذي يلي الجمعة ويسبق الأحد
entries.example: We go to the market on Saturday morning.

entries.definitionEn: A thick liquid served with food to add flavour.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلصة: سائل كثيف يُقدَّم مع الطعام لإكسابه نكهة
entries.example: The pasta comes with a tomato sauce.

entries.definitionEn: A deep, round metal pot with a handle and often a lid, used for cooking on a hob.
entries.arabicMeaning: قدر معدني عميق بمقبض، وغالباً بغطاء، يُستعمل للطبخ على الموقد
entries.example: Heat the milk in a small saucepan.

entries.definitionEn: A small, shallow plate that a cup stands on.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحن فنجان: طبق صغير ضحل يُوضع عليه الفنجان
entries.example: The cup sat on a matching saucer.

entries.definitionEn: A small hot room filled with steam, used to relax and sweat.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساونا: غرفة صغيرة حارة مملوءة بالبخار للاسترخاء والتعرّق
entries.example: They sat in the sauna after swimming.

entries.definitionEn: A tube of skin filled with chopped meat and spices, eaten cooked.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقانق: أنبوب من غشاء يُحشى بلحم مفروم وتوابل ويُؤكل مطبوخاً
entries.example: He cooked sausages for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: To keep someone or something from harm. Also to keep money instead of spending it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقذ من الأذى؛ وأيضاً يدّخر مالاً بدل إنفاقه
entries.example: She is trying to save money for a trip.

entries.definitionEn: Money that you have kept and not spent, often in a bank.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدّخرات: مال احتفظت به ولم تنفقه، وغالباً في مصرف
entries.example: He used his savings to buy a bicycle.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a sharp toothed blade, used for cutting wood or other hard materials.
entries.arabicMeaning: منشار: أداة ذات نصل مسنّن حاد لقطع الخشب وغيره من المواد الصلبة
entries.example: He cut the board with a small saw.

entries.definitionEn: To cut something with a saw.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينشر شيئاً بالمنشار فيقطعه
entries.example: He sawed the plank in half.

entries.definitionEn: The right to give an opinion or to help decide something.
entries.arabicMeaning: حق إبداء الرأي أو المشاركة في القرار
entries.example: The staff wanted a say in the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: To speak words; to express something in speech or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقول كلاماً؛ يعبّر عن شيء نطقاً أو كتابة
entries.example: What did she say about the meeting?

entries.definitionEn: A set of numbers or marks for measuring, or an instrument for weighing. Also how large something is.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقياس أرقام أو علامات للقياس، أو ميزان للوزن؛ وأيضاً حجم الشيء ونطاقه
entries.example: Place the bag on the scale to check its weight.

entries.definitionEn: A medical image made by a special machine. Also a quick look through something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحص تصويري بجهاز طبي؛ وأيضاً إلقاء نظرة سريعة
entries.example: He had a scan on his shoulder after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: To look through something quickly, or to examine it with a special machine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمسح بنظره بسرعة، أو يفحص بالجهاز
entries.example: She scanned the list for her name.

entries.definitionEn: An event or situation that shocks people because it is morally or legally wrong, and that becomes widely known.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضيحة: حدث أو وضع يصدّم الناس لمخالفته الخلق أو القانون ويذيع خبره
entries.example: The newspaper reported a scandal at the local bank.

entries.definitionEn: A lasting mark on the skin after a wound has healed. Also a lasting effect of a painful experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: ندبة تبقى على الجلد بعد التئام الجرح؛ وأيضاً أثر باقٍ من تجربة مؤلمة
entries.example: The operation left a thin scar on her knee.

entries.definitionEn: Almost not; only just. Used to say that something is barely true or barely happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالكاد؛ لا يكاد الشيء يحدث أو يكون صحيحاً
entries.example: We had scarcely sat down when the phone rang.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel frightened or worried.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيف شخصاً أو يثير قلقه
entries.example: Loud thunder can scare young children.

entries.definitionEn: Frightened or worried about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خائف أو قلق من شيء
entries.example: She felt scared walking home in the dark.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth that you wear around your neck to keep warm or as decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: وشاح يُلف حول العنق للتدفئة أو للزينة
entries.example: He put on a wool scarf before going out.

entries.definitionEn: A bright red colour, like the colour of fresh blood.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون القرمزي الزاهي، كلون الدم القاني
entries.example: The dancers wore silk in a deep scarlet.

entries.definitionEn: Frightening, or likely to make you feel afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخيف أو من شأنه أن يثير الخوف
entries.example: The film was too scary for me to watch alone.

entries.definitionEn: Severely critical, often in a sharp or mocking way that is meant to hurt.
entries.arabicMeaning: لاذع النقد، قاسٍ في الكلام على نحو يجرح
entries.example: The review was a scathing attack on the play.

entries.definitionEn: To throw or drop things so that they spread in different directions. Also to move apart quickly in different directions.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينثر أشياء فتتفرق؛ أو يتفرق الناس بسرعة في اتجاهات شتى
entries.example: The wind scattered leaves across the path.

entries.definitionEn: An animal that feeds on dead animals or waste. Also a person who searches through discarded things for something useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان يقتات الجيف أو الفضلات؛ أو شخص يبحث في المهملات عما ينتفع به
entries.example: Vultures are scavengers that feed on dead animals.

entries.definitionEn: A possible way that a situation might develop. Also a written outline of what happens in a film or play.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيناريو: تصور لتسلسل محتمل للأحداث؛ أو مخطط مكتوب لمشاهد فيلم أو مسرحية
entries.example: The team prepared for the worst-case scenario.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a film or play. Also the place where something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشهد في فيلم أو مسرحية؛ أو المكان الذي يقع فيه أمر
entries.example: The last scene of the film made everyone quiet.

entries.definitionEn: The natural features of a place that you look at, such as hills, trees, and rivers.
entries.arabicMeaning: المناظر الطبيعية في مكان، كالتلال والأشجار والأنهار
entries.example: We stopped the car to look at the mountain scenery.

entries.definitionEn: Having beautiful natural views.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو مناظر طبيعية جميلة
entries.example: We took the scenic road along the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A smell, especially a pleasant one. Also the smell left by a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائحة، وغالباً زكية؛ وأيضاً أثر الرائحة الذي يتركه شخص أو حيوان
entries.example: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: A plan that shows when things will happen, or a list of times for buses, trains, or classes.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدول مواعيد أو خطة زمنية تبين متى تحدث الأمور
entries.example: My schedule is full on Monday morning.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange for something to happen at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّد موعداً لحدوث شيء في وقت معيّن
entries.example: They scheduled the meeting for Thursday afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Planned to happen at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقرَّر أن يحدث في وقت محدد
entries.example: The scheduled flight left twenty minutes late.

entries.definitionEn: An official plan or system for doing something. Also a secret and often dishonest plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: خطة أو نظام رسمي لإنجاز أمر؛ أو مكيدة سرية غير نزيهة
entries.example: The city started a scheme to plant more trees.

entries.definitionEn: A person who studies a subject in a deep and serious way, often at a university.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم أو باحث يتعمق في موضوع، وغالباً في الجامعة
entries.example: She is a scholar of medieval history.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of serious academic study: careful, learned, and well researched.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكاديمي رصين؛ يدل على بحث متقن وعلم واسع
entries.example: He published a scholarly article on ancient trade.

entries.definitionEn: Money given to a student to help pay for their studies. Also serious academic learning.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحة دراسية تساعد الطالب على تمويل دراسته؛ وأيضاً سعة العلم والبحث
entries.example: She won a scholarship to study engineering.

entries.definitionEn: A medieval method of theology and philosophy that used strict logic, especially in European universities.
entries.arabicMeaning: المدرسية: منهج وسيط في اللاهوت والفلسفة يعتمد المنطق الدقيق، ولا سيما في الجامعات الأوروبية
entries.example: The course compared scholasticism with later ways of thinking.

entries.definitionEn: A place where children go to learn.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرسة يتعلم فيها الأطفال
entries.example: My sister walks to school every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A child who goes to school.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلميذ أو تلميذة في المدرسة
entries.example: Each schoolchild received a new reading book.

entries.definitionEn: A girl who goes to school.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتاة تلميذة تذهب إلى المدرسة
entries.example: The photo shows her as a schoolgirl in a dark uniform.

entries.definitionEn: A person who goes to the same school as you.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل أو زميلة في المدرسة
entries.example: I met an old schoolmate at the station.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to teach in a school.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلّم أو معلّمة في مدرسة
entries.example: Her father was a schoolteacher in a small town.

entries.definitionEn: Work that students do for school, including homework and class tasks.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأعمال والواجبات التي يؤديها الطالب للمدرسة
entries.example: He finished his schoolwork before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Stories about imagined science, future worlds, or life in space.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخيال العلمي: قصص عن علوم متخيَّلة أو عوالم مستقبلية أو الحياة في الفضاء
entries.example: He reads science fiction about travel to other planets.

entries.definitionEn: The study of nature and how things in the world work, using tests and facts.
entries.arabicMeaning: العلوم: دراسة الطبيعة وكيف تعمل الأشياء بالاختبار والوقائع
entries.example: She likes science, especially biology.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with science, or using the methods of science.
entries.arabicMeaning: علمي؛ متصل بالعلوم أو بأساليبها
entries.example: They used a scientific method to test the idea.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that follows the methods of science.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو علمي يتبع منهج العلوم
entries.example: The claim has not been scientifically tested.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to study science.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم يدرس العلوم
entries.example: The scientist explained the results in simple words.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with two blades, used for cutting paper, cloth, or hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقص: أداة ذات نصلين تُستخدم لقص الورق أو القماش أو الشعر
entries.example: Please pass me the scissors.

entries.definitionEn: To speak about someone or something with contempt and mockery.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسخر باستهزاء واحتقار
entries.example: They scoffed at the idea at first.

entries.definitionEn: To speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يؤنّب شخصاً أو يوبّخه لأنه أخطأ
entries.example: Do not scold him for such a small mistake.

entries.definitionEn: A light two-wheeled vehicle that you stand on and push with one foot, or a similar vehicle with a small engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكوتر: مركبة خفيفة بعجلتين تُدفع بالقدم أو بمحرك صغير
entries.example: She rides a scooter to the station.

entries.definitionEn: The range of things that a subject, activity, or job includes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نطاق الموضوع أو العمل ومدى ما يشمله
entries.example: That question is outside the scope of today's class.

entries.definitionEn: The number of points that a player or team has in a game.
entries.arabicMeaning: النتيجة بعدد النقاط في مباراة أو لعبة
entries.example: The final score was two to one.

entries.definitionEn: To get points or a goal in a game or test.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرز نقاطاً أو هدفاً في لعبة أو اختبار
entries.example: She scored the winning goal in the last minute.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدراء شديد يرى أن شخصاً أو شيئاً لا يستحق الاحترام
entries.example: He spoke of the plan with open scorn.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you have no respect for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مليء بالازدراء؛ يُظهر احتقاراً وعدم احترام
entries.example: She gave him a scornful look and walked away.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows scorn or lack of respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: بازدراء وعدم احترام
entries.example: He laughed scornfully at the suggestion.

entries.definitionEn: A hurried and confused struggle to get something. Also a difficult climb over rough ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدافع محموم غير منظّم للحصول على شيء؛ أو تسلق وعر صعب
entries.example: There was a scramble for the last seats on the bus.

entries.definitionEn: To climb or move quickly using your hands and feet. Also to compete in a hurried, messy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسلق أو يتحرك بسرعة مستخدماً اليدين والقدمين؛ أو يتدافع على نحو عاجل
entries.example: We had to scramble over the rocks to reach the path.

entries.definitionEn: A thin cut or mark on a surface or on the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: خدش رفيع على سطح أو على الجلد
entries.example: There was a scratch on the wooden table.

entries.definitionEn: To rub your skin with your nails. Also to make a thin mark on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحكّ الجلد بالأظافر؛ أو يخدش سطحاً فيترك علامة رفيعة
entries.example: The cat likes to scratch the sofa.

entries.definitionEn: A loud, high cry, often because of fear, pain, or strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: صرخة عالية حادة، غالباً من خوف أو ألم أو انفعال شديد
entries.example: We heard a scream from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: To cry out loudly in a high voice, often because you are afraid, hurt, or excited.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرخ بصوت عالٍ حاد، غالباً من خوف أو ألم أو إثارة
entries.example: She had to scream to be heard above the music.

entries.definitionEn: The flat surface of a television, computer, or phone that you look at. Also a flat object used to hide or protect something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاشة تلفاز أو حاسوب أو هاتف؛ أو حاجز يُستخدم للستر أو الحماية
entries.example: He spends too many hours looking at a screen.

entries.definitionEn: To show a film or programme. Also to test someone or something to find a problem or disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض فيلماً أو برنامجاً؛ أو يفحص شخصاً أو شيئاً للكشف عن مشكلة أو مرض
entries.example: The festival will screen three short films tonight.

entries.definitionEn: The written text of a film, including dialogue and directions for the action.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيناريو الفيلم: النص المكتوب للحوار وتوجيهات المشاهد
entries.example: She spent a year writing the screenplay.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes screenplays for films or television.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاتب سيناريو للأفلام أو للتلفزيون
entries.example: The screenwriter changed the ending after the first draft.

entries.definitionEn: A small metal pin with a spiral, used to join things together.
entries.arabicMeaning: برغي: مسمار معدني حلزوني يُستخدم لربط الأشياء
entries.example: I need four screws for this shelf.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something with a screw, or to turn something round so that it fits tightly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت شيئاً ببرغي، أو يدير شيئاً حتى ينحكم
entries.example: He screwed the shelf firmly to the wall.

entries.definitionEn: Untidy writing or drawing done quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: خربشة أو كتابة متعجلة غير واضحة
entries.example: I could not read his scribble on the note.

entries.definitionEn: The written words of a play, film, or speech. Also a particular system of writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نص مسرحية أو فيلم أو خطاب؛ أو نظام معيّن للكتابة
entries.example: The actors learned their lines from the script.

entries.definitionEn: A roll of paper or parchment with writing, used especially in earlier times as a document or book.
entries.arabicMeaning: طومار: لفافة من ورق أو رقّ مكتوبة، استُخدمت قديماً وثيقة أو كتاباً
entries.example: The museum displayed an ancient scroll in a glass case.

entries.definitionEn: A person who hates spending money and is unwilling to be generous.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخيل شحيح يكره الإنفاق ولا يجود
entries.example: Don't be a scrooge; it is only a small gift.

entries.definitionEn: To examine someone or something very carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدقق النظر ويفحص شخصاً أو شيئاً بعناية شديدة
entries.example: The committee will scrutinize every line of the report.

entries.definitionEn: Close and careful examination of someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فحص دقيق صارم لشخص أو أمر
entries.example: The accounts came under close scrutiny.

entries.definitionEn: Equipment that lets a diver breathe underwater from a tank of air.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجهزة الغوص بالهواء المضغوط التي تسمح بالتنفس تحت الماء
entries.example: She packed her scuba gear for the reef trip.

entries.definitionEn: A work of art made by shaping stone, wood, metal, or similar material. Also this form of art.
entries.arabicMeaning: منحوتة فنية من حجر أو خشب أو معدن؛ أو فن النحت نفسه
entries.example: A bronze sculpture stands in the middle of the square.

entries.definitionEn: A tool with a long curved blade on a long handle, used for cutting grass or crops.
entries.arabicMeaning: منجل طويل النصل بمقبض، يُستخدم لقطع العشب أو الحصاد
entries.example: He cut the tall grass with a scythe.

entries.definitionEn: The salt water that covers a large part of the earth, or a large area of this water.
entries.arabicMeaning: البحر: الماء المالح الذي يغطي جزءاً كبيراً من الأرض، أو مساحة واسعة منه
entries.example: They swam in the sea until sunset.

entries.definitionEn: Fish and other sea animals that people eat.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأكولات بحرية من السمك وغيره مما يؤكل من حيوان البحر
entries.example: The restaurant is famous for its fresh seafood.

entries.definitionEn: A sea animal with smooth fur that eats fish and lives partly in water and partly on land.
entries.arabicMeaning: فقمة: حيوان بحري ذو فرو أملس يقتات السمك ويعيش بين الماء والبر
entries.example: A seal lay on the rocks, drying in the sun.

entries.definitionEn: The act of looking carefully for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحث أو تفتيش دقيق عن شخص أو شيء
entries.example: The search for the missing keys took an hour.

entries.definitionEn: To look carefully for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبحث أو يفتش بعناية عن شخص أو شيء
entries.example: The police searched the building for hours.

entries.definitionEn: An area next to the sea, especially one where people go for a holiday.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاطئ البحر ومنطقته، ولا سيما حيث يُقضى المصيف
entries.example: We spent a week at the seaside.

entries.definitionEn: One of the four main parts of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. Also a period when a particular activity happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصل من فصول السنة الأربعة؛ أو موسم يحدث فيه نشاط معيّن
entries.example: Autumn is my favourite season.

entries.definitionEn: Happening, used, or available at a particular time of year.
entries.arabicMeaning: موسمي: يحدث أو يُستخدم أو يتوافر في وقت معيّن من السنة
entries.example: The farm hires seasonal workers in the harvest months.

entries.definitionEn: A place where you can sit, such as a chair or a space on a bus.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقعد تجلس عليه، ككرسي أو مكان في حافلة
entries.example: Please take a seat near the window.

entries.definitionEn: Water from the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماء البحر
entries.example: The boat's engine was damaged by seawater.

entries.definitionEn: A plant that grows in the sea, often with long leaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعشاب بحرية تنمو في البحر وغالباً ذات أوراق طويلة
entries.example: Green seaweed covered the rocks at low tide.

entries.definitionEn: Coming after the first in order, time, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثاني في الترتيب أو الزمن أو الأهمية
entries.example: This is my second visit to the city.

entries.definitionEn: In second place, or after something already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: في المرتبة الثانية، أو بعد أمر ذُكر أولاً
entries.example: She finished second in the race.

entries.definitionEn: Owned or used by someone else before you. Also not known from your own experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعمل سبق أن ملكه أو استخدمه غيرك؛ أو غير مباشر لم تعرفه بنفسك
entries.example: He bought a second-hand bicycle.

entries.definitionEn: From someone else rather than new, or from another person's report rather than from your own experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مستعمل من الغير، أو سماعاً من شخص آخر لا عن تجربة مباشرة
entries.example: I only heard the story second-hand.

entries.definitionEn: A very short unit of time. There are sixty seconds in a minute.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثانية: وحدة زمنية قصيرة، وفي الدقيقة ستون ثانية
entries.example: Wait a second; I need my keys.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, the form used for the person spoken to, such as you in English.
entries.arabicMeaning: المخاطَب في النحو: الصيغة المستخدمة لمن تُكلّمه في الجملة
entries.example: Rewrite the letter in the second person.

entries.definitionEn: Used to talk about the person or thing that comes after the first, without repeating the noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُستعمل للدلالة على الثاني من مجموعة دون إعادة الاسم
entries.example: The first cake was too sweet, but I liked the second.

entries.definitionEn: Less important than something else. Also relating to education after primary school.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثانوي: أقل أهمية من غيره؛ أو متعلق بالتعليم بعد المرحلة الابتدائية
entries.example: Cost is a secondary concern; safety comes first.

entries.definitionEn: A school for children after primary school, usually for teenagers.
entries.arabicMeaning: المدرسة الثانوية التي تلي الابتدائية، وغالباً للمراهقين
entries.example: She started secondary school at the age of eleven.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the second point in a list of reasons or ideas.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثانياً: تُستخدم لتقديم النقطة الثانية في تعداد أسباب أو أفكار
entries.example: Firstly, the plan is cheap; secondly, it is easy to start.

entries.definitionEn: Known about by only a few people, and not told to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرّي لا يعرفه إلا قليلون ولا يُباح لغيرهم
entries.example: They held a secret meeting after work.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you do not tell other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرّ لا تخبر به الآخرين
entries.example: Can you keep a secret?

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to do office work, such as letters, phone calls, and meetings.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكرتير أو سكرتيرة يتولى أعمال المكتب من رسائل واتصالات واجتماعات
entries.example: Please leave a message with the secretary.

entries.definitionEn: In a secret way; without other people knowing.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرّاً من غير علم الآخرين
entries.example: She secretly planned a party for her friend.

entries.definitionEn: One of the parts that something is divided into.
entries.arabicMeaning: قسم أو جزء من شيء مقسَّم
entries.example: Please read the last section of the chapter.

entries.definitionEn: A part of a country's economy, or a part of an area or group.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطاع من اقتصاد بلد، أو جزء من منطقة أو مجموعة
entries.example: Jobs in the health sector have increased this year.

entries.definitionEn: Not connected with religion or with religious institutions.
entries.arabicMeaning: دنيوي لا يتصل بالدين أو بالمؤسسات الدينية
entries.example: The university is a secular institution with no religious affiliation.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not religious; according to worldly rather than religious principles.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو دنيوي غير ديني
entries.example: The school is run secularly, with no religious instruction.

entries.definitionEn: Safe from danger, firmly fixed, or feeling safe and confident.
entries.arabicMeaning: آمن من الخطر، أو ثابت بإحكام، أو شاعر بالاطمئنان والثقة
entries.example: Make sure the window is secure before you leave.

entries.definitionEn: To obtain something, especially after effort. Also to make something safe or firmly fixed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحصل على شيء ولا سيما بعد جهد؛ أو يؤمّن شيئاً ويجعله ثابتاً آمناً
entries.example: She secured a place on the graduate course.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being safe from danger, or the people and systems that protect a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأمن والسلامة من الخطر؛ أو الأجهزة والأشخاص الذين يحمون مكاناً
entries.example: Airport security checked every bag.

entries.definitionEn: Calm, slow, and quietly dignified, without excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصين هادئ بطيء الوتيرة، بعيد عن الصخب
entries.example: They walked at a sedate pace through the park.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone a drug that makes them calm, sleepy, or less able to feel pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطي شخصاً مهدئاً دوائياً فيجعله هادئاً أو ناعساً أو أقل إحساساً بالألم
entries.example: The vet had to sedate the injured dog before treatment.

entries.definitionEn: Involving a lot of sitting and little physical activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الحركة؛ يعتمد على الجلوس أكثر من النشاط البدني
entries.example: A sedentary job can make it harder to stay fit.

entries.definitionEn: To notice someone or something with your eyes.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرى شخصاً أو شيئاً بعينيه
entries.example: I can see the bus from here.

entries.definitionEn: The small hard part of a plant from which a new plant can grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: بذرة: الجزء الصغير الصلب من النبات الذي ينبت منه نبات جديد
entries.example: She planted tomato seeds in a pot.

entries.definitionEn: A young plant that has grown from a seed.
entries.arabicMeaning: شتلة صغيرة نابتة من بذرة
entries.example: Move the seedlings outside after the last frost.

entries.definitionEn: Shabby, dirty, and suggesting dishonest or disreputable activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: رثّ قذر يوحي بنشاط مشبوه أو قليل الاحترام
entries.example: They met in a seedy bar near the station.

entries.definitionEn: To try to find or get something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسعى إلى إيجاد شيء أو الحصول عليه
entries.example: Many people seek advice before changing jobs.

entries.definitionEn: To appear to be a certain way, or to give a particular impression.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدو على حال معيّنة أو يعطي انطباعاً ما
entries.example: You seem tired this morning.

entries.definitionEn: A long board on a playground that goes up and down when children sit on each end.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرجوحة التوازن في الملعب: لوح طويل يرتفع طرفه ويهبط بجلوس طفلين على طرفيه
entries.example: The children took turns on the seesaw.

entries.definitionEn: One of the parts that something is divided into.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة أو جزء من كلّ مقسَّم
entries.example: Each orange segment was sweet and juicy.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to earthquakes or other vibrations of the earth. Also used of a change that is extremely large.
entries.arabicMeaning: زلزالي متعلق بالهزات الأرضية؛ ويوصف به أيضاً التغيير البالغ الأثر
entries.example: The region recorded several seismic shocks overnight.

entries.definitionEn: To take hold of something suddenly and firmly. Also to take something by force or by official power.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقبض على شيء فجأة وبقوة؛ أو يستولي عليه قسراً أو بسلطة رسمية
entries.example: She seized his arm to stop him falling.

entries.definitionEn: Not often; almost never.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادراً؛ قلّما يحدث
entries.example: He seldom eats out during the week.

entries.definitionEn: Carefully chosen as the best, or limited to a small exclusive group.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختار بعناية بوصفه الأفضل، أو مقصور على نخبة صغيرة
entries.example: Only a select group of guests was invited.

entries.definitionEn: To choose someone or something from a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختار شخصاً أو شيئاً من مجموعة
entries.example: Please select one option from the list.

entries.definitionEn: The act of choosing, or a group of things that have been chosen or are available to choose from.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل الاختيار؛ أو مجموعة مختارة أو معروضة للاختيار
entries.example: The shop has a good selection of bread.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of choosing carefully rather than accepting everything.
entries.arabicMeaning: الانتقائية: جودة الاختيار الدقيق بدل قبول كل شيء
entries.example: The university is known for its selectivity.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making yourself seem more powerful, important, or gifted than you are.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعظيم الذات والمبالغة في إبراز الأهمية أو القدرة
entries.example: The speech was full of self-aggrandizement rather than facts.

entries.definitionEn: The belief that you can do things well and deal with situations successfully.
entries.arabicMeaning: الثقة بالنفس: الإيمان بأنك تحسن العمل وتواجه المواقف بنجاح
entries.example: Public speaking class helped her self-confidence.

entries.definitionEn: Sure of your own abilities and not easily made nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: واثق بقدراته ولا يضطرب بسهولة
entries.example: He is quiet, but self-confident in meetings.

entries.definitionEn: Uncomfortably aware of yourself and of being watched or judged by others.
entries.arabicMeaning: محرج لفرط وعيه بنفسه وبأن الآخرين ينظرون إليه أو يحكمون عليه
entries.example: He felt self-conscious in the new suit.

entries.definitionEn: Who a person is, or the way they usually feel and act.
entries.arabicMeaning: الذات: من يكون الشخص، أو حاله وطبعه المعتاد
entries.example: After a rest she felt more like her usual self.

entries.definitionEn: Designed so that customers take what they need and pay without being served at a counter.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو خدمة ذاتية يأخذ فيه الزبون ما يحتاج ويدفع من غير خدمة على المنضدة
entries.example: We had lunch in a self-service cafeteria.

entries.definitionEn: The sense that you have value as a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشعور بقيمة الذات وأنك جدير بالاعتبار
entries.example: Kind feedback can support a child's self-worth.

entries.definitionEn: Caring only about yourself and not about other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: أناني لا يبالي إلا بنفسه دون الآخرين
entries.example: It was selfish to take the last seat without asking.

entries.definitionEn: Caring more about other people than about yourself.
entries.arabicMeaning: إيثاري؛ يقدّم مصلحة غيره على مصلحته
entries.example: Her selfless work at the clinic impressed everyone.

entries.definitionEn: To give something to someone who pays you money for it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبيع شيئاً مقابل مال
entries.example: They sell fresh fruit at the market.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that sells something.
entries.arabicMeaning: بائع أو جهة تبيع شيئاً
entries.example: The seller agreed to lower the price.

entries.definitionEn: One of two main parts of a school or university year.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصل دراسي: أحد قسمي السنة الدراسية الرئيسيين
entries.example: The first semester ends in January.

entries.definitionEn: A match or competition just before the final, to decide who will play in the final.
entries.arabicMeaning: نصف النهائي: مباراة تسبق النهائي لتحديد المتأهل إليه
entries.example: They reached the semi-final of the cup.

entries.definitionEn: The punctuation mark ; used to join two closely related parts of a sentence, or to separate items in a complex list.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفاصلة المنقوطة ؛ تُستخدم لوصل جملتين مترابطتين أو لفصل عناصر قائمة معقدة
entries.example: Use a semicolon between the two related clauses.

entries.definitionEn: A class at a university or college in which a small group discusses a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلقة دراسية جامعية يناقش فيها مجموعة صغيرة موضوعاً
entries.example: She presented her research at a weekly seminar.

entries.definitionEn: A member of a senate, which is one of the law-making groups in some countries.
entries.arabicMeaning: عضو في مجلس الشيوخ، وهو هيئة تشريعية في بعض البلدان
entries.example: The senator asked a question during the hearing.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone or something go to a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل شخصاً أو شيئاً إلى شخص أو مكان
entries.example: I will send you the file this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Older, or higher in rank at work or in an organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكبر سناً، أو أعلى رتبة في العمل أو المؤسسة
entries.example: She is a senior engineer in the team.

entries.definitionEn: An older person, or a student in the last year of school or college.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أكبر سناً؛ أو طالب في السنة الأخيرة من المدرسة أو الكلية
entries.example: Seniors get a lower price on the bus.

entries.definitionEn: A physical feeling in the body. Also a state of great public excitement or interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: إحساس جسدي؛ أو ضجة واسعة تثير اهتمام الناس
entries.example: She felt a burning sensation on her skin.

entries.definitionEn: One of the five ways the body notices the world, such as sight or hearing. Also good judgment, or a meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: حاسة من الحواس الخمس؛ وأيضاً إدراك سليم أو معنى
entries.example: Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.

entries.definitionEn: To become aware of something without being told, often by feeling or instinct.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستشعر أمراً من غير أن يُخبَر به، غالباً بالإحساس أو الحدس
entries.example: He sensed that something was wrong.

entries.definitionEn: Showing good judgment; practical and reasonable.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاقل حكيم؛ عملي سديد الرأي
entries.example: It is sensible to take an umbrella today.

entries.definitionEn: Easily affected or hurt. Also able to understand other people's feelings, or needing careful handling.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسّاس سهل التأثر؛ أو مدرك لمشاعر غيره؛ أو يحتاج معاملة حذرة
entries.example: He has sensitive skin and cannot use that soap.

entries.definitionEn: A group of words that makes a complete idea, usually starting with a capital letter and ending with a full stop.
entries.arabicMeaning: جملة تامة المعنى، تبدأ بحرف كبير وتنتهي بنقطة في الإنكليزية
entries.example: Write each answer in a full sentence.

entries.definitionEn: If a court sentences someone, it officially gives them a punishment.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحكم القاضي على شخص بعقوبة رسمية
entries.example: The court sentenced him to two years in prison.

entries.definitionEn: Able to perceive and feel, not merely existing as an object.
entries.arabicMeaning: واعٍ قادر على الإدراك والإحساس، لا مجرد جماد
entries.example: Many people argue that some animals are sentient beings.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling, attitude, or opinion, often based more on emotion than on reason.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور أو موقف أو رأي يستند إلى العاطفة أكثر مما يستند إلى العقل في كثير من الأحيان
entries.example: I share your sentiment about the need for rest.

entries.definitionEn: Showing or causing tender emotion, sometimes in an excessive way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاطفي يثير الحنان، وقد يبلغ حد المبالغة
entries.example: He kept the ticket for sentimental reasons.

entries.definitionEn: In a sentimental way; with tender or excessive emotion.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعاطفية فيها حنان أو مبالغة شعورية
entries.example: She spoke sentimentally about her childhood home.

entries.definitionEn: Not together; independent or different from something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: منفصل؛ مستقل أو مختلف عن غيره
entries.example: They work in two separate offices.

entries.definitionEn: To divide things, or to move them so that they are no longer together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصل أشياء أو يباعد بينها حتى لا تبقى معاً
entries.example: Please separate the glass from the other rubbish.

entries.definitionEn: Not together; as individual things or people.
entries.arabicMeaning: على حدة؛ كلٌّ بمفرده
entries.example: The twins were interviewed separately.

entries.definitionEn: The act of separating, or a state of being apart. Also a period when a couple lives apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: انفصال أو فراق؛ وأيضاً فترة يعيش فيها زوجان متفرقين
entries.example: The long separation made the reunion more emotional.

entries.definitionEn: The ninth month of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبتمبر / أيلول؛ الشهر التاسع من السنة
entries.example: School usually starts in September.

entries.definitionEn: A book, film, or play that continues the story of an earlier one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تتمة: كتاب أو فيلم أو مسرحية تواصل قصة عمل سابق
entries.example: The sequel was weaker than the first film.

entries.definitionEn: A set of things that happen or are arranged in a particular order.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسلسل مرتب لأمور تحدث أو تُرتَّب وفق نظام معيّن
entries.example: Follow the sequence of steps in the booklet.

entries.definitionEn: Calm, peaceful, and not disturbed.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ صافٍ لا يعكره اضطراب
entries.example: The lake looked serene at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Happening as a series of similar events, or arranged in a numbered sequence.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسلسل يحدث على دفعات متشابهة، أو مرتب بأرقام متتابعة
entries.example: Each product has a unique serial number.
