entries.definitionEn: A number of similar things that come one after another. Also a set of television programmes with the same characters or subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلسلة من أمور متشابهة تتوالى؛ أو مسلسل تلفزيوني ذو شخصيات أو موضوع واحد
entries.example: I watched a new series about ocean life.

entries.definitionEn: Not joking, or important and needing careful thought. Also bad or worrying.
entries.arabicMeaning: جاد غير هازل، أو مهم يحتاج تفكيراً؛ وأيضاً بالغ السوء أو مقلق
entries.example: The problem is serious, and we cannot ignore it.

entries.definitionEn: In a serious way; not as a joke. Also to a large and worrying degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجدية لا على سبيل المزاح؛ أو إلى درجة كبيرة مقلقة
entries.example: She was seriously ill last winter.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works in someone else's house, doing jobs such as cooking or cleaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: خادم يعمل في بيت غيره في الطبخ أو التنظيف ونحوهما
entries.example: A servant brought tea into the sitting room.

entries.definitionEn: To give someone food or drink. Also to do work for a person, organization, or community.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّم طعاماً أو شراباً؛ أو يؤدي عملاً لشخص أو مؤسسة أو جماعة
entries.example: They serve breakfast until ten.

entries.definitionEn: A computer that stores data and provides it to other computers. Also a person who brings food in a restaurant.
entries.arabicMeaning: خادم حاسوبي يخزّن البيانات ويقدّمها لأجهزة أخرى؛ أو من يقدّم الطعام في مطعم
entries.example: The website was slow because the server was busy.

entries.definitionEn: Help or work provided for people. Also a system that meets a public need, such as buses or health care.
entries.arabicMeaning: خدمة تُقدَّم للناس؛ أو مرفق عام كالنقل أو الرعاية الصحية
entries.example: The hotel service was excellent.

entries.definitionEn: To examine a vehicle or machine and repair it if necessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجري صيانة لمركبة أو جهاز ويصلحه عند الحاجة
entries.example: You should service the car once a year.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time spent doing a particular activity, such as a class, meeting, or training.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلسة أو فترة تُقضَى في نشاط معيّن كدرس أو اجتماع أو تدريب
entries.example: The training session lasted two hours.

entries.definitionEn: A group of things that belong together.
entries.arabicMeaning: طقم أو مجموعة أشياء ينتمي بعضها إلى بعض
entries.example: I bought a new set of kitchen knives.

entries.definitionEn: To put something in a particular place or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع شيئاً في موضع معيّن
entries.example: Please set the plates on the table.

entries.definitionEn: A problem that delays progress or makes a situation worse for a time.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتكاسة أو عائق يؤخر التقدم أو يسيء الوضع إلى حين
entries.example: The injury was a setback, but she returned to training.

entries.definitionEn: A long, soft seat with a back, for two or more people; a sofa.
entries.arabicMeaning: أريكة طويلة ناعمة ذات ظهر يجلس عليها أكثر من شخص
entries.example: They sat on the settee and talked until late.

entries.definitionEn: The place and time in which a story happens, or the surroundings of an event or building.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطار القصة المكاني والزماني؛ أو المحيط الذي يقع فيه حدث أو مبنى
entries.example: The novel's setting is a small coastal town.

entries.definitionEn: To go and live in a place permanently. Also to reach an agreement, or to become calm.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستقر للعيش في مكان؛ أو يسوي أمراً باتفاق؛ أو يهدأ
entries.example: After years of travel, they settled in a quiet town.

entries.definitionEn: An official agreement that ends a dispute. Also a place where people have come to live.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسوية رسمية تنهي نزاعاً؛ أو مستوطنة يقيم فيها الناس
entries.example: The two sides reached a settlement last week.

entries.definitionEn: A person who goes to live in a new country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستوطن يذهب للعيش في بلد أو منطقة جديدة
entries.example: Early settlers built wooden houses near the river.

entries.definitionEn: The number 7.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبعة؛ العدد 7
entries.example: There are seven days in a week.

entries.definitionEn: The number 17.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبعة عشر؛ العدد 17
entries.example: She will be seventeen next month.

entries.definitionEn: The number 70.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبعون؛ العدد 70
entries.example: My grandfather is seventy years old.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a plural noun to mean more than two, but not a large number.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل اسم جمع بمعنى عدة، أي أكثر من اثنين وليس عدداً كبيراً
entries.example: Several students were late this morning.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun phrase to mean more than two people or things, but not a large number.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل بدل عبارة اسمية بمعنى عدة أشخاص أو أشياء يُفهمون من السياق
entries.example: I invited ten colleagues, and several came.

entries.definitionEn: Very serious, bad, or strict.
entries.arabicMeaning: شديد الخطورة أو السوء أو الصرامة
entries.example: She had a severe headache all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: In a severe way; very badly or strictly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشدة؛ على نحو بالغ السوء أو الصرامة
entries.example: The roof was severely damaged in the storm.

entries.definitionEn: To join cloth with a needle and thread.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخيط القماش بإبرة وخيط
entries.example: She learned to sew a button on her coat.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being male or female. Also sexual activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنس من حيث الذكورة أو الأنوثة؛ وأيضاً النشاط الجنسي
entries.example: The form asked for my age and sex.

entries.definitionEn: Unfair treatment of people because of their sex, especially of women.
entries.arabicMeaning: تمييز جنسي يظلم الناس بسبب جنسهم، ولا سيما النساء
entries.example: The firm trained staff to recognise sexism at work.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the sexes, or to sexual activity and attraction.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنسي: متعلق بالذكورة والأنوثة أو بالنشاط والانجذاب الجنسيين
entries.example: The booklet explains sexual health in clear language.

entries.definitionEn: Sexually attractive, or intended to seem so.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذاب جنسياً، أو معدّ ليبدو كذلك
entries.example: The dancer moved with a slow, sexy rhythm.

entries.definitionEn: In poor condition because of age or use. Also unfair or not generous in the way someone is treated.
entries.arabicMeaning: رثّ بالٍ من القدم أو الاستعمال؛ أو دنيء غير كريم في معاملة أحد
entries.example: He wore a shabby coat with a torn pocket.

entries.definitionEn: An area that is darker and cooler because the sun cannot reach it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظل: موضع أظلم وأبرد لأن الشمس لا تبلغه
entries.example: We sat in the shade under a large tree.

entries.definitionEn: A dark shape made when something blocks the light.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظلّ الجسم: شكل داكن يحدث حين يحجب شيء الضوء
entries.example: His shadow stretched across the pavement.

entries.definitionEn: To follow someone closely, often in order to watch or learn from them. Also to cover with shadow.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلازم شخصاً عن قرب ليراقب أو يتعلم منه؛ أو يظلّل مكاناً
entries.example: A junior doctor shadowed the surgeon for a week.

entries.definitionEn: Dark and full of shadows. Also mysterious and not clearly known.
entries.arabicMeaning: مظلم مليء بالظلال؛ أو غامض غير واضح المعالم
entries.example: They walked down a shadowy corridor.

entries.definitionEn: A quick movement from side to side or up and down.
entries.arabicMeaning: هزة أو رجة سريعة يميناً ويساراً أو صعوداً وهبوطاً
entries.example: Give the bottle a shake before you open it.

entries.definitionEn: To move something quickly from side to side or up and down. Also to tremble.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهزّ شيئاً بسرعة يميناً ويساراً أو صعوداً وهبوطاً؛ أو يرتجف
entries.example: Please shake the bottle before you pour.

entries.definitionEn: Upset, shocked, or made less steady by something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضطرب أو مصدوم مما حدث، أو أقل ثباتاً بسببه
entries.example: She was badly shaken after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to William Shakespeare, his plays, or his style of writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكسبيري: متعلق بوليام شكسبير أو بمسرحه أو بأسلوبه
entries.example: She is writing a paper on Shakespearean comedy.

entries.definitionEn: Not steady, firm, or reliable.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزعزع غير ثابت أو غير موثوق
entries.example: He felt shaky after skipping breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: Used with I or we to talk about the future, or to make a suggestion or offer.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد مع ضمير المتكلم مفرداً أو جمعاً للدلالة على المستقبل، أو لتقديم اقتراح أو عرض
entries.example: Shall we start the meeting now?

entries.definitionEn: Not deep. Also not showing serious thought or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضحل غير عميق؛ أو سطحي قليل العمق في الفكر أو الشعور
entries.example: The children played in the shallow end of the pool.

entries.definitionEn: To walk slowly and awkwardly, dragging the feet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمشى متثاقلاً بخطى غير منتظمة وهو يجرّ قدميه
entries.example: The old man shambled down the corridor in worn slippers.

entries.definitionEn: A state of complete mess or disorder.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوضى عارمة واختلال تام
entries.example: After the move, the flat was a shambles.

entries.definitionEn: A painful feeling of having done something wrong or foolish. Also something that is sad or disappointing.
entries.arabicMeaning: خجل مؤلم من فعل خاطئ أو أحمق؛ أو أمر محزن يدعو للأسف
entries.example: She felt shame after lying to her friend.

entries.definitionEn: Causing shame because it is very bad or wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشين يبعث على الخجل لشدة قبحه أو خطئه
entries.example: It is shameful to leave rubbish on the beach.

entries.definitionEn: A liquid soap used for washing hair.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامبو: سائل يُستخدم لغسل الشعر
entries.example: I need to buy some shampoo.

entries.definitionEn: The form of something, such as a circle, square, or star.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكل الشيء وهيئته، كالدائرة أو المربع أو النجمة
entries.example: Cut the cookies in the shape of a star.

entries.definitionEn: To influence the way something develops, or to form it into a particular shape.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكّل شيئاً أو يؤثر في مسار تطوره
entries.example: Her early teachers helped shape her love of music.

entries.definitionEn: A part of something that is divided among people.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصة أو نصيب من شيء يُقسَم بين الناس
entries.example: I paid my share of the bill.

entries.definitionEn: To give some of what you have to another person, or to use something together.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطي جزءاً مما لديه لغيره، أو يستعمل شيئاً معه
entries.example: The children share a bedroom.

entries.definitionEn: Having a thin edge or point that can cut. Also sudden, clear, or clever.
entries.arabicMeaning: حادّ الطرف يقطع؛ وقد يعني مفاجئاً أو واضحاً أو ذكياً
entries.example: Be careful; that knife is very sharp.

entries.definitionEn: Exactly at a stated time. Also in a sudden or steep way.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً في الوقت المحدد؛ وأيضاً على نحو مفاجئ أو شديد الانحدار
entries.example: The meeting starts at ten o'clock sharp.

entries.definitionEn: In a sudden, steep, or severe way. Also in a clear or slightly unkind tone.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفاجئ أو شديد أو حادّ؛ وقد يعني بنبرة قاطعة
entries.example: Prices rose sharply after the storm.

entries.definitionEn: To break suddenly into many small pieces, or to destroy a hope or feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحطم إلى شظايا كثيرة، أو يحطم أملاً أو شعوراً
entries.example: The glass fell and shattered on the floor.

entries.definitionEn: To cut hair off the skin with a razor, especially on the face.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلق الشعر عن الجلد، ولا سيما عن الوجه
entries.example: He shaves every morning before work.

entries.definitionEn: Used to talk about a female person or animal already known, as the subject of a verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير الغائبة المؤنث في محل فاعل، لمن سبق ذكرها
entries.example: Fatima is my sister, and she lives nearby.

entries.definitionEn: A bundle of papers, or of cut grain stems, tied or held together.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزمة من الأوراق أو من سنابل الحصاد مربوطة معاً
entries.example: He carried a sheaf of documents into the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A small simple building used for storing tools, bicycles, or garden equipment.
entries.arabicMeaning: سقيفة صغيرة لحفظ الأدوات أو الدراجات أو معدات الحديقة
entries.example: The lawnmower is in the shed behind the house.

entries.definitionEn: To lose or drop something naturally, such as leaves, skin, or tears. Also to get rid of something unwanted.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطرح أو يسقط شيئاً بصورة طبيعية كأوراق الشجر أو الدموع؛ وأيضاً يتخلّص مما لا يريده
entries.example: The trees shed their leaves in autumn.

entries.definitionEn: A farm animal with a thick coat, kept for wool and meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: خروف أو شاة: حيوان مزرعة يُربّى للصوف واللحم
entries.example: The farmer keeps sheep on the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize that a quality is complete and not mixed with anything else. Also very steep.
entries.arabicMeaning: محض تامّ يُستعمل للتأكيد؛ وأيضاً شديد الانحدار
entries.example: It was sheer luck that we found a taxi so quickly.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper. Also a large piece of cloth used on a bed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورقة؛ وأيضاً شرشف يُفرش على السرير
entries.example: Write your name at the top of the sheet.

entries.definitionEn: A flat board on a wall or in a cupboard, used for putting things on.
entries.arabicMeaning: رفّ مستوٍ على الجدار أو في الخزانة لوضع الأشياء
entries.example: Put the books back on the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: The hard outer covering of an egg, a nut, or some sea animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: قشرة صلبة لبيضة أو جوزة، أو صدفة لبعض الكائنات البحرية
entries.example: She found a small shell in the sand.

entries.definitionEn: To remove the hard outer covering from nuts, eggs, or seeds.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقشر المكسرات أو البيض أو البذور من غلافها الصلب
entries.example: We sat outside and shelled the pistachios.

entries.definitionEn: A place or structure that protects you from weather or danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأوى يحمي من الطقس أو الخطر
entries.example: We waited in a bus shelter until the rain stopped.

entries.definitionEn: A law officer in a county, especially in the United States.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريف: مسؤول أمني في مقاطعة، ولا سيما في الولايات المتحدة
entries.example: The sheriff asked drivers to slow down near the school.

entries.definitionEn: An object held in front of the body for protection, or anything that protects someone from harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: درع يُحمَل للوقاية، أو أي شيء يقي من الأذى
entries.example: The umbrella was a poor shield against the wind.

entries.definitionEn: A period of work in a place that stays open through the day and night. Also a change from one thing to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: وردية عمل؛ وأيضاً تحوّل من حال إلى حال
entries.example: She is working the night shift this week.

entries.definitionEn: To move something, or to change position or direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقل شيئاً أو يغيّر موضعه أو اتجاهه
entries.example: Can you help me shift this table to the wall?

entries.definitionEn: To shine with a soft, slightly wavering light.
entries.arabicMeaning: يومض ببريق خافت مترجّح
entries.example: The lake shimmered in the late afternoon sun.

entries.definitionEn: To give out light, or to be bright.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضيء أو يلمع
entries.example: The sun shines through the window in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: Smooth and bright, reflecting light.
entries.arabicMeaning: لمّاع أملس يعكس الضوء
entries.example: She polished the table until it was shiny.

entries.definitionEn: A large boat that carries people or goods across the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفينة كبيرة تنقل الناس أو البضائع عبر البحر
entries.example: The ship left the harbour at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: To send goods to a place by sea, road, or air.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشحن البضائع بحراً أو براً أو جوّاً
entries.example: We will ship the order tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The business or cost of sending goods from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشحن: نقل البضائع من مكان إلى آخر أو تكلفته
entries.example: Shipping to the island takes three days.

entries.definitionEn: The destruction of a ship at sea, or a ship that has been destroyed in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرق سفينة أو تحطمها في البحر، أو حطام السفينة نفسها
entries.example: Divers found the shipwreck off the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing for the upper body, usually with a collar and buttons.
entries.arabicMeaning: قميص يُلبس على الجزء العلوي من الجسم، غالباً بياقة وأزرار
entries.example: He put on a clean white shirt.

entries.definitionEn: To shake slightly because you are cold or frightened.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتعد قليلاً من البرد أو الخوف
entries.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind.

entries.definitionEn: A large group of fish swimming together. Also a shallow area of water.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرب كثيف من السمك يسبح معاً؛ وأيضاً ضحضاح في الماء
entries.example: A shoal of sardines moved beneath the boat.

entries.definitionEn: A strong feeling of surprise, usually because something bad has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدمة: شعور قوي بالمفاجأة، غالباً لحدوث أمر سيئ
entries.example: It was a shock to hear that the shop had closed.

entries.definitionEn: To surprise and upset someone, often because something is unexpected or wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصدم شخصاً ويقلقه بمفاجأة غير متوقعة أو أمر مستنكر
entries.example: The sudden news shocked everyone in the office.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصدوم مندهش ومضطرب لأمر غير متوقع
entries.example: I was shocked to see the high prices.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprising in a way that is upsetting or wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادم يثير الدهشة على نحو مزعج أو مستنكر
entries.example: The report described the shocking condition of the building.

entries.definitionEn: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm bottom.
entries.arabicMeaning: حذاء يُلبس في القدم، غالباً وله نعل متين
entries.example: These shoes are too small for me.

entries.definitionEn: To fire a gun, or to kick a ball towards a goal. Also to take photographs or film.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطلق النار، أو يسدد الكرة نحو المرمى؛ وأيضاً يصوّر
entries.example: The player shot the ball into the net.

entries.definitionEn: The act of firing a gun. Also the process of filming a movie or programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: إطلاق النار؛ وأيضاً تصوير فيلم أو برنامج
entries.example: The shooting of the film lasted six weeks.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to serve customers in a shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: بائع في محل يخدم الزبائن
entries.example: The shop assistant helped me find my size.

entries.definitionEn: A building or room where you can buy things.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجر أو محل تُشترى منه الأشياء
entries.example: There is a small shop on the corner.

entries.definitionEn: To go to shops to buy things.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسوّق: يذهب إلى المتاجر ليشتري
entries.example: We shop at the market on Fridays.

entries.definitionEn: A person who owns or manages a small shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب متجر صغير أو مديره
entries.example: The shopkeeper knows most of her regular customers.

entries.definitionEn: To steal goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسرق بضائع من متجر وهو يتظاهر بأنه زبون
entries.example: Cameras are used to stop people who try to shoplift.

entries.definitionEn: A person who steals goods from a shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يسرق بضائع من المتجر
entries.example: The guard stopped the shoplifter near the door.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of stealing goods from a shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرقة المحلات: أخذ بضائع من المتجر دون دفع ثمنها
entries.example: Shoplifting has increased on the busy shopping street.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is buying things in a shop.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسوّق يشتري من المتاجر
entries.example: The shop was full of shoppers on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of buying things from shops.
entries.arabicMeaning: التسوّق: شراء الأشياء من المتاجر
entries.example: I do the shopping on Saturday morning.

entries.definitionEn: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or wide river.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاطئ: اليابسة على حافة بحر أو بحيرة أو نهر واسع
entries.example: We walked along the shore at sunset.

entries.definitionEn: Measuring a small distance from one end to the other, or lasting only a little time. Also not tall.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصير في الطول أو في المدة؛ وأيضاً غير طويل القامة
entries.example: It is a short walk from here to the station.

entries.definitionEn: Used to give a shorter form of a name, or to say that something ends earlier than planned.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل للاسم المختصر، أو للدلالة على أن شيئاً انتهى قبل أوانه
entries.example: Her name is Elizabeth, but we call her Liz for short.

entries.definitionEn: Short trousers that end above the knee.
entries.arabicMeaning: شورت: بنطال قصير ينتهي فوق الركبة
entries.example: He wore shorts and a T-shirt in the heat.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting or relating to a short period of time, not the distant future.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصير الأمد يتعلق بفترة وجيزة لا بالمستقبل البعيد
entries.example: They offered her a short-term contract for six months.

entries.definitionEn: A situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقص: عدم كفاية شيء مطلوب
entries.example: There is a shortage of affordable housing in the city.

entries.definitionEn: A list of the most suitable people or things, chosen from a larger group for a final decision.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائمة مختصرة بأفضل المرشحين أو الخيارات تمهيداً للقرار النهائي
entries.example: Three candidates remain on the shortlist for the job.

entries.definitionEn: To put someone or something on a shortlist.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدرج شخصاً أو شيئاً في القائمة المختصرة
entries.example: The committee shortlisted five designs for the new library.

entries.definitionEn: In a short time; soon.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد قليل؛ قريباً
entries.example: The train will arrive shortly.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being short in length, height, or time. Also used of breath when breathing is difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: قِصَر في الطول أو القامة أو المدة؛ وأيضاً ضيق في التنفس
entries.example: Shortness of breath made it hard for him to climb the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: An attempt to hit or score, with a gun or a ball. Also a photograph.
entries.arabicMeaning: طلقة أو تسديدة نحو هدف؛ وأيضاً لقطة فوتوغرافية
entries.example: He took a shot at the goal but missed.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to say what is right, expected, or a good idea.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يأتي قبل الفعل ليفيد ما ينبغي أو ما يُتوقَّع أو ما يُستحسن
entries.example: You should drink more water.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the body between the neck and the top of the arm.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتف: ما بين العنق وأعلى الذراع
entries.example: He carried the bag on his shoulder.

entries.definitionEn: A loud call or cry.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيحة أو نداء بصوت عالٍ
entries.example: We heard a shout from the other room.

entries.definitionEn: To say something in a very loud voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرخ أو ينادي بصوت عالٍ جداً
entries.example: Don't shout; I can hear you.

entries.definitionEn: A performance for an audience, such as a play, concert, or television programme.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرض للجمهور كمسرحية أو حفلة أو برنامج
entries.example: We watched a great show last night.

entries.definitionEn: To let someone see something. Also to make something clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُري شخصاً شيئاً؛ وأيضاً يبيّن أمراً
entries.example: Can you show me your photos?

entries.definitionEn: Informal word for the entertainment industry, especially film, television, and popular music.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم الفن والترفيه، ولا سيما السينما والتلفزيون والموسيقى الشعبية، في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: She has worked in showbiz for twenty years.

entries.definitionEn: An event or place that displays the best examples of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: منصّة عرض تُبرز أفضل النماذج
entries.example: The festival is a showcase for young musicians.

entries.definitionEn: A device that sprays water so you can wash, or the act of washing under it. Also a short fall of rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: دُش للاغتسال أو الاغتسال به؛ وأيضاً زخة مطر قصيرة
entries.example: I take a shower every morning.

entries.definitionEn: To wash yourself under a shower. Also to give someone a large amount of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغتسل تحت الدش؛ وأيضاً يغمر شخصاً بشيء كثير
entries.example: They showered the team with praise after the match.

entries.definitionEn: Designed to attract attention, often in a way that looks too bright or expensive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبهرج يلفت النظر، وغالباً بأسلوب مفرط في اللمعان أو الفخامة
entries.example: The lobby was elegant rather than showy.

entries.definitionEn: A small sea animal with a shell and a long tail, eaten as food.
entries.arabicMeaning: جمبري: كائن بحري صغير بقشرة وذيل طويل يُؤكل
entries.example: We ordered grilled shrimp with rice.

entries.definitionEn: Informal word for a psychiatrist or therapist.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب نفسي أو معالج، في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: After months of stress, she decided to see a shrink.

entries.definitionEn: To become smaller, or to make something smaller, especially after washing.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينكمش أو يُقلِّص حجم شيء، ولا سيما بعد الغسل
entries.example: The sweater shrank in the hot wash.

entries.definitionEn: To raise and lower your shoulders to show that you do not know or do not care.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع كتفيه ويخفضهما دلالة على الجهل أو عدم الاكتراث
entries.example: He shrugged when I asked him about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Closed; not open.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغلق غير مفتوح
entries.example: The window was shut to keep out the cold.

entries.definitionEn: To close something, or to become closed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلق شيئاً أو ينغلق
entries.example: Please shut the door.

entries.definitionEn: Nervous about meeting or talking to people you do not know well.
entries.arabicMeaning: خجول يتردد في لقاء الغرباء أو الحديث معهم
entries.example: The little boy is shy with new people.

entries.definitionEn: Ill; not healthy. Also wanting to vomit.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريض غير معافى؛ وقد يعني شاعراً بالغثيان
entries.example: She stayed home because she was sick.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being ill, or a particular illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرض أو علة؛ أو حالة المرض عموماً
entries.example: He missed a week of work because of sickness.

entries.definitionEn: One of the surfaces or edges of something, or a position to the left or right.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب أو طرف شيء، أو موضع عن اليمين أو اليسار
entries.example: There is a lamp on this side of the bed.

entries.definitionEn: To avoid dealing with a question or problem. Also to step to one side to avoid someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتفادى معالجة سؤال أو مشكلة؛ وأيضاً يتنحّى خطوة إلى الجانب
entries.example: The minister side-stepped the question about the budget.

entries.definitionEn: A path with a hard surface beside a road, for people to walk on.
entries.arabicMeaning: رصيف للمشاة بجانب الطريق
entries.example: Please walk on the sidewalk, not in the street.

entries.definitionEn: A long, audible breath that shows tiredness, relief, or sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنهيدة: زفير مسموع يدل على تعب أو ارتياح أو حزن
entries.example: She let out a sigh of relief when the test ended.

entries.definitionEn: To let out a long breath that shows tiredness, relief, or sadness.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنهّد زفيراً طويلاً دلالة على تعب أو ارتياح أو حزن
entries.example: He sighed and closed the heavy book.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to see. Also something that you see.
entries.arabicMeaning: البصر: القدرة على الرؤية؛ وأيضاً مرأى أو مشهد
entries.example: My grandmother still has good sight.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيارة المعالم السياحية
entries.example: We spent the afternoon sightseeing in the old city.

entries.definitionEn: A notice that gives information or a warning. Also a movement or mark that has a meaning.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة إرشادية أو تحذيرية؛ وأيضاً إشارة أو علامة ذات معنى
entries.example: The sign said the museum was closed.

entries.definitionEn: To write your name on a document to show you agree to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوقّع اسمه على وثيقة إقراراً بالموافقة
entries.example: Please sign the form at the bottom.

entries.definitionEn: A sound, light, or movement that sends a message or instruction.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشارة صوتية أو ضوئية أو حركية تنقل رسالة أو أمراً
entries.example: The driver waited for the green signal.

entries.definitionEn: To show that something is happening or is likely, or to send a message by a sign.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدلّ على حدوث شيء أو رجحانه، أو يرسل رسالة بإشارة
entries.example: Falling sales may signal a wider problem in the market.

entries.definitionEn: A person's name written in a special way, used to show identity or agreement.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقيع: كتابة الاسم بأسلوب صاحبه إثباتاً للهوية أو الموافقة
entries.example: I need your signature on this letter.

entries.definitionEn: The importance or meaning of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أهمية الشيء أو دلالته
entries.example: They discussed the significance of the new findings.

entries.definitionEn: Large or important enough to be noticed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهم أو كبير بما يكفي لأن يُلاحَظ
entries.example: There has been a significant increase in prices.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة ملحوظة في الكبر أو الأهمية
entries.example: Costs have fallen significantly this year.

entries.definitionEn: To be a sign of something, or to mean something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدلّ على شيء أو يعنيه
entries.example: A nod can signify agreement.

entries.definitionEn: A sign by a road that shows the way to a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوحة إرشادية على الطريق تدلّ على الاتجاه
entries.example: Follow the signpost to the station.

entries.definitionEn: A state in which there is no sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: صمت: انعدام الصوت
entries.example: There was silence in the library.

entries.definitionEn: Making no sound; not speaking.
entries.arabicMeaning: صامت لا صوت له ولا كلام
entries.example: Please remain silent during the exam.

entries.definitionEn: Without making a sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: في صمت بلا صوت
entries.example: She closed the door silently.

entries.definitionEn: The dark outline of a person or object seen against a lighter background.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظلّ خارجي لشخص أو جسم يظهر على خلفية أفتح
entries.example: We saw the silhouette of the mosque against the evening sky.

entries.definitionEn: A fine, smooth cloth made from threads produced by silkworms.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرير: قماش ناعم رقيق من خيوط دودة القز
entries.example: She wore a dress made of silk.

entries.definitionEn: Not serious or not showing good sense; foolish in a light way.
entries.arabicMeaning: سخيف أو أحمق على نحو خفيف بلا رصانة
entries.example: It was a silly mistake, but easy to fix.

entries.definitionEn: Made of silver, or having a shiny grey-white colour like silver.
entries.arabicMeaning: فضّي: مصنوع من الفضة أو بلون رمادي لمّاع كالفضة
entries.example: She wore a silver necklace.

entries.definitionEn: A valuable grey-white metal used for jewellery, coins, and objects. Also the colour of this metal.
entries.arabicMeaning: الفضة: معدن ثمين رمادي مبيض يُصنع منه الحلي والنقود؛ وأيضاً لونه
entries.example: The spoons are made of silver.

entries.definitionEn: Objects made of silver, especially knives, forks, and spoons for the table.
entries.arabicMeaning: أدوات المائدة الفضية كالسكاكين والشوك والملاعق
entries.example: She polished the silverware before the guests arrived.

entries.definitionEn: Almost the same, but not exactly the same.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشابه يكاد يماثل غيره دون تطابق تام
entries.example: The two bags are similar in colour.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being similar, or a way in which two things are alike.
entries.arabicMeaning: تشابه أو وجه شبه بين شيئين
entries.example: There is a clear similarity between the two plans.

entries.definitionEn: In a similar way; likewise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالمثل؛ على نحو مشابه
entries.example: The first test was easy; similarly, the second one was short.

entries.definitionEn: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسيط سهل الفهم أو التنفيذ وغير معقّد
entries.example: The instructions are simple and clear.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being simple, clear, or not decorated.
entries.arabicMeaning: بساطة: صفة السهولة أو الوضوح أو البعد عن الزخرفة
entries.example: I admire the simplicity of her writing.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making something simpler, or a simpler form of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبسيط شيء أو الصورة المبسَّطة منه
entries.example: The new tax form is a welcome simplification.

entries.definitionEn: To make something easier to do or understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبسّط شيئاً فيجعله أسهل فعلاً أو فهماً
entries.example: Can you simplify this explanation for the class?

entries.definitionEn: In a simple way. Also used to emphasize that something is nothing more than what you say.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببساطة؛ وقد تُستعمل للتأكيد على أن الأمر لا يعدو ما يُقال
entries.example: I simply forgot to call her.

entries.definitionEn: Happening at exactly the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزامن يحدث في الوقت نفسه تماماً
entries.example: The two concerts were simultaneous, so we could not attend both.

entries.definitionEn: At the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الوقت نفسه
entries.example: She was talking and writing simultaneously.

entries.definitionEn: From a time in the past until now.
entries.arabicMeaning: منذ ذلك الحين حتى الآن
entries.example: He moved away in 2019 and I have not seen him since.

entries.definitionEn: Used to mean because, or to mean from the time when something happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يفيد السببية بمعنى لأنّ، أو الزمن بمعنى منذ أن
entries.example: Since you are here, we can start the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: From a time in the past until now.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى منذ وقت في الماضي حتى الآن
entries.example: I have lived here since 2018.

entries.definitionEn: Honest and truly meant, not pretended.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادق خالص لا تكلّف فيه
entries.example: Please accept my sincere thanks.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being sincere; honesty of feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: إخلاص وصدق في الشعور
entries.example: Nobody doubted the sincerity of her apology.

entries.definitionEn: To make musical sounds with your voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغني بصوته
entries.example: The children sing in the school choir.

entries.definitionEn: To burn the surface of something slightly, without setting it fully on fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوي ظاهر الشيء كياً خفيفاً دون أن يحرقه تماماً
entries.example: He singed his sleeve when he leaned over the candle.

entries.definitionEn: A person who sings, especially as a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغنٍّ يغني، ولا سيما على سبيل العمل
entries.example: She is a singer in a local band.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or art of making musical sounds with the voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغناء: إصدار أصوات موسيقية بالصوت
entries.example: Her singing filled the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Only one. Also not married or not in a romantic relationship.
entries.arabicMeaning: واحد فقط؛ وأيضاً غير متزوّج أو غير مرتبط
entries.example: There is a single key to this door.

entries.definitionEn: A song released on its own rather than on a full album. Also an unmarried person, or a one-way ticket.
entries.arabicMeaning: أغنية تُصدَر منفردة؛ وأيضاً شخص غير متزوّج، أو تذكرة ذهاب فقط
entries.example: The band released a new single in May.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, relating to one person or thing, not more than one.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرد في النحو: يدلّ على واحد لا على أكثر
entries.example: Child is a singular noun.

entries.definitionEn: The form of a word that refers to one person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة المفرد في الكلمة
entries.example: The singular of mice is mouse.

entries.definitionEn: A bowl with taps in a kitchen or bathroom, used for washing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوض غسيل في المطبخ أو الحمّام بصنابير
entries.example: Please wash the cups in the sink.

entries.definitionEn: To go down below the surface of water, or to move slowly downwards.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغوص تحت سطح الماء، أو يهبط ببطء
entries.example: The stone sank to the bottom of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A polite word used to speak to a man, especially a customer or someone in authority.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيدي: لفظ مهذّب لمخاطبة رجل، ولا سيما زبون أو صاحب سلطة
entries.example: Excuse me, sir, you dropped your ticket.

entries.definitionEn: The sister of your husband or wife, or the wife of your brother.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخت الزوج أو الزوجة، أو زوجة الأخ
entries.example: My sister-in-law is visiting us this weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A girl or woman who has the same parents as you.
entries.arabicMeaning: أخت: بنت الوالدين نفسيهما
entries.example: I have one sister and two brothers.

entries.definitionEn: To rest with your body on a chair or similar seat, and your back upright.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجلس مستنداً إلى كرسي أو ما شابه وظهره منتصب
entries.example: Please sit here.

entries.definitionEn: A place where something is, was, or will be built, or where something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقع: مكان يوجد فيه شيء أو يُقام أو يحدث
entries.example: This is the site of the new school.

entries.definitionEn: A room in a house where people sit and relax.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة الجلوس في البيت
entries.example: They were watching television in the sitting room.

entries.definitionEn: The things that are happening at a particular time and place.
entries.arabicMeaning: وضع أو حالة الأمور في وقت ومكان معيّنين
entries.example: The situation at work is better now.

entries.definitionEn: The number 6.
entries.arabicMeaning: ستة
entries.example: There are six chairs around the table.

entries.definitionEn: The number 16.
entries.arabicMeaning: ستة عشر
entries.example: She will be sixteen next month.

entries.definitionEn: The number 60.
entries.arabicMeaning: ستون
entries.example: My father is sixty years old.

entries.definitionEn: How big or small something is. Also a numbered measure for clothes or shoes.
entries.arabicMeaning: حجم الشيء كبراً أو صغراً؛ وأيضاً مقاس الثياب أو الأحذية
entries.example: What size shoes do you take?

entries.definitionEn: A boot with a blade or wheels, used for moving on ice or a hard surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: حذاء تزلج بشفرة أو عجلات للحركة على الجليد أو سطح صلب
entries.example: She put on her skates and stepped onto the ice.

entries.definitionEn: To move on skates.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتزلج على حذاء ذي شفرة أو عجلات
entries.example: The children skate on the frozen lake in winter.

entries.definitionEn: A short board on wheels that you stand on and ride.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوح تزلج بعجلات يُركَب وقوفاً
entries.example: He rode his skateboard down the empty street.

entries.definitionEn: A person who rides a skateboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: متزلج على اللوح ذي العجلات
entries.example: The skateboarder practised a new jump in the park.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of riding a skateboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزلج على اللوح ذي العجلات
entries.example: Skateboarding is popular with teenagers in this town.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of moving on skates.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزلج على الجليد أو على العجلات
entries.example: We went skating at the ice rink.

entries.definitionEn: The set of bones that supports the body of a person or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيكل عظمي: مجموعة العظام التي تدعم جسم الإنسان أو الحيوان
entries.example: We studied a human skeleton in biology class.

entries.definitionEn: A simple, quickly made drawing. Also a short comic scene, or a brief outline of a plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم سريع مبسّط؛ وأيضاً مشهد فكاهي قصير، أو مخطط موجز لفكرة
entries.example: She made a sketch of the harbour before painting it.

entries.definitionEn: To make a quick, simple drawing of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسم رسماً سريعاً مبسّطاً
entries.example: He sketched the old bridge in his notebook.

entries.definitionEn: A book of blank pages used for drawing sketches.
entries.arabicMeaning: دفتر رسم بصفحات فارغة للتخطيط السريع
entries.example: She never travels without a sketchbook.

entries.definitionEn: To distort something so that it is not accurate, balanced, or straight.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرّف شيئاً فيخرجه عن الدقة أو التوازن أو الاستقامة
entries.example: A small sample can skew the results of a survey.

entries.definitionEn: One of a pair of long narrow boards that you fasten to boots in order to move over snow.
entries.arabicMeaning: زلّاجة ثلج: لوح طويل رفيع يُربَط بالحذاء للحركة على الثلج
entries.example: He rented a pair of skis for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: To move over snow on skis.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتزلج على الثلج بزلاجات طويلة
entries.example: They ski in the mountains every winter.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.
entries.arabicMeaning: التزلج على الثلج
entries.example: Skiing is her favourite winter sport.

entries.definitionEn: An ability to do something well, usually because you have practised it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهارة: قدرة على أداء شيء جيداً، غالباً بعد التمرين
entries.example: Cooking is a useful skill.

entries.definitionEn: Having the training and ability to do a job well.
entries.arabicMeaning: ماهر ذو تدريب وقدرة على أداء العمل بإجادة
entries.example: The company is looking for skilled electricians.

entries.definitionEn: Good at doing something that needs ability and practice.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارع حاذق فيما يحتاج إلى قدرة وتمرين
entries.example: She is a skillful negotiator.

entries.definitionEn: In a skillful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببراعة وحذق
entries.example: He skilfully avoided the difficult question.

entries.definitionEn: The natural outer covering of a person or animal. Also the outer layer of some fruits.
entries.arabicMeaning: جلد الإنسان أو الحيوان؛ وأيضاً قشرة بعض الثمار
entries.example: Use cream if your skin feels dry.

entries.definitionEn: To not do or not attend something that you usually do. Also to move forward with little jumps.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجاوز أمراً أو يتغيب عنه؛ وأيضاً يقفز قفزات خفيفة إلى الأمام
entries.example: She skipped lunch and worked through the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing for a woman or girl that hangs from the waist and is not divided like trousers.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنّورة: لباس نسائي يتدلى من الخصر وليس مقسوماً كالبناطيل
entries.example: She wore a blue skirt to the interview.

entries.definitionEn: The space above the earth where you see clouds, the sun, and stars.
entries.arabicMeaning: سماء: الفضاء فوق الأرض حيث تُرى الغيوم والشمس والنجوم
entries.example: The sky was clear and blue.

entries.definitionEn: A small brown bird that sings while flying high in the sky.
entries.arabicMeaning: قُبَّرة: طائر بني صغير يغرّد وهو محلّق عالياً
entries.example: A skylark rose from the field, singing as it flew.

entries.definitionEn: A very tall building with many floors, usually in a city.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناطحة سحاب: مبنى شاهق كثير الطوابق، غالباً في مدينة
entries.example: The new skyscraper changed the city's skyline.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the sky.
entries.arabicMeaning: صُعُداً نحو السماء
entries.example: The fireworks shot skyward and burst into colour.

entries.definitionEn: A thick, flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or chocolate.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلاطة سميكة مستوية من حجر أو خرسانة أو نحو ذلك
entries.example: Workers lifted a slab of concrete into place.

entries.definitionEn: Loose rather than tight. Also not busy, or not working as hard as you should.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتخٍ غير مشدود؛ وأيضاً راكد أو متراخٍ في العمل
entries.example: The rope was slack and needed tightening.

entries.definitionEn: Looseness in a rope or system; unused capacity that can be used if needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ارتخاء في حبل أو نظام؛ أو طاقة غير مستغلة يمكن استعمالها عند الحاجة
entries.example: There is little slack in the timetable this week.

entries.definitionEn: To work less hard than you should; to ease off.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتراخى في العمل أو يقصّر فيه
entries.example: The team cannot afford to slack before the deadline.

entries.definitionEn: In a loose or careless way; without tightness or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مرتخٍ أو متهاون بلا شدّ أو اجتهاد
entries.example: The banner hung slackly from the pole.

entries.definitionEn: To shut something with force and a loud noise, or to hit something hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغلق شيئاً بعنف وصوت عالٍ، أو يضربه بقوة
entries.example: Don't slam the door when you leave.

entries.definitionEn: Very informal words used by a particular group, often instead of standard language.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألفاظ عامية غير فصيحة تستعملها فئة معيّنة
entries.example: Teenagers often use slang that their parents do not understand.

entries.definitionEn: A hit with the flat of the hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفعة بباطن الكف
entries.example: He gave the table a slap to get everyone's attention.

entries.definitionEn: To hit someone or something with the flat of the hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفع بباطن الكف
entries.example: She slapped the mosquito on her arm.

entries.definitionEn: The writing mark /, used between words or numbers. Also a long cut made with a sweeping stroke.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخط المائل بين الكلمات أو الأرقام؛ وأيضاً قطْع طويل بضربة ماسحة
entries.example: Write the dates with a slash between month and year.

entries.definitionEn: The killing of animals for food. Also the killing of a large number of people in a cruel way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذبح الحيوانات للأكل؛ وأيضاً مقتل عدد كبير من الناس بقسوة
entries.example: The farm sent the cattle to slaughter in the autumn.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is owned by someone else and forced to work without pay or freedom.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبد: شخص مملوك لغيره يُجبَر على العمل بلا أجر ولا حرية
entries.example: In the ancient world, a slave had no legal rights.

entries.definitionEn: The system in which people are owned and forced to work without freedom.
entries.arabicMeaning: الرقّ: نظام يُملَك فيه الناس ويُجبَرون على العمل بلا حرية
entries.example: The museum exhibit explained the history of slavery.

entries.definitionEn: The natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed and you are not awake.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوم: حالة راحة طبيعية تُغمَض فيها العينان ويغيب فيها الوعي
entries.example: You need eight hours of sleep each night.

entries.definitionEn: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind not awake.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينام مستريحاً مغمض العينين
entries.example: The baby sleeps in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: Without sleep; unable to sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا نوم؛ سهران لا يستطيع النوم
entries.example: She spent a sleepless night before the exam.

entries.definitionEn: Tired and ready to sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناعس يشعر بالتعب ويحتاج إلى النوم
entries.example: I feel sleepy after a big lunch.

entries.definitionEn: The part of a shirt, coat, or similar piece of clothing that covers the arm.
entries.arabicMeaning: كمّ الثوب الذي يغطي الذراع
entries.example: He rolled up his sleeves and started cooking.

entries.definitionEn: A thin, flat piece cut from a larger piece of food.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريحة رقيقة تُقطَع من طعام أكبر
entries.example: Would you like a slice of bread?

entries.definitionEn: To cut something into thin, flat pieces.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقطّع شيئاً شرائح رقيقة
entries.example: She sliced the tomatoes for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: A structure in a playground that children sit on and move down.
entries.arabicMeaning: زحليقة يجلس عليها الأطفال وينزلقون في الملعب
entries.example: The children took turns on the slide.

entries.definitionEn: To move smoothly over a surface, or to move something in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزلق بسلاسة على سطح، أو يحرّك شيئاً كذلك
entries.example: The drawer slides open easily.

entries.definitionEn: Small in amount or degree. Also thin and not strong in appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: طفيف في المقدار أو الدرجة؛ وأيضاً نحيل الهيئة
entries.example: There has been a slight delay, but the train is coming.

entries.definitionEn: A remark or action that shows a lack of respect; an insult, often a small one.
entries.arabicMeaning: إهانة خفيفة أو تجاهل يدلّ على قلة الاحترام
entries.example: She took his joke as a slight and left the room.

entries.definitionEn: A little; to a small degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليلاً؛ بدرجة يسيرة
entries.example: The soup is slightly too salty.

entries.definitionEn: Thin in an attractive or healthy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رشيق نحيل على نحو مقبول أو صحي
entries.example: He looks slim after months of walking.

entries.definitionEn: A small mistake. Also a small piece of paper.
entries.arabicMeaning: هفوة صغيرة؛ وأيضاً قصاصة ورق
entries.example: One slip in the figures delayed the whole report.

entries.definitionEn: To slide accidentally and almost fall, or to move quietly and quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزلق دون قصد ويكاد يسقط، أو يتحرك بهدوء وسرعة
entries.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.

entries.definitionEn: To move by sliding close to the ground, like a snake.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينزلق زحفاً ملاصقاً للأرض كالأفعى
entries.example: A lizard slithered under the rock.

entries.definitionEn: A small, thin piece of something that has been cut or broken off.
entries.arabicMeaning: شظية أو شريحة رفيعة جداً انقطعت أو انكسرت من شيء
entries.example: She added a sliver of garlic to the pan.

entries.definitionEn: Informal word for a person who is lazy and untidy.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص كسول مهمل الهندام، في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: He admitted he had been a slob about cleaning the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: A short, memorable phrase used in advertising or to express an aim.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعار قصير يعلق في الذهن للدعاية أو للتعبير عن هدف
entries.example: The company chose a simple slogan for the new product.

entries.definitionEn: A surface that rises or falls at an angle; the side of a hill.
entries.arabicMeaning: سطح مائل صاعد أو هابط؛ سفح تل
entries.example: They walked carefully down the steep slope.

entries.definitionEn: Careless, messy, or not done with enough attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمل أو فوضوي أو غير متقن
entries.example: The report was full of sloppy mistakes.

entries.definitionEn: A narrow opening, or a time or place available for someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتحة ضيقة، أو موعد أو موضع شاغر لشخص أو شيء
entries.example: There is a slot for your card on the side of the machine.

entries.definitionEn: Not fast; taking a long time to move or happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطيء؛ يستغرق وقتاً طويلاً
entries.example: The slow train arrived twenty minutes late.

entries.definitionEn: At a low speed, especially in informal speech after a verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببطء، وخصوصاً في الكلام غير الرسمي بعد الفعل
entries.example: The sign told us to go slow near the school.

entries.definitionEn: To become slower, or to make something slower.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبطئ أو يجعل شيئاً أبطأ
entries.example: The car slowed as it approached the corner.

entries.definitionEn: At a slow speed; not quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ببطء؛ على مهل
entries.example: Please speak slowly so I can understand.

entries.definitionEn: Little in size; not large.
entries.arabicMeaning: صغير الحجم
entries.example: She lives in a small apartment near the station.

entries.definitionEn: Clever, or looking neat and stylish.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذكي، أو أنيق المظهر
entries.example: That was a smart answer to a difficult question.

entries.definitionEn: To break something into pieces with force, or to hit something hard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحطّم شيئاً بقوة أو يضربه بشدة
entries.example: A stone smashed the kitchen window.

entries.definitionEn: A small and incomplete amount of knowledge, or a thin scattering of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: معرفة يسيرة غير مكتملة، أو قدر ضئيل متناثر من شيء
entries.example: She has only a smattering of Arabic, but she tries to use it.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of something that you notice with your nose.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائحة تُدرَك بالأنف
entries.example: There was a smell of coffee in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: To notice a smell, or to have a particular smell.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمّ رائحة، أو تفوح منه رائحة معيّنة
entries.example: I can smell bread baking in the next room.

entries.definitionEn: An expression in which the corners of the mouth turn up, showing happiness or friendliness.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابتسامة يظهر فيها ارتفاع طرفي الفم فرحاً أو ودّاً
entries.example: She gave him a warm smile.

entries.definitionEn: To make a smile appear on your face.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبتسم
entries.example: He smiled when he saw his friends at the door.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes things from metal, especially by heating and shaping it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدّاد يصنع الأشياء من المعدن بالتسخين والطرق
entries.example: The smith shaped the iron while it was still hot.

entries.definitionEn: The grey or black gas that comes from fire.
entries.arabicMeaning: دخان يتصاعد من النار
entries.example: Smoke rose from the chimney.

entries.definitionEn: To breathe in smoke from a cigarette, cigar, or pipe. Also to produce smoke.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدخّن سيجارة أو نحوها؛ وقد يعني يُصدر دخاناً
entries.example: He used to smoke, but he stopped last year.

entries.definitionEn: A person who smokes cigarettes or other tobacco.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدخّن
entries.example: The café has a separate room for smokers.

entries.definitionEn: A tall chimney on a factory or ship that carries smoke into the air.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدخنة عالية في مصنع أو سفينة تُخرج الدخان
entries.example: Thick smoke poured from the factory smokestack.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of smoking cigarettes or other tobacco.
entries.arabicMeaning: التدخين
entries.example: Smoking is not allowed in this building.

entries.definitionEn: Flat and even, with no lumps or roughness. Also happening without problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: أملس مستوٍ بلا خشونة؛ وقد يعني سلساً بلا عقبات
entries.example: The table has a smooth wooden surface.

entries.definitionEn: In a smooth way; without sudden movements or problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسلاسة؛ بلا حركات مفاجئة أو مشكلات
entries.example: The meeting went smoothly from start to finish.

entries.definitionEn: Too pleased with yourself, in a way that other people find annoying.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزهوّ بنفسه على نحو يغيظ الآخرين
entries.example: He looked smug after winning the argument.

entries.definitionEn: In a smug way; with too much self-satisfaction.
entries.arabicMeaning: بزهوٍ مفرط بالنفس
entries.example: She smiled smugly as she announced the result.

entries.definitionEn: A small amount of food eaten between meals.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجبة خفيفة بين الوجبات
entries.example: I had a snack of fruit and nuts in the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: A small, slow-moving animal with a soft body and a spiral shell.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلزون صغير بطيء الحركة له صدفة لولبية
entries.example: After the rain, a snail crossed the garden path.

entries.definitionEn: A long, thin animal with no legs that slides along the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثعبان طويل بلا أرجل يزحف على الأرض
entries.example: We saw a snake near the river.

entries.definitionEn: To break suddenly with a sharp sound, to speak sharply, or to take a photograph quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينكسر فجأة بصوت حاد، أو يردّ بجفاء، أو يلتقط صورة بسرعة
entries.example: The dry branch snapped under his foot.

entries.definitionEn: To go somewhere quietly and secretly, often to avoid being seen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسلل بهدوء وسرّاً تفادياً لأن يُرى
entries.example: She tried to sneak out of the house without waking anyone.

entries.definitionEn: An unkind smile or look that shows contempt.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابتسامة أو نظرة ساخرة تدل على الاحتقار
entries.example: There was a sneer on his face when he heard the suggestion.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden burst of air from the nose and mouth, often caused by dust or a cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطسة؛ اندفاع مفاجئ للهواء من الأنف والفم
entries.example: A loud sneeze interrupted the lecture.

entries.definitionEn: To suddenly force air out through the nose and mouth, usually because of dust, pollen, or a cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطس
entries.example: The pepper made her sneeze.

entries.definitionEn: To breathe in quickly through the nose in order to smell something, or because you have a cold.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمّ بسرعة عبر الأنف، أو يستنشق بسبب زكام
entries.example: The dog sniffed the bag before sitting down.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece of information, conversation, or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقتطف صغير من معلومات أو حديث أو نص
entries.example: I caught only a snippet of their conversation.

entries.definitionEn: The attitude of looking down on people thought to have lower social status or poorer taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترفّع طبقي أو ذوقي ينظر إلى الآخرين باستعلاء
entries.example: Her remarks about cheap clothes were pure snobbery.

entries.definitionEn: To sleep lightly for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغفو نوماً خفيفاً لوقت قصير
entries.example: He snoozed on the sofa after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: The noisy sound made by someone who breathes heavily while asleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخير؛ صوت التنفس الثقيل أثناء النوم
entries.example: His snore kept the whole room awake.

entries.definitionEn: To breathe noisily through the mouth and nose while sleeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشخر أثناء النوم
entries.example: He snores when he sleeps on his back.

entries.definitionEn: Soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلج يسقط من السماء في البرد
entries.example: The children played in the snow.

entries.definitionEn: To fall as snow from the sky.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتساقط الثلج
entries.example: It started to snow just after we left the house.

entries.definitionEn: A ball of packed snow, often thrown in play.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة ثلج تُضغط غالباً للّعب والرمي
entries.example: She threw a snowball and then ran behind the wall.

entries.definitionEn: A board used for sliding down snow slopes, with both feet attached to it.
entries.arabicMeaning: لوح تزلّج على الثلج تُثبَّت عليه القدمان
entries.example: He rented a snowboard for the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: The sport of riding a snowboard down a snowy slope.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة التزلّج بلوح على المنحدرات الثلجية
entries.example: Snowboarding is popular at this mountain resort.

entries.definitionEn: A storm with heavy falling snow and strong wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاصفة ثلجية شديدة الرياح
entries.example: Flights were delayed because of the snowstorm.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with snow, or with a lot of snow falling.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغطى بالثلج أو كثير الثلوج
entries.example: We woke up to a snowy garden.

entries.definitionEn: Used to mean very, or to such a degree. Also used to refer back to something already said.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدل على المبالغة في الدرجة بمعنى جداً؛ وقد تحيل إلى كلام سبق
entries.example: The bag was so heavy that I had to put it down.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a name or description to show that you think it is wrong or doubtful.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُقال له كذا، للدلالة على الشك في صحة التسمية أو الوصف
entries.example: The so-called expert could not answer a basic question.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce a result or purpose; therefore.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف يربط السبب بالنتيجة بمعنى لذلك أو حتى
entries.example: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

entries.definitionEn: A period of lying in water, or the act of becoming thoroughly wet.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقع أو استحمام طويل حتى يتشرب الشيء الماء
entries.example: The towels need a good soak before you wash them.

entries.definitionEn: To leave something in liquid until it is wet through, or to become very wet.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقع شيئاً في سائل حتى يتشربه، أو يبتلّ بشدة
entries.example: Soak the beans overnight before you cook them.

entries.definitionEn: Completely wet.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلول تماماً
entries.example: We arrived home soaked after walking in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely wet; wet through.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبتلّ حتى العظم؛ شديد البلل
entries.example: Take off those soaking shoes before you come in.

entries.definitionEn: A substance used with water for washing the body or clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: صابون يُستعمل مع الماء للغسل
entries.example: Wash your hands with soap and warm water.

entries.definitionEn: A television or radio series about the daily lives and problems of a group of characters.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسلسل درامي يومي يتابع حياة مجموعة من الشخصيات
entries.example: She watches the same soap opera every evening.

entries.definitionEn: To fly or rise high in the air, or to increase quickly to a high level.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلق عالياً، أو يرتفع بسرعة إلى مستوى عالٍ
entries.example: Prices soared after the shortage began.

entries.definitionEn: To cry noisily, with short, uneven breaths.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتحب باكياً بأنفاس متقطعة
entries.example: The child sobbed until her mother returned.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two teams kick a ball and try to score goals; football in American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرة القدم، وخصوصاً بالتسمية الأمريكية
entries.example: The children play soccer in the park after school.

entries.definitionEn: Enjoying the company of other people; friendly in groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: اجتماعي يحب مخالطة الناس
entries.example: She is sociable and makes friends easily at parties.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with people living together as a community, or with meeting other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: اجتماعي؛ متعلق بحياة الجماعة أو بمخالطة الناس
entries.example: Humans are social animals who need other people.

entries.definitionEn: The use of websites and apps to meet, share, and stay in contact with other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: التواصل الاجتماعي عبر المواقع والتطبيقات
entries.example: Social networking has changed how colleagues keep in touch.

entries.definitionEn: The process by which people, especially children, learn the skills and habits needed to live in a society.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنشئة اجتماعية يتعلّم بها المرء مهارات العيش في المجتمع
entries.example: School plays an important role in the socialization of children.

entries.definitionEn: To spend time with other people for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخالط الناس ويقضي معهم وقتاً للمتعة
entries.example: He likes to socialize with colleagues after work.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to society or to spending time with other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الاجتماعية أو في المخالطة
entries.example: She is shy at work but quite confident socially.

entries.definitionEn: People living together in an organized community or country.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجتمع الناس المنظم في بلد أو جماعة
entries.example: Education is important in any society.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe.
entries.arabicMeaning: جورب يُلبس في القدم داخل الحذاء
entries.example: He put on a clean pair of socks.

entries.definitionEn: A sweet fizzy drink, or water with bubbles used in mixed drinks.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروب غازي حلو، أو ماء فوار
entries.example: Would you like a soda with your meal?

entries.definitionEn: A long, comfortable seat with a back, for more than one person.
entries.arabicMeaning: أريكة طويلة مريحة لأكثر من شخص
entries.example: They sat on the sofa and watched a film.

entries.definitionEn: Not hard or rough; pleasant to touch. Also not loud.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليّن غير خشن؛ وقد يعني خافتاً غير مرتفع الصوت
entries.example: The kitten has soft fur.

entries.definitionEn: A cold drink that does not contain alcohol, often with bubbles.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروب بارد غير كحولي، وغالباً غازي
entries.example: The café serves juice and other soft drinks.

entries.definitionEn: In a quiet or gentle way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء أو بلطف
entries.example: She spoke softly so as not to wake the baby.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being soft to the touch, or gentle rather than harsh.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليونة الملمس أو الرقة مقابل القسوة
entries.example: He liked the softness of the cotton shirt.

entries.definitionEn: The programs used by a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: برمجيات الحاسوب
entries.example: You need to update the software on your laptop.

entries.definitionEn: The top layer of earth in which plants grow.
entries.arabicMeaning: تربة ينمو فيها النبات
entries.example: These plants grow best in dry soil.

entries.definitionEn: To make something dirty.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوسّخ شيئاً أو يلطّخه
entries.example: Be careful not to soil your shirt with ink.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the sun, or using energy from the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمسي؛ متعلق بالشمس أو يستخدم طاقتها
entries.example: The house has solar panels on the roof.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is in an army.
entries.arabicMeaning: جندي في الجيش
entries.example: Her brother is a soldier in the army.

entries.definitionEn: To ask someone for money, help, or business, often in a formal or persistent way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلتمس مالاً أو عوناً أو عملاً، وغالباً بإلحاح أو بصفة رسمية
entries.example: The charity was not allowed to solicit donations in the station.

entries.definitionEn: Firm and hard, not liquid or gas. Also strong and reliable.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلب متماسك ليس سائلاً ولا غازاً؛ وقد يعني متيناً موثوقاً
entries.example: Ice is water in solid form.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being solid, firm, or reliable.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلابة أو متانة أو موثوقية
entries.example: The solidity of the old stone walls impressed the visitors.

entries.definitionEn: To speak one's thoughts aloud when alone, especially as a character in a play.
entries.arabicMeaning: يناجي نفسه جهراً، وخصوصاً في دور مسرحي
entries.example: The actor began to soliloquize in the empty hall.

entries.definitionEn: The philosophical view that only one's own mind can be known to exist.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرية لا ترى يقيناً إلا وجود العقل الذاتي
entries.example: Critics accused the essay of sliding into solipsism.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being alone, without companions.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحدة وانفراد عن الناس
entries.example: He chose the solitariness of a cabin in the woods.

entries.definitionEn: Done or existing alone; without the company of others.
entries.arabicMeaning: منفرد أو منعزل بلا رفقة
entries.example: She took a solitary walk along the beach at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Informal for a prison punishment of being kept completely alone. Also a person who lives in isolation.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحبس الانفرادي في السجن؛ وقد تعني شخصاً يعيش في عزلة
entries.example: The prisoner spent three days in solitary.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being alone, often by choice and in a peaceful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عزلة هادئة يختارها المرء غالباً
entries.example: She needed a few days of solitude to finish the book.

entries.definitionEn: Done by one person alone, without others.
entries.arabicMeaning: فردي يؤدّيه شخص واحد
entries.example: She made a solo flight across the country.

entries.definitionEn: Alone; without anyone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمفرده؛ من دون أحد
entries.example: He prefers to travel solo.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of music played or sung by one person, or a performance done alone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطع موسيقي أو غنائي يؤديه شخص واحد، أو أداء منفرد
entries.example: The guitarist played a short solo in the middle of the song.

entries.definitionEn: An answer to a problem, or a liquid in which something has been dissolved.
entries.arabicMeaning: حل لمشكلة، أو محلول تذوب فيه مادة
entries.example: We need a solution to this delay.

entries.definitionEn: To find an answer to a problem or puzzle.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحلّ مسألة أو لغزاً
entries.example: Can you help me solve this puzzle?

entries.definitionEn: A liquid that can dissolve another substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذيب سائل يذيب مادة أخرى
entries.example: Use a mild solvent to remove the paint.

entries.definitionEn: Dark, serious, and sad in mood or appearance.
entries.arabicMeaning: كئيب قاتم الجدّية والحزن
entries.example: The room was painted in somber colors.

entries.definitionEn: In a somber way; with a serious or sad manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بكآبة أو بجدّية حزينة
entries.example: They walked somberly out of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to mean an amount or number that is not exact, and not all.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعض؛ تدل على مقدار غير محدد وليس الكل
entries.example: I bought some apples at the market.

entries.definitionEn: An unspecified amount or number of people or things, but not all of them.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعضهم أو بعضها؛ مقدار غير مسمّى من الناس أو الأشياء
entries.example: Some of the students stayed after class.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is not named or not known.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص ما غير مسمّى
entries.example: Somebody left a bag on the chair.

entries.definitionEn: At an unknown time in the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: في يوم من الأيام مستقبلاً
entries.example: Someday I would like to visit that museum.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not known or not easy to explain.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطريقة ما غير واضحة
entries.example: We somehow finished the work before the deadline.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is not named or not known; the same as somebody.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحدهم؛ شخص غير مسمّى
entries.example: Someone is knocking at the door.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a place that is not named; mainly used in American English for somewhere.
entries.arabicMeaning: في مكان ما؛ استعمال أمريكي بمعنى في موضع غير مسمّى
entries.example: Let's go someplace quiet to talk.

entries.definitionEn: A movement in which the body turns over completely in the air or on the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: شقلبة يدور فيها الجسم دورة كاملة
entries.example: The gymnast landed a perfect somersault.

entries.definitionEn: To perform a somersault; to turn over completely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشقلب أو يدور دورة كاملة
entries.example: The child somersaulted across the mat.

entries.definitionEn: A thing that is not named or not known.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء ما غير مسمّى
entries.example: I have something to tell you.

entries.definitionEn: At a time that is not specified, in the past or future.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وقت ما غير محدد
entries.example: We should meet sometime next week.

entries.definitionEn: On some occasions but not always.
entries.arabicMeaning: أحياناً؛ في بعض الأوقات لا دائماً
entries.example: Sometimes I walk to work instead of taking the bus.

entries.definitionEn: To a limited degree; rather.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد ما؛ نوعاً ما
entries.example: The exam was somewhat harder than I expected.

entries.definitionEn: In or to a place that is not named or not known.
entries.arabicMeaning: في مكان ما أو إلى مكان غير مسمّى
entries.example: I left my keys somewhere in the house.

entries.definitionEn: The husband of your daughter.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوج الابنة؛ صهر
entries.example: Her son-in-law helped her move the furniture.

entries.definitionEn: A male child.
entries.arabicMeaning: ابن ذكر
entries.example: Their son is ten years old.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of music with words that you sing.
entries.arabicMeaning: أغنية ذات كلمات ولحن
entries.example: She sang a song she learned at school.

entries.definitionEn: A poem of fourteen lines with a fixed pattern of rhyme.
entries.arabicMeaning: سونيت؛ قصيدة من أربعة عشر بيتاً بنظام قافية ثابت
entries.example: He wrote a sonnet about the changing seasons.

entries.definitionEn: In a short time from now.
entries.arabicMeaning: قريباً؛ بعد وقت قصير
entries.example: Dinner will be ready soon.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel calmer, or to reduce pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهدّئ شخصاً أو يخفف ألماً
entries.example: A cup of tea helped soothe her nerves.

entries.definitionEn: Knowing a lot about culture and the world, or complex and advanced in design.
entries.arabicMeaning: راقٍ واسع الاطلاع، أو معقّد متقدم التصميم
entries.example: The software has a sophisticated security system.

entries.definitionEn: A student in the second year of high school or college, especially in the United States.
entries.arabicMeaning: طالب في السنة الثانية من المدرسة الثانوية أو الجامعة، وخصوصاً في الولايات المتحدة
entries.example: She is a sophomore studying biology.

entries.definitionEn: Painful and uncomfortable, often from injury or too much use.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلم أو موجع، غالباً من إصابة أو إرهاق
entries.example: His legs were sore after the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of deep sadness, especially after a loss.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزن عميق، وخصوصاً بعد فقد
entries.example: They shared their sorrow after the funeral.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling sad because you have done something wrong, or used to apologize. Also feeling sympathy.
entries.arabicMeaning: نادم أو معتذر؛ وقد تعني مشفقاً
entries.example: I am sorry I was late.

entries.definitionEn: A type or kind of person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوع أو صنف من الأشخاص أو الأشياء
entries.example: What sort of music do you like?

entries.definitionEn: To put things into groups or into an order.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتّب الأشياء في مجموعات أو حسب نظام
entries.example: Please sort the letters by date.

entries.definitionEn: The spiritual part of a person. Also deep feeling, or a kind and living person.
entries.arabicMeaning: روح الإنسان؛ وقد تعني عمقاً شعورياً أو شخصاً طيباً
entries.example: She believes every person has a soul.

entries.definitionEn: In good condition and reliable, or based on good reasons and judgment.
entries.arabicMeaning: سليم متين، أو قائم على أسباب سديدة
entries.example: The engineer said the bridge was structurally sound.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you can hear.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوت يُسمَع
entries.example: I heard a strange sound in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: To produce a noise, or to seem a particular way from what you hear or read.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُصدر صوتاً، أو يبدو على نحو معيّن مما يُسمَع أو يُقرأ
entries.example: That sounds like a good plan.

entries.definitionEn: The recorded music that accompanies a film, show, or video game.
entries.arabicMeaning: الموسيقى التصويرية لفيلم أو عرض أو لعبة
entries.example: I bought the soundtrack because I loved the film's music.

entries.definitionEn: A liquid food made by cooking vegetables, meat, or fish in water or stock.
entries.arabicMeaning: حساء يُطبخ من خضار أو لحم أو سمك
entries.example: She had a bowl of vegetable soup for lunch.

entries.definitionEn: Having a sharp taste like lemon or unripe fruit. Also unfriendly or bad-tempered.
entries.arabicMeaning: حامض المذاق كالحامض أو الفاكهة الفجّة؛ وقد يعني عابس المزاج
entries.example: These apples are still too sour to eat.

entries.definitionEn: The place, person, or thing that something comes from.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصدر يأتي منه الشيء
entries.example: The river is the main source of water for the town.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the south.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوبي؛ في الجنوب أو باتجاهه
entries.example: They live on the south side of the city.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the south.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوباً؛ باتجاه الجنوب
entries.example: The birds fly south in winter.

entries.definitionEn: The direction that is opposite north, or the southern part of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنوب؛ الجهة المقابلة للشمال أو الجزء الجنوبي من مكان
entries.example: The mountains lie to the south of the lake.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the southeast.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوبي شرقي؛ في الجنوب الشرقي أو باتجاهه
entries.example: A southeast wind brought warmer air.

entries.definitionEn: The direction between south and east, or the area that lies that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنوب الشرقي؛ الجهة بين الجنوب والشرق أو المنطقة الواقعة فيها
entries.example: The storm moved in from the southeast.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the south of a country or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوبي؛ من جنوب بلد أو منطقة أو فيها
entries.example: She grew up in a southern town near the coast.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the south.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوباً؛ في اتجاه الجنوب
entries.example: The river flows southward through the valley.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the southwest.
entries.arabicMeaning: جنوبي غربي؛ في الجنوب الغربي أو باتجاهه
entries.example: They bought a house on the southwest corner of the street.

entries.definitionEn: The direction between south and west, or the area that lies that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجنوب الغربي؛ الجهة بين الجنوب والغرب أو المنطقة الواقعة فيها
entries.example: Dry weather is common in the southwest of the country.

entries.definitionEn: Something you buy or keep to remember a place or event.
entries.arabicMeaning: تذكار يُشترى أو يُحفظ ذكرى لمكان أو مناسبة
entries.example: She bought a small souvenir from the museum shop.

entries.definitionEn: A person from the former Soviet Union. Historically, also a council in that political system.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص من الاتحاد السوفييتي السابق؛ وقد تعني مجلساً في ذلك النظام
entries.example: Her grandfather was a Soviet who later became a citizen of an independent state.

entries.definitionEn: A bean grown for its oil, for food, and for animal feed.
entries.arabicMeaning: فول الصويا يُزرع للزيت والغذاء وعلف الحيوانات
entries.example: This cooking oil is pressed from the soybean.

entries.definitionEn: A place where people go for health treatments, baths, and rest.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتجع صحي للاستحمام والعلاج والاسترخاء
entries.example: They spent a weekend at a spa in the mountains.

entries.definitionEn: An empty area that can be used, or the area beyond the Earth where the stars and planets are.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيّز فارغ يمكن استخدامه، أو الفضاء خارج الأرض
entries.example: There is not enough space in this cupboard.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle designed to travel in space.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركبة فضائية
entries.example: The children built a model of a spaceship.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of room; large and not crowded.
entries.arabicMeaning: فسيح واسع غير مزدحم
entries.example: The apartment is spacious enough for a home office.
