entries.definitionEn: The light and warmth that come from the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: أشعة الشمس ودفؤها
entries.example: The children played in the sunshine.

entries.definitionEn: Informal. Very good.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: That was a super meal; thank you.

entries.definitionEn: Excellent; of very high quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتاز رفيع الجودة
entries.example: The orchestra gave a superb performance.

entries.definitionEn: On the surface only; not deep, thorough, or sincere.
entries.arabicMeaning: سطحي لا يعمق ولا يصدق تماماً
entries.example: The article offered only a superficial account of the problem.

entries.definitionEn: On the surface; without going deeply into something.
entries.arabicMeaning: على السطح من غير تعمق
entries.example: The two plans look similar, but only superficially.

entries.definitionEn: More than is needed; unnecessary.
entries.arabicMeaning: زائد على الحاجة؛ غير ضروري
entries.example: Please delete any superfluous words from the letter.

entries.definitionEn: In an unnecessary way; more than is required.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو زائد لا تدعو إليه الحاجة
entries.example: He added, rather superfluously, that the meeting was already over.

entries.definitionEn: A person in charge of a department, building, school district, or police unit.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناظر أو مشرف أعلى على قسم أو مبنى أو جهاز
entries.example: The building superintendent fixed the broken lift.

entries.definitionEn: Better than others of the same type, or higher in rank.
entries.arabicMeaning: أفضل من غيره، أو أعلى رتبة
entries.example: This cloth is of superior quality.

entries.definitionEn: The form of an adjective or adverb that shows the highest degree, such as best or tallest.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة التفضيل العليا للصفة أو الظرف، مثل best أو tallest
entries.example: Biggest is the superlative of big.

entries.definitionEn: A large shop that sells food and other things for the home.
entries.arabicMeaning: سوبرماركت: متجر كبير للطعام ومستلزمات البيت
entries.example: I bought milk and bread at the supermarket.

entries.definitionEn: Not explained by the laws of nature, involving ghosts, magic, or similar forces.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارق للطبيعة، كالأشباح أو السحر
entries.example: The story is full of supernatural events.

entries.definitionEn: A very famous and successful performer or sports player.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجم بالغ الشهرة في الفن أو الرياضة
entries.example: The film made her a superstar almost overnight.

entries.definitionEn: A belief that is not based on reason, often about luck or omens.
entries.arabicMeaning: خرافة أو اعتقاد لا يستند إلى عقل، وغالباً عن الحظ
entries.example: Walking under a ladder is, by superstition, said to bring bad luck.

entries.definitionEn: To watch and direct work or people so that it is done correctly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرف على عمل أو أشخاص كي يُنجَز على الوجه الصحيح
entries.example: A teacher must supervise the students during the exam.

entries.definitionEn: The act of watching and directing work or people.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشراف ومتابعة للعمل أو للأشخاص
entries.example: Young children should not swim without supervision.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to supervise other people at work.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشرف على العاملين
entries.example: Speak to your supervisor if the machine stops working.

entries.definitionEn: A meal that you eat in the evening.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشاء: وجبة المساء
entries.example: We had soup and bread for supper.

entries.definitionEn: Bending or moving easily; not stiff.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرن يتحرك بسهولة غير متصلب
entries.example: Years of dance had kept her body supple.

entries.definitionEn: Something added to complete or improve something else, such as extra pages or extra nutrients.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملحق أو إضافة تكمّل شيئاً أو تحسّنه، كصفحات زائدة أو عناصر غذائية
entries.example: The weekend paper includes a travel supplement.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that provides goods or services.
entries.arabicMeaning: مورّد يقدّم سلعاً أو خدمات
entries.example: We need a new supplier for office paper.

entries.definitionEn: An amount of something that is available to be used.
entries.arabicMeaning: مخزون أو كمية متاحة للاستعمال
entries.example: There is a limited supply of tickets.

entries.definitionEn: To provide something that is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمدّ بما يُحتاج إليه
entries.example: The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.

entries.definitionEn: Help or encouragement, or something that holds a thing up.
entries.arabicMeaning: دعم أو تشجيع، أو سند يحمل شيئاً
entries.example: Thank you for your support during a difficult week.

entries.definitionEn: To help someone or something, or to hold something so that it does not fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدعم شخصاً أو أمراً، أو يسند شيئاً كي لا يسقط
entries.example: Her friends supported her when she changed jobs.

entries.definitionEn: A person who agrees with a person, team, or idea and wants them to succeed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤيد لشخص أو فريق أو فكرة
entries.example: Thousands of supporters filled the stadium.

entries.definitionEn: Giving help and encouragement.
entries.arabicMeaning: داعم يقدّم العون والتشجيع
entries.example: She has a very supportive family.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something is likely to be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظنّ أن أمراً راجح
entries.example: I suppose the train will be late again.

entries.definitionEn: According to what is said or believed, though it may not be true.
entries.arabicMeaning: فيما يُقال أو يُظَنّ، وقد لا يكون صحيحاً
entries.example: The shop is supposedly open until ten, but the door was locked.

entries.definitionEn: To stop something from being expressed, published, or continuing.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكبت أمراً أو يمنعه من الظهور أو الاستمرار
entries.example: She tried to suppress a laugh during the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Certain that something is true; not having doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: واثق لا يساوره شك
entries.example: Are you sure this is the right address?

entries.definitionEn: Informal. Used to mean yes, or certainly.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعم أو بالتأكيد في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: Sure, I can help you with that.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that you believe something must be true, or to express surprise that it might not be.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل للتعبير عن أن الأمر لا بد أن يكون كذلك
entries.example: Surely you remember her from last year's conference.

entries.definitionEn: The white foam of waves as they break on the shore.
entries.arabicMeaning: زبد الأمواج حين تتكسر على الشاطئ
entries.example: Children played at the edge of the surf.

entries.definitionEn: To ride on waves on a board, or to look through pages on the internet.
entries.arabicMeaning: يركب الأمواج على لوح، أو يتصفّح صفحات الإنترنت
entries.example: He likes to surf early in the morning when the waves are quiet.

entries.definitionEn: The outside or top layer of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: سطح الشيء أو طبقته الخارجية
entries.example: The surface of the table was smooth and clean.

entries.definitionEn: The sport of riding on waves on a board.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة ركوب الأمواج على لوح
entries.example: Surfing is popular on this stretch of coast.

entries.definitionEn: To increase or move forward suddenly and with great force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يندفع أو يرتفع فجأة بقوة
entries.example: Demand for electricity can surge on very hot days.

entries.definitionEn: A doctor who treats injury or disease by cutting into the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرّاح يعالج بالجراحة
entries.example: The surgeon explained the operation in simple words.

entries.definitionEn: Medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into the body. In British English, also a doctor's office.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية جراحية؛ وفي الإنجليزية البريطانية أيضاً عيادة الطبيب
entries.example: She had surgery on her knee last month.

entries.definitionEn: The name that you share with other people in your family; your last name.
entries.arabicMeaning: اسم العائلة؛ اللقب
entries.example: Please write your surname in capital letters.

entries.definitionEn: Something that happens that you did not expect, or the feeling this causes.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفاجأة أو شعور الدهشة مما لم يُتوقَّع
entries.example: The party was a complete surprise.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel surprise because something unexpected happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفاجئ شخصاً بأمر غير متوقع
entries.example: Her question surprised me.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling surprise because something unexpected has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفاجئ مما لم يتوقعه
entries.example: I was surprised to see him at the door.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel surprise; unexpected.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفاجئ غير متوقع
entries.example: It is surprising how quickly the days get shorter.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is unexpected.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مفاجئ
entries.example: The test was surprisingly easy.

entries.definitionEn: A movement in art and literature that presents dreamlike, unexpected images rather than ordinary reality.
entries.arabicMeaning: السريالية: اتجاه فني وأدبي يقدّم صوراً حلمية غير مألوفة
entries.example: The museum has a room devoted to surrealism.

entries.definitionEn: An artist or writer who works in the style of surrealism.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريالي: فنان أو كاتب يعمل وفق السريالية
entries.example: The young surrealist exhibited collages of everyday objects.

entries.definitionEn: To stop resisting and give control or a possession to someone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستسلم ويتوقف عن المقاومة، أو يسلّم ما بيده
entries.example: He agreed to surrender his old passport when he collected the new one.

entries.definitionEn: Done secretly, because it would not be approved of if it were seen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متخفٍّ يُفعَل خلسة خشية الإنكار
entries.example: She cast a surreptitious glance at the clock.

entries.definitionEn: In a secret, unnoticed way.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلسة من غير أن يُلاحَظ
entries.example: He surreptitiously checked his phone under the table.

entries.definitionEn: To be or go all around someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحيط بشخص أو شيء من كل جانب
entries.example: Tall trees surround the house.

entries.definitionEn: That is around a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: محيط بمكان أو شخص
entries.example: People came from the surrounding villages to the market.

entries.definitionEn: The area and conditions around a person or place.
entries.arabicMeaning: البيئة المحيطة بمكان أو شخص
entries.example: She felt calm in the quiet surroundings of the garden.

entries.definitionEn: Close watching of a person or place, often by cameras or by the police.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراقبة لصيقة لشخص أو مكان، وغالباً بكاميرات أو من الشرطة
entries.example: The shop uses cameras for surveillance at night.

entries.definitionEn: A set of questions to find out what people think or do.
entries.arabicMeaning: استطلاع بالأسئلة لمعرفة آراء الناس أو سلوكهم
entries.example: Please fill in this short survey after your visit.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of continuing to live or exist, especially after danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقاء على قيد الحياة أو استمرار الوجود بعد خطر
entries.example: Clean water is essential for survival in the desert.

entries.definitionEn: To continue to live after a dangerous event or a difficult period.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينجو ويبقى حيّاً بعد خطر أو محنة
entries.example: Luckily, everyone survived the accident.

entries.definitionEn: A person who continues to live after an accident, illness, or disaster.
entries.arabicMeaning: ناجٍ بقي حيّاً بعد حادث أو مرض أو كارثة
entries.example: A survivor of the crash described the rescue.

entries.definitionEn: A person who the police think may have committed a crime.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشتبه فيه تظن الشرطة أنه قد ارتكب جريمة
entries.example: The police released the suspect after questioning.

entries.definitionEn: To think that someone may be guilty, or that something is likely, especially something unwelcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: يظنّ أن شخصاً مذنب أو أن أمراً راجح، وغالباً مما يُكرَه
entries.example: I suspect the train will be delayed again.

entries.definitionEn: To stop something for a time, or to hang something so that it hangs freely.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّق أمراً موقتاً، أو يعلّق شيئاً في الهواء
entries.example: The school decided to suspend the trip until next month.

entries.definitionEn: The official stopping of an activity or a person from a role for a period. Also a mixture in which particles hang in a liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقف رسمي مؤقت لنشاط أو شخص عن مهمة؛ أو معلّق دقائق في سائل
entries.example: He received a two-week suspension from the team.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling that someone has done something wrong, without definite proof.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريبة من غير دليل قاطع أن أحداً قد أخطأ
entries.example: She was arrested on suspicion of theft.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling that something is wrong, or making other people feel that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مريب يبعث الشك، أو شاكّ في أمر
entries.example: The guard became suspicious of the unattended bag.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows or causes suspicion.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مريب
entries.example: He glanced suspiciously at the open drawer.

entries.definitionEn: To keep something going over time, or to support it so that it can continue.
entries.arabicMeaning: يديم أمراً أو يسنده كي يستمر
entries.example: The charity needs regular gifts to sustain its work.

entries.definitionEn: Able to continue over time without destroying the resources needed for the future.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستدام يمكن أن يستمر من غير استنزاف موارد المستقبل
entries.example: The farm uses sustainable methods that protect the soil.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can continue without harming future resources.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مستدام لا يضرّ موارد المستقبل
entries.example: The forest is managed sustainably so that trees can grow again.

entries.definitionEn: To make food or drink go down your throat.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبتلع الطعام أو الشراب
entries.example: Chew the bread well before you swallow.

entries.definitionEn: A large water bird, usually white, with a long neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: بجعة: طائر مائي كبير أبيض في الغالب طويل العنق
entries.example: A swan glided across the lake.

entries.definitionEn: An exchange of one thing for another.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقايضة شيء بشيء
entries.example: We arranged a swap of desks so she could sit by the window.

entries.definitionEn: To give one thing and receive another in its place.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبادل شيئاً بشيء
entries.example: Can we swap seats so I can sit with my friend?

entries.definitionEn: A large group of insects flying or moving together.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرب كثيف من الحشرات يتحرك معاً
entries.example: A swarm of bees settled on the garden wall.

entries.definitionEn: To use rude language, or to make a serious promise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبّ بكلام فاحش، أو يحلف يميناً جدّياً
entries.example: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth in court.

entries.definitionEn: Moisture that comes through the skin when you are hot, ill, or nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرق يخرج من الجلد عند الحر أو المرض أو التوتر
entries.example: After the climb, his shirt was wet with sweat.

entries.definitionEn: To produce liquid from your skin when you are hot or nervous.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعرق حين يسخن الجسم أو يتوتر
entries.example: I always sweat when I run in the heat.

entries.definitionEn: A warm knitted piece of clothing for the upper body.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنزة دافئة محاكة للجزء العلوي من الجسم
entries.example: She put on a thick sweater because the room was cold.

entries.definitionEn: A loose cotton top with long sleeves, often worn for sport or at home.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلوزة قطنية فضفاضة بأكمام طويلة تُلبس للرياضة أو في البيت
entries.example: He wore a grey sweatshirt to the gym.

entries.definitionEn: To move quickly across an area. Also to clean a floor with a broom.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجتاز مساحة بسرعة؛ وأيضاً يكنس الأرض بمكنسة
entries.example: A cold wind swept across the empty square.

entries.definitionEn: Having a taste like sugar.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلو المذاق كالسكر
entries.example: This tea is too sweet for me.

entries.definitionEn: A small piece of sugary food. In British English, also a sweet dish at the end of a meal.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة صغيرة من الحلوى؛ وفي الإنجليزية البريطانية أيضاً طبق الحلوى في آخر الوجبة
entries.example: The children were each given a sweet after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: A person you love romantically. Also used as a kind way to speak to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحبيب أو الحبيبة؛ وتُستعمل أيضاً لمخاطبة شخص برفق
entries.example: He bought flowers for his sweetheart.

entries.definitionEn: To become larger and rounder than usual, often because of injury or fluid under the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتورم أو ينتفخ، غالباً بسبب إصابة أو تجمع سائل تحت الجلد
entries.example: Her ankle began to swell after she twisted it.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or moving very quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع خاطف في الحركة أو الحدوث
entries.example: They made a swift decision to leave.

entries.definitionEn: A time spent swimming for exercise or pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة سباحة للرياضة أو المتعة
entries.example: Let's go for a swim this afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To move through water using your arms and legs.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسبح بذراعيه وساقيه
entries.example: Can you swim across the lake?

entries.definitionEn: A person who swims, especially as a sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: سبّاح، وخصوصاً من يمارس السباحة رياضة
entries.example: She is a strong swimmer and trains every morning.

entries.definitionEn: Clothing worn for swimming, especially by women; a British term.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملابس سباحة، وخصوصاً للنساء؛ تعبير بريطاني
entries.example: Don't forget your swimming costume if we go to the beach.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or sport of moving through water.
entries.arabicMeaning: السباحة نشاطاً أو رياضة
entries.example: Swimming is good exercise.

entries.definitionEn: A large structure filled with water for people to swim in.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسبح يُملأ بالماء للسباحة
entries.example: The hotel has a large swimming pool.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing worn for swimming.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملابس سباحة
entries.example: She packed a swimsuit for the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: A seat hanging from ropes or chains that moves back and forth. Also a swinging movement, or a change from one state to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرجوحة معلّقة؛ وأيضاً حركة تأرجح أو تحوّل من حال إلى حال
entries.example: The children took turns on the swing in the park.

entries.definitionEn: To move freely back and forth while hanging, or to make something do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتأرجح ذهاباً وإياباً وهو معلّق، أو يحرّك شيئاً على هذا النحو
entries.example: The door started to swing open in the wind.

entries.definitionEn: A small device that you press or move to turn something on or off.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفتاح يُضغط أو يُحرَّك لتشغيل شيء أو إيقافه
entries.example: The light switch is next to the door.

entries.definitionEn: To change from one thing to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبدّل من شيء إلى آخر
entries.example: She decided to switch to a new phone company.

entries.definitionEn: To turn around a fixed central point, or to make something turn in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدور حول محور ثابت، أو يدير شيئاً على هذا النحو
entries.example: He swivelled the lamp so that it shone on the page.

entries.definitionEn: Larger than usual because of injury, infection, or fluid under the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: متورّم أكبر من المعتاد بسبب إصابة أو التهاب أو سائل تحت الجلد
entries.example: His swollen finger made it hard to hold a pen.

entries.definitionEn: A weapon with a long, sharp metal blade and a handle.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيف ذو نصل معدني طويل حاد ومقبض
entries.example: The museum displayed a sword from the last century.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to syllables, or organized according to them, as in some kinds of verse or speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطعي؛ متعلق بالمقاطع الصوتية أو قائم عليها كما في بعض الشعر والكلام
entries.example: The poem uses a syllabic pattern of seven beats per line.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of sound in a word that usually contains a vowel.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطع صوتي في الكلمة يحتوي عادة على حركة
entries.example: The word computer has three syllables.

entries.definitionEn: A sign, shape, or object that represents an idea, person, or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمز يمثّل فكرة أو شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: A heart is a symbol of love.

entries.definitionEn: Representing an idea or quality rather than mattering only in a practical way.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمزي يعبّر عن فكرة أو صفة أكثر مما يهم عملياً وحده
entries.example: The handshake was a symbolic end to the long dispute.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that you understand and care about someone's feelings, especially when they have a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعاطف يُظهر فهماً واهتماماً بمشاعر غيره، وخصوصاً عند الضيق
entries.example: She was sympathetic when I told her I had failed the exam.

entries.definitionEn: To feel or show understanding and care for someone who is having problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعاطف مع من يعاني مشكلة ويُظهر تفهّماً
entries.example: I sympathize with anyone who has to work such long hours.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of understanding and caring about someone else's problems or suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاطف وفهم لمعاناة غيره أو مشكلاته
entries.example: We sent flowers as a sign of sympathy.

entries.definitionEn: A long piece of music written for an orchestra, usually in several parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيمفونية: قطعة موسيقية طويلة للأوركسترا، غالباً في عدة أجزاء
entries.example: The orchestra played a famous symphony last night.

entries.definitionEn: A change in the body or mind that shows a person may have an illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرَض يدل على احتمال وجود مرض
entries.example: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.

entries.definitionEn: Being a sign of an illness or of a larger problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: عرَضي؛ يدل على مرض أو على مشكلة أوسع
entries.example: The delays were symptomatic of poor planning.

entries.definitionEn: A set of medical symptoms that occur together and suggest a particular condition.
entries.arabicMeaning: متلازمة: مجموعة أعراض تظهر معاً وتشير إلى حالة معيّنة
entries.example: The doctor explained the syndrome in simple language.

entries.definitionEn: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرادف لكلمة أخرى في المعنى أو قريب منها
entries.example: Begin is a synonym of start.

entries.definitionEn: A short summary of the main points of a book, film, or piece of writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: موجز لأبرز نقاط كتاب أو فيلم أو نص
entries.example: The back cover gives a brief synopsis of the novel.

entries.definitionEn: The combining of separate ideas, substances, or elements into a coherent whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: توليف عناصر أو أفكار منفصلة في كلٍّ متماسك
entries.example: Her essay is a synthesis of history and personal memory.

entries.definitionEn: Made by a chemical process rather than occurring naturally, especially of materials.
entries.arabicMeaning: اصطناعي يُصنع كيميائياً لا يوجد في الطبيعة، وخصوصاً للمواد
entries.example: The jacket is made of synthetic fabric.

entries.definitionEn: By artificial chemical means rather than by a natural process.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطريقة كيميائية اصطناعية لا طبيعية
entries.example: The flavouring is produced synthetically in a laboratory.

entries.definitionEn: A set of connected things or methods that work together for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظام من أشياء أو أساليب مترابطة تعمل لغرض واحد
entries.example: The school has a new system for borrowing books.

entries.definitionEn: Done according to a careful plan and in an organized way.
entries.arabicMeaning: منهجي يُنجَز وفق خطة منظمة
entries.example: They made a systematic search of every room.

entries.definitionEn: A simple cotton shirt with short sleeves and no collar.
entries.arabicMeaning: تي شيرت قطني بسيط بأكمام قصيرة بلا ياقة
entries.example: He wore a white T-shirt and jeans.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs, used for eating, working, or putting things on.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاولة ذات سطح مسطح وأرجل للأكل أو العمل أو وضع الأشياء
entries.example: Please put the plates on the table.

entries.definitionEn: An indoor game in which players hit a small ball over a net on a table.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنس الطاولة: لعبة داخلية يضرب فيها اللاعبون كرة صغيرة فوق شبكة على طاولة
entries.example: We played table tennis after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A cloth spread over a table, especially before a meal.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرش يُفرش على المائدة، وخصوصاً قبل الطعام
entries.example: She laid a white tablecloth on the dining table.

entries.definitionEn: A large spoon used for serving food, or the amount it holds as a cooking measure.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملعقة كبيرة للتقديم، أو مقدار ما تحمله في الوصفات
entries.example: Add two tablespoons of oil to the pan.

entries.definitionEn: A small portable computer with a touch screen. Also a small solid piece of medicine.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز لوحي بشاشة لمس؛ وأيضاً قرص دواء
entries.example: She reads the news on her tablet every morning.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to newspapers that use short, striking stories and large photographs, often about famous people.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالصحف الشعبية ذات الأخبار القصيرة المثيرة والصور الكبيرة، غالباً عن المشاهير
entries.example: He prefers serious papers to tabloid headlines.

entries.definitionEn: A newspaper of that kind, typically smaller in page size and more sensational in style.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيفة شعبية صغيرة القطع تميل إلى الإثارة
entries.example: The story appeared on the front page of a tabloid.

entries.definitionEn: Understood or agreed without being spoken or written.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمني مفهوم أو متفق عليه من غير أن يُقال أو يُكتب
entries.example: There was a tacit agreement not to mention the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is understood without being stated openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ضمني من غير تصريح
entries.example: The board tacitly accepted the new timetable.

entries.definitionEn: Saying very little; habitually quiet and reserved in speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الكلام؛ صامت متحفظ في حديثه عادة
entries.example: The taciturn driver answered only with a nod.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being habitually silent or reserved in speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: صمت وتحفّظ معتاد في الكلام
entries.example: His taciturnity made him hard to know at first.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something loosely with a small nail or pin. Also to add something extra, often quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبّت شيئاً بمسمار أو دبوس صغير على نحو غير محكم؛ وأيضاً يضيف شيئاً إضافياً على عجل
entries.example: She tacked the poster to the wall.

entries.definitionEn: To make a serious effort to deal with a difficult problem. In sport, to try to take the ball from an opponent.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصدى لمشكلة صعبة بجدّ؛ وفي الرياضة يحاول انتزاع الكرة من الخصم
entries.example: The city must tackle traffic delays this year.

entries.definitionEn: Skill in dealing with people or difficult situations without causing offence.
entries.arabicMeaning: لباقة في التعامل مع الناس أو المواقف الحرجة من غير إساءة
entries.example: You need tact when you give someone criticism.

entries.definitionEn: Careful not to say or do anything that would upset or offend someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: لبق يتحاشى ما يجرح أو يسيء
entries.example: A tactful reminder is better than an angry email.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that avoids causing offence or embarrassment.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلباقة تتجنّب الإساءة أو الإحراج
entries.example: She tactfully changed the subject.

entries.definitionEn: A planned method or manoeuvre used to achieve a particular immediate aim.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسلوب أو مناورة مخططة لتحقيق هدف قريب
entries.example: Delaying the announcement was a deliberate tactic.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to tactics; chosen for a short-term advantage rather than a lasting principle.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكتيكي؛ مختار لمصلحة قريبة لا لمبدأ دائم
entries.example: They made a tactical change in the second half.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is planned for a short-term advantage.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو تكتيكي يخدم مصلحة قريبة
entries.example: The team was tactically stronger after the substitution.

entries.definitionEn: A small label attached to something to give information, such as a name or price.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة صغيرة تُعلَّق على شيء لبيان اسم أو سعر
entries.example: The price tag was still on the jacket.

entries.definitionEn: The long part at the back of an animal's body. Also the last or rear part of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذيل الحيوان؛ وأيضاً الجزء الخلفي أو الأخير من شيء
entries.example: The dog wagged its tail when we came in.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to make clothes, especially men's suits, to fit individual customers.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيّاط يصنع الملابس، وخصوصاً بدلات الرجال، حسب مقاس الزبون
entries.example: He had the suit made by a local tailor.

entries.definitionEn: To make or adapt something so that it is exactly right for a particular person or purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكيّف شيئاً أو يصنعه ليناسب شخصاً أو غرضاً بعينه
entries.example: The course is tailored to the needs of new managers.

entries.definitionEn: A particular opinion or interpretation of a situation. Also one continuous recorded attempt at a scene.
entries.arabicMeaning: رؤية أو تفسير معيّن لموقف؛ وأيضاً لقطة تصوير متصلة واحدة
entries.example: I'd like to hear your take on the new schedule.

entries.definitionEn: To get hold of something and move it, or to carry it with you. Also used for transport, time, and medicine.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأخذ شيئاً وينقله أو يحمله؛ ويُستخدم أيضاً مع وسائل النقل والوقت والدواء
entries.example: Please take this letter to the office.

entries.definitionEn: A meal that you buy and take home to eat. Also the main point you remember from a talk or meeting.
entries.arabicMeaning: وجبة تُشترى وتُؤكل في البيت؛ وأيضاً الخلاصة المستفادة من حديث أو اجتماع
entries.example: We ordered a takeaway because we were too tired to cook.

entries.definitionEn: The moment when an aircraft leaves the ground and begins to fly.
entries.arabicMeaning: إقلاع الطائرة عن الأرض وبدء التحليق
entries.example: Please stay seated during takeoff.

entries.definitionEn: A story, especially one that is imagined or told for interest rather than as exact fact.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكاية، وخصوصاً متخيّلة أو تُروى للمتعة لا بوصفها واقعاً دقيقاً
entries.example: Grandfather told a tale about his first journey abroad.

entries.definitionEn: A natural ability to do something well.
entries.arabicMeaning: موهبة طبيعية في عمل شيء بإجادة
entries.example: She has a talent for languages.

entries.definitionEn: Having a natural skill or ability.
entries.arabicMeaning: موهوب ذو مهارة طبيعية
entries.example: He is a talented young musician.

entries.definitionEn: A conversation, or a speech given to a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: حديث بين أشخاص، أو كلمة تُلقى على مجموعة
entries.example: She gave a short talk about her research.

entries.definitionEn: To say words to someone; to speak.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتكلم مع أحد
entries.example: Can I talk to you for a minute?

entries.definitionEn: Of greater than average height; not short.
entries.arabicMeaning: طويل القامة
entries.example: My sister is taller than I am.

entries.definitionEn: Of an animal, not wild and used to living with people. Of an activity, dull and not exciting.
entries.arabicMeaning: أليف غير متوحش ومعتاد على الناس؛ وللأنشطة يعني فاتراً قليل الإثارة
entries.example: The tame birds ate from her hand.

entries.definitionEn: The brown colour that skin gets from being in the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمرة يكتسبها الجلد من الشمس
entries.example: She came back from the holiday with a deep tan.

entries.definitionEn: A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things. Also a confused or complicated situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتلة متشابكة من خيوط أو شعر أو نحوه؛ وأيضاً وضع معقّد مربك
entries.example: She spent ten minutes undoing the tangle in her necklace.

entries.definitionEn: To become twisted together in a messy way, or to make this happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتشابك على نحو فوضوي، أو يوقع شيئاً في التشابك
entries.example: The kite string began to tangle in the branches.

entries.definitionEn: Twisted together in a messy knot, or complicated and hard to follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشابك في عقدة فوضوية، أو معقّد يصعب تتبّعه
entries.example: His hair was wet and tangled after the swim.

entries.definitionEn: A large container for liquid or gas. Also a heavy military vehicle with a gun.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزان كبير للسائل أو الغاز؛ وأيضاً دبابة عسكرية
entries.example: The fish live in a large glass tank.

entries.definitionEn: Having brown skin from spending time in the sun.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسمر الجلد من التعرض للشمس
entries.example: His tanned face showed he had been outdoors all summer.

entries.definitionEn: To tease or torment by offering something desirable that remains just out of reach.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُغري أو يعذّب بعرض شيء مرغوب يبقى بعيد المنال
entries.example: The smell from the bakery would tantalize us every morning.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that arouses desire or curiosity while remaining just out of reach.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مُغرٍ يثير الرغبة أو الفضول بينما يبقى الشيء قريب المنال ممتنعاً
entries.example: The answer was tantalizingly close, but we could not prove it.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, noisy outburst of anger, typically when someone cannot have what they want.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوبة غضب صاخبة مفاجئة، غالباً حين لا يُنال المراد
entries.example: He threw a tantrum when the shop had sold out.

entries.definitionEn: A device that you turn to control the flow of water from a pipe.
entries.arabicMeaning: صنبور يُدار للتحكم في ماء الأنبوب
entries.example: Don't forget to turn off the tap.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something lightly, often making a small sound. Also to draw liquid or a resource from a supply.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقر شيئاً بخفة وغالباً بصوت خفيف؛ وأيضاً يستمد سائلاً أو مورداً من مصدر
entries.example: She tapped him on the shoulder to get his attention.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow strip of material used for sticking, measuring, or recording sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: شريط طويل رفيع يُستخدم للصق أو القياس أو تسجيل الصوت
entries.example: I need some tape to wrap this parcel.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something with sticky tape. Also to record sound or pictures.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلصق بشريط لاصق؛ وأيضاً يسجّل صوتاً أو صوراً
entries.example: Please tape the box shut before you post it.

entries.definitionEn: Something that you aim at, or a result that you try to achieve.
entries.arabicMeaning: هدف تسدَّد إليه، أو نتيجة تسعى لبلوغها
entries.example: Our target is to finish the work by Friday.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of work that you have to do.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهمة يتعيّن إنجازها
entries.example: My first task is to reply to these emails.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose opinions strongly influence what others regard as fashionable or in good taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: صانع ذوق تؤثّر آراؤه بقوة فيما يُعدّ رائجاً أو حسن الذوق
entries.example: The magazine's editor became a taste-maker in contemporary design.

entries.definitionEn: The flavour of food or drink as sensed by the tongue. Also a person's liking for particular styles or things.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذاق الطعام أو الشراب على اللسان؛ وأيضاً ذائقة الشخص لما يحب من الأساليب والأشياء
entries.example: I don't like the taste of this coffee.

entries.definitionEn: To notice the flavour of something in your mouth, or to try a little of it. Also to have a particular flavour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتذوّق نكهة شيء أو يجرّب منه قليلاً؛ وأيضاً يكون له مذاق معيّن
entries.example: Would you like to taste the soup?

entries.definitionEn: A small organ on the tongue that detects flavour.
entries.arabicMeaning: برعم تذوّق على اللسان يستشعر النكهة
entries.example: Each tastebud sends signals about flavour to the brain.

entries.definitionEn: Having little or no flavour. Also showing a lack of good judgement about what is suitable or attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الطعم؛ وأيضاً ركيك يدل على سوء تقدير لما يليق أو يجمل
entries.example: The soup was hot but almost tasteless.

entries.definitionEn: Having a pleasant flavour.
entries.arabicMeaning: لذيذ المذاق
entries.example: This stew is really tasty.

entries.definitionEn: A torn, hanging piece of cloth. Often used in the plural, in tatters, to mean badly torn or ruined.
entries.arabicMeaning: خرقة ممزقة متدلية؛ وغالباً بالجمع بمعنى ثياب بالية أو حال مدمَّرة
entries.example: A tatter of cloth still hung from the torn sleeve.

entries.definitionEn: A design made on the skin with ink using a needle.
entries.arabicMeaning: وشم يُرسم على الجلد بالحبر عبر إبرة
entries.example: She has a small tattoo on her wrist.

entries.definitionEn: A remark intended to hurt, annoy, or provoke someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبارة جارحة يُقصد بها الإيذاء أو الاستفزاز
entries.example: He ignored every taunt from the crowd.

entries.definitionEn: Stretched or pulled tight. Also of writing or a situation, tense and tightly controlled.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشدود بإحكام؛ وللكتابة أو الموقف يعني متوتراً مضبوطاً
entries.example: Keep the rope taut while I tie the knot.

entries.definitionEn: In a tight, stretched, or tightly controlled way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مشدود أو مضبوط بإحكام
entries.example: The canvas was stretched tautly over the frame.

entries.definitionEn: Money that people and businesses must pay to the government for public services.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضريبة يدفعها الأفراد والشركات للحكومة لتمويل الخدمات العامة
entries.example: The price includes tax.

entries.definitionEn: A car that you pay to take you somewhere.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيارة أجرة
entries.example: We took a taxi to the station.

entries.definitionEn: A hot drink made by pouring boiling water onto dried leaves, or the leaves themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاي: شراب ساخن يُحضَّر بصب الماء المغلي على أوراق مجففة
entries.example: Would you like a cup of tea?

entries.definitionEn: To help someone learn something by giving lessons or showing them how.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعلّم شخصاً شيئاً بالدرس أو بالتبيين
entries.example: She teaches mathematics at the college.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to teach, especially in a school.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلّم وخصوصاً في مدرسة
entries.example: My teacher explained the homework clearly.

entries.definitionEn: The work or profession of a teacher. Also the ideas or methods that are taught.
entries.arabicMeaning: التدريس مهنة؛ وأيضاً ما يُدرَّس من أفكار أو أساليب
entries.example: She has twenty years of teaching behind her.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people who play a sport or work together.
entries.arabicMeaning: فريق يلعب أو يعمل معاً
entries.example: Our team won the match.

entries.definitionEn: A person who belongs to the same team as you.
entries.arabicMeaning: زميل في الفريق نفسه
entries.example: Her teammate passed her the ball.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of working well together as a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: العمل الجماعي المنسّق
entries.example: Good teamwork helped us finish the project on time.

entries.definitionEn: A drop of salty liquid that comes from the eye when you cry.
entries.arabicMeaning: دمعة مالحة تسقط من العين عند البكاء
entries.example: A tear ran down her cheek.

entries.definitionEn: To pull something apart or make a hole in it by force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمزّق شيئاً أو يحدث فيه ثقباً بالقوة
entries.example: Be careful not to tear the paper.

entries.definitionEn: A person who makes fun of others in a playful way. Also a remark made in that way.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يمازح غيره أو يغيظه على سبيل الدعابة؛ وأيضاً عبارة من هذا النوع
entries.example: Don't mind him; he's just a tease.

entries.definitionEn: To laugh at someone or make jokes about them, either playfully or in an unkind way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمازح شخصاً أو يسخر منه، على سبيل الدعابة أو بقصد الإيذاء
entries.example: They used to tease him about his old bicycle.

entries.definitionEn: A small spoon used for stirring tea or coffee, or the amount it holds as a measure.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملعقة صغيرة لتحريك الشاي أو القهوة، أو مقدار ما تحمله كوحدة قياس
entries.example: Add one teaspoon of sugar to the mixture.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the practical skills and methods used in a science, art, or job. Also requiring specialized knowledge.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقني متعلق بالمهارات والأساليب العملية في علم أو فن أو مهنة؛ وقد يعني أنه يحتاج معرفة متخصصة
entries.example: The manual is full of technical terms.

entries.definitionEn: According to the exact facts or rules, even if the situation feels different. Also in a way that relates to specialized skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: من حيث الوقائع أو القواعد الدقيقة حتى لو بدا الأمر مختلفاً؛ وأيضاً من الناحية التقنية
entries.example: Technically the office is still open, but no one is at the desk.

entries.definitionEn: A particular way of doing something, especially one that needs skill.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسلوب معيّن لإنجاز شيء، وخصوصاً ما يحتاج مهارة
entries.example: She showed us a new technique for making bread.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to technology and to scientific machines and methods.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكنولوجي متعلق بالتقنية والآلات والأساليب العلمية
entries.example: The factory has made several technological improvements.

entries.definitionEn: Scientific knowledge used in machines and methods for practical purposes.
entries.arabicMeaning: تكنولوجيا: معرفة علمية تُستخدم في الآلات والأساليب العملية
entries.example: Modern technology makes it easy to stay in touch.

entries.definitionEn: Too long, slow, or dull, and therefore tiring or boring.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملّ لفرط طوله أو بطئه أو رتابته حتى يُتعب
entries.example: Filling in the forms was a tedious job.

entries.definitionEn: In a long, slow, or dull way that tires or bores people.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو مملّ بطيء أو رتيب
entries.example: He explained the rules tediously, point by point.

entries.definitionEn: To be full of people or things moving about in large numbers. Often used as teem with.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعجّ بناس أو أشياء كثيرة تتحرك؛ وغالباً مع with
entries.example: The market teemed with shoppers before the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: A person between the ages of thirteen and nineteen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراهق بين الثالثة عشرة والتاسعة عشرة
entries.example: The film is popular with teens.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to people aged between thirteen and nineteen.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمراهقين بين الثالثة عشرة والتاسعة عشرة
entries.example: She has two teenage sons.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.
entries.arabicMeaning: مراهق في سن بين الثالثة عشرة والتاسعة عشرة
entries.example: My cousin is a teenager now.

entries.definitionEn: The systems and activity of sending information by telephone, radio, internet, or similar means.
entries.arabicMeaning: الاتصالات: نظم وإرسال المعلومات بالهاتف أو الراديو أو الإنترنت ونحوها
entries.example: She works in telecommunications.

entries.definitionEn: A short message sent quickly over a telegraph, used especially in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: برقية: رسالة قصيرة كانت تُرسل سريعاً عبر التلغراف، خصوصاً في الماضي
entries.example: They sent a telegram to announce the birth.

entries.definitionEn: A device that lets you speak to someone in another place.
entries.arabicMeaning: هاتف يتيح الكلام مع شخص في مكان آخر
entries.example: The telephone is ringing.

entries.definitionEn: To call someone by telephone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتصل بشخص هاتفياً
entries.example: I'll telephone you tomorrow morning.

entries.definitionEn: An instrument that makes distant objects look closer and larger, used especially for looking at stars.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلسكوب يقرّب الأشياء البعيدة ويكبّرها، وخصوصاً لرصد النجوم
entries.example: We looked at the moon through a telescope.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a telescope. Also made of parts that slide into one another so that something can be made longer or shorter.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلسكوبي متعلق بالمنظار الفلكي؛ وأيضاً مؤلَّف من أجزاء تنزلق فتمدّ الشيء أو تطويه
entries.example: The camera comes with a telescopic lens.

entries.definitionEn: By means of a telescope, or in a way that extends and collapses in sections.
entries.arabicMeaning: بواسطة تلسكوب، أو على نحو يتمدد وينطوي بأجزاء منزلقة
entries.example: The handle extends telescopically for extra reach.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of equipment with a screen that shows programmes, or the programmes themselves.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلفاز ذو شاشة يعرض برامج، أو البرامج نفسها
entries.example: We watched television after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: To say something to someone, often giving information or a story.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبر شخصاً بشيء، وغالباً بمعلومة أو قصة
entries.example: Please tell me the time.

entries.definitionEn: A person who works in a bank and deals with customers' money.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمين صندوق في مصرف يتعامل مع أموال الزبائن
entries.example: The teller counted the notes carefully.

entries.definitionEn: Revealing something that was meant to stay hidden, often without anyone intending it.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاشف عن أمر أريد إخفاؤه، غالباً من غير قصد
entries.example: A telltale stain on the carpet showed where the cup had fallen.

entries.definitionEn: A tendency to become angry easily, or a short period of anger. Also a person's mood.
entries.arabicMeaning: حدة غضب أو ميل سريع إليه؛ وأيضاً مزاج الشخص
entries.example: He has a short temper when he is tired.

entries.definitionEn: To make something less extreme by adding a balancing quality; to moderate.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلطّف شيئاً أو يخفف حدّته بإضافة ما يوازنه
entries.example: She tempered her criticism with a few kind remarks.

entries.definitionEn: A person's usual way of thinking, feeling, and behaving; their nature.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبع الشخص ومزاجه المعتاد في التفكير والشعور والسلوك
entries.example: His calm temperament suits emergency work.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to change mood suddenly and without much reason. Of a machine, working unreliably.
entries.arabicMeaning: متقلب المزاج فجأة وبلا سبب كافٍ؛ وللآلة يعني غير موثوق العمل
entries.example: The printer is temperamental and often jams.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to a person's natural character or usual mood.
entries.arabicMeaning: من حيث الطبع أو المزاج الطبيعي
entries.example: She is temperamentally unsuited to noisy offices.

entries.definitionEn: Of climate, neither very hot nor very cold. Of behaviour, moderate and self-controlled.
entries.arabicMeaning: للمناخ: معتدل لا شديد الحر ولا شديد البرد؛ وللسلوك: متزن ممسك بنفسه
entries.example: Olives grow well in a temperate climate.

entries.definitionEn: How hot or cold something is. Also a body heat that is higher than normal because of illness.
entries.arabicMeaning: درجة الحرارة؛ وأيضاً ارتفاع حرارة الجسم بسبب المرض
entries.example: The temperature today is twenty degrees.

entries.definitionEn: A building used for religious worship.
entries.arabicMeaning: معبد يُستخدم للعبادة
entries.example: We visited an ancient temple on the hill.

entries.definitionEn: For a limited time only, not permanently.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤقتاً لا على الدوام
entries.example: The shop is temporarily closed for repairs.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a limited time; not permanent.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤقت لا يدوم
entries.example: She found a temporary job for the summer.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone want to do or have something, especially something unwise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يغري شخصاً بفعل شيء أو الحصول عليه، وخصوصاً إن كان غير حكيم
entries.example: The smell of fresh bread might tempt you to eat more than you need.

entries.definitionEn: A strong desire to do or have something, especially something you know you should not.
entries.arabicMeaning: إغراء قوي بفعل شيء أو نيله، وخصوصاً ما تعلم أنه لا ينبغي
entries.example: I resisted the temptation to check my phone during the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: The number 10.
entries.arabicMeaning: العدد عشرة
entries.example: There are ten chairs in this room.

entries.definitionEn: Holding firmly to a purpose, belief, or possession; not easily giving up.
entries.arabicMeaning: متشبث بغاية أو اعتقاد أو شيء؛ لا يسهل تخليه
entries.example: She was tenacious in her search for the missing documents.

entries.definitionEn: In a determined way that does not give up.
entries.arabicMeaning: بمثابرة لا تلين
entries.example: He tenaciously defended his original plan.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of continuing firmly despite difficulty; persistent determination.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثابرة على الثبات رغم الصعوبة؛ إصرار عنيد
entries.example: It was her tenacity that finally solved the problem.

entries.definitionEn: To be likely to happen or to do something, often as a usual pattern.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميل في العادة إلى الحدوث أو إلى فعل شيء
entries.example: I tend to wake up early on weekdays.

entries.definitionEn: A likelihood of behaving or happening in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميل إلى سلوك أو حدوث على نحو معيّن
entries.example: He has a tendency to interrupt when he is excited.

entries.definitionEn: Gentle and kind. Of food, soft and easy to cut or chew. Of a part of the body, painful when touched.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقيق لطيف؛ وللطعام طري سهل القطع أو المضغ؛ ولموضع في الجسم مؤلم عند اللمس
entries.example: The meat was tender after slow cooking.

entries.definitionEn: In a gentle, caring way.
entries.arabicMeaning: برقة وعناية
entries.example: He held the injured bird tenderly.

entries.definitionEn: Gentleness and warm feeling. Also soreness in a part of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقة وعطف دافئ؛ وأيضاً ألم عند اللمس في موضع من الجسم
entries.example: There was tenderness in her voice when she spoke to the child.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets.
entries.arabicMeaning: تنس: لعبة يضرب فيها لاعبان أو أربعة كرة فوق شبكة بمضرب
entries.example: They play tennis every Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: Nervous and unable to relax. Also stretched tight.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوتر لا يقدر على الاسترخاء؛ وأيضاً مشدود
entries.example: I always feel tense before an interview.

entries.definitionEn: A form of a verb that shows whether the action is in the past, present, or future.
entries.arabicMeaning: زمن الفعل النحوي الذي يبيّن إن كان الحدث في الماضي أو الحاضر أو المستقبل
entries.example: In this sentence the verb is in the past tense.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of worry, nervousness, or strain between people or in a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: توتر وقلق أو شدّة بين الناس أو في موقف
entries.example: There was tension in the room before the results were read.

entries.definitionEn: A shelter made of cloth and supported by poles, used especially when camping.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيمة من قماش على أعمدة، تُستخدم خصوصاً في التخييم
entries.example: We slept in a tent beside the lake.

entries.definitionEn: A word or expression used for something, especially in a particular subject. Also one of the periods of the school year.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصطلح يُطلق على شيء وخصوصاً في مجال معيّن؛ وأيضاً فصل من السنة الدراسية
entries.example: The autumn term starts in September.

entries.definitionEn: A large building at an airport or station where passengers arrive and leave.
entries.arabicMeaning: صالة في مطار أو محطة يصل منها المسافرون ويغادرون
entries.example: Please wait for me in the arrivals terminal.

entries.definitionEn: A flat outdoor area next to a building, often used for sitting. In British English, also a row of joined houses.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرفة خارجية مسطحة بجانب مبنى للجلوس غالباً؛ وفي الإنجليزية البريطانية أيضاً صف بيوت متلاصقة
entries.example: We had breakfast on the terrace.

entries.definitionEn: The physical features of an area of land, such as how flat, rocky, or hilly it is.
entries.arabicMeaning: تضاريس مساحة من الأرض من حيث الاستواء أو الصخور أو التلال
entries.example: The vehicles are designed for rough terrain.

entries.definitionEn: Very bad or of very low quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ جداً أو رديء الجودة
entries.example: The weather was terrible all weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Very; used to emphasize an adjective. Also in a very bad way.
entries.arabicMeaning: للغاية لتوكيد الصفة؛ وأيضاً على نحو سيئ جداً
entries.example: I'm terribly sorry I'm late.

entries.definitionEn: Excellent; very good.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع ممتاز
entries.example: You did a terrific job on the presentation.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely frightened.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذعور أشد الخوف
entries.example: She was terrified of speaking in front of a large group.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel extremely frightened.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُرعب شخصاً أشد الرعب
entries.example: Thunderstorms terrify my little brother.

entries.definitionEn: Causing great fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرعب يثير خوفاً شديداً
entries.example: The climb along the cliff was terrifying.

entries.definitionEn: Land that belongs to a particular country, or an area that an animal regards as its own.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض تتبع بلداً، أو منطقة يعدّها حيوان ملكاً له
entries.example: The birds defended their territory around the nest.

entries.definitionEn: A very strong feeling of fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: رعب شديد
entries.example: He woke in terror from the nightmare.

entries.definitionEn: The use of violent attacks against people to create fear, usually for political aims.
entries.arabicMeaning: استخدام العنف لإشاعة الخوف، وغالباً لأغراض سياسية
entries.example: The report examined how terrorism affects ordinary travel.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with terrorism or with people who use it.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرهابي؛ متعلق بالإرهاب أو بمن يمارسه
entries.example: Police increased security after a terrorist threat.

entries.definitionEn: A person who uses violent attacks to create fear, usually for political aims.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يستخدم العنف لإشاعة الخوف، وغالباً لغاية سياسية
entries.example: Security staff stopped a suspected terrorist at the airport.

entries.definitionEn: A set of questions or practical tasks to measure knowledge or skill. Also a medical check.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختبار لقياس المعرفة أو المهارة؛ وأيضاً فحص طبي
entries.example: We have an English test on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: To examine how well someone or something works, or how much someone knows.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختبر جودة عمل شخص أو شيء أو مدى معرفة أحد
entries.example: They will test the new engine next week.

entries.definitionEn: Clear evidence or proof of something. Also a legal document stating how a person wants their property handled after death.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاهد بيّن أو دليل على شيء؛ وأيضاً وصية تبيّن التصرف في التركة بعد الموت
entries.example: The restored building is a testament to careful craft.

entries.definitionEn: To make a formal statement of what you know to be true, especially in a court.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشهد رسمياً بما يعلم أنه حق، وخصوصاً أمام محكمة
entries.example: Three witnesses will testify tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: A formal statement praising a person's character, work, or a product, often used as a recommendation.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهادة تزكية تمدح شخصاً أو عملاً أو منتجاً، وغالباً على سبيل التوصية
entries.example: The website published a testimonial from a long-time customer.

entries.definitionEn: A formal statement of evidence, especially in a court. Also evidence that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: شهادة رسمية وخصوصاً في المحكمة؛ وأيضاً دليل على صحة شيء
entries.example: Her testimony helped the jury reach a decision.

entries.definitionEn: Easily annoyed, especially over small matters.
entries.arabicMeaning: سريع الانفعال لأتفه الأسباب
entries.example: He gets tetchy when he has not slept enough.

entries.definitionEn: A short written message sent from one mobile phone to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسالة نصية قصيرة تُرسل من هاتف محمول إلى آخر
entries.example: I sent her a text message to say I would be late.

entries.definitionEn: Written words, especially in a book, on a screen, or in a message.
entries.arabicMeaning: نص مكتوب في كتاب أو على شاشة أو في رسالة
entries.example: Please read the text on page twelve.

entries.definitionEn: To send someone a written message on a mobile phone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرسل رسالة نصية عبر الهاتف المحمول
entries.example: I'll text you when I arrive.

entries.definitionEn: A book used for studying a school or college subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتاب مدرسي أو جامعي لدراسة مادة
entries.example: I left my history textbook on the bus.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a comparative adjective or adverb to introduce the second part of a comparison.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم بعد صفة أو ظرف تفضيل لتقديم الطرف الثاني من المقارنة
entries.example: She is older than I thought.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a comparative to introduce the person or thing being compared.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم بعد صيغة تفضيل لتقديم الشخص أو الشيء الذي تُعقد به المقارنة
entries.example: He is taller than his brother.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done or given.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشكر شخصاً على ما فعل أو أعطى
entries.example: I want to thank you for your help.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling or showing that you are glad and grateful, especially after a difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: ممتن سعيد بما كان، وخصوصاً بعد ضيق
entries.example: We were thankful that the train was only a little late.

entries.definitionEn: Words or feelings of gratitude that you offer to someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكر يُقدَّم لشخص قولاً أو شعوراً
entries.example: Thanks for the lift to the station.

entries.definitionEn: To that degree; used with adjectives and adverbs, often in negatives, to mean so or so much.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى ذلك الحد؛ تُستخدم مع الصفات والظروف وغالباً في النفي بمعنى إلى هذه الدرجة
entries.example: The film wasn't that long, but I still left early.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce a clause that reports what is said, thought, known, or shown.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم لربط جملة تبيّن ما يُقال أو يُظن أو يُعلم أو يُبيَّن
entries.example: I think that she is right.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to point to a particular person or thing, often one farther away or already known.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم قبل الاسم للإشارة إلى شخص أو شيء معيّن، وغالباً الأبعد أو المعروف سلفاً
entries.example: Can you pass me that book on the shelf?

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a noun to refer to a particular thing or person already mentioned or pointed to.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم بدل الاسم للإشارة إلى شيء أو شخص معيّن ذُكر أو أُشير إليه
entries.example: That is my coat.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun when you mean a particular person or thing, or one that people already know.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة تعريف تسبق الاسم للدلالة على شخص أو شيء معيّن، أو على ما يعرفه السامع
entries.example: Please close the window.

entries.definitionEn: A building where people watch plays, or the art of performing plays on a stage.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسرح؛ مبنى تُعرض فيه المسرحيات، أو فن التمثيل على الخشبة
entries.example: We went to the theater on Saturday evening.

entries.definitionEn: The crime of stealing something from a person or a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: سرقة؛ جريمة أخذ شيء من شخص أو مكان دون حق
entries.example: The shop reported the theft of several laptops.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to them.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدِّد ملكية يسبق الاسم ليبين أن الشيء يخصّهم
entries.example: Their house is at the end of the street.

entries.definitionEn: The possessive form of they, used instead of a noun to mean something that belongs to them.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير ملكية مستقل بمعنى ما يخصّهم، يقوم مقام الاسم
entries.example: This bag is theirs, not mine.

entries.definitionEn: The object form of they, used after a verb or a preposition.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير نصب للجمع المذكور يُستعمل بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر
entries.example: I saw them at the station.

entries.definitionEn: The main idea or subject that a book, film, discussion, or piece of music is about.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضوع أو فكرة محورية يدور عليها كتاب أو فيلم أو نقاش أو قطعة موسيقية
entries.example: The theme of the novel is friendship.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize they, or to show that an action happens to the same people who do it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يوكّد هم، أو يدل على أن الفعل يقع عليهم أنفسهم
entries.example: They cooked dinner themselves.

entries.definitionEn: At that time; next, after that.
entries.arabicMeaning: حينئذ؛ ثم بعد ذلك
entries.example: We had lunch, then we went for a walk.

entries.definitionEn: A person who develops or studies ideas that explain how something works.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظّر؛ من يضع أو يدرس أفكاراً تفسّر عمل شيء
entries.example: The theorist published a new paper on climate change.

entries.definitionEn: An idea or set of ideas that tries to explain something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نظرية؛ فكرة أو مجموعة أفكار تفسّر شيئاً
entries.example: His theory about the missing keys turned out to be right.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to help people with physical or mental problems through treatment.
entries.arabicMeaning: معالج؛ من يساعد الناس على مشكلات جسدية أو نفسية بالعلاج
entries.example: She sees a therapist once a week.

entries.definitionEn: Treatment that helps someone recover from illness, injury, or emotional difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاج يساعد على التعافي من مرض أو إصابة أو صعوبة نفسية
entries.example: He started therapy after the accident.

entries.definitionEn: In, at, or to that place. Also used at the start of a sentence to say that something exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: هناك؛ في ذلك المكان أو إليه، وتُستعمل أيضاً في أول الجملة للدلالة على وجود شيء
entries.example: The bag is over there.

entries.definitionEn: After that time; from then on.
entries.arabicMeaning: بعد ذلك؛ من ذلك الحين فصاعداً
entries.example: She moved abroad in 2018 and rarely returned thereafter.

entries.definitionEn: By that means; as a result of that action.
entries.arabicMeaning: بذلك؛ نتيجةً لذلك الفعل
entries.example: He sold the shares, thereby reducing his risk.

entries.definitionEn: For that reason; as a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: لذلك؛ نتيجة لذلك
entries.example: The train was cancelled, therefore we took a bus.

entries.definitionEn: An instrument that measures temperature.
entries.arabicMeaning: ميزان حرارة؛ أداة تقيس درجة الحرارة
entries.example: The nurse put a thermometer under his tongue.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a plural noun for people or things that are near you, or that you have just mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: هؤلاء/هذه؛ محدِّد إشارة للجمع القريب أو المذكور للتو
entries.example: These shoes are too small.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a plural noun to mean people or things that are near you, or just mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: هؤلاء/هذه؛ ضمير إشارة للجمع القريب يقوم مقام الاسم
entries.example: Are these yours?

entries.definitionEn: A long piece of writing on a subject, done as part of a university degree. Also a main claim that you argue for.
entries.arabicMeaning: أطروحة جامعية مطوّلة في موضوع معيّن؛ وقد تعني الدعوى الرئيسية التي تحتجّ لها
entries.example: She spent a year writing her thesis.

entries.definitionEn: Used as the subject to mean more than one person or thing already mentioned. Also used for a person whose gender is not specified.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير رفع للجمع المذكور؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً لشخص غير محدد الجنس
entries.example: They live next door.

entries.definitionEn: Having a large distance between opposite sides; not thin. Also dense, as with hair, smoke, or fog.
entries.arabicMeaning: سميك؛ ذو مسافة كبيرة بين الجانبين. وقد يعني كثيفاً كالشعر أو الدخان أو الضباب
entries.example: She cut a thick slice of bread.

entries.definitionEn: A dense group of bushes or small trees growing close together.
entries.arabicMeaning: أجمة؛ مجموعة كثيفة من الشجيرات أو الأشجار الصغيرة المتقاربة
entries.example: The fox disappeared into the thicket.

entries.definitionEn: In a thick way; with a large amount covering a surface, or in dense groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسماكة أو بكثافة؛ بكمية كبيرة تغطي سطحاً، أو في مجموعات متقاربة
entries.example: She spread the butter thickly on the toast.

entries.definitionEn: The distance between opposite sides of something; how thick it is.
entries.arabicMeaning: سُمك؛ المسافة بين وجهي الشيء
entries.example: The thickness of the glass makes it hard to break.

entries.definitionEn: A person who steals things.
entries.arabicMeaning: سارق
entries.example: The thief ran off with her bag.

entries.definitionEn: The part of the leg between the hip and the knee.
entries.arabicMeaning: فخذ
entries.example: She pulled a muscle in her thigh.

entries.definitionEn: Having little distance between opposite sides; not thick. Also not fat, or with little substance.
entries.arabicMeaning: رقيق أو نحيل؛ قليل السماكة أو قليل المادة
entries.example: He wore a thin jacket in the cold.

entries.definitionEn: An object, idea, or matter, used when you do not name it exactly.
entries.arabicMeaning: شيء؛ يُستعمل حين لا تُسمّى العين أو الفكرة باسمها
entries.example: What is that thing on the table?

entries.definitionEn: To use your mind to consider something, or to have an opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفكّر؛ يستخدم عقله للنظر في أمر، أو يكون له رأي
entries.example: I think the shop is closed on Sundays.

entries.definitionEn: A person who thinks carefully about important ideas, especially in philosophy or public life.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفكّر؛ من يتأمّل الأفكار المهمة، ولا سيما في الفلسفة أو الشأن العام
entries.example: She is regarded as a leading thinker of her generation.

entries.definitionEn: Coming after the second in order; number three in a sequence.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثالث؛ التالي بعد الثاني في الترتيب
entries.example: This is the third time I have called.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, the form used to talk about someone other than the speaker or the person spoken to, such as he, she, or they.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الغائب في النحو؛ الشكل المستعمل للحديث عن غير المتكلم والمخاطب
entries.example: The novel is written in the third person.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce the third point in a list of reasons or arguments.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثالثاً؛ لعرض النقطة الثالثة في قائمة
entries.example: Thirdly, we should check the budget before we decide.

entries.definitionEn: The feeling of needing or wanting to drink. Also a strong desire for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطش؛ الشعور بالحاجة إلى الشرب. وقد يعني رغبة شديدة في شيء
entries.example: After the long walk, her thirst was intense.

entries.definitionEn: To have a strong desire for something, especially something such as knowledge, freedom, or success.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعطش إلى؛ يشتهي شيئاً بشدة، وخصوصاً أمراً كالمعرفة أو الحرية أو النجاح
entries.example: They thirst for a chance to prove themselves.

entries.definitionEn: Needing or wanting a drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطشان
entries.example: I am thirsty after that run.

entries.definitionEn: The number 13.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاثة عشر
entries.example: There are thirteen chairs in the room.

entries.definitionEn: The number 30.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاثون
entries.example: She turned thirty last year.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a singular noun for a person or thing that is near you, or that you are talking about now.
entries.arabicMeaning: هذا/هذه؛ محدِّد إشارة للمفرد القريب أو المذكور الآن
entries.example: This book is mine.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a singular noun to mean a person or thing that is near you, or just mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: هذا/هذه؛ ضمير إشارة للمفرد القريب يقوم مقام الاسم
entries.example: This is my brother.

entries.definitionEn: Done carefully and completely, without missing anything important.
entries.arabicMeaning: شامل متقن؛ يُنجَز بعناية دون إغفال المهم
entries.example: The mechanic gave the engine a thorough check.

entries.definitionEn: Completely and carefully; to a full degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً وبعناية؛ على نحو شامل
entries.example: She cleaned the kitchen thoroughly.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a plural noun for people or things that are farther away, or already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولئك/تلك؛ محدِّد إشارة للجمع البعيد أو المذكور سابقاً
entries.example: Those books on the shelf are old.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of a plural noun to mean people or things farther away, or already mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: أولئك/تلك؛ ضمير إشارة للجمع البعيد يقوم مقام الاسم
entries.example: Those are my keys, not yours.

entries.definitionEn: Used especially at the end of a sentence to mean however; in spite of that.
entries.arabicMeaning: مع ذلك؛ تُستعمل وخصوصاً في آخر الجملة بمعنى غير أنّ
entries.example: The room is small. It is comfortable, though.

entries.definitionEn: Used to join two ideas when the second is surprising after the first; although.
entries.arabicMeaning: رغم أنّ؛ حرف يربط فكرتين الثانية منهما مفاجئة
entries.example: Though it was late, she kept working.

entries.definitionEn: An idea in your mind; the act of thinking.
entries.arabicMeaning: فكرة في الذهن؛ أو فعل التفكير
entries.example: I had a sudden thought about the answer.

entries.definitionEn: Kind and showing that you think about other people's needs. Also quiet and thinking carefully.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفهّم لطيف يراعي الآخرين؛ وقد يعني متأملاً هادئاً
entries.example: It was thoughtful of you to bring extra chairs.

entries.definitionEn: Not thinking about how your actions affect other people; careless.
entries.arabicMeaning: طائش أو غير مراعٍ لشعور الآخرين
entries.example: Leaving the door open was a thoughtless thing to do.

entries.definitionEn: The number 1,000.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألف
entries.example: About a thousand people came to the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A long thin piece of cotton, silk, or similar material used for sewing. Also a line of connected ideas or messages.
entries.arabicMeaning: خيط للخياطة؛ وقد يعني سلسلة أفكار أو رسائل متصلة
entries.example: She pulled a loose thread on her coat.

entries.definitionEn: A statement that you will harm someone, or a person or thing that may cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: تهديد؛ قول بإيقاع ضرر، أو شخص أو شيء قد يسبب أذى
entries.example: The storm is a threat to the coastal towns.

entries.definitionEn: To say that you will harm someone if they do not do what you want. Also to be likely to cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهدّد؛ يقول إنه سيؤذي إن لم يُطع، أو يكون وشيك الضرر
entries.example: The company threatened to close the factory.

entries.definitionEn: Showing that harm or trouble may happen; looking or sounding as if you mean to hurt someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: مهدِّد؛ يدل على احتمال أذى أو متاعب
entries.example: The sky looked threatening before the storm.

entries.definitionEn: The number 3.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاثة
entries.example: I have three sisters.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden strong feeling of excitement or pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشوة أو قشعريرة من الإثارة والسرور
entries.example: She felt a thrill as the plane took off.

entries.definitionEn: Very pleased and excited.
entries.arabicMeaning: سعيد جداً ومتحمّس
entries.example: We were thrilled to hear that you got the job.

entries.definitionEn: A book, film, or play with an exciting story, often about crime or danger.
entries.arabicMeaning: رواية أو فيلم إثارة، غالباً عن جريمة أو خطر
entries.example: He stayed up late reading a thriller.

entries.definitionEn: Very exciting and enjoyable in a slightly tense way.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير جداً على نحو مشوّق
entries.example: The final match was a thrilling game.

entries.definitionEn: The passage inside the neck that food and air go through; the front of the neck.
entries.arabicMeaning: حلق؛ مجرى العنق للطعام والهواء، أو مقدّم العنق
entries.example: Her throat was sore after the long talk.

entries.definitionEn: From one side or end to the other; from beginning to end. Also finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: من جانب إلى آخر أو من البداية إلى النهاية؛ وقد تعني منتهياً
entries.example: The door was open, so we walked through.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show movement from one side of something to the other, or from the start to the end of a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على العبور من جانب إلى آخر، أو على امتداد فترة زمنية
entries.example: We walked through the park.

entries.definitionEn: In every part of a place, or during the whole of a period.
entries.arabicMeaning: في كل أنحاء المكان، أو طوال المدة كلها
entries.example: It rained throughout the afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: An act of sending something through the air with your hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: رمية؛ فعل قذف شيء باليد في الهواء
entries.example: That was a good throw from the back of the field.

entries.definitionEn: To send something through the air with your hand or arm.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرمي؛ يقذف شيئاً في الهواء بيده
entries.example: Please throw me the keys.

entries.definitionEn: The short, thick finger set apart from the others on the hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: إبهام اليد
entries.example: She held the coin between her thumb and finger.

entries.definitionEn: To hit something hard, making a dull, heavy sound. Also to beat strongly, as a heart does.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب بقوة فيُحدث صوتاً مكتوماً؛ وقد يخفق القلب بقوة
entries.example: He thumped the table in frustration.

entries.definitionEn: The loud rumbling sound that follows lightning in a storm.
entries.arabicMeaning: رعد
entries.example: We heard thunder in the distance.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely loud, like thunder.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادر كالرعد؛ شديد الارتفاع في الصوت
entries.example: The speech was met with thunderous applause.

entries.definitionEn: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاصفة رعدية
entries.example: A thunderstorm stopped the outdoor concert.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday.
entries.arabicMeaning: الخميس
entries.example: The meeting is on Thursday.

entries.definitionEn: In this way; as a result of this.
entries.arabicMeaning: هكذا؛ وبذلك أو نتيجة لذلك
entries.example: The road was closed, and thus we arrived late.

entries.definitionEn: A small mark used to show that something is correct or has been done. Also a short, regular sound, as from a clock.
entries.arabicMeaning: علامة صحّ؛ وقد تعني تكة ساعة منتظمة
entries.example: Put a tick next to each item you have finished.

entries.definitionEn: To mark with a tick to show that something is correct or done. Also to make a short, regular sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع علامة صحّ؛ أو يُصدر تكة منتظمة
entries.example: Please tick the box if you agree.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of paper or electronic pass that lets you travel, enter a place, or take part in something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تذكرة للسفر أو الدخول أو المشاركة
entries.example: I bought a ticket for the train.

entries.definitionEn: To touch someone lightly in a way that makes them laugh. Also to please someone slightly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدغدغ؛ يلمس بلطف فيُضحك، أو يسرّ قليلاً
entries.example: The baby laughed when she tickled his feet.

entries.definitionEn: The regular rise and fall of the sea. Also a strong movement of feeling or events.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدّ وجزر البحر؛ وقد تعني تياراً قوياً من شعور أو أحداث
entries.example: We waited for the tide to go out before walking on the sand.

entries.definitionEn: Neat and in good order; not messy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتب نظيف؛ غير فوضوي
entries.example: Her desk is always tidy.

entries.definitionEn: To make a place neat by putting things in order.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتب المكان بوضع الأشياء في مواضعها
entries.example: Please tidy your room before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck with a shirt. Also a result in which both sides have the same score.
entries.arabicMeaning: ربطة عنق؛ وقد تعني تعادلاً في النتيجة
entries.example: He wore a blue tie to the interview.

entries.definitionEn: To fasten something with a string, rope, or similar. Also to have the same score as someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: يربط بخيط أو حبل؛ وقد يعني يتعادل في النتيجة
entries.example: She tied the parcel with string.

entries.definitionEn: A large wild cat with orange fur and black stripes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نمر؛ قط بري كبير ذو فرو برتقالي وخطوط سوداء
entries.example: We saw a tiger at the zoo.

entries.definitionEn: Fitting closely, not loose. Also firm, or with little spare room or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضيق ملاصق؛ غير فضفاض. وقد يعني محكماً أو شحيح الفسحة
entries.example: These shoes are too tight.

entries.definitionEn: In a firm, close way; so that something cannot move easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإحكام؛ على نحو ضيق لا يسهل معه الحركة
entries.example: Hold on tight to the rail.

entries.definitionEn: To make something tighter or firmer; to become tighter.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضيّق أو يُحكم؛ يصير أشدّ إحكاماً
entries.example: Please tighten the screw so it does not come loose.

entries.definitionEn: In a tight, firm way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بإحكام وضيق
entries.example: She held the child tightly.

entries.definitionEn: A tightly stretched rope or wire that an acrobat walks along high above the ground.
entries.arabicMeaning: حبل مشدود يمشي عليه البهلوان عالياً فوق الأرض
entries.example: The acrobat walked along the tightrope.

entries.definitionEn: A close-fitting piece of clothing that covers the legs and feet, usually worn by women.
entries.arabicMeaning: جوارب طويلة ضيقة تغطي الساقين والقدمين، ترتديها النساء عادة
entries.example: She put on black tights under her skirt.

entries.definitionEn: A thin, flat piece of baked clay or other material used to cover roofs, walls, or floors.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلاطة رقيقة تُغطى بها الأسطح أو الجدران أو الأرضيات
entries.example: One tile on the bathroom floor was cracked.

entries.definitionEn: Until; up to the time when.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى أن؛ حتى الوقت الذي
entries.example: Wait here till I come back.

entries.definitionEn: A drawer or box in a shop where money from sales is kept; a cash register.
entries.arabicMeaning: درج أو صندوق في المتجر تُحفظ فيه نقود المبيعات
entries.example: She put the notes in the till.

entries.definitionEn: Until; up to a stated time.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتى؛ إلى وقت معيّن
entries.example: The shop is open till six.

entries.definitionEn: What we measure in minutes, hours, and days; a particular moment or occasion.
