entries.arabicMeaning: وقت؛ ما نقيسه بالدقائق والساعات والأيام، أو لحظة أو مناسبة معيّنة
entries.example: What time does the train leave?

entries.definitionEn: To measure how long something takes, or to choose a particular moment for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوقّت؛ يقيس مدة شيء أو يختار له لحظة مناسبة
entries.example: The coach timed each runner with a stopwatch.

entries.definitionEn: Not seeming to belong to a particular period; still attractive or true after a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالد لا يرتبط بعصر بعينه؛ يبقى جميلاً أو صادقاً مع مرور الزمن
entries.example: The film has a timeless quality.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of happening at a suitable or useful moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: حسن التوقيت؛ وقوع الأمر في لحظة مناسبة مفيدة
entries.example: The timeliness of her advice saved us a lot of trouble.

entries.definitionEn: Happening at a suitable or useful moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أوانه؛ واقع في وقت مناسب
entries.example: Your timely warning helped us avoid the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Multiplied by; used when you calculate one number by another.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضروباً في؛ تُستعمل في الحساب عند ضرب عدد بآخر
entries.example: Three times four is twelve.

entries.definitionEn: A list of times when events, classes, or vehicles are planned to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدول مواعيد للأحداث أو الحصص أو وسائل النقل
entries.example: According to the timetable, the bus leaves at noon.

entries.definitionEn: Easily frightened; lacking confidence; shy in a nervous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: هيّاب قليل الثقة؛ خجول على نحو قلق
entries.example: The timid child hid behind her mother.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being easily frightened or lacking in confidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: خجل وضعف ثقة؛ صفة الشخص الهيّاب
entries.example: His timidity kept him from asking questions in class.

entries.definitionEn: The choice of when something happens, or the skill of doing something at the right moment.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقيت؛ اختيار متى يحدث الشيء، أو مهارة الفعل في اللحظة المناسبة
entries.example: The timing of the announcement was unfortunate.

entries.definitionEn: A metal used to make cans; also a metal container for food.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصدير؛ معدن تُصنع منه العلب، أو علبة معدنية للطعام
entries.example: She opened a tin of tomatoes.

entries.definitionEn: A person who enjoys making small repairs or adjustments. In older use, a travelling mender of pots and pans.
entries.arabicMeaning: من يحب الإصلاحات والتعديلات الصغيرة؛ وكان قديماً مصلّحاً متجوّلاً للقدور
entries.example: He was a tinker who could fix almost any old pot.

entries.definitionEn: To make small changes to something in an attempt to improve or repair it, often without a clear plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعبث بإصلاح شيء بتعديلات صغيرة، غالباً من غير خطة واضحة
entries.example: He likes to tinker with old radios at the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely small.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضئيل جداً؛ بالغ الصغر
entries.example: The kitten was tiny when we found it.

entries.definitionEn: A useful piece of advice. Also extra money given for service, or the pointed end of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نصيحة مفيدة؛ أو مبلغ إضافي يُعطى مقابل خدمة، أو طرف الشيء المدبّب
entries.example: Can you give me a tip for learning new words?

entries.definitionEn: To move something so that it leans or pours. Also to give extra money for service.
entries.arabicMeaning: يميّل شيئاً حتى ينسكب أو ينحرف؛ وقد يعني يعطي بقشيشاً مقابل خدمة
entries.example: She tipped the bottle and poured the oil.

entries.definitionEn: To walk quietly on your toes so as not to make a noise.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمشي على أطراف أصابعه بهدوء حتى لا يُحدث صوتاً
entries.example: He tiptoed past the sleeping baby.

entries.definitionEn: To become tired, or to make someone tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعب أو يُتعب غيره
entries.example: Long meetings tire me quickly.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling that you need to rest or sleep.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعب؛ يشعر بالحاجة إلى الراحة أو النوم
entries.example: I am tired after a long day at work.

entries.definitionEn: The state of feeling tired and needing rest.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعب؛ حالة الشعور بالإرهاق والحاجة إلى الراحة
entries.example: Tiredness made it hard for her to concentrate.

entries.definitionEn: Annoying because something lasts too long or happens too often; wearying.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملّ مزعج لطول أمده أو تكراره
entries.example: The delays became tiresome after an hour.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُتعب؛ يسبّب الإرهاق
entries.example: The climb up the hill was tiring.

entries.definitionEn: A soft, thin piece of paper used for wiping. Also the group of cells that form a part of a plant or animal.
entries.arabicMeaning: منديل ورقي رقيق للمسح؛ وقد تعني نسيجاً من الخلايا في جسم حي
entries.example: She wiped her glasses with a tissue.

entries.definitionEn: The name of a book, film, or piece of writing. Also a word such as Dr or Ms used before a name.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنوان كتاب أو فيلم أو نص؛ وقد تعني لقباً يسبق الاسم مثل دكتور
entries.example: What is the title of that book?

entries.definitionEn: Used to show direction, a destination, or who receives something. Also used before a verb in its basic form.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر يدل على الاتجاه أو الوجهة أو المتلقّي؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً قبل الفعل في صيغته الأساسية
entries.example: She walked to the shop.

entries.definitionEn: Bread that has been heated until it is brown and crisp. Also a short speech of good wishes before people drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: خبز محمّص حتى يسمرّ ويقرمش؛ وقد تعني نخب شرب مع تمنيات طيبة
entries.example: I had toast and jam for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: The dried leaves of a plant that people smoke in cigarettes, cigars, or pipes.
entries.arabicMeaning: تبغ؛ أوراق نبات مجففة تُدخَّن في السجائر أو الغليون
entries.example: The shop sells tobacco and newspapers.

entries.definitionEn: On this day; at the present time.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليوم؛ في هذا اليوم أو في الوقت الحاضر
entries.example: It is raining today.

entries.definitionEn: This day; the present day.
entries.arabicMeaning: اليوم الحاضر
entries.example: Today is Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: One of the five parts at the end of the foot.
entries.arabicMeaning: إصبع القدم
entries.example: He stubbed his toe on the chair.

entries.definitionEn: The hard covering at the end of a toe.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظفر إصبع القدم
entries.example: She painted her toenails red.

entries.definitionEn: With each other; in the same place or as a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاً؛ في المكان نفسه أو كمجموعة
entries.example: We had dinner together.

entries.definitionEn: To work very hard for a long time, especially at a difficult or tiring task.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكدح؛ يعمل بجدّ طويل في عمل شاق
entries.example: They toiled in the fields from dawn until dusk.

entries.definitionEn: A bowl that you sit on to get rid of waste from your body; also a room with this.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرحاض؛ وعاء لقضاء الحاجة، أو الغرفة التي فيها
entries.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Willing to accept people or ideas that are different from your own. Also able to bear something unpleasant.
entries.arabicMeaning: متسامح يقبل اختلاف الناس والأفكار؛ وقد يعني صبوراً على المكروه
entries.example: She is tolerant of views she does not share.

entries.definitionEn: To accept something unpleasant without complaining, or to allow something you do not like.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحتمل أمراً مكروهاً من غير شكوى، أو يسمح بما لا يرضيه
entries.example: I cannot tolerate that noise any longer.

entries.definitionEn: Money paid to use a road or bridge. Also the amount of harm or death caused by something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رسم عبور طريق أو جسر؛ وقد تعني حصيلة الضرر أو القتلى
entries.example: We paid a toll to cross the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: A soft red fruit used in salads and cooking.
entries.arabicMeaning: طماطم؛ ثمرة حمراء طرية تُستعمل في السلطة والطبخ
entries.example: She sliced a tomato for the salad.

entries.definitionEn: On the day after today.
entries.arabicMeaning: غداً؛ في اليوم التالي لهذا اليوم
entries.example: I will call you tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The day after today.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغد؛ اليوم الذي يلي اليوم الحاضر
entries.example: Tomorrow is a holiday.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of weight equal to 2,000 pounds in the US, or 2,240 pounds in the UK. Also, informally, a very large amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: طن؛ وحدة وزن، وقد تعني مقداراً ضخماً في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: The truck was carrying a ton of sand.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of a voice or sound that can show feeling. Also the general character of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبرة صوت تدل على شعور؛ وقد تعني الطابع العام لشيء
entries.example: I did not like the tone of his email.

entries.definitionEn: To make muscles firmer, or to adjust the quality of a colour or sound. Often with down, to make something less strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقوّي العضلات أو يعدّل نوعية لون أو صوت؛ وقد يعني أيضاً تخفيف الحدّة
entries.example: Regular swimming helped tone her muscles.

entries.definitionEn: The soft part inside the mouth used for tasting and speaking. Also a language.
entries.arabicMeaning: لسان؛ عضو التذوق والكلام في الفم، وقد تعني لغة
entries.example: He burned his tongue on the hot soup.

entries.definitionEn: On the evening or night of today.
entries.arabicMeaning: الليلة؛ في مساء هذا اليوم أو ليله
entries.example: We are staying at home tonight.

entries.definitionEn: The evening or night of today.
entries.arabicMeaning: ليلة اليوم الحاضر
entries.example: Tonight will be cold.

entries.definitionEn: More than is wanted or needed; also meaning also.
entries.arabicMeaning: أكثر مما ينبغي؛ وتعني أيضاً كذلك
entries.example: This bag is too heavy.

entries.definitionEn: An object that you hold and use to do a job, such as a hammer or a screwdriver.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة تُمسَك لإنجاز عمل، كالمطرقة أو المفك
entries.example: He put the tools back in the box.

entries.definitionEn: One of the hard white parts in the mouth used for biting and chewing.
entries.arabicMeaning: سنّ؛ واحدة من الأجزاء الصلبة البيضاء في الفم للعضّ والمضغ
entries.example: I have a pain in this tooth.

entries.definitionEn: Pain in a tooth.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألم في السنّ
entries.example: She stayed home because of a toothache.

entries.definitionEn: A small brush used for cleaning the teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرشاة أسنان
entries.example: Do not forget to pack your toothbrush.

entries.definitionEn: A thick paste that you put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth.
entries.arabicMeaning: معجون أسنان
entries.example: He squeezed toothpaste onto the brush.

entries.definitionEn: Highest in position, rank, or quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعلى في الموقع أو الرتبة أو الجودة
entries.example: She got a top mark in the exam.

entries.definitionEn: The highest part of something. Also a piece of clothing for the upper body.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعلى الشيء؛ وقد تعني قطعة لباس للجزء العلوي من الجسم
entries.example: The book is on the top of the pile.

entries.definitionEn: A subject that you talk or write about.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضوع يُتحدَّث أو يُكتب عنه
entries.example: The topic of today's class is food.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the physical shape and features of an area of land.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبوغرافي؛ يتصل بشكل الأرض وتضاريسها
entries.example: The topographical map showed every ridge and valley.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to the physical shape and features of land.
entries.arabicMeaning: من الناحية الطبوغرافية؛ بما يتصل بشكل الأرض وتضاريسها
entries.example: The two valleys are topographically quite different.

entries.definitionEn: The physical shape and features of an area of land, or the study of them.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبوغرافيا؛ شكل الأرض وتضاريسها، أو دراستها
entries.example: The topography of the island made farming difficult.

entries.definitionEn: To become unsteady and fall, or to cause a person or structure to fall from a high position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسقط متمايلاً، أو يُسقط شخصاً أو بناءً من موضع عالٍ
entries.example: The vase toppled off the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: A small electric light that you carry in your hand. Also a stick with a flame at one end, used as a light.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصباح يدوي كهربائي؛ أو مشعل عصا في طرفه لهب
entries.example: She switched on her torch in the dark hallway.

entries.definitionEn: Severe physical or mental suffering; something that causes this.
entries.arabicMeaning: عذاب شديد في الجسد أو النفس؛ أو ما يسبّبه
entries.example: The wait for news was a torment.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone severe physical or mental suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعذّب؛ يُلحق بشخص عذاباً شديداً في الجسد أو النفس
entries.example: The memory of the mistake continued to torment him.

entries.definitionEn: A violent storm with a spinning column of air that can destroy buildings.
entries.arabicMeaning: إعصار دوّار عنيف قد يدمّر المباني
entries.example: A tornado damaged several houses in the town.

entries.definitionEn: Of rain: falling very heavily and in large amounts.
entries.arabicMeaning: غزير جداً، ويُقال للمطر الهاطل بغزارة بالغة
entries.example: Torrential rain flooded the streets.

entries.definitionEn: The mottled brown and yellow material from a turtle's shell, or a similar pattern, especially of a cat's fur.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدف السلحفاة المرقّط بالبني والأصفر، أو نقش شبيه به ولا سيما في فرو القطط
entries.example: The tortoiseshell cat slept in the sun.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone severe pain, often to punish them or force them to speak. Also to cause great mental pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعذّب شخصاً بألم شديد، غالباً للعقاب أو للإجبار على الكلام؛ وقد يعني يؤلم النفس ألماً عظيماً
entries.example: The unanswered questions continued to torture him.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely painful or difficult to bear; causing great suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: مؤلم جداً أو عسير الاحتمال؛ يسبّب معاناة شديدة
entries.example: The wait for the results was torturous.

entries.definitionEn: To throw something lightly or carelessly. Also to move something up and down or from side to side.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقذف شيئاً بخفة أو بغير اكتراث؛ أو يحرّكه صعوداً وهبوطاً أو يمنة ويسرة
entries.example: She tossed the keys onto the table.

entries.definitionEn: Complete; including everything. Also used for emphasis to mean complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامل شامل لكل شيء؛ وقد يُستعمل للتوكيد بمعنى تام
entries.example: The total cost was higher than we expected.

entries.definitionEn: The whole number or amount when everything has been added together.
entries.arabicMeaning: المجموع؛ حاصل جمع الكل
entries.example: The total came to fifty pounds.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; in every way.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ من كل وجه
entries.example: I totally agree with you.

entries.definitionEn: Serving as a respected symbol of a group or idea; like a totem.
entries.arabicMeaning: طوطمي؛ يقوم مقام رمز موقّر لجماعة أو فكرة
entries.example: The old oak became a totemic symbol of the village.

entries.definitionEn: To walk or stand in an unsteady way, as if about to fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمايل في مشيه أو وقوفه كأنه على وشك السقوط
entries.example: The toddler tottered across the room.

entries.definitionEn: The act of putting your hand on something. Also a small amount, or contact with someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: لمسة؛ وضع اليد على شيء. وقد تعني مقداراً قليلاً أو تواصلاً
entries.example: I felt a touch on my shoulder.

entries.definitionEn: To put your hand or another part of your body on someone or something. Also to affect someone emotionally.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلمس بيده أو بجزء من جسمه؛ وقد يعني يؤثّر في المشاعر
entries.example: Please do not touch the paintings.

entries.definitionEn: Strong and not easily damaged or defeated. Also difficult, or strict.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلب لا يسهل كسره أو هزيمته؛ وقد يعني صعباً أو صارماً
entries.example: It was a tough decision to leave the job.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being strong, difficult to damage, or able to deal with hardship.
entries.arabicMeaning: صلابة؛ قوة الاحتمال وصعوبة الكسر
entries.example: The toughness of the material made it ideal for the floor.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to show visitors around a place and give them information.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرشد سياحي يصطحب الزوار ويعرّفهم بالمكان
entries.example: The tour guide explained the history of the castle.

entries.definitionEn: A journey in which you visit several places for pleasure, or a trip around a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: جولة زيارة لعدة أماكن للمتعة، أو تطواف في مكان
entries.example: We went on a tour of the old city.

entries.definitionEn: To visit several places for pleasure, or to travel around performing or playing sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: يطوف في عدة أماكن للنزهة، أو يسافر للعروض أو المباريات
entries.example: The band will tour Europe next summer.

entries.definitionEn: The business of providing services for people who visit a place for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: سياحة؛ نشاط توفير الخدمات لمن يزورون مكاناً للمتعة
entries.example: Tourism is important to the local economy.

entries.definitionEn: A person who visits a place for pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائح يزور مكاناً للمتعة
entries.example: Many tourists take photographs of the square.

entries.definitionEn: A sports competition in which many players or teams play against each other until there is a winner.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطولة رياضية يتنافس فيها لاعبون أو فرق حتى يُتوَّج فائز
entries.example: She won the tennis tournament.

entries.definitionEn: In the direction of someone or something. Also used to show purpose or a relationship to something.
entries.arabicMeaning: باتجاه شخص أو شيء؛ وقد تدل على غاية أو صلة بأمر
entries.example: She walked toward the station.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of cloth used for drying your body, hands, or dishes.
entries.arabicMeaning: منشفة تجفيف للجسم أو اليدين أو الأطباق
entries.example: He dried his hands on a towel.

entries.definitionEn: A tall, narrow building or part of a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: برج؛ بناء مرتفع ضيق أو جزء مرتفع من مبنى
entries.example: You can see the church tower from here.

entries.definitionEn: A place with houses, shops, and other buildings, smaller than a city.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلدة؛ مكان فيه بيوت ومتاجر، أصغر من مدينة
entries.example: They live in a small town by the river.

entries.definitionEn: Poisonous; able to harm people, animals, or the environment. Also, of a situation or relationship, very harmful.
entries.arabicMeaning: سامّ يضرّ الناس أو الحيوان أو البيئة؛ وقد يوصف به موقف أو علاقة شديد الأذى
entries.example: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste.

entries.definitionEn: An object for children to play with.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة يتسلى بها الأطفال
entries.example: The child put the toy back in the box.

entries.definitionEn: A small sign that someone or something was present. Also a very small amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: أثر يدل على حضور سابق؛ أو مقدار ضئيل جداً
entries.example: There was no trace of the missing keys.

entries.definitionEn: To find the origin or path of something by following evidence. Also to copy by drawing over lines.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقتفي أثر شيء لمعرفة أصله أو مساره؛ أو ينسخ بالرسم فوق الخطوط
entries.example: The police tried to trace the stolen car.

entries.definitionEn: A path or rough road. Also the two metal rails that trains run on, or a prepared course for races.
entries.arabicMeaning: درب أو طريق وعر؛ أو قضبان القطار، أو مضمار للسباق
entries.example: We followed the track through the woods.

entries.definitionEn: To follow the movements of a person or thing, often in order to find them.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتتبع حركة شخص أو شيء، غالباً للعثور عليه
entries.example: The app can track the package until it arrives.

entries.definitionEn: A loose set of jacket and trousers worn for sport or informal exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدلة رياضية فضفاضة من جاكيت وبنطال للرياضة أو التمرين
entries.example: He wore a tracksuit to the gym.

entries.definitionEn: A large area of land. Also a system of connected body parts, such as the digestive tract.
entries.arabicMeaning: مساحة واسعة من الأرض؛ وقد تعني منظومة أعضاء متصلة كالجهاز الهضمي
entries.example: A wide tract of forest lies beyond the river.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of buying and selling goods. Also a particular type of skilled work.
entries.arabicMeaning: تجارة بيع السلع وشرائها؛ وقد تعني حرفة مهنية معيّنة
entries.example: Trade between the two countries has grown.

entries.definitionEn: To buy and sell goods or services. Also to exchange one thing for another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتاجر ببيع السلع أو الخدمات وشرائها؛ أو يبادل شيئاً بشيء
entries.example: The company trades with partners in several countries.

entries.definitionEn: A person who buys and sells goods, or who buys and sells shares and other financial products.
entries.arabicMeaning: تاجر يبيع ويشتري سلعاً، أو يتعامل بالأسهم والمنتجات المالية
entries.example: The trader spent the morning at the market.

entries.definitionEn: A belief or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a group of people.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقليد؛ معتقد أو أسلوب عمل دام طويلاً في جماعة
entries.example: It is a family tradition to eat together on Fridays.

entries.definitionEn: Following the ways and beliefs that have existed for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقليدي يتبع الأساليب والمعتقدات القديمة
entries.example: They wore traditional clothes for the festival.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that follows long-established custom.
entries.arabicMeaning: على النحو التقليدي الموروث
entries.example: The festival is traditionally held in spring.

entries.definitionEn: A line of vehicles that cannot move, or can move only very slowly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ازدحام مروري تتوقف فيه المركبات أو تسير ببطء شديد
entries.example: We sat in a traffic jam for half an hour.

entries.definitionEn: A set of red, yellow, and green lights that control traffic at a junction.
entries.arabicMeaning: إشارة مرور بألوان الأحمر والأصفر والأخضر عند تقاطع
entries.example: Stop when the traffic light is red.

entries.definitionEn: The vehicles that are moving along a road.
entries.arabicMeaning: حركة المركبات على الطريق
entries.example: There is a lot of traffic in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A very sad event, especially one involving death or serious suffering. Also a serious play with a sad ending.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأساة؛ حدث محزن جداً وخصوصاً إن اقترن بموت أو ألم بالغ. وقد تعني مسرحية جدّية ذات خاتمة حزينة
entries.example: The fire was a tragedy for the whole town.

entries.definitionEn: Very sad, especially because it involves death or serious suffering.
entries.arabicMeaning: مأساوي محزن جداً، وخصوصاً إن اقترن بموت أو ألم بالغ
entries.example: It was a tragic accident.

entries.definitionEn: A path through the countryside, or a line of marks left by someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: درب أو مسار في الريف، أو أثر يتركه شخص أو شيء
entries.example: We followed a narrow trail through the forest.

entries.definitionEn: To follow behind someone, or to hang down behind. Also to be losing in a contest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتبع من الخلف أو يتدلى وراء شيء؛ وقد يعني التأخر في سباق أو مباراة
entries.example: The children trailed behind their parents on the long walk.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle pulled behind a car or truck. Also a short preview of a film.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطورة تُجرّ خلف سيارة أو شاحنة؛ أو إعلان قصير يعرض مشاهد من فيلم
entries.example: They watched the trailer before booking tickets for the film.

entries.definitionEn: A set of carriages that run on rails and carry people or goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطار يسير على قضبان وينقل الناس أو البضائع
entries.example: The train leaves the station at six.

entries.definitionEn: To practise and learn skills, or to teach someone those skills.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتدرّب ويتعلّم مهارة، أو يدرّب غيره عليها
entries.example: She trains at the gym three times a week.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is learning a job or skill while working.
entries.arabicMeaning: متدرّب يتعلّم عملاً أو مهارة في أثناء الممارسة
entries.example: The trainee shadowed a senior nurse for a month.

entries.definitionEn: A person who teaches a skill or prepares an athlete. In British English, also a sports shoe.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدرّب يعلّم مهارة أو يعدّ رياضياً؛ وفي الإنكليزية البريطانية أيضاً حذاء رياضي
entries.example: Her trainer changed the workout after the injury.

entries.definitionEn: The process of learning skills for a job, sport, or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدريب على مهارات عمل أو رياضة أو نشاط
entries.example: He starts his training for the new job on Monday.

entries.definitionEn: A quality in someone's character or appearance that makes them different.
entries.arabicMeaning: سمة في الشخصية أو المظهر تميّز صاحبها
entries.example: Patience is a trait that helps in this kind of work.

entries.definitionEn: A person who betrays a friend, group, or country by helping the other side.
entries.arabicMeaning: خائن يفرّط في صديق أو جماعة أو بلد لصالح طرف آخر
entries.example: They called him a traitor for selling the company's secret plans.

entries.definitionEn: An electric vehicle that runs on rails in city streets.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترام كهربائي يسير على قضبان في شوارع المدينة
entries.example: We took the tram into the city centre.

entries.definitionEn: A long walk, or the sound of heavy footsteps.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسيرة طويلة سيراً، أو صوت وقع أقدام ثقيلة
entries.example: They heard the tramp of boots in the hallway.

entries.definitionEn: The act of stepping heavily on something and crushing it.
entries.arabicMeaning: وطء وهرس بالأقدام
entries.example: The trample of the crowd flattened the wet grass.

entries.definitionEn: A strong sheet attached to a frame with springs, used for jumping.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترامبولين: سطح مرن مشدود إلى إطار بنوابض يُقفَز عليه
entries.example: The children bounced on the trampoline in the garden.

entries.definitionEn: Calm, quiet, and peaceful.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ ساكن مطمئن
entries.example: The lake was tranquil at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: A state of calm and peace, without noise or disturbance.
entries.arabicMeaning: سكينة وهدوء بلا ضجيج أو اضطراب
entries.example: She came to the village seeking tranquility.

entries.definitionEn: To make a person or animal calm or unconscious, especially with a drug.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهدّئ شخصاً أو حيواناً أو يفقده الوعي، وخصوصاً بعقار
entries.example: The vet had to tranquilize the injured deer before treating it.

entries.definitionEn: Crossing the Atlantic Ocean, or involving countries on both sides of it.
entries.arabicMeaning: عابر للمحيط الأطلسي أو متعلق بجانبيه
entries.example: They booked a transatlantic flight to New York.

entries.definitionEn: A written copy of spoken words. Also an official record of a student's grades.
entries.arabicMeaning: نسخة مكتوبة من كلام منطوق؛ أو كشف رسمي بالدرجات الدراسية
entries.example: The university asked for a transcript of her grades.

entries.definitionEn: The act of moving a person, thing, or sum of money from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقل شخص أو شيء أو مبلغ من موضع إلى آخر
entries.example: The bank transfer arrived the next morning.

entries.definitionEn: To move someone or something from one place, job, or account to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقل شخصاً أو شيئاً من مكان أو عمل أو حساب إلى آخر
entries.example: Please transfer the files to the new folder.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone unable to move because of shock, fear, or intense interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسمّر شخصاً في مكانه من الصدمة أو الخوف أو شدة الانتباه
entries.example: The sudden noise transfixed everyone in the room.

entries.definitionEn: To change something completely in form, appearance, or character.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحوّل شيئاً تحويلاً تاماً في الشكل أو الهيئة أو الطابع
entries.example: The new windows transformed the dark kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: A complete change in form, appearance, or character.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحوّل تام في الشكل أو الهيئة أو الطابع
entries.example: The transformation of the old factory into apartments took two years.

entries.definitionEn: The process of putting blood from one person into the body of another.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقل دم من شخص إلى جسم آخر
entries.example: She needed a blood transfusion after the operation.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting only a short time; not permanent.
entries.arabicMeaning: عابر لا يدوم إلا قليلاً
entries.example: The pain was transient and faded within an hour.

entries.definitionEn: A small electronic part that controls or strengthens an electrical signal.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترانزستور: قطعة إلكترونية صغيرة تتحكّم بالإشارة الكهربائية أو تضخّمها
entries.example: Early radios used a transistor to amplify the signal.

entries.definitionEn: The process of passing through a place on the way to somewhere else.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبور مكان في أثناء التوجّه إلى مقصد آخر
entries.example: The goods were damaged in transit.

entries.definitionEn: The process of changing from one state, job, or system to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتقال من حال أو عمل أو نظام إلى آخر
entries.example: The transition from school to university felt sudden.

entries.definitionEn: Belonging to a period of change from one state or system to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتقالي؛ يخص مرحلة التحوّل من وضع إلى آخر
entries.example: This is a transitional period before the new system starts.

entries.definitionEn: In grammar, describing a verb that takes a direct object.
entries.arabicMeaning: في النحو: يوصف به الفعل المتعدي الذي يحتاج مفعولاً به
entries.example: In this sentence, 'buy' is a transitive verb because it takes an object.

entries.definitionEn: To change words from one language into another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يترجم كلاماً من لغة إلى أخرى
entries.example: Can you translate this letter into Arabic?

entries.definitionEn: A text that has been changed from one language into another, or the act of doing this.
entries.arabicMeaning: نص منقول من لغة إلى أخرى، أو عملية الترجمة نفسها
entries.example: The translation of the novel won a prize.

entries.definitionEn: A person whose job is to change writing or speech from one language into another.
entries.arabicMeaning: مترجم ينقل الكتابة أو الكلام من لغة إلى أخرى
entries.example: A translator sat beside the speaker at the conference.

entries.definitionEn: The sending of signals, programmes, or disease from one place or person to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: بث إشارات أو برامج، أو انتقال مرض من موضع أو شخص إلى آخر
entries.example: The radio transmission was unclear because of the storm.

entries.definitionEn: To send out signals, or to pass a disease from one person or animal to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبث إشارات، أو ينقل مرضاً من شخص أو حيوان إلى آخر
entries.example: Mosquitoes can transmit the disease.

entries.definitionEn: A device that sends out radio, television, or other electromagnetic signals.
entries.arabicMeaning: جهاز إرسال يبث إشارات إذاعية أو تلفازية أو غيرها
entries.example: The emergency transmitter sent a signal from the hillside.

entries.definitionEn: Clear enough to see through. Also open and easy to understand, with nothing hidden.
entries.arabicMeaning: شفاف يُرى من خلاله؛ أو واضح صريح لا يخفي شيئاً
entries.example: The box is made of transparent plastic.

entries.definitionEn: The system or vehicles used for moving people or goods from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: وسائل النقل أو نظام نقل الناس والبضائع
entries.example: Public transport is cheap in this city.

entries.definitionEn: To move people or goods from one place to another in a vehicle.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينقل أناساً أو بضائع من مكان إلى آخر بمركبة
entries.example: Lorries transport food from the farms to the shops.

entries.definitionEn: The activity or system of moving people or goods from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: عملية النقل أو نظامه للناس والبضائع
entries.example: The city improved transportation between the airport and the centre.

entries.definitionEn: A device for catching an animal, or a situation that is hard to escape.
entries.arabicMeaning: فخ لصيد حيوان، أو موقف يصعب الخروج منه
entries.example: The mouse walked straight into the trap.

entries.definitionEn: Things that have been thrown away; rubbish. Also something of very poor quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفايات تُرمى؛ أو شيء رديء جداً
entries.example: Please put the trash in the bin outside.

entries.definitionEn: A very severe shock or injury, to the mind or the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: صدمة نفسية أو إصابة جسدية بالغة
entries.example: He needed time to recover from the trauma of the accident.

entries.definitionEn: Causing severe shock or lasting emotional pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادم يخلّف ألماً نفسياً شديداً أو أثراً يدوم
entries.example: Moving house so suddenly was a traumatic experience for the children.

entries.definitionEn: A person or company that arranges journeys, tickets, and holidays for customers.
entries.arabicMeaning: وكيل سفر يرتّب الرحلات والتذاكر والإجازات للزبائن
entries.example: The travel agent found us a cheaper flight.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of going from one place to another, especially over a long distance.
entries.arabicMeaning: السفر والتنقّل من مكان إلى آخر، وخصوصاً عبر مسافة بعيدة
entries.example: Air travel is often faster than going by train.

entries.definitionEn: To go from one place to another, especially far from home.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسافر من مكان إلى آخر، وخصوصاً بعيداً عن البيت
entries.example: I travel to work by bus.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is on a journey, or who travels often.
entries.arabicMeaning: مسافر في رحلة، أو كثير الأسفار
entries.example: Every traveller on the tour received a map.

entries.definitionEn: A route or movement across something, especially across a mountain slope.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبور عرضي أو مسار عبور، وخصوصاً عبر سفح جبلي
entries.example: The climbers planned a traverse across the icy face.

entries.definitionEn: A flat board with raised edges, used for carrying food, cups, or papers.
entries.arabicMeaning: صينية مسطحة ذات حافة لحمل الطعام أو الأكواب أو الأوراق
entries.example: He carried the cups in on a tray.

entries.definitionEn: Likely to betray trust. Also dangerously unstable, though it may not look so.
entries.arabicMeaning: غادر يخون الثقة؛ أو خطر على نحو خادع وإن بدا آمناً
entries.example: The ice made the steps treacherous.

entries.definitionEn: In a disloyal way, or in a way that is secretly dangerous.
entries.arabicMeaning: بغدر، أو على نحو خطر خادع
entries.example: The path dropped treacherously toward the river.

entries.definitionEn: The act of betraying someone who trusts you.
entries.arabicMeaning: غدر وخيانة لمن يثق بك
entries.example: The plot failed when his treachery was discovered.

entries.definitionEn: The patterned surface of a tyre that grips the road. Also a person's way of walking.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقش إطار العجلة الذي يمسك الطريق؛ أو طريقة مشي الشخص
entries.example: The tyre tread was too worn to be safe in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: To put your foot down on something while walking; to walk on a surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدوس أو يضع قدمه على شيء في أثناء المشي
entries.example: Please tread carefully on the wet floor.

entries.definitionEn: Gold, jewels, or other valuable things, especially when hidden or found.
entries.arabicMeaning: كنز من ذهب أو جواهر أو نفائس، وخصوصاً إن كان مخفياً أو مكتشفاً
entries.example: The children pretended to look for buried treasure.

entries.definitionEn: Something special and enjoyable that you do not have often.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكافأة ممتعة أو شيء خاص لا يتكرر كثيراً
entries.example: Ice cream after dinner was a special treat.

entries.definitionEn: To behave towards someone in a particular way. Also to give medical care, or to pay for something enjoyable.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعامل شخصاً بأسلوب معيّن؛ أو يعالج طبياً، أو يستضيف على حسابه
entries.example: The doctor treated her infection with antibiotics.

entries.definitionEn: Medical care for an illness or injury. Also the way a person or subject is dealt with.
entries.arabicMeaning: علاج طبي لمرض أو إصابة؛ أو أسلوب التعامل مع شخص أو موضوع
entries.example: The treatment lasted six weeks.

entries.definitionEn: A formal written agreement between countries or groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: معاهدة مكتوبة رسمية بين دول أو أطراف
entries.example: The two countries signed a trade treaty.

entries.definitionEn: A tall plant with a wooden trunk, branches, and leaves.
entries.arabicMeaning: شجرة عالية ذات جذع خشبي وأغصان وأوراق
entries.example: There is a tall tree in front of the house.

entries.definitionEn: A long, difficult journey on foot, often in mountains or countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة طويلة شاقة سيراً على الأقدام، غالباً في جبال أو ريف
entries.example: The trek through the mountains took three days.

entries.definitionEn: To shake slightly because of cold, fear, or strong feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتجف قليلاً من برد أو خوف أو انفعال شديد
entries.example: His hands began to tremble from the cold.

entries.definitionEn: Very large, great, or impressive.
entries.arabicMeaning: هائل أو عظيم أو مثير للإعجاب
entries.example: She has tremendous energy in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: To a very great degree; extremely.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى حد هائل؛ للغاية
entries.example: The course helped her tremendously.

entries.definitionEn: A slight shaking of the ground or of part of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: هزة خفيفة في الأرض أو ارتعاش في جزء من الجسم
entries.example: A slight tremor shook the cups on the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: A general direction in which something is developing or becoming popular.
entries.arabicMeaning: اتجاه عام يسير فيه شيء أو يزداد انتشاراً
entries.example: Working from home is a growing trend.

entries.definitionEn: A court process to decide if someone is guilty. Also a test of something new.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاكمة قضائية للبتّ في الإدانة؛ أو اختبار تجريبي لشيء جديد
entries.example: She downloaded the app for a free trial.

entries.definitionEn: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثلث: شكل مسطّح بثلاثة أضلاع وثلاث زوايا
entries.example: Draw a triangle with sides of equal length.

entries.definitionEn: A community of people who share a language, culture, and ancestry.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبيلة أو جماعة تشترك في لغة وثقافة ونسب
entries.example: The museum exhibit explained the history of the local tribe.

entries.definitionEn: An action meant to deceive, or a clever action done for entertainment.
entries.arabicMeaning: خدعة يُقصد بها الخداع، أو حيلة بارعة للترفيه
entries.example: He showed the children a card trick.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone believe something that is not true, usually in order to gain something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخدع شخصاً فيصدّق ما ليس صحيحاً، غالباً لنيل شيء
entries.example: She tricked her brother into doing the dishes.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to deal with or easy to get wrong.
entries.arabicMeaning: صعب المعالجة أو سهل أن يُخطَأ فيه
entries.example: That question is tricky, so take your time.

entries.definitionEn: Something of little importance or value. Also a sweet dish of cake, fruit, and cream.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمر تافه قليل الشأن؛ وأيضاً حلوى من كعك وفاكهة وكريمة
entries.example: The delay was a trifle compared with the larger problem.

entries.definitionEn: To treat a person or matter without seriousness or respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستهين بشخص أو أمر أو يعبث به من غير جدّ
entries.example: Do not trifle with people's feelings.

entries.definitionEn: Something that causes a sudden reaction or event. Also the part of a gun that you pull to fire it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما يطلق رد فعل أو حدثاً مفاجئاً؛ أو زناد السلاح
entries.example: Stress is a common trigger for her headaches.

entries.definitionEn: A slight cut, especially of hair. Also a decorative edge on clothes or objects.
entries.arabicMeaning: قصة خفيفة وخصوصاً للشعر؛ أو حاشية زينة على ثوب أو شيء
entries.example: He went to the barber for a quick trim.

entries.definitionEn: A group of three people or things, especially three musicians.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثلاثي من أشخاص أو أشياء، وخصوصاً ثلاثة عازفين
entries.example: A jazz trio played in the corner of the café.

entries.definitionEn: A journey to a place and back, often for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة إلى مكان والعودة منه، غالباً قصيرة
entries.example: We are planning a trip to the sea.

entries.definitionEn: To catch your foot on something and almost fall, or to fall.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتعثّر بقدمه فيكاد يسقط أو يسقط
entries.example: She tripped on the step and almost fell.

entries.definitionEn: A great success or victory, or the feeling that comes with it.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتصار أو نجاح باهر، أو الشعور المصاحب له
entries.example: Winning the cup was a personal triumph.

entries.definitionEn: Of little importance or value; not worth serious attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: تافه قليل الأهمية لا يستحق اكتراثاً جدياً
entries.example: They argued over a trivial detail.

entries.definitionEn: A cart on wheels for carrying shopping or luggage. Also a small table on wheels.
entries.arabicMeaning: عربة بعجلات للتسوق أو الحقائب؛ أو منضدة صغيرة بعجلات
entries.example: She pushed a trolley around the supermarket.

entries.definitionEn: A group of soldiers. In the plural, soldiers in general.
entries.arabicMeaning: فرقة من الجنود؛ وفي الجمع غالباً بمعنى القوات
entries.example: A troop of soldiers marched through the town.

entries.definitionEn: An object given as a prize for winning a competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: كأس أو جائزة تُمنَح للفائز في مسابقة
entries.example: The winning team lifted the trophy.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the hot regions of the earth near the equator.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمناطق الحارة القريبة من خط الاستواء
entries.example: He could not sleep in the tropic heat.

entries.definitionEn: From or typical of the hot, wet regions near the equator.
entries.arabicMeaning: استوائي؛ من المناطق الحارة الرطبة قرب خط الاستواء أو شبيه بها
entries.example: Mangoes grow well in a tropical climate.

entries.definitionEn: Problems, difficulties, or worry.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشكلات أو صعوبات أو قلق
entries.example: The car caused a lot of trouble on the journey.

entries.definitionEn: To cause someone worry, pain, or inconvenience.
entries.arabicMeaning: يزعج شخصاً أو يقلقه أو يحمّله مشقة
entries.example: I am sorry to trouble you, but I need a moment.

entries.definitionEn: Causing problems, inconvenience, or worry over a period of time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مزعج يسبب متاعب أو قلقاً على مدى وقت
entries.example: The troublesome leak returned after the repair.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of clothing that covers both legs separately, from the waist down.
entries.arabicMeaning: بنطال يغطي الساقين من الخصر إلى أسفل
entries.example: He bought a new pair of trousers for the interview.

entries.definitionEn: A large vehicle used for carrying goods by road.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاحنة كبيرة لنقل البضائع على الطريق
entries.example: A truck delivered the furniture this morning.

entries.definitionEn: Correct and not false; real.
entries.arabicMeaning: صحيح غير كاذب؛ حقيقي
entries.example: Is that story true?

entries.definitionEn: A statement that is true but too obvious to be interesting or useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: بديهية صحيحة لكنها أظهر من أن تضيف علماً أو فائدة
entries.example: It is a truism that people work better when they feel respected.

entries.definitionEn: Really; in a true, honest, or complete way.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقاً؛ على نحو صادق أو تام
entries.example: I am truly sorry for the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: A brass musical instrument with a flared end, played by blowing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بوق نحاسي يتّسع طرفه، يُعزَف بالنفخ
entries.example: She has played the trumpet since she was twelve.

entries.definitionEn: The thick main stem of a tree. Also an elephant's long nose, a large packing case, or the storage space at the back of a car.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذع الشجرة الغليظ؛ أو خرطوم الفيل، أو صندوق كبير، أو صندوق السيارة الخلفي
entries.example: The trunk of the old oak was very wide.

entries.definitionEn: A firm belief that someone is honest and will not harm you or let you down.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثقة راسخة في صدق شخص وأنه لن يضرك أو يخيّب ظنك
entries.example: There is little trust between the two teams.

entries.definitionEn: To believe that someone is honest and will do what they should.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثق في صدق شخص وأنه سيفعل ما ينبغي
entries.example: I trust her to lock the door.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be trusted; honest and reliable.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بالثقة؛ صادق يعتمد عليه
entries.example: He is a trustworthy neighbour.

entries.definitionEn: Reliable because it has been used and proven for a long time, often said with affection.
entries.arabicMeaning: موثوق لأنه جُرّب طويلاً، غالباً بنبرة ودّية
entries.example: She packed her trusty old camera for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The real facts about something; what is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحقيقة؛ الوقائع كما هي
entries.example: Just tell me the truth.

entries.definitionEn: Telling the truth; not lying.
entries.arabicMeaning: صادق لا يكذب
entries.example: Please give a truthful answer.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being honest and telling the truth.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصدق وملازمة قول الحق
entries.example: The judge praised the witness for her truthfulness.

entries.definitionEn: An attempt to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: محاولة لأداء شيء
entries.example: Have another try if the first one fails.

entries.definitionEn: To make an effort to do something, or to test something to see if it works or if you like it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحاول أداء شيء، أو يجرّب شيئاً ليرى إن نجح أو إن أعجبه
entries.example: Try the soup before you add salt.

entries.definitionEn: Annoying or difficult to deal with; putting a strain on patience.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهق أو عسير الاحتمال يضيق معه الصبر
entries.example: It has been a trying week at work.

entries.definitionEn: A wide, round, open container. Also a bath.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعاء واسع مستدير مفتوح؛ أو حوض استحمام
entries.example: She filled the tub with hot water.

entries.definitionEn: A long hollow object, often used to hold liquid or paste. Also, in London, the underground railway.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنبوب أجوف طويل يُحفظ فيه سائل أو معجون؛ وفي لندن أيضاً قطار الأنفاق
entries.example: Squeeze some toothpaste from the tube.

entries.definitionEn: A serious infectious disease that usually affects the lungs.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرض السلّ، وهو داء معدٍ خطير يصيب الرئتين غالباً
entries.example: The clinic tests patients for tuberculosis.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوم الثلاثاء، الذي يلي الاثنين ويسبق الأربعاء
entries.example: The meeting is on Tuesday.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden hard pull. Also a small powerful boat that pulls larger ships.
entries.arabicMeaning: جذبة قوية مفاجئة؛ أو قارب صغير قوي يسحب سفناً أكبر
entries.example: She felt a tug on her sleeve.

entries.definitionEn: Teaching, especially of one person or a small group. Also, in American English, the money paid for a course of study.
entries.arabicMeaning: تدريس وخصوصاً لشخص أو مجموعة صغيرة؛ وفي الأمريكية أيضاً رسوم الدراسة
entries.example: He pays extra for piano tuition on Saturdays.

entries.definitionEn: A garden flower with a cup-shaped bloom on a tall stem, often brightly coloured.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزامى (توليب): زهرة كأسية على ساق طويلة، غالباً زاهية اللون
entries.example: A row of red tulips lined the path.

entries.definitionEn: To fall suddenly and in a rolling or clumsy way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسقط فجأة متدحرجاً أو على نحو غير متماسك
entries.example: The books tumbled off the shelf.

entries.definitionEn: A mass of tissue that grows in the body in an abnormal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورم: كتلة نسيجية تنمو في الجسم على نحو غير سوي
entries.example: The scan showed a small tumour that doctors could treat.

entries.definitionEn: A large sea fish, eaten fresh or from a tin.
entries.arabicMeaning: تونة: سمك بحري كبير يُؤكل طازجاً أو من علبة
entries.example: She made a sandwich with tuna and salad.

entries.definitionEn: A series of musical notes that form a melody; a song or piece of music.
entries.arabicMeaning: لحن من نغمات متتابعة؛ أغنية أو قطعة موسيقية
entries.example: He whistled a familiar tune.

entries.definitionEn: To adjust a musical instrument so that it plays at the right pitch. Also to adjust a radio or other device.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضبط آلة موسيقية على الطبقة الصحيحة؛ أو يضبط مذياعاً أو جهازاً آخر
entries.example: She tuned the guitar before the concert.

entries.definitionEn: A long passage under the ground or through a hill, for a road, railway, or pedestrians.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفق طويل تحت الأرض أو عبر تل، لطريق أو سكة أو مشاة
entries.example: The train entered a long tunnel under the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Irregular movement of air that makes an aircraft shake. Also a state of confusion and disorder.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطراب جوي يهز الطائرة؛ أو حال من الفوضى والاختلال
entries.example: The plane shook during a patch of turbulence.

entries.definitionEn: Full of sudden change, disorder, or violent movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضطرب مليء بالتقلّب أو الفوضى أو الحركة العنيفة
entries.example: It was a turbulent year for the company.

entries.definitionEn: A large bird that is often eaten at celebrations.
entries.arabicMeaning: ديك رومي كبير يُؤكل غالباً في المناسبات
entries.example: They roasted a turkey for the family dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A state of great noise, confusion, and uncertainty.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطراب وفوضى شديدة مع غموض الحال
entries.example: The office was in turmoil after the sudden news.

entries.definitionEn: A time when you may do something that others also do, one after another. Also a change of direction.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوبة أو دور يأتي بعد غيره؛ أو انعطاف في الاتجاه
entries.example: It is your turn to wash the dishes.

entries.definitionEn: To go to someone for help or advice. Also to start doing a different activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلجأ إلى شخص طلباً للمساعدة أو المشورة؛ أو يشرع في نشاط مختلف
entries.example: When the computer failed, she turned to a colleague for help.

entries.definitionEn: To move so that you face a different direction, or to make something do this. Also to become.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستدير ليواجه اتجاهاً آخر، أو يدير شيئاً كذلك؛ وقد يعني يصير
entries.example: Turn left at the traffic lights.

entries.definitionEn: A place where a road branches off another road.
entries.arabicMeaning: منعطف تتفرع عنده الطريق
entries.example: Take the second turning on the right.

entries.definitionEn: A small tower on a building, or a rotating structure for guns on a tank or ship.
entries.arabicMeaning: برج صغير فوق مبنى، أو برج دوّار للمدافع على دبابة أو سفينة
entries.example: A stone turret rose at the corner of the castle.

entries.definitionEn: A reptile with a hard shell, living on land or in water.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلحفاة ذات صدفة صلبة، برية أو مائية
entries.example: A turtle swam slowly near the boat.

entries.definitionEn: A teacher who works with one student or a small group, often privately.
entries.arabicMeaning: معلّم خصوصي لطالب واحد أو لمجموعة صغيرة
entries.example: Her maths tutor explained the problem again.

entries.definitionEn: A screen that shows programmes; short for television.
entries.arabicMeaning: تلفاز: شاشة تعرض البرامج
entries.example: The children watched TV after dinner.

entries.definitionEn: The number 12.
entries.arabicMeaning: العدد اثنا عشر
entries.example: There are twelve months in a year.

entries.definitionEn: The number 20.
entries.arabicMeaning: العدد عشرون
entries.example: He will be twenty next month.

entries.definitionEn: Two times; on two occasions.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرتين؛ في مناسبتين
entries.example: I have visited that museum twice.

entries.definitionEn: One of two children born to the same mother at the same time.
entries.arabicMeaning: توأم: أحد طفلين وُلدا معاً من الأم نفسها
entries.example: She has a twin who lives in another city.

entries.definitionEn: A small, quick flash of light, like a star.
entries.arabicMeaning: وميض خفيف سريع كلمعة نجم
entries.example: There was a twinkle of light from the distant house.

entries.definitionEn: A bending or turning shape. Also an unexpected change in a story or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: التواء أو انحناء؛ أو منعطف غير متوقع في قصة أو موقف
entries.example: The story has a twist in the last chapter.

entries.definitionEn: To turn or bend something, often with force, so that it changes shape or position.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلوي شيئاً أو يبرمه، غالباً بقوة، حتى يتغيّر شكله أو موضعه
entries.example: Twist the cap to open the bottle.

entries.definitionEn: Bent or turned out of its usual shape. Also morally strange or cruel.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملتوٍ عن شكله المعتاد؛ أو منحرف التفكير قاسٍ
entries.example: The twisted metal was all that remained of the gate.

entries.definitionEn: A small, sudden, uncontrolled movement of a muscle.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفضة عضلية قصيرة لا إرادية
entries.example: A small twitch in his eyelid lasted all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To make a small, sudden, uncontrolled movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتفض انتفاضاً خفيفاً مفاجئاً لا إرادياً
entries.example: The cat's ear twitched at the sudden sound.

entries.definitionEn: The number 2.
entries.arabicMeaning: العدد اثنان
entries.example: I need two tickets, please.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has made a great fortune in business and has a lot of power.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجل أعمال بالغ الثراء والنفوذ
entries.example: The shipping tycoon donated money to the hospital.

entries.definitionEn: A group of people or things that are similar; a kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوع أو صنف من الناس أو الأشياء المتشابهة
entries.example: What type of music do you like?

entries.definitionEn: To write using a keyboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكتب على لوحة مفاتيح
entries.example: She can type quickly without looking at the keys.

entries.definitionEn: A serious infectious disease that causes fever and is often spread through dirty water or food.
entries.arabicMeaning: حمى تيفية: مرض معدٍ خطير يسبب ارتفاعاً في الحرارة وينتشر غالباً بالماء أو الطعام الملوّث
entries.example: The doctor suspected typhoid after the fever lasted several days.

entries.definitionEn: Having the usual qualities of a particular person, thing, or group.
entries.arabicMeaning: نموذجي أو معتاد في شخص أو شيء أو جماعة
entries.example: Rain in April is typical here.

entries.definitionEn: In the usual way; in most cases.
entries.arabicMeaning: على النحو المعتاد؛ في أغلب الحالات
entries.example: The office typically closes at five.

entries.definitionEn: Cruel and unfair government, or any harsh control over people.
entries.arabicMeaning: طغيان وحكم ظالم، أو سيطرة قاسية على الناس
entries.example: The novel describes life under tyranny.

entries.definitionEn: A ruler who uses power in a cruel and unfair way.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاغية يستعمل السلطة بقسوة وجور
entries.example: The play is about a tyrant who fears losing power.

entries.definitionEn: Unpleasant to look at.
entries.arabicMeaning: قبيح المنظر
entries.example: That ugly stain will not come out of the shirt.

entries.definitionEn: Final, or the best or most extreme of its kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهائي؛ أو أقصى ما في بابه جودة أو شدة
entries.example: This is the ultimate guide for new cooks.

entries.definitionEn: In the end, after everything else has been considered.
entries.arabicMeaning: في نهاية المطاف بعد النظر في كل أمر
entries.example: Ultimately, they decided to stay.

entries.definitionEn: An object you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain.
entries.arabicMeaning: مظلة تُحمَل فوق الرأس للوقاية من المطر
entries.example: Take an umbrella; it might rain.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير قادر على فعل شيء
entries.example: I was unable to open the file.

entries.definitionEn: Too bad or wrong to be allowed or agreed to.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مقبول؛ لا يجوز الرضا به
entries.example: Such delays are unacceptable in a hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Not mixed with anything else; complete and not softened or qualified.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالص لم يُخلط بغيره؛ أو تام لم يُلطَّف ولم يُقيَّد
entries.example: After the exam she felt unadulterated relief.

entries.definitionEn: Not frightened; showing no fear.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير خائف؛ لا يظهر جزعاً
entries.example: The child seemed unafraid of the big dog.

entries.definitionEn: Without shame or apology; openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا خجل أو اعتذار؛ على المكشوف
entries.example: He unashamedly admitted that he had copied the idea.

entries.definitionEn: Done without help from anyone else.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا مساعدة من أحد
entries.example: She made an unassisted climb to the top of the wall.

entries.definitionEn: Not pleasant to look at; not appealing.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير جذاب المنظر أو غير مستحب
entries.example: The building looks unattractive from the street.

entries.definitionEn: Done or used without official permission.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مصرّح به؛ بغير إذن رسمي
entries.example: Unauthorised staff may not enter this room.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to be obtained, used, or spoken to at a particular time.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متاح للحصول عليه أو استعماله أو مقابلته في وقت معيّن
entries.example: The manager is unavailable until Thursday.

entries.definitionEn: Not knowing about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مدرك أو لا يدري بأمر
entries.example: He was unaware that the meeting had been cancelled.

entries.definitionEn: Too unpleasant, painful, or difficult to accept or endure.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُطاق من شدة الألم أو السوء أو العسر
entries.example: The heat in the room was unbearable.

entries.definitionEn: Too good or strong to be defeated or matched.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُقهر ولا يُبارى في الجودة أو القوة
entries.example: At that price, the offer is unbeatable.

entries.definitionEn: Very surprising, or so strange that it is hard to believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: مذهل أو غريب حتى يصعب تصديقه
entries.example: The view from the roof is unbelievable.

entries.definitionEn: Strange or mysterious in a way that is unsettling or hard to explain.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب مقلق على نحو يعسر تفسيره
entries.example: She has an uncanny ability to remember names.

entries.definitionEn: Not sure; not known clearly.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متأكد؛ أو غير معلوم بوضوح
entries.example: I am uncertain about the time of the train.

entries.definitionEn: The state of not knowing what will happen, or of not being sure.
entries.arabicMeaning: حال من عدم الجزم بما سيكون أو بما هو قائم
entries.example: There is still some uncertainty about the results.

entries.definitionEn: Remaining the same; not made different.
entries.arabicMeaning: باقٍ على حاله لم يتغيّر
entries.example: The rules have remained unchanged for years.

entries.definitionEn: Not typical of a particular person; unusual for them.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير معهود في شخص؛ مخالف لما عُرف عنه
entries.example: His silence was uncharacteristic; he usually talks a lot.

entries.definitionEn: The brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt.
entries.arabicMeaning: العم أو الخال، أو زوج العمّة أو الخالة
entries.example: My uncle is visiting us this weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Not easy to understand, see, or be sure about.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير واضح الفهم أو الرؤية أو الجزم
entries.example: The instructions are unclear.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not easy to understand or hear.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يغيب معه الوضوح في الفهم أو السمع
entries.example: He spoke unclearly, and we missed the address.

entries.definitionEn: Not pleasant to wear, sit in, or feel; causing slight pain or unease.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مريح في اللبس أو الجلوس أو الإحساس؛ يسبب ضيقاً
entries.example: This chair is uncomfortable.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that causes physical or social unease.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يسبب ضيقاً في الجسم أو في الموقف
entries.example: The room was uncomfortably warm.

entries.definitionEn: Rare; not happening or found very often.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير شائع؛ نادر الحدوث أو الوجود
entries.example: Snow in May is uncommon here.

entries.definitionEn: Not worried or interested; showing no anxiety.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير قلق أو غير مكترث؛ لا يبدو عليه جزع
entries.example: She seemed unconcerned about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: In a state like sleep, unable to see, hear, or feel. Also not aware of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاقد الوعي لا يبصر ولا يسمع ولا يحس؛ أو غير مدرك لأمر
entries.example: He was unconscious for a few minutes after the fall.

entries.definitionEn: Impossible to stop, hold back, or manage.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يمكن وقفه أو ضبطه أو السيطرة عليه
entries.example: She burst into uncontrollable laughter.

entries.definitionEn: Different from what is usual or generally accepted.
entries.arabicMeaning: خارج عن المألوف أو عما جرى عليه العرف
entries.example: They chose an unconventional design for the house.

entries.definitionEn: Not seeming true or good enough to make you believe it.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مقنع؛ لا يبدو صادقاً أو كافياً للتصديق
entries.example: His excuse sounded unconvincing.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that fails to make people believe something.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا يقنع السامع أو القارئ
entries.example: She smiled unconvincingly and looked away.

entries.definitionEn: To find out something that was hidden, or to remove a cover from something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكشف أمراً كان خافياً، أو يزيل غطاء عن شيء
entries.example: The investigation uncovered several errors in the accounts.

entries.definitionEn: Not discouraged by difficulty, danger, or disappointment.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثابت الجأش لا يثنيه عسر أو خطر أو خيبة
entries.example: Undaunted by the rain, they finished the walk.

entries.definitionEn: Not showing feelings openly, even when they are strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتوم العاطفة لا يظهر مشاعره ولو كانت قوية
entries.example: He is kind but undemonstrative, and rarely shows affection in public.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that does not display emotion openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو كتوم لا تُظهَر فيه العاطفة
entries.example: She squeezed his hand undemonstratively and said nothing.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is below or covered by something else. Also used for less than a number, age, or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى تحت أو أسفل شيء أو في باطنه؛ ويُستعمل أيضاً بمعنى أقل من عدد أو سن أو مقدار
entries.example: The cat is under the table.

entries.definitionEn: Younger than the legal age for an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: دون السن القانونية لنشاط معيّن
entries.example: Underage customers cannot buy that product.

entries.definitionEn: To think that something is smaller, easier, or less important than it really is.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر شيئاً بأقل من حجمه أو سهولته أو أهميته الحقيقية
entries.example: Do not underestimate how long the job will take.

entries.definitionEn: To experience something, especially a change, test, or medical procedure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخضع لتجربة أو تغيير أو فحص أو إجراء طبي
entries.example: She will undergo surgery next week.

entries.definitionEn: A university student who has not yet taken a first degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: طالب جامعي في مرحلة البكالوريوس قبل التخرج
entries.example: He is an undergraduate in his second year.

entries.definitionEn: Below the surface of the earth. Also secret and not official.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع تحت سطح الأرض؛ أو سريّ خارج الإطار الرسمي
entries.example: There is an underground car park below the shop.

entries.definitionEn: Below the surface of the earth. Also in hiding, away from public view.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحت الأرض؛ أو في الخفاء بعيداً عن الأعين
entries.example: The cables run underground along the street.

entries.definitionEn: A line drawn under a word or sentence.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط يُرسَم تحت كلمة أو جملة
entries.example: There is an underline under the title.

entries.definitionEn: To draw a line under words. Also to show that something is important.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضع خطاً تحت الكلام؛ أو يبرز أهمية أمر
entries.example: Please underline the key words in the text.

entries.definitionEn: In a lower position; below something.
entries.arabicMeaning: في موضع أسفل؛ من تحت شيء
entries.example: The spare key is taped underneath.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something is directly below it, under its lower surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى تحت شيء مباشرة؛ أسفل سطحه
entries.example: The keys were underneath the newspaper.

entries.definitionEn: A piece of underwear worn on the lower part of the body.
entries.arabicMeaning: سروال داخلي يُلبس على الجزء الأسفل من الجسم
entries.example: He packed clean socks and underpants for the trip.

entries.definitionEn: Located or happening beneath the surface of the sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: واقع أو حادث تحت سطح البحر
entries.example: The island is linked by an undersea cable.

entries.definitionEn: To know what something means, or why someone feels a certain way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفهم معنى شيء أو سبب شعور شخص
entries.example: Do you understand this question?

entries.definitionEn: Easy to understand, or reasonable in the circumstances.
entries.arabicMeaning: سهل الفهم، أو مفهوم ومبرَّر في هذه الظروف
entries.example: Her anger was understandable after such a long delay.

entries.definitionEn: Showing sympathy and a willingness to see another person's point of view.
entries.arabicMeaning: متفهم؛ يُظهر تعاطفاً واستعداداً لرؤية وجهة نظر الآخر
entries.example: He was patient and understanding when I explained the mistake.

entries.definitionEn: Knowledge of a subject, or an agreement between people. Also sympathy for someone's situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: فهم لموضوع، أو اتفاق بين أطراف؛ وقد يعني التعاطف مع وضع شخص
entries.example: The two sides reached an understanding after hours of talks.

entries.definitionEn: To start and accept responsibility for a task or project.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشرع في عمل ويتحمل مسؤوليته
entries.example: The firm undertook a review of its safety rules.

entries.definitionEn: Below the surface of the water.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحت سطح الماء
entries.example: They took underwater photos of the fish.

entries.definitionEn: Below the surface of the water.
entries.arabicMeaning: تحت سطح الماء
entries.example: The diver stayed underwater for three minutes.

entries.definitionEn: Clothes worn next to the skin under other clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: ملابس داخلية تُلبس ملاصقة للجلد تحت الثياب
entries.example: She bought new underwear at the store.

entries.definitionEn: Not becoming smaller, weaker, or less intense.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يتراجع ولا يخفّ؛ لا ينقص مع الوقت
entries.example: She spoke with undiminishing energy until the last question.

entries.definitionEn: To reverse something that has been done, or to open a fastening.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلغي ما فُعل أو يفكّ رباطاً
entries.example: You can undo the last change with this button.

entries.definitionEn: Without any doubt; certainly.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلا شك؛ يقيناً
entries.example: She is undoubtedly the strongest candidate.

entries.definitionEn: Not imagined before; beyond what anyone thought possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: لم يُتخيَّل من قبل؛ يفوق ما ظُنّ ممكناً
entries.example: The discovery opened undreamed possibilities for treatment.

entries.definitionEn: To take off your clothes.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخلع ملابسه
entries.example: The child learned to undress himself before bed.

entries.definitionEn: Not wearing clothes, or with clothes removed.
entries.arabicMeaning: قد خلع ملابسه؛ بغير ثياب
entries.example: The baby was undressed and ready for a bath.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of worry or slight fear, often without a clear cause.
entries.arabicMeaning: شعور بالقلق أو الانزعاج، غالباً من دون سبب واضح
entries.example: A sense of unease spread through the waiting room.

entries.definitionEn: In a worried or uncomfortable way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقلق أو على نحو غير مريح
entries.example: He glanced uneasily at the closed door.

entries.definitionEn: Worried or not comfortable about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق أو غير مرتاح تجاه شيء
entries.example: I felt uneasy walking home so late.

entries.definitionEn: Without a paid job, though usually able and wanting to work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاطل عن العمل مع القدرة والرغبة فيه عادةً
entries.example: He has been unemployed since the factory closed.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being without a paid job, or the number of people in that state.
entries.arabicMeaning: البطالة؛ حالة فقدان العمل بأجر أو نسبة العاطلين
entries.example: Unemployment rose during the winter.

entries.definitionEn: Free from burdens, debts, or restrictions that would slow someone down.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مقيَّد بأعباء أو ديون أو قيود تعوق الحركة
entries.example: She started the new role unencumbered by old contracts.

entries.definitionEn: Showing little interest, energy, or eagerness.
entries.arabicMeaning: فاتر الحماس؛ قليل الاهتمام أو النشاط
entries.example: The audience was unenthusiastic about the long speech.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult, unpleasant, or not something anyone would want.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محمود؛ صعب أو مزعج لا يتمناه أحد
entries.example: She had the unenviable task of announcing the cuts.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is difficult or unpleasant; not to be wished for.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير محمود؛ بطريقة صعبة لا تُتمنى
entries.example: He was unenviably placed between two angry clients.

entries.definitionEn: Completely clear and leaving no room for doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: قاطع لا لبس فيه ولا مجال للشك
entries.example: The committee gave an unequivocal yes to the proposal.

entries.definitionEn: In a completely clear way, leaving no doubt.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل قاطع لا لبس فيه
entries.example: She stated unequivocally that she would not resign.

entries.definitionEn: Not level, equal, or consistent; irregular in quality or surface.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مستوٍ أو غير متساوٍ؛ متفاوت في الجودة أو السطح
entries.example: The path was uneven and hard to walk on.

entries.definitionEn: With nothing unusual, exciting, or important happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: هادئ بلا أحداث بارزة أو مفاجآت
entries.example: After a tense week, the flight home was uneventful.

entries.definitionEn: Ordinary; not outstanding or remarkable.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادي غير استثنائي؛ لا يتميز بشيء بارز
entries.example: His first novel was competent but unexceptional.

entries.definitionEn: In an ordinary way, without anything remarkable.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو عادي لا يلفت النظر
entries.example: The season ended unexceptionally, with no surprises.

entries.definitionEn: Without an accepted reason or official permission, especially of an absence.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مبرَّر؛ بلا عذر مقبول، وخصوصاً في الغياب
entries.example: Three unexcused absences can affect your grade.

entries.definitionEn: Not thought likely to happen; surprising.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متوقع؛ مفاجئ
entries.example: We had an unexpected visitor on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that was not expected; surprisingly.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير متوقع؛ بشكل مفاجئ
entries.example: The meeting ended unexpectedly early.

entries.definitionEn: Not right or equal; treating people badly or unequally.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير عادل؛ لا يُنصف الناس
entries.example: It is unfair to blame her for the delay.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not fair or equal.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشكل غير عادل
entries.example: He felt he had been treated unfairly.

entries.definitionEn: Not known or recognized; not often experienced.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مألوف؛ لا يُعرَف جيداً
entries.example: The street names were unfamiliar to me.

entries.definitionEn: Not following current style or popular taste.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مواكب للموضة؛ خارج الذوق الشائع
entries.example: The furniture looked comfortable but unfashionable.

entries.definitionEn: Not possible to do in a practical way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير قابل للتنفيذ عملياً
entries.example: Completing the project in a week was unfeasible.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not practical or possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يتعذر تنفيذه عملياً
entries.example: The plan was unfeasibly expensive for a small team.

entries.definitionEn: Not in good physical condition, or not suitable or good enough for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير لائق بدنياً، أو غير مناسب لغرض معيّن
entries.example: He felt unfit after months without exercise.

entries.definitionEn: To open something that was folded, or to happen and become clear over time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرد شيئاً مطوياً، أو يتضح حدث مع مرور الوقت
entries.example: She unfolded the map on the table.

entries.definitionEn: Not expected or planned for.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متوقع ولم يُحسَب حسابه
entries.example: Unforeseen costs delayed the building work.

entries.definitionEn: So special or strong that you will always remember it.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُنسى؛ راسخ في الذاكرة
entries.example: The concert was an unforgettable night.

entries.definitionEn: Unlucky, or something you wish had not happened. Also regrettable.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ الحظ أو مؤسف؛ يُؤسَف لحدوثه
entries.example: It was an unfortunate mistake, but no one was hurt.

entries.definitionEn: Used to say that something is sad or disappointing.
entries.arabicMeaning: للأسف؛ مما يؤسف له
entries.example: Unfortunately, the museum is closed today.

entries.definitionEn: Not kind or welcoming; not showing warmth to others.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ودّي؛ بارد الاستقبال
entries.example: The shop assistant seemed unfriendly at first.

entries.definitionEn: Shockingly early, late, or extreme. Also morally wrong in older use.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفرط إلى حدّ فاحش، وخصوصاً في الوقت؛ وقد يعني منافياً للأخلاق
entries.example: The phone rang at an ungodly hour.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being sad or not satisfied.
entries.arabicMeaning: تعاسة أو حزن أو عدم رضا
entries.example: She could not hide her unhappiness after the news.

entries.definitionEn: Sad, or not pleased with a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: حزين أو غير راضٍ عن وضع ما
entries.example: He looked unhappy after the test.

entries.definitionEn: Not rushed, bothered, or pressured; calm and unhurried.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مستعجل ولا مضيَّق عليه؛ هادئ البال
entries.example: She answered in an unharried voice, as if she had all day.

entries.definitionEn: Bad for your body, or not in good health.
entries.arabicMeaning: مضرّ بالصحة، أو غير صحيح البدن
entries.example: Eating only fried food is unhealthy.

entries.definitionEn: Not listened to or noticed; not taken into account.
entries.arabicMeaning: لم يُسمَع أو لم يُلتفَت إليه
entries.example: Her warning went unheard.

entries.definitionEn: Not useful; not giving the help that is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مفيد؛ لا يقدّم العون المطلوب
entries.example: The instructions were confusing and unhelpful.

entries.definitionEn: The same in every part; not changing from one place to another.
entries.arabicMeaning: موحَّد؛ متماثل في كل أجزائه
entries.example: The paint should be a uniform colour on every wall.

entries.definitionEn: Special clothes worn by people in the same school, job, or team.
entries.arabicMeaning: زيّ موحَّد يرتديه طلاب أو موظفون أو فريق
entries.example: Students must wear a school uniform.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being the same throughout, without variety.
entries.arabicMeaning: التماثل والاطراد من غير تنوّع
entries.example: The new rules brought greater uniformity across the offices.

entries.definitionEn: To join separate parts into one whole.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوحّد أجزاء متفرقة في كيان واحد
entries.example: The new leader tried to unify the two groups.

entries.definitionEn: Too great, strange, or extreme to picture in the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُتصوَّر؛ يفوق الخيال
entries.example: The scale of the damage was unimaginable.

entries.definitionEn: To a degree that is hard to picture or believe.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة تفوق التصوّر
entries.example: The desert nights were unimaginably cold.

entries.definitionEn: Not important; of little value or effect.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مهم؛ قليل القيمة أو الأثر
entries.example: That detail is unimportant for now.

entries.definitionEn: Failing to excite interest, energy, or imagination.
entries.arabicMeaning: باهت لا يحرّك الحماس ولا الخيال
entries.example: The speech was long and uninspiring.

entries.definitionEn: Not wanting to know or take part; showing no interest.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مهتم؛ لا رغبة لديه في الأمر
entries.example: He seemed uninterested in the discussion.

entries.definitionEn: Not holding your attention; dull.
entries.arabicMeaning: مملّ؛ لا يشدّ الانتباه
entries.example: I found the lecture uninteresting.

entries.definitionEn: An organization of workers, or the act of joining things or people together.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقابة عمالية، أو اتحاد واندماج بين أطراف
entries.example: She joined the teachers' union last year.

entries.definitionEn: Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.
entries.arabicMeaning: فريد من نوعه؛ لا مثيل له
entries.example: Each fingerprint is unique.

entries.definitionEn: The fact of people doing or saying the same thing at the same time. In music, singing or playing the same notes together.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداء الشيء نفسه في آنٍ واحد؛ وفي الموسيقى الغناء أو العزف بنغمة واحدة
entries.example: The crowd shouted her name in unison.

entries.definitionEn: A single thing, group, or amount used as a standard for measuring or counting.
entries.arabicMeaning: وحدة؛ شيء مفرد أو مجموعة أو مقدار يُقاس به
entries.example: The course is divided into ten units.

entries.definitionEn: To come together, or to bring people or things together, for a shared purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتّحد أو يجمع أناساً أو أشياء لغاية مشتركة
entries.example: The crisis united the neighbours.

entries.definitionEn: Joined together and acting as one group.
entries.arabicMeaning: متّحد؛ يعمل كجماعة واحدة
entries.example: The staff remained united during the talks.

entries.definitionEn: True or available for everyone, or existing everywhere.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامّ يشمل الجميع أو يوجد في كل مكان
entries.example: Access to clean water should be universal.

entries.definitionEn: All of space and everything in it, including stars and planets.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكون؛ الفضاء وما فيه من نجوم وكواكب
entries.example: Scientists still debate how the universe began.

entries.definitionEn: A place of higher education where people study for degrees.
entries.arabicMeaning: جامعة؛ مؤسسة تعليم عالٍ تُمنَح فيها الشهادات
entries.example: She wants to study medicine at university.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not just or deserved.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو ظالم غير مستحق
