entries.example: He was unjustly accused of cheating.

entries.definitionEn: Not kind; slightly cruel or thoughtless toward others.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير لطيف؛ فيه قسوة أو قلة مراعاة
entries.example: It was unkind to laugh at her idea.

entries.definitionEn: Not known, famous, or identified.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجهول؛ غير معروف
entries.example: The author of the letter is unknown.

entries.definitionEn: Except if; used before a clause to say that something will happen only if another thing does not.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلا إذا؛ أداة ربط بمعنى أن الأمر يقع ما لم يحدث شرط آخر
entries.example: We will go for a walk unless it rains.

entries.definitionEn: Different from someone or something; not similar.
entries.arabicMeaning: مختلف عن غيره؛ غير شبيه
entries.example: The two sisters are unlike in almost every way.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to contrast it with the subject; in contrast to.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى بخلاف؛ يقابل بين المذكور وما قبله
entries.example: Unlike her brother, she enjoys early mornings.

entries.definitionEn: Not probable; not expected to happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرجَّح؛ لا يُتوقع حدوثه
entries.example: It is unlikely that he will arrive before noon.

entries.definitionEn: With no limit on amount, number, or time.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محدود كميةً أو عدداً أو زمناً
entries.example: The ticket gives you unlimited travel for a month.

entries.definitionEn: To remove goods from a vehicle or container. Also to get rid of a burden.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفرّغ حمولة من مركبة أو وعاء؛ وقد يعني يُلقي عبئاً
entries.example: They helped unload the boxes from the truck.

entries.definitionEn: To open a lock, or to make something available that was blocked.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتح قفلاً، أو يتيح شيئاً كان محظوراً
entries.example: She used her key to unlock the front door.

entries.definitionEn: Having bad luck, or likely to bring bad luck.
entries.arabicMeaning: سيئ الحظ، أو يجلب سوء الحظ
entries.example: He has been unlucky with the weather all week.

entries.definitionEn: Too difficult to control, organize, or deal with.
entries.arabicMeaning: عصيّ على السيطرة أو التنظيم
entries.example: The workload had become unmanageable.

entries.definitionEn: Operated without a person on board, as of a vehicle or craft.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مأهول؛ يعمل من دون شخص على متنه
entries.example: An unmanned aircraft surveyed the coastline.

entries.definitionEn: Direct, with no person or system standing in between.
entries.arabicMeaning: مباشر بلا وسيط
entries.example: The diary offers an unmediated view of her daily life.

entries.definitionEn: So clear that it cannot be confused with anything else.
entries.arabicMeaning: جليّ لا يُخطَأ فيه
entries.example: There was an unmistakable smell of smoke.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be mistaken.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا يُخطَأ فيه
entries.example: The voice was unmistakably hers.

entries.definitionEn: Having little sense of music, or unpleasant as sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الحس الموسيقي، أو نابي الصوت
entries.example: He was charming but completely unmusical.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that lacks musical skill or pleasant sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يفتقر إلى الموسيقى أو عذوبة الصوت
entries.example: The phone rang unmusically in the quiet hall.

entries.definitionEn: Not normal or not occurring in nature; forced or fake in manner.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير طبيعي؛ متكلَّف أو مصطنع
entries.example: Her smile looked stiff and unnatural.

entries.definitionEn: Not needed; more than what is required.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ضروري؛ زائد على الحاجة
entries.example: All that extra packaging is unnecessary.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone lose confidence or feel suddenly uneasy.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُفقد الشخص رباطة جأشه أو يثير قلقه فجأة
entries.example: The long silence began to unnerve her.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel nervous or lose confidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلق يزعزع الثقة أو يثير التوتر
entries.example: It was unnerving to walk through the empty building.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that makes someone uneasy or less confident.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يثير القلق ويزعزع الاطمئنان
entries.example: He smiled unnervingly and said nothing.

entries.definitionEn: Not attracting attention; quietly present without getting in the way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير لافت؛ حاضر بهدوء من دون أن يزاحم
entries.example: The cameras were small and unobtrusive.

entries.definitionEn: In a quiet way that does not attract attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: بهدوء لا يلفت الأنظار
entries.example: She slipped unobtrusively into the back row.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of not attracting attention or getting in the way.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفة الخفاء اللطيف وعدم لفت النظر
entries.example: The design is praised for its unobtrusiveness.

entries.definitionEn: Empty of people, or not busy with an activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغر من السكان، أو غير مشغول بنشاط
entries.example: The apartment upstairs has been unoccupied for months.

entries.definitionEn: Not approved or arranged by an authority, though it may still happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير رسمي؛ لم تعتمده جهة مخوَّلة
entries.example: An unofficial report circulated among the staff.

entries.definitionEn: To take things out of a suitcase, box, or bag.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُخرج محتويات حقيبة أو صندوق
entries.example: I need to unpack after the long trip.

entries.definitionEn: Not nice; causing discomfort or dislike.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير سارّ؛ يسبب ضيقاً أو نفوراً
entries.example: There was an unpleasant smell in the kitchen.

entries.definitionEn: To disconnect a device from an electricity supply by removing its plug.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصل جهازاً عن الكهرباء بنزع القابس
entries.example: Please unplug the iron before you leave.

entries.definitionEn: Not liked by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير محبوب؛ لا يحظى بقبول واسع
entries.example: The new timetable was unpopular with students.

entries.definitionEn: Changing in a way that is hard to know in advance.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يمكن التنبؤ به؛ متقلّب
entries.example: The weather here is unpredictable in spring.

entries.definitionEn: Not showing signs of future success or improvement.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير واعد؛ لا يبشّر بنجاح
entries.example: The first draft was messy and unpromising.

entries.definitionEn: To undo twisted threads, or to make a complex matter clear. Also for a plan to fall apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفكّ خيوطاً متشابكة، أو يوضح أمراً معقّداً؛ وقد يعني أن خطة تتفكك
entries.example: Detectives tried to unravel the sequence of events.

entries.definitionEn: Not sensible or possible in real life; too hopeful or extreme.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير واقعي؛ مفرط في التفاؤل أو البعد عن الممكن
entries.example: Finishing all the work in one hour is unrealistic.

entries.definitionEn: Not fair or sensible; asking too much.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير معقول؛ مبالغ فيه أو مجانب للإنصاف
entries.example: The landlord's demands were unreasonable.

entries.definitionEn: Not connected with something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرتبط؛ لا صلة له بالأمر الآخر
entries.example: The two delays were unrelated.

entries.definitionEn: Not able to be trusted or depended on.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير موثوق؛ لا يُعتمد عليه
entries.example: That old printer is unreliable.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot be trusted or depended on.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا يُوثق به
entries.example: The connection worked unreliably during the storm.

entries.definitionEn: A situation in which people protest or show angry dissatisfaction, often in public.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطراب واحتجاج يعكسان سخطاً جماعياً
entries.example: Labour unrest delayed shipments for a month.

entries.definitionEn: Not safe; likely to cause harm.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير آمن؛ ينطوي على خطر
entries.example: The bridge was closed because it was unsafe.

entries.definitionEn: Not good enough; failing to meet what is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مُرضٍ؛ دون المستوى المطلوب
entries.example: The explanation was brief and unsatisfactory.

entries.definitionEn: Not harshly critical; mild rather than cutting in tone.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير لاذع؛ معتدل اللهجة لا يجرح
entries.example: Even his rivals offered an unscathing assessment of the plan.

entries.definitionEn: Thinking of other people's needs before your own.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير أناني؛ يقدّم حاجة غيره على حاجته
entries.example: It was an unselfish decision to share the prize.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone feel anxious, less confident, or less secure.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلق شخصاً أو يزعزع اطمئنانه
entries.example: The sudden change of plan unsettled the whole team.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel anxious or slightly afraid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلق يبعث على الاضطراب
entries.example: There was an unsettling silence after the question.

entries.definitionEn: Too strong or determined to be stopped.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُوقَف؛ أقوى من أن يُصدّ
entries.example: Once she starts a project, she is unstoppable.

entries.definitionEn: Not achieving what was wanted or intended.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير ناجح؛ لم يبلغ غايته
entries.example: His first application was unsuccessful.

entries.definitionEn: Not right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose, or situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مناسب لشخص أو غرض أو ظرف
entries.example: Those shoes are unsuitable for wet weather.

entries.definitionEn: Not certain or confident about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير واثق أو غير متيقن
entries.example: She was unsure which train to take.

entries.definitionEn: Better than all others; not exceeded in quality or degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يُبارى؛ لم يفوقه أحد في الجودة أو الدرجة
entries.example: The museum's collection of maps is unsurpassed.

entries.definitionEn: Not thought to exist, be true, or be present.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير متوقَّع وجوده أو صدقه؛ خفيّ عن الظن
entries.example: The repair revealed unsuspected damage inside the wall.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to continue at the same rate without harm or collapse.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير قابل للاستمرار دون ضرر أو انهيار
entries.example: Such high spending is unsustainable in the long term.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that cannot continue without harm or collapse.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو لا يمكن استمراره دون ضرر
entries.example: The company had grown unsustainably fast.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking natural skill or ability in a particular area.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الموهبة في مجال معيّن
entries.example: I am untalented at drawing, so I keep to writing.

entries.definitionEn: To free something from knots, or to make a confused situation clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفكّ التشابك، أو يوضح أمراً مختلطاً
entries.example: She sat down to untangle the necklace chain.

entries.definitionEn: No longer twisted or knotted; made clear.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفكوك التشابك؛ لم يعد معقوداً أو غامضاً
entries.example: The wires were finally untangled behind the desk.

entries.definitionEn: In a way too extreme or shocking to imagine as possible.
entries.arabicMeaning: بدرجة لا تُتصوَّر أو يُستبعد تصوّرها
entries.example: The ticket prices rose unthinkably overnight.

entries.definitionEn: Not neat; with things out of order.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرتب؛ فوضوي
entries.example: His desk is always untidy.

entries.definitionEn: To undo a knot or something that is tied.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفكّ عقدة أو رباطاً
entries.example: Please untie the rope from the post.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a clause to mean up to the time that something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى أن؛ أداة ربط تسبق جملة وتحدد نهاية مدة
entries.example: Wait here until I come back.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a time or event to mean up to that point and not after.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتى؛ حرف جر يسبق وقتاً أو حدثاً بمعنى إلى ذلك الحد
entries.example: The shop is open until six.

entries.definitionEn: An old-fashioned or literary preposition meaning to, used before a person or thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر قديم أو أدبي بمعنى إلى، يسبق شخصاً أو شيئاً
entries.example: She remained faithful unto the end.

entries.definitionEn: Not given medical care, or not processed or cleaned.
entries.arabicMeaning: لم يُعالَج طبياً، أو لم يُعالَج صناعياً ولم يُنظَّف
entries.example: Untreated wood will rot in the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Not cut, neatened, or made shorter.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مقصوص أو مهذَّب
entries.example: The untrimmed hedge blocked part of the path.

entries.definitionEn: Different from what is normal or expected.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير معتاد؛ خارج المألوف
entries.example: It is unusual for her to be late.

entries.definitionEn: More than is usual; in a way that is not typical.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير معتاد؛ أكثر من المألوف
entries.example: The summer has been unusually wet.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of being unusual or not typical.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفة الخروج عن المألوف
entries.example: The unusualness of the design attracted buyers.

entries.definitionEn: Not wished for or not welcome.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير مرغوب فيه
entries.example: He deleted the unwanted messages.

entries.definitionEn: Firm and steady; not changing in belief, support, or purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثابت لا يتزعزع في الرأي أو الدعم
entries.example: She gave the team unwavering support.

entries.definitionEn: In a firm, steady way, without changing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بثبات لا يتزعزع
entries.example: He remained unwaveringly loyal to his friends.

entries.definitionEn: Slightly ill; not in good health.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوعّك؛ ليس على ما يرام
entries.example: She felt unwell and went home early.

entries.definitionEn: Not wanting to do something; reluctant.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير راغب؛ متردد أو رافض
entries.example: He was unwilling to share the details.

entries.definitionEn: Not showing good judgment; likely to cause problems.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير حكيم؛ ينمّ عن سوء تقدير
entries.example: It would be unwise to sign without reading the contract.

entries.definitionEn: Lacking experience of practical life; innocent, or more concerned with spiritual than material things.
entries.arabicMeaning: قليل الخبرة بشؤون الحياة؛ ساذج أو منشغل بالروحانيات عن المادة
entries.example: She had an unworldly air, as if money hardly mattered.

entries.definitionEn: Used after a verb to show movement to a higher place, or that something is upright or finished.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف بمعنى إلى أعلى، أو إلى وضع قائم أو مكتمل بعد الفعل
entries.example: She stood up when the guest arrived.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun for movement toward a higher point along it, such as a hill or stairs.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر بمعنى نحو نقطة أعلى على امتداد شيء كتلّ أو درج
entries.example: We walked up the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Having the latest information or style; modern and current.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدَّث؛ يواكب أحدث المعلومات أو الطراز
entries.example: Keep your records up-to-date.

entries.definitionEn: The way a child is raised and the values taught at home.
entries.arabicMeaning: التنشئة؛ أسلوب تربية الطفل في البيت
entries.example: His upbringing taught him to be polite.

entries.definitionEn: New information, or a newer version of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستجدّ من المعلومات، أو نسخة أحدث من شيء
entries.example: I will send you an update after the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: To add the latest information, or to make something more modern.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحدّث المعلومات أو يجعل شيئاً أكثر مواكبة
entries.example: Please update your address on the form.

entries.definitionEn: An improvement to a higher standard, version, or class.
entries.arabicMeaning: ترقية إلى مستوى أو نسخة أو درجة أعلى
entries.example: They offered us a free upgrade to a larger room.

entries.definitionEn: To improve something to a better version or higher standard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرقّي شيئاً إلى نسخة أو مستوى أفضل
entries.example: We need to upgrade the office computers.

entries.definitionEn: A sudden, major change that causes disruption and difficulty.
entries.arabicMeaning: اضطراب كبير مفاجئ يخلّ بالنظام
entries.example: Moving cities caused months of upheaval for the family.

entries.definitionEn: Raised to a higher position, or made to feel more hopeful and positive.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرفوع إلى أعلى، أو قد انشرح صدره وارتفع معنويّاً
entries.example: She felt uplifted after the kind message.

entries.definitionEn: To send a file from your device to a computer network or website.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرفع ملفاً من جهازه إلى شبكة أو موقع
entries.example: He will upload the photos this evening.

entries.definitionEn: A more formal preposition with the same role as on, used of position, time, or something happening.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرف جر أرقى أسلوباً بمعنى على، للمكان أو الزمان أو حدوث أمر
entries.example: Upon arrival, please go to the front desk.

entries.definitionEn: Higher in position, rank, or the higher of two parts.
entries.arabicMeaning: أعلى موضعاً أو رتبة؛ الجزء الأعلى من شيئين
entries.example: His office is on the upper floor.

entries.definitionEn: Standing straight, not leaning. Also honest and morally decent.
entries.arabicMeaning: منتصب لا يميل؛ وقد يعني نزيهاً مستقيم الخلق
entries.example: Keep the bottle upright in the bag.

entries.definitionEn: In a straight, vertical position.
entries.arabicMeaning: في وضع قائم مستقيم
entries.example: Sit upright so your back does not hurt.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy, worried, or angry because of something that has happened.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزعج أو حزين أو غاضب مما حدث
entries.example: She was upset about the cancelled trip.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone unhappy or worried, or to knock something over.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحزن شخصاً أو يقلقه، أو يقلب شيئاً
entries.example: I didn't mean to upset you with that remark.

entries.definitionEn: With the top where the bottom should be; inverted.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقلوب رأساً على عقب
entries.example: The picture on the wall was upside down.

entries.definitionEn: In a position with the top where the bottom should be.
entries.arabicMeaning: رأساً على عقب
entries.example: He hung the painting upside down by mistake.

entries.definitionEn: On or of a higher floor in a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: في الطابق الأعلى أو خاص به
entries.example: There is an upstairs bathroom.

entries.definitionEn: To or on a higher floor in a building.
entries.arabicMeaning: إلى الطابق الأعلى أو فيه
entries.example: The children went upstairs to bed.

entries.definitionEn: The upper floor or floors of a house.
entries.arabicMeaning: الطابق العلوي أو الأدوار العليا من منزل
entries.example: The upstairs needs painting this year.

entries.definitionEn: Directed or moving towards a higher place or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: متجه إلى أعلى مكاناً أو مقداراً
entries.example: We saw an upward movement in prices.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to a city or town, not the countryside.
entries.arabicMeaning: حضري؛ يتصل بالمدينة لا بالريف
entries.example: Urban traffic is heavier in the morning.

entries.definitionEn: A strong wish or sudden need to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: رغبة ملحة أو دافع قوي لفعل شيء
entries.example: He felt a sudden urge to call his sister.

entries.definitionEn: To try hard to persuade someone to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحثّ شخصاً بقوة على فعل شيء
entries.example: Doctors urge people to wash their hands.

entries.definitionEn: Needing to be dealt with immediately.
entries.arabicMeaning: عاجل؛ يحتاج معالجة فورية
entries.example: I have an urgent message for you.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that needs immediate action.
entries.arabicMeaning: بصورة عاجلة تستدعي تدخلاً سريعاً
entries.example: We need to speak to her urgently.

entries.definitionEn: The object form of we; used for the speaker and others as the object of a verb or preposition.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير نصب للمتكلم ومن معه؛ يقع مفعولاً أو بعد حرف جر
entries.example: Can you help us with this box?

entries.definitionEn: The way something is used, or how much it is used. Also the way words are used in a language.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة الاستعمال أو مقداره؛ وفي اللغة أسلوب استعمال الكلمات
entries.example: Water usage has increased this summer.

entries.definitionEn: The act of using something, or the purpose it has.
entries.arabicMeaning: استعمال الشيء أو الغرض منه
entries.example: This room is for the use of guests only.

entries.definitionEn: To do something with an object, tool, or method in order to achieve a result.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعمل شيئاً أو أداة أو طريقة لتحقيق غاية
entries.example: May I use your pen?

entries.definitionEn: Not new; owned or used by someone else before.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعمل؛ ليس جديداً وقد سبق أن امتلكه غيرك
entries.example: They bought a used car to save money.

entries.definitionEn: An auxiliary used with a verb to talk about a past habit or state that is no longer true.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يدل على عادة أو حال في الماضي لم تعد قائمة
entries.example: She used to play the piano every evening.

entries.definitionEn: Helpful; able to be used for a purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: مفيد؛ يصلح لغرض ما
entries.example: A map is useful when you visit a new city.

entries.definitionEn: Not useful; not able to do what is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم الفائدة؛ لا يُجدي
entries.example: The broken charger is useless now.

entries.definitionEn: A person who uses a product, service, or system.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستخدم لمنتج أو خدمة أو نظام
entries.example: New users must create a password.

entries.definitionEn: A person who shows people to their seats in a theatre, cinema, or at a ceremony.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرشد مقاعد في مسرح أو قاعة أو حفل
entries.example: An usher showed us to our seats.

entries.definitionEn: To show someone where to go, or to mark the start of a new period.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُدخل شخصاً إلى مكانه، أو يؤذن ببدء عهد جديد
entries.example: A guide ushered the guests into the hall.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or done most of the time; typical.
entries.arabicMeaning: معتاد؛ يحدث في معظم الأحيان
entries.example: I took my usual seat by the window.

entries.definitionEn: Most of the time; in the normal way.
entries.arabicMeaning: عادةً؛ في معظم الأحيان
entries.example: I usually have breakfast at seven.

entries.definitionEn: A tool used for cooking or eating, such as a spoon or pan.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة للأكل أو الطبخ كالملعقة أو المقلاة
entries.example: Put the cooking utensils in the top drawer.

entries.definitionEn: Designed to be useful rather than attractive; concerned with practical use.
entries.arabicMeaning: نفعي؛ مصمَّم للفائدة لا للجمال
entries.example: The chairs were plain and utilitarian.

entries.definitionEn: The act of using something, especially a resource, in an effective way.
entries.arabicMeaning: الانتفاع بشيء، وخصوصاً مورد، على نحو فعّال
entries.example: Better utilization of office space saved money.

entries.definitionEn: To use something, especially in a practical or effective way; a more formal word for use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعمل شيئاً على نحو عملي فعّال؛ صيغة أرقى لمعنى الاستعمال
entries.example: The school will utilize the hall for evening classes.

entries.definitionEn: To put a resource or opportunity to practical and effective use.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوظّف مورداً أو فرصة توظيفاً عملياً نافعاً
entries.example: The study shows how plants utilize sunlight.

entries.definitionEn: Complete and total, often of something negative; used for emphasis.
entries.arabicMeaning: تامّ مطلق، وغالباً في سياق سلبي للتوكيد
entries.example: The meeting ended in utter confusion.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; to the fullest degree.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً؛ إلى أقصى حد
entries.example: I was utterly exhausted after the climb.

entries.definitionEn: A job that is available, or a room or seat that is free.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغر وظيفي، أو غرفة أو مقعد خالٍ
entries.example: There is a vacancy for a receptionist.

entries.definitionEn: Empty and available to be used. Also showing no thought or interest, of a look.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاغر ومتاح للاستعمال؛ وقد يصف نظرة فارغة بلا انتباه
entries.example: The seat next to me was vacant.

entries.definitionEn: A time when you do not work or study and you rest or travel.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطلة يتوقف فيها المرء عن العمل أو الدراسة للراحة أو السفر
entries.example: We spent our vacation at my grandparents' house.

entries.definitionEn: A substance given to a person or animal to protect them from a disease.
entries.arabicMeaning: لقاح يُعطى للإنسان أو الحيوان للوقاية من مرض
entries.example: The clinic offered a free flu vaccine in October.

entries.definitionEn: Not clear, not exact, or not easy to understand.
entries.arabicMeaning: غامض أو غير دقيق أو صعب الفهم
entries.example: His directions were too vague to follow.

entries.definitionEn: Too proud of your appearance or abilities. Also unsuccessful, especially in the phrase in vain.
entries.arabicMeaning: مغرور بمظهره أو قدراته؛ وأيضاً عديم الجدوى ولا سيما في عبارة in vain
entries.example: She tried in vain to open the locked window.

entries.definitionEn: A card, gift, or message sent on Valentine's Day to show affection. Also the person it is sent to.
entries.arabicMeaning: بطاقة أو هدية أو رسالة تُرسل في عيد الحب لإظهار المودة؛ وأيضاً الشخص المُهدى إليه
entries.example: She left a valentine on his desk at work.

entries.definitionEn: Legally or officially acceptable. Based on good reasons or evidence.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساري المفعول قانوناً أو رسمياً؛ أو قائم على أسباب أو أدلة وجيهة
entries.example: Your passport must be valid for the whole trip.

entries.definitionEn: Low land between hills or mountains, often with a river.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض منخفضة بين تلال أو جبال، يجري فيها نهر غالباً
entries.example: The village sits in a green valley.

entries.definitionEn: Worth a lot of money, or very useful and important.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو قيمة مالية كبيرة، أو نافع ومهم جداً
entries.example: She gave me some valuable advice before the interview.

entries.definitionEn: How useful or important something is, or how much money it is worth.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى نفع الشيء أو أهميته، أو مقدار ثمنه
entries.example: This watch has great value to our family.

entries.definitionEn: To think that someone or something is important. To decide how much money something is worth.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقدّر شخصاً أو شيئاً ويراه مهماً؛ أو يقدّر ثمن شيء
entries.example: I value her honesty more than easy praise.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle larger than a car, used for carrying goods or people.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركبة أكبر من السيارة تُستخدم لنقل البضائع أو الركاب
entries.example: The shop sent a van to deliver the furniture.

entries.definitionEn: A person who deliberately damages property, especially public property.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يتلف الممتلكات عمداً، ولا سيما العامة منها
entries.example: A vandal had smashed the station clock.

entries.definitionEn: To damage property on purpose, often in a reckless or hostile way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتلف الممتلكات عمداً، غالباً على نحو طائش أو عدائي
entries.example: Someone vandalized the playground overnight.

entries.definitionEn: To disappear suddenly or in a way that you cannot explain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختفي فجأة أو على نحو يتعذّر تفسيره
entries.example: The fog vanished as the sun rose.

entries.definitionEn: Too much pride in your appearance or achievements.
entries.arabicMeaning: زهو مفرط بالمظهر أو بالإنجازات
entries.example: He refused the hat out of vanity, though he was cold.

entries.definitionEn: A change or difference from the usual form or amount.
entries.arabicMeaning: تغيّر أو اختلاف عن الشكل أو المقدار المعتاد
entries.example: There is wide variation in house prices across the city.

entries.definitionEn: Including many different types or changing often.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشمل أنواعاً كثيرة مختلفة أو يتغيّر كثيراً
entries.example: The museum offers a varied programme of talks.

entries.definitionEn: A lot of different types of the same thing. Also a particular type of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنواع كثيرة مختلفة من الشيء نفسه؛ وأيضاً صنف معيّن منه
entries.example: The market sells a variety of fresh fruit.

entries.definitionEn: Several different; more than one kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: عدة أشياء مختلفة؛ أكثر من نوع واحد
entries.example: She has worked in various jobs since leaving school.

entries.definitionEn: To be different in different situations, or to change.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختلف بحسب الحال، أو يتغيّر
entries.example: Opening hours vary from shop to shop.

entries.definitionEn: A container used for holding flowers or for decoration.
entries.arabicMeaning: إناء تُوضع فيه الزهور أو يُستخدم للزينة
entries.example: She put the roses in a glass vase.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely large in size, amount, or area.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضخم جداً في الحجم أو المقدار أو المساحة
entries.example: They crossed a vast desert on the journey.

entries.definitionEn: A plant or part of a plant that you eat, such as carrots or potatoes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبات أو جزء منه يُؤكل، كالجزر أو البطاطس
entries.example: Eat more vegetables with your dinner.

entries.definitionEn: Made without meat, or relating to a diet that does not include meat.
entries.arabicMeaning: خالٍ من اللحم، أو متعلق بنظام غذائي لا يشمل اللحم
entries.example: The café has a good vegetarian menu.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص لا يأكل اللحم ولا السمك
entries.example: My brother has been a vegetarian for five years.

entries.definitionEn: Plants in general, especially the plants covering an area of land.
entries.arabicMeaning: النباتات عموماً، ولا سيما الغطاء النباتي لمنطقة
entries.example: Dense vegetation covered the riverbank.

entries.definitionEn: A machine such as a car, bus, or truck that carries people or goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركبة مثل سيارة أو حافلة أو شاحنة تنقل الناس أو البضائع
entries.example: Police stopped every vehicle at the bridge.

entries.definitionEn: A tube in the body that carries blood towards the heart.
entries.arabicMeaning: وريد يحمل الدم نحو القلب
entries.example: The nurse found a vein in his arm for the injection.

entries.definitionEn: To regard someone or something with deep respect, often in a formal or religious way.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُجلّ شخصاً أو شيئاً إجلالاً عميقاً، غالباً على نحو رسمي أو ديني
entries.example: The community venerates the founder of the school.

entries.definitionEn: Deep respect for someone or something regarded as important or sacred.
entries.arabicMeaning: توقير عميق لمن يُعدّ مهماً أو مقدساً
entries.example: The shrine is a place of quiet veneration.

entries.definitionEn: Able to inject poison through a bite or sting. Also bitterly hostile in words.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على حقن السم بعضّة أو لسعة؛ وأيضاً حاقد لاذع في الكلام
entries.example: Keep away from venomous snakes on the path.

entries.definitionEn: In a bitterly hostile way, as if meant to wound.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو حاقد لاذع كأنما القصد منه الجرح
entries.example: She replied venomously to the unfair remark.

entries.definitionEn: To let fresh air into a room or building. Also to discuss a feeling or issue openly.
entries.arabicMeaning: يدخل هواءً نقيّاً إلى غرفة أو مبنى؛ وأيضاً يطرح شعوراً أو مسألة للنقاش
entries.example: Open the windows to ventilate the kitchen after cooking.

entries.definitionEn: The movement of fresh air through a room or building, or a system that provides it.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرور الهواء النقي في غرفة أو مبنى، أو الجهاز الذي يوفّره
entries.example: Poor ventilation made the office feel stuffy.

entries.definitionEn: The place where a public event, meeting, or performance happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: المكان الذي تُقام فيه فعالية عامة أو اجتماع أو عرض
entries.example: The concert venue was full an hour before the start.

entries.definitionEn: A roofed platform along the outside of a house, often with an open front.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرفة مسقوفة ممتدة على جانب المنزل، واجهتها مفتوحة غالباً
entries.example: They sat on the verandah and watched the rain.

entries.definitionEn: A word that describes an action, a state, or an event, such as run, be, or happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة تصف فعلاً أو حالة أو حدثاً، مثل run أو be أو happen
entries.example: In this sentence, opened is the verb.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to words, especially spoken words rather than written ones.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالكلام، ولا سيما المنطوق لا المكتوب
entries.example: They had a verbal agreement, with nothing on paper.

entries.definitionEn: In spoken words rather than in writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلاماً منطوقاً لا كتابة
entries.example: Please confirm the booking verbally, then send an email.

entries.definitionEn: Copied or repeated using exactly the same words as the original.
entries.arabicMeaning: منقول أو مكرَّر بالكلمات الأصلية نفسها من غير تغيير
entries.example: The report included a verbatim transcript of the interview.

entries.definitionEn: Word for word; using exactly the same words.
entries.arabicMeaning: حرفياً؛ بالكلمات ذاتها من غير زيادة ولا نقصان
entries.example: She quoted the letter verbatim in her speech.

entries.definitionEn: An official decision by a jury or judge in a court. Also a judgment or opinion about something.
entries.arabicMeaning: قرار رسمي من هيئة محلفين أو قاضٍ في المحكمة؛ وأيضاً حكم أو رأي في أمر
entries.example: The jury delivered its verdict after two days.

entries.definitionEn: Truly; used in old-fashioned or formal language to stress that something is so.
entries.arabicMeaning: حقاً؛ تُستعمل في لغة عتيقة أو رسمية لتوكيد صدق الأمر
entries.example: Verily, this is the finest harvest we have seen.

entries.definitionEn: The appearance of being true or real, especially in a work of art or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظاهر الصدق أو الواقعية، ولا سيما في عمل فني أو أدبي
entries.example: The novel's verisimilitude comes from its small domestic details.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize that something is truly the thing named, often something striking.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل لتوكيد أن الشيء هو حقاً ما سُمّي به، وغالباً لأمر لافت
entries.example: The garden was a veritable jungle after the wet summer.

entries.definitionEn: Small animals or insects that damage crops, food, or buildings, such as rats or cockroaches.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوانات أو حشرات صغيرة تضرّ الزرع أو الطعام أو المباني، كالفئران أو الصراصير
entries.example: The old warehouse was infested with vermin.

entries.definitionEn: Able to do many different things well, or useful in many different ways.
entries.arabicMeaning: قادر على أداء أمور كثيرة بإجادة، أو صالح لاستعمالات متعددة
entries.example: A versatile jacket works for both walking and the office.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to be used in many ways, or to do many different things well.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة على تعدد الاستعمال أو على إجادة أعمال مختلفة
entries.example: Her versatility made her valuable to every department.

entries.definitionEn: Writing arranged in lines, especially poetry. Also one section of a poem or song.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلام منظوم على أسطر، ولا سيما الشعر؛ وأيضاً مقطع من قصيدة أو أغنية
entries.example: The choir sang the first verse again.

entries.definitionEn: To make someone knowledgeable or practised in a subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمرّس شخصاً في موضوع حتى يُلمّ به
entries.example: Her grandfather versed her in the family trade.

entries.definitionEn: A particular form of something that is slightly different from others. Also someone's account of an event.
entries.arabicMeaning: شكل معيّن من شيء يختلف قليلاً عن غيره؛ وأيضاً رواية شخص لحدث
entries.example: This version of the software is easier to use.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show that two sides are against each other, or that two things are being compared.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل لتبيّن أن طرفين متقابلان، أو أن شيئين يُقارن بينهما
entries.example: The final is France versus Italy on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: Standing or pointing straight up, at a right angle to the ground or to a horizontal line.
entries.arabicMeaning: قائم أو متجه إلى الأعلى بزاوية قائمة على الأرض أو على خط أفقي
entries.example: The cliff formed a nearly vertical wall of rock.

entries.definitionEn: Energy, enthusiasm, and liveliness in the way something is done or expressed.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوية وحماسة وانطلاق في أداء الشيء أو التعبير عنه
entries.example: She played the piece with real verve.

entries.definitionEn: Used to emphasize a particular thing, person, or moment, meaning the exact one.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل لتوكيد شيء أو شخص أو لحظة بعينها، بمعنى عينه أو ذاته
entries.example: You are the very person I hoped to meet.

entries.definitionEn: Used before an adjective or adverb to make it stronger.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل صفة أو حال لتقويتها
entries.example: The soup is very hot, so wait a moment.

entries.definitionEn: A ship or large boat. Also a container for holding liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفينة أو قارب كبير؛ وأيضاً وعاء لحفظ سائل
entries.example: The vessel reached the harbour at dawn.

entries.definitionEn: Remaining as a small, poorly developed part of something that was once larger or more useful.
entries.arabicMeaning: متبقٍّ كجزء صغير ضعيف النمو مما كان أكبر أو أنفع
entries.example: Whales have vestigial bones that once formed hind legs.

entries.definitionEn: In a slight leftover way, as a trace of something that was once more complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو أثري طفيف، كأثر مما كان أتمّ في الماضي
entries.example: The old custom survives vestigially in a few villages.

entries.definitionEn: A doctor who treats animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: طبيب يعالج الحيوانات
entries.example: We took the cat to the vet for a check-up.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has long experience in a job or activity. Also someone who has served in the armed forces.
entries.arabicMeaning: صاحب خبرة طويلة في عمل أو نشاط؛ وأيضاً من خدم في القوات المسلحة
entries.example: A veteran teacher ran the workshop for new staff.

entries.definitionEn: By going through a place. By means of a person, system, or method.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالمرور عبر مكان؛ أو بواسطة شخص أو نظام أو طريقة
entries.example: We flew to Rome via Frankfurt.

entries.definitionEn: To move continuously and very quickly from side to side, or to make something do this.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتحرك بسرعة متواصلة يمنة ويسرة، أو يجعل شيئاً يفعل ذلك
entries.example: The windows vibrate when a truck passes.

entries.definitionEn: A continuous small, fast shaking movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: رجفة صغيرة سريعة متواصلة
entries.example: We felt a vibration in the floor before the train arrived.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a title to mean next in rank below that person; deputy.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل لقب لتعني التالي في الرتبة دون ذلك الشخص؛ نائب عنه
entries.example: She was elected vice captain of the team.

entries.definitionEn: The person next in rank below a president, who can act in that role if needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: الشخص التالي في الرتبة دون الرئيس، وقد ينوب عنه عند الحاجة
entries.example: The vice president opened the conference in the president's place.

entries.definitionEn: The area around a particular place; the near neighbourhood.
entries.arabicMeaning: المنطقة المحيطة بمكان معيّن؛ الجوار القريب
entries.example: Several cafés opened in the vicinity of the station.

entries.definitionEn: Violent and cruel. Also severe or intended to hurt.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنيف وقاسٍ؛ وأيضاً شديد أو مقصود به الإيذاء
entries.example: A vicious storm tore tiles from the roof.

entries.definitionEn: In a cruel, violent, or bitterly hostile way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو قاسٍ عنيف أو عدائي لاذع
entries.example: The wind viciously slammed the shutters against the wall.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is hurt, killed, or made to suffer by a crime, accident, or unfair action.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص أُصيب أو قُتل أو عانى بسبب جريمة أو حادث أو فعل جائر
entries.example: The flood left thousands of victims without homes.

entries.definitionEn: Having won a battle, game, or struggle.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظافر في معركة أو مباراة أو نزاع
entries.example: The victorious team lifted the cup on the pitch.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you have won.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يبيّن الفوز والنصر
entries.example: She smiled victoriously as the final whistle blew.

entries.definitionEn: Success in a game, contest, or struggle against someone or something.
entries.arabicMeaning: نجاح في مباراة أو مسابقة أو نزاع ضد شخص أو شيء
entries.example: The team celebrated their first victory of the season.

entries.definitionEn: A short piece of video, often taken from a longer film or recording.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقطع فيديو قصير، يُؤخذ غالباً من تسجيل أطول
entries.example: He shared a video clip of the concert on his phone.

entries.definitionEn: A game that you play on a computer, console, or phone, with pictures that move.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة تُلعب على حاسوب أو جهاز أو هاتف، وصورها متحركة
entries.example: The children played a video game after homework.

entries.definitionEn: A recording of moving pictures and sound that you can watch on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: تسجيل لصور متحركة وصوت يمكن مشاهدته على شاشة
entries.example: We watched a video about sea birds.

entries.definitionEn: What you can see from a place, especially a beautiful scene. Also an opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما تراه من مكان، ولا سيما مشهد جميل؛ وأيضاً رأي
entries.example: Our hotel room had a view of the sea.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something, or to consider it in a particular way.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظر إلى شيء، أو يعدّه على نحو معيّن
entries.example: Many people view the new law as unfair.

entries.definitionEn: A person who watches television, a video, or a similar display.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يشاهد التلفاز أو فيديو أو عرضاً مشابهاً
entries.example: Viewers were asked to vote at the end of the show.

entries.definitionEn: A way of thinking about a subject; an opinion. Also a place from which you look at a scene.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة في النظر إلى موضوع؛ رأي. وأيضاً موضع تشاهد منه مشهداً
entries.example: From her viewpoint, the plan needed more time.

entries.definitionEn: Physical or mental energy and strength. Spelled vigor in American English and vigour in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط وقوة في الجسم أو الذهن. تُكتب vigor في الإنجليزية الأمريكية وvigour في البريطانية
entries.example: He returned to work with fresh vigour after the holiday.

entries.definitionEn: Strong, energetic, and full of force.
entries.arabicMeaning: قوي نشيط مليء بالاندفاع
entries.example: She takes a vigorous walk every morning.

entries.definitionEn: With energy and force.
entries.arabicMeaning: بقوة ونشاط
entries.example: He shook his head vigorously to refuse.

entries.definitionEn: A house, often large, in the country or by the sea, used especially as a holiday home.
entries.arabicMeaning: منزل، غالباً واسع، في الريف أو على البحر، يُستخدم ولا سيما للإجازة
entries.example: They rented a villa near the coast for two weeks.

entries.definitionEn: A small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة صغيرة من البيوت في الريف، أصغر من بلدة
entries.example: My aunt lives in a quiet village.

entries.definitionEn: A person who lives in a village.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يسكن قرية
entries.example: The villagers repaired the old stone bridge together.

entries.definitionEn: To show that someone or something is right, reasonable, or not guilty after doubt or criticism.
entries.arabicMeaning: يثبت أن شخصاً أو شيئاً كان على حق أو بريئاً بعد شك أو نقد
entries.example: The inquiry vindicated her decision to close the site.

entries.definitionEn: Proof that a person, claim, or action was justified or innocent.
entries.arabicMeaning: دليل على أن شخصاً أو زعماً أو فعلاً كان مبرَّراً أو بريئاً
entries.example: The test results were a complete vindication of his method.

entries.definitionEn: A sour liquid made from wine, cider, or similar drinks, used in cooking and for preserving food.
entries.arabicMeaning: سائل حامض يُصنع من الخمر أو عصير التفاح ونحوه، يُستخدم في الطبخ وحفظ الطعام
entries.example: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.

entries.definitionEn: To break a law, agreement, or right. Also to disturb a place or privacy that should be respected.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخالف قانوناً أو اتفاقاً أو حقاً؛ وأيضاً يخلّ بحرمة مكان أو خصوصية
entries.example: The company was fined for violating safety rules.

entries.definitionEn: Behaviour that hurts people or damages things through physical force.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلوك يؤذي الناس أو يتلف الأشياء بالقوة الجسدية
entries.example: The protest ended without violence.

entries.definitionEn: Using force to hurt people or damage things. Also very strong and sudden.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستخدم القوة لإيذاء الناس أو إتلاف الأشياء؛ وأيضاً شديد ومفاجئ
entries.example: A violent storm hit the coast last night.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that uses strong physical force, or very strongly and suddenly.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يستخدم قوة جسدية شديدة، أو بقوة ومفاجأة بالغتين
entries.example: The door slammed violently in the wind.

entries.definitionEn: Of a bluish-purple colour, like the flower of the same name.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلون أرجواني يميل إلى الأزرق، كلون الزهرة التي تحمل الاسم نفسه
entries.example: She wore a violet scarf against the grey coat.

entries.definitionEn: A musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow, holding it under your chin.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة موسيقية ذات أربعة أوتار تُعزف بقوس وتُمسك تحت الذقن
entries.example: She is learning to play the violin.

entries.definitionEn: Pure, unused, or untouched, as if new and innocent.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاهر أو غير مستعمل أو لم تمسّه يد، كأنّه جديد بريء
entries.example: Snow gave the fields a virginal white.

entries.definitionEn: Made by a computer and appearing real, though not physically present. Also almost complete.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنوع بالحاسوب ويبدو حقيقياً وإن لم يكن موجوداً مادياً؛ وأيضاً يكاد يكون تاماً
entries.example: We held a virtual meeting instead of travelling.

entries.definitionEn: A computer-made environment that looks and feels real when you wear special equipment.
entries.arabicMeaning: بيئة يصنعها الحاسوب تبدو حقيقية عند ارتداء أجهزة خاصة
entries.example: The museum uses virtual reality to show the ancient city.

entries.definitionEn: Almost; very nearly. Also by computer rather than in person.
entries.arabicMeaning: تقريباً؛ يكاد يكون. وأيضاً عبر الحاسوب لا بالحضور
entries.example: The shop was virtually empty after six.

entries.definitionEn: A good moral quality in a person. Also an advantage of something.
entries.arabicMeaning: خصلة أخلاقية محمودة في الشخص؛ وأيضاً مزية في شيء
entries.example: Patience is a virtue in teaching young children.

entries.definitionEn: Outstanding technical skill, especially in music or another art.
entries.arabicMeaning: براعة تقنية فائقة، ولا سيما في الموسيقى أو فن آخر
entries.example: The pianist was famous for sheer virtuosity.

entries.definitionEn: A person with outstanding skill in music or another performing art.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص ذو مهارة فائقة في الموسيقى أو فن أدائي آخر
entries.example: A jazz virtuoso played late into the night.

entries.definitionEn: A very small living thing that can cause disease. Also a program that damages a computer.
entries.arabicMeaning: كائن بالغ الصغر قد يسبب مرضاً؛ وأيضاً برنامج يضرّ بالحاسوب
entries.example: Rest is important when you have a virus.

entries.definitionEn: In relation to; compared with. Also facing or opposite.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالنسبة إلى؛ مقارنةً بـ؛ وأيضاً مواجهاً أو مقابل
entries.example: The plan looks weak vis-a-vis last year's results.

entries.definitionEn: An official mark or document that allows you to enter, leave, or stay in a country.
entries.arabicMeaning: ختم أو وثيقة رسمية تسمح بدخول بلد أو مغادرته أو الإقامة فيه
entries.example: You need a visa to stay longer than three months.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be seen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمكن رؤيته
entries.example: The mountains were visible from the train.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that can be seen; clearly showing a feeling or change.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يُرى؛ بما يُظهر شعوراً أو تغيّراً بوضوح
entries.example: He was visibly relieved when the results arrived.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to see. Also an idea of what the future could be, or a picture in the mind.
entries.arabicMeaning: القدرة على الإبصار؛ وأيضاً تصوّر للمستقبل أو صورة في الذهن
entries.example: The accident did not affect her vision.

entries.definitionEn: A time when you go to see a person or a place for a short period.
entries.arabicMeaning: وقت تذهب فيه لرؤية شخص أو مكان لفترة قصيرة
entries.example: We had a short visit from our cousins on Sunday.

entries.definitionEn: To go to see a person or a place for a short time.
entries.arabicMeaning: يذهب لرؤية شخص أو مكان وقتاً قصيراً
entries.example: I visit my grandparents every weekend.

entries.definitionEn: A person who goes to see a person or a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يذهب لرؤية شخص أو مكان
entries.example: The museum had many visitors in the summer.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to seeing or to things that you look at.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالإبصار أو بما يُنظر إليه
entries.example: Charts are a useful visual aid in the lesson.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that relates to seeing or to how something looks.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يتعلق بالإبصار أو بمظهر الشيء
entries.example: The two designs were visually very similar.

entries.definitionEn: Extremely important and necessary. Also full of energy and life.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالغ الأهمية والضرورة؛ وأيضاً مفعم بالنشاط والحياة
entries.example: Clean water is vital for public health.

entries.definitionEn: Energy, liveliness, and the power to stay active and healthy.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط وحيوية وقدرة على البقاء نشيطاً معافى
entries.example: The old city has kept its vitality despite the new buildings.

entries.definitionEn: A natural substance in food that you need in small amounts to stay healthy.
entries.arabicMeaning: مادة طبيعية في الطعام يحتاج إليها الجسم بمقدار صغير ليبقى سليماً
entries.example: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.

entries.definitionEn: Producing a strong, clear picture in the mind. Also very bright in colour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يولد صورة قوية واضحة في الذهن؛ وأيضاً زاهي اللون جداً
entries.example: She gave a vivid description of the market.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is very clear, strong, and easy to imagine or remember.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو شديد الوضوح والقوة يسهل تخيّله أو تذكّره
entries.example: I still vividly remember my first day at school.

entries.definitionEn: All the words that a person knows or that are used in a language or subject.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموع الكلمات التي يعرفها شخص، أو المستعملة في لغة أو موضوع
entries.example: Reading stories is a good way to learn new vocabulary.

entries.definitionEn: Related to the skills and training needed for a particular job, rather than to general academic study.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعلق بالمهارات والتدريب اللازمين لمهنة معيّنة، لا بالدراسة الأكاديمية العامة
entries.example: She chose a vocational course in electrical work.

entries.definitionEn: The sound you make when you speak or sing.
entries.arabicMeaning: الصوت الذي تُحدثه حين تتكلم أو تغني
entries.example: I recognised her voice on the phone.

entries.definitionEn: To say what you think or feel, especially a concern or opinion.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفصح عما يفكر فيه أو يشعر به، ولا سيما قلق أو رأي
entries.example: Several staff voiced doubts about the timetable.

entries.definitionEn: A mountain with an opening through which hot rock, ash, and gas can come out.
entries.arabicMeaning: جبل فيه فتحة قد تخرج منها صخور حارة ورماد وغازات
entries.example: The volcano has been quiet for many years.

entries.definitionEn: A game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands.
entries.arabicMeaning: لعبة يضرب فيها فريقان كرة فوق شبكة عالية بأيديهما
entries.example: We played volleyball on the beach.

entries.definitionEn: How loud a sound is. Also the amount of space something fills, or one book in a set.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدى ارتفاع الصوت؛ وأيضاً مقدار الحيز الذي يشغله شيء، أو كتاب من مجموعة
entries.example: Please turn the volume down on the television.

entries.definitionEn: Willingly, without being forced or paid as a duty.
entries.arabicMeaning: طوعاً، من غير إكراه أو إلزام بأجر واجب
entries.example: He voluntarily gave up his seat to an older passenger.

entries.definitionEn: Done by choice, not because you must. Also unpaid, as of work for a charity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُفعل اختياراً لا إلزاماً؛ وأيضاً بلا أجر كالعمل الخيري
entries.example: Attendance at the evening class is voluntary.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does work without being paid, or who offers to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يعمل بلا أجر، أو يعرض القيام بشيء
entries.example: Volunteers packed food boxes for the shelter.

entries.definitionEn: To offer to do something without being asked or forced, often without pay.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعرض القيام بشيء من غير طلب أو إكراه، وغالباً بلا أجر
entries.example: She volunteered to drive the guests to the station.

entries.definitionEn: Food and liquid that has come back up from the stomach and out of the mouth.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام وسائل خرجا من المعدة إلى الفم
entries.example: The smell of vomit made him leave the room.

entries.definitionEn: Eating a very large amount of food. Also wanting a great deal of something, such as books or information.
entries.arabicMeaning: يأكل مقداراً عظيماً من الطعام؛ وأيضاً شديد الرغبة في شيء كثير كالقراءة أو المعرفة
entries.example: She is a voracious reader of travel writing.

entries.definitionEn: In a very eager, consuming way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو نهم بالغ الرغبة
entries.example: He voraciously read every report before the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: Extreme eagerness to consume, whether food or, more broadly, knowledge or experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: نهم بالغ في الاستهلاك، طعاماً كان أو معرفة أو تجربة على نحو أوسع
entries.example: His voracity for detail slowed the investigation.

entries.definitionEn: A mass of air or liquid that spins rapidly and pulls things toward its centre.
entries.arabicMeaning: كتلة من الهواء أو السائل تدور بسرعة وتجذب الأشياء نحو مركزها
entries.example: Leaves were sucked into a vortex of wind in the courtyard.

entries.definitionEn: A choice that you make in an election, or the act of making that choice.
entries.arabicMeaning: اختيار تُدلي به في انتخابات، أو فعل الإدلاء به
entries.example: Each member has one vote.

entries.definitionEn: To make a choice in an election or meeting, usually by marking a paper or raising a hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يختار في انتخابات أو اجتماع، عادة بوضع علامة على ورقة أو برفع اليد
entries.example: Many people voted early on Monday morning.

entries.definitionEn: A person who has the right to vote, or who votes, in an election.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص له حق التصويت، أو يصوّت، في انتخابات
entries.example: Young voters turned out in large numbers.

entries.definitionEn: A serious promise, often made in a formal or solemn way.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعد جادّ، يُقطع غالباً على نحو رسمي أو مهيب
entries.example: They exchanged vows at a small ceremony.

entries.definitionEn: A speech sound such as a, e, i, o, or u, made with an open mouth, or the letter that represents it.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوت كلامي مثل a وe وi وo وu يُخرج والفم مفتوح، أو الحرف الذي يرمز إليه
entries.example: The word team has two vowels.

entries.definitionEn: A long journey, especially by sea or in space.
entries.arabicMeaning: رحلة طويلة، ولا سيما بحراً أو في الفضاء
entries.example: The voyage across the Atlantic took ten days.

entries.definitionEn: Money paid regularly for work, especially work paid by the hour or week rather than a yearly salary.
entries.arabicMeaning: مال يُدفع بانتظام مقابل عمل، ولا سيما بالساعة أو الأسبوع لا راتباً سنوياً
entries.example: The factory raised the hourly wage in April.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle with four wheels, pulled by a horse or used on a railway to carry goods.
entries.arabicMeaning: مركبة ذات أربع عجلات يجرّها حصان أو تُستخدم على السكة لنقل البضائع
entries.example: A wagon of hay stood in the farmyard.

entries.definitionEn: The narrow part of the body between the ribs and the hips.
entries.arabicMeaning: الجزء الضيق من الجسم بين الأضلاع والوركين
entries.example: The coat was too tight at the waist.

entries.definitionEn: A sleeveless garment with buttons down the front, worn over a shirt, especially as part of a suit.
entries.arabicMeaning: قطعة بلا أكمام ذات أزرار في الأمام، تُلبس فوق القميص ولا سيما ضمن بدلة
entries.example: He wore a grey waistcoat with his suit.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time when you stay in a place or delay action until something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة تبقى فيها في مكان أو تؤجّل عملاً حتى يحدث شيء
entries.example: There was a long wait for the next bus.

entries.definitionEn: To stay in a place or delay doing something until a person comes or something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: يبقى في مكان أو يؤجّل فعل شيء حتى يأتي شخص أو يحدث أمر
entries.example: Please wait here until your name is called.

entries.definitionEn: A person, especially a man, whose job is to serve food and drink in a restaurant.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص، ولا سيما رجل، عمله تقديم الطعام والشراب في مطعم
entries.example: The waiter brought the menu to our table.

entries.definitionEn: A woman whose job is to bring food and drink to people in a restaurant.
entries.arabicMeaning: امرأة عملها أن تأتي بالطعام والشراب إلى الناس في مطعم
entries.example: The waitress asked if we wanted coffee.

entries.definitionEn: The moving water that a boat leaves behind it as it goes.
entries.arabicMeaning: الماء المتحرك الذي يخلّفه القارب خلفه وهو يسير
entries.example: The little boat left a long wake on the lake.

entries.definitionEn: To stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستيقظ، أو يوقظ شخصاً
entries.example: I wake at six every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A journey that you make on foot, especially for pleasure or exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: انتقال سيراً على القدمين، ولا سيما للمتعة أو الرياضة
entries.example: We went for a walk after lunch.

entries.definitionEn: To move along on foot at a normal speed.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينتقل على قدميه بسرعة عادية
entries.example: The children walk to school.

entries.definitionEn: An informal walk among ordinary people by a well-known public figure.
entries.arabicMeaning: جولة سيراً غير رسمية بين الناس يقوم بها شخص عام معروف
entries.example: The mayor went on a walkabout in the market.

entries.definitionEn: A person who walks, especially for pleasure or as a sport.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يمشي، ولا سيما للمتعة أو رياضة
entries.example: Early walkers were already on the hill path.

entries.definitionEn: The activity of going somewhere on foot, especially for exercise or pleasure.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشاط الانتقال سيراً، ولا سيما للرياضة أو المتعة
entries.example: Walking is a cheap way to stay healthy.

entries.definitionEn: The side of a room or building, or a structure of brick or stone that divides land.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب غرفة أو مبنى، أو بناء من طوب أو حجر يفصل أرضاً
entries.example: Please hang the picture on that wall.

entries.definitionEn: Flat boards used to cover the inside walls of a building, often made of plaster.
entries.arabicMeaning: ألواح مسطحة تُغطى بها الجدران من الداخل، تُصنع غالباً من الجبس
entries.example: They fixed new wallboard over the damaged plaster.

entries.definitionEn: A small flat case for carrying paper money and cards, usually kept in a pocket.
entries.arabicMeaning: محفظة صغيرة مسطحة للنقود الورقية والبطاقات، تُحفظ عادة في الجيب
entries.example: He left his wallet on the kitchen table.

entries.definitionEn: Of an animal, to roll about in mud or water. Of a person, to remain in a feeling such as self-pity without trying to change.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمرغ الحيوان في الوحل أو الماء؛ ويقال للشخص إنه ينغمس في شعور كالرثاء للنفس من غير سعي إلى التغيير
entries.example: He tends to wallow in regret instead of changing course.

entries.definitionEn: A nut with a hard wrinkled shell, or the tree that produces it. Also the wood of that tree.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثمرة جوز ذات قشرة صلبة مجعّدة، أو الشجرة التي تنتجها؛ وأيضاً خشبها
entries.example: Chop a handful of walnuts for the cake.

entries.definitionEn: To walk slowly around with no clear direction or purpose.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمشي ببطء بلا اتجاه أو قصد واضح
entries.example: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.

entries.definitionEn: To become gradually smaller, weaker, or less intense.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصغر أو يضعف أو يخفّ تدريجاً
entries.example: Public interest in the story began to wane.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of something needed. Also a thing that someone wishes to have.
entries.arabicMeaning: نقص في شيء مطلوب؛ وأيضاً أمر يرغب المرء في الحصول عليه
entries.example: There was a want of clean water in the village.

entries.definitionEn: To wish to have or do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرغب في أن يكون له شيء أو أن يفعل شيئاً
entries.example: I want a glass of water.

entries.definitionEn: Fighting over a period of time between countries or groups, using weapons.
entries.arabicMeaning: قتال يمتد زمناً بين بلدان أو جماعات باستخدام السلاح
entries.example: The two countries were at war for many years.

entries.definitionEn: A room or part of a hospital for people who need similar care.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرفة أو قسم في مستشفى لمن يحتاجون رعاية متشابهة
entries.example: She recovered in a quiet ward after the operation.

entries.definitionEn: A tall cupboard for hanging clothes. Also all the clothes that a person owns.
entries.arabicMeaning: خزانة طويلة لتعليق الملابس؛ وأيضاً مجموع ما يملكه الشخص من ثياب
entries.example: He hung the coat in the wardrobe.

entries.definitionEn: Goods offered for sale, especially by a trader or shopkeeper.
entries.arabicMeaning: بضائع معروضة للبيع، ولا سيما لدى تاجر أو صاحب دكان
entries.example: The stallholder laid out her wares on a wooden table.

entries.definitionEn: A little hot in a pleasant way. Also friendly and kind.
entries.arabicMeaning: دافئ على نحو مريح؛ وأيضاً ودود لطيف
entries.example: The room felt warm after we lit the fire.

entries.definitionEn: To make something or someone warmer, or to become warmer.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجعل شيئاً أو شخصاً أدفأ، أو يصير أدفأ
entries.example: Warm the soup before you serve it.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that gives heat, or in a friendly, kind way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو يبعث الدفء، أو بودّ ولطف
entries.example: They welcomed us warmly at the door.

entries.definitionEn: The heat that something produces, or a friendly, kind feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحرارة التي يصدرها شيء، أو شعور بالودّ واللطف
entries.example: We sat near the fire to enjoy its warmth.

entries.definitionEn: To tell someone about a possible danger or problem so that they can avoid it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يخبر شخصاً بخطر أو مشكلة محتملة حتى يتفاداها
entries.example: The sign warns drivers about ice on the road.

entries.definitionEn: Something that tells you about a possible danger or problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما ينبّهك إلى خطر أو مشكلة محتملة
entries.example: They issued a storm warning for the coast.

entries.definitionEn: A written promise by a seller to repair or replace a product if it fails within a stated time.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعد مكتوب من البائع بإصلاح منتج أو استبداله إن تعطّل خلال مدة محددة
entries.example: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.

entries.definitionEn: A person who fights in battles, especially in the past.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يقاتل في المعارك، ولا سيما في الماضي
entries.example: The museum shows the weapons of an ancient warrior.

entries.definitionEn: A ship designed and armed for fighting at sea.
entries.arabicMeaning: سفينة صُمّمت وجُهّزت للقتال في البحر
entries.example: The warship entered the harbour at sunrise.

entries.definitionEn: A period when a country is fighting a war.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة يكون فيها بلد في حرب
entries.example: Food was rationed in wartime.

entries.definitionEn: Cautious because you think there may be danger or a problem.
entries.arabicMeaning: حذر لأنك تظن أن ثمة خطراً أو مشكلة
entries.example: Investors remained wary of the sudden price rise.

entries.definitionEn: The past form of the verb be, used with I, he, she, and it.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الماضي من الفعل be، تُستعمل مع I وhe وshe وit
entries.example: She was at home yesterday evening.

entries.definitionEn: An act of cleaning something with water, or clothes that are being washed.
entries.arabicMeaning: غسلة؛ عملية تنظيف شيء بالماء، أو الملابس التي تُغسل
entries.example: The car needs a wash after the dusty trip.

entries.definitionEn: To clean something, or yourself, with water and usually soap.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظّف شيئاً أو نفسه بالماء والصابون عادة
entries.example: Wash your hands before dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A bowl, often in a bathroom, used for washing your hands and face.
entries.arabicMeaning: وعاء، غالباً في الحمّام، يُستخدم لغسل اليدين والوجه
entries.example: Cold water stood in the washbowl on the stand.

entries.definitionEn: A machine that washes clothes automatically.
entries.arabicMeaning: آلة تغسل الملابس تلقائياً
entries.example: Put the towels in the washing machine.

entries.definitionEn: The work of washing plates, glasses, and cutlery after a meal. Also those dirty items.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل غسل الصحون والكؤوس وأدوات المائدة بعد الأكل؛ وأيضاً تلك الأشياء الوسخة
entries.example: I will do the washing-up if you dry.

entries.definitionEn: A large tub, formerly used for washing clothes by hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوض كبير كان يُستخدم لغسل الملابس باليد
entries.example: She filled the washtub with hot water and soap.

entries.definitionEn: A flying insect with black and yellow stripes and a sting.
entries.arabicMeaning: حشرة طائرة مخططة بأسود وأصفر ولها إبرة تلسع
entries.example: A wasp landed on the jam jar.

entries.definitionEn: Left over, unused, or no longer wanted, especially of materials or land.
entries.arabicMeaning: فائض أو غير مستعمل أو لم يعد مرغوباً فيه، ولا سيما من المواد أو الأرض
entries.example: Put the waste paper in the recycling bin.

entries.definitionEn: Unwanted material that is thrown away. Also the bad use of something useful, such as time or money.
entries.arabicMeaning: مواد غير مرغوب فيها تُرمى؛ وأيضاً سوء استعمال شيء نافع كالوقت أو المال
entries.example: Leaving the lights on is a waste of electricity.

entries.definitionEn: To use too much of something, or to use it badly, so that it is lost.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعمل من شيء فوق الحاجة، أو يستعمله على نحو سيئ فيضيع
entries.example: Do not waste water while you brush your teeth.

entries.definitionEn: Using more of something than is needed, so that it is lost or thrown away.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستعمل من الشيء فوق الحاجة حتى يضيع أو يُرمى
entries.example: Leaving the heating on all day is wasteful.

entries.definitionEn: A small clock that you wear on your wrist.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة صغيرة تُلبس في المعصم
entries.example: She looked at her watch and stood up.

entries.definitionEn: To look at something for a period of time, especially something that is changing or moving.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينظر إلى شيء فترة من الوقت، ولا سيما إن كان يتغيّر أو يتحرك
entries.example: We watch television in the evening.

entries.definitionEn: The clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers, lakes, and the sea, and that we drink.
entries.arabicMeaning: السائل الشفاف الذي يسقط مطراً ويملأ الأنهار والبحيرات والبحر، والذي نشربه
entries.example: Please drink a glass of water.

entries.definitionEn: To pour water on plants. Of eyes, to fill with tears.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصبّ الماء على النبات؛ ويقال للعين إنها تدمع
entries.example: Water the tomatoes every morning in summer.

entries.definitionEn: A place where water from a river or stream falls from a high point.
entries.arabicMeaning: موضع يسقط فيه ماء نهر أو جدول من مكان مرتفع
entries.example: We walked to the waterfall at the end of the valley.

entries.definitionEn: Land or buildings beside a river, lake, or the sea, especially in a town.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض أو مبانٍ على نهر أو بحيرة أو البحر، ولا سيما في مدينة
entries.example: Cafés line the waterfront in the old harbour.

entries.definitionEn: Not allowing water to pass through.
entries.arabicMeaning: لا يسمح للماء بالنفاذ منه
entries.example: Wear a waterproof jacket if rain is likely.

entries.definitionEn: A raised line of water on the sea or a lake. Also a movement of the hand used to greet someone.
entries.arabicMeaning: خط مرتفع من الماء في البحر أو البحيرة؛ وأيضاً حركة باليد للتحية
entries.example: A large wave knocked him off his feet.

entries.definitionEn: To move your hand from side to side to greet or attract attention. Also to move from side to side.
entries.arabicMeaning: يحرك يده يمنة ويسرة للتحية أو للفت الانتباه؛ وأيضاً يتمايل من جانب إلى جانب
entries.example: She waved to us from the other side of the street.

entries.definitionEn: A solid substance made by bees or from oil, used in candles and to polish surfaces.
entries.arabicMeaning: شمع يُستعمل في صنع الشموع أو في تلميع الأسطح
entries.example: She melted the wax to make a small candle.

entries.definitionEn: A method of doing something. Also a road or path that you follow.
entries.arabicMeaning: طريقة لفعل شيء، أو طريق يُسلك
entries.example: This is the shortest way to the station.

entries.definitionEn: The land along the edge of a road or path.
entries.arabicMeaning: جانب الطريق أو حافته
entries.example: Wildflowers grew along the wayside.

entries.definitionEn: Difficult to control or predict, because behaviour is stubborn or keeps changing.
entries.arabicMeaning: عنيد شارد يصعب ضبط سلوكه أو توقعه
entries.example: The novel follows a wayward teenager who ignores every rule.

entries.definitionEn: Used by a speaker to talk about himself or herself and one or more other people, as the subject of a verb.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير المتكلم مع غيره في محل فاعل
entries.example: We live in the same building.

entries.definitionEn: Not strong in the body, or not good at something.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضعيف الجسم أو ضعيف في أمر ما
entries.example: After the flu, she still felt weak.

entries.definitionEn: To make something less strong, or to become less strong.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُضعِف شيئاً أو يفقد قوته
entries.example: The storm is expected to weaken overnight.

entries.definitionEn: In a weak way, without much strength or force.
entries.arabicMeaning: بضعف أو بلا قوة تُذكر
entries.example: He smiled weakly and sat down.

entries.definitionEn: A lack of strength, or a fault in a person or a plan.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضعف في القوة، أو ثغرة في شخص أو خطة
entries.example: Honesty is not a weakness.

entries.definitionEn: A large amount of money and valuable things.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثروة كبيرة من المال والممتلكات
entries.example: Hard work brought the family some wealth.

entries.definitionEn: Having a lot of money and property.
entries.arabicMeaning: ثري ذو مال وممتلكات كثيرة
entries.example: She comes from a wealthy family.

entries.definitionEn: An object used to hurt people or to fight, such as a gun or a knife.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلاح يُستعمل للإيذاء أو القتال
entries.example: The museum shows old weapons from the region.

entries.definitionEn: To have clothes, shoes, or jewellery on your body.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرتدي ثياباً أو حذاء أو حلياً
entries.example: I wear a coat when it is cold.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel tired or bored because it goes on for a long time.
entries.arabicMeaning: مُتعِب مملّ من طول استمراره
entries.example: The meeting was long and wearisome.

entries.definitionEn: Very tired, especially after work, travel, or effort.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرهَق شديد التعب بعد عمل أو سفر
entries.example: He looked weary after the night shift.

entries.definitionEn: A report that says what the weather will be like soon.
entries.arabicMeaning: نشرة تبيّن حالة الطقس المتوقعة
entries.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The conditions outside, such as rain, sun, wind, or snow.
entries.arabicMeaning: حالة الجو من حرّ ومطر وريح وثلج
entries.example: The weather is warm today.

entries.definitionEn: The pattern in which threads are crossed to make cloth.
entries.arabicMeaning: نمط تقاطع الخيوط في القماش
entries.example: This cotton has a tight, even weave.

entries.definitionEn: The internet. Also a net of thin threads made by a spider.
entries.arabicMeaning: شبكة الإنترنت؛ وأيضاً نسيج العنكبوت
entries.example: I looked up the opening hours on the web.

entries.definitionEn: A single document on the internet that you can view on a screen.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفحة واحدة على الإنترنت تُعرض على الشاشة
entries.example: Open the web page and read the instructions.

entries.definitionEn: A small camera on a computer that sends live pictures during a call.
entries.arabicMeaning: كاميرا صغيرة على الحاسوب تبث صورة مباشرة
entries.example: She turned on the webcam before the meeting.

entries.definitionEn: A set of pages on the internet with information about a person or an organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: موقع على الإنترنت يضم صفحات عن شخص أو جهة
entries.example: The school's website lists the exam dates.

entries.definitionEn: To marry someone, often in a slightly formal or literary style.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتزوج شخصاً، بأسلوب أقرب إلى الرسمية
entries.example: They plan to wed in June.

entries.definitionEn: A ceremony in which two people get married, and the party after it.
entries.arabicMeaning: حفل زفاف وعقد قران
entries.example: We went to their wedding last Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: The day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوم الأربعاء
entries.example: I have a class on Wednesday.

entries.definitionEn: A wild plant that grows where it is not wanted, especially in a garden.
entries.arabicMeaning: عشبة تنمو حيث لا يُراد لها، ولا سيما في الحديقة
entries.example: She pulled the weeds out of the flower bed.

entries.definitionEn: A period of seven days.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسبوع: مدة سبعة أيام
entries.example: The course lasts one week.

entries.definitionEn: Any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوم عمل ليس السبت ولا الأحد
entries.example: The library closes earlier on weekdays.

entries.definitionEn: Saturday and Sunday, when many people do not go to work.
entries.arabicMeaning: عطلة نهاية الأسبوع: السبت والأحد
entries.example: We stay at home at the weekend.

entries.definitionEn: Happening or appearing once a week.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسبوعي: يحدث أو يصدر مرة في الأسبوع
entries.example: She reads a weekly magazine about cooking.

entries.definitionEn: Once every week.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسبوعياً: مرة كل أسبوع
entries.example: The bins are collected weekly.

entries.definitionEn: A short time of crying.
entries.arabicMeaning: نوبة بكاء قصيرة
entries.example: She had a quiet weep in the kitchen, then washed her face.

entries.definitionEn: To find how heavy something is, or to have a particular weight.
entries.arabicMeaning: يَزِن شيئاً أو يكون له وزن معيّن
entries.example: Can you weigh this bag of apples?

entries.definitionEn: How heavy a person or thing is.
entries.arabicMeaning: وزن الشخص أو الشيء وثقله
entries.example: What is the weight of this box?

entries.definitionEn: Strange and unusual, in a way that is a little surprising.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب غير مألوف على نحو يثير الاستغراب
entries.example: That is a weird noise coming from the fridge.

entries.definitionEn: Received with pleasure; wanted or accepted.
entries.arabicMeaning: مرحَّب به ومقبول عن رضى
entries.example: A cup of tea would be welcome after that walk.

entries.definitionEn: Said to greet someone who has just arrived.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبارة ترحيب تُقال للقادم
entries.example: Welcome! Come in and sit down.

entries.definitionEn: The greeting someone receives when they arrive.
entries.arabicMeaning: الترحيب الذي يلقاه القادم عند وصوله
entries.example: They gave the guests a warm welcome.

entries.definitionEn: To greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرحّب بشخص عند قدومه
entries.example: They came to the door to welcome us.

entries.definitionEn: The health, comfort, and safety of a person or group. Also money from the state to help people in need.
entries.arabicMeaning: صالح الإنسان وسلامته؛ وأيضاً إعانة اجتماعية للمحتاجين
entries.example: The new rules aim to protect the welfare of children.

entries.definitionEn: In good health; not ill.
entries.arabicMeaning: بخير وسليم الصحة
entries.example: I hope you are well.

entries.definitionEn: In a good or successful way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو جيد أو ناجح
entries.example: She plays the piano well.

entries.definitionEn: Having the right amounts of different parts. Also calm and sensible in character.
entries.arabicMeaning: متوازن العناصر؛ وأيضاً متزن النفس راجح العقل
entries.example: A well-balanced meal includes vegetables and protein.

entries.definitionEn: Strong and solid in body, or strongly made.
entries.arabicMeaning: متين البنية أو البناء
entries.example: The well-built cottage survived the storm.

entries.definitionEn: Wearing clothes that are neat, smart, or attractive.
entries.arabicMeaning: أنيق الملبس حسن الهندام
entries.example: He always arrives well-dressed for interviews.

entries.definitionEn: Known by many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: معروف لدى كثير من الناس
entries.example: Paris is a well-known city.

entries.definitionEn: Arranged in a clear and efficient way.
entries.arabicMeaning: منظَّم بعناية وعلى نحو واضح فعّال
entries.example: She keeps a well-organized desk.

entries.definitionEn: Earning or offering a good amount of money.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو أجر مرتفع أو يدرّ دخلاً جيداً
entries.example: It is a well-paid job with regular hours.

entries.definitionEn: The past form of be used with you, we, and they, before another verb or an adjective.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة الماضي من فعل الكون مع you وwe وthey
entries.example: They were late for dinner.

entries.definitionEn: In or towards the west.
entries.arabicMeaning: غربي: واقع في الغرب أو متجه إليه
entries.example: The west door faces the garden.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the west.
entries.arabicMeaning: غرباً: باتجاه الغرب
entries.example: Drive west until you see the lake.

entries.definitionEn: The direction where the sun goes down.
entries.arabicMeaning: الغرب: جهة غروب الشمس
entries.example: The sun sets in the west.

entries.definitionEn: In or from the west of a place. Also relating to Europe and North America.
entries.arabicMeaning: غربي: من غرب منطقة ما؛ وقد يعني متعلقاً بأوروبا وأمريكا الشمالية
entries.example: The western part of the island is drier.

entries.definitionEn: Towards the west.
entries.arabicMeaning: باتجاه الغرب
entries.example: The birds flew westward at dusk.

entries.definitionEn: Covered or soaked with water or another liquid.
entries.arabicMeaning: مبلل بالماء أو بسائل آخر
