entries.example: My shoes are wet from the rain.

entries.definitionEn: Land that is covered with water for much of the time, such as a marsh.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرض رطبة تغمرها المياه كثيراً كالمستنقع
entries.example: Birds nest in the wetland near the river.

entries.definitionEn: A very large sea animal that breathes air.
entries.arabicMeaning: حوت: حيوان بحري ضخم يتنفس الهواء
entries.example: A whale surfaced beside the boat.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to ask which thing or what kind of thing.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل قبل اسم للسؤال عن شيء أو عن نوعه
entries.example: What time does the train leave?

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask for information about something, without a noun after it.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل للسؤال عن شيء من دون اسم بعدها
entries.example: What did you say?

entries.definitionEn: Any; it does not matter which, used before a noun.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ كان؛ لا يهم أيّ، وتُستعمل قبل اسم
entries.example: Take whatever book you like.

entries.definitionEn: Anything or everything; no matter what.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شيء؛ مهما يكن الأمر
entries.example: Do whatever you think is right.

entries.definitionEn: A grain crop that is ground into flour for bread.
entries.arabicMeaning: قمح يُطحن لصناعة الدقيق والخبز
entries.example: This bread is made from wheat.

entries.definitionEn: A round object that turns and lets a vehicle or machine move.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجلة مستديرة تدور فتحرك مركبة أو آلة
entries.example: The wheel on my bike is loose.

entries.definitionEn: A chair with wheels used by someone who cannot walk easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: كرسي بعجلات لمن يصعب عليه المشي
entries.example: She uses a wheelchair to get around the office.

entries.definitionEn: To breathe with a noisy whistling sound, usually because the chest is tight.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتنفس بصفير مسموع، غالباً من ضيق في الصدر
entries.example: He began to wheeze after climbing the stairs.

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask or talk about the time at which something happens.
entries.arabicMeaning: متى: للسؤال عن الوقت الذي يحدث فيه شيء
entries.example: When does the shop close?

entries.definitionEn: At the time that; as soon as.
entries.arabicMeaning: عندما: في الوقت الذي يحدث فيه شيء
entries.example: Call me when you arrive.

entries.definitionEn: At any time; every time, used without a following clause.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أي وقت شئت، من غير جملة بعدها في الغالب
entries.example: You can visit whenever.

entries.definitionEn: Every time that; at any time that.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلما؛ متى ما وقع الأمر
entries.example: Whenever it rains, the roof leaks.

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask or talk about a place.
entries.arabicMeaning: أين: للسؤال عن المكان أو الحديث عنه
entries.example: Where do you live?

entries.definitionEn: In the place that; at the place in which.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيث: في المكان الذي
entries.example: This is the house where I grew up.

entries.definitionEn: Used to put two facts side by side in order to show a contrast.
entries.arabicMeaning: في حين أنّ: للمقابلة بين أمرين متباينين
entries.example: She likes tea, whereas I prefer coffee.

entries.definitionEn: In any place that; no matter where.
entries.arabicMeaning: أينما: في أي مكان، مهما يكن الموضع
entries.example: Sit wherever you like.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show a choice between two possibilities, or to introduce an indirect yes/no question.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما إذا: للاختيار بين احتمالين أو لطرح سؤال غير مباشر
entries.example: I do not know whether to stay or leave.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to ask or say which one of a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ: تُستعمل قبل اسم للسؤال أو التعيين من مجموعة
entries.example: Which colour do you prefer?

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask which thing, or to add information about something just mentioned.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيٌّ منها؛ أو الذي/التي لزيادة معلومة عن شيء ذُكر
entries.example: Which of these bags is yours?

entries.definitionEn: Any of the ones named, used before a noun; it does not matter which.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّاً شئت من المجموعة، وتُستعمل قبل اسم
entries.example: Take whichever seat is free.

entries.definitionEn: Any one of a group; it does not matter which.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيٌّ كان من المجموعة؛ لا يهم أيّاً تختار
entries.example: Choose whichever you prefer.

entries.definitionEn: During the time that something else is happening. Also although.
entries.arabicMeaning: بينما: في أثناء حدوث شيء؛ وقد تعني مع أنّ
entries.example: I listened to music while I cooked.

entries.definitionEn: A period of time, often not very long.
entries.arabicMeaning: برهة أو مدة من الزمن
entries.example: Let's wait a while before we decide.

entries.definitionEn: During the time that; although. More formal than while, especially in British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: بينما: في أثناء ذلك أو مع أنّ، بأسلوب أرقى من while
entries.example: Whilst the idea is attractive, it is not practical.

entries.definitionEn: To hit with a long thin object, or to beat a mixture very quickly. Also to move with sudden force.
entries.arabicMeaning: يضرب بسوط، أو يخفق مزيجاً بسرعة، أو يضرب بعنف كحركة الريح
entries.example: Whip the cream until it is thick.

entries.definitionEn: To make a low continuous buzzing sound while moving fast.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُحدث أزيزاً متصلاً خافتاً مع حركة سريعة
entries.example: The fan began to whir as soon as she switched it on.

entries.definitionEn: A tall spinning column of air. Also a very fast, intense period of activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوبعة هوائية دوّارة؛ وأيضاً فترة نشاط محمومة سريعة
entries.example: Their week in the city was a whirlwind of meetings.

entries.definitionEn: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain. Spelled whiskey in Ireland and the US, whisky in Scotland.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشروب كحولي قوي يُصنع من الحبوب، ويُكتب whiskey أو whisky بحسب البلد
entries.example: He poured a small glass of whisky.

entries.definitionEn: A very quiet way of speaking, using little voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: همس: كلام في غاية الخفوت
entries.example: She spoke in a whisper so the baby would not wake.

entries.definitionEn: To speak very quietly, using breath more than the full voice.
entries.arabicMeaning: يهمس: يتكلم بصوت خافت جداً
entries.example: Please whisper; the others are still working.

entries.definitionEn: A high sound made by forcing air through the lips, or a small device that makes this sound.
entries.arabicMeaning: صفير بالشفتين، أو صفّارة تُحدث هذا الصوت
entries.example: The referee blew a whistle to stop the game.

entries.definitionEn: To make a high sound by forcing air through your lips or a device.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصفر بالشفتين أو بالصفّارة
entries.example: He likes to whistle while he walks.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of snow or milk.
entries.arabicMeaning: أبيض كلون الثلج أو الحليب
entries.example: She wore a white shirt.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of snow or milk.
entries.arabicMeaning: اللون الأبيض
entries.example: White looks clean on the walls of a small room.

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask or talk about a person.
entries.arabicMeaning: مَن: للسؤال عن شخص أو الحديث عنه
entries.example: Who is that at the door?

entries.definitionEn: Any person who; no matter who.
entries.arabicMeaning: أيّ شخص؛ مهما يكن الشخص
entries.example: Whoever finishes first can leave early.

entries.definitionEn: Complete; all of something, with nothing left out.
entries.arabicMeaning: كامل؛ كلّ الشيء بلا نقص
entries.example: I spent the whole day at home.

entries.definitionEn: All of something considered together.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكلّ مجتمعاً لا أجزاؤه منفردة
entries.example: We need to look at the problem as a whole.

entries.definitionEn: Completely; in every part or respect.
entries.arabicMeaning: تماماً وكلياً من كل وجه
entries.example: The plan is wholly unrealistic.

entries.definitionEn: Used instead of who as the object of a verb or preposition, especially in formal English.
entries.arabicMeaning: مَن في محل مفعول به، ولا سيما في الأسلوب الرسمي
entries.example: To whom did you send the letter?

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to ask or say who something belongs to.
entries.arabicMeaning: لِمَن: تُستعمل قبل اسم للدلالة على المالك
entries.example: Whose bag is this?

entries.definitionEn: Used without a following noun to ask which person something belongs to.
entries.arabicMeaning: لِمَن: ضمير يسأل عن المالك من غير اسم بعده
entries.example: I found a key, but I do not know whose it is.

entries.definitionEn: Used to ask or talk about the reason for something.
entries.arabicMeaning: لماذا: للسؤال عن السبب
entries.example: Why are you late?

entries.definitionEn: Morally very bad. Also playfully mischievous, as if enjoying a little trouble.
entries.arabicMeaning: شرير جداً؛ وقد يعني خبيثاً بمرح خفيف
entries.example: The story's villain is truly wicked.

entries.definitionEn: In a morally bad way, or in a playfully mischievous way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بشرّ بيّن، أو بخبث مرح
entries.example: He grinned wickedly at the joke.

entries.definitionEn: Measuring a large distance from one side to the other.
entries.arabicMeaning: واسع العرض من جانب إلى آخر
entries.example: The river is very wide here.

entries.definitionEn: As far as possible; fully open or apart.
entries.arabicMeaning: على اتساع؛ بالكامل إلى أقصى حد
entries.example: Open your mouth wide.

entries.definitionEn: By many people, or over a large area.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نطاق واسع بين الناس أو في رقعة كبيرة
entries.example: The news was widely reported.

entries.definitionEn: To become wider, or to make something wider.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتسع أو يوسّع شيئاً
entries.example: They plan to widen the road next year.

entries.definitionEn: Existing or happening in many places or among many people.
entries.arabicMeaning: واسع الانتشار في أماكن كثيرة أو بين أناس كثيرين
entries.example: There is widespread support for the new park.

entries.definitionEn: A woman whose husband has died and who has not married again.
entries.arabicMeaning: أرملة: امرأة توفي زوجها ولم تتزوج بعده
entries.example: She became a widow at forty.

entries.definitionEn: The distance from one side of something to the other.
entries.arabicMeaning: العرض: المسافة من جانب الشيء إلى الجانب الآخر
entries.example: Measure the width of the table.

entries.definitionEn: A married woman, in relation to her husband.
entries.arabicMeaning: زوجة
entries.example: His wife is a doctor.

entries.definitionEn: Living or growing in nature, not kept by people. Also uncontrolled.
entries.arabicMeaning: بريّ يعيش في الطبيعة لا عند الناس؛ أو جامح بلا ضابط
entries.example: Lions are wild animals.

entries.definitionEn: A large natural area with few or no people living in it.
entries.arabicMeaning: برّية واسعة يقلّ فيها السكان أو ينعدمون
entries.example: They hiked through the wilderness for three days.

entries.definitionEn: Animals and other living things that live in nature, not as pets or on farms.
entries.arabicMeaning: الحياة البرية من حيوانات ونباتات في الطبيعة
entries.example: The forest is full of wildlife.

entries.definitionEn: In a wild, uncontrolled, or extreme way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو جامح أو مفرط بلا ضابط
entries.example: The crowd cheered wildly.

entries.definitionEn: Used with a verb to talk about the future, or to show that someone is ready to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستعمل مع الفعل للحديث عن المستقبل أو عن الاستعداد للفعل
entries.example: I will call you tomorrow.

entries.definitionEn: The power to decide and keep trying. Also a legal document saying who should receive your things after death.
entries.arabicMeaning: إرادة وعزم؛ وأيضاً وصية شرعية بمصير التركة
entries.example: She has a strong will to succeed.

entries.definitionEn: Ready and happy to do something if it is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مستعد وراضٍ أن يفعل إن دعت الحاجة
entries.example: Are you willing to help this weekend?

entries.definitionEn: In a way that shows you are happy to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: عن طيب خاطر ومن غير تردد
entries.example: She willingly shared her notes.

entries.definitionEn: The state of being ready and happy to do something.
entries.arabicMeaning: استعداد ورغبة في القيام بأمر
entries.example: His willingness to listen made him a good manager.

entries.definitionEn: A victory in a game, race, or contest.
entries.arabicMeaning: فوز في مباراة أو سباق أو مسابقة
entries.example: Their first win of the season came on Saturday.

entries.definitionEn: To be first or best in a game, race, or competition.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفوز في لعبة أو سباق أو مسابقة
entries.example: I hope our team will win.

entries.definitionEn: Moving air.
entries.arabicMeaning: ريح: هواء متحرك
entries.example: The wind is strong today.

entries.definitionEn: To turn something around itself or around another object. Also to follow a twisting path.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلفّ شيئاً حول نفسه أو حول غيره؛ أو يسير في طريق متعرّج
entries.example: Wind this string around the stick.

entries.definitionEn: Following a path that turns again and again.
entries.arabicMeaning: متعرّج كثير الانعطاف
entries.example: We drove along a winding mountain road.

entries.definitionEn: An opening in a wall, usually with glass, that lets in light and air.
entries.arabicMeaning: نافذة في جدار، غالباً بزجاج، يدخل منها الضوء والهواء
entries.example: Please close the window; it is cold.

entries.definitionEn: The front window of a car. Mainly British English.
entries.arabicMeaning: الزجاج الأمامي للسيارة، وهي كلمة بريطانية في الغالب
entries.example: Rain hit the windscreen as we drove.

entries.definitionEn: The front window of a car. Mainly American English.
entries.arabicMeaning: الزجاج الأمامي للسيارة، وهي كلمة أمريكية في الغالب
entries.example: He cleaned the windshield before the trip.

entries.definitionEn: The sport of standing on a board with a sail and moving across water.
entries.arabicMeaning: رياضة الوقوف على لوح بشراع والحركة فوق الماء
entries.example: She tried windsurfing on holiday.

entries.definitionEn: With a lot of wind.
entries.arabicMeaning: كثير الريح
entries.example: It is too windy to sit outside.

entries.definitionEn: An alcoholic drink made from grapes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نبيذ يُصنع من العنب
entries.example: They ordered a bottle of wine with dinner.

entries.definitionEn: A quick closing and opening of one eye, often as a private signal.
entries.arabicMeaning: غمزة سريعة بعين واحدة، غالباً إشارة خفية
entries.example: He gave her a wink to show it was a joke.

entries.definitionEn: A person or team that wins a game, race, or prize.
entries.arabicMeaning: فائز في لعبة أو سباق أو جائزة
entries.example: The winner of the race raised her arms.

entries.definitionEn: The cold season of the year.
entries.arabicMeaning: فصل الشتاء
entries.example: Winter is cold in this city.

entries.definitionEn: To clean or dry a surface by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand.
entries.arabicMeaning: يمسح سطحاً بقطعة قماش أو باليد لينظفه أو يجففه
entries.example: Wipe the table with a clean cloth.

entries.definitionEn: Thin metal used to carry electricity or to tie and support things.
entries.arabicMeaning: سلك معدني رفيع لنقل الكهرباء أو للربط والتثبيت
entries.example: The lamp needs a new wire.

entries.definitionEn: To connect something with electrical wire. Also to send money electronically.
entries.arabicMeaning: يوصل شيئاً بأسلاك كهربائية؛ أو يحوّل مالاً إلكترونياً
entries.example: An electrician will wire the new lights.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to make good decisions, based on knowledge and experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكمة في الرأي مبنية على العلم والتجربة
entries.example: My grandmother's wisdom helped me decide.

entries.definitionEn: Able to make good decisions, based on knowledge and experience.
entries.arabicMeaning: حكيم حسن التقدير عن علم وتجربة
entries.example: It was a wise choice to leave early.

entries.definitionEn: Something you want to happen or to have.
entries.arabicMeaning: أمنية تريد حدوثها أو الحصول عليها
entries.example: My only wish is to rest this weekend.

entries.definitionEn: To want something to happen, or to say you hope someone is happy or well.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتمنى حدوث شيء، أو يتمنى لغيره الخير
entries.example: I wish you a happy birthday.

entries.definitionEn: Feeling a gentle sadness because you want something from the past, or something you cannot have.
entries.arabicMeaning: مشوب بحنين شفيف إلى ماضٍ أو إلى شيء بعيد المنال
entries.example: She gave the old photograph a wistful look.

entries.definitionEn: In a gently sad, longing way.
entries.arabicMeaning: بحنين شفيف يشوبه الأسى
entries.example: He gazed wistfully at the empty stage.

entries.definitionEn: The ability to say clever and funny things quickly.
entries.arabicMeaning: ظرف وسرعة خاطر في القول الطريف
entries.example: Her conversation is full of wit.

entries.definitionEn: Used to show that people or things are together, or that someone has or uses something.
entries.arabicMeaning: مع: للمصاحبة، أو لبيان ما مع الشخص أو ما يستعمله
entries.example: I went to the shop with my brother.

entries.definitionEn: To take money out of a bank, or to pull back from a place, plan, or activity.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسحب مالاً من مصرف، أو ينسحب من مكان أو خطة أو نشاط
entries.example: She went to the bank to withdraw some cash.

entries.definitionEn: Quiet and not wanting to talk or spend time with other people.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطوٍ قليل الكلام والمعاشرة
entries.example: After the move, he became quiet and withdrawn.

entries.definitionEn: Inside a place, a period of time, or a limit.
entries.arabicMeaning: خلال أو داخل حدّ من مكان أو زمان أو مقدار
entries.example: Please finish within an hour.

entries.definitionEn: Not having something, or not doing something.
entries.arabicMeaning: من دون شيء أو من غير فعل شيء
entries.example: Don't go out without a coat.

entries.definitionEn: A person who sees an event, especially a crime or accident, and can describe it.
entries.arabicMeaning: شاهد عيان يرى الحدث ويقدر أن يصفه
entries.example: A witness described the accident to the police.

entries.definitionEn: To see something happen, especially an accident, a crime, or an important event.
entries.arabicMeaning: يشهد حدثاً بأم عينه، ولا سيما حادثاً أو أمراً مهماً
entries.example: We witnessed a beautiful sunset from the hill.

entries.definitionEn: Clever and funny in speech or writing.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارع الظرف في الكلام أو الكتابة
entries.example: She made a witty remark about the delay.

entries.definitionEn: Informal: extremely good or skilful.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير رسمي: بارع جداً أو ممتاز
entries.example: He's wizard at repairing old radios.

entries.definitionEn: Looking old, with dry skin that is full of small lines.
entries.arabicMeaning: متغضّن يابس الجلد يبدو أكبر سنّاً
entries.example: The wizened gardener knew every plant by name.

entries.definitionEn: A wild animal like a large dog, that lives and hunts in groups.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذئب: حيوان بريّ شبيه بكلب كبير يعيش ويصيد في جماعات
entries.example: A wolf howled in the distance.

entries.definitionEn: An adult female person.
entries.arabicMeaning: امرأة بالغة
entries.example: The woman at the desk helped me.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of surprise and admiration. Also something that causes this feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: دهشة وإعجاب؛ أو أمر يبعث هذا الشعور
entries.example: The canyon filled the visitors with wonder.

entries.definitionEn: To think about something and want to know more.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتساءل في نفسه ويريد أن يعرف
entries.example: I wonder if the shops are still open.

entries.definitionEn: Very good; causing pleasure and surprise.
entries.arabicMeaning: رائع جداً يبعث السرور والدهشة
entries.example: We had a wonderful meal.

entries.definitionEn: Amazing and impressive, in a slightly literary style.
entries.arabicMeaning: عجيب مدهش، بأسلوب فيه مسحة أدبية
entries.example: The night sky was a wondrous sight.

entries.definitionEn: To try to win someone's love. Also to try to gain support, custom, or favour.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسعى لكسب ودّ شخص، أو لكسب تأييد أو زبائن أو حظوة
entries.example: The city tried to woo new businesses with lower rents.

entries.definitionEn: The hard material that trees are made of. Also a small forest.
entries.arabicMeaning: خشب الشجر؛ وأيضاً غيضة أو غابة صغيرة
entries.example: The table is made of wood.

entries.definitionEn: The art of cutting shapes in wood, or an object made in this way.
entries.arabicMeaning: فن النحت في الخشب، أو قطعة منحوتة منه
entries.example: She bought a small woodcarving at the market.

entries.definitionEn: Covered with trees.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكسوّ بالأشجار
entries.example: They built a cabin in a wooded valley.

entries.definitionEn: Made of wood.
entries.arabicMeaning: مصنوع من الخشب
entries.example: The box is wooden.

entries.definitionEn: The thick hair of sheep, used to make clothes and cloth.
entries.arabicMeaning: صوف الأغنام يُصنع منه الثياب والقماش
entries.example: This jumper is made of wool.

entries.definitionEn: A unit of language with meaning, spoken or written.
entries.arabicMeaning: كلمة ذات معنى منطوقة أو مكتوبة
entries.example: I do not know that word.

entries.definitionEn: The number of words used in a piece of writing, or the particular wording chosen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مقدار الكلمات في نص، أو صياغتها المختارة
entries.example: Cut the wordage; the report is too long.

entries.definitionEn: Without speaking.
entries.arabicMeaning: من غير أن ينطق بكلمة
entries.example: She nodded wordlessly and left.

entries.definitionEn: A person who is skilled at using language, especially a writer.
entries.arabicMeaning: بارع في صياغة الكلام، ولا سيما الكاتب
entries.example: The columnist is a gifted wordsmith.

entries.definitionEn: A job, or the activity of doing a job. Also something produced by effort, such as a book or a painting.
entries.arabicMeaning: عمل أو وظيفة؛ وأيضاً نتاج جهد ككتاب أو لوحة
entries.example: I have a lot of work today.

entries.definitionEn: To do a job, often for money. Also to function as it should.
entries.arabicMeaning: يعمل في وظيفة، غالباً مقابل أجر؛ أو يؤدي وظيفته كما ينبغي
entries.example: I work in a hospital.

entries.definitionEn: Unable to stop working, even when rest is needed.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدمن على العمل لا يكاد يتوقف حتى عند الحاجة إلى الراحة
entries.example: His workaholic schedule left little time for friends.

entries.definitionEn: A strong table used for making or repairing things.
entries.arabicMeaning: منضدة متينة يُصنع عليها أو يُصلح
entries.example: He sanded the wood on the workbench.

entries.definitionEn: A person who does a job, especially for a company or organization.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل يؤدي عملاً، ولا سيما لدى جهة أو شركة
entries.example: Every worker needs a break.

entries.definitionEn: Having a paid job. Also used while you work, or functioning as it should.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو عمل مأجور؛ أو خاص بوقت العمل؛ أو شغّال يؤدي وظيفته
entries.example: She has two working parents.

entries.definitionEn: A man who does physical work, especially building or repairs.
entries.arabicMeaning: عامل يعمل بيده، ولا سيما في البناء أو الإصلاح
entries.example: A workman repaired the leaking pipe.

entries.definitionEn: A period of physical exercise.
entries.arabicMeaning: حصة تمرين رياضي
entries.example: I do a short workout before breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: The office, factory, or other place where you do your job.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان العمل من مكتب أو مصنع أو نحوه
entries.example: Phones are not allowed in this workplace.

entries.definitionEn: A room or building where things are made or repaired. Also a short course of practical training.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورشة صنع أو إصلاح؛ وأيضاً دورة تدريبية عملية قصيرة
entries.example: I went to a photography workshop last month.

entries.definitionEn: A table used for working, especially for making or assembling things.
entries.arabicMeaning: طاولة يُعمل عليها، ولا سيما في الصنع أو التجميع
entries.example: She spread the fabric across the worktable.

entries.definitionEn: The earth and all the people and places on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: العالم: الأرض ومن عليها من ناس وأماكن
entries.example: There are many countries in the world.

entries.definitionEn: Experienced in practical life and not easily shocked. Also concerned with money and possessions rather than spiritual matters.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجرّب في شؤون الحياة لا يُدهش بسهولة؛ أو منشغل بالدنيا لا بالروح
entries.example: Years of travel had made her worldly.

entries.definitionEn: A person's overall way of seeing and understanding life and the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: رؤية شاملة للإنسان إلى الحياة والعالم
entries.example: His worldview changed after living abroad.

entries.definitionEn: Existing or happening in all parts of the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالمي يشمل أنحاء الأرض
entries.example: The band has worldwide fame.

entries.definitionEn: In all parts of the world.
entries.arabicMeaning: في أنحاء العالم كلها
entries.example: The product is sold worldwide.

entries.definitionEn: A small, long, soft animal that lives in soil.
entries.arabicMeaning: دودة صغيرة رخوة الجسم تعيش في التربة
entries.example: A worm moved through the wet soil.

entries.definitionEn: Damaged, thin, or less fresh because of long use.
entries.arabicMeaning: بالٍ أو رقيق من طول الاستعمال
entries.example: His worn shoes needed replacing.

entries.definitionEn: Too old or damaged to use any more. Also extremely tired.
entries.arabicMeaning: متهالك لم يعد يصلح للاستعمال؛ أو منهَك جداً
entries.example: She threw away the worn-out towels.

entries.definitionEn: Unhappy because you think something bad may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق خائف من سوء قد يحدث
entries.example: I am worried about the exam.

entries.definitionEn: A feeling of being unhappy because you think something bad may happen. Also a problem that causes this feeling.
entries.arabicMeaning: قلق من سوء متوقع؛ أو مشكلة تبعث هذا الشعور
entries.example: Money is her biggest worry.

entries.definitionEn: To feel unhappy because you think something bad may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: يقلق خوفاً من سوء قد يحدث
entries.example: Don't worry; the train is only five minutes late.

entries.definitionEn: Making you feel that something bad may happen.
entries.arabicMeaning: مثير للقلق لأنه يوحي بسوء محتمل
entries.example: There is a worrying rise in food prices.

entries.definitionEn: More bad than something else; of a lower quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسوأ مما يُقارن به، أو أدنى جودة
entries.example: The weather is worse today than yesterday.

entries.definitionEn: In a more bad way than before or than something else.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو أسوأ مما كان أو مما يُقارن به
entries.example: She sings worse when she has a cold.

entries.definitionEn: Something more unpleasant or more serious than what already exists.
entries.arabicMeaning: ما هو أشد سوءاً مما هو قائم
entries.example: The patient's condition took a turn for the worse.

entries.definitionEn: To become more bad, or to make something more bad.
entries.arabicMeaning: يسوء أو يزيد الأمر سوءاً
entries.example: The storm will worsen tonight.

entries.definitionEn: The act of showing love and respect to God or a god, often in a religious service.
entries.arabicMeaning: عبادة وإجلال لله أو لإله، غالباً في شعيرة دينية
entries.example: The temple is a quiet place of worship.

entries.definitionEn: Most bad; of the lowest quality.
entries.arabicMeaning: الأسوأ والأدنى جودة
entries.example: That was the worst meal I have ever had.

entries.definitionEn: In the most bad way.
entries.arabicMeaning: على أسوأ نحو
entries.example: This team played worst of all last season.

entries.definitionEn: The most unpleasant or serious thing possible in a situation.
entries.arabicMeaning: أسوأ ما يمكن أن يقع في موقف ما
entries.example: We were prepared for the worst.

entries.definitionEn: Having a particular value. Also used to say that something deserves the time, money, or effort you give it.
entries.arabicMeaning: ذو قيمة معيّنة، أو يستحق الوقت أو المال أو الجهد المبذول فيه
entries.example: The museum is worth a visit.

entries.definitionEn: Having no value, use, or importance.
entries.arabicMeaning: عديم القيمة أو النفع أو الأهمية
entries.example: Without a signature, the document is worthless.

entries.definitionEn: Worth the time, money, or effort that you spend on it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يستحق الوقت أو المال أو الجهد المبذول فيه
entries.example: The extra study was worthwhile; she passed easily.

entries.definitionEn: Deserving respect, support, or attention.
entries.arabicMeaning: جدير بالاحترام أو الدعم أو الاهتمام
entries.example: It is a worthy cause, so we decided to donate.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a verb to talk about the past of will, to imagine something, or to ask politely.
entries.arabicMeaning: فعل مساعد يأتي قبل الفعل للدلالة على ماضي will، أو على موقف متخيَّل، أو على طلب مؤدّب
entries.example: Would you like a cup of tea?

entries.definitionEn: An injury to the body, especially one that cuts or breaks the skin.
entries.arabicMeaning: جرح في الجسد، وخصوصاً ما يقطع الجلد أو يشقّه
entries.example: The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.

entries.definitionEn: To injure someone with a weapon or by cutting the body. Also to hurt someone's feelings deeply.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجرح شخصاً بسلاح أو بقطع في الجسد، أو يؤذي مشاعره بعمق
entries.example: His remark wounded her more than he knew.

entries.definitionEn: To cause extreme pain, distress, or destruction.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُوقع ألماً أو كرباً شديداً، أو يحلّ خراباً
entries.example: He was wracked with guilt for weeks.

entries.definitionEn: To argue for a long time, often angrily or noisily, especially about a practical matter.
entries.arabicMeaning: يتجادل طويلاً بحدّة أو صخب، وغالباً في شأن عملي
entries.example: The two sides wrangled over the budget for hours.

entries.definitionEn: A covering of paper or cloth, or food rolled in thin bread. Also a light garment worn around the shoulders.
entries.arabicMeaning: غلاف من ورق أو قماش، أو طعام ملفوف بخبز رقيق؛ وقد تعني شالاً خفيفاً على الكتفين
entries.example: She pulled a wrap around her shoulders.

entries.definitionEn: To cover something by folding paper, cloth, or similar material around it.
entries.arabicMeaning: يلفّ شيئاً بورق أو قماش ليغطّيه
entries.example: Please wrap the gift in blue paper.

entries.definitionEn: Paper or other material used to cover a gift or package.
entries.arabicMeaning: ورق أو مادة يُغلَّف بها شيء كهدية أو طرد
entries.example: Keep the wrapping until you have opened the box.

entries.definitionEn: A vehicle, ship, or building that has been badly damaged. Also a person in a very poor physical or emotional state.
entries.arabicMeaning: حطام مركبة أو سفينة أو مبنى أصابه تلف بالغ؛ وقد يُقال لشخص في حال جسدية أو نفسية سيئة جداً
entries.example: Divers found the wreck of an old cargo ship.

entries.definitionEn: To pull or twist something suddenly and violently, or to injure a joint that way. Also to cause sudden emotional pain.
entries.arabicMeaning: يجذب أو يلوي شيئاً بقوة مفاجئة، أو يلتوي مفصلاً كذلك؛ وقد يعني إيلاماً عاطفياً حاداً
entries.example: She wrenched the door open and ran outside.

entries.definitionEn: The joint between the hand and the arm.
entries.arabicMeaning: المفصل بين اليد والذراع؛ المعصم
entries.example: She wore a thin bracelet on her wrist.

entries.definitionEn: A watch worn on a strap around the wrist.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساعة تُلبس بسير حول المعصم
entries.example: He glanced at his wristwatch and stood up.

entries.definitionEn: To make words or letters with a pen, pencil, or keyboard.
entries.arabicMeaning: يكوّن كلمات أو حروفاً بقلم أو بلوحة مفاتيح
entries.example: Please write your name at the top.

entries.definitionEn: A person who writes books, articles, or other texts, especially as a job.
entries.arabicMeaning: شخص يكتب كتباً أو مقالات، وغالباً على سبيل المهنة
entries.example: My uncle is a writer.

entries.definitionEn: Words that have been written; the activity of making texts.
entries.arabicMeaning: الكلمات المكتوبة؛ أو عمل الكتابة نفسه
entries.example: His writing is clear and easy to read.

entries.definitionEn: Expressed in writing rather than spoken.
entries.arabicMeaning: معبَّر عنه كتابةً لا كلاماً
entries.example: Please send a written confirmation of the booking.

entries.definitionEn: Not correct, or not the right one.
entries.arabicMeaning: غير صحيح، أو ليس المناسب
entries.example: That answer is wrong.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is not correct.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو غير صحيح
entries.example: I think I spelled her name wrong.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that is incorrect or unfair.
entries.arabicMeaning: على نحو خاطئ أو غير عادل
entries.example: He was wrongly accused of taking the money.

entries.definitionEn: Showing dry, slightly bitter humour, especially when a situation is disappointing or difficult.
entries.arabicMeaning: ينمّ عن دعابة جافة خفيفة فيها مرارة، وخصوصاً عند الخيبة أو الصعوبة
entries.example: She gave a wry smile when the plan failed.

entries.definitionEn: In a wry way; with dry, slightly bitter humour.
entries.arabicMeaning: بسخرية جافة خفيفة فيها شيء من المرارة
entries.example: He smiled wryly at his own mistake.

entries.definitionEn: A picture of the inside of the body made with a special kind of radiation; also that radiation itself.
entries.arabicMeaning: صورة لداخل الجسم بأشعة خاصة؛ وتُطلق أيضاً على تلك الأشعة
entries.example: The doctor studied the X-ray of her chest.

entries.definitionEn: A large boat used for pleasure or racing, with sails or an engine.
entries.arabicMeaning: قارب كبير للنزهة أو السباق، بشراع أو بمحرّك
entries.example: They spent the weekend on a yacht.

entries.definitionEn: An area of ground next to a house or other building, often with a fence.
entries.arabicMeaning: ساحة أرض بجانب بيت أو مبنى، وغالباً مسيَّجة
entries.example: The children played in the yard.

entries.definitionEn: An act of opening the mouth wide and breathing in deeply, usually because you are tired or bored.
entries.arabicMeaning: فتح الفم واسعاً مع شهيق عميق، من تعب أو ملل
entries.example: He hid a long yawn behind his hand.

entries.definitionEn: To open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored.
entries.arabicMeaning: يفتح فمه واسعاً ويتنفّس بعمق من تعب أو ملل
entries.example: She began to yawn during the long meeting.

entries.definitionEn: An informal way of saying yes.
entries.arabicMeaning: نعم في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: Yeah, I can come on Friday.

entries.definitionEn: A period of twelve months, or the time from January to December.
entries.arabicMeaning: مدّة تبلغ اثني عشر شهراً، أو من يناير إلى ديسمبر
entries.example: She lived in Cairo for a year.

entries.definitionEn: To want something very much, especially something you cannot have easily.
entries.arabicMeaning: يرغب في شيء رغبة شديدة، وخصوصاً ما يصعب نيله
entries.example: After months abroad, he yearned for home.

entries.definitionEn: A loud cry, often of pain, anger, or excitement.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيحة عالية من ألم أو غضب أو حماس
entries.example: We heard a yell from the next room.

entries.definitionEn: To shout loudly, often because you are angry, in pain, or excited.
entries.arabicMeaning: يصرخ بصوت عالٍ، غالباً من غضب أو ألم أو حماس
entries.example: Don't yell at the children.

entries.definitionEn: Having the colour of lemons or of sunlight.
entries.arabicMeaning: بلون الليمون أو ضوء الشمس
entries.example: She wore a yellow scarf.

entries.definitionEn: The colour of lemons or of sunlight.
entries.arabicMeaning: لون الليمون أو ضوء الشمس
entries.example: She painted the door a pale yellow.

entries.definitionEn: Used to agree, to accept an offer, or to say that something is true.
entries.arabicMeaning: تُستخدم للموافقة، أو لقبول عرض، أو لإثبات أن الأمر صحيح
entries.example: Yes, I can help you.

entries.definitionEn: On the day before today.
entries.arabicMeaning: في اليوم الذي قبل اليوم
entries.example: I met her yesterday at the market.

entries.definitionEn: Until now; used especially in questions and after not.
entries.arabicMeaning: حتى الآن؛ تُستخدم وخصوصاً في السؤال ومع النفي
entries.example: Have you finished yet?

entries.definitionEn: Used to join two ideas when the second is surprising after the first; similar to but.
entries.arabicMeaning: تربط فكرتين حين تكون الثانية مفاجئة بعد الأولى؛ بمعنى لكن
entries.example: The room was small, yet it felt warm.

entries.definitionEn: To produce a crop, profit, or result. Also to stop resisting, or to let someone go first.
entries.arabicMeaning: يُنتج محصولاً أو ربحاً أو نتيجة؛ أو يكفّ عن المقاومة ويفسح المجال
entries.example: The experiment yielded clear results.

entries.definitionEn: A set of physical and mental exercises, often used to stay fit and calm.
entries.arabicMeaning: مجموعة تمارين للجسد والذهن، تُمارس غالباً للياقة والهدوء
entries.example: She does yoga every morning.

entries.definitionEn: A thick, slightly sour food made from milk.
entries.arabicMeaning: طعام كثيف حامض قليلاً يُصنع من الحليب؛ زبادي
entries.example: I had yogurt with fruit for breakfast.

entries.definitionEn: Used for the person or people the speaker is talking to.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير يدل على الشخص أو الأشخاص الذين يكلّمهم المتكلم
entries.example: You can sit here.

entries.definitionEn: Having lived for only a short time; not old.
entries.arabicMeaning: صغير السن؛ لم يمضِ عليه عمر طويل
entries.example: They have two young children.

entries.definitionEn: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to the person or people you are talking to.
entries.arabicMeaning: محدد يسبق اسماً ليبين أن الشيء يخصّ المخاطب
entries.example: Is this your bag?

entries.definitionEn: The possessive form of you, used without a following noun to mean something that belongs to the person spoken to.
entries.arabicMeaning: صيغة ملكية من you من غير اسم بعدها، بمعنى ما يخصّ المخاطب
entries.example: This coat is yours.

entries.definitionEn: Used when the person spoken to both does an action and is affected by it. Also used to emphasize you.
entries.arabicMeaning: ضمير منعكس للمخاطب حين يفعل ويتأثر بالفعل، أو لتوكيد you
entries.example: Please help yourself to some bread.

entries.definitionEn: The time of life when a person is young. Also young people as a group.
entries.arabicMeaning: فترة العمر التي يكون فيها المرء شاباً؛ وتُطلق أيضاً على الشبان جماعةً
entries.example: He spent his youth in a small coastal town.

entries.definitionEn: Typical of young people, or looking or seeming younger than your age.
entries.arabicMeaning: من سمات الشباب، أو يبدو أصغر من سنّه
entries.example: She has a youthful face.

entries.definitionEn: Tasting very good; used in informal speech.
entries.arabicMeaning: لذيذ جداً في الكلام غير الرسمي
entries.example: This soup is yummy.

entries.definitionEn: Strange and amusing in an energetic, slightly wild way.
entries.arabicMeaning: غريب مضحك نشيط على نحو أهوج بعض الشيء
entries.example: The play is full of zany jokes.

entries.definitionEn: An African wild animal like a horse, with black and white stripes.
entries.arabicMeaning: حيوان أفريقي شبيه بالحصان، مخطط بالأبيض والأسود
entries.example: We saw a zebra at the wildlife park.

entries.definitionEn: A fastener with two rows of teeth that lock together, used on clothes and bags.
entries.arabicMeaning: أداة إغلاق بصفّين من الأسنان تتشابك، في الثياب والحقائب
entries.example: The zip on my bag is stuck.

entries.definitionEn: An area with a particular purpose or set of rules.
entries.arabicMeaning: منطقة ذات غرض أو قواعد معيّنة
entries.example: This is a no-parking zone.

entries.definitionEn: A place where wild animals are kept for people to see.
entries.arabicMeaning: مكان تُحفظ فيه الحيوانات البرية ليراها الناس
entries.example: We took the children to the zoo.

entries.definitionEn: A scientist who studies animals, including their structure, behaviour, and classification.
entries.arabicMeaning: عالم يدرس الحيوانات بنيةً وسلوكاً وتصنيفاً
entries.example: The zoologist recorded the birds' feeding habits.

entries.definitionEn: The scientific study of animals.
entries.arabicMeaning: الدراسة العلمية للحيوانات
entries.example: She studied zoology at university.

entries.definitionEn: A camera function that makes a subject look closer or farther. Also a sudden rapid movement.
entries.arabicMeaning: خاصية في الكاميرا تقرّب المنظر أو تبعّده؛ وقد تعني اندفاعاً سريعاً مفاجئاً
entries.example: Use the zoom to get a closer picture of the bird.
